translations.translation: 1) Bo zikri Khudo tilovati K'ur'onro og'oz bakhshida, bo iodi ismash az U kumak mekhokh'am. "Bismillokh'i-r-Rakh'moni-r-Rakh'im" shomili se nomi zeboi Khudo ast: (alaikh'is salom) Allokh': "Ma'budi barkh'ak'". In lafzi muborak khususitarin nomkh'oi Kh'ak' taolo buda, g'air az Parvardigor kh'ech' kas bo on nomguzori nameshavad. (B) Rakh'mon: "Sokh'ibi mekh'ri pakh'novar". Parvardigor doroi rakh'mati zoti ast. Ia'ne, rakh'matro az kase ik'tibos namegirad. (V) Rakh'im: "Sokh'ibi rakh'mati kh'ameshagi". Khudo az bandagonash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, mavridi rakh'mat k'aror medikh'ad. Az ch'umla mu'minon ba rakh'mati ilokh'i noil meshavand.

2) Kh'amai nav'i sitoishkh'o va sifatkh'oi ifodagari azamatu kamoli sutudani tankh'o makhsusu loik'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astand. Zero U Parvardigor, Kholik' va Chorasozi tamomi mavch'udot ast. Kalimai "Olamin" dar in oiati karima shakli ch'am'i kalimai "olam" buda, ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kulli mavch'udotro dar bar megirad.
3) Khudoi Sokh'ibi mekh'ri farovon va mekh'ri kh'ameshagi,- In oiat ba'd az sitoishi Parvardigor dar oiati k'abli ifodagari sano bar Ust.

4) Moliki ruzi ch'azo ast. Murod az "Iavmuddin" ruzi ch'azo va kh'isob ast. Dar in oiat azamati Khudo baion shuda ast, ki ruzi k'iiomat iagona U Moliki mutlak' ast. Onch'o kh'ech' kas baroi shakhsi digar moliki chize nest.

5) Mo dar kh'amai nav'i toat va ibodat tankh'o Turo meparastem va makh'z az Tu itoat mekunem, kh'ech' kasro ba Tu sharik namesozem va dar kulli korkh'oi khesh fak'at az Tu madad mech'uem, zero tamomi nekikh'o dar dasti Tust, ch'uz Tu kh'ech' madadrasone nest.

6) Moro ba rokh'i rost rakh'namoi namuda, rokh'ravi on gardon, dar ch'odai durust sobitk'adam nigokh'amon bidor va kh'idoiatamonro afzun bisoz. Mak'sad az "Siroti mustak'im" rokh'i vozekh'u rosti dini Islom ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro baroi tablig'i on firistoda ast.

7) Rokh'i on bandagone az paiombaron, siddik'on, shakh'idon va solekh'on, ki bo kh'idoiat bar onkh'o in'om kardai va in ch'amoa kh'amdamoni nikh'oiat khub kh'astand, na rokh'i shakhsone misli iakh'udikh'o, ki kh'ak'ro shinokhtand, ammo az on pairavi nakardand va ba g'azab giriftor gashtand va na rokh'i kasone misli nasronikh'o, ki az rokh'i kh'ak' gumrokh' shudand, zero onkh'o dar ch'ustani kh'ak' kutokh'i namuda, ba on betavach'ch'ukh'i nishon dodand.

1) "Alif. Lom. Mim." Ba'ze az surakh'oi K'ur'oni mach'id bo kh'amin kh'arfkh'o og'oz iofta ast. Inkh'o az ch'umlai kh'urufi alifbo buda, dar surati alokh'ida ba misli "Alif, Bo, To, So..." istifoda shudan, ma'noi khosero ifoda namekunand, vale vak'te dar Kalomi Khudo ba kor burda shavand, albatta, doroi kh'ikmat va ma'noi baland meboshand. Chunki dar K'ur'on kh'ech' chiz az kh'ikmat kholi nest. Az mukh'imtarin kh'ikmatkh'oi kh'urufi mazkur on ast, ki Parvardigor bo K'ur'oni az kh'amin kh'urufi alifbo tarkibiofta mushrikonro ba muboriza faro khonda, notavonii onkh'oro isbot mesozad. In kh'uruf baroi kofironu mushrikoni zamoni nuzuli K'ur'on, ki da'voi akh'li fasokh'atu balog'at budanro doshtand, oshno bud va onkh'o bo istifoda az on gap mezadand. Az kh'amin sabab, dar aksar mavrid ba'd az ovardani kh'arfkh'oi mazkur K'ur'oni karim zikr meshavad. Dar surai mavridi nazar niz in gufta mavch'ud ast.

2) In K'ur'oni boazamatest, ki dar nozilshavi va lafzu ma'noiash kh'ech' shakku shubkh'ae nest. Zero in Kalomi Parvardigor buda, bandagoni parkh'ezkorro ba sui rokh'i vaslkunanda ba Khudo rakh'namoi mekunad.

3-4) On bandagoni parkh'ezkore, ki ba g'aib imon meorand. Kh'ar on chi Khudovu Rasul -monandi ruzi okhirat- dar borai on ba mo khabar doda, az doirai kh'is berun boshad, g'aib ast. Va parkh'ezkoron bandagone kh'astand, ki namozro bo rioiai farzu voch'ib va sunnatkh'o barpo medorand va onkh'o bandagoneand, ki kholisona bo pardokhti zakot io sadak'akh'oi nofila az ba'zei on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o ruzi doda ast, kharch' menamoiand. Va onkh'o bandagoneand, ki ba vakh'ii bar tu Paiombar furudovardai Khudo va ba on chi bar paiombaroni k'abl az tu nozil karda ast, biduni ch'udosozi imon meorand. Va onkh'o bandagoneand, ki k'iiomat va ch'azoi onro ba surati k'at'i tasdik' menamoiand.

3-4) On bandagoni parkh'ezkore, ki ba g'aib imon meorand. Kh'ar on chi Khudovu Rasul -monandi ruzi okhirat- dar borai on ba mo khabar doda, az doirai kh'is berun boshad, g'aib ast. Va parkh'ezkoron bandagone kh'astand, ki namozro bo rioiai farzu voch'ib va sunnatkh'o barpo medorand va onkh'o bandagoneand, ki kholisona bo pardokhti zakot io sadak'akh'oi nofila az ba'zei on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o ruzi doda ast, kharch' menamoiand. Va onkh'o bandagoneand, ki ba vakh'ii bar tu Paiombar furudovardai Khudo va ba on chi bar paiombaroni k'abl az tu nozil karda ast, biduni ch'udosozi imon meorand. Va onkh'o bandagoneand, ki k'iiomat va ch'azoi onro ba surati k'at'i tasdik' menamoiand.

5) In ch'amoai bo sifatkh'oi mazkur tavsifshuda dar rokh'i kh'idoiati Parvardigorashon ustuvorona k'aror dorand va in gurukh' dar duniovu okhirat bo noilshavi ba matlubi kheshtan va rakh'oi ioftan az on chi baroi onkh'o nomatlub ast, komiobshudagoni vok'ei kh'astand.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi k'abli sifatkh'oi mu'minoni parkh'ezkori doroi zokh'ir va botini pokro zikr namud, dar oiatkh'oi zerin sifatkh'oi iddae az kofironi zokh'ir va botinashon fosidro baion karda meguiad:
6) Kh'amono on shakhsone, ki kh'ukmi ilokh'i oidi imon naovardanashon voch'ib gashta ast, gumrokh'i va iakraviashonro idoma medikh'and. Az in ru, onkh'oro bim dodan va bim nadodanat iakson ast. Onkh'o imon nameorand.

7) Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'albkh'oiashonro bo botile, ki dar on mavch'ud ast, makh'kam karda, bar k'alb va bar gushkh'oiashon mukh'r nikh'oda ast. Binobar in, onkh'o kh'ak'ik'atro amalan nameshunavand va dar barobari on taslim nameshavand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar didagonashon parda k'aror doda ast. Likh'ozo, onkh'o bo vuch'udi ravshan budani kh'ak'ik'at onro namebinand. Va dar okhirat onkh'oro azobi buzurge ast.

Chun Khudovand dar oiatkh'oi zikrshuda sifatkh'oi kofironi doroi zokh'iru botini fosidro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin sifatkh'oi munofik'oni botinan fosid va zokh'iran dar nazari mardum solekh'ro baion namuda meguiad:
8) Va az miioni mardum gurukh'e kh'astand, ki da'voi imondori mekunand. Onkh'o az khavfi khunu molashon dar zokh'ir khudro mu'min nishon medikh'and, kh'ol on ki dar botin imon nadorand.

9) Onkh'o bo oshkor sokhtani imon va pinkh'on kunonidani kufrashon mepindorand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va mu'minonro fireb medikh'and va kh'ol on ki dar kh'ak'ik'at khudro mefireband va inro ekh'sos namekunand. Chunki U oshkoru nikh'onro medonad, mu'minonro az sifotu kh'olati munofik'on ogokh' mesozad.

10) Sabab dar on ast, ki dar dilkh'oi in toifa bemorii shubkh'a mavch'ud buda, pas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shubkh'aashonro afzun gardonida ast. Zero ch'azo az nav'i amal ast. Va baroiashon ba sababi durug' guftan dar kh'ak'k'i Khudovu mardum va takzibi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar poiontarin tabak'ai duzakh azobi dardnok ast.
11) Va chun munofik'on az fasodkori bo kufru ma'siiat va g'airi on dar zamin man' karda shavand, fasodkorii kheshro inkor karda, da'vo menamoiand, ki onkh'o bandagoni solekh' va islokh'kor kh'astand.
12) Ogokh' boshed! In munofik'on fasodkori vok'ei meboshand, vale onkh'o ekh'sos namekunand va pai namebarand, ki a'molashon fasodi kh'ak'ik'i ast.

13) Va chun ba onon amr shavad, ki imon ored monandi sakh'obagoni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), maskharaomez va inkorkunon meguiand: "Oio monandi imoni shakhsoni bekhirad imon biiorem?" Begumon bekhirad va sabukmag'zi kh'ak'ik'i khudi onkh'o kh'astand, ammo inro namedonand.

14) Va chun bo mu'minon rubaru gardand, meguiand: "Ba on chi shumo imon dored, imon ovardaem." Onkh'o in sukhanro az rui tars meguiand. Va chun az nazdashon bargashta, peshi rakh'baroni shaitonsifatashon ravand va bo onkh'o tankh'o bimonand, dar rokh'i pairavii peshvoioni shaitonsifatashon sobitk'adamii kheshro ta'kid karda, meguiand: "Ba durusti ki mo dar rokh'i peshgiriftaaton bo shumoem, valekin kh'amono mo bo mu'minon az rui rishkhand va tamaskhur dar zokh'ir muvofik'at mekunem."

15) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ivazi tamaskhuri akh'li imon onkh'oro mavridi tamaskhur k'aror medikh'ad, chunki ch'azo az ch'insi amal ast. Az in ru, dar dunio bar onkh'o akh'komi musalmononro ch'ori sokhta ast. Ammo dar okhirat baroi nifok' va kufrashon ch'azoiashon medikh'ad. Va inchunin baroiashon mukh'lat medikh'ad, to dar zalolat va tug'ioni kheshtan furu rafta, kh'aironu sargardon bok'i bimonand.

16) Bekhiradon va sabukmag'zoni kh'ak'ik'i kh'amin ch'amoai munofik'oni doroi sifatkh'oi mazkurand, zero onkh'o imonro bo kufr ivaz kardaand. Pas, azbaski imon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az dast dodaand, dar "tich'orati" khud sud nakardaand. Va onkh'o ba sui kh'ak' kh'idoiatiofta nabudand.

17) Khudo dar in oiat baroi munofik'on du nav' masal va dostonero zikr menamoiad, ki iake az otash va digare az ob misol ovarda shuda ast. Ammo masali az otash ovardashuda chunin ast: Dostoni akh'li nifok' ba misli dostoni nafarone ast, ki otashero meafruzand, to az ravshanii on bakh'ra barand. Pas, chun nuri on otash medurakhshad va otashafruzon mepindorand, ki az rushnoiash manfiat khokh'and girift, on otash khomush meshavad va rushnoiash az bain rafta, khususiiati suzondanash bok'i memonad. Dar natich'a, sokh'iboni on otash dar torikikh'o monda, chizero namebinand va rokh'i durustro nameeband.
18) Onkh'o noshunavoiand, kh'ak'ik'atro amalan nameshunavand, loland, kh'ak'ik'atro nameguiand, nobinoiand, kh'ak'ik'atro namebinand. Pas, onkh'o az gumrokh'ii khesh barnamegardand.

19) Ammo masali az ob ovardashuda chunin ast: Dostoni munofik'on misli dostoni boroni shadidi az abrkh'o furudomada ast. Dar on abrkh'o torikikh'oi anbukh'shuda va ra'du bark' ast. Boron ba mardum nozil shuda, onkh'oro bimi sakht faro girifta, ba sababi shiddati sadoi otashakkh'o az rui tarsi favtidan bo atrofi angushtoni khesh ba pushidani gushkh'oiashon shuru' mekunand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ikh'otakunandai kofiron meboshad. Chize Uro notavon gardonida nametavonad.

20) K'arib ast, ki on bark' az shiddati rushnoi va durakhshoni didakh'oiashonro az bain bibarad. Kh'ar gokh' bark' baroiashon rushnoi andozad, k'adam mezanand va chun rushnoi naandozad, dar toriki bok'i memonand va kh'arakat karda nametavonand. Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ad, bo k'udrati farogiri khesh shunavoi va didagonashonro az bain mebarad va ba sababi az kh'ak' rui toftan shunavoi va binoiashon barnamegardad. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ama chiz Tavono ast.

Boron dostoni K'ur'on, sadoi otashakkh'o dostoni bongkh'oi bimnoki K'ur'on, rushnoii bark' dostoni gokh'o oshkorshavii kh'ak'ik'at baroi akh'li nifok', az shiddati otashakkh'o pushidani gushkh'o dostoni rui toftani munofik'on az kh'ak'ik'at va shabokh'at miioni munofik'on va sokh'iboni du dostoni mazkur istifoda naburdand ast. Shakhsi otashafrukhta dar dostoni az otash zikrshuda, az kori kardaash ch'uz toriki va suzonidan foidae namebarad. Sokh'iboni boron dar dostoni az boron zikrgashta g'airi ra'du bark', ki onkh'oro ba takh'luka andokhta, nooromashon mesozad, foidae namegirand. Munofik'on niz dar Islom g'airi shiddatu sakhti chizero namebinand va az rakh'namoikh'oi K'ur'on sude namebarand. Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati guzashta nav'kh'oi mardum az mu'minon va kofironu munofik'onro zikr kard, dar oiati zerin kh'amai onkh'oro ba ibodati Khud faro khonda mefarmoiad:
21) Ei mardum, tankh'o Parvardigori kheshro biparasted. Zero U On Zotest, ki shumo va ummatkh'oi pesh az shumoro khalk' karda ast. Ch'uz U kasero naparasted, to bo ich'roi amrkh'o va duri ch'ustan az kh'aromkh'o az uk'ubati ilokh'i parkh'ez namoed.

22) On Zote, ki zaminro baroi shumo chun farshi gusturda va osmonro az boloi on doroi binoi ustuvor gardonid va U bo furud ovardani boron dar kh'ak'k'i makhluk'ot in'om namuda, ba vositai on az zamin mevakh'oi gunogunrangro ruionid, to baroiaton ruzi gardad. Pas, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) anbozkh'o va sharik k'aror nadikh'ed va kh'ol on ki medoned ch'uz U ofaridgore nest.

23) Va ei mardum, agar oidi K'ur'oni bar bandaamon Mukh'ammad nozilkardai Mo shubkh'a dored, pas, Mo shumoro ba muboriza da'vat mekunem, ki bo ovardani iak surai shabekh'i K'ur'on agarchi kutokh' ast, dar barobari on muk'obiliiat nishon dikh'ed va kh'ar kiro az iovaronaton metavoned, ba ioriaton faro khoned. Agar dar da'voi khesh, ki guio Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) in Kitobro az peshi khud ovarda ast, sodik' kh'asted, pas in guftai Moro ich'ro kuned.

24) Va agar az ukh'dai in kor namebaroed - va kh'argiz onro ich'ro karda nametavoned - pas parkh'ez namoed az otashe, ki kh'ezumi on mardumi loik'i azob, -sangkh'o- butkh'oi mushrikon va g'aira meboshad, Khudo in otashro baroi kofiron omoda namuda ast.

25) Va chun takh'didi guzashta ba kofiron taalluk' dorad, pas, ei Paiombar, bandagoni boimoni anch'omdikh'andai amalkh'oi shoistaro ba bustonkh'oe bashorat bidekh', ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtkh'oi on rudkh'o ravon ast. Kh'ar bor ba onkh'o az mevakh'oi lazizi on bustonkh'o ruzi doda shavad, az sababi shabokh'ati ziiodi mevakh'oiash ba mevakh'oi dunio meguiand: "In monandi mevakh'oest, ki k'abl az in ba mo ruzi doda shuda bud." Va baroi onkh'o mevakh'oi dar shaklu nom monandi iakdigar peshkash shavad, to ba e'tibori in ki on mevakh'oro meshinosand, ba iste'molash ik'dom namoiand, valekin on mevakh'o dar ta'm az iakdigar fark' dorand. Va dar ch'annat baroi akh'li on kh'amsaronest, ki az aibu nuk'sonkh'oi dar kh'ak'k'i zanoni dunio tasavvurshavanda, ki tabiati bashari az on nafrat doshta, onro palid meshumorad, pok meboshand. Va onkh'o dar ch'annat dar ne'mati doimii k'at'noshavanda k'aror megirand. Bar aksi ne'mati dunio, ki zavolpazir buda, abadi nest.

26) Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kh'ar chi khokh'ad, masal mezanad va az on sharm namekunad. Ba durusti ki U bo pashsha va bo on chi dar kh'ach'm az pashsha kalontar io khurdtar ast, masal meorad. Mardum dar barobari on masal ba gurukh'i mu'minon va kofiron ch'udo meshavand. Pas, ammo mu'minon, tasdik' mekunand va medonand, ki baioni in masal kh'ikmati baland dorad. Va ammo kofiron az rui tamaskhur sababi onro, ki baroi chi Khudo bo in mavch'udoti khurd ba misli pashsha, magas, tortanak va g'aira masal meorad, mepursand. Khudo ba onkh'o posukh medikh'ad, ki in masalkh'o shomili kh'idoiat, rakh'namoi va ozmoishi mardum meboshand. Pas, Khudo ba'zei mardumro bo in masalkh'o ba sababi rui gardonidan az andeshidan oidi on gumrokh' mesozad va te'dodi in toifa ziiod ast va ba'zei digarashonro ba sababi az on pand giriftan kh'idoiat menamoiad va adadi gurukh'i duium niz ziiod ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tankh'o kasonero gumrokh' mesozad, ki arzandai on kh'astand. On kasone loik'i gumrokh'i meboshand, ki monandi munofik'on az doirai itoati Khudo berun shudaand,-

27) on kasone, ki akh'di Khudoro dar borai ibodati U va pairavi az Paiombari okhirzamon, ki paiombaroni guzashta az omadanash khabar dodaand, meshikanand va on chizero, az k'abili paivandi kheshovandi, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba paivastani on dastur doda ast, k'at' mekunand va bo sodir namudani ma'siiat baroi nashri fasod dar zamin talosh menamoiand. Iak'inan in gurukh' bandagon dar duniovu okhirat bebakh'ra va ziionkorand.

28) Ei kofiron, vok'ean kh'olati shumo kh'airatovar ast! Chiguna ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir meshaved, dar kh'ole ki dalolatkh'oi k'udrati Uro dar vuch'udi khesh mebined?! K'ablan dar olami nesti k'aror doshted, pas, shumoro kh'ast namuda, kh'aiot bakhshid, sipas, shumoro dubora memironad, ba'dan az nav zinda megardonad, sipas, shumoro ba sui khesh barmegardonad, to az korkh'oiaton pursida shaved.

29) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iagona Zote ast, ki tamomi dariokh'o, darakhton va digar nav'i ne'matkh'oi zaminro baroi shumo ofarid. Shumo az on ne'matkh'o manfiat mebared va az on chi baroiaton musakhkhar gashta ast, bakh'ramand megarded. Sipas ba ofaridani osmon k'asd namud va onro kh'aft tabak'ai barobar ofarid va U kh'amai chizro medonad.

Parvardigor ba farishtagon guft, ki dar zamin basharro ch'onishine khokh'am guzosht, pas farishtagon pursidand kh'ikmat az guzoshtani farzandi Odam ch'onishin dar zamin va onkh'o tabakh'kori va khunrezi mekunand, dar kh'ole ki mo Turo bo sipos ba poki mesitoem va tak'dis mekunem? Allokh' taolo guft: Man dar borai kh'adafu maslikh'ati ofarinishi u chizkh'oe medonam, ki shumo namedoned

31) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba khotiri baioni mak'omi Odam (alaikh'is salom) nomkh'o, lafzkh'o va ma'nokh'oi tamomi chiz, az k'abili kh'aivonot va mavch'udoti bech'onro ba u ta'lim dod. Sipas on ashioro ba farishtagon peshkash namuda guft: "Agar shumo dar da'voi on ki guio az in makhluk'i navpaido izzat va fazilati beshtar dored, rostgu boshed, pas, ba Man nomkh'oi in ashioro khabar dikh'ed."

32) Farishtagon ba kutokh'ii khesh e'tirof karda, fazilatro ba Parvardigor nisbat dodand va guftand: "Parvardigoro, mo ba kh'ukm va k'onunat e'tiroz nadorem va Turo ba azamat va poki iod mekunem. Mo g'air az on chize, ki Tu donishashro baroiamon ruzi namudai, kh'ech' chizro namedonem. Beguftugu, Tu Donandai Kh'akim meboshi, chize az Tu makhfi namemonad, kh'ar kh'ukm va k'onunatro dar ch'oi munosibi on meguzori."

33) In kh'angom Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Odam (alaikh'is salom) farmud: "Farishtagonro az nomkh'oi on chizkh'o bokhabar soz." Pas, chun Odam (alaikh'is salom) tik'bi ta'limoti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nomkh'oi kh'amai ashioro ba farishtagon khabar dod, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba farishtagon guft: "Oio ba shumo naguftam, ki Man begumon on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin pushida ast, onro medonam va on chiro az kh'olatkh'oi khesh oshkor va on chiro dar zamiraton pinkh'on mesozed, medonam."

34) Khudovand dar in oiat meguiad: "Va iod kun zamonero, ki Mo ba farishtagon dastur doda guftem: "Dar nazdi Odam (alaikh'is salom) sach'dai ekh'tirom va arch'guzori kuned." Pas, farishtagon kh'amagi ba ich'roi amri Khudo shitoftand va sach'da namudand, magar Iblis, ki az ch'umlai ch'inkh'o buda, kh'amchun e'tiroz ba amri Khudo va bo kibru g'urur az sach'da kardan sarpechi namud va bo in kori khesh az toifai kofiron gardid.

35) Va Mo guftem: "Ei Odam, kh'amrokh'i kh'amsarat Kh'avvo dar ch'annat sukunat namo va dar kh'ar ch'oi on khokh'ed, ba tavri farovonu guvoro bikhured, inch'o kh'ech' chiz aishi shumoro talkh namegardonad va az nazdik shudan ba in darakhte, ki az iste'moli on man' shudaed, duri bich'ued, zero dar surati ich'ro nakardani amri Khudo az ch'umlai zolimon megarded."

36) Pas, Shaiton kh'amesha Odamu kh'amsarash Kh'avvoro vasvasa mekard va ma'siiatro baroiashon oroish medod. Bilokhira onkh'oro ba sababi iste'mol az darakhti mamnu' giriftori lag'zhish va khato gardonid. Pas, Khudo kh'amchun much'ozot Odamu Kh'avvoro az ch'annate, ki dar on k'aror doshtand, berun sokht va Khudovand ba onkh'o va Shaiton guft: "Az ch'annat ba sui zamin, dar kh'ole ki ba'zei shumo bo ba'zei digar dushman kh'asted, furud oed va shumoro dar zamin to zamoni poion ioftani mukh'lati zindagi va barposhavii k'iiomat kh'ak'k'i sukunat, bak'o va bakh'ra burdan az ne'matkh'oi on ast."

37) Pas, Odam (alaikh'is salom) kalimotero, ki Khudo ba suiash andokhta, baroiash ilkh'om namuda bud, to bo istifoda az on duo kunad, faro girift va tibk'i on amal namud. On kalimoti dar oiati bistu seiumi surai "A'rof" omada chunin ast: "Odam va kh'amsarash Kh'avvo guftand: "Parvardigoro, mo bar ch'oni kheshtan sitam namudem va agar Tu gunokh'oni moro naomurzi va mavridi rakh'mati Khud k'aroramon nadikh'i, begumon az ch'umlai ziionkoron megardem." Ba'd az guftani in kalimot Parvardigor tavbai uro paziruft va az lag'zhishash darguzasht. Zero iak'inan U dar kh'ak'k'i bandagonash bisior Tavbapaziru bag'oiat Mekh'rubon ast.

38) Mo ba onkh'o guftem: "Kh'amagi az ch'annat ba zamin furud oed. Ba'd az in agar baroiaton tavassuti paiombaronamon rakh'namoi oiad, pas, kh'ar ki az on pairavi namuda, ba firistodagoni Man imon orad, pas, onkh'oro dar okhirat tarse nest va onkh'o baroi on chi dar dunio az dast dodaand, andukh'gin nameshavand.
39) Va ammo kasone, ki kofir shudaand va oiatkh'oi Moro takzib kardaand, in gurukh' kh'amdamoni otashi duzakh kh'astand. Onkh'o dar on ch'o abadi bok'i memonand."

40) Ei farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi! Ne'matkh'oi pai dar paiamro, ki ba shumo in'om kardaam, ba khotir ovarda, shukri onro ba ch'o biiored va bar akh'di bo Man bastaaton az imon ovardan ba Manu paiombaronam va amal bo shariat vafo kuned. Agar shumo bar akh'di khesh vafo kuned, Man niz bar akh'di ba shumo dodaam, ki dar dunio zindagonii bosaodat va dar okhirat podoshi nek nasibaton megardad, vafo menamoiam. Va tankh'o az Man bikh'arosed va akh'datonro nashikaned.

41) Va ba K'ur'one, ki ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozil kardaam, dar kh'ole ki ba farmudakh'oi Tavroti takh'rifnogashta oidi tavkh'id va nubuvvati Paiombari okhirzamon muvofik' ast, imon ored va az on ki nakhustin gurukh'i ba K'ur'on kofirshuda boshed, biparkh'ezed va oiatkh'oi Maro dar ivazi mablag'i andak az ch'okh'u mansab ivaz nakuned va az g'azabu uk'ubatam bitarsed.

42) Va kh'ak'ik'atero, ki ba paiombaronam furud ovardaam bo durug'kh'oi boftaaton omekhta nasozed va kh'ak'ik'ati Kitobkh'oiatonro dar borai sifatkh'oi Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) pinkh'on nakuned va kh'ol on ki shumo kh'ak' budani uro medoned.

43) Va namozro bo farzkh'o, voch'ibkh'o va sunnatkh'oiash ba surati komil ado namoed va zakoti molkh'oi dodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bipardozed va dar barobari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ruku'kunandagoni ummati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ruku' namoed. [Murod az ruku' adoi namoz ast].

44) Chi k'adar zisht ast, ki shumo digaronro ba imon va amali nek amr mekuned va khudro faromush karda, az ich'roi on rui megardoned, kh'ol on ki shumo Tavrot mekhoned va dar bobati pairavi az dini Kh'ak' taolo va tasdik'i paiombaronash amri Uro medoned. Pas, oio az ak'lkh'oi khud istifoda namebared?!

45) Va dar tamomi kh'olatkh'oi dini va duniavii khesh az sabr va namoz, ki shumoro ba Khudo nazdik mesozad, madad bich'ued. Khudovand ba shumo kumak merasonad, kh'ifzaton mekunad va zarari baroiaton rasidaro bartaraf menamoiad. Va kh'amono namoz amali mashak'k'atovar va garon ast, magar baroi bandagoni dar muk'obili Parvardigorashon furutan.
46) Zero bandagoni furutan iak'in dorand, ki onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigorashon rafta, bo U mulok'ot mekunand va saranch'om ba sui U barmegardand, to ch'azoi a'molashonro ba dast orand.

47) Ei farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi! Ne'mati dini va duniavii baroi shumo in'omnamudaamro ba iod ored va niz ba iod ored, ki Man shumoro ba vositai nubuvvat va saltanat bar akh'li zamonaton bartari dodam.

48) Va khudro bo anch'omi dasturoti ilokh'i az uk'ubati ruzi k'iiomat nigokh' dored. K'iiomat ruzest, ki dar on kase chizero az kasi digar dur karda nametavonad va dar on ruz shafoati kh'ech' kas bo bartaraf sokhtani zarar io ch'alb sokhtani foida, ba ch'uz bo rukhsati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pazirufta nameshavad va az kase bakh'oi ozodi agarchi on ba andozai tamomi tiloi rui zamin kh'am boshad, k'abul namegardad va onkh'o dar on ruz iovarone nadorand. Vak'te ruzi rastokhez shafoat foida nabakhshad, bakh'oi ozodi pazirufta nashavad va iovare naboshad, pas az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kuch'o ch'oi gurez ast?!

49) Va ei farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi! On zamonero iod kuned, ki Mo shumoro az sitami pairavoni Fir'avn nach'ot dodem, onkh'o ba shumo azobkh'oi gunogunro mechashonidand, pisaronatonro zabkh' mekardand, to az shumo nasl bok'i namonad va dukhtaronatonro zinda meguzoshtand, to dar oianda baroiashon khidmatgor shavand. Onkh'o in a'moli badro ba mak'sadi ikh'onat va khoru zor gardonidani shumo anch'om medodand. Va dar nach'ot dodani shumo az zeri sitami Fir'avn va pairavonash az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton ozmoishi buzurge bud, to dar badali kh'amai in lutfu ekh'sonkh'o shukri Uro ba ch'o ored.

50) Va ba'ze az ne'matkh'oi digaramonro ba iod ored, ki Mo baroi shumo darioro shikoftem va onro rokh'i khushkigardi k'obili kh'arakat gardonidem, pas, shumoro nach'ot dodem va dushmanaton Fir'avnro bo pairavonash dar peshi chashmaton, dar kh'ole ki ba onkh'o nigokh' mekarded, dar dario g'ark' sokhtem.

51) Va inchunin ba iod ored ne'mati va'da dodai Moro ba Muso, ki chil shabu ruz ba munoch'ot mepardozad. Mak'sad az va'da dodan ba Muso munoch'oti chil shabonaruz bud, ki dar in muddat furud ovardani Tavroti ravshangaru rakh'namo ba itmom birasad. Sipas, shumo ba'd az raftani Muso, gusolaparasti karded, dar kh'ole ki shumo bo in amali badaton zolim buded.
52) Sipas, ba'di tavba az gunokh'aton darguzashtem va shumoro dar kh'ol much'ozot nakardem, to bo toatu ibodat shukri Moro ba ch'o ored.

53) Va inchunin on ne'matero iod kuned, ki Mo ba Muso Tavroti ch'udosozandai kh'ak'ik'at az botil va kh'idoiat az gumrokh'iro ato namudem, shoiad shumo bo istifoda az on ba sui kh'ak'ik'at rokh' meiobed.

54) Va az ch'umla ba iod ored, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro baroi tavba az amali gusolaparasti komiob gardonid. On gokh', ki Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba shumo guft: "Ei k'avmi man, kh'amono shumo bo ma'bud k'aror dodani gusola dar kh'ak'k'i khesh sitam kardaed. Pas, ba sui Ofaridgor va Paidosozandai khesh tavba namoed va tavbai shumo ba in tartib boshad, ki ba'zeaton ba'zei digarro bikushad. In shevai tavba baroi shumo az furu raftan dar kufre, ki boisi dar duzakh abadi mondanaton megardad, bekh'tar ast." Shumo bo tavfik' va madadi Parvardigor in korro karded. Ba'd az in Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbai shumoro paziruft. Zero U dar kh'ak'k'i bandagonash begumon bag'oiat Tavbapaziri Mekh'rubon ast.

55) Va on zamonero iod kuned, ki padaronaton az khud ch'asorat nishon dodand va ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) guftand: "Kh'argiz ba Tu imon nameorem, to vak'te ki Khudoro oshkor mushokh'ida kunem." Pas, shumoro otashi suzanda faro girifta, kh'alok gardonid va kh'ol on ki ba'zeaton ba ba'zei digar nigokh' mekarded.
56) Sipas, Mo shumoro ba'd az margaton zinda sokhtem, to shukri ekh'sonkh'oi Moro ba ch'o ored.

57) Va az ch'umlai ne'matkh'oi Mo bar shumo on ast, ki vak'te dar zamin sargardon shuded, abrkh'oro firistodem, to shumoro az kh'arorati khurshed soiaboni kunad va bar shumo az ne'matkh'oi khesh nushobai monandi asal shirin va parrandai khurdi monandi bedona khushta'm furud ovardem va guftem: "Az ne'matkh'oi poke, ki baroiaton ruzi namudaem, bikhured." Va onkh'o bo inkor va nosiposii in ne'matkh'o az Mo chizero kam nakardaand, valekin bo nok'is namudani kh'issaashon az savob va dar ma'razi uk'ubat k'aror dodani khud bar ch'oni khesh sitam mekardand.

58) Va az ch'umlai ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i zamonero ba iod ored, ki Mo ba shumo guftem: "Voridi Bait-ul-mak'dis shaved va az kh'ar ch'o khokh'ed, az ruzikh'oi poki on farovonu guvoro bikhured va kh'angomi voridshavi dar kh'olati ruku' va izkh'ori furutani ba Khudo boshed va az Kh'ak' taolo darkhost namoed, ki "Khudovando, gunokh'oni moro makh'v bisoz", Mo darkhostatonro mepazirem va ach'ri nekukoronro afzun megardonem."

59) Pas, zolimoni onkh'o amalu k'avli guftaamonro ivaz namudand. Ba sarzamini Bait-ul-mak'dis bar mak''adkh'oiashon khazida-khazida vorid shudand va ba ch'oi darkhosti mag'firati gunokh' bo tamaskhur ba farmoni Parvardigor "Donai khushai ch'av" guftand. Pas, Mo baroi much'ozoti in ch'amoai sitamkor ba sababi az doirai shar' berun shudan va khilofi farmon amal kardanashon az osmon azob furud ovardem.

60) Va az ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i on kh'olatero ba iod ored, ki shumo dar vodii sargardoni k'aror doshted va duchori tashnagii shadid gardida buded, pas, Muso ba sui Parvardigorash rui ovarda, bo iltich'o talab kard, to Khudo shumoro serob gardonad. Ba'd az in Mo ba vai amr namudem, ki bo asoi dastash sangro bizanad. Pas, chun Muso sangro zad, ba adadi k'abilakh'oi shumo az on sang duvozdakh' chashma favvora zada ob berun shud. Mo baroi nushidani kh'ar k'abila makoni makhsusashro baion sokhtem, to dar miionaton nizo' paido nashavad va ba shumo guftem: "Az ruzii Parvardigor, ki onro biduni ranch' kashidanaton ba shumo omoda sokhta ast, bikhured va binushed va dar zamin ba fasodkori talosh navarzed."

61) Va zamonero ba iod ored, ki nisbati ne'mati Parvardigoraton nosiposi namuda, az iste'moli nushobai ba monandi asal shirin va parrandai khurdi misli bedona bolazzat malol shuda gufted: "Kh'argiz ba iak nav'i taom sabr namekunem." Pas, az Muso (alaikh'is salom) talab karded, to az Parvardigorash bikhokh'ad, ki baroiaton az rastanikh'oi zamin az tarakh'ovu sabzavotash va bodiringash va gandumash va naskash va piiozash berun sozad. Muso (alaikh'is salom) in darkhosti shumoro inkor kard va guft: "Oio nushobai monandi asal shirin va parrandai khurdi monandi bedona khushmazzai bekh'tarro bo chizi pasttari kamarzishtar ivaz mekuned, dar kh'ole ki in ne'matkh'o biduni ranch' baroiaton meoiad?! Az in ch'o ba kh'ar dekh'ai digare furud oed, pas, dar ziroatgokh'kh'o va bozorkh'oi on kh'ar chiro talab karded, meiobed." Va vak'te Farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi az khostakh'oi nafsi khud pairavi karda, az on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon ikhtiior namuda bud, doimo rui gardonidand, khorivu rasvoi va tangdastivu badbakhti domangirashon gardid va bo g'azabi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargashtand. In zillatu rasvoi va khashmi ilokh'i ba sababi on bud, ki onkh'o oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro inkor mekardand va paiombaronro zolimona mekushtand. Illati kh'amai in on ast, ki onkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ision varzida va paivasta marzkh'oi muk'arrar sokhtai ilokh'iro poimol menamudand.

62) Kh'amono mu'minoni in ummat va inchunin mu'minoni ummatkh'oi pesh az bi'sati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) guzashta az iakh'udu nasoro va sabaikh'o (toifae az pairavoni ba'ze paiombaroni sobik'), on kasone, ki dar onkh'o imon ba Khudo va ruzi okhirat takh'ak'k'uk' iofta ast va amali shoista anch'om dodaand, pas, podoshi in gurukh' nazdi Parvardigorashon ast va bar onkh'o az on chi ruzi k'iiomat rukh medikh'ad, tarse nest va onkh'o baroi on chi dar dunio az dast dodaand, g'amgin nameshavand.

63) Va on paimoni mustakh'kamero, ki dar borai imon ba Khudo va paiombaronash az shumo giriftem, iod kuned va kukh'ro ba khotiri az paimonshikani tarsonidan boloi saraton bardoshta, shumoro amr namudem, ki Tavroti baroiaton nozilkardai Moro bo ch'iddiiatu talosh va biduni sustivu tanbali bigired va on chi dar in Kitob mavch'ud ast, onro az khud kuned va dar boraash biandeshed, shoiad shumo bo ich'roi in amal az azobi Parvardigor dar amon bimoned.

64) Sipas shumo ba'd az in paimoni ustuvori giriftai Mo rui gardonided va nofarmoni karded. Pas, agar fazli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba shumo bo darguzashtan az gunokh'onaton va rakh'mati U bo paziruftani tavbaaton namebud, kh'atman ba sababi nofarmoni va rui gardonidan az ch'umlai ziionkoron megashted.

65) Va shumo iak'inan khabari guzashtagonatonro, ki marzkh'oi Khudoro zeri po namudand, donisted. Onkh'o bo shikor kardan dar ruzi shanbe, ki on ruz in amal baroiashon kh'arom bud, az marzi Khudo guzashta, bo vuch'udi mamnu' budani on iak ruz k'abl az shanbe shastkh'oro nasb sokhtand va ruzi iakshanbe mokh'i giriftand. Ba kh'amin sabab, Mo ba in kh'ilagaron kh'amchun ch'azoi amalashon gufem: "Ba buzinakh'oi zalili rondagashta tabdil shaved."

66) Pas, Mo akh'li in dekh'ai tach'ovuzkorro baroi dekh'akh'oi kh'amch'ivori on va baroi kasone, ki ba'd az onkh'o meoiand, moiai ibrat k'aror dodem, to monandi onkh'o amal nakunand, zero dar surati takrori kirdori eshon duchori azob meshavand. Va inchunin akh'li in dekh'ai marzshikanro baroi parkh'ezkorone, ki az azobi Parvardigor va intik'omgirii U az bandagoni marzshikan metarsand, moiai pand gardonidem.

67) Va az khabari guzashtagonaton kh'odisai miioni onkh'o va Muso (alaikh'is salom) rukhdodaro ba iod ored. On gokh', ki Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba ach'dodi shumo khabar dod, ki Khudo onkh'oro ba zabkh'i gove amr karda ast. Ammo onkh'o ba ch'oi on ki zudtar farmoni ilokh'iro ba ch'o orand, bo iakravi guftand: "Oio moro maskhara mekuni?" Muso (alaikh'is salom) dar posukh guft: "Az on ki az ch'umlai bandagone bosham, ki dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo durug' meguiand va mardumro maskhara mekunand, ba Khudo panokh' mebaram."

68) Onkh'o ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) guftand: "Ba khotiri mo [1] az Parvardigorat bikhokh', to baroiamon sifati govero, ki moro ba zabkh'i on amr karda ast, baion kunad." Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Khudo meguiad: "Kh'amono on gov na solkhurda ast va na navrasida, balki dar kh'addi miiona ast. Pas, ba ich'roi amri Parvardigoraton bishitobed."

69) Pas iakravi va ch'idoli kheshro idoma doda, ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) guftand: "Ba khotiri mo az Parvardigorat bikhokh', to baroiamon rangi onro baion sozad." Muso (alaikh'is salom) dar posukhi onkh'o guft: "Kh'amono Khudo meguiad: "Iak'inan rangi gov sakht zardi khushrang ast. Kh'ar binandaro ba kh'airat meorad."

70) Sipas, Farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi ba iakravii khesh idoma doda guftand: "Ba khotiri mo az Parvardigorat bikhokh', to baroiamon ba'ze az sifatkh'oi digari on govro baion sozad. Zero bo sifatkh'oi guftaat gov ziiod buda, baroiamon omekhta gashta va mo onro ch'udo karda nametavonem. Va mo bo ta'kid meguem, ki agar Khudo khokh'ad, ba paido namudani govi mavridi nazar rokh' meiobem."

71) Muso (alaikh'is salom) dar ch'avob guft: "Kh'amono Khudo meguiad: "Iak'inan iake az sifatkh'oi digari gov in ast, ki on baroi amal dar kishtu kor va obiorii zamini ziroat rom nest, az kh'amai aibkh'o solim ast, dar on ba ch'uz rangi zard kh'ech' range vuch'ud nadorad." Farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi ba'di shunidani in sifatkh'o guftand: "Inak vasfi dak'ik'ero, ki on govro ba purragi mushakhkhas mesozad, baion namudi." Pas, on govro ba'd az on ki k'arib bo iakravi va bakh'si bemavrid az zabkh'ash khuddori menamudand, zabkh' kardand.

72) Va zamoni rukhdodero iod kuned, ki az miioni khud iakero kushted, pas bo iakdigar ikhtilof namuded va kh'ar kas khudro donista, on ch'inoiati kushtorro bar ukh'dai digaron kh'avola mesokht. Va Khudo kh'odisai k'atli shakhsi begunokh'ro, ki onro pinkh'on mekarded, oshkor kunonid.

73) Pas, Mo ba shumo guftem: "Bo iak k'it'ai gove, ki ba zabkh'i on amr shudaed, shakhsi kushtashudaro bizaned." Zero Khudo begumon uro zinda mesozad va u dar borai k'otilash khabar medikh'ad. Onkh'o in korro anch'om dodand va mak'tul zinda shuda, k'otilashro oshkor kard. Khudo ruzi k'iiomat monandi zinda gardonidani in maiit murdagonro zinda megardonad va baroiaton dalelkh'oi ravshani nishondikh'andai k'udrati Kheshro nishon medikh'ad, shoiad on dalelkh'oro bifakh'med va ba U imoni vok'ei ored.

74) Sipas k'albi shumo ba'd az in nasikh'atkh'oi ta'sirbakhsh va mu'ch'izakh'oi oshkor dar sakhti monandi sang, balki az sang niz sakhttar gardid. K'albi shumo az in kh'olat kh'ech' gokh' tag'iir nameiobad, vale sangkh'o tag'iir meioband. Pas, begumon az ba'ze sangkh'o dariokh'o favvora mezanad va ba'zei sangkh'o pora-pora meshavad va az on chashmakh'oi ch'ori berun meoiad, mardum va chakh'orpoion az obi on sud mebarand va ba'zei sangkh'o az tarsi Khudo az boloi kukh'kh'oi baland meaftad. Va Khudo az on korkh'oe, ki anch'om medikh'ed, g'ofil nest, balki onro medonad va kh'atman shumoro baroi kardakh'oiaton podosh khokh'ad dod.

75) Ei mu'minon! Ba'd az on ki bo kh'ak'ik'ati kh'olati iakh'udikh'o va iakraviashon oshno gashted, oio umed dored, ki onkh'o imon meorand va da'vatatonro mepazirand?! Va kh'ol on ki gurukh'e az donishmandonashon kalomi Khudoro dar Tavrot meshunidand, sipas ba'di fakh'm va shinokht lafzu ma'noi onro tag'iir medodand, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o buzurgii in gunokh'ashonro medonistand.

76) Az ch'umlai korkh'oi ziddu nak'iz va dasisai iakh'udikh'o on ast, ki vak'te ba'zei onkh'o bo mu'minon rubaru shavand, dar nazdi akh'li imon rostk'avlii Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va durustii risolatashro ik'ror mekunand. Tavrot niz bar durustii risolatash shakh'odat medikh'ad. Valekin chun ba'zei iakh'udikh'o bo ba'zei digar khilvat kunand, dar baini khud iakdigarro ba sababi in e'tirofkh'o sarzanish namuda meguiand: "Oio on chiro Khudo dar Tavrot oidi vasfi Mukh'ammad baroiaton baion sokhta ast, ba musalmonon khabar medikh'ed, to onkh'o az e'tirofaton istifoda namuda, dar ruzi okhirat nazdi Parvardigoraton bar muk'obilaton kh'uch'ch'at orand va makh'kumaton kunand?! Oio ak'latonro ba kor namedarored?!"

77) In ch'amoai iakh'ud dar in rokh'i bad gom mebardorand va guio onkh'o g'ofiland, ki Khudo guftoru kirdorero, ki pinkh'on va oshkor mesozand, medonad va ok'ibat bo oshkor kardani on sharmandaashon megardonad.

78) Va az iakh'udikh'o gurukh'e kh'astand, ki az Tavrot tankh'o tilovatashro medonand va az dalolati on ogokh' nestand va ch'uz durug'kh'oi az peshvoioni khesh giriftaashon chize nadorand va onkh'o kh'amin durug'kh'oro az Tavrot mekh'isoband.

79) Pas, kh'alokat va azobi shadid muntaziri in gurukh'est, ki bo dasti khud kitob menavisand, sipas bo durug' "In navishta az nazdi Khudost" meguiand, to kh'ak'ik'at va pairavii rokh'i rostro bo mablag'i andaki dunio, ki az molu mansab iborat ast, ivaz namoiand. Pas, onkh'oro ba khotiri bo dastonashon dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo durug' navishtan kh'alokat va azobi sakht ast va onkh'oro ba khotiri az rui in navishtakh'oi durug' kasb kardani molu mansab kh'alokat va azobi azim ast.

80) Va bo durug'u g'urur guftand: "Kh'argiz otashi ch'akh'annam ch'uz ruzkh'oi boshumor ba mo namerasad va kh'amagi chand ruz ba on vorid meshavem." Ei Paiombar, ba in toifai mag'ruri durug'gu bigu: "Oio shumo baroi in da'voi khesh az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va'dai ustuvor giriftaed?! Agar az Parvardigor va'da girifta boshed, U kh'ech' gokh' ba va'dai dodaash khilof namekunad. Io shumo bo durug' va tukh'mat dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizkh'oero, ki namedoned, megued?!"

81) Kh'ak'ik'at on tavre nest, ki in gurukh' mepindorand. Bale, kh'ar ki amali badi kufrro anch'om dikh'ad va gunokh'onash uro az kh'ar ch'onib ikh'ota kunand, kh'atman in firk'a kh'amdamoni duzakhand, onkh'o dar onch'o abadi memonand.
82) Va kasone, ki ba Allokh'u Rasul imon meorand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om medikh'and, podoshi inkh'o vorid shudan ba ch'annat va kh'amdamii on ast. Onkh'o dar ch'annat ch'ovidon memonand.

83) Va ei Farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi! On akh'di ustuvorero, ki Mo az shumo giriftaem, ba iod ored. Paimoni az shumo giriftaamon chunin bud, ki Khudoro ba iagonagi ibodat karda, kasero ba U sharik nasozed va ba padaru modar va kheshovandon va iatimon va miskinoni mukh'toch' neki namoed va ba mardum sukhani nek gued, onkh'oro bo zaboni shirin amri ma'ruf va nakh'ii munkar kuned va namozro chunonchi farmon shudaed, ba surati komil ado namoed va zakoti moli kheshro bo sarf kardani on dar ch'oikh'oi sazovor bo rizomandi bipardozed. Sipas az vafo namudan ba in paimon rui gardonided va shumo odatan kh'amin guna az vafodori ba akh'd rui megardoned, magar te'dodi andakaton, ki bo tavfik'i ilokh'i akh'dshikani nakardand va akh'du paimonashonro ba ch'o ovardand.

84) Va on zamonero iod kuned, ki Mo dar mavridi ch'oiz nabudani rekhtani khuni iakdigar va noravo budani khorich' kardani kh'amdigar az manzilkh'oi khesh az shumo paimoni ustuvor giriftem. Sipas, in paimonro pazirufted va kh'ol on ki shumo bar durustii on guvokh'i medoded.

85) Sipas, shumo bo paimoni bastaaton mukholifat karded. Pas, ba'zeaton ba'zei digarro mekushted va gurukh'ero az manzilkh'oiashon zolimona berun mekarded, dar in amal az dushmanon alaikh'i iakdigar kumak mekhosted va murtakibi gunokh'u zulm meshuded. Va chun onkh'o nazdi shumo dar dasti dushmanon asiraftoda meomadand, baroi az bandi asorat rakh'onidanashon dar pardokhti bakh'oi ozodi talosh menamuded, kh'ol on ki berun sokhtani onkh'o az diiorashon bar shumo kh'arom gardonida shuda bud. Pas, shumo chiguna ba ba'zei akh'komi Tavrot az voch'ib budani pardokhti bakh'oi ozodii asiron imon meovared va ba ba'zei akh'komi digari on az kh'arom budani iakdigarkushi va man'i berun kardani kh'amdigar az manzilkh'oi khesh kofir meshaved?! Pas, much'ozoti kase, ki ba ba'zei akh'komi Khudo imon ovarda, ba ba'zei on kofir megardad, dar dunio ba ch'uz khori va rasvoi chize nest va dar ruzi okhirat in guna ashkhos ba sui shadidtarin azob bargardonida meshavand. Va Khudo az on chi mekuned, g'ofil nest, balki az kulli a'molaton ogokh'i doshta, kh'atman shumoro ba sazoi kardakh'oiaton khokh'ad rasond.

86) Inkh'o kasoneand, ki zindagonii abadii okhiratro bo dunioi foni ivaz karda, kh'aioti fanoshavandaro az zindagonii ch'ovidona muk'addam guzoshtaand. Pas, ruzi k'iiomat azob az onkh'o sabuk karda nameshavad va on ruz madadrasone nest, ki kumakashon rasonad.

87) Va ba durusti, Mo ba Muso Tavrotro dodem va ba dunboli vai paiombaronro paiopai firistodem va ba Isoi pisari Mariam mu'ch'izakh'oi ravshani zinda sokhtani murdagon va solim gardonidani kuri modarzodu mubtaloi marazi makhavro, ki inkh'o rostk'avlii uro isbot menamud, ato namudem va bo Ch'abraili Rukh'i muk'addas k'uvvatash bakhshidem. Ei Farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi! Oio kh'ar gokh' paiombare az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton akh'komero, ki bo khokh'ishoti nafsi shumo muvofik'at namekunad, biiorad, az k'abulash kibr varzida, khudro az firistodagoni Parvardigor bolotar mekh'isobed, pas iak iddaro durug'gu meshumored va iak iddai digarro ba k'atl merasoned?!

88) Begumon daleli Bani Isroil dar tarki pairavi az Paiombari okhirzamon (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) on bud, ki onkh'o guftand: "Ba durusti ki k'albkh'oi mo pushida ast. Az on chi megui, kh'ech' chiz voridi k'albi mo nameshavad." Kh'olati iakh'udikh'o chunonchi da'vo dorand, nest, balki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba sababi kufrashon az rakh'matash ronda ast. Pas, onkh'o tankh'o ba k'ismi andaki on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furud ovarda ast, imon meorand. Onkh'o ba ba'ze akh'komi ilokh'i bovar dorand.

89) Va chun ba Bani Isroil az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) K'ur'oni karim, ki bo e'tik'odoti Tavrotu Inch'il muvofik' buda, onro tasdik' mekunad, omad va onkh'o k'abl az nuzuli on meguftand: "Vak'te Paiombari okhirzamon oiad, ba vai imon ovarda, az rakh'namoikh'oiash pairavi mekunem va alaikh'i mushrikon g'olib gashta, piruzi nasibamon megardad.", pas chun K'ur'on va Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba onkh'o bo sifat va kh'ak'ik'ati baroiashon ma'lum omad, ba on kofir shudand. Ba kh'amin sabab, [1] la'nati Khudo bod bar kofiron.

90) Nikh'oiat zisht ast, ki onkh'o sakh'mi kheshtanro az imon ovardan ba Khudovu Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar ivazi kufr furukhta, ba khotiri on ki Khudo az fazlash K'ur'onro bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) furud ovarda ast, sitam va kh'asad varzida, ba Kitobi furudovardai Khudo kofir shudand va paiombaroni Uro durug'gui shumurdand. Pas in toifa az sababi inkori nubuvvati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va k'ablan bo ch'urmi tag'iir dodani Tavrot loik'i g'azab andar g'azabi Khudo gashtand. Va ruzi k'iiomat baroi kasone, ki dar dunio ba nubuvvati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kofir shudaand, azobi khorkunanda ast.

91) Va chun ba iakh'udikh'o gufta shavad: "Ba on kh'ak'ik'at va kh'idoiate, ki Khudo ba Paiombarash firistoda ast, imon ored", dar posukh guiand: "Mo ba on chi ba paiombaronamon nozil karda shuda ast, imon meorem." Va onkh'o ba g'aior az Kitobkh'oi paiombaronashon ba on chi ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) furud omada ast, kofir meshavand, kh'ol on ki K'ur'on Kitobi barkh'ak' buda, Kitobkh'oiashonro tasdik' va bo on muvofik'at mekunad. Agar onkh'o dar kh'ak'ik'at ba Kitobkh'oi baroiashon nozilshuda imon medoshtand, ba K'ur'on niz imon meovardand. Ei Paiombar, dar ch'avob bigu: "Agar shumo vok'ean ba kh'ak'ik'ati baroiaton omada imon ovarda boshed, pas, charo k'abl az in paiombaroni Khudoro mekushted?!"

92) Va begumon Musoi paiombaraton ba shumo mu'ch'izakh'oi ravshanero ovard, ki ba rostguiash dalolat mekard, sipas, shumo ba'd az raftani Muso ba va'dagokh'i Parvardigorash gusolaro ma'budi khesh k'aror doda, onro parastided va shumo bo shirk ovardan ba Khudo zolim buded, zero ibodatro dar ch'oi nomunosib k'aror doded.

93) Va zamonero ba iod ored, ki Mo az shumo dar mavridi pairavii Muso (alaikh'is salom) va paziruftani dini ovardaash paimoni ustuvor giriftem va ba mak'sadi bim dodan kukh'ro boloi saraton bardoshtem va guftem: "Tavroti ba shumo dodaamonro bo ch'iddiiat va talosh bigired va onro baroi paziruftanu taslim shudan bishnaved, dar aksi surat kukh'ro ba saraton meafkanem." Shumo dar ch'avob gufted: "Bo gushkh'oiamon shunidem va bo af'olamon nofarmoni kardem." Va ba sababi kufr varzidan gusolaparasti dar k'albashon sakht ch'o girifta bud. Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Agar mu'min boshed, pas on imone, ki shumoro ba kufr dastur medikh'ad, chi imoni zishtest. Zero kufr bo imoni vok'ei iakch'o ch'am' nameshavad."

94) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei iakh'udikh'o, agar dar saroi okhirat ch'annat khos ba shumo taalluk' doshta, digar mardum voridi on nashavand, agar shumo dar in da'voi khesh sodik' kh'asted, pas, margro tamanno va talab namoed, to kh'ar chi zudtar ba in mak'om noil gashta, az ranch'u azobkh'oi zindagonii in dunio rakh'oi iobed."

95) Va onkh'o ba sababi ch'urmkh'oe, ki dar dunio az kufr varzidan ba Khudo, takzib namudani paiombaroni Khudo va tag'iir dodani Kitobkh'oi ilokh'i anch'om dodaand, kh'argiz margro orzu namekunand. Va Khudo kulli sitamkoronro medonad. Kh'atman ba kh'ar kas muvofik'i amalash podosh khokh'ad dod.

96) Va ei Paiombar, begumon tu iakh'udikh'oro baroi zindagonii dunio agarchi bearzish va fanopazir ast, kh'aristarin mardum meiobi, balki onkh'o sarfi nazar az on ki akh'li Kitob buda, ba rastokhezu suoli k'iiomat imon dorand, ba kh'aioti in dunio az mushrikoni munkiri rastokhezu suoli on ruz kh'irsi beshtar dorand. Kh'ar iak nafari onkh'o dust medorad, ki umrash ba kh'azor sol birasad va umrash kh'ar k'adar tuloni kh'am boshad, uro az uk'ubat dur sokhta nametavonad. Va Khudo az a'molashon ogokh' buda, onro mebinad. Chize az U pushida nest va onkh'oro ba sazoi kirdorashon merasonad.

97) Ei Paiombar, ba iakh'udikh'oe, ki meguiand: "Begumon az miioni farishtagon Ch'abrail dushmani most", bigu: "Kh'ar ki dushmani Ch'abrail boshad, pas beshubkh'a, u farishtaest, ki K'ur'onro bo rukhsati Khudo ba k'albi tu furud ovarda ast, kh'ol on ki K'ur'on tasdik'kunandai Kitobkh'oi guzashta ba misli Tavrotu Inch'il va rakh'namo ba sui neki va ba akh'li imon muzhdadikh'andai ne'matkh'oi omodasokhtai Khudost. Kh'ar ki bo sokh'ibi in sifat va amal dushmani varzad, beguftugu, az ch'umlai zolimon ast.

98) Kh'ar ki dushmani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va farishtagon va paiombaron va ba khusus dushmani du farishtai muk'arrabi Khudo, Ch'abrail va Mikoil boshad, pas, beshubkh'a, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dushmani kulli kofiron ast. Parvardigor bo kh'ar ki dushmani namoiad, begumon vai duchori ziioni oshkor gashta ast."

99) Va ei Paiombar, beshak, Mo ba sui tu nishonakh'oi ravshanero furud ovardem, ki durustii nubuvvat va paig'omatro isbot mekunad. Va ba in alomatkh'oi ravshani nozilkardai Mo tankh'o bandagoni az din khorich' kofir meshavand.

100) Az ch'umlai khislatkh'oi badi iakh'udikh'o on ast, ki kh'ar gokh' akh'di ustuvor mebandand -imon ovardan ba akhbori Tavrot dar borai nubuvvati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az ch'umlai akh'di bastai onkh'ost-, gurukh'e az onkh'o akh'dashonro meshikanad, balki in ch'amoai iakh'ud ba on chi Khudo furud ovarda ast, imon nadorand. Zero imoni kh'ak'ik'i sokh'ibashro ba vafodori vodor mesozad.

101) Va chun Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) firistodai Khudo, ki tasdik'kunandai dini onkh'o bud, nazdashon omad, dar kh'ole ki vasfash bo akhbori Tavrot muvofik'at dosht, gurukh'e az eshon az dalolati Tavrot rui gardonidand va onro bo beparvoi ba pushtashon andokhtand. Kh'olati onkh'o ba kh'olati ch'okh'ile shabokh'at dorad, ki az kh'ak' va rakh'namoii on sud namebarand va ba on dik'k'at namekunand.

102) Va chun onkh'o dini Khudoro kanor guzoshtand, dar ivazi on az chizkh'oe pairavi namudand, ki Shaitonkh'o onro dar borai saltanati paiombar Sulaimon durug' meboftand. Farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi da'vo mekardand, ki saltanati Sulaimon bo rokh'i ch'odugari ba dast omada va poiai on ba kh'amin vosita mustakh'kam gashta ast. Va Sulaimon chunonchi iakh'udikh'o da'vo dorand, bo anch'omi ch'odugari kofir nashuda ast, valekin Shaitonkh'o kofir shudaand, chunki onkh'o ba mardum amali ch'odugariro ta'lim medikh'and va baroi mardum on ch'oduero, ki ba du farishtai bo nomi Kh'orutu Morut dar shakh'ri Bobuli Irok' baroi ozmoishi mardum furud ovarda shud, meomuzand. Va in du farishta ba kase ch'oduro nameomukhtand, to vak'te ki uro kh'ushdor doda meguftand: "Ba durusti ki mo baroi mardum vasilai ozmoish kh'astem. Pas, bo omuzishi ch'odugari kofir mashav." Kh'ar ki nasikh'ati Kh'orutu Morutro napaziruft, az onkh'o ch'odugariro omukht. Az ch'umla iak nav' sekh're bud, ki bo koshtani tukhmi dushmani miioni zanu shavkh'ar onkh'oro az iakdigar ch'udo mekard. Va in ch'odugaron ba kase ch'uz bo khostu ich'ozati Khudo zarar ovarda nametavonand va chizkh'oero meomuzand, ki ba onkh'o zarar meorad va ba onkh'o foida nameorad. Va begumon iakh'udikh'o medonand, ki kh'ar ki Kitobi Khudoro bo ch'odu ivaz namoiad, dar okhirat sakh'me nadorad. Va on chi kheshtanro dar ivazi on furukhtand, nikh'oiat zisht ast, zero paig'om va shar'i Khudoro bo ch'odugari ivaz namudand. Agar onkh'o medonistand, ki ba onkh'o chi sud mebakhshad, kh'argiz ba in amal va gumrokh'ii oshkor ik'dom namenamudand.

103) Va agar iakh'udikh'o ba Khudo imoni kh'ak'ik'i meovardand va bo anch'omi ibodatu tarki ma'siiat parkh'ezkori mekardand, begumon podoshi abadii nazdi Khudo az on chi dorand, baroiashon bekh'tar bud. Agar inro medonistand, kh'argiz chizero az on pesh nameguzoshtand.

104) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in oiat mu'minonro ba intikhobi kalimakh'oi nek rakh'namoi mekunad va mefarmoiad: "Ei mu'minon, "Ro'ino" nagued va "Unzurno" bigued va dasturotro shunida, ba on amal kuned." Va kofironro azobi nikh'oiat dardovar ast. Illati man' shudani mu'minon az korburdi ta'biri mazkur on ast, ki iakh'udikh'o bo istifoda az on Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro mavridi khitob k'aror doda, ma'noi badro ba nazar megiriftand. Fe'li farmoishii "Ro'i" ba e'tibori mak'sadi iakh'udikh'o az reshai vozhai "ru'unat" ba ma'noi "bekhiradi" girifta shuda ast. Ia'ne, mak'sadi onkh'o az ch'umlai mazkur "Akh'volamonro rioia kun" nabuda, balki k'asdashon "bekhirad" khondani On Kh'azrat (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bud. Binobar in, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mu'minonro az istifodai on man' namuda, amr kard, ki dar ivazi on ch'umlai "Unzurno", ia'ne "Moro muntazir bosh, to guftakh'oiatro bifakh'mem"-ro istifoda namoiand. In ta'bir ma'noi zaruriro ba tavri durust ifoda mesozad.

105) Kofiron novobasta az on ki az akh'li Kitob io mushrikand, dust namedorand, ki bar shumo az nazdi Parvardigoraton khairi kamu ziiod furud ovarda shavad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro az bandagonash mekhokh'ad, bo rakh'mati khesh az nubuvvat, paig'om va imon khos megardonad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sokh'ibi fazli buzurg ast. Kh'ar nekie, ki ba bandagon merasad, az nazdi Ust. Firistodani Paiombaron va nozil kardani Kitobkh'o az ch'umlai lutfu ekh'sonkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

106) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in oiat baion karda ast, ki vak'te U kh'ukm io lafzi oiatero az K'ur'on az bain mebarad io onro az iodi bandagon faromush mesozad, der io zud kh'ukmi digarero, ki az kh'ukmi k'abli sudmandtar io shabekh'i on ast, meorad. In bekor kunonidani kh'ukm io lafzi oiatkh'oi K'ur'on ba donish va kh'ikmati Khudo vobastagi dorad. Ei Paiombar, tu medoni, ki begumon Khudo bar kh'ama chiz Tavono ast. Kh'ar chiro khokh'ad, anch'om medikh'ad va kh'ar kh'ukmero khokh'ad, sodir mekunad.

107) Ei Firistodai Mo, begumon tu medoni, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moliki osmonkh'o va zamin ast. Kh'ar chi khokh'ad, kh'ukm mekunad, bandagonashro ba kh'ar chi khokh'ad, amr va az kh'ar chi khokh'ad, man' mesozad, kh'ar kh'ukmero khokh'ad, muk'arrar va kh'ar kh'ukmero khokh'ad, mansukh megardonad. Va Shumo ba'd az Khudo korsoz va madadrasone nadored, ki korkh'oiatonro sarparasti va zararro az shumo dur namoiad. Balki tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Korsozi tamomi in korkh'o va ba anch'omi on Tavono ast.

108) Ei mu'minon, dar sha'ni shumo zebanda nest, ki bo e'tiroz va iakravi az Paiombaraton suol kuned, chunonchi pesh az in k'avmi Muso az Paiombarashon talab karda guftand: "Ba mo Khudoro oshkor va beparda nishon dekh'." Va kh'ar ki imonro bo kufr ivaz namoiad, pas, vai begumon ch'odai mu'tadili rostro gum karda ast.

109) Bisiore az iakh'udu nasoro ba sababi kh'asadi dar dilashon pinkh'on orzu dorand, ki chunonchi dar guzashta butkh'oro ibodat mekarded, ba'd az imon ovardan shumoro dubora ba kufr bargardonand. Inro ba'd az on orzu dorand, ki kh'ak' budani dini ovardai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) baroiashon ma'lum ast. Pas, ei mu'minon, kirdorkh'oi onkh'oro afv namoed va az ch'akh'olat va palidii botinashon guzasht kuned, to on vak'te ki kh'ukmi Khudo dar boraashon biioiad. Kh'amono Khudo ba tamomi chiz K'odir ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro och'iz sokhta nametavonad. Ba'dan kh'ukmi Khudo dar borai onkh'o sodir gasht. Kofiron miioni Islom, pardokhti moliiot ba nomi "ch'izia" va k'atl ikhtiior doda shudand.

Ba'd az on ki Khudo dar oiatkh'oi k'abli mu'minonro dar muk'obili ozori dushmanon ba sabr kardan amr namud, dar oiatkh'oi zerin onkh'oro ba ustuvori dar din va k'avi gardonidani imon dastur doda guft:
110) Namozro bo rioiai farzkh'o, voch'ibkh'o va sunnatkh'o ba surati mukammal barpo dored va zakoti molatonro ba ashkhosi loik' bidikh'ed. Va kh'ar chi az amali shoista dar zindagi ba ch'o meored va onro k'abl az marg ba kh'aisi tushai okhirati khesh mefiristed, ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) podoshi onro meiobed. On ruz U ba shumo podoshi sazovor medikh'ad. Iak'inan on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Khudo onro mebinad. Kh'ar kasro ba sazoi amalash merasonad.

111) Va iakh'udu nasoro guftand: "Ch'annat makhsusi mo ast." Iakh'udikh'o guftand: "Kh'argiz ch'uz iakh'udi kase voridi ch'annat nameshavad" va nasronikh'o guftand: "Kh'argiz ch'uz nasroni kase voridi ch'annat nameshavad." In orzukh'oi botilu khaiolkh'oi fosidi onkh'ost. Ei Paiombar, dar raddi da'voiashon bigu: "Agar shumo dar da'voi khesh sodik'ed, pas, baroi isboti on kh'uch'ch'ati kheshro biiored."

112) Kh'ar kas Khudoro kholisona parastida, dar korkh'oiash tankh'o ba U rui meorad va ilova bar toati kholisona bo pairavii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nekukor ast, sarfi nazar az toifaash voridi ch'annat meshavad va uro nazdi Parvardigorash podoshi buzurg ast va in toifa az kh'avodisi okhirat tarse nadorand va onkh'o baroi on chi dar dunio az dast dodaand, g'amgin nameshavand. Sifati mazkur ba'di bi'sati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) iagona dar musulmonon takh'ak'k'uk' iofta ast.

113) Va iakh'udikh'o guftand: "Nasronikh'o dini sakh'ekh' nadorand" va nasronikh'o guftand: "Iakh'udikh'o dini sakh'ekh' nadorand", dar kh'ole ki kh'amagi Kitobkh'oi ba onkh'o furudovardai ilokh'iro tilovat mekunand va medonand, ki Parvardigor onkh'oro dar in Kitobkh'o amr namuda ast, to biduni ch'udo sokhtan ba tamomi paiombaron imon biiorand. Onkh'o dar in raftorashon ba k'avli mushrikone, ki az Tavrotu Inch'il bekhabarand, monandi dorand, zero in ki mushrikon kh'amai paiombaron va Kitobkh'oi firistodai Khudoro takzib menamoiand. Pas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat bo kh'ukmi odilonai ba bandagon khabar dodaash, ki "Iagona rokh'i komebiiu rastagori imon ovardan ba tamomi akh'komi ilokh'i ast", dar baini ikhtilofgaron oidi on chi ikhtilof mevarzand, k'azovat mekunad.

114) Zolimtarin shakhs onest, ki dar masoch'idi Khudo iodi nomi U, adoi namoz, khondani K'ur'onro man' mesozad va az rokh'i vaironsozi io man'i iodi Khudo dar takhribi masoch'id talosh menamoiad. Ba in toifai kharobkor daromadani masoch'id sazovor nest, magar dar kh'olati tarsu kh'aros, zero onkh'o ba Khudo kufr varzidand va mardumro az raftan ba khonakh'oi Khudo boz doshtand. Baroiashon az dasti mu'minon dar dunio khoriiu rasvoi va dar okhirat azobi buzurg ast.

115) Va kh'ukmfarmoii mashrik'u mag'rib va kh'amai mavch'udot tankh'o az Khudo ast. Ba bandagonash kh'ar chi khokh'ad, farmon medikh'ad. Pas, ba kh'ar samte rui ored, iak'inan ba sui Khudo rui ovardaed. Agar Khudo shumoro ba rui ovardan sui Bait-ul-mak'dis io Ka'ba amr namoiad io dar ioftani Ka'ba ba khato rokh' dikh'ed io rui ovardan ba sui Ka'ba baroiaton dushvor boshad, boke nest. Zero kulli samtkh'o ba Parvardigor taalluk' dorand. Beshak, rakh'matu osongirii Khudo pakh'novari farogir buda, mak'sad va korkh'oi bandagonro medonad.

116) Va iakh'udu nasoro va mushrikon meguiand: "Khudo baroi Khud farzand girifta ast." Khudo az in tukh'mat poku muk'addas ast. Zero U az bandagonash beniioz meboshad. Kase farzand megirad, ki ba on niioz dorad. Balki saltanatu molikiiati kh'amai mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Ust. Tamomi khaloik' banda va mutei U kh'astand. Kh'ar tavre khokh'ad, bo onkh'o munosibat mekunad.

117) Khudo biduni namunai sobik' Kh'astkunandai osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti miioni onkh'o ast. Va chun korero muk'addar gardonida, paidoishi onro iroda kunad, ba on "Kh'ast shav" meguiad, pas on tibk'i irodai U paido meshavad. Kh'ech' kas kh'ukmashro rad karda nametavonad.

118) Va akh'li Kitobu mushrikoni nodon iakravi namuda meguiand: "Charo Khudo bo mo bevosita gap namezanad?! Io charo ba mo alomati makhsusi kh'isshavanda nameoiad?!" Va ummatkh'oi takzibgari pesh az in toifa guzashta agarchi zamonu makonashon az inkh'o fark' dorad, kh'amin gapro gufta budand. Dilkh'oiashon ba kh'am shabekh' ast. Mo begumon oiatkh'oi ravshanamonro baroi k'avme baion namudem, ki chun kh'ak'ik'at baroiashon oshkor shavad, ba on iak'in menamoiand, dar in mavrid duchori shubkh'a namegardand va iakraviashon onkh'oro az k'abuli on man' namekunad.

119) Ei Paiombar, iak'inan Mo turo bo dini rostine firistodaem, ki dar durustiash kamtarin shubkh'a vuch'ud nadorad, to mu'minonro ba ch'annat bashorat va kofironro az duzakh kh'ushdor bidikh'i. Mas'uliiati tu tankh'o tablig'i oshkor ast. Va kh'ech' gokh' Khudo turo az akh'li otashi duzakh, ki imon naovardaand, namepursad.

120) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in oiati karima Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro mavridi khitob k'aror doda, uro dar munosibat bo iakh'udu nasoro rakh'namoi va barkh'azar doshta meguiad: Va kh'argiz iakh'udikh'o va nasronikh'o az tu rozi nameshavand, to vak'te ki Islomro tark namuda, az oiini onkh'o pairavi kuni. Bigu: "Beshak, kh'idoiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki Islom ast, kh'idoiati vok'ei meboshad, g'airi on ch'umlagi gumrokh'ii oshkor ast." Va agar tu va io pairavonat ba'd az kh'ak'ik'ati oshkore, ki baroiaton omada ast, tobei khostakh'oi iakh'udu nasoro shaved, kh'ech' gokh' az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dusti va nusratero nameiobed. In oiat baiongari khatarnokii tarki kh'ak'ik'at va kh'amk'adami bo akh'li botil ast.

121) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in oiat oidi gurukh'e az akh'li Kitob khabar doda meguiad: Mo ba in gurukh' Kitob dodem. Onkh'o ba Kitobkh'oi nozilshuda amal va az on ba tavri arzanda pairavi mekunand. Eshon dar Kitobkh'oi khesh alomatkh'oi dalolatkunandai rostk'avlii Paiombari okhirzamon (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro ioftand va az kh'amin sabab ba sui imon shitoftand. Ammo iak toifai digar kufri khudro idoma doda, ok'ibat korashon bo khasorati buzurg meanch'omad. Va on kasone, ki ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kofir meshavand, pas in gurukh' ziionkoroni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand.
122) Ei farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi! On ne'mati dini va duniavii Maro, ki bar shumo in'om namudam va shumoro bo nubuvvatu saltanat bar akh'li zamonaton bartari dodam, iod kuned.

123) Va bo ich'roi amrkh'o va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o az azobi ruzi k'iiomat biparkh'ezed, ruze, ki kh'ech' kas az kh'ech' kas chizero dur sokhta nametavonad va dar on ruz az kase bakh'oi ozodi pazirufta nameshavad va dar on ruz shafoati kase nisbati kase, sarfi nazar az baland budani mak'omi shafoatkunanda sud namebakhshad va kh'ech' kas ba onkh'o ch'uz Khudo manfiat ovarda nametavonad.

124) Va on zamonero iod kun, ki Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro Parvardigorash bo amr kardan ba akh'kom va mas'uliiatkh'o ozmoish namud. Pas, Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) on akh'kom va mas'uliiatkh'oro ba tavri komil ba ch'o ovard. Parvardigor ba Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Kh'amono Man turo baroi mardum namunai ibrat k'aror medikh'am, to onkh'o dar korkh'o va guftorkh'oi khesh ba tu pairavi kunand." Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Va az naslam niz ei Parvardigoram, peshvoione k'aror bidekh', ki mardum ba onkh'o pairavi kunand." Parvardigor dar posukh guft: "Taakh'kh'udi Man bo tu dar borai peshvo gashtanat ba zolimoni naslat namerasad."

125) Va on zamonero iod kun, ki Mo Khonai Ka'baro ch'oi bozgashti mardum gardonidem, k'albashon doim ba on alok'amand ast, vak'te az on Khona rakhti safar bandand, boz mekhokh'and ba sui on bargardand va onro baroi mardum makoni amn k'aror dodem. Va ba mardum guftem: "Az nazdi sangi k'adamgokh'i Ibrokh'im, ki kh'angomi binoi Ka'ba rui on istoda bud, makonero baroi adoi namoz bigired." Ibrokh'im va pisarash Ismoilro dastur dodem, ki Khonai Ka'baro az palidikh'o va butkh'o poksozi kuned va in makonro baroi kh'ar ki mekhokh'ad bo tavofu e'tikof va namozu g'airi on dar onch'o ibodat kunad, omoda sozed.

126) Va ei Paiombar, on zamonero iod kun, ki Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) kh'angomi duo guft: "Parvardigoro, Makkaro kishvari doroi amn bigardon, ki dar on ba kase ziion rasonida nashavad va akh'li in sarzaminro az nav'kh'oi gunoguni mevakh'o ruzi bidekh' va on ruziro makhsusi kasone bisoz, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi okhirat imon ovardaand." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft: "Va kh'ar ki az onkh'o kofir shavad, Man begumon uro bo ruzi dodan dar dunio andak bakh'ramand mesozam, sipas, ruzi k'iiomat uro mach'buri ba otashi duzakh meandozam va makone, ki ruzi okhirat ba sui on barmegardad, chi ch'oi nikh'oiat zisht ast."

127) Va ei Paiombar, on zamonero iod kun, ki Ibrokh'im va Ismoil poiakh'oi Khonai Ka'baro mebardoshtand, onkh'o bo furutani meguftand: "Parvardigori mo, korkh'oiamon va az on ch'umla amali binoi in Khonaro az mo bipazir. Ba durusti ki Tu duoi moro shunida, onro k'abul mekuni, niiatu amalkh'oiamonro medoni.

128) Parvardigoro, va moro taslimi farmonat bigardon, to kasero ba Tu sharik nasozem va az naslamon ummatero taslimi Khud bigardon va tarzi ibodatatro baroiamon nishon bidekh' va dar ibodat az gunokh'onu kutokh'ikh'oiamon darguzar. Albatta, Tu nisbati bandagoni tavbakunandaat Tavbapaziru bag'oiat Mekh'ruboni.

129) Parvardigori mo, dar bainashon az khudashon paiombarero az nasli Ismoil, ki baroiashon oiatkh'oi nozilkardaatro tilovat kunad va ba onkh'o K'ur'on va sunnatro ta'lim dikh'ad va onkh'oro az shikru korkh'oi nopisand pok sozad, barangez. Kh'amono Tu Tavonoi G'olibu dar kor va kh'ukmat Kh'akim kh'asti."

130) Va az oiini Ibrokh'im tankh'o kase ba dinkh'oi g'air barmegardad, ki bo bekhiradi va tarki kh'ak'ik'atu barguzidani zalolat dar kh'ak'k'i khesh sitam karda, ba khoriiu rasvoi rozi gashta ast. Va kh'amono Mo Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro dar dunio ba sifati paiombar va dusti khosi Khud barguzidem va u begumon dar okhirat az zumrai bandagoni solekh'e meboshad, ki on chi Khudo bar onkh'o farz karda ast, ba ch'o ovarda, ba darach'akh'oi baland noil megardand.

131) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on sabab Ibrokh'imro barguzid, ki dar taslim gashtan va ba farmoni U tobe' shudan meshitoft va dar in kor ta'khir namekard. On gokh', ki Parvardigorash ba vai guft: "Ibodatro kholis baroi Man anch'om bidekh' va bo anch'omi toat mutei Man bosh", u dar posukh guft: "Dar barobari Khudovandi Ofaridgor, Ruzirason va Chorasozi korkh'oi tamomi bandagon taslim shudam."

132) Va Ibrokh'im farzandonashro ba ch'umlai zikrgardidai "Dar barobari Khudovandi Ofaridgor, Ruzirason va Chorasozi korkh'oi bandagon taslim shudam" suporish dod va Ia'k'ub niz farzandonashro ba on suporish dod. Ibrokh'im va Ia'k'ub farzandonashonro nido karda guftand: "Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo oiini Islomro barguzid. Pas, to omadani marg ba Islom chang zaned va namired, magar dar kh'olate, ki bo zokh'iru botin taslimshudai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boshed."

133) Io chun marg ba Ia'k'ub faro rasid, vak'te ba farzandonash khitob namuda pursid: "Ba'd az margi Man chiro ibodat mekuned?" shumo onch'o kh'ozir buded? Onkh'o dar ch'avobi savoli padarashon guftand: "Mo Ma'budi tu va Ma'budi padaronat Ibrokh'im va Ismoil va Iskh'ok', Ma'budi Iagonai bemislro meparastem va mo tankh'o taslim va mutei U kh'astem."

134) Onkh'o ummate budand, ki monandi ummatkh'oi k'abli guzashtand va ba natich'ai korkh'oiashon rasidand. On chi onkh'o az neki va badi kardaand, az khudi onkh'o va on chi shumo az neki va badi kardaed, az khudi shumo ast. Va shumo az a'moli onkh'o pursida nameshaved va onkh'o az a'moli shumo pursida nameshavand. Kh'ech' kas baroi ch'urmi shakhsi digar giriftori ch'azo namegardad. Balki kh'ar kas ch'avobgui a'moli khesh ast. Az in ru, naboiad a'moli guzashtagon shumoro az islokh'i korkh'oi khud mashg'ul gardonad. Zero kasero ba'di rakh'mati Parvardigor ch'uz amali nekash manfiat namebakhshad.

135) Va iakh'udikh'o ba ummati islomi meguiand: "Iakh'udi shaved, to kh'idoiat iobed." Va nasronikh'o guftand: "Nasroni shaved, to kh'idoiat iobed." Ei Paiombar, dar posukhi onkh'o bigu: "Balki az dini Ibrokh'im, ki az oiinkh'oi digar ba sui dini rostin moil buda, az ch'umlai mushrikon nabud, pairavi mekunem."

136) Ei mu'minon! Ba iakh'udu nasoroi sokh'ibi chunin da'voi botil bigued: "Mo ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va K'ur'oni ba mo nozilshuda va ba on chi ba Ibrokh'im va Ismoil va Iskh'ok' va Ia'k'ub va ba paiombaroni nasli Ia'k'ub va ba Tavroti baroi Muso Parvardigor ato namuda ast va ba Inch'ili az sui Khudo ba Iso dodashuda va ba kh'amai Kitobkh'oe, ki Khudo onkh'oro ba paiombaron doda ast, imon ovardaem. Baini kh'ech' kase az paiombaron fark' nameguzorem, ki ba ba'zei on imon orem va ba ba'zei digar kofir shavem, balki ba kh'amaashon imon dorem va mo tankh'o mute' va taslimshudai Parvardigor kh'astem."

137) Pas, agar iakh'udu nasoro va digar kofiron monandi imoni shumo imon orand, ba durusti, ba rokh'i rosti mavridi pisandi Khudoi mutaol kh'idoiat shudaand va agar az imon rui tofta, kh'amai paiombaron io ba'zei onkh'oro durug'gu donand, iak'inan ma'lum meshavad, ki onkh'o dar khilofkori va adovati shadid k'aror doshta, kh'ak'ik'atro paziruftan namekhokh'and. Ei Paiombar, g'amgin mabosh! Pas, Khudo baroi peshgiri namudani ozorashon turo basanda ast. U turo az sharrashon nigokh' medorad va piruziat mebakhshad. Va U Shunavandai guftorkh'o, Donandai mak'sadu kirdorkh'oi onkh'o ast.

138) Az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki zokh'iru botinatonro bar on sirishta ast, pairavi kuned. Zero kh'ech' dine az oiini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bekh'tar nest. In din muvofik'i sirishti inson ast, foidakh'oro ch'alb va zararkh'oro bartaraf megardonad. Va bigued: "Mo tankh'o ibodatkunandagoni Parvardigorem. Kh'ech' kas va kh'ech' chizro ba U sharik namesozem."

139) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei akh'li Kitob, oio bo mo ba daleli k'adim budani Kitobu dinaton oidi on ki guio ba Khudo va dinash az mo sazovortared, ch'idol mekuned? In kor baroi shumo foidae nadorad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Parvardigori kh'amai most. Va moro a'moli mo ast, ki shumo az on pursida nameshaved va shumoro a'moli shumo ast, ki mo az on pursida nameshavem. Ba kh'ar kas dar ivazi kirdorash ch'azo doda meshavad. Va Mo itoatu ibodati khudro kholis baroi Khudo anch'om medikh'em va kh'ech' kasro ba U sharik namesozem."

140) Io in ki ei akh'li Kitob, shumo megued: "Kh'amono Ibrokh'im va Ismoil va Iskh'ok' va Ia'k'ub va paiombaroni nasli Ia'k'ub dar dini iakh'udiiat io masekh'iiat kh'astand." Ei Paiombar, dar posukh bigu: "Oio shumo donotared io Khudo?!" Agar onkh'o da'vo kunand, ki in paiombaron dar oiini iakh'udiiat io masekh'iiat budand, begumon durug' guftaand. Zero bi'sat va margi paiombaroni mazkur k'abl az nuzuli Tavrotu Inch'il ba vuk'u' paivasta ast. Ma'lum megardad, ki on chi akh'li Kitob meguiand, dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo durug' buda, kh'ak'ik'atro pinkh'on mekunand. Va kh'ech' kas az shakhse, ki misli akh'li Kitob shakh'odati az sui Khudo sobitro pinkh'on mesozad, zolimtar nest. Va Khudo az kirdori shumo g'ofil nameboshad. Kh'atman ba shumo podosh khokh'ad dod.

141) Onkh'o ummate budand, ki monandi ummatkh'oi k'abli guzashtand va ba natich'ai korkh'oiashon rasidand. On chi onkh'o az neki va badi kardaand, az khudi onkh'o va on chi shumo az neki va badi kardaed, az khudi shumo ast. Va shumo az a'moli onkh'o pursida nameshaved va onkh'o az a'moli shumo pursida nameshavand. Kh'ech' kas baroi ch'urmi shakhsi digar giriftori ch'azo namegardad. Balki kh'ar kas ch'avobgui a'moli khesh ast. Az in ru, naboiad a'moli guzashtagon shumoro az islokh'i korkh'oi khud mashg'ul gardonad. Zero kasero ba'di rakh'mati Parvardigor ch'uz amali nekash manfiat namebakhshad.

142) Ba zudi ch'okh'iloni bekhiradi iakh'ud va munofik'oni shabekh'ashon khokh'and guft: "Musulmononro az samti Bait-ul-mak'dis, ki k'abl az in k'iblai onkh'o bud, chi bargardonida ast?" Ei Paiombar, dar posukhashon bigu: "Kh'ukmfarmoi va molikiiati mashrik'u mag'rib va kulli samtkh'o tankh'o az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'ar kiro ba kh'ar taraf khokh'ad, megardonad. Va U az miioni bandagonash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, ba rokh'i rost rakh'namoi mekunad."

143) Va chunonchi Mo ba sui Ka'ba rui ovardanatonro pisandidem, kh'amin tavr shumoro dar baini ummatkh'oi digar bekh'tarin ummati adolatparvar va dar e'tik'od, ibodat, muomila mu'tadil gardonidem, to ruzi k'iiomat shokh'idoni paiombaroni ilokh'i gashta, guvokh'i dikh'ed, ki onkh'o dasturoti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba pairavoni kheshtan rasonidand va to Mukh'ammadi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bar shumo guvokh' shavad, ki u paig'omi ilokh'iro ba shumo rasonida ast. Va Mo k'iblai Bait-ul-mak'disro, ki ba sui on rui meovardi, barnagardonidem, magar ba mak'sadi on ki ilmi g'aibii Mo ba ilmi aini tabdil gashta, baroi mardum aion shavad, ki chi kase ba on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muk'arrar karda ast, rozi shuda, muteash megardad va az Paiombar pairavi mekunad va chi kase az dinash bargashta, az khokh'ishi khud pairavi karda, az amri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) itoat namekunad. Va ba durusti, rukhdodi bargardonidani musulmonon az k'iblai nakhustinashon kori buzurge bud, ch'uz baroi bandagone, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui imonro doda ast va medonand, ki akh'komi ilokh'i kh'ikmati bisere dorad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'argiz imoni shumo, az ch'umla on namozatonro, ki to imruz, k'abl az tag'iir eftani k'ibla ba tarafi Bait-ul-mak'dis ado mekarded, zoe' namesozad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i bandagon nikh'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Onkh'oro duchori sakhti namekunad va podoshi amalashonro zoe' namegardonad.

144) Ei Paiombar, Mo begumon ba sui osmon gashtani chekh'ra va nigokh'atro baroi intizorii on ki dar borai az sui Bait-ul-mak'dis ba sui Khonai Ka'ba tag'iir ioftani k'ibla paig'omi Khudo nozil khokh'ad shud, mebinem. Pas, Mo kh'atman turo az samti Bait-ul-mak'dis ba sui Khonai Ka'ba, ki k'iblai makh'bub va pisandidai tu ast, barmegardonem. Pas, chekh'raatro ba samti Masch'id-ul-kh'aromi Makkai mukarrama bargardon. Va ei mu'minon, dar kh'ar kuch'o boshed, pas vak'ti adoi namoz chekh'rai khudro ba on taraf bargardoned. Va kh'amono akh'li Kitob az iakh'udu nasoro ba iak'in medonand, ki bargashtani k'ibla ba sui Ka'ba amri rostini az ch'onibi Ofaridgor va Chorasozi korkh'oiashon nozilshuda ast. Zero in mas'ala dar Kitobkh'oiashon mavch'ud ast. Va Khudo az korkh'oe, ki in toifai az kh'ak' rui gardonida anch'om medikh'and, g'ofil nest. Balki U kh'amaro medonad va kh'atman onkh'oro ba sazoi a'molashon merasonad.

145) Va ei Paiombar, ba Zoti Khesh savgand, ki agar tu ba akh'li Kitob az iakh'udu nasoro kh'ar oiat va kh'uch'ch'atero oidi kh'ak' budani tag'iiriobii k'ibla biiori, onkh'o bo iakravi va kibr ba sui k'iblai tu rui nameorand va tu niz ba'd az on ki Khudo turo az k'iblai onkh'o bargardonida ast, ba sui k'iblaashon ruiovaranda nesti va ba'zeashon ba sui k'iblai ba'zei digar ruioranda nestand. Zero onkh'o iakdigarro kofir medonand. Va agar tu dar borai k'ibla va digar akh'kom ba'd az on ki baroiat donishi sakh'ekh'i az shubkh'a kholi omada ast, az in ch'amoa pairavi kuni, on gokh' iak'inan bo tarki kh'idoiatu pairavii khostakh'oi nafs az ch'umlai zolimon megardi. In khitob bo mak'sadi baioni zishtii pairavii iakh'udu nasoro ba Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ravona shuda ast, ammo dar vok'e' Khudovand on kasro az pairavii onkh'o nigokh' doshta ast. Musalmonon mukhotabi zimni buda, Parvardigor onkh'oro az tobei iakh'udu nasoro gashtan kh'ushdor medikh'ad.

146) On kasone az donishmandoni iakh'udu nasoro, ki Mo baroiashon Kitob dodaem, chunonchi farzandonashonro meshinosand va onkh'oro az iakdigar fark' mekunand, kh'amin guna rukhdodi tag'iiriobii k'iblaro, ki nazdi onkh'o az ch'umlai nishonakh'oi nubuvvati Paiombari okhirzamon (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ast, meshinosand. Ammo bo vuch'udi in toifae az onkh'o begumon az rui kh'asad kh'ak'ik'ati ovardai Paiombari okhirzamonro dar kh'ole ki durust budani onro medonand, pinkh'on mekunand.
147) In kh'ak'ik'at az sui Parvardigorat omada ast. Pas, dar borai durustii on az zumrai shubkh'akunandagon mabosh.

148) Va kh'ar iak ummat samti kh'issi io ma'navii khudro dorad, ki on ummat ba on samt rui meorad. Gunogunii ummatkh'o oidi k'ibla va k'onunkh'oi Khudo az kh'amin k'abil ast. Pas, agar gunogunii samte, ki ba sui on rui meorand, bar asosi farmoni Khudo surat girifta boshad, boke nadorad. Pas, ei mu'minon, dar korkh'oi khaire, ki ba anch'omi on amr shudaed, bo iakdigar peshdasti kuned. Dar kh'ar kuch'o boshed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat shumoro ch'am' mesozad, to podoshi a'molatonro bidikh'ad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tamomi chiz K'odir ast. Gird ovardani shumo va much'ozot dodanaton Uro och'iz namegardonad.

149) Va ei Paiombar, tu va pairavonat az kh'ar kuch'oe berun shaved va kh'ar kuch'oe boshed va k'asdi adoi namozro kuned, pas, ruiatonro ba samti Khonai Ka'ba bargardoned. Va albatta, in rui ovardan ba samti Ka'ba kh'ak'ik'atest, ki ba tu az ch'onibi Parvardigorat vakh'i shuda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chizkh'oe mekuned, g'ofil nest, balki kh'amai ch'uz'iioti koratonro medonad va kh'atman baroi on ba shumo podosh khokh'ad dod.

150) Va ei Paiombar, az kh'ar kuch'oe berun shavi va k'asdi adoi namoz kuni, pas, ruiatro ba sui Masch'id-ul-kh'arom bargardon va ei mu'minon, dar kh'ar kuch'o boshed, pas ruii kheshro kh'angomi khondani namoz ba sui on bargardoned, to mardum alaikh'i shumo kh'uch'ch'at nadoshta boshand, magar zolimoni onkh'o. Zolimon sitezach'uii khudro idoma doda, bo zaiftarin dalel alaikh'i shumo kh'uch'ch'at meorand. Pas, az onkh'o natarsed va bo ich'roi amrkh'o va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o tankh'o az Man bitarsed. Kh'amono Man baroi on ba sui Masch'id-ul-kh'arom rui ovardanro mashru' gardonidam, ki ne'mati Khudro bo ch'udo sokhtani shumo az digar ummatkh'o baroiaton ba itmom rasonam va shumoro ba sui musharraftarin k'iblai mardum rakh'namoi kunam.

151) On guna ki baroiaton ne'mati digarero in'om namuda, ba sui shumo az khudi shumo paiombarero firistodem, ki baroiaton oiatkh'oi Moro tilovat mekunad va shumoro bo amr namudan ba korkh'oi doroi fazilatu neki va boz doshtan az a'moli nopisandu bad pok mesozad va ba shumo K'ur'on va sunnatro ta'lim medikh'ad va ba shumo az umuri dinu dunio chizkh'oero meomuzonad, ki k'ablan onro namedonisted.

152) Pas, Maro bo k'albu a'zoi badanaton iod kuned, Man shumoro bo madkh'u sitoish va kh'ifz namudan iod mekunam. Zero podosh az nav'i amal ast. Va lutfu ekh'sonkh'oi Maro, ki onro ba shumo in'om kardaam, shukrguzori namoed va bo inkor va dar ch'oi kh'arom istifoda burdani ne'matkh'o Maro nosiposi nakuned.

153) Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, dar anch'omi ibodat va taslim gashtan ba farmoni Man az sabr va namoz iori ch'ued. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo sabrkunandagon ast. Ba onkh'o kumak merasonad va sarfarozashon megardonad.

154) Va ei mu'minon, dar sha'ni kasone, ki dar ch'ikh'odi rokh'i Khudo kushta meshavand, "Onkh'o chun digaron murdaand" nagued, balki onkh'o nazdi Parvardigorashon zinda kh'astand, valekin shumo nav'i kh'aioti onkh'oro dark namekuned. Chunki on zindagonii makhsus buda, iagona rokh'i shinokhtanash paig'omi Khudo ast.

155) Va Mo begumon shumoro ba vositai musibatkh'oi gunogun, bo khavf az dushman va gurusnagi va kamshavii molkh'o bo az bain raftan io dushvor gashtani kasbi on va kamshavii ch'onkh'o bo omadani ofatkh'oi kh'aloksozanda io shakh'odat dar rokh'i Khudo va kamshavii makh'suloti zamin mesanch'em. Va ei Paiombar, bandagoni dar musibat sabrkunandaro az on chi onkh'oro dar duniovu okhirat khushkh'ol megardonad, muzhda bidekh'.

156) Bandagoni bosabr kasoneand, ki vak'te az kh'avodisi mazkur, ba onkh'o musibate birasad, bo rizomandi meguiand: "Iak'inan mo az oni Khudo kh'astem, dar kh'ak'k'amon kh'ar guna khokh'ad, kh'ukm mekunad va mo begumon ruzi k'iiomat ba sui U bozmegardem. U Parvardigorest, ki moro ofarida, bo ne'matkh'oi gunogun ba mo lutf namuda va khotimai mo ba sui U ast."
157) Baroi in ch'amoai doroi sifati iodshuda az ch'onibi Khudo dar miioni ch'am'i farishtagon sitoish va rakh'matest, ki bar onkh'o furud meoiad va in gurukh' kh'idoiatioftagoni kh'ak'ik'i meboshand.

158) Kh'amono du kukh'i ba nomi Safo va Marvai dar nazdikii khonai Ka'ba ch'oigirifta az nishonakh'oi zokh'irii dini Khudo ast. Pas, kh'ar ki baroi adoi marosimi kh'ach' io umra k'asdi Khonai Ka'ba kunad, pas, bar vai gunokh'e nest, ki dar baini on du sa'i namoiad. Va kh'ar ki ibodatkh'oi nofilaro ikhtiioran va kholis ich'ro kunad, Khudo Shukrguzori Dono ast. Korkh'oi nekashro pazirufta, podoshash medikh'ad va az kh'amai korkh'oiash ogokh' ast. Dar ibtidoi Islom ba'ze az musulmonon sa'i miioni kukh'i Safo va Marvaro az korkh'oi davroni ch'okh'iliiat va gunokh' pindoshta, az anch'omi on parkh'ez mekardand. Khudovand baroi mutmain sokhtani onkh'o dar in oiati karima k'aidi "...bar vai gunokh'e nest"-ro ovarda, baion sokht, ki in amal az ch'umlai oinkh'oi kh'ach' ast.

159) Kh'amono kasone az iakh'udu nasoro va g'airi onkh'o, ki on chiro Mo az kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi isbotkunandai nubuvvat va dini Paiombar nozil kardaem, ba'd az on ki onro ba mardum dar Kitobkh'oiashon baion sokhtaem, pinkh'on mekunand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in gurukh'i bandagonro az rakh'matash dur mesozad va kh'amai farishtakh'o, paiombaron va mardum ba onkh'o la'nat mefiristand.

160) Magar on kasone, ki az pinkh'on kardani oiatkh'oi Mo pushaimon shuda, tavba menamoiand va amalkh'oi oshkoru nikh'oni kheshtanro islokh' mesozand va kh'ak'ik'ati pinkh'on doshtaashonro oshkor baion mekunand, pas, Man tavbai in toifaro mepaziram va Man nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakunanda Tavbapaziru bag'oiat Mekh'rubonam.

161) Kh'amono kasone, ki kofir shudand va dar kh'olati kufr vafot namudand, bar in gurukh' la'nati Khudo va farishtagon va kulli mardum khokh'ad bud. Farishtgon va mardum az Khudo la'nati onkh'oro mekhokh'and.
