162) Onkh'o dar duzakh ch'ovidon memonand, az onkh'o azob sabuk karda nameshavad va niz ba onkh'o dar okhirat mukh'lat doda nameshavad.

163) Va ei mardum, Ma'budi barkh'ak'k'i shumo Ma'budi dar zotu sifotash Iagona ast. G'air az U Ma'budi barkh'ak' nest. U Parvardigori Bakhshoiandai Mekh'rubon ast. Baroi kh'amin ba bandagonash ne'matkh'oi farovon medikh'ad.

164) Ba durusti ki dar ofarinishi osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti shigiftangezi miioni on va paepai omadani shabu ruz va kishtikh'oe, ki dar dariokh'o bo bardoshtani libosu taom va mato'kh'oi tich'orativu digar niezmandikh'oi mardum ba onkh'o foida merasonad, kh'arakat mekunand va obe, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az osmon furud ovarda, ba vositai on zaminro ba'di khushki bo ruiidani ziroatkh'o va giiokh'on zinda sokht va on chi dar zamin az ch'ondorkh'o pakh'n namud va dar gardonidani bodkh'o az iak samt ba samti digar va abri baini osmon va zamin musakhkhar, iak'inan dar tamomi in nombarshudakh'o baroi on kasone, ki dalelro mefakh'mand va ak'lashonro kor mefarmoiand, kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi vozekh'i isbotkunandai iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

165) Va bo vuch'udi in dalelkh'o, az mardum kasone kh'astand, ki g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oero girifta, on khudoioni sun'iro kh'amchun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dust medorand va mukh'abbati mu'minon nisbati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar k'ies ba mukh'abbati onkh'o ba khudoionashon sakhttar ast. Zero akh'li imon kasero ba Parvardigor sharik namesozand va Uro dar kh'olatkh'oi tangivu farokhi dust medorand. Ammo mushrikon, dar kh'olati farokhi ma'budkh'oiashonro dust medorand, lekin chun duchori sakhti shavand, tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui meorand. Va agar bandagoni bo shirku ma'siiat bar khud sitamkarda ruzi k'iiomat vak'ti didani azob kh'olati kheshtanro mushokh'ida namoiand, kh'atman iak'in khokh'and kard, ki tamomi neru tankh'o az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast va azobi U baroi bandagoni nofarmon sakht ast. Agar onkh'o in kh'olatro dar dunio medidand, kh'ech' gokh' ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk nameovardand.

166) Ei bandai kh'ushmand! On zamonero iod kun, ki peshvoioni kufru zalolat az pairavonashon bezori mech'uiand va kh'amagi azobro mebinand va tamomi asbobi nach'ot ba sababi kufrashon az onkh'o k'at' megardad.

167) Va on bandagone, ki ba in peshvoioni rokh'i zalolat pairavi kardaand, meguiand: "Ei kosh, ba sui dunio bargashta metavonistem, pas, az peshvoionamon bezori mech'ustem, chunone onkh'o az mo bezori ch'ustand." Chunonchi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat baroi onkh'o azobi shadidro nishon medikh'ad, kh'amin tavr ok'ibati dar rokh'i botil az peshvoionashon pairavi namudanashonro ba onkh'o nishon medikh'ad, dar kh'ole ki a'moli onkh'o sababi nadomatkh'o va andukh'ashon megardad va onkh'o kh'argiz az duzakh khorich' nameshavand.

168) Ei mardum, az ne'matkh'oi zamin az k'abili kh'aivonot, nabotot va mevakh'oi darakhton, ki kasbu nav'i on kh'aloli pokiza boshad, bikhured va az gomkh'oi Shaiton pairavi nakuned. Zero Shaiton iak'inan baroiaton dushmani oshkor ast. Insoni sokh'ibkhirad az dushmanash, ki kh'amesha dar paii zarar va gumrokh'sozii u ast, pairavi namekunad.

169) Kh'amono Shaiton shumoro ba sodir kardani amalkh'oi nopisand va gunokh'oni azim amr mekunad va shumoro farmon medikh'ad, to biduni ilmi shar'i dar borai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oidi e'tik'odu shariat sukhan bigued.

170) Va chun ba in kofiron gufta shavad: "Az on kh'idoiat va nure, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furud ovarda ast, pairavi kuned", bo siteza meguiand: "Balki mo az e'tik'odu rokh'e pairavi mekunem, ki padaronamonro bar on ioftaem." Oio agarchi padaronashon az kh'idoiat va nur chizero namefakh'midand va ba rokh'i rosti pisandidai Khudo rokh' nameioftand, az onkh'o pairavi mekunand?!

171) Va dostoni kofiron dar pairavi az padaroni khesh monandi dostoni chupone ast, ki chakh'orpoionashro fariod mezanad, on chakh'orpoion fariod va nidoi chuponro meshunavand, ammo sukhanashro namefakh'mand. Kofiron az shunidani kh'ak' kar, az guftanash lol va az didanash nobino kh'astand. Dar natich'a, on kh'idoiatero, ki onkh'oro ba suiash da'vat menamoi, namefakh'mand.

172) Ei on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi namudaed, az ne'matkh'oi kh'aloli pokizai baroiaton ruzi va ravo gardonidai Mo tanovul kuned va baroi lutfu ekh'sonkh'oi ba shumo atoshuda shukri zokh'iri va botinii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o ored. Az ch'umlai shukrguzorii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on ast, ki agar vok'ean tankh'o Uro meparasted, pas, toatashro ich'ro namoed va az nofarmoniash biparkh'ezed.

173) Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo az taomkh'o murdor (kh'aivone, ki biduni ismi Khudo zabkh' meshavad) va khuni rekhtai ch'orishuda va gushti khuk va kh'aivonoti kh'alolgushti kh'angomi zabkh' bar on nomi g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zikrshudaro kh'arom gardonida ast. Pas, agar shakhse ba khurdani chizi kh'arome mach'bur shavad, dar kh'ole ki bo biduni kh'och'at iste'mol namudan zulm nakarda va az kh'addi zarurat naguzashta boshad, pas, bar vai gunokh'u uk'ubate nest. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbati bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Iake az namunakh'oi rakh'mati U ba bandagon on ast, ki iste'moli ashioi kh'aromro dar vak'ti zarurat rukhsat medikh'ad.

174) Ba durusti ki on kasone, ki ba monandi iakh'udu nasoro Kitobi nozilsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va bar nubuvvati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dalolat kardani onro pinkh'on mesozand va bo in raftori khesh ivazi andakero ba misli molu mansab mesitonand, onkh'o dar shikami khud g'airi on chi sababi ba otashi duzakh daromadanashon megardad, chize namekhurand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat ba onkh'o sukhani nek va pisandida nameguiad, balki kalomi nopisand meshunavand va onkh'oro az gunokh' pok namesozad, sitoishashon namekunad va onkh'oro azobi nikh'oiat dardovar ast.

175) In toifai bo sifati pushonidani donishi mavridi niiozi mardum tavsifshuda kasoneand, ki chun ilmi kh'ak'ro pinkh'on sokhtand, bo in raftori khud kh'idoiatro bo gumrokh'i va mag'firati Khudoro bo azobi U ivaz namudand. Pas, onkh'o chi k'adar dar anch'omi on amalkh'oe, ki sababi duzakhi gashtanashon meshavad, bosabrand?!

176) Sababi much'ozoti pinkh'on kardani ilmu kh'idoiat dar on ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Kitobkh'oi Khudro ba rosti furud ovarda ast. Barkh'ak' budani nozilshavii in Kitobkh'o az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tak'ozokunandai on ast, ki naboiad akh'komash az mardum pinkh'on karda shavad. Va kh'amono kasone, ki dar mavridi Kitobkh'oi osmoni ikhtilof varzida, ba ba'zeash imon ovarda, ba ba'zei digarash kofir gashtand, dar kharkhasha va fosilai az kh'ak' dur k'aror dorand.

177) Nekii mavridi pisandi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) fak'at ba samti mashrik'u mag'rib rui gardonidan va dar in bobat ikhtilof kardan nest, valekin nekii vok'ei raftori kasest, ki ba iagona Ma'bud budani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi okhirat va kulli farishtagon va Kitobkh'oi az nazdi Parvardigor nozilshuda va biduni ch'udosozi ba kh'amai paiombaron imon ovarda va molashro bo vuch'udi ba on mukh'abbat va kh'irs doshtan, ba kheshovandon va iatimon va mukh'toch'on va g'aribi dar safar k'arordoshtai az akh'lu vatani khud ch'udo va kasone, ki niiozmandii sakht onkh'oro ba gadoi vodor mesozad va dar rokh'i ozod kardani g'ulomon va asiron sarf mekunad va namozro tibk'i dasturi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tavri komil barpo medorad va zakotashro mepardozad va vak'te akh'd bandand, ba akh'dashon vafo menamoiand va dar tangdasti va sakhtiiu bemori va dar vak'ti shiddati ch'ang bosabr buda, az maidon namegurezand. In gurukh'i doroi sifatkh'oi mazkur shakhsoneand, ki dar imon va amal bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sodik'ona raftor namuda va onkh'o bo anch'omi suporishkh'o va duri ch'ustan az nakh'ikh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ezkoroni vok'ei kh'astand.

178) Ei on shakhsone, ki ba Allokh' imon ovardaed va az Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) pairavi mekuned, kasone, ki digaronro k'asdan va bo zulm mekushand, bar shumo dar ch'azo dodani on k'otilon rioiai barobari va adolat farz gardonida shuda ast. Ozod dar badali ozod va g'ulom dar badali g'ulom va zan dar badali zan kushta meshavad. Pas, agar mak'tul k'abl az marg gunokh'i k'otilro bakhshad, io sarparastash dar badali khunbakh'o az ch'urmi k'otil darguzarad, pas bar shakhsi ch'inoiati k'otilro bakhshida voch'ib ast, ki k'otilro dar talabi khunbakh'o bo neki, na bo minnatu ozor rasonidan dunbol kunad va bar k'otil pardokhtani khunbakh'o ba neki va biduni ta'khir voch'ib ast. In bakhshidani ch'urmi k'otil va giriftani khunbakh'o az sui Parvardigoraton baroi shumo sabuki va dar kh'ak'k'i in ummat mekh'ruboni ast. Pas, kh'ar ki ba'd az afvi ch'urmi k'otil va paziruftani khunbakh'o ba u dastdarozi kunad va intik'om girad, pas uro az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) azobi dardovar ast.

179) Va ei khiradmandon, baroi shumo dar k'isosgiri bo peshgirii khunrezi va man'i dastdarozi bar iakdigar zindagonii buzurge ast. Mo k'isosro muk'arrar sokhtem, to shumo az ch'inoiati kushtor biparkh'ezed va dar fazoi amnu orom umr ba sar bared.

180) Chun alomat va asbobi marg ba iake az shumo kh'ozir gardad, agar az khud moli ziiod guzoshta boshad, bar shumo az on baroi padaru modar va kheshovandon ba vach'kh'i shar'ii na beshtar az seiakashro vasiiat kardan farz shuda ast. Anch'omi in amal bar zimmai parkh'ezkoron kh'ak'k'i k'at'i meboshad. Kh'ukmi mazkur k'abl az nozilshavii oiatkh'oi marbut ba meros bud. Vak'te akh'komi meros furud omad, vorison va sakh'mashon muaiian gardid.

181) Pas, kh'ar ki ba'di donistani kh'ukmi vasiiat onro bo ziiodu kam io man' kardan digargun sozad, pas gunokh'i in raftor bar ukh'dai ashkhosi tag'iirdikh'anda guzoshta shuda, shakhsi vasiiatgar gunakh'kor nest. Albatta, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai guftori bandagon, Donandai kirdori onkh'ost. Kh'ech' chize az ikh'oati ilmi U dur nameboshad.

182) Pas, kh'ar ki az ch'onibi vasiiatkunanda kanoragiri az kh'ak' io dar vasiiat zulm namudanro donad, ba'dan bo nasikh'at kori tabokh'sokhtai uro islokh' kunad va miioni tarafkh'oi dar borai vasiiat ikhtilofdoshta sulkh' andozad, pas bar vai kh'ech' gunokh'e nest, balki baroi in amali nekash ach'r megirad. Beguftugu, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i tavbakoron bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

183) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, ruza bar shumo az sui Parvardigoraton farz shuda ast, on guna ki bar ummatkh'oi k'abl az shumo guzashta farz gashta bud, to shoiad bo anch'omi amalkh'oi shoista, ki ruza iake az buzurgtarini on ast, parkh'ezkori menamoed va khudro az azobi ilokh'i nigokh' medored.

184) Ruza bar shumo dar chand ruzi andaki sol farz karda shuda ast. Pas, kh'ar on nafare az shumo bemor buda, ruza baroiash mashak'k'at orad io musofir boshad, kh'ak' dorad ruzaashro khurad, ba'di on bar u ba andozai on ruzkh'o ruzai k'azoi giriftan farz ast. Va bar nafarone, ki tavoni ruzaro dorand, vak'te onro bikhurand, dar badali on bar onkh'o pardokhti fidia voch'ib ast. Fidia on ast, ki shakhs dar ivazi kh'ar ruz ba iak miskin taom bidikh'ad. Pas, kh'ar ki ba beshtar az iak miskin taom dikh'ad e ilova bar taom dodani miskin ruza kh'am girad, in kor baroiash bekh'tar ast. Va agar shumo fazilatkh'oi ruzaro medonisted, baroiaton giriftani ruza az khurdani on va dar ivaz pardokhtani fidia bekh'tar ast. In kh'ukm dar ibtidoi mashru' shudani ruza bud. On vak't kh'ar shakhs mekhost, ruza megirift va kh'ar shakhs mekhost, ruzaashro khurda, dar ivazi kh'ar ruz ba iak miskin taom medod. Ba'dan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kh'ar insoni bolig'e, ki k'udrati giriftani ruzaro dorad, onro farz kard va kh'ukmi ikhtiiori budanashro mansukh gardonid.

185) Mokh'i Ramazon on mokh'est, ki dar shabi k'adrash nuzuli K'ur'on ba Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) og'oz gasht, dar kh'ole ki K'ur'on rakh'namoi mardum buda, dar on dalolatkh'oi ravshani kh'idoiat va ch'udosozii kh'ak' az botil ast. Pas, kh'ar kas dar mokh'i Ramazon kh'uzur doshta, musofiru bemor naboshad, pas ruzai on bar vai farz ast. Va kh'ar kas bemor boshad va ruza giriftan natavonad io musofir boshad, khurdani ruza baroiash durust ast. Sipas bar ukh'daash ba ivazi ruzkh'oi khurdaash giriftani ruzai k'azoi farz ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo bo on chi muk'arrar karda ast, osoni mekhokh'ad va dushvori namekhokh'ad va to shumorai kh'amai mokh'ro ba itmom rasoned va pas az anch'omi mokh'i Ramazon va faro rasidani idi Fitr, baroi on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo tavfik'i ruzagiriro doda, dar takmili on eriaton namuda ast, Uro ba buzurgi iod kuned va to Uro siposguzori namoed, ki shumoro ba dini mavridi pisandash rakh'namoi karda ast.

186) Va ei Paiombar, chun bandagonam az tu dar borai nazdikii Man va duoi onkh'oro paziruftanam pursand, pas beshubkh'a, Man bo ilmam ba onkh'o nazdikam, kh'olatashonro medonam, duoiashonro meshunavam. Az in sabab, kh'och'at nest, ki onkh'o baini Manu khud kasero vosita k'aror dikh'and va kh'angomi duo sadoiashonro baland kunand. Vak'te ki duokunanda Maro boikhlos duo kunad, duoiashro mepaziram. Pas, boiad bandagon ba Man va dasturotam taslim bishavand va dar imoni khesh ustuvor bimonand, in nofe'tarin rokh'i k'abulshavii duo ast, to onkh'o umed doshta boshand, ki ba in vosita dar korkh'oi diniiu duniaviashon ba rokh'i rost rokh' meioband.

187) Dar og'ozi farz gashtani ruza agar mard shabona khob meraft va k'abl az damidani subkh' az khobash bedor meshud, khurdan io kh'ambistari bo kh'amsar bar vai kh'arom bud. Ba'd Khudo in kh'ukmro mansukh sokhta guft:
Ei mu'minon! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo dar shabkh'oi Ramazon kh'ambistari bo kh'amsaronatonro ch'oiz gardonida ast. Zanon vasilai pushish va pokdomanii shumoiand va shumo vasilai pushish va pokdomanii onkh'o kh'asted. Shumo va kh'amsaronaton az iakdigar beniioz nested. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonist, ki shumo dar kh'ak'k'i kheshtan bo anch'omi on chi mamnu' ast, khiionat mekuned, pas shumoro mavridi rakh'matash k'aror doda va tavbaatonro pazirufta, baroiaton sabuki ovard. Likh'ozo, aknun bo zanonaton kh'ambistar shaved va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on naslero, ki baroiaton muk'addar namuda ast, talab kuned va tamomi shab to zamoni baroiaton muaiianshavii tului subkh'i sodik' bo safedii fach'r va ch'udoshavii on az torikii shab bikhured va binushed. Sipas ruzaro bo duri ch'ustan az shikanandakh'oi on shuru' az tului subkh' to furu raftani khurshed ba itmom birasoned. Va bo kh'amsaroni kheshtan dar kh'ole ki dar masch'idkh'o e'tikof nishastaed, kh'ambistar nashaved. Chunki kh'ambistari bo kh'amsar onro botil mesozad. In akh'komi mazkur marzkh'oi miioni kh'alolu kh'arom muk'arrarsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Pas, kh'argiz ba on nazdik nashaved. Zero kh'ar shakhse ba marzkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdik meshavad, ekh'timol dorad onro poimol kunad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amin guna oiatkh'oi Khudro baroi mardum ba tavri vozekh'u ravshan baion menamoiad, to onkh'o bo ich'roi amrkh'o va parkh'ez az nakh'ikh'o tak'vo kunand.

188) Va ba'zeaton moli ba'zei digarro bo rokh'kh'oi g'airi shar'i ba misli duzdi, g'asb, fireb va g'aira nagired va dar borai molkh'oi khesh bo kh'am nizo' karda, in k'aziiaro ba mak'sadi bo gunokh' omekhta khurdani k'isme az amvoli mardum peshi kh'okimon nakashoned, dar kh'ole medoned Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in amalro kh'arom gardonida ast. Agar shakhs kh'arom budani gunokh'ro donista, ba on ik'dom kunad, zishtii korash beshtar va azobash buzurgtar megardad.

190) Va tankh'o bo kh'adafi g'olibshavii dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kofirone, ki muk'obilaton mech'angand, to shumoro az dini U boz dorand, bich'anged va bo kushtani kudakon, zanon, pironsolon io buridani gushu binii kushtashudagon va ba in monand amalkh'o az marzkh'oi muk'arrarnamudai ilokh'i naguzared. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kasonero, ki az marzkh'oi dar dinu akh'kom muk'arrarsokhtaash meguzarand, dust namedorad.

191) Va dar kh'ar ch'oe bo on kofironi ch'angch'u rubaru shaved, onkh'oro ba k'atl rasoned va onkh'oro az sarzamini Makka, ki shumoro az on berun rondand, berun kuned. Va fitnae, ki bo boz doshtani mu'min az din va bozgashtash ba sui kufr kh'osil meshavad, az k'atl buzurgtar ast. Va nazdi Masch'id-ul-kh'arom ba khotiri rioiai ekh'tiromi on bo kofiron ch'angro shuru' nakuned, to vak'te ki onkh'o bo shumo ch'angro shuru' kunand. Pas, agar onkh'o nazdi Masch'id-ul-kh'arom muk'obilaton ch'angro og'oz namoiand, pas onkh'oro bikushed. Much'ozoti kofiron kh'amin guna ast, ki dar surati nazdi Masch'id-ul-kh'arom ba shumo dastdarozi kardan kushta meshavand.

192) Pas, agar onkh'o az ch'angidan bo shumo va kufr khuddori kunand, shumo niz az ch'angidan va k'atlashon khuddori namoed. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba tavbakoron bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Binobar in, bandagonro baroi gunokh'oni guzashta azob namekunad va onkh'oro dar kh'ol ch'azo namedikh'ad.

193) Va muk'obili kofiron to zamone bich'anged, ki ch'urmi shirk, man'i mardum az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va kufrashon bok'i namonad va tankh'o dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) g'olib gardad. Pas, agar onkh'o az ch'urmi kufr va man'i mardum az rokh'i ilokh'i khuddori kunand, pas ba muk'obilashon nach'anged, zero dasti taarruz daroz namudan tankh'o alaikh'i kasone ch'oiz ast, ki bo kufr varzidan va man'i mardum az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zulm kardaand.

194) Mokh'i Kh'aromi soli kh'aftumi kh'ich'ri, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo imkoni ba sarzamini Kh'aram daromadan va adoi umraro dod, dar ivazi mokh'i Kh'aromi soli shashumi kh'ich'ri ast, ki mushrikon shumoro az ziiorati Khonai Ka'ba man' kardand. Va dar kh'ak'k'i shakhsone, ki kh'urmati muk'addasotero ba monandi kh'urmati sarzamini Kh'aram, mokh'i kh'arom va bastani ekh'rom poimol mesozand, k'isos ch'ori megardad. Pas, kh'ar ki dar in muk'addasot bar ziddi shumo dasti taarruz daroz kunad, dar ivazi raftorash monandi khudash muomila kuned va az andozai raddi monand berun nashaved. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on bandagonero, ki az kh'ududi muaiiansokhtaash meguzarand, dust namedorad. Va az guzashtani andozai baroiaton ch'oiz az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo tavfik' va ta'iidi Khud kh'amrokh'i bandagoni parkh'ezkor ast.

195) Va amvolatonro dar ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba monandi ch'ikh'od va g'aira kharch' namoed va bo tarki muborizai rokh'i Kh'ak', khuddori az kharch'i mol dar in rokh' io anch'omi kore, ki sababi margaton megardad, khudro ba kh'alokat naafkaned. Va dar anch'omi ibodat, muomila va akhlok' nekukori kuned. Albatta, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni dar kh'ama kor nekukorashro dust medorad, ba onkh'o ach'r medikh'ad va ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiatashon mekunad.

196) Kh'ach' va umraro kholisan lillokh' ba itmom rasoned. Pas, agar shumo ba sababi bemori io dushman e g'airi inkh'o az itmomi kh'ach' va umra man' shaved, pas, bar shumo baroi berun shudan az ekh'rom zabkh'i on chi az chakh'orpoioni k'urboni az shuturu govu gusfand, ki muiassar gardad, voch'ib meboshad. Va to zamoni rasidani chakh'orpoi k'urbonii zabkh'shavanda ba makh'ale, ki zabkh'ash dar on makh'al kh'alol ast, mui saratonro nataroshed io onro kutokh' nakuned. Pas, agar shakhsi ozimi ziiorati Khonai Khudo ba'di ba rokh' baromadan az rasidan ba ziiorati Khona man' karda shavad, boiad k'urboniashro dar on makone, ki man' shuda ast, zabkh' kunad. Va agar az rasidan ba sarzamini Kh'aram man' nashuda boshad, boiad k'urboniashro dar ruzi k'urboni va io aiiomi tashrik' zabkh' kunad. Pas, az shumo kh'ar ki bemor io dar mui sarash chizi ziionovare, misli shapush va g'aira boshad va ba kh'amin illat mui sarashro bitaroshad, bar vai gunokh'e nest, balki bar u voch'ib ast, ki dar ivazi on bo se ruz ruza giriftan io taom dodani shash miskini Kh'aram io zabkh'i gusfand va tak'simi gushtash ba fak'ironi Kh'aram fidia bidikh'ad. Vak'te ki shumo dar kh'olati kh'aros k'aror nadoshta boshed, pas, kh'ar nafare az shumo dar mokh'kh'oi kh'ach'ch'i farzi bo adoi umra bakh'ra barad va to zamoni dar kh'amon sol baroi kh'ach'ch'i farzi ekh'rom bastan az korkh'oi dar kh'olati ekh'rom mamnu' bakh'ra barad, pas, boiad on chi az gusfand muiassar shavad, zabkh' kunad va io dar zabkh'i iak gov io shutur bo kh'aft shakhs sharik gardad. Pas, agar az ukh'dai k'urboni nabaroiad, bar u ba ivazi on se ruz dar ruzkh'oi mavsimi kh'ach' va kh'aft ruz ba'd az nazdi akh'lash bargashtan ruza giriftan voch'ib ast, to mach'muan dakh' ruz boshad. In kh'ukmi anch'omi "tamattu'" bo voch'ib gashtani k'urboni io giriftani ruza baroi shakhsi az k'urboni och'iz, ba g'airi akh'li Makka va ba g'airi kase, ki dar nazdikii sarzamini Kh'aram zindagi mekunad, rabt dorad. Zero akh'li Makka va kasone, ki dar nazdikii Kh'aram zindagi mekunand, ba "tamattu'" niioz nadorand. Chunki onkh'o dar Kh'aram k'aror doshta, dar badali "tamammu'" mutlak'i tavof baroiashon basanda ast. Va bo pairavi az akh'komi shar' va poimol nasokhtani marzkh'o az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbati bandagoni nofarmonash azobi bag'oiat shadide dorad.

197) Mavsimi kh'ach' doroi mokh'kh'oi ma'lum ast. On az mokh'i Shavvol shuru' shuda to ruzi dakh'umi mokh'i Zulkh'ich'ch'a idoma meiobad. Pas, kh'ar ki dar in mokh'kh'o bo bastani ekh'rom kh'ach'ro baroi khud lozim gardonad, az sababi on ki dar zamon va makoni azim k'aror dorad, omezishi ch'insi bo kh'amsar, inchunin muk'addimakh'oi on va ch'idole, ki ok'ibat ba g'azabu khusumat mekashonad, bar u kh'arom meboshad. Khuruch' az itoati ilokh'i bo sodir kardani gunokh' baroi kh'och'i uk'ubati shadidtar dorad. Va on chi az neki anch'om medikh'ed, pas, begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad va baroi on shumoro podosh medikh'ad. Va dar adoi kh'ach' tamomi vasilakh'oi ba on niioz doshtai khudro, ba misli khuroku nushoba bo khud bigired va bidoned, ki bekh'tarin vasilai dar kh'ama kh'olatkh'o baroiaton iorirason tak'vo ast. Va ei sokh'iboni khiradi solim, bo ich'roi amrkh'o va parkh'ez az nakh'ikh'oiam az Man bitarsed.

198) Bar shumo gunokh'e nest, ki dar asnoi ich'roi marosimi kh'ach' bo rokh'i tich'orat va g'airi on ruzii kh'alol bitalabed. Pas, vak'te az kukh'i Arafot, ba'd az on ki ruzi nukh'um bar rui on tavak'k'uf karded, furud omada, ruzi iozdakh'umi Zulkh'ich'ch'a ba sui Muzdalifa rafted, dar nazdi "Mash'ar-ul-kh'arom"-i Muzdalifa bo guftani "Subkh'onallokh'", "Lo ilokh'a illallokh'" va duo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro iod kuned. Va Uro iod kuned, chunki shumoro ba sui oinkh'oi din va marosimi ziiorati Khonai Khud rakh'namoi namud va begumon shumo k'abl az rakh'namoii U g'ofil buded.

199) Sipas, az Kukh'i Arafot faroed, chunonchi mardumoni pairavi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) kh'amin guna mekardand, na on tavr, ki mardumoni davroni ch'okh'iliiat az ch'ikh'ati kibru g'urur bo mardumoni digar bar kukh'i Arafot nameistodand. Va baroi on kambudikh'oe, ki az ch'onibi shumo dar ich'roi dasturoti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sar zada ast, az U talabi omurzish namoed. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbati bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

200) Ba'dan chun oinkh'oi kh'ach'ro ba okhir rasonided va az on forig' shuded, pas, on guna ki bo padaroni khud mefakhred va onkh'oro sitoish mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro iod va sitoish kuned io Uro az zikri padaronaton beshtar iod namoed. Zero kh'ar ne'mate, ki az on bakh'ra mebared, tankh'o az suii U ast. Mardum gunogunand. Ba'zeashon kofiru mushrikand, fak'at ba zindagonii dunio bovar dorand, az Parvardigorashon ch'uz ne'matkh'oi dunioi foni, az k'abili tandurusti, mol, farzand va g'aira chizi digare namekhokh'and. Va onkh'o az ne'matkh'oi makhsus baroi mu'minon dar okhirat omodashuda kh'ech' sakh'me nadorand. Zero in toifa ba dunio dil basta va az okhirat rui gardonidaand.

201) Va gurukh'i digari mardum ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi okhirat imon ovardaand. Inkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui ovarda meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, baroiamon dar dunio ne'mat va tavfik'i anch'omi amali shoista va dar okhirat ne'mati daromadan ba bikh'isht va solim mondan az duzakhro ato namo."
202) Baroi in ch'amoa ba khotiri dar dunio anch'om dodani amalkh'oi shoista, podoshi buzurg ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) a'moli bandagonro zud kh'isob mekunad.

203) Va dar ruzkh'oi bashumori iozdakh'um, duvozdakh'um va sezdakh'umi mokh'i Zulkh'ich'ch'a bo guftani "Allokh'u akbar" va "Lo ilokh'a illallokh'" Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro iod kuned. Pas, kh'ar shakhse shitob namuda, ba'd az sangzanii Shaiton ruzi duvozdakh'um az Mino berun shavad, in amalash ch'oiz buda, bar u gunokh'e nest, zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiash sabuki ovarda ast va kh'ar ki to ruzi sezdakh'um ta'khir namoiad, to Shaitonro sang bizanad, in amalash ravo buda, bar u gunokh'e nest, balki komiltarin tarzi sang zadanro ba ch'o ovarda, az raftori Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) pairavi karda ast. In ravo budani ta'ch'ilu ta'khir va dar du kh'olat gunakh'kor nashudani kh'och'i baroi kasest, ki dar adoi kh'ach' az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tarsida, onro ba surati farmudai U ich'ro kunad. Va bo anch'omi amrkh'o va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va iak'in doshta boshed, ki shumo tankh'o ba sui U bargardonida meshaved. On ruz kh'atman podoshi amalkh'oiatonro megired.

204) Va ei Paiombar, az miioni mardum munofik'e kh'ast, ki sukhanash dar kh'aioti dunio turo ba kh'airat meorad, uro shirinzabon mebini, kh'atto shakhsi sodik' va khairkhokh'ash mepindori, lekin mak'sadi asosii u kh'ifzi ch'onu molash ast va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bar imon va gue "niiati neki" k'albash guvokh' megardonad, dar kh'ole ki u durug' meguiad va nisbat ba musulmonon khusumatu dushmanii sakht dorad.

205) Va vak'te ki az nazdat bargardad va az tu ch'udo shavad, dar zamin talosh mevarzad, to dar on fasodkori namoiad va ziroatro talaf dikh'ad va chorvokh'oro bikushad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar zamin fasodkori va bandagoni fasodkorro dust namedorad.

206) Va vak'te ki ba kh'aisi nasikh'at ba on fasodkor "Az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo rioiai marzkh'o va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'oiash bitars" gufta shavad, kibru g'urur uro az bargashtan ba sui kh'ak' boz medorad va nofarmonii kheshro idoma medikh'ad. Pas, daromadani ch'akh'annam baroiash ch'azoi basanda ast va begumon ch'akh'annam baroi boshandagonash ch'oigokh'i bag'oiat bade ast.

207) Va az miioni mardum mu'mine kh'ast, ki ch'onashro mefurushad, onro dar rokh'i toatu rizoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ch'ikh'od mebakhshad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbati bandagonash doroi rakh'mati pakh'novar va nikh'oiat Mekh'rubon ast.

208) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, dar Islom ba purragi dokhil shaved. Az on kh'ech' chizro tark nasozed va ba monandi akh'li Kitob naboshed. Pairavoni Tavrot va Inch'il ba ba'zei Kitobkh'oiashon amal mekardand va ba'zei onro inkor menamudand. Va az rokh'kh'oi Shaiton pairavi nakuned, chunki u ba shumo dushmani kh'ak'ik'ii oshkor buda, adovatashro pinkh'on namesozad.

209) Pas, agar az ch'onibi shumo ba'd az on ki baroiaton dalelkh'oi ravshan omad, lag'zhish va kach'ravi az rokh'i kh'ak' surat girad, bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti kh'amesha G'olibi dar chorasozi va akh'komash Kh'akim ast. Az in ch'ikh'at, az U bitarsed va azamatashro bishinosed.

210) In ch'amoai tobei rokh'i Shaiton va az kh'ak' kach'rafta muntaziri onand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi dovari dar zeri soiabonkh'oi abr on gunae, ki loik'i Ust, kh'amrokh'i farishtagon nazdashon biioiad, farishtagon onkh'oro az kh'ar ch'onib ikh'ota kunand va on vak't amri Parvardigor dar boraashon sodir shuda, kor az kor meguzarad. Va tamomi korkh'oi khaloik' tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardonida meshavad.

211) Ei Paiombar, az Farzandoni Ia'k'ub (alaikh'is salom) bo sarzanish bipurs, ki Mo ba onkh'o chi k'adar oiatkh'oi nishondikh'andai sidk'i paiombaronashonro dodem?! Pas, onkh'o on oiatkh'oro durug' shumurdand va az paziruftanash ru toftand. Va kh'ar kase ne'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba'd az shinokhtan va oshkor gashtani on ba kufru takzib ivaz kunad, pas, begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba kofironi takzibkunanda Doroi uk'ubati sakht ast.

212) Baroi on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir gashtaand, zindagonii dunio va lazzatkh'oi muvak'k'atii on zebo ch'ilva doda shuda ast va onkh'o bandagoni ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va okhirat imon ovardaro maskhara mekunand. Va shakhsoni bo ich'roi amrkh'o va tarki kh'aromkh'o parkh'ezkor ruzi k'iiomat az kofiron bartarand. Zero onkh'o bo fazli ilokh'i sokh'ibi ch'annati abadi meshavand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar kase az bandagonash khokh'ad, biduni kh'isob ruzi medikh'ad.

214) Ei mu'minon, oio gumon mebared, ki dokhili bikh'isht meshaved, kh'ol on ki kh'anuz ba shumo misli ozmoishi ummatkh'oi guzashta ozmoishe naomada ast?! Ba ummatkh'oi guzashta tangdasti va bemorii sakht rasid va kh'olatkh'oi khavfnok onkh'oro chunon ba larza ovard, ki kh'atto paiombar va mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ash nusrati Khudoro talabida meguftand: "Nusrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kai meoiad?" Ogokh' boshed! Ba durusti, nusrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni mu'mini tavakkulkunanda bag'oiat nazdik ast.

215) Ei Paiombar, askh'obat az tu mepursand, ki az molkh'oi khesh chiro va dar kuch'o kharch' kunand? Dar posukh ba onkh'o bigu: "On chi az khair (moli kh'aloli pokiza) kharch' mekuned, pas, on boiad ba padaru modar va kheshovandoni nazdiktarin bo nazardoshti kh'och'atmandiashon va iatimoni mukh'toch' va benavokh'oe, ki chize nadorand va musofiri ba sababi safar az akh'lu vatan dur sarf shavad." Va ei mu'minon, kh'ar chi az neki anch'om medikh'ed, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad. Kh'ech' chize az U pushida namemonad va kh'atman podoshi onro khokh'ed girift.

216) Ei mu'minon! Ch'angidan dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo farz shuda ast, dar kh'ole on tabiatan ba nafsaton pisand nest, chunki dar in rokh' molu ch'on bakhshida meshavad. Va shoiad shumo chizero misli nabardi rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) namepisanded, kh'ol on ki on dar vok'e' baroiaton khairu sudmand ast. In amal ilova bar savobi ziiod doshtan, doroi foidakh'oi piruzi alaikh'i dushman va baland bardoshtani Kalimai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) niz kh'ast. Va shoiad shumo chizero dust medored, dar kh'ole ki on baroiaton bad va ziionovar ast. Monandi ak'ibnishini az ch'ikh'odi rokh'i Parvardigor, ki natich'ai on mag'lubiiat va zabardast gashtani dushman ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) neki va badii korkh'oro komilan medonad va shumo inro namedoned. Binobar in, farmoni Uro ich'ro kuned, zero dar on baroi shumo khairi makh'z nukh'ufta ast.

217) Ei Paiombar, mardum az tu dar borai kh'ukmi ch'angidan dar mokh'kh'oi kh'aromi Zulk'a'da, Zulkh'ich'ch'a, Mukh'arram, Rach'ab mepursand. Dar posukh bigu: "Dar in mokh'kh'o ch'angidan nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'i azim va amali nopisand ast. Va on chi mushrikon az man'i mardum az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va kufr varzidan va peshgiri kardani mu'minon az Masch'id-ul-kh'arom va berun sokhtani akh'li Masch'id-ul-kh'arom az on anch'om medikh'and, nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az ch'urmi ch'angidan dar mokh'kh'oi kh'arom buzurgtar ast. Va gunokh'i shirke, ki ba on oluda gashtaand, az k'atl badtar ast." Va ei mu'minon, mushrikon ba zammi sitamkori paivasta muk'obilaton mech'angand, to shumoro az dini rostinaton ba dini botili khud bargardonand, agar in korro kardan tavonand. Va kh'ar ki az shumo az dinash barmegardad va dar kh'oli kofir budan memirad, pas, begumon amalkh'oi solekh'i in toifa dar dunio va okhirat botil shuda ast. Va in toifa boshandagoni doimii duzakhand. Onkh'o dar duzakh abadi memonand.

218) Iak'inan on kasone, ki ba Allokh' va Rasulash imon ovardaand va on kasone, ki bo mak'sadi kh'ich'rat ba sui Allokh' va Rasulash tarki vatan kardaand va ba mak'sadi g'olibiiati din dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'angidaand, in gurukh' umedi rakh'matu mag'firati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dorand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bakhshandai gunokh'on buda, nisbat ba bandagonash nikh'oiat Mekh'rubon ast.

220) In kh'ukmro baroi shumo muk'arrar gardonid, to dar bobati on chi dar dunio va okhirat ba shumo manfiatovar ast, andesha namoed. Va ei Paiombar, sakh'obagonat az tu dar borai sarparastii iatimon mepursand, ki dar muomila bo onkh'o chi kor kunand? Oio amvoli iatimonro bo amvoli khud dar kharoch'oti zindagii mushtarakashon omekhta sozand? Dar ch'avobashon bigu: "Molkh'oi iatimonro biduni ivaz io biduni omekhta sokhtan ba amvoli kheshtan islokh' namudan va ba onkh'o neki kardan baroiaton nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bekh'tar va ach'ri buzurgtar doshta, baroi onkh'o niz khair ast, chunki bo in rokh' doroiashon kh'ifz meshavad. Va agar bo iakch'o sokhtani moli iatimon bo moli kheshtan dar khurdanu nushidanu maskan va g'aira bo onkh'o sharik garded, pas, kh'ech' gunokh'e bar shumo nest, zero ki onkh'o barodaroni dinii shumo kh'astand. Barodaron ba iakdigar eri merasonand va kh'amdigarro sarparasti mekunand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sarparastonero, ki bo sharik gashtan dar moli iatimon k'asdi fasodkori dorand, az shakhsoni islokh'talab ch'udo karda, in du gurukh'ro medonad. Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar bobi iatimon shumoro ba mashak'k'at giriftor kardan mekhost, begumon in korro mekard." Vale Paembar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) rokh'kh'oi muomila bo iatimonro baroi shumo oson karda ast, zero osoni az khususiiatikh'oi akh'komi Islom ast. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti G'olib va dar chorasozi, ofarinish va akh'kom Kh'akim ast.

221) Va ei mu'minon, zanoni mushrikaro to zamone imon naorand va musalmon nashavand, ba ak'di nikokh'i khud vorid nasozed. Va beshubkh'a, kanizi boimon az zani ozodi mushrika agarchi ch'amolu molash shumoro ba shigift kh'am orad, bekh'tar ast. Va zanoni boimonro ba ak'di nikokh'i mardoni mushrik vorid nasozed. Va begumon g'ulomi boimon az mardi ozodi mushrik agarchi ch'amolu molash shumoro ba shigift kh'am orad, bekh'tar ast. In mardonu zanoni mushrik bo guftorkh'o va kirdorkh'oiashon ba sui chize faro mekhonand, ki shakhsro duzakhi megardonad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sui amalkh'oi shoistae faro mekhonad, ki shakhsro bo ich'ozat va fazli ilokh'i ba ch'annat va mag'firati gunokh'on merasonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oiatkh'oi Khudro ba mardum baion mekunad, to shoiad onkh'o az dalolatkh'oi on ibrat girand va amal kunand.

222) Va ei Paiombar, sakh'obagonat az tu dar borai kh'aiz[ Khuni tabii, ki dar vak'ti makhsus az bachadoni zan berun meshavad] mepursand. Dar posukhashon bigu: "On baroi mardu zan boisi ozor ast. Pas, dar vak'ti kh'aiz az kh'ambistari bo zanonaton duri ch'ued va bo ch'imo' ba onkh'o nazdik nashaved, to vak'te ki khunashon k'at' shavad va bo g'usl pok shavand. Pas, chun khuni kh'aiz k'at' gashta, pok shudand, bo onkh'o ba kh'amon shevae, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton ich'ozat doda ast, ia'ne dar kh'olati poki va dar makoni naslgiri kh'ambistar shaved." Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni bisior tavbakunandaro dust medorad va bandagoni az palidi nekpokshavandaro dust medorad.

225) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro baroi k'asamkh'oi biduni k'asd ba misli "Ne, k'asam ba Allokh'", "Bale, k'asam ba Allokh'" ba zabonaton ch'orishavanda mavridi bozpursi k'aror namedikh'ad. Pas, vobasta ba in nav' savgandkh'o bar shumo kaffora va uk'ubat nest. Valekin shumoro bo on savgandkh'oe, ki az sidk'i dil k'asdan iod kardaed, mavridi bozpursi k'aror khokh'ad dod. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bakhshandai gunokh'oni bandagonash buda, bag'oiat Kh'alim ast. Bandagoni isionkorashro dar kh'ol ch'azo namedikh'ad.

226) On kasone, ki baroi tarki ch'imo' bo kh'amsaronashon savgand iod mekunand, metavonand shuru' az ruzi savgandashon chor mokh' muntazir shavand. In mas'ala dar akh'komi fik'kh'i bo nomi "Iilo'" ma'ruf ast. Pas, agar shavkh'aron ba'd az savgand khurdanashon bar tarki ch'imo' bo kh'amsaroni khesh dar muddati chor mokh' io az on kamtar ba kh'ambistari bo onkh'o bargardand, beshubkh'a, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Kh'ar chi az suii onkh'o rukh doda ast, kh'amaro mebakhshad. Az rui rakh'matash kafforaro dar in bob kh'amchun rokh'kh'al k'aror doda ast.

229) Te'dodi talok'e, ki mard dar on kh'ak'k'i bo zan dubora zindagi kardan dorad, du talok' ast. Mard metavonad talok' kunad, dubora ak'di nikokh' bandad, bori duium talok' kunad va boz bargardad. Sipas ba'd az talok'i duium io zanro dar ak'di nikokh'ash bo muoshirati kh'asana nigokh' medorad va io uro marotibai seium talok' doda, nisbatash neki mekunad va kh'uk'uk'ashro ado mesozad. Va ei mardon, baroi shumo kh'alol nest, ki az makh'ri ba kh'amsaronaton dodai khesh chizero bigired, magar on ki zan ba shavkh'arash az rui badakhlok'i io badsurati pisand naoiad va zanu shavkh'ar gumon barand, ki bo illati nabudani mukh'abbat dar miioni tarafain kh'uk'uk'i bar ukh'daashon mavch'udro vafo karda nametavonand. Pas, dar in surat boiad zanu shavkh'ar k'aziiai khudro ba kase matrakh' namoiand, ki bo onkh'o az nigokh'i kheshi io g'aira alok'a dorad. Pas, agar sarparastonashon az on tarsand, ki in zanu shavkh'ar kh'uk'uk'i mushtaraki dar bainashon muk'arrarro ado karda nametavonand, pas, bar zavch'ain gunokh'e nest, ki zan baroi giriftani talok' va rakh'osozii khud ba shavkh'ar mablag' dikh'ad. In akh'kom marzkh'oi ch'udosozandai kh'alol az kh'arom ast. Az in ch'ikh'at, az in marzkh'o naguzared. Va kh'ar on nafare az marzkh'oi miioni kh'alol va kh'arom muk'arrarsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meguzarad, pas, in gurukh' bo afkandani khesh ba kh'alokat va g'azabu azobi U bar ch'oni khud zulm kardaand.

230) Pas, agar shavkh'ar zanashro marotibai seium talok' kunad, minba'd baroi shavkh'ar nikokh'i on zan kh'alol nest, to on vak'te ki zani talok'shuda bo mardi digar bo mak'sadi zindagi, na kh'alola kardan ak'di sakh'ekh'i nikokh' bandad va shavkh'ari duiumash bo u dar in nikokh' omezishi ch'insi kunad. Pas, agar shavkh'ari duiumash zanro talok' dikh'ad io bimirad, ba'di in bar on zanu shavkh'ari sobik'ash gunokh'e nest, ki bo ak'du makh'ri ch'adid ba nazdi kh'am bargardand, agar g'olibi gumonashon on boshad, ki akh'komi shar'ii bar zimmashon voch'ibro ba ch'oi ovarda metavonand. Va in marzkh'oi mazkur akh'komi shar'i ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro baroi mardume baion mesozad, ki kh'ukm va kh'ududi Uro medonand. Zero makh'z kh'amin gurukh' az baioni on manfiat mebarand.

231) Va chun zanoni kheshro talok' doded, pas, onkh'o ba tamomshavii iddaashon nazdik shudand, shumo kh'ak' dored onkh'oro bargardoned io biduni bargardonidan to vak'ti ba okhir rasidani muddati iddaashon bo rokh'i neki rakh'oiashon kuned. Va onkh'oro ba k'asdi zarar rasonidan va dasti taarruz daroz kardan barnagardoned, chunonchi dar davroni ch'okh'iliiat dar kh'ak'k'ashon kh'amin guna muomila surat megirift. Va kh'ar ki in korro bo mak'sadi rasonidani zarar anch'om dikh'ad, pas, begumon khudro dar ma'razi gunokh' va uk'ubat k'aror doda, bar ch'onash sitam karda ast. Va oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bo mavridi bozi k'aror dodan ba tamaskhur nagired. Va ne'matkh'oero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton in'om namuda ast va ne'mati K'ur'on va sunnati ba shumo furud ovardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba iod ored. Allo (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo in ne'matkh'oro ba mak'sadi targ'ibu bim dodan ba iodaton meorad. Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo anch'omi dasturkh'o va tarki nakh'ikh'o bitarsed va bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amai chizro medonad. Kh'ech' chize az U pushida nest va kh'atman dar badali amalkh'oi anch'omdodaaton ba shumo podosh medikh'ad.

232) Va chun zanonatonro kamtar az se marotiba talok' doded va iddaashon ba okhir rasid, pas, ei sarparastoni zanon, dar in surat onkh'oro az bargashtan bo ak'd va nikokh'i ch'adid ba sui shavkh'aronashon man' nakuned, vak'te rag'bati bozgasht doshta va bo shavkh'aronashon dar bobi bark'aror kardani zindagi rozi shuda boshand. Az shumo shakhsone bo in kh'ukmi nakh'i az man'i bozgashti zanon ba sui shavkh'aronashon pand doda meshavand, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi okhirat imon dorand. In kh'ukm dar shumo nekiro beshtar rushd medikh'ad va nomusu kirdoratonro az palidi bekh'tar pok mesozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ak'ik'at va ok'ibati korkh'oro medonad va shumo onro namedoned.

233) Va boiad modaron farzandoni khudro du soli komil shir dikh'and. In ta'iini du sol baroi kase ast, ki k'asd dorad muddati shir dodani kudakro ba itmom rasonad. Va ruzii modaroni shirdikh'andai talok'shuda va bo libos ta'min kardani onkh'o tibk'i urfi mardum, ki bo shariat mukholifat nakunad, bar zimmai padari kudak voch'ib ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kasero beshtar az doirai tavonash mukallaf namegardonad. Va baroi kh'ech' nafare az padaru modar kh'alol nest, ki farzandro kh'amchun vasilai zarar rasondani tarafi digar istifoda barad. Va dar surati mavch'ud nabudani padar va doroi nadoshtani kudak, bar ukh'dai vorisi on kudak kh'uk'uk'e voch'ib meshavad, ki ich'roi on kh'uk'uk' bar ukh'dai padarash voch'ib bud. Pas, agar padaru modar k'abl az tamom shudani du sol k'asdi az shir ch'udo kardani kudakro kunand, vak'te in kor ba'di mashvarat va rozigii tarafain surat girifta, ba naf'i kudak boshad, dar in surat anch'omi on bar volidain kh'ech' gunokh'e nest. Va agar k'asd kuned, ki baroi farzandonaton g'airi modaronashon digar zanonro ba sifati doiai shirdikh'anda gired, vak'te muzdi ittifok'shudaro bo rokh'i nek, biduni nuk'son va ta'khir ba zani shirdekh' pardozed, pas, kh'ech' gunokh'e bar shumo nest. Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo anch'omi amrkh'o va parkh'ez az nakh'ikh'oiash bitarsed. Va donista boshed, ki kh'ar chi mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro mebinad. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida namemonad va kh'atman ba shumo dar ivazi kirdorkh'oiaton podosh medikh'ad.

234) Va kasone az shumo memirand va ba'd az khud kh'amsaroni g'airi kh'omilaashonro meguzorand, farz ast, ki on zankh'o az peshi khud, na bo kh'ukmi k'ozi muddati chor mokh'u dakh' ruz muntazir shavand. Dar in muddat kh'ak'k'i az khonai shavkh'ar berun shudan, khudro oroish dodan va bo mardi digar izdivoch' kardanro nadorand. Pas az in vak'te in muddat ba poion rasad, pas, dar on chi on zankh'o nisbat ba kheshtan az korkh'oi dar in muddat baroiashon mamnu' bo rokh'i az rui shariat va urfi mardum nek anch'om dikh'and, bar shumo sarparastonashon gunokh'e nest. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'ar amale mekuned, Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' chize az zokh'iru botini shumo az U pushida nest va iak'inan baroi amalkh'oiaton podoshaton medikh'ad.

235) Va dar surate, ki bo zani az vafoti shavkh'ar io az talok'i boin dar idda k'arordoshta rag'bati nikokh' doshtani khudro bo ishora, biduni oshkorbaioni izkh'or namoed, monandi on ki ba vai "Chun iddaat tamom shud, maro ogokh' bisoz" bigued, bar shumo gunokh'e nest. Io dar on ki mail doshtani khudro ba izdivoch' bo zani dar idda k'arordoshta ba'd az guzashtani iddaash pinkh'on mekuned, bar shumo gunokh'e nest. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonad, ki shumo az sababi rag'bati ziedaton ba izdivoch' zanonro iod khokh'ed kard. Binobar in, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ishora izkh'or kardani rag'batro baroi shumo ch'oiz gardonid, valekin dar muddati iddai zanon oshkor baion sokhtani rag'bati nikokh'ro man' karda ast. Ammo az on ki pinkh'oni ba zanon va'dai nikokh' dikh'ed, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o dar kh'olati idda k'aror dorand, biparkh'ezed, magar mutobik'i k'avli pisandidai bo rokh'i kinoia izkh'or sokhtani rag'bat, ki in durust ast. Va dar muddati idda to zamoni sipari gashtani on bo zanon ak'di nikokh' nabanded. Va bidoned, ki on chi dar dilaton oidi kh'alol va kh'aromkh'oi ilokh'i pinkh'on mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad. Likh'ozo, az U boekh'tiiot boshed va khilofi amrash amal nakuned. Va bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Burdbor ast. Vak'te bandagonash ch'urm mekunand, onkh'oro dar kh'ol ch'azo namedikh'ad.

236) Agar on kh'amsaronatonro, ki bo onkh'o ak'di nikokh' bastaed, k'abl az kh'ambistari bo onkh'o va k'abl az on ki makh'rashonro muaiian gardoned, talok' bidikh'ed, bar shumo gunokh'e nest. Vak'te onkh'oro dar in kh'olat talok' dikh'ed, dodani makh'r bar zimmaaton voch'ib namegardad. Va bar shavkh'aron tibk'i tavon, sarfi nazar az on ki tavongar io tangdastand dodani chize ba zanon, ki az on bakh'ra burda va boisi tasallii khotiri shikastaashon megardad, voch'ib meboshad. In andozae, ki dar chunin kh'olatkh'o ba zanon doda meshavad, bar zimmai bandagoni dar raftor va muomila nekukor kh'ak'k'i k'at'i ast.

237) Va agar kh'amsaronatonro, ki bo onkh'o ak'di nikokh' bastaed, k'abl az kh'amkhobagi bo onkh'o, dar kh'ole ki makh'rashonro muaiian sokhtaed, talok' bidikh'ed, bar shumo dodani nisfi makh'ri ta'iingashta voch'ib meshavad, magar on ki zanon khudashon az on makh'r guzasht kunand io khudi shavkh'aron bo bakhshidani makh'ri komil ba zanon guzasht kunand. Va az kh'uk'uk'i dar bainaton mushtarak az kh'amdigar guzasht namudanaton ba tars va toati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdiktar ast. Va ei mardum, dar bainaton lutfu ekh'son va az kh'amdigar guzasht kardanro tark nakuned. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Bino ast. Dar anch'omi amalkh'oi nek bo kh'adafi kasbi podoshi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) talosh namoed.

238) Bar adoi namozkh'o chunonchi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amr karda ast va khususan bar namozi bekh'tarin va miiona, ki namozi asr ast, mukh'ofizat kuned va dar namozaton dar kh'olati furutani va farmonbardori rost biisted.

239) Pas, agar az dushman va monandi on bitarsed va tavonoii ba surati komil khondani namozro nadoshta boshed, onro piioda io savorai shutur, asp va g'aira io ba kh'ar vach'kh'e, ki metavoned, ado kuned. Pas, vak'te kh'arosaton bartaraf gardad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bo tamomi nav'kh'oi zikr, az ch'umla khondani namoz ba tavri komil ed kuned, kh'amon guna ki ba shumo on chiro az nur va kh'idoiat namedonisted, ta'limaton doda ast.

240) Va on nafarone az shumo, ki memirand va ba'd az vafotashon kh'amsaronashonro meguzorand, bar onkh'o voch'ib ast, ki baroi zanonashon vasiiat kunand, ki zanon to iak soli komil bo maskan va nafak'a ta'min shuda, az on bakh'ramand gardand, vorisoni maiit kh'ak' nadorand onkh'oro az khona berun sozand. In kh'ukmi bakh'ramand gashtani zanon az maskan va nafak'a ba mak'sadi tasallii khotiri kh'amsaron va nishonai vafodorii maiit ba onkh'o ast. Pas, agar zanon k'abl az takmili iak sol az nazdi khud az khona berun shavand, dar on chi az kori shar'an nek ba misli oroish va iste'moli khushbui anch'om dodaand, bar shumo va onkh'o gunokh'e nest. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti G'olib va dar chorasozi, akh'kom va ta'iini k'azovu k'adar bag'oiat Kh'akim ast. Boiad k'aid kard, ki beshtari mufassiron kh'ukmi in oiatro bo oiati k'ablan zikrshudai "Va kasone az shumo, ki memirand va ba'd az khud kh'amsaroni g'airi kh'omilaashonro meguzorand, farz ast, ki az peshi khud, na bo kh'ukmi k'ozi ba muddati chor mokh'u dakh' ruz muntazir shavand..."[Bak'ara: 234] mansukh medonand.

241) Va boiad ba zanon baroi tasalii khotiri az vok'e'shavii talok' ozurdaashon ba k'adri imkon libos, mol va misli on kh'adia doda shavad, to az on bakh'ramand gardand. In kh'ukm bar zimmai bandagoni bo ich'roi amrkh'o va tarki nakh'ikh'o parkh'ezkor kh'ak'k'i k'at'i ast.

242) Ei mu'minon, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo oiatkh'oi darbargirandai kh'udud va akh'komashro misli baioni mazkur baion mekunad, to shoiad shumo on oiatkh'oro fakh'mida, mutobik'i on amal kuned va dar du olam sarfaroz shaved.

243) Ei Paiombar, oio baroiat khabari on kasone, ki az khonakh'oiashon ba sababi bemorii vabo io g'airi on az tarsi marg berun shudand, narasida ast? Onkh'o toifae az Farzandoni Ia'k'ub budand. Ba'd az in Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o "Bimired" guft. Bo farmoni ilokh'i murdand. Sipas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro dubora zinda gardonid, to ba onkh'o baion sozad, ki tamomi kor dar ikhtiiori U buda, onkh'o ba khud foida va zarar ovarda nametavonand. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba mardum Sokh'ibi lutfu ekh'son ast, valekin beshtari mardum shukri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o nameorand.

244) Va ei mu'minon, baroi piruzii Islom muk'obili dushmanon dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bich'anged. Bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavo va Dono ast. Sukhanatonro meshunavad va niiatu kirdoratonro medonad. Kh'atman dar ivazi kh'ar koraton ba shumo podosh medikh'ad.

245) Chi kase kh'amchun k'arzdikh'anda amal karda, molashro ba niiati nek va kholisona dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kharch' menamoiad, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moli uro chand barobar beshtar baroiash bargardonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ruzi, tandurusti va g'aira az rui kh'ikmat va adolat tangi va farokhi meorad. Va ruzi okhirat tankh'o ba sui U bargardonida meshaved. On ruz ba shumo dar badali a'molaton podosh medikh'ad.

246) Ei Paiombar, oio baroiat khabari ashrofoni Bani Isroil, ki ba'd az favti Muso (alaikh'is salom) zistaand, narasida ast? On gokh', ki onkh'o ba paiombarashon guftand: "Baroi mo podshokh'ero barguzin, to bo u dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bich'angem." Paiombarashon ba onkh'o guft: "Agar ch'angidan dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo farz gardonida shavad, shoiad namech'anged." Onkh'o pindori paiombarashonro inkor kardand va guftand: "Moro kadom monea az ch'angidan dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boz medorad, kh'ol on ki omilkh'oi tak'ozokunandai ch'ang vuch'ud dorad?! Dushmanonamon moro az sarzaminkh'oiamon berun sokhtand va farzandonamonro asir giriftand. Mo baroi bozpas giriftani sarzaminkh'o va az asorat ozod sokhtani farzandonamon mech'angem." Pas, vak'te ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar onkh'o ch'angidanro farz gardonid, az ich'roi farmon rui toftand va ba va'dai khud, ba g'air az shumorai andak vafo nakardand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zolimonero, ki az farmonash rui gardonida, akh'di kheshro meshikanand, medonad va baroi in amal onkh'oro ch'azo khokh'ad dod.

247) Va paiombarashon ba onkh'o guft: "Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Tolutro baroi shumo podshokh' barguzida ast, to zeri parchami u bich'anged." Ashrofoni Bani Isroil in intikhobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro inkor karda va bo e'tiroz guftand: "Chitavr Tolut bar mo saltanat doshta metavonad, dar kh'ole ki mo dar bobi saltanat az vai sazovortarem, chunki u az shokh'zodagon nest. Va baroiash doroii gusturdae, ki bo istifoda az on mamlakatro idora kunad, doda nashuda ast. U bo in kh'ol chi guna podshokh'i mekunad?" Paiombarashon guft: "Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro bar shumo barguzida va vus'ati ilmi va nerui ch'ismonii uro dar k'iios bo shumo afzun sokhta ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) podshokh'iashro az rui kh'ikmat va rakh'mati Khud ba kh'ar nafare khokh'ad, medikh'ad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) doroi lutfu ekh'soni pakh'novar buda, bar kh'ar ki kh'ar chi khokh'ad, ato menamoiad. U bandagoni sazovori fazlashro medonad."

248) Va paiombarashon ba onkh'o guft: "Ba durusti ki alomati rost budani podshokh' intikhob shudani Tolut on ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo sanduk'ro barmegardonad, dar on ekh'sosi oromish az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton va monandi aso va takhtakh'oi Tavrot iodgorikh'oi guzoshtai khonadoni Muso va khonadoni Kh'orun ast. Farishtagon onro mebardorand. Agar shumo dar kh'ak'ik'at mu'mined, beshubkh'a, baroiaton dar in sanduk' alomati ravshan bar saltanati u ast."

249) Pas, chun Tolut kh'amrokh'i lashkariion az shakh'r berun shud, ba onkh'o guft: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro ba vositai rudkhonae mesanch'ad. Pas, kh'ar kas az obi on binushad, dar rokh'i man nest va maro dar ch'angidan alaikh'i dushmanon kh'amrokh'i namekunad. Va kh'ar kas az obi on nanushad, pas, u dar rokh'i man ast, bo man dar nabardi dushman kh'amrokh' meshavad, magar on kase, ki az rui mach'buri, az obi dario ba andozai iak mushti dastash binushad." Pas, tamomi lashkarien ob nushidand, magar te'dodi andake, ki bo vuch'udi tanshangii sakht sabr kardand va nanushidand. Pas, vak'te Tolut bo mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ash az dario guzashtand, gurukh'e az lashkariionash guftand: "Mo imruz tavoni onro nadorem, ki muk'obili Tolut va lashkarash bich'angem." Dar on vak't kasone, ki ba mulok'oti khesh bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ruzi okhirat iak'in doshtand, guftand: "Chi baso gurukh'i andaki mu'minon bo ich'ozat va kumaki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) alaikh'i gurukh'i ziedi kofiron piruz gashtaand. Zero dar piruzi imon e'tibor dorad, na shumora. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo bandagoni sabrkunandaash ast. Onkh'oro madad va ta'iid mekunad."

250) Va chun Tolut bo lashkariioni mu'minash baroi muk'obili Ch'olut va lashkariionash ch'angidan berun shuda, saf kashidand, bo duovu iltich'o ba Parvardigor rui ovarda guftand: "Parvardigori mo, bar k'albkh'oiamon sabr birez va k'adamkh'oiamonro ustuvor bisoz, to az maidon nagurezem va dar muk'obili dushman shikast nakhurem va bo neru va madadi Khud moro alaikh'i kofiron piruz bigardon."

251) Pas, onkh'o bo ich'ozati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dushmanonashonro shikast dodand va Dovud rakh'barashon Ch'olutro ba k'atl rasonid va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiash saltanatu nubuvvat dod va uro az nav'kh'oi gunoguni donishkh'oi mekhostaash omuzond. Khairi duniovu okhiratro dar u ch'am' ovard. Va agar iake az k'onunkh'oi sobiti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chunin namebud, ki fasodi ba'zero ba vositai ba'zei digarashon bartaraf mesozad, ba durusti ki zamin bo kh'ukmfarmo gashtani fasodkoron tabokh' megasht, valekin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i kh'amai mavch'udot Sokh'ibi lutfu ekh'son ast.

252) In oiatkh'oi ravshani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Ei Paiombar, Mo onro bar tu ba rosti tilovat mekunem. In oiatkh'o shomili khabarkh'oi durust va kh'ukmkh'oi odilona ast. Va beshubkh'a, tu az firistodagoni Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion kh'asti.

253) In paiombaronero, ki baroi tu zikr kardem, ba'zeashonro dar paig'om, te'dodi ziiodi pairavon va darach'ot bar ba'zei digar bartari dodem. Az miioni onkh'o ba misli Muso (alaikh'is salom) shakhsest, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo vai guftugu karda ast va darach'akh'oi ba'zero ba misli Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) baland bardoshta ast. Zero Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba kulli mardum firistoda shuda, bo omadanash nubuvvat ba okhir rasida va ummatonash az digar ummaton bartarand. Va Mo ba Isoi pisari Mariam (alaikh'is salom), az k'abili zinda sokhtani murdagon, solim gardonidani ashkhosi duchori bemorii makhav va kuri modarzod mu'ch'izakh'oi ravshani isbotkunandai nubuvvatashro dodem va uro bo mak'sadi dar ich'roi dasturotamon k'uvvat bakhshidan ba vositai Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom) madad namudem. Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, kasone, ki pas az paiombaron omadand, ba'di ba onkh'o omadani dalelkh'oi vozekh' muk'obili iakdigar namech'angidand, lekin onkh'o ikhtilof namudand va ba du gurukh' ch'udo shudand. Pas, az onkh'o ba'zeashon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardand va az onkh'o ba'zeashon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir gashtand. Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, onkh'o alaikh'i kh'amdigar namech'angidand, valekin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar chi khokh'ad, mekunad. Kh'ar kasero bikhokh'ad, bo fazlu rakh'matash ba suii imon kh'idoiat mekunad va kh'ar kasero khokh'ad, bo adolatu kh'ikmatash gumrokh' mesozad.

254) Ei mu'minon! Az on chi ba shumo az nav'kh'oi gunoguni moli kh'alol ruzi dodaem, k'abl az omadani ruzi k'iiomat kharch' kuned, ruze ki dar on na savdoest, to inson foida kh'osil namoiad va na dustii kh'angomi sakhti sudmand va na shafoat. Shafoati ruzi okhirat tankh'o bo ich'ozati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) surat megirad. Va kofiron zolimoni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand. Zero onkh'o ba Ofaridgori Iagona kufr mevarzand.

255) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) On Zotest, ki ch'uz U ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ii loik'i ibodat vuch'ud nadorad, kh'amesha Zinda, Nigakh'dori ch'akh'oni kh'asti va az mavch'udot beniioz ast, kh'astii mavch'udot ba U taalluk' doshta, kh'argiz az U beniioz namegardad, Uro pinak va khob faro namegirad, farmonravoii tamomi mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az oni Ust, kh'ech' kas nazdash baroi kase moliki shafoat nest, magar ba'd az ich'ozat va rizoi U, on chi dar guzashta az umuri bandagonash rukh doda va on chi dar oianda rukh khokh'ad dod, kh'amaro medonad va khaloik' az ilmi U chizero ikh'ota namekunand, magar on chiro, ki Khud onkh'oro az on ogokh' gardonad, kursii (ch'oi du k'adam) -i U osmonkh'o va zaminro bo vuch'udi vus'at va buzurgiashon ikh'ota kunonida ast va nigakh'dorii osmonkh'ovu zamin bar U sangini nameorad va U Balandmartabai dar saltanatash Sokh'ibazamat ast.

256) Dar vorid shudan ba Islom mach'bur sokhtani kase ravo nest, zero kh'ak' budani in din oshkor ast va mach'bur kardan dar paziruftani on zarurat nadorad. Begumon rokh'i rost az gumrokh'i ch'udo shuda ast. Pas, kh'ar ki ba on chi g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parastida meshavad, kofir shuda, az on bezori mech'uiad va ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon meorad, beshubkh'a, baroi nach'ot ioftan ba k'avitarin dastovez, ki kh'argiz k'at' namegardad, chang zada ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavoi Dono ast. Guftori bandagonashro meshunavad va kirdorashonro medonad.

257) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kasonero, ki imon ovardaand, sarparasti mekunad, ba onkh'o tavfik'u nusrat mebakhshad, onkh'oro az torikikh'oi kufru nodoni ba sui rushnoii imonu donish berun mesozad. Va kasone, ki kofir shudaand, sarparastonashon butkh'oiand, ma'budkh'oi botilashon kufrro dar nazarashon oroish doda, onkh'oro az rushnoii imonu donish ba sui torikikh'oi kufru nodoni berun mesozand. In gurukh' boshandagoni duzakh meboshand. Onkh'o dar onch'o abadi memonand.

Chun Khudovand dar oiati guzashta du gurukh'i kofiru mu'minro zikr namud, dar oiati zerin baroi kh'ar kadomi on misol ovarda guft:
258) Ei Paiombar, oio kh'ech' rukhdodero az ch'ur'ati on tug'iongar, ki bo Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) dar borai kholik'iiat va iagonagii Parvardigorash ch'idol namud, shigiftangeztar didai? Sababi in ch'asorati on bandai sarkash dar on bud, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba vai saltanat dod va saltanat boisi tug'ionash gardid. Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) baroiash sifatkh'oi Parvardigorro baion karda guft: "Parvardigori man Zotest, ki khaloik'ro zinda mesozad va memironad." On bandai tug'iongar az rui siteza guft: "Man niz bo rokh'i e'loni afv va kushtan kh'ar kiro khokh'am, zinda megardonam va kh'ar kiro khokh'am, memironam." Pas, Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) daleli buzurgtarero ovarda guft: "Ba durusti, On Parvardigore, ki man meparastam, oftobro az samti mashrik' meorad. Pas, tu onro az ch'onibi mag'rib biiovar." Ba'd az ovardani in burkh'on, on shakhsi tug'iongari mutakabbir dar kh'airat monda, az sababi nerumandii daleli ovardai Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) mag'lub shud. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba zolimon tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro namedikh'ad. Illati makh'rum shudan az kh'idoiat zulm va tug'ioni onkh'ost.

259) Io oio kasero misli on bandae didai, ki az nazdi dekh'ae dar kh'ole ki sak'fi khonakh'oiash aftoda, devorkh'oiash kharob gashta, sokinonash kh'alok shuda, ba makoni vakh'shatnoke tabdil iofta bud, guzasht? On mard bo taach'ch'ub guft: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chi guna akh'li in dekh'aro ba'd az margashon zinda megardonad?!" Pas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on mardro ba muddati sad sol mironida, sipas zindaash sokhta pursid: "Chand muddat dar kh'olati marg istodi?" Dar posukh guft: "Muddati iak io nim ruz." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft: "Balki sad soli purra chunin istodi. Inak ba taomu sharobi kh'amrokh'at buda nazar andoz. On du bar kh'olati khud bok'i monda, digargun nashuda ast. Kh'ol on ki dar asl taomu sharob zud tag'iir meiobad. Va ba darozgushi murdaat nigokh' kun. Va Mo in korro kardem, to turo baroi mardum dar bobi zinda sokhtani murdagon alomati ravshani isbotkunandai k'udrati ilokh'i gardonem. Pas, ustukhonkh'oi pora-pora ch'udoshudai darozgushatro bubin, ki Mo onro chi guna bardoshta, ba'zeashro ba ba'zei digar zam mekunem, sipas, ba'd az in ba on ustukhonkh'o gusht mepushonem va onro zinda megardonem." Pas, chun on mard in kh'olatro did, kh'ak'ik'ati kor baroiash ma'lum shuda, ba tavonoii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iak'in kh'osil namud va bo e'tirof guft: "Man ba iak'in medonam, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ama chiz Tavono ast."

260) Va ei Paiombar, zamonero ba iod biior, ki Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) khitob ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gufta bud: "Ei Parvardigoram, ba man nishon bidekh', ki murdagonro chiguna zinda megardoni?" Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba vai guft: "Oio ba in imon naovardai?" Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Bale, imon ovardaam, valekin mekhokh'am oromishi k'albam afzun gardad." Pas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro dastur doda guft: "Az parandagon chakh'or adadro bigir, pas, onkh'oro ba khud nazdik karda, pora-pora bikun, sipas bar kh'ar kukh'e az kukh'kh'oi atrofat ch'uz'e az on parandagonro biguzor, ba'd az on onkh'oro ba ch'onibi khesh bikhon, onkh'o zinda gashta, shitobon nazdat meoiand. Va ei Ibrokh'im, bidon, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar mulkash G'olibi Shikastnopazir, dar amr, akh'kom va ofarinish bag'oiat Kh'akim ast."

261) Sifati sadak'akh'oi on mu'minone, ki molkh'oi khudro dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sarf mekunand, monandi sifati donai dar zamini serkh'osil koshtai dekh'k'on ast. On dona kh'aft khusha meruionad, kh'ar iak khusha sad dona dorad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kh'ar kas az bandagonash khokh'ad, chand barobar beshtar podosh doda, muzdi bekh'isob ato mekunad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Sokh'ibi ekh'soni farogir buda, shakhsoni sazovori ach'ri beshtarro medonad.

262) On kasone, ki molkh'oiashonro dar rokh'i toat va rizoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kharch' menamoiand, sipas ba dunboli moli bakhshidaashon bo zabonu amal minnat nameguzorand, zero minnat amalashonro botil mesozad va ba sadak'agiranda bo minnat guzoshtan ozor namerasonand, muzdi onkh'o nazdi Parvardigorashon ast va bar onkh'o az kh'avodisi okhirat tarse nest va onkh'o baroi on chi dar dunio az dast dodaand, andukh'gin nameshavand. Zero ruzi k'iiomat sokh'ibi ne'mati buzurgi abadi megardand.

263) Guftani sukhani neki khushkh'olsozandai mu'min va bakhshidani gunokh'i shakhsi dar kh'ak'k'at badi ravo dida az sadak'ae, ki ba dunboli on nisbat ba shakhsi sadak'agirifta minnat va ozor surat megirad, bekh'tar ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Beniiozi Burdbor ast. Ba kh'ech' kas az khaloik' niiozmand nest va bandagonashro zud ch'azo namedikh'ad.

264) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, savobi sadak'ai kheshro bo minnat nikh'odan bar shakhsi fak'ir va ozor dodanash tabokh' nagardoned. Sifati chunin shakhs misli sifati kasest, ki molashro ba mak'sadi on ki mardum uro dida, madkh' kunand, kharch' mesozad va ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi k'iiomatu savobu ik'obi on imon nadorad. Pas dostoni on shakhs ba dostoni sangi kh'amvore shabokh'at dorad, ki dar rui on khok bud, pas ba on sang boroni ziiod rasidu khoki onro dur kard, pas sangro sakhti biduni g'ubor guzosht. Kh'olati ashkhosi riiokor niz chunin ast. Savobi a'mol va sadak'otashon az bain meravad va nazdi Khudo kh'ech' chizi on bok'i namemonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofironro ba korkh'oi mavridi rizoiash va dar okhirat sudmand rakh'namoi namekunad.

265) Va sifati kasone, ki ba khotiri talabi rizoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ba khotiri az umk'i dil ba va'dai U bovaru iak'in doshtan, biduni mach'buri molkh'oiashonro sarf mekunand, monandi sifati bustonest dar makoni baland, ki boroni bisior ba on rasida, pas mevai duchand dikh'ad. Pas agar boroni bisior ba on narasad, pas boroni sabuk rasida, az sababi serkh'osilii zamin ba boroni andak iktifo kunad. Sadak'ai bandagoni boikhlos niz chunin ast. Khudo onro agarchi kam kh'am boshad, mepazirad va dar ivaz chand barobar afzuntar podosh medikh'ad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Bino ast. Akh'voli bandagoni boikhlosu riiokor az U pushida nest va ba kh'ar kas ch'azoi bosazo khokh'ad dod.

Sipas Khudo dar oiati zerin misoli kh'olati kasero, ki molashro az rui riiokori kharch' mekunad, baion namuda meguiad:
266) Oio kase az shumo dust medorad, ki moliki bog'i darakhtoni khurmo va angure boshad, ki az vasati on obkh'oi shirin ch'ori shavad, uro dar onch'o kh'ar nav' mevakh'oi khushtam' boshad va ba u pironsoli rasida, kor kardan natavonad va farzandoni khurdsoli az kor notavon doshta boshad, dar in kh'angom ba on bog' girdbode, ki dar on otash ast, birasad, pas bog' komilan bisuzad, dar kh'ole ki sokh'ibash az sababi pironsoli va za'fi farzandonash ba on niiozmand ast?! Kh'olati kase, ki molashro az rui g'arazi riiokori kharch' mekunad, ba kh'amin monand ast. Shakhsi riiokor ruzi k'iiomat, ki ba kamtarin neki niioz dorad, vak'ti nazdi Khudo meoiad, podoshe nameiobad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amin guna baroi shumo chizkh'oi dar duniovu okhirat sudmandro baion mesozad, to shoiad shumo dar borai on andesha kuned.

267) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, az ba'zei moli kh'aloli pokizai kasbkardai khud va az ba'zei on chi Mo baroiaton az nabototi zamin berun ovardaem, kharch' kuned. Va ba kharch' namudani moli pastsifat rui naored, kh'ol on ki agar on mol ba khudaton doda shavad, onro ch'uz bo chashmpushi va tab'i khira namegired. Pas chiguna on chiro ba khud ravo namebined, ba Khudo ravo mebined va mepisanded?! Va bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Beniiozi Sutuda ast. Az korkh'oi khairi shumo beniioz ast.

Chun Khudo dar oiati mazkur mu'minonro ba kharch'i moli kh'aloli pokiza amr kard, dar oiati zerin onkh'oro az vasvasai Shaiton barkh'azar doshta guft:
268) Shaiton shumoro az tangdasti tarsonida, ba bukhl varzidan targ'ib mekunad va shumoro ba anch'om dodani korkh'oi fakh'shi zinokori, kushtor, tarki namozu zakot va g'aira da'vat menamoiad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo mag'firati gunokh'on va ruzii gusturdaro va'da medikh'ad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Sokh'ibii ekh'soni pakh'novar, Donandai akh'voli bandagon ast.

269) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ikmat (dar guftoru kirdor dariofti rokh'i durust)-ro ba kh'ar kas az bandagon khokh'ad, medikh'ad va kh'ikmat ba kh'ar kas doda shavad, pas begumon baroiash khairi ziiod ato shuda ast. Va az oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pand namegirand, magar sokh'iboni khiradi komil, ki az nur va rakh'namoii K'ur'on rushnoi mech'uiand.

270) Va kh'ar chize az moli ziiodu kam bo kh'adafi talabi rizoi ilokh'i kharch' kardaed io az nazdi khud biduni on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro mukallaf sozad, anch'omi ibodatero az rokh'i nazr bar khud lozim gardonidaed, pas begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad. Kh'ech' chiz nazdi U zoe' namegardad va ba shumo podoshi buzurgtarin khokh'ad dod. Va zolimone, ki kh'uk'uk'i bar zimmaashon voch'ibro man' namuda, az marzkh'oi Khudo tach'ovuz mekunand, ruzi k'iiomat baroi peshgirii uk'ubati ilokh'i iovarone nadorand.

271) Agar sadak'akh'oi kheshro oshkor sozed, pas chi sadak'ai khubest va agar onro pinkh'on nigokh' dored va ba fak'iron dikh'ed, in amali pinkh'oni baroi shumo az oshkor kardanash bekh'tar ast, zero chunin tarzi amal ba ikhlos nazdiktar meboshad. Va Khudo az shumo ba'ze gunokh'onatonro makh'v mesozad. Chunki sadak'ai bandagoni boikhlos boisi pushida mondan va mag'firati gunokh'on megardad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Bokhabar buda, akh'voli shumo az U pushida nest.

272) Ei Paiombar, kh'idoiat namudani onkh'o baroi paziruftani kh'ak' va taslim shudan ba on bar zimmai tu nest, balki mas'uliiati tu az on iborat ast, ki onkh'oro ba sui kh'ak'ik'at rakh'namoi karda, bo on oshno megardoni. Valekin kh'idoiati tavfik' ba sui kh'ak'ik'at dar dasti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, onro ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, medikh'ad. Va on chi az mol kharch' mekuned, pas foidai on ba shumo barmegardad, zero Khudo az on beniioz ast. Va boiad sadak'akh'oi shumo kholisan lillokh' anch'om iobad. Zero mu'minoni kh'ak'ik'i moli khudro ba ch'uz k'asdi talabi rizoi Parvardigor bo digar mak'sad kharch' namekunand. Va on chi az moli kamu ziiod kharch' mekuned, pas begumon podoshi on ba shumo ba tavri komil doda meshavad va shumo zulm nameshaved. Chunki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kase sitam namekunad.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi k'abli dar rokh'i Khud kharch' kardani molro zikr karda, mu'minonro ba sui in amal da'vat namud, dar oiati zerin mavze'kh'oi kharch'ashro baion namuda guft:
273) Sadak'akh'oi kheshro ba fak'irone kharch' kuned, ki ch'ikh'od onkh'oro az safari talabi ruzi boz doshta, shakhsi az kh'olatashon bekhabar az sababi on ki az tama'kori pokdomani mech'uiand, onkh'oro tavongar mekh'isobad va shakhsi az kh'olashon ogokh' onkh'oro bo alomatashon az namoion budani osori niiozmandi bar ch'ismkh'o va liboskh'oiashon meshinosad, az ch'umlai sifatashon on ast, ki onkh'o misli digar fak'iron kh'och'atashonro az mardum boisror namepursand. Va on chi az mol va g'aira kharch' mekuned, pas iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad. Kh'atman baroi in amal podoshaton khokh'ad dod.

274) Kasone, ki molkh'oiashonro ba khotiri talabi rizoi Khudo shab va ruz, oshkor va pinkh'on, biduni khudnamoi kharch' mekunand, pas onkh'oro ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigorashon podoshi buzurg ast va bar onkh'o az kh'avodisi on okhirat tarse nest va onkh'o baroi on chi dar dunio az dast dodaand, g'amgin nameshavand, zero ba lutfi Khudo noil megardand.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi iodshuda mu'minonro ba kharch'i mol dar rokh'i khud tashvik' kard, zero dar in kor kh'amkori va kh'ambastagii musulmonon mavch'ud ast, dar oiati zerin az amali ribokhurii khilofi kh'ambastagii akh'li imon kh'ushdor dod va guft:
275) On kasone, ki bo ribo muomila mekunand va ribo megirand, ruzi k'iiomat az k'abrkh'oiashon ba monandi kase barmekhezand, ki Shaiton uro bo rasonidani oseb devona sokhta ast. Shakhsi ribokhur ruzi k'iiomat az k'abrash monandi devona aftonu khezon barmekhezad. In ba sababi on ast, ki onkh'o ribokhuriro kh'alol shumurdand va baini ribovu kasbi kh'alol fark' naguzoshta guftand: "Kh'amono tich'orat az nigokh'i kh'alol budan misli ribo ast. Zero kh'ar du nav'i muomila molro afzoish medikh'ad." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) da'voi onkh'oro rad namuda, k'iiosashonro botil gardonid va durug'guiashonro nishon doda, baion kard, ki U tich'oratro az sababi on ki manfiati umumi va khususi dorad, kh'alol va riboro az sababi on ki dar on mardum mavridi zulm k'aror girifta va molashon bo rokh'i nomashru' khurda meshavad, kh'arom gardonida ast. Pas ba kh'ar ki az nazdi Parvardigorash pande biioiad, ki dar on vobasta ba ribo nakh'i va kh'ushdor vorid shuda ast, pas az in amal khuddori karda, ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavba kunad, pas, on chi dar guzashta az ribo girifta ast, az oni ust va bar u gunokh'e nest va mas'alai afv shudanash ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vobastagi dorad. Va kh'ar ki ba'd az on ki dar bobati ribo nakh'ii Parvardigor ba u rasida va kh'uch'ch'at alaikh'ash barpo gardida ast, ba porakhuri bargardad, pas, inkh'o sazovori daromadani duzakh buda, onch'o ba tavri darozmuddat memonand. Ma'noi "ch'ovid mondan dar duzakh", ki dar lafzi arabii in oiat oidi ribokhuron omada ast, ba mak'sadi "istodani tuloni" ast. Zero dar duzakh tankh'o kofiron abadi meistand va mu'minon onch'o ch'ovidon namemonand.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati bolo kharch' kardani mol dar rokh'i Khudo va kh'ukmi ribokhuriro ovard, dar oiati zail fark'i on duro az likh'ozi ch'azo baion karda guft:
276) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moli az ribo kh'osilgashtaro io ba tavri kh'issi io ba tavri ma'navi bo bebarakat gardonidan nobud karda, az bain mebarad va sadak'akh'oro bo duchand sokhtani podoshi on afzoish va rushd medikh'ad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar muk'obili iak amali shoista az dakh' to kh'afsad va az on kh'am beshtar ivazi nek mebakhshad va dar moli shakhsoni sadak'akunanda barakat ato mesozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amai kofiri sitezach'ui gunakh'kori kh'alolshumorandai kh'aromro dust namedorad.

277) Kh'amono kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, az Paiombarash pairavi kardaand va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand va namozro tibk'i farmudai Shariat ba tavri komil barpo doshtaand va ba shakhsoni loik' zakoti moli kheshro pardokhtaand, onkh'oro podoshashon nazdi Parvardigorashon ast va bar onkh'o az kh'odisakh'oi ikhirat tarse nest va onkh'o baroi on chi dar dunio az dast dodaand, g'amgin nameshavand.

278) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo anch'omi farmonkh'o va duri ch'ustan az kh'aromkh'o bitarsed va molkh'oi az rokh'i ribo kasbshudai nazdi mardum bok'iro talab nakuned, agar dar kh'ak'ik'at ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va kh'ukmi k'at'ii kh'arom budani sudkhuri imon doshta boshed.

279) Pas, agar akh'komi amrshudaro ba ch'o naored, pas ogokh' boshed va iak'in kuned, ki az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash bo ch'angi buzurge rubaru megarded. Va agar tavba namuda, muomilai sudkhuriro tark sozed, pas kh'ak'k'i giriftani sarmoiai molkh'oi k'arz dodaatonro dored. Ba kase bo beshtar giriftan az sarmoiai molaton zulm namekuned va khudi shumo bo kam giriftani on mavridi zulm k'aror namegired.

280) Va agar shakhse, ki molatonro az vai talab mekuned, tangdast boshad va k'udrati pardokhti k'arzatonro nadoshta boshad, pas talabi k'arzatonro to paido kardani mol va k'odir gashtanash ba pardokhti on ba ta'khir guzored. Va agar bar on shakhsi k'arzdori fak'ir bo talab nakardani moli khesh io bakhshidani ba'zei k'arz sadak'a kuned, baroiaton bekh'tar ast. Agar fazilati in korro nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) doned, dar ich'roi on sakh'langori nakuned va kh'ar chi zudtar onro amali gardoned.

281) Va az azobi ruze bitarsed, ki dar on kh'amagi ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardonida shuda, nazdash kh'ozir megarded, sipas ba kh'ar kas ch'azoi neki va badii amalash purra doda meshavad, kh'ol on ki dar on ruz ba onkh'o bo kamshavii savobi nekikh'o io ziiodshavii uk'ubati badikh'o zulm nameshavad.

282) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, vak'te bo iakdigar muomilai k'arzi karda, ba'zeaton ba ba'zei digar to iak muddati muaiian k'arz medikh'ad, pas, onro navised va boiad dar baini shumo navisandae ba rostivu adolat va mutobik' ba shariat ak'dro navisad va naboiad kotib az navishtani in ak'd ba on shevae, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiash az navishtani odilona ta'lim doda ast, khuddori namoiad. Pas boiad kotib baioni shakhsi vomgirro ba sifati ak'di ch'onibain navisad va boiad vomgir kalimakh'oi navishtashavandaro imlo kunad, to bo in rokh' ba madiun budani khud ik'ror namoiad. Va kotib az Allokh'i Parvardigorash bitarsad va az andoza io nav'i k'arz chizero kam nakunad. Pas agar vomgir bekhirad boshad va az ukh'dai tasarrufi durust nabaroiad io az sababi khurdsoli va io devonagi notavon boshad va io ba illati gungi va monandi on imlo karda natavonad, pas boiad ba ch'oi vai sarparasti korash bo adolat kalimakh'oi kitobatshavandaro imlo kunad. Va kh'angomi navishtani ak'd az du mardi ok'ili odil guvokh'i bitalabed. Pas agar shokh'idon mardoni ok'ili odil naboshand, pas guvokh'ii iak mard va du zanero talab namoed, ki diionat va amonatashon pisandaton boshad, zero agar iake az on du zan shakh'odatashro az khotir barorad, zani duiumi shokh'id onro ba iodash meorad. Va chun az shokh'idon talab shavad, ki dar bobi k'arz guvokh'i dikh'and, naboiad az shakh'odat khuddori namoiand, balki chun az onkh'o shakh'odat darkhost meshavad, ich'roi on bar zimmashon voch'ib megardad. Va az navishtani ak'di k'arz to muddati muaiiani on, sarfi nazar az kam io ziiod budanash susti, kamkh'avsalagi va beparvoi nakuned. Zero navishtani k'arz dar shar'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boinsoftar va dar adoi guvokh'i durusttar va baroi on ki dar mavridi nav', mik'dor va muddatash duchori shubkh'a nagarded, k'aribtar ast, magar dar surate, ki ak'di miioni shumo tich'orati nak'dii dast ba dast boshad, pas dar in surat az sababi adami kh'och'at dar tark kardani navishtani k'arz bar shumo gunokh'e nest. Va chun bo iakdigar kharidu furukht karded, ba mak'sadi peshgirii sababkh'oi nofakh'mi guvokh' k'aror dikh'ed. Va naboiad ba kotiboni ak'd va shokh'idon zarar rasonida shavad. Inchunin naboiad kotibon va shokh'idon ba shakhse, ki az onkh'o talabi navishtan io shakh'odat namuda ast, zarar rasonidand. Va agar az ch'onibi shumo ch'urmi zarar dodan surat girad, pas begumon in amal shumoro az ibodati Khudo ba ma'siiat khorich' mesozad. Va ei mu'minon, az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi dasturotash bitarsed va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo chizkh'oero ta'lim medikh'ad, ki dar on saodati duniovu okhirat ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ama chizro medonad. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida namemonad.

283) Va agar shumo musofir boshed va kotibe naiobed, ki baroiaton ak'di k'arzro navisad, pas garav guzoshtani ch'onibi k'arzgiranda, ki k'arzdikh'anda onro to vak'ti giriftani k'arz ba sifati kafolat nigokh' dorad, basanda ast. Pas agar ba'zeaton ba ba'zei digar e'timod kunad, navishtani ak'dnomai k'arz, shokh'id ovardan va guzoshtani garav zarurat nadorad va dar in surat k'arz bar zimmai vomgir amonat megardad. Adoi on voch'ib buda va boiad dar nigakh'dorii on az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tarsida, az on chizero inkor nakunad. Pas agar vai amonati giriftaashro inkor sozad, bar shakhsi shokh'idi on muomila guvokh'i dodan voch'ib meboshad. Va shokh'idi dodanro pinkh'on nakuned. Va kh'ar ki shokh'idi dodanro pinkh'on mekunad, pas begumon k'albash k'albi badkor ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar on chi anch'om medikh'ed, medonad. Az U kh'ech' chiz pushida namemonad va dar ivazi amalkh'oiaton ba shumo podosh khokh'ad dod.

284) Tamomi mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va mavch'udoti zamin az likh'ozi ofarinish, molikiiat va chorasozi tankh'o az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va agar on chiro dar dilaton dored, oshkor io pinkh'on kuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad va az on shumoro bozpursi menamoiad. Pas az in az rui fazlu rakh'matash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, mebakhshad va az rui adolat va kh'ikmatash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, azob mekunad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ar chiz K'odir ast.

285) Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba kh'amai on chi az nazdi Parvardigorash ba vai furud ovarda shuda ast, imon dorad va mu'minon niz imon dorand.
