Ch'umlagi ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va tamomi farishtagonash va kulli Kitobkh'oi ba paiombaron nozilkarda va paiombaroni firistodaash imon ovardaand. Onkh'o imon ovarda meguiand: "Baini kase az paiombaroni Khudo fark' nameguzorem." Va meguiand: "On chi moro ba on amr va on chi moro az on nakh'i namudai, shunidem va bo ich'roi dasturotat Turo itoat namudem va ei Parvardigori mo, az Tu omurzishi gunokh'onamonro mekhokh'em va dar tamomi kor bozgashti mo tankh'o ba sui Tu ast."

286) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kase ch'uz ba andozai tavonash korero mukallaf namesozad. Chunki dini Khudo oson va az mashak'k'at kholi ast. Kh'ar ki kori khaire anch'om dikh'ad, pas podoshi onro purra megirad va kh'ar ki kori bade anch'om dikh'ad, pas ch'azoi kardaashro megirad va kase gunokh'i uro ba zimma girifta nametavonad. Paiombaronu mu'minon megund: "Ei Parvardigori mo, agar mo dar kirdor io guftore beikhtiior faromush io khato kardem, moro uk'ubat makun. Ei Parvardigori mo, va moro ba anch'omi korkh'oe mukallaf magardon, ki baroiamon mashak'k'atovar va az doirai tok'atamon berun boshad, on guna ki ummatkh'oi guzashtaro ba monandi iakh'udikh'o baroi sitamkoriashon ch'azo doda, ba anch'omi chunin korkh'oi berun az doirai tok'atashon mukallaf namudi. Va bar mo amru nakh'ii dushvorero, ki tok'ati onro nadoshta boshem, kh'aml makun va az gunokh'onamon darguzar va moro mag'firat namo va bo fazlat moro mavridi rakh'matat k'aror bidekh', Tu Sarvaru Madadrasoni mo kh'asti, pas moro alaikh'i k'avmi kofir piruz bigardon."

1)	"Alif. Lom. Mim". Monandi in kh'uruf dar ibtidoi surai "Bak'ara" niz omada ast. Ovardani kh'arfkh'oi mazkur ba notavonii mardumi Arab ishora mekunad. Onkh'o da'voi zabondoni karda, khudro dar fasokh'atu balog'ati kalom az digaron bartar mekh'isobidand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ovardani ba'ze az kh'urufi alifbo nishon dod, ki K'ur'oni Karim az kh'amin kh'arfkh'o iborat ast. Agar mushrikoni Arab dar da'voi khesh, ki guio K'ur'oni Karim boftai shakhsii Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ast, sodik' boshand, pas, voridi maidoni sukhanvari shuda, monandi on kitobe ta'lif namoiand. Ammo mushrikoni da'vogari sukhanvari kh'ar bor az ich'roi in peshnikh'od och'iz gashta, kh'atto iak oiati kutokh'i shabekh'i K'ur'on ovarda nametavonistand.

2) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki ba ch'uz U digar ma'budi barkh'ak'k'i loik'i ibodat nest, kh'amesha Zindavu Poidor ba Zoti Khesh va az kh'ama Beniioz ast, ammo bak'oi mavch'udot ba U vobasta buda, kh'argiz chize az U beniioz namegardad.

3-4 Ei Paiombar, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) K'ur'onro ba tu bo sadok'at dar akhbor va adolat dar akh'kom furud nozil namud, on bo Kitobkh'oi ilokh'ii guzashta mutobik' buda, baini K'ur'on va digar Kitobkh'oi osmoni ziddiiat nest. Va k'abl az on ki K'ur'onro ba tu nozil sozad, Tavrotro ba Muso va Inch'ilro ba Iso (alaikh'is salom) furud ovarda ast. Tamomi in Kitobkh'oi osmoni kh'idoiatgari mardum ba khairi duniovu okhirat meboshad va U Kitobkh'oi ch'udosozandai kh'ak' az botil va kh'idoiat az zalolatro nozil karda ast. Albatta, kasone, ki ba oiatkh'oi baroiat furud ovardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudaand, duchori azobi nikh'oiat sakht meshavand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) G'olibi Shikastnopaziri Sokh'ibi intik'om ast. Az kasone, ki paiombaronashro takzib namuda, khilofi amrash amal mekunand, intik'om megirad.

3-4 Ei Paiombar, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) K'ur'onro ba tu bo sadok'at dar akhbor va adolat dar akh'kom furud nozil namud, on bo Kitobkh'oi ilokh'ii guzashta mutobik' buda, baini K'ur'on va digar Kitobkh'oi osmoni ziddiiat nest. Va k'abl az on ki K'ur'onro ba tu nozil sozad, Tavrotro ba Muso va Inch'ilro ba Iso (alaikh'is salom) furud ovarda ast. Tamomi in Kitobkh'oi osmoni kh'idoiatgari mardum ba khairi duniovu okhirat meboshad va U Kitobkh'oi ch'udosozandai kh'ak' az botil va kh'idoiat az zalolatro nozil karda ast. Albatta, kasone, ki ba oiatkh'oi baroiat furud ovardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudaand, duchori azobi nikh'oiat sakht meshavand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) G'olibi Shikastnopaziri Sokh'ibi intik'om ast. Az kasone, ki paiombaronashro takzib namuda, khilofi amrash amal mekunand, intik'om megirad.
5) Kh'amono az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar osmon va dar zamin kh'ech' chiz pinkh'on namemonad. Donishash zokh'iru botini mavch'udotro ikh'ota namuda ast.

6) U Zotest, ki shumoro dar shikamkh'oi modaronaton ba suratkh'oi gunoguni naru moda, zebovu zisht, safedu siiokh', ki khokh'ad, meofarad. Ba ch'uz U ma'budi barkh'ak'k'e nest. G'olibi Shikastnopaziru dar ofarinish, chorasozi va akh'komash bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

7) Ei Paiombar, U Zotest, ki bar tu K'ur'onro nozil karda ast. Dar kh'ole ki ba'zeash oiatkh'oi doroi dalolati ravshan ast. In oiatkh'o asosi K'ur'on va k'ismi beshtari on ast. Kh'angomi oidi fakh'mi oiatkh'o va baioni kh'alolu kh'arom rukh dodani ikhtilof va nofakh'mi az in oiatkh'oi mukh'kam chun kalidi k'uflkusho dar kh'alli on nomafkh'umikh'o istifoda meshavad. Va k'ismi digari on oiatkh'oe ast, ki ekh'timolpaziri beshtar az iak ma'no buda, darki kunkh'i ma'noiash bar aksari mardum nomafkh'um ast. Pas ammo on kasone, ki dar k'albkh'oiashon kach'ravi az kh'ak' mavch'ud boshad, oiatkh'oi mukh'kamro tark mesozand va az oiatkh'oi mutashobekh'i ekh'timolpaziri ma'noi ziiod pairavi mekunand. Onkh'o bo in amalkardi khesh mekhokh'and shubkh'a ech'od namuda, mardumro gumrokh' sozand va on oiatkh'oi mutashobekh'ro tibk'i khostakh'o va mazokh'ibi fosidi khudashon ta'vil kunand. Va kh'ak'ik'atu kunkh'i ma'noi oiatkh'oi mutashobekh'ro ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' kas namedonad.] Va donishmandoni zabardast meguiand: "Mo ba kulli K'ur'on imon dorem, zero kh'amaash az sui Parvardigoramon nozil shuda ast." In gurukh'i donishmandon oiatkh'oi mutashobekh'ro bar asosi oiatkh'oi mukh'kam tafsir karda, oiatkh'oi mukh'kamro asl va mutashobekh'ro far'i on k'aror medikh'and. Va tankh'o bandagoni sokh'ibi ak'li solim pand megirand.

8) In donishmandoni zabardast meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, ba'd az on ki moro ba sui kh'ak' rakh'namoi namudi, k'albkh'oiamonro az on kach' masoz va moro az kach'ravikh'oi bandagoni munkh'arifgashta solim nigokh' dor va baroiamon az nazdi Khud rakh'mati gusturdae ato namo, ki bo on k'albkh'oiamonro kh'idoiat kuni va moro az gumrokh'i makh'fuz dori. Bor Ilokh'o, begumon Tu bag'oiat Bakhshanda kh'asti.

9) Ei Parvardigori mo, iak'inan Tu dar ruze, ki dar vok'e' shudanash shakke nest, kh'amai mardumro baroi bozpursi ba sui Khud ch'am' meori. Begumon k'iiomat omadanist va dar omadani on shakke nest. Ilokh'o, Tu kh'ech' gokh' ba va'daat khilof namekuni."

10) Beshak, on kasone, ki ba Khudo va paiombaronash kofir shudaand, kh'argiz amvol va farzandonashon uk'ubati ilokh'iro az onkh'o dar duniovu okhirat man' karda nametavonand. Va in ch'amoai tavsifshuda onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat kh'ezumi otashafruzi duzakhand.

11) Odatashon monandi odati khonadoni Fir'avn va kofironi pesh az onkh'o guzashtaest, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudand va oiatkh'oi Uro durug' shumurdand, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba sababi gunokh'onashon uk'ubat karda va amvolu farzandonashon ba onkh'o sud nabakhshid. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba kofironi takzibgaroni oiatkh'oi Khudo Sakhtuk'ubat ast.

12) Ei Firistodai Mo, ba kofiron sarfi nazar az dinashon bigu: "Mu'minon ba zudi shumoro shikast khokh'and dod va Khudo shumoro ba'di kofir favtidanaton ba sui otashi duzakh ch'am' mesozad va duzakh baroiaton ch'oigokh'i nikh'oiat bad ast."

13) Iak'inan baroiaton dar du gurukh'e, ki dar ruzi g'azvai Badr baroi ch'angidan bo iakdigar rubaru shudand, rakh'namoi va ibrat ast. Iake az on du gurukh' firk'ai mu'min buda, bo mak'sadi piruzii Islom va shikasti dushmanoni on dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mech'angidand. Mak'sad az in toifa Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va ioronashon kh'astand. Va gurukh'i digar kofirone budand, ki mu'minon onkh'oro bo chashm du barobar az khud beshtar medidand. Mak'sad az in toifa kofironi Makka meboshand, ki dar ch'angi Badr bo iftikhoru khudnamoi va taassubi ch'okh'ilona az khonaashon berun shudand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in nabard dustonashro alaikh'i dushmanonash nusrat dod. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, bo madadi Khesh ta'iid menamoiad. Kh'atman dar in rukhdod baroi shakhsoni doroi binoii botini pandu ibrat ast, to bidonand, ki ok'ibati mu'minon, sarfi nazar az kamii adadashon g'olibiiat va ok'ibati kofiron sarfi nazar az adadi ziiodashon shikast ast.

14) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo mak'sadi ozmoish shakh'vatkh'oi dunio az zanon va farzandon va amvoli anboshtai bisiori tillovu nuk'ra va aspkh'oi ta'limdidai zebo va chakh'orpoion (shuturu govu gusfand) va ziroati zaminro baroi mardum zinat doda ast. In bakh'rai zindagonii dunio ast, ki muvak'k'ati az on bakh'ra burda shuda, ok'ibat fano megardad. Binobar in, naboiad bandai mu'min dilbastai matoi dunio shavad. Va ch'oi bozgashti nek iagona nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. On ch'oi bozgasht ch'annatest, ki pakh'noiash ba andozai osmonkh'o va zamin ast.

Az sababi on ki shakh'vatkh'oi dunio ok'ibat zavol meioband, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati zerin ne'matkh'oi az on bekh'tarro iodovari namuda guft:
15) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Oio man ba shumo chizero khabar dikh'am, ki az in shakh'vatkh'oi nombarshuda bekh'tar ast? Baroi bandagoni bo ich'roi toat va tarki ma'siiat parkh'ezkor bog'kh'oest, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtonash rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad, onkh'o dar onch'o abadi memonand, marg va fanoiobi domanashononro namegirad va baroiashon dar ch'annat kh'amsaroni az kh'ar nav'i badakhlok'iiu badsurati pok va ilova bar in khushnudii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, Khudo onkh'oro dar ikh'otai rizomandiash k'aror doda, minba'd ba onkh'o khashm namegirad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba akh'voli bandagonash Bino ast. Chize az U pinkh'on nest va dar ivazi kh'ar kor podosh medikh'ad."

16) Akh'li ch'annat kasoneand, ki dar duoi khesh ba Khudovand meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, mo begumon ba Tu va on chi ba paiombaronat furud ovardai, imon ovardaem va az dasturat pairavi namudaem. Pas baroiamon gunokh'onamonro mag'firat bikun va moro az azobi duzakh dur bigardon."

17) Akh'li ch'annat dar anch'omi ibodat, tarki gunokh' va musibat sobir va dar guftoru kirdor sodik' va itoatkunandai Khudo va dar rokh'i kh'ak' kharch'sozandai amvol va sakh'argokh'on az Khudo khostgori omurzish kh'astand. Zero duoi sakh'argokh'on ba k'abulshavi nazdiktar va k'alb az sargarmikh'o kholi ast.

18) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ovardani oiatkh'oi shar'i va namoish dodani nishonakh'oi k'udratash dar koinot bar tankh'o Ma'budi barkh'ak' budanash shokh'idi doda ast. Va farishtagon va donishmandon niz bo rokh'i baion va da'vati mardum ba tavkh'id bar in kh'ak'ik'ati mutlak' guvokh'i dodaand. Dar kh'ole ki kh'amagi bar buzurgtarin kh'ak'ik'at, ki vakh'doniiati Khudost va on ki U nisbat ba khaloik' va akh'komi shar'i adolatro barpo medorad, shokh'id meboshand. Ba ch'uz U kh'ech' ma'budi loik'i ibodat nest. U G'olibi Shikastnopazir, dar ofarinish, chorasozi va akh'kom bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

19) Iak'inan iagona dini mak'bul nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Islom ast. Islom ba ma'noi bo toatu ibodat taslim gashtan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), imon ovardan ba kulli firistodagoni Khudo, az ch'umla ba Paiombari okhirzamon (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va napaziruftani kh'ukmi g'airi ilokh'i ast. Va iakh'udu nasoro dar dini khesh az rui kh'asad va kh'irsi dunio tankh'o ba'di on ki ba onkh'o ilm omad va kh'uch'ch'ati Parvardigor alaikh'ashon barpo shud, ikhtilof kardand va ba gurukh'kh'oi gunogun ch'udo gashtand. Va kh'ar ki ba oiatkh'oi bar Paiombar nozilkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir gardad, pas begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba kofironi takzibgar Zudkh'isobkunanda ast.

20) Pas ei Paiombar, agar onkh'o bo tu dar mavridi kh'ak'ik'ati baroiat furudomada ch'idol kunand, pas dar ch'avob bigu: "Man va mu'minoni pairavam ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) taslim shudaem." Va ei Paiombar, ba akh'li Kitob va mushrikoni nodon bigu: "Oio shumo ba U taslim gashta, kholisona Uro ibodat karda va az dini ovardai man pairavi namudaed?" Pas agar onkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) taslim gardand va tobei dinat shavand, begumon kh'idoiat ioftaand. Va agar onkh'o az taslim gashtan rui gardonand, g'amgin mashav, zero mas'uliiati tu tankh'o az on iborat ast, ki paig'omi ilokh'iro baroiashon birasoni va kh'avolai a'molashon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagonashro mebinad va kh'atman ba kh'ar kas dar ivazi amalash podosh khokh'ad dod.

21) Kh'amono on kasone, ki ba kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi baroiashon furudovardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir meshavand va paiombaronro ba nokh'ak' zolimona ba k'atl merasonand va mardumi nosekh'i ba adolatparvari farmondikh'andaro mekushand, pas in kofironi k'otilro ba azobi dardovar muzhda bidekh'.

22) In toifai tavsifshuda kasoneand, ki begumon amalkh'oiashon botil gashta ast. Onkh'o az amalkh'oiashon na dar dunio va na dar okhirat sud namegirand, zero ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofirand va onkh'o iovarone nadorand, ki azobi ilokh'iro bartaraf sozad.

23) Ei Paiombar, oio ba kh'oli iakh'udikh'oe, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o kh'issae az ilmi Tavrot va bar risolati tu dalolat namudanashro doda bud, namenigari?! Onkh'o ba bozgasht ba sui Kitobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Tavrot da'vat meshavand, to dar bainashon vobasta ba on chi ikhtilof dorand, k'azovat namoiad, sipas gurukh'e az olimon va rakh'baronashon az kh'ukmi Kitobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pusht megardonand, zero on ba khokh'ishotashon muvofik'at namekunad va onkh'o odatashon kh'amin ast, ki az kh'ak' ruigardonand. Vak'te onkh'o da'voi tobei Tavrot budanashonro dorand, loik'tar ast, ki baroi dovar k'aror dodani on dar k'iios ba digaron beshtar talosh kunand.

24) Sababi az kh'ak' bargashtan va onro k'abul nakardani onkh'o on ast, ki da'vo dorand ruzi k'iiomat kh'argiz otashi ch'akh'annam ch'uz ruzkh'oi andak ba onkh'o namerasad, sipas dokhili bikh'isht megardand. Pas in gumoni az durug'u botil sarchashma girifta va boftaashon onkh'oro mag'rur sokhta, dar barobari Khudo va dini U chunin "daler" namuda ast.

25) Pas, chun Mo onkh'oro dar ruzi k'iiomat, ki dar omadani on shakke nest, baroi bozpursi ch'am' kunem va ba kh'ar kas ba tavri sazovor podosh doda shavad, kh'ol on ki ba onkh'o bo kamshavii nekikh'o va afzun gashtani badikh'oiashon sitam nashavad, kh'olat va nadomatashon chi guna khokh'ad bud?! Onkh'o dar on ruz ba badtarin kh'olat duchor megardand va az korkh'oi khesh pushaimon meshavand.

26) Ei Paiombar, Parvardigoratro sitoish namuda, Uro bo azamat khonda bigu: "Bor Ilokh'o! Ei Zote, ki dar duniovu okhirat Moliki podshokh'i kh'asti! Tu podshokh'iro bar kh'ar ki az khalk'at khokh'i, medikh'i va onro az kh'ar ki khokh'i, mesitoni va kh'ar kiro khokh'i, izzat mebakhshi va kh'ar kiro khokh'i, khor megardoni. Kh'amai in korkh'oiat az rui kh'ikmat va adolat ast. Tamomi nav'i neki tankh'o dar dasti Tust. Beshubkh'a, Tu bar kh'ama chiz Tavono kh'asti.

27) Az nishonakh'oi k'udrati Tu on ast, ki shabro dar ruz medarori, ruz daroz meshavad va ruzro dar shab medarori, shab daroz meshavad va ba monandi berun ovardani mu'min az kofir va makh'sulot az dona, az murda zindaro berun meori va ba monandi berun kardani kofir az mu'min va tukhm az murg', az zinda murdaro berun meori va ba kh'ar ki khokh'i, be kh'isobu kitob ruzii farovon medikh'i.

28) Naboiad mu'minon ba ch'oi mu'minon kofironro dustoni khesh girand va onkh'oro kumak kunand. Va kh'ar ki chunin mekunad, pas begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az vai bezori ch'usta, az dini ilokh'i bakh'ra nadorad, magar dar surate, ki shumo takh'ti kh'ukmi kofiron k'aror doshta, az zararashon bar ch'onaton kh'arosed. Agar dar chunin kh'olat zokh'iran izkh'ori dusti namuda, dushmaniatonro bo onkh'o pinkh'on dored va ba in vasila az sharrashon parkh'ez namoed, ch'oiz ast va gunakh'kor nameshaved. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro az Khud metarsonad. Az U bitarsed va bo sodir kardani ma'siiat khudro dar ma'razi g'azabash k'aror nadikh'ed. Va ruzi k'iiomat baroi dariofti podoshi a'mol bozgashti kh'amai bandagon ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

29) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "On chiro dar k'albaton az man'kardakh'oi Khudo ba misli dusti bo kofiron pinkh'on mekuned io onro oshkor mesozed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad. Chize az U pushida nest. Va U on chiro dar osmonkh'o va on chiro dar zamin ast, medonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ama chiz K'odir ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro notavon sokhta nametavonad."

30) Kh'ar kas dar ruzi k'iiomat bo amali neki anch'om dodaash rubaru megardad, on amal nazdash be nuk'son kh'ozir kunonida meshavad va on chi az amali bad anch'om doda ast, orzu mekunad, ki kosh, baini u va baini on amal zamoni tuloni fosila mebud, ammo orzuiash kh'ech' gokh' takh'ak'k'uk' nameiobad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro az Khud metarsonad. Binobar in, bo sodir kardani gunokh' khudro dar ma'razi g'azabi U k'aror nadikh'ed. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagonash bag'oiat Mekh'rubon ast. Az kh'amin ch'ikh'at onkh'oro az uk'ubati okhirat kh'ushdor medikh'ad.

31) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Agar shumo dar vok'e' Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dust dored, pas az on chi ovardaam, dar oshkoru nikh'on pairavi kuned. Agar in shartro ich'ro namoed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro dust medorad va baoroiaton gunokh'onatonro mebakhshad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni tavbakunandaash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast."

32) Ei Firistodai Mo, bigu: "Bo ich'roi dasturot Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulashro itoat kuned." Pas agar az farmonbardori rui gardonand, iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofironi khilofi dasturotash amalkunandaro dust namedorad.

33) Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Odam (alaikh'is salom)-ro barguzida, farishtagonro amr kard, to dar nazdash sach'dai ekh'tirom va salom kunand va Nukh' (alaikh'is salom)-ro intikhob namuda, uro nakhustin firistodai Khud ba sui mardum k'aror dod va khonadoni Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro ikhtiior karda, mak'omi nubuvvatro dar naslash bok'i guzosht va khonadoni Imronro barguzid. Kh'amai inkh'oro barguzida, az akh'li zamonashon bartar gardonid.

34) In paiombaroni iodshuda va farzandonu navodagoni pairavi rokh'ashon nasle kh'astand, ki ba'zeashon dar iaktoparasti va anch'omi amalkh'oi shoista silsilai ba'zei digarand. Onkh'o neki va fazilatkh'oro az iakdigar ba meros mebarand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guftori bandagonashro meshunavad, kirdorashonro medonad. Ba kh'amin asos, az bainashon kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, barmeguzinad va az bandagoni khosash megardonad.

35) Ei Paiombar, zamonero ba iod biior, ki kh'amsari Imroni modari Mariam guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, kh'amono man ba vositai nazr bar kheshtan voch'ib gardonidaam, ki kh'amli batnamro az kh'ar chizi digar ozodkardashudai kholis baroi khidmati Tu va khonaat k'aror dikh'am. Pas onro az man bipazir. Beshak, Tu Shunavandai duovu Donandai niiati man kh'asti."

36) Pas, vak'te muddati kh'amli shikamash komil shud va onro tavallud kard, az sababi on ki umedi pisar budanashro dosht, ammo bar'aksi umedash dukhtar ba dunio omad, ma'zaratkhokh'i karda guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, begumon man kh'amli shikamamro dukhtar tavallud kardam." Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chi tavallud karda bud, bekh'tar medonad va pisare, ki orzuiashro dosht, dar neruiu surat ba misli dukhtari baroiash atoshuda nest. Kh'amsari Imron dar idoma guft: "Va beshubkh'a, man dukhtaramro Mariam nom guzoshtam va man begumon u va naslashro az Shaitoni az rakh'matat rondashuda dar panokh'i Tu mesuporam."

37) Pas, Parvardigorash nazri uro paziruft va nikh'oli vuch'udi dukhtarash Mariamro ba tarzi shoista ruionida, tarbiiat kard va k'albi bandagoni solekh'ro nisbat ba Mariam mushfik' sokhta, kafolatashro ba Zakariio (alaikh'is salom) suporid. Kh'ar gokh' Zakariio nazdi Mariam ba ch'oi ibodatash medaromad, dar peshi vai ruzii kh'aloli omodaro meioft. Pas Zakariio (alaikh'is salom) ba Mariam (alaikh'is salom) khitob namuda meguft: "Ei Mariam, in ruzi az kuch'o ba tu merasad?" Mariam (alaikh'is salom) ch'avob medod: "In ruzi az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, bekh'isob ruzii gusturda medikh'ad."

38) Inch'o vak'te Zakariio did, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Mariam (alaikh'is salom) bar khilofi k'onunkh'oi oidi rasonidani rizk' muk'arrar ruzi medikh'ad, bo vuch'udi pironsolii khud va nozoi budani kh'amsarash az Parvardigorash orzu kard, to uro farzande bakhshad. Zakariio (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, az nazdi Khesh ba man farzandi poki shoista bibakhsh. Ba durusti, Tu duoi kasero, ki Turo mekhonad, meshunavi va onro mepaziri."

39) Pas, farishtagon ba u dar kh'ole ki dar ibodatgokh' istoda namoz mekhond, nido karda guftand: "Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo ba vilodati farzande bo nomi Iakh'io, ki tasdik'kunandai Isoi Kalimai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, bashorat medikh'ad. Va in farzand dar ilm va ibodat bar k'avmash sarvar megardad va nafsashro az shakh'vatkh'o, minch'umla az nazdikshavii zanon nigokh' doshta, ba purragi baroi ibodat forig' shuda va inchunin paiombare az ch'umlai solekh'on meshavad." Sababi "Kalimai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)" vasfshavii Isoi pisari Mariam (alaikh'is salom) dar on ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro bo kalimai Khud ba tavri khos ofarida ast.

40) Chun farishtagon Zakariio (alaikh'is salom)-ro ba vilodati Iakh'io bashorat dodand, vai guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, ba'd az on ki man solkhurda shuda va kh'amsaram nozoi buda, farzand tavallud namekunad, chi guna sokh'ibi farzand meshavam?" Khudo dar ch'avob guft: "Masali ofarinishi Iakh'io dar kh'olati pironsolii tu va nozoi budani kh'amsarat monandi on ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar chi khokh'ad, bar khilofi odat meofarad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ar chiz K'odir ast. Az rui kh'ikmat va adolat kh'ar chi khokh'ad, mekunad."

41) Zakariio (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, baroiam dar mavridi bordor shudani kh'amsaram nishonae k'aror bidekh'." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar posukh guft: "Nishonai khostaat on ast, ki biduni mubtalo shudan ba bemori se shabu ruz bo mardum ba ch'uz bo ishora va monandi on gap zada nametavoni. Pas dar okhir va avvali ruz zikru tasbekh'i Parvardigoratro ziiod anch'om bidekh'."

42) Va ei paiombar, ba iod biior, on gokh', ki farishtagon ba Mariam (alaikh'is salom) guftand: "Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo ba sababi on ki doroi sifatkh'oi nek kh'asti, barguzida va az nuk'sonkh'o pok gardonida va turo bar zanoni ch'akh'oniioni zamoni khud bartari doda ast.
43) Ei Mariam, k'iiomi namozatro baroi Parvardigorat tuloni soz va sach'da kun va kh'amrokh'i solekh'oni ruku'kunanda ruku' namo."

44) In rukhdodi zikrshudai davroni Zakariio (alaikh'is salom) va Mariam (alaikh'as salom) az khabarkh'oi g'aib ast. Ei Paiombar, Mo onro ba tu paig'om mefiristem. Va zamone ki donishmandonu solekh'on dar borai on ki chi kase ba tarbiiai Mariam loik'tar ast, bo kh'am ikhtilof namuda, bilokhira, ba k'ur'akashi ru ovarda, k'alamkh'oi kheshro dar ob andokhtand va k'ur'a ba nomi k'alami Zakariio baromad, tu onch'o kh'ozir nabudi.

45) Ei Paiombar, on zamonero iod kun, ki farishtagon ba Mariam (alaikh'as salom) guftand: "Ei Mariam, kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo ba vilodati farzandi biduni padar muzhda medikh'ad. On farzand ba vositai Kalimai "Kh'ast shav"-i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ast meshavad. Nomash Masekh'i Isoi pisari Mariam buda, dar dunio va okhirat doroi ch'oigokh'i baland va az ch'umlai bandagoni muk'arrabi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meboshad. -

46) Va on farzandat bo mardum dar kh'olati khurdsoli, ki kh'anuz ba sinni sukhan kardan narasida ast, sukhan mekunad va inchunin bo mardum dar miionasoli, ki mardonagi va neruiash komil shuda ast, gap mezanad, onkh'oro ba anch'omi korkh'oe, ki dar on salokh'i duniovu okhiratashon ast, rakh'namoi menamoiad va u dar guftoru kirdorash az ch'umlai solekh'on ast."

47) Mariam az on ki beshavkh'ar chi guna sokh'ibi farzand meshavad, kh'airatzada shuda guft: "Chi guna man sokh'ibi farzand meshavam, kh'ol on ki kase ba man na bo rokh'i kh'alol va na bo rokh'i kh'arom nazdiki nakarda ast?" Farishtae bo dasturi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'avob doda guft: "On gunae, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi tu be padar farzand meofarad, kh'amin guna U kh'ar chiro khokh'ad, bar khilofi odati ma'muli khalk' mekunad. Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korero iroda kunad, ba on "Kh'ast shav" meguiad, pas, on ba vuch'ud meoiad. Kh'ech' chiz Uro och'iz namesozad."
48) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba u kitobat va kh'ikmat -dar guftoru kirdor darki durusti- va Tavroti Muso va Inch'ilro, ki ba zudi onro baroiash furud meorad, meomuzonad.

49) Va inchunin uro ba sui Farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi ba sifati paiombar mefiristad. Ba onkh'o meguiad: "Begumon man ba sui shumo az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) firistoda shudaam. Kh'amono man ba shumo az nazdi Parvardigoraton alomati tasdik'kunandai rostii nubuvvatamro ovardaam. Mu'ch'izai ovardaam on ast, ki begumon man baroiaton az gil monandi shakli paranda mesozam, pas dar on dam meandozam, ba'd az in bo ich'ozati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) paranda zinda megardad. Va kuri modarzodro shifo medikh'am, pas, bino meshavad va inchunin shakhsi giriftori bemorii pustro shifo mebakhsham, pas, pusti badanash sikh'kh'at meiobad va murdagonro zinda mesozam. Tamomi in korkh'oro bo ich'ozati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) anch'om medikh'am. Va shumoro az on chi mekhured va on chi dar khonakh'oi khesh az gandum zakhira va pinkh'on mekuned, bokhabar mesozam. Agar shumo k'asdi imon ovardan va tasdik'i kh'uch'ch'atkh'oro dored, beshubkh'a, dar on chi az in mu'ch'izakh'oi buzurgi berun az tavoni bashar ba shumo zikr kardam, alomati ravshani nishondikh'andai risolat va nubuvvati man ast.

50) Va inchunin nazdi shumo omadam, dar kh'ole ki Tavroti k'abl az man ba Muso nozilshudaro tasdik' menamoiam va to in ki ba'ze az chizkh'oero, ki pesh az man bar shumo kh'arom gardonida shuda ast, bo mak'sadi sabuki baroiaton kh'alol sozam. Va ba khotiri isboti sikh'kh'at doshtani guftakh'oiam baroi shumo kh'uch'ch'at ovardaam. Pas, az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi dasturotash bitarsed va maro dar on chi shumoro ba sui on faro mekhonam, itoat namoed.

51) In ba on sabab ast, ki beshubkh'a, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Parvardigori man va Parvardigori shumost. Tankh'o U arzandai itoat va tars ast. Pas, fak'at Uro biparasted. Kh'amin ibodat va tak'voi Parvardigor, ki shumoro ba ich'roi on amr namudam, rokh'i rostu durust ast."

52) Pas, chun Iso (alaikh'is salom) iak'in kard, ki Farzandoni Ia'k'ub kufri kheshro idoma medikh'and, ba onkh'o khitob namuda guft: "Ki ba man dar rokh'i da'vati mardum ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kumak merasonad?" Pairavoni barguzidaash guftand: "Mo iovaroni dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astem. Ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, az tu pairavi namudaem. Va ei Iso, guvokh' bosh, ki mo bo iaktoparasti va itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) taslimshudagoni U meboshem."

53) Pairavoni barguzidai Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) inchunin guftand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, ba Inch'ili furudovardai Tu imon ovardem va Iso (alaikh'is salom)-ro pairavi namudem. Pas moro kh'amrokh'i bandagoni ba Tu va paig'ombaronat mu'mini barkh'ak' guvokh'idikh'anda k'aror bidekh'."

54) Va kofironi Bani Isroil makr namuda, ba k'atli Iso (alaikh'is salom) sa'i kardand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) makrashonro barkh'am zada, onkh'oro dar gumrokh'i guzoshta, shabokh'ati surati Iso (alaikh'is salom)-ro ba mardi digare andokht. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar chorasozi va barkh'am zadani dasisa az kh'amai makkoron K'avitar ast. Zero baroi dushmanoni Khudo az tadbiri U chize sakhttar nest.

55) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) niz nisbat ba onkh'o chora sokht. On gokh', ki ba Iso (alaikh'is salom) khitob karda guft: "Ei Iso, Man begumon turo biduni on ki bimiri az in dunio bargiranda kh'astam va rukh'u badanatro ba sui khesh mebardoram va turo az palidii shakhsoni kofirgashta pok va az onkh'o dur mesozam va kasonero, ki dar dini kh'ak', az ch'umla dar imon ovardan ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) turo pairavi kardaand, to ruzi k'iiomat bo burkh'on va izzatu e'tibor az kasone, ki ba tu kofir shudaand, bartar megardonam. Sipas bozgashti shumo dar ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui Man ast. Pas, Man on ruz miioni shumo dar borai on chi bo iakdigar ikhtilof dored, bo kh'ak' dovari mekunam.

56) Pas, ammo on kasone, ki ba tu va kh'ak'ik'ati ovardaat kofir shudaand, pas Man onkh'oro bo rokh'i kushtashavi, asir gashtan, zalil shudan va g'aira dar dunio va bo azobi otashi ch'akh'annam dar okhirat sakht uk'ubat mekunam va onkh'o madadrasonkh'oe nadorand, ki azobi Khudoro bartaraf sozad.

57) Va ammo kasone, ki ba tu va kh'ak'ik'ati ovardaat imon ovardaand va amalkh'oi shoistai namozu ruza, nigokh' doshtani paivandi kheshovandi va g'airaro anch'om dodaand, pas iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) podoshi korashonro ba tavri komil doda, az on kh'ech' chizro kam namesozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zolimonro dust namedorad." Buzurgtarin nav'i sitamgari shirk ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va durug' shumurdani paiombaroni Ust. On chi dar oiatkh'oi k'abli zirk shud, ba nasronikh'oi pesh az bi'sati Rasuli akram (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) guzashta taalluk' dorad.

58) In khabarkh'oero, ki oidi Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) baroiat mekhonem, az alomatkh'oi ravshani tasdik'gari kh'ak'ik'at doshtani nuzuli K'ur'on bar tu va parkh'ezkoronro pandi ustuvor ast. Botil ba on rokh' nameiobad.

59) Kh'amono kh'olati ofaridani Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) monandi kh'olati biduni padaru modar az khok ofaridani Odam (alaikh'is salom) ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba gili vai "Odami shav" guft, pas tibk'i irodai U odami gardid. Modom ki chunin ast, pas chitavr nasronikh'o bo daleli on ki Iso (alaikh'is salom) be padar khalk' shuda ast, da'voi ma'budiiati uro dorand, ammo bo vuch'udi on ki Odam (alaikh'is salom) be padaru modar ofarida shuda ast, bashar budanashro e'tirof mekunand?!

60) Kh'ak'ik'ati makh'z oidi Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) kh'amon ma'lumote ast, ki bar tu az sui Parvardigorat furud omada ast. Pas az shakkunandagon mabosh, balki dar rokh'i rosti khud ustuvor bimon.

61) Pas, ei Paiombar, kh'ar ki az nasronikh'oi sarzamini Nach'ron bo tu dar borai Iso (alaikh'is salom) ba'd az on ki baroiat dar in bobat donishi sakh'ekh' omada ast, ch'idol va da'voi ma'budiiati uro kunad, pas dar ch'avobashon bigu: "Biioed, ki farzandoni khud va farzandoni shumo va kh'amsaroni khud va kh'amsaroni shumoro baroi kh'ozir gashtan faro khonem va mo khudro va shumo khudro omoda sozed, kh'amagi ch'am' shavem, sipas ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui ovarda, iltich'o kunem, to la'nati Khudro bar kh'ar ki az movu shumo durug'gu ast, furud orad."

62) Kh'amono ma'lumoti dar borai Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) zikr kardai Mo khabari rost ast. Va ch'uz Allokh'i Iagona digar ma'budi barkh'ak' nest. Va ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ukmfarmoiash G'olibi dar chorasozi, farmon va ofarinish Kh'akim ast.

63) Pas, agar onkh'o az oiini ovardaat rui gardonida, turo pairavi nakunand, in nishonai fasodkoriashon ast va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni dar zamin fasodkorro medonad va dar ivazi on ch'azoiashon medikh'ad.

64) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob, biioed atrofi sukhani odilonae, ki ch'umlagi dar on barobarem, muttakh'id gardem. Sukhani odilona on ast, ki ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kasero ibodat nakunem, kh'ech' kasro novobasta az ch'oigokh'ash ba U sharik nasozem va ba'zeamon ba'zei digarro ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oi ibodat va itoatshavanda nagirad." Ba'd az in agar onkh'o az kh'ak'ik'at va adolate, ki ba sui on da'vatashon mekuni, bargardand, pas ei mu'minon, ba onkh'o bigued: "Guvokh' boshed, ki mo begumon bo toatu ibodat mute' va taslimshudagoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astem."

65) Ei akh'li Kitob, charo dar mavridi millati Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ch'idol mekuned va kh'ol on ki medoned, ki iakh'udiiat va nasroniiat tankh'o ba'di guzashtani muddati tuloni az margi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) zukh'ur karda ast?! Iakh'udikh'o az rui da'voi khesh Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro iakh'udi va nasronikh'o uro nasroni mekh'isoband. Pas oio bo ak'li khud butloni guftor va khatoi pindoratonro dark mekuned?!

66) Ogokh' boshed! Shumo ei akh'li Kitob, bo Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) oidi umuri dinii khesh va Kitobi ba shumo nozilshuda, ki dar borai on donish dored, ch'idol karded, pas charo dar mavridi kh'ak'ik'ati Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) va dinash, ki donish nadored va dar Kitobkh'ovu tavassuti paiombaronaton niz oidi on chize naomada ast, ch'idol mekuned?! Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ak'ik'atu asrori tamomi chizro medonad va shumo inro namedoned.

67) Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) az nigokh'i oiin iakh'udi va nasroni nabud, valekin az kh'ama dinkh'o ba sui dini barkh'ak' moilu dar barobari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) taslimgashtai iaktoparast bud. Va chunonchi mushrikoni arab da'vo dorand, ki Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) dar oiini onkh'o bud, vai az zumrai mushrikon niz nabud.

68) Kh'amono sazovortarin mardum dar mansubiiat ba Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) kasoneand, ki dar zamoni vai ba on chi az nazdi Khudo ovard, pairavi kardand va inchunin arzandatarin mardum dar mansubiiat ba Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va mu'minoni ummatash kh'astand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Iovar va Kh'ofizi mu'minon ast.

69) Ei akh'li imon, donishmandoni iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob orzu dorand, to shumoro az rokh'i rosti Khudo gumrokh' sozand va kh'ol on ki onkh'o tankh'o khudro gumrokh' mesozand, zero taloshashon dar gumrokh'sozii mu'minon zalolatashonro afzun megardonad va onkh'o farch'omi korkh'oi kardaashonro namedonand.

70) Ei iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob, charo ba oiatkh'oi ba shumo nozilshuda va ba daleli dar Kitobkh'oiaton dar borai kh'ak'ik'at doshtani nubuvvati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) omada kofir meshaved va kh'ol on ki shumo medoned, ki Kitobkh'oiaton barkh'ak' budanashro guvokh'i medikh'and?!

71) Ei iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob, charo kh'ak'ik'ati dar Kitobkh'oiaton nozilshudaro bo botili sokhtai kheshtan omekhta mesozed va kh'ak'ik'atu kh'idoiati dar Kitobkh'oi shumo mavch'ud, az on ch'umla khabari rost budani nubuvvati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro pinkh'on menamoed va kh'ol on ki shumo kh'ak'k'u botil va kh'idoiatu gumrokh'iro medoned?!

72) Va ch'amoae az donishmandoni iakh'ud guftand: "Dar avvali ruz ba K'ur'oni bar mu'minon nozilshuda zokh'iran imon biiored va dar okhiri ruz ba on kofir shaved, shoiad onkh'o az sababi dubora kofir shudani shumo oidi dinashon shubkh'a karda, bo guftani "Iakh'udikh'o akh'li Kitoband. Nisbat ba mo az Kitobkh'oi Khudo ogokh'ii beshtar dorand. Onkh'o az in din bargashtand" az dinashon barmegardand."

73) Va inchunin guftand: "Tankh'o kasero namoed, ki u tobei dini shumo boshad." Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Beshak, kh'idoiati kh'ak'ik'i ba sui rosti kh'idoiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, na sarkashi va takzibi shumo. Takzib va sarkashii shumo az tarsi on ast, ki monandi fazli ba shumo dodashuda ba kasi digar doda meshavad io az tarsi on ast, ki agar ba Kitobashon imon ored, onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigoraton shumoro bo pesh ovardani kh'uch'ch'at mag'lub mesozand." Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Kh'amono fazl dar dasti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, onro ba kh'ar nafare az bandagon khokh'ad, medikh'ad. Fazli U makh'dudi millati khos nest. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Doroi fazli gusturda buda, bandagoni loik'i lutfashro medonad.

74) Kh'ar kiro az bandagon khokh'ad, bo rakh'matash khos gardonida, bar vai bo kh'idoiat, nubuvvat va nav'kh'oi gunoguni lutfash ekh'son menamoiad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Sokh'ibi fazli bag'oiat buzurg ast."

75) Va az miioni akh'li Kitob kasest, ki agar moli farovonero kh'amchun amonat ba vai supori, onro ba tu barmegardonad va az miioni onkh'o kasest, ki agar moli andakro kh'amchun amonat ba vai supori, onro ba tu barnamegardonad, magar on ki molatro az vai bo isror va paiopai talab namoi. In amali khiionati toifai duium ba sababi k'avlu gumoni fosidashon ast, ki meguiand: "Bar mo dar barobari mardumi arab va khurdani amvoli onkh'o kh'ech' gunokh' va ch'azoe nest. Chunki Parvardigor molkh'oi onkh'oro bar mo kh'alol karda ast." Va bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' meguiand va kh'ol on ki onkh'o durug'guii khudro medonand.

76) Kh'ak'ik'at on guna ki mepindorand, nest, balki onkh'o ba sababi sodir kardani ch'urmi khiionatkori gunakh'korand va kh'atman dar badali on ch'azo mebinand. Valekin kh'ar ki bar akh'di bo Khudo bastai khesh, ki az imon ovardan ba U va paiombaronash iborat ast va inchunin bar akh'di bo mardum bastaash vafo namuda, amonatashonro bargardonad va bo ich'roi farmudakh'oi ilokh'i parkh'ezkori kunad, pas begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni botak'voro dust medorad va ba onkh'o dar ivazi parkh'ezkori loik'tarin podoshro ruzi mesozad.

77) Iak'inan on shakhsone, ki tavsiiai ilokh'iro dar borai pairavi az akh'komi kutubi osmoni va rakh'namoii paiombaron va savgandkh'oiashonro dar borai vafodori ba paimoni ilokh'i bo bakh'oi andaki matoi dunio ivaz mekunand, az podoshi okhirat sakh'me nadorand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo onkh'o sukhani farakh'bakhsh nameguiad va ruzi k'iiomat ba sui onkh'o bo nazari rakh'mat nigokh' namekunad va onkh'oro az palidii gunokh' va kufrashon pok namesozad va onkh'oro azobi sakht dardovar ast.

78) Va kh'amono az iakh'udikh'o toifaest, ki zabonashonro ba zikri on chi az Tavrot nest, mepechand, to gumon bared, ki onkh'o Tavrot mekhonand va kh'ol on ki khondaashon az Tavrot nest, balki on az durug'kh'oi bar Khudo boftaashon ast. Va meguiand: "On chi mo k'iroat mekunem, az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nozil shuda ast" va kh'ol on ki on az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nest va dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' meguiand va kh'ol on ki bar Khudovu Rasul durug' guftani khudro medonand.

79) Baroi kh'ech' kas az insonkh'o sazovor nest, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az nazdi Khud baroiash Kitob dikh'ad va ba u ilmu fakh'mi solim ruzi namoiad va uro barguzinad, sipas u ba mardum "Ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni man boshed" guiad, valekin ba onkh'o meguiad: "Bo ta'lim dodani Kitobi Khudo va bo kh'ifzu fakh'm khondani on olimoni boamal, murabbii mardum, islokh'gari umuri onkh'o boshed."

80) Va niz baroi kh'ech' kas az insonkh'o loik' nest, ki shumoro amr kunad, to farishtagon va paiombaronro baroi khesh ma'bud girifta, ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) biparasted. Oio durust ast, ki kase shumoro ba'd az on ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) taslim va mute' gashtaed, ba kofir shudan amr namoiad?!

81) Va ei Paiombar, on zamonero iod kun, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az paiombaron paimoni k'at'i girifta, ba onkh'o guft: "Vak'te Man ba shumo Kitob va kh'ikmat bidikh'am va agarchi ba darach'akh'oi baland kh'am birased, sipas Rasulam Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), ki tasdik'gari Kitob va kh'ikmati shumost, nazdaton oiad, kh'atman ba on chi ovarda ast, imon meored va uro pairavi karda, nusratash medikh'ed. Ei paiombaron, oio inro ik'ror dored va baroi ich'roi on akh'di k'at'ii Maro pazirufted?" Onkh'o dar ch'avob "Ik'ror dorem" guftand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft: "Pas, bar kheshtan va ummatkh'oiaton shokh'id boshed va Man niz kh'amrokh'aton bar shumovu ummatkh'oiaton az ch'umlai guvokh'on kh'astam.
82) Pas, on kasone, ki ba'di in paimoni k'at'i rui gardonand va akh'dshikani kunand, beshak, in toifai akh'dshikan az dinu toati Khudo khorich'and."

83) Pas, oio in gurukh'i az dinu toati ilokh'i khorich' g'air az Islom, ki dini barguzida Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, dini digarero metalaband va kh'ol on ki tamomi khaloik'i osmonkh'o va zamin ba misli akh'li imon ikhtiioran io ba misli kofiron beikhtiior ba U taslim va tobe' kh'astand?! Sipas, kulli khaloik' ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va podosh ba sui U bargardonida meshavand.

84) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ba ma'budiiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, farmonkh'oi Uro itoat kardem va ba paig'omi bar mo nozilkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ba on chi bar Ibrokh'im va Ismoil va Iskh'ok' va Ia'k'ub va paiombaroni az nasli Ia'k'ub ba dunio omada furud ovarda ast va ba on Kitobkh'o va oiatkh'oe, ki ba Muso va Iso va ba kh'ama paiombaron az ch'onibi Parvardigorashon doda shuda ast, imon ovardem. Baini kh'ech' kas az paiombaron bo imon ovardan ba ba'ze va kofir shudan ba ba'zei digar ch'udo namesozem va mo iagona mute' va taslimi U kh'astem."

85) Va kh'ar ki g'air az dini Islomi barguzidai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dini digarero mech'uiad, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro az u kh'argiz namepazirad va u dar okhirat az ch'umlai kasonest, ki bo daromadani duzakh bar ch'oni khud ziion rasonda ast.

86) Chi guna Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi ba U va Rasulash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) imon ovardan k'avmero kh'idoiat mesozad, ki onkh'o ba'd az on ki imon ovardand va oidi kh'ak' budani dini Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) shokh'idi dodand va ba onkh'o kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ravshani isbotkunandai durustii nubuvvatash omad, dubora kofir shudand?! Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mardumi sitamgare, ki dar badali kh'idoiat zalolatro barmeguzinand, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui imonro namedikh'ad.
87) Kh'amono podoshi in toifai sitamgari barguzidai botil on ast, ki bar onkh'o la'nati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va farishtagon va tamomi mardum boshad va az rakh'mati Khudo ronda shavand.
88) Onkh'o dar duzakh ch'ovidon memonand, az on namebaroiand, azobi ch'akh'annam az onkh'o sabuk nameshavad va onkh'o mukh'lat doda nameshavand, to tavba kunand io uzr biiorand,-

89) ch'uz on kasone, ki ba'di kufru sitamgari ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardand va amali kheshro islokh' namoiand, pas iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

90) Ba durusti, on bandagone, ki ba'd az imon ovardanashon kofir shudand, sipas kufrashonro idoma doda, dar kh'olati beimoni az dunio guzashtand, kh'argiz tavbaashon kh'angomi omadani marg k'abul nameshavad, zero vak'ti k'abuli tavba guzashta ast va onkh'o bandagoni az rokh'i rosti ba Khudo vaslkunanda gumrokh'shuda kh'astand.

91) Kh'amono on kasone, ki kofir shudand va dar kh'olati beimoni favtidand, pas, agarchi dar ivazi rakh'oi az duzakh kh'amvazni zamini pur az tillo fidia kh'am dikh'and, kh'argiz on fidia az kh'ech' kasi onkh'o pazirufta nameshavad. Baroi in gurukh' mazkur azobi dardovar buda, ruzi k'iiomat iovarone nadorand, ki azobi ch'akh'annamro az onkh'o bartaraf sozand.

92) Ei mu'minon, kh'ech' gokh' ba podoshi akh'li nekon va darach'ai onkh'o namerased to on ki dar rokh'i Khudo az molkh'oi dust medoshtaaton kharch' kuned. Va kh'ar chiro novobasta az kam io ziiod budani on kharch' mekuned, pas begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai mak'sad va amalkh'oi shumost. Ba kh'ar kas dar ivazi kirdorash podosh khokh'ad dod.

93) Tamomi nav'i khurdanikh'oi pok baroi Farzandoni Ia'k'ub kh'alol buda, kh'ech' chiz bar onkh'o man' nabud, magar on chi Ia'k'ub k'abl az nuzuli Tavrot bar khesh kh'arom gardonid. Da'voi iakh'udikh'o, ki guio kh'arom sokhtani Ia'k'ub dar Tavrot mavch'ud bud, asos nadorad. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Agar dar da'voi khud sodik' kh'asted, pas Tavrotro kh'ozir namoed va onro bikhoned." Iakh'udikh'o dar ich'roi in peshnikh'od mag'lub shudand va da'voi kheshro isbot karda natavonistand. In misol daleli on ast, ki onkh'o nisbat ba Tavrot durug' bofta, lafzu mazmuni onro takh'rif namudand.

94) Pas, kh'ar ki ba'd az oshkor gashtani kh'uch'ch'at dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' bofad, ki guio on chi Ia'k'ub (alaikh'is salom) baroi khud kh'arom karda ast, kh'ukmi shakhsiash buda, kh'ukmi Khudo nabud, pas in ch'amoa ba sababi on ki kh'ak'ro ba'di oshkorshaviash tark kardand, dar kh'ak'k'i khud zulm namudaand.

95) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar mavridi akhbori marbut ba Ia'k'ub, Kitobkh'oi nozilkarda va akh'komash rost gufta ast. Pas az dini Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom), ki az tamomi dinkh'o ba sui Islom moil buda va kh'argiz chizero ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik nasokhta ast, pairavi kuned."

96) Kh'amono nakhustin khonae, ki baroi tamomi mardum ba mak'sadi ibodat bino shuda ast, Khonai muk'addasi Khudo, vok'e' dar Makkai Mukarrama buda, makoni muboraki doroi manfiatkh'oi dinivu duniavi va rakh'namoi kulli ch'akh'oniion ast.

97) Dar on Khona ba misli oinkh'oi kh'ach', nishonakh'oi ravshanest, ki sharofat va fazilati onro nishon medikh'ad. Az ch'umlai on alomatkh'o sangest, ki Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) kh'angomi bardoshtani devori Ka'ba rui on istoda ast. Va inchunin kh'ar ki ba on Khona daroiad, dar amon buda, tars az vuch'udash dur shuda, ozor namebinad. Va k'asd kardani Khonai Ka'ba, ba mak'sadi adoi oinkh'oi kh'ach' bar mardum, bar on kas, ki k'udrati ba onch'o raftanro dorad, farzi ilokh'i ast. Va kh'ar ki ba farziiati ziiorati Khonai Khudo kofir gardad, pas kh'atman Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az vai va az kulli ch'akh'oniion Beniioz ast.

98) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob, charo kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi tasdik'kunandai sidk'i Paiombari okhirzamon, az ch'umla kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi dar Tavrotu Inch'il oidi in omadaro inkor mekuned?! Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az in amali shumo ogokh' buda, bar on Shokh'id ast. Dar badali on ba shumo podosh khokh'ad dod."

99) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob, charo az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mardumi ba on garavidaro man' mekuned, baroi in din moilshavi az kh'ak' ba botil va baroi dindoron gumrokh'iro metalabed va kh'ol on ki shumo shokh'id kh'asted, ki in rokh' kh'ak' buda, tasdik'kunandai Kitobkh'oi shumost?! Va on chi shumo az kufr va man'i mardum az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) anch'om medikh'ed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on g'ofil nest va dar ivazi on ch'azoiaton khokh'ad dod."

100) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, agar az iddae az iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob dar on chi meguiand, itoat kuned va andeshaashonro dar on chi mepindorand, k'abul namoed, az sababi on ki inkh'o mubtaloi marazi kh'asadu zalolat kh'astand, shumoro ba'd az imon ovardanaton ba sui kufr barmegardonand.

101) Va chi guna ba'd az imon ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir meshaved va kh'ol on ki buzurgtarin sababi ustuvori dar imon bo shumost, oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo khonda meshavad va Paiombarash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) onro baroiaton baion mesozad?! Va kh'ar nafare ba Kitobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va sunnati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) chang zanad, pas, kh'atman Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba u tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro medikh'ad.

102) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon dored va az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi dasturot va shukri ne'matkh'o ba tavri shoistai az U tarsidan bitarsed va to dami vopasin bar dini khesh chang bizaned va tankh'o musalmon bimired.

103) Va ei akh'li imon, kh'amagi ba Kitobi Khudo va sunnati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) chang bizaned va kore nakuned, ki duchori parokandagi garded va in'omi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bar kheshtan ba khotir ored, on gokh', ki pesh az zukh'uri Islom dushmani kh'am buded, bo sababkh'oi andak alaikh'i iakdigar mech'angided. pas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az barakati Islom miioni dilkh'oiaton ulfat ech'od namuda, shumoro muttakh'id sokht, pas bo lutfi U bo kh'amdigar barodaroni dini shuded. Ba iakdigar shafk'at va khairkhokh'i mekuned va pesh az zukh'uri Islom ba illati kufr varzidan dar labai chuk'urii otashi ch'akh'annam k'aror doshta, ba on vorid gashtanaton nazdik bud. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro bo ne'mati Islom nach'ot dod va ba sui imon rakh'namoi namud. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton kh'amin guna az oiatkh'oi Khud chizkh'oi dar duniovu okhirat sudmandro baion mekunad, to ba sui rokh'i rost kh'idoiat shaved.

104) Va ei akh'li imon, boiad az shumo gurukh'e boshand, ki mardumro ba sui guftoru kirdori neki dustdoshtai Khudo da'vat namoiand va ba guftoru kirdori az rui shariat va ak'li solim pisandida amr kunand va az guftoru kirdori az rui shariat va ak'li solim nopisand man' namoiand va in gurukh' dar duniovu okhirat rastagoroni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand.

105) Va ei mu'minon, ba monandi akh'li Kitob naboshed, ki ba'd az on ki ba onkh'o az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oiatkh'oi ravshan omad, parokanda gashta, ba gurukh'kh'oi gunogun ch'udo shudand va dar dinashon ikhtilof namudand. Va baroi in toifa az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) azobi buzurg ast.

106) In azobi buzurg bar onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat vok'e' megardad, on gokh', ki chekh'rakh'oi mu'minon az shiddati khursandi va khushbakhti safed va chekh'rakh'oi kofiron az shiddati g'amnoki va badbakhti siiokh' meshavad. Pas ammo kasone, ki on ruz chekh'rakh'oiashon siiokh' gardad, bo sarzanish ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Oio ba'd az on ki imon ovarda, bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) paimon basted, ki chizero ba U sharik namesozed, kofir shuded va akh'di khudro shikasted?! Pas ba sababi kofir shudanaton azobero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo omoda karda ast, bichashed."
107) Va ammo kasone, ki chekh'rakh'oiashon on ruz safed gardad, pas dar ch'annati ilokh'i k'aror megirand Onkh'o dar on ch'annati bezavol ch'ovidon memonand.

108) Ei Paiombar, in oiatkh'oi ilokh'iro, ki shomili va'dai ch'azoi nek va bad ast, bo rosti dar akhbor va adolat dar akh'kom baroiat mekhonem. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba kase az ch'akh'oniion zulm kardan namekhokh'ad va kh'ech' kasro ch'uz dar ivazi amalash ch'azo namedikh'ad.

109) Va on chi dar osmonkh'o va on chi dar zamin vuch'ud dorad, az rui ofarinish, molikiiat va tadbir tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va farch'omi kori kh'amai bandagonash fak'at ba sui Ust. Ba'd az on ba kh'ar kas tibk'i shoistagiash podosh medikh'ad.

110) Ei ummati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), shumo dar bobi imonu amal az baini kh'amai ummatkh'o bekh'tarin ummate kh'asted, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro baroi naf'i mardum berun sokhta ast. Mardumro ba guftoru kirdori shar'an va ak'lan pisandida amr va az guftoru kirdori shar'an va ak'lan zisht nakh'i mekuned va ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imoni amalii k'at'i meored. Va agar iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) imon meovardand, in dar duniovu okhirat baroiashon bekh'tar bud. Az akh'li Kitob ba dini u te'dodi andakashon imon dorand va beshtarashon az on khorich'and.

111) Ei mu'minon, az sui akh'li Kitob nisbat ba shumo kh'ar k'adar dushmani anch'om iobad, kh'ech' gokh' dar dinu ch'onaton ziion namerasonand, magar on ki bo zabonashon shumoro bo ta'na zadani dinaton, tamaskhur va g'aira ozor medikh'and va agar ba muk'obilaton bich'angand, az nazdaton shikast khurda, pusht megardonand, sipas bar ziddi shumo nusrat doda nameshavand.

112) Bar iakh'udikh'o kh'ar kuch'o paido shavand, khori va bearzishi ikh'ota gardonida shuda, shomili kh'olashon gashta, dar amon nestand, magar bo paimon io amoni az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) io mardum ba onkh'o dodashuda. Va iakh'udikh'o bo g'azabi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bozgashtand. Va az kh'ar taraf kh'och'atmandiiu fak'r ikh'otagarashon k'aror doda shuda ast. In ba sababi on ast, ki onkh'o ba oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) doim kofir meshudand va paiombaronro zulman mekushtand. Sababi digar dar on ast, ki onkh'o nisbat ba amri Khudo va paiombaronash nofarmoni mekardand va doim az marzi guzoshtai Khudo meguzashtand.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati mazkur kh'olati aksari akh'li Kitobro baion namud, dar oiati zerin kh'olati gurukh'i bar kh'ak'ik'at ustuvorashonro zikr karda guft:
113) Kh'amai akh'li Kitob barobar nestand, balki az onkh'o gurukh'e kh'ast, ki bar dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ustuvorand, dasturashro ich'ro mekunand. Onkh'o dar soatkh'oi shab dar kh'olati adoi namoz oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro mekhonand. In gurukh' pesh az bi'sati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) guzashtaand. Ammo kh'ar ki az in ch'amoa dar zamoni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) zindagi karda boshad, ba on kas imon ovarda ast.

114) Onkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi okhirat k'oteona imon meorand va mardumro ba neki amr va az badi nakh'i mekunand va ba ich'roi amalkh'oi khair shitofta, mavsimkh'oi toatro g'animat meshumorand. Va in gurukh'i tavsifshuda az ch'umlai bandagoni doroi niiat va amali solekh'and.

115) Va on chi onkh'o az neki, sarfi nazar az kam io ziiod budani on anch'om medikh'and, pas kh'argiz savobash zoe' va nok'is sokhta nameshavad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni anch'omdikh'andai amr va parkh'ezkunanda az nakh'ii botak'voro medonad. Kh'ech' chiz az U pinkh'on namemonad va ba parkh'ezkoron dar ivazi kirdorkh'oi nekashon podosh khokh'ad dod.

116) Beshak, kasone, ki ba Allokh' va paiombaronash kofir shudaand, kh'argiz na molkh'o va na farzandonashon az onkh'o az azobi ilokh'i chizero dur va rakh'matashro ch'alb karda nametavonad, balki bar'aks sababi afzun shudani azobu kh'asratashon megardad. Va in toifa boshandagoni duzakh kh'astand. Onkh'o dar onch'o abadi memonand.

117) Sifati on chi in kofiron dar in dunio dar rokh'kh'oi khair sarf mekunand va az on muntaziri podoshand, ba monandi sifati bodest, ki dar on sardii sakht ast, on bod ba kishtzori k'avme rasida ast, ki on k'avm bo anch'omi gunokh' va g'aira nisbat ba kheshtan zulm kardaand, pas on kishtzorro nobud sokhta ast, kh'ol on ki sokh'ibonash az on umedi ziiod doshtand. Chunonchi bodi tavsifshuda kishtzorro nobud kunonida va sokh'ibonash az on sude nagiriftand, kh'amin guna kufr savobi amalkh'oro barbod doda, kofiron dar ruzi k'iiomat az korkh'oi nekashon bakh'ra namebarand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o zulm nakarda ast, U az sitamkori pok ast, valekin khudi onkh'o bo kufr varzidan bar ch'onashon sitam kardaand.

118) Ei on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi namudaed, az g'airi mu'minon baroi khesh dustoni makh'rami [rozi barguzida, ki onkh'oro az asror va kh'olatkh'oi khususiaton ogokh' mesozed], nagired. Zero onkh'o dar zarar dodani shumo va tabokh' shudani akh'volaton kutokh'i namekunand. Doim orzui rukh dodani kh'olatero dorand, ki shumo duchori ziion va ranch' shaved. Begumon dushmani va nafrati onkh'o nisbat ba shumo az zabonashon bo ta'na zadani din, ech'odi tafrik'a va kashfi rozkh'oiaton oshkor shuda ast va on adovatero, ki dar k'albashon nisbat ba shumo pinkh'on medorand, az dushmanii az zabonashon oshkorgashta ba marotib buzurgtar ast. Ei mu'minon, beshubkh'a, Mo baroi shumo vobasta ba manfiatkh'oi dini va duniavi oiatkh'oi vozekh'ro baion namudem, agar shumo rakh'namoikh'oi nozilsokhtai Parvardigoratonro bifakh'med.

119) Ogokh' boshed! Ei mu'minon, shumo in k'avmro dust medored, ba onkh'o neki mekhokh'ed va onkh'o shumoro dust namedorand, ba shumo khairkhokh' nestand, balki nisbataton dushmani dorand va shumo ba tamomi Kitobkh'oi osmoni, az ch'umla ba Kitobi onkh'o imon dored, ammo onkh'o ba K'ur'on imon nadorand va chun bo shumo rubaru shavand, bo zabon "Imon ovardaem" meguiand va chun bo iakdigar khilvat kunand, az sababi on ki shumo bo kh'amdigar muttakh'id buda, Islom doroi izzat ast, ammo onkh'o zaliland, az rui andukh'u g'azab atrofi angushtonashonro megazand. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Bar kh'amin kh'olati khesh bok'i bimoned, to ok'ibat az shiddati andukh'u g'azab bimired." Albatta, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro, ki dar k'alb az imonu kufr va nekivu badi pinkh'on ast, medonad.

120) Ei akh'li imon, agar ba shumo ne'mate az piruzi alaikh'i dushman va afzun gashtani molu farzandonaton birasad, onkh'oro g'am faro megirad va badkh'ol meshavand va agar ba shumo musibate az piruzii dushman va kam shudani molu farzandonaton birasad, az in kh'olati shumo khushkh'ol megardand. Va agar dar barobari farmonkh'o va tak'diri ilokh'i sabr kuned va az khashmash biparkh'ezed, makr va ozori dushmanon ba shumo zarar namerasonad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) makrero, ki anch'om medikh'and, ikh'otakunanda buda, makkoronro nokom megardonad.

121) Va ei Paiombar, iod kun on zamonero, ki dar ch'angi Ukh'ud baroi nabardi mushrikon dar og'ozi ruz az Madina berun shuda, ba ta'iini mavze'kh'oi ch'angidani mu'minon shuru' karda, ch'oi kh'ar kasro mushakhkhas namudi. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai guftorkh'o, Donandai kirdorkh'oi shumost.

122) Ei Paiombar, vok'eai nisbat ba du toifai mu'minon -Bani Salima va Bani Kh'orisa- rukhdodaro ba khotir biior. On gokh', ki onkh'o notavon shudand va vak'te munofik'on az maidoni nabard bargashtand, onkh'o niz k'asdi bargashtan kardand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Madadrasonashon bud. Dar ch'ang ustuvorashon sokht va az mak'sadashon barnagardonid. Va boiad mu'minon dar kh'ama kh'olat tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia namoiand.

123) Va beshubkh'a, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro dar ch'angi Badr alaikh'i mushrikon nusrat dod va kh'ol on ki shumo az sababi kamii shumora va tach'kh'izoti ch'angi notavon buded. Pas az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed, to shoiad shukri ne'matkh'oi Uro ba ch'o ored.

124) Ei Paiombar, on zamonero ba iod biior, ki chun mu'minon dar ch'angi Badr khabari ba mushrikon rasidani k'uvvakh'oi madadrasonro shunidand, tu bo mak'sadi sobitk'adam gardonidanashon ba onkh'o gufti: "Oio baroiaton basanda nest, ki Parvardigoraton shumoro bo sesad kh'azor farishtagoni az nazdash ba khotiri k'uvvat dodanaton furud ovardashuda kumak mekunad?!"

125) Ore, in adadi farishtagon baroiaton basanda ast. Shumoro bo kumaki Parvardigor muzhdai digarest, ki agar dar nabard sabr va parkh'ezkori kuned va ba dushmanonaton kh'amin lakh'za madad omada, sui shumo shitoband, pas begumon Parvardigoraton shumoro bo panch' kh'azor farishta dar kh'ole ki on farishtagon kh'am khud va kh'am markabkh'oiashonro bo nishonai oshkori ch'ang alomatguzori kardaand, kumak menamoiand.

126) Va iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in imdod bo farishtagonro baroi shumo khabari farakh'bakhsh gardonid va to dilkh'oiaton bo on orom girad va illo piruzi dar asl bo mavch'udiiati asbobi ma'rufash surat namegirad. Va begumon piruzi tankh'o az nazdi Allokh'i G'olibi Shikastnopaziri dar tak'diru k'onunguzori Kh'akim kh'osil meshavad.

127) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo piruz gashtani shumo dar ch'angi Badr khost iak idda kofironro bo rokh'i kushtashavi kh'alok sozad va iak iddai digarro bo shikast khurdan khoru rasvo va khashmgin gardonad, pas dar kh'olati nokomi va zillat bargardand.

128) Vak'te Rasuli akram (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba'd az kh'odisai ch'angi Ukh'ud dar kh'ak'k'i rakh'baroni mushrikon duoi kh'alok gashtanashonro kardand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on kas guft: "Az kori onkh'o chize dar ikhtiiori tu nest, balki on dar dasti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Pas to vak'te ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baini shumo kh'ukm kunad io baroiashon tavfik'i tavba doda, musulmon shavand va io bar kufrashon bok'i monda, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro azob dikh'ad, sabr bikun. Zero onkh'o begumon zolimoni sazovori uk'ubat kh'astand."

129) Va on chi dar osmonkh'o va on chi dar zamin mavch'ud ast, az rui ofarinish, molikiiat, kh'ukmfarmoi va tadbir tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Bo rakh'matash gunokh'oni kh'ar kiro az bandagon khokh'ad, mag'firat mekunad va bo adolatash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, azob medikh'ad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

130) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi namudaed, chand barobar az sarmoiai k'arzdodai khesh beshtar ribo magired, chunonchi mardumi davroni ch'okh'iliiat in korro mekardand va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi dasturotash bitarsed, to shoiad dar duniovu okhirat ba khostai neki khud noil bishaved.
131) Va bo anch'omi ibodat va tarki ma'siiat az giriftor shudan ba otashi duzakh, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro baroi kofiron omoda gardonida ast, parkh'ez namoed.
132) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulashro bo ich'ro kardani dasturotashon itoat kuned, to shoiad dar duniovu okhirat ba rakh'mati ilokh'i noil shaved.

133) Va bo anch'omi amalkh'oi nek va nav'kh'oi gunoguni ibodat ba sui nazdiki ch'ustan bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bishitobed va dar in maidon bo iakdigar rak'obat namoed, to ba mag'firati buzurgi Parvardigoraton noil garded va voridi ch'annate shaved, ki pakh'noii on monandi pakh'noii osmonkh'o va zamin ast. Khudo onro baroi bandagoni parkh'ezkorash omoda sokhta ast.

134) Parkh'ezkoron kasoneand, ki molkh'oi khudro dar kh'olati osoni va dushvori dar rokh'i Khudo kharch' mekunand va bo vuch'udi on ki k'udrati sitonidani intik'omro dorand, g'azabashonro furu mebarand va ch'urmi shakhsoni dar kh'ak'k'ashon sitamkardaro afv menamoiand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni nekukori bo in guna akhlok' orostaro dust medorad.

135) Va onkh'o kasoneand, ki chun murtakibi gunokh'oni kabira shavand io bo sodir namudani gunokh'oni khurd bar kheshtan sitam kunand, Allokh' taoloro zikr mekunand va takh'didu va'dai Uro ba isionkoronu parkh'ezkoron ba iod meorand, pas bo nadomat az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) satri gunokh'on va adami much'ozotashonro metalaband, zero kh'ech' kas ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'onro namebakhshad va bar gunokh'onashon pofishori namekunand va onkh'o ba iak'in medonand, ki gunakh'korand va tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'onro mag'firat menamoiad.

136) Podoshi in toifai tavsifshuda on ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'onashonro pushonida, onro mebakhshad va baroi onkh'o dar okhirat bog'kh'oest, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oi on rudkh'o ch'ori buda, dar onch'o ch'ovidon memonand. Va podoshi bandagoni anch'omdikh'andai ibodati Khudo nikh'oiat nek ast.

137) Vak'te mu'minon ruzi ch'angi Ukh'ud bo kh'avodisi sakht ozmoish shudand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi baioni ta'ziia va tasallii khotir ba onkh'o guft: "K'onunkh'oi Khudo dar borai on ki ba'd az omadani ozmoishkh'o kofironro kh'alok sokhta, mu'minonro nusrat medikh'ad, k'abl az shumo guzashta ast. Pas dar zamin sairu gasht kuned, pas bo ibrat nazar namoed, ki ok'ibati takzibgaroni Khudovu paiombaronash bo chi anch'omid. Manzilkh'oiashon kholi va saltanatu doroiashon nobud shud."

138) In K'ur'oni mach'id baroi tamomi mardum baiongari kh'ak'ik'atu kh'ushdordikh'anda az botil va dalolat ba sui kh'idoiat va bozdorandai parkh'ezkoron az rokh'i nodurust ast. Chunki bandagoni botak'vo az kh'idoiat va irshodoti K'ur'oni karim manfiat mebarand.

139) Va ei mu'minon, notavon maboshed va baroi on chi ruzi ch'angi Ukh'ud ba shumo rasida ast, g'amgin nagarded, zero in guna kh'olat ba shumo zebanda nest. Va agar ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va va'dai ba bandagoni parkh'ezkor dodaash imon dored, pas shumo bo imoni khesh, iorii ilokh'i va umedvori ba nusrati U az digaron bartar va g'olib kh'asted.

140) Ei mu'minon, agar ruzi ch'angi Ukh'ud ba shumo zakhmu kushtor rasida ast, pas ruzi ch'angi Ukh'ud ba kofiron niz monandi on rasida bud. Va Mo bo kh'ikmatkh'oi ziiod in ruzkh'oro miioni mardumi mu'minu kofir bo on chi az piruzi va shikast khokh'em, gardish doda, dast ba dast megardonem. Az ch'umlai kh'ikmatkh'oi Parvardigor on ast, ki dar chunin rukhdodkh'o mu'minoni vok'ei az munofik'on ch'udo meshavand va ba'ze az bandagoni barguzidai ilokh'i ba darach'ai shakh'odat noil megardand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni bo tarki ch'ikh'od bar ch'oni kheshtan sitamkunandaro dust namedorad.

141) Va az kh'ikmatkh'oi gardish dodan va dast ba dast gardonidani ruzkh'o dar baini mu'minonu kofiron on ast, ki mu'minon az gunokh' va saffashon az munofik'on pok shavad va to Parvardigor kofironro kh'alok va makh'v sozad.

142) Ei mu'minon, oio gumon dored biduni ozmoish va sabr, ki much'okh'idoni kh'ak'ik'iaton va bandagoni dar musibati rokh'i Khudo sobir ba kh'amin vasila oshkor meshavand, dokhili bikh'isht megarded?!

143) Va ei mu'minon, kh'amono shumo k'abl az on ki bo asbobi marg va sakhtii on rubaru shaved, mulok'oti kofironro baroi noil gashtani darach'ai shakh'odat -on guna ki barodaronaton ruzi ch'angi Badr ba in mak'om rasidand- orzu mekarded. Pas begumon shumo ruzi ch'angi Ukh'ud dar kh'ole ki oshkor ba sui marg nazar mekarded, on chiro orzu doshted, bo chashm dided.

Vak'te ruzi ch'angi Ukh'ud ovoza shud, ki guio Paiombari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kushta shudaand, ba'zekh'o az idoma dodani nabard ak'ibnishini kardand va Khudo baroi sarzanishashon oiati zerinro furud ovarda guft:
144) Va Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba misli paiombaroni sobik', ki ba'zeashon vafot kardand va ba'zeashon kushta shudand, paiombare besh nest. Oio agar u vafot kunad io kushta shavad, shumo az dini khesh barmegarded va ch'ikh'odro tark mekuned?! Va kh'ar ki az shumo az dinash barmegardad, pas kh'argiz ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chize zarar namerasonad, zero U Zoti Nerumandi G'olibi Mag'lubnashavanda ast, balki vai ch'onashro dar ma'razi ziioni duniovu okhirat k'aror doda, tankh'o ba khud ziion meorad. Va begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni siposguzorash baroi ustuvori va idoma dodani ch'ikh'od bekh'tarin podoshro medikh'ad.

145) Va kase ch'uz bo k'azoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) namemirad. Kh'ar ch'ondor vak'te memirad, ki muddati baroiash ba tavri dak'ik' muk'addarshudaro sipari namoiad, on muddat kamu ziiod nameshavad. Va kh'ar ki bo amalash podoshi dunioro bikhokh'ad, Mo az dunio on andozaero, ki baroiash muk'addar ast, ba vai medikh'em, ammo dar okhirat kh'ech' sakh'me nadorad va kh'ar ki bo amalash dar okhirat podoshro bikhokh'ad, ba vai az podoshi okhirat medikh'em. Va begumon Mo ba bandagoni siposguzoramon podoshi buzurg khokh'em dod.

146) Va az zumrai paiombaroni Khudo nafaroni ziiode budand, ki az pairavonashon ch'amoatkh'oi bisiore bo onkh'o alaikh'i dushman ch'angidand. Pas baroi on ki dar rokh'i Khudo ba onkh'o kushtoru zakhm rasida ast, tarsui nakardand va az ch'angidan alaikh'i dushman notavon nashudand va tobei onkh'o nagashtand, balki az khesh sabr va ustuvori nishon dodand va Khudo bandagoni dar dushvorikh'oi rokh'ash sabrkunandaro dust medorad.

147) Va chun ba in bandagoni bosabr in ozmoish rasid, sukhanashon tankh'o in bud: "Ei Parvardigori mo, baroiamon gunokh'onamon va dar koramon az kh'udud tach'ovuz kardanamonro mag'firat namo va vak'ti mulok'ot bo dushman k'adamkh'oiamonro ustuvor gardon va moro bar k'avmi kofir nusrat bidekh'."

148) Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon bo dodani nusrat va dar zamin k'udratmand gardonidan podoshi dunioro ato namud va dar okhirat bo izkh'ori rozigiash va ne'matkh'oi bezavoli ch'annat podoshi nek medikh'ad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni dar ibodatu muomila nekukorro dust medorad.

149) Ei mu'minon! Agar az kofironi iakh'udu nasoro va mushrikon dar zalolate, ki ba on farmonaton medikh'and, itoat kuned, shumoro ba'd az imon ba kh'olati kufri k'abli barmegardonand, pas dar duniovu okhirat ziionkor megarded.

150) In kofiron kh'ech' gokh' dar surati az onkh'o itoat kardanaton ba shumo kumak karda nametavonand, balki alaikh'i dushmanonaton tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Madadgori shumost. Az in ru, fak'at Uro itoat kuned. Va U bekh'tarini madadrasonkh'o ast. Ba'di madadi ilokh'i ba kh'ech' kas niiozmand nameshaved.

151) Beshubkh'a, Mo dar dili kofiron ba sababi on ki bo pairavii kh'avoi nafs ma'budkh'oi botilero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai ibodatashon kh'ech' dalele nozil nakarda ast, shariki U sokhta, parastidand, tarsi sakht meafkanem. Va k'arorgokh'ashon, ki ruzi k'iiomat ba sui on barmegardand, otashi duzakh ast. Va duzakhi k'arorgokh'i zolimon ch'oi nikh'oiat bad ast.

152) Va begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va'daero, ki oidi piruz gardonidani shumo dar ruzi ch'angi Ukh'ud doda bud, amali sokht. On gokh', ki shumo dushmanonatonro bo ich'ozati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo shiddat mekushted, to on ki chun tarsui karda, az sobitk'adami dar ich'roi amri Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az khud notavoni nishon doded va dar borai dar makoni khesh istodan io tarki on va ch'am'ovarii moli g'animat bo iakdigar ikhtilof namuded va amri Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro vobasta ba on ki dar kh'amai kh'olat dar ch'oikh'oiaton bok'i bimoned, nofarmoni karded, in kh'avodis ba'd az on rukh dod, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton on chiro az piruzi alaikh'i dushman dust medoshted, nishon dod, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pas az in nusrati Kheshro az shumo boz dosht Az shumo on shakhsone, ki makonkh'oi ta'iinkardai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro rakh'o karda, ba ch'am'ovarii moli g'animat mashg'ul shudand, dunioro mekhokh'and va az shumo on shakhsone, ki dar on makonkh'oi ta'iinshuda bok'i monda, amri uro ba ch'o ovardand, okhiratro mekhokh'and. Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro az on dushmanonaton bargardonid va onkh'oro alaikh'i shumo chiradast sokht, to shumoro ozmuda, mu'mini dar imtikh'on bosabr az besabri notavon ma'lum gardad. Va beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'i sarpechi az amri Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro az shumo afv karda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbati mu'minon Sokh'ibi lutfi buzurg buda, onkh'oro ba suii imon rakh'namoi mekunad, gunokh'oni eshonro mebakhshad va dar ivazi musibatkh'o baroiashon podosh medikh'ad.

153) Ei mu'minon! Zamonero iod kuned, ki ruzi ch'angi Ukh'ud baroi on ki bo nofarmonii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) duchori shikast shuded, az maidoni nabard gurekhta, dar zamin dur merafted va ba kase nigokh' namekarded va Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), ki baini shumovu mushrikon k'aror dosht, shumoro az pushtaton faro khonda "Ei bandagoni Khudo, ba sui man biioed! Ei bandagoni Khudo, ba sui man biioed..." meguft. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro baroi in kirdoraton bo mag'lubiiat, az dast dodani moli g'animat va pakh'n shudani khabari k'atli Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bo ranch'u diltangii boloi kh'am ch'azo dod. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro ba in falokatkh'o mubtalo kard, to baroi az dast dodani moli g'animatu piruzi va zakhmu kushtor g'amgin nashaved. Zero ma'lumaton gasht, ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) zinda ast va g'air az musibati vafoti u takh'ammuli kh'amai musibatkh'o baroiaton oson ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Ogokh' ast. Akh'voli botini va a'moli zokh'irii shumo az U pinkh'on nameboshad.

154) Sipas Khudo bar shumo ba'd az ranch'u diltangi oromish va e'timodro furud ovard. Iak iddai shumoro, ki ba va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) e'timod doshtand, az sababi on ki dar k'albashon amnu oromish ch'oi girifta bud, khobi sabuke faro girift. Va iddai digarro, ki akh'li nifok' budand va onkh'oro oromishu khobi sabuk faro nagirift, tankh'o g'ami solim mondani kheshro doshtand. Onkh'o paivasta dar kh'olati tarsu iztirob buda, nisbat ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gumoni bad mekardand, ki guio U Paiombarash va mu'minonro nusrat namedikh'ad va ta'iid namekunad, chunonchi mardumi davroni ch'okh'iliiat dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amin guna badgumoni karda, Uro ba surati shoista k'adrdoni namekardand. In ch'amoai munofik'on ba illati durust nashinokhtani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meguiand: "Mo oidi mas'alai baromadan ba ch'ang ikhtiior nadoshtem. Agar dar in bora ra'ii mo mavridi k'abul k'aror megirift, kh'ech' gokh' ba maidoni nabard namebaromadem." Ei Paiombar, dar posukhi in akh'li nifok' bigu: "Ba durusti, kh'ama korkh'o dar dasti Allokh' taolo ast. U kh'ar on chi khokh'ad, muk'addar va kh'ukm mekunad. Ba maidoni ch'ang baromadani shumoro U muk'addar namuda ast." In munofik'on dar k'albkh'oiashon chizkh'oero az shakku badgumoni pinkh'on mesozand, ki onro baroiat oshkor namekunand. Onkh'o meguiand: "Agar ra'ii mo dar bobi khuruch' ba maidon ba e'tibor girifta meshud, dar in makon kushta nameshudem." Ei Paiombar, dar raddi munofik'on bigu: "Agar shumo dar khonakh'oi khud az mavze'kh'oi kushtor va marg dur mebuded, begumon kasone, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar onkh'o kushta shudanro navishta bud, ba sui bistarkh'oi margashon mebaromadand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in rukhdodro dar tak'dirot nanavishta ast, magar baroi on ki niiat va mak'sadkh'oi dar sinaaton mavch'udro bisanch'ad va imonu nifok'i k'albatonro az iakdigar ch'udo sozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai asrori dilkh'oi bandagon buda, kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nameboshad."

155) Ei ioroni Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), kh'amono on kasone az shumo, ki ruzi rubaru shudani ch'am'i mushrikon bo ch'am'i mu'minon dar ch'angi Ukh'ud shikast khurdand, begumon Shaiton onkh'oro ba sababi sodir namudani ba'zei gunokh'on ba lag'zhidan vodor sokht. Va iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'oni onkh'oro afv namuda, az rui lutfu rakh'mati Khud much'ozotashon nakard. Albatta, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Bakhshandai Burdbor ast. Binobar in, gunakh'koronro dar kh'ol uk'ubat namekunad.

156) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi namudaed, ba monandi munofik'oni kofir naboshed va onkh'o chun kheshovandonashon baroi talabi ruzi safar mekardand io ch'angovar buda, dar ch'ang darmeguzashtand va io kushta meshudand, in munofik'on dar kh'ak'k'ashon meguftand: "Agar onkh'o nazdi mo meistodand va ba khotiri talabi ruzi io ch'ang khorich' nameshudand, namemurdand va kushta nameshudand." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in e'tik'odro dar k'albashon ch'oi dod, to nadomat va kh'asrat dar k'albashon afzun gardad. Va tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo irodai Khud zinda mesozad va memironad. Dar khona nishastan peshi rokh'i tak'diri ilokh'iro namegirad va az khona baromadan niz omadani onro sare' namesozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro anch'om medikh'ed, mebinad. Korkh'oi shumo az U pushida nest va dar ivazi on podoshaton medikh'ad.

157) Va ei mu'minon, agar dar rokh'i Khudo kushta shaved io bimired, iak'inan mag'firat va rakh'mati azimi ilokh'i shomili kh'olaton megardad. Mag'firat va rakh'mati ilokh'i az in dunio va on chi akh'li on az ne'matkh'oi fanoshavanda ch'am' meorand, bekh'tar ast.
158) Va agar shumo kh'ar nav'e bimired io kushta shaved, pas kh'amagi tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardonida meshaved, to shumoro ch'azo dikh'ad.

159) Pas ei Paiombar, akhlok'i tu dar munosibat bo sakh'obagonat ba sababi rakh'mati azimi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) narm shuda ast. Va agar tu dar guftoru kirdorat shadidu sangdil mebudi, begumon onkh'o az nazdat parokanda meshudand. Pas az kutokh'ie, ki onkh'o dar kh'ak'k'at mekunand, darguzar va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon omurzish bitalab va dar on chi ba mashvarat niioz dorad, az onkh'o mashvarat purs, to nazari kheshro ibroz dorand. Pas chun ba'd az mashvarat dar kore tasmim bigiri, az paii ich'roi on shuda va bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavakkul bikun. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni tavakkulkunandaro dust medorad va ta'iidashon menamoiad.

160) Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro bo kumak va nusratash ta'iid kunad, pas agar kulli mavch'udoti zamin kh'am ch'am' shavand, kh'ech' kas shumoro mag'lub karda nametavonad va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kumakaton narasonad va shumoro ba kh'olaton kh'avola sozad, ba'd az U kh'ech' kas az ukh'dai nusrati shumo namebaroiad, zero nusrat tankh'o dar dasti Allokh'i Iagona ast. Va boiad mu'minon fak'at ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia kunand.

161) Kh'ech' paiombarero namesazad, ki bo giriftani chize az moli g'animat ba ch'uz on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba vai khos doda ast, khiionat kunad. Va kh'ar ki az shumo bo giriftani moli g'animat khiionat kunad, giriftori uk'ubat megardad, ruzi k'iiomat dar peshi nazari khaloik' on chi dar dunio az moli g'animat rabuda bud, bardoshta meoiad va sharmandaiu rasvo meshavad. Sipas Mo ba kh'ar kas ch'azoi amalashro be nuk'son medikh'em. Va ruzi okhirat ba onkh'o bo afzunshavii badikh'o io kamshavii nekikh'oiashon sitam karda nameshavad.

162) Kh'ar kas az imonu amali shoista, ki in du vasilai rasidan ba rizoi ilokh'i meboshad, pairavi namuda ast, nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'argiz bo kase, ki kofir shuda, amali bad sodir karda, bo khashmi shadidi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargashta va k'arorgokh'ash duzakh boshad, barobar nest. Va duzakh ch'oi bozgashti nikh'oiat bad ast.

163) Onkh'o nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar duniovu okhirat martabakh'oi gunogun dorand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro anch'om medikh'and, mebinad. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest va kh'atman ba kh'ar kas dar ivazi amalash ch'azoi loik' khokh'ad dod.

164) Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar mu'minon in'om va ekh'son namud. Zero dar bainashon Paiombarero az nav'i khudashon barangekht, ki bar mu'minon K'ur'on mekhonad va onkh'oro az shirku a'moli zisht pok mesozad va ba onkh'o K'ur'onu sunnatro ta'lim medikh'ad va begumon onkh'o k'abl az bi'sati in Paiombar az kh'idoiat va rokh'i durust dar gumrokh'ii oshkor k'aror doshtand.

165) Ei mu'minon, oio vak'te bo shikast khurdan dar ch'angi Ukh'ud va kushta shudani ba'zeaton ba shumo musibate rasid, ki begumon shumo ruzi ch'angi Badr az kh'isobi kushtashudagon va asiron du barobari onro ba dushman oseb rasonida buded, gufted: "Az kuch'o in musibat ba mo rasid, kh'ol on ki mo ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon dorem va Rasuli Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bo most?!" Ei Paiombar, bigu: "On chi ba shumo rasid, ba sababi a'moli khudaton bud. Zero az amri Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) sarpechi karda, bo iakdigar ikhtilof namuded. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar tamomi chiz Tavono ast. Kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, nusrat medikh'ad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, az nusratash makh'rum mesozad."

166) Va on chi ruzi ch'angi Ukh'ud nisbat ba shumo az kushtoru zakhmu shikast rukh dod, on gokh', ki ch'am'i shumo bo ch'am'i mushrikon rubaru gardid, pas on kh'avodis az rui kh'ikmat bo ich'ozat va tak'diri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) surat girift, to mu'minoni sodik'ro ba mardum ma'lum sozad.

167) Va to munofik'onro ba mardum ma'lum sozad, on kasonero, ki chun ba onkh'o gufta shud: "Dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bich'anged io agar namech'anged, loak'al bo bisior gardonidani te'dodi musulmonon az kheshtan va khonadonu kishvaraton difo' kuned", guftand: "Agar mo medonistem, ki ch'ang surat megirad, kh'atman az shumo pairavi mekardem, lekin mo az vok'e' shudani ch'ang miioni shumovu on k'avm bekhabar budem."
