Onkh'o ruzi guftani in sukhan nisbat ba imon ba on chi dalolatgari kufrashon ast, nazdiktar budand. Bo zabonashon chizkh'oero meguiand, ki on dar k'albashon nest. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on chi dar k'albashon pinkh'on medorand, Donotar buda, onkh'oro uk'ubat khokh'ad kard.

168) Munofik'on kasoneand, ki az maidoni nabard khudro kanor girifta va ba kheshovandoni ruzi ch'angi Ukh'ud osebdidaashon guftand: "Agar onkh'o az mo itoat karda, baroi ch'ang namebaromadand, kh'ech' gokh' kushta nameshudand." Ei Paiombar, dar raddi in ch'amoai munofik' bigu: "Agar shumo dar da'voiaton, ki guio az shumo itoat nakardani onkh'o boisi margashon shud va sababi az marg nach'ot ioftani shumo dar maidoni ch'ikh'od shirkat nakardanaton ast, sodik' boshed, pas vak'te marg domangiraton gardad, onro az khud dur sozed."

169) Va ei Paiombar, on kasonero, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kushta shudaand, murda mapindor, balki onkh'o nazdi Parvardigorashon ba surati makhsus zinda kh'astand, az nav'kh'oi gunoguni ne'matkh'oi tankh'o ba Parvardigor ma'lum ruzi doda meshavand,-

170) dar kh'ole ki shakh'idon ba sababi on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az lutfash bar onkh'o in'om namuda ast, g'ark'i saodat gashta, farakh'mandi onkh'oro faro megirad. Va onkh'o orzumand va muntazirand, ki agar barodaroni ba'd az darguzashi onkh'o dar dunio bok'i mondaashon shakh'id shavand, ba onkh'o mepaivandand va monandi eshon ba fazli ilokh'i noil gashta, bar onkh'o az kh'odisakh'oi okhirat kh'ech' tarse nest va baroi az dast dodani ne'matkh'oi zavoliobandai dunio g'amgin nameshavand.

171) Shakh'idon izofa bar ne'matkh'oi mazkur bo podoshi buzurge az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va podoshi ilovagii digare khushkh'ol meshavand va niz az on shod megardand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ach'ri mu'minonro zoe' namegardonad, balki onro purra, kh'atto chand barobar beshtar ato mekunad.

172) On kasone, ki pas az on ki dar ch'angi Ukh'ud ba onkh'o nav'kh'oi gunoguni zakhm rasid, vale chun ba'd az anch'omi in ch'ang biduni fosila ba ch'ikh'od va mulok'oti dushman ba nabardi "Kh'amro'-ul-asad"[g'azvai ba'di ch'angi Ukh'ud, subkh'i ruzi duium] da'vat shudand, dasturi Allokh' va Rasulashro paziruftand. Zakhmashon monei paziruftani nidoi Allokh'u Rasulash nagasht. Az onkh'o baroi kasone, ki dar amalkh'oiashon nekui kardand va bo ich'roi farmudakh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tarsidand, podoshi buzurgi ch'annat ast.

173) On kasone, ki ba'zei mushrikon ba onkh'o guftand: "Kh'amono mardumi K'uraish bo rakh'barii Abusufion baroi ch'angidan va nobud kardani shumo gurukh'kh'oi ziiodero ch'am' ovardaand. Az in ru, az onkh'o bitarsed va az mulok'otashon biparkh'ezed." Pas in sukhanoni tarsdikh'anda dar onkh'o imon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va e'timod ba va'dai Uro beshtar sokht. Onkh'o ba mulok'oti dushmanon dar kh'ole berun shudand, ki meguftand: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi mo Basanda va bekh'tarin Kh'imoiatgar buda, korkh'oi kheshro ba U mesuporem."

174) Pas onkh'o ba'di baromadan ba ch'angi "Kh'amro-ul-asad" az onch'o bo podoshi buzurgi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), balandshavii darach'akh'o va solim mondan az sharri dushmanon bargashta, kushtor va zakhme ba onkh'o narasid va az korkh'oe ba misli ibodat va tarki ma'siiat, ki boisi khushnudii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) megardad, pairavi kardand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar bandagoni mu'minash Sokh'ibi lutfu ekh'soni buzurg ast.

175) Beshak, in Shaiton ast, ki shumoro az iovaronash metarsonad. Pas az onkh'o natarsed, zero Shaitonu iovaronash doroi k'udrat nestand. Va agar shumo mu'minoni vok'ei kh'asted, bo poiband gashtan ba ibodat tankh'o az Man bitarsed.

176) Va ei Paiombar, naboiad on kasone az munofik'on, ki az din bargashta, dar rokh'i kufr bo iakdigar peshdasti mekunand, turo g'amgin sozand. Zero onkh'o kh'argiz ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zarare namerasonand, balki bo dur shudan az imonu ibodat ba khud ziion meorand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo makh'rum sokhtani in ch'amoa az tavfik'ash mekhokh'ad onkh'o az ne'matkh'oi okhirat sakh'me nadoshta boshand. Va onkh'oro ruzi k'iiomat dar duzakh azobi azim ast.
177) Kh'amono kasone, ki imonro bo kufr ivaz kardaand, kh'ech' gokh' ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zarare namerasonand, balki khud zarar mebinand va onkh'oro ruzi rastokhez azobi dardovar ast.

178) Va kasoni ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofirshudai dushmani Islom gumon nabarand, ki bo vuch'udi kufr varzidanashon onkh'oro mukh'lat dodani Mo va tuloni sokhtani umrashon baroi onkh'o nek ast. Vok'eiiat on guna ki mepindorand, nest. Ba durusti ki Mo ba onkh'o mukh'lat medikh'em, to bo sodir kardani ma'siiat gunokh'ashon beshtar gardad va onkh'oro azobi khorkunanda muntazir ast.

179) Ei mu'minon, az kh'ikmati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on nest, ki shumoro bar kh'olati khud az omekhtagi bo akh'li nifok', mavch'ud nabudani fark' baini shumo va akh'li nifok' va oshkor nashudani mu'minoni vok'ei voguzorad, to on ki shumoro bo mas'uliiatkh'o va ozmoishkh'oi mukhtalif sanch'ad va mu'minro az munofik' ch'udo sozad. Va az kh'ikmati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on nest, ki shumoro az g'aib ogokh' namoiad va bo in rokh' mu'minro az kofir fark' kuned, valekin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az paiombaronash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, barguzida, uro az ba'ze mas'alakh'oi g'aibi ogokh' megardonad. On guna ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro az akh'voli ba'zei munofik'on ogokh' namuda bud. Pas imoni khudro ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash vok'ei gardoned. Va agar imoni vok'ei biiored va bo ich'roi dasturoti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ezkori kuned, pas nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro podoshi azime ast.

180) Va on kasone, ki ba on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az fazli Khud baroiashon bakhshida ast, bukhl varzida, kh'ak'k'i Uro namepardozand, gumon nakunand, ki in bukhl varzidan baroiashon nek ast, balki in baroiashon bag'oiat bad ast. Zero begumon ruzi k'iiomat on chi ba on bukhl varzidand, ba zavlonae tabdil meiobad, ki bo on tavk' zada va ch'azo doda meshavand. Va tamomi on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barmegardad, zero U ba'd az zavoli mavch'udot Zindavu Poianda memonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'amai asrori korkh'oe, ki mekuned, Bokhabar buda, kh'atman dar badali on ba shumo podosh khokh'ad dod.

181) Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sukhani iakh'udikh'oro shunid, ki guftand: "Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) fak'ir ast, zero az mo k'arz talab mekunad va mo ba sababi on ki doroii ziiod dorem, tavongaronem." Beshubkh'a, Mo on tukh'matero, ki in gurukh' dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo boftaand va paiombaronro ba nokh'ak' kushtaand, kh'amai inro menavisem va ba onkh'o meguem: "Dar duzakh azobi suzoni onro bichashed.

182) Ei iakh'udikh'o, in azob ba sababi ma'siiat va rasvoikh'oest, ki dastoni khudi shumo onro peshopesh firistoda ast va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az bandagonash dar kh'ak'k'i kase zulmkunanda nest."

183) Onkh'o kasoneand, ki beasos va bo durug' guftand: "Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar Kitobkh'oiash va ba vasilai paiombaronash moro tavsiia doda va az mo paimon girifta ast, ki ba kh'ech' rasule to vak'te ki daleli tasdik'kunandai kheshro naorad, imon naorem. On alomati tasdik'gari nubuvvatash on ast, ki ba vositai sadak'ae, ki otashe az osmon omada onro bisuzonad, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdiki bich'uiad." Onkh'o bo nisbat dodani vasiiati bardurug' ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va makh'dud gardonidani dalelkh'oi sidk'i firistodagoni ilokh'i dar on chi guftand, dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' boftand. Binobar in Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Paiombarash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro dastur dod, to dar posukhashon biguiad: "Kh'amono paiombaroni k'abl az man guzashta baroi shumo dalelkh'oi ravshani isbotkunandai rostk'avlii khud va sadak'ai guftaatonro, ki az osmon otash omada, onro bisuzonad, ovarda budand. Pas agar shumo dar on chi megued, sodik'ed, charo paiombaroni guzashtaro ba durug'gui nisbat doda, onkh'oro ba k'atl rasonided?!"

184) Ei Paiombar, pas, agar onkh'o turo durug'gui kh'isoband, g'amgin mashav, zero odati kofiron kh'amin ast. K'abl az tu paiombaroni bisiore ba durug'gui nisbat doda shudaand. Onkh'o dalelkh'oi ravshan va kitobkh'oi shomili pandu andarzkh'o va kitobi bo akh'kom va k'onunkh'oiash rakh'namoro ovarda budand.

185) Kh'ar nafar sarfi nazar az on ki dar kadom satkh' k'aror dorad, noguzir margro mechashad. Baroi kh'amin naboiad kase fireftai in dunio shavad. Va ruzi k'iiomat kh'atman ba shumo muzdkh'oi amalaton ba purragi doda meshavad. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro az otashi ch'akh'annam dur sozad va uro dokhili ch'annat gardonad, iak'inan on banda bo noilshavi ba ch'annat va nach'ot az ch'akh'annam rastagor shuda ast. Va zindagonii dunio ch'uz matoi fanoshavandae besh nest va ba kh'aioti dunio tankh'o shakhsi firebkhurda dil mebandad.

186) Ei akh'li imon! Noguzir shumo dar molkh'oiaton bo pardokhti kh'uk'uk'i voch'ib va duchori ofat gashtani on va inchunin dar ch'onkh'oiaton bo ado namudani mas'uliiatkh'oi shar'i mavridi ozmoish k'aror megired va noguzir az sui shakhsone, ki k'abl az shumo ba onkh'o Kitob doda shuda bud va az sui mushrikon ozori ziiod, ba misli ta'na zadan dar shakhsiiat va dinaton meshunaved. Va agar dar barobari ozmoishu musibatkh'o sabr kuned va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi dasturotash bitarsed, kh'amono in sabru tak'vo az ch'umlai korkh'oest, ki ba irodai k'avi niioz dorad va bandagoni rak'obatkunanda baroi kh'osil namudanash bo kh'am rak'obat mekunand.

187) Va ei Paiombar, ba iod biior, chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az donishmandoni iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob paimoni k'at'i girift, ki kh'atman Kitobi Uro ba mardum ravshan baion menamoed va kh'idoiatu daleli dar on oidi nubuvvati Paiombari Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) mavch'udro pinkh'on namesozed. Pas onkh'o paimonashonro dur afkanda, ba on tavach'ch'ukh' nakardand va kh'ak'ro pushida, botilro oshkor namudand va akh'di bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bastai khudro bo bakh'oi andaki ch'okh'u mol ivaz kardand. Pas bakh'oi andake, ki paimoni ilokh'iro bo on ivaz kardand, bag'oiat bad ast.

188) Ei Paiombar, gumon mabar on kasone, ki bo on chi az amalkh'oi zisht anch'om dodaand, shod meshavand va dust medorand mardum onkh'oro bo amalkh'oi khairi anch'om nadodaashon sitoish kunand, pas onkh'oro dar makh'alli nach'ot az azobi Khudo mapindor, balki ch'oi onkh'o duzakh buda va baroiashon dar ch'akh'annam azobi dardnok ast.

189) Va kh'ukmfarmoii osmonkh'ovu zamin va kh'amai mavch'udoti miioni onkh'o az rui ofarinish va chorasozi tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ama chiz Tavono ast.

190) Beshak, dar biduni namunai sobik' ofaridani osmonkh'o va zamin va paii iakdigar omadani shab va ruz va tafovuti on du az rui darozi va kutokh'i baroi sokh'iboni khiradi solim dalelkh'oi ravshanest, ki onkh'oro ba sui Kholik'i koinot va loik'i ibodat rakh'namoi mekunad.

191) Sokh'ibkhiradon kasoneand, ki dar kh'ama kh'olat, dar kh'olati rost istodan va nishastan va dar kh'olati ba pakh'lukh'oiashon takia zadan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro iod mekunand va dar borai ofarinishi osmonkh'o va zamin andesha namuda meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, Tu in makhluk'i azimro bekh'uda khalk' nakardai, Tu az bekh'udakori pok kh'asti, pas moro bo tavfik' dodan ba anch'omi korkh'oi shoista va makh'fuz nigokh' doshtan az amalkh'oi bad az otashi duzakh dur bigardon.-

192) Zero ei Parvardigori mo, Tu kh'ar kiro az bandagoni Khud dokhili duzakh megardoni, pas, begumon uro khoru rasvo sokhtai. Va zolimon dar ruzi k'iiomat iovarone nadorand, ki azobro az onkh'o bartaraf sozand.-

193) Ei Parvardigori mo, kh'amono mo da'vatgarat Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro shunidem, ki ba sui imon faro khonda meguft: "Ba iagona Ma'budi khesh, Allokh'i Parvardigoraton imon ored", pas mo zud ba da'vatash imon ovardem va az dinash pairavi namudem. Pas Ei Parvardigori mo, gunokh'onamonro pushonida, moro sharmandavu rasvo magardon va az badikh'oiamon darguzashta, much'ozotamon makun va moro bo tavfik' dodan ba anch'omi toat va tarki ma'siiat kh'amrokh'i bandagoni solekh' bimiron.-

194) Ei Parvardigori mo, on chi dar dunio tavassuti zaboni paiombaronat az kh'idoiat va piruzi baroiamon va'da dodai, ba mo ato bikun va dar ruzi k'iiomat moro bo voridi duzakh shudan rasvo magardon. Beshak, Tu Sokh'ibi karam buda, kh'argiz ba va'dai Khud khilof namekuni."

195) Pas, Parvardigorashon duoiashonro paziruft va posukhashon dod, ki "Ba durusti, Man podoshi amalkh'oi kamu ziiodi shumoro, sarfi nazar az mard ast io zan budani sokh'ibi on zoe' namesozam. Ba'zeaton az ba'zei digar kh'asted va dar kh'ukm iakson meboshed. Pas kasone, ki kh'ich'rat kardand va kofiron onkh'oro az diiorashon berun sokhtand va dar rokh'i itoati Man ozor doda shudand va ba khotiri piruzii dini ilokh'i dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'angida va kushta shudand, kh'atman Man ruzi k'iiomat a'moli badi onkh'oro bakhshida, onro makh'v mesozam va onkh'oro voridi bustonkh'oe megardonam, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oi on rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad. Podoshe, ki az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o doda meshavad. Va podoshi neki bemisl tankh'o dar nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast."
196) Ei Paiombar, naboiad gashtuguzori kofiron dar kishvarkh'o va tich'oratu ruzii farokhashon turo bifirebad, ki kh'olati onkh'oro dida, ekh'sosi diltangi va andukh' namoi.
197) Zero in dunio matoi andaki zavoliobanda ast. Sipas ba'd az in dunio farch'omi onkh'o, ki ruzi okhirat ba sui on barmegardand, duzakh ast. Va duzakhi ch'oigokh'i onkh'o nikh'oiat makoni bad ast.

198) Lekin kasone, ki az Parvardigorashon bo ich'roi dasturotash metarsand, onkh'oro bustonkh'oest, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oi on rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad, dar onch'o abadi memonand, ziioftai az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi onkh'o omodashuda ast. Va on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi bandagoni solekh'ash omoda karda ast, az gashtuguzori shakh'rkh'o va lazzatkh'oi zavoliobandai kofiron bekh'tar ast.

199) Va kh'amai akh'li Kitob iakson nestand. Begumon az onkh'o toifae ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va on chi az kh'ak' va kh'idoiat ba shumo va on chi ba onkh'o dar Kitobkh'oiashon furud ovarda shuda ast, imon meorand, paiombaroni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az iakdigar ch'udo namekunand, dar barobari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo rag'bat ba on chi nazdi Ust, dar kh'olati furutani va shikastakh'oli k'aror megirand, oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bo bakh'oi andaki dunio ivaz namekunand. In ch'amoai tavsifshudaro nazdi Parvardigorashon podoshi buzurg ast. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amalkh'oro zud kh'isob namuda, anch'omdikh'andagoni onro zud ch'azo medikh'ad.

200) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi namudaed, dar barobari mas'uliiatkh'oi shar'i va musibatkh'oi dunio bosabr boshed va kofironro dar sabr mag'lub sozed, to az shumo sabri beshtar nadoshta boshand va dar ch'ikh'od poidor bimoned va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi dasturotash bitarsed, shoiad shumo bo emin mondan az otashi duzakh va dukhuli ch'annat ba matlubi khesh noil bishaved.

1) Ei mardum, az azobi Parvardigoraton, ki shumoro az iak inson - Padaraton Odam ofarid va az on kh'amsarash Kh'avvoi modaratonro khalk' kard va az on du dar gushakh'oi gunoguni zamin nasli bisiore az mardonu zanonro muntashir sokht, biparkh'ezed. Va az azobi On Khudoe biparkh'ezed, ki khostai kheshro az iakdigar bo ovardani nomi U va guftani "Turo ba Khudo savgand, ki chunin io chunon bikun" darkhost mekuned va az k'at'i alok'ai kheshovandi biparkh'ezed. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo Nigakh'bonu az kh'amai kh'olatkh'o, guftorkh'o va kirdorkh'oiaton Ogokh' ast. Kh'ech' amalkh'oi shumo az U pushida nest va kh'ar koratonro bo dik'k'at ba kh'isob girifta, dar ivazi on podoshaton medikh'ad.

2) Va ei sarparaston, ba iatimkh'o (kudakone, ki ba sinni balog'at norasida, padaroni kheshro az dast dodaand) chun bolig' shavand va khiradmand boshand, molkh'oiashonro ba tavri komil bidikh'ed va bo rokh'i az iatimon giriftani moli balandsifati arzishmand va dar badalash dodani moli pastsifat kh'alolro bo kh'arom ivaz makuned va moli iatimonro bo moli khesh ilova karda makhured. Ba durusti ki in nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'i azim ast.

3) Va agar khavfi onro doshta boshed, ki vak'te iatimdukhtaroni takh'ti sarparastiaton k'arordoshtaro ba ak'di nikokh' darored, ba sababi kam ado namudani makh'ri voch'ib io bo onkh'o muomilai bad kardan adolatro ba ch'o ovarda nametavoned, pas onkh'oro biguzored va digar zanoni pokdomanro izdivoch' kuned, agar khokh'ed, du io se va io chor zanro ba ak'di nikokh'aton darored. Pas agar az on bitarsed, ki dar baini du io se va io chor zan az ukh'dai adolat namebaroed, pas bo iak zan iktifo namoed io az kanizonaton bakh'ra bared, zero kh'uk'uk'i kanizon bar khoch'aashon monandi kh'uk'uk'i zanoni ozod bar shavkh'aron nest. In kh'ukmi dar oiat k'aidshuda oidi iatimon, iktifo ba nikokh'i iak zan io bakh'ra burdan az kanizon ba sitam nakardan va munkh'arif nagashtanaton nazdiktar ast.

4) Va ba zanon makh'rashonro ba kh'ukmi farzi va kh'adiai biduni ivaz bidikh'ed. Pas, agar onkh'o bo rizomandi va be on ki mach'bur kunonida shavand, chizero az makh'rashon baroi shumo guzarand, dar in surat onro khushu guvoro bikhured.

5) Va ei sarparastoni iatim, molkh'oiatonro ba shakhsoni kamkhirade, ki az ukh'dai tarzi durusti istifodabarii on namebaroiand, nadikh'ed, zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) molkh'oro sababi poidorii manfiatkh'o va vasilai idorai korkh'oi maishii bandagon sokhta ast, ammo in toifai kamkhirad salokh'iiati nigakh'dori va durust istifoda burdani onro nadorand. Va bar onkh'o az on amvol kharch' namoed va bo libos ta'minashon kuned va baroiashon k'avl va va'dai nek bidikh'ed, ki vak'te ba balog'at birasand va az ukh'dai idorai molkh'oiashon baroiand, on chi ba eshon taalluk' dorad, ba onkh'o barmegardoned.

6) Va ei sarparaston, iatimonro chun ba sinni balog'at birasand, bo dodani iak ch'uz'i molashon, to onro istifoda barand, bisanch'ed. Pas agar onkh'o on k'ismati molro khub istifoda burda tavonistand va baroi shumo khiradmandiashon ma'lum shud, dar in surat molkh'oiashonro ba tavri komil ba onkh'o supored. Va kh'angomi pesh omadani kh'och'at molkh'oi iatimonro bo guzashtan az kh'addi muk'arrarsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) makhured va az tarsi on ki vak'te onkh'o ba balog'at merasand, molikiiati kheshro az shumo bozpas megirand, ba khurdani amvolashon mashitobed. Va kh'ar ki mole doshta boshad, ki uro beniioz megardonad, pas az giriftani moli iatim khuddori kunad va kh'ar ki tangdast buda, doroi nadoshta boshad, pas az on ba k'adri niiozash bikhurad. Va chun ba'di ba balog'at rasidani iatimon va ma'lum gashtani ok'il budanashon molkh'oiashonro ba onkh'o suporided, pas bo kh'adafi nigakh'dorii kh'uk'uk' va peshgiri az omilkh'oi iakdigarnofakh'mi bar suporidani amvolashon shokh'id k'aror dikh'ed. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati Guvokh'i in kh'olat va Kh'isobkunandai a'moli bandagon basanda ast.

7) Az on chi novobasta az kamu ziiod budani on, padaru modar va kheshovandon, az k'abili barodaronu amakkh'o ba'd az marg meguzorand, mardon kh'issa dorand va zanon az on chi padaru modar va kheshovandon ba'di marg meguzorand, kh'issa dorand. Bar khilofi zamoni ch'okh'iliiat, ki zanon va kudakon az moli meros makh'rum budand. In kh'issa kh'ak'k'est, ki andozai onro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muaiian karda ast.

8) Va chun dar vak'ti tak'simi moli meros kheshovandon va iatimon va miskinone, ki akh'li meros nestand, kh'ozir shavand, pas az on mol pesh az tak'simot istekh'boban on chi dilaton mekhokh'ad, ba onkh'o bidikh'ed, zero onkh'o ba doroii maiit chashm dukhtaand va in doroi ba shumo biduni ranch' ba dast omada ast va ba in gurukh'i nombarshuda sukhani nek bigued.

9) Va on kasone khavf dorand, ki chun bimirand va ba'd az khud farzandoni khurdsoli notavonashonro biguzorand, on farzandonashon zoe' khokh'and gasht, boiad az sitam namudan dar kh'ak'k'i iatimoni takh'ti sarparastiashon bitarsand, pas boiad bo zulm nakardan az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bikh'arosand, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba'd az margashon baroi farzandonashon kasonero vobasta sozad, ki chunonchi onkh'o ba iatimon neki karda budand, on vobastashudagon niz ba farzandonashon neki namoiand va boiad onkh'o dar kh'ak'k'i farzandoni shakhse, ki kh'angomi vasiiatash kh'ozir budand, neki kunand va ba on shakhsi dar kh'olati k'abl az marg k'arordoshta sukhani ba kh'ak'ik'at rostro biguiand, ki naboiad vai bo vasiiati khud kh'ak'k'i digar vorisonro poimol sozad va naboiad bo tarki vasiiat kheshtanro az khair makh'rum gardonad.

10) Kh'amono kasone, ki molkh'oi iatimonro megirand va dar on az rui zulm raftor mekunand, begumon dar shikami khud otashro mekhurand va kh'atman ruzi k'iiomat ba otashi shu'lavari duzakh vorid khokh'and shud.

11) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo dar borai merosi farzandonaton farmon medikh'ad, ki moli meros baini vorison ba pisar sakh'mi du dukhtar doda shavad. Pas, agar maiit ba'd az khud tankh'o dukhtaronro guzorad, dar in surat agar adadi dukhtaron du nafar io az du beshtar boshad, az se kh'issa du kh'issai moli guzoshtai maiitro megirand va agar iak nafar boshad, pas nisfi moli maiit kh'ak'k'i ust. Va agar maiit farzandi pisar io dukhtar doshta boshad, dar in kh'olat kh'ar iake az padaru modarash az shash kh'issa iak kh'issagii onro ba meros mebarad. Va agar maiit g'air az padaru modar farzand io vorise nadoshta boshad, pas, az se kh'issa iak kh'issai meros kh'ak'k'i modarash va bok'imondai on az padari ust. Va agar maiit du barodar io beshtar az on va io du khokh'ar io beshtar az on khokh'ari kh'amtan va io g'airi kh'amtan doshta boshad, pas, az rui andozai shar'i az shashiaki meros kh'ak'k'i modar va bok'imondai on ba surati ta'sib kh'ak'k'i padar ast va barodaron kh'ak'k'e nadorand. In nav' tak'simi moli meros ba'di ich'roi vasiiati maiit va ba'di pardokhti k'arzash surat megirad. Naboiad vasiiat az seiaki mol beshtar boshad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tak'simi moli merosro kh'amin guna muk'arrar namuda ast, zero shumo namedoned, ki az padaron va farzandonaton az rui manfiat dar duniovu okhirat kadomi onkh'o ba shumo nazdiktar kh'astand. Shoiad maiit nisbat ba kase az vorisonash gumoni nek karda, kh'amai doroii khudro ba vai dikh'ad io bar'aks nisbat ba kase az onkh'o gumoni bad karda, uro az meros makh'rum sozad, kh'ol on ki kh'ak'ik'at khilofi pindori ust. Iagona kase, ki tamomi in asrorro medonad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U pinkh'on nest. Az kh'amin sabab, merosro ba tavri mazkur tak'sim namud va onro bar bandagonash farz gardonid. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donoi Kh'akim ast. Naf'i bandagon az U pushida nameboshad va kh'amai akh'kom va chorasoziash az rui kh'ikmat ast.

12) Va kh'ak'k'i shumo shavkh'aron nisfi on doroiest, ki kh'amsaronaton ba'di margi khesh guzoshtaand, ba sharti on ki onkh'o farzand nadoshta boshand, novobasta az pisaru dukhtar budani on va novobasta az on ki az nasli shumo kh'astand io az kasi digar. Pas agar kh'amsaronaton farzandi pisar io dukhtar doshta boshand, dar in surat kh'ak'k'i shumo az moli ba'di marg guzoshtai onkh'o choriaki on ast. In moli meros ba'd az ich'roi vasiiati kh'amsaronaton va ba'd az pardokhti k'arzashon tak'sim karda meshavad. Va agar shumo shavkh'aron ba'di marg az kh'amsaronaton io az kh'amsaroni k'abliaton farzandi pisar io dukhtar nadoshta boshed, az choriaki moli pas az marg guzoshtaaton az kh'amsaronaton ast. Pas agar shumo farzandi pisar io dukhtar doshta boshed, pas kh'ak'k'i kh'amsaronaton az moli guzoshtaaton az kh'ashtiaki on ast. In mol ba kh'amsaronaton ba'di ich'roi vasiiataton va adoi k'arzaton pardokhta meshavad. Va agar mardi be padaru farzand io zani be padaru farzand bimirad va on mard io zan barodar io khokh'ari modari doshta boshad, pas kh'ar kadomi on az rui andozai shar'i shashiaki molro ba meros mebarand. Pas agar barodaron io khokh'aroni modari az iak nafar beshtar boshand, dar in surat az rui andozai shar'i iakch'oia dar seiaki moli meros sharikand. Mardu zan dar in kh'ukm barobar meboshand. Onkh'o in kh'issai khudro ba'di ich'roi vasiiat va pardokhti k'arzi maiit megirand, ba sharti on ki vasiiat vorisonro bo beshtar budan az andozai seiaki mol duchori zarar nagardonad. In kh'ukmi oiati karima suporishi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, ich'roi on bar shumo farz ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donoi Burdbor ast. Manfiati bandagonashro medonad va onkh'oro zud ch'azo namedikh'ad.

13) In akh'komi dar borai iatimon va g'airi onkh'o zikrshuda k'onun va marzkh'oi muk'arrarsokhtai Allokh' taolo ast, to bandagon tibk'i on amal kunand. Va kh'ar ki az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash bo ich'roi dasturotashon farmon mebarad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro ba bustonkh'oe vorid mesozad, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oiash rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad, onkh'o dar onch'o abadi memonand. Va in podosh rastagorii nikh'oiat buzurg ast. Kh'ech' komiobi ba on barobar nest.

14) Va kh'ar ki az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash bo poimol sokhtani akh'komi shar'i va tarki amal bo on io shubkh'a namudan dar borai on nofarmoni mekunad va az marzkh'oi ilokh'i meguzarad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro voridi duzakh mesozad, onch'o abadi memonad va uro azobi khorkunanda ast.

15) Va zanoni shumo, ki murtakibi zino meshavand, sarfi nazar az much'arrad va g'airi much'arrad budan pas bar onkh'o az baini khud az chakh'or mardi mu'mini odil shokh'idi bitalabed, pas agar on chakh'or mardi odil bar zinoi zanon shokh'idi dikh'and, pas on zanonro kh'amchun much'ozot to vak'ti faro rasidani margashon io to on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi onkh'o g'air az kh'abs rokh'i digarero muk'arrar sozad, dar khonakh'o kh'abs kuned. Ba'di guzashtani chand muddat Khudo baroi mu'minon g'airi kh'absi khonagi rokh'i digarero muk'arrar gardonid. Minba'd dukhtari dushizai zinokor bo sad toziiona va iak sol tab'id makh'kum megardad, ammo zani shavkh'ardori zinokor sangsor meshavad.

16) Va on du kas az mardoni much'arrad io g'airi much'arradi shumo, ki murtakibi zino meshavand, pas onkh'oro bo dastu zabon ch'azo dikh'ed, ki ekh'sosi zillat kunand va az in amal boz istand. Pas, agar on du mardi zinokor az raftori khud tavba namuda va a'molashonro islokh' sozand, dar in surat az ozorashon khuddori kuned. Zero bandai az ma'siiat tavbakor ba monandi kasest, ki guio gunokh' nakarda ast. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Tavbapaziri Mekh'rubon ast. Much'ozoti mardi zinokor bo dastu zabon dar og'oz bud. Vale ba'dan on bo zadani sad toziiona va duri dar g'urbati iak sola ba mardi zinokori much'arrad, pas ba sangsori mardi zinokori sokh'ibi kh'amsar mansukh shud.

17) Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbai bandagonero mepazirad, ki ok'ibat va shumii ma'siiatro nadonista, dar borai farch'omash fikr nakarda, ba on ik'dom menamoiand (kh'olati kh'amai shakhsoni murtakibshavandai gunokh', sarfi nazar az on ki k'asdan gunokh' kardaand io sakh'van kh'amin ast), sipas k'abl az mushokh'idai marg tavba mekunand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbai onkh'oro mepazirad va gunokh'onashonro mebakhshad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donoi Kh'akim ast. Az kh'olati bandagon ogokh' va tak'diru kh'ukmash kh'akimona ast.

18) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbai on kasonero namepazirad, ki kh'amesha gunokh' sodir mekunand va to vak'ti muoiinai sakaroti marg az gunokh'oni khesh tavba namekunand, pas chun marg ba sari bolini iakeashon kh'ozir shavad, meguiad: "Beshak, man az gunokh'onam tavba namudam." Va niz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbai on kasonero, ki dar kh'olati kufr memirand, namepazirad. Mo baroi in ch'amoai to vak'ti omadani marg isionkor va kasoni dar kh'olati kufr favtida azobi dardovar omoda sokhtaem.

19) Ei bandagone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, shumoro ravo nest, ki zanoni padaronaton va zanoni kheshonatonro kh'amchun mol ba meros bared. Inchunin shumo kh'ak' nadored, ki ba'd az vafoti padaronaton nisbat ba kh'amsaroni onkh'o tibk'i tab'i dilaton raftor karda, onkh'oro ba ak'di nikokh'i khud darored io ba shakhsi mekhostaaton izdivoch' kunoned va io onkh'oro az izdivoch' man' namoed. Va naboiad shumo on kh'amsaronatonro, ki dustashon namedored, bo mak'sadi zarar rasonidan dar ak'di nikokh'aton nigokh' dored, to onkh'o az bakh'ri ba'zei on chi ba onkh'o az makh'r va g'aira dodaed, guzarand va shumo onro az khud kuned, magar in ki onkh'o kirdori k'abekh'i ravshanero ba monandi zino murtakib shavand. Agar onkh'o murtakibi in amal gardand, dar in surat shumo kh'ak' dored, ki onkh'oro dar ak'di nikokh'aton nigokh' dored va fishor ored, to bo bargardonidani makh'ri dodaaton io kharch'i dar ak'di nikokh' kardaaton khudro az bandi nikokh'i shumo rakh'onand. Va kh'amrokh'i kh'amsaronaton bo khuddori az ozor dodan va nekui namudan muoshirati duch'onibai khub kuned. Pas, agar shumo onkh'oro az ruii sababkh'oi duniavi napisanded, sabur boshed, chunki shoiad shumo chizero namepisanded va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo dar on chiz nekii ziiodero dar dunio va okhirat k'aror medikh'ad.

20) Va agar shumo shavkh'aron k'asdi talok' dodani kh'amsaraton va dar ivazash kh'amsari digar giriftanro kuned, dar in kor bar shumo gunokh'e nest va agar ba on zane, ki mekhokh'ed talok'ash dikh'ed, ba sifati makh'r moli farovon doda boshed, pas shumo az on mol kh'ak'k'i bargardonidani chizero nadored. Zero begumon bozpas giriftani on tukh'mat va durug'i ravshan ast.

21) Va chi guna makh'ri ba onkh'o dodaatonro bozpas megired va kh'ol on ki baini shumovu onkh'o alok'a, mukh'abbat, bakh'rabardori az iakdigar va ittilo' ioftan az asrori kh'am kh'osil shuda ast?! Ba'd az in alok'akh'oi makh'ramona tama' namudan ba moli dasti kh'amsaron kori bag'oiat zishtu nopisand ast. Chi tavr chunin mekuned va kh'ol on ki zanon dar ivazi on ki onkh'oro bo kalima va shar'i Khudo baroi kheshtan kh'alol gardoned, az shumo paimoni sakht giriftaand?!

22) Va on zanonero, ki padaronaton izdivoch' kardaand, ba ak'di nikokh'i khud nadarored, zero in kor baroi shumo kh'arom shuda ast, magar amalkh'oi k'abl az zukh'uri Islom guzashta, ki dar barobari on ch'avobgar nameshaved. Beshak, izdivoch'i farzandon bo kh'amsaroni padaron amali bag'oiat zisht va boisi khashmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar anch'omdikh'andaash gashta va baroi kase, ki ba in kor ik'dom mekunad, rokh'i khele bad ast.

23) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo nikokh'i modaronaton (modari modar, modari padar va kh'okazo) va dukhtaronaton (dukhtari dukhtar, dukhtari pisar va kh'okazo) va khokh'aroni kh'amtan io g'airi kh'amtanaton va ammakh'oiaton, inchunin ammakh'oi padaronu modaronaton -kh'ar chi bolo ravand- va kholakh'oiaton, inchunin kholakh'oi padaronu modaronaton -kh'ar chi bolo ravand- va dukhtaroni barodar va dukhtaroni khokh'ar, inchunin farzandoni onkh'o -kh'ar chi poion ravand- va on modaronaton, ki shumoro shir dodaand va khokh'aroni shirkhoraaton va modaroni kh'amsaronaton, novobasta az on ki ba'd az izdivoch' bo kh'amsarononaton kh'ambistari kardaed io nakardaed va dukhtaroni kh'amsaronaton (dukhtaroni az digar shavkh'ar ba dunio ovardai onkh'o), ki g'oliban dar khonakh'oi shumo nash'unamo iofta, tarbiiat mebinand -dar surati dar khonakh'oi shumo nash'unamo va tarbiiat naioftanashon niz kh'amin kh'ukmro dorand- ba sharti on ki bo on kh'amsaronaton kh'ambistar shuda boshed, ammo agar bo kh'amsaronaton kh'amkhoba nashudaed, pas dar izdivoch'i dukhtaronashon bar shumo kh'ech' gunokh' nest va izdivoch'i kh'amsaroni on pisaronaton, ki az kamari shumoiand, agar onkh'o bo kh'amsaronashon omezishi ch'insi kh'am nakarda boshand, kh'arom gardonida ast va kh'amsaroni pisaroni shirkhoraaton niz kh'amin kh'ukmro dorand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo dar iak nikokh' ch'am' kunonidani du khokh'ari nasabi io shirkhoraro kh'arom namuda ast, magar on chi az in nav' korkh'o dar davroni ch'okh'iliiat guzashta bud, zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'oni pesh az Islomro afv karda ast. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i tavbakunandagon Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Inchunin dar sunnati sakh'ekh'i Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) sobit shuda ast, ki ch'am' kardani zan bo amma io kholaash dar iak ak'di nikokh' kh'arom meboshad.

24) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo izdivoch'i zanoni shavkh'ardorro kh'arom gardonida ast, magar on zanoni shavkh'ardore, ki dar ch'angi rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) asir meaftand va molikashon meshaved, pas baroiaton kh'ambistari bo in nav' zanon ba'd az on ki bo guzashtani iak kh'aiz bachadonashon pok shavad, durust ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in akh'komro bar shumo farz k'aror doda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) g'air az zanoni zikrshuda digar khonumkh'oro bar shumo kh'alol namuda ast, to bo istifoda az amvoli khesh az rokh'i kh'alol pokii nafsatonro talabida, ba zino mail nakuned. Pas, agar az zanone, ki shar'an izdivoch'ashon ravo ast, bo bastani ak'di nikokh' komi khudro bigired, pas ba onkh'o makh'rashonro, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro bar shumo farz karda ast, bidikh'ed. Va dar on chi ba'd az ta'iini makh'r bo rozigii tarafain muvofik'at karda, makh'ri zanonro afzun mesozed io zanon az bakh'ri ba'zei on meguzarand, bar shumo gunokh'e nest. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai kh'amai khaloik' buda, chize az U pushida nest, dar chorasozi va akh'kom bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

25) Va kh'ar ki az shumo mardon ba sababi kamii molash k'udrati izdivoch'i zanoni ozodro nadoshta boshad, pas kh'ak' dorad bo kanizoni dar molikiiati digaron k'arordoshta ak'di nikokh' bandad, ba sharti on ki on kanizakon dar on chi zokh'iran baroiaton ma'lum megardad, doroi imon boshand va kh'ak'ik'ati imonu botini akh'volatonro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bekh'tar medonad. Shumo va on kanizon dar dinu insoniiat iaksoned. Binobar in, az izdivoch' bo onkh'o kibr nakuned. Pas onkh'oro bo ich'ozati sokh'ibonashon ba ak'di nikokh'aton darored va makh'rashonro biduni nuk'son va ta'khir bidikh'ed, ba sharti on ki on kanizon zanoni pokdoman buda, zinokor naboshand va dustpisaron nagirand, ki makhfiiona bo onkh'o zino kunand. Pas chun on kanizakon izdivoch' kunand, sipas murtakibi amali zishti zino shavand, dar in surat kh'addi ch'urmi zinokoriashon nisfi uk'ubati zanoni ozod, panch'okh' toziiona ast va sangsor nameshavand. Bar khilofi zanoni ozod, ki vak'te zino kunand, agar sokh'ibshavkh'ar boshand, sad toziiona zada shuda va iak sol tab'id megardand, ammo agar dar kh'olati shavkh'ardori ba amali zino dast zanand, sangsor meshavand. In kh'ukmi ravo budani izdivoch' bo kanizoni pokdomani boimon az shumo baroi on kase ast, ki az sodir namudani zino khavf doshta, tavoni nikokh'i zanoni ozodro nadorad. Va sabr kardanaton az izdivoch' bo kanizon baroi shumo bekh'tar ast, zero farzandonro az g'ulomi nigokh' medored. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Az rakh'matash on ast, ki kh'angomi khavfi zino va adami k'udrati izdivoch' bo zanoni ozod nikokh'i kanizonro ch'oiz gardonida ast.

26) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo muk'arrar sokhtani in akh'kom mekhokh'ad baroi shumo k'onunkh'oi din, niz on chiro, ki dar on naf'i dini va ukhravii shumost, baion sozad va shumoro dar bobi kh'alolu kh'arom, akhlok'i kh'amida va raftorkh'oi pisandida ba rokh'kh'oi paiombaroni pesh az shumo guzashta rakh'namoi kunad, to az onkh'o pairavi namoed va shumoro az ma'siiat ba sui toatash bargardonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donoi Kh'akim ast. Manfiati bandagonro medonad va onro ch'oiz megardonad, kh'ukmu chorasozii korkh'o az rui kh'ikmatash surat megirad.

27) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhokh'ad tavbaatonro bipazirad va gunokh'onatonro biomurzad va kasone, ki dunboli lazzatkh'oiashon megardand, mekhokh'and shumo az rokh'i rost khele k'ach' shaved va ba sui botil mail namoed.

28) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhokh'ad az shumo akh'komashro sabuk va oson gardonad, ba korkh'oi az tavonaton ziiod muvazzafaton nasozad. Zero U medonad, ki inson dar surat va khilk'at notavon ofarida shuda ast.

29) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi namudaed, naboiad amvoli iakdigarro bo rokh'i botil, az k'abili g'asb, duzdi, rishva va g'aira bigired, lekin vak'te on amvol ba vositai tich'orati shumo bo rozigii ch'onibain kh'osil shavad, dar in kh'olat iste'mol va istifodai on kh'alol ast. Va naboiad ba'zeaton ba'zei digarro bikushad va niz naboiad kase az shumo khudro ba k'atl rasonad io ba kh'alokat andozad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba shumo bisior Mekh'rubon ast. Az rakh'matash on ast, ki rekhtani khuni begunokh', sitonidani moli g'air va dastdarozi ba obrui digaronro bar shumo kh'arom namuda ast.

30) Va kh'ar ki donista va k'asdan -na az rui nodoni io sakh'van- moli g'airro banokh'ak' mekhurad io bo rokh'i k'atl va monandi on ba ch'oni kase dastdarozi mekunad va io khudro ba kh'alokat meandozad, pas, Mo begumon ruzi k'iiomat in bandaro ba otashi buzurgi duzakh medarorem va az kh'aroratu azobash ranch' mebarad. Va in kor baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat oson ast. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti K'odir buda, chize Uro och'iz sokhta nametavonad.

31) Ei mu'minon, agar shumo az sodir kardani gunokh'oni kabira, az k'abili shirk ovardan ba Khudo, ozori volidain, rekhtani khuni nokh'ak', iste'moli ribo va g'aira duri ch'ued, Mo az shumo gunokh'oni khurdatonro makh'v mesozem va shumoro ba makoni arzishmandi ch'annat medarorem.

32) Va ei mu'minon, on chizero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba'zeatonro bo on bar ba'zei digar bartari doda ast, orzu nakuned, to in orzui ne'mati g'air boisi ba g'azab va kh'asad giriftor shudanaton nagardad. Binobar in, naboiad zanon ne'matkh'oi makhsusi mardonro orzu kunand, zero kh'ar kadome az gurukh'i mardon va zanon tibk'i on khususiiatkh'o podoshi ba khud munosibro dorand. Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitalabed, to baroiaton az atoi Khud biafzoiad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ama chiro medonad. Az in ru, ba mardon va zanon mas'uliiat va amalkh'oero doda ast, ki ba onkh'o munosib meboshad.

33) Va Mo baroi kh'ar iaki shumo vorisonero k'aror dodaem, ki az merosi ba'di margi khesh guzoshtai padaru modar va kheshovandon meros mebarand. Va kasone, ki bo onkh'o oidi kh'ampaimoni va kumaki tarafain savgandkh'oi k'at'i khurda, akh'd bastaed, pas ba onkh'o az moli meros sakh'mashonro bidikh'ed. Albatta, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ama chiz, az ch'umla bar in savgand va paimonkh'oi bastai shumo Guvokh' ast. Kh'ukmi bo rokh'i kh'ampaimoni meros burdan az iakdigar dar ibtidoi Islom bud va minba'd mansukh gardid.

34) Mardon zanonro sarparasti va korkh'oiashonro idora mekunand, ba sababi on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mardonro bo ba'zei khususiiatkh'o bar zanon bartari doda ast va ba sababi on ki nafak'ai zanon va idorai umuri onkh'o bar zimmai mardon voch'ib buda, az amvolashon baroi zanon kharch' mekunand. Modom ki chunin ast, pas, zanoni solekh'a on kasoneand, ki farmonbardori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va shavkh'aronashon buda, bo kh'ifzu tavfik'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar g'oibii shavkh'aron nigakh'dorandai onkh'o kh'astand. Va on zanone, ki az sarkashiashon mekh'arosed, pas islokh'ashonro avval az pand va bim dodan az Khudo og'oz kuned va agar pandatonro napaziruftand, pas onkh'oro dar bistar tark sozed va kh'ambistari nakuned va dar surati sud nabakhshidani in uslub onkh'oro be shiddat va be past zadani sha'nu sharaf bizaned. Ba'd az in agar az shumo farmonbardori kardand, pas baroi ozorashon kh'ech' rokh'ero nach'ued. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Balandmartabai dar zotu sifotash Buzurg ast. Az in ru, tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed.

35) Va ei sarparastoni mardu zan, agar shumo khavfi onro doshta boshed, ki nofakh'mi baini zanu shavkh'ar ba kh'addi dushmani va ch'udoi merasad, pas mardi odilero az akh'li shavkh'ar va mardi odilero az akh'li zan bifiristed, to miioni on du oidi ch'udoshavi io iakch'oshavi bar asosi manfiati tarafain dovari kunand. Ioftani rokh'i musolakh'a va ch'am'i baini zavch'ain az ch'udoiashon bekh'tar ast. Agar on du dovar k'asdi islokh' doshta boshand va ba khotiri sozishi zanu shavkh'ar rokh'i munosibro pesh girand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar bainashon ulfatu iakdigarfakh'mi ech'od mekunad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donoi Bokhabar ast. Asrori k'albi bandagonashro medonad va kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest.

36) Va iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro biparasted va nisbat ba padaru modaron neki kuned va nisbat ba kheshovandon va iatimon va benavoion va kh'amsoiai kheshovand va kh'amsoiai g'airi kheshovand va rafik'i pakh'lu va musofiri g'aribi az vatan dur va g'ulomonu kanizon neki kuned. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kasi khudpisandi mutakabbiri bo fakhr khudsitoro dust namedorad.

37) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) inchunin on kasonero, ki az ruzii ba onkh'o dodaash kh'uk'uk'i voch'ibro boz doshta, bukhl mevarzand va mardumro bo guftoru kirdorashon ba bukhl varzidan farmon medikh'and va on chiro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az fazlash ba misli ruziiu donishu g'airi on ba onkh'o ato namuda ast, pinkh'on mesozand, kh'ak'ik'atro ba mardum nameguiand, balki onro makhfi doshta, botilro oshkor mekunand, dust namedorad. In kh'ama khislatkh'oi kofiron ast. Va Mo iak'inan baroi kofiron azobi khorkunandaro omoda kardaem.

38) Va Mo azobro inchunin baroi kasone omoda sokhtaem, ki amvoli kheshro ba mak'sadi on ki mardum kori onkh'oro dida, madkh'ashon kunand, kharch' mesozand va onkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ba ruzi okhirat imon nameorand. Beshak, onkh'oro pairavii Shaiton gumrokh' sokhta ast. Va kh'ar ki kh'amdamu kh'amnafasash Shaiton boshad, pas chi kh'amdamu kh'amnafasi bad ast.

39) Va agar in ch'amoa ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi okhirat imoni vok'ei orand va az amvoli ba onkh'o ruzi namudai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kholisona, biduni riiokori dar rokh'kh'oi mavridi pisandi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kharch' sozand, chi ziion mebinand?! Bar'aks in amal khairi makh'z ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai onkh'o ast. Akh'volashon az U pushida nest va kh'atman ba kh'ar iak shakhs ch'azoi bosazo khokh'ad dod.

40) Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Odil buda, nisbat ba bandagonash kamtarin sitamro ravo namebinad, az nekikh'oiashon ba andozai murchai khurd kam namekunad va ba badikh'oiashon chizero zam namesozad. Va agar nekiashon ba andozai murchai khurd boshad, podoshashro az fazlash chand barobar afzun megardonad va ilova bar in az nazdi Khud podoshi azim medikh'ad.

41) Pas, vak'te Mo dar okhirat paiombari kh'ar iak ummatro, ki bar ummatonash guvokh'i medikh'ad, biiorem va tu Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro ba sifati shokh'id bar ummatonat biiorem, on gokh' vaz'i iakh'udu nasoro va kofironi digar chi guna khokh'ad bud?!

42) Bandagone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudaand va Paiombarashro nofarmoni kardaand, dar ruzi azimi rastokhez orzui khok shudan va ba zamin iakson gashtanro mekunand. Va onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' amalashonro pinkh'on namesozand, chunki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar zabonashon mukh'r mezanad va a'zoi badanashon bo izni U alaikh'ashon guvokh'i medikh'and.

43) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi namudaed, dar kh'olati masti namoz naguzored to on ki ba khud biioed va ba guftakh'oi khesh sarfakh'm biraved. (In kh'ukm k'abl az kh'aromi mutlak' gashtani nushidani sharob bud.) Va dar kh'olati ch'anobat namoz nakhoned va dar chunin kh'olat ba masch'id nadaroed to on ki g'usl kuned, magar on ki kh'amchun rakh'guzar be istodan az on guzared. Va agar ba shumo bemorie birasad, ki istifoda burdani ob nomumkin gardad io musofir boshed io kase az shumo az k'azoi kh'och'at bargardad va io bo kh'amsaronaton omezishi ch'insi kuned, pas ob naiobed, dar chunin kh'olat k'asdi khoki pok namuda, az on bar chekh'rakh'o va dastonaton maskh' bikashed. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Afvkunandai Omurzanda ast. Az tak'sirotaton meguzarad.

44) Ei Paiombar, oio khislat va maromi iakh'udikh'oro, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o kh'issae az ilmi Tavrotro doda ast, namedoni?! Onkh'o kh'idoiatro bo zalolat ivaz mekunand va bar gumrokh'sozii shumo mu'minon az rokh'i Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bag'oiat kh'arisand va mekhokh'and shumo niz ba rokh'i kach'i onkh'o raved.

45) Va ei mu'minon, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dushmanonatonro az shumo bekh'tar medonad. Binobar in, oidi dushmanonaton ba shumo ma'lumot doda, adovatashonro ba shumo baion sokhta ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati Korsozi shumo basanda ast, az sharri dushmanon kh'ifzaton mekunad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati Iovari shumo basanda ast, az dasisa va ozori onkh'o nigokh'aton medorad va piruzaton megardonad.

46) Ba'zei iakh'udikh'o Kalomi Khudoro az mavze'kh'oi khud tag'iir doda, onro ba ma'noi g'airi asliash ta'vil mekunand va chun Rasuli Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) onkh'oro ba ich'roi kore amr kunad, ba u meguiand: "Sukhanatro shunidem va amratro nofarmoni kardem", inchunin bo rishkhand ba u meguiand: "Isma' g'aira musma'", ia'ne "On chi meguem, bishunav, dar kh'ole ki nashunida boshi" va "Ro'ino" gufta on guna vonamud mekunand, ki guio mak'sadashon az in ch'umla "Ba on chi az tu suol mekunem, gush kun" ast, ammo kh'adafashon az on ifodai ma'noi "Tu akh'mak' kh'asti" buda, zabonashonro dar guftani on ba mak'sadi duoi bad nisbat ba Rasuli Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va ta'na zadani Islom mepechand. Va agar onkh'o dar ivazi "Sukhanatro shunidem va az amrat itoat nakardem", "Sukhanatro shunidem va amratro ich'ro kardem" va dar ivazi "On chi meguem, bishunav, dar kh'ole ki nashunida boshi", "On chi meguem, bishunav" va dar ivazi "Ro'ino", "Muntazir shav, to sukhanatro bifakh'mem" meguftand, in ba onkh'o az guftakh'oiashon bekh'tar va ba adolat nazdiktar bud. Zero dar tarzi baioni duium odobi neki sazovori mak'omi Ch'anobi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba inobat girifta shuda ast. Valekin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba sababi kufrashon la'nat karda, az rakh'matash ronda gardonid. Pas ch'uz te'dodi andakashon imoni sudmand nameorand.

47) Ei k'avmi iakh'udu nasoro, ki ba shumo Kitobi Tavrotu Inch'il doda shuda ast, ba K'ur'oni bar Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilkardai Mo, ki tasdik'gari Tavrotu Inch'ili shumost, imon ored, pesh az on ki a'zoi doroi kh'issi dar chekh'rakh'o mavch'udi chashm, gush, bini, dakh'on, abru va labro makh'v sozem, pas onkh'oro ba tarafi pushtashon gardonem io pesh az on ki sokh'ibonashonro az rakh'mati Khesh bironem, chunonchi "Ioroni shanbe"-ro, ki ruzi shanbe ba'di man'shavii shikori mokh'i dar ruzi shanbe shikor kardand, la'nat namuda, az rakh'mati Khud dur gardonida, simoi onkh'oro ba surati buzina tabdil dodem. Va farmoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'atman vok'e'shavanda ast.

48) Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'i ba U sharik sokhtani chizero kh'argiz namebakhshad va ba ch'uz shirku kufr digar gunokh'onro baroi kh'ar ki khokh'ad, bo fazlash meomurzad io bo adlash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, ba andozai ma'siiatash azob mekunad. Va kh'ar ki makhluk'ero ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik mesozad, pas begumon az nazdi khud gunokh'i nobakhshidanii azime bofta ast, ki agar ba kh'amin kh'ol bimirad, gunokh'ash bakhshida nameshavad.

49) Ei Paiombar, oio kasonero, ki khud va amalashonro madkh'u takh'sin mekunand va lofi bekh'uda mezanand, namedoni?! Balki tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ar ki az bandagonash khokh'ad, takh'sin mekhonad va pokash megardonad, chunki U az rozkh'oi dilkh'o Ogokh' ast. Va kh'ech' gokh' az podoshi a'moli onkh'o agarchi ba andozai rishtai dokhili donai khurmo khurd kh'am boshad, kam va sitam karda nameshavad.
50) Ei Paiombar, bubin, ki onkh'o bo khudsitoi chitavr bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' mebofand. Va kh'amin korashon ba sifati gunokh'i oshkorsozandai zalolatashon basanda ast.

51) Ei Paiombar, oio kh'olati iakh'udikh'oero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o kh'issae az donishro doda ast, namedoni va az raftorashon taach'ch'ub namekuni?! Onkh'o ba ma'budkh'oi g'air az Khudo giriftaashon imon meorand va bo mak'sadi khushomadgui dar borai kofironi K'uraish meguiand; "Inkh'o az mu'minoni askh'obi Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) beshtar kh'idoiatiofta kh'astand."

52) In ch'amoai doroi chunin e'tik'odi fosid kasoneand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro la'nat namuda, az rakh'mati Khesh ronda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro az rakh'matash meronad, pas kh'argiz baroiash iovarero, ki korkh'oiashro somon dikh'ad, nameiobi.
53) Onkh'o az podshokh'i kh'ech' sakh'me nadorand. Pas agar az podshokh'i sakh'm medoshtand, kh'ech' gokh' az on, kh'atto ba andozai nuk'tai pushti donai khurmo ba kase chize namedodand.

54) Balki onkh'o ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va ioronash baroi on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o nubuvvat, imon va k'udratmandi doda ast, kh'asad mebarand. Charo onkh'o ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va askh'obash kh'asad mebarand?! Naboiad chunin kunand, zero Mo begumon dar guzashta ba nasli Ibrokh'im Kitob va on chi g'airi Kitob paig'om shuda bud, bakhshida va ba onkh'o podshokh'ii azim doda budem.

55) Pas ba'zei akh'li Kitob ba on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) va paiombaroni az naslash padidomada furud ovard, imon ovardand va az ba'zei digarashon az on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furud ovard, rui gardonidand va kofir shudand. Onkh'o dar barobari Kitob va dini Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ainan chunin mavk'e' giriftand. Va baroi azobi kofiron otashi furuzoni duzakh basanda ast.

56) Beshak, kasone, ki ba oiatkh'oi Mo kofir gashtaand, kh'atman Mo onkh'oro ruzi k'iiomat ba otashi az kh'ar su ikh'otakunanda vorid mesozem. Kh'ar vak't pustkh'oi badanashon pukhta shavad, g'airi on digar pustkh'oro ba onkh'o ivaz mekunem, to paivasta azobro bichashand. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti G'olibi Mag'lubnashavandai dar tak'diru tadbirash Kh'akim ast.

57) Va kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, az Paiombarash pairavi karda va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, begumon Mo onkh'oro ruzi k'iiomat ba bustonkh'oe dokhil mekunem, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oi on rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad, dar onch'o abadi memonand. Baroi onkh'o dar ch'annat kh'amsaroni az kh'ar palidi pok mavch'ud ast. Va Mo onkh'oro ba soiai g'afsi doimi, ki dar on garmi va sardi nest, vorid mesozem.

58) Beshubkh'a, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro farmon medikh'ad, ki amonatkh'oro ba sokh'ibonashon birasoned va chun dar baini mardum dovari karded, adolat kuned va dar k'azovati khesh ba sitamkori rokh' nadikh'ed. Kh'amono on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro ba on pand medikh'ad va rakh'namoi mekunad, bag'oiat nek ast. Albatta, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai guftorkh'o, Binandai kirdorkh'oi shumo ast.

59) Ei akh'li imon, bo ich'roi dasturot Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro itoat kuned va Rasulashro itoat kuned va tobe' ba farmonbardorii Khudovu Rasul az amri farmonravoionaton niz itoat namoed, ba sharti on ki shumoro ba ma'siiat farmon nadikh'and. Pas agar dar borai chize bo kh'am ikhtilof namuded, agar ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi k'iiomat imon dored, pas kh'alli onro ba sui Kitobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va sunnati Paiombarash (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bargardoned. In bargardonidani mas'ala ba sui K'ur'onu sunnat baroi shumo az idoma dodani ikhtilof va takia namudan bar ra'ii khesh bekh'tar va farch'omi nektar dorad.

60) Ei Paiombar, oio ziddiiati baini k'avlu amali munofik'onro nadidi!? Onkh'o da'voi durug' mekunand, ki guio ba on chi bar tu va on chi bar paiombaroni k'abl az tu furud ovarda shuda ast, imon dorand, ammo mekhokh'and dovariro dar kh'alli nizo'kh'oi khesh ba sui g'airi shar'i Khudo bibarand va kh'ol on ki onkh'o amr shudaand, ki boiad ba dovar k'aror dodani g'airi shar'i Khudo kofir shavand?! Va Shaiton mekhokh'ad onkh'oro az rokh'i rost gumrokh' va dur sozad, to digar kh'idoiat naioband.

61) Va ei Paiombar, chun ba in munofik'on gufta shavad: "Ba sui kh'ukmi dar Kitobi khesh nozilkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ba sui Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) biioed, to dar baini shumo oidi k'aziiakh'oi ikhtilofiaton dovari namoiad", onkh'oro mebini, ki komilan az tu rui megardonand va ba dovarii g'airi shariatat rui meorand.

62) Pas, chun ba munofik'on ba sababi gunokh'oni sodir kardaashon musibat rasad, sipas bo ma'zaratkhokh'i nazdat omada, ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savgand iod mekunand, ki: "K'asam ba Allokh', mo bo dovar k'aror dodani g'airi tu dar k'aziiakh'oi bakh'stalabi khud ch'uz ekh'son va ech'odi sozish miioni tarafkh'o chizero namekhostem." kh'olatashon chi guna khokh'ad bud?! Kh'ol on ki onkh'o dar da'voi khesh durug'guiand. Zero ekh'soni kh'ak'ik'i on ast, ki banda dar kh'alli k'aziiakh'oi bakh'stalab k'onuni Khudoro dovar gardonad.

63) In toifa kasoneand, ki on chi dar k'albashon az nifok'u k'asdi bad pinkh'on kardaand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad. Az in ru, munofik'onro ba kh'olashon biguzor va az onkh'o rui bigardon va kh'ukmi ilokh'iro ba onkh'o bo tashvik' va bim dodan baion soz va ba onkh'o k'avli ta'sirnoki shadide bigu, ki dar umk'i k'albashon ch'oigir shavad.

64) Va Mo kh'ech' paiombarero nafiristodem, magar baroi on ki dar on chi ba mardum farmon medikh'ad, bo khostu tak'diri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) itoat shavad. Va ei Paiombar, vak'te onkh'o bo sodir kardani ma'siiat bar ch'oni khesh zulm kardand, agar dar kh'oli zinda budanat nazdi tu omada, ba gunokh'i khud e'tirof karda, izkh'ori pushaimoni namuda, tavba kunand va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omurzish khokh'and va tu az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon omurzish khokh'i, beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bag'oiat Tavbapaziri Mekh'rubon meioband.

65) Pas, vok'eiiat on tavre nest, ki munofik'on da'vo dorand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Zoti muk'addasi Khud savgand iod karda meguiad: "Ei Paiombar, k'asam ba Parvardigorat, onkh'o mu'mini vok'ei nameshavand to on ki dar tamomi k'aziiakh'oi bakh'stalabi dar bainashon rukhdoda turo dar kh'olati zinda budanat va shar'i ovardaatro ba'di az dunio guzashtanat dovar k'aror dikh'and, sipas ba dovariat rozi shuda, dar k'albashon oidi kh'ukmi sodirkardaat ekh'sosi tangdili va shubkh'a paido nakunand va bo zokh'iru botin ba purragi taslim gardand."

66) Va agar Mo bar onkh'o kushtani iakdigar io az sarzaminkh'oiashon berun shudanro farz megardonidem, ch'uz te'dodi andakashon kase in farmonro ich'ro namekard. Binobar in, boiad shukri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o orand, ki onkh'oro ba korkh'oi az tavonashon berun va mashak'k'atovar mukallaf nasokhta ast. Va agar onkh'o itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro, ki ba anch'omi on pand doda meshavand, ich'ro mekardand, iak'inan in baroiashon az khilofkori bekh'tar bud va imonashonro ustuvortar megardonid. 67) Va on vak't Mo ba onkh'o az nazdi Khesh podoshi buzurg medodem.
68) Va kh'atman ba onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui rokh'i vaslkunanda ba Khud va ch'annatro mebakhshidem.

66) Va agar Mo bar onkh'o kushtani iakdigar io az sarzaminkh'oiashon berun shudanro farz megardonidem, ch'uz te'dodi andakashon kase in farmonro ich'ro namekard. Binobar in, boiad shukri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o orand, ki onkh'oro ba korkh'oi az tavonashon berun va mashak'k'atovar mukallaf nasokhta ast. Va agar onkh'o itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro, ki ba anch'omi on pand doda meshavand, ich'ro mekardand, iak'inan in baroiashon az khilofkori bekh'tar bud va imonashonro ustuvortar megardonid. 67) Va on vak't Mo ba onkh'o az nazdi Khesh podoshi buzurg medodem.
68) Va kh'atman ba onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui rokh'i vaslkunanda ba Khud va ch'annatro mebakhshidem.

66) Va agar Mo bar onkh'o kushtani iakdigar io az sarzaminkh'oiashon berun shudanro farz megardonidem, ch'uz te'dodi andakashon kase in farmonro ich'ro namekard. Binobar in, boiad shukri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o orand, ki onkh'oro ba korkh'oi az tavonashon berun va mashak'k'atovar mukallaf nasokhta ast. Va agar onkh'o itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro, ki ba anch'omi on pand doda meshavand, ich'ro mekardand, iak'inan in baroiashon az khilofkori bekh'tar bud va imonashonro ustuvortar megardonid. 67) Va on vak't Mo ba onkh'o az nazdi Khesh podoshi buzurg medodem.
68) Va kh'atman ba onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui rokh'i vaslkunanda ba Khud va ch'annatro mebakhshidem.

69) Va kh'ar ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulashro itoat kunad, pas in gurukh'i bandagoni mute' kh'amrokh'i on kasone az paiombaron va siddik'oni dar tasdik'i dini paiombaron ba kamol rasida va shakh'idoni rokh'i Kh'ak' va bandagoni doroi zokh'iru botini solekh' kh'astand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo dokhil shudani in nombarshudagon ba ch'annat nisbat ba onkh'o in'om karda ast. Va in ch'amoai iodshuda dar ch'annat chi rafik'oni nekuiand.

70) In podoshi zikrshuda lutfi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar bandagonash ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati Donandai akh'volashon basanda ast. U begumon ba kh'ar kas dar badali amalash ch'azoi bosazo medikh'ad.

71) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi namudaed, az dushmanonaton bo istifoda az asbobi muk'obili onkh'o iorirason ekh'tiioti kheshtanro bigired, pas ba sui onkh'o gurukh'-gurukh' berun shaved io ba iakch'oiagi berun shaved. Intikhobi iake az in du kh'olati khuruch'i gurukh'-gurukh' io dastach'am'i vobasta ba manfiat va zarba zadan ba dushman dar dasti shumost. Agar khuruch'i gurukh'-gurukh' foidai beshtar doshta boshad, az in va agar khuruch'i dastach'am'i foidai beshtar doshta boshad, az khuruch'i dastach'am'i istifoda bared.

72) Va ei musalmonon, iak'inan az miioni shumo mardume kh'astand, ki az tarsui az khorich' shudan baroi ch'angidan muk'obili dushman kundi va susti mekunand va digaronro niz kund va sust megardonand. Manzur az in mardum munofik'on va shakhsoni doroi imoni zaifand. Pas agar ba shumo kushtor io shikaste birasad, kh'ar iakei onkh'o az khushkh'olii on ki solim monda ast, meguiad: "Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar man lutf karda ast. Zero bo onkh'o dar nabard kh'ozir nashudam va az oseb emin mondam."

73) Va ei musalmonon, agar ba shumo bo piruzi io ch'am'ovarii g'animat fazli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) birasad, on shakhse, ki az ch'ikh'od ak'ibnishini karda bud, guio az zumrai shumo nabuda ast va miioni shumo va u kh'ech' gokh' mukh'abbatu dusti vuch'ud nadoshta ast, ki meguiad: "Ei kosh, man niz dar in nabard bo mu'minon mebudam, pas bo ishtirok kardanam ba monandi onkh'o ba komiobi va zafarmandii azim merasidam."

74) Pas, boiad dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kholisona on mu'minoni sodik'e bich'angand, ki zindagonii dunioro az sababi rag'bat nadoshtan ba on bo zindagonii abadii okhirat ivaz mekunand, zero onkh'o kh'amesha mushtok'i okhiratand. Va kh'ar ki dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kholisona mech'angad, pas kushta shuda, shakh'id meshavad io alaikh'i dushman piruz megardad, Mo begumon ba u podoshi azimi ch'annat va rizoi Khudro medikh'em.

75) Va ei mu'minon, shumoro az ch'angidan dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mak'sadi baland bardoshtani kalimai Kh'ak' va rakh'onidani mardon va zanon va kudakoni notavon, ki duo karda meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, moro az sarzamini Makka, ki akh'li on bo shirk ovardan ba Tu va dast darozi ba bandagonat zolimand, berun kun va baroi mo az nazdi Khud kasero k'aror bidekh', ki koramonro bo kh'ifzu kh'imoiat sarparasti kunad va baroiamon madadrasone k'aror bidekh', ki az mo zararro bartaraf namoiad." chi man' mekunad?!

76) Mu'minoni sodik' kholisona dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mech'angand va kofiron dar rokh'i ma'budkh'oiashon mech'angand. Pas muk'obili iovaroni Shaiton bich'anged. Agar shumo muk'obilashon bo sidk'u ikhlos bich'anged, mag'lubashon mekuned, chunki makri Shaiton bag'oiat notavon buda, ba bandagoni tavakkulkunanda zarare namerasonad.

77) Ei Paiombar, magar kh'olati ba'zei ioronatro namedoni, ki onkh'o dar borai farz gashtani ch'ikh'od pursidand, pas dar ch'avobashon gufta shud: "Dastonatonro az ch'ang nigokh' dored va namozro barpo kuned va zakoti molatonro pardozed." In rukhdod k'abl az farz shudani ch'ikh'od bud. Pas chun ba Madinai Munavvara kh'ich'rat kardand va Islom doroi izzat gashta, ch'ikh'od bar onkh'o farz gardonida shud, in kh'ukm baroi ba'zeashon dushvor omada, az mardum monandi az Khudo tarsidan io az on kh'am sakhttar metarsidand. Va guftand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, charo muk'obili dushman ch'angidanro bar mo farz kardi? Charo onro to iak muddati nazdik ba ta'khir naguzoshti, to az lazzatkh'oi dunio bakh'ramand shavem." Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Matoi dunio kh'ar chi boshad, andaki fanoshavanda ast. Va okhirat baroi kase, ki bo ich'roi dasturot az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) metarsad, bekh'tar ast, zero ne'matkh'oi on abadi va bezavoland. Va az amalkh'oi shoistai shumo, kh'atto ba andozai rishtai dokhili donai khurmo kam nameshavad va mavridi zulm k'aror namegired."

78) Kh'ar kuch'o boshed va lav dar k'asrkh'oi mustakh'kami dur az maidoni nabard kh'am k'aror doshta boshed, chun mukh'lati margaton faro rasad, on domangiraton megardad va agar ba in munofik'on nekii farakh'bakhsh ba misli farzandu ruzi birasad, meguiand: "In az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast." Va agar ba onkh'o dar farzand va ruziashon sakhti birasad, az Paiombari Allokh' foli bad girifta meguiand: "In kh'olati bad ba sababi tu ba mo rasida ast." Ei Paiombar, dar ch'avobi in toifa bigu: "Tamomi kh'olatkh'oi osoni va sakhti bo k'azovu k'adari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast." Modom ki chunin ast, pas guiandagoni in guna sukhankh'oro chi shuda ast, ki k'arib sukhani ba onkh'o guftai turo namefakh'mand.

79) Ei farzandi Odam, on chi az farzand va ruzi, ki khushkh'olat mesozad, ba tu birasad, pas on az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, bo ne'matkh'oi Khud bar tu lutf karda ast. Va on chi az badi ba farzand va rizk'at birasad, pas on ba sababi gunokh'i sodir namudai tust. Va ei Paiombar, Mo turo ba sui tamomi mardum ba kh'aisi firistodai Khesh ravon kardem, to ba onkh'o paiomi ilokh'iro birasoni. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ovardani burkh'onkh'oi k'ote' ba sifati Shokh'idi sidk'i nubuvvati tu basanda ast.

80) Va kh'ar ki Paiombari Khudoro bo ich'roi amr va parkh'ez az nakh'i itoat kunad, pas begumon az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) itoat karda ast. Va ei Paiombar, kh'ar ki az itoati tu rui gardonad, g'amgin mashav, zero Mo turo baroi on nafiristodaem, ki nozir va nigakh'boni korkh'oi in toifa bandagon boshi.

81) Va munofik'on ba tu bo zabon meguiand: "Farmonatro itoat mekunem." Pas chun az nazdat berun shavand, iak iddae az onkh'o on chiro baroiat oshkor kard, ba tavri makhfi bar khilofi on chorach'ui mekunad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chi chorach'ui mekunand, medonad va dar ivazi dasisakh'oi omoda kardaashon ch'azoiashon medikh'ad. Az in sabab ba onkh'o tavach'ch'ukh' makun, zero ba tu zarar rasonda nametavonand va korkh'oiatro ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'avola namuda, tankh'o ba U tavakkul namo. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati Korsoz basanda ast, ki dar tamomi korkh'oiat ba U e'timod kuni.

82) Charo in ch'amoa dar borai K'ur'on andesha namekunand va onro namekhonand, to baroiashon sobit gardad, ki dar in Kitob kh'ech' nav'i ikhtilof dar ma'no va nokh'amvori dar kh'ukm vuch'ud nadoshta, on begumon Kitobi barkh'ak' ast. Va agar in K'ur'on az nazdi g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mebud, onkh'o kh'atman dar akh'komash nokh'amvori va dar ma'nokh'oiash ikhtilofi ziiod meioftand.

83) Va chun ba munofik'on khabari kore, ki marbut ba emini va khushkh'oli io tars va andukh'i musalmonon ast, biioiad, zud onro ifsho va pakh'n mesozand. Va agar sabr namuda, onro ba sui Paembari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va khiradmandon, donishmandon, nosekh'on barmegardonidand, beshak, az baini onkh'o akh'li nazar va istinbot bo on khabar chi kor kardanro dark mekardand, ki oio nashr shavad va io makhfi monad. Va ei akh'li imon, agar lutfi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba vositai Islom va markh'amatash ba vositai K'ur'on bar shumo namebud, ki az bemorikh'oi ma'navii munofik'on nach'otaton doda ast, iak'inan shumo, ba ch'uz shumorai andak az vasvasakh'oi Shaiton pairavi mekarded.

84) Modom ki chunin ast, pas ei Paiombar, dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo mak'sadi baland bardoshtani dini ilokh'i bich'ang. Az tu oidi digaron pursida nameshavad, zero tu tankh'o ba on mukallaf shudai, ki khudro bar ch'angidan dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vodor namoi. Va mu'minonro bar ch'angidan dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) targ'ib kun. Shoiad Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ch'angidani shumo nerui kofironro bartaraf va man' sozad va k'uvvai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shadidtar va uk'ubatash sakhttar ast.

85) Kh'ar ki baroi ch'albi neki ba digaron sa'i mekunad, az podoshi on neki kh'issae az u meshavad va kh'ar ki baroi ch'albi badi ba digaron talosh menamoiad, az gunokh'i on badi k'ismate az u megardad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ar kore, ki inson anch'om medikh'ad, Shokh'id buda, dar badalash ch'azoi munosib khokh'ad dod. Kh'ar ki az shumo dar kh'osilshavii khair sabab shavad, iak kh'issai savobashro az khud mekunad va kh'ar ki sababgori ech'odi badi gardad, iak kh'issai gunokh'ashro bar zimmai khesh megirad.

86) Va vak'te kase ba shumo salom dikh'ad, pas dar ch'avob salomi az on bekh'tar bidikh'ed io salomashro bo posukhi monand bargardoned. Albatta, ch'avobi bekh'tar dodan ba salom fazilati ziiodtar dorad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ar amali shumo Nigakh'bon ast. Ba shumo dar ivazi amalkh'oiaton ch'azoi sazovor khokh'ad dod.

87) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ch'uz U ma'budi barkh'ak'k'i digar nest, kh'amono U kh'amai shumoro az avval to okhir ruzi k'iiomat, ki dar vuk'ui on shubkh'ae nest, baroi bozpursi va dodani ch'azoi a'mol ch'am' mesozad. Va kase az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rostk'avltar nest.

88) Pas ei mu'minon, shumoro chi shuda ast, ki dar borai muomila bo munofik'on ba du gurukh' ch'udo shudaed?! Iak gurukh' meguiand, muk'obili munofik'on ch'angidan durust ast, chunki onkh'o kofirand va iak gurukh'i digaraton onkh'oro mu'min kh'isobida, alaikh'ashon ch'angidanro nodurust medonand. Shumo naboiad oidi munofik'on ikhtilof kuned. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba sababi amalashon ba kufru zalolat bargardonida ast. Oio mekhokh'ed kasero kh'idoiat kuned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro az rokh'i rost gumrokh' sokhta, tavfik'i kh'idoiat nadoda ast?! Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro gumrokh' sozad, pas kh'argiz baroi on banda rokh'i kh'idoiatero nameiobi.

89) Munofik'on on guna ki khud kofir shudaand, orzu dorand, ki shumo niz ba Kitob va Paiombaraton kofir garded, pas bo onkh'o dar kufr iakson shaved. Modom ki chunin ast, pas az baini onkh'o ba sababi adovatashon kh'ech' kasro dust nagired to on ki dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi isboti daleli imonashon az sarzamini shirk ba sarzaminkh'oi islomi kh'ich'rat kunand. Pas agar onkh'o az kh'ich'rat io az oshkor sokhtani imon rui gardonand va bar kh'olati khesh bok'i monand, pas onkh'oro bigired va kh'ar kuch'o onkh'oro iofted, ba k'atl rasoned va az baini onkh'o na dust va na madadrasonero ba mak'sadi on ki dar korkh'o ioriaton dikh'and va ziddi dushman kumakaton rasonand, nagired, -

90) - magar munofik'oni paivastshuda ba k'avme, ki miioni shumo va on k'avm oidi tarki ch'ang paimon basta shuda ast io on akh'li nifok'e, ki nazdi shumo omadaand, dar kh'ole ki dilashon az ch'angidan muk'obili shumo io k'avmashon tang ast. Na bar ziddi shumo ch'angidan mekhokh'and va na bar ziddi k'avmashon. Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, onkh'oro bar shumo musallat megardonid, pas bo shumo mech'angidand. Binobar in, ofiiati bakhshidai ilokh'iro bipazired va bo rokh'i kushtor va asir giriftan ba onkh'o dastdarozi nakuned. Pas agar onkh'o az shumo khudro kanor girifta, muk'obilaton nach'angand va ba shumo taslim shuda, musolikh'a namuda, ch'angro kanor guzorand, dar in surat Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton alaikh'i onkh'o rokh'i kushtan io asir giriftanro k'aror nadoda ast.

91) Ei mu'minon, beshubkh'a, shumo toifai digare az munofik'onro meiobed, ki dar nazdaton khudro mu'min nishon medikh'and, to az shumo emin bimonand va nazdi k'avmi kofirashon kufri khudro oshkor mesozand, to kh'angomi suiashon bargashtan az onkh'o niz emin bimonand. Kh'ar vak't onkh'o ba kufru shirk faro khonda shavand, bo badtarin surat dar on vok'e' meshavand. Pas agar in toifai akh'li nifok' muk'obilaton nabardro kanor naguzorand va ba shumo taslim nashavand va musolakh'a nakunand va dastashonro az shumo boz nadorand, pas onkh'oro bigired va kh'ar kuch'o onkh'oro iofted, ba k'atlashon rasoned. Va Mo baroi shumo alaikh'i in ch'amoai akh'dshikani makkor oidi giriftan va kushtanashon kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan k'aror dodaem.

92) Va baroi kh'ech' mu'mine namesazad, ki mu'minero ba k'atl rasonad, magar on ki in kor az ch'onibi vai ba surati khato sodir shavad. Va kh'ar ki mu'minero ba surati khato bikushad, pas bar k'otil ba sifati kaffora ozod kardani g'ulomi boimon va bar kheshovandoni merosbarash suporidani khunbakh'o ba vorisoni mak'tul voch'ib megardad, magar on ki vorisoni mak'tul az bakh'ri khunbakh'o guzarand, dar in surat khunbakh'o sok'it meshavad. Pas agar mak'tul az k'avme boshad, ki on k'avm bo shumo dushmani doshta, muk'obilaton dar kh'olati paikorand va kh'ol on ki khudi mak'tul mu'min ast, dar in surat bar k'otil ozod kardani g'ulomi boimon voch'ib meboshad, ammo ch'azoi khunbakh'o nadorad. Va agar mak'tul mu'min naboshad, lekin az k'avme boshad, ki baini shumo va onkh'o ba misli akh'li zimma akh'du paimon mavch'ud ast, dar chunin surat bar kheshovandoni merosbari k'otil suporidani khunbakh'o ba vorisoni mak'tul va bar khudi k'otil ba sifati kafforai gunokh'ash ozod kardani g'ulomi boimon voch'ib ast. Pas agar k'otil baroi ozod sokhtan g'ulom naiobad io k'udrati pardokhti mablag'i onro nadoshta boshad, bar vai du mokh' paiopai ruza giriftan voch'ib ast, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbai uro az gunokh'i sodirkardaash bipazirad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai a'molu mak'sadkh'oi bandagon buda, dar akh'kom va chorasozi bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

93) Va kh'ar kase mu'minero k'asdan banokh'ak' bikushad, pas, much'ozoti k'otil on ast, ki ba duzakh medaroiad va agar in gunokh'ro kh'alol shumorad, dar duzakh ch'ovidon memonad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar vai khashm girifta, uro az rakh'matash ronda va baroiash ba sababi anch'om dodani ch'inoiati sangini odamkushi azobi buzurgero omoda namuda ast.

94) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, chun dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo mak'sadi ch'ikh'od berun shaved, pas dar borai kase, ki muk'obilash mech'anged, takh'k'ik' kuned va ba on kase, ki baroiaton alomati nishondikh'andai islomashro oshkor sokht "Tu musalmon nesti, balki az tarsi molu ch'onat khudro musalmon vonamud mesozi" nagued va in guna da'voi bepoiaro dar k'atlash kh'uch'ch'at k'aror nadikh'ed, kh'ol on ki bo k'atli on shakhs, ba monandi moli g'animat matoi nochizi kh'aioti dunioro mekhokh'ed. Pas nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) g'animatkh'oi ziiodi az matoi dunio bekh'tar va buzurgtar mavch'ud ast. Shumo niz k'abl az in misli kh'amin shakhsi imonashro az k'avmash pinkh'ondoshta buded, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo Islom bar shumo in'om karda, rekhtani khunatonro noch'oiz gardonid. Pas andesha va takh'k'ik' kuned. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mekuned, Bokhabar ast. Kamtarin koraton az U pushida namemonad va ba shumo dar badali kh'ar iak kor podoshi sazovor medikh'ad.

Mu'minon [-i khonanishin]-e, ki biduni kh'ech' bemori va nobinoioi az ch'ikh'od boznishastand, bo much'okh'idone, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo bo molu ch'oni khud ch'ikh'od kardand, [kh'argiz] iakson nestand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) darach'ai mu'minoni bo amvolashon va ch'onashon ch'ikh'odkunandaro bar mu'minoni az ch'ikh'od nishasta beshtar sokhta ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar du gurukh'i much'okh'idon va mu'minoni ma'zur ach'ri nekui sazovorro va'da doda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) much'okh'idonro bo podoshi azim bar nishastagon bartari bakhshida ast.

96) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) much'okh'idonro bo dodani darach'akh'oi ziiod az suiash va omurzishi gunokh'on va rakh'mat namudan az bandagoni dar ch'ikh'od shirkat nakarda bartar gardonida ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagonash Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

97) Beshak, kasonero, ki farishtagon memironand, kh'ol on ki onkh'o bo tarki kh'ich'rat az diiori kufr ba diiori islomi bar ch'onashon sitam kardaand, vak'ti k'abzi rukh'ashon bo sarzanish meguiand: "Dar dunio dar kadom kh'olat k'aror doshted? Az mushrikon bo chi fark' mekarded?" Onkh'o dar ch'avob uzr ovarda meguiand: "Mo dar zamin notavonu bechora budem. K'udrati az khud difo' kardanro nadoshtem." Farishtagon bo sarzanish meguiand: "Oio sarzaminkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pakh'novar nabud, ki ba iakei on khorich' shaved, to din va ch'onaton az zillatu zerdasti emin monad?!" Pas maskani in gurukh'i bakh'onach'ui tarki kh'ich'rat karda duzakh ast va duzakh ch'oi bozgashti nikh'oiat bad ast.

98) Az in takh'didi ilokh'i bandagoni boimoni notavoni ma'zur az mardon va zanon va kudakon, ki k'udrati az kh'olati zulmu zerdasti kh'imoiat namudani khudro nadorand va baroi rakh'oi az in vaz'iiat rokh'ero nameioband, istisno kh'astand.

99) Pas shoiad Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az gunokh'oni in toifa bo lutfu markh'amati Khud darguzarad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Afvkunandai gunokh'oni bandagonash buda, nisbat ba tavbakoron bag'oiat Omurzanda ast.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi k'abli shakhsoni k'odir ba kh'ich'ratro bo azobi sakht takh'did namud, dar oiati zerin bandagonashro ba kh'ich'rat targ'ib karda guft:
100) Va kh'ar ki ba k'asdi kasbi rizoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az sarzamini kufr kh'ich'rat kunad, ch'oi gashtuguzor va zamini pakh'novari g'airi makoni k'abliashro meiobad, dar kh'ich'ratgokh' ba izzatmandi va rizk'i farokh noil megardad. Va kh'ar ki bo mak'sadi kh'ich'rat ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash az khonaash berun shavad, sipas k'abl az rasidan ba kh'ich'ratgokh' marg uro dariobad, pas podoshash bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sobit megardad va ba kh'ich'ratgokh' narasidan ba vai zarar namerasonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

101) Va vak'te ki dar rui zamin safar karded, pas, agar khavfi onro doshta boshed, ki az ch'onibi kofiron ba shumo nokhushie merasad, dar chunin kh'olat bar shumo kh'ech' gunokh'e nest, ki namozi chorrak'atai farzro ba du rak'at kutokh' namoed. Ba durusti, kofiron baroi shumo dushmani oshkorand.
Dar akh'odisi sakh'ekh' az Paembar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) sobit shuda ast, ki dar safar dar kh'olati adami khavf az dushman niz kutokh' sokhtani namozi chorrak'ata ba du rak'at ch'oiz ast.

102) Va ei Paiombar, chun kh'angomi nabard bo dushman dar miioni lashkar boshi, pas k'asdi bo onkh'o namoz khondanro kuni, artishro ba du gurukh' ch'udo soz. Boiad iak gurukh'i onkh'o barkhesta, kh'amrokh'at namoz guzorand va dar namoz aslikh'aashonro bo khud girand va gurukh'i digar shumoro posboni kunand. Pas, chun ch'amoati iakum bo imom iak rak'at khondand, bok'imondai namozro khudashon be imom ba itmom rasonand. Pas, chun onkh'o namozashonro ado namudand, boiad az pushti shumo dar rubarui dushman biistand va on gurukh'e, ki shumoro mukh'ofizat karda va namoz nakhondaand, biioiand, pas bo imom iak rak'at namoz guzorand. Pas, chun imom salom dikh'ad, onkh'o barkhezand va bok'imondai namozashonro ba ch'o orand va az dushman ekh'tiiotashonro bigirand va aslikh'aashonro bo khud bardorand. Zero beshak, kofiron orzu dorand, ki shumo kh'angomi adoi namoz az aslikh'a va mato'kh'oi khesh g'ofil bimoned, pas, alaikh'i shumo iak kh'amlai sakht anch'om doda, g'ofilgiraton kunand. Va agar binobar sababi boron ba shumo ozore rasid io bemor boshed va io uzri digare doshted, bar shumo gunokh'e nest, ki aslikh'ai khudro guzoshta, onro nabardored va ba andozai tavonaton az dushmanaton biparkh'ezed. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kofiron azobi khorkunandaro omoda sokhta ast.

103) Ei mu'minon, pas chun az namoz forig' shuded, dar kh'olati rost istodan va nishastan va bar pakh'luiaton takia kardan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bo guftani "Subkh'onallokh'", "Alkh'amdu lillokh'", "Lo ilokh'a illallokh'", "Allokh'u akbar" iod kuned. Pas chun tars az shumo dur shuda, az kh'uch'umi dushman emin bimoned, dar in surat namozro on guna ki amr shudaed, bo rioiai farzu voch'ibu sunnat barpo dored. Kh'amono namoz dar vak'ti muaiian farz shuda ast. Biduni uzr ta'khiri namoz az vak'tash ravo nest. In kh'ukm dar g'airi safar ast, ammo agar shakhs musofir boshad, kh'ak' dorad namozro ba surati ch'am' va k'asr bikhonad.

104) Va mu'minon, dar ch'ustuch'ui dushmanoni kofiraton notavoni va tanbali nakuned. Agar shumo az duchori kushtoru zakhm shudan ranch' mebared, pas on kofiron niz on guna ki shumo ranch' mebared, ranch' mebarand va misli shumo bo kushtoru zakhm rubaru megardand. Binobar in, naboiad sabri onkh'o az sabri shumo beshtar boshad, zero shumo az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizero az savob, madad va piruzi umed dored, ki kofiron onro umed nadorand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai akh'voli bandagon buda, dar chorasozi va akh'komash bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

105) Ei Paiombar, ba durusti, Mo K'ur'onro, ki shomili kh'ak'ik'at ast, bar tu furud ovardem, to dar baini mardum vobasta ba korkh'oiashon tibk'i on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiat omukhta ast, na tibk'i khokh'ish va andeshaat kh'ukm namoi. Va baroi shakhsoni dar kh'ak'k'i khesh va amonatkh'oi mardum khiionatkor kh'imoiatgar mabosh. Kh'ar ki kh'ak'k'ashro az khoinon talabad, tu naboiad peshi rokh'i on kh'ak'talabro bigiri.
106) Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omurzish bikhokh'. Beshubkh'a, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

107) Va az on kasone, ki bo ma'siiat bar khud khiionat mekunand va dar makhfi nigokh' doshtani on sa'i menamoiand, pushtiboni makun. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shakhsero, ki ba khiionatkori va gunokh' biser dast mezanad, dust namedorad.

108) Kh'angomi sodir kardani ma'siiat az rui tars va sharm onro az nazari mardum pinkh'on mekunand va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharm namekunand va kh'ol on ki U bo ilmash kh'amrokh'i onkh'o buda, az tamomi ch'onib ikh'otaashon karda ast.
