Vak'te onkh'o sukhanero ba misli kh'imoiai gunakh'kor va tukh'mati begunokh', ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro namepisandad, pinkh'on mesozand, on az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pinkh'on namemonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro dar oshkoru nikh'on anch'om medikh'and, Ikh'otakunanda ast. Chize az U makhfi nabuda, dar ivazi kh'ar guftoru kirdor ba onkh'o ch'azoi bosazo khokh'ad dod.

109) Ogokh' boshed shumo ei ch'amoai kh'omii much'rimon! Shumo az onkh'o dar kh'aioti dunio kh'imoiat mekuned, to begunokh'iashonro isbot namoed va ch'azoiashonro bartaraf sozed. Pas chi kase ruzi k'iiomat bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'idol namuda, az onkh'o kh'imoiat mekunad va kh'ol on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ak'ik'ati kh'olashonro medonad?! Io chi kase on ruz bar onkh'o korsoz va nigakh'bon meshavad?! Albatta, kh'ech' kas az ukh'dai chunin kor namebaroiad.

110) Va kh'ar ki amali bad anch'om dikh'ad, io bo sodir kardani ma'siiat nisbat ba khesh sitam kunad, sipas az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omurzish talabad, bo nadomat ba gunokh'ash e'tirof namuda, az on dur shavad, doim Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro baroi gunokh'onash Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon meiobad.

111) Va kh'ar ki murtakibi gunokh'i khurd io buzurg shavad, pas uk'ubati on iak'inan bar ukh'dai khudash buda, ba digaron zarar nameorad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai kh'oli bandagon, dar chorasozi va akh'kom bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

112) Va kh'ar ki sakh'van murtakibi khato shavad io k'asdan gunokh' sodir kunad, sipas insoni begunokh'ero bo on gunokh'i anch'om dodaash tukh'mat zanad, pas bo in amalash begumon durug'i sakht va ma'siiati ravshanro bar ukh'da girifta ast.

113) Va ei Paiombar, agar bar tu fazli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo makh'fuz nigokh' doshtanat az sharri dushman namebud, kh'amono ch'amoae az in khoinon tasmimi k'at'i girifta budand, ki turo az rokh'i rost gumrokh' sozand, to ba'di gumrokh' shudanat kh'ukmi noodilona sodir namoi va kh'ol on ki onkh'o dar kh'ak'ik'at ch'uz khesh kasero gumrokh' namekardand. Zero paiomadi badi k'asdi gumrokh'sozii tu ba khudashon barmegasht. Va azbaski Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo kh'ifz karda ast, onkh'o tavoni ba tu zien rasonidanro nadorand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar tu K'ur'on va sunnatro furud ovard va baroiat az nuri kh'idoiat chizero omuzonid, ki k'abl az in onro namedonisti. Va fazli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar tu bo bakhshidani nubuvvat va kh'ifzat az badii dushmanon buzurg ast.

114) Dar beshtari kalomi pinkh'onii mardum kh'ech' khaire nest, magar kase, ki ba dodani sadak'a io guftoru kirdori az rui shariat va khirad pisandida va io ech'odi sulkh' baini mardumi bo iakdigar nizo'kunanda amr kunad. Va kh'ar ki in korkh'oro bo mak'sadi talabi rizoi Khudo anch'om dikh'ad, pas begumon Mo ba on banda podoshi azim medikh'em.

115) Va kh'ar ki ba'd az on ki kh'ak' baroiash ravshan gashta ast, bo Rasuli Allokh' dar borai Kitob va dini ovardaash siteza va mukholifat menamoiad va az rokh'i g'airi mu'minon pairavi mekunad, uro bo on chi baroi khud barguzida ast, guzoshta, ba sui kh'ak'ik'at az sababi k'asdan az on bargashtanash rakh'namoi namekunem va uro ba duzakh medarorem, dar onch'o az kh'arorati otashash ranch' mebarad va duzakh baroi boshandagonash ch'oi bozgashti nikh'oiat bad ast.

116) Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'argiz gunokh'i ba U shirk ovardanro nameomurzad, balki mushrik dar duzakh abadi memonad va gunokh'oni g'airi shirkro baroi kh'ar ki az bandagon khokh'ad, az rui rakh'mat va fazli Khud meomurzad. Va kh'ar ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk orad, pas begumon az rokh'i kh'ak'ik'at sargardon va az on sakht dur shuda ast. Chunki mushrik Kholik'ro bo makhluk' barobar kunonida ast. Mag'firati tamomi ma'siiatkh'o ba irodai ilokh'i vobasta ast. Shoiad U sokh'ibi kh'ar gunokh'ero ba g'air az shirk mebakhshad. Ammo agar mushrik az in gunokh'ash tavba nakunad va dar kh'olati shirk vafot namoiad, kh'argiz bakhshida nameshavad.

117) In mushrikon kh'amrokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ibodat va duo namekunand, magar butkh'oero, ki ba misli Lotu Uzzo bo nomkh'oi zanona nomguzori shuda, moliki ziionu sud nestand. Va onkh'o dar asl nameparastand, ch'uz Shaitoni az itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) berunshudaro, ki dar on khaire nest. Zero onkh'oro ba ibodati g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shaiton amr karda ast.

118) Binobar in, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shaitonro az rakh'mati Khud dur sokht. Va Shaiton ba Parvardigorash bo savgand guft: "Begumon az bandagonat kh'issai muaiianero baroi khesh megiram va onkh'oro az rokh'i rost gumrokh' mesozam.

119) Va beshak, onkh'oro az paimudani rokh'i rost man' mekunam va bo va'dakh'oi kozibe, ki zalolatro baroiashon oroish medikh'ad, onkh'oro dunbolaravi orzuiu khaiolkh'o megardonam va onkh'oro ba pora kardani gushkh'oi chakh'orpoion farmon medikh'am, to az nazdi khud kh'alolkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro kh'arom shumorand va onkh'oro ba digargun sokhtani ofarinishi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) suporish medikh'am." Va kh'ar ki Shaitonro ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dusti khud girifta, az farmudakh'oiash itoat kunad, pas vai begumon bo in amalash ziioni oshkor karda ast.
120) Shaiton ba onkh'o va'dakh'oi durug' medikh'ad va ba orzuiu khaiolkh'oi botil giriftorashon mesozad. Va dar asl Shaiton ba onkh'o ch'uz botili az kh'ak'ik'at kholi chize va'da namedikh'ad.
121) In ch'amoai tobei rakh'namoikh'oi Shaiton k'arorgokh'ashon otashi duzakh buda, az on baroi panokh' burdan ch'oi gurez nameioband.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi mazkur ch'azoi pairavoni Shaitonro ovard, dar oiati zerin podoshi pairavoni paiombaronro zikr karda guft:
122) Va on kasone, ki imon ovardaand va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, begumon Mo onkh'oro ba bustonkh'oe dokhil menamoem, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oi on rudkh'o ch'ori ast, dar onch'o ch'ovidon memonand. In va'daro ba onkh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) doda ast va va'dai U kh'ak' ast. Zero U ba va'daash khilof namekunad. Va kh'ech' kas az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sodik'tar nest.

123) Ei musalmonon, mas'alai rasidan ba ch'annat va nach'ot az duzakh na tobei orzui shumo ast va na tobei orzui akh'li Kitob, balki on ba amal vobasta ast. Az in ru, kh'ar ki az shumo amali badero anch'om dikh'ad, ruzi k'iiomat dar barobari on ch'azo doda meshavad va baroi khesh g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) na dust va na iovare nameiobad, ki sudash rasonad.

124) Va kh'ar ki novobasta az mardu zan budan amalkh'oi shoista anch'om dikh'ad va kh'ol on ki vai dar kh'ak'ik'at ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon dorad, pas in gurukh' kasoneand, ki imonu amalro bo iakdigar ch'am' kardaand, onkh'o dokhili ch'annat meshavand va az podoshi a'molashon, kh'atto ba andozai siiokh'ii pushti donai khurmo kam namegardad va zulm nameshavand.

125) Va kh'ech' kas az rui dindori az bandae, ki bo zokh'iru botin ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) taslim gashta, mak'sadashro kholis gardonida va dar amal bo pairavii shariat ba kh'addi ekh'son rasida va az oiini Ibrokh'im, ki az shirku kurf ba tavkh'idu imon moil buda, asosi dini Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) niz kh'amin ast, pairavi namuda ast, bekh'tar nest. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az baini bandagonash Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro bo mukh'abbati tom barguzida, dusti makhsus girifta ast.

126) Va tamomi on chi dar osmonkh'o va on chi dar zamin ast, tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ilm, k'udrat va chorasozi Ikh'otakunandai kh'amai mavch'udot ast.

127) Va ei Paiombar, az tu oidi korkh'oi marbut ba zanon va kh'uk'uk'u ukh'dadorikh'oiashon mepursand. Dar ch'avob bigu: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo on chiro mepursed, baion mekunad va U inchunin ba suolaton bo on chi dar K'ur'on bar shumo oidi iatimdukhtaroni zeri sarparastiaton k'aror doshta tilovat meshavad, ch'avob medikh'ad, iatimdukhtarone, ki ba onkh'o makh'r io merosi baroiashon farzsokhtai ilokh'iro namedikh'ed va ba nikokh'ashon mail nadored va onkh'oro bo tama' doshtanaton dar amvolashon az izdivoch' boz medored. Va ba shumo baion mesozad, ki kh'ak'k'i kudakoni notavonro az meros bidikh'ed va nisbatashon bo dastdarozi dar amvolashon zulm nakuned. Va ba shumo dastur medikh'ad, ki bo iatimon on guna bo adolat munosibat namoed, ki kh'olashon dar duniovu okhirat islokh' gardad. Va on chi az neki nisbat ba iatimon va g'aira ba ch'o meored, iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad va ba shumo dar ivazash ch'azoi loik' khokh'ad dod."

128) Va agar zane az sarkashi va badraftori io az rui gardonidan va berag'batii shavkh'arash khavf doshta boshad, pas bar on du gunokh'e nest, ki baini khud sulkh' kunand. Sulkh'i onkh'o ba in tartib surat megirad, ki zan az bakh'ri ba'zei kh'uk'uk'i bar zimmai shavkh'arash voch'ib, ba monandi adoi nafak'ai moddi va g'airi on meguzarad. Va dar in kh'olatkh'o sulkh' baroi kh'ardu ch'onib az talok' bekh'tar ast. Va nafskh'o bar kh'irs va bukhl sirishta shudaand. Az in ch'ikh'at nafs dar guzashtan az kh'ak'k'i khesh rag'bat nadorad. Zanu shavkh'arro zarur ast, ki nafsi kheshro az in akhlok'i bad bo ekh'son va az iakdigar guzashtan tarbiia namoiand. Va agar dar kh'amai korkh'oiaton ekh'son kuned va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi farmonash bitarsed, pas begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mekuned, Bokhabar buda, chize az U makhfi nest va dar ivazi kh'ar kor ba shumo podoshi munosib khokh'ad dod.

129) Va shumo mardon kh'argiz baini kh'amsaronaton dar mukh'abbat agarchi talosh namoed, adolati komil karda nametavoned, zero idorai maili k'alb gokh'o az tavoni inson berun ast. Pas az kh'amsari nazdaton dilnokash ba kh'amsari dilkashaton ba kulli mail nakuned, ki uro ba misli zani muallak' guzored, na shavkh'ar dorad, ki kh'ak'k'ashro ado kunad va na az shavkh'ar ch'udo ast, to bo mardi digar ak'di nikokh' bandad. Va agar nofakh'mikh'oi bainatonro bo vodor sokhtani khud ba adoi kh'uk'uk'i kh'amsar islokh' kuned va dar kh'ak'k'i kh'amsaron az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed, pas begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba shumo bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

130) Va agar zanu shavkh'ar bo rokh'i talok' io khul' az iakdigar ch'udo shavand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar iakei onkh'oro az fazli pakh'novari Khesh tavongar gardonida, ba onkh'o kh'amsari navi az guzashta bekh'tar va ruzii farokhtar nasib menamoiad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Doroi fazlu rakh'mati gusturda buda, dar chorasozi va tak'dir bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

131) Va mavch'udoti osmonkh'ovu zamin va on chi miioni on du vuch'ud dorad, tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va Mo begumon ba iakh'udu nasoro, ki k'abl az shumo ba onkh'o Kitob doda shuda bud va ba shumo suporish dodem, ki az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi amrkh'oiash va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'oiash bitarsed. Va agar ba in paimon kofir shaved, pas ch'uz ba kheshtan ba kase zarar namerasoned, zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mukh'toch'i ibodati shumo nest, makhluk'oti osmonkh'o va zamin az U ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az makhluk'otash Beniioz buda, dar sifat va fe'lash Sutuda ast.

132) Va kh'amai mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va kh'amai mavch'udoti zamin tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Iagona U sazovori ibodat ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati Korsozi tamomi korkh'oi bandagon basanda ast.

133) Ei mardum, agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ad, shumoro kh'alok mekunad va ba ch'oi shumo bandagonero meorad, ki Uro itoat karda, az amrash sarpechi namekunand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar in kor Tavono ast.

134) Ei bandagoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), kh'ar ki az shumo bo anch'omi amalash tankh'o podoshi dunioro mekhokh'ad, pas donista boshad, ki podoshi dunio va okhirat nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Boiad kh'ardu az U khosta shavad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavoi Bino ast. Sukhanatonro meshunavad va koratonro mebinad. Ba shumo dar badali kh'ar iak guftoru kirdor podosh khokh'ad dod.

135) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash itoat kardaed, dar kh'ama kh'olat barposozandagoni adolat boshed, dar borai kh'ar kas kholis baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guvokh'ii barkh'ak' dikh'ed, agarchi dodani guvokh'i az shumo tak'ozo kunad, ki muk'obili khud io volidain io kheshovandon shokh'id shaved. Naboiad fak'iri io tavongarii kase shumoro ba adoi guvokh'i io tarki on vodor sozad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba tangdast va tavongar az shumo avlotar buda, manfiati on duro bekh'tar medonad. Pas dar adoi shakh'odat az khokh'ishoti nafs pairavi nakuned, to dar bobi dodani guvokh'i az kh'ak' munkh'arif nashaved. Va agar shakh'odatro ba sababi nodurust ado kardani on takh'rif namoed io az adoi on rui gardoned, pas iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Bokhabar ast.

136) Ei akh'li imon, bar imonaton ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash va Kitobe, ki bar Paiombarash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) furud ovard va Kitobkh'oe, ki k'abl az Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bar digar paiombaronash nozil namud, ustuvor bimoned. Va kh'ar ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va farishtagonash va Kitobkh'oiash va paiombaronash va ruzi okhirat kofir shavad, pas begumon az rokh'i rost nikh'oiat dur shuda ast.

137) Kh'amono kasone, ki az ch'onibi onkh'o ba'd az imon ovardan kufr takror iofta, avval imon meorand, sipas ba kufr barmegardand, sipas bori digar imon meorand, sipas boz ba kufr bozgashta va onro idoma doda, kofir memirand, kh'ech' gokh' Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'onashonro nameomurzad va ba onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro namedikh'ad.
138) Ei Paiombar, ba munofik'on "muzhda" bidekh', ki ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi onkh'o azobi dardovar ast.

139) Sababi in uk'ubat on ast, ki in munofik'on ba ch'oi mu'minon kofironro dustoni khud megirand. Oio onkh'o k'uvvat va izzatro nazdi kofiron metalaband, to ba martabakh'oi baland birasand?! In angezai dust intikhob kardani kofiron az ch'onibi munofik'on peshi akh'li kh'ak' kh'airatovar ast. Zero iak'inan kh'amai k'uvvat va izzat az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

140) Va kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo mu'minon dar K'ur'on furud ovarda ast, ki chun dar mach'lise nishasted va onch'o shunided, ki kase ba oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kufr mevarzad va onro tamaskhur mekunad, pas bar shumo tarki kh'amnishini bo onkh'o va az in guna mach'lis barkhostan voch'ib ast, to onkh'o g'air az kufr va tamaskhuri oiatkh'o ba sukhani digar vorid shavand. Zero vak'te shumo ba'di shunidani in kh'ukm bo akh'li on mach'lis dar kh'oli kufr varzidan va oiatkh'oro tamaskhur kardanashon kh'amnishini kuned, on gokh' shumo bo mukholifat namudani amri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amsoni onkh'o kh'asted. Zero chunonchi onkh'o bo kufru maskhara nofarmonii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro kardand, shumo niz kh'amin guna bo khilofkorii khesh az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nofarmoni kardaed. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat munofik'onro bo kofiron dar otashi duzakh ch'am' mesozad.

141) Munofik'on kasoneand, ki muntaziri shumo memonand, ki oio duchori neki meshaved io badi. Pas agar ba shumo az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) piruzi rasad va moli g'animat ba dast ored, onkh'o meguiand: "Oio mo kh'amrokh'aton nabudem? Oio mo ba monandi shumo dar nabard kh'ozir nagashtem?!" Mak'sadashon az in sukhan kasbi moli g'animat ast. Va agar kh'issae az piruzi az kofiron gardad, ba kofiron meguiand: "Oio umuri shumoro mo bar zimmai khud nagiriftem va shumoro mavridi tavach'ch'ukh'i khosi khesh k'aror doda, nusrat nadodem va az mu'minon bo kumak kardani shumo va tarki nusrati onkh'o pushtiboniaton nakardem?!" Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat miioni kh'amai shumo dovari mekunad. Ba mu'minon bo dukhuli ch'annat va ba munofik'on bo dukhuli poiontarin tabak'ai ch'akh'annam podosh medikh'ad. Va kh'argiz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo fazlash baroi kofiron bar ziddi mu'minon dalele k'aror namedikh'ad, balki farch'omi nekro az oni mu'minon gardonida ast, ba sharti on ki tibk'i shariat amal karda, dar imonashon sodik' boshand.

142) Iak'inan munofik'on bo oshkorsozii imon va pinkh'onsozii kufr mekhokh'and Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bifireband va U onkh'oro mefirebad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo vuch'udi on ki kufrashonro medonad, rekhtani khunashonro man' karda, ammo dar okhirat baroiashon sakhttarin nav'i azobro omoda sokhta ast. Va vak'te onkh'o ba namoz barkhezand, bo tanbali va bekhushi barmekhezand, kh'adafashon khudnamoi va ba dast ovardani madkh'i mardum ast va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro zikr namekunand, magar zikri andak, ba in ma'no, ki chun mu'minonro bubinand, ba'd Uro iod mekunand.

143) Onkh'o baini kufru imon dar kh'olati kh'airatu sargardoni kh'astand, bo zokh'iru botinashon na bo mu'minonand va na bo kofiron, balki zokh'irashon bo mu'minon va botinashon bo kofiron ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro gumrokh' sozad, pas kh'argiz tu Paiombar baroi az gumrokh'i kh'idoiat namudani vai rokh'ero nameiobi.

144) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va az Paiombarash pairavi namudaed, ba ch'oi mu'minon kofironro dustoni samimii khesh nagired. Oio bo in koraton mekhokh'ed baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muk'obili khud kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan k'aror dikh'ed, ki akh'li nifok' va arzandai azob kh'asted?!
145) Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) munofik'onro ruzi k'iiomat dar poiontarin makoni duzakh ch'oigir mesozad. Va tu kh'ech' gokh' baroi onkh'o iovare nameiobi, ki azobashonro bartaraf kunad.

146) Magar on kasone, ki az nifok'ashon tavba karda, ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargashtand va botinashonro islokh' namudand va ba paimoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chang zadand va amalashonro biduni riiokori kholis baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) anch'om dodand. Pas in toifai tavsifshuda dar duniovu okhirat kh'amrokh'i mu'minonand va kh'atman Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mu'minon ach'ri azim khokh'ad dod.

147) Agar shumo az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shukrguzori kuned va imon biiored, U ba azob dodani shumo chi niioz dorad?! Kh'ech' niioz nadorad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Nekukori Mekh'rubon ast. U shumoro tankh'o dar barobari gunokh'onaton azob mekunad. Ammo agar amalatonro islokh' namoed, az U siposguzor boshed va sidk'an imon ored, kh'argiz azobaton namekunad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shukrguzori Dono ast. Ba shakhsoni e'tirofkunandai ne'matash ach'ri ziiod medikh'ad va az kh'ak'ik'ati imoni bandagon ogokh' meboshad. Ba kh'ar kas dar ivazi amalash podoshi munosib khokh'ad dod.

148) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baland guftan va oshkor kardani sukhani badro dust namedorad, balki ba chunin amal nafrat dorad va anch'omdikh'andai onro uk'ubat mekunad, lekin ba kh'ar ki zulm karda shavad, on mazlum kh'ak' dorad az zolim shikoiat barad, dar kh'ak'k'i sitamgar duoi bad kunad, muk'obili sukhani zisht posukhi ba on monand dikh'ad, ammo agar mazlum az baland guftan va oshkor kardani sukhani bad sabr kunad, bekh'tar ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai guftorkh'o, Donandai mak'sadkh'oi shumo ast. Binobar in, az guftor io k'asdi bad parkh'ez namoed.

149) Agar kh'ar guftor io kirdori nekro oshkor kuned io onro pinkh'on sozed io az gunokh'i on kas, ki nisbat ba shumo badi karda ast, darguzared, pas beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Afvkunandai Tavono ast. Boiad guzasht kardan az ch'urmi digaron ch'uz'e az akhlok'aton boshad, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) niz shumoro mavridi mag'firati khesh k'aror dikh'ad.

150) Kh'amono on nafarone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va paiombaronash kofir meshavand va mekhokh'and, ki baini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va paiombaronash bo imon ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va takzibi paiombaron ch'udo kunand va meguiand: "Ba ba'zei paiombaron imon meorem va ba ba'zei digar kofir meshavem" va mekhokh'and baroi khud baini imon va kufr rokh'e bigirand, ba gumoni on ki in rokh' nach'otashon medikh'ad.

151) In toifae, ki in rokh'ro mepaimoiand, onkh'o kofironi kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand. Zero kh'ar ki ba kh'amai paiombaron io ba ba'zei onkh'o kofir shavad, pas begumon ba Khudo va paiombaronash kofir gashta ast. Va Mo dar ruzi k'iiomat baroi kofiron az sababi on ki az imon ovardan rui gardonidand, azobi khorkunandaro omoda namudaem.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi mazkur ch'azoi kofironro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin podoshi akh'li imonro ovarda guft:
152) Va kasone, ki ba iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, kh'ech' kasro ba U sharik nagardonidand va tamomi paiombaronashro tasdik' namudand va baini kh'ech' kadomi paiombaron ch'udo nakardand, on guna ki kofiron chunin kardaand, balki ba kulli paiombaron imon ovardand, beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba in bandagonash dar badali imon va amalkh'oi shoistaashon podoshkh'oi azimashonro medikh'ad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

153) Ei Firistodai Mo, iakh'udikh'o az tu talab mekunand, ki baroi onkh'o az osmon ba iakboragi, na tadrich'an Kitobero nozil namoi, to rostk'avlii turo nishon dikh'ad, chunonchi Tavrot ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) kh'amin guna ba iakboragi furud omada bud. In darkhostro az ch'onibi iakh'udikh'o buzurg mashumor, zero guzashtagonashon az Muso (alaikh'is salom) kori az in buzurgtarro pursidand. Pas guftand: "Ba mo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro oshkor nishon bidekh'." Ba'd az in onkh'oro ba sababi gunokh'oni sodirkardaashon sadoi shadidi doroi otashi kh'avlnok faro girifta, kh'alokashon sokht, sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro dubora zinda gardonid. Sipas ba'd az on ki ba onkh'o oiatkh'oi ravshane omad, ki dar bobi ofaridgori va ibodat bar iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dalolat mekard, onkh'o ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gusolaro parastidand. Pas Mo ba'di murtakib shudani chunin gunokh'i azim az on darguzashtem va sodirkunandagonashro bakhshidem va ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) bo dodani kh'uch'ch'at kh'ukmfarmoii komil bar k'avmash ato namudem.

154) Va baroi az on iakh'udikh'o giriftani akh'di k'at'i kukh'ro ba mak'sadi bim dodanashon boloi sarashon bardoshtem, to bo dasturoti Tavrot amal kunand va ba'd az bardoshtani kukh' ba onkh'o guftem: "Az dari Bait-ul-muk'addas bo furutani sach'dakunon vorid shaved." Onkh'o az daromadgokh'i Bait-ul-muk'addas bar mak''adkh'oiashon khazida-khazida daromadand. Va ba onkh'o guftem: "Bo ik'dom bar shikori mokh'i dar ruzi shanbe az marzkh'oi muk'arrarshuda naguzared." Onkh'o in farmoni Moro khilof namuda, az kh'addi guzoshtaamon guzashta, shikor kardand. Va az onkh'o dar in bora paimoni k'at'i girifta budem, ammo on paimonro barkh'am zadand.

155) Pas Mo iakh'udikh'oro az rakh'mati Khesh dur sokhtem, ba sababi on ki akh'di k'at'ii az onkh'o giriftashudaro shikastand va ba oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudand va ba k'atli paiombaron "ch'asorat" kardand va ba Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) "Dilkh'oiamon parda girifta, makh'kam shuda ast va guftakh'oi turo dark namekunad" guftand, kh'ol on ki dar vok'e' k'albashon chunin nest, balki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sababi kufrashon bar k'albi onkh'o mukh'r zada ast. Az in ru, kh'ech' khaire ba on rokh' nameiobad. Pas, eshon imon nameorand, ba ch'uz imoni andake ki foidaashon namerasonad.
156) Va Mo inchunin onkh'oro ba sababi on ki kofir shudand va Mariam (alaikh'is salom)-ro bo durug'u bukh'ton ba zinokori tukh'mat zadand, az rakh'mati Khud dur sokhtem.

157) Va niz onkh'oro baroi on ki bo durug' va iftikhor "Beshak, mo Masekh'i pisari Mariamro kushtem" guftand, la'nat kardem. Va onkh'o on guna ki da'vo dorand, Isoi pisari Mariamro nakushtaand va ba dor naovekhta budand, balki mardero kushtand va ba dor ovekhtand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar u shabokh'ati surati Isoro afkanda bud va pindoshtand, ki Isoi pisari Mariamro kushtaand. Va beshubkh'a, iakh'udu nasoro, ki dar borai Isoi Masekh' ikhtilof namudaand va gurukh'i iakum da'voi k'atlashro va gurukh'i duium da'voi taslimashro dorand, kh'ardu gurukh' az kori Isoi Masekh' dar kh'airat va shak kh'astand. Onkh'o dar in bobat donish nadorand, balki az gumon pairavi menamoiand va kh'ol on ki gumon kh'ech' kh'ak'ik'atero sobit namesozad. Va iak'inan onkh'o Isoi Masekh'ro nakushtaand va uro ba dor naovekhtaand, -

158) - balki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro az dasisai onkh'o nach'ot dod va bo rukh'u ch'ismash ba sui Khud bolo burd. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar mulkash Zoti G'olibi Shikastnopazir, dar chorasozi, akh'kom va guzoshtani tak'dir Kh'akim ast.

159) Va kh'ech' kas az akh'li Kitob nest, magar on ki kh'atman ba Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) -ba'd az on ki dar okhiri zamon furud oiad- k'abl az margi vai imon meorad. Va Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) ruzi k'iiomat bar a'moli onkh'o shokh'id meshavad, ki kadomash muvofik' va kadomash mukholifi din ast.

160) Pas ba sababi zulmi iakh'ud va ba sababi on ki onkh'o kheshtan va mardumro ba kh'adde az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) man' kardaand, ki khislati man' namudani digaron az amali khair ba tabiatashon tabdil iofta ast, Mo bar onkh'o ba'ze az khurdanikh'oi pokro, ki k'ablan baroiashon kh'alol shuda bud, kh'arom sokhtem. Iste'moli kh'ar ch'onvare, ki ba monandi shutur va shuturmurg' angushtoni poiash ch'udo nest va ravg'ani govu gusfand, ba ch'uz ravg'ani dar pusht io rudakh'oi in du nav'i chakh'orpo bok'imonda io ravg'ani ba misli dumbaiu pakh'lu ba ustukhoni onkh'o omekhta baroiashon kh'arom bud.

161) Va sababi digari kh'arom gashtani khurdanikh'oi kh'alol dar on ast, ki iakh'udikh'o bo ribo muomila mekardand va kh'ol on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar Tavrot onkh'oro az on man' karda bud va amvoli mardumro banokh'ak' megiriftand. Va Mo baroi iakh'udikh'oi idomadikh'andai kufrashon azobi dardovar omoda sokhtaem.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi k'abli khislatkh'oi badi akh'li Kitobro ovard, dar oiati zerin gurukh'i mu'minonashonro ovarda guft:
162) Ei Paiombar, lekin iakh'udikh'oi dar ilm ustuvor va mu'minon K'ur'oni bar tu furudovardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Kitobkh'oi ba misli Tavrot va Inch'ili k'abl az tu bar digar paiombaron nozil kardashudaro tasdik' mekunand va namozro barpo medorand va zakoti molro mepardozand va ba iagona ma'bud budani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi okhirat imon dorand. Beshak, Mo ba in ch'amoai doroi sifatkh'oi mazkur podoshi azim khokh'em dod.

163) Ei Paiombar, begumon Mo ba sui tu vakh'i firistodem, on guna ki ba sui Nukh' va paiombaroni ba'd az u guzashta vakh'i firistoda budem. Az in sabab, tu nakhustin Paiombari Allokh' nesti. Va ba sui Ibrokh'im va Ismoil va Iskh'ok'i pisaronash va Ia'k'ubi pisari Iskh'ok' va paiombarone az nasli Ia'k'ub (ba duvozdakh' k'abilai Bani Isroil mab'us shudaand) va ba Iso va Aiub va Iunus va Kh'orun va Sulaimon vakh'i firistodem. Va ba Dovud kitobi Zaburro dodem.

164) Va Mo paiombaronero firistodaem, ki onkh'oro k'abl az in dar K'ur'on bar tu k'issa kardaem va inchunin paiombaronero firistodaem, ki onkh'oro bar tu k'issa nakardaem va az rui kh'ikmate ismashonro dar K'ur'on naovardaem. Va beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mak'sadi giromidosht bo Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba surati loik'i Khud oidi nubuvvat bevosita sukhan gufta ast.

165) Mo paiombaronro muzhdarason va bimdikh'anda firistodem. Onkh'o mu'minonro ba ach'ri buzurg bashorat medodand va kofironro az azobi dardovari duzakh metarsonidand, to mardum ba'd az firistoda shudani paiombaron bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'uch'ch'ate nadoshta boshand, ki onro bakh'ona k'aror dikh'and. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar mulkash Zoti bag'oiat G'olibu dar muk'arrar sokhtani tak'dir bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

166) Ei Paiombar, agar iakh'udikh'o turo inkor mekunand, pas, iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo vobasta ba kh'ak' budani K'ur'oni baroiat furudovardaash tasdik' menamoiad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in Kitobro bo ilmash nozil sokhta ast. Bo omadani K'ur'on bandagoni kheshro az on chi dust medorad va on chi dust namedorad, ogokh' namuda ast. Va farishtagon niz ba rost budani Kitob va dini ovardai tu guvokh'i medikh'and. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati Shokh'id basanda ast. Shakh'odati U az digar shakh'odatkh'o beniioz megardonad.
167) Beshak, kasone, ki ba paiombariat kofir gashtand va mardumro az rokh'i Islom boz doshtand, begumon az rokh'i rost sakht dur shudaand.

168) Ba durusti, on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va paiombaronash kofir shuda va bo mondan dar kufr nisbat ba khud sitam kardand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi onkh'o gunokh'i dar kufr mondanashonro namebakhshad va onkh'oro ba sui rokh'i az azobash nach'otdikh'anda rakh'namoi namekunad,-
169) ch'uz rokh'e, ki onkh'oro ba duzakh burda, dar onch'o abadi memonand. Va in kor baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat oson ast. Zero U az kh'ech' chiz och'iz nest.

170) Ei mardum, iak'inan Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nazdi shumo az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kh'idoiat va dini barkh'ak' omada ast. Pas ba on chi ovarda ast, imon ored. In baroi shumo dar duniovu okhirat bekh'tar ast. Va agar ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shaved, beshubkh'a, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az imonaton Beniioz buda, kufraton ba U ziion nameorad, zero beshak kh'amai mavch'udoti osmonkh'ovu zamin va baini on du tankh'o az U ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat Donoi Kh'akim ast. Shakhsoni loik'i kh'idoiatro medonad va kh'idoiatro osonash mesozad. Ammo shakhsoni noloik'ro az didani rokh'i durust nobino megardonad. Akh'kom va ta'iini tak'diri korkh'o az rui kh'ikmatash surat megirad.

171) Ei Paiombar, ba nasoroi akh'li Inch'il bigu: "Dar dini khesh az kh'ad naguzared va oidi Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'uz kh'ak' chize nagued. Beshak, Masekh'i Isoi pisari Mariam rasuli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bud, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro kh'amrokh'i kh'ak' firistod, uro bo kalimai Khesh, ki Ch'abrailro bo on ba sui Mariam ravon sokht, khalk' kard, on kalima k'avli "Kh'ast shav"-i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bud va ba'di on Isoi pisari Mariam ba vuch'ud omad va on kalima nafkhai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bud, ki Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom) onro bo amri U damid. Pas, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va tamomi paiombaronash, biduni on ki onkh'oro az kh'am ch'udo namoed, imon ored. Va "Se adad ma'bud ast" nagued. Az in sukhani durug'i beasos khuddori kuned, in baroiaton dar duniovu okhirat bekh'tar ast. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Ma'budi iagona buda, az doshtani sharik va farzand pok ast, zero U ba kh'ech' chiz niioz nadorad. On chi dar osmonkh'ovu zamin va on chi dar baini on du kh'ast, az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati Korsozi umuri mavch'udoti osmonkh'ovu zamin basanda ast."

172) Kh'argiz Isoi pisari Mariam az bandai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) budanash parkh'ez va nang namekunad va niz farishtagone, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro muk'arrabi dargokh'i Khud k'aror doda, ch'oigokh'ashonro bardoshta ast, az bandai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) budanashon parkh'ez va nang namekunand. Pas, chitavr shumo Isoi pisari Mariamro baroi khud ma'bud giriftaed?! Va chitavr mushrikon farishtagonro ma'bud giriftaand?! Va kh'ar ki az ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ezu nang kunad va khudro az ibodati U bolotar shumorad, pas kh'atman Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amai onkh'oro ruzi k'iiomat ba sui Khesh ch'am' meorad va ba kh'ar kas ch'azoi bosazo medikh'ad.

Chun Khudo dar oiati mazkur baion kard, ki ruzi rastokhez kulli khaloik'ro nazdash ch'am' meorad, dar oiati zerin ch'azoi onkh'oro tafsilan baion namuda guft:
173) Ammo kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va paiombaronash imon ovarda va tibk'i shar' kholisona amalkh'oi shoista anch'om dodand, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o podoshi a'molashonro komil medikh'ad va az lutfu ekh'sonash ach'rashonro afzun megardonad. Va ammo kasone, ki az ibodati U parkh'ezu nang kardand va khudro az parastishash bolotar kh'isobidand, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba azobi dardovar giriftor mesozad va g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dust va iovare nameioband, ki nekiashon kunad va azobashonro dur namoiad.

174) Ei mardum, beshak, baroi shumo az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton daleli ravshani barkh'amzanandai uzr va shubkh'akh'o omada ast. Manzur az kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ast. Va Mo ba sui shumo nuri ravshan -K'ur'oni karim--ro nozil kardaem.

175) Ammo kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardand va ba K'ur'oni mach'id chang zadand, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) begumon onkh'oro bo dukhuli ch'annat ba rakh'mati Khesh megirad va bo fazlash podosh va darach'akh'oi onkh'oro afzun megardonad va ba onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiati paimudani rokh'i rostero, ki ba ch'annati abadi vaslashon mesozad, medikh'ad.

176) Ei Paiombar, az tu dar borai merosi shakhsi "Kalola" fatvo mepursand. "Kalola" on kasest, ki ba'di favtidanash az khud padar va farzand bok'i nameguzorad. Dar ch'avobashon bigu: "Kh'ukmi "kalola"-ro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baion menamoiad." Agar kase bimirad, ki padaru farzand nadorad va kh'ol on ki khokh'ari kh'amtan io khokh'ari padari dorad, pas dar in surat on khokh'ar az rui mik'dori ta'iinsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisfi moli guzoshtai maiitro megirad. Va agar maiit vorisi sokh'ibi sakh'mi ta'iinsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nadoshta boshad, barodari kh'amtani maiit io barodari padariash bo ta'sib moli ba'di marg guzoshtai maiitro ba meros mebarad. Ammo agar bo maiit sokh'ibi sakh'mi ta'iinsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boshad, pas on barodari kh'amtan io barodari padarii maiit moli ba'd az on sokh'ibsakh'm bok'imondaro ba meros mebarad. Pas agar khokh'aroni kh'amtan io khokh'aroni padari du io beshtar az du nafar boshand, onkh'o az rui mik'dori ta'iinsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az se du kh'issai molro ba meros mebarand. Va agar vorison barodaroni kh'amtan io padari buda, dar bainashon mardkh'o va zankh'o boshand, dar in kh'olat bar asosi ta'sib mutobik'i k'oidai "Mard du sakh'mi zanro ba meros mebarad" meros megirand. Ia'ne iak mard du barobari sakh'mi zan meros mebarad. Kh'ukmi "kalola" va digar akh'komi merosro ba shumo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baion mesozad, to dar in masoil gumrokh' nashaved. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ama chizro medonad, chize az U pinkh'on nameboshad.

1) Ei mu'minon! Ba akh'dkh'oi bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va mardum bastaaton vafo namoed. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo rakh'mati Khesh baroi shumo chakh'orpoion (shuturu govu gusfandu buz)-ro kh'alol gardonida ast, magar on chi kh'arom budanash bar shumo tilovat meshavad va magar saidi khushkigard, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro bar shumo dar kh'olati ekh'romi kh'ach' io umra kh'arom karda ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oidi kh'alolu kh'arom tibk'i kh'ikmatash kh'ar chi khokh'ad, kh'ukm mekunad. Kase muk'obili kh'ukmash e'tiroz karda nametavonad.

2) Ei mu'minon! Kh'urmati nishonakh'oi dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro, ki shumoro ba rioiai on amr namuda ast, nigokh' dored va onro kh'alol nagardoned, dar kh'olati ekh'rom az istifodai libosi dukhtashuda va az shikori kh'aivoni khushkigard dar Kh'aram khuddori kuned va ch'angidan dar mokh'kh'oi kh'aromi Zulk'a'da, Zulkh'ich'ch'a, Mukh'arram, Rach'ab va k'urbonikh'oi baroi dar sarzamini Kh'aram zabkh' kardan kh'amchun kh'adia burdashudaro az rokh'i g'asb va g'airi on io boz doshtan az rasidan ba makh'alli zabkh' va chakh'orpoionero, ki kh'amchun ishorai k'urboni az pashm va monandi on gardanband dorand va bandagoni ozimi Khonai Ka'baro, ki manfiati tich'orati va rizoi Parvardigorashonro mech'uiand, kh'alol nagardoned. Va chun az kh'olati ekh'romi kh'ach' io umra va az sarzamini Kh'aram khorich' shaved, pas, agar khokh'ed, shikor bikuned. Va naboiad adovati k'avme ba illati on ki shumoro az Masch'id-ul-kh'arom man' kardaand, ba zulm va beadolati vodoraton sozad. Va dar anch'omi neki va parkh'ezkori ba kh'amdigar kumak rasoned va dar ma'siiat va sitamkori dar khunu doroi va nomusi mardum ba kh'amdigar kumak narasoned. Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo anch'omi ibodat va tarki ma'siiat bitarsed. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba isionkoron Doroi azobi sakht ast. Binobar in, az azobash biparkh'ezed.

3) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo murdor va khuni ch'ori va gushti khuk va on chi kh'angomi zabkh' bar on nomi g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) burda shavad va kh'aivoni bo nafasgirshavi murda va kh'aivoni ba vositai zarb murda va kh'aivoni bo aftidan az balandi murda va kh'aivoni bo shokhzanii kh'aivoni digar murda va on chi darrandae az k'abili sher, palang, gurg va g'aira onro shikor karda khurda va murda ast, kh'amai inro kh'arom gardonida ast, magar on kh'aivone az nombarshudakh'o, ki dar kh'oli zinda budanash onro dariofta, zabkh'i shar'i kardaed, dar in surat iste'molash bar shumo kh'alol meboshad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iste'moli on kh'aivonero, ki baroi butkh'o zabkh' shuda ast, bar shumo kh'arom karda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) inchunin bar shumo kh'arom gardonida ast, ki bo istifoda az chubakh'oi naiza k'ismati khudro az g'aib donistan khokh'ed. (Vozhai "Azlom" az sangkh'o io chubakh'oi naizae iborat ast, ki dar on "Bikun", "Nakun" kitobat shuda bud. Mardumi davroni ch'okh'iliiat pesh az ich'roi kh'ar kor avval az kh'amin sangkh'o io chubakh'oi naiza istifoda meburdand. Agar ch'avobi on "Bikun" mebaromad, on korro mekardand va dar surati ch'avobi manfi az on boz meistodand.) Anch'omi kh'aromkh'oi mazkur ma'noi az itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khorich' shudanro dorad. Imruz kofiron ba'd az mushokh'idai k'udrati Islom az on ki shumo az dini kheshtan bargarded, noumed shudaand. Pas, az onkh'o natarsed va tankh'o az Man bitarsed. Imruz Man bar shumo dinaton Islomro komil sokhtam va ne'matkh'oi oshkoru nikh'onamro bar shumo ba itmom rasonidam va Islomro baroi shumo din barguzidam. Ba g'airi on kh'ech' dinero k'abul namekunam. Pas, kh'ar ki dar kh'olati gurusnagii sakht ba khurdani kh'aromkh'oi nombarshuda mach'bur shavad, kh'ol on ki ba gunokh' moil naboshad, bar u kh'ech' gunokh'e nest. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

Dar oiati peshina Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chi, ki iste'molash kh'arom gardidaast zikr karda, pas shuru' namud ba zikri on chi iste'molash kh'alol budanro, va guft:
4) Ei Paiombar, sakh'obagonat az tu dar borai on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iste'molashro bar onkh'o kh'alol gardonida shuda ast, mepursand. Dar posukhashon bigu: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton iste'moli khurdanikh'oi pok va on chiro, ki kh'aivonoti ta'limdidai doroi dandonkh'oi nesh ba misli sag va palang va io doroi changol ba misli kargas va g'aira baroi shumo shikor kardaand, kh'alol namuda ast. Az donishi vobasta ba odobi shikor, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo on bar shumo ekh'son namuda ast, ba on kh'aivonoti shikori ta'lim medikh'ed. Vak'te on kh'aivonotro ba kore amr mekuned, onro ba ch'o meorand va agar az kore man'ashon sozed, az on boz meistand. Pas az gushti on kh'aivonoti kh'alolgushte, ki in kh'aivonoti ta'limdida baroi shumo nigokh' doshtaand, agarchi onro bikushand, bikhured va kh'angomi ba shikor ravon namudanashon "Bismillokh'" bigued. Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo anch'omi farmon va parkh'ez az kh'arom bitarsed. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zudkh'isobkunandai amalkh'o ast."

5) Imruz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo khurdani kh'aivonoti pokro kh'alol karda ast. Va khurdani zabkh'i iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob baroi shumo kh'alol va khurdani zabkh'i shumo baroi onkh'o kh'alol ast. Va baroi shumo izdivoch' bo zanoni ozodi pokdomani boimon va izdivoch' bo zanoni ozodi pokdomani iakh'udu nasoro, ki k'abl az shumo ba onkh'o Kitob doda shuda bud, kh'alol gardonida shuda ast, vak'te ki ba onkh'o makh'rashonro bidikh'ed va az amali zino pokdomani ch'ued va baroi zino ma'shuk'akh'oi pinkh'oni nagired. Va kh'ar ki ba akh'komi muk'ararsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir gardad, pas begumon amalash botil meshavad, zero sharti k'abulshavii amalro az dast doda ast. Sharti k'abuli on imon ast. Va u ruzi k'iiomat az ch'umlai ziionkoron ast. Zero abadi dokhili duzakh megardad.

6) Ei mu'minon, chun k'asdi adoi namoz karded, dar kh'ol ki vuzu' nadored, pas takh'orat kuned, ba in tartib, ki rui va dastonatonro bo bandi dast bishued va saratonro maskh' bikashed va poikh'oi khudro bo du shitolangi on bishued. Va agar ch'unub boshed, pas g'usl kuned. Va agar bemor buda, az ziiodshavii maraz io der sikh'kh'at ioftani on khavf dored io musofired io az k'azoi kh'och'at omaded io bo zanon kh'ambistar shuda, ch'unub gashted, pas ba'd az ch'ustuch'u ob naiofted, ki bo on takh'orat io dar kh'olati ch'unub budan g'usl kuned, pas ba khoki poki rui zamin k'asd namoed, pas az on bar chekh'ra va dastonaton maskh' bikashed. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) namekhokh'ad bo akh'komash az rokh'i dar kh'ama kh'olat voch'ib sokhtani iste'moli ob, ki ba'zan istifodai on ba tandurusti zarar merasonad, ba shumo tangi va dushvori orad. Binobar in, dar kh'olatkh'oe, ki istifodai ob zarar rasonad io naboshad, ch'oiguzinash khokro baroiaton muk'arrar karda ast. Valekin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhokh'ad shumoro pok sozad va ne'mati Kheshro bar shumo ba itmom rasonad, to shukri ekh'soni Uro ba ch'o ovarda, nosiposi nakuned.

7) Va ne'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bar khesh, ki shumoro ba Islom kh'idoiat namud va paimoni bo shumo bastaashro iod kuned, on gokh', ki bo Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba sharti dar kh'olatkh'oi tangi va farokhi shunidan va itoat kardani amrash bai'at namuded va gufted: "Sukhanatro shunidem va az amrat itoat kardem." Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi dasturotash, az ch'umla bo vafo ba paimonkh'oiaton bitarsed. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai asrori k'albkh'o ast. Chize az U pushida nest.

8) Ei mu'minon! Baroi rizoi ilokh'i kh'uk'uk'i bar zimmaaton budai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o ored va bo adolat shokh'idi dikh'ed. Va naboiad adovati k'avme shumoro ba beadolati vodor sozad. Zero adolat bo dustu dushman amali matlub ast. Baroi kh'amin, bo kh'ama odilona raftor kuned, chunki adolat ba tarsidan az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va beadolati ba notarsi dar barobari U nazdiktar ast. Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi dasturotash bitarsed. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mekuned, Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' amali shumo az U makhfi nest va baroi kh'ar iak amal ba shumo ch'azoi bosazo medikh'ad.

9) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kasone, ki ba U va paiombaronash imon meorand va amalkh'oi nek mekunand, va'dai mag'firat namudani gunokh'onashon va podoshi buzurgi daromadani ch'annatro doda ast. Kh'argiz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba va'dai Khud khilof namekunad.

10) Va kasone, ki kofir shudand va oiatkh'oi Moro durug' shumurdand, in toifa akh'li duzakhand. Akh'li on baroi uk'ubati kufr va takzibashon ba duzakh medaroiand va on guna ki dust az dustash ch'udo nameshavad, onkh'o niz az duzakh ch'udo namegardand.

11) Ei mu'minon! Bo k'albu zaboni khesh ne'mati dar amon budan va dar k'albi dushmanonaton afkandani kh'arosro, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro bar shumo in'om karda ast, iod kuned, on gokh', ki dushmanonaton ba shumo k'asdi dastdarozi kardand, to nobudaton sozand, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dastoni onkh'oro az ziion rasonidan ba shumo nigokh' doshta, shumoro az badiashon mukh'ofizat namud. Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi dasturotash bitarsed. Va boiad mu'minon dar kasbi manfiatkh'oi dini va duniavi tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia kunand.

12) Va beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az Bani Isroil oidi on chi dar idomai in oiat zikr khokh'ad shud, paimoni k'at'i girift va bar onkh'o duvozdakh' kasro rakh'bar muk'arrar namud. Kh'ar iak rakh'bar korkh'oi zerdastonashro nazorat mekard. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Bani Isroil guft: "Begumon Man bo nusrat va ta'iidi Khesh bo shumoiam. Savgand iod mekunam, ki agar namozro ba surati komil barpo dored va zakoti molkh'oiatonro bipardozed va ba tamomi paiombaronam biduni ch'udosozi imon ored va ekh'tiromashonro ba ch'o ovarda, kumakashon rasoned va molatonro dar rokh'kh'oi khair kharch' namoed, beshubkh'a, az shumo gunokh'onatonro makh'v megardonam va shumoro ruzi k'iiomat ba bustonkh'oe dokhil mekunam, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oi on rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad. Pas kh'ar ki az shumo ba'di giriftani in akh'di k'at'i kofir gardad, begumon az ch'odai kh'ak' didavu donista gumrokh' shuda ast."

13) Pas Mo onkh'oro ba sababi on ki paimonashonro shikastand, az rakh'matamon dur sokhtem va dilkh'oiashonro on chunon sakht gardonidem, ki kh'ech' khair va pande ba on rokh' nameiobad. Onkh'o kalomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az mavze'kh'oiash bo tabdili lafz va ta'vili maonii on tibk'i khostakh'oi nafsashon takh'rif mekardand va amali sokhtani kh'issai buzurge az on chiro, ki bo on pand doda shuda budand, tark sokhtand. Va ei Paiombar, paivasta az ch'onibi onkh'o nisbat ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va bandagoni mu'minash khiionatero oshkor menamoi, magar te'dodi andakashon, ki bar akh'di khud vafodor memonand. Pas az onkh'o guzasht namo va az ch'azoiashon sarfi nazar kun. In guzashtan va sarfi nazar kardani gunokh'onashon az ch'umlai nekukori ast. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nekukoronro dust medorad.

14) Va on guna ki az iakh'udikh'o akh'du paimoni k'at'i girifta budem, inchunin az on kasone, ki kheshtanro sitoish karda, pairavoni Iso (alaikh'is salom) mekhondand, paimon giriftaem. Nasronikh'o niz monandi guzashtagoni iakh'udiashon amal kardan ba on chiro, ki baroiashon pand doda shud, tark namudand. Mo dar baini gurukh'kh'oi nasoro to ruzi k'iiomat adovat va nafrati sakhtro andokhtem. Az in ru, onkh'o bo kh'am doim dar ch'angand va in gurukh' on gurukh'ro kofir mekhonad. Va iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro az on chi dar dunio mekardand, ogokh' sokhta, ch'azoi a'molashonro khokh'ad dod.

Chun Khudo dar oiati bolo akh'li Kitob, paimoni az onkh'o girifta va paimonshikaniashonro baion namud, dar oiati zerin onkh'oro ba imon ovardan ba Rasuli akram (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) farmon dod va guft:
15) Ei iakh'udu nasoroi sokh'ibi Tavrotu Inch'il! Iak'inan ba sui shumo Paiombaramon Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) omada, baroi shumo beshtare az kh'ak'ik'ati kitobkh'oi osmonii pinkh'on kardaatonro baion mesozad va az beshtari on chi ki oshkorshaviash ch'uz sharmandashavii shumo sude nadorad, guzasht menamoiad. Shakke nest, ki az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton Nur va Kitobi ravshangar omada ast. K'ur'on Nur va Kitobi ravshangarest, ki dar torikikh'oi ma'navi az ravshaniash istifoda mebared va zaruratkh'oi duniovu okhirati shumoro baion menamoiad.

16) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo in Kitob kasonero, ki bo imon va amali solekh' khushnudii Uro mekhokh'and, ba rokh'kh'oi nach'ot az ch'akh'annam va daromadan ba ch'annat rakh'namoi mekunad. Kh'amchunin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo in dasturi osmoni bandagoni khudro az torikikh'oi kufru ma'siiat ba sui rushnoii imonu ibodat berun meorad va ba onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro medikh'ad. Murod az rokh'i rost dini Islom ast.

17) Beshak, nasronikh'o, ki guftand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amon Masekh'i pisari Mariam ast, kofir shudand. Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bigu, agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) irodai kh'alok sokhtani Masekh'i pisari Mariam va Modarash va tamomi mardumi rui zaminro kunad, ki k'udrati peshgirii onro dorad?! Chun kh'ech' kas tavoni peshgirii irodai Allokh'(ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro nadorad, in ba iagonagii U dalolat mekunad va Isoi Masekh', Modarash Mariam va kulli mavch'udot makhluk'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astand. Kh'ama mavch'udoti osmonkh'ovu zamin va baini onkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'ar chiro khokh'ad, meofarad. Isoi pisari Mariam bo irodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khalk' shuda ast. Isoi Masekh' banda va firistodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ama kor Tavono meboshad.

18) Va iakh'ud va nasoro da'vo dorand, ki onkh'o pisaron va dustoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astand. Ei Paiombar! Dar posukh ba onkh'o bigu, agar chunin ast, pas charo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro baroi gunokh'onaton azob mekunad?! Agar dar kh'ak'ik'at farzandon va dustoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mebuded, kh'ech' gokh' shumoro dar dunio bo kushtoru tag'iiri surat va dar okhirat bo azobi duzakh ch'azo namedod. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' gokh' dustonashro azob namekunad. Balki shumo ba monandi digaron inson kh'asted, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ofarida ast. Kh'ar kase az insonkh'o neki kunad, podoshi vai bikh'isht va kh'ar kas badi kunad, bo azobi duzakh ch'azo doda meshavad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'oni kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, bo fazlash mag'firat mekunad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, bar asosi adolat ba azob giriftor mesozad. Tamomi mavch'udoti osmonkh'ovu zamin va baini onkh'o tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Bozgashti kh'ama chiz iagona ba sui U ast.

19) Ei iakh'ud va nasoroi akh'li Kitob! Beshak, ba'd az k'at' shudani bi'sati paiombaron va niiozmandi ba ravon kardani onkh'o, Firistodai Mo Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba sui shumo omad, to bakh'onach'ui nakuned, ki ba mo baroi muzhda dodan ba bikh'isht va bim dodan az duzakh kh'ech' paiombare naomada ast. Zero Ba durusti ki Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba sui shumo ba sifati muzhdarason ba bikh'isht va bimdikh'anda az duzakh omada ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tamomi kor K'odir ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro notavon karda nametavonad. Iake az namunakh'oi k'udratash firistodani paiombaron va khotima dodani onkh'o bo omadani Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ast.

20) Ei Firistodai Mo! Zamonero iod kun, ki Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba k'avmash Bani Isroil gufta bud: "Ei k'avmi man! Bo k'albu zabon ne'matero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton arzoni namuda ast, ba iod ored. On gokh', ki az bainaton paiombaroni ziiod barguzid, to shumoro ba rokh'i durust rokh'namoi kunand va shumoro ba'di navkari va g'ulomii kh'ukumati Fir'avn sokh'ibi podshokh'iiu molikiiat kard va dar on zamon ba shumo on k'adar ne'mat dod, ki ba kase az olamiion nadoda bud."

21) Muso guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Ba sarzamini poke (Bait-ul-muk'addas va atrofi on), ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton daromadani on va ch'angidan bo kofironashro va'da doda ast, vorid shaved va dar barobari k'avmi nerumandi in sarzamin shikast makhured. Chunki dar surati amal nakardan ba in guftakh'o dar duniovu okhirat ziioni sakht domangiraton megardad."

22) K'avmi Muso dar posukh ba vai guftand: "Ei Muso! Dar on Sarzamini Muk'addas afrodi bisior sarkashi nerumand zindagi mekunand. In kh'olat moro az daromadan ba on ch'o boz medorad. To vak'te, ki on afrod dar Sarzamini Muk'addas kh'astand, mo ba onch'o vorid nameshavem. Zero k'udrat va tavoni muboriza bo onkh'oro nadorem. Agar onkh'o az in sarzamin berun shavand, mo medaroem."

23) Du mard az kh'amrakh'oni Muso, ki az azobi ilokh'i bim doshtand va tavfik'i ilokh'i iorashon gashta bud, k'avmi Musoro ba pairavi az farmoni vai targ'ib karda, chunin guftand: "Az darvozai in shakh'r, ki onch'o k'avmi sarkashi nerumand ba sar mebarand, notarsida vorid shaved. Vak'te shumo az k'onunkh'oi piruzi az imon doshtan ba Khudo va omodagikh'oi moddi istifoda mebared va ba on takia mekuned, kh'atman alaikh'i on gurukh'i sitamgari nerumand piruz meshaved. Agar mu'mini vok'ei kh'asted, tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavakkul namoed. Zero imoni kh'ak'ik'i tavakkul ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro tak'ozo menamoiad."

24) Bani Isroili k'avmi Muso (alaikh'is salom) bo pofishori bar mukholifati farmoni paiombarashon guftand: "To zamone, ki on k'avmi sarkashi nerumand dar Sarzamini Muk'addasand, mo ba onch'o namedaroem. Pas tu Muso kh'amrokh'i Parvardigorat birav va iakch'o alaikh'i onkh'o bich'anged. Ammo mo dar kh'amin ch'oi khud memonem va az ch'angidan bo shumo bar ziddi on k'avm ak'ibnishini mekunem."

25) Muso ba Parvardigorash guft: "Parvardigoro! Man ch'uz khud va barodaram digar bar boloi kase k'udrat nadoram. Pas baini mo va baini in k'avmi az amri Tu va Paiombarat khorich'shuda bo k'azovati odilonaat faisala kun."

26) Allokh' taolo ba Musoi paiombarash (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi Bani Isroil daromadan ba Sarzamini Muk'addasro chil sol kh'arom gardonid. Onkh'o tuli in muddat dar in sakh'ro kh'aironu sargardon megardand. Ei Muso! Baroi kh'amin afsusi in k'avmi az doirai toati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) berunshudaro makhur! Zero kh'ar azobe, ki ba onkh'o merasad, ba sababi gunokh'onashon ast."

27) Ei Firistodai Mo! Baroi in k'avmi iakh'udi sitamgari kh'asadkhur khabari K'obil va Kh'obili pisaroni Odamro ba rosti, ki dar on zarrae shubkh'a nest, k'issa kun. On gokh', ki onkh'o k'urboni kardand va khostand bo in kor ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdik shavand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'urbonii Kh'obilro, ki bandai botak'vo bud, paziruft va k'urbonii K'obilro napaziruft. Chunki K'obil az parkh'ezkoron nabud. Pas, K'obil ba k'abul gardidani k'urbonii barodari khesh Kh'obil kh'asad burd va guft: "Ei Kh'obil! Man kh'atman turo ba k'atl merasonam." Kh'obil guft: "Okhir, man chi gunokh' doram?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tankh'o k'urbonii parkh'ezkoroni ich'rokunandai farmonkh'oiashro mepazirad.

28) Savgand ba Allokh', agar tu baroi kushtani man dast daroz kuni, man ba tu dast daroz nakhokh'am kard. In ba ma'noi on nest, ki man az tu tars doshta bosham, balki man dar anch'omi ma'siiat az Parvardigori tamomi mavch'udot sakht metarsam."

29) Pas Kh'obil baroi tarsonidani barodarash, ki dast ba ch'inoiati barodarkushi nazanad, guft: "Man mekhokh'am tu bo zulmu dastdarozi ba man gunokh'i k'atli maro bo gunokh'oni guzashtaat iakch'o bari, pas dar okhirat az zumrai duzakhiion gardi. Ch'azoi tach'ovuzkoron kh'amin ast. Ammo man namekhokh'am gunokh'i k'atli turo bar dush giram va az zumrai duzakhiion gardam."
30) Pas nafsi sarkashi K'obil baroi vai kushtani Kh'obilro zinat dod va uro zolimona kusht. Pas K'obil bo in kori badi khud dar duniovu okhirat az ch'umlai ziionkoron gasht.

31) Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) peshi K'obil zog'ero firistod, to dar zamin zog'i murdaero dafn kunad va baroi K'obil tarzi zeri khok sokhtani ch'asadi barodarashro ta'lim dikh'ad. K'obil guft: "Ei voi bar man! Oio az on ki monandi in zog' bosham, pas ch'asadi barodaramro dafn kunam, och'iz mondam?!" U ba'd az in vok'ea az pushaimonshudagoni kh'asratzada gardid.

32) Mo ba sababi kushtashavii Kh'obil az ch'onibi barodarash K'obil Bani Isroilro ogokh' sokhtem, ki kh'ar kas shakhsero be sababi sitonidani k'isos, az din khorich'shavi va rokh'zani ba k'atl rasonad, pas, guio kh'amai mardumro kushta ast. Chunki ma'lum meshavad, ki k'otil baini begunokh' va gunakh'kor fark' nameguzorad. Va kh'ar kas az kushtani shakhse ba e'tik'odi on ki k'atli insoni begunokh' ch'inoiati buzurg va kh'arom ast, khuddori kunad, pas, guio kh'amai mardumro zinda karda ast. Chunki bo in raftori u mardum dar amnu amon zindagi mekunand. Va ba durusti ki paiombaroni Mo ba nazdi Bani Isroil bo kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ravshan omadand, sipas iak'inan ba'd az in beshtari onkh'o bo anch'omi gunokh' va mukholifat bo paiombaron dar zamin az marzkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guzashtand.

33) Begumon kasone, ki bar ziddi Khudovu Paiombar mech'angand va dar zamin bo ech'odi dushmani, k'atli begunokh'on, banokh'ak' giriftani moli g'air va rokh'zani ba fasodkori mashg'ul meshavand, ch'azoi onkh'o kushtan io ba dor ovekhtan io buridani dastashon bo poii chap, sipas agar dubora ba in amal bozgardad, buridani dasti chap bo poii rost va io ba digar sarzaminkh'o badarg'a kunonidan ast. In ch'azo baroi rasvoshavii onkh'o dar dunio ta'iin shuda ast va dar okhirat onkh'oro azobi azim ast.

34) Magar on kasone az gurukh'i mazkur, ki pesh az dast ioftanaton bar onkh'o (ia'ne pesh az on ki onkh'oro dastgir kuned, khudashon bo ikhtiiori shakhsi taslim shavand) tavba kunand. Pas bidoned, ki Khudo bar onkh'o ba'd az tavbai sodik'ona bisior Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Iake az namunakh'oi rakh'matash ba onkh'o on ast, ki ba'di tavbai samimi ch'azoi onkh'o bee'tibor megardad.

35) Ei mu'minon! Bo ich'roi amrkh'o va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed. Va bo anch'om dodani dasturot va duri ch'ustan az ma'siiat rokh'i bo U nazdikshaviro bich'ued va dar rokh'i U bo kuffor kholisona ch'ikh'od kuned, to bo noil shudan ba ch'annat va emin mondan az ch'akh'annam rastagor garded.

36) Iak'inan kofiron agar ba farzi misol, tamomi molikiiati zamin va iak barobari on az onkh'o boshad va ruzi k'iiomat onro baroi ozodsozii ch'oni khud az azobi ilokh'i peshkash kunand, kh'ech' gokh' in bakh'oi ozodi az onkh'o k'abul nameshavad va onkh'oro azobi dardovare ast.

37) Chun kofiron ba duzakh medaroiand, az on berun shudan mekhokh'and, vale in khokh'ishashon az kuch'o muiassar megardad?! Va onkh'o kh'argiz az on berun nameshavand va onkh'oro dar ch'akh'annam azobi doimi ast.

Vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi guzashta kh'ukmi oshkor rabudani moli mardumro baion kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin mas'alai pinkh'oni giriftani moli onkh'o, ia'ne kh'ukmi duzdro zikr karda guft:
38) Ei kh'okimon! Dasti rosti kh'ar iake az mard va zani duzdro baroi ch'azoi ch'urmi banokh'ak' giriftani moli mardum va uk'ubate az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bibured, to ba in amal barnagardand va ba digaron darsi ibrat shavand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti G'olibi Mag'lubnashavandai dar akh'kom va ta'iini tak'dirot Kh'akim ast.

39) Pas kh'ar ki ba'd az ich'roi gunokh'i duzdi tavbai samimona karda, a'molashro islokh' kunad, begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo fazli Khesh tavbai uro mepazirad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakor Omurzandai Mekh'rubon ast. Ammo vak'te khabari duzdiashon ba kh'okimon rasad, ch'azoi duniavii shar'ii buridani dastashon bo tavba sok'it nameshavad.

40) Ei Firistodai Mo! Tu iak'inan medoni, ki tamomi mavch'udoti osmonkh'ovu zamin va baini onkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'ar guna khokh'ad, dar on amal mekunad. Kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, az rui adlash azob medikh'ad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, az rui fazlash meomurzad. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ama kor K'odir ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro notavon sokhta nametavonad.

41) Ei Firistodai Mo! Naboiad turo on kasone ki dar oshkorsozii asarkh'oi kufr -agar fursat paido kunand- meshitoband, az munofik'on, ki bo zabonashon khudro mu'min meguiand va k'alban imon nadorand va niz az k'avmi iakh'ud andukh'gin gardonand. Onkh'o ba sukhanoni durug'i sarvaronashon ziiod gush faro medikh'and va onro mepazirand, inchunin ba sukhanoni digar rakh'baronashon, ki az rui kibru g'urur dar mach'lisat kh'ozir nashudand, ziiod gush meandozand va pairavi mekunand. Onkh'o[3] Kalomi Khudoro dar Tavrot muvofik' bo maili kheshtan tag'iir medikh'and. Ba pairavonashon meguiand: "Agar kh'ukmi sodirkardai Mukh'ammad ba in kh'ukmi takh'rifshudai muvofik'i dilaton boshad, onro bipazired va dar aksi kh'olat az paziruftanash biparkh'ezed." Va ei Paiombar, agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gumrokh'ii kasero khokh'ad, kh'argiz shakhsero paido karda nametavoni, ki gumrokh'iashro dur kunad va ba rokh'i rost rokh'namoiash sozad. In ch'amoai munofik'on va iakh'udikh'oi tavsifshuda kasoneand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kufr pok gardonidani k'albashonro nakhosta ast. Onkh'oro dar dunio rasvoi va dar okhirat azobi buzurgi duzakh ast.

42) Iakh'udikh'o sukhani durug'ro bisior gush mekunand, moli kh'aromro ba misli ribo bisior mekhurand. Pas agar onkh'o baroi kh'alli k'aziiakh'oi khud nazdi tu Paiombar oiand, agar khokh'i, dar baini onkh'o dovari namo va agar khokh'i, dovariashonro tark kun. Tu dar in kor ikhtiiori komil dori. Va agar dar kh'alli k'aziiakh'oi onkh'o dovariro tark namoi, kh'argiz onkh'o ba tu zarar rasonida nametavonand. Va agar dar bainashon k'azovat kardi agarchi zolim va dushmanat kh'astand, pas odilona k'azovat kun. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dovaroni odilero, ki sarfi nazar az dushmanii tarafkh'oi da'vogar bo onkh'o az adolat dast namekashand, dust medorad.

43) Va raftori in toifa kh'airatovar ast! Onkh'o ba oiini tu kufr mevarzand va dar aini zamon baroi on ki kh'ukmi muvofik'i tab'i dilashonro sodir namoi, baroi k'azovat nazdat meoiand va kh'ol on ki onkh'o nazdashon Kitobi Tavrot ast, ki da'voi ba on imon doshtanro dorand va dar on kh'ukmi ilokh'i ast. Sipas vak'te kh'ukmi sodirkardaat ba tab'i dilashon muvofik' naoiad, az kh'ukmi tu rui metoband va onro rad mekunand. Onkh'o bo in raftori shigiftovar kufr varzidan ba akh'komi Kitobashon Tavrot va napaziruftani dovarii turo iakch'o ch'am' meorand. Kh'ech' gokh' in raftori mu'minon nest. Va onkh'o na ba tu va na ba akh'komi Kitobi khud imon nadorand.

44) Begumon, Mo Tavrotro ba Muso furud ovardem, dar kh'ole ki dar on rokh'namoi ba sui neki va dar torikikh'oi kufru shirku ch'akh'olat va khurofot rushnoi bud. Paiombaroni ba kh'ukmi Khudo taslimshudai Bani Isroil baroi iakh'ud bo Tavrot kh'ukm mekardand va niz donishmandon va fuk'akh'oi iakh'udi, ki Khudo nigokh'dorii Tavrot va bar asosi on tarbiiati mardumro ba onkh'o supurda bud, to onro az voridshavii tag'iirot kh'ifz kunand, bo in Kitob kh'ukm mekardand. Va onkh'o guvokh'i kh'ak'ik'at doshtani Tavrot buda, mardum dar tamomi kor ba onkh'o muroch'iat menamudand. Pas ei k'avmi iakh'ud, tankh'o az Man bitarsed va az mardum natarsed va kh'ukmi nozilkardai Maro bo bakh'oi nochiz az mansabu moli dunio ivaz makuned. Va kasone, ki bar asosi talaboti akh'komi nozilkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ukm namekunand va in korashonro kh'alol medonand io digar akh'komi duniaviro az on bolo meguzorand va io bo on iakson meshumorand, pas in gurukh' dar kh'ak'ik'at kofir kh'astand.

45) Va Mo bar k'avmi iakh'ud dar Tavrot ich'roi in akh'komro farz gardonidem, ki kh'ar kas shakhsero banokh'ak' va k'asdan bikushad, dar ivazi on kushta meshavad, kh'ar kas k'asdan chashmi shakhsero barkanad, chashmash barkanda meshavad, kh'ar kas k'asdan binii kasero k'at' kunad, biniash k'at' karda meshavad, kh'ar kas gushi shakhsero k'asdan biburad, gushash burida meshavad va kh'ar kas dandoni shakhsero k'asdan barkanad, dandonash barkanda meshavad. Va inchunin dar bobi ch'arokh'atkh'o bar onkh'o farz gardonidem, ki shakhsi ch'inoiatkor ba andozai ch'inoiatash much'ozot meshavad. Va kh'ar kas ikhtiioran az gunokh'i shakhsi ch'inoiatkor darguzarad, in amalash sababi makh'v shudani gunokh'onash megardad. Zero ch'abrdida gunokh'i shakhsi nisbatash sitamkardaro bakhshida ast. Va kasone, ki dar mavzui k'isos va g'airi on bar asosi talaboti akh'komi nozilkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ukm namekunand, pas onkh'o iak'inan az marzkh'oi muaiiansokhtai ilokh'i tach'ovuzkunandai zolim kh'astand.

46) Va ba'd az paiombaroni Bani Isroil Isoi pisari Mariamro firistodem, ki ba Tavroti k'abl az u nozilshuda bovar dosht va bar asosi on kh'ukm mekard. Va ba u Inch'ilro dodem. Dar on rakh'namoii mardum ba sui kh'ak' bud va bo dalelkh'oi k'ote' shubkh'akh'oro barkh'am zada, akh'komi dushvorro kh'al menamud va akh'komi on ba akh'komi Tavrot ba g'air az chand ch'oi mansukhshuda muvofik'at dosht. Va Mo Inch'ilro rokh'namoi parkh'ezkoron va az korkh'oi zisht bozdoranda gardonida budem.

47) Va boiad nasronikh'o ba on chi Allokh' dar Inch'il nozil karda ast, imon orand va bar asosi akhborash, ki iakei on khabari tasdik'i bi'sati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ast, kh'ukm kunand. Va on kasone, ki bar asosi on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furud ovarda ast, kh'ukm namekunand, pas onkh'o iak'inan az ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khorich', az kh'ak'ik'at ruigardon va ba sui botil moil kh'astand.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi guzashta Tavrot va Inch'ilro madkh' kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin K'ur'oni karimro madkh' namud va guft:
48) Va ei Paiombar! Beshak, K'ur'onro ba rosti ba tu firistodem, dar kh'ole ki akh'komi kitobkh'oi osmonii guzashtaro tasdik' mekunad va bar on kitobkh'o kh'ukmi dovarro dorad. Kh'ar kh'ukme az kitobkh'oi guzashta, ki bo K'ur'on mutobik' boshad, kh'ak' va kh'ar kh'ukme bo on mukholif boshad, botil ast. Pas dar baini mardum bo on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar K'ur'on nozil sokhta ast, dovari namo. Va az kh'ak'ik'ati baroiat omada rui gardonida, az khokh'ishi iakh'udu nasoro, ki sababi kh'alok shudanashon gashta ast, pairavi makun. Mo baroi kh'ar ummat shariati ch'udo va rokh'i ravshan muk'arrar kardaem. Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, shumoro iak ummati doroi shariati iagona megardonid, ammo U baroi kh'ar ummat shariati alokh'ida guzosht, to kh'amaro ozmuda, farmonbardoronro az nofarmonkh'o ch'udo kunad. Pas ba sui anch'omi nekikh'o va tarki badikh'o shitobed. Zero bozgashti kh'amai shumo ruzi k'iiomat ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Dar on ruz shumoro az on chi dar borai on ikhtilof dored, ogokh' mesozad va dar ivazi amalkh'oiaton ba shumo podosh medikh'ad.

49) Va ei Firistodai Mo! Dar miioni onkh'o bar asosi on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar tu furud ovarda ast, dovari kun va az andeshakh'oi barkhosta az kh'avoi nafsashon pairavi makun va az onkh'o barkh'azar bosh, ki turo az ba'zei on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba suiat furud ovarda ast, berokh'a nasozand. Zero onkh'o ba khotiri ba in kh'adaf rasidan kh'amai taloshi khudro ba kharch' medikh'and. Pas agar in toifai sarkash az paziruftani kh'ukmi K'ur'on rui gardonand, bidon, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhokh'ad onkh'oro dar dunio ba sazoi ba'zei gunokh'onashon rasonad va ruzi k'iiomat dar ivazi kh'amai korkh'oi badashon duchori azob gardand. Va beshak, beshtari mardum az doirai toati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khorich'and.

50) Oio onkh'o kh'ukmi akh'li ch'okh'iliiatro, ki bo pairavi az khokh'ishashon dovari mekunand, mech'uiand va az kh'ukmi tu rui metoband?! Nazdi akh'li iak'in, ki ba darki akh'komi ilokh'i sarfakh'm meravand, kh'ech' kas az nigokh'i kh'ukm az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bekh'tar nest. Nazari shakhsoni nodon va kh'avoparast, ki ch'uz akh'komi muvofik' ba tab'i dilashon kh'ukmero k'abul namekunand, arzish nadorad. Zero inkh'o tab'i kh'avoi nafsi khudro asos medonand va kh'ar chi bo on muvofik' ast agarchi botil boshad, onro mepazirand.

51) Ei mu'minon! Iakh'ud va nasororo baroi kheshtan dust magired. Zero k'avmi iakh'ud va nasoro tankh'o kh'amkeshoni khudro dust medorand. In du gurukh' shumo musulmononro dushmani mushtarakashon mekh'isoband. Va kh'ar kas az shumo bo onkh'o dusti kunad, pas iak'inan az zumrai onkh'o ast. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shakhsoni ba sababi dusti bo iakh'udu nasoro zolimro kh'idoiat namekunad.

52) Pas tu Paiombar on kasonero, ki dar dilashon bemorii nifok' ast, mebini, ki ba sui dusti bo iakh'udu nasoro shitobida meguiand: "Mo kh'aros dorem, ki iakh'ud va nasoro bar alaikh'i Paiombar va mu'minon g'olib shavand va sokh'ibi k'udrat gashta, az onkh'o ba mo ziion rasad." Pas umed ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) piruziro nasibi Paiombarash va mu'minon gardonad, io az sui Khud kore kunad, ki shukukh'i iakh'udikh'o bo dustonashon zavol iofta, munofik'oni dusti iakh'ud az pinkh'on sokhtani nifok'ashon dar k'albashon pushaimon shavand. Zero ba asbobi bepoia dil bastaand.

53) Va mu'minon bo taach'ch'ub az kh'olati munofik'on meguiand: "Oio inkh'o kasone kh'astand, ki bo k'asamkh'oi paiopai va k'at'i khudro dar imon va nusrat bo shumo mu'minon mekh'isoband?!" Kh'amai amalkh'oi munofik'on botil gashta, pas ba sababi az dast dodani matlubashon va giriftori ba azobi abadi az ch'umlai ziionkoron meshavand.

54) Ei akh'li imon! Kh'ar kas az shumo az imon ba sui kufr bargardad, pas iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ivazi onkh'o k'avmero khokh'ad ovard, ki onkh'oro baroi ustuvoriashon dar e'tik'od dust medorad va onkh'o Uro samimona dust medorand, bo mu'minon rakh'mdil va bar kofiron sakhtgirand, bo molu ch'oni khud ba khotiri piruzii dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'ikh'od mekunand va dar tak'dimi rizoi ilokh'i bar rizoi makhluk'ot az malomati kh'ech' kas kh'aros va parvo nadorand. In mak'omi baland az ch'umlai bakhshoishkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast va onro ba kh'ar kas khokh'ad, ato mekunad va lutfi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat gusturda buda, bandagoni sazovori lutfashro medonad.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi zikrshuda mu'minonro az dusti bo iakh'ud va nasoro man' kard, dar oiati zerin baroiashon gurukh'ero, ki boiad bo onkh'o alok'ai dusti doshta boshand, khabar dod va guft:
55) Iakh'udu nasoro va digar kofiron dustoni shumo nestand, balki dustoni vok'eii shumo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash va mu'minone kh'astand, ki namozro barpo medorand, zakoti molashonro mepardozand va onkh'o dar barobari farmonkh'oi ilokh'i taslimshuda meboshand.

56) Va kh'ar ki bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash va mu'minon sodik'ona dusti kunad, pas vai az gurukh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast va iak'inan gurukh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) piruz kh'astand. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o iori merasonad.

57) Ei mu'minon! Kasonero az iakh'ud va nasoro, ki dini shumoro ba maskhara va bozi megirand, dust va kh'ampaimon magired. Va agar dar kh'ak'ik'at mu'min kh'asted, bo parkh'ez az dustii onkh'o va amal kardan bar asosi on chi ba shumo nozil shuda ast, az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed.

58) Va inchunin vak'te ki shumo bo sadoi azon iakdigarro ba namoz faro mekhoned, onkh'o namozro, ki dar Islom buzurgtarin ibodat ast, ba maskhara va bozi megirand. Sababi in amalashon on ast, ki onkh'o k'avmi bekhirad buda, ma'noi ibodat va akh'komi ilokh'iro namefakh'mand.

59) Ei Firistodai Mo! Ba maskharakunandagoni akh'li Kitob bigu: "Ei akh'li Kitob! Oio moro tankh'o baroi on aib megired va ta'na mezaned, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ba on chi az nazdash baroiamon furud ovarda shuda ast va ba kitobkh'oi guzashta imon dorem va niz imon dorem, ki aksari shumo bo kufr varzidan va tarki amal tibk'i kh'ukmi ilokh'i az toati U khorich' kh'asted?! In a'mol bar'aks boisi iftikhor va korkh'oi sutudani ast."

60) Ei Firistodai Mo, bigu: "Oio shumoro az on chi nisbat ba mo gumon dored, az ch'azoi badtar az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar k'iiomat khabar dikh'am?! On ch'azoi kasone ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro az rakh'mati Khud ronda ast va ba'zeashonro ba surati buzina va khuk mubaddal sokhta va ibodatkunandai tog'ut gardonida ast. In ch'amoa ruzi okhirat dar badtarin ch'oi k'aror megirand va az rokh'i rost dar muk'oisa bo digar kofiron gumrokh'tarand." Kh'ar chi g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo k'anoat parastida shavad, tog'ut ast.

61) Va vak'te munofik'on nazdi shumo mu'minon biioiand, meguiand: "Mo imon ovardaem" va kh'ol on ki iak'inan onkh'o nazdaton bo kufr dokhil va bo kufr khorich' shudaand. Va onkh'o agarchi zokh'iran khudro baroi shumo mu'min nishon dikh'and, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kufre, ki dar k'albashon pinkh'on mesozand, Ogokh' meboshad. Kh'atman ba onkh'o ch'azo medikh'ad.

62) Va ei Paiombar! Beshtari iakh'udikh'oro mushokh'ida mekuni, ki dar sodir kardani gunokh' (ba misli durug'gui) va zulm dar kh'ak'k'i mardum va az rokh'i kh'arom khurdani moli g'air meshitoband. Ba durusti ki on chi mekunand, kori nikh'oiat bad ast.

63) Charo peshvoion va donishmandonashon onkh'oro az shitoftan dar durug'gui, banokh'ak' shokh'idi dodan, khurdani moli mardum bo rokh'i botil man' namekunand?! Kori peshvoion va donishmandonashon, ki onkh'oro az in a'moli zisht boz namedorand, bisior bad ast!

64) Va k'avmi iakh'ud kh'angomi duchori ranch' va kamkh'osili gashtanashon meguiand: "Dasti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az ato namudani ne'mat basta shuda ast. Ba mo rizk' dodanro man' karda ast." Ogokh' boshed! Dastoni onkh'o az anch'omi khair va dodani mol ba fak'iron basta ast va baroi in sukhani zisht az rakh'mati ilokh'i ronda shudaand. Balki du dasti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo atoi ne'mat doim boz ast. Ba bandagon on guna ki khokh'ad, kharch' mekunad, ruzii kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, farokh va ruzii kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, tang mesozad. Kh'ech' kas Uro az kore man' io dar kore mach'bur kardan nametavonad. Va begumon on chi az ch'onibi Parvardigorat ba sui tu nozil shuda ast, sarkashi va kufri beshtari iakh'udikh'oro afzun mesozad. Zero onkh'o nisbat ba tu va digar mu'minon sakht kh'asad mebarand. Va Mo to ruzi k'iiomat dar baini toifakh'oi iakh'udikh'o adovat va nafratro afkandaem. Onkh'o kh'ar gokh' baroi shu'lavar sokhtani otashi ch'ang alaikh'i mu'minon imkonoti khudro ch'am' kunand va omodagi binand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'am'i onkh'oro parokanda karda, k'udratashonro az bain mebarad. Va k'avmi iakh'ud kh'amesha dar rokh'i fasodkori baroi makh'vi Islom va makr alaikh'i on mekushand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) fasodkoronro dust namedorad.

65) Va agar iakh'ud va nasoro ba oiini ovardai Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) imon orand va bo parkh'ez az ma'siiat az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tarsand, begumon Mo kh'amai gunokh'onashonro agarchi bisior kh'am boshad, makh'v mesozem va ruzi k'iiomat onkh'oro ba bog'kh'oi doroi ne'matkh'o dokhil mekunem. Onkh'o dar ch'annat ba rokh'ati abadi noil megardand.

66) Va agar iakh'udikh'o bar asosi akh'komi Tavrot va nasronikh'o bar asosi akh'komi Inch'il amal kunand va kh'amagi az dasturoti K'ur'on, ki az sui Parvardigorashon nozil shuda ast, kor girand, Man iak'inan baroi onkh'o asbobi ruziro az boridani boron va ruionidani giiokh'oni zamin oson mesokhtam va az boloi sar va az zeri k'adamashon rizk' mekhurdand. Va ba'zei akh'li Kitob shakhsoni mu'tadil va bar kh'ak'ik'at poidorand va aksarashon ba sababi imon naovardan badkor kh'astand.

67) Ei Paiombar! Kh'ar on chi az ch'onibi Parvardigorat ba suiat vakh'i shuda ast, onro ba mardum birason va chizero pinkh'on mador. Pas agar az paig'omi ilokh'i chizero pinkh'on sozi, tu risolati Parvardigoratro narasondai. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo minba'd az badikh'oi mardum kh'imoiat mekunad. Az in pas onkh'o ba tu ziion rasonda nametavonand. Pas mas'uliiati tu tankh'o tablig'i din ba mardum ast. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kofirone, ki kh'idoiatro namekhokh'and, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro namedikh'ad.
Biduni shakku tardid, Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kh'amai paig'omi ilokh'iro ba mardum rasonidaand. Kh'ar kas da'voi g'airi inro mekunad, pas beshak dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo durug' bofta ast.

68) Ei Paiombar! Ba iakh'ud va nasoro bigu: "To vak'te ki ba akh'komi Tavrotu Inch'il va K'ur'oni ba shumo az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton nozil shuda, ki imonu a'molaton tankh'o bo kh'amin sakh'ekh' megardad, amal nakuned, shumo mardumi dindor donista nameshavad." Va Ba durusti ki on chi ba sui tu az ch'onibi Parvardigorat nozil shuda ast, sarkashi va kufri beshtari akh'li Kitobro afzun megardonad. Chunki onkh'o g'ark'i girdobi kh'asad kh'astand. Pas baroi in kofiron afsus makhur va mu'minoni pairavat baroiat basanda meboshand.

69) Kh'amono mu'minon, iakh'udikh'o, sabaikh'o (toifae az pairavoni ba'ze az paiombaroni Khudo) va nasronikh'o, on shakhsone az onkh'o, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi k'iiomat imon biiorand va korkh'oi shoista kunand, pas bar onkh'o az kh'avodisi ruzi okhirat kh'ech' tarse nest va onkh'o baroi az dast dodani lazzatkh'oi dunio g'amgin nameshavand.

70) Beshak, Mo az Bani Isroil baroi itoat va farmonbardori az dasturoti Khud paimonkh'oi k'at'i giriftem va ba suiashon paiombaroni ziiodero baroi tablig'ili shariat firistodem. Ammo onkh'o paimonkh'oi giriftaamonro shikastand va az khokh'ishotashon pairavi kardand. Kh'ar gokh' ba onkh'o paiombare bo chize, ki nafsashon dust namedosht, meomad, az oiinash rui megardonidand va gurukh'ero takzib mekardand va gurukh'ero mekushtand.

71) Va iakh'udikh'o pindoshtand, ki ba onkh'o baroi akh'dshikani, takzibi paiombaron va k'atli onkh'o kh'ech' zarare namerasad, pas az didani kh'ak'ik'at nobino va az shunidanash noshunavo gashtand. Ammo ba balokh'oe duchor shudand, ki gumonashro nadoshtand. Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az rui fazlash tavbai onkh'oro paziruft. Ba'd az in beshtarashon dubora az didani kh'ak'ik'at nobino va az shunidanash noshunavo gashtand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tamomi kardakh'oiashonro mebinad, kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nameboshad va kh'atman onkh'oro ba sazoi a'molashon merasonad.

72) Beshak, on nasronikh'oe, ki: "Allokh' kh'amon Masekh'i pisari Mariam ast" meguiand, bo in sukhan kofir shudaand. Zero onkh'o bo in k'avlashon "ma'budiiat"-ro ba g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat dodaand. Va Isoi pisari Mariam ba onkh'o gufta bud: "Ei Bani Isroil! Iagona Allokh'i Parvardigori man va Parvardigori khudro biparasted. Kh'amai mo ba e'tibori bandagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barobar kh'astem. Chunki kh'ar kas ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk varzad, begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) daromadani bikh'ishtro baroiash abadi man' mekunad, k'arorgokh'ash otashi duzakh ast. Va zolimon iovarone nadorand, ki nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'ur'at namuda, kumakashon rasonad va az azobi ilokh'i rakh'oiashon sozad."

73) Dar kh'ak'ik'at nasronikh'oe, ki meguiand: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) seiumi se khudo (padar, pisar va Rukh'-ul-k'uds) ast", kofir shudaand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az in da'voi beasosi onkh'o pok ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az chand unsur tarkibiofta nest. Va kh'ech' ma'bude ba ch'uz Ma'budi Iagonai Bemisl vuch'ud nadorad. Va agar az in sukhani zisht boz naistand, kh'atman ba kasone az onkh'o, ki bar kufrashon idoma medikh'and, azobi dardovar merasad.

74) Pas oio onkh'o az in k'avli zisht bo tavbai sodik'ona ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barnamegardand va az U omurzish namekhokh'and?! Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i tavbakoron agarchi az kufr tavba kardaand, Bakhshanda buda, dar kh'ak'k'i mu'minon Mekh'rubon ast.

75) Masekh'i pisari Mariam niz monandi digar paiombaron iake az firistodagoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. On chi bar sari digar paiombaroni ilokh'i ba misli marg omada ast, bar sari u kh'am meoiad. Va Mariami modarash zani bisior rostk'avl va tasdik'kunandai sukhanoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bud. Modar va Pisar monandi digaron taom mekhurdand, zero ba on niioz doshtand. Pas onkh'o bo niiozmandi ba iste'moli taom chitavr metavonand Khudo boshand?! Pas ei Paiombar! Bo tafakkur nigokh' kun, ki Mo chi guna nishonakh'oi isbotkunandai iagonagii Khud va botil budani e'tik'odi shirkoludi nasronikh'oro ba surati ravshan baion mesozem, ammo onkh'o bar zammi in oiatkh'oi Moro inkor mekunand. Sipas bori digar bo tafakkur nigokh' kun, ki onkh'o bo vuch'udi in kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi isbotkunandai iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chi guna az on rui metoband.

76) Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bo ovardani kh'uch'ch'ati zerin oidi butloni ak'idai shirkoludashon bigu: "Oio chizero meparasted, ki baroi shumo kh'ech' zarar io foida rasonida nametavonad?!
