Ma'budi shumo notavon ast va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az och'izi pok ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavoi Dono ast. Iagona U kh'amai sukhanoni shumoro meshunavad va kh'ech' chiz az U dur namemonad. Fak'at U az tamomi korkh'oi shumo ogokh' ast. Va iak'inan shumoro ba ch'azoi amalkh'oi badaton merasonad."

77) Ei Paiombar! Ba nasronikh'o bigu: "Dar pairavi az dini khesh banokh'ak' az marzkh'oi muk'arrarsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) naguzared va dar ekh'tiromi shakhsone ba misli paiombaron, ki ba arch'guzorii onkh'o farmon shudaed, ba ziiodaravi rokh' nadikh'ed. Paiombaronro -on guna ki nisbat ba Iso (alaikh'is salom) chunin e'tik'od dored- ma'bud nashumored va az khokh'ishi nafsi guzashtagonaton, ki k'ablan bo ma'bud khondani Iso (alaikh'is salom) gumrokh' shudand va aksari mardumro gumrokh' sokhtand va az rokh'i rosti dini Islom gumrokh' gashtand, pairavi nakuned."

78) Kofironi Bani Isroil tavassuti zaboni Dovud (alaikh'is salom) dar Zabur va Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) dar Inch'il az rakh'mati Khudo ronda shudaand. In ba sababi on ast, ki onkh'o nofarmoni menamudand va muk'addasoti dini Khudoro poimol mesokhtand.

79) Onkh'o iakdigarro az anch'omi gunokh' nakh'i namekardand, balki bar'aks isionkoroni in k'avm dar baini mardum ba tavri oshkor gunokh' va amalkh'oi zisht anch'om medodand. Zero kase amalkh'oi k'abekh'i onkh'oro rad namekard. Amali onkh'o, ki ich'roi mas'uliiati "amri ma'ruf va nakh'ii munkar"-ro tark kardand, bag'oiat zisht ast.

80) Ei Paiombar! Tu aksari iakh'udikh'oi kofirro mushokh'ida mekuni, ki kofironro dust medorand va ba onkh'o mailu rag'bat dorand, ammo bo tu va iaktoparaston dushmani mevarzand. Beshak, bo dustii kofiron kori bisior zishtero anch'om medikh'and, zero in khislati dust giriftani kofiron va dushmani bo tu va iaktoparaston sabab shuda ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar onkh'o g'azab karda ast va dar duzakh ch'ovidon khokh'and mond.

81) Va agar iakh'udikh'o dar kh'ak'ik'at ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va paiombarashon Muso (alaikh'is salom) va Tavroti ba U nozil karda shuda imon medoshtand, kh'ech' gokh' mushrikonro baroi khud dust k'aror namedodand va akh'li imonro iaksu guzoshta, ba akh'li shirk rag'bat namekardand. Zero onkh'o dar Kitobashon az dusti bo kofiron nakh'i shudaand. Valekin aksari iakh'udikh'o az doirai toati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va dusti bo U va mu'minon khorich' kh'astand.

82) Va ei Paiombar! Iak'inan, dushmantarini mardum nisbati Islomu mu'minon k'avmi iakh'ud va mushrikonro khokh'i ioft. Zero iakh'udikh'o k'avmi kinatuz, kh'osid va mutakabbir ast. Va beshak, nazdiktarin gurukh'i mardum dar dustii mu'minon va Islom kasonero meiobi, ki meguiand: "Mo Nasoro kh'astem." Sababi nazdiki dustii onkh'o bo mu'minon on ast, ki dar bainashon donishmandon va bandagoni porso kh'astand va khudi onkh'o niz k'avmi g'airi mutakabbiri khoksorand. Zero neki ba k'albi shakhsi mutakabbir rokh' nameiobad.

83) Va k'albi in gurukh'i nasronikh'o -ba misli Nach'ch'oshi va amsolash- narm ast. Vak'te K'ur'oni bar Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozil shudaro shunavand, ba sababi on ki kh'ak'ro shinokhtaand, bo izkh'ori shikastakh'oli ashki chashmonashon ch'ori meshavad. Zero az kh'ak'ik'ati oiini Isoi (alaikh'is salom) bokhabarand. Onkh'o meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo! Mo ba on chi bar Paiombarat Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) firistodai, imon ovardaem. Pas moro kh'amrokh'i umatoni Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), ki dar ruzi k'iiomat bar digaron shokh'id meshavand, binavis."

84) Va chi monei imon ovardani mo ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va K'ur'oni ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozil shuda megardad va kh'ol on ki mo umedi onro dorem, ki Parvardigoramon moro bo paiombaron va pairavoni itoatkori az uk'ubati ilokh'i khavfdoshtai onkh'o voridi ch'annat mesozad.

85) Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sababi imon ovardan va e'tirof kardani kh'ak' ba onkh'o bustonkh'oero podosh medikh'ad, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtoni on rudkh'o ch'ori buda, dar onch'o abadi memonand. Va podoshi bandagoni nekukori pairav va taslimgashtai kh'ak' kh'amin guna ast.

86) Va kasone, ki ba Allokh' va Rasulash kufr mevarzand va oiatkh'oi ba Rasulamon nozilkardai Moro durug' meshumorand, onkh'o akh'li otashi shu'lavari duzakh kh'astand. Kh'argiz az on berun nameshavand.

87) Ei mu'minon! Bo da'voi "ba bakh'onai zukh'du dindori" khurdanikh'ovu nushidanikh'o va izdivoch'kh'oi pokizai kh'alolsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bar kheshtan kh'arom makuned va az marzkh'oi dar kh'arom ta'iinshuda naguzared. Zero iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shakhsoni az marzkh'oi muk'arrar guzarandaro dust namedorad.

88) Va az ne'matkh'oi kh'aloli pokizae, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro ba shumo ruzi doda ast, bikhured. Ammo az khurdanikh'o va nushidanikh'oi kh'arom, ki bo rokh'kh'oi nomashrui g'asb va g'aira kh'osil meshavad, biparkh'ezed. Va bo ich'roi dasturot va duri ch'ustan az kh'aromkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki ba U imon dored, bitarsed. Imon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az U tarsidanro lozim mesozad.

89) Ei mu'minon! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro baroi k'asamkh'oe, ki biduni k'asd bar zabonaton ch'ori megardad, bozpursi namekunad. Balki vak'te mavridi bozpursii ilokh'i k'aror megired, ki az takh'ti dil savgand iod kuned va onro shikaned. Pas agar baroi shikastani k'asamkh'oiaton iake az se kori zerinro ich'ro namoed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'i k'asam shikastanatonro makh'v mekunad: 1. Ba dakh' miskin, baroi kh'ar kas az nav'i miionai taomi kishvari shakhsi k'asamshikasta ba andozai iak so' taom dodan;
2. Io dakh' nafar miskinro muvofik' ba urfu odati mardum bo lisob ta'min kardan; 3. Va io ozod kardani g'ulomi boimon. Pas agar shakhsi k'asamshikasta iake az in se chizro paido nakunad, dar in surat se ruz ruza medorad. Ei mu'minon! Chun dar kore savgand khurda, onro ich'ro namekuned, kafforai on kh'amon chizest, ki inch'o zikr karda shud. Va az savgandi durug' khurdan, bo ismi boazamati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bisior savgand iod kardan va az bevafoi dar on biparkh'ezed. Ammo agar on chi dar anch'om nadodanash savgand khurdaed, amali nek boshad, onro anch'om doda, k'asamro shikaned va dar ivaz on guna ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) akh'komi kafforaro baroiaton baion karda ast, kaffora dikh'ed. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo kh'amin guna akh'komi kh'alol va kh'aromro meomuzad, to Uro baroi ne'mati donishi kh'osil kardaaton siposguzori kuned.

90) Ei mu'minon! Beshak, kh'ar mavodi mastkunandai tirasozandai ak'l, k'imor, sangkh'oe, ki mushrikon dar nazdash chorvo zabkh' menamudand io onro ba khotiri ibodat nasb mekardand va tirkh'oi k'ur'akashi, ki dar ch'okh'iliiat bo istifoda az on k'ismati khudro donistan mekhostand, kh'amai in korkh'o gunokh'i buzurg va az a'moli orostai Shaiton ast. Pas favran az on duri bich'ued, to ba kh'aioti neki dunio va ne'matkh'oi abadii okhirat noil garded.

91) Beshak, Shaiton mekhokh'ad az rokh'i orosta kardani sharobnushi va k'imor dar baini shumo dushmani va nafrat ech'od kunad va shumoro az zikri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va namoz boz dorad. Pas ei mu'minon! Oio shumo az in a'moli zisht boz meisted?! Beshubkh'a, sazovori sha'ni shumo tarki on ast. Favran az in korkh'oi zisht bechunu charo dast kashed!

92) Va bo ich'roi dasturoti shariat va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) itoat kuned va az Paiombarash (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) itoat kuned va bo onkh'o mukholifat nakuned. Pas agar az in rui gardoned, boiad bidoned, ki mas'uliiati Paiombari Mo tankh'o az tablig'i oshkori paig'omi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iborat ast. Beshak, Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) paig'omro ba mardum rasonda va mas'uliiati khudro ich'ro karda ast. Agar rokh'i durustro paido kuned, ba naf'i shumost va ziioni badkori niz ba khudaton barmegardad.

Chun kh'ukmi kh'arom gashtani sharob nozil shud, ba'ze az mu'minon khostand az kh'olati barodaroni mu'mini pesh az kh'aromshavii on vafot kardaashon ogokh' shavand. Posukh ba in oiati karimai zerin furud omad.
93) Bar kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, baroi nazdik shudan bo U amalkh'oi nek kardaand, baroi nushidani sharob pesh az kh'arom gashtani on gunokh' sabt nameshavad, ba sharti on ki az kh'aromkh'o duri ch'usta, az g'azabi ilokh'i parkh'ez karda, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, a'moli nek anch'om doda, sipas ekh'sosi nazorati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar k'albashon on k'adar k'avi boshad, ki kh'angomi ibodat guio Uro mebinand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagonero, ki bo chunin ekh'sosi imoni Uro ibodat mekunand, bisior dust medorad. Zero vuch'udashon az kh'issiioti on ki Uro mebinand, pur ast. Va makh'z kh'amin ekh'sosi imoni bandaro ba anch'omi durusti korkh'o peshbari menamoiad.

94) Ei mu'minon! Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro dar kh'olati ekh'rom bo ch'albi saidi khushkigardi dilkash, ki kh'aivonoti khurdro bo daston va kalonkh'ach'mi onro bo naizakh'o (ia'ne, ba osoni) ba dast meored, ozmoish mekunad. Mak'sadi in ozmoish ch'udo kardani bandagonest, ki az sababi imoni komil doshtan dar g'aib az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) metarsand va dar kh'olati ekh'romi kh'ach' az tarsi U az shikor kardani on kh'aivonoti dastras khuddori menamoiand. Pas kh'ar ki ba'd az in nakh'i dar kh'olati ekh'rom az marzkh'oi ilokh'i guzashta, kh'aivonoti khushkigardro said mekunad, dar k'iiomat uro baroi khilofkori bo amri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) azobi dardovar ast.

96) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton shikori kh'aivonoti obi va kh'aivonoti zinda io murdai berun andokhtai bakh'rro ba khotiri foidai kasone az shumo, ki muk'im va musofir kh'astand, kh'alol gardonida ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo kh'aivonoti khushkigardro to vak'te ki dar kh'olati ekh'romi kh'ach' io umra k'aror dored, kh'arom sokhta ast. Va bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki dar ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui U bargardonida meshaved, bitarsed. On ruz ba shumo ch'azoi a'molatonro medikh'ad.

97) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Ka'bai Khonai Muazzamro vasilai poidorii korkh'oi mardum sokhta ast. Foidakh'oi dini ba misli namozu kh'ach' va manfiatkh'oi duniavii onkh'o ba misli ekh'sos namudani amniiat dar sarzamini Kh'aram va ch'am'ovarii kh'amai makh'sulot ba sui on makh'z az barakoti in Makoni Muk'addas kh'osil megardad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mokh'kh'oi kh'arom (Zul-k'a'da, Zul-kh'ich'ch'a, Mukh'arram va Rach'ab)-ro niz sababi poidorii korkh'oi mardum k'aror doda ast. Zero onkh'o dar in mokh'kh'o az ch'angidan va kh'uch'umi dushman emin memonand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'urbonikh'oi benishon va nishondorro, ki kh'amchun alomat gardanband dorand, rokh'i poidorii korkh'oi mardum gardonida ast. Chunki sokh'iboni in nav'i kh'aivonot az duchor shudan ba ozori digaron dar amon memonand. Zero vak'te kase onkh'oro bo chunin nav'i kh'aivonot binad, mefakh'mad, ki onkh'o mak'sadi ziiorati Ka'baro dorand. Kh'amai in ne'matkh'o ba shumo ato shuda ast, to bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar on chiro dar osmonu zamin va g'airi on kh'ast, medonad va to bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar tamomi chiz Dono ast. Akh'komi U baroi ch'albi manfiat va peshgirii zarar muk'arrar shuda ast.
98) Ei mardum! Bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba isionkoron Sakhtuk'ubat va ba tavbakoron bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

99) Mas'uliiati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) fak'at az tablig'i paig'omi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mardum iborat ast. Tavfik' dodani onkh'o baroi rasidan ba kh'idoiat vazifai u nest. In kor tankh'o dar dasti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va kh'ar on chi az kh'idoiat va zalolat oshkor va pinkh'on mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad va bar asosi on ch'azoiaton medikh'ad.

100) Ei Paiombar! Bigu: "Kh'ech' gokh' palidi bo poki barobar nest, agarchi bisior budani te'dodi palidi turo ba kh'airat andozad. Ba durusti ki bisior budani adadi palidi ma'noi fazilat doshtani onro nadorad. Pas ei khiradmandon, bo tarki palidi va anch'omi poki az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed, to ba ch'annati ch'ovidon noil shaved."

101) Ei mu'minon! On mas'alakh'oero, ki ba shumo dar korkh'oi dini kumak namekunad va ba on niioz nadored, az Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) napursed. Zero agar on masoil baroiaton oshkor sokhta shavad, az sababi mashak'k'atash shumoro norokh'at mesozad. Va agar az masoile, ki az pursidanash man' shudaed, kh'angomi furud ovardani K'ur'on bipursed, on ba shumo baion meshavad. Va ich'roi in kor bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khele oson ast. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az masoili sukutkardai K'ur'on guzashta ast. Baroi kh'amin az on napursed. Zero agar purson shaved, bo nuzuli kh'ukmi ilokh'i ba anch'omash mukallaf megarded. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Bakhshandai Burdbor buda, az rui burdbori onkh'oro zud azob namekunad.

102) Beshak, ummatoni k'abl az shumo guzashta ba paiombaroni khud chunin pursishkh'oro matrakh' kardand, sipas chun ba anch'omi on mukallaf gashtand, onro ba ch'o naovardand va ba kh'amin sabab kofir shudand.

103) Khurdani gushti buz, gusfand, shutur va gov baroi shumo kh'alol ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro mushrikon az "Bakh'ira", "Soiba", "Vasila" va "Kh'omi" makhsusi butkh'o donista, khurdanashro bar khud kh'arom kardaand, kh'arom nakarda ast. Valekin kofiron az rui durug' va tukh'mat dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) da'vo mekardand, ki guio U iste'moli in nav'i chakh'orpoionro kh'arom sokhta ast. Va aksari kofiron kh'ak'k'u botil va kh'alolu kh'aromro namefakh'mand va onro az kh'am ch'udo namekunand.
"Bakh'ira" shuturi modaero meguftand, ki gushash ba'di tavalludi adadi muaiian bo mak'sadi nishon guzoshtan burida meshud. "Soiba" shuturi modaero meguftand, ki ba'di ba sinni muaiian rasidan makhsusi butkh'o megasht. "Vasila" shuturi modaero meguftand, ki paiopai bachakh'oi moda tavallud mekard. "Kh'omi" shuturi narero meguftand, ki az on iak chand shuturi digar tavallud meshud.

104) Va chun ba in toifae, ki bo kh'arom donistani ba'ze chakh'orpoion bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' bastaand, gufta shavad "Ba sui K'ur'oni nozil kardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) biioed, to az kh'alol va kh'arom ogokh' shaved", dar ch'avob meguiand: "Ak'idakh'o va guftoru kirdorkh'oe, ki az guzashtagoni khud meros burdaem, moro basanda ast." Chi guna ba onkh'o in basanda ast, kh'ol on ki guzashtagonashon chizero namedonistand va shakhsoni rokh'gumzada budand?! Onkh'o bo in raftorashon ba shakhsone tak'lid mekunand, ki az khudi onkh'o kh'am nodontar va gumrokh'tar kh'astand. Az in ru, in gurukh'i ba guzashtagon tak'lidkor gumrokh'u ch'okh'iland.

105) Ei akh'li imon! Dar fikri islokh'i khud boshed va kheshtanro ba anch'omi korkh'oi manfiatovar vodor kuned. Vak'te shumo kh'idoiat shaved, mardume, ki da'vatatonro napaziruftand va gumrokh' shudand, kh'argiz baroiaton zarar namerasonand. Iake az nishonakh'oi kh'idoiat ioftani shumo ich'roi vazifai "amri ma'ruf va nakh'ii munkar" ast. Ruzi k'iiomat bozgashti shumo tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Pas shumoro az on chi dar dunio mekarded, ogokh' mesozad va ch'azoi onro baroiaton medikh'ad.

106) Ei mu'minon! Agar dar kh'olati safar boshed va lakh'zai margi iakei shumo bo oshkor gashtani alomate az alomatkh'oi on nazdik shavad, pas baroi vasiiati ba khonadon rasonidani molkh'oi az khud bok'imonda du nafar mardi adolatpeshai musalmon io kh'angomi paido nakardani shakhsi musalmon va noiloch'i du mardi kofirro ba kh'aisi shokh'id kh'ozir namoed. Va agar dar guvokh'ii on du mardi shokh'id shubkh'a paido shavad, pas onkh'oro ba'di iake az namozkh'o man' kuned, sipas savgand iod kunand, ki mo dar ivazi savgand khurdan ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'asdi kasbi matoi dunioro nadorem va az kh'ech' kas agarchi kheshovandamon boshad, ch'onibdori namekunem, baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guvokh'i dodanro pinkh'on namesozem. Agar chunin kardem, on gokh' az zumrai gunakh'koron boshem.

107) Pas agar ba'di k'asam dodani on du shokh'id durug' guftanashon dar bobi shakh'odat io savgandi khurdaashon oshkor gardad io khiionatkorii onkh'o ma'lum shavad, pas boiad du nafar az nazdiktarin shakhsoni maiit dar ivazi on du shokh'idi peshina guvokh'i dikh'and io k'asam iod kunand. On shokh'idon boiad ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savgand iod kunand, ki shakh'odati onkh'o baroi durug'gui va khiionati shokh'idoni k'adim ba k'abulshavi sazovortar ast va shakh'odati mo durug' nest va az kh'ad tach'ovuz nakardaem. Agar mo shokh'idii bardurug' dikh'em, pas az sitamkoron va poimolkunandagoni marzkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boshem.

108) In kh'ukmi mazkur baroi on ast, ki shokh'idon az tarsi azobi okhirat io khavfi rad shudani shakh'odatashon dar nazdi ommai mardum va bo oshkor shudani durug'guiashon sharmanda gashtan, guvokh'ii khudro dar chunin kh'olat ba tavri sakh'ekh' ich'ro kunand. Angezai tars az azobi ilokh'i va kh'aros az sharmanda shudan dar nazdi mardum onkh'oro az tag'iir dodani shakh'odat io dar on khiionat kardan man' mekunad. Va bo tarki durug' dar k'asam va khiionat dar shakh'odat az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va ba on chi farmon meshaved, bo amal gush andozed. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni az itoatash khorich'shuda tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro namedikh'ad.

109) Ei mardum! Ruzi k'iiomatro ba khotir ored, on gokh', ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amai paiombaronashro ch'am' karda, az onkh'o mepursad: "Ummatkh'oe, ki shumoro baroi kh'idoiati onkh'o firistodem, chi posukhaton dodand?" Paiombaron ch'avobi in pursishro ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'avola namuda, meguiand: "Mo dar in bora donishi zaruri nadorem. Kh'amai ma'lumot peshi Tu kh'ozir ast. Ilokh'o! Kh'amono tankh'o Tu Donandai g'aibkh'o kh'asti."

110) Va zamonero ba iod biior, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo khitob ba Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Isoi pisari Mariam! Ne'mati bar tu va bar Modarat dodai Maro iod kun. Turo biduni padar ofaridam va Mariami Modaratro az baini zanoni kh'amasrash barguzidam va az tamomi onkh'o bartar gardonidam. Inchunin digar ne'matkh'oero, ki baroiat bakhshidam, iod kun. On gokh', ki turo ba vositai Ch'ibril nerumand sokhtam, dar shirkhoragi bo mardum gap mezadi va onkh'oro ba sui dini ilokh'i faro mekhondi va dar miionasoli on chiro baroiat firistodam, ba mardum merasondi va bo onkh'o guftugu mekardi va on gokh', ki ba tu navishtan va fakh'm va Kitobi Tavroti Muso (alaikh'is salom) va Inch'ilro, ki baroiat firistodam, ta'lim dodam, asrori shariat, va kh'ikmatkh'oi onro baroiat omukhtam va on gokh', ki bo ich'ozati Man az gil shabekh'i surati paranda mesokhti, pas dar on medamidi, pas on bo ich'ozati Man ba parandai zinda tabdil meioft va bo ich'ozati Man ba kuri modarzod va shakhsi mubtaloi bemorii makhav bekh'bud mebakhshidi va solim meshud va bo darkhost kardanat az Man murdagonro zinda mesokhti. Tamomi in korkh'o bo ich'ozati Man surat megirift. Va az ch'umlai ne'matkh'oi Man baroiat on bud, ki vak'te bo mu'ch'izakh'oi oshkor nazdi Bani Isroil omadi va onkh'o ba ch'oi paziruftani oiinat k'asdi ch'onat kardand, sharri onkh'oro az tu boz doshtam. Bani Isroil dini turo bo kufr varzidan posukh dodand va guftand: "On chi Isoi pisari Maiarm ovarda ast, ch'odui oshkore besh ast.""

111) Va g'air az in digar ne'matkh'oi baroiat dodai Maro iod kun. On gokh', ki iovaronro omoda namuda, dar dilashon ilkh'om andokhtam, to ba Man va tu imon biiorand. Pas onkh'o imon ovardand va guftand: "Mo imon ovardem. Va Ilokh'o, Shokh'id bosh, ki mo mutei amrat kh'astem."

112) Va on zamonero ba khotir biior, ki iovaroni Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) guftand: "Oio Parvardigorat k'udrat dorad, ki baroi mo az osmon dastarkhon furud orad?!" Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) onkh'oro dar ch'avob ba tars az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va tarki chunin pursishkh'oi khilofi odob da'vat namud. Zero ekh'timol dosht, ki in savolkh'o baroiashon boisi ofati buzurg gardad. Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) ba onkh'o guft: "Agar akh'li imon kh'asted, dar ch'ustuch'ui rizk' tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavakkul kuned."

113) Iovaroni Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) ba vai guftand: "Mo mekhokh'em az on dastarkhoni osmoni g'izo bikhurem va k'albamon ba komil budani k'udrati ilokh'i, paiombar budani tu mutmain gardad va iak'in kh'osil namoem, ki dar on chi baroiamon ovardai, rost megui va mekhokh'em baroi oiandagone, ki in mu'ch'izakh'oro nadidaand, shokh'id boshem."

114) Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) darkhosti onkh'oro paziruft va ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui ovarda guft: "Bor Ilokh'o! Baroi mo az osmon dastarkhoni pur az g'izo nozil kun, to ba khotiri siposguzori az in ne'mat nakhustin ruzi furud omadanash baroi mo va kasone, ki ba'd az mo meoiand, ruzi id shavad va on dastarkhon az sui Tu daleli iagonagi va rost budani paiombarii man gardad. Va ba mo ruziero nasib gardon, ki dar ibodat ioriamon dikh'ad. Va Tu Bekh'tarini ruzidikh'andagoni."

115) Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) duoi Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom)-ro paziruft va guft: "Ba durusti ki Man on dastarkhonro bar shumo furud meoram. Ammo kh'ar kas az shumo ba'd az nozil shudani on kufr varzad, pas tankh'o khudro malomat kunad. Zero ba azobi on chunon sakht giriftorash mekunam, ki kasero az ch'akh'oniion chunin azob nakarda bosham. Chunki vai bo chashmash mu'ch'izai ravshanro did va kufrash az rui iakravi ast." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba va'daash vafo kard va baroi onkh'o az osmon dastarkhon nozil namud.

116) Va on zamonero ba khotir biior, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat bo khitob ba Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) meguiad: "Ei Isoi pisari Mariam! Oio tu ba mardum gufti, ki man va modaramro ba g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi khud ma'bud k'aror dikh'ed?!" Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) dar posukh Parvardigorashro ba poki iod karda meguiad: "Man Turo az doshtani sharik va aibu nuk'son ba poki mekhonam. Baroi man sazovor nest, ki ba mardum on chiro kh'ak' nadoram, biguiam. Va agar -ba farzi misol- man in sukhanro gufta bosham, pas Tu onro medoni, zero kh'ech' chiz az Tu pinkh'on nest. On chiro man dar zamiram pinkh'on mekunam, Tu medoni va man ma'lumoti makhfi nigokh'doshtai Turo namedonam. Beshak, Tu Donandai g'aibkh'o kh'asti. Kase ch'uz Tu az on ogokh' nest."

117) Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) on ruz ba Parvardigorash meguiad: "Man ba mardum fak'at chizero guftaam, ki Tu maro dastur dodai. Ba onkh'o meguftam: "Allokh'i Parvardigori man va Parvardigori khudro biparasted." Va man to vak'te ki dar bainashon budam, kh'ar on chi meguftand, nazorat mekardam. Pas chun muddati bak'oi maro dar zamin bo burdan ba osmon khotima dodi, Tu Nigakh'boni korkh'oi onkh'o budi va Tu bar kh'ama kor Shokh'id kh'asti. Chize az ma'lumotat g'oib nest. On chi man ba in mardum guftaam va on chi onkh'o ba'd az man guftaand, az Tu pushida nameboshad.

118) Ei Parvardigoram! Agar onkh'oro azob kuni, pas ch'oi shak nest, ki onkh'o bandagonat meboshand, nisbatashon kh'ar chi khokh'i, mekuni va agar ba mu'minonashon bo mag'firati gunokh'onashon ekh'son namoi, kase Turo az in kor man' karda nametavonad. Zero Tu Zoti G'olibu dar tadbiri korkh'oiat bag'oiat Kh'akim kh'asti."

119) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on ruz ba Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) meguiad: "Imruz ruzest, ki ba bandagoni dar niiat, guftor va kirdor sodik' sadok'atashon sud merasonad. Baroi bandagoni sodik' bog'kh'oest, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtoni on rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad va onkh'o dar onch'o ch'ovidon memonand. Digar duchori marg nameshavand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az sodik'on rozi gashta, kh'argiz az onkh'o khashmgin nameshavad va onkh'o niz baroi noil shudan ba ne'matkh'oi abadi az U khushnud meshavand. Rasidan ba in podosh komiobii buzurg ast. Kh'ech' komiobi bo on kh'amson nest."

120) Podshokh'ii osmonkh'o va zamin va on chi dar on du az makhluk'ot mavch'ud ast, tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Iagona U Kholik' va Tadbirkunandai korkh'o ast. Molikiiati kh'amai mavch'udot fak'at az U ast. Va U bar kh'ar chiz Tavono ast. Chize Uro notavon karda nametavonad.

1) Iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki osmonkh'o va zaminro biduni namunai k'abli ofarida va shabro torik va ruzro rushan sokhta ast, loik'i on ast, ki ba kamoli mutlak' vasf va ba nekikh'oi baland madkh' shavad. Sipas kofiron sarfi nazar az in kh'ama, ma'budonashonro bo Parvardigorashon iakson medonand va ba U sharik k'aror medikh'and.

2) Ei mardum! U Zotest, ki asli shumo Odam (alaikh'is salom)-ro az gil ofarid, sipas baroi zindagoniaton dar dunio muddati muaiian guzosht va niz baroi ba'd az marg dubora zinda gashtanaton mukh'lat muk'arrar namud, ki onro ba g'air az U kh'ech' kas namedonad. Sipas shumo kofiron oidi k'udrati U dar zinda sokhtanaton ba'di marg shubkh'a mekuned.

3) Va dar osmonkh'o va zamin Iagona U Ma'budi Barkh'ak' ast. Chize az U pinkh'on nameboshad. Kh'ar on chi az niiat va guftoru kirdoraton oshkor va kh'ar on chi pinkh'on mesozed, U kh'amai onro medonad va bar asosi on ba shumo ch'azo khokh'ad dod.

4) Va ba mushrikon kh'ech' iak kh'uch'ch'ate az kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi Parvardigorashon nameoiad, magar on ki beparvoiona az on rui metoband va tark mesozand. Iak'inan ba mushrikon kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ravshan va mu'ch'izakh'oi oshkor, ki ba iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va rostguii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dalolat mekunad, omada bud, ammo onkh'o mutobik'i tak'ozoi on amal nakardand.

5) Va agar mushrikon az dalelkh'oi vozekh' rui toftaand, pas begumon az kh'uch'ch'ati ravshantari digar niz rui gardonidaand. Chun az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o K'ur'on omad, onro durug' kh'isobidand. Pas kh'atman ba onkh'o dar k'iiomat ch'azoi on chi dar dunio az azobi ilokh'i tamaskhur mekardand, khokh'ad omad va barkh'ak' budani K'ur'onro khokh'and donist.

6) Oio kofiron az k'onuni doimamali Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'aloksozii sitamkoron ogokh'i nadorand?! Beshak Mo k'abl az in kofiron ummatkh'oi ziiodero kh'alok kardaem, ki ba on kofiron on k'adar asbobi k'udrat va bak'o dar zaminro doda budem, ki ba shumo onro nadodaem. Va bar onkh'o boronkh'oi paiopai furud ovardem, ki kh'ar gokh' kh'och'atashon pesh oiad, az on istifoda barand va az zeri manzilashon ch'uikh'oro ch'ori sokhtem. Pas onkh'oro ba sababi gunokh'ashon kh'alok gardonidem va ba'di kh'alokatashon ummatkh'oi digarro ofaridem.

7) Va ei Paiombar! Agar bar tu kitobi dar varak' navishtashudaro nozil namoem va kofiron onro bo chashmi sar binand, pas baroi iak'in kh'osil kardan bo dastonashon onro lams kunand, boz kh'am az rui iakravi va sarkashii akh'mak'ona ba on imon nameorand va meguiand: "On chi ba mo ovardai, ch'odui ravshane besh nest. Az in ru, imon nameorem."

8) Va kofiron meguiand: "Charo Khudo bo Mukh'ammad farishtaero nafiristod, ki oshkor bo mo guftugu kunad va bar paiombarii vai shokh'idi dikh'ad. Agar chunin kore surat girad, mo imon meorem." Va agar Mo baroi onkh'o ba kh'amon vasfi guftaashon farishta nozil kunem, chun imon naorand, iak'inan nobudashon mesozem, sipas ba onkh'o fursati tavba doda nameshavad.

9) Va agar Mo paiombari ba sui onkh'o firistodaamonro farishta mekardem, begumon uro ba shakli mard megardonidem, to imkoni gush kardani sukhanoni farishtai odamsurat va didani uro paido kunand. Zero onkh'o k'udrati onro nadorand, ki az farishtai dar surati asli bok'imonda istifoda barand va ba sukhanonash gush faro dikh'and. Va agar Mo on farishtaro dar shakli mard megardonidem, bar mushrikon on chiro bar kheshtan dar k'abuli risolati bashari omekhta mekunand, omekhta mekardem.[Ia'ne, on gokh' da'vo mekardand, ki in farishta ast va az olami bashar ogokh' nest].

10) Va agar onkh'o bo talabi nozil kardani farishta tu va oiinatro maskhara mekunand, ummatkh'oi pesh az tu niz paiombaroni khudro kh'amin guna maskhara kardaand. Pas on kasonero, ki paiombaronro maskhara kardand, az kh'ar su azobi tamaskhur va inkor mekardaashon ikh'ota namud.

11) Ei Firistodai Mo! Ba in toifai takzib va tamaskhurkunandai oiinat bigu: "Dar kh'ar gushaiu kanori zamin sairu gasht kuned. Sipas dar borai ok'ibati kori takzibgaroni paiombaroni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo dik'k'at biandeshed, ki on bo chi anch'om ioft. Beshak, bar onkh'o bo vuch'udi k'udrat va k'uvvati doshtaashon azobi sakht furud omad."

12) Ei Firistodai Mo! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Molikiiati osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini on du az ki ast?" Dar posukh bigu: "Kh'amai in molikiiatkh'o tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. U az rui fazlash rakh'mati bandagonro bar Khud zaruri gardonida, dar kh'ol onkh'oro ba uk'ubat giriftor namekunad. Kh'atman kh'amai shumoro ruzi k'iiomat, ki dar omadanash shakke nest, ch'am' meorad. On kasone bo zoe' sokhtani fitrati asil va khiradi solim, ki sarmoiai kh'aiot ast, bar ch'onashon ziion rasonidaand, pas onkh'o imon nameorand."

13) Molikiiati tamomi on chi dar shabu ruz k'aror dorad, tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va U Shunavoi Dono ast. Guftori bandagonro meshunavad va kirdorashonro mebinad. Ba kh'ar kas ch'azoi loik' medikh'ad.

14) Ei Firistodai Mo! Ba mushrikone, ki digar makhluk'otro ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) anboz k'aror medikh'and, bigu: "Oio az rui ak'li solim durust ast, ki man baroi khud g'airi Allokh'i Ofaridgori osmonkh'ovu zamin kasi digarro ma'budu iovar giram?! U osmonkh'o va zaminro biduni namunai sobik' ofarida ast. Va U Zotest, ki ba kh'ar kas az bandagonash khokh'ad, ruzi medikh'ad va kase ba U ruzi namedikh'ad. Az bandagon beniioz va kh'amai mavch'udot ba U niiozmand kh'astand." Ei Firistodai Mo! Bigu: "Parvardigori pokam maro dastur doda ast, to az miioni in ummat nakhustin shakhse bosham, ki dar barobari kh'ama farmudakh'oiash sari ta'zim furud ovarda, ba U taslim shavam va maro az on ki az mushrikon bosham, k'at'iian man' karda ast."
15) Ei Firistodai Mo! Bigu: "Ba durusti ki man agar bo shirk va tarki imonu korkh'oi nek az Parvardigoram nofarmoni kunam, az azobi sakhti ruzi k'iiomat metarsam."

16) Dar on ruz kh'ar kiro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az azobi Khud dur sozad, pas begumon vai ba rakh'mati ilokh'i noil va komiob gashta ast. Va dar on ruz az azobi ilokh'i nach'ot ioftan komiobii vok'ei buda, kh'ech' muvaffak'iiat ba on barobar nest.

17) Va ei inson! Agar az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiat baloe rasad, pas kase ch'uz U k'udrati dur sokhtanashro nadorad va agar baroiat az ch'onibi U neki rasad, pas begumon kase onro az tu man' karda va peshi rokh'i onro girifta nametavonad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ama kor Tavono ast. Chize Uro notavon namegardonad.

18) Va U Zoti bar bandagon G'olib va az kh'ama ch'ikh'at bar onkh'o Bartar va Sokh'ibi k'udrat ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro notavon va mag'lub namesozad. Kh'amai khaloik' taslimi U kh'astand. U ba tavri shoistai Zotash bar bandagonash Bartar ast. Va U dar ofarinish, tadbir va akh'komash Kh'akimu Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U pinkh'on nest.

19) Ei Paiombar! Ba mushrikone, ki turo durug'gui medonand, bigu: "Baroi isboti rostguii man kadom shakh'odat buzurgtar ast?!" Dar ch'avob bigu: "Shakh'odati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi isboti sadok'ati man az kh'ama shakh'odatkh'o bolotar va buzurgtar ast. U baini manu shumo Guvokh' ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro baroiaton ovardaam va shumo dar posukhi da'vati man chi ch'avob megardoned, medonad. Va Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba man in K'ur'onro paig'om firistod, to shumo va kh'ar on insu ch'innero, ki in Kalom ba vai rasida ast, az azobi ilokh'i bitarsonam. Shumo ei mushrikon, ba on bovar dored, ki g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) digar ma'budon niz loik'i parastishand." Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Man bar on chi shumo onro kh'amchun ma'bud e'tirof mekuned, guvokh'i namedikh'am, zero on kh'ama ma'budkh'oi barguzidai shumo az aslu resha botiland. Beshak, Ma'budi Iagonai Barkh'ak' va Sazovori ibodat fak'at Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast va man az kh'ar chi ba U sharik k'aror medikh'ed, bezoram."

20) K'avmi iakh'ud va nasoro, ki ba onkh'o Tavrot va Inch'ilro dodaem, oidi nubuvvati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ma'rifati komil dorand. Ma'rifati onkh'o dar in bobat ba misli shinokhtashon dar borai farzandonashon ast. Onkh'o kasone az akh'li Kitob, ki bo dokhil sokhtani kheshtan ba duzakh bar ch'onkh'oiashon ziion rasonidaand, imon nameorand.

21) Kase ba e'tibori sitamkori az shakhse, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik nisbat doda, onro meparastad io oiatkh'oi ba paiombarash firistodai Uro durug' meshumorad, zolimtar nest. Kh'amono kasone, ki bo nisbat dodani sharik ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va durug' donistani oiatkh'oi U bar kheshtan sitam kardaand, agar tavba nakunand, kh'argiz rastagor nameshavand.

22) Va ruzi okhiratro iod kun. Mo dar on ruz kh'amai mushrikonro ch'am' meorem, sipas ba onkh'o bo sarzanish meguem: "On ma'budkh'oe, ki bo durug' onkh'oro shariki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonisted, dar kuch'oiand?!"

23) Sipas onkh'o dar posukh bo ovardani uzru bakh'ona az ma'budkh'oi khud bezori ch'usta, bo durug' meguiand: "Savgand ba nomi Allokh'i Parvardigoramon, ki mo dar dunio mushrik nabudem. Balki mo az ch'umlai mu'minoni iaktoparast budem."

24) Ei Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)! Nigokh' kun, ki chitavr onkh'o bo inkor kardani shirk ovardanashon bar alaikh'i khud durug' meguiand. Va bubin, ki chitavr on ma'budkh'oi botili dar dunio boftaashon az nazdi onkh'o g'oib gashta, mushrikonro ba kh'oli khud kh'avola kardaand!

25) Va ei Paiombar! Vak'te tu K'ur'on tilovat mekuni, ba'ze az mushrikon ba tilovatat gush meandozand, ammo az on sud namebarand. Zero Mo ba sababi sarkashi va pofishoriashon bar kufru shirk k'albi onkh'oro bo pardakh'o pushonidaem, to K'ur'onro nafakh'mand va dar gushkh'oi onkh'o az shunidani on garoni guzoshtaem. Va baroi kh'amin onkh'o kh'ar oiati ravshanro binand va shunavand, ba on imon nameorand. Kh'atto vak'te dar borai kh'ak'ik'at doshtani dini Islom baroi bakh'su munozirai botil nazdat biioiand, meguiand: "On chi tu ba mo ovardai, az k'issakh'oi kitobkh'oi guzashtagon bargirifta shuda ast."

26) Va onkh'o mardumro az imon ovardan ba Paiombar boz medorand va khud niz az on dur meshavand. Na kasero meguzorand, ki az vuch'udi muboraki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) istifoda barad va na khud az on sud mebarand. Va onkh'o bekhabarand, ki bo in korashon tankh'o kheshtanro nobud mesozand.

27) Va ei Paiombar! Agar mushrikonro ruzi k'iiomat bubini, ki bar otashi duzakh peshkash shavand va bo kh'asrat guiand: "Ei kosh, bori digar ba kh'aioti dunio bargardonida shavem va digar oiatkh'oi Khudoro durug' nashumorem va az ch'umlai mu'minon boshem", dar on ruz ba sababi kh'olati badi onkh'o manzarai kh'airatovarro mushokh'ida khokh'i kard.

28) Kh'ak'ik'ati kor on tavre, ki meguiand: "Agar mo ba kh'aeti dunio az nav bargardonida shavem, beshubkh'a, imon meorem", nest, balki chun kufru shirkero, ki bo guftani "Savgand ba Allokh'i Parvardigori khud, ki dar dunio mushrik nabudem" pinkh'on mesokhtand, bo shokh'idii a'zoi badanashon oshkor meshavad va iak'inan medonand, ki rokh'i khalosi nadorand, orzui ba dunio bargashtan va kh'idoiatro mekunand. Va agar ba farzi misol, onkh'o ba zindagonii dunio bagardonida shavand, begumon dubora ba kh'amon kufru shirki az on nakh'ishudaashon barmegardand va onkh'o dar va'dai imon ovardanashon sodik' nestand, balki durug'guiand.
29) Va in mushrikon meguiand: "Zindagonii digare ch'uz kh'amin kh'aioti dunio nest va mo ba'd az marg dubora zinda nameshavem."

30) Va Paiombar! Agar tu in munkironi rastokhezro kh'angome, ki dar nazdi Parvardigorashon boz doshta shavand, bubini, az vaz'i badashon kh'olati taach'ch'ubovarero mushokh'ida mekuni. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o meguiad: "Oio in zinda shudani shumo, ki dar dunio onro durug' donista, rad mekarded, kh'ak'ik'at nadoshta ast?!"Dar ch'avob meguiand: "Savgand ba nomi Parvardigoramon, ki zindashavii ba'd az marg kh'ak' ast."Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on vak't ba in ch'amoai munkir meguiad: "Pas ba sababi on ki dar dunio kufr mevarzided, azobi Maro bichashed. Zero shumo dar dunio kh'ak'ik'at doshtani k'iiomatro inkor mekarded."

31) Kh'amono kasone, ki zinda gashtani ba'd az margro inkor karda, nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi bozpursi istodanro nomumkin medonand, ruzi k'iiomat ziioni sakht mebinand. Takzibashon to on zamonest, ki k'iiomat nogakh'on ba onkh'o biioiad, on gokh' bo nadomat meguiand: "Ei dareg' bar mo, ki dar dunio kutokh'i kardem va ba sababi ba Khudo kufr varzidan va omodagii k'iiomatro nadidan az rakh'mati ilokh'i noumed kh'astem." Onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat dar kh'ole kh'asrat mekhurand, ki gunokh'onashonro bar pushtashon mebardorand. Ogokh' boshed! On kh'ama gunokh'one, ki bar pushti khud mebardorand, bisior bad ast.

32) Va on zindagonii dunio, ki bo tamomi kh'asti ba on rag'bat dored, baroi shakhsone, ki dar on ba khotiri rizoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amal namekunand, ch'uz bozi va sargarmi chize besh nest. Va ammo okhirat baroi kasone, ki bo imonu ibodat va tarki shirku ma'siiat tak'vo kardaand, az kh'aioti in dunio bekh'tar ast. Ei mushrikon! Oio ak'li khudro ba kor namedarored, to imon ored va korkh'oi nek anch'om dikh'ed?!

33) Ei Paiombar! Albatta, Mo medonem, ki turo durug'gu guftani mushrikon g'amgin mekunad. Pas boiad bidoni, ki onkh'o turo dar botini khud durug'gu namedonand. Zero dar asl ba rostk'avli va amonatdoriat iak'in dorand. Valekin zolimon paivasta oiatkh'oi ravshani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro inkor mekunand. In mushrikon niz zolimand. Dar zokh'ir nubuvvati turo inkor menamoiand, ammo dar botin ba on bovar dorand.

34) Va mapindon, ki tankh'o tu mavridi takzibi mushrikoni k'avmat k'aror giriftai. Beshak, paiombaroni guzashta niz az sui k'avmi khesh ba durug'gui nisbat doda shuda, mavridi aziiati sakht k'aror giriftaand. Pas onkh'o ba takzib va ozori k'avmashon bo sabr dar da'vat va muboriza dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'avob guftand, to on gokh', ki ba onkh'o kumaki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omad. Va kh'ech' kas piruziero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muk'addar sokhta, takh'ak'k'uk'i onro ba paiombaronash va'da doda ast, tag'iir doda nametavonad. Va ei Paiombar! Kh'amono akhbori paiombaroni guzashta, aziiati az k'avmashon ba onkh'o rasida va nusrati ilokh'i, ki dushmanashonro kh'alok va khudashonro g'olib gardonid, baroi tu omada ast.

35) Va ei Paiombar! Agar takh'ammuli sakhtikh'oe ba misli ba durug'gui nisbat dodan va rui toftan az oiinat, ki az tarafi mushrikon ba tu merasad, dushvoriat kunad, dar in surat agar baroi k'one' kardani onkh'o k'udrati ba vositai ch'ustuch'ui rokh'i zeri zamini va io ba vasilai nardbon ba osmon rafta, kh'uch'ch'ati az kh'uch'ch'ati Mo k'avitar ovardanro doshta boshi, pas in korro bikun. Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, onkh'oro atrofi kh'idoiati ovardai tu sarch'am' mekard, ammo U bo kh'ikmate inro nakhosta ast. Pas dar in bobat az ch'umlai nodonkh'o mabosh, ki baroi imon naovardani onkh'o kh'asrat khuri va khudro az g'am ziiod kh'alok gardoni.

36) Kh'amono ba da'vati tu bo paziruftani dini ovardaat kasone posukh medikh'and, ki sukhanro meshunavand va mefakh'mand. Vale kofiron ba murdagon shabokh'at doshta, sukhanro namefakh'mand. Dili onkh'o murda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat murdagonro zinda mesozad. Sipas tankh'o ba sui U bozgardonida meshavand, to onkh'oro baroi on chi kardaand, ch'azoi sazovor dikh'ad.

37) Va mushrikon bo iakravi va bakh'onach'ui meguiand: "Charo baroi Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az sui Parvardigorash mu'ch'iza nozil nameshavad, ki rostguii uro dar da'voi paiombari isbot kunad?!" Ei Paiombar, dar ch'avobi onkh'o bigu: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'udrat dorad, ki on guna ki onkh'o khokh'and, mu'ch'iza firistad. Valekin in mushrikoni bakh'onach'ui va tolibi mu'ch'iza namedonand, ki furud ovardani mu'ch'iza bar Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bar asosi kh'ikmati ilokh'i surat megirad, na bo khokh'ishi dili onkh'o. Pas agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mu'ch'izakh'oro nozil sozad va onkh'o imon naorand, kh'amaashonro nobud mekunad."

38) Va kh'ech' ch'ondori dar zamin ch'unbanda va parandai dar osmon parvozkunanda nest, magar on ki dar ofarinish va niiozmandi ba ruzi ch'amoatkh'oe monandi shumo insonkh'o kh'astand. Mo dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz kh'ech' chizro furu naguzoshtaem va oidi tamomi chiz ma'lumot dorem. Sipas ruzi k'iiomat baroi kh'allu fasli mas'alakh'o tankh'o nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'am' ovarda meshavand va ba kh'ar kas tibk'i amalash ch'azo medikh'ad.

39) Va on kasone, ki oiatkh'oi Moro durug' medonand, ba shakhsoni noshunavo va lol shabokh'at dorand. Onkh'o ilova bar shabokh'at doshtan ba shakhsoni noshunavoi lol monandi kasoni nobino dar torikikh'o rokh' meravand va kh'ech' chizro namebinand. Pas kh'ar ki dar chunin kh'olat k'aror dorad, az kuch'o rokh'i durustro iobad?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kasro khokh'ad, gumrokh' va kh'ar kasro khokh'ad, bo k'aror dodanash dar rokh'i rost kh'idoiat mekunad.

40) Ei Paiombari Mo! Ba mushrikon bigu: "Ba man khabar dikh'ed. Agar ba shumo azobi ilokh'i io k'iiomate, ki omadani on baroiaton va'da shuda ast, biioiad, chi kor mekuned?! Agar dar da'voi khud, ki guio ma'budkh'oi shumo k'udrati ziion va sud rasonidanro dorand, sodik' boshed, oio dar on lakh'zakh'o az "khudoioni" khesh kumak mekhokh'ed, to in balovu sakhtikh'oi bar saraton omadaro bartaraf sozand?!"

41) Kh'ak'ik'at on ast, ki shumo dar on ruzkh'oi sakht baroi bartaraf kardani balovu zararkh'o g'air az Ofaridgori Iagona digar ba kase rui nameored va g'air az U kasero namekhoned. Pas, agar khokh'ad, on baloro az shumo baratarf mesozad. Chunki iagona kase, ki ba in kor k'udrat dorad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va ma'budkh'oi khudro, ki dar in dunio onkh'oro kh'amson va shariki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meshumored, dar on lakh'za faromush va tark mekuned. Zero medoned, ki onkh'o ba shumo sud va ziion rasonida nametavonand.

42) Va ei Paiombar! Kh'amono Mo pesh az bi'sati tu ba sui k'avmkh'oi guzashta paiombaroni ziiod firistodem. K'avmashon onkh'oro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand va imon naovardand. Pas onkh'oro ba sakhtikh'oi khorich' az ch'ism ba misli fak'r va sakhtikh'oi marbuti ch'ism ba misli bemori uk'ubat namudem, to dar barobari Parvardigori khesh izkh'ori notavoni karda, ba dasturotash sari ta'zim furud orand.

43) Pas charo kh'angomi ba onkh'o omadani sakhti dar barobari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) izkh'ori bandagi nakardand?! Agar chunin mekardand, ba onkh'o rakh'm menamudem. Vale onkh'o chunin nakardand, balki bar'aks dilashon sakht gardida, pand nagiriftand va Shaiton amalkh'oi kufru gunokh'i anch'om medodaashonro dar nazarashon ch'ilva dod va ba rokh'i khud idoma dodand.

44) Pas Mo vak'te onkh'oro bo duchor sokhtan ba kambag'ali va bemori pand dodan khostem va az on ibrat nagirifta, ba farmonkh'oi Mo amal nakardand, ba khotiri tadrich'an kh'alok kardanashon ba'd az fak'iri va bemori darkh'oi ruzi va tandurustiro baroi onkh'o boz kardem, to on ki mubtaloi kibru g'urur va maftuni maishati dunio shudand, ba nogokh' bo azobi Khesh ch'azoiashon dodem. Pas onkh'o az in kh'olat dar kh'airat monda, az on chi orzu doshtand, noumed gashtand.

45) Pas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tamomi k'avmi sitampesharo reshakan sokht va paiombaroni Khudro g'olib gardonid. Va sitoish khos va loik'i Allokh'i Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast, ki dushmanonashro mag'lub va dustonashro g'olib kard.

46) Ei Paiombar! Ba in mushrikon bigu: "Ba man khabar dikh'ed! Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo giriftani kh'issi shunavoi va binoi shumoro karu kur sozad va bar dilkh'oiaton mukh'r nikh'ad, ki digar kh'ech' chizro nafakh'med, chi kor mekuned?! Oio ma'budi barkh'ak'k'i digare kh'ast, ki ba shumo in ne'matkh'oro bargardonad?!" Ei Paiombar! Andesha kun, ki Mo chi guna baroi in mushrikon dalelkh'oi ziiodi gunogunro meorem, sipas onkh'o az k'abuli on dalelkh'o rui megardonand!

47) Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Ba man khabar dikh'ed! Agar azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nogakh'on io oshkor ba shumo biioiad, ba chi kh'olat giriftor meshaved?!" Beshak, k'avme bo on uk'ubat kh'alok karda meshavand, ki bo kufr varzidan va takzibi paiombaron bar ch'oni khud sitam kardaand.

48) Va Mo paiombaronro ba sui mardum tankh'o bashoratdikh'anda va bimdikh'anda mefiristem. Mu'minonro ba ch'annat bashorat medikh'and va kofironu isionkoronro az duzakh metarsonand. Pas on kasone, ki ba paiombaron imon orand va amali khudro islokh' kunand, ruzi k'iiomat bar onkh'o kh'ech' tarse nest va baroi az dast dodani lazzatkh'oi dunio g'amgin nameshavand va kh'asrat namekhurand.
49) Va on kasone, ki oiatkh'oi Moro durug' meshumorand, onkh'oro ba sababi az toati ilokh'i berun shudan azob merasad.

50) Ei Paiombar! Ba in mushrikon bigu: "Ba shumo nameguiam, ki kh'amai khazinakh'oi rizk'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar peshi man ast. Va nameguiam, ki man az g'aib ogokh' kh'astam. Ma'lumoti man dar borai g'aib ba kh'amon andozae ast, ki Parvardigor (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tarik'i paig'om maro az on ogokh' karda ast. Va nameguiam, ki man az ch'umlai farishtagonam, balki Firistodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mebosham. Tankh'o az on chize pairavi mekunam, ki baroiam paig'om meshavad. Va on chi dar nazdi man nest, da'voi doshtani onro namekunam." Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Oio shakhsi kofire, ki nuri k'albash az didani kh'ak'ik'at khomush shuda ast, bo mu'mini kh'ak'ik'atbin iakson ast?! Ei mushrikon, oio oidi alomatkh'oi k'udrati ilokh'i, ki shumoro ikh'ota karda ast, nameandeshed?!"

51) Va ei Paiombar, kasonero, ki az kh'ashr shudanashon ruzi k'iiomat ba sui Parvardigorashon metarsand, bo K'ur'on bim bidekh'. Dar on ruz kh'ech' korsoze g'air az U ba onkh'o sud namerasonad va kh'ech' shafoatkunanda k'udrati az onkh'o dur sokhtani ziionro nadorad. Onkh'oro az ruzi k'iiomat bitarson, to bo ich'roi dasturot va duri ch'ustan az kh'aromkh'o parkh'ezkori kunand. Makh'z parkh'ezkoron az irshodoti K'ur'on foida mebarand.

52) Va ei Firistodai Mo, baroi moil kardani dili sarkardakh'oi mushrikon ba sui khud musulmononi fak'irero, ki shab va ruz ba tavri doimi Parvardigorashonro tankh'o ba khotiri kasbi rizoiash mekhonand va meparastand, az mach'lisi khesh naroni. Chize az kh'isobi onkh'o bar dushi tu nest. Begumon kh'isobi onkh'o nazdi Parvardigorashon ast. Va az kh'isobi tu niz bar dushi onkh'o chize nest. Agar tu onkh'oro az mach'lisi khud bironi, beshak, az ch'umlai zolimoni poimolsozandai marzi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) megardi.

53) Va Mo inchunin ba'zei mardumro bo ba'zei digar ozmudem va sakh'mi onkh'oro az dunio gunogun muk'arrar kardem, to kofironi tavongar ba mu'minoni fak'ir guiand: "Oio Parvardigor az miioni mo bo fazlu ekh'soni Khud kh'amin gurukh'i bechorai kambag'alro kh'idoiat karda ast?! Agar imon kori nek mebud, inkh'o az mo peshdasti namegiriftand. Zero mo dar kh'ama korkh'oi nek peshk'adam kh'astem." Oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'oli bandagoni siposguzori ne'matkh'oiash ogokh'tar nest, to onkh'oro ba imon ovardan muvaffak' gardonad?! Va oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'oli bandagoni nosipos ogokh'tar nest, to az imon makh'rumashon sozad?! Ore, U az kh'oli onkh'o ogokh'tar ast.

54) Va ei Paiombar! Vak'te nazdat on nafarone oiand, ki ba oiatkh'oi az suii Mo nozilshudai shokh'idi rostk'avliat imon dorand, ba khotiri ekh'tiromashon ba salomashon ch'avob bigu va onkh'oro ba rakh'mati farokhi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muzhda bidekh'. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az rui fazlash rakh'mati bandagoni nekukorashro bar Khud lozim gardonida ast, ki kh'ar kase az shumo dar kh'olati nodoni va kamkhiradi dast ba gunokh' zanad, sipas az kardaash pushaimon gashta, tavbai sodik'ona kunad va amalashro islokh' namoiad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'onashro meomurzad. Chunki ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

55) Va chunonchi baroi tu on chiro, ki zikr shud, baion kardem, kh'amin guna kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi Khudro baion mesozem, to kh'ak' va rokh'u ravishi gunakh'koron va akh'li botil ravshan gardida, bo iakum amal va az duium parkh'ez shavad.

56) Ei Paiombar, bigu! "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) maro az ibodati ma'budkh'oe, ki ba ch'uz U meparasted, man' karda ast." Ei Paiombar, bigu! "Man dar bobi ibodati g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'avovu kh'avasi shumo pairavi namekunam. Agar dar in kor pairavi kh'avovu kh'avasi nafsi shumo shavam, on gokh' man rokh'i rostro gum karda va az kh'idoiatioftagon namebosham. Kh'olati kh'ar shakhse, ki biduni dalel az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pairavi kh'avoi nafsash megardad, gumrokh'i va makh'rum mondan az ne'mati kh'idoiat ast."

57) Ei Paiombar! Ba in mushrikon bigu: "Man az Parvardigoram kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan doram va pairavi khokh'ishoti nafsoni nestam va Shumo in kh'uch'ch'atro durug' shumorided. On azob va mu'ch'izakh'oero, ki ba tavri favri ovardani onro az man talab dored, dar ikhtiior nadoram, balki on dar dasti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'ukm va niz on chi az man talab dored, tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ak'ro meguiad va bo kh'ak' faisala mekunad. Va U Bekh'tarini faisalakunandagon ast. Kh'ak'ro az botil ch'udo mesozad."

58) Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Agar azobe, ki ba tavri favri ovardani onro talab dored, dar ikhtiiori man mebud, kh'atman onro bar saraton furud meovardam. On gokh' kori baini manu shumo ba anch'om merasid. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'olati sitamkoron Ogokh'tar ast. U medonad, ki to kai ba onkh'o mukh'lat dikh'ad va kadom vak't ba uk'ubat duchorashon gardonad."

59) Va kh'amai khazinakh'oi g'aib tankh'o dar nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, g'airi U kh'ech' kas dar borai on ma'lumot nadorad. Va kh'ar iak mavch'udi ch'ondoru bech'oni khushki va darioro medonad. Va kh'ech' barge az darakht va kh'ech' donae dar torikikh'oi zamin va kh'ech' chizi tar va khushk nameaftad, magar on dar Kitobi ravshani "Lavkh'i makh'fuz" sabt shuda ast.

60) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zotest, ki ch'onkh'oi shumoro kh'angomi khob ba tavri muvak'k'ati megirad va kh'amai korkh'oero, ki ruzona dar vak'ti fa'oliiat anch'om medikh'ed, medonad. Sipas dar ruz ba'd az sipari shudani khobi shab, ki dar on ba tavri muvak'k'ati ch'onkh'oiatonro girifta bud, shumoro barmeangezad, to ba korkh'oi zindagii khesh idoma dikh'ed. In kh'olat to on vak'te idoma meiobad, ki mukh'lati zindagonii nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton ta'iinshuda ba anch'om rasad. Ba'd az on bo dubora zinda gashtan dar ruzi rastokhez tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bozgardonida meshaved. Sipas shumoro az kirdorkh'oi dar dunio anch'om dodaaton ogokh' mesozad va bar asosi on ch'azoi sazovor medikh'ad.

61) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar bandagonash G'olib buda, kh'ama chiz dar nazdi azamatash taslim meboshad. Va U bar shumo farishtagoni nigakh'bonro mefiristad, ki to okhiri mukh'lati kh'aiotaton a'molatonro menavisand. Vak'te vafoti iakei shumo faro rasad, farishtai marg va iovaronash, ki az sui Mo firistoda meshavand, uro memironand va onkh'o dar ich'roi farmonamon kutokh'i namekunand.

62) Sipas kh'amai kasone, ki ch'onashon k'abz megardad, ba sui Allokh'i Moliki kh'ak'ik'iashon bargardonida meshavand, to ch'azoi korkh'oiashonro dikh'ad. Ogokh' boshed! Farmoni ich'roshavanda va dovarii odilona nisbat ba bandagon tankh'o az U ast. Va U Bosur'attarini kh'isobkunandagon ast. Tamomi amalkh'oi shumoro ba sur'at kh'isob mekunad.

63) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Vak'te dar torikikh'oi khushki va bakh'r bo kh'olatkh'oi mudkh'ish ru ba ru megarded, ki k'udrati onro dorad, ki shumoro az on nach'ot dikh'ad?! Dar on lakh'zakh'oi sakht bo zoriiu tavallo va oshkoru nikh'on tankh'o Uro mekhoned va megued: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moro az in kh'olati mudkh'ish solim berun sozad, baroi ne'matkh'oiash az U siposguzori mekunem va minba'd ba ch'uz U kasero nameparastem.""

64) Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, ki shumoro az on kh'olatkh'oi dakh'shatnok va digar mushkilot nach'ot medikh'ad, sipas shumo ba'd az nach'ot ioftan dar kh'olati farokhi ba U sharik k'aror medikh'ed. Oio az in raftori shumo zulmi buzurgtare vuch'ud dorad?!"

65) Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'udrati onro dorad, ki baroi azobi shumo az boloi saraton sangporakh'o, ra'du bark' va tufon firistad io az zeri k'adamaton zaminlarzaiu furu raftani zaminro orad io baini dilkh'oiaton dushmani andozad va ba gurukh'kh'o ch'udo shaved va shumoro ba ch'oni kh'am andozad." Ei Paiombar! Andesha kun, ki Mo chi guna baroi onkh'o dalelkh'oi gunogun meorem va rokh'i durustro baion mekunem, to shoiad ba kh'ak'ik'at doshtani oiini ovardai tu va botil budani rokh'i khud sarfakh'm ravand.

66) Va k'avmi tu in K'ur'onro durug' donistand, dar kh'ole ki on Kitobi kh'ak' buda, dar furud omadanash az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shubkh'ae nest. Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Man bar nazorati shumo vazifador nestam. Mas'uliiati man tankh'o az on iborat ast, ki shumoro pesh az omadani azobi sakhti k'iiomat ogokh' sokhta, bim dikh'am."
67) Kh'ar khabari K'ur'on vak'ti vuk'ui khudro dorad. Khabari ok'ibati shumo niz az kh'amin k'abil ast. Va kh'atman ruzi rastokhez inro ba khubi khokh'ed donist.

68) Va ei Paiombar, chun mushrikonro bubini, ki dar borai oiatkh'oi Mo bo tamaskhur sukhan mekunand, pas, az onkh'o to vak'ti ba sukhani digari kholi az tamaskhuri oiatkh'oi Mo mashg'ul shudanashon dur bishav. Va agar Shaiton in dasturi Moro az iodat faromush sokht va bo onkh'o nishasti, sipas onro ba iod ovardi, pas, mach'lisashonro tark kun va kh'amrokh'i in toifai tach'ovuzgari sitmakor manishin.

69) Va bar zimmai kasone, ki bo ich'ro kardani farmonkh'oi Khudo va duri ch'ustan az kh'aromkh'oiash tak'vo mekunand, az kh'isobi in zolimon chize nest. Valekin vazifai mu'minon dar barobari zolimon az on iborat ast, ki onkh'oro az anch'omi korkh'oi zisht nakh'i kunand, to shoiad az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tarsida, az amrash itoat namoiand va az nakh'iash biparkh'ezand.

70) Va ei Paiombar, in ch'amoai mushrikro, ki dini ba pairavii on amrshudaro ba bozi va bekh'udagi girifta, onro tamaskhur mekunand va zinati zindagonii dunio firebashon doda ast, rakh'o kun. Va mardumro bo K'ur'on pand bidekh', to kase bo kasbi badikh'o giriftori kh'alokat nagardad. Ruzi k'iiomat baroi kase ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dusti kumakrason io miionaravi az azobi duzakh nach'otdikh'andae nest. Va vak'te shakhsi much'rim bo kh'ar bakh'oe az uk'ubati ilokh'i k'asdi kharidani ch'oni khudro kunad, az vai pazirufta nameshavad. Onkh'o kasone kh'astand, ki ba sababi a'moli bad va ak'idakh'oi kach'i khesh ba uk'ubat taslim karda meshavand. Onkh'oro ruzi okhirat ba sababi on ki kufr mevarzand, obi nikh'oiat ch'ush va azobi dardovar ast.

71) Ei Rasuli Mo! Ba in mushrikon bigu: "Oio mekhokh'ed mo g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oero biparastem, ki k'udrati foida va zarar rasonidanro nadorand. Va ba'd az kh'idoiat namudani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moro ba sui imon az on rui gardonida, ba kase monand shavem, ki Shaitonkh'o uro az rokh'i rost berun karda, dar kh'olati sargardoni guzoshtaand va rokh'i rostro namedonad, dar kh'ole ki vai dar rokh'i rost dustone dorad, ki uro ba rokh'i khud faro khonda "Sui mo biio" meguiand, ammo u da'vati onkh'oro namepazirad?! Shumo mekhokh'ed mo ba kh'amin kh'olati gumrokh'i va makh'rumiiat az imon duchor shavem?!" Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Begumon tankh'o kh'idoiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'idoiati barkh'ak' ast. Va mo dastur shudaem, ki bo anch'omi ibodat va iaktoparasti iagona mutei Parvardigori kh'amai ch'akh'oniion boshem."

72) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moro farmon doda ast, ki: "Namozro ba tavri komil barpo dored va bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o az U bitarsed." Va U Zotest, ki kh'amai shumo ruzi k'iiomat ba sui U ch'am' ovarda meshaved va ba kh'ar kas tibk'i amalash ch'azo medikh'ad.

73) Va U Zotest, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro bo kh'ikmat ofarida ast. Ruze, ki ba kh'ar chize "Paido shav" guiad, pas on paido megardad. Ruzi k'iiomat "Barkhezed" meguiad va kh'amagi barmekhezand. Beshak, sukhani U kh'ak' va rost ast. On kh'atman vok'e' meshavad. Ruzi k'iiomat, ki Isrofil (alaikh'is salom) suri duiumro medamad, kh'ukmfarmoi tankh'o az U ast. Donandai kh'ar chizi nikh'on va oshkor ast. Va U dar ofarinish va tadbiri korkh'o Kh'akimu Bokhabar ast. Chize az U pinkh'on nest. Korkh'oi nikh'on nazdash ba monandi korkh'oi oshkor ma'lum ast.

74) Va ei Paiombar, iod kun on zamonero, ki Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba padari mushriki khud bo nomi Ozar gufta bud: "Ei Padar! Oio butkh'oro baroi khud ma'bud k'aror doda, onkh'oro ibodat mekuni va Ofaridgori Iagonaro nameparasti?! Beshubkh'a, man tu va k'avmi butparastatro ba sababi parastishi g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar gumrokh'ii oshkor va sargardoni az rokh'i kh'ak' mebinam. Iagona ma'budi barkh'ak' Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, digar ma'budkh'o kh'amagi botiland."

75) Va on guna ki ba Ibrokh'im gumrokh'ii padar va k'avmashro nishon dodem, kh'amchunin ba u mulki azimi osmonkh'o va zaminro nishon dodem, to ba in vosita bar iagonagi va sazovori ibodat budani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dalel girad va az bandagoni akh'li iak'in boshad.

76) Pas chun torikii shab uro faro girift, sitoraro dida guft: "In parvardigori man ast." Pas vak'te sitora bo tului subkh' az nazarash g'oib shud, guft: "Man g'oibshavandagonro dust namedoram. Zero ma'budi barkh'ak' kh'amesha kh'ozir buda, g'oib namegardad."

77) Va chun mokh'ro durakhshon did, guft: "Parvardigori man in ast." Pas vak'te mokh' az nazarash g'oib gasht, guft: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) maro ba sui tavkh'id va ibodati Khesh kh'idoiat nakunad, begumon az ch'umlai k'avme megardam, ki az rokh'i rost gumrokh' shudaand."

78) Va chun ruz oftobro durakhshon did, guft: "Parvardigori man kh'amin ast. Zero az sitoraiu mokh' kalontar ast."Pas vak'te oftob niz az nazarash pinkh'on shud, guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Kh'amono man az kh'amai on ma'budkh'oe, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik mesozed, bezoram."

Vak'te Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) az ma'budkh'oi botili k'avmash bezori ch'ust, guio onkh'o pursidand, ki agar chunin ast, pas tu chiro meparasti?! Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) dar ch'avobi onkh'o guft:
79) Kh'amono man dini khudro kholis baroi On Zote k'aror dodaam, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro biduni namunai guzashta ofarida ast, az shirk bezor va ba iaktoparasti moil kh'astam. Va man az ch'umlai kasone nestam, ki ba Parvardigori iagona shirk meorand.

80) K'avmi mushrikash bo vai dar bobati tavkh'id va ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'idol kardand va uro az butkh'oi khesh tarsondand. Pas Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) dar posukhi onkh'o guft: "Oio shumo bo man dar mavridi iaktoparasti va iagona donistani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ibodat ch'idol mekuned, dar kh'ole ki U ba man tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro doda ast. Va boiad bidoned, ki man az ma'budkh'oi botili shumo kh'aros nadoram. Zero onkh'o kh'ech' zarar va foidae rasonida nametavonand, magar on chiro ki Parvardigoram khokh'ad. On chiro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ad, meshavad va on chiro nakhokh'ad, nameshavad. Chunki ilmi U tamomi chizro faro girifta ast, kh'ech' chiz dar osmonkh'o va zamin az U pushida nest. Ei k'avmi man, oio az in guftakh'o pand namegired va az ishtibokh'oti tak'dirsuzi khud az kufr va shirk dast namebardored, to bo tarki in tankh'o ba Ofaridgori Iagona imon ored?!"

81) Chi guna imkon dorad, ki man az ma'budkh'oi botili shumo bitarsam va kh'ol on ki shumo baroi sharik k'aror dodani "khudoion"-i botil ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki oidi ibodati onkh'o dalel nafiristoda ast, az U nametarsed?! Pas kadom iake az in du gurukh'i iaktoparast va mushrik ba emin mondan az rasidani kh'ama guna ziion sazovortar kh'astand?! Agar gurukh'i sazovortarro medoned, az onkh'o pairavi kuned. Beshak, gurukh'i sazovortar ba emin mondan az ziion mu'minoni iaktoparastand.

82) Kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, az shariat pairavi mekunand va imoni khudro bo shirk oluda namesozand, khos kh'amin gurukh' az tarsu azobu badbakhti eminand va onkh'o rokh'ioftagonand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro doda ast.

83) Va in kh'uch'ch'ate, ki Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) bo istifoda az on mushrikonro dar munozara mag'lub kard, kh'uch'ch'ati Mo bud. Mo onro baroiash dodem va uro dar g'olib gashtan bar k'avmash komiob namudem. Mo darach'akh'oi kh'ar bandaero, ki khokh'em dar duniovu okhirat mebardorem. Ei Paiombar, Ba durusti ki Parvardigorat dar ofarinish va tadbiri korkh'o bag'oiat Kh'akimu Donandai kh'oli bandagon ast.

84) Mo ba Ibrokh'im pisarash Iskh'ok' va naberaash Ia'k'ubro ruzi sokhtem. Kh'ar iakei onkh'oro ba sui kh'ak' rakh'namoi namudem. Va k'abl az onkh'o Nukh' va az nasli Nukh' Dovud va pisarash Sulaimon va Aiub va Iusuf va Muso va barodarash Kh'orunro ba sui kh'ak' rokh'namoi kardem. Va ba kh'amin monand podoshi nek, ki ba paiombaron dodaem, ba nekukoron az g'airi paiombaron niz medikh'em.
85) Va Mo kh'amchunin Zakariio va Iakh'io va Iso va Iliosro ba suii kh'ak' rakh'namoi namudem. Kh'amagi bandagoni solekh' budand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro paiombari Khud barguzida bud.

86) Va Ismoil va Iasa' va Iunus va Lutro niz ba sui kh'ak' rakh'namoi kardem. Va kh'amai paiombaroni mazkur va saravval Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro bar kulli ch'akh'oniion bartariiat bakhshidem.

87) Va az padaronashon va farzandonashon va barodaronashon ba onkh'oe, ki khostem, tavfik'i kh'idoiat bakhshidem. Va onkh'oro barguzidem va ba paimudani rokh'i iaktoparasti va ibodat rokh'namoi namudem.

88) In tavfik'e, ki ba bandagoni neki iodshuda rasid, az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bud. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kasero az bandagonash khokh'ad, ba tavfik'i Khud noil megardonad. Va agar onkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk meovardand, a'molashon botil megasht. Zero shirk korkh'oi nekro botil mesozad.

89) In gurukh'i paiombaroni zirkgashta shakhsoneand, ki Mo ba onkh'o kitob, kh'ikmat va mak'omi nubuvvatro dodaem. Pas agar k'avmi tu ba in se chizi ba paiombaron dodaamon kofir gardand, Mo baroi paziruftan va tasdik'ash k'avmero omoda sokhtaem, ki ba on kofir nestand, balki imoni k'avi dorand. Va on gurukh'i mazkur sakh'obagoni mukh'och'ir, ansor va kasoneand, ki to ruzi k'iiomat bo neki az onkh'o pairavi mekunand.

90) In paiombaron va on padaronu farzandonu barodaronashon, ki az onkh'o iod shud, rokh'ioftagoni vok'ei kh'astand. Pas az rokh'i onkh'o pairavi namo. Va ei Paiombar, ba k'avmat bigu: "Man dar badali tablig'i K'ur'on az shumo muzd namekhokh'am. Begumon K'ur'on baroi kh'amai ch'akh'oniion az insonkh'o va ch'inkh'o pand ast. Boiad az irshodoti on dar ioftani rokh'i rost rakh'namoi ch'uiand."

91) Va k'avmi iakh'ud va mushrikon vak'te ba Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kh'ech' odami paig'ome nozil nakarda ast" guftand, ba tavri shoista ba azamati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pai naburdaand va Uro nashinokhtaand. Ei Paiombar! Dar ch'avobashon bigu: "Tavroti ovardai Musoro, ki nur va kh'idoiatgari k'avmash bud, chi kase nozil karda ast?!" Shumo iakh'udikh'o Tavrotro dar daftarkh'o ch'am' namuda, az on chizkh'oi ba khokh'ishi khud muvofik'ro oshkor va chizkh'oi ba misli baioni sifoti Paiombari okhirzamon (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro, ki ba khokh'ishaton mukholif boshad, pinkh'on mesozed. Va bo K'ur'on ba shumo mardumi arab chizkh'oe ta'lim doda shud, ki pesh az nuzulash, na shumo va na guzashtagonaton az on ogokh'i nadoshted. Ei Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Tavrotro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furud ovarda ast." Sipas onkh'oro dar nodoni va gumrokh'iashon rakh'o bisoz, ki to omadani marg bozi va tamaskhur kunand.

92) Va ei Paiombar, in K'ur'on Kitobest, ki onro Mo bar tu nozil sokhtaem, Kitobi muboraki tasdik'kunandai kh'amai Kitobkh'oi pesh az on nozilshuda va to bo on akh'li Makka va kh'ama mardumi olamro bim dikh'i. Va kasone, ki ba okhirat imon dorand, kh'atman ba K'ur'on imon meorand va tibk'i dasturotash amal mekunand va onkh'o namozkh'oi khudro bo rioiai farzu voch'ibot va sunnatkh'o dar vak'tash barpo medorand.

93) Va kist zolimtar az kase, ki bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' bofta meguiad: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kase chize nozil nakarda ast", io meguiad: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar man vaikh' firistoda ast" dar kh'ole ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar u vakh'i nafiristoda ast va az kase, ki meguiad: "Man monandi on K'ur'one, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furud ovarda ast, kitob furud khokh'am ovard"?! Kh'ech' kas az u zolimtar nest. Va ei Paiombar, chun in zolimon duchori sakaroti marg megardand va farishtagon baroi uk'ubat dastoni khudro ba suiashon daroz karda, bo sarzanish ba onkh'o meguiand: "Ch'oni khudro az badan berun kuned, to onro bigirem. Imruz shumo az sababi bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' boftan bo inkori vakh'ii osmoni, da'voi guio bar shumo furud omadani vakh'i, da'voi on ki shumo niz k'udrati chun K'ur'on nozil kardani kitobero dored va kibr varzidan az k'abuli oiatkh'oi on, bo azobi sakhte much'ozot meshaved, ki khoru rasvoiaton megardonad", agar tu kh'olati onkh'oro mushokh'ida kuni, vaz'i bisior dakh'shatnokro khokh'i did.

94) Va ruzi rastokhez ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Va kh'amono shumo imruz nazdi Mo tankh'o omadaed. Doroi va mansab nadored. Kh'amon tavre, ki bori avval shumoro poiluchi tanbarakh'nai khatnanoshuda khalk' karda budem. Va kh'amai doroii khudro bar khilofi khokh'ishi dilaton dar dunio tark namuded. Va imruz on ma'budkh'oero, ki shafoatgari khesh va dar ibodat shariki sazovori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonisted, kh'amrokh'aton namebinem. Ba durusti, imruz paivandi shumovu on ma'budkh'oi botilaton k'at' gardid va on chi vobasta ba shafoat va shariki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) budani onkh'o mepindoshted, az shumo gum shud."

95) Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Iagona Zotest, ki donaro shikofta, az on ziroatkh'oro berun meorad va kh'astakh'oro shikofta, az on darakhtonero ba misli darakhti khurmo, angur va g'aira meruionad. Az murda (obi nutfa) zinda (inson va kh'aivonot)-ro berun meorad va az zinda (odamu murg') murda (nutfa va tukhm)-ro berun meorad. Zoti anch'omdikh'andai inkh'o kh'amon Allokh'i Ofaridgori shumo ast. Pas, ei mushrikon, chi guna bo vuch'udi mushokh'idai k'udratkh'oi ilokh'i az kh'ak'ik'at ruigardon meshaved?!

96) Va U Zotest, ki rushnoii subkh'ro az torikii shab meshikofad va shabro vasilai oromishi mardum k'aror doda ast, onkh'o dar shab az kh'arakati ch'ustuch'ui ruzi orom megirand va az ranch'i ruzona istirokh'at mekunand va oftob va mokh'ro vasilai kh'isob gardonida ast. In san'ati dilrabo andozai muaiiansokhtai Zoti kh'amesha G'olibi bag'oiat Dono ast. U az kh'oli makhluk'ot va on chi ba onkh'o shoista ast, ogokh' meboshad.

97) Va U Parvardigorest, ki dar osmon baroi shumo insonkh'o sitorakh'oro ofarida ast, to dar safar vak'te dar khushkiiu bakh'r rokh'ro gum kuned, bo istifoda az on rokh'atonro iobed. Ba durusti ki Mo kh'amai in dalelkh'oi k'udrati Khudro baroi k'avme baion kardaem, ki dar borai kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ovardaamon andesha karda, az on istifoda mebarand.

98) Va U Khudoest, ki shumoro az iak kas padaraton Odam ofarid. Ofarinishi shumoro bo khalk' kardani padaraton az gil shuru' kard. Sipas shumoro az padaraton Odam ofarid va baroiaton k'arorgokh' (ba monandi bachadoni modaron io zamin) va ch'oi amonat (ba monandi kamari padaron io k'abar), ki dar on iak muddat kh'amchun amonat nigokh' doshta meshaved, padid ovard. Mo in alomatkh'oi k'udrati Khudro baroi k'avme baion kardaem, ki ba ma'noi Kalomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sarfakh'm meravand.

99) Va U Zotest, ki az osmon obi boronro furud meorad, pas bo on nav'kh'oi gunoguni rastaniro meruionem. Pas az on rastanikh'o ziroat va darakhti sabzero berun meorem, ki az on donakh'oi ba misli khushakh'o iake bar digarash paivastaro padid meorem va az shukufai darakhti khurmo khushakh'oe berun meshavad, ki ba kh'ar kas nazdik va dastras ast. Va niz bog'kh'oi angur, zaitun va anorro, ki bargoni darakhtoni on du ba kh'am monand va mevakh'oiashon fark' mekunand, berun mesozem. Ei mardum, ba mevai darakht dar avvalin lakh'zakh'oi namoion shudani on va kh'angomi pukhta rasidanash bo ibrat nigokh' kuned. Ei mardum, kh'amono dar kh'amai in ne'matkh'oi mazkur baroi k'avme, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon dorand, dalelkh'oi ravshani nishondikh'andai k'udrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Mu'minon az in dalelkh'o istifoda mebarand.

100) Va mushrikon vak'te e'tik'od kardand, ki ch'inkh'o niz k'udrati zarar va foida rasonidanro dorand, bo in e'tik'od onkh'oro dar ibodat shariki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sokhtand va kh'ol on ki ch'inkh'oro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ofarida ast. Iagona U arzandai ibodat ast. Va k'avmi iakh'udu nasoro va mushrikoni arab biduni donish baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pisaron va dukhtaronro boftand. Iakh'ud Uzair, nasoro Isoi Masekh'ro pisaroni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va mushrikoni arab farishtagonro dukhtaroni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meguftand. Ammo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi akh'li botil Uro tavsif mekunand, poku muk'addas ast.

101) Va U Ofaridgori osmonkh'ovu zamin be namunai peshina ast. Chitavr metavonad pisar doshta boshad, dar kh'ole ki kh'amsare nadorad?! Va kh'ol on ki kh'ama chizro U ofarida ast. Va U ba kh'ar chiz Dono ast. Kh'ech' chiz bar U pushida nameboshad.

102) Ei mardum, Sokh'ibi in sifatkh'o Allokh'i Parvardigori shumo ast. Shumo g'air az U ma'budi barkh'ak' nadored. U Ofaridgori kh'ama chiz ast. Pas tankh'o Uro biparasted. Zero kase ch'uz U loik'i ibodat nest. Va U bar kh'ama chiz Nigakh'bon va Korsoz ast.

103) Chashmkh'o Uro ikh'ota karda nametavonand va U Parvardigori az tamomi aibkh'o pokest, ki kh'amai chashmkh'oro ikh'ota mekunad. Va U nisbat ba solekh'on nikh'oiat Mekh'rubonu az kh'oli bandagon Bokhabar ast.

104) Ei mardum, kh'amono baroi shumo az tarafi Parvardigoraton dalelkh'oi ravshan omada ast. Pas kh'ar kas in dalelkh'oro khub dark kunad va taslim shavad, foidai kh'osil kardaash ba khudi vai barmegardad. Ammo kh'ar kas az didanash kur gashta, mak'sadashro nafakh'mad va taslim nagardad, pas zararash ba khudi vai barmegardad. Va man noziri shumo nestam, ki amalkh'oiatonro kh'isob kunam. Kh'amono man Firistodai Khudo kh'astam va tankh'o U noziri amalkh'oi shumost.

105) Va on guna ki baroi isboti k'udrati Khud dalelkh'oi gunogun ovardem, kh'amin tavr dar borai va'daiu takh'did va andarzi onkh'o oiatkh'oi gunogunro meorem, to imoni mu'minon afzun gardad va to mushrikon guiand: "On chi ovardai, paig'omi Khudo nest. Balki onro az iakh'ud va nasoro omukhtai." Va to bo ovardani oiatkh'oi gunogun kh'ak'ik'atro baroi k'avmi boimon az ummati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) baion kunem. Zero onkh'o kasone kh'astand, ki kh'ak'ik'atro mepazirand va bo on amal mekunand.

106) Ei Paiombar! Az on kh'ak'ik'ate, ki baroiat az sui Parvardigorat paig'om meshavad, pairavi namo. Zero ba ch'uz U ma'budi barkh'ak'k'e nest. Va khudro mashg'uli kofiron va sitezach'uii onkh'o magardon. Chunki kori onkh'o dar ikhtiiori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

107) Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, mushrikon ba U shirk nameovardand. Va ei Paiombar, Mo turo bar mushrikon nozir nagardondaem, ki kori onkh'oro kh'isob kuni va tu bar onkh'o korsoz kh'am nesti. Kh'amono tu tankh'o Rasuli Parvardigori va vazifaat tablig'i paig'om ba mardum ast.

108) Va ei mu'minon! Ma'budkh'oi mushrikonro dashnom nadikh'ed, zero onkh'o dar ivazi on zolimonaiu ch'okh'ilona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dashnom medikh'and. On guna ki dar nazari in mushrikon gumrokh'iashon oroish doda shuda ast, baroi kh'ar ummat korkh'oi neku badashonro zinat dodaem. Sipas ruzi k'iiomat bozgashti kh'amaashon ba sui Parvardigorashon ast. Pas onkh'oro az korkh'oi kardaashon bokhabar sokhta, ch'azoiashon medikh'ad.

109) Va mushrikon bo sangintarin savgandkh'oe, ki dar tavoni khesh doshtand, ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'asam khurdand, ki agar ba onkh'o mu'ch'izai az Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) khostaashon biioiad, kh'atman ba on imon meorand. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Ovardani mu'ch'izakh'o dar ikhtiiori man nest. Ba durusti ki on dar nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'ar vak'te khokh'ad, onro furud meorad." Va ei mu'minon! Shumo chi medoned, ki kh'atto agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mu'ch'izakh'oi khostaashonro furud orad, imon nameorand! Balki bar sarkashi va kufrashon idoma medikh'and. Zero onkh'o khostori kh'idoiat nestand.

110) Va bo ech'odi monea k'albkh'o va didagonashonro az shinokhti kh'ak' barmegardonem, on guna ki bori nakhust ba sababi sarkashi ba K'ur'on imon naovardand. Va onkh'oro dar gumrokh'i va sarkashiashon meguzorem, to sargardon bimonand va rokh'i kh'ak'ro paido nakunand.

111) Va agar Mo on chiro mushrikon dar borai ovardani mu'ch'izakh'o peshnikh'od namudand, k'abul kunem, pas bar onkh'o farishtagonro furud orem va bo chashmi sar onkh'oro binand va murdagon bo mushrikon sukhan kunand va ba onkh'o rostguii turo dar nubuvvatat khabar dikh'and va kh'amai on chiro, ki peshnikh'od mekunand, baroiashon ch'am' sozem, to oshkor dar ru ba rui on k'aror girand, bo vuch'udi in onkh'o ba dini ovardaat imon nameorand, magar on kase, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az bainashon kh'idoiatashro khosta boshad. Vale beshtari onkh'o in kh'ak'ik'atro namedonand va ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) panokh' namebarand, to ba onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ik'atro dikh'ad.

112) Va on guna ki turo bo adovati in mushrikon ozmoish kardaem, inchunin kh'ar iak paiombari guzashtaro sanch'ida, baroi kh'ar kadomi onkh'o dushmanone az insonkh'o va ch'inkh'oi sarkash k'aror dodem, ki ba'zei onkh'o ba'zei digarro vasvasa menamoiand va botilro zebo ch'ilva medikh'and, to shakhsoni zaifimonro bifireband. Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, onkh'o in korro namekardand, ammo U bo mak'sadi sanch'ish anch'omi in amalro az onkh'o khosta ast. Pas onkh'oro bo kufru botili boftaashon biguzor va ba onkh'o tavach'ch'ukh' makun.

113) Va mak'sadi digari vasvasai insonkh'o va ch'inkh'oi sarkash dar on ast, ki mekhokh'and k'albi munkironi okhirat ba vasvasaashon moil gashta, onro k'abul kunand va pisand namoiand va vasvasashudagon ba monandi vasvasakunandagon murtakibi gunokh' shavand.

114) Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon bigu: "Oio man az rokh'i durust be rokh' shavam va baini kheshtan va shumo g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kasi digarero ba kh'aisi dovar bikhokh'am, dar kh'ole ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zotest, ki K'ur'onro baroi baioni kh'ama mas'alakh'oi zaruri bar shumo nozil kardaast?!" Va iakh'udu nasoro, ki ba onkh'o Tavrotu Inch'ilro dodaem, ba khubi medonand, ki K'ur'oni shomili kh'ak'ik'atro bar tu Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nozil karda ast. Zero dar Kitobkh'oi onkh'o dalelkh'oi isboti kh'ak' budani nuzuli K'ur'on va dinat mavch'ud ast. Pas tu dar borai on chi vakh'i mefiristem, az ch'umlai shubkh'akunandagon mabosh.

115) Va K'ur'oni karim dar bobi sadok'at dar akhbor va adolat dar akh'kom ba darach'ai balandtarini khud rasida ast. Kh'ech' kas nametavonad kalimakh'oi Uro digargun sozad. Va U Shunavandai guftori bandagonu Donandai on ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nameboshad. Agar kase baroi digargun kardani kalimakh'oi U talosh kunad, sakht ch'azoiash medikh'ad.

116) Va agar tu Paiombar (ba farzi misol) az aksari mardumi rui zamin pairavi kuni, onkh'o turo az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gumrokh' mesozand. K'onuni ilokh'i bar on ch'ori ast, ki kh'amesha te'dodi andak pairavi kh'ak'ik'at kh'astand. Beshtari mardum az gumone pairavi mekunand, ki asos nadorad. Mushrikon mepindorand, ki ma'budkh'oi botil onkh'oro ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdik megardonad, dar kh'ole ki dar in da'voi khud durug' meguiand.
117) Ei Paiombar! Kh'amono Parvardigorat az kh'oli shakhsoni az rokh'i durust gumrokh'shuda va kh'idoiatioftagon Ogokh'tar ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nest.

118) Ei mardum! Agar shumo vok'ean ba kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ravshani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon dored, pas az gushti kh'aivonote, ki vak'ti zabkh' nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar on zikr shuda ast, bikhured.

119) Ei mu'minon, shumoro az khurdani gushti kh'aivonote, ki bar on nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iodshuda ast, chi man' mekunad?! Dar kh'ole ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'aromkardakh'oi Khudro bar shumo bo tafsil baion namuda ast. Az in ru, tarki kh'aromkh'o bar shumo farz ast, magar on ki zarurat va nochori shumoro ba iste'molash vodor sozad. Zero kh'olati zarurat va nochori iste'moli kh'aromro ch'oiz megardonad. Va begumon beshtari mushrikon ba sababi andeshakh'oi fasodzadai khesh biduni ilm pairavonashonro az shinokhti kh'ak' gumrokh' mekunand. Onkh'o baroi pairavonashon iste'moli gushti kh'aivoni murdorro, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro kh'arom karda ast, kh'alol va iste'moli gushtkh'oi kh'alolshudaro kh'arom megardonand. Va ei Paiombar, Parvardigorat dar borai shakhsone, ki az marzkh'oi U berun shudaand, Ogokh'tar buda, onkh'oro baroi in amali bad ch'azoi bosazo medikh'ad.

120) Va ei mardum, dar oshkoru nikh'on gunokh'ro tark kuned. Kh'amono shakhsone, ki dar kh'olati oshkor va io pinkh'oni gunokh' mekunand, kh'atman Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba ch'azoi on chi anch'om medodand, merasonad.

121) Va ei musalmonon! Gushti kh'aivonero, ki kh'angomi zabkh' bar on nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iod nashuda ast va io nomi g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iod shuda ast, makhured. Ba durusti ki iste'moli chunin gusht ma'noi berun gashtan az toati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va nofarmonii Uro dorad. Beshak, Shaitonkh'o bo andokhtani shubkh'akh'o dustoni khudro vasvasa mekunand, to oidi khurdani gushti murdor bo shumo ch'idol namoiand. Va agar vobasta ba shubkh'akh'oi shaitoni oidi durust budani iste'moli gushti murdor az onkh'o itoat kuned, pas shumovu onkh'o dar gunokh'i shirk barobar kh'asted.

122) Oio kase, ki pesh az kh'idoiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sababi kufru nodoni va gunokh' murda ba kh'isob meraft, sipas uro bo kh'idoiat kardan ba imonu donishu ibodat zinda kardem va baroiash rushnoi dodem, ki bo on dar baini mardum rokh' meravad, bo kase, ki dar torikikh'oi kufru nodoni va ma'siiat g'ark' buda, az on berun shuda nametavonad, rokh'i kh'ak'k'u botil baroiash omekhta va kh'ama pairokh'akh'o dar peshi nazarash torik shudaand, oio in du kas bo kh'am barobarand?! Kh'amon gunae, ki baroi in mushrikon shirku iste'moli murdoru bakh'si botil oroish doda shud, dar nazari kofiron niz gunokh'onashon orosta shuda ast, to dar ruzi k'iiomat baroi kardakh'oi badashon bo azobi dardnok ch'azo doda shavand.

123) Va chunonchi mushrikon dar Makkai mukarrama mardumro az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boz medoshtand, kh'amin guna Mo dar kh'ar dekh'a sarkardakh'o va buzurgoni onro padid ovardaem, to dar da'vat ba rokh'i Shaiton va muboriza bar ziddi paiombaronu pairavonashon tamomi kh'ilai khudro ba kor barand. Va dar asl zarari makrashon ba khudashon barmegardad va onkh'o az rui nodoni va pairavii kh'avoi nafs inro ekh'sos namekunand.
