124) Va chun ba rakh'baroni kuffor oiate az oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) biioiad, meguiand: "To on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chi az nubuvvat va paiombariro ba paiombaronash doda ast, ba mo nadikh'ad, kh'argiz imon nameorem." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ch'avobashon guft: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on kasero, ki baroi ich'ro kardani mas'uliiati paiombari sazovortar ast, bekh'tar medonad va onro tankh'o ba shakhsi arzandai in mak'om medikh'ad." Kh'atman ba in sarkashon dar nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sababi az k'abuli kh'ak' kibr varzidan va dasisai anch'om dodaashon zillat va azobi sakht merasad.

125) Va ba kh'ar ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro dodan khokh'ad, dilashro baroi k'abuli Islom boz mekunad va kh'ar kiro khor va az tavfik' makh'rum sokhtan khokh'ad, dilashro az k'abuli kh'ak' tang megardonad. Vorid shudani kh'ak'ik'at bar dilash monandi och'iz mondanash az raftan ba osmon nomumkin meshavad. On guna ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'albi in shakhsi gumrokh'ro tang karda va kh'ak'ik'atro pazirufta nametavonad, kh'amin tavr shakhsoni beimonro ba azob giriftor mekunad.
126) Va in oiinero, ki baroi tu Paiombar muk'arrar sokhtaem, rokh'i nikh'oiat rost ast. Iak'inan Mo oiatkh'oi Khudro baroi bandagoni bofakh'm va pandpazir baion kardaem.

127) Baroi in bandagon dar ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigorashon manzilest, ki dar on az kh'amai nokhushi solim memonand va on makon ch'annati ch'ovidon ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar badali amalkh'oi shoistaashon kh'amchun podoshi on Iovar va K'uvvatdikh'andai onkh'o ast.

128) Va ei Paiombar, on ruzero ba khotir biior, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amai insonkh'o va ch'inkh'oro ch'am' menamoiad va ba onkh'o meguiad: "Ei ch'amoati ch'inkh'o! Shumo adadi ziiodi insonkh'oro gumrokh' karda, az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boz doshted." Va insonkh'oi dustu pairavi ch'inkh'o dar ch'avobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meguiand: "Parvardigoro, kh'ar iake az mo dar dunio az rafik'i khud kh'alovat burdem. Ch'in bo itoat kardani inson az vai va inson bo rasidan ba shakh'vatkh'oi nafsash kh'alovat burd. Va imruz mo ba on mukh'late, ki baroiamon ta'iin karda budi, rasidem. Imruz k'iiomat ast." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ch'avobashon meguiad: "K'arorgokh'i shumo otashi duzakh buda, dar onch'o ch'ovidon memoned, magar ba andozai muddati barangekhta gashtanaton az k'abr to raftan ba ch'akh'annam. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amin muddatro az abadi mondani duzakhiion dar onch'o istisno karda ast." Ei Paiombar, Ba durusti ki Parvardigorat dar tak'dir va va tadbiri korkh'oi bandagon Kh'akimi Dono ast. U bandai loik'i azobi duzakhro medonad.

129) Va chigunae, ki ch'inkh'oi sarkashro bar ba'zei mardum chiradast kardaem, to onkh'oro gumrokh' kunand, kh'amin tavr bar kh'ar zolim zolimi digarero zabardast mesozem, to uro ba anch'omi badi targ'ib va az neki boz dorand, in ch'azoi on gunokh'one ast, ki anch'om medodand.

130) Va ruzi k'iiomat ba onkh'o meguem: "Ei ch'amoati insonkh'o va ch'inkh'o! Oio ba suiaton paiombaroni kh'amnav'i khudi shumo (murod paiombaroni insi) naomadand, ki oiatkh'oi nozilkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)- ro baroiaton tilovat kunand va shumoro az mulok'oti ruzi k'iiomat bitarsonand?!" Onkh'o dar ch'avob meguiand: "Ore, paiombaron omada budand. Imruz mo alaikh'i khesh guvokh'i medikh'em va ik'ror meshavem, ki paiombaronat paiomkh'oi Turo ba mo rasonidand va moro az ruzi k'iiomat bim dodand, vale mo onkh'oro durug'gui va k'iiomatro afsona kh'isobidem." Va zebu zinati nopoidori dunio onkh'oro fireb dod va bar alaikh'i kheshtan guvokh'i doda, ik'ror shudand, ki dar dunio ba Allokh'u paiombaronash kofir budand. Ammo in ik'ror gashtan va bovar kardan ba onkh'o foida nadorad. Zero onkh'o dar dunio fursatro az dast dodand.

131) Mak'sad az firistodani paiombaron ba sui insonkh'o va ch'inkh'o on ast, ki ruzi k'iiomat kase bo da'voi on ki baroiash da'vati ilokh'i narasida ast, bakh'ona pesh naorad va k'abl az firistodani paiombaron va rasidani da'vat baroi gunokh'onash giriftori azob nagardad. Zero Mo kh'ech' ummatero pesh az firistodani paiombaron uk'ubat namekunem.

132) Va kh'ar kas az insonkh'o va ch'inkh'o muvofik' ba korkh'oi kardaashon darach'akh'oi khudro dorand. Shakhsi bag'oiat badkor bo shakhsi nisbatan badkor va peshvoi rokh'i botil bo pairavi oddi barobar nest. Inchunin savobi bandagone, ki korkh'oi nek mekunand, bo kh'am iakson nameboshad. Va Parvardigorat az on chi bandagon anch'om medikh'and, g'ofil nabuda, az tamomi a'moli onkh'o ogokh'i dorad. Kh'ech' chiz az U pinkh'on nest va kh'atman onkh'oro ba ch'azoi a'molashon merasonad.

133) Va ei Paiombar, Parvardigori tu Zoti az bandagonash Beniiozi Mekh'rubon ast. Ba ibodati onkh'o kh'och'at nadorad va kufr varzidanashon niz ba U zarar namerasonad. Vale bo vuch'udi in ba onkh'o Mekh'rubon ast. Ei bandagoni nofarmon! Agar Parvardigor kh'alokati shumoro khokh'ad, bo ovardani azob reshai shumoro az zamin barmekanad va chigunae, ki shumoro az nasli k'avmi guzashta ofarid, inchunin bo khosti Khesh ba'di kh'alokati shumo bandagoni digari boimon va mute' meofarad.

134) Ei kofiron! On chi ba shumo oidi zindashavii ba'di marg, bozpursi va uk'ubati k'iiomat va'da doda shuda ast, noguzir omadanist. Va shumo bo firor az Parvardigor rakh'oi nameiobed. Zero U shumoro az muii ch'abinaton girifta va ba azobi Khud vorid mekunad.

135) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei K'avmi man! Bar rokh'i barguzidai kheshtan az kufru gumrokh'i bok'i bimoned. Ba durusti ki man bo baioni oshkor kh'uch'ch'atro bar shumo barpo gardonida, peshi rokh'i bakh'ona ch'ustanatonro giriftaam. Shumo uzre nadored. Az kufru gumrokh'iaton parvo nadoram. Balki dar rokh'i rosti barguzidaam ustuvor memonam. Pas kh'atman khokh'ed donist, ki piruzii dunio, merosi zamin va nekikh'oi manzili okhirat az ki meshavad. Beshak, mushrikon dar duniovu okhirat komiob namegardand. Balki ok'ibati onkh'o agarchi dar dunio bekh'tarin lazzatkh'oro kh'am dida boshand, ziion va nokomi ast."

136) Va mushrikon navovari karda, baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az ziroatkh'o va chorpoioni ofaridaash sakh'm ch'udo namudand. Bo pindori durug'ashon guftand, ki in sakh'mi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast va sakh'mi digarero baroi butkh'o va kh'aikalkh'oi khesh ch'udo sokhtand. Pas on sakh'mero, ki ba butkh'oi khud ikhtisos dodaand, ba masrafkh'oi muaiiangardonidai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az fak'iron va miskinon namerasad. Va on sakh'mero, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ikhtisos dodaand, ba butkh'oiashon merasad va baroi manfiati onkh'o sarf meshavad. Ogokh' boshed! In tak'simbandi va dovarii onkh'o nikh'oiat zisht ast.

137) Va on guna ki Shaiton in tak'simi zolimonaro dar nazari mushrikon ch'ilva dod, kh'amin tavr sharikoni onkh'o az shaitonkh'o baroi aksarashon az tarsi fak'r k'atli farzandonashonro zinat bakhshidand, to mushrikonro bo gunokh'i k'atli banokh'ak' kh'alok sozand va dinashonro bar onkh'o omekhta kunand, ki durustu nodurustro shinokhta natavonand. Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, in korro namekardand, vale U bo kh'ikmatash in amalro az onkh'o khosta ast. Pas tu Paiombar mushrikonro bo durug'kh'oi dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boftaashon rakh'o kun. Zero amali onkh'o ba tu ziion namerasonad. Korashonro ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'avola namo.

138) Va mushrikon meguiand: "Inkh'o chorpoion va ziroati mamnu' kh'astand. Tankh'o kase kh'ak'k'i az onkh'o khurdan dorad, ki mo bikhokh'em va az khodimoni butkh'o boshad." In kh'ukm az ak'idai botili onkh'o mansha' girifta, nisbat ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tukh'mat bud. Inchunin meguftand: "Va bar chorpoioni nav'i "bakh'ira", "soiba", "vasila" va "kh'omi" savor shudan va io bor kardan kh'arom gardonida shudaast. Va kh'angomi zabkh' bar in chorpoion nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro iod namekunand, balki boiad bo nomi butkh'o zabkh' shavand." Mushrikon in tak'simbandi va akh'komro az khud sokhta, bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' boftand. Kh'atman Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba sababi on chi az durug' meboftand, bo azobi Khud ch'azo khokh'ad dod.

139) Va onkh'o meguiand: "Ch'anini shikami chakh'orpoioni mazkur az shuturoni nav'i "bakh'ira", "soiba", "vasila" va "kh'omi" agar zinda ba dunio oiad, bar mardonamon kh'alol va bar zanonamon kh'arom ast. Ammo agar ch'anin murda ba dunio oiad, pas bar mardonu zanon ba tavri iakson va mushtarak kh'arom ast." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o dar ivazi in sukhani botilashon ch'azo medikh'ad. Beshak, U dar kh'ukm va tadbiri korkh'oi bandagon bag'oiat Kh'akimu Dono ast.

140) On kasone, ki az rui bekhiradiiu nodoni farzandoni khudro ba k'atl merasondand va iste'molu istifodai chorpoioni kh'alolro baroi khud kh'arom donista, in kh'ukmro bardurug' ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat medikh'and, kh'amono ziionkor shudaand va begumon az rokh'i rost dur gashta, kh'idoiat naioftaand.

141) Va U Zotest, ki bog'kh'oi be sok'a bar zamin pakh'ngashta va bustonkh'oi sok'dori baland va darakhti khurmo va ziroati kh'osilash dar shaklu ta'm gunogun va zaitunu anori dar barg shabekh'i iakdigar va dar mazza mukhtalifro ofarid. Ei mardum! Chun meva dikh'ad, az mevakh'oiash bikhured va ruzi daravidanash zakotashro bipardozed, va dar khurdanu kharch'i on az kh'ududi shar'i naguzared. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagonero, ki dar khurdan, kharch' kardan va g'airi on kh'ududro poimol mesozand, dust namedorad. Ofaridgori in ne'matkh'o iste'moli onro ravo gardonida ast. Mushrikon kh'ak'k'i kh'arom kardani onro nadorand.

142) Va U on Zotest, ki baroi shumo chakh'orpoioni borbar (monandi shuturoni buzurgch'ussa) va g'airi borbar (monandi shuturbacha va buzu gusfand)-ro khalk' karda ast. Ei mardum! Az on ne'matkh'oi kh'alole, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton ruzi namuda ast, iste'mol kuned va ba monandi mushrikon dar kh'alol donistani kh'aromkh'o va kh'arom donistani kh'alolkh'o az gomkh'oi Shaiton pairavi makuned. Ei mardum, beshak, Shaiton dushmani oshkori shumo ast. U mekhokh'ad shumo niz monandi vai az amri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sarpechi namoed va bandai nofarmon garded.

143) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi savori va khurdani shumo kh'asht ch'uft chakh'orpo ofarida ast. Az gusfand du ch'uft (naru moda) va az buz du ch'uft (naru moda) khalk' karda ast. Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon bigu: "Oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gusfand va buzi narro ba sababi nar budan kh'arom karda ast?!" Agar dar ch'avob "Ore" guiand, ba onkh'o bigu: "Charo shumo modai onro kh'arom meshumored?!" Io magar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gusfand va buzi modaro ba sababi moda budan kh'arom karda ast?!"Agar dar ch'avob "Ore" guiand, ba onkh'o bigu: "Charo shumo ch'insi nari onro kh'arom meshumored?!" Io Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on nav'ero, ki dar bachadoni ch'insi moda k'aror dorad, ba illati dar shikami on budan kh'arom karda ast?! Agar dar ch'avob "Ore" guiand, ba onkh'o bigu: "Charo shumo miioni ch'aninkh'oi dar bachadoni on buda fark' meguzored?! Ba'zan ch'anini nar va ba'zan modai onro kh'arom meshumored?!" Ei mushrikon, agar shumo dar da'voi khud, ki guio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro kh'arom karda ast, sodik'ed, ba man az ruii donishi sakh'ekh'e, ki bar on takia mekuned, khabar dikh'ed?!

144) Nav'kh'oi digari chakh'orpoion du ch'uft (nar va moda) az shutur va du ch'uft (nar va moda) az gov ast. Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon bigu: "Oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'insi nar io modai on va io on chiro, ki bachadonashon dar bar girifta ast, kh'arom gardonida ast?! Io magar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro ba kh'arom budani in nav'i chakh'orpoion suporish dod -on guna ki da'voi kh'arom budani onro dored- va on vak't kh'ozir buded?!" Pas kh'ech' kas zolimtar va gunakh'kortar az kase nest, ki bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' bofta, kh'arom kardani chizi kh'alolro ba U nisbat medikh'ad, to biduni ilm mardumro az rokh'i rost gumrokh' sozad. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shakhsone, ki bo boftani durug' nisbat ba U sitam mekunand, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro namedikh'ad.

145) Ei Paiombar! Bigu, ki dar on chi baroi man paig'om shuda ast, kh'ech' chizro bar khuranda az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'aromshuda nameiobam, magar gushti murdor io khuni ch'ori io gushti khuk, ki k'at'an palid ast, io gushti kh'aivone, ki monandi kh'aivoni baroi butkh'o zabkh'gashta vak'ti zabkh' nomi g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar on iod shuda boshad. Pas kh'ar kas az rui nochori va gurusnagii sakht ba khurdani inkh'o mach'bur gardad, dar kh'ole ki mak'sadash az khurdani on ch'ustuch'ui lazzat nest va az kh'addi zarurat naguzarad, pas dar in kh'olat bar vai gunokh'e nest. Ei Paiombar, kh'amono Parvardigorat baroi kase, ki ba iste'moli kh'aromkh'o mach'bur shavad, bisior Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati mazkur khurdanikh'oi baroi ummati Islom kh'aromro nombar kard, dar oiati zerin on chiro baroi iakh'udikh'o kh'arom karda ast, zikr menamoiad. Mak'sad az ovardani on baioni in nukta ast, ki mushrikon dar bobi chakh'orpoioni bar khud kh'arom sokhtaashon az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' kh'uch'ch'at nadoshtand, balki az vasvasakh'oi Shaiton pairavi mekardand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meguiad:
146) Va Mo baroi iakh'udikh'o kh'ar ch'onvarero, ki ba monandi shutur va shuturmurg' angushtoni poiash az kh'am ch'udo nest, kh'arom sokhtem va az gov va gusfand bar onkh'o ravg'anashonro kh'arom kardem, ba ch'uz on ravg'ane, ki pusht io rudakh'oiashon bardoshta ast va io on ravg'ane, ki ba misli ravg'ani dumba va pakh'lu ba ustukhon omekhta meboshad. K'avmi iakh'udro ba sababi zulmashon bo kh'arom gardonidani in nav'i kh'aivonot ch'azo dodem va Ba durusti ki Mo dar on chi khabar medikh'em, rost meguem.

147) Pas ei Paiombar, agar onkh'o turo dar on chi az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ovardai, ba durug'gui nisbat dikh'and, bo mak'sadi targ'ib va takh'didashon bigu: "Parvardigori shumo Sokh'ibi rakh'mati vase' ast. Az rakh'mati U on ast, ki ba shumo mukh'lat medikh'ad va zud ba azob giriftoraton namesozad. Va azobi U az k'avmi isionkor -chun biioiad- rad karda nameshavad."

148) Ba zudi mushrikon az khosti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va tak'diri guzoshtai U oidi durustii shirkashon kh'uch'ch'at ovarda meguiand: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, mo va padaronamon ba U shirk nameovardem va khurdani on chakh'orpoionro bar khesh kh'arom namesokhtem." Kofironi guzashta niz vak'te paiombaronro ba durug'gui nisbat medodand, ainan ba kh'amin guna kh'uch'ch'ati beasos chang zada meguftand: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, mo paiombaronro durug'gui namedonistem." Onkh'o ba takzibi kheshtan to chashidani azobamon idoma dodand. Ei Paiombar! Ba in mushrikon bigu: "Oio baroi isboti in guftai khud, ki guio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az shumo shirk ovardan va kh'arom donistani chakh'orpoioni kh'alol io kh'alol donistani chakh'orpoioni kh'aromro pisandida ast, kh'uch'ch'at dored, to onro baroi mo berun sozed?! Sodir shudani ch'inoiatkh'oi iodshuda az tarafi shumo daleli on shuda nametavonad, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro pisandida ast. Shumo dar in bobat tankh'o pairavi gumon kh'asted va Ba durusti ki gumon kh'ak'ik'atro sobit namesozad. Va begumon shumo k'avmi durug'gue besh nested."

149) Ei Firistodai Mo! Ba in mushrikon bigu: "Modom ki shumo g'air az in daleli beasosi ovardaaton digar dalele nadored, pas bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dalelkh'oi radnoshavandae dorad, ki dar barobari on kulli bakh'onakh'oi peshovarda va shubkh'akh'oi ba on chang zadaaton makh'v va botil megardad. Pas ei mushrikon! Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'amai shumo tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro dodan mekhost, beshak onro baroiaton medod."

150) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon, ki az peshi khud kh'alolro kh'arom donista, in kh'ukmro ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat medikh'and, bigu: "Shokh'idoni in da'voi khudro, ki guio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro kh'arom medoned, kh'arom karda ast, kh'ozir namoed." Pas ei Paiombar, agar onkh'o guvokh'i dikh'and, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) inkh'oro kh'arom sokhta ast, pas guvokh'iashonro tasdik' makun. Zero onkh'o durug' meguiand. Va az on kasone, ki khokh'ishoti nafsi khudro dovar k'aror medikh'and, pairavi makun. Kh'amono chun onkh'o ne'matkh'oi kh'alolro kh'arom donistand, oiatkh'oi Moro durug' shumurdand. Va az kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nadorand va onkh'o ma'budkh'oi botilro ba Parvardigorashon barobar sokhta, shirk meorand, pairavi makun. On kase, ki bo Parvardigorash chunin taomul dorad, chi guna metavon az vai pairavi namud?!

151) Ei Paiombar, ba mardum bigu: "Biioed, to bar shumo on chiro Parvardigoraton kh'arom karda ast, bikhonam. Farmuda ast, ki ba U chizero sharik nasozed va ba padaru modari khesh neki kuned va ba sababi fak'r - on guna ki mardumi davroni ch'okh'iliiat mekardand - farzandonatonro nakushed. Shumo va onkh'oro Mo rizk' medikh'em. Va ba gunokh'on on chi oshkor va on chi nikh'on ast, nazdik nashaved va kasero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kushtanashro kh'arom gardonida ast, ch'uz ba kh'ak' nakushed." K'atli inson tankh'o dar suratkh'oi muk'arrarsokhtai shariat ba misli zinoi shakhsi oilador va ba'di paziruftani Islom az on bargashtan durust ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az shumo on chiro zikr gasht, k'oteona talab karda ast, to in ki dasturkh'oi Uro bifakh'med va amal namoed.

152) Va bar shumo dastdarozi ba moli iatimro kh'arom karda ast, magar ba on rokh'e, ki dar on baroiash manfiat boshad va molash afzoish iobad. Moli iatimonro to zamoni ba balog'at rasidan va kamol ioftan kh'ifz kuned. Vak'te ba balog'at rasidand, molashonro ba onkh'o bisupored. Va kam kardan az chenak va tarozuro bar shumo kh'arom karda ast, balki dar tich'orat rioiai adolat baroiaton farz ast. Mo kh'argiz kasero khorich' az doirai tok'atash ba kore mukallaf namesozem. Az in ru, mik'dori kame, ki gokh'o dar dodu sitad ba foidaiu zarari kharidor io furushanda surat megirad, be ch'azo ast. Va chun lab ba sukhan mekushoed, pas adolatro rioia namoed, agarchi mukh'okimashavanda bo shumo khesh boshad. Guftani g'airi kh'ak'ik'atro bar shumo kh'arom gardonida ast. Dar bobi khabar io guvokh'i dodan naboiad rui khotiri dust io kheshatonro rioia sozed. Va agar bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va io bo nomi U akh'du paimon basted, shikastani on kh'arom ast, balki vafo ba on paimon bar shumo farz ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro ba akh'komi guzashta, k'oteona dastur doda ast, to pand gired va az kh'aromkh'o boz isted.

153) Va bar shumo pairavi az rokh'kh'oi zalolat kh'arom ast. On chi shumoro ba on dastur dodam, rokh'i rosti Man ast. Pas az on pairavi kuned, zero pairaviash bar shumo farz ast. Az rokh'kh'oi zalolat pairavi makuned, ki shumoro ba parokandagi va durshavi az rokh'i kh'ak' mebarad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro ba paimudani rokh'i rosti Khud k'oteona farmon doda ast, to bo ich'roi amrkh'o va duri ch'ustan az kh'aromkh'o parkh'ezkori namoed.

154) Sipas ba'd az ogokh' kunonidani shumo ba akh'komi guzashta ba ma'lumotaton merasonem, ki Mo ba Muso bo mak'sadi takmili ne'mat va dodani ch'azoi nekikh'oiash va baioni zaruriioti dini va rokh'namoi ba sui kh'ak' va izkh'ori mekh'ruboni Tavrotro dodem, to k'avmash ba mulok'oti ruzi k'iiomat bo Parvardigori khud imon biiorand va bo amalkh'oi solekh' baroi on ruz omodagi binand.

155) Va in K'ur'one, ki Mo furud ovardem, Kitobi bobarakat ast, zero on shomili naf'i dinu dunio meboshad. Pas az on chi dar in Kitob nozil shuda ast, pairavi kuned va az mukholifatash biparkh'ezed, to az sui Parvardigor mavridi rakh'mat k'aror gired.

156) To shumo mushrikoni arab nagued, ki: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'abl az mo ba iakh'ud va nasoro Tavrotu Inch'ilro nozil sokht, vale ba mo kitob nozil nakarda ast. Va Ba durusti ki mo Kitobkh'oi onkh'oro khondan nametavonem, zero zabonashonro namedonem."

157) Va to nagued: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mo niz monandi iakh'udikh'o va nasronikh'o kitob nozil mekard, albatta, ba rokh'i rost az onkh'o kh'idoiati beshtar meioftem." Kh'amono baroiaton Kitobe omada ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro ba zaboni modariaton bar Paiombarash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozil karda, kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan va rokh'namoi rokh'i kh'ak'ik'at va rakh'mati ilokh'i bar ummati islomi ast. Minba'd uzrkh'oi beasos va illatkh'oi botil pesh naored. Pas kh'ech' kas az shakhse nest, ki oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro durug' meshumorad va az on rui megardonad, zolimtar nest. Mo kh'atman kasonero, ki az oiatkh'oiamon rui toftaand, ba sababi in kirdorashon bo dokhil namudan ba otashi duzakh uk'ubati sakht mekunem.

158) Ei Paiombar! Oio takzibgaron muntaziri omadani farishtai marg va iovaronash baroi k'abzi ch'on io omadani Parvardigorat dar ruzi k'iiomat baroi k'azovat baini bandagon io omadani ba'ze az nishonakh'oi k'iiomat az ch'onibi Parvardigorat kh'astand?! Ruze, ki ba'zei nishonakh'oi Parvardigorat ba misli tului khurshed az mag'rib oiad, imon ovardani kofir io amali shoistai mu'mine, ki k'abl az in onro nakarda bud, ba onkh'o manfiat namerasonad. Ei Paiombar! Ba takzibgaroni in kh'ak'ik'at bigu: "Dar intizori iake az kh'olatkh'oi nombarshuda boshed. Mo niz intizori mekashem."

159) Ei Paiombar! Kh'amono kasone az iakh'udu nasoro, ki dini khudro bo amal kardan ba ba'zei on va tarki ba'zei digar parokanda sokhta va ba gurukh'kh'o ch'udo shudaand, tu kh'argiz az onkh'o nesti, balki az gumrokh'ii onkh'o bezori. Mas'uliiati tu tankh'o az bim dodani onkh'o iborat ast. Korkh'oiashon dar ikhtiiori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat onkh'oro az on chi dar dunio mekardand, ogokh' sokhta,ch'azoiashon medikh'ad.

160) Kh'ar ki ruzi k'iiomat iak neki orad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro baroiash dakh' barobar afzun mesozad va kh'ar ki iak badi orad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro ba k'adri on, na az on afzuntar azob mekunad. Va onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat bo kamshavii savobi nekikh'o io ziiodshavii uk'ubati badikh'oiashon zulm nameshavand.

161) Va ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikoni takzibgari kh'ak'ik'atkh'o bigu: "Kh'amono Parvardigoram maro ba rokh'i rost rokh'namoi karda ast, rokh'i dine, ki kasro ba foidakh'oi duniovu okhirat rasonida, oiini Ibrokh'imest, ki paivasta moil ba kh'ak'ik'at bud va kh'argiz az ch'umlai mushrikon nabud."

162) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Namozam va zabkh'i kh'aivon kardanam va kh'aiotam va margam tankh'o khos ba khotiri Allokh'i Parvardigori kh'ama mavch'udot ast. Kh'ech' kas ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ibodatam sakh'm nadorad.

163) U sharike nadorad va ch'uz U ma'budi barkh'ak' nest. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) maro ba in tavkh'idi kholis dastur doda ast va man az miioni in ummat nakhustin shakhsi taslimshuda kh'astam."

164) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Oio g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Parvardigori digar ch'ustuch'u kunam, dar kh'ole ki U Parvardigori tamomi chiz ast?! Moliki ma'budkh'oi shumo niz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va kh'ech' kase gunokh'ero ch'uz bar zarari kheshtan murtakib nameshavad va kh'ech' begunokh'e bori gunokh'i kasi digarro namebardorad va baroiash ch'avobgar namegardad. Sipas dar ruzi k'iiomat bozgashti kh'amaaton tankh'o ba sui Ust va dar onch'o shumoro az on mas'alakh'oi dini, ki dar dunio bo kh'am ikhtilof mekarded, bokhabar mesozad."

165) Va U On Zotest, ki shumoro dar zamin baroi obod kardani on ch'onishini guzashtagon sokht va darach'akh'oi ba'zeatonro dar ofarinish, ruzi va g'aira az ba'zei digar balandtar bardosht, to shumoro bo on chi baroiaton doda ast, ozmoish kunad. Kh'amono Parvardigorat nisbat ba isionkoron Zuduk'ubat va kh'amono U nisbat ba tavbakoron Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.
1) "Alif. Lom. Mim. Sod." Bakh's dar borai ma'no va mukh'tavoi in kh'uruf dar avvali surai "Bak'ara" guzashta ast.

2) Ei Paiombar! K'ur'on Kitobest, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro bar tu nozil karda ast, pas naboiad oidi on dar sinaat tangi va shubkh'a ch'oi girad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in Kitobro bar tu nozil sokht, to mardumro az uk'ubatash bitarsoni va kh'uch'ch'atro bar onkh'o barpo namoi va mu'minonro pand bidikh'i. Shakhsoni boimon az pandi K'ur'on manfiat mebarand.

3) Ei mardum! Az Kitobe, ki Parvardigoraton bar shumo nozil karda ast va az sunnati Paiombaraton pairavi kuned. Va ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az khostakh'oi Shaitonkh'o va peshvoioni badkore, ki onkh'oro dusti khud medoned, pairavi makuned va ba khotiri pairavi az guftakh'oi onkh'o on chiro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton nozil sokhta ast, rakh'o masozed. Dar kh'ak'ik'at shumo kam pand megired. Agar khub pand megirifted, chizero az kh'ak'ik'at bolo naguzoshta, tobei rokh'i Paiombaraton shuda, bo on amal menamuded va g'airi onro rakh'o mekarded.

4) Va chi k'adar ziiodand te'dodi akh'li on dekh'akh'oe, ki vak'te bar kufr va gumrokh'iashon idoma dodand, Mo onkh'oro bo azobi Khud nobud sokhtem. Pas azobi Mo ba onkh'o shabona io ruzona dar kh'olati g'aflatashon furud omad va khudro az on kh'imoiat karda natavonistand va ma'budkh'oiashon niz az ukh'dai in kor nabaromadand.

5) Pas chun uk'ubati Mo ba onkh'o omad, sukhanashon ch'uz in nabud, ki guftand: "Ba durusti ki mo ba sababi kufr varzidan sitamkor budem." Onkh'o bo in sukhan alaikh'i khesh guvokh'i dodand va ba gunokh'ashon ik'ror namudand.

6) Pas Mo ruzi k'iiomat kh'atman ummatkh'oero, ki ba suiashon paiombar firistoda shuda ast, mepursem, ki ba da'vati paiombaron chi ch'avob dodand va kh'atman paiombaronro niz dar borai tablig'i dasturamon ba mardum va posukhi mardum ba da'vati onkh'o mepursem.

7) Pas az rui ilmi dak'ik'i Khesh ba bandagon korkh'oero, ki dar dunio anch'om dodaand, khabar medikh'em. Kh'amono Mo az kh'amai korkh'oi onkh'o ogokh' budem, chize az ilmi Mo pinkh'on nabud va dar kh'ech' soatu lakh'za az onkh'o g'oib nabudem.

8) Va barkashidani amalkh'o dar k'iiomat bo adolat ich'ro megardad va kamtarin zulm surat namegirad. Pas on kasone, ki vak'ti barkashidani amal pallai nekikh'oiashon dar tarozu az pallai badikh'oiashon vaznintar gardad, begumon onkh'o kasoneand, ki ba ch'annati ch'ovidon noil shuda, az azobi dakh'shatnoki duzakh nach'ot iofta, rastagoroni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand.

9) Va on kasone, ki dar k'iiomat kh'angomi barkashidani amal pallai badikh'oiashon dar tarozu az pallai nekikh'oiashon sangintar shavad, pas in ch'amoa kasoneand, ki ba sababi inkori oiatkh'oi Mo bo giriftori ba kh'alokati abadi bar ch'oni kheshtan ziion rasonidaand.
10) Va ei farzandoni Odam, Ba durusti ki Mo shumoro dar zamin ch'oi dodem va asbobi maishatro baroiaton padid ovardem. Boiad shumo shukri inro ba ch'o meovarded, vale khele andak siposguzori mekuned.

11) Va ei mardum, Ba durusti ki Mo Padaraton Odam (alaikh'is salom)-ro khalk' kardem, sipas baroiash bekh'tarin suratu andomro bakhshidem, ba'd az on farishtagonro dastur dodem, to ba khotiri ikrom dar nazdash sach'da kunand. Pas tamomi farishtagon farmoni Moro ich'ro karda, ba sach'da raftand, lekin Iblis bo kibru iakravi az sach'dakunandagon nabud.

12) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo sarzanish ba Iblis guft: "Vak'te turo farmon dodam, ki nazdi Odam sach'da kun, chi turo az ich'roi on boz dosht?!" Iblis dar ch'avob guft: "Bekh'tar budani man az Odam maro naguzosht, ki nazdash sach'da kunam. Tu maro az otash va uro az gil ofaridai. Ma'lum ast, ki otash az gil sharofati beshtar dorad."

13) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Iblis guft: "Ba sababi nofarmoniat az ch'annat poion rav. Zero tu kh'ak'i dar inch'o kibr kardan nadori, chunki in manzili bandagoni pok ast. Baroi kh'amin bok'i mondani tu dar in makon durust nest. Az inch'o berun shav. Kh'amono tu agarchi khudro az Odam shariftar mepindori, vale dar kh'ak'ik'at az mavch'udoti pastu zalil kh'asti."
14) Iblis guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, ba man to ruzi rastokhez mukh'lat bidekh', to kh'ar kiro az mardum bitavonam, gumrokh' kunam."

15) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba vai guft: "Ei Iblis! Ba durusti ki tu az mukh'lat dodashudagone kh'asti, ki margashon ruzi damidani suri iakum faro merasad. On ruz kh'amai khaloik' ch'uz Ofaridgori Iagona memirand."

16) Iblis guft: "Ba sababi on ki Tu maro gumrokh' kardi va amratro oidi sach'dai nazdi Odam tark kardam, kh'atman baroi az rokh'i durust bargardondani farzandoni Odam dar rokh'i rosti Tu menishinam, to onkh'o niz monandi gumrokh' gashtani man az sach'dai padarashon az rokh'i Tu gumrokh' shavand."

17) Sipas az sui peshashon va az pushtashon va az ch'onibi rostashon va az ch'onibi chapashon bo vasvasai berag'bat sokhtanashon az okhirat, shavk'mand gardonidanashon ba dunioi nopoidor, andokhtani shubkh'a va oroish dodani shakh'vat ba nazdashon meoiam va Tu beshtarashonro ba sababi kufri ba onkh'o talk'in kardaam shukrguzor nameiobi.

18) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba vai guft: "Ei Iblis, az ch'annat dar kh'ole berun shav, ki mazammatshudaiu az rakh'matam rondashuda kh'asti. Savgand, ki kh'ar ki az bandagon turo pairavi kunad, duzakhro az kh'amai shumo pur mekunam."

19) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Odam guft: "Ei Odam! Tu bo Kh'avvoi kh'amsarat dar bikh'isht sukunat kuned. Pas dar onch'o az kh'ar ne'mati poki baroiaton dilkash tanovul namoed va az mevai in darakht makhured. Zero agar shumo ba'd az nakh'ii Man az on bikhured, az zolimoni poimolsozandai marzkh'oi ilokh'i megarded."

20) Shaiton ba khotiri on ki sharmgokh'i pushidai Odam va Kh'avvoro dar peshi chashmonashon oshkor sozad, onkh'oro ba vasvasa andokht va guft: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro az iste'moli in darakht tankh'o baroi on man' karda ast, ki dar surati az on khurdan du farishta io az bandagoni dar ch'annat ch'ovid megarded."
21) Va ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savgand iod karda guft: "Ei Odamu Kh'avvo, beshak, kh'adafam az in mashvarat khairkhokh'ii shumo ast. Man kh'adafi digare nadoram."

22) Pas Shaiton bo makru nairangash onkh'oro az mak'omashon poion ovard. Sipas chun az darakhti mamnu' khurdand, sharmgokh'ashon namoion gasht va baroi pushondani on ba chaspondani bargoni darakhti ch'annat ba badani kheshtan shuru' kardand va Parvardigorashon ba onkh'o nido karda guft: "Oio shumoro az iste'moli in darakht man' nakardam?! Oio shumoro kh'ushdor doda naguftam, ki Shaiton dushmani oshkori shumo ast?!"

23) Odam va Kh'avvo guftand: "Parvardigoro! Mo bo khurdani on darakhti mamnu' bar ch'oni khesh zulm kardem va agar Tu gunokh'oni moro naomurzi va ba kh'oli zoramon rakh'm nakuni, beguftugu, dar duniovu okhirat az ziionkoron megardem."

24) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Odamu Kh'avvo va Iblis guft: "Az ch'annat ba zamin poion shaved. Ba zudi ba'zeaton dushmani ba'zei digar megarded va shumo to vak'ti ma'lum dar zamin k'arorgokh' dored va az ne'matkh'oi on bakh'ra khokh'ed burd."

25) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Odamu Kh'avvo va naslash guft: "Shumo to muddati muaiiansokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar zamin zindagi karda, dar on memired va dar on dafn megarded va ruzi rastokhez az on berun ovarda meshaved."

26) Ei farzandoni Odam, Mo ba shumo tarzi sokhtani libosi dar kh'addi zaruratro, ki sharmgokh'atonro pinkh'on kunad va libosi zinatro, ki kheshtanro dar baini mardum bo on oroish dikh'ed, ilkh'om namudem va pushishi botinii tak'vo, ki bo ich'roi dasturkh'o va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o kasb meshavad, az liboskh'oi zokh'iri bekh'tar ast. On chi oidi libos zikr shud, az nishonakh'oi k'udrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, to ne'matkh'oi Uro ba khotir ored va az U siposguzor boshed.

27) Ei farzandoni Odam, naboiad Shaiton shumoro bo da'vat ba tarki satr io dast kashidan az tak'vo bifirebad, on guna ki k'ablan bo zinat dodani khurdan az darakhti mamnu' padaru modaratonro fireb doda, az ch'annat berunashon karda, libosashonro az tanashon kashid, to sharmgokh'ashonro ba onkh'o oshkor namoiad. Shaiton va sipokh'iionash az ch'inkh'o shumoro mebinand, ammo shumo onkh'oro namebined. Baroi kh'amin az onkh'o sakht barkh'azar boshed. Beshak, Mo Shaitonkh'oro dusti kasone sokhtaem, ki imon nadorand, ammo mu'minoni mukhlisro gumrokh' sokhta nametavonand.

28) Va chun mushrikon ba korkh'oi zisht ba misli shirk ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), bo tani barakh'na dar atrofi Khonai Ka'ba tavof kardan va g'aira dast zanand, bakh'ona ovarda meguiand: "Mo padaroni khudro dar kh'olati anch'omi in korkh'o ioftem va moro ba ich'roi inkh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) farmon doda ast." Ei Paiombar, dar ch'avobi onkh'o bigu: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagonashro ba gunokh' dastur namedikh'ad, balki bar'aks az on man' mekunad. Pas, chitavr chunin da'voi beasosro pesh meored?! Oio az rokh'i durug'u tukh'mat chizkh'oero dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) megued, ki namedoned?!"

29) Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon bigu: "Kh'amono Parvardigoram ba rioiai adolat amr karda, ba amali zisht amr nakarda ast va dastur doda ast, ki ibodatro umuman va khosatan dar masch'id kholis baroi U anch'om dikh'ed va iagona Uro parastida, toatro khosi U gardoned. On guna ki U bori avval shumoro az nesti paido kard, inchunin ba'd az marg shumoro zinda mesozad. Zero Zote, ki k'udrati bori nakhust ofaridanro dorad, dubora zinda kardan metavonad."

30) Va kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mardumro ba du gurukh' ch'udo kunonida ast. Iak gurukh'i shumoro bo farokh'am ovardani asbobi kh'idoiat va dur sokhtani moneakh'oi on rokh'namoi namuda va bar gurukh'i digar gumrokh' shudan az rokh'i kh'ak' lozim gardida ast. Zero onkh'o dar kh'ak'ik'at ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shaitonkh'oro dusti khesh girifta, taslim shudand va mepindoshtand, ki ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat ioftaand.

31) Ei farzandoni Odam, kh'angomi namoz va tavofi Ka'ba libosi tozaiu pokizaero, ki avratatonro mepushonad, bipushed va az ne'matkh'oi kh'alol on chiro mekhokh'ed, bikhuredu binushed, isrofkori nakuned va az marzi kh'alol ba sui kh'arom naguzared. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shakhsoni isrofkori az marzkh'oi kh'alolu kh'arom guzarandaro dust namedorad.

32) Ei Paiombar, dar raddi mushrikone, ki liboskh'o, khurdanikh'o va digar ne'matkh'oi kh'alolro kh'arom medonand, bigu: "Kist libosi baroi oroishi bandagonash ofaridai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va khurdanikh'o, nushidanikh'o va digar rizk'kh'oi kh'aloli pokizaro bar shumo kh'arom karda ast?!" Ei Paiombar, bigu: "In ne'matkh'o dar dunio loik'i bandagoni mu'min ast. Agarchi dar dunio g'airi mu'minon niz dar on sharik kh'astand, ammo dar okhirat khosi mu'minon meboshad va kofiron dar on sharik nameshavand. Zero dukhuli ch'annat bar kofiron kh'arom ast." Mo oiatkh'oi Khudro baroi k'avmi sokh'ibi ilmu idrok kh'amin guna bo tafsil baion mekunem. Chunki onkh'o az in baioni Mo sud mebarand.

33) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon, ki ne'matkh'oi kh'alolro kh'arom medonand, bigu: "Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'oni kabirai oshkor va nikh'on va kh'ama nav'i ma'siiat va dastdarozi ba khunu molu nomusi mardum va biduni dalel ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik sokhtani chize va az ch'okh'ilona dar mavridi nom, sifat, fe'l va dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sukhan kardanro bar shumo ba tavri k'at'i kh'arom sokhta ast."
34) Va dar dunio kh'ar nasle mukh'lati muaiiani kheshtanro dorad. Pas chun vak'ti ta'iinshudaashon oiad, iak lakh'za pesh va ak'ib nameravand.

35) Ei farzandoni Odam, vak'te ba sui shumo az baini k'avmaton paiombaroni Mo omada, bar shumo Kitobkh'oi Moro tilovat kunand, pas az onkh'o itoat va az Kitobkh'oi ovardaashon pairavi namoed. Pas kasone, ki bo ich'roi farmonkh'o va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) metarsand va korkh'oi khudro islokh' mekunand, ruzi k'iiomat bar onkh'o kh'arose nest va baroi az dast dodani lazzatkh'oi dunio makh'zun namegardand.

36) Va ammo kofirone, ki oiatkh'oi Moro durug' medonand, ba on imon nameorand va az rui kibru g'urur az amal ba Kitobkh'oi ovardai paiombaron sarpechi mekunand, onkh'o az boshandagoni kh'ameshagii duzakh kh'astand va dar onch'o abadi memonand.

37) Pas, kh'ech' kas az on shakhse, ki bo shirk ovardan bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' mebofad io dar borai U az rui nodoni sukhan mekunad va io oiatkh'oi ravshani kh'idoiatgari Uro durug' meshumorad, zolimtar nest. Ba ch'amoai mavsuf sakh'mashon az neki e badi, ki dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz baroi onkh'o kitobat shuda ast, merasad. To on ki chun farishtai marg bo iovaronash az farishtagon ba khotiri k'abzi ch'onashon oiand, bo sarzanish ba onkh'o meguiand: "On ma'budkh'oe, ki dar dunio g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ibodat mekarded, kuch'oiand?! Onkh'oro faro bikhoned, to ba shumo dasti iori dikh'and." Mushrikon dar ch'avobi farishtagon guiand: "Ma'budkh'oe, ki dar dunio ibodat mekardem, az nazdi mo rafta va g'oib gashtaand. Dar kuch'o budanashonro namedonem." Va bar alaikh'i kheshtan guvokh'i medikh'and, ki onkh'o dar kh'ak'ik'at kofir budand, vale ik'rorashon dar on ruz ba ziionashon meanch'omad va baroiashon sude namerasonad.

38) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavassuti farishtagon meguiad: "Ei mushrikon, kh'amrokh'i insonkh'o va ch'inkh'oe, ki pesh az shumo bar kufru gumrokh'i guzashtaand, ba duzakh daroed." Kh'ar gokh' ch'amoate dokhili duzakh shavad, ch'amoati digari shabekh'i khudro, ki pesh az onkh'o voridi ch'akh'annam shudaand, la'nat mekunad. To vak'te ki paiopai ba ch'akh'annam daroiand va kh'amagi onch'o ch'am' shavand, ch'amoati ba'd voridshuda, ki pairavonand, dar kh'ak'k'i ch'amoati peshvoi iakum daromada meguiand: "Parvardigoro! Kasone, ki moro az rokh'i rost gumrokh' kardand, kh'aminkh'o kh'astand. Pas uk'ubati onkh'oro baroi on ki gumrokh'iro dar nazari mo zinat dodand, duchand gardon." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar posukhi onkh'o guiad: "Kh'ar iak toifai shumo az azobi duzakh sakh'mi duchandi khudro dorad, vale shumo in kh'ak'ik'atro namedoned va onro dark namekuned."

39) Va peshvoioni kufru zalolat ba pairavonashon meguiand: "Ei mardumi dumrav, shumo az mo fazli beshtar nadored, ki azobaton sabuk karda shavad. Imruz korkh'oi kardaaton ba e'tibor girifta meshavad. Dar pairavi az rokh'i botil uzre nadored. Baroi kh'amin shumo niz ba misli mo ba sababi sodir namudani kufru ma'siiat azobi ilokh'iro bichashed."

40) Kh'amono kasone, ki oiatkh'oi ravshani Moro durug' pindoshtand va az itoat kardan ba on kibr varzidand, ruzi k'iiomat az kh'amai nav'i neki noumed kh'astand. Vak'te vafot mekunand, ba sababi gunokh'i kufr varzidan darkh'oi osmon baroi istik'boli a'mol va rukh'ashon kushoda nameshavad va kh'argiz ba ch'annat namedaroiand. Agar shutur, ki iake az buzurgch'ussatarin kh'aivonot ast az surokhii suzan, ki iake az khurdtarin chizkh'ost guzarad, on gokh' kofiron va mushrikon ba ch'annat rokh' meioband. Ammo on guna ki guzashtani shutur az surokhii suzan nomumkin ast, ba kh'amin monand dukhuli onkh'o kh'am ba ch'annat nomumkin ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shakhsonero, ki gunokh'ashon buzurg ast, kh'amin tavr ch'azo medikh'ad.

41) Dar duzakh baroi in takzibgaroni mutakabbir az zer bistari otashin va az boloiashon bolopushi otashin boshad. Mo onkh'oero, ki bo kufr varzidan va az Ofaridgori Iagona rui toftan marzkh'oro poimol mekunand, kh'amin guna ch'azo medikh'em.

42) Va shakhsone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon meorand va ba k'adri tavon korkh'oi nek mekunand -chunki Mo kh'ech' kasro az doirai tok'atash beshtar ba anch'omi kore mukallaf namesozem- onkh'o boshandagoni bikh'ishtand. Onkh'o dar bikh'isht ch'ovidon memonand.

43) Va az kamoli ne'matkh'oi ch'annat on ast, ki Mo kina va nafrati dilashonro berun mesozem va az zeri k'asrashon rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad va onkh'o ba ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i e'tirof karda meguiand: "Siposu sitoish On Parvardigorero, ki dar dunio baroiamon tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba anch'omi in amali nekro doda, moro ba in mak'om rasonid va agar tavfik'i ilokh'i iovaramon namegasht, ba anch'omi a'moli shoista rokh' nameioftem. Ba durusti ki paiombaroni Parvardigoramon bo kh'ak'ik'at va va'daiu bimi rostin ba bikh'ishtu duzakh nazdi mo omada budand." Va on ruz farishtagon nido namuda, meguiand: "In kh'amon ch'annatest, ki paiombaron ba shumo dar dunio khabar doda budand va on ba shumo ba sababi on chi az a'moli solekh' mekarded, doda shuda ast."

44) Va boshandagoni ch'annat duzakhiionro ba'di ch'oigir shudani kh'ar du gurukh' dar manzili ch'ovidonai khesh nido karda, meguiand: "Mo imruz ch'annatero, ki Parvardigoramon baroiamon va'da doda bud, ba durusti ioftem. U moro ba bikh'ishti ch'ovidon dokhil kard. Pas ei kofiron! Oio shumo niz on duzakhero, ki Parvardigoraton shumoro az on bim medod, ba durusti iofted?!" Kofiron guiand: "Ore, mo imruz on duzakhero, ki Parvardigoramon moro az on bim medod, ba durusti ioftem." Pas munodie dar miioni onkh'o nido karda, az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ish menamoiad, ki zolimonro az rakh'matash dur gardonad. Dar dunio dari rakh'mati ilokh'i baroiashon boz bud, vale onkh'o az on bargashtand.

45) Inkh'o zolimone kh'astand, ki dar dunio az rokh'i rosti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui gardonida, mardumro az on boz medoshtand va baroi rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kach'i mekhostand va onkh'o ba okhirat kufr varzida, omodagii onro namedidand.

46) Va miioni akh'li ch'annat va duzakh devori balandest, ki "A'rof" nomguzori shuda va bar on devor mardone k'aror dorand, ki nekikh'o va badikh'oiashon barobar buda, akh'li ch'annatro az rui nishonakh'o ba misli nuri chekh'ra va inchunin duzakhiionro az rui nishonakh'o ba misli siiokh'ii bashara meshinosand. Va onkh'o ba akh'li ch'annat ekh'tiromona nido karda meguiand: "Salom bar shumo". Boshandagoni a'rof kh'anuz ba bikh'isht dokhil nashudaand va bo rakh'mati ilokh'i umedi daromadanashro dorand.

47) Va chun didagoni akh'li A'rof ba sui akh'li duzakh bargardonida shavad va azobi onkh'oro mushokh'ida kunand, bo duovu iltich'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui ovarda meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo! Moro bo kasone, ki bo kufru shirk bar ch'onashon zulm kardaand, kh'amrokh' magardon."

48) Va akh'li A'rof mardoni az akh'li duzakhro, ki az rui nishonai basharai siiokh' va chashmi kabudashon meshinosand, nido karda meguiand: "Imruz molu pairavoni ziiode, ki dar dunio doshted va az on fakhr mekarded ba shumo naf' narasonid va niz bo kibr az kh'ak' sarpechi namudanaton ba shumo naf' narasonid."

49) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo sarzanish ba kofiron meguiad: "Oio shumo dar kh'ak'k'i kh'amin mu'minon savgand iod karda, megufted, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba rakh'matash noil namesozad?!" Va ba mu'minon meguiad: "Ei mu'minon, ba ch'annat dar kh'ole daroed, ki digar az oiandaaton nametarsed va bo kh'osil namudani ne'mati abadi baroi az dast dodani lazzatkh'oi dunio g'amgin nameshaved."

50) Va akh'li duzakh akh'li ch'annatro nido karda, bo iltich'o meguiand: "Ei akh'li ch'annat, az ob io taome, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo ruzi namuda ast, bar mo birezed." Akh'li ch'annat meguiand: "Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ob va taomi ch'annatro baroi kofiron kh'arom karda ast. Mo ba shumo bo on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton kh'arom karda ast, kumak namerasonem."

51) In kofiron kasoneand, ki dini ba tobeiiati on ma'mur shudai kheshtanro ba maskhara va bozi giriftaand va zindagonii dunio onkh'oro bo zinatash firebida ast. Pas Mo ruzi k'iiomat onkh'oro tark mesozem ba duzakh medarorem, on guna ki onkh'o niz dar dunio mulok'oti imruzro faromush karda, baroi on amal nakardand va omodagi nadidand va bo vuch'udi on ki kh'ak'ik'at doshtani kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi Moro medonistand, onro inkor menamudand.

52) Va Mo ba kofiron K'ur'onero ovardem, ki onro az rui donish baion kardem, dar kh'ole ki on baroi mu'minon rakh'namo ba rokh'i rost va moiai rakh'mat ast. Zero onkh'oro ba khairi duniovu okhirat kh'idoiat mekunad.

53) Kofiron tankh'o muntaziri vuk'ui azobi dardovari va'da dodai K'ur'on meboshand, ki ok'ibatashon dar okhirat ba on meanch'omad. Ruze, ki ba kofiron azob va ba mu'minon savobi va'da dodai ilokh'i oiad, on ruz kasone, ki dar dunio bo K'ur'on amal nakardand, meguiand: "Kh'amono paiombaroni Parvardigori mo dar dunio kh'ak'ik'atro ovardand va on az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omada bud. Ei kosh, imruz miionaravkh'oe medoshtem, ki nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi nach'oti mo az azob shafoat mekardand va io ei kosh, bori digar ba dunio barmegashtem, to dar ivazi korkh'oi badi kardaamon amalkh'oi nek mekardem va az in azob nach'ot meioftem." Begumon in kofiron ba sababi kufr varzidan ba Parvardigor khudro ba vartai kh'alokat andokhta, ba ch'oni kheshtan ziion rasonidand va ma'budkh'oi boftaashon az nazdashon g'oib gashta, ba onkh'o kh'ech' sude nabakhshidand.

54) Beshak, Parvardigori shumo mardum On Khudoe ast, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro be namunai guzashta dar shash ruz ofarid, sipas on guna ki shoistai Zotash buda, kunkh'i on az fakh'mu darki bashar khorich' ast, boloi arsh baromad. Zulmati shabro bo rushnoii ruz va rushnoii ruzro bo zulmati shab mepushonad, kh'ar iake iakdigarro bo sur'at talabida, az on ba ta'khir nameaftad. Chun shab ravad, ruz va chun ruz ravad, shab meoiad. Va oftob va mokh' va sitoragonro romshudai amri Khud ofarid. Ogokh' boshed! Ofarinish va farmon tankh'o az oni Khudo ast. Oio g'airi U ofaridgore kh'ast?! Khudoi Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion Boazamat va Doroi ekh'soni ziiod ast. U Sokh'ibi sifatkh'oi ifodagari azamat va kamol ast.

55) Ei mu'minon, az Parvardigoraton kh'och'ati khudro bo zoriiu tavozu' ba tavri oshkoru nikh'on va kholisonaiu dur az shirk bipursed. Zero beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagonero, ki dar duo az marzi U meguzarand, dust namedorad. Az buzurgtarin namunai guzashtani marzkh'oi duo on ast, ki shakhs monandi mushrikon g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro duo kunad.

56) Va dar zamin ba'd az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sababi firistodani paiombaron va ibodatash onro obod va islokh' karda ast, bo dast zadan ba gunokh' fasodkori makuned. Va kh'och'ati khudro az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ekh'sosi tars az uk'ubat va umedvori ba rakh'matash bipursed. Ba durusti ki rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba nekukoron bag'oiat nazdik ast. Shumo niz kushish kuned, ki az ch'umlai nekukoron boshed.

57) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) On Zotest, ki bodkh'oro baroi muzhda dodani rekhtani boron mefiristad, to vak'te ki bodkh'o abrkh'oi az bardoshtani ob sanginro bardorad, Mo on abrkh'oro ba sarzamini beob meronem, pas onch'o ob furud meorem, sipas ba sababi on ob tamomi nav'i mevakh'oro berun mesozem. Mo ba monandi mevakh'o murdagonro niz az k'abr zinda berun meorem, to shumo san'ati dilraboi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va tavonoiashro oidi zinda kardani murdagon ba iod ovarda, pand bigired.

58) Va rastanii zamini pokiza ba surati komil va zebo bo ich'ozai Parvardigorash meruiad. Mu'min niz monandi kh'amin ast. Nasikh'atro gush mekunad, istifoda mebarad va az on kori nek kh'osil megardad. Va zamini shurai bekh'osil rastaniash tankh'o bo dushvori meruiad va dar on kh'ech' khaire dida nameshavad. Sifati kofir kh'amin guna ast. Az nasikh'at manfiat namebarad va az on amali nek kh'osil nameshavad, ki mavridi foida k'aror girad. Mo dalelkh'oiamonro kh'amin tavr bo mak'sadi isboti kh'ak' ba suratkh'oi gunogun baroi k'avme baion mekunem, ki az ne'matkh'oi Mo sipoguzor buda, kufr namevarzand va itoat mekunand.

59) Kh'amono Mo Nukh'ro ba sui k'avmash paiombar firistodem, to onkh'oro ba iaktoparasti va tarki ibodati g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) da'vat kunad. Pas Nukh' ba k'avmash guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ibodat kuned. Shumo g'air az U digar ma'budi barkh'ak' nadored. Man baroi shumo -dar kh'olati idoma dodani kufr- az giriftori ba uk'ubati ruzi buzurg metarsam."
60) Peshvoioni k'avmash guftand: "Ei Nukh'! Beshak, Mo turo az rokh'i durust dar durii oshkor mebinem."

61) Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) dar ch'avobi k'avmash guft: "Man -on guna ki shumo mepindored- gumrokh' nestam, balki dar rokh'i rost kh'astam. Kh'amono man az sui Parvardigori khesh va Parvardigori tamomi ch'akh'oniion ba sifati paiombar firistoda shudaam.

62) Baroi shumo paig'omkh'oi Parvardigoramro merasonam va bo targ'ib ba ich'roi farmonash va bim dodan az man'kardakh'oiash nisbat ba shumo khair mekhokh'am. Zero dar surati ich'roi farmon va parkh'ez az nakh'ii ilokh'i ba podoshash noil gashta, az azobash emin memoned. Va man bo rokh'i vakh'i az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizkh'oero medonam, ki shumo onro namedoned."

63) Oio kh'airati shumoro kh'amin barangekhta ast, ki ba shumo az sui Parvardigoraton ba vositai zaboni mardi baroiaton oshno paig'om va pand omada ast?! On mard omad, to shumoro az azobi ilokh'i bitarsonad va to bo ich'roi amr va parkh'ez az nakh'i az uk'ubati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) biparkh'ezed va shoiad mavridi rakh'matash k'aror gired?! Ba durusti ki u dar miioni shumo ba voia rasida, durug'guiu gumrokh' va az nav'i g'airi bashar nest.

64) Pas k'avmash uro takzib namuda, imon naovardand va ba kufri khesh poiband mondand. Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) duo kard, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro kh'alok gardonad. Pas Mo uro va mu'minoni dar kishti kh'amrokh'ashro az g'ark' shudan dar tufon solim nigokh' doshtem va on kasonero, ki oiatkh'oi Moro durug' donista, in ak'idai khudro idoma dodand, dar tufon g'ark' sokhta, kh'alok gardonidem. Zero iak'inan onkh'o k'avmi az didani kh'ak'ik'at nobino budand.

65) Va ba sui k'avmi Od az miioni onkh'o paiombarero bo nomi Kh'ud (alaikh'is salom) firistodem. Kh'ud (alaikh'is salom) ba k'avmash guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro biparasted. Shumo g'air az U digar ma'budi barkh'ak' nadored. Pas oio bo ich'ro kardani amr va duri az nakh'i az uk'ubati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ez namekuned?!"

66) Peshvoioni kofiri k'avmash guftand: "Ei Kh'ud! Beshubkh'a, mo medonem, ki vak'te moro ba ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) da'vat karda, az butparasti man' mekuni, in kori tu az rui bekhiradi ast va mo e'tik'odi k'at'i dorem, ki tu dar da'voi on ki guio firistodai Parvardigor kh'asti, az ch'umlai durug'guion meboshi."
67) Kh'ud (alaikh'is salom) dar raddi in sukhan ba onkh'o guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Man bekhirad nestam, balki begumon az sui Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion firistoda shudaam."

68) Man ba shumo tavkh'id va shar'ero merasonam, ki Parvardigor tablig'ashro ba man farmuda ast va dar on chi ba shumo tablig' mekunam, khairkhokh'u amonatdor kh'astam. Kh'ech' chizro az on kamu ziiod namekunam.

69) Oio kh'airati shumoro kh'amin barangekhta ast, ki ba shumo az sui Parvardigoraton ba vositai zaboni mardi baroiaton oshno paig'om va pand omada ast, to shumoro az azobi ilokh'i bim dikh'ad?! Marde, ki az nav'i farishtagon va ch'inkh'o nest. Magar kh'amin sababi kh'airati shumo gashta ast?! Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro kh'amdu sipos gued, ki dar zamin baroiaton k'udrat dod va shumoro ch'onishini k'avmi ba sababi kufr kh'alokgashtai Nukh' gardonid va Uro kh'amdu sipos gued, ki shumoro bo ch'ismi buzurg va nerumandi ikhtisos dod. Pas ne'matkh'oi gusturdai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bar khud iod kuned, to bo noilshavi ba bikh'isht va nach'ot az duzakh rastagor garded.

70) K'avmash ba vai guftand: "Ei Kh'ud! Oio tu nazdamon baroi on omadai, ki mo tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ibodat kunem va ma'budkh'oi parastidai padaronamonro tark kunem?! Pas agar tu dar va'da va da'voi khud oidi omadani azob sodik' boshi, onro ba mo biior."

71) Pas Kh'ud dar posukhi onkh'o guft: "Beshubkh'a, shumo omadani azob va g'azabi Parvardigoratonro bar khud kh'atmi sokhted. Aknun on noguzir vok'e' meshavad. Oio bo man dar borai butkh'oe, ki onkh'oro khud va padaronaton ma'bud nomidaed va ma'budiiatashon kh'ak'ik'at nadorad, munozara mekuned?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kh'ak' budani ibodati onkh'o, kh'ech' kh'uch'ch'ate furud naovarda ast. Pas muntaziri omadani azobe boshed, ki khud omadani onro talab karded. Beshak, man niz bo shumo muntazir meshavam. Uk'ubat kh'atman meoiad."

72) Pas Mo bo rakh'mati Khesh Kh'ud va mu'minonero, ki kh'amrokh'ash budand, az azob emin nigokh' doshtem va kasonero, ki oiatkh'oi Moro durug' medonistand, az bekh reshakan kardem. Va onkh'o mu'min nabudand. Baroi kh'amin sazovori azob gashtand.

73) Va Mo begumon ba sui k'avmi Samud Solekh'i barodarashonro paiombar firistodem, ki onkh'oro ba iaktoparasti va ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) da'vat kunad. Solekh' ba onkh'o guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro biparasted. Zero shumo g'air az U digar ma'budi loik'i ibodat nadored. Kh'amono ba shumo az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mu'ch'izai ravshan, ki durustii dinamro isbot mekunad, omada ast. In modashuturi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, baroi shumo az kharsang chun mu'ch'iza berun meoiad. Modashutur vak'ti muaiiani obnushii khud va shumo vak'ti muaiiani obnushii khudro dored. Pas uro ba kh'olash guzored, to dar zamini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) g'izo bikhurad. G'izo dodanash vazifai shumo nest. Va uro ozor nadikh'ed, zero dar surati ozor dodan shumoro azobi dardovar megirad.-

74) Va ne'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba khotir ored, on gokh', ki ba'd az k'avmi Od shumoro ch'onishini onkh'o gardonid va shumoro dar sarzaminaton sukunat dod, to dar on bakh'ra bared va ba khostakh'oi khesh birased. Shumo dar narmikh'oi zamin k'asrkh'o buniod mekuned va kukh'kh'oro pora mesozed, to dar on baroi khud khonakh'o bisozed. Pas, ne'matkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro iod kuned, to shukri Uro ba ch'o ored va dar zamin taloshi fasodkoriro tark kuned. Tarki taloshi fasod dar zamin bo tarki kufru ma'siiat ast."

75) Peshvoioni mutakabbiri k'avmi Solekh' ba mu'minoni bechorai takh'ti sitamashon buda, ki notavonashon mekh'isobidand, guftand: "Ei akh'li imon! Oio shumo medoned, ki Solekh' az sui Parvardigorash firistoda shuda ast?!" Mu'minoni zeri shikanch'ai kofiron k'aror doshta guftand: "Kh'amono mo on dinero, ki Solekh' baroi tablig'i on firistoda shudaast, tasdik' mekunem, onro e'tirof dorem, mutei on kh'astem va ba shariati ovardaash amal menamoem."
76) Mutakabbironi k'avmash guftand: "Ei mu'minon! Beshak, mo ba on chi shumo imon ovarded, kofir kh'astem. Kh'argiz ba on imon nameorem va ba shariati ovardai Solekh' amal namekunem."

77) Pas onkh'o modashuturero, ki Solekh' az ozorash man'ashon karda bud, kushtand va bo in raftorashon az ich'roi amri Parvardigorashon sarkashi kardand va bo tamaskhur va nomumkin donistani vok'e'shavii takh'didkh'oi Solekh' guftand: "Ei Solekh', agar vok'ean az paiombaroni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boshi, pas, on azobero, ki ba mo va'da dodai, biior."

78) Pas ba k'avmi Solekh' (alaikh'is salom) azobe, ki zudtar omadanashro khostand, omad. Zilzilai shadid onkh'oro faro girifta, bo rui va zonuiashon bar zamin chaspida murdand. Kh'ech' kasi onkh'o az kh'alokat nach'ot naioft.

79) Pas Solekh' (alaikh'is salom) ba'di navmedi az imon ovardani k'avmash az onkh'o rui gardonid va guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Kh'aroiina, man on chiro, ki Parvardigoram rasonidanashro talab namud, ba shumo rasonidam va shumoro bo targ'ib ba imonu amali solekh' va bim dodan az kufru ma'siiat nasikh'at kardam, valekin shumo mardumi nasikh'atgari nisbataton khairkhokh'ro dust namedored"

80) Va Lutro ba khotir biior, on gokh', ki amali zishti k'avmashro inkor namuda guft: "Oio shumo ba amali zishti bo sirishti solim nomunosibi bachabozi dast mezaned?! Shumo in kori fakh'shro az nazdi khud boftaed. Kh'ech' kas az ch'akh'oniion pesh az shumo chunin kori fakh'shro nakarda ast."

81) Kh'amono shumo bo mak'sadi shakh'vat zanonro, ki baroi k'azoi on ofarida shudaand, guzoshta, bo mardon bachabozi mekuned, balki shumo kasone meboshed, ki bo berun shudan az kh'addi e'tidol va talaboti ak'lu sirishti solim az marzi kh'alol ba kh'arom guzashtaed.

82) Va posukhi k'avmi Lut dar ivazi inkori Paiombarashon in kori fakh'shi onkh'oro ch'uz in nabud, ki bo rui toftan az k'abuli kh'ak' guftand: "Lut va pairavonashro az dekh'ai khud berun kuned. Zero onkh'o mardume kh'astand, ki az in amali mo parkh'ez mekunand va poki mech'uiand. Az in ru, dar bainamon bok'i mondanashon loik' nest."

83) Pas Mo uro kh'amrokh'i khonadon va pairavonash az azobamon emin nigokh' doshtem. Ba onkh'o dastur dodem, to shabona az dekh'ae, ki bar on azobi sakht meoiad, berun shavand, ba istisnoi kh'amsari Lut, ki dar dekh'a bo bok'imondagon istod va duchori azob gardid.

84) Va bar onkh'o borone sakht boridem. Az sui bolo bar sarashon sangkh'oe az gil afkanda, dekh'aashonro vozhgun sokhtem. Pas ei Paiombar, bo dik'k'at andesha kun, ki ok'ibati kori k'avmi gunakh'kori Lut bo chi anch'omid. Beshak, ok'ibati kori onkh'o kh'alokat va rasvoii abadi gardid.

85) Va kh'amono Mo ba sui k'abilai Madian Shuaibi barodarashonro paiombar firistodem. Vai ba k'avmash guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ibodat kuned. Zero shumo g'air az U digar ma'budi sazovori parastish nadored. Ba shumo az sui Parvardigoraton baroi isboti rost budani dini ovardaam, kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan omada ast. Bo purra kardani paimona va tarozu kh'ak'k'i mardumro komil ado kuned va bo aibdor barovardani mato'kh'o, berag'bat kardani digaron az kharidanash va io fireb dodani sokh'iboni kolo arzishi ashioi onkh'oro kam makuned va dar zamin, ki pesh az omadani shumo az barakati bi'sat va da'vati paiombaron islokh' gashta ast, bo kufr va gunokh' fasodkori makuned. On chi zikr gasht, baroiaton bekh'tar va foidai ziiodtar dorad, agar imon doshta boshed. Zero dar tavsiiakh'oi mazkur ba tarki ma'siiat va anch'omi ibodat targ'ib meshavad va in rokh'i nazdik shudan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

86) Va dar kh'ar sari rokh' baroi tarsondani mardumi rokh'guzar va bo in vosita rabudani moli onkh'o va peshgiri kardani rokh'i shakhsoni kh'idoiatch'u manishined, dar kh'ole ki kach'ii rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro mekhokh'ed, to mardum ba in rokh' naravand. Va ne'mati baroiaton dodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro iod kuned, to az U siposguzor boshed. On gokh', ki te'dodi shumo kam bud, pas U shumoro ziiod kard va dar borai ok'ibati fasodkoroni guzashta biandeshed, ki saranch'omi onkh'o bo chi anch'omid. Ok'ibat kh'alok va nobud shudand.

87) Va agar iak gurukh'i shumo ba dini az sui Parvardigoram bo on firistodai man imon dorand va iak gurukh'aton imon nadorand, pas ei takzibgaron, muntazir boshed, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baini mo va shumo bo nach'ot dodani kh'ak' va kh'alok sokhtani nokh'ak' faisala kunad va U bekh'tarini faisalakunandagon va odiltarini dovaron ast."

88) Peshvoion va sarkardagoni mutakabbiri k'avmi Shuaib ba vai guftand: "Ei Shuaib, begumon mo tu va mu'minoni kh'amrokh'atro az in dekh'ai khud berun mekunem io ba dini mo barmegarded." Shuaib bo taach'ch'ub guft: "Oio mo agarchi dini shumoro nakhokh'em, az on pairavi kunem?! Zero mo medonem, ki rokh'i shumo zalolat ast.

89) Agar mo ba dini shumo ba'd az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moro az on emin nigokh' doshta ast, e'tik'od kunem va shirk varzem, iak'inan dar in surat bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' boftaem. Va baroi mo durust va loik' nest, ki ba oiini botili shumo bargardem, magar on ki Allokh'i Parvardigoram onro bikhokh'ad. Zero kh'ama mavch'udot tobei khosti U ast. Parvardigori mo tamomi chizro bo ilmash ikh'ota karda, kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nest. Mo tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia dorem, to moro dar rokh'i kh'ak' ustuvor dorad va az rokh'kh'oi rasonanda ba duzakh kh'ifz namoiad. Ei Parvardigori mo, miioni mo va k'avmi kofiramon bo adolat dovari kun, sitamdidai sokh'ibkh'ak'ro bar zolimi sarkash piruz gardon va Tu bekh'tarin dovaron kh'asti."

90) Sarkardagon va peshvoioni kofiri k'avmi Shuaib, ki da'vati uro napazirufta, mardumro az pairaviash kh'ushdor medodand, guftand: "Ei mardum, agar ba dini Shuaib vorid shaved va dini kheshtan va padaronatonro tark kuned, begumon bo in amal ziiondida kh'asted."
91) Pas onkh'oro zilzilai shadid faro girifta, dar manzilkh'oi khud ba zonu va chekh'raashon aftoda kh'alok shudand.

92) Kh'amai kasone, ki Shuaibro durug'gui donistand, kh'alok gashta, chunon shudand, ki guio k'ablan dar manzilkh'oiashon zindagi nakarda va az on bakh'ra naburda boshand. Kasone, ki Shuaibro durug'gui donistand, ziionkori kh'ak'ik'i budand. Zero onkh'o bar ch'oni kheshtan va doroiashon khasorat rasonidand. Mu'minoni k'avmi Shuaib on guna ki kofiron da'vo doshtand, ziionkor nabudand.

93) Va chun k'avmi Shuaib kh'alok shudand, Paiombarashon az onkh'o rui gardonid va guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Kh'amono man ba shumo on chiro, ki Parvardigoram dastur dod, rasondam va shumoro nasikh'at kardam, vale nasikh'atamro napazirufted va az man itoat nakarded. Pas chi guna baroi k'avme, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shuda, dar in rokh' bok'i mondand, g'amgin gardam?!"

94) Va beshak, Mo dar kh'ar dekh'a paiombarero, ki firistodem va k'avmash bo takzibash kofir shudand, onkh'oro ba badbakhti, tangdasti va bemori giriftor sokhtem, to nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zoriiu iltich'o kunand va kufru kibru g'ururi khudro tark sozand. In sukhani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kofironi K'uraish va g'aira kh'ushdor buda, iake az k'onunkh'oi ilokh'iro nisbat ba takzibgaron nishon medikh'ad.

95) Sipas kh'olati onkh'oro ba'd az badbakhti va kambag'ali ba neki, farokhi va amnu osoish tabdil dodem to on ki te'dod va amvolashon afzoish ioft va guftand: "On khair va sharre, ki ba mo rasid, odati doimi va derina ast. Pesh az mo guzashtagonamon niz duchori on gashta budand." Onkh'o dark nakardand, ki kh'adaf az giriftori sakhti namudanashon pand giriftan va kh'adaf az ne'mat dodanashon tadrich'an kh'alok kardan bud. Pas onkh'oro bo azobi Khud nogakh'on giriftem va kh'ol on ki onkh'o vuk'ui azobro ekh'sos namekardand va intizor nadoshtand.

96) Va agar akh'li in dekh'akh'oe, ki ba sui onkh'o firistodagoni Kheshro ravon kardem, dini ovardai paiombaronashonro tasdik' mekardand va bo tarki kufru ma'siiat va ich'roi dasturoti Mo tak'vo menamudand, beshak, az kh'ar taraf darkh'oi khairu barakatro bar ruiashon mekushodem, ammo onkh'o imon naovardand va tak'vo nakardand, balki oiini ovardai paiombaronashonro durug' kh'isobidand, ba'd az on Mo onkh'oro ba sababi murtakib shudani gunokh'oni ziiod ba tavri nogakh'oni uk'ubat namudem.
97) Pas oio sokinoni takzibgari in dekh'akh'o kheshro az on ki azobi Mo shabona ba onkh'o oiad, dar kh'ole ki g'ark'i khobu rokh'at boshand, emin mekh'isoband?!
98) Io in ki onkh'o khudro az ruzona omadani azobi Mo, dar kh'ole ki g'ofil va mashg'uli boziiu sargarmi dunio boshand, emin mekh'isoband?!

99) Ba mukh'lat va neruiu ne'mati farokhi baroiashon in'om kardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki ba mak'sadi tadrich'an kh'alok sokhtanashon doda shuda ast, nigokh' kuned. Oio sokinoni takzibgari in dekh'akh'o kheshtanro az tadbiri pushidai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar amon mekh'isoband?! Az tadbiri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'uz k'avmi kh'alokshuda kase khudro dar amon namekh'isobad. Ammo bandagoni botavfik', az tadbiri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'aros buda, bo in'omkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mag'rur nameshavand, balki onro makh'z az lutfu ekh'soni ilokh'i medonand va shukrashro ba ch'o meorand.

100) Oio baroi kasone, ki ba'di ba sababi gunokh' kh'alok shudani ummatkh'oi guzashta dar zamin ch'onishinashon shudaand, ma'lum nashuda ast, ki agar Mo bikhokh'em, ba sababi gunokh'onashon uk'ubatashon mekunem va in iake az k'onunkh'oi doimii Mo ast va bar dilashon mukh'r mezanem, pas kh'ech' mav'izaero bo taammul nameshunavand va ibrat namegirand?! Magar az azobi bar peshiniion omada ibrat nagiriftaand, ki ainan kori onkh'oro takror dorand?!

101) Ei Paiombar! Mo akhbori dekh'akh'oi guzashtaro az k'abili akh'li dekh'ai Nukh', Kh'ud, Solekh', Lut va Shuaib bar tu tilovat va khabar mekunem, ki chitavr oiatkh'oi Moro takzib karda, sarkashi namuda, duchori kh'alokat gashtand, to in akhbor baroi shakhsoni pandpazir va nasikh'atshunav ibrat boshad. Va Ba durusti ki paiombaroni sokinoni in dekh'akh'o nazdi k'avmashon bo dalelkh'oi vozekh'i isbotkunandai sidk'ashon omadand. Pas, onkh'o kh'angomi omadani paiombaron ba sababi on chi dar ilmi azalii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guzashta bud, ki dini paiombaronro durug' medonand, imon naovardand. Chigunae, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar dili sokinoni takzibkunandai in dekh'akh'o mukh'r nikh'od, kh'amin tavr bar k'albi shakhsoni ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kofir shuda niz mukh'r menikh'ad va minba'd kh'idoiat nameioband.

102) Va Mo az sui aksari ummatkh'oe, ki baroi kh'idoiatashon paiombar firistoda shud, vafodori va poibandi ba akh'du paimon va itoat az dasturotamonro paido nakardem va beshak, beshtari onkh'oro az toati Khud khorich'shuda ioftem.

103) Sipas ba'd az in gurukh'i paiombaron Musoro bo kh'uch'ch'atkh'o va dalelkh'oi isbotkunandai nubuvvatash ba sui Fir'avn va k'avmash ravon kardem. Pas az tarafi onkh'o ch'uz inkor va kofir shudan ba on kh'uch'ch'atkh'o va mu'ch'izakh'o digar chize surat nagirift. Pas ei Paiombar, andesha kun, ki ok'ibati kori Fir'avn va k'avmash bo chi anch'omid. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amai onkh'oro bo g'ark' sokhtan dar dario kh'alok kunonida, dar duniovu okhirat la'natro dunbolagirashon gardonid.
104) Va Muso vak'te ba sui Fir'avn firistoda shud va nazdi vai omad, guft: "Ei Fir'avn! Man az sui Ofaridgoru Moliki kh'amai mavch'udot va Tadbirkunandai kori onkh'o firistoda shudaam."

105) Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Chun man az nazdi Parvardigor firistoda shudaam, pas baroiam shoista ast, ki dar borai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba ch'uz kh'ak' sukhane naguiam. Man ba shumo az sui Parvardigoraton daleli ravshane ovardaam, ki paiombar budanamro isbot mekunad. Pas Bani Isroilro, ki to imruz dar bandi asorat va zeri sitamu shikanch'a k'aror doshtand, ozod namo va kh'amrokh'am bifirist."
106) Fir'avn ba Muso guft: "Agar tu dar kh'ak'ik'at baroi isboti nubuvvati khesh on guna ki da'vo dori, mu'ch'iza doshta boshi, onro biior, agar dar da'voi khud sodik' kh'asti."
107) Ba'd az in sukhan Muso asoi dasti khudro ba zamin andokht, pas on dar chashmi kh'ar binanda ba mori buzurgch'ussai namoion tabdil ioft.

108) Va Muso dasti kheshro az girebon io az zeri bag'alash berun va namoion sokht, pas dastash biduni marazi pust chunon dar kh'olati safedi va durakhshoni berun shud, ki az shiddati rushnoi dar nazari kh'ar binanda medurakhshid.

109) Va peshvoionu sarkardagoni k'avmi Fir'avn ba'di mushokh'idai tabdil ioftani asoi Muso ba mori kalon va berun shudani dastash dar kh'olati safed dar borai vai guftand: "Ba durusti ki Muso ch'odugari bisior dono va nerumand ast.

110) Vai bo in korkh'oiash mekhokh'ad shumoro az sarzamini Misr berun kunad." Sipas, Fir'avn bo onkh'o dar mavridi Muso (alaikh'is salom) mashvarat kard va guft: "Dar borai Muso ba man chi mashvarat medikh'ed?"

111) Onkh'o dar ch'avobi Fir'avn guftand: "Shitobkori makun va kori Musovu Kh'oruni barodarashro ba ta'khir guzor va dar kh'amai shakh'rkh'oi Misr ch'am'ovarandagonro firist, to sokh'ironro ch'am' kunand.
112) To kh'amai ch'odugaroni mokh'ir va dar kasbi khud nerumandro nazdat ch'am' orand."

113) Pas Fir'avn baroi az kh'ama gushavu kanori shakh'r ch'am'ovarii ch'odugaron afrodero firistod. Vak'te onkh'o nazdi Fir'avn omadand, az vai pursidand: "Agar mo bo sekh'ri khud alaikh'i Muso piruz shavem, sokh'ibi ch'oiza megardem?"
114) Fir'avn dar ch'avobi onkh'o guft: "Ore, dar surati piruz gashtan, sokh'ibi ch'oizaiu muzd meshaved va beshubkh'a, bo giriftani mansabkh'oi baland az ch'umlai muk'arraboni dargokh'am meshaved."

115) Ch'odugaron az rui kibru g'urur bo dili pur va e'timodi g'olib omadan alaikh'i Muso guftand: "Ei Muso! Khudat intikhob kun. Iakum tu on chi mekhokh'i, meafkani io avval mo on chi mekhokh'em, afkanem?!"

116) Muso bo takia ba kumaki Parvardigor va biduni tavach'ch'ukh' ba imkonoti moddii onkh'o guft: "Nakhust shumo resmonkh'o va asokh'oi dasti khudro andozed." Chun resmonkh'o va asokh'oi khudro ba zamin andokhtand, ch'odu karda, chashmi mardumro az didani kh'ak'ik'ati matlab bastand va onkh'oro tarsonida, dar nazari shakhsoni mushokh'idagar ch'odui buzurge ovardand.

117) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Musoi paiombarash paig'om firistod, ki ei Muso, asoi dasti khudro ba zamin andoz. U asoiashro ba zamin andokht. Pas, asoi Muso ba mori buzurgch'ussae tabdil iofta, kh'amai resmonkh'o va asokh'oi ch'odugaronro, ki az on baroi chappa nishon dodani kh'ak'ik'atkh'o va fireb dodani mardum istifoda kardand va tavre namoish dodand, ki guio on resmonu asokh'o morkh'oi khurdi doroi kh'arakatand, furu burd.
118) Bo kh'amin kh'ak' namoion shud va rost budani on chi Muso ovarda va botil budani sekh'ri ch'odugaron isboti khudro paido kard.
119) Pas ch'odugaron mag'lub gashta shikast khurdand va Muso dar on sakh'na alaikh'i onkh'o g'olib omad va ch'odugaron bo khoriiu sarafkandagi bargashtand.

120) Va ch'odugaron ba'di mushokh'idai k'udrati buzurgi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va dar borai mu'ch'izakh'oi ravshan iak'in kh'osil namudanashon khudro doshta natavonistand va chunon dar kh'olati sach'da ba zamin aftodand, ki guio kase onkh'oro afkanda boshad.
121) Ch'odugaron guftand: "Ba Parvardigori tamomi mavch'udot imon ovardem-
122) ba Parvardigori Muso va Kh'orun (alaikh'imas salom). Zero fak'at U loik'i ibodat buda, digar ma'budkh'oi sokhta arzishi ibodatro nadorand."

123) Fir'avn ba'di ba Parvardigori iagona imon ovardani ch'odugaron bo takh'id ba onkh'o guft: "Oio ba Muso pesh az rukhsat dodani man imon ovarda, paiombariashro tasdik' karded?! Begumon, imon ovardanaton ba vai va tasdik'i nubuvvatash makru dasisaest, ki onro shumo va Muso baroi berun kardani sokinoni in shakh'r az sarzamini kheshtan andeshidaed. Pas, ei sokh'iron, ba zudi medoned, ki chi azobi sakhte bar saraton meoiad va ba kadom uk'ubati bad duchor megarded.

124) Savgand mekhuram, ki dasti rostu poii chap io dasti chapu poii rosti kh'ar kadomatonro k'at' mekunam, sipas kh'amaatonro bar tanai darakhtoni khurmo dor meovezam, to baroi shumo uk'ubat va baroi digaron, ki shumoro dar in kh'ol mebinand, darsi ibrat boshad."
125) Ch'odugaron dar posukhi Fir'avn guftand: "Ba durusti ki mo tankh'o ba sui Parvardigoramon barmegardem. Baroi kh'amin ba takh'didkh'oi tu parvo nadodem.

126) Va tu az mo tasdik'i oiatkh'oi Parvardigoramonro, ki ba vositai Muso baroiamon omada ast, namepisandi va tankh'o baroi kh'amin az mo intik'om giriftan mekhokh'i. Agar in koramon "gunokh'" boshad, pas mo ba "gunokh'"-i khud ik'ror mekunem." Sipas bo zori va iltich'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui ovardand va guftand: "Parvardigoro! On chunon sabru takh'ammulro bar mo birez, ki tamomi vuch'udamonro faro girad, to dar rokh'i kh'ak'ik'at ustuvor monem. Moro dar kh'olati taslim gardidan ba Tu, mute' shudan ba farmonkh'oiat va pairavii Paiombarat bimiron."

127) Va peshvoionu sarkardagoni k'avmi Fir'avn baroi shurangezi alaikh'i Musovu digar mu'minon ba vai guftand: "Ei Fir'avn, oio tu Muso va k'avmashro meguzori, ki dar zamin fasodro pakh'n kunand va tu va ma'budkh'oiatro kanor guzoshta, mardumro ba ibodati Parvardigor faro khonand?!" Fir'avn guft: "Ank'arib pisaroni Bani Isroilro ba k'atl merasonem va zanonashonro baroi adoi khidmati khesh bok'i memonem va Ba durusti ki mo bar onkh'o az rokh'i k'udrat, g'olibiiat va kh'ukumat zabardast kh'astem."

128) Muso k'avmashro tavsiia doda guft: "Ei k'avmi man, dar dur sokhtani zarar va ch'albi naf' tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kumak bikhokh'ed va dar barobari ozmoishe, ki k'aror dored, sabr kuned. Kh'amono zamin fak'at az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, ba Fir'avnu digar makhluk'ot vobasta nest va kh'ech' kas k'udrati onro nadorad, ki zaminro chitavre khokh'ad, idora kunad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo khosti Khud idorai onro dar baini mardum az iak dast ba dasti digar megardonad. Ammo ok'ibati nek dar zamin az mu'minonest, ki dasturoti ilokh'iro ba ch'o meorand va az man'kardakh'oiash parkh'ez mekunand. Idorai zamin ok'ibat az kh'amin gurukh' mardum ast, agarchi gokh'o duchori sakhttarin imtikh'onkh'o va giriftorikh'o gardand."

129) K'avmi Muso az Farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi ba vai guftand: "Ei Muso! Mo bo dastoni Fir'avn pesh az omadan va ba'di omadanat ba uk'ubati kushta shudani farzandonamon va baroi khidmat bok'i mondani zanonamon mubtalo gashtaem." Muso (alaikh'is salom) bo k'asdi nasikh'at va muzhdai farokhi ba onkh'o guft: "Umed ast, ki Parvardigoraton Fir'avni dushmanatonro bo k'avmash kh'alok gardonad va ba'd az nobudii onkh'o baroiaton dar zamin k'udrat bakhshad, pas, nigokh' mekunad, ki ba'di tag'iir ioftani in kh'olat chi kor mekuned, oio az in ne'mat siposguzor meshaved io nosiposi mekuned."

130) Va kh'amono Mo pairavoni Fir'avnro ba beobi va k'akh'tsoli uk'ubat kardem va onkh'oro bo kamshavii mevakh'o va g'allakh'oi zamin ozmoish namudem, to pand girifta, ba khulosa biioiand, ki in uk'ubat ch'azoi nosiposiashon ast va ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bozgardand.

131) Pas chun ba k'avmi Fir'avn ne'mati sarsabzivu serkh'osili va arzoni meomad, meguftand: "In ne'matkh'o ba on sabab baroiamon doda shudaast, ki tankh'o mo sazovori on kh'astem." Va agar ba onkh'o musibate az beobi, k'akh'tsoli, bemori va g'aira meomad, az Muso va pairavoni Bani Isroilash foli bad megiriftand. Kh'ak'ik'at on ast, ki kh'amai musibatkh'oi bar onkh'o omada bo tak'diri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, na khud va na Muso dar on dakholat nadoshtand, g'air az duoi badi Muso dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o, vale beshtarashon in kh'ak'ik'atro namedonistand va az rui nodoni onro ba g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat medodand.

132) Va k'avmi Fir'avn bo iakravi ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) guftand: "Kh'ar mu'ch'iza va kh'ar dalelero, ki baroi isboti botil budani rokh'amon va rost budani nubuvatat ba mo ovardai, to bo on mu'ch'iza va dalel moro az rokh'amon bargardoni, kh'argiz onro k'abul va tasdik' namekunem."

133) Pas Mo baroi uk'ubati takzib va sarkashiashon bar onkh'o obi ziiod furud ovardem, ki kh'amai ziroatkh'o va mevach'otashonro g'ark' kard va ba onkh'o malakh ravon kardem, ki kh'amai kh'osilotashonro khurda nobud sokht va kh'asharote bo nomi shapush va k'urbok'k'a firistodem, zarfkh'oi onkh'o az k'urbok'k'a pur gashta, khurdanikh'oiashonro tabokh' karda, az sadoi ziiod khobro baroiashon talkh gardonid va bar onkh'o khun ravon kardem, kh'amai obi chokh'kh'o va ch'uikh'oiashon ba khun tabdil gardid. Mo tamomi in alomatkh'oi ifodagari k'udrati Khudro ba tavri ravshani parokanda-parokanda firistodem, ki iake pas az digar meomad. Onkh'o bo vuch'udi in kh'ama uk'ubatkh'o az imon ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va tasdik'i oiini Muso (alaikh'is salom) sarpechi karda, kibr varzidand va onkh'o mardumi isiongare budand, ki az botil ch'udo nameshudand va ba sui kh'ak' rokh' nameioftand.

134) Vak'te onkh'o ba sababi omadani oftakh'oi mazkur duchori azob gashtand, dar kh'ol ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) rui ovardand va guftand: "Ei Muso, ba vositai mak'omi nubuvvate, ki Parvardigorat makhsus turo loik'i on donista ast va bar asosi paimoni baroiat dodaash, ki ba sababi tavba azobro baratarf mesozad, az U bikhokh', to in azobro az mo dur sozad. Agar bo duoiat onro az mo bartaraf sozi, kh'atman ba tu imon meorem va Bani Isroilro rakh'o namuda, kh'amrokh'at mefiristem."

135) Pas vak'te k'abl az nobud sokhtanashon bo g'ark' kardan dar darioi Nil uk'ubati Khudro to iak muddati muaiian az onkh'o bardoshtem, nogakh'on akh'du paimoni bastaashonro, ki nubuvvati Musoro tasdik' mekunand va Bani Isroilro rakh'o mesozand, shikastand. Onkh'o bar kufri khesh idoma dodand va az firistodani Bani Isroil bo Muso (alaikh'is salom) khuddori kardand.

136) Pas vak'te mukh'lati kh'alokatashon faro rasid, ba sababi on ki oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro durug' shumurdand va az on rui gardonidand, Mo az onkh'o intik'om giriftem, pas dar bakh'r g'ark'ashon kardem.

137) Va ba Bani Isroil, ki Fir'avn va k'avmash onkh'oro shikanch'a doda, khor mesokhtand, k'alamravi shark'u g'arbi on sarzaminro (mak'sad sarzaminkh'oi Shom) ba meros dodem, on sarzamine, ki Mo dar on ba sababi dar komiltarin surat berun gardonidani ziroat va mevakh'oiash barakat nikh'odem. Va ei Paiombar, va'dai neki ba Bani Isroil dodai Parvardigorat ba sababi sabr kardanashon ba itmom rasid va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar zamin ba onkh'o baroi dar barobari ozoru musibati rasonidai Fir'avn va k'avmash sabr namudanashon k'udrat bakhshid va kh'ar on chi Fir'avnu k'avmash az kishovarzi va manzil anch'om medodand va kh'ar on chi az k'asrkh'oi baland buned mekardand, nobud sokht.

138) Va kh'angome, ki Muso bo asoi dastash ba bakh'r zad va on ba du k'ism duch'o shud, Bani Isroilro az on bakh'r guzaronidem. Pas, onkh'o az nazdi k'avme guzashtand, ki doim ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba ibodati butkh'oiashon mashg'ul budand. Bani Isroil ba'di didani in manzara ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) guftand: "Ei Muso, chunonchi in mardum g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) butkh'oro meparastand, baroi mo niz butero muk'arrar soz, ki onro ibodat kunem." Muso dar ch'avobi onkh'o guft: "Ei k'avmi man, vok'ean shumo mardumi ch'okh'il kh'asted, ki azamat va iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va noloik' budani shirkro ba U namedoned.

139) Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dini botili inkh'o va butkh'oiashonro ba vosiati dastoni man nobud khokh'ad kard va kh'ar chi az toat anch'om medikh'and, botil ast, zero onkh'o dar ibodat ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik k'aror dodaand."

140) Muso ba k'avmash guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Man chi guna baroi ibodati shumo ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digar ch'ustuch'u mekunam, dar kh'ole ki bo chashm nishonakh'oi buzurgi isbotkunandai k'udrati Uro dided va U bo ne'matkh'oi kh'alok kardani dushman, dar zamin ch'onishin sokhtan va baroiaton k'udrat dodan, shumoro dar zamoni kheshtan bar olamiion bartari bakhshid?!"

141) Va ei Farzandoni Ia'k'ubi Nabi, on zamonro ba khotir ored, ki shumoro bo rakh'o kardan az zeri azobu shikanch'ai Fir'avn va k'avmash nach'ot dodem. Onkh'o ba shumo nav'kh'oi gunoguni azobro mechashonidand. Pisaronatonro mekushtand va dukhtaronatonro baroi khidmat zinda meguzoshtand va dar rakh'onidani shumo az dasti Fir'avnu k'avmash az sui Parvardigoraton baroiaton sanch'ish va in'omi buzurg bud va in az shumo shukrguzori mekhokh'ad.

142) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Musoi paiombarash baroi si shab munoch'ot bo Khud va'da dod va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in muddatro bo ilova kardani dakh' shabi digar takmil dod, pas on chil shab shud. Va chun Muso baroi munoch'oti Parvardigorash k'asdi safar kard, ba Kh'oruni barodarash guft: "Ei Kh'orun, dar miioni k'avmam ch'onishini man bosh va bo idorai nek va narmi onkh'oro islokh' kun va dar rokh'i kasone, ki bo ma'siiat fasod mekunand, rokh' marav va iovari isionkoron mabosh."

143) Va chun Muso baroi munoch'oti Parvardigorash dar muddati ta'iinshuda omad va Parvardigorash bo u dar borai dasturot va g'airi on sukhan guft, Muso mushtok'i didori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shud va bo iltich'o guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, Khudro baroi man nishon bidekh', to Turo bubinam." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Muso ch'avob dod: "Kh'argiz Maro dar in dunio namebini, zero k'udrati onro nadori. Lekin ba in kukh' nigokh' kun. Agar kukh' ba'di tach'allii Man bar on dar makoni khud bok'i monda, zeri ta'sir k'aror nagirad, pas, Maro khokh'i did va ammo agar kukh' ba zamin iakson shavad, pas, dar in dunio kh'argiz Maro namebini." Pas, vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kukh' tach'alli kard, kukh'ro ba zamin iakson namud va Muso madkh'ush ba zamin aftod. Pas az on kh'angome, ki Muso az kh'olati uro faro girifta ba khud omad, guft: "Parvardigoro, Turo az kh'amai on chi loik'i Zoti Tu nest, pok medonam.
