Inak man az gustokhii talabi didorat dar in dunio tavba kardam va az miioni k'avmi khud nakhustin shakhsi imon ovarda kh'astam."

144) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Muso guft: "Ei Muso, kh'amono Man turo bo paig'omkh'oi Khud va bo bevosita kh'amrokh'at sukhan guftan barguzidam va az digaron bartar gardonidam. Pas on chiro ba tu az in sharafi buzurg dodaam, bigir va baroi on az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shukrguzor bosh."

145) Va ba Muso dar lavkh'akh'oi sokhtashuda az chub io g'airi on tamomi niiozmandikh'oi dini va duniavii Bani Isroilro baion kardem, to baroi shakhsoni pandpazir andarz boshad va akh'komero, ki ba tafsil dodani on niioz bud, mufassal zikr namudem. Pas ei Muso, in Tavrotro bo ch'iddiiat va talosh bigir va Bani Isroili k'avmatro dastur bidekh', to bekh'tarin rakh'namoikh'oi onro ba misli sabr kardan va guzasht namudan, ki ach'ri beshtar dorad, bo komiltarin surat bigirand. Man kh'atman ba shumo ok'ibati kasonero, ki bo dasturam mukholifat karda, az doirai itoatam berun shuda, chi guna kh'alok megardand, nishon khokh'am dod.

146) Begumon Man k'albi on kasonero, ki khudro banokh'ak' az mardum va kh'ak'ik'at bolotar donista, kibr mevarzand, az ibrat giriftan az nishonakh'oi k'udratam dar olami kh'asti, vuch'udi khudi onkh'o va az fakh'mi Kitobam boz khokh'am dosht. In khudparaston az kh'amai in nishonakh'o pand girifta nametavonand. Va agar kh'ar alomati k'udratamro binand, onro tasdik' namekunand, zero bar on e'tiroz mekunand, az on rui metoband va bo Allokh'u Rasulash dushmani mevarzand va agar rokh'i kh'ak'ik'atro, ki ba khushnudii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) merasonad, bubinand, onro rokh' namegirand va ba on mail nadorand va agar rokh'i gumrokh'iro, ki boisi g'azabi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) megardad, bubinand, onro rokh'i khud megirand. On chi ba onkh'o rasida ast, sababash on ast, ki oiatkh'oi isbotkunandai rost budani nubuvvati paiombaronro takzib kardand va az on ki dar boraash andesha kunand, g'ofil mondand.

147) Va on kasone, ki oiatkh'oi isbotkunandai durustii nubuvvati paiombaronamon va lik'oi Moro dar okhirat inkor mekunand, kh'amai on amalkh'oiashon, ki az nav'i ibodat ast, botil megardad. Ba sababi imon nadoshtan, ki sharti k'abulshavii amal ast, baroi korkh'oi nekashon savob namegirand va dar ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o ch'azoi kufru shirkashonro mebinand. Ch'azoi kufru shirk dar duzakh ch'ovidon mondan ast.

148) Va k'avmi Muso ba'di baroi munoch'oti Parvardigor raftani vai az zaru zevarkh'oiashon kh'aikali gusolai bech'onu beovozero ba khotiri ibodat sokhtand. Oio namedonistand, ki in gusola bo onkh'o sukhan karda nametavonad va k'udrati ba rokh'i nek rakh'namoi kardanashonro nadorad va az ukh'dai ch'albi foida io bartaraf sokhtani zarar namebaroiad?! Onkh'o gusolaro baroi khud ma'bud giriftand va bo in amal bar ch'oni kheshtan ch'avr kardand.

149) Va chun az in kori khud pushaimon gashta, dar kh'airat mondand va iak'in kh'osil kardand, ki bo ma'bud giriftani gusola az rokh'i rost gumrokh' gashtaand, ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iltich'o kardand va guftand: "Agar Parvardigoramon bo tavfik' dodan baroi anch'omi ibodat ba kh'oli mo rakh'm nakunad va in gunokh'i moro nabakhshad, begumon az ch'umlai kasone megardem, ki dar duniovu okhirat ziion kardaand."

150) Va vak'te Muso az safari munoch'ot bo Parvardigorash ba nazdi k'avmash bargasht, dar kh'ole ki ba sababi gusolaparastii onkh'o az khashmu andukh' vuch'udash pur gashta bud, guft: "Ei k'avmi man, pas az raftani man chi bad ch'onishini karded! Zero in kh'olat shumoro ba nobudi va badbakhti merasonad. Oio az intizorii man malol shuda, ba gusolaparasti ik'dom namuded?!" Va az shiddati khashmu andukh'e, ki uro faro girifta bud, lavkh'akh'oi dastashro ba zamin andokht va az saru rishi barodarash Kh'orun girifta uro ba sui khud mekashid. Zero Kh'orun kh'amrokh'i k'avm bud, vale gusolaparastii onkh'oro dida, onro man' nakard. Kh'orun bo ma'zaratkhokh'i va dilch'uii Musoi barodarash ba vai guft: "Ei Pisari modaram, in mardum notavonam kh'isobida, khoram kardand va nazdik bud, ki maro ba k'atl rasonand. Baroi kh'amin ba sababi khashmat maro bo on uk'ubate, ki dushmanonamro khushkh'ol mesozad, much'ozot makun va dar shumori k'avmi sitamkori gusolaparast magardon."

151) Muso ba Parvardigorash rui ovarda guft: "Parvardigoro, maro va Kh'oruni barodaramro mag'firat kun va moro g'ark'i darioi rakh'matat gardon, to az kh'ar taraf ikh'otaamon kunad va Tu ei Parvardigori mo, az kh'ar mekh'rubone bar mo Mekh'rubontar kh'asti."

152) Ba durusti, kasone, ki gusolaro baroi khud ma'bud k'aror dodand, dar oiandai nazdik ba g'azabi sakhti Parvardigorashon mubtalo gashta va dar in dunio duchori zillat meshavand. Zero onkh'o Ofaridgori khudro ba khashm ovarda, bo U bekh'urmati kardand va kasonero, ki bar Mo durug' mebofand, kh'amin guna ch'azo medikh'em.

153) Va ei Paiombar, on kasone, ki korkh'oi badero az misoli shirk ovardan ba Khudo va sodir kardani gunokh', anch'om dodand, sipas az korashon tavba karda, imon ovardand va az korkh'oi bad dast kashidand, kh'atman Parvardigorat baroi onkh'o ba'di tavbai sodik'onai bozgasht az shirk ba imon va az ma'siiat ba toat, bo satr kardani gunokh'onashon va az on darguzashtan bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

154) Va chun khashmi Muso furu nishast va orom shud, lavkh'akh'oi az rui g'azab ba zamin andokhtaashro girift va navishtakh'oi on shomili kh'idoiat az zalolat va baioni kh'ak' buda, kasonero, ki az Parvardigori khud va uk'ubatash kh'aros doshtand, shomili rakh'mat bud.

155) Va Muso (alaikh'is salom) kh'aftod mardi bekh'tarini k'avmashro barguzid, to dar nazdi Parvardigor az gusolaparastii bekhiradoni k'avm uzrkhokh'i kunand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o va'dagokh'ero baroi kh'ozir shudan va'da dod. Vak'te onkh'o ba va'dagokh' omadand, nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'ur'at kardand va az Muso darkhost namudand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba onkh'o oshkor nishon dikh'ad. Ba'd az in ch'asorat va gustokhi zilzilai sakhte onkh'oro faro girift va az dakh'shati on madkh'ush gashta, kh'alok shudand. Pas az in vok'ea Muso ba Parvardigorash bo iltich'oiu zori guft: "Parvardigoro, agar Tu pesh az omadani in k'avm ba inch'o kh'alokati onkh'o va maro mekhosti, in korro mekardi. Oio moro ba sababi amali anch'omdodai iak gurukh'i bekhiradamon kh'alok mesozi? Amali gusolaparastiero, ki k'avmi man anch'om dodand, ch'uz ozmoish va sanch'ishi Tu chize nest, ba in vosita kh'ar kiro khokh'i, gumrokh' va kh'ar kiro khokh'i, kh'idoiat mekuni, Tu Korsozi kh'amai korkh'oi mo kh'asti, pas moro biomurz va bo rakh'mati gusturdaat bar mo rakh'm bikun va Tu bekh'tarini omurzandagoni.

156) Va moro dar in dunio az zumrai kasone bigardon, ki bo dodani ne'matkh'o va bakhshidani ofiiat mavridi lutfu navozish k'aror doda va ba amali nek kh'idoiatashon kardai va dar okhirat az zumrai on bandagoni solekh' bigardon, ki ch'annatro baroiashon omoda sokhtai. Kh'amono kh'amai mo sidk'an tavba karda, bo e'tirof ba khatokh'oiamon ba sui Tu bozgashtaem." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft: "Az kasone, ki ba asbobi badbakhti dast mezanand, kh'ar kiro khokh'am, ba azobam giriftor mesozam va rakh'matam dar in dunio tamomi mavch'udotro faro girifta ast. Kh'ech' makhluk'e nest, ch'uz on ki rakh'matam shomili kh'olash gashta, g'ark'i darioi fazlu ekh'sonam ast. Sipas rakh'matamro kh'atman dar ruzi okhirat baroi on kasone menavisam, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va duri az mamnuot tak'vo mekunand va zakotashonro ba shakhsoni arzanda medikh'and va ba oiatkh'oi Mo imon meorand-

157) on kasone, ki az Mukh'ammadi Paiombar, ki khondan va navishtan nametavonad, balki Khudo baroiash paig'om mefiristad, pairavi mekunand va u on kasest, ki iakh'udu nasoro nomu sifat va nubuvvati uro dar Tavroti Muso va Inch'ili Iso (alaikh'is salom) kitobatshuda meioband, in Paiombar onkh'oro ba korkh'oi nek farmon medikh'ad va az korkh'oe, ki baroi ak'lkh'oi solim va sirishtkh'oi pok zishtiash ma'lum ast, man' mekunad va iste'moli khurdanikh'o, nushidanikh'o va izdivoch'kh'oi pokizaro ba onkh'o kh'alol va khurdanikh'o, nushidanikh'o va izdivoch'kh'oi nopokro ba onkh'o kh'arom mesozad va mas'uliiatkh'oi sanginero ba misli voch'ib budani kushtani shakhsi k'otil, sarfi nazar az on ki k'atl bo khato surat girifta ast io bark'asd, az onkh'o sok'it mesozad. Pas, on kasone az Bani Isroil va g'airi onkh'o, ki ba in Paiombar imon meorand va uro bo arch'guzori kh'imoiat mekunand va alaikh'i dushmanonash eriash merasonand va az K'ur'oni shabekh'i nuri rakh'namoi bar u nozilgashta pairavi menamoiand, in ch'amoa rastagoroni kh'ak'ik'i buda, ba khostai kheshtan noil shuda va az azobi ilokh'i nach'ot meioband."

158) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei mardum, man az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sui kh'amai shumo (arabu ach'am) firistoda shudaam, On Zote, ki kh'ukmfarmoi va molikiiati osmonkh'o va zamin az Ust. Ba g'air az U digar ma'budi loik'i ibodat nest, murdagonro zinda mesozad va zindagonro memironad. Pas, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash Mukh'ammad, Paiombare, ki khondan va navishtan nametavonad, balki ba shumo paig'omi Parvardigorashro ovarda ast, imon ored, on Paiombare, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va on chi bar u va digar paiombaroni guzashta nozil shudaast, biduni ch'udosozi baini onkh'o imon dorad va az on chi ba shumo az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ovardaast, pairavi kuned, to ba kh'ar kore, ki ba foidai duniovu okhirati shumo ast, kh'idoiat iobed."

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi guzashta gusolaparastii iak gurukh'i Bani Isroilro k'issa kard, dar oiati zerin gurukh'i digari k'avmi Musoro, ki ba gusolaparaston mukholifat nishon dodand, baion namuda meguiad:
159) Va az miioni k'avmi Muso (alaikh'is salom) az Bani Isroil ch'amoate dar rokh'i rost k'aror doshta, mardumro ba rokh'i rost rakh'namoi mekardand va bar asosi kh'ak'ik'at va adolat kh'ukm karda, sitam namenamudand.

160) Va Mo Bani Isroilro ba duvozdakh' k'abila ch'udo kardem va chun onkh'o az Muso ob khostand, ba vai paig'om firistodem, ki "Ei Muso, bo asoiat sangro bizan." Muso bo asoi dastash sangro zad, pas az on sang ba te'dodi k'abilakh'o duvozdakh' chashma ravon shud. Kh'amono kh'ar k'abila makoni khosi obi khudro medonist. Iak k'abila bo k'abilai digar dar on makon sharik nameshud. Va abrro bar onkh'o soiabon sokhtem, ki bo kh'arakatashon ba kh'arakat medaromad va bo istodanashon meistod. Va baroi onkh'o az ne'matkh'oi Khud nushobai misli asal shirin va parandai doroi gushti khushta'mi misli bedona nozil kardem va guftem: "Az ne'matkh'oi pokizai baroiaton ruzi kardaamon bikhured." Va onkh'o bo zulmu nosiposi va k'adrnoshinosi az Mo kh'ech' chizro kam nakardand, valekin bo khilofkori khudro ba kh'alokat afkanda, bar ch'onashon sitam menamudand.

161) Va ei Paiombar, zamonero iod kun, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Bani Isroil guft: "Ba Bait-ul-muk'addas vorid shaved va az mevakh'oi kh'ar dekh'ai on kh'ar vak'te dilaton khokh'ad, bikhured va "Parvardigoro, az khatoi mo darguzar" bigued va dar kh'olati ruku' va taslim shudan voridi darvoza shaved. Agar in guftakh'oro ich'ro karded, az gunokh'onaton darmeguzarem. Beshak, Mo ba bandagoni nekukor az khairi dunio va okhirat afzun megardonem."

162) Pas sitamkoroni Bani Isroil on sukhanero, ki ba guftanash farmon girifta budand, digargun kardand va dar ivazi "Kh'ittatun" (Omurzish), "Kh'intatun" (Gandum) guftand. Ba ch'oi talabi mag'firat kalimai farmudashudaro tag'iir dodand. G'air az in on amalero, ki boiad tibk'i amri ilokh'i vak'ti az darvoza daromadan ba ch'o meovardand, digargun sokhtand. Ba ch'oi on ki bo shikastakh'oli va sarafkandagi az darvoza daroiand, bar mak''adashon khazida-khazida daromadand. Pas Mo bar onkh'o ba sababi on ki paivasta zulm menamudand, az ch'onibi osmon azob firistodem.

163) Va ei Paiombar, az iakh'udikh'o baroi khotirrason kardaniashon az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guzashtagoni onkh'oro uk'ubat namuda bud, oidi k'issai dekh'ae, ki dar ch'ivori bakh'r k'aror dosht, suol kun. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro az shikori mokh'i dar ruzi shanbe man' kard, ammo onkh'o az marzkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guzashtand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro chunin sanch'ish karda bud, ki mokh'ikh'o ruzi shanbe bar rui bakh'r namoion shuda, nazdashon meomadand, vale dar digar ruzkh'o nopadid gashta, nazdashon nameomadand. Mo onkh'oro ba sababi on ki az toatamon berun meshudand va gunokh' mekardand, kh'amin guna ozmudem. Onkh'o ba khotiri shikori mokh'i az kh'ila kor giriftand. Shastashonro dar dario guzoshta, chokh' mekandand. Mokh'ikh'o ruzi shanbe omada, dar dom meaftodand va onkh'o ruzi iakshanbe mokh'ikh'oro girifta, mekhurdand.

164) Va ei Paiombar, ba iod biior on zamonero, ki ch'amoate az Bani Isroil ch'amoati nofarmonro az shikori mokh'i dar ruzi shanbe man' kardand va az azobi ilokh'i kh'ushdor dodand va ch'amoati digar ba in nasikh'atgaron guftand: "Charo mardumero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba sababi gunokh'onashon dar dunio kh'alok mesozad io dar ruzi k'iiomat azobi sakht medikh'ad, nasikh'at mekuned?!" Nasikh'atgaron guftand: "Mo mas'uliiati amri ma'ruf va nakh'ii munkarro anch'om medikh'em, to nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uzr doshta boshem, ki baroi tarki in amal moro azob nakunad va niz shoiad in k'avmi nofarmon az andarz foida megirand va az on gunokh'i khud dast mekashand."

165) Pas vak'te on k'avmi nofarmon az andarzi ch'amoati nasikh'atgar rui tofta, az gunokh' naistodand, Mo on toifaero, ki gunakh'koronro az gunokh' man' mekardand, az azob nach'ot dodem va on kasonero, ki ruzi shanbe mokh'i shikor karda, az marzamon guzashtand, ba sababi az itoat berun shudan va idoma dodani gunokh' bo azobi sakht giriftem.

166) Pas, chun bo takabbur va sarkashi dar nofarmonii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'ad guzashtand va pand nagiriftand, ba onkh'o guftem: "Ei gurukh'i nofarmon, ba buzinakh'oi khorshuda tabdil iobed." Kh'amin tavr kh'am shudand. Vak'te Mo paidoishi chizero khokh'em, ba on "Kh'ast shav" meguem, on chiz favran kh'ast meshavad.

167) Va ei Paiombar, ba khotir biior on zamonero, ki Parvardigorat oshkor e'lom namud, ki kh'atman bar iakh'udikh'o to ruzi k'iiomat kasero megumorad, ki ba onkh'o shadidtarin azobro mechashonad. Kh'amono Parvardigorat nisbat ba bandagoni nofarmon Zuduk'ubat ast, gokh'o dar kh'amin dunio azobashon medikh'ad va beguftugu, U nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

168) Va Mo Bani Isroilro ba'di sarch'am'i dar zamin parokanda va ba toifakh'o ch'udo kardem. Ba'zeashon mardumi solekh'i ich'rokunandai kh'uk'uk'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va bandagonand va ba'zei digarashon bo anch'omi gunokh' bar khud sitam kardaand. Va Mo onkh'oro bo osoniiu dushvori ozmudem, to az rokh'i badashon bozgardand.

169) Pas ba'd az onkh'o farzandoni badkore ch'onishini guzashtagon shuda, Tavrotro ba meros burda, onro khondand, ammo amal nakardand, matoi bearzishi dunioro baroi tag'iir dodani Kitobi Khudo va amal ba g'airi on chun rishva megiriftand va kheshtanro umedvor mesokhtand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba zudi gunokh'oni onkh'oro meomurzad va agar baroiashon matoi dunio meomad, onro megiriftand. Oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az onkh'o dar Tavrot akh'd nagirifta bud, ki dar borai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) biduni takh'rif va tabdil ch'uz kh'ak' chizi digar naguiand?! Onkh'o az rui nodoni bo Tavrot amal kardanro tark nakardaand, balki in raftorashon az rui donish surat girifta bud. Onkh'o Tavrotro khondand va az mazmunu mak'sadi on ogokh' shudand. Az in ch'ikh'at gunokh'ashon sakhttar ast. Va okhirat bo ne'matkh'oi bezavolash baroi parkh'ezkoroni ich'rokunandai farmonkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az mato'kh'oi zavolpaziri in dunio ba marotib bekh'tar ast. Oio shumo kasoni maftuni matoi nochizi in dunio andesha namekuned, ki on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar saroi okhirat baroi parkh'ezkoron omoda kardaast, bekh'tar va poidortar ast?!

170) Va kasone, ki ba Kitobi Khudo chang zada, bo dasturoti on amal mekunand va namozi khudro dar vak'tkh'oi muaiianshuda bo rioiai shartkh'o, voch'ibot va sunnatkh'o barpo medorand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro baroi anch'omi nekikh'oiashon podosh medikh'ad, zero begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muzdi kasonero, ki amalashon solekh' va islokh'korand, zoe' namesozad.

171) Va ei Mukh'ammad, iod kun on zamonero, ki chun Bani Isroil az k'abuli akh'komi Tavrot sarpechi namudand, Mo kukh'ro barkandem va onro boloi sarashon bardoshtem. Kukh' bar boloi onkh'o chunon menamud, ki guio abrporaest bar sarashon soia meafkanad va onkh'o iak'in doshtand, ki on kukh' bar boloiashon meaftad. Ba onkh'o gufta shud: "On chiro baroiaton dodaem, bo ch'iddiiat, talosh va azmi k'avi bigired va on akh'komero, ki dar Tavrot ba shumo muk'arrar kardaem, ba iod ovarda faromush makuned, to bo ich'roi in guftakh'o parkh'ezkori namoed."

172) Va ei Mukh'ammad, iod kun on zamonero, ki Parvardigorat az kamari farzandoni Odam naslashonro berun ovard va onkh'oro bo on chi dar sirishtashon az ik'rori ofaridgoriash nikh'oda bud, ba Ofaridgor budanash e'tirof kunonida pursid: "Oio Man Parvardigori shumo nestam?!" Nasli Odam kh'amagi dar posukh "Bale, Tu Parvardigori mo kh'asti" guftand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft: "Ba durusti ki Mo ozmoishaton kardem va az shumo paimon giriftem, to ruzi k'iiomat kh'uch'ch'ati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bar khud inkor nakuned va nagued: "Mo dar in bora ma'lumot nadoshtem. -

173) Io dar on ruz dalel naored, ki padaronaton dar guzashta akh'dshikani karda, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk ovardaand va shumo niz chun onkh'oro mushrik ioftaed, az onkh'o pairavi kardaed va bo kh'amin bakh'ona bigued: "Parvardigoro, oio moro bo on chi padaronamon kardaand, ki bo shirk ovardan amalkh'oi kheshro botil sokhtand, ba ch'avobgari mekashi va uk'ubat mekuni? Mo gunokh' nadorem, zero kh'ak'ik'atro namedonistem va dar gunokh'oni sodirkardaamon ba padaronamon tak'lid kardem.""

174) Va on guna ki oiatkh'oi Khudro dar borai sarnavishti ummatkh'oi takzibkunanda baion kardem, kh'amin tavr onro baroi in gurukh' niz baion menamoem, to az gunokh'i shirk ovardan ba sui iaktoparastivu ibodati Ma'budi Iagona bozgardand. Chunonchi dar akh'dashon bo Khudo omada ast.

175) Va ei Paiombar, baroi Bani Isroil khabari mardero, ki az baini khudashon bud, bikhon. Mo ba u oiatkh'oi Kheshro dodem, onro donist va kh'ak'ik'atro fakh'mid, lekin amal nakard, balki onro tark namuda, az muk'tazoi on ch'udo gasht, pas Shaiton dar paiash aftod va k'arinash shud. Pas ba'd az on ki az kh'idoiat va nach'otioftagon bud, az ch'umlai gumrokh'oni kh'alokshuda gardid.

176) Va agar Mo foida burdanashro bo in oiatkh'o mekhostem, kh'atman ch'oigokh'ashro bo oiatkh'oi Khud mebardoshtem, baroi amal kardan komiobash mesokhtem, pas mak'omash dar duniovu okhirat baland megasht. Ammo vak'te vai ba shakh'vatkh'o mail karda, zindagonii in dunioro az zindagonii abadii okhirat pesh guzosht va pairavi khostakh'oi botili nafsash gasht, bo in raftorash baroi kheshtan rokh'ero barguzid, ki ok'ibat uro ba sharmandagi va rasvoi rasonid. Sifati vai dar kh'aris budan ba dunio monandi sifati sag ast. Zabonash dar kh'ama kh'olat az dakh'onash berun ast. Agar uro bironi, zabonashro az dakh'onash berun meorad va agar ba kh'olash kh'am guzori, zabonashro az dakh'onash berun meorad. In vasfi k'avmest, ki ba sababi takzibi oiatkh'oi Mo gumrokh' shudaand. Pas, ei Paiombar, in k'issakh'oro baroi onkh'o nak'l kun, to andesha karda, az rokh'i takzib va gumrokh'iashon bozgardand.

177) Kh'ech' kh'olate az kh'olati k'avme, ki kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi Moro takzib karda, ba on bovar nadorand, badtar nest va onkh'o bo in raftor khudro ba kh'alokat andokhta, bar ch'oni kheshtan ch'avr mekunand.

178) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar ki tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostashro dikh'ad, pas, vai kh'idoiatioftai kh'ak'ik'i ast va kh'ar kiro az rokh'i rost dur sozad, pas, in ch'amoa dar ruzi k'iiomat bar ch'oni khudu khonavodaashon ziioni sakht rasonidaand. Ogokh' boshed, ki ziioni oshkor kh'amin ast.

179) Ba durusti ki Mo baroi duzakh bisiore az ch'inkh'o va insonkh'oro ofaridem. Zero bo ilmi Khud medonem, ki onkh'o amali duzakhiionro mekunand. Onkh'o dilkh'oe dorand, ki bo on zararu foidai kheshro dark namekunand va chashmone dorand, ki alomatkh'oi k'udrati ilokh'iro dar vuch'udashon va atrofi koinot namebinand, to az on ibrat girand va gushkh'oe dorand, ki bo on oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro nameshunavand, to dar borai ma'noiash fikr kunand. In ch'amoai tavsifshuda dar nadoshtani ak'l ba chakh'orpoion monandand, balki dar gumrokh'i az chakh'orpoion niz gumrokh'tarand. In ch'amoa kasoneand, ki az imon ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi k'iiomat g'ofiland.

180) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) doroi nomkh'oi zeboest, ki ba azamat va kamoli U dalolat mekunad. Pas dar talabi khostakh'oiaton nomkh'oi Uro vasila k'aror dikh'ed va ba in vosita ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sano firisted va kasonero, ki dar bobi nomkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo nisbat dodani on ba g'airi U, inkor, takh'rif io tashbekh'ash ba sifoti makhluk'ot az kh'ak'ik'at kach' meravand, rakh'o sozed. Kh'amono on kasone, ki dar borai nomkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kach' raftaand, ba sababi in kirdorashon bo azobi dardnok ch'azo doda meshavand.

181) Va az miioni bandagoni ofaridaamon ch'amoate kh'astand, ki khud dar rokh'i kh'ak'ik'at buda, kh'idoiat ioftaand va digaronro ba sui on da'vat mekunand, to onkh'o niz kh'idoiat ioband va bar asosi kh'ak'ik'at kh'ukm namuda, adolatro pesha kardaand va kh'ech' gokh' sitam namekunand.

182) Va on kasone, ki oiatkh'oi Moro takzib karda, ba on bovar nadorand, begumon darkh'oi rizk'ro ba ruiashon mekushoem. In kushodani darkh'oi ruzi baroi giromidoshtashon nest, balki bo mak'sadi tadrich'an kh'alok kardani onkh'o ast, to rokh'i gumrokh'ii khudro idoma dikh'and, sipas Mo ba tavri nogakh'oni az ch'oe ba onkh'o azobro meorem, ki namedonand.

183) Va uk'ubati onkh'oro ba ta'khir meandozam, to gumon kunand, ki azob nameshavand, sipas bo in pindor takzibu kufri kheshro idoma medikh'and va uk'ubatashon duchand meshavad. Makri Man bisior k'avi ast. Ekh'sonro baroiashon oshkor mesozam, vale mak'sadam az on tadrich'an az tavfik' makh'rum kardan va kh'alok sokhtani onkh'o ast.

184) Oio in takzibgaroni Allokh'u Rasulash andesha namekunand, to ak'li khudro ba kor darorand va ba onkh'o ravshan shavad, ki Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) devona nest. U begumon Firistodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, ba sifati az azobi ilokh'i bimdikh'andai oshkor omada ast.

185) Oio onkh'o dar borai mulki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar osmonkh'ovu zamin va dar borai kh'aivonot, ashioi bech'on va g'aira, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar on osmonkh'o va zamin ofaridaast, bo nazari ibrat nigokh' namekunand?! Va oio dar borai mukh'lati kh'aioti khesh nameandeshand, ki shoiad anch'omi on nazdik shudaast, pas bo kh'amin andeshakh'oi ibratomuz pesh az on ki fursatro az dast dikh'and, tavba kunand?! Agar onkh'o ba K'ur'oni karim va va'davu takh'didkh'oi on imon nameorand, pas ba kadom kitob imon meorand?!

186) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro az kh'idoiat makh'rum gardonida, az rokh'i rost gumrokh' sozad, pas kh'ech' kh'idoiatgar uro rakh'namoi karda nametavonad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro dar gumrokh'ivu kufr sargardon meguzorad, onkh'o rokh'i durustro paido namekunand.

187) In k'avmi takzibkunandai khudra'i az tu dar borai k'iiomat pursida meguiand: "K'iiomat kai ba vuk'u' mepaivandad va dar borai on kai ma'lumot kh'osil meshavad?" Ei Mukh'ammad, dar posukhi onkh'o bigu: "Na man va na kasi digar dar borai kai omadani k'iiomat ma'lumot nadorem. Kh'amono ma'lumoti vak'ti rukh dodani k'iiomat tankh'o nazdi Parvardigoram ast. Kase ch'uz Parvardigor onro dar vak'ti muk'arrarshudaash oshkor namekunad. Zamoni oshkorshavii on baroi akh'li osmonkh'o va zamin pushida ast. Beshubkh'a, k'iiomat nogakh'on meoiad." Az tu dar borai k'iiomat tarze mepursand, ki guio tu baroi donistani on kh'aris kh'asti, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o namedonand, ki ba sababi dar borai Parvardigorat donishi komil doshtanat az omadani k'iiomat namepursi. Ei Mukh'ammad, ba onkh'o bigu: "Dar vok'e', donishi vak'ti omadani k'iiomat tankh'o peshi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, vale beshtari mardum in kh'ak'ik'atro namedonand."

188) Ei Mukh'ammad, bigu: "Man k'udrati baroi khud ch'albi foida va dur sokhtani zararro nadoram, magar on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ad. Begumon, ch'albi foida va dur sokhtani zarar dar tavoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Chizero ch'uz on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiam omukhta ast, namedonam. Az g'aib ogakh'i nadoram. Va agar man g'aibro medonistam, kh'atman korkh'oero, ki baroiam sababi ch'albi manfiat va dur kardani zarar megardad, anch'om medodam. Zero dar surati az g'aib ogokh'i doshtanam kh'ar kh'odisaro pesh az vuk'u' va bo chi anch'om ioftanashro medonistam. Man tankh'o firistodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astam. Mardumro az azobi dardovari U bim medikh'am va k'avmero, ki ba paiombarii man imon va dinamro tasdik' dorand, ba podoshi nek az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muzhda medikh'am."

189) U Zotest, ki shumo zanonu mardonro az iak shakhs, Odam ofarid va az vai Kh'avvoi kh'amsarashro khalk' kard, to bo u uns girad va oromish kh'osil kunad. Vak'te zanu shavkh'ar bo kh'am iakch'o meshavand, zavch'aash bori sabuk girifta, bordor shudanashro ekh'sos namekunad, zero kh'anuz kh'amli vai ruzkh'oi nakhustinashro meguzaronad. Pas bordoriash idoma meiobad, korkh'oiashro anch'om medikh'ad va ekh'sosi sangini namekunad. Pas vak'te kh'amli shikamash kalon shud va ekh'sosi garoni kard, zanu shavkh'ar dar iakch'oiagi ba Allokh'i Parvardigorashon ru ovarda, duo karda, meguiand: "Ilokh'o, agar ba mo farzandi tandurust va solimandom bakhshi, begumon az shukrkunandagoni ne'matkh'oiat meshavem."

190) Ba'd az on chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) duoi onkh'oro paziruft va baroiashon muvofik' ba darkhostashon farzandi solimu tandurust dod, dar on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon dodaast, sharik k'aror medikh'and. Farzandashonro Abdulkh'oris (Bandai dekh'k'on), Abdurrasul (Bandai Rasul) va g'aira nom meguzorand. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi sharik k'aror medikh'and, bartar va pok ast. Tankh'o U Ofaridgor va Ma'budi barkh'ak' ast.

191) Oio onkh'o in butkh'o va g'airi onro, ki chizero naofaridaand, dar ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik megardonand va kh'ol on ki on ma'budkh'o khud makhluk'and?! Pas chitavr makhluk'ro shariki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mesozand?!

192) Va in ma'budkh'oi botili onkh'o k'udrati onro nadorand, ki ba bandagonashon kumak kunand va khudro kh'am iori kardan nametavonand. Pas mushrikon bo kadom ak'l in khudokh'oi boftaro ibodat mekunand?!

193) Va ei mushrikon, agar shumo on ma'budkh'oi khudro ba ch'onibi kh'idoiat faro khoned, da'vatatonro namepazirand va az shumo pairavi namekunand. Onkh'oro ba ch'onibi kh'idoiat da'vat kuned io khomush boshed, barobar ast. Zero butkh'oiaton mavch'udi bech'oni az ak'lu shunavoi va nutk' makh'rum meboshand.

194) Ei mushrikon, kh'amono on kasonero, ki ba g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted, ba monandi shumo makhluk' va banda kh'astand, balki kh'olati shumo az onkh'o bekh'tar ast. Shumo zindaed, gap mezaned, rokh' meraved, meshunaved, mebined, ammo butkh'oiaton chunin nestand. Agar shumo dar da'voi khesh oidi on chi ba butkh'o nisbat medikh'ed, sodik'ed, pas onkh'oro bikhoned va boiad da'vatatonro bipazirand.

195) Oio in ma'budkh'oi shumo poii rokh' raftan dorand, to baroi ich'roi kh'och'atkh'oiaton k'adam zanand?! Io onkh'o dast dorand, to bo tamomi k'uvvat zararro az shumo dur sozand?! Io onkh'o chashm dorand, to on chiro, ki az nazari shumo g'oib ast, binand va baroiaton khabar dikh'and?! Io onkh'o gush dorand, to chizkh'oi az shumo pushidaro shunida ma'lumot dikh'and?! Vak'te ma'budkh'oiaton az inkh'o makh'rumand, pas chitavr onkh'oro ba mak'sadi ch'albi manfiat va dur kardani zarar ibodat mekuned?! Ei Firistodai Mo, ba mushrikon bigu: "Tamomi ma'budkh'oi khudro, ki bo Allokh'i Iagona iakson meshumored, faro khoned, sipas biguzor onkh'o baroi ba man zarar rasondan makr kunand va baroiam mukh'lat nadikh'and."

196) Kh'amono kumakrason va korsozi man fak'at Allokh' ast, U maro mukh'ofizat mekunad, az g'airash chize umedvor nestam va az butkh'oi shumo kh'arose nadoram, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki K'ur'onro baroi kh'idoiati mardum bar man nozil namud va U bandagoni solekh'ashro korsozi va mukh'ofizat menamoiad va kumakashon merasonad.

197) Va ei mushrikon, on butkh'oe, ki ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ibodat mekuned, k'udrati kumaki shumoro nadorand va kh'atto az ukh'dai iori dodani khud namebaroiand. Ma'budkh'oi sun'ii shumo mavch'udoti bisior notavonand. Pas chi guna va bo kadom ak'l onkh'oro meparasted?!

198) Va ei mushrikon, agar ma'budkh'oiatonro ba rokh'i durust faro khoned, da'vati shumoro nameshunavand va vak'ti dar muk'obilat k'aror giriftan, onkh'oro doroi chashmoni sun'i mebini va chunon menamoiand, ki guio mebinand va dar asl onkh'o chizero dida nametavonand. Mushrikon on zamon butkh'oiashonro ba surati inson va io kh'aivon mesokhtand. On butkh'o dastu poi va chashm doshtand, ammo bech'on budand va kh'arakat namekardand.

199) Ei Paiombar, az mardum on korkh'o va akhlok'ero, ki baroiashon oson boshad va tavoni takh'ammulashro doshta boshand, bipazir va ba korkh'oi az takh'ammulashon berun vodorashon makun. Zero in kor onkh'oro az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mutanaffir mesozad. Va mardumro ba kh'ar sukhani zeboiu amali solekh' farmon bidekh' va az shakhsoni ch'okh'il rui bigardon. Raftori ch'okh'ilonai onkh'oro bo raftori ch'okh'ilona ch'avob madekh'. Kh'ar ki turo ozor dikh'ad, dar ch'avobash uro ozor madekh' va kh'ar ki turo az chize makh'rum gardonad, dar ch'avobash uro makh'rum magardon.

200) Va ei Firistodai Mo, vak'te vasvasai Shaiton io sust shudan az anch'omi kori nekro ekh'sos kardi, dar kh'ol ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) panokh' bibar va ba U chang bizan. Zero begumon U sukhanatro meshunavad va ba U panokh' burdanatro medonad. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo az vasvasakh'oi Shaiton kh'imoiat mekunad.

201) Kh'amono kasone, ki bo ich'ro kardani dasturot va duri ch'ustan az mamnuot az uk'ubati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ez mekunand, chun duchori vasvasai Shaiton gashta, gunokh' sodir kunand, zud azamati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), uk'ubati isionkoron va savobi farmonbardoronro ba khotir ovarda, favran az gunokh' tavba namuda, ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bozmegardand. Pas nogakh'on onkh'o ba sababi iodovari bino shuda, ba khud meoiand va az gunokh' boz meistand.

202) Va shaitonkh'o mudom gumrokh'ii barodaroni badkoru kofiri khudro bo gunokh' andar gunokh' afzoish medikh'and. Va na shaiotin az vasvasa va gumrokh'sozi dast mekashand va na insonkh'oi badkor az itoati onkh'o va amali zisht khuddori mekunand.

203) Va ei Paiombar, chun ba onkh'o oiat biiori, turo durug'gui donista, az on rui megardonand va agar ba onkh'o oiat naori, meguiand: "Charo az peshi khud oiat ikhtiro' nakardi va nabofti?!" Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Man kh'ak' nadoram, ki az nazdi khud oiat biioram va ch'uz az on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiam paig'om mefiristad, pairavi namekunam. In K'ur'one, ki ba shumo mekhonam, kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi az sui Parvardigori Chorasozi korkh'o omada va baroi bandagoni mu'min kh'idoiatgar va rakh'mat ast. Ammo kofiron az kh'idoiat va rakh'mat makh'rum kh'astand."
204) Va chun K'ur'on tilovat shavad, bo kh'avasmandi onro gush kuned, kh'angomi k'iroat sukhan nakuned va ba digar korkh'o mashg'ul nashaved, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro rakh'mat kunad.

205) Va Allokh'i Parvardigoratro dar kh'olati furutani, tavozu' va kh'aros zikr kun va duoi khudro dar avvalu okhiri ruz baini sadoi pastu baland, dar kh'addi miiona nigokh' bidor, chunki in du vak't fazilati khos dorad va az zumrai bandagoni az iodi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) g'ofil mabosh.

206) Ei Paiombar, kh'amono farishtagone, ki nazdi Parvardigorat kh'astand, az ibodati U kibr va sarkashi namekunand, balki mutei toati U buda, susti namevarzand va onkh'o shabu ruz Uro az on chi sazovor nest, ba poki iod mekunand va tankh'o ba U sach'da menamoiand.

1) Ei Paiombar! Sakh'obagonat az tu dar borai chi guna tak'simshavii molkh'oi g'animat va tak'simkunandaash mepursand? Dar posukhashon bigu: "Molkh'oi g'animat az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasuli Ust. Kh'ukmi tasarruf va tak'sim kardani on niz dar ikhtiiori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasuli U ast. Vazifai shumo tankh'o az itoat namudan va taslim gashtan iborat meboshad. Ei bandagoni boimon, pas bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va bo istifoda az ech'odi alok'ai barodari, dusti, akhlok'i nek va guzashtan az lag'zhishkh'oi iakdigar vaz'i badi ch'udoi va ba kh'am pusht gardondanatonro islokh' kuned. Va agar vok'ean mu'min kh'asted, pas itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasuli Uro bar khud lozim gired." Zero imon shakhsro ba farmonbardori va duri az gunokh' vodor mesozad.

2) Mu'minoni kh'ak'ik'i kasone kh'astand, ki vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iod karda shavad, dilashon ba larza omada, onro tars faro megirad, pas k'alb va ch'ismashon ba sui itoat ravona megardad va chun oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar onkh'o tilovat shavad, oidi ma'noiash andeshida, imonashon afzoish meiobad va dar ch'albi manfiat va dur kardani kh'ama guna zarar tankh'o ba Parvardigori Iagonaashon e'timod mekunand.

3) Onone, ki doim namozi khudro dar vak'tkh'oi muk'arrari bo rioiai tamomi sifatkh'oi on ado menamoiand va az on chi bar onkh'o rizk' dodaem, ba mardumi tangdast sadak'akh'oi farzi va nofilaashonro mepardozand.

4) Shakhsoni doroi sifatkh'oi iodshuda mu'minoni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand. Zero in toifa mardum khislatkh'oi zokh'irivu botinii imonu islomro ch'am' kardaand. Podoshashon dar nazdi Parvardigorashon darach'akh'oi baland, mag'firati gunokh'on va ruzii neki nogusastani ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ch'annat baroi onkh'o in ne'matkh'oi ch'ovidonaro omoda sokhta ast.

5) On guna ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tak'simi molkh'oi g'animatro ba'di atrofi on ikhtilofi nazar va bakh's surat giriftan az shumo girifta, ba Khud va Paiombarash (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ikhtisos dod, kh'amchunin Parvardigorat turo (Paiombar) bo mak'sadi mulok'oti mushrikon baroi berun shudan az Madina ba kh'ak' dastur dod va kh'ol on ki gurukh'e az mu'minon inro khush nadoshtand. Dasturi in kor bo paig'omi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba vuk'u' paivasta bud.

6) Ei Paiombar, in toifai mu'minon bo tu dar borai ch'angidan bo mushrikon ba'di ma'lum shudani vuk'ui on tavre munozara mekunand, ki guio ba sui marg ronda shuda va onkh'o onro oshkor mushokh'ida dorand. Illati in kh'olatashon dar on ast, ki onkh'o az Madina baroi ch'ang berun shudanro sakht namekhokh'and. Zero onkh'o baroi ch'angidan bo mushrikon omodagii zaruri nagiriftaand.

7) Va ei mu'minoni ch'idolkunanda, ba iod ored on zamonero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo zafarmandi bar iake az du toifai mushrikonro va'da dod. Parvardigor ba shumo va'da doda bud, ki io kh'amai shuturoni mushrikonro bo tamomi doroii on kh'amchun g'animat ba dast meored va io dar korzori nabard bo onkh'o ch'angida, piruz megarded. Va shumo dust medoshted, ki shuturoni mushrikonro be nabard ba dast ored, zero in kor baroiaton dar k'iios bo ch'ang oson bud va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kalimakh'oiash bo dastur dodan ba nabardi mushrikon mekhokh'ad kh'ak'ro ba kh'ak'dor rasonad va sarkardagonashon kushta shuda, beshtarashon asir gardida, buniodi onkh'o k'at' gardad va dini Islom piruz shavad.

8) To in ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo piruz sokhtani Islom va akh'li on kh'ak'ro sobit sozad va in bo oshkor kardani dalelkh'oi isbotkunandai rostii in oiin surat megirad va inchunin butloni botilro isbot namoiad va agarchi mushrikon inro nakhokh'and. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Islomro piruz mesozad.

9) Va ei mu'minon, ruzi ch'angi Badrro iod kuned, on gokh', ki baroi piruzi alaikh'i dushmanonaton az Parvardigoraton kumak khosted, pas darkhostatonro paziruft, ki "Man ba shumo bo kh'azor adad farishta, ki paiopai meoiand, madad merasonam."

10) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro bo firistodani farishtagon tankh'o baroi dodani in muzhda madad kard, ki begumon bar ziddi dushmanon ioriaton mekunad va to in ki k'albkh'oi shumo bo iak'in doshtan ba piruzi orom girad. Va piruzi bo adadi ziiod va farokh'am budani lavozimoti g'olibiiat kh'osil namegardad, balki on fak'at az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar mulki Khud kh'amesha G'olib buda, kase Uro mag'lub namesozad va dar akh'kom va ta'iini tak'dirot bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

11) Ei mu'minon, ba khotir ored on gokh', ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi ekh'sosi emini az on tarse, ki dar dilaton az dushman paido gashta bud, ba shumo khobi sabukero afkand va bar shumo az sui osmon boron furud ovard, to bo on az nopokikh'o pokaton kunad va vasvasakh'oi shaitonro az shumo dur sozad va dilatonro baroi ustuvorii ch'ismaton kh'angomi mulok'ot bo dushman mustakh'kam namoiad va bo namnok kardani zamini regi k'adamatonro ustuvor sozad, ki dar zamin furu naravad.

12) Ei Paiombar, ba khotir biior on zamonero, ki Parvardigorat ba farishtagone, ki ba vasilai onkh'o dar ch'angi Badr mu'minonro kumak namud, paig'om firistod, ki: "Ei farishtagon, Man beshak bo kumak va dastgiri kh'amrokh'i shumoiam. Baroi kh'amin irodai mu'minonro dar ch'ang alaikh'i dushmanonashon k'avi gardoned. Man ba zudi dar dili kofiron kh'arosi sakhtro ch'oigir mekunam. Pas ei mu'minon, gardani kofironro bizaned, to bimirand va az onkh'o kh'ar tarafi dastkh'o va poikh'oiashonro bizaned, to az ch'ang boz monand."

13) Sababi k'atli kofiron va buridani dastu poii onkh'o dar on ast, ki eshon bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash mukholifat kardand. Farmonkh'oi onkh'oro ich'ro nakardand va az on chi nakh'i namudaand, boz naistodand. Va kh'ar ki bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash mukholifat kunad, pas iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro dar dunio bo kushta shudan, dar bandi asorat aftodan va dar okhirat bo giriftor sokhtanash ba otashi duzakh sakht uk'ubat mekunad.
14) In azob baroi shumo mukholifoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasul ast. Pas, in uk'ubati favrii in dunioro bichashed va dar ruzi okhirat agar kofir bimired, baroiaton azobi duzakh ast.

15) Ei on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, vak'te dar maidoni nabard bo mushrikon dar kh'olati bo iakdigar nazdik ru ba ru megarded, pas ba onkh'o pusht nagardoned va firor nakuned. Balki dar barobarashon ustuvor boshed va kh'angomi bo onkh'o dar nabard mulok'ot kardan sabrro pesha kuned. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kumak va dastgirii Khud kh'amrokh'i shumo ast.

16) Va kh'ar kas az maidoni nabard ba kofiron pusht gardonida, megurezad, pas begumon az maidon bo g'azabi Parvardigor bozgashta, sazovori khashmi U meshavad va ch'oiash dar okhirat duzakh ast va on ch'oii bozgashti nikh'oiat bad ast, ba istisnoi on ki ch'angovar k'asdi ba ch'angi onkh'o bozgashtanro doshta, dar zokh'ir az maidon pusht gardonida, in amali khudro baroi kofiron kh'amchun firor nishon medikh'ad, ammo dar asl az in kh'olat kh'amchun vasilai makri ch'angi istifoda mebarad va mak'sadi dubora ba ch'angi onkh'o bargashtanro dorad io az maidon pusht megardonad, vale ba gurukh'i digari ch'angovaron mepaivandad. Agar shakhsi much'okh'id ba in mak'sad az nabardi kofiron pusht gardonad, pas vai ba kh'ukmi bolo zikrshuda dokhil nameshavad.

17) Pas ei mu'minon, shumo dar ruzi ch'angi Badr mushrikonro bo tavonoii khud nakushted, valekin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton dar in kor kumak rasonid. Va ei Paiombar vak'te mushti khokro ba sui kofiron afkandi, onro tu naafkandi, balki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro afkanda, ba nishon rasond va to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az nazdi Khud mu'minonro bo ne'mati piruzi bar mushrikon, sarfi nazar az kamii te'dod va lavozimoti ch'angiashon ozmoish kunad, ki oio shukrashro ich'ro mesozed. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) duovu guftorkh'oi shumoro meshunavad, amalkh'o va manfiatkh'oiatonro medonad.

18) On chi dar borai k'atli mushrikon va afkandani khok bar rui onkh'o, ki sababi shikastashon shud va piruzii te'dodi kami mu'minon alaikh'i dushmanonashon zikr shud, tankh'o az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bud va beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) makri kofironro, ki ziddi Islom dasisa mekunand, notavon megardonad.

19) Ei mushrikon, agar shumo az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) darkhosti onro dored, ki azobashro bar zolimon furud orad, pas, beshubkh'a, talabi kardaatonro bar khudi shumo vok'e' kunonida ast. Bar shumo on azobero nozil kard, ki baroiaton uk'ubat va baroi bandagoni parkh'ezgor darsi ibrat ast. Va agar az in talabi khud khuddori kuned, baroiaton bekh'tar ast. Chunki shoiad Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) to imruz ba shumo mukh'lat doda, favran intik'om nagirifta ast. Va agar ba talabi kheshtan va ch'angidan bo mu'minon bozgarded, Mo niz bo ovardani azob bar shumo va piruzsozii mu'minon bozmegardem va ch'amoatu iovaronaton agarchi doroi adadi ziiodu lavozimoti zarurii ch'angi buda, shumorai mu'minon kam kh'am boshad, azobi Mo va piruzii akh'li imonro az shumo dur karda nametavonad. Va ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo dastgiri va nusratash bo mu'minon ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kh'ar bandae boshad, kh'ech' kas uro shikast namedikh'ad.

20) Ei mu'minon, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarashro itoat namoed va az Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bo mukholifati farmonash rui nagardoned va kh'ol on ki oiatkh'oi baroiaton tilovatshavandaro meshunaved.

21) Va ei mu'minon, monandi kofironu munofik'one naboshed, ki vak'te bar onkh'o oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tilovat meshavad, meguiand: "On chi baroi mo az K'ur'on tilovat shud, shunidem." Dar kh'ole ki onkh'o bo tafakkur va ibratpaziri onro nameshunavand, to manfiat girand.

22) Kh'amono badtarin khazandai zamin nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mavch'udoti noshunavoe kh'astand, ki kh'ak'ik'atro dar amal nameshunavand, az guftani kh'ak'ik'at lol buda, amr va nakh'ii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dark namekunand.

23) Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar vuch'udi mushrikoni takzibgar khairero medonist, kh'ak'ro ba onkh'o tavre meshunavonid, ki az on sud meburdand va kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi Moro mefakh'midand, ammo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonad, ki dar onkh'o kh'ech' khaire nest. Va agar ba farzi misol, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ak'ro ba onkh'o meshunavonid, onkh'o az az on sarpechi menamudand va onkh'o bo iakravii khesh ruigardonand.

24) Ei mu'minon! Vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash shumoro ba sui kh'ak', ki sababi kh'aioti shumost, faro mekhonand, bo itoat kardani dasturoti onkh'o da'vatashonro bipazired. Va iak'in doshta boshed, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tamomi kor k'udrat dorad. U k'udrat dorad, ki miioni shumovu kh'ak'ik'at, vak'te ba'di rad namudanash dubora mekhokh'ed onro k'abul kuned, monea ech'od kunad va digar onro pazirufta natavoned. Baroi kh'amin ba sui kh'ak' bishitobed va bidoned, ki ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ashr meshaved, pas shumoro dar ivazi korkh'oi dar dunio anch'omdodaaton podosh medikh'ad.

25) Va ei mu'minon, az on uk'ubate biparkh'ezed, ki az shumo fak'at domani nofarmonkh'oro namegirad, balki nofarmonu farmonbardor kh'amagi duchorash meshavand. In azobi umumi vak'te meoiad, ki zulm kh'ama ch'oro faro girad va peshi rokh'i on girifta nameshavad. Va iak'in doshta boshed, ki uk'ubati ilokh'i baroi shakhsi nofarmon bisior sakht ast. Ba kh'amin sabab, az nofarmonii U biparkh'ezed.

26) Ei mu'minon, ba iod ored on zamonero, ki dar Makka te'dodaton andak bud, akh'li in sarzamin shumoro notavon donista, ozoraton medodand. Az on khavf doshted, ki dushmanonaton shumoro meraboiand. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro dar sarzamini Madina panokh' dod va dar maidonkh'oi nabard, az ch'umla dar ch'angi Badr bo noil gashtan ba piruzi alaikh'i dushman nerumand sokht va az ne'matkh'oi pok baroiaton ruzi namud. Az ne'matkh'oi pok on molkh'oi g'animatest, ki onro dar maidon az dushmanon girifted. In kh'amaro ba shumo ato kard, to baroi ne'matkh'oiash Uro shukrguzori kuned va shukri ne'mat sababi afzoish ioftani on meshavad va az nosiposi biparkh'ezed, ki lutfu ekh'soni Khudro az dastaton girifta, ba azob giriftoraton mesozad.

27) Ei mu'minon! Bo tarki dasturot va adami parkh'ez az mamnuot ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash khiionat makuned va ba on chi baroiaton az din va g'airi on amonat doda shuda ast, khiionat makuned va kh'ol on ki shumo khiionat budani kori khud va farch'omi khiionatkoriro medoned.

Chun dar bisior kh'olat mukh'abbati molu farzand boisi khiionatkori megardad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati zerin vasilai ozmoish budani on duro khabar doda meguiad:
28) Va ei mu'minon, bidoned, ki molkh'o va farzandonaton baroi shumo az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vasilai ozmoish kh'astand. Gokh'o shumoro az amali okhirat man' namuda, ba khiionatkori mebarand. Va bidoned, ki nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) podoshi buzurg ast. Naboiad bo mak'sadi rioiai khotiri farzandon va kh'ifzi amvolaton khiionatkori karda, az savobi nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) makh'rum moned.

29) Ei mu'minon! Bidoned, ki agar bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed, U baroiaton ilm va kh'idoiate medikh'ad, ki bo on k'udrati ch'udosozii kh'ak'ik'at az botilro paido mekuned, digar in du baroiaton omekhta namegardad va ba sababi parkh'ezkori a'moli badatonro makh'v megardonad va gunokh'onatonro meomurzad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Sokh'ibi fazli buzurg ast. Iake az alomatkh'oi fazlash omoda kunonidani ch'annat baroi bandagoni parkh'ezkor ast.

30) Ei Paiombar, ba iod biior on zamonero, ki mushrikon baroi kh'amkori bo kh'am ittifok' basta, dasisa mekardand, to turo kh'abs kunand io bikushand va io az Makkai Mukarrama bironand. Va onkh'o mudom makr mekunand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ch'avobi on tadbir namuda, nairangashonro barbod medikh'ad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bekh'tarini chorasozon ast.

31) Va chun oiatkh'oi Mo bar onkh'o tilovat karda shavad, bo sarkashi va iakravi meguiand: "Pesh az in sukhanon monandashro shunidaem. Agar mo niz monandi in K'ur'on sukhan guftan khokh'em, meguem. In K'ur'oni shunidai mo ch'uz afsonakh'oi durug'i peshiniion chize nest. Baroi kh'amin kh'ech' gokh' ba on imon nameorem."

32) Va ei Paiombar, on zamonero ba iod biior, ki mushrikon guftand: "Parvardigoro, agar on chi Mukh'ammad ovardaast, rost boshad, pas az osmon bar mo sangkh'oe bibor, ki kh'alokamon sozad va io baroiamon azobi sakht biior." Mak'sad az in sukhan shadidan rad kardani kh'ak' bud.

33) Va to on zamone, ki tu ei Paiombar, dar baini ummatonat zindai, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo uk'ubati reshakansozanda uk'ubatashon namekunad. Mavch'udiiati tu dar miioni onkh'o vasilai emin mondanashon az uk'ubati ilokh'i ast. Va inchunin to on ki onkh'o baroi gunokh'onashon az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) talabi omurzish mekunand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) azobashon namekunad.

34) Va omadani azobro az kofiron chi man' mekunad, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o ba gunokh'oni man'i mardum az tavofi Khonai Ka'ba va adoi namoz dar on dast mezanand va in korashon boisi uk'ubatashon megardad?! Va mushrikon dustoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nestand. Tankh'o kasone dustoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astand, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va duri ch'ustan az mamnuot parkh'ezkori mekunand. Vale aksari mushrikon namedonand, ki dusti U nestand.

35) Va namozi mushrikon dar nazdi Masch'id-ul-kh'arom ch'uz kh'ushtak kashidan va kafkubi chize nest. Pas ei mushrikon, ba sababi kufr varzidan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va takzibi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) uk'ubatro dar ch'angi Badr bo rokh'i kushta shudan va asorat aftodan bichashed.

36) Kh'amono kofiron amvoli khudro ba mak'sadi peshgirii mardum az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kharch' menamoiand. Pas amvolashonro kharch' mekunand, vale khostaashon kh'argiz takh'ak'k'uk' nameiobad, sipas ok'ibat kori kardai onkh'o boisi kh'asrat va pushaimoniashon megardad, zero kh'am molashon az bain meravad va kh'am ba mak'sadashon namerasand, ba'd az on dar okhir bo g'olibshavii musalmonon mag'lub megardand. Va kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudaand, dar ruzi k'iiomat ba sui duzakh ronda meshavand va dar onch'o abadi memonand.

37) In kofirone, ki molkh'oi khudro baroi peshgiri az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kharch' mekunand, ba sui duzakh ronda meshavand, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) toifai palidi kofironro az toifai poki mu'minon ch'udo kunad va ba'zei ashkhos, a'mol va amvoli palidro bar ba'zei digarash ch'am' va tuda megardonad, pas onkh'oro ba duzakh medarorad. Inkh'o ziionkoroni vok'ei kh'astand. Zero onkh'o dar k'iiomat bar khud va khonadonashon ziion meorand.

38) Ei Paiombar, ba kofironi k'avmat bigu: "Agar onkh'o az kufr varzidan ba Allokh'u Rasulash va man'i mardum az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khuddori kunand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'oni guzashtaashonro mebakhshad, zero paziruftani Islom ma'siiatkh'oi peshinaro makh'v mesozad va agar ba kufrashon bozgardand, pas beshak k'onuni tag'iirnopaziri ilokh'i oidi peshiniion guzashta ast, ki agar onkh'o paiombaronro takzib namuda, kufrashonro idoma dikh'and, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'amin dunio k'abl az okhirat onkh'oro azob medikh'ad."

39) Va ei mu'minon, bo dushmanoni kofiraton to vak'te bich'anged, ki az shirk va man'i mu'minon az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nishone namonad va dinu ibodat tankh'o az oni Allokh'i Iagona gardad. Pas agar kofiron az amali kufr va man'i mardum az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boz istand, onkh'oro ba kh'olashon guzored. Zero iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mekunand, Ogokh' buda, chize az U pushida nest.

40) Va agar onkh'o az korkh'oi badi khesh, ki az kufru man'i mardum az rokh'i Khudo iborat buda, bar tarki on amr shudaand, barnagardand, pas ei mu'minon, iak'in doshta boshed, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro alaikh'i onkh'o kumak mekunad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bekh'tarin Sarparast va Iorirason ast. Kh'ar ki az sui sarparasti shavad, rastagor meshavad va kh'ar ki az U iori binad, ba piruzi merasad.

41) Va ei mu'minon, bidoned, ki on chi bo rokh'i ch'ang dar maidoni ch'ikh'od az kofiron ba dast ovardaed, ba panch' kh'issa tak'sim meshavad. Az panch' chor kh'issai on ba much'okh'idon ch'udo shuda, iak kh'issai bok'imondaash niz ba panch' k'ism tak'sim gashta, k'ismi iakumi on az Khudovu Paiombarash buda, dar masorifi umumii musulmonon sarf megardad, k'ismi duium ba kheshovandoni Paiombar az k'abilai Kh'oshimu Muttalib, kh'issai seium ba iatimon, chorum ba fak'ironu bechoragon va panch'um ba musofironi rokh'monda doda meshavad. Agar shumo dar vok'e' ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ba on chi Mo dar ruzi ch'angi Badr bar bandai Khud Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) firistoda, ba vositai on kh'ak'ro az botil ch'udo kardem, on vak't, ki shumoro kh'angomi mulok'ot bo dushmanonaton piruz gardonidem, imon doshta boshed, pas boiad bo ilmi khesh amal kuned va ba in tak'simot rozi shaved. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki shumoro piruz gardonid, ba kh'amai kor K'odir ast.

42) Va on zamonero ba iod ored, ki shumo dar tarafi nazdiktarini vodi az ch'onibi Madina buded va mushrikon dar tarafi durtarini on az ch'onibi Makka budand va k'ofila dar makoni poiontar az shumo az samti sokh'ili darioi surkh k'aror dosht. Va agar shumo va mushrikon bar ruiorui dar mintak'ai Badr ba kh'am va'da medoded, kh'atman ba'zeaton bo ba'zeaton va'dakhilofi mekarded, vale Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro dar on ch'oi biduni va'dai k'abli ch'am' ovard, to kori muk'addarashro ba itmom rasonad. Kori muk'addar, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro dar ch'angi Badr ba anch'om rasonid, piruzii mu'minon va mag'lubiiati kofiron, izzat ioftani Islom va khoru rasvo gashtani shirku kufr bud. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kori muk'addarshudaro ba itmom rasonid, to in ki kh'ar ki az kofiron ba'di barposhavii kh'uch'ch'at bo piruzii mu'minon, sarfi nazar az kamii te'dod va lavozimoti ch'angiashon kh'alok shudani ast, kh'alok gardad va kh'ar ki az rui daleli baroiash oshkor sokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zinda mondani ast, zinda monad. Minba'd kh'ech' kas muk'obili Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dalel nadorad. Va kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai guftorkh'o, Donandai kirdorkh'o ast. Chize az U makhfi nest va kh'amaro baroi k'avlu amalash ch'azo medikh'ad.

43) Ei Paiombar, lutfkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bar khud va mu'minon ba khotir biior, on gokh', ki te'dodi mushrikonro dar khobat kam nishon dod, sipas mu'minonro az on ogokh' kardi, onkh'o az khobi didaat muzhdai nek giriftand, irodai onkh'o baroi mulok'ot bo dushmanon va ch'angidan bo onkh'o k'avi gasht. Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) te'dodi dushmanonro dar khobat ziiod nishon medod, irodai ioronat notavon shuda, az mulok'oti dushman khavf meburdand va dar borai ch'ang bo dushmanon ikhtilof mekardand, vale Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro az in kh'olat solim nigokh' doshta, az tarsui kh'ifzashon kard va adadi dushmanonro dar nazari Paiombarash andak nishon dod. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai asrori k'albi bandagon ast.

44) Va ei mu'minon, on zamonero iod kuned, ki vak'te bo mushrikon dar maidon rubaru shuded, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) te'dodi onkh'oro baroiaton andak nishon medod, pas in kor ch'ur'ati shumoro baroi ik'domi ch'ang bo onkh'o beshtar namud va adadi shumoro dar nazari akh'li shirk andak nishon medod, sipas akh'li shirk ch'asurona baroi muk'obilaton ch'angidan k'adam mezadand va dar borai ak'ibnishini fikr namekardand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in korro baroi on kard, ki az mushrikon bo kushta va asir gashtanashon intik'om sitonad va bar mu'minon bo piruziashon alaikh'i dushmanon ekh'son namoiad. Va kh'amai korkh'o tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bozgardonida meshavad. Pas badkoron va nekukoronro ba sazoi korashon merasonad.

45) Ei on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon dored va az Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, vak'te bo ch'amoae az kofiron rubaru shaved, pas kh'angomi mulok'otashon ustuvor istoda, tarsui nakuned va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bisior iod kuned va az U khoch'ati khudro bikhokh'ed. Zero fak'at Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kumaki shumo Tavono ast. In guftakh'oro ich'ro kuned, shoiad Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro ba matlubaton noil sokhta, az on chi namekhokh'ed, dur gardonad.

46) Va dar guftoru kirdor va kh'ama kh'olatkh'oiaton farmonbardorii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulashro bar khud lozim bigired va nizo' nakuned. Zero nizo' sababi za'f, tarsui va az miion raftani shavkatu shakh'omataton megardad va kh'angomi mulok'oti dushman sabr kuned. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kumak va ta'iidash bo bandagoni sobir ast. Kh'ar bandae, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ust, kh'atman piruz megardad.

47) Va misli mushrikone, ki bo kibr va khudnamoi az Makka berun shuda, mardumro az daromadan ba dini Khudo man' mekunand, naboshed va on chi anch'om medikh'and, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Ikh'otagari on ast. Kh'atman onkh'oro ba sazoi amalkh'oiashon merasonad.

48) Va ei mu'minon, ne'matkh'oero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo arzoni doshta ast, ba iod ored. Vak'te Shaiton kirdorkh'oi zishti mushrikonro dar nazarashon zebo nishon dod, sipas ch'asorati onkh'oro baroi mulok'ot va ch'angidani musulmonon bedor karda guft: "Imruz kase shumoro mag'lub sokhta nametavonad. Man baroiaton kumak merasonam va az sharri dushmanon baroiaton panokh' medikh'am." Pas vak'te du gurukh'-mu'minon bo farishtagon az iak su va mushrikon bo Shaiton, ki andak ba'd onkh'oro tark khokh'ad kard, az sui digar - rubarui iakdigar istodand, Shaiton pusht gardonida, ru ba firor nikh'od va ba mushrikonguft: "Beshubkh'a, az shumo bezoram. Zero man farishtagonero, ki baroi kumaki mu'minon omadaand, mebinam. Kh'amono az on metarsam, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) maro kh'alok gardonad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Sakhtuk'ubat buda, kase takh'ammuli azobashro nadorad."

49) Va ba iod ored, on gokh', ki munofik'on va bandagoni zaifimon meguftand: "Dini musulmonon onkh'oro fireb dodaast. Baroi onkh'o bo vuch'udi kam budani te'dodu lavozimoti ch'angiashon va ziiodii adadi dushmanon va az nigokh'i kh'arbi much'akh'kh'az budani onkh'o va'dai piruzi dodast." Va in gurukh'i notavonbin dark namekunand, ki kh'ar kas ba Allokh'i Iagona takia karda, ba va'dai dar borai piruzi dodaash e'timod kunad, Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ioriash merasonad va novobasta az kh'addi za'fash uro tankh'o nameguzorad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti kh'amesha G'olibu dar ta'iini k'azovu k'adar va akh'komash bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

50) Va ei Paiombar, agar kofironro medidi, vak'te ki farishtagon ba sakhti ch'onashonro az badan mekashand va farishtagon kh'angomi rui ovardani kofiron bar chekh'ra va vak'ti pusht tofta gurekhtanashon, bar pushtashon zada "Ei kofiron, uk'ubati suzonro bichashed" meguiand, agar on lakh'zakh'oro medidi, kh'olati bisior sakhtro mushokh'ida mekardi.

51) Ei kofiron, sababi in azobi dardovar dar vak'ti k'abzi ch'on va uk'ubati suzon dar k'abru ruzi rastokhez on korkh'oest, ki dar dunio khud bo dasti khud onro anch'om dodaed. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'argiz ba mardum sitam ravo namebinad, balki dar bainashon bo adolat dovari mekunad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Dovari Odil ast.

52) Va in uk'ubati baroi kofiron omada khosi onkh'o nest, balki on k'onuni sobiti ilokh'i buda, dar kh'ar zamonu makon onro bar akh'li kufru shirk amali gardonida ast. Ba durusti ki vak'te pairavoni Fir'avn va ummatkh'oi pesh az onkh'o guzashta ba oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudand, uk'ubati ilokh'i onkh'oro faro girift. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba sababi gunokh'onashon bo ovardani azobi sakht kh'alok gardonid. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti Tavonoi bar bandagoni nofarmon Sakhtuk'ubat ast.

53) Sababi in uk'ubati sakht dar on ast, ki vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi k'avme ne'mat ato kunad, on lutfu ekh'sonashro az onkh'o namegirad, magar on ki onkh'o kh'olati neki khudro az imon, ustuvori dar rokh'i durust va siposguzori az ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i ba kh'olati badi kufr, sarpechi az farmonkh'oi ilokh'i va nosiposii ne'matkh'o tag'iir dikh'and. Va kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai guftori bandagon, Donandai kirdori onkh'ost. Kh'ech' guftoru kirdorashon az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) makhfi nameboshad.

54) Kh'olati in kofiron ba kh'olati digaron ba monandi pairavoni Fir'avn va ummatkh'oi takzibkunandai pesh az onkh'o guzashta shabokh'at dorad. Onkh'o oiatkh'oi Moro takzib kardand, pas ba sababi gunokh'onashon kh'alokashon sokhtem va pairavoni Fir'avnro bo g'ark' namudan dar bakh'r nobud sokhtem. Va kh'ar iake az tobeoni Fir'avn va ummatkh'oi pesh az onkh'o guzashta bo kufr varzidan va shirk ovardan sitamkor budand. Binobar in, sazovori azob gashtand.

55) Kh'amono nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) badtarin mavch'udi dar zamin khazanda kofironand. Pas onkh'o ba sababi isror bar kufr agarchi baroiashon mu'ch'izakh'oi ziiod oiad, imon nameorand va dar kufru shirk pofishori menamoiand. Zero khirad, shunavoi va binoiashon, ki vasilakh'oi kh'idoiat ast, az fakh'midan, shunidan va didani kh'ak'ik'at och'iz gashta ast.

56) Kasone az kofiron ba misli Bani K'uraiza, ki bo onkh'o paimon bastai, boz kh'ar bor on paimonro meshikanand va onkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nametarasand. Baroi kh'amin ba paimonashon vafo namekunand va ba talaboti on poiband namemonand.

57) Pas ei Paiombar, agar dar kh'olati ch'ang bo in gurukh'i akh'dshikan rubaru shavi, onkh'oro bo sangintarin nav'i uk'ubat ch'azo bidekh', to kh'ar kasi digar inro shunida, ch'am'i akh'dshikanon parokanda shuda, shoiad az on chi bar toifai akh'dshikan omadaast, ibrat girand va az ch'angidan bo tu va kumaki dushmanonat bikh'arosand.

58) Va ei Paiombar, agar bo oshkor shudani alomati khiionat az paimonshikanii k'avme, ki bo onkh'o akh'd bastai, bitarsi, pas onkh'oro az bekor kardani paimonashon ogokh' namo, to bo tu dar borai donistani vairon sokhtani paimoni k'ablan bastashuda barobar boshand. Pesh az ogokh' kardanashon az bekor sokhtani akh'dnoma ba tavri nogakh'oni ba onkh'o kh'uch'um makun. Zero kh'uch'um ovardan pesh az ogokh'sozii lag'vi sozishnoma khiionat ast. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khoinonro dust namedorad. Az in ru, az khiionatkori biparkh'ez.
59) Va kofiron gumon nakunand, ki az azobi ilokh'i rakh'oi ioftaand. Kh'ak'k'o, ki onkh'o kh'ech' gokh' az azobi ilokh'i rakh'oi nameioband, balki kh'atman mubtaloi on megardand.

60) Va ei mu'minon, kh'ar chi az te'dod, lavozimot va tirandozi, ki k'udrati omoda sokhtanashro dored va niz asponi baroi rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nigokh'doshtai kheshro omoda namoed, to ba in vasila dushmanoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va dushmani khudro az kofiron, ki kh'ar zamon muntaziri omadani musibat bar sari shumo kh'astand, bitarsoned. Va inchunin ba in vasila k'avmi digarero bitarsoned, ki onkh'oro namedoned va az dushmanii dar dilashon nisbat ba shumo pinkh'on ogokh'i nadored, balki fak'at Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai onkh'o va dushmanii dar dilashon pinkh'on ogokh'i dorad. Va on chi dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), sarfi nazar az mik'dorash kharch' mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo ivazashro dar dunio va okhirat ba purragi medikh'ad va ba shumo zulm karda nameshavad. Pas baroi kharch'i molkh'oi khud dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bishitobed.

61) Va agar onkh'o ba musolakh'a va tarki nabard mail kunand, pas tu niz ei Paiombar, ba on mail namuda, bo onkh'o paimon band va ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia namo. Zero U kh'argiz turo tark namekunad. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai guftor, Donandai mak'sad va kirdori onkh'ost.

62) Va agar mak'sadi onkh'o az mail kardan ba musolakh'a va tarki ch'ang fireb dodani tu boshad, to bo in rokh' ba ch'angi navbati omoda shavand, pas iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiat dar barobari makru firebashon basanda ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki turo bo iorii Khud va dastgirii musulmononi mukh'och'iru ansor k'uvvat doda ast.

63) Va ba'di parokandagi dilkh'oi mu'minonero, ki ba sababi onkh'o turo kumak karda bud, ch'am' ovard va baini dilkh'oiashon ulfat andokht. Agar tamomi doroii zaminro baroi ch'am'sozii k'albkh'oi parokandai onkh'o kharch' menamudi, az ukh'dai in kor namebaromadi va dilkh'oiashonro ch'am' ovarda nametavonisti. Vale Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dilkh'oi parokandaashonro bo kh'am ch'am' ovard. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar mulkash kh'amesha G'olib buda, dar ta'iini tak'diru tadbir va akh'komash bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.
64) Ei Paiombar, Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi nigokh' doshtani tu va mu'minoni kh'amrokh'at az sharri dushmanon basanda ast. Binobar in, tankh'o ba U takia namo.

65) Ei Paiombar, bo kh'ar vasila, ki iroda va kh'immati mu'minonro baroi ch'angidan bo dushman k'avi megardonad, onkh'oro targ'ib kun. Agar az shumo mu'minon muk'obili kofiron bist nafar muborizi bosabr boshad, dusad nafari onkh'oro mag'lub mesozad va agar sad nafari bosabr boshad, kh'azor nafari onkh'oro mag'lub mesozad. Zero kofiron k'avme kh'astand, ki az k'onuni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai g'olib gardonidani dustonash va sarkub sokhtani dushmanonash noogokh' buda, mak'sadi aslii ch'angro namefakh'mand. Chunki mak'sadi asliashon az ch'ang kh'ukmfarmoi bar digaron ast.

66) Inak ei mu'minon, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ukmi k'ablii Khudro az shumo sabuk kard. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) notavoniatonro medonad. Baroi kh'amin bo lutfash ba shumo sabuki ovard. Dar maidon baroi iak nafari shumo muk'obili du nafar kofir ustuvor istodanro farz namud, dar kh'ole ki tibk'i kh'ukmi k'abli boiad iak musulmon dar barobari dakh' kofir ustuvor meistod. Pas, agar dar muk'obili kofiron az shumo sad nafari bosabr boshad, dusad nafari onkh'oro mag'lub megardonad va agar kh'azor nafari bosabr boshad, bo amr va nusrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) du kh'azori onkh'oro mag'lub megardonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo dastgiri va kumakash kh'amrokh'i mu'minoni bosabr ast.

67) Paiombarro sazovor nest, ki dar ikhtiiorash az kofironi bo vai ch'angida asir doshta boshad, magar on ki dar bainashon kushtori bisior kunad, to ba in rokh' dar dilashon tarsro ch'oi dikh'ad va minba'd ba ch'ang bo Paiombar barnagardand. Ei mu'minon, shumo bo asir giriftani kofironi ch'angi Badr mak'sadi kasbi matoi nochizi dunioro dored va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo okhiratero mekhokh'ad, ki bo iorii din metavon ba on noil gasht. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar Zotu sifotash kh'amesha G'olib, dar ta'iini tak'dirot va akh'komash bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

68) Agar kh'ukmi sobik'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki baroiaton giriftani moli g'animat va bakh'oi ozodii asiron kh'alol ast, namebud, begumon ba shumo ba sababi on ki k'abl az omadani paig'om moli g'animat va bakh'oi ozodi giriftaed, az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) azobi sakht merasid.

69) Pas ei mu'minon, moli g'animati az kuffor sitonidai khudro, ki baroi shumo kh'aloli pokiza ast, bikhured. Va bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az man'shudakh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni mu'min bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

70) Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikoni ruzi ch'angi Badr asir aftoda bigu: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dili shumo niiati nekro donad, baroiaton dar ivazi bakh'oi ozodii dodaaton az on bekh'tarro medikh'ad va gunokh'oni shumoro mag'firat mekunad. Pas baroi bakh'oi ozodie, ki az shumo girifta shud, andukh'gin mashaved. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast." In va'dai Parvardigor baroi Abbosi amui Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va digar shakhsoni musulmongashta takh'ak'k'uk' ioft.

71) Va ei Mukh'ammad, agar asiron bo on sukhane, ki baroiat oshkor mekunand, mak'sadi khiionati turo doshta boshand, pas ba durusti, pesh az in bo kufr va akh'dshikani ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khiionat kardand va begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo bar onkh'o piruz gardonid. Pas az onkh'o chand adad kushta va chand adadi digar asir shudand. Agar boz ba khiionatkori bargardand, boiad muntaziri omadani kh'amin guna uk'ubat boshand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai makhluk'ot va on chi ba salokh'i onkh'ost, Dono buda, dar chorasozii korkh'oiashon bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

72) Beshak, kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardand va Paiombarashro tasdik' karda, bo shariatash amal namudand va az diiori kufr ba diiori Islom io kh'ar ch'oi baroi ibodat emin rokh'i kh'ich'ratro pesh giriftand va bo mak'sadi g'olibiiati din molkh'o va ch'onkh'oi khudro dar rokh'i ch'ikh'od bakhshidand va shakhsone, ki in gurukh'i mukh'och'iri much'okh'idro dar manzilkh'oiashon furud ovarda, ba onkh'o kumak namudand, kh'ar du gurukh'i mukh'och'iron va iovaronashon dar bobi kumakrasoni va dastgiri ba'ze dusti ba'zei digar kh'astand. Va kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, az diiori kufr ba diiori Islom kh'ich'rat nakardand, pas ei mu'minon, ba shumo kumak va kh'imoiatashon, magar on ki kh'ich'rat kunand, voch'ib nest. Va agar kofiron bar onkh'o zulm kunand va onkh'o az shumo kumak khokh'and, pas baroiashon muk'obili dushman kumak rasoned, magar vak'te miioni shumo va dushmanonashon paimone boshad, ki onro nashikastaand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tamomi on chi mekuned, Bino ast. Kh'ech' chiz az nazari U makhfi nest va iak'inan shumoro ba ch'azoi kirdoraton merasonad.

73) Va kofiron dar kh'amkori muk'obili shumo ba'zeashon dust va iovari ba'zei digarashon kh'astand. Paivandi kufr onkh'oro alaikh'i shumo ch'am' mesozad. Bo kh'amin paivand iakdigarro iori medikh'and. Mu'min kofironro dusti kheshtan namegirad. Agar shumo mu'minonro dust va kofironro dushman nagired, in amalaton baroi mu'minon boisi fitnai buzurg megardad -zero onkh'o barodaroni kh'amkeshi khudro, ki baroiashon kumak rasonand, paido namekunand- va bo man'i mardum az rokh'i Khudo dar zamin fasodi buzurg ba vuch'ud meoiad.

74) Va kasone, ki imon ovardand va dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ich'rat va ch'ikh'od kardand va kasone, ki mukh'och'ironi rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dar vatani khud ch'oi dodand va kumak namudand, in du gurukh' mu'minoni vok'ei buda, onkh'oro az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mag'firati gunokh'on va ruzii neki ch'annat ast.

75) Va kasone, ki ba'd az shumo mukh'och'iron va ansor imon ovardand va kh'ich'rat kardand va ba khotiri piruzii Islom dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'ikh'od namudand, in ch'amoa az ch'umlai shumo mu'minon kh'astand. Onkh'o ba monandi shumo salokh'iiat va ukh'dadorikh'o dorand. Va kheshovandon dar bobi meros dar kh'ukmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba'zeashon ba ba'zei digarashon az merosbarii k'abli, ki bar asosi imon va kh'ich'rat meros burda meshud, sazovortarand. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ama chiz Dono ast. Kh'ech' chiz az ilmi U makhfi nest. U on chiro ba salokh'i kori bandagon ast, medonad va onro baroiashon dar akh'komash muk'arrar mesozad.
1) In oiatkh'o az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash e'loni bezori va ogokh'ii intikh'oi paimonkh'oest, ki shumo musalmonon dar ch'azirai Arab bo mushrikon bastaed.

2) Pas ei mushrikon, dar in sarzamin muddati chor mokh' dar amnu amon sairu gasht kuned. Ba'd az poion ioftani in muddat shumo digar paimon va amnu amon nadored. Va bidoned, ki agar kufri khudro idoma dikh'ed, kh'ech' gokh' az uk'ubati ilokh'i rakh'oi nameiobed va bidoned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofironro dar dunio bo kushtashavi va asir aftodan va dar okhirat bo darovardan ba duzakh khor mesozad. In kh'ukm shakhsoni akh'dshikan va niz kasonero, ki sozishnomai g'airi muvak'k'ati bastaand, darbar megirad. Ammo on kase, ki paimoni muvak'k'ati dorad, agarchi muddati on az chor mokh' kh'am beshtar boshad, paimoni bastaash to anch'om ioftani muddati ta'iinshuda rioia karda meshavad.

3) Va in oiatkh'o az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash dar ruzi k'urboni ba kh'ama mardum e'lon ast, ki Allokh' va Rasulash az mushrikon bezorand. Pas, ei mushrikon, agar tavba kuned, in baroi shumo bekh'tar ast. Dar surati az tavba rui toftan iak'in doshta boshed, ki az uk'ubati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rakh'oi nameiobed. Va kofironro ba omadani azobi dardovar "muzhda" bidekh'. Azobi nikh'oiat sakht muntaziri onkh'o ast.

4) Magar on mushrikone, ki bo onkh'o paimon basted va ba paimoni khesh vafo namuda, az on kh'ech' chizro nak'z nakardaand. In toifa az kh'ukmi guzashta ch'udoiand. Pas ba paimonashon to tamomshavii muddatash vafo kuned. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagonero, ki bo ich'roi amrkh'o va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o tak'vo mekunand, dust medorad. Vafo ba paimon va parkh'ez az khiionatkori az ch'umlai dasturoti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

5) Pas, chun muddati chor mokh'e, ki dar on dushmanonatonro amon dodaed, ba anch'om rasad, dar kh'ar kuch'o bo mushrikon vokhurded, onkh'oro bikushed va onkh'oro asir gired dar k'al'akh'oiashon mukh'osiraashon kuned va dar kh'ar sari rokh'i eshon kamin nishined. Pas, agar az shirk ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavba karda, namozashonro barpo dorand va zakoti moli khudro bidikh'and, dar in kh'olat onkh'o barodaroni dinii shumo shudaand, Az in ru, muk'obilashon ch'angidanro tark namoed. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni tavbakor bisior Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

6) Va agar iake az mushrikone, ki rekhtani khun va sitonidani molash durust ast, az tu Paiombar panokh'andagi khokh'and, darkhostashro bipazir, to K'ur'onro bishunavad, sipas uro ba ch'oi baroiash doroi amn birason. In kh'ukm baroi on ast, ki kofiron k'avmi az kh'ak'ik'atkh'oi in din noogokh' meboshand. Agar kofiron bo shunidani K'ur'on az kh'ak'ik'atkh'oi Islom ogokh' shavand, shoiad kh'idoiat ioband.

7) Durust nest, ki mushrikon nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash sokh'ibi paimon va amnu amon boshand, magar paimoni on mushrikone, ki shumo musulmonon dar sulkh'i Kh'udaibiia dar nazdi Masch'id-ul-kh'arom bo onkh'o paimon basted. Pas to on vak'te ki onkh'o bar paimoni bo shumo bastaashon bok'i monda, onro nameshikanand, shumo niz bar on bok'i bimoned va onro nashikaned. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni parkh'ezkorashro, ki dasturoti Uro ich'ro mekunand, dust medorad.

8) Chi guna onkh'o metavonand sokh'ibi paimon va amnu amon boshand, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o dushmanaton buda, agar bar shumo piruz shavand, nisbat ba shumo na kh'ak'i kheshi va na paimonro rioia namekunand, balki ba sakhtarin azob giriftoraton mesozand?! Onkh'o shumoro bo sukhani shirine, ki az zabonashon mebaroiad, rozi mesozand, vale dilashon bo zabonashon iakson nest. Baroi kh'amin ba paimoni khud vafo namekunand. Va beshtarashon ba sababi akh'dshikani az toati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khorich'and.

9) Onkh'o pairavi namudan ba oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro, ki vafo ba akh'd ch'uz'i on ast, bo bakh'oi nochizi matoi dunio ivaz kardand. Matoi dunio baroi onkh'o rokh'i rasidan ba khostakh'oi nafs ast. Pas khud az pairavii kh'ak' boz istoda, az on rui toftand va digaronro niz az on boz doshtand. Ba durusti ki onkh'o amalkh'oi nikh'oiat badero anch'om medodand.

10) Onkh'o nisbat ba kh'ech' mu'mine kh'ak'i kheshovandi va akh'dro rioia namekunand. Zero ba mu'minon adovati sakht dorand. Va inkh'o k'avmi az marzkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guzaranda kh'astand. Chunki doroi sifoti zolimi va tach'ovuzkori meboshand.

11) Pas agar az kufri khud ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavba karda, kalimai shakh'odatro ba zabon orand va namozro barpo dorand va zakoti molro dikh'and, beshak, musulmon shuda, barodari diniaton makh'sub meshavand. Dar in surat onkh'o niz monandi shumo sokh'ibi salokh'iiat va ukh'dadorikh'o megardand. Muk'obilashon ch'angidan kh'alol nest. Zero Islom molu khunu nomusashonro makh'fuz gardonida ast. Va Mo oiatkh'oi Khudro baroi k'avme, ki medonand, baion mekunem. Zero shakhsoni sokh'ibdonish az oiatkh'oi Mo istifoda mebarand va ba digaron niz foida merasonand.

12) Va agar in mushrikone, ki bo onkh'o to iak muddati muaiian oidi nach'angidan paimon basted, paimonashonro vairon kunand va ba dini shumo aib girifta, onro ta'na zanand, pas bo onkh'o bich'anged. Zero onkh'o peshvoion va rakh'baroni kufrand. Minba'd paimone, ki to imruz khuni onkh'oro makh'fuz medosht, nadorand. Muk'obilashon bich'anged, to az kufr varzidan, akh'dshikani va aibu ta'ni dinaton khuddori kunand.

13) Ei mu'minon, charo bo k'avme, ki paimonashonro shikasta, dar ch'am'omadi dar Doru-n-nadva doir sokhtaashon baroi ikhroch'i Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az Makka tasmim giriftand, namech'anged?! Dar kh'ole ki bori nakhust onkh'o bo kumak rasonidan ba k'abilai Bakri kh'ampaimoni K'uraish bar ziddi k'abilai Khuzoai kh'ampaimoni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bo shumo ch'angidanro og'oz namudand. Oio az onkh'o metarsed, ki muk'obilashon namech'anged?! Agar mu'mini kh'ak'ik'i boshed, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sazovortar ast, ki az U bitarsed.

14) Ei mu'minon, bo in gurukh'i mushrikon bich'anged. Zero agar bo onkh'o bich'anged, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavassuti dastoni shumo eshonro uk'ubat mekunad. Azob dodani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro bo rokh'i az sui shumo kushta shudanashon surat megirad. Va inchunin onkh'oro bo shikast dodan dar maidoni ch'ang va asir aftodan khor megardonad va shumoro bo piruz sokhtan kumak mekunad va dardi dilkh'oi k'avmi mu'minero, ki dar ch'ang kh'ozir nabudand, bo kushta gashtani dushmanon, asir aftodani onkh'o va g'olib shudani akh'li imon shifo mebakhshad.

15) Va bo noil gashtani mu'minon ba piruzi khashmi dilashonro dur megardonad va dar surati tavba kardani in k'avmi iakravi sarkash -chunone ruzi fatkh'i Makka az tarafi ba'zekh'o in guna kh'olat pesh omad- Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az baini onkh'o tavbai kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, mepazirad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai sadok'ati shaskhi tavbakunanda buda, dar ofarinish, tadbiri korkh'oi makhluk'ot va akh'komash bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

16) Ei mu'minon, oio mepindored, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro biduni ozmoish meguzorad?! Imtikh'on dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az ch'umlai k'onunkh'oi kh'ameshagi ast. Kh'atman shumo mavridi sanch'ish k'aror megired, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) much'okh'idoni boikhlosatonro az g'airi onkh'o ch'udo kunad ba digaron ma'lum sozad, on kasonero, ki baroi khud ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash va mu'minon az kofiron dusti pinkh'on va makh'rami roz nagiriftaand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mekuned, Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nameboshad va kh'atman shumoro ba sazoi amalkh'oiaton merasonad.

17) Mushrikonro sazovor nest, ki bo ibodat va nav'kh'oi toati khud masch'idkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro obod kunand, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o bo oshkorsozii kufr ba kofir budani khud e'tirof dorand. In ch'amoa a'molashon ba sababi az dast dodani imon, ki sharti k'abulshavii a'moli nek ast, botil shudaast va onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat ba duzakh daromada, dar on ch'ovidon memonand, magar on ki pesh az marg az amali shirkashon tavba kunand.

18) Ba durusti, kase sazovori obodsozii masch'id buda, in vazifaro ba tavri shoisat ich'ro mekunad, ki ba Allokh'i Iagona imon ovarda, az shirk biparkh'ezad va niz ba ruzi k'iiomat imon dorad va namozro barpo medorad va zakoti molashro mepardozad va g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) digar az kase nametarsad. Pas umed ast, ki in gurukh' az ch'umlai kh'idoiatioftagon ba rokh'i rost boshand. Ammo mushrikon az kh'idoiati ilokh'i durand.

19) Ei mushrikon, oio anch'omdikh'andagoni vazifakh'oi ob dodan ba zoironi khonai Khudo va obodsozii Masch'id-ul-kh'aromro bo shakhse, ki ba Allokh'i Iagona va ruzi okhirat imon ovarda va ba mak'sadi piruzii din va mag'lubiiati kofiron bo ch'onu moli khud ch'ikh'od kardaast, barobar gardonidaed?! Oio shumo in du gurukh'ro az rui fazilat nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barobar medoned?! Inkh'o kh'argiz nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barobar nestand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on kasone, ki ba sababi shirk ovardan sitam namudand agarchi ba misli ob dodan ba zoironi khonai Khudo kori nek kh'am kunand, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i durustro namedikh'ad.

20) Kasone, ki imon ovardand va az k'alamravi kufr ba kishvarkh'oi islomi kh'ich'rat kardand va bo amvol va ch'onashon dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'ikh'od namudand, mak'omashon nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az digaron buzurgtarand. Va kh'amin gurukh'i mavsuf bo ba dast ovardani ch'annat rastagoronand.
