21) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gurukh'i mu'mini mukh'och'iri much'okh'idro az shomil shudan ba rakh'matash va izkh'ori khushnudiash ogokh' sokhta, onkh'oro bashorat medikh'ad, digar kh'argiz ba onkh'o khashm namegirad va inchunin onkh'oro ba dukhuli bog'kh'oi doroi ne'matkh'oi ch'ovidona bashorat medikh'ad.

22) Onkh'o dar on bog'kh'o abadi memonand. Inkh'o podoshi amalkh'oi shoistaest, ki dar dunio anch'om medodand. Kh'amono dar nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi on bandagone, ki dasturotashro kholisona ich'ro mekunand, savobi buzurg ast.

23) Ei on shakhsone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, az dini ovardai Paiombarash pairavi mekuned, agar padaron va barodaroni nasabiaton va digar kheshovandoni nazdikaton kufrro az imon ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muk'addam guzorand, onkh'oro bo oshkor sokhtani asrori mu'minon va dar korkh'oiaton mashvarat pursidan baroi khud dust nagired. Va kh'ar kas onkh'oro bo vuch'udi dar kufr bok'i mondanashon baroi khud dust megirad, ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro nofarmoni karda, ba sababi sodir namudani in ma'siiat ch'onashro ba kh'alokat andokhta, dar kh'ak'k'i khud zulm kardaast.

24) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei mu'minon! Agar padaronaton va farzandonaton va barodaronaton va kh'amsaronaton va kheshovandonaton va amvoli kasbkardaaton va tich'orate, ki rivoch'i onro khosta, az kasod gashtanash kh'aros dored va khonakh'oi pisandidaaton baroi shumo az Allokh' va Paiombarash va ch'ikh'od dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) makh'bubtar boshad, pas muntaziri furud omadani uk'ubat va ch'azoi sakht bimoned." Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni az amrash berun tavfik'i ich'roi amalkh'oero, ki Uro rozi mesozad, namedikh'ad.

25) Ei mu'minon, kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo vuch'udi kam budani te'dod va ba tavri zaruri farokh'am nabudani lavozimoti ch'angi, shumoro dar ch'oikh'oi ziiod alaikh'i dushmanonaton kumak kard. In g'olibiiatkh'o zamone nasibaton gardid, ki tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavakkul namuda, az vasilakh'oi moddi istifoda burded va mag'ruri adadi khud nagashted. Va ammo ruzi ch'angi Kh'unain, ki bisior budani te'dodaton shumoro mag'rur sokht, pas, gufted: "Imruz mag'lub namegardem, zero adadamon ziiod ast", vale in adadi ziiod, ki boisi mag'rur shudanaton gashta bud, baroiaton kh'ech' foidae naovard, dushmanonaton muk'obilaton piruz shudand va zamin bo vuch'udi pakh'noi baroiaton tang shud, sipas az nabardi dushman dar kh'olati mag'lubiiat pusht gardonida, firor karded.

26) Sipas ba'di gurekhtanaton az dushman Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) taskini Khudro bar Paiombarash va bar mu'minon nozil namud. Ba'd az in kh'ama baroi nabardi dushmanon ustuvor gashtand. Va farishtagonero furud ovard, ki shumo onkh'oro namedided. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofironro bo kushta shudan, asir aftodan, sitonidani amvol va kaniz gashtani zanonashon azob dod va in azob ch'azoi kofironest, ki Paiombarashonro takzib karda, az oiinash rui gardonidand.

27) Sipas kh'ar kas ba'di chashidani on uk'ubat az kufru gumrokh'ii khesh tavba kunad, Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbai uro mepazirad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi bandagoni tavbakor bisior Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Ba'di kofir shudan va sodir kardani ma'siiat niz ba sharti on ki az rokh'i khud bargardand, tavbai onkh'oro k'abul mekunad.

28) Ei on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash imon ovarda, az oiini ovardaash pairavi mekuned, kh'amono mushrikon palidand. Zero dar vuch'udi onkh'o kufr, sitamkori, akhlok'i zisht va odatkh'oi bad ch'oigir shuda ast. Binobar in, ba'd az kh'amin solashon, ki soli nukh'umi kh'ich'ri ast, agarchi bo mak'sadi ziiorati kh'ach' io adoi umra kh'am boshad, naboiad ba sarzamini Kh'aram va Masch'idi Kh'arom daroiand. Va ei mu'minon, agar khavf dored, ki ba sababi man'i vurudi mushrikon az khurdanikh'o va tich'oratkh'oi az tarafi onkh'o ch'albshavanda makh'rum shuda, duchori fak'r megarded, pas ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) agar khokh'ad, shumoro az fazlash tavongar mesozad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai kh'olati shumo buda, dar on chi baroiaton tadbir mekunad, bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

29) Ei mu'minon, bar muk'obili kofiron az iakh'udu nasoro, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amchun Ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ii bemisl va ba ruzi k'iiomat imon nameorand, az kh'aromkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash ba misli murdor, gushti khuk, sharob, ribo va g'airi on parkh'ez namekunand va ba dini barkh'ak' tobe' nameshavand, to vak'ti bo dastashon dar kh'olati khorivu mag'lubiiat suporidani ch'izia (moliiot) bich'anged.

30) Va k'avmi iakh'udu nasoro mushrik kh'astand. Iakh'udikh'o vak'te da'vo kardand, ki Uzair pisari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, bo in sukhan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk ovardand va nasronikh'o vak'te Isoi Masekh'ro pisari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khondand, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk ovardand. In sukhani boftaro biduni dalel bo dakh'onashon gufta, dar in bobat ba mushrikoni k'abli shabokh'at dorand, ki gufta budand: "Farishtagon dukhtaroni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meboshand." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az in tukh'mati onkh'o Pok ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'alokashon gardonad, ki chi guna az kh'ak'ik'ati oshkor ba sui botil gardonida meshavand?!

31) Iakh'udikh'o donishmandon va nasronikh'o rukh'oniioni khudro g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'bud giriftand. Olimoni iakh'ud va obidoni nasoro baroi pairavonashon kh'alolro kh'arom va kh'aromro kh'alol megardonidand. Va nasronikh'o Masekh'i pisari Mariamro baroi khesh ma'bud sokhtand, dar kh'ole ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) donishmandoni iakh'ud, rukh'oniioni nasoro, Uzair va Masekh'i pisari Mariamro tankh'o ba ibodati Ma'budi Iagonai Bemisl dastur doda bud. Ma'budi Iagonai barkh'ak' Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Ba g'airi U kase sazovori ibodat nest. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mushrikon ba U sharik k'aror medikh'and, pok ast.

32) In kofiron va digar raviiakh'oi akh'li kufr bo durug'bofi va takzibi on chi Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ovarda ast, mekhokh'and Islom va dalelkh'oi oidi isboti vakh'doniiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mavch'udro az bain barand va botil kunand va beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dini Khudro komil karda, bar digar dinkh'o g'olib mesozad va agarchi kofiron kamolu g'alabai dini Uro nakhokh'and, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro ba itmom rasonida, piruz megardonad. Vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korero iroda kard, kase peshi onro namegirad.

33) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki Paiombarash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro bo K'ur'oni rakh'namoi mardum va dini barkh'ak'k'i Islom firistod, to dinashro bo burkh'onkh'o va akh'komash bar digar dinkh'o bartari doda, g'olib gardonad, agarchi mushrikon inro napisandand.

34) Ei on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash imon ovarda, az akh'komi ilokh'i pairavi mekuned, Ba durusti ki beshtari olimoni iakh'ud va obidoni nasoro molkh'oi mardumro banokh'ak', bo rishva va digar rokh'kh'oi kh'arom mekhurand va inchunin mardumro az vorid shudan ba dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boz medorand. Va kasone, ki tillovu nuk'raro ch'am' ovarda, zakotashro namepardozand, pas ei Paiombar, onkh'oro ba omadani azobi dardovari ruzi k'iiomat "bashorat" bidekh'.

35) Dar ruzi k'iiomat bar on tangavu tilloi ch'am'kardaashon, ki zakotashro napardokhtaand, dar ch'akh'annam otash afrukhta meshavad, pas chun kh'aroratash shiddat girift, onro ba peshoni, pakh'lu va pushtashon guzoshta, bo sarzanish ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "In kh'amon molkh'oest, ki onro dar dunio baroi khud khazina namuda, kh'ak'k'i voch'ibashro ado nakarded. Binobar in, imruz ok'ibati badi on chiro khazina karda, kh'ak'k'ashro nadoded, bichashed."

36) Kh'amono mutobik' ba kh'ukmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz dar nakhustin ruzi ofarinishi osmonkh'o va zamin onro muk'arrar kardaast, te'dodi mokh'kh'o az duvozdakh' mokh' iborat meboshad. Az miioni on duvozdakh' mokh' Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar chor mokh' ch'angidanro kh'arom gardonida ast. On chor mokh', se mokh'i paiopaii "Zulk'a'da", "Zulkh'ich'ch'a", "Mukh'arram" va iak mokh'i tok'i "Rach'ab" ast. On chi az te'dodi mokh'kh'oi sol va kh'arom budani chor mokh' zikr shud, din va shariati durust, ustuvor va bokh'ikmat ast. Pas, ba sababi rokh'andozii ch'ang dar mokh'kh'oi kh'arom va poimol kardani ekh'tiromi on bar ch'oni kheshtan ch'avr nakuned. Va bo mushrikon dar kh'oli iakch'oiagi bich'anged, on guna ki onkh'o muk'obili shumo dar kh'oli iakch'oiagi mech'angand. Va bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kumakrasoni va ustuvorsozi kh'amrokh'i kasone ast, ki bo ich'roi amrkh'o va duri ch'ustan az man'shudakh'o parkh'ezkori mekunand. Kh'ar kase, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amrokh'ash boshad, mag'lub namegardad.

37) Kh'amono ba ta'khir guzoshtani ekh'tiromi mokh'i kh'arom ba digar mokh' va ivaz namudani ch'oii on -on guna ki arabkh'oi ch'okh'iliiat chunin karda, masalan kh'urmati mokh'i Mukh'arramro ba mokh'i Safar meburdand- afzudani kufr bar kufr ast. Shaiton bo rokh'andozii in odati bad kofironro gumrokh' mesozad. Onkh'o iak sol mokh'i kh'aromro bo badal namudan ba mokh'e az mokh'kh'oi kh'alol, kh'alol megardonand va iak soli digar onro ba kh'olati kh'arom budanash bok'i meguzorand, to bo in amali khesh bo adadi mokh'kh'oi kh'arom gardonidai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muvofik'at kunand, agarchi bo mokh'iiatash mukholifat kardaand. Pas onkh'o kh'ech' mokh'ero kh'alol namegardonand, magar on ki dar ch'oi on mokh'ero kh'arom mesozand. Onkh'o bo in kirdori khud mokh'kh'oi kh'aromsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro kh'alol karda, bo kh'ukmi U mukholifat mevarzand. Shaiton baroiashon amalkh'oi zishtro zebo ch'ilva dod, pas onro ich'ro kardand. Iake az kh'amon korkh'oi zishti ikhtiro' namudaashon kh'amin ba ta'khir andokhtani kh'urmati mokh'i kh'arom ba digar mokh' ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kofirone, ki bar rokh'i kufri khud pofishori mekunand, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro namedikh'ad.

38) Ei mu'minoni amalkunanda ba akh'komi ilokh'i! Shumoro chi shudaast, ki chun baroi muk'obili dushman ch'angidan ba ch'ikh'od dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) da'vat meshaved, kundi karda, ba mondan dar manzilkh'oiaton mail mekuned?! Oio dar ivazi ne'matkh'oi abadii okhirat, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro baroi much'okh'idon omoda kunonida ast, ba matoi fanopazir va lazzatkh'oi muvak'k'atii dunio rozi gashtaed?! Pas matoi zindagonii dunio dar k'iios ba ne'matkh'oi abadii okhirat ch'uz lazzati bearzish chize nest. Chitavr shakhsi sokh'ibkhirad kh'aioti abadiro iaksu guzoshta, zindagonii bearzishro barmeguzinad?!

39) Ei mu'minon, agar baroi ch'ikh'od alaikh'i dushmanaton berun nashaved, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro bo mag'lub sokhtan, khor gardonidan va digar rokh'kh'o azobi dardovar medikh'ad va ba ch'oiaton k'avmi farmonbardorero meorad, ki agar ba ch'ikh'od da'vat shavand, dar kh'ol ba sui maidoni ch'ang kh'arakat mekunand. Va shumo bo khilofkori ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' zarare namerasoned. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az shumo beniioz va shumo ba U niiozmand kh'asted. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ama chiz Tavono ast. Chize Uro och'iz namesozad. U k'udrat dorad, ki biduni shumo dinu Paiombarashro nusrat dikh'ad.

40) Ei mu'minon, agar shumo Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro kumak nakuned va da'vati ch'ikh'od dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro napazired, boke nest va u bo iorii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kumaki shumo beniioz ast, zero begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Paiombarashro, be shumo niz kumak kardaast, on gokh', ki mushrikon uro bo Abubakri Siddik', ki nafari duium bud va kh'ardu tankh'o budand, az Makka rondand. Vak'te onkh'o az kofiron, dar g'ori Savr pinkh'on shudand, Abubakri Siddik' az on tarsid, ki mushrikon Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro dastgir mekunand, Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba vai guft: "G'amgin mashav. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kumak va dastgiriash kh'amrokh'i mo ast." Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar k'albi Paiombarash taskin nozil namud va lashkariionero furud ovard, ki shumo onkh'oro namedided. Onkh'o farishtagone budand, ki baroi tak'viiati Paiombari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) omadand. Va kalimai kofironro poion sokht va kalimai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amon ast baland, zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Islomro g'olib gardonida ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar Zot va mamlakatash G'olibi mag'lubnashavanda, dar tadbiru tak'diru akh'komash bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

41) Ei mu'minon, baroi muboriza dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'olati sakhtivu osoni, ch'avononu piron kh'amagi kh'arakat namuda, bo molkh'o va ch'onaton ch'ikh'od kuned. Ba durusti ki foidai duniavi va ukhravii berun shudan dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ch'ikh'odi molivu ch'oni az nishastan va dilbastagi ba solim mondani molu ch'on beshtar ast. Agar in guftaro medoned, pas ba anch'omi ch'ikh'odi ch'onivu moli ch'iddi talosh namoed.

42) Ei Paiombar, agar on chi munofik'onro ba suiash faro mekhoned va bo kh'ar bakh'ona baroi adami shirkat ich'ozat mepursand, g'animati ba osoni dastrasshavanda va safari beranch' mebud, kh'atman az tu pairavi mekardand, vale on masofae, ki onkh'oro baroi rasidan ba dushman va muboriza burdan da'vat kardi, to onro tai kunand, baroiashon dur namud, pas shirkat nakardand. Va ruzkh'oi nazdik in gurukh'i munofik'e, ki baroi naraftan ba ch'ikh'od az tu rukhsat pursidand, vak'te nazdashon barmegardi, ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savgand khurda meguiand: "Agar mo k'udrat medoshtem, ki kh'amrokh'i shumo ba ch'ikh'od baroem, kh'atman in korro mekardem." Onkh'o ba sababi naraftan ba ch'ikh'od va khurdani savgandkh'oi durug' khudro duchori uk'ubati ilokh'i karda, kh'alok mesozand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonad, ki onkh'o dar da'vo va savgandkh'oiashon durug'gui meboshand.

43) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az khatoi ich'tikh'odii tu Paiombar dar mas'alai rukhsat dodani onkh'o baroi naraftan ba ch'ikh'od guzasht kunad va onro mag'firat namoiad. Charo ba onkh'o in ich'ozatro dodi?! Baroi chi dar in mas'ala tavak'k'uf nakardi, to in ki baroiat bandagoni dar uzrkh'oi ovardaashon sodik'u kozib ma'lum shuda, ba rostguion rukhsat doda, uzri durug'guionro k'abul nakuni.

44) Baroi shakhsone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi okhirat sodik'ona imon dorand, shoista nest baroi naraftan ba ch'ikh'odi molivu ch'oni az tu ei Paiombar ich'ozat pursand. Balki loik'i sha'ni onkh'o on ast, ki kh'ar vak't onkh'oro baroi muboriza bar ziddi dushman faro khoni, dar kh'ol kh'arakat kunand va bo molkh'o va ch'oni khud ch'ikh'od namoiand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni parkh'ezkorero, ki baroi adami shirkat dar ch'ikh'od ch'uz bo uzrkh'oi vok'ei va k'obili k'abul rukhsat namepursand, medonad.

45) Kh'amono kasone, ki az tu Paiombar dar mavridi naraftan ba ch'ikh'od dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rukhsat mepursand, munofik'one kh'astand, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi k'iiomat imon nadorand va dilkh'oi onkh'o dar borai dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) duchori shubkh'a gashtaast. Pas, onkh'o dar kh'olati shak va sargardoni monda, ba sui kh'ak'ik'at rokh' nameioband.

46) Va agar onkh'o dar da'voi khud, ki guio mekhokh'and kh'amrokh'i tu baroi ch'ikh'od dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) berun shavand, sodik' mebudand, bo much'akh'kh'az sokhtani lavozimoti ch'angi omodagi medidand, vale Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amrokh'i tu berun shudani onkh'oro napisandid, pas ch'ikh'od dar rokh'ashro baroi onkh'o sangin sokht va dar manzilashon nishastanro bekh'tar donistand.

Va chun g'oliban ak'ibnishinii munofik'on boisi g'amgin shudani mu'minon megasht, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati zerin mu'minonro tasalli dod, ki zarari shirkati akh'li nifok' dar ch'ikh'od az ziioni ak'ibnishiniashon beshtar ast.
47) Kh'amrokh'i shumo baroi ch'ikh'od nabaromadani munofik'on bekh'tar ast. Zero agar bo shumo berun shavand, bo adami kumak va andokhtani shubkh'a tankh'o fasodro baroiaton afzun mesozand va begumon dar saffi shumo bo mak'sadi tafrik'aandozi ba sukhanchini meshitoband va dar bainaton kasone kh'astand, ki ba durug'i munofik'on gush andokhta, onro pazirufta, pakh'n mekunand. In boisi paidoishi ikhtilof megardad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) munofik'oni zolimero, ki dar baini mu'minon dasisabozi karda, shubkh'a meandozand, medonad.

48) Vok'ean in munofik'on pesh az ch'angi Tabuk baroi parokanda kardani ch'am'iiati musulmonon va barkh'am zadani vakh'dati onkh'o bo kh'irs ba fasodkori dast zadand va bar zarari tu Paiombar kh'illakh'oi gunogun sokhtand, to shoiad dasisai onkh'o dar irodai ba ch'ikh'od doshtaat ta'sir guzorad, to on ki nusrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ta'iidash baroiat omad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dinashro nusrat doda, dushmanonashro mag'lub sokht, dar kh'ole ki munofik'on in g'olibiiati Islomro namepisandidand. Chunki onkh'o mekhostand botil bar kh'ak'ik'at piruz gardad.

49) Va ba'zei munofik'on bakh'onakh'oi sokhtavu boftaro pesh ovarda meguiand: "Ei Rasuli Khudo, baroi ba ch'ikh'od naraftan ba man rukhsat bidekh' va maro dar ishtiroki nabardi dushman mach'bur masoz, to in ki ba sababi fitnai zanoni dushmanon-rumikh'o vak'te onkh'oro mebinam, ba gunokh' vok'e' nashavam." Ogokh' boshed! Onkh'o dar fitnai buzurgtar az on chi mepindoshtand, aftodand. Fitnai dar on giriftor shudaashon fitnai nifok' va ak'ibnishini az ch'ikh'od meboshad. Kh'amono duzakh dar ruzi k'iiomat ikh'otakunandai kofiron ast. Kh'ech' iak munofik' az on rakh'oi nameiobad va ch'oi gurez nadorad.

50) Agar ba tu Paiombar ne'mati khushkh'olkunandai piruzi io moli g'animat rasad, munofik'on onro namepisandand va g'amgin meshavand va dar surati duchori musibat az sakhti io piruzii dushman gashtanat meguiand: "Mo ekh'tiioti khudro kardem. Chun mu'minon ba ch'ikh'od baromadand va mo dar on shirkat nakardem, dar in kor tasmimi durust girifta budem. Inak mu'minon kushta shuda, ba'zei digar asir gashtand." Va munofik'on bo solim mondan az k'atl va asorat dar kh'olati khushkh'oli ba nazdi khonadonashon barmegardand.

51) Ei Paiombar, ba munofik'on bigu: "Kh'argiz ba mo namerasad, magar on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiamon navishtaast. U baroi mo Korsoz va Panokh'andaest, ki dar korkh'o ba U panokh' mebarem va tankh'o ba U tavakkul mekunem. Va akh'li imon korkh'oi khudro fak'at ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'avola va takia mekunand." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi onkh'o basanda buda, Iagona Zotest, ki mesazad banda tamomi korashro ba U kh'avola sozad.

52) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Oio shumo muntaziri on kh'asted, ki baroi mo piruzi io shakh'odat vok'e' shavad?! Va mo muntaziri on kh'astem, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo uk'ubate ovarda, kh'amaatonro nobud sozad io in ki vak'te baroiamon muk'obilaton rukhsati ch'angidanro medikh'ad, shumoro bo dastoni mo az rokh'i kushtashavi io asir shudan azobi sakht kunad. Pas, shumo muntaziri ok'ibati mo bimoned va mo muntaziri ok'ibati shumo kh'astem."

53) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Khokh' ba khushi va khokh' ba nokhushi kh'ar chiro az molkh'oi khud khokh'ed, sadak'a kuned, kh'argiz on ba sababi kufr varzidan va az farmoni Parvardigor berun shudanaton az shumo k'abul namegardad."

54) Va iak'inan se chiz k'abulshavii sadak'akh'oi onkh'oro man' kardaast: ba Allokh'u Rasulash kofirand va namozro bo tanbaliiu sangini ich'ro mekunand va molashonro bo khushi kharch' namekunand, balki bo norokh'ati kharch' menamoiand. Chunki onkh'o az adoi namoz va dodani mol umedi savob nadorand.

55) Pas ei Paiombar, na molkh'o va na farzandoni munofik'on turo ba kh'airat naorand va doroii onkh'oro nek nashumor. Zero ok'ibati molu farzandonashon bisior bad ast. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhokh'ad bo molkh'o va farzandonashon onkh'oro ba sababi bo ranch'i ziiod ba dast ovardan va on musibatkh'oe, ki az kh'isobi mol va farzandonashon bar sarashon furud meoiad, azob kunad va dar kh'olati kufr ch'on dikh'and. Munofik'on ba'di marg dar poiontarin tabak'ai duzakh ba azobi abadi mubtalo megardand.

56) Va munofik'on dar nazdi shumo mu'minon ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savgand mekhurand, ki az zumrai shumo kh'astand, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o dar botin az zumrai shumo nestand, agarchi dar zokh'ir khudro chunin vonamud mekunand. Valekin onkh'o k'avmeand, ki az on ki monandi mushrikon bo kushtashavi va asir aftodan uk'ubat shavand, metarsand. Ba kh'amin sabab zokh'iran khudro musalmon nishon medikh'and, to az azob emin bimonand.
57) Agar in munofik'on baroi kh'ifzi ch'oni khud panokh'gokh'e az k'al'a, io dar kukh' g'orkh'o va io rokh'kh'oi zeri zamini paido mekardand, begumon bo shitob ba on vorid shuda, panokh' meburdand.

58) Va ba'zei munofik'on vak'te az moli sadak'a ba khostai dili khesh noil namegardand, turo ei Paiombar, dar mavridi tak'sim kardani on aib megirand. Pas agar ba onkh'o az on mol khostai dilashonro ato kuni, az tu rozi megardand va agar ba onkh'o khostaashonro nadikh'i, zud izkh'ori norokh'ati namuda, khashmgin meshavand.

59) Va agar in munofik'one, ki turo dar tak'simi moli sadak'a aib megirand, ba mik'dori muaiiankardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va on chi Rasuli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o doda ast, rozi meshudand va meguftand: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi mo basanda ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar chi az fazlash khokh'ad, ba mo khokh'ad dod va Rasluash niz az on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) doda ast, ba mo khokh'ad dod. Mo tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mail dorem, ki az fazlash bar mo arzoni namoiad.", in baroi onkh'o az aib kardani tu bekh'tar bud.

Vak'te onkh'o dar bobi tak'simi molkh'oi sadak'a Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro aib giriftand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati zerin baroi kh'imoiati Paiombarash az ta'n va malomati munofik'on ch'oikh'oi sarfi sadak'a va shakhsoni ba on loik'ro nombar namuda guft:
60) Sadak'akh'oi farzi boiad baroi fak'iron sarf shavad. Fak'iron shakhsoni niiozmande kh'astand, ki mol dorand, vale on baroiashon kifoia namekunad va kase az tangdastiashon pai namebarad. Va ch'oi duiumi sarfi sadak'akh'oi farzi miskinkh'oiand, ki k'arib kh'ech' chiz nadorand va az rui kh'ol io kalom niiozashon ma'lum ast. Va ch'oi seiumi sarfi sadak'akh'oi farzi korgaroni ch'am'ovarandai molkh'oi sadak'aand. Onkh'oro rakh'bari musulmonon baroi ch'am'ovarii sadak'akh'oi tavongaron ta'iin mesozad. Va ch'oi chorumi sarf kofironand, ki ba kh'amin rokh' dilashon ba din narm megardad va islom meorand, io ashkhosi zaifimon, to imonashon k'uvvat girad va io baroi shakhse ba mak'sadi ch'ilavgirii zararash doda meshavad. Va ch'oi panch'umi sarfi on g'ulomonand, to ba'di sokh'ibmol gashtan khudro az g'ulomi ozod kunand. Va ch'oi shashum baroi shakhsoni k'arzdore sarf meshavad, ki imkoni pardokhti k'arzashonro nadorand. Boiad moli zakot ba in gurukh' biduni isrofkori va dar g'airi ma'siiat sarf shavad. Va kh'aftum baroi much'akh'kh'az sokhtani much'okh'idoni rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va kh'ashtum ba musofiri rokh'monda, ki kharch'i rokh'ash tamom shuda ast, sarf meshavad. Sarfi molkh'oi zakot ba in gurukh'i mazkur az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sobit va farz shuda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba manfiati bandagon Dono buda, dar tadbiri korkh'o va akh'kom bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

61) Va az munofik'on kasone kh'astand, ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro bo sukhan aziiat doda, vak'te burdborii uro mebinand, meguiand: "U gapi kh'amaro gush va tasdik' mekunad. Kh'ak'k'u botilro ch'udo sokhta nametavonad." Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Kh'amono Paiombar ch'uz sukhani nek chizero gush namekunad, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon dorad va khabari mu'minoni sodik'ro tasdik' namuda, nisbat ba onkh'o mekh'rubon ast va bi'sati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) baroi mu'minon boisi rakh'mat meboshad." Va kasone, ki Rasuli Allokh'ro bo kh'ar nav'i azobe ozor medikh'and, onkh'oro uk'ubati dardovar ast.

62) Ei akh'li imon, munofik'on baroi rozi kardani shumo az khud ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savgand mekhurand, ki iagon sukhani ozordikh'andae nisbat ba Rasuli Allokh' naguftaand, kh'ol on ki agar inkh'o mu'mini kh'ak'ik'i boshand, Allokh' va Rasulash bo imon va amali solekh' ba rozi kunonidan sazovortar kh'astand.

63) Oio munofik'on namedonand, ki onkh'o bo in amalashon bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash dushmani varzidaand?! Va oio namedonand, ki kh'ar kas bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash dushmani varzad, ruzi k'iiomat ba tavri kh'ameshagi dokhili duzakh meshavad?! Khori va rasvoii buzurg kh'amin ast.

64) Munofik'on kh'aros dorand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar Rasulash suraero nozil namuda, mu'minonro az kufri k'albi onkh'o bokhabar mesozad. Ei Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), ba onkh'o bigu: "Maskhara va ta'na zadani dinro idoma dikh'ed. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo furud ovardani sura io bokhabar sokhtani Paiombarash on chiro, ki az oshkor shudanash kh'aros dored, berun mesozad."

65) Va ei Paiombar, agar az munofik'on ba'di ogokh' kardani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo az on chi dar k'albashon pinkh'on mekunand, oidi ta'na zadani din va dashnomi mu'minon purson shavi, begumon chunin meguiand: "Mo bo iakdigar shukhi va bozi mekardem va dar guftakh'oi kheshtan ch'iddi nabudem." Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Oio bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va oiatkh'oiash va Paiombarash shukhi mekarded?!

66) Bo ovardani in bakh'onakh'oi sokhta ma'zaratkhokh'i makuned. Kh'amono shumo ba'd az pinkh'on kunonidani kufraton bo maskhara namudani dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro oshkor karded. Agar az gunokh'i iak gurukh'aton baroi tarki nifok', tavba kardan va ibodati kholisona darguzarem, gurukh'i digarro ba sababi idoma dodani munofik'i va tavba nakardan az in amal uk'ubat mekunem."

67) Mardoni munofik' va zanoni munofik' dar sifati nifok' az nav'i kh'am buda, kh'ech' fark'e nadorand. Onkh'o bar'aksi sifati mu'minon kh'astand. Mardumro ba kori khilofi shariat amr mekunand va az amali nek boz medorand va bukhl varzida, molashonro dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sarf namekunand. Itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro tark kardand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) niz onkh'oro az tavfik'i Khud makh'rum gardonid. Beshak, munofik'on kasone kh'astand, ki az itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va rokh'i durust ba sui ision va gumrokh'i berun shudaand.

68) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mardon va zanoni munofik' va kofirone, ki az in ak'ida tavba namekunand, va'dai otashi duzakhro doda ast, onkh'o ba duzakh daromada, onch'o ch'ovidon memonand. Duzakh baroi azobashon kofi ast va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro az rakh'matash dur sokhta va baroiashon azobi doimi ast.

69) Shumo munofik'on dar kufr va maskhara namudani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), Paiombar va mu'minon ba monandi ummatkh'oi takzibgari sobik' kh'asted. Onkh'o az likh'ozi k'uvvat az shumo k'avitar va az likh'ozi mol va farzandon az shumo beshtar budand. Pas az kh'issai dar tak'dir ch'udoshudai kheshtan bakh'ra burdand, sipas shumo munofik'on monandi onkh'o az kh'issai dar tak'dir ch'udoshudaaton bakh'ra burded va monandi onkh'o ba takzibi kh'ak', ta'na zadani din va g'airi on furu rafted. A'moli in ch'amoai mavsuf ba sababi kufr varzidan dar dunio va okhirat botil gashtaast. Va in ch'amoa ziionkoroneand, ki khudro ba kh'alokat andokhtaand.

70) Oio ba in munofik'on khabari ummatkh'oi takzibgari guzashta va azobashon az k'avmi Nukh', Kh'ud, Solekh', Ibrokh'im, Askh'obi Madian va dekh'akh'oi k'avmi Lut naomada ast?! Paiombaronashon bo dalelkh'oi vozekh' nazdashon omadand. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o sitam nakardaast. Ba durusti ki paiombaronashon onkh'oro bim doda budand. Valekin onkh'o khud bo kufr va takzibi paiombaron bar ch'oni khud sitam kardand.

71) Mardoni boimon va zanoni boimon ba'zeashon dust va iovari ba'zei digarand. Chunki paivandi imon onkh'oro bo kh'am ch'am' mesozad. Ba kori pisandida amr va az kori nopisand nakh'i mekunand. Ibodati Parvardigor az iaktoparasti, namoz, ruza va g'airi on kori pisandida va ammo gunokh' az kufr, shirk, sudkhuri va g'aira kori nopisand ast. Va namozi khudro ba surati komil barpo medorand va zakoti molashonro mepardozand va az farmudakh'oi Allokh' va Rasulash farmon mebarand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in ch'amoai doroi sifatkh'oi neki nombarshudaro ba rakh'mati Khud dokhil mesozad. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti kh'amesha G'olib buda, dar ofarinish, tadbiri kori bandagon va akh'komash bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

72) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mardoni boimon va zanoni boimon dar ruzi k'iiomat bog'kh'oero va'da dodaast, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oiash nakh'rkh'o ch'ori buda, onkh'o dar in makon abadi memonand. Minba'd dar on namemirand va ne'mati ba onkh'o rasida gusasta nameshavad. Va inchunin va'da dodaast, ki onkh'oro dar bog'kh'oi istik'omatash ch'ovidon ba manzilkh'oi zebo dokhil mekunad va on ruz rizoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon az kh'amai in ne'matkh'o buzurgtar ast. In mukofot kh'amon komiobii buzurgest, ki kh'ech' komiobi ba on nazdik va barobar nameshavad.

73) Ei Firistodai Mo, ba muk'obili kofiron bo shamsher va ba muk'obili munofik'on bo zabonu kh'uch'ch'at ch'ikh'od kun va bar in du toifa sakht bigir. Zero onkh'o ba chunin muomila loik'and. Va k'arorgokh'i onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat duzakh ast va duzakh ch'oi nikh'oiat bad ast.

74) Munofik'on ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'asami durug' mekhurand, ki on chi az onkh'o baroiat az khabari dashnom dodani tu va ta'na zadani dinat rasida ast, nodurust ast va onkh'o in sukhanro naguftaand. Va Ba durusti ki onkh'o kalimakh'oi kufri khabarash ba tu rasidaro guftaand va ba'di khudro mu'min nishon dodan, kofir budanashonro oshkor namudand. Va iak'inan munofik'on k'asdi az bain burdani Rasuli Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro kardand, vale ba khostaashon narasidand va munofik'on chizero aib nagiriftand va inkor nakardand, magar on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az fazlash ba onkh'o az moli g'animati ba Paiombarash in'om namuda ekh'son karda, tavongarashon sokht. Agar az nifok' tavba kunand, in tavbai onkh'o az bok'i mondan bar nifok' bekh'tar ast va agar az tavba rui gardonand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro dar dunio az rokh'i kushtashavi, asir aftodan va dar okhirat bo otashi duzakh azobi dardovar mekunad. Va onkh'o dar zamin kh'ech' korsoz va iorirasone nadorand, ki az azobi ilokh'i rakh'oiashon namuda, uk'ubatro dur sozad.

75) Va ba'zei munofik'on bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) paimon basta guftand, ki: "Savgand mekhurem, ki agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi mo az lutfu ekh'sonash ato kunad, ba mukh'toch'on sadak'a medikh'em va az ch'umlai bandagoni solekh' megardem."

76) Pas chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o az lutfu ekh'soni Khud dod, ba va'dai khesh vafo nakardand, balki molkh'oiashonro man' namuda, chizero sadak'a nadodand va az toati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pusht gardonidand va onkh'o odatashon az toatu ibodat rui toftan ast.
77) Pas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nifok'ro to ruzi k'iiomat ba sababi khilofkori ba paimoni ilokh'i va ba sababi on ki darug' meguftand, dar dilashon sobit va ok'ibati kh'olashon gardonid.

78) Oio munofik'on namedonistand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amai makri dar mach'liskh'o makhfi nigokh' doshtaashonro medonad va oio namedonistand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai g'aibkh'ost?! Kh'ech' chiz az kardakh'oi onkh'o az ilmi U pinkh'on nest va kh'atman munofik'onro ba sazoi kirdorashon merasonad.

79) Munofik'on mu'minoni tavongari ikhtiiori sadak'adikh'andaro aib megirand va inchunin fak'ironero aib megirand, ki baroi sadak'a dodan ch'uz ba kh'addi tavonashon mole nameioband. Munofik'on dar kh'ak'k'i kh'amin mu'minon bo ta'na va maskhara meguiand: "Tavongaron baroi khudnamoi sadak'a medikh'and va az sadak'ai kami fak'iron chi sud?!" Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amchun ch'azoi maskharaashon ba kh'olashon maskhara karda ast va onkh'oro azobi dardovar ast.

80) Ei Paiombar, baroi munofik'on talabi omurzishi gunokh' bikun io omurzishi onro talab makun, agar kh'aftod marotiba kh'am baroi onkh'o omurzish bikhokh'i, bo in vuch'ud kh'argiz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro mag'firat namekunad. Zero onkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash kofir gashtaand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kasone, ki didaiu donista va bark'asd az doirai shariatash berun shudaand, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro namedikh'ad.

81) Munofik'oni az ch'angi Tabuk ak'ibnishini karda, ba sababi az ch'ikh'od nishastanashon, ki bo in kor khilofi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) amal kardand, khushkh'ol shudand va monandi mu'minon dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ch'on va molkh'oiashon ch'ikh'od kardanro napisandidand va ba mak'sadi dilsard va rukh'aftoda sokhtani mu'minon khitob ba onkh'o guftand: "Dar in kh'avoi garm baroi raftan ba ch'ikh'od kh'arakat nakuned." Ch'angi Tabuk dar mavsimi garm ba vuk'u' paivasta bud. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Agar munofik'on in kh'ak'ik'atro medonistand, garmii otashi duzakh, ki muntazirashon ast, az garmii firor kardaashon sakhttar ast."

82) Pas biguzor in munofik'oni az ch'ikh'od ak'ibnishini karda dar kh'aioti dunioi foni andak bikhandand va dar kh'aioti abadii okhirat bisior megiriand. In ch'azoi kufru ma'siiatkh'oest, ki onro dar dunio bo dastoni khesh kasb kardaand.

83) Pas ei Paiombar, agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo az safarat nazdi gurukh'e az munofik'oni bar nifok' ustuvor bozgardonad, sipas az tu darkhosti dar ch'ikh'odi navbati baromadanro kunand, ba onkh'o bigu: "Minba'd shumo kh'ech' gokh' kh'amrokh'i man ba ch'ikh'od berun nameshaved. In baroi shumo uk'ubat va baroi mo parkh'ez az on kh'ama fasodkh'oest, ki dar surati kh'amrokh'i mo budanaton rukh medikh'ad. Beshak, shumo ba ak'ibnishini az ch'angi Tabuk rozi shuded. Pas dar manzilaton bo bemoronu zanonu kudakoni dar khona monda binshined."

84) Va ei Paiombar, kh'argiz bar kase az favtidagoni munofik'on namoz maguzor va baroi duovu talabi mag'firat sari k'abrash naist. Zero onkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash kofir shuda, dar kh'olati khuruch' az farmoni Parvardigor favtidaand. Kh'ar kas dar chunin kh'olat bimirad, baroi vai namozi ch'anoza khondan va duoi mag'firat kardan durust nest.

85) Molkh'o va farzandoni in munofik'on turo ba kh'airat naorad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhokh'ad onkh'oro bo kh'amin molu farzandonashon azob kunad va niz ch'onashon dar kh'olati kufr az badanashon berun gardad.

86) Va chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar Paiombarash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) suraero nozil kunad, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ored va kh'amrokh'i Rasulash ba ch'ikh'od baroed, munofik'oni tavongar az tu ich'ozai az ch'ang nishastan pursida meguiand: "Moro guzor, to bo ashkhosi notavonon va barch'omondagoni ma'zur boshem."

87) Munofik'on vak'te ba mondan bo shakhsoni ma'zuri khonashin rozi gashtand, baroi khud kh'olati pastu khoriro pisandidand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sababi kufru nifok' bar dilashon mukh'r nikh'od. Pas onkh'o korero, ki dar on naf'ashon boshad, namefakh'mand.

88) Ammo Paiombar va mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ash monandi munofik'on az ch'ikh'odi rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ak'ibnishini nakardand, balki bo ch'on va molkh'oi khud ch'ikh'od namudand. Va ach'rashon nazdi Parvardigor ba dast ovardani manfiatkh'oi duniavi az noil shudan ba piruzi va kasbi moli g'animat ast va dar okhirat dokhili ch'annat gashta, ba matlubi khesh merasand va az azob nach'ot meioband.

89) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi onkh'o bog'kh'oero omoda karda ast, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oi on rudkh'o ch'ori ast, onch'o ba tavri abadi memonand. Digar fano nameshavand. Kh'amin podosh rastagorii buzurgest, ki kh'ech' komiobi bo on barobar nest.

90) Va k'avme az bodiianishinoni Madina va atrofi on bo ovardani uzr nazdi Paiombari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) omadand, to baroiashon rukhsati naraftan ba ch'ikh'odro dikh'ad va g'airi inkh'o k'avmi digare, ki kh'ech' uzrero matrakh' nakardaand, az ch'ikh'od ak'ib nishastand, zero dar da'voi imon doshtan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash durug' guftand. Kh'amono ba in gurukh' ba sababi in kufrashon azobi dardovar khokh'ad rasid.

91) Dar bobi naraftan ba ch'ikh'od bar zanon, kudakon bemoron, notavonon, nobinoion va shakhsoni fak'ire, ki mol nameioband, to onro baroi omodagii ch'ikh'od kharch' kunand, kh'ech' gunokh'e nest. Chunki onkh'o uzr dorand. Ba sharti on ki bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash kholis boshand va ba akh'komi dinash amal kunand. Rokh'e baroi uk'ubati shakhsoni nekukori ma'zur nest. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni nekukorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

92) Va ei Paiombar, inchunin on kasone, ki vak'te nazdat omadand, az tu khostand onkh'oro ba markabkh'o savor kuni va dar posukh gufti: "Man markab nadoram, ki baroi raftan ba ch'ikh'od shumoro bar on savor kunam", chun ch'avobi turo shunidand, az nazdat bargashtand, dar kh'ole ki obi chashmonashon bo izkh'ori taassuf, ki na nazdi tu va na nazdi khud markab naioftand, ch'ori meshud, bar inkh'o niz baroi shirkat nakardan dar ch'ikh'od gunokh'e nest.

93) Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi mazkur shakhsoni ma'zurero zikr kard, ki az azob istisno kh'astand, dar in oiat shakhsoni loik'i uk'ubatro baion namuda guft: "Rokh'i uk'ubat va much'ozot bar kh'amonkh'oe kushoda ast, ki az tu Paiombar baroi naraftan ba ch'ikh'od rukhsat mepursand, dar kh'ole ki k'udrati omodashavi ba ch'ikh'odro dorand, chunki kh'amai sharoitashon farokh'am ast. Onkh'o baroi kheshtan pastivu khorii kh'amrokh'i khonashinon bok'i mondanro pisandidand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar dilashon mukh'r nikh'od. Digar az shunidani pand takh'ti ta'sir k'aror namegirand. Va onkh'o ba sababi kh'amin mukh'ri dilashon foidavu zarari khudro namedonand to on chi baroiashon manfiat dorad, ikhtiior karda, az korkh'oi ziionovar duri ch'uiand."

94) Vak'te musulmonon az ch'ikh'od bozgashtand, munofik'one, ki az on ak'ibnishini kardaand, baroi in kori khud nazdi akh'li imon bakh'onakh'oi beasos pesh ovardand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va mu'minonro baroi posukh ba onkh'o rakh'namoi karda guft: "Bigu: "Bakh'onakh'oi durug'ro pesh maored. Mo khabari baroiamon dodaatonro tasdik' namekunem. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moro az ba'zei on chi dar k'albaton makhfist, ogokh' namudaast. Va begumon Allokh' va Paiombarash mebinand, ki oio shumo tavba mekuned, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbaatonro bipazirad io in ki nifok'i khudro idoma medikh'ed?! Sipas ba suii Parvardigore, ki nikh'on va oshkorro medonad, bozgardonida meshaved, ba'd az on shumoro az kirdorkh'oi anch'omdodaaton ogokh' mesozad va baroi on ch'azoiaton medikh'ad. Pas ba suii tavba va kori nek bishitobed.""

95) Ei mu'minon, vak'te shumo az nabardi dushman barmegarded, begumon in munofik'oni az ch'ikh'od ak'ibnishasta baroi ta'kidi uzrkh'oi botilashon ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savgand mekhurand, to az sarzanishi onkh'o khuddori kuned. Pas onkh'oro bo nafrat va adami khushnudi rakh'o bikun va raftuomad makun. Zero munofik'on mardumi palidand, botini nopok dorand va ch'oiashon duzakh ast. Ch'azoi nifok' va gunokh'one ast, ki dar dunio onro sodir mekardand.

96) Ei mu'minon, in munofik'oni az ch'ikh'od ak'ibnishasta baroi shumo savgand mekhurand, to in ki az onkh'o rozi shaved va uzrkh'oiashonro bipazired, ammo shumo naboiad az onkh'o rozi garded. Zero agar az onon rozi shaved, bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khilof kardaed va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az k'avme, ki bo kufr va nifok' az itoatash khorich' gashta, mukholifat mekunand, rozi nameshavad. Pas az rozi gashtan az kase, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az vai rozi nest, biparkh'ezed.

97) Agar mardumi bodiianishin kofir io munofik' shavand, kufru nifok'i onkh'o az kufru nifok'i shakh'rnishinon sakhttar ast va dar bobi nadonistani farzkh'o, sunnatkh'o va chorchubakh'oi akh'komi shar'i, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar Paiombarash furud ovardaast, sazovortarand. Zero onkh'o doroi sifati durushti va sangdili buda, az ilmu ulamo durand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donoi Bokh'ikmat ast. Kh'oli bodiianishinkh'oro medonad va dar tadbiri kori bandagon va akh'komash bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

98) Va ba'zei munofik'oni bodiianishin e'tik'od dorand, ki on chi dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sarf mekunad, ziion ast. Zero ba gumonashon baroi sadak'aashon ach'r namegirand va agar sadak'a nakunand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro uk'ubat namekunad. Vale bo vuch'udi in, gokh'o baroi khudnamoi va kh'ifzi ch'oni khesh, ki dar nazari musulmonon khudro akh'li imon nishon dikh'and, sadak'a mekunand. Va muntaziri onand, ki bar sari shumo mu'minon kh'odisai bade bieiad va az shumo khalos shavand. Balki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) orzui onkh'oro, ki mekhokh'and musulmonon duchori kh'odisai bad gardand, ba sari khudashon meorad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavoi Dono ast. Sukhanoni onkh'oro meshunavad va asrori k'albashonro medonad.

100) On mukh'och'irone, ki az kh'ama pesh ba ch'onibi imon shitofta, az manzilkh'o va vatankh'oi khud ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ich'rat kardand va mardumi iovari Paiombar va kasone, ki bo e'tik'od, guftor va raftori nek az mukh'och'ironu ansor pairavi namudand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'amaashon rozi shuda, toatashonro pazirufta va onkh'o niz az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rozi kh'astand. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi onkh'o az savobi buzurgash ato karda va bog'kh'oero, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oi on rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad, omoda sokhta va onkh'o dar ch'annat abadi memonand. In podosh rastagorii azim ast.

101) Va az bodiianishini nazdik ba Madina va az baini khudi akh'li Madina munofik'oni dar nifok' poidore kh'astand, ki tu ei Paiombar, onkh'oro namedoni. Mo onkh'oro medonem. Beshak, onkh'oro du bor uk'ubat khokh'em kard. Iak bor ba sababi kashf shudani munofik'iashon io kushta shudan va bori duium bo azobi k'abr uk'ubatashon mekunem. Sipas ruzi k'iiomat ba uk'ubati azim bozgardonida shuda, dar poiontarin tabak'ai duzakh ch'oi megirand.

103) Ei Paiombar, az molkh'oi onkh'o zakot bigir, to ba in vasila az palidii gunokh'on pokashon gardoni va nekikh'oiashonro rushd bidikh'i va ba'di giriftani moli zakot dar kh'ak'k'ashon duoi nek kun. Zero duoi tu baroiashon moiai rakh'mat va oromish ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai duoi tu, Donandai korkh'o va niiatkh'oi onkh'ost.

104) Boiad in gurukh'i az ch'ikh'od bozistodai az gunokh'i khesh tavbakarda bidonand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbai tavbakoronro mepazirad va sadak'akh'oi onkh'oro k'abul mekunad, dar kh'ole ki az on beniioz meboshad va ba shakhsi sadak'akunanda savob medikh'ad va boiad bidonand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Tavbapaziru Mekh'rubon ast.

105) Va ei Paiombar, ba in gurukh'i az ch'ikh'od bozistodai az gunokh'i khud tavbakarda bigu: "Zarari on chiro az dast dodaed, ch'ubron kuned va amalkh'oi khudro kholis baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gardoned va korero ich'ro namoed, ki Uro rozi sozad. Pas begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Pamiobarash bo mu'minon amalkh'oi shumoro mebinand va ruzi k'iiomat ba sui Khudovande bozgardonida meshaved, ki nikh'on va oshkorro medonad. Va begumon shumoro az amalkh'oi dar dunio ich'ro kardaaton bokhabar mesozad va bar asosi on ch'azo khokh'ad dod."

107) Va inchunin on kasone, ki masch'idero na bo mak'sadi ibodat, balki bo kh'adafkh'oi ziion rasonidan ba musulmonon va oshkor sokhtani kufr va ech'odi tafrik'a baini mu'minon va intizorii kase, ki pesh az buniodi masch'id bar muk'obili Allokh' va Rasulash muboriza burda ast, bino namudaand, az munofik'on kh'astand. Va begumon in munofik'on ba shumo mu'minon savgand mekhurand, ki: "Mak'sadi mo ch'uz dilsuzi ba musulmononi notavon chize nest." Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shokh'idi medikh'ad, ki onkh'o dar in da'voi khesh durug'gui meboshand.

108) Ei Paiombar, da'vati munofik'onro baroi adoi namoz dar masch'ide, ki doroi chunin sifatkh'ost, k'abul makun. Kh'amono masch'idi ba nomi K'ubo', ki az ruzkh'oi nakhust bar asosi tak'vo buniod ioftaast, baroi namozat az in masch'idi bar poiai kufr binoshuda bekh'tar meboshad. Dar masch'idi K'ubo' mardoneand, ki ba vasilai ob az nopokikh'o va inchunin ba vasilai tavbai samimi az ma'siiat pok shudanro dust medorand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni az nopokii kh'issi va ma'navi pokshavandaro dust medorad.

109) Oio kase, ki buniodi khudro bar asosi tars az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va rizoi U bino karda ast, bo shakhse, ki bo k'asdi ziion rasonidani musulmonon, neru bakhshidan ba kufr va ech'odi parokandagi dar miioni mu'minon masch'id sokhtaast, iakson ast?! Kh'ech' gokh' in du bo iakdigar barobar nestand. Binoi shakhsi iakum bisior ustuvor va k'avi buda, az furu aftodani on kh'aros nadorad. Ammo binoi shakhsi duium ba kase monand ast, ki dar labi chokh'e bino sokhta, buniodi kardaash kharob shuda, furu rekhtaast. Pas u bo binoiash dar k'a'ri duzakh aftoda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba k'avme, ki bo kufru nifok' bar ch'oni kheshtan zulm kardaand, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui rokh'i rostro namedikh'ad.

110) Kh'amesha masch'ide, ki bo kh'adafkh'oi bad sokhtaand, dar k'albashon sababi shubkh'aiu iztirob va nifok'i ustuvor bok'i memonad, magar on ki dilashon bo marg pora-pora shavad va mirand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai korkh'oi bandagon buda, dar atoi podoshi neku bad bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

Pas az on, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharmandagikh'oi munofik'oni az ch'ikh'od ak'ibnishinro baion namud, ch'azoi neki much'okh'idonro zakr karda guft:
111) Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo lutfash az mu'minon ch'on va molashonro agarchi dar asl az U kh'astand, dar ivazi ch'annat kharida ast. Zero onkh'o dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo mak'sadi piruzii dini Islom mech'angand, pas kofironro mekushand va kofiron onkh'oro mekushand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) inro dar Tavrot va Inch'il va K'ur'on va'dai sodik'ona doda ast va kase dar ich'roi va'da az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vafodortar nest. Pas ei mu'minon, bo on savdoe, ki bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kardaed, shod boshed. Zero shumo dar in savdo foidai buzurg kh'osil menamoed. Va dar kh'ak'ik'at in tich'orati shumo rastagorii buzurg ast.
113) Paiombar va mu'minonro ravo nest, ki ba'di ma'lum shudani duzakhi budani mushrikon agarchi kheshovandonashon kh'am boshand, baroi onkh'o omurzish khokh'and.

114) Va omurzish khostani Ibrokh'im baroi padarash tankh'o az rui va'dai peshinae bud, ki ba padarash va'da doda bud, ki dar kh'ak'k'ash az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omurzish mekhokh'ad. Vai ba on khotir chunin va'da dod, ki umed dosht padarash imon meorad. Pas chun baroi Ibrokh'im dushmani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) budani padarash ma'lum gasht, chunki nasikh'at ba u sud nabakhshid io ba Ibrokh'im ba rokh'i vakh'i ma'lum shud, ki padarash dar kh'olati kufr memirad, dar kh'ol az u izkh'ori bezori kard. Ibrokh'im az rui ich'tikh'odi shakhsi dar kh'ak'k'i padarash talabi omurzishi gunokh' mekard. U bo kh'ukmi az tarafi Parvardigor omada khilof nakarda ast. Kh'amono Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) bandae bud, ki doim nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zoriiu iltich'o namuda, az korkh'oi badi k'avmash darmeguzasht va az khud burdbori nishon medod.

115) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' k'avmero ba'd az on ki kh'idoiatashon karda ast, gumrokh' namesozad, to on ki korkh'oi kh'aromro, ki boiad az on duri ch'uiand, baroiashon baion sozad. Agar onkh'o ba'di baioni kh'aromkh'o boz ba on korkh'o dast zanand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gumrokh'ashon megardonad. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tamomi chizro medonad. Chize az U makhfi nest. Ba shumo chizkh'oero ta'lim doda ast, ki pesh az in onro namedonisted.

116) Begumon kh'ukmfarmoii osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Dar osmonkh'o va zamin chize az U makhfi nest. Kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, zinda mesozad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, memironad. Va shumo mardum ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) digar korsoze, ki korkh'oiatonro korsozi namoiad va kumakrasone, ki az shumo badiro dur sokhta, alaikh'i dushman ioriaton rasonad, nadored.

117) Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbai Mukh'ammadi Paiombarash (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro vak'te ba munofik'on baroi adami shirkat dar ch'angi Tabuk rukhsat dod, paziruft va inchunin tavbai mukh'och'iron va ansorero paziruft, ki az in ch'ang ak'ibnishini nakardand, balki bo vuch'udi garmii kh'avo, kamii imkonot va nerumandii dushman az Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) pairavi namudand, ba'd az on ki k'arib k'albi gurukh'e az onkh'o ba tarki nabardi dushman moil gardad, zero dar kh'olati bisior sakht k'aror doshtand. Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o tavfik'i ustuvori va berun shudan ba ch'angi dushmanro ato karda, tavbaashonro paziruft. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Az nishonakh'oi rakh'matash on ast, ki ba gurukh'i iodshuda tavfik'i tavbaro doda, onro k'abul namud.

118) Va dar kh'ak'ik'at Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbai on se nafarero, ki biduni uzr ba ch'angi Tabuk naraftand va kh'ukmi k'abulshavii tavbaashon ba ta'khir guzoshta shud, paziruft. Onkh'o Ka'bi pisari Molik, Mirorai pisari Rabi' va Kh'iloli pisari Umaiia (r) budand. Paiombari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba mardum dastur dodand, ki bo onkh'o raftuomad nakunand. On k'adar duchori andukh' gashtand, ki kh'atto zamin bo vuch'udi pakh'noi bar onkh'o tang gasht va dilashon ba sababi ekh'sosi vakh'shat bar onkh'o tang gasht va ba iak'in donistand, ki baroi panokh' burdan ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) digar panokh'gokh'e nadorand. Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o tavfik' dod, to sidk'an tavba kunand, va tavabaashonro paziruft. Iak'inan U nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash Tavbapaziri Mekh'rubon ast.

119) Ei mu'minon! Bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az man'shudakh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va bo bandagoni dar imon va guftoru kirdorashon sodik' kh'amrokh' boshed. Zero iagona rokh'i nach'oti shumo sadok'at dar imon, guftor va kirdor ast.

120) Akh'li Madina va sokinoni atrofi on az bodiianishinon kh'ak' nadorand, ki vak'te Paiombari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) baroi ch'ikh'od berun shavad, az raftan bo u ak'ibnishini kunand. Va inchunin onkh'o kh'ak' nadorand, ki baroi kh'ifzi ch'onashon kh'aris buda, dar fikri kh'ifzi ch'oni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) naboshand. Balki baroiashon lozim ast, ki ch'oni khudro fido karda, ch'oni Paiombarro kh'ifz kunand. Sababi in dar on ast, ki ba onkh'o dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' kh'olati tashnagi va khastagi va gurusnagi namerasad va dar kh'ech' manzile, ki vuch'udashon boisi khashmi dushman megardad, furud nameoiand va ba dushman kh'ech' osebe az kushtan, asir giriftan, ba dast ovardani moli g'animat io mag'lub sokhtan namerasonand, magar on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ivazi kh'amai in korkh'o baroiashon podosh menavisad va onro mepazirad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) podoshi bandagoni nekukorro zoe' namegardonad, balki onro ba tavri komil ado mekunad va meafzoiad.

121) Va onkh'o kh'ar moli andak va io bisiorero, ki kharch' menamoiand va kh'ar vodiero, ki tai mekunand, albatta, dar ivazi on baroiashon savob navishta megardad, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar okhirat ba onkh'o ba ivazi on chi dar dunio anch'om medodand, bekh'tarin muzdro dikh'ad.

122) Va mu'minonro sazovor nest, ki kh'amagi ba nabardi dushman berun shavand, to mabodo dar surati piruzii dushman bar onkh'o kh'ama kushta shavand. Pas charo gurukh'e az onkh'o ba ch'ikh'od nabaroiand va gurukh'i digar bok'i namonand, to Paiombari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro kh'amrokh'i kunand va bo istifoda az K'ur'on va akh'komi shar'ii az Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) shunidaashon donishmand shavand va to k'avmashonro chun az maidoni ch'ang ba suiashon bargashtand, bo ma'lumoti kh'osilkardaashon onkh'oro bim dikh'and, to onkh'o az azobi ilokh'i parkh'ez karda, dasturoti Uro ba ch'o orand?!
In sukhani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba ch'angkh'oe taalluk' dorad, ki Rasuli Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar on shirkat namekardand va iak gurukh'ro ba atrof ravon sokhta, dar in kor toifae az sakh'obagonro intikhob mekardand.

123) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in oiat mu'minonro ba ch'angidan bo kofironi kh'amch'ivor dastur doda ast. Zero kofiron kh'amch'ivor az sababi nazdiki bo mu'minon kh'ar zamon metavonand khatar ech'od kunand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meguiad: Ei mu'minon! Bo on kofirone, ki ba shumo nazdikand, bich'anged va biioband dar shumo nerumandi va shiddatro. Boiad shumo bo mak'sadi bim dodanashon va peshgirii sharrashon az khud neru va shiddat nishon dikh'ed. Va bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kumakash kh'amrokh'i parkh'ezkoron ast.

124) Va chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar Paiombarash (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) suraero furud orad, dar kh'ol ba'zei munofik'on bo mak'sadi tamaskhur mepursand: "In surai ba Mukh'ammad nozilshuda imoni kadomi shumoro afzun sokht?" Pas ammo on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash imon dorand, nuzuli sura imonashonro afzun mesozad va onkh'o az nuzulash shod meshavand. Zero dar vakh'ii ilokh'i foidakh'oi duniovu okhiratashon ast.

125) Va ammo munofik'on, pas furud omadani K'ur'on bo akh'kom va k'issakh'oiash maraz va palidiashonro bar maraz va palidiashon afzun mesozad, zero onkh'o paig'omro durug' medonand. Binobar in, bemorii k'albashon bo nuzuli oiatkh'oi K'ur'on beshtar meshavad. Chunki kh'ar vak't az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chize furud oiad, dar on shubkh'a mekunand. Va in akh'li nifok' kh'aioti khudro dar kufr, fisk' va ision sipari namuda, az on tavba namekunand va ok'ibat dar kh'olati kufr memirand.

126) Oio munofik'on bo ibrat namenigarand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ama sola iak io du marotiba bo bardoshtani pardai nifok' va sharmandavu rasvo kunonidan onkh'oro meozmoiad?! Sipas, bo vuch'udi on ki medonand in ozmoishro nisbatashon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) karda ast, az kufru nifok'i khesh tavbai samimona namekunand va az musibati bar sarashon omada ibrat namegirand.

127) Va chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Paiombarash suraero nozil gardonad, ki dar on akh'voli munofik'on zikr shudaast, ba'zeashon ba ba'zei digar nigokh' karda meguiand: "Oio kase shumoro mebinad?" Agar kase onkh'oro nadida boshad, bo g'azab va norokh'ati az on mach'lis barmegardand. Ogokh' boshed! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'albashonro ba sababi on ki mardumi nofakh'mand va bo andeshidan dar borai oiatkh'oi K'ur'on kh'ak'ro namech'uiand, az kh'idoiat va neki bargardonida ast.

128) Ba durusti, ba sui shumo mardumi arab, Paiombare az nav'i khudi shumo omada ast. U misli shumo arab ast. On chi shumoro ba ranch' andozad, uro niz ba ranch' meandozad va duchori mashak'k'at shudanatonro namekhokh'ad, rag'batash bar kh'idoiat va tavach'ch'ukh' ba shumo bag'oiat ziiod buda, khususan nisbat ba mu'minon bisior mushfik'u mekh'rubon ast.

129) Pas aggar onkh'o ba'd az in az tu rui gardonida, ba nubuvvatat, imon naorand, ba onkh'o bigu: "Baroi man Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) basanda ast. G'air az U ma'budi barkh'ak' nest. Dar korkh'oiam tankh'o bar U takia kardaam va U Parvardigori arshi buzurg ast."
1) "Alif, Lom, Ro." Oiatkh'oi dar in sura tilovatshavanda oiatkh'oi K'ur'oni ustuvorest, ki doroi kh'ikmat va akh'komi ziiod ast.

2) Oio kh'airati mardumro on barangekhta ast, ki Mo paig'omi Khudro ba marde az nav'i onkh'o firistoda, dastur doda guftem: "Ei Paiombar, mardumro az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarson va mu'minonro bashorat bidekh', ki onkh'oro nazdi Parvardigorashon ch'oigokh'i baland ast."?! In podosh dar ivazi amali shoistai ich'ro kardaashon ast. Kofiron meguiand: "Begumon in marde, ki in oiatkh'oro ovarda ast, ch'odugari oshkor ast."

3) Ei kh'airatzadagon, kh'amono Parvardigori shumo Khudovandest, ki osmonkh'oro bo kh'ama buzurgiash va zaminro bo kh'ama pakh'noiash dar shash ruz ofarid, sipas on guna ki shoistai Zotash buda, kunkh'i on az fakh'mu darki bashar khorich' ast, boloi arsh baromad. Pas, chitavr dar mavridi on ki U mardero az nav'i khudi shumo paiombar firistoda ast, taach'ch'ub mekuned?! Va U iagona Zotest, ki kori makhluk'otro dar mamlakati vasei Khud tibk'i irodaash kh'akimona tadbir mekunad. Va kase kh'ak' nadorad, ki nazdash dar borai kase shafoat kunad, magar ba'd az rukhsat dodanash va rozi budanash az shakhsi shafoatkunanda. In Allokh'i Parvardigori shumost. Pas tankh'o Uro biparasted. Oio az in dalelkh'oi iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pand namegired?! Zero kh'ar kas andaktarin idroki ibrat giriftan dorad, inro medonad va zud ba Parvardigori olamiion imon meorad.

4) Ruzi k'iiomat bozgashti kh'amaaton tankh'o ba sui U buda, shumoro ba ch'azoi a'molaton merasonad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in bora ba mardum va'dai sodik'ona dodaast. Kh'ech' gokh' Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba va'daash khilof namekunad. U ba in K'odir ast. Mavch'udotro be namunai peshina paido mekunad, sipas onro ba'di marg barmegardonad, to kasonero, ki imon ovardaand va amalkh'oi nek kardaand, odilona podosh dikh'ad. Az nekikh'oi onon chizero kam namekunad va bar badikh'oiashon nameafzoiad. Va baroi kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash kofir meshavand, nushidanie az obi bag'oiat suzon ast. On nushidani rudakh'oiashonro pora-pora mesozad. Va niz ba sababi kufrashon baroiashon azobi dardovar ast.

5) U Zotest, ki oftobro nurafshon va mokh'ro tobon gardonid va baroi kh'arakati mokh' bistu kh'asht manzilro muaiian gardonid. Murod az manzilkh'oi mokh' masofaest, ki dar kh'ar shabu ruz onro tai mekunad. To shumo mardum ba vasilai oftob adadi ruzkh'o va ba vasilai mokh' adadi mokh'u solkh'oro bidoned. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini onkh'oro ch'uz ba kh'ak' va kh'ikmat naofaridaast, to k'udratu azamati Kheshro ba mardum oshkor namoiad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in dalelkh'oi vozekh'i vakh'doniiati Khudro baroi k'avme baion mekunad, ki chi budani istidlol bo in guna kh'uch'ch'atkh'oro medonand.

6) Ba durusti ki dar paii iakdigar omadani shab va ruz, torikivu rushnoi, kutokh' va darozshavii on du va tamomi mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va zamin baroi bandagone, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) metarsand, alomatkh'oi k'udrati Ust.

7) Kh'amono kofirone, ki umedvori mulok'oti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nestand, to az azobi U bikh'arosand va io ba rakh'matash tama' namoiand va dar ivazi kh'aioti abadii okhirat kh'aioti dunioi foniro pisandida va dilashon bo khushkh'oli ba on orom giriftaast va on kasone, ki az oiatkh'o va dalelkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui tofta dar g'aflat mondaand -
8) k'arorgokh'i in ch'amoai mavsuf ba sababi kasb namudani kufr va durug' donistani k'iiomat otashi duzakh ast.

9) Ba durusti, kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda, korkh'oi shoista kardaand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon ba sababi imon ovardan kh'idoiati ich'roi amali solekh'i ch'albsozandai rizoi Khudro ruzi mesozad. Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro dar ruzi okhirat ba bog'kh'oi doroi ne'mate dokhil menamoiad, ki az zeri darakhtkh'o va k'asrkh'oi on rudrkh'o ch'ori ast.

10) Duoi onkh'o dar ch'annat az tasbekh' va ba poki iod kardani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iborat ast va durudi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va farishtagon bar onkh'o va durudi ba'ze bar ba'zei digar guftani "Salom bar shumo az kh'ar nokhushi" ast. Va khotimai duoi onkh'o guftani "Sipos ba Allokh'i Parvardigori kh'amai mavch'udot" ast.

11) Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) duoi badi mardumro, ki kh'angomi g'azab bar khud va molu farzandonashon mekunand, mepaziruft, on guna ki baroi ba dast ovardani ne'mat meshitoband, beshak, kh'amagi kh'alok meshudand. Ammo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o mukh'lat medikh'ad. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on kasonero, ki dar intizori mulok'ot bo U dar ruzi k'iiomat nestand, chunki na ba rakh'matash umed va na az azobash kh'aros dorand, dar kh'oli sargardoniiu shubkh'aashon rakh'o mesozad.

12) Va agar ba insoni bo gunokh' bar ch'oni khud zulmkarda bemori va io badkh'oli rasad, zud ba umedi on ki mushkilotash bartaraf shavad, ba pakh'lu takiakunon io nishasta va io rost istoda, bo khorivu zori az Mo iltich'o mekunad. Pas chun Mo duoi uro pazirufta, ziionashro bartaraf namoem, korkh'oi guzashtai khudro idoma medikh'ad, guio in ki baroi dur sokhtani musibatash ba Mo bo zoriiu duo muroch'iat nakardaast. Kh'amon tavre, ki baroi in shakhsi az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruitofta amali idoma dodani gumrokh'i zinat doda shudaast, kh'amin guna ba kasoni tach'ovuzkunandai marzkh'oi ilokh'i kufru ma'siiat oroish doda shudaast. Binobar in, onro tark namekunand.

13) Va ei mushrikon, Mo beshak, ummatkh'oi pesh az shumo guzashtaro chun bo takzibi paiombaron va sodir namudani gunokh' bar ch'onashon zulm kardand, kh'alok sokhtem. Va paiombaronashon az sui Mo ba onkh'o dalelkh'oi ravshani isbotsozandai durustii nubuvvatro ovardand, pas imon ovardan ba onkh'o muiassar nashud, zero baroi k'abuli on k'asdan omodagi nadidand. Baroi kh'amin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro bar kh'oli khud voguzoshta, az tavfik'i imon ovardan makh'rumashon gardonid. Chunonchi Mo in k'avmi sitamgarro ch'azo dodem, kh'amin guna dar kh'ar zamonu makon k'avmiiatkh'oi shabekh'ashonro ch'azo medikh'em.

14) Sipas shumo mardumro baroi on ummatkh'oi takzibkunandae, ki dar guzashta kh'alok sokhtem, ch'onishin gardonidem, to bubinem chi guna amal mekuned. Oio kori nek mekuned, to in ki dar ivazi on savob doda shaved io ba amali bad dast mezaned, to on amalaton sababi ba uk'ubat giriftor shudanaton gardad?

15) Va vak'te baroi onkh'o oiatkh'oi ravshani isbotkunandai iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tilovat karda shavad, munkironi zindashavii ba'd az marg, ki ba savob umed va az uk'ubat tars nadorand, meguiand: "Ei Mukh'ammad, baroi mo g'airi K'ur'on, ki butparastiro mazammat menamoiad, kitobi digar biior io onro bo mansukh sokhtani ba'ze va io kh'amaash mutobik'i khostakh'oi mo digargun bisoz." Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Baroi man az peshi khud tag'iir dodani Kalomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durust nest va k'udrati ovardani kitobi digarro niz nadoram, balki tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavon dorad, ki on chiro az in Kitob khokh'ad, digargun megardonad. Pas man ba ch'uz az on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiam paig'om mefiristad, pairavi namekunam. Kh'amono man az on kh'aros doram, ki agar darkhosti shumoro ich'ro karda, Parvardigoramro nofarmoni kunam, dar k'iiomat ba azobi azim mubtalo megardam."

16) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, man kh'argiz in K'ur'onro bar shumo tilovat va tablig' namekardam va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, shumoro ba vasilai zaboni man az K'ur'on bokhabar namesokht. Ba durusti, man k'abl az nuzuli K'ur'on dar baini shumo zamoni tuloni (chil sol) zindagi karda, khondan va navishtan nametavonistam va dar ch'usutch'ui on kh'am nabudam. Pas oio bo ak'li khud dark namekuned, ki on chi baroiaton ovardaam, az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omada, man dar on dakhl nadoram?!"

17) Pas kh'ech' kas az shakhse, ki bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' bofta ast io oiatkh'oi Uro durug' shumurda ast, zolimtar nest. Modom ki chunin ast, pas man chi guna dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' bofta, K'ur'onro tag'iir medodaam?! Begumon shakhsone, ki bo durug'bofi bar Parvardigor marzkh'oi muk'arar kardai Uro meguzarand, kh'argiz rastagor namegardand.

18) Va mushrikon g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oero meparastand, ki k'udrati ba onkh'o rasonidani foida va zararro nadorand. Kh'ol on ki ma'budi kh'ak'ik'i in korro karda metavonad. Va mushrikon dar borai ma'budkh'oiashon meguiand: "Inkh'o dar nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moro shafoat mekunand. Az in ru, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moro baroi gunokh'onamon uk'ubat namekunad." Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Oio mekhokh'ed Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az sharik doshtanash khabar sozed, dar kh'ole ki U dar osmonkh'ovu zamin anbozero baroi Khud namedonad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on sukhanoni botilu durug'e, ki mushrikon meguiand, pok va bartar ast."

19) Va begumon mardum dar ibtido ummati iakporchai mu'mini iaktoparast budand, pas ikhtilof kardand. Ba'zeashon mu'min mondand va ba'zei digarashon kofir shudand. Va agar tak'diri Parvardigorat k'ablan nameguzasht, ki dar in dunio dar bainashon oidi mas'alakh'oi ikhtilofiashon dovari namekunad, balki dar k'iiomat dovari mekunad, ba durusti, dar kh'amin dunio dar baini onkh'o dovari mekard va shakhsi kh'idoiatiofta az gumrokh' ch'udo meshud.

20) Va mushrikon meguiand: "Charo baroi Mukh'ammad az ch'onibi Parvardigorash kh'ech' mu'ch'izae nozil nameshavad, ki rostguiashro isbot kunad?!" Ei Paiombar, dar ch'avobi onkh'o bigu: "Furud omadani mu'ch'izakh'o mas'alai g'aibi buda, onro tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonad. Pas muntaziri mu'ch'izakh'oe bimoned, ki omadani onro peshnikh'od karded. Ba durusti, man niz bo shumo muntaziri furud omadani on memonam."

21) Va chun ba mushrikon ba'd az on ki duchori k'akh'tsoli va ranch'u azob gardand, ne'mati boron va sarsabziro chashonem, dar kh'ol onkh'o oiatkh'oi Moro tamaskhur karda, durug' meshumorand. Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Uk'ubat va kh'alok kardani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro az makri shumo sare'tar ast. Begumon farishtagoni Mo on chi makr mekuned, menavisand. Kh'ech' chiz az onkh'o zoe' nameshavad. Vak'te chize az farishtagon zoe' nashavad, pas chitavr az Ofaridgorashon zoe' shavad?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro baroi makraton ch'azo medikh'ad."

22) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki shumo mardumro dar khushki bar k'adamkh'o va markabkh'oiaton va dar bakh'r bar kishtikh'o ba kh'arakat meandozad. To on ki dar kishtikh'o boshed va on on kishtikh'o kh'amrokh'i savoragonashon bo bodi muvofik' kh'arakat kunand, savoragon az on bodi muvofik' khushkh'ol gardand. Pas vak'te onkh'o dar kh'olati khushkh'oli k'aror dorand, nogakh'on ba onkh'o tundbod oiad va az kh'ar taraf ba onkh'o mavch'i bakh'r oiad va g'olibi gumonashon on boshad, ki kh'alok meshavand, zud Allokh'i Iagonaro duovu iltich'o mekunand va kh'ech' chizro ba U sharik nasokhta meguiand: "Savgand mekhurem, ki agar moro az in ozmoishi kh'alokatovar nach'ot bidikh'i, begumon baroi in ne'mati baroiamon arzoni doshtaat az ch'umlai shukrguzoronat megardem."

23) Pas chun Parvardigor duoiashonro k'abul karda, onkh'oro az on ozmoish birakh'onad, dar kh'ol bo murtakib shudani kufr va ma'siiat dar zamin banokh'ak' fasod mekunand. Ei mardum, az kh'olati g'aflat ba khud biioed. Kh'amono ok'ibati badi sitamkoriaton bar zarari khudi shumost va ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ziion namerasonad. Shumo az foidai sitamkorii khesh dar zindagonii dunioi foni kh'alovat mebared. Sipas ruzi k'iiomat sui Mo bozgardonida meshaved, pas shumoro bo gunonkh'oni kardaaton oshno mesozem va ch'azoiaton medikh'em.

24) Ba durusti, sifati zindagonii in dunio, ki dar on kh'alovat mebared, dar zud sipari shudan ba boroni az osmon furud ovardai Mo monand ast. Pas rastanikh'oi zamin az donakh'o va mevakh'oe, ki mardum onro iste'mol mekunand va giiokh'one, ki chorpoion onro mekhurand, bo on boron omekhta meshavad, to on ki zamin rangi zebogiashro megirad va bo ruiidani rastanikh'oi rangorang perosta meshavad va mardum gumon mekunand, ki k'udrati daravidani ziroatkh'o va chidani mevakh'oi onro dorand, nogokh'agon kh'ukmi Mo shab io ruz baroi nobudsozii on makh'sulot meoiad, pas onro monandi daravshuda megardonem, guio on zamin ba in nazdikikh'o bo darakhton va nabotot obod nabud. Chunonchi Mo baroiaton kh'olati dunio va sur'ati sipari shudanashro baion kardem, kh'amin tavr dalelkh'oro baroi k'avme, ki andeshida, pand megirand, baion menamoem.

25) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amai mardumro ba sui ch'annatash, ki saroi amnu amon va osoish ast, faro mekhonad. Mardum dar onch'o az kh'amai musibatu g'amkh'o va az marg niz dar amonand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar ki az bandagoni Khud khokh'ad, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba Islomro, ki rokh'i rasidan ba ch'annat ast, medikh'ad.

26) Podoshi kasone, ki ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro neku anch'om medikh'and va kh'aromkh'oro tark mekunand, ch'annat va afzun bar on ne'mati didori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va kh'argiz chekh'rai onkh'oro g'ubori andukh' va osori khoriiu rasvoi namegirad. In ch'amoat akh'li bikh'isht meboshand. Onkh'o dar onch'o abadi memonand.

27) Va kasone, ki amalkh'oi badi kufru ma'siiatro anch'om medikh'and, ruzi k'iiomat ch'azoiashon az azobi ilokh'i ba misli a'moli badashon ast va chekh'raashonro osori zillatu rasvoi megirad. Vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) azobi Khudro bar onkh'o furud meorad, kh'ech' bozdorandae nadorand, ki monei on azob shavad. On ruz az sababi on ki chekh'raashonro dudi otash va siiokh'ii ziiod megirad, chunon menamoiand, ki guio chekh'raashon bo siiokh'i az shabi torik pushonida shuda ast. In ch'amoai tavsifshuda akh'li duzakh kh'astand. On dar onch'o abadi memonand.

28) Va ei Paiombar, ruzi k'iiomatro ba khotir biior, on gokh', ki kh'amai khaloik'ro ch'am' mekunem, sipas ba mushrikon meguem: "Ei mushrikon, shumo kh'amrokh'i ma'budkh'oiaton, ki dar ibodat shariki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonisted, dar ch'oiaton biisted." Pas ma'budkh'oro az obidonashon ch'udo mekunem. Va on ma'budkh'o az ibodatkunandagonashon bezori ch'usta meguiand: "Shumo dar dunio moro ibodat namekarded."

29) Onch'o ma'budkh'oi botile, ki mushrikon dar dunio onkh'oro g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastidand, az ibodatkunandagon izkh'ori bezori karda, meguiand: "Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shokh'id buda, shakh'odati U basandaast, ki dar dunio az moro parastidanaton rozi nabudem. Mo shumoro ba anch'omi on nafarmudaem va ibodatatonro ekh'sos namekardem."

30) Dar on sakh'nai buzurg kh'ar shakhs amali dar dunio kardaashro mesanch'ad va mushrikon ba sui Allokh'i Parvardigori kh'ak'ik'iashon, ki kh'isobu kitobi on ruz dar ikhtiiori Ust, bozgardonida meshavand. Va on ruz shafoatero, ki baroi butkh'o meboftand, az onkh'o zoe' meshavad.

31) Ei paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Ki baroi shumo az tarafi osmon bo ovardani boron va ki baroi shumo az zamin ba vasilai nabotot va ma'dankh'oi zeri zamini rizk' medikh'ad?! Va ki monandi berun kardani inson az obi mani va paranda az tukhm, az ashioi bech'on makhluk'i ch'ondor berun mesozad?! Va ki monandi berun ovardani obi mani az kh'ar ch'ondor va tukhm az paranda az makhluk'i ch'ondor ashioi bech'on berun mesozad?! Va ki korkh'oi osmon va zaminu digar mavch'udotro chorasozi mekunad?!" Pas dar posukhi in pursishkh'o khokh'and guft: "Ba durusti ki ich'rokunandai kh'amai in korkh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meboshad." Pas ba onkh'o bigu: "Modome inro doned, pas, bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az kh'aromkh'o az uk'ubati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ez namekuned?!"

32) Pas ei mardum, On Zote, ki in korkh'oro mekunad, Allokh'i Parvardigori Barkh'ak' va Tadbirkunandai korkh'oi shumost. Pas ba'di shinokhtani kh'ak'ik'at ch'uz duri az on va gumrokh'i chist?! Sipas shumo chi guna ba'd in kh'ak'ik'at ba sui zalolat barmegarded?!

33) Ei Paiombar, chunonchi sifati ofaridgori baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sobit ast, kh'amin guna kh'ukmi Parvardigorat dar tak'dir dar mavridi shakhsone, ki az rui iakravi az kh'ak' khorich' gashtaand, voch'ib shuda ast, ki onkh'o kh'ech' gokh' imon nameorand.

34) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Oio az miioni ma'budkh'oi kase kh'ast, ki ofarinishro be namunai sobik' og'oz bakhshad, sipas ba'di marg onro az nav zinda kunad?!" Ba onkh'o bigu: "Tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ofarinishro be namunai sobik' og'oz mebakhshad va ba'di marg dubora onro zinda mekunad. Pas ei mushrikon, chitavr az kh'ak'ik'at ba sui botil barmegarded?!"

35) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Oio az miioni ma'budkh'oi shumo kase kh'ast, ki ba sui kh'ak' rakh'namoi karda tavonad?!" Bigu: "Iagona Allokh' ba sui kh'ak' rakh'namoi mekunad. Pas, baroi pairavi Zote, ki mardumro ba sui kh'ak' rakh'namoi mekunad va faro mekhonad, bekh'tar ast io ma'budkh'oi shumo, ki to rakh'namoi nashavand, khudashon rokh'i durustro paido karda nametavonand?! Pas, shumoro chi shudaast?! Chi guna az rui botil kh'ukm mekuned?! Vak'te megued, ma'budkh'oiaton dar ibodat shariki Allokh' kh'astand, in da'voiaton asos nadorad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az guftoru pindori botili shumo poku bartar ast."

36) Va beshtari mushrikon tankh'o az chize pairav mekunand, ki dar borai on ilm nadorand, balki az gumon va shubkh'a pairavi menamoiand. Iak'inan gumonu shubkh'a ch'oi ilmro namegirad va az on beniioz namesozad. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korkh'oero, ki anch'om medikh'and, medonad. Kh'ech' iak amali onkh'o az U makhfi nest va ruzi k'iiomat ch'azoiashon khokh'ad dod.

37) Va imkon nadorad, ki in K'ur'on az sui g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bofta shavad. Zero bashariiat tavoni monandash ovardanro nadorand. Vale in Kitob tasdik'kunandai kitobkh'oi pesh az in guzashta va baionsozandai akh'komi mukhtasari on kitobkh'ost. Pas dar bobi on ki K'ur'on az nazdi Parvardigori kh'amai mavch'udot nozil shudaast, kh'ech' shubkh'ae nest.

38) Balki oio in mushrikon meguiand: "Kh'amono Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) in K'ur'onro az nazdi khud bofta, onro ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat dodaast?!" Ei Paiombar, dar ch'avobi da'voi onkh'o bigu: "Agar man, ki kh'amchun shumo inson kh'astam, in Kitobro az nazdi khesh ovarda bosham, pas shumo niz suraero monandi on biovared va kh'ar kiro metavoned, baroi dar ich'roi in kor ioriaton kardan da'vat kuned. Agar dar da'voiaton, ki guio K'ur'on sukhani boftai durug' ast, sodik' kh'asted, talabamro ba ch'o ored." Va kh'ech' gokh' shumo az ukh'dai in kor namebaroed. K'udrat nadoshtanaton dar ich'roi in kor, kh'ol on ki shumo akh'li fasokh'at va balog'at kh'asted, daleli on ast, ki K'ur'on az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furud omada ast.

39) Pas ba in darkhosti Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) posukh naguftand, balki k'abl az andeshidan dar borai K'ur'on va fakh'midani on va k'abl az on ki azobi dar K'ur'on az on bim dodashudaashon vok'e' shavad, ba durug' donistani on shitoftand, dar kh'ole ki vak'ti omadani azob nazdik ast. Ummatkh'oi guzashta niz kitobkh'oi osmoniro durug' kh'isobidand va bar onkh'o azobi ilokh'i omad. Pas ei paiombar, dar borai ummatkh'oi takzibkunandai guzashta biandesh, ki farch'omi korashon bo chi anch'omid. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amaashonro nobud sokht.

40) Va az mushrikon kasone kh'astand, ki k'abl az marg ba K'ur'on imon meorand va ba'zei digarashon bo iakravi va sarkashi to dami marg ba on imon nameorand va Parvardigori tu Paiombar dar borai kasone, ki bar kufri khud pofishori mekunand, Donotar ast. Begumon onkh'oro ba sazoi kardakh'oiashon merasonad.

41) Pas, ei Paiombar, agar k'avmat turo ba durug'gui nisbat dikh'and, ba onkh'o bigu: "Savobi amali man baroi man buda, kaifarashro kh'am khud takh'ammul mekunam va savobi amali shumo baroi shumo buda, uk'ubatashro niz khud takh'ammul mekuned. Shumo az ch'azoi on chi man mekunam, bari kh'asted va man az ch'azoi on chi shumo mekuned, bari kh'astam."

42) Va ei Paiombar, vak'te K'ur'on mekhoni, ba'zei mushrikon ba khondakh'oiat gush meandozand, vale na ba mak'sadi paziruftan va az on itoat kardan. Pas oio tu metavoni sukhanatro ba shakhsoni az shunavoi makh'rum shunavoni, agarchi namefakh'mida boshand. Kh'amin guna k'avmero, ki az shunidani kh'ak' kar kh'astand va onro namefakh'mand, kh'idoiat karda nametavoni.

43) Va ei Paiombar, ba'zei mushrikon ba suiat menigarand va on chi az kh'ak' ovardai, mebinand, ammo amal namekunand. Pas oio tu metavoni kuronro rakh' namoi va bino sozi, agarchi namedida boshand, Tu k'udrati inro nadori. Kh'amchunin shakhsi kurdilro kh'idoiat karda nametavoni.

44) Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az sitam kardani bandagon pok ast. U dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o ba andozai iak zarra zulm namekunad. Vale onkh'o bo taassubi botil va sarkashi khudro ba kh'alokat afkanda, bar ch'oni kheshtan ch'avr mekunand.

45) Va ruze, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mardumro dar k'iiomat baroi bozpursi ch'am' meorad, guio in ki onkh'o dar dunio va olami k'abr az iak soat beshtar naistodaand. On ruz ba'zeashon ba'zei digarro meshinosand. Sipas, az shiddati mushokh'idai dakh'shatkh'oi k'iiomat shinosoiashon bo iakdigar k'at' megardad. Kh'amono kasone, ki mulok'oti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dar ruzi k'iiomat durug' kh'isobidand, ziion kardaand. Va dar dunio ba ruzi rastokhez imon nadoshtand, to az ziioni k'iiomat solim bimonand.

46) Va ei Paiombar, Mo ba'zei uk'ubatero, ki ba onkh'o va'da dodaem, io pesh az margat ba tu nishon medikh'em io turo pesh az on memironem. Pas dar kh'ardu kh'olat bozgashti onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar on chi mekunand, Guvokh' va az on Ogokh' ast. Chize az U makhfi nest va kh'atman onkh'oro ch'azo medikh'ad.

47) Va baroi kh'ar ummate az ummatkh'oi guzashta paiombare bud, ki ba suiashon firistoda shud. Pas vak'te paiombar dasturoti Parvardigorro ba mardum rasonid va uro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand, dovari miioni onkh'o va on paiombar bar asosi adolat surat girift. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az rui fazli Khud paiombarashro nach'ot dod va ummati takzibgarro kh'alok sokht. Va ba onkh'o az podoshi amalashon chize sitam karda nameshavad.
48) Va in kofiron bo sarkashi meguiand: "Agar shumo dar da'voi khud sodik' kh'asted, on azobe, ki ba mo va'da dodaed, kai meoiad?!"

49) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Man moliki on nestam, ki ba khud zarar io foida rasonam, magar on chiro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ad. Pas chi guna ba kasi digar moliki zararu foida bosham. Modom ki kh'ak'ik'at in ast, pas oidi g'aib az kuch'o ilm doram?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar ummatero, ki ba nobudsozi takh'did kardaast, kh'alokati onkh'o zamoni muaiiani khudro dorad. Kh'ech' kas ba ch'uz az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro namedonad. Pas vak'te mukh'lati kh'alokatashon faro rasad, kh'atto iak lakh'za peshu ak'ib nameravand.

50) Ei Paiombar, ba in kofirone, ki zud omadani azobro talab dorand, bigu: "Ba man khabar dikh'ed! Agar azobi ilokh'i dar kh'ar vak'te az shab io ruz oiad, shumo gunakh'koron az on azob chiro bo shitob metalabed?!

51) Oio ba'd az vok'e'shavii azobi baroiaton va'dashuda imon meored?! Oio vak'te imon meored, ki ba kase imonash, agar k'ablan imon naovarda bud, foida namerasonad?! Oio aknun imon meored, dar kh'ole ki pesh az in bo g'arazi takzib zudtar omadani uk'ubati ilokh'iro talab mekarded?!"
