52) Sipas ba'd az on ki ba azob mubtalo megardand va darkhosti nach'ot mekunand, ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Azobi abadii okhiratro bichashed. Oio imruz ba shumo g'air az kufru gunokh'i kardaaton dar ivazi chizi digar podosh doda meshavad?! Albatta, ne!"

53) Va ei Paiombar, mushrikon az tu mepursand: "Oio in azobe, ki ba mo va'da doda shudaast, vok'eiiat dorad?" Dar ch'avobi onkh'o bigu: "Bale, savgand ba Parvardigoram, ki on kh'ak'ik'at dorad va shumo az on rakh'oi nameiobed."

54) Va agar ba farzi misol, tamomi molkh'oi garonbakh'oi zamin dar ikhtiiori shakhsi mushrik mebud va baroiash fursat doda meshud, to onro dar ivazi ozod kardani ch'oni khud az azobi Khudo kharch' kunad, begumon in korro mekard. Va mushrikon vak'te ruzi k'iiomat azobi Parvardigorro mushokh'ida kunand, nadomati khudro az kufru shirk pinkh'on mesozand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar baini onkh'o bo adolat dovari mekunad va ba onkh'o sitam karda nameshavd. Balki tankh'o ch'azoi a'molashonro megirand.

55) Ogokh' boshed! Beshak, podshokh'ivu molikiiati osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Ogokh' boshed! Iak'inan va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai azobi kofiron vok'e'shavanda buda, dar on shakke nest. Vale beshtari onkh'o inro namedonand va baroi kh'amin dar in bora shubkh'a mekunand.
56) U Khudoest, ki murdagonro zinda megardonad va zindagonro memironad va ruzi rastokhez tankh'o ba nazdi U bozgardonida meshaved. Pas shumoro ba ch'azoi kardakh'oiaton merasonad.

57) Ei mardum, begumon baroi shumo K'ur'one, ki dar on andarz va va'davu takh'did ast va shifobakhshi bemorii shubkh'ai dilkh'o va rakh'namo ba rokh'i kh'ak'ik'at va baroi mu'minon rakh'mat ast, omada ast. Mu'minon az rakh'namoikh'oi on sud mebarand.

58) Ei Paiombar, ba mardum bigu: "On K'ur'one, ki Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba shumo ovardaast, baroiaton lutf va rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Pas bo lutf va rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki baroi shumo K'ur'onro furud ovarda ast, khushkh'ol garded." Zero on chi Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ovarda ast, az tamomi matoi dunioi foni, ki onkh'o ch'am' meorand, bekh'tar meboshad.

59) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Ba man dar borai on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton az rizk' furud ovarda, ekh'son namud, pas dar on bo maili nafsi kheshtan amal karda, ba'zeashro kh'alol va ba'zei digari onro kh'arom gardonided, khabar dikh'ed." Ba onkh'o bigu: "Oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo rukhsat doda ast, ki chunin kh'ukm kuned io in ki az peshi khud dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' mebofed?!"

60) Va shakhsone, ki bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' mebofand, ruzi k'iiomat dar kh'ak'k'i khud vok'e' shudani chiro gumon dorand?! Oio gumon mekunand, ki gunokh'onashon bakhshida meshavad? Kh'aikh'ot, ki kh'ech' gokh' chunin nameshavad! Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo mukh'lat dodani mardum va zud azob nakardan bar onkh'o Sokh'ibi lutfu ekh'son ast, vale beshtarashon ne'matkh'oi ilokh'iro inkor karda, siposguzori namekunand.

61) Va ei Paiombar, tu dar kh'ech' shug'le k'aror namegiri va kh'ech' oiatero az K'ur'on tilovat namekuni va shumo mu'minon kh'ech' amalero ich'ro namekuned, magar on ki Mo bar on guvokh'em va dar boraaton ma'lumot dorem, kh'amon vak'te ki korero shuru' mekuned. Va dar osmonu zamin ba andozai iak zarra va na kamtar az on io beshtar az ilmi Parvardigorat g'oib namemonad, magar in ki on dar kitobi ravshane, ki kh'ama ch'uz'iioti khurdu kalonro kh'isob kardaast, sabt shudaast.

62) Ogokh' boshed! Ba durusti ki baroi dustoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar on chi az dakh'shatkh'oi k'iiomat mushokh'ida mekunand, kh'arose nest va inchunin baroi az dast dodani lazzatkh'oi dunio andukh'gin namegardand.
63) In dustoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kasoneand, ki ba Allokh'u Rasulash imon ovardand va paivasta bo ich'roi amrkh'o va duri ch'ustan az kh'aromkh'o tak'vo mekardand.

64) Baroi onkh'o dar zindagonii dunio az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba vasilai didani khobi rost io mavridi madkh'u sitoishi mardum k'aror giriftan, ki in du kh'olat onkh'oro shod megardonad, muzhda ast va inchunin baroi onkh'o vak'ti k'abzi ch'on, ba'di marg va ruzi makh'shar az sui farishtagon bashorati nek ast. Va'dai ba onkh'o dodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tag'iiriobanda nest. Rastagorii buzurg kh'amin ast. Zero shakhs bo in podosh ba matlubi khesh noil gashta, az otashi duzakh nach'ot meiobad.

65) Ei Paiombar, baroi ta'navu malomate, ki kofironu mushrikon dar kh'ak'k'i din meguiand, g'amgin mashav. Ba durusti ki tamomi izzat va g'olibiiat az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro notavon karda nametavonad. U Shunavandai guftor, Donandai kirdori onkh'ost. Dar ivazash ch'azoiashon medikh'ad.

66) Kh'amono tamomi mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va zamin az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va mushrikone, ki g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) digar anbozkh'oro meparastand, az chi pairavi mekunand?! Onkh'o dar kh'ak'ik'at ba ch'uz shubkh'a chizero pairavi namekunand. Va ch'uz in nest, ki onkh'o dar nisbat dodani sharik ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' meguiand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az in guftaashon Bartar va Pok ast.

67) Ei Mardum, U iagona Parvardigorest, ki baroi shumo shabro ofarid, to dar on az kh'arakat va ranch'i ruzona orom gired va inchunin ruzro ravshan ofarid, to dar on ba kasbi on chi dar zindagi ba shumo sud meorad, talosh kuned. Ba durusti ki dar on chi gufta shud, baroi mardume, ki bo mak'sadi ibratpaziri sukhanro gush mekunand, dalelkh'oi ravshan ast.

68) Iak gurukh'e az mushrikon meguiand: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) farishtagonro baroi Khud dukhtar giriftaast." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az in guftai onkh'o Pok ast. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'amai ofaridakh'oiash beniioz ast. Mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Ust. Ei mushrikon, shumo baroi isboti in guftai khesh dalel nadored. Oio be burkh'on dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sukhani buzurgi nisbat dodani farzandro, ki az kh'ak'ik'atash ogokh'i nadored, megued?!

69) Ei paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Ba durusti, kasone, ki bo nisbat dodani farzand dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' mebofand, kh'ech' gokh' rastagor nameshavand va az uk'ubati ilokh'i nach'ot nameioband."

70) Baroi kh'amin naboiad ba lazzatkh'o va ne'matkh'oi dunio, ki kh'alovat mebarand, mag'rur shavand. Zero tamomi lazzatkh'oi kh'aioti dunio matoi nochizi zudguzar ast. Sipas ruzi k'iiomat bozgashtashon ba nazdi Mo ast. Sipas baroiashon ba sababi kofir gashtan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va durug'gu donistani Paiombarash azobi bag'oiat sakht mechashonem.

71) Ei Paiombar, baroi in mushrikoni takzibkunanda khabari Nukh' (alaikh'is salom)-ro k'issa kun, on gokh', ki ba k'avmash guft: "Ei k'avmi man, agar kh'astiam dar baini shumo va bo oiatkh'oi Parvardigor shumoro pand dodanam baroiaton sangini karda, boisi mashak'k'at gashta boshad va mak'sadi kushtanamro dored, pas dar barkh'am dodani dasisaaton tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia kardaam. Pas kori khudro mustakh'kam gardonida, ba nobud sokhtanam azm namoed va baroi kumak kh'amai ma'budkh'oiatonro faro khoned, sipas naboiad makraton bar shumo pushida boshad, balki onro oshkor sozed. Sipas ba'di tadbiri k'atli man ba ich'roi on chi dar k'albaton pinkh'on medored, kh'arakat kuned va kh'atto iak lakh'za kori maro ba ta'khir naguzored.

72) Ba'd az in agar az da'vatam rui gardonided, pas ba takh'k'ik' medoned, ki man dar ivazi rasonidani paig'omi Parvardigoram az shumo muzd talab nakardaam. Savobi man ch'uz bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar ukh'dai kasi digar nest. Dar mavridi on ki ba man imon meored io kofir meshaved, ikhtiior dored. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) maro dastur dodaast, ki bo ibodat va amali nek az zumrai bandagoni mutei U bosham."

73) Pas k'avmash uro durug'gui donista, bovar nakardand. Ba'd az in Uro iakch'o bo mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ash dar kishti nach'ot dodem va onkh'oro baroi guzashtagon ch'onishin gardonidem. Va kasonero, ki mu'ch'izakh'o va kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ovardai Nukh'ro takzib namudand, ba vositai tufon nobud sokhtem. Pas ei Paiombar, dar borai on k'avme, ki Nukh' onkh'oro az uk'ubat bim dod, vale imon naovardand, biandesh, ki khotimai korashon bo chi anch'omid.

74) Sipas Mo ba'd az Nukh' paiombaroni ziiodero ba sui k'avmashon firistodem. Pas paiombaron nazdi k'avmi khesh bo mu'ch'iza va dalelkh'o omadand. Pas k'avmashon ba sababi isrori guzashtaashon dar takzibi paiombaron irodai imon ovardan nadoshtand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar dilashon mukh'r nikh'od. Mo on guna ki bar dili pairavoni guzashtai paiombaron mukh'r nikh'odem, kh'amin guna dar kh'ar zamon va makon bar k'albi kasone, ki bo kufr az marzkh'o meguzarand, mukh'r menikh'em.

75) Sipas ba'di sipari shudani muddate az bi'sati on paiombaron Muso va barodarash Kh'orunro bo mu'ch'izakh'oi isbotkunandai durustii nubuvvatashon ba sui Fir'avni podshokh'i Misr va buzurgoni k'avmash firistodem. Ba'd az in Fir'avn va pairavonash az imon ovardan ba oiini Musovu Kh'orun kibr varzidand va onkh'o ba sababi kofir shudan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va takzibi paiombaronash k'avmi gunakh'kor budand.

76) Pas vak'te az nazdi Mo dini rosti Musovu Kh'orun ba Fir'avn va mansabdoroni k'avmash omad, dar mavridi mu'ch'izakh'oi isbotkunandai durustii nubuvvati Muso guftand: "Kh'amono in oiini ovardai Muso ch'odui oshkor buda, asosi vok'ei nadorad."

77) Muso bo inkori sukhanashon ba onkh'o guft: "Oio vak'te baroiaton kh'ak'ik'at omad, onro ch'odu megued?! On chi ba shumo ovardaam, ch'odu nest. Va iak'in doram, ki ch'odugar kh'argiz rastagor nameshavad. Pas chitavr imkon dorad, ki man ba ch'odugari mashg'ul shavam?!"

78) K'avmi Fir'avn ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) posukh doda guftand: "Oio bo ch'odu nazdamon omadai, to moro az dine, ki padaramonro bar on paido kardaem, bozgardoni va saltanat dar zamin az tu va barodarat Kh'orun gardad?! Va ei Musovu Kh'orun, mo kh'argiz paiombar budani kh'ardui shumoro tasdik' va ba on imon nameorem."
79) Va Fir'avn ba k'avmash guft: "Tamomi ch'odugaroni az fanni ch'odu ogokh' va bomakh'oratro nazdi man ored."
80) Pas, chun ch'odugaroni Fir'avn omadand, Muso ba onkh'o dar kh'ole ki ba piruz shudanash iak'in dosht, guft: "Ei ch'odugaron, kh'ar on chiro afkandan mekhokh'ed, biafkaned."

81) Pas, vak'te ch'odugaron ch'odui khudro afkandand, Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba onkh'o guft: "On chiro ba namoish guzoshtaed, ch'odu ast. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kori kardai shumoro botil va beta'sir megardonad. Zero shumo bo istifoda az ch'odugari dar zamin ba fasod mashg'uled va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kori fasodkoronro islokh' namesozad."

82) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kalimakh'oi muk'addarsokhta va bo dalelkh'oi dar kalimakh'oi shar'i mavch'udash kh'ak'ik'atro ustuvor megardonad va ba on neru mebakhshad, agarchi kofironi much'rimi pairavi Fir'avn va digar much'rimon inro napisandand.

83) K'avmi Fir'an bar imon naovardan tasmim giriftand. Pas bo kh'amai mu'ch'izakh'o va kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ravshani ovardai Muso, uro az Bani Isroil ch'uz ch'avononi k'avmash digaron tasdik' nakardand, bo vuch'udi on ki on ch'avonon az Fir'avn va buzurgoni k'avmash kh'aros doshtand, ki agar imonashon oshkor gardad, Fir'avnu pairavonash bo chashonidani azob onkh'oro az rokh'ashon barmegardonand. Va ba durusti, Fir'avn bar sarzamini Misr va akh'li on mutakabbiri zabardast buda va kh'amono u dar kufr, kushtor va uk'ubati Bani Isroil az zumrai on shakhsone bud, ki az marzkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guzashtaand.

84) Va Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba k'avmash guft: "Ei k'avmi man, agar vok'ean ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon dored, pas tankh'o ba U takia kuned, agar musulmon kh'asted. Zero tavakkul ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ama guna badiro az shumo dur karda, baroiaton neki meorad."

85) Pas onkh'o dar ch'avobi Muso (alaikh'is salom) guftand: "Mo tankh'o ba Allokh' tavakkul kardem. Parvardigoro, bar mo sitamkoronro musallat magardon. Chunki dar in surat onkh'o moro bo rokh'i shikanch'a, k'atl, tashvik' ba ma'siiat az dini intikhob kardaamon barmegardonand.
86) Va ei Parvardigoro, moro bo rakh'mati Khud az dasti k'avmi kofiri Fir'avn birakh'on. Zero onkh'o moro g'ulom sokhta, shikanch'a medikh'and va k'atl mekunand."

87) Va ba sui Musovu Kh'oruni barodarash (alaikh'is salom) paig'om firistodem, ki dar Misr baroi k'avmi khud ba mak'sadi ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khonakh'o bigired va barguzined va samti khonakh'oiatonro ba tarafi k'ibla (Bait-ul-muk'addas) bargardoned va namozro ba tavri komil ado kuned. Va ei Muso, ba mu'minon muzhda bidekh', ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro kumak va ta'iid mekunad va dar zamin ch'onishinashon mesozad.

88) Va Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Parvardigori mo, iak'inan Tu ba Fir'avn va ashrofoni k'avmash zinati zindagonii dunioro ato kardai va dar in dunio ba onkh'o moli ziiod dodai. Ei Parvardigori mo, onkh'o baroi ne'matkh'oi dodaat az Tu siposguzori nakardand, balki bar'aks bo istifoda az on mardumro az dini Tu gumrokh' sokhtand. Ei Parvardigori mo, kh'amai doroiashonro makh'vu nobud bisoz va dilashonro sakht bigardon. Zero onkh'o to vak'te ki azobi dardovaratro nabinand, imon nameorand, lekin on zamon imon ovardan baroiashon foidae nadorad."

89) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft: "Ei Musovu Kh'orun, Ba durusti ki Man duoi shumoro dar kh'ak'k'i Fir'avnu ashrofoni k'avmash paziruftam. Pas, bar dini khud ustuvor bimoned va az on bo pairavii rokh'i ch'okh'ilone, ki rokh'i kh'ak'ro namedonand, munkh'arif nashaved."

90) Va baroi Bani Isroil az bakh'r guzashtanro ba'di ba du k'ism ch'udo shudani on oson gardonidem. Onkh'o az bakh'r solim guzashtand. Pas Fir'avn va lashkariionash ba khotiri zulm va zurovari namudan onkh'oro dunbol kardand, to on ki bakh'r Fir'avnro pushonid va g'ark'shavi uro rasida, az nach'ot noumed gardid, guft: "Imon doram, ki ch'uz Ma'budi ba U imon ovardai Bani Isroil digar ma'budi barkh'ak' nest va man az ch'umlai itoatkunandagoni farmoni Khudo kh'astam."

Chun mushokh'idai marg monei k'abulshavii tavba ast, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ch'avobi Fir'avn guft:
91) Oio aknun ba'di noumed shudan az zindagi imon meori?! Va ei Fir'avn, Ba durusti ki pesh az furud omadani azob bo kofir gashtan va man' kardani mardum az rokh'i kh'ak' Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro nofarmoni kardi va ba sababi gumrokh'ii khud va niz digaronro gumrokh' sokhtanat az ch'umlai fasodkoron budi.

92) Pas, ei Fir'avn, imruz Mo turo az bakh'r berun mesozem va dar ch'oi baland meguzorem, to kh'ar ki ba'di tu meoiad, az kh'aioti badbakhtona sipari namudaat ibrat girad. Va Ba durusti ki beshtari mardum az dalelkh'oi k'udrati Mo g'ofil buda, dar borai on nameandeshand.

93) Va kh'amono Bani Isroilro dar makoni pisandidai sarzamini muboraki Shom furud ovardem va baroiashon az rizk'i kh'alolu pokiza ruzi dodem. Pas dar dini khesh ikhtilof nakardand, to on ki K'ur'on ba onkh'o omad, dar kh'ole ki K'ur'on sifatkh'oero, ki onkh'o dar Tavrot oidi Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) khondaand, tasdik' mekard. Pas chun in kh'ak'ik'atro inkor kardand, vatanashon az onkh'o sitonida shud. Ei Paiombar, Ba durusti ki Parvardigorat dar ruzi k'iiomat dar miioni onkh'o oidi on chi ikhtilof menamudand, k'azovat karda, kh'ar kh'ak'k'u nokh'ak'ro ba ch'azoiash merasonad.

94) Pas, ei Paiombar, agar dar borai kh'ak'ik'at doshtani K'ur'one, ki baroiat furud ovardaem, dar shak va kh'airat k'aror doshta boshi, dar in surat az iakh'ud va nasoro, ki k'abl az tu Tavrot va Inch'ilro mekhondand, bipurs. Onkh'o kh'atman baroiat kh'ak' budani paig'omi furud ovardaamonro khabar medikh'and. Iakh'udu nasoro vasfi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro dar Kitobkh'oi khud paido kardaand. Kh'amono baroi tu az ch'onibi Parvardigorat kh'ak'ik'ate omadaast, ki dar on shubkh'ae nest. Pas az shubkh'akunandagon mabosh.

95) Va az ch'umlai shakhsoni durug' shumorandai kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mabosh, ki az zumrai ziionkorone megardi, ki ba sababi kofir shudan khudro ba kh'alokat andokhta, ba ch'oni kheshtan ziion ovardaand. In ta'kidkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi baioni khatarnok budani mas'alai shubkh'a kardan dar e'tik'od va durug' donistani paig'omi Khudo ast va illo imkon nadorad, ki az sui Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kamtarin shubkh'a sodir gardad, chunki on kas az gunokh' ma'sum kh'astand.
96) Ba durusti, kasone, ki dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o az sababi idoma dodani kufr, k'azoi Parvardigorat oidi kofir favtidanashon k'at'i gardida ast, kh'argiz imon nameorand.

97) Va agarchi ba onkh'o kh'ar oiati shar'i io mu'ch'iza kh'am oiad, to azobi darovarro nabinand, imon nameorand. Vak'te on azobro binand, on gokh' imon meorand, vale dar on lakh'za imon baroiashon sud namebakhshad.

98) Pas, in tavr nashuda ast, ki akh'li dekh'ae az dekh'akh'oe, ki Mo ba sui onkh'o paiombaronamonro firistodem, pesh az mushokh'idai azob imoni boe'tibor ovarda boshand, pas baroi on ki pesh az mushokh'idai azob imon ovardaand, imonashon ba onkh'o foida rasonida boshad, ch'uz k'avmi Iunus. Chun onkh'o sidk'an imon ovardand, dar in dunio az onkh'o uk'ubati khoru rasvokunandaro bartaraf namudem va onkh'oro to sipari shudani mukh'lati zindagiashon az kh'aiot bakh'ramand sokhtem.

99) Va ei Paiombar, agar Parvardigorat imon ovardani tamomi mardumi zaminro mekhost, begumon kh'amagi imon meovardand, ammo U bo kh'ikmati baroi Khud ma'lum inro nakhosta ast. Az rui adolatash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, gumrokh' mesozad va az rui fazlash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, kh'idoiat mekunad. Tu k'udrat nadori, ki mardumro mach'bur kuni, to kh'amaashon mu'min shavand. Dodani tavfik'i imon tankh'o dar dasti Parvardigori Iagona ast.

100) Va baroi kase ravo nest, ki be ich'ozati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az peshi khud imon orad. Mavch'udiiati imon be irodai Parvardigor imkon nadorad. Ba kh'amin khotir khudro az andukh'i on ki onkh'o imon nameorand va dar botil k'aror dorand, kh'alok masoz. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uk'ubat va rasvoiro bar kasone k'aror medikh'ad, ki kh'uch'ch'atkh'o va dasturoti Uro dark namekunand.

101) Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikone, ki az tu dar borai nishonakh'oi kh'asti va azamati ilokh'i mepursand, bigu: "Dar borai on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin az nishonakh'oi iagonagi va k'udrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mavch'ud ast, andesha namoed. Va baroi k'avme, ki omodagi imon ovardan nestand, firistodani oiatkh'o, kh'uch'ch'atkh'o va paiombaron sud namebakhshad, zero onkh'o bo iakravi kufri khudro idoma medikh'and."

102) Pas in k'avmi ba durug'gui nisbatdikh'andai Paiombari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) muntazir nestand, magar monandi on vok'eakh'oero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi ummatkh'oi takzibgari guzashta ovardaast. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Muntaziri azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boshed. Kh'amono man kh'am kh'amrokh'i shumo az ch'umlai shakhsoni muntaziri vuk'ui va'dai ilokh'i kh'astam."

103) Sipas uk'ubatro bar onkh'o furud meorem va paiombaronamonro kh'amrokh'i kasone, ki imon ovardaand, nach'ot medikh'em. Baroi kh'amin onkh'o ba uk'ubati mubtaloshudai k'avmashon duchor nameshavand. On guna ki Mo paiombaroni sobik'ro kh'amrokh'i mu'minon nach'ot dodem, kh'amchunin bar Khud ich'roi in va'daro k'at'i gardonidaem, ki kh'atman Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ashro nach'ot medikh'em.

104) Ei Rasuli Mo, bigu: "Ei mardum, agar dar borai dini iaktoparastiam, ki shumoro ba suiash da'vat mekunam, shak doshta boshed, pas bidoned, ki man dar borai fosid budani oiini shumo iak'in doram. Az in ru, az on pairavi namekunam va ma'budkh'oero, ki g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted, nameparastam. Vale man Allokh'ero ibodat mekunam, ki shumoro memironad va ba man dastur dodaast, to az ch'umlai mu'minoni boikhlos bosham.

105) Va inchunin baroiam farmon dodaast, to dar oiini barkh'ak' ustuvoru pobarch'o monda, az digar dinkh'o ba sui on mail namoiam va maro az in ki az zumrai mushrikon bosham, k'at'iian man' kardaast."

106) Va ei Paiombar, g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) digar ma'budkh'oero, ki k'udrati ba tu zarar va foida rasonidanro nadorand, makhon va ibodat makun. Pas agar onkh'oro ibodat kuni, iak'inan on vak't az sitamkorone megardi, ki kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro rioia nakarda, on makhluk'oti ma'bud k'arordodaatro az kh'addashon bolo burdai.

107) Va ei Paiombar, agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tu zarare rasonad va tu darkhosti dur kardani onro kuni, pas baroi bartaraf namudani on dursozandae ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nest va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tu khaire khokh'ad, pas kh'ech' kas peshi lutfu ekh'soni Uro girifta nametavonad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az bandagon ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, fazlashro merasonad. Kase k'udrati mach'bur kardani Uro nadorad. Va U ba bandagoni tavbakunandaash Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

108) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei mardum, ba durusti, K'ur'on baroi shumo az sui Parvardigoraton omadaast. Pas, kh'ar ki kh'idoiat iofta, ba on imon orad, foidai on ba khudash barmegardad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az ibodati bandagonash beniioz ast. Va kh'ar ki gumrokh' shavad, kh'amono ta'siri badi munkh'arif gashtanash niz tankh'o ba khudash barmegardad. Ma'siiati bandagon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zarar namerasonad. Va man nigakh'boni shumo nestam, ki amalkh'oiatonro nazorat karda, bar asosi on shumoro bozpursi kunam."

109) Va ei Paiombar, az on chi Parvardigorat ba sui tu paig'om mefiristad, pairavi namuda, bo on amal kun va dar barobari ozori mukholifon va rasonidani dasturi ilokh'i sabrro pesha karda, rokh'atro idoma bidekh', to vak'te ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo piruz sokhtanat dar dunio va dar okhirat -agar kofir bimirand- bo mubtalo kardanashon ba azob dar borai onkh'o k'azovat kunad va U Odiltarini k'azovatkunandagon ast.

1) "Alif, Lom, Ro." In K'ur'on kitobest, ki oiatkh'oi on az nigokh'i lafzu ma'no ustuvor sokhta shuda ast. Dar on kamtarin khalal va nuk'son nameiobi. Sipas oiatkh'oiash bo zikri kh'alolu kh'arom, amru nakh'i, va'daiu takh'did va k'issavu digar mavzu'kh'o az sui Parvardigori dar tadbiri kori bandagon va akh'komash Bokh'ikmatu az akh'voli onkh'o va manfiatashon Bokhabar tavzekh' iofta ast.

2) Mazmuni asosii in oiatkh'oi bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilshuda az on iborat ast, ki bandagonro az ibodati makhluk'ot man' karda, Paiombari Allokh' (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba onkh'o meguiad: "Ei mardum, ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kase va chizero naparasted. Beshak, man baroi shumo az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bimdikh'anda va muzhdarason kh'astam. Agar ba U kofir gashta, nofarmoni kuned, ba azobash mubtalo meshaved, ammo dar surati ba U imon ovardan va tibk'i kh'ukmash amal namudan podoshi azimro ba dast meored.

3) Va az Parvardigoraton mag'firati gunokh'onatonro bikhokh'ed va baroi on kambudie, ki dar kh'ak'k'i U kardaed, bo tavbai samimi ba suiash bozgarded, to in ki shumoro dar zindagonii dunio to zamoni sipari shudani mukh'latkh'oi baroiaton muaiianshuda bo bakh'rai nek bakh'ramand sozad va baroi kh'ar kas, ki dar itoat va amal doroi fazl ast, ba tavri komil podoshi fazlashro ato kunad. Va agar az imon ovardan ba on chi az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ovardaam, rui gardoned, Ba durusti ki man baroi shumo az mubtalo gashtan ba azobi ruzi k'iiomat, ki sakht dakh'shatnok ast, kh'aros doram.

4) Ei mardum, ruzi k'iiomat bozgashti shumo tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va U ba kh'ama kor k'udrat dorad. Kh'ech' chiz Uro notavon karda nametavonad. Shumoro ba'di marg zinda sokhta, bozpursi namudan Uro och'iz namesozad."

5) Ogokh' boshed! Kh'amono in mushrikon az rui ch'akh'olat va shinokhti nodurust dar borai azamati Parvardigor sinakh'oi khudro mepechand, to az in rokh' shubkh'ai dar k'albashon mavch'udro az U pinkh'on kunand. Ogokh' boshed! Vak'te onkh'o bo liboskh'oiashon khudro mepushonand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro oshkor va on chiro pinkh'on mekunand, medonad. Ba durusti ki U Donanandai asrori dar k'albkh'o pinkh'on ast.

6) Va kh'ech' ch'unbandae dar zamin nest, magar on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az rui lutfash rizk'ashro kafolat dodaast va U k'arorgokh'i on ch'unbandaro dar zamin va makonero, ki dar on memirad, medonad. Kh'ar chi oidi ruzii kulli ch'onvaron, k'arorgokh' va ch'oikh'oi margashon, ki zikr gardid, dar Kitobi ravshani Lavkh'i Makh'fuz sabt shuda ast.

7) Va U Zotest, ki osmonkh'ovu zaminro bo on kh'ama kh'ach'mi buzurg va mavch'udoti baini on duro dar muddati shash ruz ofarid va arshash pesh az khalk'i osmonkh'ovu zamin bar ruii ob bud, to shumo mardumro ozmoish kunad, ki kadom iakeaton az rui amali pisandidaash bekh'tar va kadom iakaton az rui amali nokhubi ba g'azab ovarandai U badtar kh'asted. Pas kh'ar kasro bo on chi arzandaed, ch'azo medikh'ad. Va agar tu Paiombar bigui: "Ei mardum, ba durusti, shumo ba'd az marg dubora baroi bozpursi zinda karda meshaved", begumon, kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shuda, rastokhezro inkor mekunand, meguiand: "In K'ur'one, ki onro tilovat mekuni, ch'uz ch'odui oshkor chize nest. Baroi kh'amin botil budani on ma'lum ast."

8) Va agar Mo dar dunio az mushrikon on azobero, ki sazovori on kh'astand, to muddati ruzkh'oi boshumor ba ta'khir andozem, bo mak'sadi maskhara zudtar omadani on uk'ubatro talab karda meguiand: "Omadani uk'ubatro bar mo chi man' mekunad?" Ogokh' boshed! Ba durusti, azobe, ki in ch'amoa sazovori on meboshand, nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mukh'lati muaiian dorad. Ruze, ki azobi ilokh'i ba onkh'o meoiad, kasero nameioband, to onro az eshon dur sozad, balki on vak't uk'ubat vok'e' meshavad va azobe, ki az rui tamaskhur zudtar omadanashro talab mekardand, kh'amaashonro ikh'ota mekunad.

9) Va agar ba inson ne'matero az k'abili tandurusti va tavongari bidikh'em, sipas onro az on inson bigirem, kh'amono u az rakh'mati ilokh'i bisior noumed va dar barobari ne'matkh'o sakht nosipos meshavad. Vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ne'matashro az inson megirad, kh'ama lutfu ekh'soni k'ablan dodai Uro az iod mebarorad.

10) Va agar baroi u ba'di fak'iri va bemorie, ki ba on duchor gashtaast, ne'mati farokhi va tandurustiro chashonem, begumon meguiad: "Badikh'o az man dur shud va ranch'u dardkh'o barataraf gasht." Baroi in ne'matkh'o shukri ilokh'iro ba ch'o nameorad. Ba durusti, vai bo kibru g'urur khushkh'ol gashta, bo ne'matkh'oi dodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khudro az mardum bolo kh'isobida, iftikhor mekunad.

11) Magar kasone, ki dar ranch'kh'ovu anch'omi ibodat va duri az gunokh' sabr mekunand va korkh'oi nek anch'om medikh'and. In gurukh' fark' dorand. Zero onkh'o ba noumedi rokh' namedikh'and, ne'matkh'oi Parvardigorro nosiposi namekunand va khudro bo kibru g'urur az mardum bolotar namekh'isoband. In ch'amoate, ki bo sifatkh'oi mazkur tavsif shudaand, onkh'oro az ch'onibi Parvardigorashon mag'firati gunokh'on va dar ruzi k'iiomat podoshi buzurg ast.

12) Pas ei Paiombar, shoiad tu bo on chi az sui kofiron az kufru iakravi va peshnikh'odi ovardani mu'ch'izakh'o rubaru shudai, tablig'i ba'zei dasturoti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro, ki bar onkh'o bo on amal kardan dushvor ast, tark kuni va k'albat az ich'roi on tang gardad, to in ki naguiand: "Charo bar vai khazinae furud ovarda nashudaast, ki uro g'ani sozad io charo bo u farishtae naomadaast, ki sukhanashro tasdik' namoiad." Naboiad tu ba sababi in sukhanonashon ba'zei on chiro baroiat paig'om meshavad, tark sozi. Zero tu bimdikh'andae besh nesti. On chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiat dastur dodaast, ba mardum merasoni. Vazifai tu on nest, ki kh'ar mu'ch'izai peshnikh'odkardai kofironu mushrikonro mukh'aiio namoi. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ar chiz Nigakh'bon ast.

13) Balki oio mushrikon meguiand: "Mukh'ammad K'ur'onro az peshi khud bofta va on vakh'ii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nest." Ei Paiombar, onkh'oro baroi isboti in sukhanashon ba muboriza khonda bigu: "Agar dar da'voi khud sodik' kh'asted, pas chunonchi megued, K'ur'on kitobi bofta ast, ba monandi on dakh' surai bofta biiored va baroi talabi kumak dar ich'roi in amal kh'ar kiro g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhokh'ed, faro khoned."

14) Pas agar onkh'o ba sababi k'udrat nadoshtan darkhosti shumoro ba ch'o ovarda natavonand, pas ei mu'minon, iak'inan bidoned, ki begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in K'ur'onro bo ilmi Khud bar Paiombarash furud ovarda va Kitobi boftashuda nest va niz bidoned, ki ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi barkh'ak' nest. Pas oio shumo ba'di in kh'ama kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi radnoshavanda ba U taslimshavanda kh'asted?!

15) Kh'ar ki bo ich'roi amali khud zindagonii dunio va lazzatkh'oi onro khosta, okhiratro nakhokh'ad, baroiashon dar in dunio podoshi korkh'oiashonro bo bakhshidani tandurusti, amnu osoishtagi va farokhi dar ruzi ato mekunem. Va onkh'o az podoshi amalkh'oiashon dar in dunio chize kam karda nameshavad.

16) In ch'amoati sokh'ibi chunin mak'sadi bearzish kasoneand, ki dar okhirat ba ch'uz otashi duzakh podoshe nadorand va podoshi korkh'oiashon dar okhirat az onkh'o rafta va on chi dar dunio mekardand, botil meshavad. Zero amalkh'oi onkh'o bar asosi imon va kh'adafi sakh'ekh' anch'om naiofta ast. Onkh'o kh'angomi anch'omi korkh'o rizoi Parvardigor va saroi okhiratro maddi nazar k'aror namedodand.

17) Paiombar Mukh'ammad, ki az nazdi Parvardigorash bo khud kh'uch'ch'at dorad va Ch'abrail niz az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati shokh'idi durustii nubuvvatash uro ta'iid mekunad va pesh az in Tavrote, ki bar Muso kh'amchun rakh'bar va rakh'mati mardum nozil shuda bud, bar nubuvvatash guvokh'i medikh'ad, kh'ech' gokh' in Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ash bo kofironi gumrokh' iakson nestand. Mu'minon ba K'ur'onu Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) imon dorand va kh'ar ki az tobeoni adioni digar ba K'ur'on va Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kofir shavad, pas dar ruzi k'iiomat va'dagokh'ash duzakh ast. Pas ei Paiombar, tu dar borai K'ur'on va va'dagokh'i onkh'o shak makun. Zero in kh'ak'ik'ati makh'zest, ki az cui Parvardigorat furud omada ast. Valekin beshtari mardum bo vuch'udi mavch'udiiati dalelkh'oi ravshani ziiod imon nameorand.

18) Va kist sitamgortar az shakhse, ki bo nisbat dodani anboz va io farzand dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' mebofad?! Kh'aminkh'oe, ki dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' mebofand, dar k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigorashon ovarda meshavand, to onkh'oro az korkh'oiashon bipursad va farishtagon va paiombaroni on ruz shokh'id meguiand: "Inkh'o kh'amon kasoneand, ki dar dunio bo nisbat dodani sharik va farzand dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' guftaand." Ogokh' boshed! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on kasonero, ki bo nisbat dodani durug' nisbat ba U bar ch'oni khesh sitam namudaand, az rakh'matash dur kardaast.

19) On zolimone, ki mardumro az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boz medorand va baroi in rokh' kach'iro mekhokh'and, to kase dar on gom nazanad va onkh'o ba zindashavii ba'di marg kofir kh'astand.

20) In ch'amoai mavsuf vak'te uk'ubati Parvardigor ba onkh'o furud oiad, dar kh'ech' k'it'ai zamin az on gurekhtan nametavonand va onkh'o g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) duston va iovarone nadorand, to azobashonro dur sozand. Ruzi k'iiomat ba sababi on ki dar dunio khud va digaronro az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardonidaand, azobashon afzuda meshavad. Onkh'o dar dunio kh'ak'ik'at va kh'idoiatro bo mak'sadi k'abul namudanash shunida nametavonistand va nishonakh'oi vakh'doniiat va azamati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dar koinot ba surate, ki baroiashon foida rasonad, namedidand. Zero onkh'o az kh'ak' ba shiddat rui gardonida budand.

21) In gurukh'i doroi sifatkh'oi iodshuda kasoneand, ki bo shirk ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khudro ba kh'alokat andokhta, bar ch'oni kheshtan ziion rasonidaand va kh'ama on ma'budon va shafoatkunandagone, ki dar dunio onro boftaand, az nazdashon g'oib megardad.
22) Dar kh'ak'ik'at in gurukh' ruzi k'iiomat dar dodu sitad ziionkortarin mardumand, zero onkh'o kufrro bo imon, dunioro bo okhirat va rakh'mati ilokh'iro bo azob ivaz kardaand.

23) Ba durusti, kasone, ki ba Parvardigor va paiombaronash imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand va dar barobari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furutani namuda, itoatash kardand, in gurukh'i mardum boshandagoni bikh'isht buda, dar bikh'isht ba tavri abadi memonand.

24) Masali toifai kofiron va mu'minon ba kh'ammonandi shakhsi kuru kar va binovu shunavo shabokh'at dorad. Kuru kar baioni kh'olati kofiron ast, ki kh'ak'ik'atro bo mak'sadi paziruftan nameshunavand va onro ba surati baroiashon sudbakhsh namebinand. Ammo shunavo va bino baioni sifati gurukh'i bandagoni mu'min ast, ki kh'ak'ik'atro meshunavand va onro mebinand. Oio kh'olat va sifati in du gurukh' barobar ast?! Onkh'o bo kh'am barobar nestand. Oio az adami barobarii onkh'o pand namegired?!

Vak'te mushrikon az da'vati Paiombari (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) rui gardonida imon naovardand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tasliiatashon dod, ki eshon nakhustin paiombari ba durug'gui mansubgashta nestand. K'ablan digar paiombaron niz chunin kh'olatro az sar guzaronidaand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo zikri k'issakh'oi paiombaron Kh'abibi khudro dilbardori namuda guft:
25) Va ba durusti, Mo Nukh'ro ba sui k'avmash paiombar firistodem. Pas Nukh' ba onkh'o guft: "Ei k'avmi man, kh'amono man baroi shumo az azobi ilokh'i bimdikh'andai oshkorkunandai dasturote kh'astam, ki bo on ba suiaton firistoda shudaam.
26) Va shumoro ba sui ibodati Allokh'i Iagona da'vat mekunam. Ba ch'uz U kase va chizero ibodat nakuned. Ba durusti, man bar shumo az duchor shudanaton ba azobi ruzi dardovar metarsam."

27) Pas, ashrofon va rakh'baroni k'avmash, ki ba vai kofir gardida budand, guftand: "Kh'ech' gokh' da'vati turo k'abul namekunem. Chunki tu az mo iagon bartari nadori. Tu niz monandi mo inson kh'asti. Va bo on chi baroi mo oshkor ast, mebinem, ki turo tankh'o furumoiagoni k'avmamon pairavi kardaand va chunki shumo dar sharaf, mol, ch'okh'u mansab az mo kh'ech' afzunie nadored, ki shumoro shoistai pairavi gardonad, balki mo shumoro dar on chi da'vo menamoed, durug'gui mepindorem."

28) Nukh' dar ch'avobashon guft: "Ei k'avmi man, baroiam khabar dikh'ed. Agar man az ch'onibi Parvardigoram burkh'one doshta bosham, ki ba sadok'atam guvokh'i medikh'ad va tasdik'amro baroiaton zaruri megardonad va ba man az nazdi Khud nubuvvatu risolatro doda ast, pas on az rui nodoniaton az chashmi shumo pinkh'on monda ast, oio shumoro baroi imon ovardan ba risolatam mach'bur sozem va onro dar k'albaton dokhil kunem, dar kh'ole ki onro namepisanded?! Mo in k'udratro nadorem. Zero iagona kase, ki ba bandagon tavfik'i imon ovardan medikh'ad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

29) Va ei k'avmi man, az shumo dar ivazi rasonidani paig'omi Parvardigor mol namepursam. Savobi man tankh'o nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va man az mach'lisam mu'minoni fak'irero, ki az nazdam rondani onkh'oro mekhokh'ed, nameronam. Zero Ba durusti ki onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat bo Parvardigori khesh mulok'ot mekunand va U baroi imoni ovardaashon ba onkh'o podosh medikh'ad. Vale vak'te az man darkhosti rondani mu'minoni notavonro mekuned, man shumoro k'avme mebinam, ki kh'ak'ik'ati da'vati maro namefakh'med.

30) Va ei k'avmi man, agar in mu'minonro zolimona va begunokh' az nazdam bironam, ki azobi ilokh'iro az man bartaraf mesozad?! Oio pand namegired va baroi anch'omi kori shoistatar va sudmandtar talosh namekuned?!

31) Va ei k'avmi man, ba shumo nameguiam, ki khazinakh'oi ruzii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdi man buda, dar surati imon ovardan baroiaton az on kharch' mekunam va man dar borai g'aib ma'lumot nadoram va inchunin nameguiam, ki begumon man az farishtagon kh'astam, balki monandi shumo insonam. Va dar borai fak'irone, ki chashmonaton onkh'oro takh'k'iromez dida, kh'ak'ir meshumorand, nameguiam, ki kh'ech' gokh' Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o tavfik' va kh'idoiat namedikh'ad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) niiatu kh'olatashonro bekh'tar medonad. Agar man in da'voro kunam, on gokh' az ch'umlai zolimoni sazovori azobi ilokh'i megardam."

32) Onkh'o dar ch'avobi Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) az rui taassub va kibru g'urur guftand: "Ei Nukh', dar kh'ak'ik'at bo mo ch'idol kardi, pas ch'idoli durudaroz kardi. Pas agar dar da'voiat sodik' kh'asti, azobero, ki ba mo va'da medikh'i, onro baroiamon biior."

33) Nukh' ba onkh'o guft: "Azobro bar shumo man nameoram. Kh'amono agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ad, onro baroiaton meorad va agar Parvardigor irodai azobatonro kunad, shumo k'udrati az on rakh'oiro nadored.

34) Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sababi iakraviaton irodai az rokh'i rost gumrokh' namudan va az kh'idoiat makh'rum sokhtani shumoro kunad, nasikh'at va pandi man ba shumo sud namerasonad. U Parvardigori shumo va Moliki tamomi korkh'oiaton ast. Agar khokh'ad, shumoro gumrokh' mesozad. Va dar ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui U bargardonida meshaved. On ruz shumoro baroi amalkh'oi anch'omdodaaton ch'azoi bosazo medikh'ad."

35) Balki mushrikon meguiand: "Mukh'ammad in dinashro az peshi khud bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bofta ast." Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Agar onro az nazdi khud bofta bosham, pas ch'azoi gunokh'am tankh'o bar man ast va chizero az gunokh'i takzibi shumo bar ukh'dai khesh namegiram va Ba durusti ki man az on bezoram."

36) Va Parvardigor ba Nukh' paig'om firistoda guft: "Ei Nukh', minba'd az miioni k'avmat ch'uz shakhse, ki to imruz imon ovardaast, kh'ech' kas imon nameorad. Pas, baroi tamaskhur va takzibe, ki onkh'o dar in muddati tuloni dar kh'ak'k'i tu ravo didaand, g'amgin mashav.

37) Va zeri nazaru kh'ifozat va bar asosi vakh'ii ta'lim dodanat oidi tarzi kishtisozi kishti bisoz va bo Man baroi darkhosti mukh'lat dodani kasone, ki ba sababi kufr varzidan bar ch'oni khesh ch'avr kardaand, guftugu makun. Chunki onkh'o beguftugu ba vasilai tufon g'ark' karda meshavand. In uk'ubati pofishori va idoma dodani kufrashon ast."

38) Va Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) dasturi Parvardigorashro ich'ro namuda, ba sokhtani kishti shuru' kard. Va kh'ar vak'te sarkardagon va peshvoioni k'avmash az nazdash meguzashtand, uro maskhara mekardand. Chunki vai kishtiro dar kh'olate mesokht, ki dar zamin ob va dario nabud. Chun tamaskhurashon paii kh'am takror shud, ba onkh'o guft: "Ei ch'amoa, agar imruz baroi sokhtani kishti moro maskhara mekuned, kh'atman mo niz shumoro on guna ki moro maskhara mekuned, maskhara khokh'em kard, zero namedoned, ki ok'ibati koraton ba g'ark' shudan dar tufon meanch'omad.
39) Pas ba zudi on kasero, ki dar dunio baroiash azob omada, uro khoru rasvo mekunad va ruzi okhirat bar vai uk'ubati doimi furud meoiad, khokh'ed donist."

40) Va Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) ba dasturi Parvardigor kori kishtisoziro idoma dod, to on gokh', ki farmoni Mo oidi kh'alok kardani onkh'o omad va baroi e'loni og'ozi tufon obi tanuri dar on non mepukhtaashon ch'ushid, ba Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) guftem: "Dar kishti az kh'ar nav'i kh'aivonoti rui zamin du ch'insi naru modai on va akh'li khonadonatro bardor, magar on kasero, ki kh'ukmi Mo dar borai on ki az ch'umlai g'ark'shavandagon ast, dar kh'ak'k'ash guzashta boshad. Zero vai imon naovarda ast. Va inchunin kasonero az k'avmat, ki kh'amrokh'i tu imon ovardaand, dar on kishti bardor." Va dar kh'amai on muddati tulonie, ki Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) dar baini k'avmash baroi da'vati onkh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zindagi kard, ch'uz te'dodi andak digar kase bo u imon naovard.

41) Va Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) ba khonadonash va k'avmi imon ovardaash guft: "Ba kishti savor shaved. Ravon shudan va istodani on ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'amono Parvardigoram nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash Omurzandai Mekh'rubon ast." Az nishonakh'oi rakh'matash ba bandagoni mu'minash on ast, ki onkh'oro az kh'alokat nach'ot doda ast.

42) Va kishti bo mardumi dar darunash buda va digaron dar mavch'i buzurgi shabekh'i kukh'kh'o kh'arakat mekard va Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) az rui ekh'sosi padari farzandi kofirashro, ki az padar va k'avmash dar karona k'aror dosht, nido karda guft: "Ei pisaram, kh'amrokh'i mo ba kishti savor shav, to az g'ark' shudan nach'ot iobi va bo kofiron mabosh, ki monandi onkh'o dar tufon g'ark' meshavi."

43) Pisari Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) dar ch'avobi padarash guft: "Ba zudi ba tarafi kukh'i baland panokh' mebaram, to maro az rasidani tufon nigokh' dorad." Nukh' ba pisarash guft: "Imruz kase azobi ba vasilai tufon g'ark' sokhtani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro man' karda nametavonad, magar on kase, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar vai rakh'm karda, az g'ark' shudan nach'otash dikh'ad." Va mavch'i tufon Nukh' va pisari kofirashro az iakdigar ch'udo sokht. Pas, pisarash ba sababi kufr varzidan az ch'umlai g'ark'shudagon gardid.

44) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba'd az anch'omi tufon ba zamin guft: "Ei zamin, obi tufoni bar ruiat budaro furu bar." Va ba osmon guft: "Ei osmon, az boridan man' shav va boron mafirist." Va ob to kh'addi khushk shudani zamin kam gashta, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofironro kh'alok gardonid va on kishti dar boloi kukh'i ba nomi "Ch'udi" istod va gufta shud: "Duri va kh'alokat bod baroi k'avme, ki ba sababi kufr varzidan az marzkh'oi Parvardigor guzashtand."

45) Va Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) bo k'asdi kumakkhokh'i Parvardigorashro nido karda guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, Ba durusti ki farzandam az ch'umlai khonadoni man ast, ki Tu va'dai nach'ot dodani onkh'oro dodai va kh'amono va'dai Tu rost buda, khilof nameshavad va Tu Odiltarin va Donotarini dovaron va kh'ukmkunandagon kh'asti."

46) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Nukh' guft: "Ei Nukh', beshak, pisarat az ch'umlai akh'li oilaat, ki va'dai az azob rakh'o kardanashonro dodaam, nest. Zero u kofir ast. Ei Nukh', in nav'i pursish baroi shakhse monandi tu, ki dar mak'omi nubuvvat k'aror dorad, shoista nameboshad. Pas, az Man on chiro, ki dar boraash donish nadori, napurs. Kh'amono Man turo az in ki az zumrai ch'okh'ilon gardida, chizero purson shavi, ki bo donishu kh'ikmatam mukholif ast, barkh'azar medoram."

47) Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Parvardigoro, ba durusti, man az pursidani on chi dar boraash donish nadoram, ba Tu panokh' mebaram va agar gunokh'i maro naomurzi va mavridi rakh'matat k'aror nadikh'i, az ziionkorone megardam, ki dar okhirat benasiba kh'astand."

48) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Nukh', bo amnu osoishtagi az sui Mo va ne'matkh'oi ziiodamon bar tu va nasli mu'minoni kh'amrokh'at, ki ba'd az tu meoiand, az kishti poion shav. Va ummatkh'oi kofiri digare az naslashon padid meoiand, ki Mo onkh'oro dar dunio az kh'aiot bakh'ramand mesozem va ba onkh'o vasoili zindagiro medikh'em, sipas dar ruzi k'iiomat az sui Mo baroiashon azobi dardovar merasad."

49) In k'issai Nukh' az khabarkh'oi g'aib ast. Ei Paiombar, na tu va na k'avmat pesh az omadani paig'om dar borai on ma'lumot nadoshted. Pas, chunonchi Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) dar rokh'i da'vat sabr kard, tu niz dar barobari ozor va takzibi k'avmat sabrro pesha kun. Ba durusti, piruzi va g'olibiiat az bandagoni parkh'ezkorest, ki dasturoti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o meorand va az man'kardakh'oi U duri mech'uiand.

50) Va Mo ba sui k'avmi Od barodarashon Kh'udro firistodem. Vai ba onkh'o guft: "Ei k'avmi man, tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ibodat karda, ba U kasero sharik nasozed. Shumo ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) digar ma'budi barkh'ak' nadored. Va shumo dar da'voi khesh, ki guio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik dorad, dar kh'ak'ik'at nisbat ba U durug' mebofed.

51) Ei k'avmam, man dar ivazi on chi az ch'onibi Parvardigoram baroiaton merasonam va shumoro ba suiash da'vat mekunam, az shumo podosh namekhokh'am. Podoshi man tankh'o bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, ki maro khalk' karda ast. Oio shumo inro namefakh'med va oio da'vati maro k'abul namekuned?!

52) Va ei k'avmi man, az Parvardigoraton omurzish bikhokh'ed, sipas az gunokh'onaton, ki shirk buzurgtarini on ast, ba sui U sidk'an tavba kuned, U ba in vasila bo furud ovardani boron bar shumo podosh medikh'ad va ba sababi bisior kardani shumorai naslu molkh'oiaton nerui shumoro bar nerui doshtaaton meafzoiad va az on chi shumoro ba suiash da'vat mekunam, rui nagardoned, zero dar in surat bo rui toftan az da'vat, kofir gashtan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va durug' shumoridani oiinam az ch'umlai gunakh'koron megarded."

53) K'avmash dar ch'avobash guftand: "Ei Kh'ud, baroiamon daleli k'obili e'timode naovardi, ki boisi imon ovardanamon gardad va mo ba khotiri sukhanoni beasosat ibodati ma'budkh'oi kheshtanro tark namekunem va ba tu dar da'voi on ki paiombari Khudo kh'asti, imon nameorem."

54-55) Mo tankh'o kh'aminro meguem, ki chun az ibodati ma'budkh'oiamon moro man' mekuni, ba'zei ma'budkh'oiamon bo badi ziionat rasonidaand va devona shudai. Kh'ud (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ba durusti, man Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro guvokh' megiram va shumo niz guvokh' boshed, ki man az ibodati ma'budkh'oi g'airi Parvardigor meparastidai shumo bezoram. Pas shumovu on ma'budkh'oiaton, ki guio bo devonagi maro ziion rasonidaand, kh'ar chi az dastaton meoiad, anch'om dikh'ed va maro mukh'lat nadikh'ed.

54-55) Mo tankh'o kh'aminro meguem, ki chun az ibodati ma'budkh'oiamon moro man' mekuni, ba'zei ma'budkh'oiamon bo badi ziionat rasonidaand va devona shudai. Kh'ud (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ba durusti, man Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro guvokh' megiram va shumo niz guvokh' boshed, ki man az ibodati ma'budkh'oi g'airi Parvardigor meparastidai shumo bezoram. Pas shumovu on ma'budkh'oiaton, ki guio bo devonagi maro ziion rasonidaand, kh'ar chi az dastaton meoiad, anch'om dikh'ed va maro mukh'lat nadikh'ed.

56) Beshak, man ba Allokh'i Parvardigori khud va Parvardigori shumo tavakkul namuda, dar korkh'oiam tankh'o ba U takia doram. Kh'ech' chiz dar zamin namech'unbad, magar on ki mute' va tobei Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, zeri farmonravoi va saltanati Ust. On guna ki khokh'ad, onro megardonad. Begumon, Parvardigori man dar rokh'i kh'ak' va adolat ast. Binobar in, shumoro bar man kh'ukmfarmo namegardonad. Zero man dar rokh'i durust va shumo dar rokh'i botiled.

57) Pas agar az on chi ba shumo ovardaam, rui gardonida, k'abul nakuned, bidoned, ki bar ukh'dai man ch'uz rasonidani on ba shumo chize nest. Va beshak, kh'ar on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) maro baroi rasonidanash firistod, ba shumo rasonidam. Shumo digar uzre nadored. Kh'atman Parvardigoram shumoro kh'alok megardonad va baroi ch'onishinii shumo k'avmi digarero g'airi shumo meorad va ba sababi takzib namudan va napaziruftani dinam ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kamtarin zarar rasonida nametavoned. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az bandagonash beniioz ast. Iak'inan Parvardigoram bar kh'ama chiz Nozir ast. U maro az badii makre, ki muk'obilam mesozed, nigokh' medorad."

58) Va vak'te farmoni Mo dar borai kh'alok kardani onkh'o omad, bo rakh'mati Khesh Kh'ud va mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ashro nach'ot doda, onkh'oro az azobi sakhte, ki k'avmi kofirashro faro girift, solim nigokh' doshtem.

59) Va in sarguzashti k'avmi Od ast. Oiatkh'oi Parvardigorashonro inkor namuda, ba on kofir shudand va Paiombarashonro nofarmoni kardand va az farmoni kh'ar mutakabbiri sarkash, ki kh'ak'ro rad namuda, mutei on nameshud, pairavi kardand.

60) Va dar zindagonii in dunio rasvoi va rondashavi az rakh'mati ilokh'i dunbolagirashon shud va ruzi k'iiomat niz az rakh'mati ilokh'i dur meshavand. Sababi in kh'ama uk'ubatkh'o dar on ast, ki onkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudand. Ogokh' boshed! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Odi k'avmi Kh'udro az kh'ar amali nek dur va ba kh'ar amali bad nazdik sokhta bud.

61) Va ba sui Samud barodarashon Solekh'ro firistodem. Vai ba onkh'o guft: "Ei k'avmi man, tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ibodat kuned. Shumo g'airi U digar ma'budi sazovori parastish nadored. U shumoro az khoki zamin (bo ofaridani Padaraton Odam az on) khalk' karda va shumoro me'moroni zamin sokhta ast. Pas az U omurzish khosta, bo anch'omi ibodat va tarki ma'siiat ba sui U bargarded. Kh'amono Parvardigoram ba kase, ki ibodatro kholis anch'om medikh'ad, k'arib buda, duoi duokunandaro k'abul mekunad."

62) K'avmi Solekh' ba u guftand: "Ei Solekh', pesh az in da'vatkh'oiat dar miioni mo sokh'ibi mak'omi baland budi. Ba durusti, mo umed doshtem, ki tu shakhsi ok'ilu sokh'ibi nasikh'at va akh'li mashvarat boshi. Ei Solekh', oio moro az parastidani ma'budkh'oe, ki k'abl az in padaronamon onkh'oro meparastidand, man' mekuni?! Va mo kh'amono dar borai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki moro ba ibodatash da'vat mekuni, shubkh'ai sakht dorem. In bois megardad, ki turo ba durug'gui dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muttakh'am kunem."

63) Solekh' dar posukhi k'avmash guft: "Ei k'avmi man, baroiam khabar dikh'ed! Agar man az sui Parvardigoram daleli vozekh' doshta bosham va ba man az sui Khud nubuvvatro doda boshad, pas agar bo tarki tablig'i dasturotash Uro nofarmoni kunam, chi kase maro az uk'ubati U kh'imoiat mekunad?! Pas, shumo baroiam chizero g'air az gumrokh' sokhtan va dur shudan az rozigii U afzun namesozed?!

64) Va ei k'avmi man, in modashuturi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, baroiaton alomati isbotkunandai sadok'ati man ast. Pas, onro ba kh'oli khud guzored, to dar zamini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bicharad va bo iagon nav'i ozor ba on dastdarozi nakuned, ki dar on surat ba shumo azobi nazdik va ta'ch'ili merasad."

65) Pas onkh'o Solekh'ro ba durug'gui nisbat doda, modashuturro zabkh' kardand. Solekh' ba'di in ch'inoiat ba onkh'o guft: "Az og'ozi vak'ti zabkh'i on dar sarzamini khud ba muddati se ruz az zindagi bakh'ra bared. Sipas, baroiaton azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meoiad. Omadani uk'ubat ba'di guzashtani in muddat va'dai beguftugu vok'e'shavanda buda, durug' nest, balki on va'dai kh'ak' va rost ast."

66) Pas chun farmoni Mo oidi kh'alok sokhtani onkh'o sodir shud, bo rakh'mati Khesh Solekh' va digar mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ashro nach'ot dodem va onkh'oro az zillat va rasvoii on ruz solim nigokh' doshtem. Ei Paiombar, ba durusti, Parvardigori tu Zoti Nerumandi G'olibest, ki kase Uro mag'lub namesozad. Az in ru, ummatkh'oi takzibkunandaro kh'alok sokht.
67) Va k'avmi Samudro sadoi sakhti kh'aloksozanda faro girift, pas onkh'o az sakhtii on sado murdand va bo chekh'raashon ba zamin aftodand, dar kh'ole ki ruiashon ba khok chaspida bud.

68) Onkh'o on chunon giriftori uk'ubati shadid shudand, ki guio dar sarzamini khud dar ne'mat va zindagonii farokh ba sar naburdaand. Ogokh' boshed! Ba durusti, k'avmi Samud ba Allokh'i Parvardigori khesh kofir shudand. Ogokh' boshed! Onkh'o kh'amesha az rakh'mati Kh'ak' dur kh'astand.

69) Va Ba durusti ki farishtagon ba surati mard nazdi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) omadand, dar kh'ole ki U va kh'amsarashro ba tavalludi Iskh'ok' va ba'd az vai Ia'k'ub bashorat dodand. Farishtagon ba Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) "Salom" guftand. Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) niz dar ch'avobi onkh'o "Salom" guft va shitobon az nazdashon raft va dere naguzashta bud, ki baroiashon gushti gusolai birion ovard, to az on bikhurand. Zero u gumon dosht, ki onkh'o insonand.

70) Pas chun Ibrokh'im did, ki dastonashon ba gushti gusolai birion namerasad va az on namekhurand, in amalashonro napisandid va tarsi khudro az onkh'o dar k'albash pinkh'on kard. Ba'd az in vak'te farishtagon kh'olati tarsi Ibrokh'imro mushokh'ida kardand, guftand: "Az mo natars. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moro baroi uk'ubat kardani k'avmi Lut firistoda ast."

71) Va Sorai kh'amsari Ibrokh'im onch'o rost istoda bud. Pas, Mo uro bo on chi khushkh'olash mesokht, bashorat dodem. Khabari farakh'bakhsh on bud, ki Sora pisarash Iskh'ok'ro ba dunio meorad va Iskh'ok' sokh'ibi pisare bo nomi Ia'k'ub meshavad. Pas Sora khandid va az khabari shunidaash izkh'ori khushkh'oli namud.

72) Vak'te farishtagon Sorai kh'amsari Ibrokh'imro bo on khabari farakh'bakhsh muzhda dodand, vai bo taach'ch'ub guft: "Ach'abo! Chitavr man farzand mezoiam, dar kh'ole ki pirazan gardida, az zodani farzand navmedam va in shavkh'aram niz ba sinni pironsoli rasidaast?! Dar chunin kh'olat ba dunio ovardani farzand kori kh'airatovar ast. Odatan dar chunin kh'olat va sinnu sol in kor surat namegirad."

73) Farishtagon ba Sora ba'di taach'ch'ub namudanash guftand: "Oio az k'azovu k'adari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) taach'ch'ub dori?! Baroi shakhsi monandi tu pushida nest, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba in guna korkh'o k'udrat dorad. Ei khonadoni Ibrokh'im, rakh'matu barakoti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo bod. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar sifot va af'olash Zoti Sutudai Azim ast."

74) Pas vak'te ki kh'arosi ba sababi taom nakhurdani mekh'monon Ibrokh'imro faro girifta ba'di ma'lumshavii farishta budanashon az bain raft va baroiash khabari khushkh'olkunanda rasid, ki dar ruzkh'oi nazdik sokh'ibi farzand meshavad, bo farishtagoni firistodai Mo dar borai k'avmi Lut ba munozara og'oz kard, to onkh'o azobro az k'avmi Lut ba ta'khir andozand va Lutro bo khonadonash nach'ot dikh'and.
75) Ba durusti, Ibrokh'im bandai burdbori ba sui Parvardigorash ziiod zoriiu tavallo va duovu tavbakunanda bud. U ba ta'khir guzoshtani azobro dust medosht.

76) Farishtagon guftand: "Ei Ibrokh'im, az in munozara oidi k'avmi Lut boz ist. Kh'amono farmoni Parvardigorat vobasta ba vuk'ui azobi baroiashon muk'addargashta omada ast va beshak, baroi k'avmi Lut uk'ubati buzurge meoiad, ki munozara va duo peshi rokh'i onro namegirad."

77) Va chun farishtagon nazdi Lut ba surati mard omadand, in guna omadan ba u pisand naomad va ba sababi khavfe, ki az k'avmi bachabozash nisbat ba on farishtagon dosht, k'albash ba tang omad va guft: "Imruz-ruzi bisior sakht ast." Zero gumon kard, ki k'avmash uro dar robita ba mekh'monon mag'lub va sharmsor mekunand.

78) Va k'avmi Lut bo mak'sadi anch'omi amali zishti bachabozi bo mekh'mononi vai shitobon nazdash omadand. Va odati onkh'o pesh az in on bud, ki zanonro rakh'o sokhta, bachabozi mekardand. Lut ba khotiri kh'imoiat az mekh'monon va baioni uzrash nazdi onkh'o ba k'avmash guft: "In gurukh'i khonumoni in dekh'a dukhtaroni man makh'sub meshavand. Pas, bo onkh'o izdivoch' kuned. Zero onkh'o baroi shumo az anch'omi amali bachabozi poktarand. Pas, az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va dar kh'ak'k'i mekh'mononam baroi man nangu rasvoiro naored. Ei mardum, oio az miioni shumo iak mardi sokh'ibi ak'li solim, ki az in fakh'sho man' kunad, nest?"

79) K'avmi Lut ba vai guftand: "Ei Lut, kh'amono tu medoni, ki mo ba dukhtaroni tu va zanoni k'avmat niioz va mail nadorem va chi khostanamonro niz medoni. Mo ba ch'uz mardon kh'ech' kasi digarero namekhokh'em."
80) Lut guft: "Ei kosh, neru medoshtam io sokh'ibi takiagokh'e az sui kheshovandonam mebudam, to shumoro az in amal man' mekardam va peshi rokh'i dastdaroziaton ba mekh'mononi khudro megiriftam."

81) Farishtagon guftand: "Ei Lut, kh'amono mo firistodagoni Parvardigorat kh'astem. Kh'argiz k'avmat ba tu zarar namerasonand. Pas shab dar soati toriki kh'amrokh'i khonadonat az in dekh'a berun shav va kase az shumo ba ak'ibash nigokh' nakunad, magar kh'amsarat, ki ba in dastur mukholifat karda, ba tarafi ak'ib nigokh' mekunad. Zero beguftugu, on uk'ubate, ki ba k'avmat rasad, ba kh'amsarat niz merasad. Ba durusti, zamoni va'dai kh'alokati onkh'o subkh' ast. Subkh' khele nazdik ast."
82) Pas vak'te amri Mo dar borai kh'alok sokhtani k'avmi Lut omad, on dekh'akh'oro kh'amrokh'i sokinonash zeru zabar sokhta va bar onkh'o sangkh'oi az nav'i gili sakhti paiopai boridem.

83) Sangkh'o nazdi Parvardigorat bo alomati khos nishon guzoshta shuda bud. Va rekhtani in guna sangkh'o bar zolimoni K'uraish va g'airi onkh'o dur nest, balki on nazdik ast. Kh'ar gokh' Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar in zolimon furud ovardani onro muk'addar gardonad, furud meoiad.

84) Va ba sui Madian barodarashon Shuaibro firistodem. Vai ba onkh'o guft: "Ei k'avmi man, tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ibodat kuned. Shumo g'airi U digar ma'budi sazovori parastish nadored. Va vak'te dar kharidufurush baroi mardum bo paimona io vazn barmekashed, az on kam nakuned. Kh'amono man shumoro dar ruzii farokh va ne'mati farovon mebinam. Baroi kh'amin, ba sababi anch'om dodani gunokh' ne'mati ilokh'iro tag'iir nadikh'ed. Va ba durusti, man baroi shumo az giriftor shudan ba azobi ruzi ikh'otakunanda, ki kh'amaatonro faro megirad, metarsam. Shumo az on azob gurekhta nametavoned va panokh'gokh'e niz nameiobed.

85) Va ei k'avmi man, vak'te baroi digaron chizero bo paimona io tarozu barmekashed, onro odilona komil kuned va bo kam kunonidani paimonavu tarozu io firebkori chizero az kh'uk'uk'i mardum kam nasozed va dar zamin bo k'atlu digar nav'kh'oi ch'inoiat fasodkori nakuned.

86) Manfiat va barakati mik'dori bok'imondai kh'alole, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro ba'di odilona ba tavri komil ado kardani kh'uk'uk'i mardum meguzorad, baroiaton az moli ziiodatii bo rokh'i fireb dar paimonavu tarozu va fasodkori kh'osilshavanda beshtar va bekh'tar meboshad. Agar dar vok'e' mu'min kh'asted, pas ba kh'amin mik'dori bok'iguzoshtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rozi shaved. Va man noziru nigakh'boni shumo nestam, ki korkh'oiatonro shumorida, bar asosi on bozpursiaton kunam. Ba durusti, nozir va nigakh'boni korkh'o On Zotest, ki oshkoru nikh'onro medonad."

87) K'avmi Shuaib ba vai guftand: "Ei Shuaib, oio namozat turo farmon medikh'ad, ki mo parastishi on chiro padaronamon ibodat mekardand, tark kunem io az on ki dar molkh'oiamon tibk'i khosti khud amal mekunem va ba rokh'kh'oi baroiamon ma'k'ul onro rushd medikh'em boz istem?! Ba durusti ki tu mardi burdbori sokh'ibkhirad kh'asti. Turo pesh az in rokh'at kh'amchun mardi ok'ilu kh'akim meshinokhtem. Ba tu chi shudaast?"

88) Shuaib ba k'avmash guft: "Ei k'avmi man, agar man az ch'onibi Parvardigoram kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan va ma'rifat doshta bosham va az nazdi khesh baroiam rizk'i kh'alolro, ki nubuvvat ch'uz'i on ast, ruzi karda boshad, vak'te kh'ak'ik'at in ast, pas, ba man az kh'oli khud khabar dikh'ed. Va namekhokh'am shumoro az chize man' karda, khud bo anch'omi on bo shumo mukholifat kunam. Mak'sadi man az da'vati shumo ba sui iaktoparasti va ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tankh'o az on iborat ast, ki ba k'adri tavon islokh'aton namoiam va tavfik'i man baroi kh'osil namudani in kh'adaf fak'at dar ikhtiiori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Dar tamomi korkh'oiam tankh'o ba U tavakkul doram va ba suiash barmegardam.

89) Ei k'avmi man, naboiad dushmaniaton bo man shumoro boisi takzibi dinam gardad, zero khavf doram, ki monandi uk'ubati ba k'avmi Nukh' io k'avmi Kh'ud io k'avmi Solekh' rasida ba shumo niz merasad va k'avmi Lut ba e'tibori zamon va makon az shumo dur nestand va medoned, ki ok'ibatashon bo chi anch'om ioft. Pas az guzashtai onkh'o ibrat gired.
90) Va az Parvardigoraton talabi mag'firat namoed, sipas, az gunokh'onaton ba suiash bargashta, sidk'an tavba kuned. Ba durusti, Parvardigoram nisbat ba tavbakoron Mekh'ruboni Dustdor ast."

91) Va k'avmi Shuaib ba vai guftand: "Ei Shuaib, mo beshtari on chiro ovardai, namefakh'mem va kh'amono mo turo dar bainamon notavoni zalil mebinem. Va agar k'abilaat dar dini mo namebud, begumon turo sangsor karda, mekushtem va tu baroi mo aziz nesti, ki az k'atlat kh'aros namoem. Sababi turo nakushtanamon on ast, ki ba k'abilaat ekh'tirom dorem."

92) Shuaib ba k'avmash guft: "Ei k'avmi man, oio k'abilaam nazdi shumo az Allokh'i Parvardigoraton ekh'tiromi beshtar dorand?! Va vak'te ba Paiombari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon naovarded, in koraton ma'noi onro dorad, ki Uro pushti saraton andokhta, faromush kardaed. Kh'amono Parvardigoram tamomi on chiro mekuned, ikh'otakunanda ast. Iagon kori shumo az U makhfi nameboshad. Ba sababi korkh'oiaton dar dunio va okhirat ch'azoiaton medikh'ad.

93) Va ei k'avmi man, kh'ar kori dar tavonaton budaro ba kh'amon ravishe, ki onro baroi khud pisandidaed, ich'ro kuned, ba durusti, man niz on chiro metavonam, tibk'i usuli baroi khesh pisandidaam ba ch'o meoram. Kh'atman khokh'ed donist, ki azobi khorkunandai ilokh'i ba kadomi mo meoiad va khokh'ed donist, ki az baini manu shumo ki dar da'voiash durug'gui ast. Pas, muntaziri kh'ukmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boshed. Beshak, man niz bo shumo intizor meshavam."

94) Va chun farmoni Mo baroi kh'alok kardani k'avmi Shuaib omad, bo rakh'mati Khesh Shuaibro bo mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ash nach'ot dodem va k'avmi zolimashro sadoi sakhti kh'aloksozanda faro girift. Pas kh'amagi dar zamin bar chekh'ra aftoda, dar kh'ole ki ruiashon ba khok chaspid, kh'alok shudand.

95) On chunon mavridi uk'ubat k'aror giriftand, ki guio pesh az in dar rui zamin nabudand. Ogokh' boshed! Chunonchi k'avmi Samud bo furud omadani khashmi ilokh'i az rakh'matash ronda gashtand, kh'amin guna akh'li Madian bo omadani azobash az rakh'matash ronda shudand.
96) Va iak'inan Musoro bo oiatkh'oi Khud, ki bar iagonagii Ofaridgor dalolat mekard va bo mu'ch'izakh'oi ravshani nishondikh'andai durustii nubuvvatash firistodem.
97) Uro ba nazdi Fir'avn va rakh'baroni k'avmash firistodem. In ch'amoai ashrof az farmoni Fir'avn pairavi karda, kofir shudand. Va farmoni Fir'avn durusti rakh'namoi kh'ak' va loik'i pairavi nabud.
98) Ruzi k'iiomat Fir'avn peshopeshi k'avmash meshavad, pas onkh'oro ba duzakh medarorad va duzakhi ch'oii voridshaviashon, ki onkh'oro vorid mesozad, nikh'oiat makoni bad ast.

99) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in dunio ilova bar uk'ubati g'ark'shaviashon dar bakh'r onkh'oro az rakh'matash dur sokht va dar ruzi k'iiomat niz az rakh'matash durashon mesozad. On chi baroiashon az la'natu azob dar dunio va okhirat kh'osil meshavad, bag'oiat bad ast.

100) Ei Paiombar, Mo akhbori dar in sura zikrshudaro ba tu khabar medikh'em. Az baini in dekh'akh'o nishonakh'oi ba'zeash bok'i va nishonakh'oi ba'zei digarash makh'vshuda va ba monandi ziroati daravshuda az on kh'ech' asare namonda ast.

101) Va Mo dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o bo kh'alok sokhtanashon sitam nakardaem, valekin onkh'o bo kofir shudan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khudro ba kh'alokat andokhta, bar ch'onashon zulm kardand. Pas ei Paiombar, chun amri Parvardigori tu oidi kh'alokatashon omad, ma'budkh'oiashon, ki onkh'oro ba g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastidand, uk'ubatashonro az onkh'o dur nakardand va ch'uz ziion va kh'alokat chizero baroiashon naafzudand.

102) Va kh'aloksozii Parvardigor, ki dar kh'ama davru zamon akh'li takzibgari dekh'akh'oro nobud kardaast, kh'amin guna ast. Begumon azobi U baroi akh'li sitamgari dekh'akh'o uk'ubati dardovari bag'oiat sakht ast.

103) Ba durusti, dar sakht uk'ubat dodani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) akh'li sitamgari on dekh'akh'oro baroi kase, ki az azobi ruzi k'iiomat kh'aros dorad, pand ast. On ruz ruze ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tamomi mardumro baroi bozpursi ch'am' meorad va on ruz ruze ast, ki mardum dar on kh'ozir karda meshavand.
104) Va Mo on ruzro tankh'o to iak muddati andaki ba Khud ma'lum ba ta'khir meandozem.

105) Vak'te on ruz meoiad, kh'ech' kas dar borai ovardani kh'uch'ch'at io be rukhsati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shafoat kardan sukhan namekunad. Pas mardum on ruz du gurukh'and. Gurukh'i badbakhti duzakhi va gurukh'i nekbakhti akh'li bikh'isht.
106) Pas ammo kasone, ki ba sababi kufr va fasodi amalkh'oiashon badbakht shudand, dokhili duzakh gardida, az shiddati ranch'i otashi duzakh sado va nolakh'oiashon dar onch'o baland meshavad.

107) Dar duzakh abadi memonand. Az duzakh to zamoni bak'oi osmonkh'o va zamin namebaroiand, magar on isionkoroni iaktoparaste, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baromadanashonro bikhokh'ad. Ei Paiombar, begumon Parvardigorat kh'ar korero khokh'ad, anch'om medikh'ad. Kase Uro mach'bur sokhta nametavonad.

108) Va ammo kasone, ki ba sababi imon va ich'roi amalkh'oi shoista nekbakht shuda va baroiashon dar tak'dir az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) saodat guzashta ast, pas dar ch'annat abadi memonand. Az on to vak'ti bak'oi osmonkh'o va zamin namebaroiand, ch'uz on mu'minoni gunakh'kore, ki Parvardigori tu k'abl az vorid gashtan ba bikh'isht ba duzakh daromadanashonro khokh'ad. Ba durusti ki ne'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar akh'li bikh'isht k'at'noshavanda ast.

109) Pas, ei Paiombar, az botil budani on chi in ch'amoai mushrik meparastand, dar shak mabosh. Onkh'o oidi durustii amalashon daleli ak'liiu shar'i nadorand. Begumon angezai asosiashon az ibodati g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tak'lid az padaronashon ast. On guna ki k'ablan padaronashon but meparastidand, onkh'o niz ma'budkh'oi botilro meparastand. Va Mo sakh'mashonro az azob be kamiiu kosti baroiashon medikh'em.

110) Va dar kh'ak'ik'at Mo ba Muso Tavrotro dodem. Pas mardum dar borai on ikhtilof kardand. Ba'zei onkh'o ba on imon ovarda va ba'zei digar kofir shudand. Va agar k'azoi ilokh'i dar mavridi dar kh'ol uk'ubat nakardan, balki bo kh'ikmati baroiash ma'lum azobashonro to okhirat ba ta'khir guzoshtan nameguzasht, kh'atman dar dunio bar onkh'o azobi sazovore furud meovard. Va kh'amono iakh'ud va mushrikon oidi K'ur'on dar shakki nikh'oiat k'avi k'aror dorand.

111) Va Ei Paiombar, ba durusti ki Parvardigorat ch'azoi a'moli kh'amai ikhtilofkunandagoni zikrshudaro komilan medikh'ad. Dar ivazi neki ch'azoi nek va dar ivazi badi ch'azoi bad ato mekunad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tamomi korkh'oero, ki anch'om medikh'and, dak'ik' medonad. Amali onkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pinkh'on namemonad.

112) Ei Paiombar, ustuvoriatro dar rokh'i rost on guna ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dasturat doda ast, idoma bidekh'. Amrashro ich'ro kun va az on chi man'at mekunad, biparkh'ez. Va inchunin boiad mu'minoni kh'amrokh'at, ki imon ovardaand, dar rokh'i rost ustuvor boshand. Va bo gunokh' az marzi ilokh'i tach'ovuz nakuned. Begumon on korkh'oero, ki mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mebinad. Kh'ech' amalaton az U makhfi nest va dar ivazi on shumoro ch'azo khokh'ad dod.

113) Va ba kofironi zolim az rokh'i tamalluk', mudoro va mukh'abbat moil nashaved, ki on gokh' ba shumo otashi duzakh merasad va shumo ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dustone nadored, ki az otashi duzakh rakh'oiaton sozand, sipas baroi khud iorirasonero paido namekuned, ki ioriaton rasonad.

114) Va ei Paiombar, namozro dar avvalu okhiri ruz va soatkh'oe az shab barpo namo. Ba durusti ki korkh'oi shoista gunokh'oni khurdro makh'v mesozand. In sukhanon baroi shakhsoni pandpazir pandu ibratand.

115) Va bar on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo az ustuvori dar rokh'i durust va g'airi on farmon doda va az zulmu moil shudan ba zolimon man' karda ast, sabr kun. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savobi nekukoronro botil namesozad, balki amalashonro pazirufta, savobi az on bekh'tarro medikh'ad.

116) Pas charo az miioni ummatkh'oi k'abl az shumo mavridi uk'ubat k'aror girifta sokh'iboni fazlu salokh'e nabudand, ki on ummatkh'oro az kufr va fasodkori dar zamin man' kunand, magar gurukh'i kami sokh'ibi fazl va islokh'kor, ki mardumro az fasod man' mekardand. Pas vak'te sitamkoronashonro kh'alok sokhtem, islokh'koronashonro nach'ot dodem. Va sitamkoronashon az doroi, zindagonii farokh va shakh'vatkh'oi duniavi, ki dar on k'aror doshtand, pairavi kardand va ba kh'amin sabab gunakh'kori zolim budand.

117) Va ei Paiombar, beshak, Parvardigorat chunin nest, ki dekh'aero dar kh'ole ki sokinonash islokh'korand, zolimona kh'alok sozad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro vak'te kh'alok mesozad, ki bo kufru zulmu gunokh' fasod kunand.

118) Va ei Paiombar, agar Parvardigorat mekhost, kh'amai mardumro dar rokh'i kh'ak' millati iaknavokht megardonid, lekin U inro nakhosta ast. Pas mardum ba sababi pairavii kh'avoi nafs va sitamkori paivasta bo kh'am dar borai kh'ak' ikhtilof dorand -

119) magar on kasone, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro bo bakhshidani tavfik'i kh'idoiat mavridi rakh'mati Khesh k'aror doda ast. In gurukh'i mardum dar bobi ak'ida ikhtilof nadorand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro baroi ozmudan bo rokh'i ikhtilof khalk' karda ast. Ba'zei onkh'o khushbakht va ba'zei digar badbakht kh'astand. Va ei Paiombar, kalimai azalii Parvardigorat oidi on ki duzakhro az tobeoni insi va ch'innii shaiton pur mekunad, k'at'i gashta ast.

120) Va ei Paiombar, kh'ar khabarero az akhbori paiombaroni guzashta baroiat k'issa mekunem, mak'sad az nak'li in rukhdodkh'o on ast, ki mekhokh'em ba in vasila k'albatro dar rokh'i kh'ak' ustuvor va k'avi sozem. Va dar in sura turo kh'ak'ik'at va kofironro pand va mu'minonro, ki az tazakkur dodan foida mebarand, iodovari omada ast.

121) Va ei Paiombar, ba kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon nadorand va Uro ba iagonagi nameshinosand, bigu: "Bar rokh'i khesh dar rui toftan az kh'ak' va man' kardani mardum az on amal kuned, mo niz bar rokh'i khud az ustuvor istodan dar on, da'vati digaron ba sui on va sabr dar barobari ozorkh'o amal mekunem.
122) Va muntaziri on chi bar mo furud meoiad, boshed va mo niz muntaziri on chi bar shumo furud meoiad, kh'astem."

123) Ilmi g'aibi osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nest. Va dar ruzi k'iiomat kh'ama korkh'o ba sui U bargardonida meshavad. Pas, ei Paiombar, iagona Uro biparast va dar kh'ama korkh'oiat ba U tavakkul kun. Va Parvardigorat az on chi mekuned, g'ofil nest, balki kh'amaro medonad va ba kh'ar iak kas ch'azoi sazovor khokh'ad dod.
1) "Alif. Lom. Ro." Oiatkh'oi in surai muborak oiatkh'oi K'ur'onest, ki dar baioni mukh'tavoiash ravshan ast.
2) Ba durusti ki Mo K'ur'onro bo zaboni arabi furud ovardem, to shumo mardumi arab maonii onro bifakh'med.

3) Ei Paiombar, Mo bo furud ovardani in K'ur'on bar tu bekh'tarin k'issakh'oro ba e'tibori rosti va sikh'kh'ati lafz va balog'at baroiat k'issa mekunem. Va iak'inan tu pesh az nuzuli K'ur'on az zumrai kasoni az in k'issa g'ofil budi va dar in bora donish nadoshti.

4) Mo baroi tu Paiombar on zamonero khabar medikh'em, ki Iusuf ba padarash Ia'k'ub guft: "Ei Padaram, Ba durusti ki man dar khob iozdakh' sitora va oftob va mokh'ro didam. Kh'ar iakeashonro nazdam dar kh'oli sach'da didam." In khobi didai Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) muzhdai ilokh'i bud.

5) Ia'k'ub ba pisarash Iusuf guft: "Ei Pisaram, khobi didaatro ba barodaronat k'issa makun. Zero onkh'o ma'noi onro fakh'mida, ba tu kh'asad mebarand va bo angezai kh'asad baroi ziion rasonidan makr mekunand. Beshak, Shaiton nisbat ba inson dushmani oshkor ast."

6) Va ei Iusuf, kh'amon guna ki dar khobat didi, Parvardigorat turo barmeguzinad va ba tu makh'orati ta'biri khobro ta'lim medikh'ad va ne'matashro bo nubuvvat bar tu va bar khonadoni Ia'k'ub komil mesozad, on guna ki pesh az tu ne'matashro bar padaronat Ibrokh'im va Iskh'ok' ba itmom rasonid. Iak'inan Parvardigorat Donoi Kh'akim ast. Dar borai makhluk'otash ogokh'i doshta, korkh'oiashonro bo kh'ikmat tadbir mekunad.
7) Ba durusti, dar k'issai Iusuf va barodaronash baroi kasone, ki az akhbori onkh'o mepursand, ibratkh'oi ziiod ast.

8) Vak'te barodaronash dar baini khud guftand: "Begumon Iusuf va barodari kh'amtanash nazdi Padaramon az mo dida makh'bubtarand, dar kh'ole ki mo ch'amoai doroi adadi ziiodem. Modom ki chunin ast, pas charo Padaramon onkh'oro az mo bartar medonad?! Ba durusti, chun padaramon be sababi baroiamon ma'lum Iusufu barodarashro az mo bartar meguzorad, mo uro dar khatoi oshkor mebinem.

9) Iusufro bikushed io uro dar sarzamini durdast biafkaned, to tavach'ch'ukh'i padaraton tankh'o ba sui shumo shavad, pas shumoro ba tavri makhsus dust dorad va ba'di k'atl io nopadid sokhtani Iusuf bo tavba kardan az gunokh'aton k'avmi solekh' megarded."

10) Iake az barodaronash guft: "Iusufro nakushed, balki uro dar k'a'ri chokh' andozed, to ba'ze musofirone, ki az onch'o meguzarand, uro bo khud girand. Agar shumo dar mavridi on chi dar kh'ak'k'i Iusuf gufted, azmi ch'iddi dored, pas zarari rokh'i peshnikh'odkardai man az kushtanash sabuktar ast."

11) Va vak'te kh'amagi dar mavridi badarg'a kardani Iusuf ittifok' namudand, ba Padarashon guftand: "Ei Padar, charo tu moro nisbat ba Iusuf amin namekh'isobi va kh'ol on ki mo ba vai mushfik' kh'astem va uro az kh'ar ziion kh'ifz mekunem va nisbatash khairkhokh'em, to peshi tu solim bargardad. Pas, chi turo man' mekunad, ki uro kh'amrokh'i mo bifiristi?!
12) Ba mo rukhsat bidekh', ki fardo uro kh'amrokh'amon bigirem, to az khurdanikh'o bakh'ra barad va shukhivu bozi kunad va mo uro az kh'ama guna ozor kh'ifz mekunem."

13) Ia'k'ub ba farzandonash guft: "Beshak, Iusufro burdanaton az kh'amin kh'olo maro g'amgin mesozad. Chunki man tok'ati firok'i uro nadoram va metarsam, ki shumo mashg'uli aishu bozi shuda, az kh'olash g'ofil memoned va uro gurg mekhurad."

14) Onkh'o dar ch'avobi Padarashon guftand: "Savgand ba Khudo, agar gurg Iusufro bikhurad, kh'ol on ki mo iak ch'amoai buzurge kh'astem, Ba durusti ki on gokh' kh'ech' khaire dar mo nest va ziionkorem, zero uro az gurg kh'imoia karda natavonistaem."

15) Ia'k'ub Iusufro bo barodaronash firistod. Pas vak'te onkh'o uro ba mintak'ai durdast burdand va k'asdi dar chokh' andokhtanashro kardand, Mo dar in kh'olat ba Iusuf paig'om firistodem, ki kh'atman tu onkh'oro az in korashon ogokh' khokh'i sokht, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o kh'angomi khabar dodanat ki budanatro nameshinosand.
16) Va barodaroni Iusuf shabongokh' peshi padarashon omadand, dar kh'ole ki baroi pushonidani makrashon sokhtakorona giria mekardand.

17) Onkh'o guftand: "Ei Padar, kh'amono mo raftem va musobik'ai dav va tirandozi doshtem va Iusufro nazdi libos va tushakh'oiamon guzoshtem, to onro nigokh' kunad, pas gurg uro khurd, agarchi mo dar kh'ak'ik'at rostgu kh'astem, tu sukhani moro tasdik' namekuni."

18) Va onkh'o khostand in khabarro ba vasilai dasisa isbot kunand. Pas perokh'ani Iusufro dar kh'ole ki bo khuni g'airi u oluda gashta bud, ovardand. Mekhostand ba padarshon chunon vonamud sozand, ki khuni in perokh'an asari khurdai gurg ast. Pas Ia'k'ub az rui zakovat va alomati on ki perokh'an nodarida bud, durug'ashonro fakh'mid va guft: "Asli vok'ea chunonchi shumo megued, nest. Balki nafsi shumo baroiaton anch'omi kori badro dar kh'ak'k'i barodaraton zinat dodaast va shumo onro kardaed. Va kori man pesha namudani sabri neke ast, ki dar on betobi nest va dar mavridi rost io durug' budani vasfi nisbat ba Iusuf kardaaton tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kumak talabida meshavad."

19) Va korvoni rakh'guzare omad. Pas az bainashon kasero baroi ovardani ob firistodand. On shakhs raft va zarfi obkashiashro ba chokh' andokht va Iusuf ba resmoni zarf ovezon shud. Chun on marde, ki zarfi obkashiro ba chokh' andokhta bud, uro did, az rui shodi guft: "Bashorat bod. In navch'avon ast." Va on shakhsi ob ovarda bo ba'ze az dustonash dar kh'ole ki Iusufro kh'amchun matoi furushi pindoshta, fikr kardand az ch'umlai g'ulomon ast, az bok'imondai akh'li k'ofila pinkh'on sokhtand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro nisbat ba Iusuf az bekh'urmati va k'asdi furukhtan mekardand, medonist. Kh'ech' amalashon az U pushida nabud.

20) Va on shakhs bo dustonash Iusufro dar sarzamini Misr dar ivazi puli nochiz furukhtand. Shumoridani dirkh'amkh'oi giriftai onkh'o ba sababi kam budani on oson bud. Va onkh'o dar borai Iusuf berag'bat budand, zero mekhostand zud az u khalos shavand. Onkh'o az kh'olati Iusuf ma'lum kardand, ki g'ulom nest. Az in ru, bar ch'oni khesh az khonadonash tarsidand. In az kamoli rakh'mati Parvardigor dar kh'ak'k'i Iusuf bud, to kh'amrokh'i akh'li k'ofila duru daroz bok'i namonad.

21) Va mardi misrie, ki uro kharid, ba kh'amsarash guft: "Nisbatash neki namo va mak'omashro dar bainamon giromi bidor. Shoiad dar ich'roi ba'ze korkh'oi mavridi niiozamon ba mo sud rasonad io uro az rokh'i farzandkhoni farzandamon girem." Va chunonchi Iusufro az k'atl nach'ot doda, uro az chokh' berun ovardem va dili Vaziri sarzamini Misrro nisbatash narm sokhtem, kh'amin guna ba u dar sarzamini Misr ch'oi va istik'ror dodem va Mo in korro kardem, to ba u ta'biri khobro ta'lim dikh'em. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar irodaash G'olib ast. On kh'atman amali meshavad. Kh'ech' kas Uro dar kore mach'bur sokhta nametavonad. Vale aksari mardum -kofiron- inro namedonand.
22) Va chun Iusuf ba sinni nerumand shudani ch'ism rasid, Mo ba u fakh'm va ilm dodem. Va on guna ki ba Iusuf podosh dodem, ba bandagoni dar ibodati ilokh'i nekukor niz kh'amin guna podosh medikh'em.

23) Va kh'amsari Vaziri Misr bo narmi va korburdi makr az Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) anch'omi amali zinoro talab kard va ba mak'sadi dar khilvat kh'ardu tankh'o mondan darkh'oro makh'kam namuda, ba vai guft: "Ba sui man biio." Iusuf dar ch'avob guft: "Az on kore, ki maro ba suiash da'vat dori, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) panokh' mebaram. Ba durusti ki shavkh'arat sokh'ibam buda, ch'oiamro dar nazdash giromi doshta, ba man neki karda ast. Baroi kh'amin man kh'argiz ba u khiionat namekunam. Zero agar khiionat kunam, zolim megardam. Beshak, zolimon rastagor nameshavand."

24) Va iak'inan nafsi kh'amsari Vaziri Misr ba ich'roi amali zino bo Iusuf mail kard va dar k'albi Iusuf niz on guzasht, agar vai az nishonakh'oi Parvardigorash on chiro, ki uro az in amal dur gardond, namedid, on chi meshud, meshud. Mo ba Iusuf on alomatkh'oro nishon dodem, to badiro az u bartaraf sozem va az kori zino va khiionatkori durash kunem. Beshak, Iusuf az bandagoni baroi nubuvvat barguzidai Mo ast.

25) Va kh'ar du ba sui darvoza shitoftand. Iusuf mekhost az in kh'olat khudro nach'ot dikh'ad, ammo zan k'asd dosht uro az baromadan man' kunad. Va perokh'ani Iusufro az pusht pora kard va onkh'o shavkh'ari zanro nazdi darvoza ioftand. Zan ba shavkh'arash bo makr guft: "Ei Vazir, uk'ubati kase, ki bo kh'amsari tu k'asdi amali zinoro dorad, ch'uz zindon io in ki azobi bag'oiat sakht doda shavad, chist?!"

26) Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Khudi u anch'omi zinoro talab namud. Man in amalro az u nakhostaam." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tifli on khonaro, ki dar daruni gakh'vora bud, ba zabon ovard va tifl guvokh'i doda guft: "Agar perokh'ani Iusuf az tarafi pesh pora shuda boshad, pas, in nishonai rostgu budani zan ast. Zero ma'lum meshavad, ki Iusuf bo mak'sadi zino ba u daraftoda va u khudro mukh'ofizat namuda, perokh'ani Iusufro pora karda ast.

27) Va agar perokh'ani Iusuf az ch'onibi pusht pora shuda boshad, pas in alomati rostk'avlii u ast. Zero ma'lum meshavad, ki zan az Iusuf amali zinoro talab karda va vak'te u ru ba gurez nikh'od, az dunbolash shuda, perokh'anashro pora namuda ast. Dar in surat zan durug' meguiad."

28) Vak'te Vazir perokh'ani Iusufro did, ki az ch'onibi pusht pora shuda ast, rostk'avlii u baroiash ma'lum shud va guft: "In tukh'mate, ki Iusufro ba on giriftor kardi, az ch'umlai makri shumo zanon ast. Ba durusti ki makri shumo zanon khele sakht ast."

29) Va ba Iusuf rui ovarda guft: "Ei Iusuf, az in kh'odisa rui gardon va onro ba kase nagu." Ba'd khitob ba kh'amsarash guft: "Ei zan, baroi gunokh'i sodirkardaat omurzish talab kun. Zero tu ba sababi az Iusuf darkhost namudani zino az khatokoron budai."

30) In khabar dar shakh'r pakh'n gasht. Va gurukh'e az zanoni shakh'r bo mak'sadi inkori amalkardi kh'amsari Vazir guftand: "Kh'amsari Vazir g'ulomashro paivasta ba kh'ambistari da'vat mekarda ast. Kh'amono ishk'i Iusuf dar umk'i dilash ch'oi girifta ast. Ba durusti ki mo uro ba sababi on ki g'ulomashro dust doshta, ba kh'ambistari da'vat mekarda ast, dar gumrokh'ii oshkor mebinem."
