31) Pas chun kh'amsari Vazir inkori zanoni shakh'r va g'aibati onkh'oro dar kh'ak'k'i khud shunid, ba suiashon shakhsero firistod, to onkh'oro nazdash da'vat karda, Iusufro baroiashon nishon dikh'ad va pas az didani kh'usni Iusuf uro ma'zur khokh'and donist. Va baroi onkh'o makonero, ki dar on kurpavu bolin bud, omoda namud va baroi buridani khurdanikh'o ba kh'ar iak zani da'vatshuda kord dod va ba Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ba nazdi zanon baro." Pas vak'te Iusufro didand, ch'amolashro buzurg ioftand va az on motu mabkh'ut gashta, az shiddati in kh'olat bo kordi dastashon, ki onro baroi buridani khurdanikh'o girifta budand, dastonashonro buridand va guftand: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Pok ast. In navch'avon bashar nest. Zero in guna kh'usn dar baini bashar dida nameshavad. Begumon in navch'avon farishtae az farishtagoni giromi ast."

32) Vak'te kh'amsari Vazir kh'olati duchoromadai on zanonro did, ba onkh'o guft: "In kh'amon navch'avone ast, ki shumo maro ba sababi uro dust doshtanam ta'na zaded va ba durusti, man az vai darkhosti kh'ambistari namuda, baroi ba khud ch'alb sokhtanash makr kardam, pas az ich'roi khostai man khuddori kard. Va agar dar oianda darkhosti maro ich'ro nakunad, savgand mekhuram, ki zindon karda meshavad va az ch'umlai khorshudagon megardad."

33) Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) ba Parvardigorash muroch'iat namud va guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, zindoni takh'did kardai in zanon baroiam az anch'omi amali fakh'she, ki maro ba sui on da'vat mekunand, makh'bubtar ast. Va agar Tu makri onkh'oro az man dur nagardoni, ba suiashon mail mekunam va agar ba onkh'o mail karda, dar on chi az man mekhokh'and, itoatashon kunam, az gurukh'i shakhsoni nodoni isionkor megardam."

34) Parvardigorash zud duoiashro paziruft. Pas makri kh'amsari Vazir va digar zanoni shakh'rro az Iusuf bartaraf sokht. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai duoi Iusuf va kh'ama duokunandagon, Donandai kh'oli u va kh'ama bandagon ast.
35) Sipas chun Vazir va k'avmash daleli begunokh'ii Iusufro didand, ba khulosae omadand, ki baroi peshgiri az pakh'n shudani sharmandagii kh'amsarash to muddati noma'lum uro ba kh'abs girand.

36) Iusufro zindon kardand va bo vai du ch'avon ba zindon daromad. Iake az onkh'o ba Iusuf guft: "Beshak, man dar khob didam, ki angurro mefishoram, to sharob shavad." Va ch'avoni duium guft: "Kh'amono man dar khob didam, ki bar saram non mebardoram va parandagon az on mekhurand." Onkh'o guftand: "Ei Iusuf, ta'biri khobi moro bigu. Ba durusti ki mo turo az ch'umlai nekukoron mebinem."

37) Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Baroiaton az nazdi podshokh' io g'airi vai kh'ech' taome, ki ba shumo doda meshavad, nakhokh'ad omad, magar on ki man pesh az omadani on kh'ak'ik'at va tarzi omadanashro baroiaton khabar medikh'am. In makh'orati ta'biri khob va khabar dodan az borai g'aib, ki medonam, az ma'lumoti baroiam ta'lim dodai Parvardigoram buda, folbini va ch'odugari nest. Kh'amono man oiini k'avmero, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon nameorand va onkh'o ba okhirat kofir kh'astand, tark kardam.

38) Va az oiini Ibrokh'imu Iskh'ok'u Ia'k'ubi padaronam, ki dini iaktoparasti ast, pairavi namudam. Baroi mo durust nest, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizero sharik gardonem. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti Bekh'amtoi Iagona ast. On tavkh'idu imon, ki manu padaronam doroi on kh'astem, baroiamon az lutfu ekh'soni Parvardigor buda, tavfik'i onro U ba mo doda ast va on tavkh'idu imon baroi digar mardum niz az fazli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Zero ba sui onkh'o paiombaroni Khudro firistoda ast. Valekin beshtari mardum Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro baroi ne'matkh'oi dodaash siposguzori namekunand, balki nosiposi mekunand."

39) Sipas Iusuf ba on du ch'avoni zindoni khitob kard va guft: "Ei dustoni zindoniiam! Oio parastishi ma'budkh'oi ziiodi parokanda bekh'tar ast io parastishi Allokh'i Iagonai kh'amesha G'olib, ki kh'argiz mag'lub namegardad?!

40) Shumo g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'uz nomkh'oi besokh'ib chizi digarero naparastidaed. Shumovu padaronaton onkh'oro ma'bud nomidaed, ammo dar asl on khudoioni botilaton az kh'ak'k'i khudoi kh'ech' nasibae nadorand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai nomguzori va ibodatashon dalele furud naovardaast, ki durust budani onro ifoda kunad. Kh'ukmi kh'amai makhluk'ot tankh'o az Allokh'i Iagona meboshad, na az ma'budkh'oi shumo, ki onro khud va padaronaton "khudo" nomguzori kardaed. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dastur dodaast, to tankh'o Uro ba iagonagi ibodat kuned va az sharik sokhtani digar mavch'udot ba U shumoro k'at'iian man' namuda ast. In iaktoparastii guftaam kh'amon oiini roste ast, ki dar on kh'ech' kach'i nest. Valekin beshtari mardum in kh'ak'ik'atro namedonand. Baroi kh'amin ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk meorand.

41) Ei dustoni zindoniiam, ammo on kase dar khob did, ki angur mefishorad, to sharob shavad, pas ba durusti, vai az zindon rakh'o shuda, ba kori sobik'ash bozgashta, sharobrezi podshokh' megardad va ammo on kase dar khob bar sarash nonero did, ki parandagon az on mekhurand, pas begumon vai kushta va ba dor ovekhta meshavad, ba'd az in parandagon az gushti sarash mekhurand. Kore, ki dar boraash az man fatvo pursided, tamom shuda, beguftugu, vok'e' meshavad va digar ch'oi gurez nest."

42) Va Iusuf ba sok'ii podshokh', ki gumoni nach'ot ioftanashro dosht, guft: "K'issa va kh'olati maro nazdi podshokh' ba khotir biior. Shoiad podshokh' az zindon berunam kunad." Pas Shaiton dar nazdi podshokh' zikri Iusufro az iodi sok'i faromush sokht. Ba kh'amin sabab Iusuf chand soli digar dar zindon bok'i mond.

43) Va podshokh' guft: "Beshak, man dar khob kh'aft govi farbekh'ro didam, ki kh'aft govi log'ar onro mekhurd va kh'aft khushai sabzu kh'aft khushai khushkro didam. Ei ashrofoni k'avm, maro az ta'biri khobi didaam khabar dikh'ed, agar donandagoni ta'biri khob kh'asted."
44) Ashrofoni k'avm guftand: "Khobi didaat az khobkh'oi pareshon ast. Chunin khob ta'bir nadorad va mo ta'biri khobkh'oi pareshonu parokandaro namedonem."

45) Va sok'ii podshokh', ki iake az on du ch'avoni zindonii nach'otiofta buda, ba'd az muddate Iusuf va az ta'biri khob ogokh' budanashro ba iod ovard, guft: "Man shumoro az ta'biri in khob ba'd az pursidani shakhsi donandai ta'biri khob ogokh' mekunam. Pas ei podshokh', maro nazdi Iusuf firisted, to khobatonro ta'bir kunad."

46) Pas vak'te on sok'ii az makh'bas nach'otioftai podshokh' nazdi Iusuf rasid, guft: "Ei Iusuf! ei Siddik'! Shakhse dar khobi khud kh'aft govi farbekh' dida ast, ki kh'aft govi log'ar onro mekhurad va kh'aft khushai sarsabzu kh'aft khushai khushkshuda didaast. Moro az ta'biri in khob khabar bidekh', to man nazdi podshokh' va mardumi nazdash bargardam. To onkh'o ta'biri khobi podshokh', fazilat va mak'omi turo donand."

47) Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) ta'biri khobro baion karda guft: "Kh'aft soli paiopai bo ch'iddiiat kisht kuned. Pas makh'sulote, ki dar kh'ar sol az on kh'aft sol medaraved, baroi peshgiri az vaironshavi ba g'airi mik'dori kami mavridi niiozaton, bok'imondaro dar khushakh'oiash meguzored.

48) Sipas ba'di guzashtani on kh'aft soli serkh'osilie, ki dar on ziroat karded, kh'aft soli k'akh'tsoli meoiad. Mardum dar on kh'aft soli k'akh'tsoli makh'suloti dar kh'aft soli serkh'osili daravshudaro mekhurand, ch'uz mik'dori kamero, ki baroi koshtan nigokh' medored.

49) Sipas ba'di guzashtani kh'aft soli k'akh'tsoli sole meoiad, ki dar on bar mardum boron borida, ziroatkh'o meruiand va mardum dar on soli serborish on chi ba misli angur, zaitun va naishakar ba fishurdan niioz dorad, mefishorand."

50) Vak'te ta'biri Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) ba podshokh' rasid, vai ba iovaronash guft: "Uro az zindon berun karda, nazdam ored." Vak'te firistodai podshokh' nazdi Iusuf omad, u dar ch'avobi darkhosti podshokh' guft: "Ba nazdi podshokh' bargashta, az u dar borai k'issai zanone, ki dastoni khudro buridand, bipurs." Mak'sadi Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) on bud, ki pesh az berun shudanash az zindon begunokh'iash isbot va oshkor gardad. Vai guft: "Kh'amono Parvardigoram darkhosti amali fakh'shero, ki on zanon az man talab kardand, medonad. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nest."

51) Podshokh' bo khitob ba zanon guft: "Kh'olat va k'issai shumo chi bud, on gokh', ki az rokh'i makr az Iusuf darkhost namuded, to bo shumo amali zinoro anch'om dikh'ad?!" Onkh'o guftand: "Az tukh'mati Iusuf ba kori bade ba Khudo panokh' mebarem. K'asam ba Khudo, mo az ch'onibi u kh'ech' badiero namedonemu surog' nadorem." Kh'amsari Azizi Misr ba amali badash ik'ror namud va guft: "Inak kh'ak'ik'at oshkor gasht. Man kushishi ba fitna kashidani uro kardam, vale u in korro nakarda ast va beshubkh'a, Iusuf dar da'voi pokdomaniash az tukh'mati anch'om dodai man az ch'umlai rostguion ast."

52) Zani Vaziri Misr guft: "Ba in ig'vogarii khud va begunokh'ii Iusuf baroi on ik'ror doram, to bidonad, ki man dar g'oibiash az in mach'lis va dar muddati zindoni budanash nisbatash durug' naboftam. Ba durusti ki az in rukhdod ma'lum shud, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) makri shakhsi durug'gui kh'ilagarro muvaffak' namesozad."

53) Kh'amsari aziz sukhanashro idoma dod: "Va man nafsamro az badkhokh'i ba poki vasf namekunam va mak'sadam az gapkh'oi guftaam poku beaib donistani khudam nest. Zero tabiati nafsi inson on ast, ki ba korkh'oi bad bisior amr mekunad, chunki ba khostaash ziiod mail doshta, az shakh'vat ch'udo kunonidanash khele dushvor ast, ch'uz on nafskh'oe, ki Parvardigoram onro mavridi rakh'matash k'aror doda, az amr kardan ba badi nigokh' doshta boshad. Beshak, Parvardigoram dar kh'ak'k'i tavbakoron bag'oiat Bakhshoiandai Mekh'rubon ast."

54) Va chun begunokh'i va donishmandii Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) baroi podshokh' oshkor shud, ba zerdastonash guft: "Iusufro nazdi man ored, to uro az afrodi khosam gardonam." Ba'd az in uro nazdi podshokh' ovardand. Va chun podshokh' bo u guftugu kard va donishu khiradi favk'ulodaash ba podshokh' ma'lum shud, ba vai guft: "Ei Iusuf, kh'amono tu imruz nazdi mo sokh'ibi mak'omi khosu amonatdor kh'asti."

55) Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) ba podshokh' guft: "Maro mas'uli nigokh'dorii khazinakh'oi molu khurokvorii sarzamini Misr gardon. Beshak, man khazinadoru amin buda, dar borai in sokh'a donishi amik' doram."

56) Va on guna ki baroi Iusuf bo isbot shudani begunokh'i va az makh'bas ozod shudanash minnat nikh'odem, kh'amin tavr bo rokh'i dar sarzamini Misr ch'oi dodanash baroiash lutfu ekh'son namudem. Dar kh'ar ch'o mekhost, furud meomad va zindagi mekard. Dar dunio baroi kh'ar ki az bandagon khokh'em, az rakh'mati Khesh ato mekunem va podoshi nekukoronro zoe' namegardonem, balki onro ba purragi medikh'em.
57) Va podoshi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki onro dar okhirat khos baroi bandagoni mu'min va parkh'ezkor omoda sokhta ast, az savobi dunio bekh'tar ast.

58) Va barodaroni Iusuf bo matoi khud voridi sarzamini Misr shuda, nazdash daromadand. Vai onkh'oro shinokht, ki barodarash kh'astand, vale onkh'o ba sababi guzashtani muddati ziiod va tag'iiriobii shaklash uro nashinokhtand. Zero vak'te Iusuf (alaikh'is salom)-ro dar chokh' andokhta budand, vai pisarchai khurdsol bud.

59) Va chun ba barodaronash tushai rokh' va lavozimoti khostaashonro dod, ba'd az on ba Iusuf khabar dodand, ki onkh'o barodari digare az padar dorand va uro nazdi padari khesh guzoshtaand, [Iusuf] ba onkh'o guft: "On barodari padariatonro niz biiored, to ba shumo iak shuturi digar bor dikh'am. Oio namebined, ki man paimonaro pur karda, onro kam namekunam va man bekh'tarini mizbonon kh'astam?!
60) Pas agar uro bo khud naored, durug'gu budanaton dar da'voi on ki guio iak barodari digar dored, oshkor shuda, minba'd baroi shumo gandum namedikh'am va ba kishvari man nazdik nashaved."

61) Pas barodaronash dar ch'avobi vai guftand: "Ba zudi ovardani uro az padarash darkhost mekunem va dar in bora ba k'adri tavoni khud talosh menamoem va kh'atman on chiro az mo darkhost kardi, be kutokh'i ba ch'o meorem."

62) Va Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) ba korgaronash guft: "Matoi ovardai inkh'oro dar borkhaltakh'oiashon guzoshta, baroiashon bargardoned, to zamoni ba nazdi khonadonashon bargashtan bidonand, ki mo bo onkh'o dodu sitadi tich'orati nakardaem va in kor onkh'oro ba bori digar bo barodarashon bargashtan mach'bur mesozad, to sidk'ashonro isbot kunand va matoi ovardaashonro bipaziram."

63) Pas chun ba nazdi padari kheshtan bargashtand va mekh'mondorii Iusufro ba vai k'issa kardand, guftand: "Ei padari mo, agar in bor barodaramonro bo khud nabarem, gandum az mo boz doshta meshavad. Baroi kh'amin uro bo mo bifirist. Chunki agar tu barodaramonro kh'amrokh'amon firisti, gandum megirem va baroiat va'da medikh'em, ki kh'atman uro mukh'ofizat karda, peshat solim barmegardonem."

64) Padarashon ba onkh'o guft: "Oio baroi nigokh'ubini vai ba shumo itminon kunam va aminaton donam, kh'amon gunae, ki pesh az in baroi mukh'ofizati barodari kh'amtanash ba shumo bovar kardam va aminaton donistam?! Ba durusti ki k'abl az in shumoro baroi nigakh'dorii Iusuf amin donistam, bo man paimon basted, ki uro mukh'ofizat mekuned, ammo ba paimonaton vafo nakarded. Baroi kh'amin ba paimoni navbatiaton oidi kh'ifzi barodarash bovar nadoram, balki fak'at ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) e'timod doram. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kase, ki mukh'ofizatashro khokh'ad, bekh'tarin Nigakh'bon va U baroi kase, ki rakh'matashro khokh'ad, Mekh'rubontarini mekh'rubonon ast."

65) Va chun onkh'o borkhaltakh'oi gandumi ovardaashonro kushodand, mablag'i dodaashonro ioftand, ki ba onkh'o bozgardonida shuda ast. Onkh'o ba padarashon Ia'k'ub guftand: "Ba'di in kh'ama izzatu ekh'tirom az in Vaziri Misr chi darkhost mekunem?! Vazir mablag'i baroi gandum dodai moro az rui fazlu karamash baroiamon bargardonida ast. Va mo dar safari minba'da baroi khonadonamon gandum meorem va barodaramonro az on chi dar kh'ak'k'ash kh'aros dori, kh'ifz mekunem va ba sababi kh'amrokh'amon burdani barodaramon iak shutur gandumi digar bar mo ilova megardad. Az Vaziri Misr iak shutur gandumi ilovagi giriftan kori oson ast."

66) Padarashon khitob ba onkh'o guft: "Kh'ech' gokh' uro kh'amrokh'aton namefiristam, to on ki ba man bo savgand khurdan ba ismi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) paimoni k'at'i dikh'ed, ki vairo nazdam barmegardoned, magar on ki marg kh'amaamtonro ikh'ota karda, kasero az miioni shumo bok'i naguzorad va k'udrati dur kardan io az rokh' bozgashtanro nadoshta boshed." Pas chun onkh'o ba Padarashon dar in bobat akh'di k'at'i dodand, guft: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar on chi meguem, Shokh'id buda, shakh'odati U moro basanda ast."

67) Va Padarashon onkh'oro vasiiat karda guft: "Kh'amaaton ba sarzamini Misr az iak darvoza nadaroed, balki az darvozakh'oi gunogun vorid shaved. Zero agar kase k'asdi ba kh'amai shumo zarar rasonidanro doshta boshad, baroi solim mondan az zarar chunin tarzi daromadani shakh'r bekh'tar meboshad. Va in sukhanro baroi on nameguiam, ki ziioni khostai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az shumo dur kunam va io manfiati nakhostai Uro ba shumo rasonam. Zero k'azovu k'adar va amr tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Dar kh'ama korkh'oiam fak'at ba U tavakkul mekunam va tavakkulkunandagon niz dar korkh'oi khesh boiad tankh'o ba U tavakkul kunand."

68) Ba'd az in guftugu farzandoni Ia'k'ub bo barodari kh'amtani Iusuf rakhti safar basta, ba rokh' baromadand. Va chun bar asosi tavsiiai Padarashon az darvozakh'oi gunogun daromadand, in tarzi voridshavi on chiro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon muk'addar sokhta ast, az onkh'o dur karda nametavonist, balki on shafk'ati padaronai Ia'k'ub (alaikh'is salom) dar kh'ak'k'i farzandonash bud, ki onro izkh'or namud va onkh'oro suporish dod, to onro ich'ro kunand. Va Ia'k'ub medonist, ki k'azovu k'adare ch'uz k'azovu k'adari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nest. Va u dar borai on chi Mo az imon ba tak'dir va istifoda az vasilakh'oi duniavi baroiash ta'lim dodem, sokh'ibi ilm bud. Valekin beshtari mardum inro namedonand.

69) Va chun barodaroni Iusuf ba nazdash dar kh'olate daromadand, ki barodari kh'amtanash niz kh'amrokh'ashon bud, Iusuf uro og'ush girifta, dar pinkh'oni ba vai guft: "Kh'amono man Iusufi barodari kh'amtanat kh'astam. Pas az korkh'oi bekhiradonae, ki barodaronat kardaand va nisbatamon kina varzida, manu tuvu Padaramro aziiat doda, maro ba chokh' andokhtaand, g'amgin mashav."

70) Pas chun Iusuf ba khodimonash farmon dod, to ba shuturoni barodaronash gandum bor kunand, be ogokh'ii onkh'o paimonai shokh'iro, ki bo on baroi gandumkashon gandum chen mekard, dar borkhaltai barodari kh'amtanash guzosht, to ba kh'amin vasila barodari kh'amtanashro nazdi khesh nigokh' dorad. Ba'd az in vak'te onkh'o ba k'asdi nazdi khonadoni khud bargashtan rakhti safar bastand, nidokunandae dar paiashon ovoz doda guft: "Ei sokh'iboni shuturkh'oi doroi ozuk'avori, beshak, shumo duzd kh'asted."
71) Barodaroni Iusuf ba on shakhsi nidokunanda va rafik'onash, ki dar paii onkh'o omada budand, rui ovarda guftand: "Chi chizi shumo gum shudaast, ki moro ba ch'urmi duzdi tukh'mat mekuned?!"

72) On shakhsi nidokunanda bo rafik'oni kh'amrokh'ash ba barodaroni Iusuf guftand: "Paimonae, ki podshokh' bo on gandum chen mekard, az mo gum shuda va kh'ar ki onro pesh az taftish biiorad, mukofotash iak shutur bor meboshad va man ba in kafolat medikh'am."

73) Barodaroni Iusuf ba onkh'o guftand: "Savgand ba Allokh', az rui kh'olatkh'oe, ki az mo mushokh'ida karded, poki va begunokh' budani moro medoned va shumo khub medoned, ki mo ba sarzamini Misr ba mak'sadi dar on fasod kardan naomadaem va dar tamomi umramon duzd nabudem."
74) Shakhsi nidokunanda bo rafik'onash guftand: "Agar shumo dar da'voi in ki az ch'urmi duzdi begunokh' kh'asted, durug'gui boshed, pas ch'azoi shakhse, ki paimonaro duzdida ast, nazdi shumo chist?"

75) Barodaroni Iusuf guftand: "Ch'azoi duzd dar rasmu oiini mo on ast, ki chizi duzdidashuda dar borkhaltai kh'ar kase paido shavad, duzd ba kulli ba sokh'ibi on chiz suporida meshavad, to uro baroi khud g'ulom gardonad. Mo duzdonro ba kh'amin ch'azoi g'ulomsozi ch'azo medikh'em."

76) Onkh'oro baroi taftishi borkhaltaashon nazdi Iusuf burdand. Pas Iusuf baroi pinkh'on nigokh' doshtani tadbirash pesh az koftukovi borkhaltai barodari kh'amtanash taftishi borkhaltakh'oi barodaroni g'airi kh'amtanashro og'oz kard. Sipas borkhaltai barodarashro kofta, paimonai shokh'iro az on berun sokht. On guna ki baroi Iusuf bo chorai dar borkhaltai barodarash guzoshtani paimona tadbir namudem, kh'amin guna baroiash chorai digare kardem, ki barodaronashro bar asosi ch'azoi roich'i kishvarashon oidi g'ulom gardonidani shakhsi duzd ba ch'avobgari kashad. Agar Iusuf onkh'oro bar asosi uk'ubati podshokh' dar borai shakhsi duzd, ki az zadan va ch'arima kardan iborat bud, ba ch'avobgari mekashid, foidai mavridi nazarash takh'ak'k'uk' nameioft, magar on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tadbiri digarero mekhost. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ama guna tadbir k'udrat dorad. Mo chunonchi ch'oigokh'i Iusufro bardoshtem, martabakh'oi kh'ar kiro khokh'em, mebardorem va bar kh'ar sokh'ibilm shakhsi az vai donishmandtar mavch'ud ast. Ammo ilmi farogiri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amaro ikh'ota karda ast.

77) Barodaroni Iusuf guftand: "Agar in barodaramon duzdida boshad, ch'oii taach'ch'ub nest. Zero k'ablan barodari kh'amtanash niz duzdi karda bud." Onkh'o az in gap Iusuf (alaikh'is salom)-ro dar nazar doshtand. Iusuf az in sukhanashon ozurdakhotir shudanashro pinkh'on doshta, onro oshkor nakard. Iusuf dar kh'ak'k'i barodaronash bo khud guft: "On chi shumo dar guzashta az rui kh'asad nisbat ba man va padaram kardaed, az on chi imruz ba man nisbat medikh'ed, badtar ast va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on durug'ero, ki boftaed, bekh'tar medonad."

78) Barodaroni Iusuf guftand: "Ei Vazir, kh'amono vai padari bag'oiat piri solkhurda dorad, ki uro az kh'ad ziiod dust medorad. Pas iakei moro dar ivazash nazdat boz bidor. Ba durusti, mo turo dar muomila bo khud va digaron az ch'umlai nekukoron mebinem. Baroi kh'amin nisbatamon neki kun."

79) Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ba Allokh' az on ki nisbat ba shakhsi begunokh' bo gunokh'i sitamkore sitam karda, dar ivazi kase, ki paimonai podshokh'ro dar borkhalataash ioftem, kasi digarro dastgir kunem, panokh' mebaram. Agar chunin kunem, ba durusti, mo zolim kh'astem. Chunki shakhsi gunakh'korro guzoshta, begunokh'ro ch'azo dodaem."

80) Pas, chun az Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) posukhro shunida, oidi khostaashon noumed shudand, baroi mashvarat az nazdi mardum ch'oi alokh'ida rafta, bo kh'am tankh'o mondand. Barodari kaloniashon guft: "Shumoro khotirrason mesozam, ki padaraton baroi solim bargardonidani pisarash az shumo ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) akh'di k'at'i girifta ast, magar on ki dar ikh'otai on chi az doirai tavonaton berun ast, k'aror gired. Va pesh az in dar kh'ak'k'i Iusuf kutokh'i namuda, ba akh'de, ki ba padaraton doda buded, vafo nakarded. Ba kh'amin sabab, to on ki padaram ba man rukhsati nazdash bargashtanro nadikh'ad io Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiam bargardonidani barodaramro kh'ukm nakunad, kh'argiz Misrro tark namekunam va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bekh'tarini faisalakunandagon ast. Zero U kh'ak' va odilona kh'ukm mekunad."

81) Barodari kaloniashon idoma doda guft: "Nazdi padaraton bargarded, pas ba vai gued, beshak, pisarat duzdi kard. Ba kh'amin sabab Azizi Misr baroi uk'ubati ch'urmi duzdiash uro g'ulomi khud gardonid. Va mo baroiat tankh'o on chiro donistem, khabar dodem. Az rui mushokh'idai mo paimonai podshokh'ro az borkhaltai vai berun kardand. Va mo namedonistem, ki barodaramon duzdi mekunad va agar inro medonistem, bo tu oidi bargardonidanash akh'du paimon namebastem.

82) Va ei Padar, baroi anik' kardani rostguii mo az mardumi Misr, ki mo dar onch'o budem va az akh'li korvon, ki bo onkh'o nazdat omadem, kh'ak'ik'ati kh'olro bipurs. Onkh'o niz baroiat ainan guftai moro meguiand. Va kh'amono mo dar borai khabari baroiat guftaamon, ki pisarat duzdi karda ast, rost meguem."

83) Padarashon ba onkh'o guft: "Kh'ak'ik'at chigunae shumo megued, ki guio pisaram duzdi kardaast, nest, balki nafsaton ba shumo dar nisbatash dasisa namudanro zinat dodaast, chunonchi k'ablan dar kh'ak'k'i Iusufi barodarash kh'ila karda buded. Pas sabri man, sabri zebo ast, ki az kh'olati khesh ch'uz ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdi kh'ech' kase shikoiat namekunam. Umed doram, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Iusufu barodari kh'amtan va barodari kaloniashonro kh'amagi ba nazdam bargardonad. Zero Ba durusti ki Iagona U Donandai kh'olam buda, dar tadbiri korkh'oiam bag'oiat Kh'akim ast."

84) Ia'k'ub (alaikh'is salom) az nazdi farzandonash dur raft va guft: "Ei dareg'u g'ami sakhtam bar firok'i Iusuf!" Va siiokh'ii chashmonash ba sababi az firok'i Iusuf bisior giria kardan safed gashta bud. Pas vuch'udi Ia'k'ub (alaikh'is salom) pur az andukh' buda, onro az mardum pinkh'on mekard.

85) Barodaroni Iusuf ba padarashon guftand: "Ei Padar, tu kh'amvora Iusufro ba khotir meori va baroiash zoravu nolai ziiod mekuni, to on ki bemoriat avch' girifta, sakht meshavad io vok'ean az kh'amin dard kh'alok megardi."

86) Padarashon ba onkh'o guft: "Az andukh'i sakht va g'ami khud tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shikoiat mekunam va az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizkh'oero ba misli paziruftani duoi bechora va podosh dodan ba musibatzada medonam, ki shumo onro namedoned."

87) Ia'k'ub (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei farzandonam, raved, pas khabari Iusuf va barodarashro ch'ustuch'u kuned va az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) giriftori va mushkiloti bandagonro bartaraf megardonad, noumed nashaved. Zero ba durusti, az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mushkiloti bandagonashro bartaraf megardonad, tankh'o kofiron noumed meshavand. Chunki onkh'o k'udrati ilokh'i va ekh'sonashro ba bandagonash namedonand."

88) Onkh'o dasturi padarashonro ich'ro karda, ba ch'ustuch'ui Iusufu barodarash raftand. Pas chun nazdi Iusuf daromadand, ba vai guftand: "Ei Vazir, ba mo sakhtivu tangdasti rasida ast va nazdi tu matoi kami nochiz ovardem. Pas chigunae, ki pesh az in paimonai moro komil medodi, in navbat niz onro komil baroiamon ato namo va bo ziiod kardani mik'dori on va chashm pushidan az matoi nochizi ovardaamon bar mo sadak'a bikun. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shakhsoni sadak'akunandaro bo bekh'tarin mukofot podosh medikh'ad."

89) Pas chun Iusuf sukhani barodaronashro shunid, dilash ba kh'oli onkh'o ba rik'k'at omada, khudro shinosonida guft: "Oio imruz zishtii on chiro nisbat ba Iusuf va barodarash karded, on gokh', ki az ok'ibati koraton nodon buded, donisted?!"

90) Onkh'o az shunidani in sukhan ba kh'airat aftoda guftand: "Oio Ba durusti ki tu Iusuf kh'asti?!" Iusuf guft: "Ore, man Iusufam va in kasero, ki kh'amrokh'am mebined, barodari kh'amtani man ast. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo rakh'onidanamon az sakhti va bardoshtani ch'oigokh'amon bar mo lutfu ekh'son kard. Beguftugu, kh'ar kas bo ich'roi dasturot va duri az mamnuot parkh'ezkori menamoiad va dar musibatkh'o sabr mekunad, pas beshubkh'a, in amalash nekukori meboshad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muzdi nekukoronro zoe' namesozad, balki onro baroiashon nigokh' medorad."

91) Barodaronash az korkh'oi khesh ma'zarat khosta guftand: "Savgand ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo bo sifatkh'oi neke, ki baroiat doda ast, barguzida va az mo bartar sokhta ast va iak'inan mo dar mavridi on chi dar kh'ak'k'i tu kardem, badkori zolim budem."

92) Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) uzrashonro pazirufta guft: "Imruz bar shumo malomat va sarzanishe nest va shumoro baroi korkh'oiaton uk'ubat namekunam. Az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omurzishi gunokh'onatonro mekhokh'am va U Mekh'rubontarini mekh'rubonon ast.

93) Pas chun barodaronash ba vai kh'olati chashmoni padarashonro, ki az giriai ziiod nobino gashta bud, guftand, perokh'ani khudro ba onkh'o doda guft: "In perokh'ani maro bibared, pas onro bar chekh'rai padaram andozed, binoiash barmegardad va kh'amai khonadonatonro nazdam kh'ozir kuned."

94) Va chun k'ofila az Misr ba rokh' baromad va az mintak'akh'oi obodi on ch'udo shud, Ia'k'ub (alaikh'is salom) ba farzandonash va kasone, ki kh'amrokh'ash dar istik'omatgokh'ash budand, guft: "Agar shumo maro nodon nashumored va ba piri nisbat doda "in mard solkhurda shuda, chi guftanashro namedonad", nagued, beshak, man in lakh'za buii Iusufro mebuiam."
95) Farzandoni nazdash buda ba vai guftand: "Savgand ba Allokh', ki tu dar mavridi ch'oigokh'i Iusuf dar nazdat va imkoni dubora didanash dar gumonu khaioli guzashtaat k'aror dori."

96) Pas chun shakhsi muzhdarason khabari khushkh'olkunandai Ia'k'ubro ovard, perokh'ani Iusufro bar chekh'rai vai andokht, pas bino shud. Ia'k'ub dar in kh'olat ba farzandonash guft: "Oio ba shumo naguftam, az lutfu ekh'soni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizkh'oero medonam, ki shumo onro namedoned."

97) Farzandoni Ia'k'ub (alaikh'is salom) az on chi nisbat ba Iusuf va barodarash kardaand, ma'zaratkhokh'i namuda guftand: "Ei Padari mo, az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi gunokh'oni sodirkardaamon omurzish bikhokh'. Kh'amono mo dar borai on chi nisbat ba Iusuf va barodarash kardaem, gunakh'kori badkor budem."
98) Padarashon ba onkh'o guft: "Ba zudi baroi gunokh'onaton az Parvardigoram omurzish mekhokh'am. Beshak, U Bakhshandai gunokh'oni bandagoni tavbakunanda buda, ba onkh'o bisior Mekh'rubon ast."

99) Va Ia'k'ub kh'amrokh'i khonadoni khesh az sarzaminashon berun shuda, ba sui Misr safar kardand. Pas chun onkh'o nazdi Iusuf daromadand, u padaru modarashro ba og'ush girift va ba barodaronu akh'li oilaashon guft: "Bo khosti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), dar kh'olati amn va osoishtagi voridi Misr shaved. Minba'd dar inch'o ba shumo kh'ech' zarare namerasad."

100) Va Iusuf padaru modarashro bar takhte, ki rui on menishast, shinond va padaru modaru iozdakh' barodarash bo sach'da ba vai salom dodand. Rukhdodi mazkur khosti ilokh'iro, ki Iusuf onro khob did, isbot sokht. In sach'da baroi ifodai arch'guzori bud, na ibodat. Baroi kh'amin Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) ba padarash guft: "In salomi bo sach'da anch'omdodai shumo ta'biri kh'amon khobest, ki pesh az in onro dida, baroiat k'issa kardam. Beshubkh'a, Parvardigoram onro bo rukh dodanash takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshid. Va kh'amono Parvardigoram ba man neki kard. Zero maro az zindon berun sokht va shumoro az sakh'ro nazdam ovard, ba'di on ki Shaiton irtiboti baini man va barodaronamro tabokh' namud. Beguftugu, Parvardigoram on chiro khokh'ad, dak'ik' va munosib anch'om medikh'ad. Ba durusti ki U Donandai Bokh'ikmat ast. Az kh'oli bandagon ogokh' buda, kori onkh'oro bo kh'ikmatash tadbir mekunad."

101) Sipas Iusuf ba sui Parvardigorash rui ovarda guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, podshokh'ii Misrro iak'inan Tu ba man ato namudi va ta'biri khobro ba man Tu ta'lim dodi, ei Zote, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro be namunai sobik' ba vuch'ud ovardi, Tu dar dunio va okhirat Korsozi kh'amai korkh'oi man kh'asti, vak'ti khotima ioftani mukh'lati zindagiam maro musalmon bimiron va maro dar firdavsi ch'annat ba ch'am'i paiombaronu padaronam va digar bandagoni solekh'i Khud bipaivand."

102) Ei Paiombar, on chi az k'issai Iusufu barodaronash zikr shud, onro Mo ba tu paig'om namudem. Tu dar in bora donish nadoshti. Vak'te barodaroni Iusuf tasmimi dar chokh' andokhtani uro giriftand va onkh'o dasisa mesokhtand, onch'o kh'ozir nabudi. Kh'amai inro baroiat Mo paig'om firistodem.

103) Va ei Paiombar, agarchi kh'ama taloshatro baroi imon ovardani mardum kharch' namoi, beshtari mardum mu'min nestand. Baroi kh'amin khudro az g'amu dardi in ki onkh'o imon nameorand, kh'alok nagardon.

104) Va ei Paiombar, agar mushrikon ak'li solim medoshtand, ba tu imon meovardand. Zero tu dar ivazi tablig'i K'ur'on va rakh'namoi ba rokh'i durust az onkh'o muzd talab nakardai. Iak'inan K'ur'on baroi kh'amai mardum pand ast.

105) Va dar osmonkh'o va zamin alomatkh'oi ziiodi dalolatgar bar vakh'doniiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, ki onkh'o az nazdi on meguzarand, dar kh'ole ki az tafakkur va ibrat giriftan az on alomatkh'o rui megardonand.

106) Va beshtari mushrikon ba kholik'iiat, ruzirasoni, kh'aiotbakhshi va mironidani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon nameorand, magar on ki onkh'o iakch'o bo U digar ma'budkh'oi khudro meparastand va da'vo dorand, ki Allokh'i Poki Beaib farzand dorad.

107) Oio in mushrikon az on ki bar onkh'o dar dunio azobi farogiri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) biioiad va onro az khesh dur sokhta natavonand, dar amonand io az on ki k'iiomat nogakh'on dar kh'ole bar onkh'o biioiad, ki onro ekh'sos nakunand va omoda nashavand, dar amonand?! Oio baroi kh'amin imon nameorand?!

108) Ei Paiombar, ba kase, ki uro da'vat mekuni, bigu: "Rokh'i man, ki mardumro ba on da'vat mekunam, kh'amin ast. Man ba sui on bo daleli ravshan da'vat mekunam va kh'ar kase az man pairavi karda, rokh'amro barguzinad, digaronro niz ba sui on da'vat mekunad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mushrikon Uro vasf mekunand, pok ast va man az zumrai nafarone nestam, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik k'aror dikh'am, balki man az iaktoparaston kh'astam."

109) Va k'abl az tu Paiombar ch'uz mardone az baini insonkh'o, ki az sokinoni shakh'rkh'o budand, na bodiiakh'o kasi digarro az farishtagon ba paiombari mab'us nagardonidem. Ba onkh'o vakh'i mefiristodem, chunonchi ba tu vakh'i mefiristem. Ummatkh'oiashon onkh'oro durug'gui kh'isobidand va kh'alokashon sokhtem. Pas magar in takzibkunandagoni k'avmat dar zamin sairu gasht namekunand, to dar borai ok'ibati takzibkunandagoni pesh az onkh'o guzashta andesha namuda, az sarguzashtashon ibrat girand?! Va ne'mati okhirat baroi on kasone, ki dar dunio parkh'ez mekunand, bekh'tar ast. Oio shumo bekh'tar budani onro namefakh'med, to bo ich'roi dasturot va duri ch'ustan az mamnuot tak'vo kuned. Imon buzurgtarin dasturot va shirk buzurgtarin gunokh'oni man'shuda ast.

110) Mo ba dushmanoni paiombaroni firistodaamon mukh'lat doda, onkh'oro bo mak'sadi tadrich'an kh'alok kardan zud ch'azo namedodem, to on ki vak'te kh'alokatashon ba ta'khir meaftod va paiombaron az kh'alokati onkh'o noumed meshudand va kofiron gumon mekardand, ki paiombaron dar on chi ba onkh'o oidi azobi takzibgaron va nach'oti mu'minon va'da dodaand, durug' guftaand, nusrati Mo ba paiombaronamon meomad va paiombaronu mu'minon nach'ot doda meshudand va chun uk'ubati Mo bar k'avmi gunakh'kor furud oiad, dur karda nameshavad.

111) Beshak, dar k'issakh'oi paiombaronu k'avmi onkh'o va dar k'issai Iusufu barodaronash baroi sokh'iboni khiradi solim ibrat ast. On chi K'ur'on dar in bora meguiad, sukhani az nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boftashuda nest, balki K'ur'on tasdik'gari Kitobkh'oi az sui Parvardigor furud omada va tafsili kh'amai akh'komu k'onunkh'oi ba baioni mufassal niiozdoshta va ba sui kh'ar neki rakh'namo va baroi k'avme, ki ba on imon meorand, moiai rakh'mat ast. Zero mu'minon az rakh'namoikh'oi K'ur'on sud mebarand.

1) "Alif. Lom. Mim. Ro." In oiatkh'oi volomak'om oiatkh'oi K'ur'on ast va K'ur'on, ki baroi tu Paiombar az sui Parvardigorat nozil shuda ast, kh'ak'ik'at buda, dar nuzulash az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shubkh'ae nest, vale beshtari mardum az rui iakravi va kibru g'urur ba on imon nameorand.

2) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki osmonkh'oro chunonchi onro mebined, biduni sutun ofarid, sipas ba tavri loik'i Zotash bar arsh baromad va baroi manfiatkh'oi makhluk'otash oftob va mokh'tobro rom sokht va kh'ar iakei on du to mukh'lati dar ilmash muaiian kh'arakat mekunad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kori in ch'akh'onro ba tavri mekhostaash megardonad. U nishonakh'oi dalolatgari k'udratashro baion mekunad, to shumo ba mulok'oti Parvardigori khesh dar ruzi k'iiomat iak'in namuda, bo amali nek baroi on omodagi bined.

3) Va U On Zotest, ki zaminro pakh'n sokht va bar on kukh'kh'oi sobitro ofarid, to zamin mardumro bek'aror nasozad va nakh'rkh'oi obro ofarid, to mardum, chorvokh'o va ziroatkh'oiashon ob doda shavand va az kh'ama nav'i mevakh'o ch'ufti nar va modaro ofarid (chunonchi ch'insi nar va modaro dar baini kh'aivonot niz padid ovarda ast), bo shab ruzro mepushonad va ruz ba'd az rushnoi torik megardad. Iak'inan dar on chi zikr gardid, baroi k'avme, ki oidi k'udrati ilokh'i meandeshand, dalelkh'oi ziiod ast. Zero az in nishonakh'oi vakh'doniiat va k'udrati ilokh'i tankh'o kasone naf' mebarand, ki dar in bora meandeshand.

4) Va dar zamin k'it'akh'oi bo iakdigar paivasta va bog'kh'oe az angurkh'o va ziroatkh'o va darakhtoni khurmoi dar iak resha ch'am'shuda va darakhtoni doroi reshai alokh'idai khurmoest, ki kh'amai in bog'kh'ovu on ziroatkh'o bo iak ob ob doda meshavand va Mo in k'it'akh'oro bo vuch'udi ba kh'am paivast budan va az iak ob ob khurdani makh'sulotash ba'zei onro dar ta'mu digar foidakh'o bar ba'zei digar bartari bakhshidem. Beshak, dar on chi zikr shud, baroi k'avme, ki mefakh'mand, kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ziiod ast. Zero ok'ilon az on pand megirand.

5) Va ei Paiombar, agar az chize taach'ch'ub kuni, pas sazovortarin chiz baroi kh'airat on ast, ki onkh'o zindashavii ba'di margro durug' donista, oidi inkori khesh "kh'uch'ch'at" ovarda meguiand: "Oio vak'te memirem va ba ustukhonkh'oi pusida tabdil meshavem, az nav barangekhta va dubora zinda megardem?!" In ch'amoai munkironi zindashavii ba'd az marg kasoneand, ki ba Parvardigorashon kofir shuda, baroi kh'amin k'udrati Uro dar zinda sokhtani murdagon inkor namudand va ruzi k'iiomat bar gardanashon zavlonakh'oi sokhtashuda az otash zada meshavad va in gurukh' boshandagoni duzakh buda, onkh'o dar onch'o abadi memonand. Digar fano nameioband va azobi Parvardigor az onkh'o gusasta namegardad.

6) Va ei Paiombar, mushrikon bo tamaskhur az tu k'abl az ofiiat va ne'mat zudtar ovardani uk'ubatro metalaband va nuzuli onro k'abl az ne'matkh'oe, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon muk'addar gardonida ast, nomumkin mekh'isoband, kh'ol on ki beshak, k'abl az onkh'o azobi ummatkh'oi takzibgari shabekh'ashon guzashta ast. Pas, charo az ta'rikhi onkh'o ibrat namegirand? Va ei Paiombar, ba durusti ki Parvardigorat baroi mardum bo vuch'udi zulmashon Sokh'ibi mag'firat buda, onkh'oro zud azob namekunad, to tavba kunand. Va kh'amono U baroi kasone, ki kufri khudro idoma doda, az on barnamegardand, Sakhtuk'abat ast.

7) Va kofiron az rui sarkashi meguiand: "Charo bar Mukh'ammad ba monandi on mu'ch'izae, ki bar Musovu Iso furud omada bud, nozil karda nashuda ast?!" Ba durusti, tu Paiombar bimdikh'andae meboshi, ki mardumro az azob metarsoni. Tu tankh'o sokh'ibi on mu'ch'izakh'oe kh'asti, ki Parvardigor baroiat doda ast. Va kh'ar k'avmro paiombarest, ki onkh'oro ba sui kh'ak'ik'at rakh'namoi mekunad.

8) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro kh'ar modae (az insonu g'airi on) dar shikamash mebardorad va on chi dar bachadonkh'o az kamiiu ziiodi va tandurustivu bemori kh'osil meshavad, medonad va tamomi chiz nazdi U doroi andozai muaiian meboshad, ki az on kamu ziiod nameshavad.

9) Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar chizi az doirai kh'issi bandagonash pinkh'on va kh'ar chizi dar doirai kh'issi bandagonash oshkorro medonad, nomu sifat va af'olash buzurg buda, bo zotu sifotash az kh'ama makhluk'ot bartar ast.

10) U on chi pushidavu oshkor ast, medonad. Ei mardum, dar ilmi U kase az shumo sukhanro pinkh'on va kase onro oshkor mesozad, barobar ast va niz dar ilmi U shakhsi dar torikii shab az chashmi mardum pinkh'on va shakhsi bo amalkh'oiash dar rushnoii ruz namudor barobar ast.

11) Inson farishtagone dorad, ki baroi mukh'ofizatash ba'zeashon az dunboli ba'zei digar az tarafi peshi ruiash va az pushtash meoiand. Iak idda shab va iak idda ruz meoiand. Onkh'o insonro bo suporishi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az tak'dirote, ki man' shudani onro az u muk'addar karda ast, kh'ifz mekunand va sukhanu korashro menavisand. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'olati neki k'avmero ba kh'olati nokhushoiand tag'iir namedikh'ad, to on ki onkh'o kh'olati shukrguzorii khudro tag'iir dikh'and. Va vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'alokati k'avmero iroda kunad, pas onro kase rad karda nametavonad. Va shumo mardum ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Korsozi digare, ki korkh'oiatonro korsozi kunad va dar bartaraf sokhtani mushkilot ba vai panokh' bared, nadored.

12) U Zotest, ki ba shumo mardum ozrakhashro ba khotiri bim dodan va umed bakhshidan nishon medikh'ad. Az khatarkh'oiash metarsed va ba sudash tama' mekuned. Va U abrkh'oi bo bardoshtani obi boron vazninro padid meorad.

13) Va ra'd Parvardigorro ba poki mekhonand va sitoish mekunand va farishtagon az tarsu ta'zim Uro ba poki mekhonand va U soik'akh'oro mefiristad, pas onro ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, merasonad va uro kh'alok mesozad va kofiron dar borai iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'idol menamoiand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nikh'oiat K'avi buda, kh'ar chizero khokh'ad, anch'om medikh'ad.

14) Tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sazovori ibodat va iaktoparasti buda, kase dar on bo U sharik nest, zero U Ma'budi Barkh'ak' ast. Va on butkh'oero, ki mushrikon ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhonand va meparastand, dar kh'ech' mas'alae duoi onkh'oro namepazirand va az butkh'o kh'och'at pursidani mushrikon ba kh'oli tashnae monandi dorad, ki az dur dastashro ba sui ob mekushoiad, to ba dakh'onash rasida, az on nushad va ob kh'ech' gokh' ba dakh'onash namerasad va duoi kofiron az butkh'o ch'uz zoe' gardidan va duri az savob chize nest. Chunki butkh'o k'udrat nadorand, ki ba ibodatkunandagoni khesh manfiat rasonand io badiero az onkh'o dur sozand.

15) Va mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va zamin khokh'u nokhokh' tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) farmon mebarand. Mu'minu kofir dar in bora iaksonand. Fark'ashon dar on ast, ki mu'min ikhtiiori mutei Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meboshad, ammo kofir g'airi ikhtiiori farmon mebarad va sirishtash talk'in menamoiad, to bo ikhtiior az amrash itoat kunad. Va soiakh'oi makhluk'oti soiador dar avvalu okhiri ruz nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sach'da va itoat mekunand.

16) Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon bigu: "Kholik'i osmonkh'o va zamin va Chorasozi korkh'oi onkh'o kist?" Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Kholik'i osmonkh'ovu zamin va Chorasozi korkh'oi onkh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Shumo ba in e'tirof dored." Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Pas, oio ba g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi khud dustoni notavone giriftaed, ki k'udrati ba kheshtan foida rasondan va dur sokhtani zararro nadorand. Vak'te baroi kheshtan in korro karda nametavonand, pas, chi guna ba kasi digar foida io zarar merasonand?!" Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Oio kofiri kurdil bo mu'mini ravshanzamiri kh'idoiatefta barobar ast?! Io oio kufri shabekh'i torikikh'o bo imoni shabekh'i rushnoi barobar ast?! Io onkh'o dar ofarinish ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharikone k'aror dodaand, ki on sharikonashon ba monandi ofaridani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ofaridaand, pas, ofaridai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ofaridai onkh'o omekhta gashta ast?!" Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Ofaridgori tamomi chiz Allokh'i Iagona ast. Kh'ech' chize bo U dar ofarinish sharik nest. U Parvardigori dar parastish Iagonai loik'i ibodat buda, bar kh'ama chiz G'olib ast."

17) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi zavoli botil va bak'oi kh'ak' az boroni osmon misol meorad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az abri osmon obro nozil namuda, pas rudkh'o kh'ar iak ba andozai kh'ach'mi khurdu kaloni khesh bo on ob ch'ori shuda, ba'dan sel kafkro boloi ob mebardorad. Va baroi kh'ak'ik'atu botil az ba'ze ma'dankh'oi k'imatbakh'o, ki mardum az rokh'i gudokhtan bo mak'sadi talabi abzori zinat io matoe bar on otash meafruzand, masali digarero baion mekunad. In kh'am ba monandi kafki rui ob ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'olati kh'ak' va botilro bo in du masal baion menamoiad. Botil ba misli kafki rui ob va zangi ma'dankh'oi k'imatbakh'o ast, ki gudokhtan onro az miion mebarad, ammo kh'ak' ba misli obi sofest, ki az on nushida meshavad va mevavu giiokh'u alaf meruionad va niz ba misli ma'dani kholisi ba'di gudokhtan bok'imonda ast, ki mardum az on manfiat mebarand. On guna ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in du masalro baion namuda ast, ba mardum masalkh'oi ziiodero baion mesozad, to kh'ak' az botil ch'udo shavad.

18) Baroi mu'minone, ki vak'te Parvardigorashon onkh'oro ba sui iaktoparasti va ibodatash mekhonad, da'vati Uro mepazirand, podoshi neki ch'annat ast. Va kofiron, ki da'vati Uro ba sui iaktoparasti va ibodat namepazirand agar chunin ittifok' aftad, ki tamomi nav'i molkh'oi rui zamin va monandi on bar on ilova shuda, az onkh'o boshad, beguftugu, onkh'o kh'amai inro dar badali ozodiashon az azob mebakhshand. In ch'amoa baroi korkh'oiashon kh'isob meshavand va ch'oigokh'ashon duzakh ast va duzakh ch'oi nikh'oiat bad ast.

19) Ei Paiombar, bandai mu'min, ki ba iak'in medonad on chi bar tu az nazdi Parvardigorat nozil shuda ast, kh'ak' ast, bo kase, ki nobinost, iakson nest. Nobino kofirest, ki da'vati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro rad mekunad. Ba durusti ki az in sokh'iboni khiradi solim pandu ibrat megirand.

20) Bandagoni da'vati ilokh'iro pazirufta kasoneand, ki bar akh'di bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) io digar bandagon bastaashon vafo mekunand va paimoni ustuvori bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) io bo digaron bastaashonro nameshikanand.

21) Va onkh'o kasoneand, ki on chiro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az bastani paivandi kheshovandi amr karda ast, mepaivandand va az Parvardigorashon khavf doshta, farmonkh'oiashro ich'ro va az man'kardakh'oiash parkh'ez mekunand va az on metarsand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi gunokh'oni sodirkardaashon onkh'oro mavridi bozpursi k'aror medikh'ad. Zero kh'ar ki ruzi k'iiomat bozpursi shuda, bo u munok'isha surat girad, kh'alok meshavad.

22) Va onkh'o kasoneand, ki ba mak'sadi ch'ustuch'ui rizoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ibodat, kh'olatkh'oi khushivu ranch'u azob va duri az ma'siiat sabr mekunand va namozi khudro dar komiltarin surat barpo medorand va az ba'zei molkh'oe, ki Mo ba onkh'o dodem, kh'ak'k'i voch'ibro mepardozand va inchunin az molkh'oiashon ba khotiri duri az riio pinkh'oni va ba khotiri ba onkh'o pairavi namudani digaron oshkor sadak'ai nafli medikh'and va badiro bo neki posukh medikh'and. Ok'ibati nek dar ruzi k'iiomat az in ch'amoai tavsifshuda ast.

23) In ok'ibati nek bog'kh'oi doroi ne'matest, ki onkh'o dar on abadi medaroiand va az kamoli ne'matashon on ast, ki kh'ar ki az padaronashon va modaronashon va kh'amsaronashon va farzandonashon dar rokh'i Khudo rostu ustuvor boshand, iakch'o bo onkh'o voridi bikh'isht megardand, to bo mulok'oti nazdikon bo makoni ch'adidashon uns girand. Va farishtagon dar onch'o az kh'ar dari manzilkh'oiashon ba nazdashon medaroiand va onkh'oro tabrik mekunand.

24) Va kh'ar gokh' farishtagon ba nazdashon daroiand, meguiand: "Salom bar shumo! Ba sababi on ki dar dunio dar ibodat, tak'diroti talkhu shirin va duri az gunokh' sabr kardaed, imruz az kh'amai ofat solim memoned." Pas manzili neki shumo chi manzili khub ast.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi mazkur chand sifati mu'minonro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin sifatkh'oi kofironro baion karda guft:
25) Va on kasone paimoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba'di ustuvor namudani on meshikanand va alok'ai kheshiro, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba paivastanash farmon doda ast, meburand va dar zamin bo gunokh' fasodkori menamoiand, inkh'o shakhsoni badbakhti az rakh'mati ilokh'i durand va onkh'oro manzili badi duzakh ast.

26) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ruzi baroi kh'ar ki az bandagonash khokh'ad, farokhi va baroi kh'ar ki khokh'ad, tangi meorad. Farokhii ruzi alomati khushbakhti va dusti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) budani shakhs nest. Inchunin tangii ruzi badbakhtii insonro nishon namedikh'ad. Va kofiron bo zindagonii dunio khushkh'ol shuda, ba on moil gashta, dilashon bo doshtani on orom girifta ast va zindagonii dunio dar k'iios ba okhirat ch'uz matoi andaki zavolpazir chize nest.

27) Va shakhsoni ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va oiatkh'oiash kofir meguiand: "Charo ba Mukh'ammad az sui Parvardigorash mu'ch'izai kh'issii dalolatgar ba rostk'avliash furud ovarda nameshavad, to ba vai imon orem?!" Ei Paiombar, ba in peshnikh'odkunandagon bigu: "Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, az rui adlash gumrokh' mesozad va kh'ar ki bo tavba ba sui kh'ak' gardad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro az rui fazlash ba sui Khud rakh'namoi mekunad. Kh'idoiat dar dasti onkh'o nest, ki onro ba furud ovardani mu'ch'izakh'o vobasta gardonand."

28) In ch'amoai mavridi kh'idoiati ilokh'i k'aror girifta kasoneand, ki imon meorand va dilashon bo zikri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va tilovati K'ur'onu gush faro dodan ba on va digar nav'kh'oi zikr unsu orom megirad. Ogokh' boshed! Dilkh'o tankh'o bo iodi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uns va orom megirand. Albatta, loik' ast, ki dilkh'o bo zikri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ekh'sosi oromish kunand.

29) On kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon meorand va amalkh'oi solekh'i ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdiksozanda mekunand, onkh'oro dar okhirat kh'aioti shoista va ch'oigokh'i neki bikh'isht ast.

30) Ei Paiombar, chunonchi paiombaroni sobik'ro ba sui ummatashon firistodem, inchunin turo ba sui ummatat firistodem, to baroi onkh'o K'ur'onro, ki ba tu paig'om namudaem, bikhoni. K'ur'on dar dalolat bar rostk'avliat basanda ast. Lekin k'avmi tu in dalelro inkor mekunand, zero onkh'o ba Allokh'i Mekh'rubon kufr varzida, makhluk'otro ba U sharik megardonand. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Allokh'i Mekh'rubone, ki digar mavch'udotro ba U sharik megardoned, Parvardigori man ast. G'air az U digar ma'budi barkh'ak' nest, dar kh'ama kor ba U tavakkul kardaam va dar ibodat va kh'och'atkh'oiam tankh'o ba sui U barmegardam."

31) Va agar az sifatkh'oi kitobkh'oi ilokh'i chunin mebud, ki ba sababi on kukh'kh'o az ch'oi khud dur karda meshudand io zamin shikof shuda, az on dariokh'o va chashmakh'o ravon megasht io on kitob ba murdagon khonda shuda, zinda megashtand, iak'inan kh'amin K'ur'on mebud. Zero K'ur'on daleli bisior ravshan ast va agar onkh'o sidk'an az k'alb parkh'ezkor mebudand, in Kitobi ta'sirbakhsh kh'atman dar onkh'o asar meguzosht, vale onkh'o ba ch'oi paziruftanash onro inkor kardand. Balki kh'ama korkh'o, az ch'umla furud ovardani mu'ch'iza va g'aira dar ikhtiiori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Oio mu'minon namedonand, ki agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, kh'atman tamomi mardumro be furud ovardani mu'ch'izakh'o kh'idoiat mekard?! Ammo U inro nakhosta ast. Va kh'amesha ba kofiron ba sababi on chi az kufr va gunokh'on mekunand, musibati sakhti kubanda merasad io on musibat dar nazdikii manzili onkh'o furud meoiad, to vak'te ki va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oidi vuk'ui azobashon oiad. Kh'amono chun zamoni va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) faro birasad, onro khilof namekunad, balki amali mesozad.

32) Va tu nakhustin paiombare nesti, ki k'avmash uro takzib namuda, maskharaash kardaand. Ei Paiombar, ummatkh'oi guzashta niz paiombaroni khudro maskhara karda, durug'guiashon donistaand. Pas Man ba kofiron mukh'lat dodam va pindoshtand, ki kh'alokashon namekunam, sipas onkh'oro ba'di dodani mukh'lat ba uk'ubatkh'o giriftor sokhtam. Pas uk'ubati Man dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o chi guna bud?! Beshubkh'a, on uk'ubati bag'oiat sakht bud.

33) Oio On Zote, ki nigokh'ubini ruzii tamomi mavch'udotro ich'ro karda, amali kasbkardai kh'ar kasro nazorat namuda, sipas kh'ar bandaro bar asosi on ch'azo medikh'ad, ba ibodat loik'tar ast io in butkh'oi sokhtai noloik'i mushrikon?! Va Ba durusti ki kofiron az rui zulm va durug' ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) anbozkh'o k'aror dodaand. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Agar dar da'voi khesh sodik'ed, pas ba mo sharikonero, ki bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted, nom bibared. Io Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az mavch'udiiati anbozkh'oe dar zamin khabar medikh'ed, ki U onkh'oro namedonad?! Balki shumo ma'budkh'oiatonro bo sukhani beasos sharikoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medoned" Balki Shaiton ba kofiron makrashonro zinat dod, pas ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudand va onkh'oro az rokh'i rost bargardonid. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro az rokh'i rostash bargardonad, pas uro kh'idoiatgare, ki rakh'namoiash kunad, nest.

34) Onkh'oro dar dunio ba sababi kushtashavi va asir aftodan, ki bo dasti mu'minon duchorash meshavand, azob ast. Va azobi okhirat, ki dar intizori onkh'ost, baroiashon az azobi dunio sakht va sangintar meboshad. Zero azobi okhirat k'at'noshavanda ast. Va onkh'o nigakh'dorandae, ki ruzi k'iiomat az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'imoiatashon kunad, nadorand.

35) Vasfi ch'annati ba bandagoni parkh'ezkor va'da dodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on ast, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtonash rudkh'o ch'ori buda, mevakh'oiash va soiaash abadii bezavol ast. In farch'omi kasonest, ki bo ich'roi farmon va duri az ma'siiat parkh'ez mekardaand. Ok'ibati kofiron otashi duzakh ast. Onkh'o dar onch'o abadi memonand.

36) Va ei Paiombar, iakh'udikh'o va nasronikh'one, ki baroiashon Tavrotu Inch'il dodaem, bo on chi ba tu nozil karda shuda ast, khushkh'ol meshavand, zero on bo ba'ze az kitobkh'oiashon muvofik'at mekunad. Va az toifakh'oi iakh'ud va nasoro kasoneand, ki ba'ze az on chiro ba tu nozil shuda ast, inkor mekunand, zero on ba khostakh'oiashon muvofik' nest io ba takh'rifi kitobashon aibdorashon mesozad. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) maro farmuda ast, ki tankh'o Uro biparastam va kasero ba U sharik nagardonam. Mardumro tankh'o ba sui ibodati U da'vat mekunam va bozgashti man iagona ba sui Ust. Tavrot va Inch'il niz kh'amin guftakh'oro ovardaand."

37) Va ei Paiombar, chunonchi Mo kitobkh'oi guzashtaro bo zabonkh'oi k'avmashon furud ovardem, kh'amchunin K'ur'onro ba tu bo zaboni arabi ba sifati dovar nozil kardaem. Va ei Paiombar, agar ba'di on chi ba tu az ilmi ta'limdodai Parvardigor omada ast, az khostakh'oi akh'li Kitob pairavi karda, akh'komi khilofi khokh'ishi onkh'oro kh'azf namoi, pas tu az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iovar va nigakh'dorandae nadori, ki pushtiboniat kunad.

38) Va ei Paiombar, Ba durusti ki Mo pesh az tu az baini insonkh'o paiombaroni ziiodero firistodaem. Binobar in, tu nakhustin paiombar nesti. Va ba paiombaroni guzashta monandi digar insonkh'o kh'amsaron va farzandonro dodem. Onkh'oro monandi farishtagon bekh'amsaru farzand nagardonidem. Tu niz az zumrai paiombaroni az nav'i bashar kh'asti, ki kh'amsar va farzand doshtand. Pas baroi chi mushrikon az in taach'ch'ub mekunand?! Va kh'ech' paiombarero durust nest, ki az nazdi khud oiat biiorad, magar on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro rukhsat dikh'ad. Kh'ar kori kh'ukmkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mukh'lati muaiiani kheshro dorad, ki az on peshu ak'ib nameravad.

39) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar chiro az nekiiu badi io khushbakhtiiu badbakhti va g'aira khokh'ad, makh'v mesozad va kh'ar chiro az inkh'o khokh'ad, nigokh' medorad va Lavkh'i Makh'fuz nazdi Ust. Lavkh'i Makh'fuz manbai tamomi korkh'o ast. Kh'ar chi makh'v io kh'ifz meshavad, bo k'aidkh'oi Lavkh'i Makh'fuz mutobik' ast.

40) Va ei Paiombar, agar mo ba tu pesh az margat ba'zei azobero, ki ba onkh'o va'da dodaem, nishon dikh'em, pas in dar ikhtiiori Mo ast io agar turo pesh az nishon dodani on bimironem, pas vazifaat tankh'o on ast, ki tablig'i on chiro baroiat dastur dodaem, ba mardum birasoni va ch'azo dodanu kh'isobi onkh'o bar ukh'dai tu nest. In kor dar ikhtiiori Mo ast.

41) Oio in kofiron namebinand, ki Mo ba sarzamini kufr meoem va onro bo nashri Islom va kishvarkushoii musalmonon az atrofash kam megardonem?! Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar guna khokh'ad, dar baini bandagonash kh'ukm mekunad va kase nest, ki kh'ukmi Uro bekor kunad io tag'iir dikh'ad va U Parvardigori Zudkh'isob buda, kh'amai korkh'oi bandagonro az avval to okhir dar iak ruz kh'isob mekunad.

42) Va ba durusti ki ummatkh'oi guzashta dar kh'ak'k'i paiombaroni khesh dasisai ziiod kardand va oiini ovardai onkh'oro durug' donistand. Pas on dushmanoni paiombaron bo on kh'ama makru kh'ilai anch'omdodaashon chi kor karda tavonistand?! Kh'ech' kor! Zero tadbiri ta'sirguzor tadbiri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kori anch'omdodai kh'ama bandagonashro medonad va kh'ech' kore az U pinkh'on namemonad. Va kofiron khokh'and donist, ki dar borai imon naovardan to chi andoza khatokor va mu'minon to chi andoza durustkor budaand. Mu'minon sokh'ibi ch'annatu ok'ibati nek meshavand.

43) Va kofiron meguiand: "Ei Mukh'ammad, tu firistodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nesti." Ei Firistodai Mo, ba onkh'o bigu: "Shakh'odati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baini movu shumo dar borai paiombariam va niz guvokh'ii shakhsi dar borai kitobkh'oi guzashta doroi ilm, ki dar on tavsifi man omada ast, baroiam basanda ast. Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba rostgui budani shakhse guvokh'i dikh'ad, digar takzibi kase ba u zarar namerasonad."

1) "Alif. Lom. Ro." Ei Paiombar, in K'ur'on Kitobest, ki onro Mo bar tu furud ovardem, to mardumro bo khost va erii Parvardigori eshon az kufru ch'akh'olatu gumrokh'i ba sui ilmu imonu Islom, ki rokh'i durusti Allokh'i kh'amesha G'olibi dar kh'amai korkh'oiash Sutuda ast, berun ori.

2) Allokh'e, ki molikiiati on chi dar osmonkh'o va on chi dar zamin ast, tankh'o az Ust. Binobar in, iagona U arzandai parastish buda, naboiad digar makhluk'ot ba U sharik k'aror doda shavand. Va kh'atman kofiron duchori azobi sakht megardand.

3) Kofiron kh'aioti dunio va ne'matkh'oi zavolpaziri onro bar kh'aioti okhirat va ne'matkh'oi abadii on tarch'ekh' medikh'and va mardumro az ch'odai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barmegardonand va baroi rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'ak'ik'at va rosti kach'iro mech'uiand, to kase dar in rokh' naravad. In ch'amoai bo sifatkh'oi mazkur tavsifshuda dar gumrokh'ii az kh'ak' va rosti dur k'aror dorand.

4) Va iak'inan Mo kh'ar paiombarero bo zaboni k'avmash firistodem, to baroiashon vakh'iro baion sozad va onro fakh'mand. Mo kh'ech' paiombarero baroi on nafiristodaem, ki mardumro dar imon ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mach'bur sozad. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, bo adlash gumrokh' mesozad va ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, bo fazlash tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro medikh'ad. Va U Allokh'i G'olibest, ki kh'ech' kas Uro mag'lub gardonida nametavonad, dar ofarinish va tadbiri kori Khesh bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

5) Va beshak, Mo Musoro bo mu'ch'izakh'oi Khud, ki bar rostk'avli va nubuvvatash dalolat mekard, firistodem va farmudem, ki k'avmashro az kufru nodoni ba sui imonu donish berun kunad va inchunin ruzkh'oi guzashtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro, ki dar on bar onkh'o ne'mat doda bud, ba iodashon biiorad. Kh'amono dar zikri on ruzkh'o baroi bandagoni dar ibodat bisior sobir va dar ne'mat bisior shukrguzor oidi isboti iagonagivu k'udrati ilokh'i va in'omash bar mu'minon dalolatkh'oi oshkor ast.

6) Va ei Paiombar, zamonero iod kun, ki Muso amri Parvardigori khudro ich'ro karda, ne'matkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba iodi Bani Isroili k'avmi khesh ovarda guft: "Ei mardum, ne'mati baroiaton dodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba iod ored, on zamone, ki shumoro az dasti atrofiion va khosoni Fir'avn rakh'o namuda, az azobashon ba salomat berun ovard. Onkh'o ba shumo badtarin azobro mechashonidand va pisaronatonro ba k'atl merasonidand, to dar baini shumo shakhse ba dunio naoiad, ki mamlakati Fir'avnro az khud kunad va zanonatonro bo mak'sadi takh'k'irashon zinda nigokh' medoshtand. Va dar in korkh'oiashon baroi sabri shumo ozmoishi buzurg bud. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba khotiri dar in sanch'ish sabr kardanaton bo rakh'onidanaton az uk'ubatu shikanch'ai atrofiioni Fir'avn ba shumo mukofot dod."

7) Va Muso ba onkh'o guft: "On zamonero ba khotir biiored, ki Parvardigoraton ba surati bisior shevo ba shumo e'lon namud: "Agar az ne'matkh'oi zikrshuda, ki onro ba shumo Man bakhshidaam, shukrguzori kuned, kh'atman az fazli Khud bar on meafzoiam va agar az ne'matkh'o nosiposi karda, shukrguzori nakuned, pas bidoned, ki iak'inan azobi Man baroi mardumi nosipos bag'oiat sakht ast."

8) Va Muso ba k'avmash guft: "Ei mardum, agar shumo va tamomi mardumi zamin kofir shaved, pas ziionash ba shumo barmegardad. Zero kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Beniiozi Sutuda ast. Az imoni kase foida va az kufri kase zarar namebinad."

9) Ei kofiron, oio baroiaton khabari kh'alok gardonidani ummatkh'oi takzibkunandai pesh az shumo guzashtai k'avmi Nukh' va Odi k'avmi Kh'ud va Samudi k'avmi Solekh' va ummatkh'oi ba'di inkh'o omada, ki adadashon ziiod buda, shumorai dak'ik'i onro tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonand, naomada ast?! Paiombaron suiashon bo dalelkh'oi ravshan omadand va onkh'o az rui g'azabi sakht dastonashonro dar dakh'onashon guzoshta, angushtonashonro gazidand va ba paiombaron guftand: "Ba durusti ki mo ba on chi shumo baroi rasonidanash ravon shudaed, kofirem va az on chi moro ba suiash mekhoned, dar shubkh'ai nikh'oiat sakht k'aror dorem."

10) Paiombaronashon dar posukh guftand: "Oio dar iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va tankh'o Uro parastidan shubkh'a vuch'ud dorad, dar kh'ole ki U be namunai sobik' Ofaridgori osmonkh'o va zamin ast?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro ba sui imon ovardan faro mekhonad, to in ki ba'zei gunokh'oni peshinaatonro mag'firat kunad va shumoro dar dunio to mukh'lati baroiaton muk'arrarshuda ba ta'khir guzorad." K'avmashon ba onkh'o guftand: "Beguftugu, shumo niz monandi mo insoned. Az mo bartari nadored. Mekhokh'ed moro az ibodati on chi padaronamon meparastidand, bargardoned. Pas ba mo kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan biiored, to rostk'avlii shumoro dar da'voi paiombariaton sobit namoiad."

11) Paiombaronashon dar posukhashon guftand: "Mo ch'uz insonkh'oe ba monandi shumo besh nestem. Ba shumo shabokh'at doshtanamonro inkor namekunem. Ammo in ma'noi onro nadorad, ki movu shumo dar kh'ama chiz ba kh'am monandem. Balki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo in'omi khosash ba kh'ar ki az bandagonash khokh'ad, lutfu ekh'son mekunad, bandagoni khostaashro baroi paiombarii mardum barmeguzinad. Va baroi mo durust nest, ki ch'uz bo khosti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar daleli khostai shumoro baroiaton biiorem. Binobar in, ovardani on dar tavoni mo nest, balki tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in tavonro dorad. Va mu'minon dar kh'amai korkh'oiashon boiad tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia kunand.

12) Va charo mo ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavakkul nakunem, dar kh'ole ki U moro ba rokh'kh'oi rostu ravshanamon kh'idoiat kardaast?! Va begumon mo dar barobari on ki bo takzib va tamaskhur ozoramon medikh'ed, sabr mekunem va boiad mu'minon dar tamomi korkh'oi khud tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia kunand."

13) Va kofiron vak'te az bakh's bo paiombaron och'iz mondand, ba onkh'o guftand: "Savgand mekhurem, ki shumoro az dekh'ai khud meronem io in ki kh'atman az dinaton ba oiini mo barmegarded." Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi ustuvorsozii k'albi paiombaron ba onkh'o paig'om firistoda guft: "Ba durusti ki Mo zolimonero, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va paiombaronash kofir shudaand, kh'alok megardonem.

14) Va shumo paiombaron va pairavonatonro ba'di kh'aloksozii onkh'o sokini zamin mesozem. In va'dai kh'alok sokhtani kofironi takzibgar va ba'di onkh'o sokini zamin gardonidani paiombaronu mu'minon baroi kasest, ki azamat va nazorati doimii Maro dar peshi nazarash kh'ozir mesozad va az on ki az azob uro bim medikh'am, metarsad."

15) Va paiombaron az Parvardigorashon darkhost kardand, to onkh'oro bar ziddi dushman piruz gardonad va kh'ar shakhsi mutakabbiri iakrave, ki bo vuch'udi ravshan budani kh'ak', az on sarpechi mekunad, ziion dida ast.

16) Ruzi k'iiomat az peshi rui in mutakabbir duzakh ast. Duzakh dar kamini vai istoda ast. Va dar onch'o az zardobi boshandagoni duzakh, ki az badani onkh'o ch'ori megardad, baroiash nushonida meshavad. On zardob tashnagii uro bartaraf namekunad. Pas kh'amvora bo tashnagivu digar nav'kh'oi azob uk'ubat karda meshavad.

17) Az bor-bor nushidani zardob ba sababi talkhi, kh'arorat va badbui budanash ranch' mebarad va onro furu burda nametavonad va az sakhtii azob marg az kh'ar taraf ba suiash meoiad va namemirad, to rokh'at shavad, balki paivasta azob mekashad. Va az peshi rui vai azobi sakhti digare dar intizori ust.

18) Vasfi korkh'oi nek ba monandi sadak'a, ekh'son, mekh'ruboni nisbat ba bechora va g'airai kofiron ba vasfi khokistare shabokh'at dorad, ki bodkh'o dar ruzi tundbod bar on sakht vazida, onro ba shiddat bardoshta, dar kh'ar ch'o parokanda mesozand, ki kh'atto az on asare bok'i namemonad. Amalkh'oi kofiron niz kh'amin guna ast. Tundbodi bekhudoi sakht vazida korkh'oiashonro benomu nishon mesozad. Ba kh'amin sabab, kirdori neki onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat ba sokh'ibash foida nameorad. In amale, ki bar poiai imon asos naiofta ast, kh'amon gumrokh'ii az rokh'i kh'ak' dur ast.

19) Ei inson, oio namedoni, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) osmonkh'o va zaminro bo kh'ikmati azim ofarida ast?! Parvardigor on duro bekh'uda khalk' nakarda ast. Ei mardum, agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ad, shumoro kh'alok megardonad va makhluk'i navero, ki Uro ibodat va itoat kunad, meorad.
20) Va kh'alok kardani shumovu dar ivaz ovardani digar makhluk' Uro och'iz namegardonad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ama kor K'odir ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro notavon namesozad.

21) Va ruzi va'dashuda kh'amai khaloik' az k'abrkh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mebaroiand, pas pairavoni notavon ba peshvoionashon, ki gumrokh'ashon kardaand, meguiand: "Kh'amono mo pairavoni shumo budem. Dasturi shumoro ich'ro karda, ba much'arradi moro az kore man' namudan, az on boz meistodem. Pas oio shumo az uk'ubati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizero az mo dur mekuned?!" Peshvoioni rokh'i zalolat dar posukh meguiand: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mo tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i durustro medod, begumon shumoro ba sui on rakh'namoi mekardem va kh'amagi az azobi U nach'ot meioftem. Vale mo gumrokh' shudem va shumoro niz gumrokh' sokhtem. Dar azobi ilokh'i chi betobi mekunem io chi sabr mekunem, bar mo va shumo barobar ast. Ba kh'ar surat az uk'ubat ch'oi gurez nadorem."

22) Va vak'te akh'li ch'annat dokhili ch'annat va akh'li duzakh dokhili duzakh shavand, Iblis meguiad: "Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo va'dai durust doda, onro ich'ro kard va man ba shumo va'dai botil doda, ba on vafo nakardam va man dar dunio nerue nadoshtam, ki bo istifoda az on shumoro ba kofir va gumrokh' shudan mach'bur kunonam, lekin shumoro ba sui kufr da'vat kardam va gunokh'ro baroiaton oroish dodam va ba anch'omash shitofted. Pas dar mavridi gumrokh'ii khesh maro malomat nakuned va khudro malomat kuned. Khudi shumo loik'i malomat kh'asted. Imruz man bo dur kardani azob ba fariodi shumo namerasam va shumo niz bo dur sokhtani on fariodrasi man nested. Kh'amono man ba on ki dar ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dunio maro sharik sokhtaed, bezoram. Iak'inan dar ruzi k'iiomat shakhsoni dar dunio bo shirku kufr bar ch'oni khud zulmkardaro azobi dardovar ast."

Vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi mazkur bo k'asdi bim dodani bandagon ok'ibati kofironro dar ruzi okhirat zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin bo k'asdi targ'ib farch'omi mu'minonro baion karda guft:
23) Va bar khilofi ok'ibati zolimon, kasone, ki imon meorand va korkh'oi shoista mekunand, ba bog'kh'oe darovarda meshavand, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtoni on rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad, onkh'o dar onch'o bo rukhsat va k'udrati Parvardigorashon abadi memonand. Ba'ze ba ba'zei digar salom mefiristand. Inchunin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va farishtagon ba onkh'o salom medikh'and.

24) Ei Paiombar, magar namedoni, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai kalimai poki "Lo ilokh'a illallokh'" chi guna masal zada ast?! Onro ba darakhti poki khurmo monand gardonida ast. Tanaash dar zamin furu rafta, bo reshakh'oi pokash ob menushad va shokhaash ba tarafi osmon baland buda, az boron serob megardad va az bodu kh'avoi toza nafas mekashad.
25) In darakht kh'ar vak't bo amri Parvardigorash samarai pokashro medikh'ad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) masalkh'oro ba mardum baion mesozad, to onkh'o az on pand girand va imon orand.

26) Va sifati kalimai nopoki shirk ba monandi sifati darakhti nopoki kh'anzal [nav' kadui ioboi] ast, ki az reshaash kanda shuda, dar zamin sobit nest va ba sui osmon namebaroiad. Nobud megardad va bodkh'o onro parokanda mesozand. Farch'omi sukhani kufr fano buda, az sokh'ibash ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amali nek namebaroiad.

27) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mu'minoni vok'eiro dar zindagonii dunio ba sababi kalimai tavkh'id ustuvor megardonad, to boimon bimirand va dar k'abr va ruzi k'iiomat niz onkh'oro ustuvor megardonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shakhsoni bo shirk va kufr az rokh'i rost bargashtai zolimro gumrokh' mesozad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar chi khokh'ad, anch'om medikh'ad. Ba'zero az rui adlash gumrokh' va ba'zero az rui fazlash kh'idoiat mekunad. Kh'ech' kase Uro mach'bur sokhta nametavonad.

28) Beshak, tu k'uraishro didi, ne'mati osoishtagi dar sarzamini Kh'aram va bi'sati turo, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az baroi onkh'o in'om namud, ba nosiposi tabdil doda, oiini az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ovardai turo takzib kardand va k'avmi ba onkh'o dar kufr pairavro dar saroi kh'alokat furud ovardand.
29) Saroi kh'alokat otashi duzakh ast, ki ba on dokhil meshavand va az kh'aroratash ranch' mebarand va duzakh k'arorgokh'i nikh'oiat bad ast.

30) Va mushrikon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik k'aror dodaand, to digaronro ba misli khud az rokh'i durust gumrokh' sozand. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Dar in dunio bo shakh'vatkh'o va pakh'n kardani shubkh'akh'oi khesh kh'alovat bared. Ba durusti ki ch'oi bozgashti shumo ba sui otashi duzakh ast. G'airi on kh'ech' ch'oi bozgasht nadored."

31) Ei Paiombar, ba mu'minon bigu: "Namozro dar bekh'tarin surati on barpo dored va k'abl az omadani ruze, ki dar on baroi rakh'oi az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kharidu furush, suporidani bakh'oi ozodi va dusti baroi shafoati dust vuch'ud nadorad, az on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo ruzi namuda ast, makhfi io oshkor sadak'akh'oi farzi va nafli kuned." Kh'adafi sadak'ai pinkh'oni duri az khudnamoi va kh'adafi sadak'ai oshkor ch'albi digaron ba in amali khair ast.

32) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) On Zotest, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro be namunai sobik' kh'ast namud va az osmon obi boronro furud ovard, pas ba sababi in ob ba khotiri ruzii shumo mardum nav'kh'oi gunoguni mevakh'oro berun sokht va baroi shumo kishtikh'oro musakhkhar sokht, ki bo irodai U bar rui ob meravad va baroi shumo ch'uikh'oro musakhkhar sokht, to az on khud binushed va chorpoionu ziroatatonro niz ob dikh'ed.
33) Va baroi shumo oftobu mokh'tobro musakhkhar sokht, ki doimo dar kh'oli kh'arakatand va baroi shumo shabro bo mak'sadi khobu rokh'at va ruzro bo mak'sadi koru kasbi ruzi musakhkhar sokht.

34) Va ba shumo kh'ar on chi az U pursidaed va kh'ar on chi napursidaed, doda ast va agar ne'matkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bishumored, ba sababi bisiori az ukh'dai shumoridanash namebaroed. On chi zikr kard, chand namunae az ne'matkh'o bud. Kh'amono inson nisbat ba kheshtan bisior zolim, nisbat ba ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i bisior nosipos ast.

35) Ei Paiombar, iod kun vak'tero, ki Ibrokh'im ba'di on ki pisarash Ismoilro bo kh'amsarash Kh'och'ar dar sarzamini Makka muk'im gardonid, guft: "Ei Parvardigoro, in sarzaminero, ki dar on khonadonamro muk'im sokhtam, sarzamini doroi amn bigardon, dar on khunrezi va zulm surat nagirad va maro bo farzandonam az ibodati butkh'o dur bidor.

36) Ei Parvardigoro, ba durusti ki butkh'o beshtari mardumro gumrokh' kardand, zero mardum gumon dorand, ki butkh'o nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro shafoat mekunand va baroi kh'amin sheftaashon shuda, onkh'oro parastidand. Pas, kh'ar ki baini mardum dar iaktoparasti va ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az man itoat kunad, beshak, vai az pairavoni man ast va kh'ar ki maro nofarmoni karda, dar iaktoparasti va ibodat az man pairavi nakunad, ba durusti ki ei Parvardigoram, Tu nisbati kh'ar ki bikhokh'i, Bakhshandavu Mekh'ruboni.

37) Ei Parvardigori mo, kh'amono man ba'zei farzandonam-Ismoilu farzandonashro dar vodii Makka, ki dar on ziroatu ob nest, dar ch'ivori Khonai doroi ekh'tiromu kh'aibatat sokin sokhtam. Parvardigoro, baroi on khonadonamro dar ch'ivori Khonaat sokin sokhtam, ki dar on namoz barpo dorand. Pas Parvardigoro, k'albi mardumro tavre bigardon, ki ba sui onkh'o va in sarzamin moil shavad va baroi onkh'o az mevakh'oi rangorang ruzi bidekh', to az Tu baroi in'omi kardaat siposguzori kunand.

38) Ei Parvardigori mo, Ba durusti ki kh'ar chiro mo pinkh'on va kh'ar chiro oshkor mekunem, Tu medoni. Va dar osmon va zamin az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' chize pinkh'on nameboshad, balki kh'amaro medonad. Niiozmandiamon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az U pushida nest.

39) Sipos Khudoero, ki duoi baroiam dodani farzandi solekh'ro pazirufta, ba man bo vuch'udi pironsoli az domani Kh'och'ar Ismoil va az domani Sora Iskh'ok'ro bakhshid. Kh'amono Parvardigori Poki man duoi shakhsi duokunandaro mepazirad.
40) Ei Parvardigoram, maro va naslamro barpodorandagoni namoz bigardon. Ei Parvardigoram, va duoi maro bipazir.
41) Ei Parvardigori mo, dar ruze, ki mardum nazdi Tu baroi kh'isobu kitob barmekhezand, gunokh'oni man va padaru modaram va gunokh'oni mu'minonro biomurz.

42) Va ei Paiombar, chunin gumon mabar, ki vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uk'ubati zolimonro ba ta'khir meguzorad, az amalkh'oi badi onkh'o ba misli durug' shumoridani oiini ovardai paiombaron, man'i mardum az rokh'i kh'ak' va g'airi on dar g'aflat ast, balki U kh'amai inkh'oro medonad va kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest. Ba durusti ki azobi onkh'oro to ruzi okhirat, ki didakh'o az didani dakh'shatkh'o kushodai bekh'arakat megardand, ba ta'khir meguzorad.

43) Ruze, ki mardum az k'abrashon shitobon ba sui da'vatkunanda barmekhezand, sarashonro bardoshta, az tars ba sui osmon menigarand, chashmashon ba suiashon barnamegardad, balki az shiddatnokii on chi mebinand, kushodai bekh'arakat monda va k'albashon az dakh'shati sakh'nai on ruza kholi buda, ak'lu fakh'm nadorad.

44) Va ei Paiombar, ummati khudro az omadani azobi ruzi k'iiomat bitarson. On ruz kasone, ki bo anch'omi kufru shirk bar ch'oni kheshtan sitam kardaand, meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, baroiamon mukh'lat bidekh' va azobro az mo ba ta'khir guzoshta, moro baroi iak muddati kutokh' ba dunio bargardon, to ba Tu imon biiorem va az paiombaroni ba suiamon firistodaat pairavi kunem." Ba onkh'o sarzanishkunon ch'avob doda meshavand: "Oio shumo zindashavii ba'd az margro inkor karda, savgand nakhurda buded, ki az kh'aioti dunio ba okhirat intik'ol nameiobed?!

45) Va dar ch'oi istik'omati ummatkh'oi pesh az shumo guzashta ba monandi k'avmi Kh'udu Solekh', ki ba sababi kofir shudan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar ch'oni kheshtan sitam kardand, sukunat namuded va baroiaton chi guna onkh'oro kh'alok kunonidanamon ma'lum shud va dar Kitobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo masalkh'oi ziiod baion sokhtem, to az on pand gired, vale pand nagirifted."

46) Va Ba durusti ki in ch'amoai dar ch'oi istik'omati ummatkh'oi sitamkori guzashta sokin baroi k'atli Mukh'ammadi Firistodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va makh'vi da'vati vai dasisakh'oi ziiod sokhtand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dasisai onkh'oro medonad, chize az U pushida namemonad va dasisai onkh'o notavon buda, ba sababi notavoni na kukh'kh'o va na g'airi onro az ch'oiash bech'o karda nametavonad. Bar khilofi tadbiri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o, ki bag'oiat k'avi ast.

47) Pas, ei Paiombar, chunin gumon mabar, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va'dai ba paiombaronash dar borai piruzii din dodai Khudro khilof mekunad. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti G'olibi Intik'omgiranda ast. Ba dustoni Khud izzat doda, az dushmanonash va dushmanoni paiombaron intik'omi sakht megirad.

48) In sitonidani intik'om az kofiron ruzi barposhavii k'iiomat ba vuk'u' mepaivandad, ruze, ki in zamin ba zamini safedi poki digar ivaz meshavad va osmonkh'o ba osmonkh'oi digar tabdil doda meshavand va mardum baroi istodan dar barobari Allokh'i dar podshokh'i va azamat Iagonai G'olib az k'abrkh'o bo ch'ism va amalkh'oiashon berun shuda, namoion megardand.

49) Va ei Paiombar, ruze, ki zaminu osmonkh'o ba zaminu osmonkh'oi digar ivaz shavad, ba'zei kofironu mushrikonro bo ba'zei digar dar zavlonakh'o basta mebini. Dastu poiashon bo zanch'irkh'o ba gardankh'oiashon iakch'o basta meshavad.
50) Libose, ki onro mepushand, az "K'atiron" (mavodi otashin) meboshad va chekh'rai giriftai onkh'oro otashi ch'akh'annam faro megirad.
51) To Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar kas ch'azoi nekivu badii anch'om dodaashro bidikh'ad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi a'moli bandagon Zudkh'isob ast.

52) In K'ur'on baroi mardum e'lone az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast va bo takh'didoti dar on mavch'ud tarsonida shavand va bidonand, ki Ma'budi barkh'ak' Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, iagona Uro parastida, az shirk biparkh'ezand va to sokh'iboni khiradi solim az K'ur'on pand bigirand. Zero makh'z kh'amin sokh'ibkhiradon az pandu ibrat manfiat mebarand.
1) "Alif. Lom. Ro." In oiatkh'oi balandmak'omi az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furudomada oiatkh'oi K'ur'oni karim buda, tavzekh'dikh'andai iaktoparasti va akh'komi Parvardigor ast.
2) Kofiron ruzi k'iiomat, vak'te kh'ak'ik'ati kor baroiashon ravshan gashta, butloni kufri dar dunio ikhtiior namudaashon ma'lum meshavad, orzu mekunand, ki kosh musulmon mebudand.

3) Ei Paiombar, in ch'amoai takzibkunandaro ba kh'oli khud biguzor, to monandi chorpoion bikhurand va az lazzatkh'oi zavoliobandai dunio kh'alovat barand va orzui tuloni onkh'oro az imon va amali solekh' mashg'ul sozad. Pas kh'atman onkh'o vak'te ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigor vorid shavand, on gokh' ziionkor budani khudro medonand.

4) Va Mo kh'alokatro bar kh'ech' akh'li dekh'ai zolime furud naovardem, magar on ki onkh'o dar ilmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mukh'lati muaiian doshtand. Chun mukh'lati kh'alokatashon omad, kh'atto lakh'zae ba ta'khir guzoshta nashudand. Binobar in, naboiad shakhsoni sitamkor az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon mukh'lat doda ast, mag'rur shavand.

5) Kh'ech' ummate k'abl az rasidani zamoni kh'alokatashon kh'alok nameshavand va chun zamoni kh'alokatashon faro rasad, on ba ta'khir nameaftad. Az in ru, naboiad zolimon az on ki Khudo ba eshon mukh'lat doda ast, mag'rur gardand.

6) Va kofironi Makka ba Rasuli Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) guftand: "Ei kase da'vo dorad, ki baroiash K'ur'on nozil karda shuda ast, begumon tu bo in da'voiat devonai va ba misli devonakh'o raftor dori.
7) Agar tu az rostguen kh'asti, charo ba nazdi mo farishtagonro naovardi, to guvokh'i bidikh'and, ki tu paembari va mo duchori azob khokh'em gasht?!"

8) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar posukhashon guft: "Mo farishtagonro tankh'o bo tak'ozoi kh'ikmat furud meorem. Onkh'oro zamone furud meorem, ki mukh'lati nobudii kofiron faro rasad. Va chun Mo farishtagonro nazdashon biiorem va onkh'o imon naorand, digar baroiashon mukh'lat doda nameshavad, balki zud ch'azo mebinand."
9) Kh'amono Mo in K'ur'onro bo mak'sadi pand dodani mardum bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) furud ovardem va iak'inan Mo onro az kamu ziiodshavi va tag'iiru takh'rif nigokh' medorem.

10) Va ei Paiombar, kh'ak'k'o, ki Mo pesh az tu dar baini ch'amoatkh'oi kofiri sobik' paiombaroni ziiod firistodaem, pas onkh'oro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand. Baroi kh'amin tu nakhustin paiombare nesti, ki az ch'onibi ummatonat durug'gui kh'isobida meshavi.
11) Va dar baini kofironi sobik' kh'ech' paiombare nameomad, magar on ki uro durug'gui donista, maskhara mekardand.
12) On guna ki Mo dar k'albi on ummatkh'o takzibro dokhil kardem, inchunin dar dili mushrikoni Makka ba sababi az kh'ak'ik'at rui toftan va sarkashi kardanashon takzibro vorid mesozem.

13) Onkh'o ba in K'ur'on imon nameorand va vok'ean k'onuni sobiti ilokh'i dar borai kh'aloksozii kasone, ki oiini ovardai paiombaronro durug' meshumorand, guzashta ast. Boiad takzibgaroni nubuvvati tu az on darsi ibrat girand.

14) Va in ch'amoai takzibgar agarchi kh'ak'ik'at baroiashon bo dalelkh'oi ravshan ma'lum gardad, sarkashi iakravand. Va agar Mo baroi onkh'o az osmon darvozaero boz kunem, pas az on darvoza bolo ravand-
15) bo vuch'udi in kh'argiz kh'ak'ik'atro tasdik' namekunand va begumon meguiand: "Ba durusti, chashmoni mo az didan basta shuda ast, balki on chiro mebinem, az ta'siri ch'odust, mo ch'odu shudaem."

16) Va ba durusti, dar osmon sitorakh'oi buzurgkh'ach'me ofaridem, ki mardum ba sababi on dar safarkh'oi khesh dar torikikh'oi khushki va bakh'r rokh'i khudro meioband va osmonro bo ch'am'i sitoragon baroi binandagon oroish dodem, to az on ba k'udrati ilokh'i pai barand.
17) Va osmonro az kh'ar Shaitoni az rakh'mati Khudo rondashuda kh'ifz kardem.
18) Magar on kase, ki ba sukhani farishtagoni muk'arrab pinkh'oni gush andozad, pas otashi oshkore uro dunbol karda, mesuzonad.

19) Va zaminro gustaronidem, to mardum dar rui on k'aror girand va dar on kukh'kh'oi mustakh'kam ofaridem, to bo kh'arakatash mardumro ba iztirob naorad va dar on az kh'ar nav' nabototi tibk'i tak'ozoi kh'ikmati Mo sanch'idai muaiian ruionidem.
