20) Va ei mardum, baroi shumo dar zamin to vak'te dar on zindagi mekuned, asbobi maishat az khurdanikh'o va nushidanikh'oro ofaridem va baroi digar mardum va kh'aivonot, ki shumo ruzidikh'andai onkh'o nested, asbobi zindagiashonro ofaridem.

21) Va kh'ech' chizi ba mardum va chakh'orpoion manfiatovar nest, magar on ki Mo dar padid ovardani on va ba sababi on manfiat rasonidan ba mardum K'odirem va chizero kh'ast namekunem, magar onro bo andozai tibk'i tak'ozoi kh'ikmat va khostaamon ma'lum kh'ast mekunem.

22) Va bodkh'oro firistodem, dar kh'ole ki abrkh'oro bordor mesozad, pas az abri bordorshuda boron furud ovardem, ba'd az on shumoro az obi boron serob sokhtem va shumo obro dar zamin khazina namekuned, to chokh' va chashma shavad, balki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro dar zamin khazina mekunad.

23) Va kh'amono Mo murdagonro bo ofaridan az nesti va ba'di marg kh'aiot bakhshidan zinda megardonem va zindagonro ba'd az guzaronidani mukh'lati kh'aiot memironem va tankh'o Mo poidorem, ki zaminro bo kh'ar ki va kh'ar chi bar rui on kh'ast, ba meros mebarem.
24) Va iak'inan Mo kasonero, ki pesh az shumo guzashtaand, medonem va iak'inan kasonero, ki pas az shumo meoiand, medonem. Kh'ech' chiz dar in bora az Mo pushida nameboshad.

25) Va ei Paiombar, kh'atman Parvardigorat kh'amai onkh'oro dar ruzi k'iiomat ch'am' mesozad, to ba nekukor va badkor ch'azo dikh'ad. Beguftugu, U dar tadbiri kori Khud bag'oiat Kh'akimi Dono ast. Chize az U makhfi nest.
26) Va beshak, Mo Odamro az gili khushke, ki agar zada shavad, sado mebarorad, az gili siiokh'i ba sababi ziiod istodanash bugin ofaridem.
27) Va pesh az khalk'i Odam padari ch'inkh'oro az otashi sakhtkh'arorat ofaridem.
28) Va ei Paiombar, iod kun on zamonero, ki Parvardigorat ba farishtagon va Iblis, ki kh'amrokh'i onkh'o bud, guft: "Ba durusti, Man az gili khushkidai rangash siiokh'u badbui inson meofaram.
29) Pas, chun suratashro barobar va khilk'atashro komil kardam, bo kh'adafi ich'roi amri Man va izkh'ori salom nazdash sach'da kuned."
30) Pas farishtagon dasturi Parvardigorashonro ba ch'o ovardand va on guna ki farmonashon dod, kh'amagi nazdi Odam sach'da kardand.
31) Lekin Iblis, ki bo farishtagon k'aror doshta, vale az zumari onkh'o nabud, az iakch'o bo onkh'o nazdi Odam (alaikh'is salom) sach'da kardan sarpechi kard.

32) Chun Iblis az sach'dai nazdi Odam khuddori namud, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba vai guft: "Turo az sach'da kardan bo farishtagon, ki baroi itoat az Man nazdi Odam sach'da namudand, chi boz dosht?"
33) Iblis az rui kibr guft: "Baroi man nazdi odame, ki uro az gili khushki siiokh'i bugin ofaridai, sach'da namudan durust nest."
34) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Iblis guft: "Pas az ch'annat berun shav. Zero tu begumon rondashuda kh'asti.
35) Va beguftugu, to ruzi k'iiomat la'nati Man bar tust."
36) Iblis guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, aknun maro, ki rondai, pas ba man mukh'lat bidekh' va to ruzi ba'd az marg zinda sokhtani makhluk'ot maro namiron."
37) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba u guft: "Pas tu az ch'umlai fursatdodashudagone kh'asti, ki margi onkh'oro ba ta'khir guzoshtaam-
38) to ruzi damidani suri iakum, ki tamomi mavch'udot dar on memirand."
39) Iblis guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, ba sababi maro gumrokh' namudanat baroi farzandoni Odam dar zamin nav'kh'oi gunoguni gunokh'ro oroish medikh'am va kh'amaashonro gumrokh' mesozam,-
40) ch'uz on bandagonat, ki baroi ibodati Khesh barguzidai."
41) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft: "In rokh'i rostest, ki ba Man merasonad.
42) Kh'amono tu baroi ba fitna kashidani bandagoni mukhlisam k'udrat va saltanat nadori, g'airi on gumrokh'on, ki ba tu pairavi kunand.
43) Va ba durusti, duzakh va'dagokh'i Isblis va kulli pairavoni gumrokh'i ust."
44) Duzakh kh'aft darvoza dorad, ki Iblisu pairavonash az on vorid meshavand. Az kh'ar iak darvoza andozai muaiianshudai pairavoni Iblis medaroiand.
45) Kh'amono kasone, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va khuddori az mamnuot parkh'ezkori mekunand, dar bog'kh'oi ch'annat va chashmakh'o k'aror megirand.
46) Vak'ti daromadani ch'annat ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Bo solim mondan az ofatkh'o va emini az asbobi khavf ba bikh'isht daroed."
47) Va kinavu adovati dar dilashon ch'oidoshtaro dur megardonem, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o dar ch'annat barodaroni bo iakdigar dust buda, bar rui takhtkh'o rubarui kh'amdigar menishinand.
48) Dar ch'annat ba onkh'o mashak'k'at namerasad va az on berun karda nameshavand, balki onch'o ch'ovidon memonand.
49) Ei Paiombar, baroi bandagonam e'lon kun, ki Man ba durusti, nisbat ba tavbakoron Bakhshandai Mekh'rubonam.
50) Va e'lon kun, ki azobi Man vok'ean azobi dardovar ast. Boiad tavba kunand, to ba mag'firatam noil gashta, az azobam emin monand.
51) Va onkh'oro az khabari mekh'mononi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom), farishtagone, ki muzhdai sokh'ibi farzand shudan va nobud sokhtani k'avmi Lutro baroiash ovardand, ogokh' bisoz.

52) Chun farishtagon ba nazdi Ibrokh'im daromadand, ba u "Salom" guftand, Ibrokh'im bo salomi bekh'tar ch'avob dod. Vai baroi mekh'monon gushti gusolai birion ovard, to az on bikhurand, zero farishtagonro odam pindoshta bud. Chun onkh'o az gushti ovardai Ibrokh'im iste'mol nakardand, guft: "Beshak, mo az shumo dar kh'arosem."
53) Farishtagoni firistodai Khudo guftand: "Natars. Kh'amono mo ba tu chizero muzhda medikh'em, ki khushkh'olat megardonad. Tu sokh'ibi pisarbachai donishmand meshavi."
54) Ibrokh'im bo taach'ch'ub guft: "Oio bo vuch'udi pironsolie, ki ba man rasida ast, maro ba farzand muzhda doded?! Dar kadom asos in muzhdaro ba man medikh'ed?!"
55) Farishtagon ba Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) guftand: "Mo turo ba rosti, ki dar vuk'uash shak nest, bashorat dodem. Pas az on chi turo bashorat dodem, az ch'umlai shakhsoni noumedshuda mabosh."
56) Ibrokh'im guft: "Az rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'uz shakhsoni az rokh'i rost munkh'arifshuda kase noumed nameshavad!"
57) Ibrokh'im guft: "Pas ei firistodagoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), chi kori mukh'imme, ki shumoro inch'o ovarda ast?"
58) Farishtagon guftand: "Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moro baroi kh'aloksozii k'avmi bag'oiat fasodkori badkori Lut firistoda ast,-
59) ba ch'uz khonadoni Lut va pairavoni mu'minash, ki kh'alokat shomili onkh'o namegardad. Iak'inan mo kh'amagii onkh'oro az on azob solim nigakh' medorem,-
60) ba istisnoi kh'amsari Lut. Zero Mo kh'ukm kardaem, ki vai az ch'umlai toifai dar azob va kh'alokat bok'imonda ast."
61) Vak'te farishtagon ba nazdi khonadoni Lut dar surati mardon omadand,-
62) Lut guft: "Ba durusti ki shumo k'avmi noshinosed."
63) On farishtagon ba Lut guftand: "Ei Lut, natars, balki mo nazdi tu bo uk'ubati kh'aloksozandae omadem, ki k'avmat dar boraash shubkh'a doshtand.
64) Va nazdi tu kh'ak'ik'atero ovardem, ki ch'oi kh'azl nadorad va ba durusti, mo dar on chi turo khabar dodem, rostguem.

65) Pas ba'd az guzashtani pose az shab bo khonadonat kh'arakat kun va tu az dunboli onkh'o birav va kase az shumo baroi didani azobi ba k'avmat furudomada sui ak'ib nigokh' nakunad va ba on ch'oe, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro dastur doda ast, biraved."
66) Va Mo az rokh'i paig'om in korero, ki muk'addar kardaem, Lutro ogokh' sokhtem, ki k'avmat subkh'gokh'on bo kh'alok gardonidani okhirin nafar kh'amagi reshakan karda meshavand.
67) Va akh'li shakh'ri "Sadum" omadand, dar kh'ole ki az mekh'mononi Lut khushkh'ol budand, zero onkh'o ba anch'omi amali fakh'sh tama' doshtand.
68) Lut ba onkh'o guft: "In k'avm mekh'mononi manand. Pas maro bo on chi az onkh'o mekhokh'ed, sharmandavu rasvo nagardoned.
69) Va bo tarki in kori bad az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va ba sababi raftori zishti khesh maro khor nasozed."
70) K'avmash ba u guftand: "Oio mo turo az mekh'mondorii mardum man' nakardem?"

71) Lut bo k'asdi ma'zur budanashro nazdi mekh'monon nishon dodan ba onkh'o guft: "In gurukh'i khonumoni in dekh'a dukhtaroni man makh'sub meshavand. Agar shumo k'asdi k'azoi shakh'vati khudro dored, pas bo onkh'o izdivoch' kuned."
72) Va ei Paiombar, savgand ba kh'aioti tu, ki kh'amono k'avmi Lut dar tug'ioni shakh'vati khesh nobinovu sargardon budand.
73) Pas kh'angomi tului khurshed onkh'oro sadoi sakhti kh'aloksozanda faro girift.
74) Pas dekh'akh'oiashonro zeru ru kunonidem va bar onkh'o sangkh'oe az sanggil boridem.
75) Ba durusti ki dar on chi oidi kh'alokati k'avmi Lut zikr gasht, baroi andeshakunandagon alomatkh'oi rakh'namo ba sui kh'ak' ast.
76) Va kh'amono dekh'akh'oi k'avmi Lut dar rokh'i sobit ch'oigir shuda ast. Kh'ar musofiri rakh'guzar onro mebinad.
77) Beshak, dar on chi rukh doda ast, baroi mu'minon dalolatest, ki az on darsi ibrat megirand.
78) Va vok'ean k'avmi Shuaibi boshandagoni dekh'ai doroi darakhtoni pechida sitamkor budand, chunki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shuda, Shuaibi paiombarashonro durug'gui medonistand.

79) Pas Mo az k'avmi Shuaib intik'omi Khudro giriftem. Azobamon onkh'oro kh'alok gardonid. Va beshubkh'a, dekh'akh'oi k'avmi Lut va sarzamini k'avmi Shuaib dar rokh'i baroi kh'ar rakh'guzar namoion ch'oigir shuda ast.

80) Va dar kh'ak'ik'at k'avmi Samudi boshandagoni mintak'ai "Kh'ich'r" [ makone dar sarzamini baini Kh'ich'oz va Shom] vak'te Solekh'i paiombarashonro takzib namudand, guio kh'ama paiombaronro durug'gui donistand.
81) Va ba onkh'o dalelkh'oi isbotkunandai rostguii Solekh'ro dodem. Az on dalelkh'o modashutur bud. Pas onkh'o az in dalelkh'o pand nagirifta va az on rui gardonidand.
82) Va onkh'o kukh'kh'oro pora mekardand, to dar daruni on baroi khud manzili istik'omati sozand va az kh'ar khavfu khatar dar amnu osoishtagi zindagi kunand.
83) Pas dar vak'ti subkh' onkh'oro sadoi sakhti uk'ubat faro girift.
84) Pas on molu maskane, ki kasb mekardand, azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az onkh'o dur nakard.

85) Va Mo osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini onkh'oro be kh'ikmat naofaridaem, balki in kor kh'ikmati buzurge dorad. Va k'iiomat kh'atman meoiad. Pas, ei Paiombar, az takzibgaronat guzashti zebo bikun.
86) Ei Paiombar, begumon Parvardigorat Ofaridgori kh'amai ashio, Donandai kh'amai mavch'udot ast.
87) Va ba durusti, Mo ba tu surai "Fotikh'a"-i doroi kh'aft oiatro, ki takror ba takror khonda meshavad va K'ur'oni azimro dodem.
88) Va ba tarafi lazzatkh'oi zavoliobandae, ki toifae az kofironro bo on bakh'ramand kardaem, chashm maduz va az takzibashon g'amgin mashav va bo mu'minon furutani namo.
89) Va ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ba durusti ki man paiombari az azobi Khudo oshkor bimdikh'anda kh'astam.

90) Shumoro az uk'ubate kh'ushdor medikh'am, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar guzashta onro bar k'avmi ch'udokunandai kitobkh'oiash, ki ba ba'zeash imon ovarda, ba'zei digarro inkor kardand, furud ovard.
91) On kasone, ki K'ur'onro ba ch'uz'kh'o ch'udo karda "In Kitob ch'odu io fol va io she'r ast." guftand.
92) Pas ei Paiombar, savgand ba Parvardigorat, ruzi k'iiomat kh'amai kasonero, ki K'ur'onro ba ch'uz'kh'o ch'udo kardand, mepursem.
93) Onkh'oro az on chi dar dunio az kufr va gunokh'on anch'om medodand, mepursem.
94) Pas, ei Paiombar, on chi Parvardigorat ba tu suporish doda ast, ki mardumro ba suiash da'vat namoi, oshkor kun va ba guftoru kirdori mushrikon tavach'ch'ukh' makun.
95) Az onkh'o natars. Ba durusti, Mo turo az makri peshvoioni kufri maskharakunandai k'uraish basanda kh'astem va kh'imoiat mekunem.
96) Onone, ki bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digare k'aror medikh'and. Pas ba zudi ok'ibati badi shirkashonro khokh'and donist.
97) Va ei Paiombar, iak'inan Mo medonem sinai tu ba sababi takzib va tamaskhure, ki az zaboni onkh'o berun meshavad, tang megardad.

98) Pas Parvardigoratro az on chi loik' nest ba poki iod karda, Uro sitoish namuda, ba U panokh' bibar va az zumrai namozguzor bosh. Zero rokh'i muolich'ai tangdili ibodat va sach'dai Parvardigor ast.
99) Va Parvardigoratro to zamoni omadani margat ibodat kun va onro idoma bidekh'.

1) Ei kofiron, azobi kh'ukmkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdik shud. Pas pesh az faro rasidani mukh'lat, zud omadanashro talab nakuned. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mushrikon baroi U anboz k'aror medikh'and, pok va bartar ast.

2) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'ukmi Khesh farishtagonro bo paig'om bar kh'ar ki az paiombaronash khokh'ad, bo chunin mazmun ki: "Ei Paiombaron, mardumro az shirk ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsoned. Zero ch'uz Man ma'budi barkh'ak' nest. Pas, ei mardum bo ich'roi dasturot va duri ch'ustan az mamnuot az Man bitarsed."

3) U osmonkh'o va zaminro be namunai guzashta bo kh'ikmat ofarid. Onkh'oro bekh'uda khalk' nakarda, balki baroi on ofarida ast, ki bandagon az mushokh'idai osori k'udrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba azamatash pai barand va in koinot rokh'i ma'rifati ilokh'i boshad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mushrikon ba U sharik mesozand, muk'addas va bartar ast.

4) U insonro az nutfai bearzish ofarid. Khilk'atash okh'ista-okh'ista rushd kard. Pas nogakh'on u bo rokh'i botil dushmani ch'idolgari oshkoro gashta, mekhokh'ad banokh'ak' kh'ak'ik'atro makh'v gardonad.

5) Va ei mardum, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi foidai shumo chorpoioni shuturu govu gusfandro ofarid. Az manfiatkh'oiashon on ast, ki shumo insonkh'o ba vositai pashmkh'oiashon garm meshaved va digar manfiatkh'oe dar shir, pust va pushtkh'oi onkh'o kh'ast va az gushti ba'zei onkh'o mekhured.
6) Va chun begokh' chakh'orpoionro ba molkhona medarored va subkh' baroi charo mebarored, shumoro dar onkh'o zinat ast.

7) Va chakh'orpoioni baroi shumo ofaridaamon borkh'oi sanginatonro dar safarkh'o ba sui kishvare, ki tankh'o bo mashak'k'ati sakhte bar ch'onaton ba on merasided, mebardorand. Ei mardum, kh'amono Parvardigoraton ba shumo bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Zertobei shumo sokhtani in chakh'orpoion nishonai rakh'mati Ust.

8) Va baroi shumo aspkh'o va khachirkh'o va kharkh'oro ofarid, to ba onkh'o savor shaved va borkh'oi khudro boloiashon bor kuned va baroiaton kh'usnu ch'amole gardad, ki ba sababi on dar baini mardum orosta garded. Va az on chi ofaridanashro khosta ast, chizkh'oero meofarad, ki namedoned.

9) Va baion namudani rokh'i rosti ba rizoi Parvardigor rasonanda, ki on dini Islom ast, bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meboshad va ba'zei rokh'kh'o, rokh'i az kh'ak'ik'at kach'i Shaiton ast. Kh'amai rokh'kh'oi g'airi Islom kach' ast. Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, ba kh'amaaton tavfik'i kh'idoiat baroi imon ovardanro medod.
10) U Khudoest, ki baroi shumo az abr ob furud ovard. Az on baroi shumovu chakh'orpoionaton obi oshomidani ast va az on giiokh'i darakht ba vuch'ud meoiad, ki dar on chakh'orpoioni khudro mecharoned.

11) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo bo on ob ziroatkh'oero, ki az on mekhured, meruionad va baroiaton bo on ob zaitun va darakhtoni khurmo va angurkh'o va kh'amai nav'i mevakh'oro meruionad. Kh'amono dar in ob va on chi az on paido meshavad, baroi kasone, ki dar borai ofaridanash meandeshand, nishonai isbotkunandai k'udrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

12) Va Allokh' shabro (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi oromish va istirokh'at va ruzro baroi kasbi ruzi musakhkharaton sokht va oftobro baroi shumo musakhkhar sokhta, onro durakhshon gardond va mokh'ro musakhkhar sokhta, nurafshonash kard va sitorakh'o baroi shumo bo amri U romshuda kh'astand. Ba vasilai sitoragon dar torikikh'oi khushki va bakh'r rokh' meiobed va vak'tkh'o va g'airi onro ma'lum mekuned. Ba durusti ki dar musakhkhar kunonidani kh'amai makhluk'oti nombarshuda baroi k'avme, ki ak'li khudro kor mefarmoiand, dalolatkh'oi ravshani k'udrati ilokh'i ast. Chunki shakhsoni sokh'ibkhirad kh'ikmati ofarinishi in mavch'udotro dark mekunand.

13) Va kulli ma'dankh'o, kh'aivonot, nabotot va ziroatkh'oi baroiaton ofaridaashro, dar kh'ole ki rangkh'oi gunogun dorand, ba shumo musakhkhar sokht. Begumon dar ofarinish va romsozii zikrshuda baroi k'avme, ki az on ibrat megirand va tavonoii ilokh'iro dark mekunand, dalolati ravshani isbotkunandai k'udratmandii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

14) Va U Zotest, ki bakh'rro baroiaton musakhkhar sokht, pas ba shumo k'udrati bar on savorshavi va berun kardani boiigarikh'oi dokhilashro bakhshid, to az gushti taru tozavu muloimi mokh'ie, ki shikor mekuned, bikhured va monandi marvorid az daruni bakh'r abzori zinatero, ki khud va zanonaton onro mepushed, berun mesozed va kishtikh'oro mushokh'ida mekuni, ki mavch'i bakh'rro meshikofand va bo mak'sadi darkhosti fazli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki az tich'orat kh'osil megardad, savori in kishtikh'o meshaved va to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro baroi in ne'matkh'oi dodaash siposguzori kuned va tankh'o Uro biparasted.

15) Va dar zamin kukh'kh'oro, ki onro ustuvor mesozand, afkand, to zamin shumoro ba iztirob naorad va dar on dariokh'oro ch'ori sokht, to az on binushed va chakh'orpoionu ziroatkh'oiatonro ob dikh'ed va dar on rokh'kh'oro baroi rokh' raftan padid ovard, to bo istifoda az on ba ch'oi lozimii khesh birased.
16) Va dar zamin nishonakh'oi namoionro k'aror dod, to ba vositai on ruzona rokh'atonro iobed va dar osmon sitoragonro khalk' kard, to ba vositai onkh'o shabona rokh'atonro iobed.

17) Pas oio Khudoe, ki in va digar mavch'udotro ofarida ast, monandi kasest, ki az ukh'dai khalk'i kh'ech' chiz namebaroiad?! Magar azamati Allokh'i Ofaridgori kulli mavch'udotro ba khotir nameored, to in ki tankh'o Uro parastida, chizero ba U sharik nasozed?!

18) Va ei mardum, agar kushish kuned, ki ne'matkh'oi sershumori ba shumo dodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro kh'isob kuned, az sababi ziiod va gunoguniash onro kh'isob karda nametavoned. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bakhshanda ast, shumoro ba sababi g'aflat az shukri ne'matkh'oiash zud ch'azo namedikh'ad, bag'oiat Mekh'rubon ast, ekh'sonashro baroi gunokh'on va dar izkh'ori shukr kutokh'i kardanaton az shumo k'at' namesozad.

19) Va ei bandagon, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro az korkh'oiaton pinkh'on va on chiro oshkor mekuned, medonad. Kh'ech' kori shumo az U makhfi namemonad. Iak'inan shumoro ba ch'azoi a'molaton merasonad.

20) Va on khudoionero, ki mushrikon g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastand, kamtarin chizro ofarida nametavonand va shakhsone, ki on ma'budkh'oro g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastand, khud onkh'oro sokhtaand. Pas chitavr onkh'o butkh'oero, ki bo dastoni khesh mesozand, meparastand?!

21) Ilova bar on ki shakhsan obidoni on ma'budkh'o bo dastoni khesh onkh'oro sokhtaand, on butkh'o mavch'udi bech'onu bedonishand va namedonand, ki kh'amrokh'i obidonashon ruzi k'iiomat kai barangekhta meshavand, to dar iakch'oiagi ba otashi duzakh andokhta shuda, otashangezi on shavand.

22) Ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ii shumo Ma'budi Iagonai Beanboz ast. Va on kasone, ki ba zindashavii ba'd az marg baroi giriftani podosh imon nameorand, k'albashon munkiri vakh'doniiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, zero dar dil tars nadorand. Baroi kh'amin ba kh'isobu kitob va uk'ubati ruzi okhirat imon nameorand. Va onkh'o mutakabbiri kh'ak'nopazir kh'astand.

23) Kh'ak'k'o, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro in gurukh' az kirdorkh'oiashon pinkh'on va on chiro oshkor mekunand, medonad. Chize az Vai makhfi namemonad va onkh'oro baroi korkh'oiashon ch'azo khokh'ad dod. Beshak, U bandagonero, ki az toatu ibodatash kibr mevarzand, dust namedorad.

24) Va chun ba in munkironi vakh'doniiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va zindashavii ba'di marg gufta shavad: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) chi nozil karda ast?!", meguiand: "Ba Mukh'ammad chize nozil nashuda ast. Kh'amono u az peshi khud k'issakh'oi bardurug'i guzashtagonro ovarda ast."

25) In kofiron dar farch'omi kor gunokh'onashonro ruzi k'iiomat be nuk'son mebardorand va niz ba'ze gunokh'oni kasonero mebardorand, ki az rui nodoni ba in ch'amoai beimon tak'lid kardand va tak'lidkoronro az Islom gumrokh' sokhtaand. Ogokh' boshed! On chi onkh'o az bori gunokh'oni khesh va gunokh'oni pairavonashon mebardorand, nikh'oiat bad ast.

26) Beshak, kofironi pesh az inkh'o guzashta alaikh'i paiombaroni khud makri ziiod kardand, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imoratashonro az poiakh'oiash vairon sokht, ba'd az in bomkh'oiashon az boloiashon bar onkh'o aftod va az ch'oe ba onkh'o azob omad, ki intizori az onch'o omadanashro nadoshtand.

27) Sipas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat ba vositai azob khoru rasvoiashon megardonad va ba onkh'o meguiad: "Anbozkh'oero, ki dar ibodat shariki Man k'aror medoded va ba sababi onkh'o bo paiombaronu mu'minon dushmani mevarzided, kuch'oiand?!" Donishmandoni rabboni meguiand, beshak, khori va azobi ruzi k'iiomat bar kofiron vok'e' meshavad,-

28) bar kasone, ki farishtai marg bo farishtagoni iorirasonash ch'onashonro k'abz mekunand, dar kh'ole ki ba sababi kufr bar ch'oni khesh ch'avr kardaand, pas ba margashon taslim shuda, bo gumoni on ki inkor namudan sudashon meorad, kufru gunokh'ashonro inkor karda, meguiand: "Mo kori bade anch'om namedodem." Ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Durug' megued. Vok'ean shumo kofir buded va gunokh'i ziiod sodir mekarded. Kh'amono kh'ar on chi dar dunio mekarded, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad. Kh'ech' kori kardaaton az U pushida nest va beguftugu, shumoro bar asosi on ch'azo medikh'ad."

29) Va ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Az darkh'oi duzakh muvofik'i on chi mekarded, daroed, dar kh'ole ki onch'o abadi memoned. Pas beshubkh'a, duzakh baroi kasone, ki az imon ovardan va ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kibr varzidand, k'arorgokh'i nikh'oiat bad ast."

30) Va ba kasone, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va duri ch'ustan az mamnuot parkh'ez kardaand, gufta meshavad: "Parvardigoraton ba Mukh'ammadi Paiombaraton chi nozil karda bud?" Onkh'o dar ch'avob meguiand: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba u khairi buzurg nozil karda bud." Baroi kasone, ki dar in dunio ibodati ilokh'iro ba khubi ich'ro karda, dar muomilai mardum raftori nek dorand, podoshi nek ast. Piruziiu farokhii rizk' az podoshi nek ba shumor meravad. Va savobi dar okhirat baroi onkh'o omoda sokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), az lazzatkh'oi dunio bekh'tar ast. Va beshak, okhirat saroi neki kasone ast, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va duri ch'ustan az mamnuot tak'vo mekardand.

31) Bog'kh'oe, ki baroi sukunati kh'ameshagi buda, akh'li ch'annat ba on medaroiand, az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtonash rudkh'o ch'ori ast. Onkh'oro dar onch'o on chi nafsashon az khurdanivu nushidani va g'aira khokh'ad, mukh'aiio ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ezkoroni in ummat va ummatkh'oi guzashtaro kh'amin guna podosh medikh'ad,-

32) onkh'oe, ki farishtai marg bo farishtagoni iovarash ch'onashonro dar kh'ole, ki k'albashon az kufr pok ast, k'abz mekunand. Farishtagon ba onkh'o chunin meguiand: "Salom bar shumo. Az kh'ama guna ofatkh'o solim mondaed. Imruz ba sababi on ki dar dunio e'tik'odi solim doshta, amali solekh' anch'om medoded, voridi bikh'isht shaved."

33) Oio in mushrikoni takzibgar muntaziri onand, ki farishtai marg bo farishtagoni iovarash baroi giriftani ch'onu zadani chekh'ra va pushtashon oiad, io farmoni Parvardigorat oidi dar dunio ba vositai azob kh'alok sokhtanashon oiad?! Monandi in kirdore, ki mushrikon dar Makka mekunand, mushrikoni pesh az onkh'o guzashta niz kardaand, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro kh'alok sokht. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kh'alok gardonidanashon nisbatashon sitam nakarda ast, balki onkh'o ba sababi kofir shudan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khudro ba kh'alokat andokhta, bar ch'onashon sitam menamudaand.
34) Pas ba onkh'o uk'ubati amalkh'oi badi kardaashon furud omad va onkh'oro uk'ubate, ki chun ba iodashon ovarda meshud, maskhara mekardand, ikh'ota namud.

35) Va onone, ki dar ibodat ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk ovardaand, meguiand: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost mo tankh'o Uro parastida, kasero sharikash nagardonem, kh'argiz mo va dar guzashta padaronamon ch'uz U chizero nameparastidem va agar mekhost chizero be khostash kh'arom nadonem, chizero kh'arom namedonistem." Kofironi pesh az onkh'o guzashta niz chunin kh'uch'ch'ati botilro meovardand. Pas vazifai paiombaron g'air az tablig'i oshkori farmudakh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chize besh nest. Onkh'o dasturkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba mardum rasonidaand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kofiron khokh'ish va ikhtiior doda, paiombaronro ba suiashon firistod. Onkh'o kh'ak'k'i az k'azovu k'adar bakh'ona ovardanro nadorand.

36) Va Ba durusti ki Mo dar baini kh'ama ummatkh'oi peshin paiombar firistodem. Paiombaron onkh'oro dastur medodand, ki tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro biparasted va az ibodati butkh'o, shaitonkh'o va digar mavch'udot duri bich'ued. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba ba'zei onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba imon ovardan va pairavii paiombaronashro dod va ba'zei digarashon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shuda, paiombaronashro nofarmoni namuda, az kh'idoiati tavfik' makh'rum monda, gumrokh'i bar onkh'o lozim gardid. Pas dar zamin sairu gasht kuned, to bubined, ki farch'omi takzibgaroni paiombaron ba'di furud omadani uk'ubat va kh'alokat bo chi anch'om iofta ast.

37) Ei Paiombar, agar onkh'oro ba k'adri tavonat da'vat karda, kh'amai asbobi zarurii tablig'ro istifoda burda, baroi kh'idoiatashon tamomi taloshro sarf namoi, pas beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro gumrokh' sozad, ba u tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i durustro namedikh'ad va onkh'o g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kase nadorand, ki baroiashon bo dur sokhtani azob kumak rasonad.

38) Va in ch'amoai durug'shumorandai zindashavii ba'd az marg bo mubolig'a va taloshu ta'kid bo nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savgand iod kardand, ki kh'ar ki memirad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro dubora zinda namesozad. Inkh'o baroi da'voiashon kh'uch'ch'at nadorand. Ore, kh'ar ki memirad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro zinda mesozad, in va'dai kh'ak'ik'i bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Lekin beshtari mardum namedonand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) murdagonro ruzi k'iiomat boz zinda mesozad. Binobar in, ak'idai ba'di marg zindashaviro inkor mekunand.

39) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tamomi bandagonro dar ruzi k'iiomat zinda mesozad, to ba onkh'o kh'ak'ik'ati tavkh'id, dubora zinda gashtan va nubuvvatro, ki dar boraash ikhtilof mekardand, baion sozad va to kofiron bidonand, ki dar da'voi nisbat dodani anboz ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va inkori zindashavii ba'di marg durug'gui kh'astand.

40) Ba durusti, vak'te khokh'em, ki onkh'oro dubora zinda gardonem, pas kh'ech' chiz monei Mo namegardad. Kh'amono ba kh'ar chiz vak'te paidoshavii onro khokh'em "Paido shav" meguem, pas on paido megardad.

41) Va kasone, ki ba'di az tarafi kofiron mavridi ozoru fishor k'aror giriftan bo mak'sadi ch'ustuch'ui rizoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vatan, khonadon va doroii khudro tark karda, az sarzamini kufr ba sarzamini Islom kh'ich'rat kardand, beshubkh'a, onkh'oro dar dunio dar manzile furud meorem, ki onch'o sokh'ibi izzatu ekh'tirom megardand. Va savobi okhirat buzurgtar ast, chunki ch'annat ch'uz'i on ast. Agar bandagoni az kh'ich'rat bozistoda savobi mukh'och'ironro medonistand, kh'ech' gokh' az on boz nameistodand.

42) In mukh'och'ironi rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kasoneand, ki bar ozori k'avmi khesh, ch'udoii akh'lu vatan va ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sabr karda, dar tamomi korashon tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia mekunand. Ba kh'amin sabab, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o in podoshi azimro medikh'ad.

43) Va Mo pesh az tu Paiombar fak'at mardonro az baini insonkh'o ba sifati paiombar firistoda, ba onkh'o vakh'i mekardem. Farishtagonro ba kh'aisi paiombar nafiristodaem. In shevai doimamalkunandai Mo ast. Agar kh'ak'ik'at doshtani inro inkor karda, bashar budani paiombaronro nadoned, pas az akh'li kitobkh'oi guzashta bipursed. Onkh'o ba shumo khabar medikh'and, ki paiombaron az nav'i bashar budand.

44) Mo az baini insonkh'o in paiombaronro bo kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ravshan va kitobkh'oi az nazdamon nozilshuda firistodem va ba sui tu K'ur'onro furud ovardem, to ba mardum on chi boiad tavzekh' doda shavad, baion kuni va to onkh'o andesha namuda, az K'ur'on pand girand.

45) Pas oio onone, ki bo mak'sadi az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardonidani mardum dasisakh'o mesozand, az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro monandi K'orun ba zamin furu barad io azobash az ch'oe ba onkh'o oiad, ki az onch'o omadani onro muntazir nameboshand, dar amonand?!

46) Io onkh'o az on ki azobi ilokh'i dar kh'olati gashtuguzorashon dar safarkh'o va dar kh'olati sa'ii ba dast ovardani rizk' ba onkh'o rasad, dar amonand?! Pas dar kh'olati omadani azob az on rakh'oi nameioband.

47) Io az on ki azobi ilokh'i ba onkh'o dar kh'ole rasad, ki az on kh'aros dorand, dar amonand?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ama kh'olat k'udrati azob dodani onkh'oro dorad. Ba durusti, Parvardigoraton Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Bandagonashro zud azob namekunad, to in ki sidk'an tavba namoiand.

48) Oio in ch'amoai takzibgar ba makhluk'oti Khudo bo tafakkur nigokh' namekunand?! Soiakh'oi mavch'udot bo pairavi ba kh'arakati ruzonai oftob va sairi shabonai mokh' ba sui rostu chap moil megardand, dar kh'ole ki on soiakh'o nazdi Parvardigorashon furutani namuda, dar kh'olati khori baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sach'dai kh'ak'ik'i mekunand.

49) Va kh'amai ch'unbandakh'oi osmonkh'ovu zamin va farishtagon fak'at ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sach'da meorand va farishtagon az ibodat va itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kibr namevarzand.

50) Va on farishtagon bo vuch'udi doim dar kh'olati ibodat va itoat k'aror doshtanashon az Parvardigorashon, ki bar onkh'o kh'ukmfarmo ast, metarsand va on chi Parvardigorashon ba onkh'o mefarmoiad, mekunand.
51) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagonash gufta ast: "Dar ibodat du ma'bud nagired. Beshak, U Ma'budi Iagonai Barkh'ak' ast. Pas tankh'o az Man bitarsed va az digar kas natarsed."

52) Va kholik'iiat, molikiiat, tadbiri korkh'oi mavch'udoti osmonkh'ovu zamin fak'at az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast va farmonbardori, taslim shudan, amali boikhlos doimo tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Oio az g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) metarsed?! Naboiad chunin kuned, balki iagona az U bitarsed.

53) Va ei mardum, kh'amai ne'matkh'oi dini va duniavii shumo fak'at az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Sipas chun ba shumo g'am, bemori io tangdasti birasad, pas bo duo tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zorivu niioish mekuned, to in ozmoishkh'oro az shumo bartaraf gardonad. Binobar in, kase loik'i parastish ast, ki k'udrati dodani ne'mat va dur kardani azobro dorad.
54) Sipas chun duoi shumoro pazirufta, sakhtikh'oro bartaraf sozad, nogakh'on gurukh'e az shumo ba Parvardigori kheshtan shirk meorand. In chi furumoiagi ast?!

55) Shirk ovardanashon bois gashta ast, ki ne'matkh'oi dodai Moro, az ch'umla ne'mati bartaraf sokhtani sakhtiashonro nosiposi kunand. Ba kh'amin sabab ba onkh'o gufta shud: "To omadani azobi der io zudi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az ne'matkh'o bakh'ra bared. Zero ok'ibati korkh'oiatonro kh'atman khokh'ed donist."

56) Va mushrikon az molkh'oi ba onkh'o ruzi kardai Mo baroi butkh'oi khud, ki chizero namedonand -chunki onkh'o mavch'udi bech'on buda, foidavu zarar ovarda nametavonand- sakh'me muk'arrar mekunand va ba vasilai on ba on butkh'o nazdiki mech'uiand. Ei mushrikon, savgand ba Allokh', ruzi k'iiomat az on chi mebofed, ki guio butkh'oiaton ma'budand va dar molkh'oi shumo sakh'm dorand, pursida meshaved.

57) Va mushrikon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dukhtaronro nisbat doda, meguiand, ki farishtagon dukhtaroni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astand. Onkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizero nisbat medikh'and, ki khud onro dust namedorand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az mansub donistani dukhtar ba U pok ast. Va baroi khudashon pisaronro, ki ba on rag'bat dorand, mansub medonand. Chi ch'urme az in buzurgtar ast?!

58) Va vak'te ba iakei in mushrikon az vilodati dukhtar khabar doda shavad, az nafratash ba in khabar chekh'raash siiokh' megardad va k'albash az andukh' pur meshavad. Vale ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizero nisbat medikh'ad, ki onro khud namepisandad.

59) Az badii khabari zodani dukhtar, ki ba vai doda shud, az nazari k'avmash pinkh'on megardad. Nafsash uro ba vasvasa andokhta meguiad: "Oio in dukhtarro bo vuch'udi khorivu rasvoi nigokh' dorad io uro zinda ba gur karda, zeri khok pinkh'on sozad?" Ogokh' boshed! Kh'ukmi mushrikon nikh'oiat kh'ukmi bad ast. Zero onkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizero nisbat dodand, ki onro baroi khud namepisandand.

60) On kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nameorand, doroi sifati zishti tankh'o dustdorii pisar, zinda zeri khok kardani dukhtar, bema'rifati va kufrand va Khudo doroi sifoti balandtarini azamatu tavongari va ilm ast. Va U dar mulki Khud G'olib, dar ofarinish, tadbiri korkh'o va akh'komash Bokh'ikmat ast.

61) Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mardumro ba sababi zulmu kufr azob mekard, dar zamin inson va kh'aivoni ch'unbandaero bok'i nameguzosht, valekin U onkh'oro to mukh'lati dar ilmash ma'lum ba ta'khir meguzorad. Pas chun on mukh'lat faro rasad, az on ba andozai andaktarin lakh'za ak'ib va pesh nameravand.

62) Va baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dukhtaronro, ki nisbat dodanashonro baroi khud namepisandand, ta'iin mekunand va zabonashon durug'ro talaffuz mesozad, ki agar dubora zinda shudanashon kh'ak'ik'at boshad, onkh'o nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mak'omi nek dorand. Beshak, duzakh az onkh'ost va dar on andokhta shuda, kh'argiz az on namebaroiand.

63) Ei Paiombar, savgand ba Khudo, ba durusti, Mo ba sui ummatkh'oi pesh az tu guzashta paiombaronro firistodem, pas Shaiton korkh'oi badi onkh'oro az shirku kufru gunokh' baroiashon oroish dod. Pas Shaiton ba e'tik'odi onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat iovarashon ast. Biguzor, az u kumak khokh'and. Va onkh'oro ruzi okhirat azobi dardovar ast.

64) Va ei Paiombar, Mo K'ur'onro bar tu furud naovardem, magar baroi on ki ba mardum on chiro az iaktoparasti, zinda gashtani ba'di marg, akh'komi shar'i, ki dar borai on ikhtilof dorand, baion namoi va to K'ur'on baroi kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), paiombaron va akh'komash imon meorand, rakh'namo va rakh'mat boshad. Zero az kh'ak'ik'at tankh'o mu'minon manfiat mebarand.

65) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az osmon boron furud ovard, pas ba vositai on zaminro ba'd az khushkiash bo ruionidani rastanikh'o zinda gardonid. Ba durusti ki dar nozil sokhtani boron az osmon va ruionidani rastanikh'o baroi k'avme, ki sukhani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro meshunavand va oidi on andesha mekunand, dalolati ravshani isbotkunandi k'udrati ilokh'i ast.

66) Va ei mardum, kh'amono dar chakh'orpoion (shutur, gov, gusfand, buz) shumoro pande kh'ast. Zero Mo shumoro az pistoni onkh'o shire medikh'em, ki az baini sargin va khun pokizai baroi nushandagon bolazzatu guvoro berun meshavad.

67) Va dar mevakh'oi darakhti khurmo va makh'suloti tokkh'oi angur, ki ruziaton namudaem, shumoro pande ast. Az on nushobai mastkunandae megired, ki ak'lro tira mesozad va on sharobi sokhtaaton mashruboti khub nest va az ba'zeash ba misli khurmovu mavizu sirkovu shirai khurmo ruzii khubi sudbakhsh megired. Beguftugu, dar on chi zikr gardid, baroi k'avme, ki ak'lashonro kor mefarmoiand, nishonai k'udrati ilokh'i va lutfash bar bandagon ast. Zero shakhsoni sokh'ibkhirad az in alomatkh'oi k'udrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ibrat megirand.
68) Va Parvardigorat ba zanburi asal ilkh'om namud va uro ba in mazmun rakh'namoi kard, ki: "Az kukh'kh'o va darakhton va imoratkh'oi mardum, ki onro sak'fdor mesozand, baroi khud khonakh'o bigir.

69) Sipas az kh'ar nav'i mevakh'oi khostaat bikhur va dar rokh'kh'oe, ki onro Parvardigorat ilkh'om namuda ast, dar kh'ole ki on rokh'kh'o baroi tu rom sokhta shudaand, ravon bishav. Az shikami on zanburkh'o asale berun meshavad, ki rangash gunogun ast. Dar bainash rangi safedu zardu g'air az on mavch'ud buda, dar asal mardumro shifo ast. Onkh'o bo istifodai asal bemorikh'oro muolich'a mekunand. Kh'amono dar ilkh'om firistodan ba zanburi asal va asali az shikami onkh'o berunshavanda baroi k'avme, ki meandeshand, alomati k'udrati ilokh'i va nishonai dalolatkunandai chorasozii korkh'oi makhluk'otash ast. Tankh'o khiradmandon az in alomatkh'o darsi ibrat megirand.

70) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro be namunai sobik' khalk' kard, sipas vak'ti sipari shudani mukh'lati zindagiaton shumoro memironad va umri ba'zeaton to badtarin markh'ilakh'oi on, ki pironsolii az kh'ad ziiod ast, daroz meshavad, pas ba'di ba pironsoli rasidan az on chi dar guzashta medonist, chizero nadonad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donoi Tavono ast. Amali bandagon az U pushida nest va chize Uro notavon namesozad.

71) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba'zei shumoro bar ba'zei digar dar rizk' bartar gardonida ast. Ba'zero tavongaru gurukh'i digarro fak'ir va iak k'ismro rakh'baru k'ismi digarro korgar sokhta ast. Pas on khoch'agone, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ruzi ba onkh'o bartari doda ast, on chiro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon afzun bar g'ulomonashon ato kardaast, dar baini khesh va g'ulomonashon sharik namesozand, ki bo onkh'o dar doroi sharikoni barobar boshand. Pas chi guna az bandagon baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharikonro mepisandand, dar kh'ole ki ba khud rozi nestand, ki g'ulomonashon bo onkh'o sharik boshand?! In zulmi nikh'oiat azim ast?! Kadom inkori ne'matkh'oi Parvardigor az in buzurgtar meshavad?! Oio ne'matkh'oi ilokh'iro inkor mekunand?!

72) Va ei mardum, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo az nav'i khudi shumo kh'amsaronro ofarid, ki bo onkh'o uns girifta, oromish meiobed va baroi shumo az kh'amsaronaton farzandon va naberagonro ofarid va ba shumo az khurdanikh'oi pok ba misli gushtu donagikh'ovu mevach'ot ruzi dod. Pas oio ba butkh'oi botil imon meorand va ba ne'matkh'oi beshumori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki onro kh'isobida nametavonand, nosiposi karda, ba vositai imon ovardan shukri Uro ba ch'o nameorand?!

73) Va in mushrikon g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) butkh'oero meparastand, ki ba onkh'o moliki dodani iagon nav'i rizk' az osmonkh'ovu zamin nestand va k'udratashro niz nadorand. Zero onkh'o mavch'udoti bech'on va bedonishand.

74) Pas, ei mardum, az butkh'oe, ki ziion va sud ovarda nametavonand, baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) monandkh'o k'aror nadikh'ed. Zero U monand nadorad, ki dar ibodat onro sharikash gardoned. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sifatkh'oi ifodagari azamat va kamolero, ki loik'i Ust, medonad va shumo inro namedoned. Binobar in, az shirk parkh'ezed va da'vo nakuned, ki baini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va butkh'oi shumo monandi vuch'ud dorad.

75) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi raddi mushrikon g'ulomi az koru fa'oliiat notavonero, ki baroi sadak'a dodan mol nadorad va insoni ozodero, ki ba u az nazdash moli kh'alol dod, on guna ki khokh'ad, ozodona molashro kor mefarmoiad, pas az ba'zei on ba tab'i dilash dar nikh'on va oshkor kharch' menamoiad, misol ovarda ast. In du shakhs bo kh'am barobar nestand. Chi guna shumo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro, ki Moliki mavch'udot buda, dar mulkash kh'ar chi khokh'ad, mekunad, bo butkh'oi notavonaton barobar mesozed?! Inkh'o kh'argiz barobar nestand. Sitoish Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro, ki loik'i sutudan ast. Balki beshtari mushrikon iagonagi va arzandagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dar ibodat namedonand.

76) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar raddi mushrikon du mardero misol ovarda, ki iakei on karu gung buda, nameshunavad, sukhan gufta nametavonad va az sababi noshunavoi va gungi namefakh'mad, az foida rasonidan ba khud va digaron och'iz meboshad va u baroi sarparastash bori garon ast, ba kh'ar ch'o uro firistad, neki nameorad va ba matlub namerasad. Oio shakhsi zikrshuda bo kase, ki shunavo va guio ast, foidaash ba digaron merasad, mardumro ba adolatparvari dastur medikh'ad va dar rokh'i rost k'aror dorad, barobar ast?! Pas ei mushrikon, chi guna shumo Allokh'i Doroi sifatkh'oi azamatu kamolro bo butkh'oe, ki karu gung va az sud ovardan va dur sokhtani zarar och'izand, barobar mesozed?!

77) Va ilmi g'aibi osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Fak'at U dar in bob donish dorad va kase az makhluk'ot dar borai g'aib donish nadorad. Va iak'inan vasfi k'iiomat, ki az masoili g'aibist, ba e'tibori sur'ati vok'e' gashtanash monandi pushidan va kushodani pilki chashm, balki az in kh'am nazdiktar ast. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ama chiz K'odir ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro notavon namegardonad. Vak'te paidoishi chizero khokh'ad, bo guftani "Paido shav", on paido meshavad.

78) Va ei mardum, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro az shikami modaronaton ba'd az guzashtani mukh'lati bordori dar kh'olati tifli, ki chizero dark namekarded, berun sokht va baroi shumo kh'issi shunavoi va kh'issi binoi va dilkh'oro ofarid, ki shunaved, bined va dark kuned. In ne'matkh'oro baroiaton ato kard, to baroi lutfu ekh'sonkh'oiash shukri Uro ba ch'o ored.

79) Oio mushrikon ba parandagon nigokh' namekunand, ki romshuda buda, bo bolkh'oi baroiashon bakhshidai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va musoid budani fazo omodai parvozand?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on parandagon ch'am' va pakh'n sokhtani bolkh'oro ilkh'om namuda ast. Onkh'oro dar osmon az aftodan ba zamin ch'uz Allokh'i Tavono kase nigokh' namedorad. Ba durusti ki dar in rom sokhtan va az aftodan nigokh' doshtani parandagon baroi k'avme, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon meorand, alomatkh'oi k'udrati ilokh'i ast. Mu'minon az in alomat va ibratkh'o manfiat mebarand.

80) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az khonakh'oiaton, ki onro az sangu g'airi on mesozed, baroi shumo makh'alli k'aror va rokh'at gardonid va baroiaton az pustkh'oi shuturonu govonu gusfandon dar sakh'ro ba misli khonakh'oi istik'omati khaimakh'o va chodarkh'o k'aror dod, ki kh'angomi az iak ch'o ba ch'oe kuchidanaton va kh'angomi dar ch'oe furud omadanaton nasbi on sabuk va oson ast va baroi shumo az pashmkh'oi gusfandon va kurkkh'oi shuturon va muikh'oi buzon matoi khonakh'o va liboskh'ovu rupushkh'o k'aror dod, ki az on to vak'ti muaiian bakh'ra mebared.

81) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo az darakhton va imoratkh'o vositaero padid ovard, ki az shiddati garmo az on soia mech'ued va baroi shumo az kukh'kh'o guzargokh'kh'oi makhfi, g'orkh'o va mag'orkh'oro padid ovard, ki dar on az sardi, garmi va dushman pinkh'on meshaved va baroi shumo az punba va g'airi on kurta va digar nav'i liboskh'oro k'aror dod, ki garmi va sardiro az shumo dur mesozad va baroi shumo zirekh'kh'oro k'aror dod, ki dar kh'olati ch'ang shumoro az zarbi tirkh'oi ba'zeaton kh'imoiat mekunad va ba ch'ismaton nameravad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amin guna ne'matkh'oiashro baroiaton komil mesozad, to tankh'o ba U taslim shaved va az shirk biparkh'ezed.

82) Pas, ei Paiombar, agar onkh'o az imon ovardan va tasdik'i oiinat rui toband, in ba tu ziion namerasonad, zero mas'uliiati tu tankh'o az on iborat ast, ki paig'omi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba tavri vozekh' birasoni. Mach'bur sokhtani onkh'o ba kh'idoiat kori tu nest.

83) Mushrikon on ne'matkh'oero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o in'om karda ast, az ch'umla ne'mati firistodani Paiombarro meshinosand, sipas bo nosiposi va durug' shumurdan ne'matkh'oro inkor mekunand va beshtari onkh'o munkironi ekh'soni ilokh'i kh'astand.

84) Va ei Paiombar, on ruzero iod kun, ki Mo az kh'ar ummat paiombari ba suiashon firistodai Khudro barmeangezem, ki bar imoni mu'minon va kufri kofiron shakh'odat medikh'ad, sipas ba kofiron ich'ozat doda nameshavad, ki baroi kufrashon uzr pesh biiorand va dubora ba dunio bargardonida nameshavand, to korkh'oe kunand, ki Parvardigorashon az onkh'o rozi shavad. Zero okhirat manzili kh'isob ast. On ch'oi amal nest.

85) Va vak'te sitamkoroni mushrik azobro mushokh'ida kunand, pas azob az onkh'o sabuk sokhta nameshavad va bo ta'khiri azob ba onkh'o mukh'lat doda nameshavad, balki ba tavri abadi voridi duzakh megardand.

86) Va chun mushrikon dar okhirat ma'budkh'oiashonro, ki ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastand, binand, meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, ma'budkh'oi mo, ki g'air az Tu meparastidem, inkh'o kh'astand." Mushrikon inro ba on khotir meguiand, to gunokh'i khudro bar butkh'oiashon kh'avola kunand. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oi onkh'oro guio megardonad va dar raddi da'voi onkh'o meguiand: "Ei mushrikon, Ba durusti ki shumo dar on ki sharikoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro meparastided, durug' megued. Zero U bemislu monand buda, sharik nadorad."

87) Va mushrikon on ruz ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) taslim meshavand va da'voi boftaashon, ki guio butkh'oiashon nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shafoatashon mekunand, az onkh'o zoe' va botil megardad.

88) Kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir meshavand va digaronro az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barmegardonand, ba sababi on ki khud fosidand va bo gumrokh' sokhtani bandagon fasodkori mekardand, azobi onkh'oro bar azobashon, ki az rui kufr duchori on meshavand, afzun megardonem.

89) Va ei Paiombar, ruzero iod kun, ki Mo dar baini kh'ar iak ummat paiombarero barmeangezem, ki bar imon io kufrashon shokh'idi medikh'ad, on paiombar az nav'i khudi onkh'o buda, bo zabonashon gap mezanad va turo ei Paiombar, bar kh'ama ummatkh'o ba sifati shokh'id meorem. Va K'ur'onro bar tu bo mak'sadi baioni kh'alolu kh'arom, podoshu uk'ubat va g'aira, ki ba tavzekh' niioz dorad va baroi rakh'namoii mardum ba rokh'i rost va baroi mu'minoni boamal rakh'mat va muzhdarason ba ne'mati abadii okhirat nozil kardem.

90) Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagonashro ba adolat (adoi kh'uk'uk'i Kholik'u makhluk', dar dovari kasero az kase bartar nasokhtan, magar dar surati mavch'udiiati omilkh'oi bartari) va ba nekukori (ich'roi sadak'ai ikhtiiori va guzashtan az gunokh'i zolim) va ba dodani on chi mavridi niiozi kheshovandon ast, dastur medikh'ad va az kh'ama guftorkh'o va kirdorkh'oi zisht ba misli sukhani fakh'sh va zino va az on chi bo shariat mukholif ast -kulli gunokh'on- va dar munosibat bo mardum az sitam va takabbur k'at'iian nakh'i mekunad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro bo on chi dar in oiat amr va az on chi nakh'i namud, andarz medikh'ad, to az on pand gired.

91) Va ba paimoni bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va mardum bastaaton vafo kuned va ba'd az on ki savgandkh'oiatonro bo nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ustuvor sokhted, onro nashikaned va iak'inan vak'te shumo savgand khurded, ki ba akh'di bastaaton vafo mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bar khud guvokh' gardonidaed. Beshak, on chiro anch'om medikh'ed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonad. Chize az U makhfi nest va shumoro ba sazoi a'molaton merasonad.

92) Va bo paimonshikani bekhiradi nakuned. Monandi zane, ki dar boftani pashm io punbaash ranch' mekashad va onro mustakh'kam mesozad, sipas on boftaro vairon namuda, ba surati k'abliash tabdil medikh'ad. In zan dar boftan va vairon kardani on zakh'mat kashid, vale ba mak'sud narasid. Naboiad savgandkh'oi khudro vasilai makru fireb k'aror doda, ba khotiri on ki adadi ummati shumo az ummati dushmanonaton beshtar va k'avitar boshad, kh'amdigarro bifirebed. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro bo vafo ba paimon, ki oio onro ich'ro mekuned io meshikaned, mesanch'ad?! Va beguftugu, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ruzi k'iiomat ba shumo on chiro dar dunio dar boraash ikhtilof mekarded, baion sokhta, kh'ak'ro az nokh'ak' va rostguiro az durug'gui ch'udo megardonad.

93) Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, shumoro dar rokh'i kh'ak'ik'at ummati iaknavokht mesokht, vale U bo adlash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, bo makh'rum kardan az kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak' va bevafoi gumrokh' mesozad va ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, bo fazlash tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak' va vafodoriro medikh'ad. Va beshak, shumo ruzi k'iiomat az on chi dar dunio anch'om medoded, pursida meshaved.

94) Va savgandkh'oiatonro bo pairavi ba khokh'ishoti nafsaton vasilai firebi iakdigar nagardoned, ki kh'ar vak't dilaton khokh'ad, onro shikaned va kh'ar vak't dilaton khokh'ad, ba on vafo kuned. Pas agar chunin karded, Ba durusti ki k'adamaton ba'd az ustuvori dar rokh'i rost az on melag'zhad va ba sababi on ki khud az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gumrokh' meshaved va digaronro gumrokh' mesozed, azobro mechashed va shumoro azobi duchand ast.

95) Va paimoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bo ivazi andak, ki baroi akh'dshikani va bevafoi megired, ivaz nakuned. Beshak, on chi nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dunio az piruzivu g'animat va dar okhirat az ne'mati abadi mavch'ud ast, baroiaton az badali andake, ki az paimonshikani kasb mekuned, bekh'tar meboshad, agar inro medonisted.

96) Ei mardum, kh'ar on chi az molu ne'mat dored agarchi ziiod ast, az bain meravad va podoshi nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) poianda memonad. Pas chi guna ne'mati foniro az podoshi abadi muk'addam meguzored?! Va kasonero, ki ba akh'dashon sabr karda, onro nameshikanand, az on chi az ibodatkh'o anch'om medikh'and, podoshi bekh'tar medikh'em. Dar ivazi iak neki az dakh' to kh'afsad barobar, balki az on beshtar ach'r megirand.

97) Va kh'ar ki novobasta az mard io zan budan kori neki mutobik'i shariat anch'om dikh'ad, dar kh'ole ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon doshta boshad, pas beshak, ba u dar dunio bo rozi shudan ba tak'dir, k'anoatmandi va tavfik' ba ibodat zindagii khush mebakhshem va dar okhirat savobashro az korkh'oi shoistae, ki dar dunio anch'om medod, bekh'tar medikh'em.
98) Pas ei Paiombar, vak'te k'asdi tilovati K'ur'on mekuni, pas ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az vasvasai Shaitoni az rakh'matash rondashuda panokh' bibar.
99) Ba durusti, Shaiton bar kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon dorand va dar korkh'oiashon tankh'o ba Parvardigorashon takia mekunand, tasallut nadorad.

100) Kh'amono tasalluti Shaiton ba vositai vasvasakh'o bar kasone ast, ki uro dust megirand va dar ig'vogariash az vai itoat mekunand va inchunin bar kasone farmonravoi dorad, ki ba sababi ig'vogarii u ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk ovarda, makhluk'otro meparastand.

101) Va vak'te kh'ukmi oiate az K'ur'onro bo oiati digar mansukh sozem -va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kh'ikmatash on chiro mansukh mesozad va on chiro mansukh namesozad, bekh'tar medonad- kofiron guiand: "Ei Mukh'ammad, kh'amono tu dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo durug' mebofi." Balki beshtari onkh'o namedonand, ki naskhi oiatkh'o az rui kh'ikmatkh'oi azim surat megirad.

102) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "K'ur'onro Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom) az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kh'ak'ik'ate, ki dar on ishtibokh'u digarguni nest, furud ovarda ast, to mu'minonro kh'ar vak'te ki oiati ch'adid furud omada, ba'zeash mansukh shavad, ustuvor gardonad va baroi musalmonon rakh'namoi sui rosti va bo savobe, ki dar okhirat ba dast meorand, muzhdarason boshad."

103) Va Mo medonem, ki mushrikon meguiand: "Ba durusti ki in K'ur'onro ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) odami ta'lim medikh'ad." Va onkh'o dar in da'voi khesh durug'guiand. Zero zaboni kase, ki ba da'voi mushrikon ba Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) K'ur'onro ta'lim doda ast, ach'ami va in K'ur'on bo zaboni ravshani arabii doroi balog'ati baland nozil shuda ast. Pas chi guna da'vo mekunand, ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) in onro az mardi ach'ami girifta ast?!

104) Beshubkh'a, kasone imon nameorand, ki in oiatkh'o az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nozil shuda ast, modome bar in e'tik'odi khud pofishori mekunand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro namedikh'ad va onkh'oro ba sababi kufr varzidan va durug' donistani oiatkh'o azobi dardovar ast.

105) Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar on chi az nazdi Parvardigorash ovarda ast, durug'gui nest. Iak'inan kasone durug' mebofand, ki ba oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bovar nadorand. Chunki onkh'o az azob namekh'arosand va ba savob umedvor nestand. Va in ch'amoai bo kufr tavsifshuda durug'guioni vok'ei kh'astand. Zero durug'gui odati doimii onkh'o ast.

106) Kh'ar ki ba'di imon ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir gardad -magar kase, ki dar guftani sukhani kufr mach'bur shavad, pas bo zabonash kufr guiad va dilash bo imon osuda boshad-, vale kase, ki sinaashro bo kufr boz karda, onro barguzinad va ikhtiioran sukhani kufr guiad, chunin kason az Islom bargashta buda, pas bar onkh'o g'azabi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furud meoiad va onkh'oro azobi azim ast.

107) In bargashtanashon az Islom ba on sabab ast, ki onkh'o matoi nochizi kh'aioti dunioro bar okhirat tarch'ekh' dodaand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba k'avmi kofir tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba imonro namedikh'ad, balki onkh'oro az tavfik' makh'rum mesozad.

108) In ch'amoai tavsifshuda ba bargashtan az Islom kasoneand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar dil va gush va chashmashon mukh'r nikh'oda, ba kh'amin sabab onkh'o pandro namefakh'mand, onro ba tavri sudbakhsh nameshunavand va alomatkh'oi ba sui imon dalolatkunandaro namebinand. Va dar kh'ak'ik'at in gurukh'i mavsuf az sababkh'oi khushbakhtivu badbakhti va azobe, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon omoda sokhtaast, g'ofiland.

109) Dar kh'ak'ik'at onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat ziionkoroni kh'ak'ik'ie kh'astand, ki ba sababi ba'd az imon ovardan kofir gashtan bar ch'oni kheshtan zarar rasonidand, zero agar bo imon memondand, dokhili ch'annat meshudand.

110) Sipas, iak'inan Parvardigori tu Paiombar baroi mu'minoni notavon, ki ba'di az sui mushrikon mavridi ozor k'aror giriftan va dar dinashon ozmoish shudan, kh'atto kalimai kufr ba zabon ovardand, dar kh'ole ki dilashon osudai imon bud, onkh'o ba'di in ranch'kh'o az Makka ba Madina kh'ich'rat kardand, ba'dan bo mak'sadi piruz shudani Islom va shikasti kufr dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'ikh'od namudand va bar ranch'kh'oiash sabr kardand, kh'amono Parvardigorat ba onkh'o ba'di giriftori ba in ozmoish va shikanch'akh'oi shadid Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Zero onkh'o az rui mach'buri kalimai kufrro ba zabon ovardaand.

111) Ei Paiombar, ruzero iod kun, ki kh'ar kas az sababi dakh'shatnokii k'iiomat omada, tankh'o az khud kh'imoiat mekunad va ba kh'ar kas podoshi on chi az neki va badi karda ast, purra doda meshavad va onkh'o bo kam sokhtani nekikh'o va afzun sokhtani badikh'oiashon zulm karda nameshavand.

112) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dekh'aero masal mezanad, ki mardumash dar kh'olati amnu osoish k'aror doshtand, az kase namekh'arosidand, osudakh'ol budand, dar kh'ole ki mardumi atrofash rabuda meshudand, ruzii sokinonash az kh'ar ch'o farovoni oson meomad, pas sokinonash ne'matkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro nosiposi kardand, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba sababi kufr varzidan va durug' shumurdani dinash bo gurusnagi va tarsi shadid, ki log'ari va iztirob dar ch'ismashon namoion shud, ch'azo dod, to kh'adde, ki gurusnagi va tars baroiashon monandi libos gardida, az onkh'o ch'udo nameshud.
Murod az dekh'ai mazkur Makkai Mukarrama ast.

113) Va Ba durusti ki ba akh'li Makka Paiombare az miioni khudi onkh'o omad, uro bo sifatkh'oi neki amonatdori va rostk'avli meshinokhtand va in shakhs Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ast. Pas uro dar on chi Parvardigorash baroiash nozil namuda ast, durug'gui donistand, pas azobi gurusnagi va tars az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar onkh'o furud omad va onkh'o bo shirk ovardan va takzibi Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bar ch'onashon sitam kardaand.

114) Pas ei bandagon, az khurdanikh'oi kh'aloli pokizae, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo ruzi doda ast, bikhured va agar tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro meparasted va chizero ba U sharik namesozed, pas bo ik'ror namudani ne'matkh'oiash va sarfi on dar rokh'i rizoiash shukri ekh'sonkh'oiashro ba ch'o ored.

115) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo az khurdanikh'o kh'aivoni kh'alolgushti be zabkh'i shar'i murda va khuni ba'di zabkh' rekhta va khukro bo tamomi ach'zoi on va kh'aivonero, ki zabkh'kunanda baroi g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zabkh' karda ast, k'at'iian kh'arom gardonida ast. In kh'ukm dar kh'oli ikhtiiori ast. Pas kh'ar kiro kh'olati zarurat ba khurdani kh'aromkh'oi mazkur mach'bur sozad, dar in surat metavonad az on bikhurad, ba sharti on ki ba khurdanash rag'bat nadoshta boshad va az andozai niiozmandiash beshtar nakhurad. Dar in kh'ol gunokh'kor nameshavad. Zero iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. On chi banda az kh'arom dar kh'olati mach'buri khurda ast, mebakhshad va dar nochori khurdani kh'aromro rukhsat medikh'ad.

116) Va ei mushrikon, bo on chi az zabonaton meguzarad, "in kh'alol va in kh'arom ast" nagued, ki bo kh'arom shumurdani kh'alolkh'o va kh'alol shumurdani kh'aromkh'o bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' mebofed. Kh'amono kasone, ki bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' mebofand, rastagor nameshavand.
117) Onkh'oro dar dunio ba sababi pairavi az khokh'ishoti nafs bakh'rai andaki bearzish va dar okhirat azobi dardovar ast.

Vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi k'abli khurdanikh'oi baroi musulmonon kh'aromro baion namud, dar oiati zerin chizkh'oi baroi iakh'udikh'o kh'aromro zikr karda guft:
118) Va on chi ba tu k'issa kardem, makhsusan baroi iakh'udikh'o kh'arom gardonidem va Mo bo kh'arom sokhtani on bar onkh'o zulm nakardem, vale khud bar ch'oni khud sitam kardand. Zero ba sababkh'oi ch'albsozandai azobi ilokh'i dast zadand va dar ivazi tach'ovuzgari onkh'oro ch'azo doda, bo k'asdi uk'ubatashon onro baroiashon kh'arom gardonidem.

119) Ei Paiombar, Ba durusti ki Parvardigorat baroi kasone, ki ok'ibati korashonro nadonista, amalkh'oi bad mekunand, agarchi k'asdan onro kardaand, sipas ba'di anch'omi on ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavbai sodik'a menamoiand va korkh'oi bo fasod omekhtai khudro islokh' mesozand, kh'amono Parvardigorat ba'di tavba Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Gunokh'i afrodi tavbakorro mebakhshad.

Az sababi on ki mushrikon da'voi dar dini Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) budanro doshtand, Khudo dar oiati zerin in da'voi beasosro rad karda guft:
120) Begumon Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) peshvoi ch'am'ovarandai khislatkh'oi nek, kh'amesha farmonbardori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), az kh'amai dinkh'o moil ba sui Islom buda va kh'ech' gokh' az ch'umlai mushrikon nabud.
121) U siposguzori ne'matkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bud. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro baroi nubuvvat barguzid va ba Islom, ki rokh'i rost ast, rakh'namoi namud.

122) Va baroi Ibrokh'im dar dunio nubuvvat, nomi nek va farzandi solekh' dodem va beshak, u ruzi k'iiomat az bandagoni solekh'est, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon balandtarin darach'akh'oi ch'annatro omoda karda ast.

123) Sipas ei Paiombar, ba sui tu vakh'i firistodem, ki dar borai iaktoparasti, izkh'ori bezori az mushrikon, da'vat ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va amal bo shariat az oiini Ibrokh'im, ki az kh'amai dinkh'o ba sui Islom moil bud, pairavi kun va chunonchi mushrikon da'vo dorand, Ibrokh'im az zumrai mushrikon nabud, balki bandai iaktoparast bud.

124) Kh'amono ba'di gumrokh'shavii iakh'udikh'o az ta'zimi ruzi ch'um'a, ki dar on ba forig' gashtan bakh'ri ibodat amr shuda budand, baroiashon ta'zimi ruzi shanbe, ki dar borai on khilof kardand, farz gardonida shud, to dar ruzi shanbe bo mak'sadi ibodat az mashg'uliiati dunio forig' shavand. Va ei Paiombar, beshak Parvardigorat ruzi k'iiomat miioni in ch'amoa dar on chi bo kh'am ikhtilof mekardand, k'azovat namuda, onkh'oro ch'azo medikh'ad.

125) Ei Paiombar, bo mu'minoni pairavat mardumro bo kh'ikmat va mav'izai nek ba sui Islom da'vat kun. Kh'ikmat, e'tibor dodani kh'olat, fakh'm va darach'ai itoati mardum va mav'izai nek kh'ushdor dodan az azob va tashvik' ba podosh ast. Va kh'amrokh'ashon bo shevai az likh'ozi guftor, andesha va nazokati baion bekh'tarin munozara kun. Kh'idoiati mardum bar ukh'dai tu nest, balki vazifi tu tablig'i dini ilokh'i ast. Ba durusti ki Parvardigorat bandai az dini Islom gumrokh'ro bekh'tar medonad va U kh'idoiatioftagonro bekh'tar medonad. Khudro bo g'ami on ki kofiron imon nameorand, kh'alok nagardon.

126) Va agar k'asdi ch'azo dodani dushmanatonro kuned, pas uro ainan kh'amon guna ch'azo dikh'ed, ki onro dar kh'ak'k'i shumo ravo dida ast va chizero bar on ilova nasozed va agar vak'ti k'udrati ch'azoro doshtanaton az much'ozoti onkh'o sabr kuned, pas ba durusti, in amal baroi shakhsoni bosabri shumo az on ki bo rokh'i ch'azo kh'ak'atonro mesitoned, bekh'tar ast.

127) Va ei Paiombar, dar muk'obili ozore, ki az tarafi dushmanon ba tu merasad, sabr bikun va sabri tu makh'z bo tavfik'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast va baroi on ki kofiron az tu rui metoband, g'amgin mashav va ba sababi dasisae, ki onkh'o anch'om medikh'and, diltang mabosh.

128) Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amrokh'i kasone ast, ki bo tarki gunokh' parkh'ezkori mekunand va kasone, ki bo anch'omi ibodat nekukor kh'astand. Parvardigor bo kumak va madadrasoniash kh'amrokh'i onkh'o ast.

1) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti az kh'ama nuk'sonkh'o Poki Boazamat ast, zero Vai ba korkh'oe k'udrat dorad, ki kasi digar az ukh'dai on namebaroiad. U Zotest, ki bandaash Mukh'ammadro dar pose az shab bo rukh'u ch'ism dar bedori az Masch'id-ul-kh'arom ba tarafi Masch'idi Bait-ul-muk'addas, ki bo mevakh'o, ziroatkh'o va manzilkh'oi paiombaron atrofashro barakat doda ast, burd, to ba'ze az nishonakh'oi k'udrati Khudro ba u nishon dikh'ad. Ba durusti, U Khudoi Shunavoi Bino ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi monda nametavonad.

2) Va Mo ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) Tavrotro dodem va onro baroi Bani Isroil rakh'namo gardonida, guftem: "Ch'uz Man Takiagokh'i digar, ki korkh'oiatonro ba u kh'avola kuned, nagired, balki tankh'o ba Man tavakkul kuned.

3) Shumo az nasli onone kh'asted, ki Mo onkh'oro bo kh'amrokh'i Nukh' az g'ark' gardidan nach'ot doda, nisbatashon lutf namudem. Baroi kh'amin, on lutfro ba khotir ored va bo ibodat va itoat Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro shukrguzori namuda, dar in bora pairavi Nukh' boshed. Zero vai bandai bisior siposguzori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bud."

4) Va dar Tavrot ba Bani Isroil khabar dodem va ogokh'ashon kardem, ki kh'atman az sui shumo dar zamin ba sababi gunokh' va kufroni ne'mat du marotiba fasod rukh medikh'ad va kh'atman bo zulm va ch'inoiatkori bar mardum bartari khosta, az kh'amai marzkh'o meguzared.

5) Pas chun az ch'onibi Bani Isroil fasodkorii iakum ba vuch'ud oiad, bar onkh'o on bandagonamonro, ki sokh'ibi k'udrat va nerui buzurgand, musallat mesozem, onkh'o k'avmi iakh'udro mekushand va badarg'a mekunand, pas miioni khonakh'oiashon tokhtu toz karda, az nazdi kh'ar chi guzarand, onro kharob mesozand va va'dai ilokh'i dar in bora kh'atman vok'e'shavanda ast.

6) Sipas, ei Bani Isroil, vak'te tavba kuned, baroiaton davlat va muk'obili on kasone, ki bar alaikh'aton musallat shudand, g'olibiiatro barmegardonem va ba'd az on ki doroiaton rabuda va farzandonaton asir gashtand, amvol va farzandonatonro afzun mesozem va ch'am'iiati shumoro az ch'am'iiati dushmanonaton ziiodtar menamoem.

7) Ei Bani Isroil, agar amalkh'oiatonro nek sokhta, onro ba surati matlub ich'ro kuned, pas podoshash ba shumo barmegardad, zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az korkh'oi shumo beniioz meboshad. Va agar raftori bad karded, pas ok'ibatash bar zarari shumo barmegardad, zero amalkh'oi neki bandagon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) foida va raftorkh'oi zishtashon ba U zarar namerasonad. Pas chun az ch'onibaton fasodkorii duium rukh dikh'ad, dushmanonatonro bar shumo kh'ukmfarmo mesozem, to shumoro khoru rasvo gardonand va ba sababi on ki nav'kh'oi gunoguni khoriro baroiaton mechashonand, osori nokhushiro dar chekh'raaton namoion mekunand va to ba Bait-ul-muk'addas daroiand, chunonchi bori nakhust vorid shudand va to onro takhrib sozand va shakh'rkh'oi zeri tasarruf darovardai khudro ba khok iakson gardonand.

8) Ei Bani Isroil, agar tavba karda, amalatonro nek kuned, umed ast Parvardigoraton ba'di in intik'om shumoro mavridi rakh'matash k'aror dikh'ad va agar bori seium io beshtar ba fasodkori bargarded, Mo niz ba sitonidani intik'om az shumo barmegardem va duzakhro baroi kofiron chun zindon gardonidaem, ki abadan az on rakh'oi nameioband.

9) Beshak, in K'ur'oni bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilshuda ba bekh'tarin rokh'kh'o (dini Islom) rakh'namoi mekunad va mu'minonero, ki amalkh'oi nek mekunand, bashorat medikh'ad, ki onkh'oro az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savobi azim ast.
10) Va K'ur'on shakhsoni munkiri k'iiomatro khabar medikh'ad, ki Mo baroi kofiron dar k'iiomat azobi dardovar omoda kardaem.

11) Va inson chunonchi dar kh'ak'k'i khud duoi nek mekunad, vak'ti g'azab az rui ch'akh'l dar kh'ak'k'i khud, farzand va molash duoi bad menamoiad va agar Mo duoi badashro bipazirem, kh'am vai va kh'am molu farzandonash nobud meshavand va inson fitratan shitobkor ast. Baroi kh'amin, vai az rui shitobkori duoe mekunad, ki baroiash zarar meorad.

12) Va Mo shab va ruzro du alomati dalolatkunandai vakh'doniiat va k'udrati Khud ofaridem, zero dar on du az nigokh'i darozivu kutokh'i va garmivu sardi gunoguni ast. Pas, shabro ba khotiri khobu rokh'at torik va ruzro ravshan gardondem, to on ruziero, ki Parvardigoraton az fazli Khud baroiaton muk'addar sokhta ast, talab kuned va to bo paii kh'amdigar omadani shabu ruz adadi solkh'o va on chiro az kh'isobi vak'tkh'oi mokh'kh'o va ruzkh'ovu soatkh'o, ki ba on niioz dored, bidoned va kh'amai chizro ba tavri ravshan baion kardem, to kh'amai chizkh'o az iakdigar ch'udo gardand va kh'ak' az nokh'ak' ma'lum gardad.

13) Va amali az kh'ar inson sodirshavandaro monandi paivastagii gardanband ba gardan kh'amrokh'ash k'arin gardonidem, kirdori kardaash to zamoni bozpursiash az vai ch'udo nameshavad va ruzi k'iiomat baroi u kitobero, ki dar on korkh'oi neku badash sabt gashta ast, berun mesozem, on kitobro dar nazdash kushoda meiobad.
14) Va on ruz ba vai meguem: "Ei inson, nomai a'molatro bikhon va kh'isobi korkh'oiatro khud anch'om bidekh', imruz khudi tu ba sifati kh'isobgari a'molat basandai."

15) Kh'ar ki ba sui imon kh'idoiat shavad, pas savobi on ba foidai khudi ust va kh'ar ki gumrokh' gardad, pas uk'ubati on ba zarari khudi ust va kase gunokh'i shakhsi digarro namebardorad va Mo kh'ech' k'avmero to on ki paiombar nafiristem va dalelro barpo nakunem, azob namedikh'em.

16) Va chun ba sababi zulmi sokinoni dekh'ae irodai nobud sokhtani onkh'oro kunem, kasonero, ki ne'mati bisior onkh'oro mag'rur sokhta ast, ba itoatkori dastur medikh'em, pas onkh'o farmoni Moro ba ch'o nameorand, balki nofarmoni karda, az itoat mebaroiand, pas k'avli Parvardigor oidi vuk'ui azobi reshakansozanda zaruri megardad, pas onkh'oro kh'alok gardonida, az bekhashon barmekanem.

17) Va adadi ummatkh'oi takzibgar ba monandi k'avmi Odu Samud, ki ba'di Nukh' nobudashon sokhtem, nikh'oiat ziiodand! Va ei Paiombar, Ogokh'u Bino budani Parvardigorat oidi gunokh'i bandagonash basanda ast. Kh'ech' gunokh' az U pushida nest va kh'atman onkh'oro ba sazoi korashon merasonad.

18) Kh'ar kas bo ich'roi korkh'oi nek zindagonii dunioro mak'sudi khesh k'aror doda, ba okhirat imon naorad va ba on betavach'ch'ukh'i namoiad, dar dunio baroiash on ne'matkh'oero, ki Mo mekhokh'em, na on chiro vai mekhokh'ad, ba kh'ar kase khokh'em, medikh'em, sipas duzakhro baroi u muk'arrar mesozem, ruzi k'iiomat ba on dokhil gashta, az sakhtii garmiash ranch' mebarad, dar kh'ole ki ba sababi barguzidani dunio va inkori okhirat mazammatshudai az rakh'mati ilokh'i rondashuda ast.

19) Va kh'ar kas bo ich'roi korkh'oi nek savobi okhiratro k'asd namoiad va baroi on kushishi kholi az khudnamoi anch'om dikh'ad, dar kh'ole ki vai ba ruknkh'oi asosii din imon dorad, pas taloshi ch'amoai bo sifatkh'oi mazkur tavsifshuda nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pazirufta gashta, ba onkh'o podoshi sazovor medikh'ad.

20) Ei Paiombar, kh'ar iakei in du gurukh'i badkoru nekukorro doim az rizk'i Parvardigorat medikh'em va rizk'i Parvardigorat dar dunio az kase, novobasta az badkor io nekukor budanash man' nameshavad.

21) Ei Paiombar, andesha namo, ki Mo dar dunio chi guna ba'ze az bandagonro bar ba'zei digar dar ruzi va martaba bartari dodaem va begumon darach'akh'oi ne'mati okhirat va afzaliiatnokii on az kh'aioti dunio buzurgtar ast. Az in ru, mu'minro lozim va zarur ast, ki baroi kh'osil namudani ne'matkh'oi abadii okhirat sakht talosh kunad.

22) Ei banda, dar ibodat bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digar k'aror madekh', zero in amal bois megardad, ki nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va bandagoni solekh'ash mazammatshuda gashta, kase sitoishat namekunad, inchunin az madadi ilokh'i makh'rum shuda, beiovar memoni.

23) Va ei banda, Parvardigorat amr karda va farz gardonida ast, ki g'airi U kh'ech' kas va kh'ech' chizro naparasted va dar kh'ak'k'i padaru modar, makhsusan vak'ti rasidan ba pironsoli nekui kuned. Pas agar nazdi tu padar io modar va io kh'arduiashon ba pironsoli rasand, pas ba onkh'o "uf", ki ba ma'noi diltangi ast, magu va izkh'ori diltangi makun va ba onkh'o bong mazan va sukhani sakht magu va ba onkh'o sukhani narmu shirin bigu.

24) Va az rui mekh'ruboni ba volidain va nishon dodani khori nazdi onkh'o furutani namo va bigu: "Ei Parvardigori man, ba sababi on ki padaru modaram maro dar khurdsoli tarbiiat namudand, onkh'oro mavridi rakh'mati Khesh k'aror bidekh'."

25) Ei mardum, Parvardigoraton on ikhlosero, ki kh'angomi ibodat, ich'roi kori shoista va nekuii padaru modar dar k'albaton pushida ast, bekh'tar medonad. Agar niiatkh'oi shumo dar ibodat va muomila bo padaru modaru digaron nek boshad, pas ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi bandagoni bo tavba ba suiash bozgardanda Bakhshanda meboshad. Kh'ar kas az kutokh'ie, ki dar guzashta dar ibodati ilokh'i io khidmati padaru modar karda ast, samimona tavba kunad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'ashro mebakhshad.

26) Va ei mu'min, bo nigokh' doshtani paivandi kheshovandi kh'ak'k'i kheshovand va miskin va rakh'mondai musofirro bidekh' va molatro dar rokh'i gunokh' sarf makun va az isrofkori dar kharch'i on khuddori namo.

27) Beshak, shakhsone, ki molkh'oi khudro dar ma'siiat sarf mekunand va shakhsone, ki dar kharch'i on ba isrofkori rokh' medikh'and, barodaroni shaitonkh'o buda, dar isrofkori dasturi shaitonkh'oro ich'ro mekunand va Shaiton nisbat ba Parvardigorash bisior nosipos ast. Baroi kh'amin doim gunokh' karda, ba korkh'oe mefarmoiad, ki khashmi ilokh'iro meorad.

28) Va agar ba sababi mavch'ud nabudani imkonot az dodani kh'uk'uk'i in ch'amoai mazkur khuddori namuda, intizor dori, ki Parvardigorat dari ruziashro ba tu boz mekunad, pas ba onkh'o sukhani narm bigu. Ba in monand, ki baroi farokhii ruziashon dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o duoi nek namo io va'da kun, ki agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tu doroi dikh'ad, az on ba onkh'o medikh'i.

29) Va dastatro az dodani sadak'a man' makun va dar anch'omi khairot ba isrofkori rokh' madekh', zero dar surati dastro az sadak'a boz doshtan az ch'onibi mardum baroi bukhl varzidanat malomatshuda megardi, agar isrofkori kuni, bechiz monda, az dodani sadak'a k'at' meshavi va baroi khair namudan chize paido namekuni.

30) Ba durusti ki Parvardigorat ruziro az rui kh'ikmatash baroi kh'ar kas khokh'ad, farokh va baroi kh'ar kas khokh'ad, tang megardonad. Kh'amono U az bandagonash Bokhabari Bino ast. Kh'ech' kori onkh'o az U pushida nest. Nisbat ba bandagon kh'ar chi khokh'ad, mekunad.

31) Va farzandonatonro az tarsi on ki agar ba onkh'o nafak'a dikh'ed, fak'ir megarded, nakushed. Mo rizk'i onkh'o va shumoro kafolat dodaem. Ba durusti ki kushtanashon gunokh'i azim ast, zero onkh'o gunokh' nadorand.

32) Va az zino va kh'ar amali tashvik'kunandai on biparkh'ezed, zero on begumon amali bag'oiat zisht va rokh'i nikh'oiat bad ast. Zero zinokori ba omekhtashavii naslu nasab va azobi ilokh'i ovarda merasonad.

33) Va kh'ech' kasero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rekhtani khunashro ba sababi imon io amonkhokh'i kh'ifz karda ast, nakushed, magar on ki ba sababi murtadshavi io ba'di sokh'ibkh'amsari zino kardan io k'isos kushtanash voch'ib gardida boshad. Va kh'ar ki mazlumona, besababi ch'oizgardonandai k'atl kushta shavad, pas iak'inan baroi vorisoneash, ki sarparasti kori u kh'astand, kh'ak'k'i kh'ukmfarmoi bar k'otilro dodaem. U metavonad az rokh'i k'isos k'atli uro talabad io be giriftani khunbakh'o k'otilro bakhshad io k'otilro bakhshad va khunbakh'o sitonad. Pas naboiad vorisi shakhsi mazlumona ba k'atl rasida bo buridani gushu binii k'otil io kushtani k'otil ba g'airi oloti kushtaash io k'atli g'airi k'otil az marzi rukhsatdodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guzarad. Kh'amono sarparasti shakhsi kushtashuda az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kumak va ta'iid shuda ast. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba u kh'ak'k'i darkhosti k'isosro bakhshida, kh'okimonro dastur doda ast, to dar in mas'ala baroiash kumak rasonand.

34) Va ba moli iatim dastdarozi nakuned, magar bo shevai ba misli rushd dodan va nigakh'dorii doroiash shoistatar, to on ki ba balog'at va kamol birasad. Va ba akh'di baini kheshtan va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va baini khud va bandagon bastaaton be shikastan io kam kardanash vafo kuned. Begumon, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat shakhsi akh'dbastaro mepursad, ki oio ba paimonash vafo namuda io onro shikasta ast. Agar vafo karda boshad, savob va dar surati bevafoi much'ozot meshavad.

35) Va chun baroi mardum ba vositai paimona chen mekuned, onro komil gardoned va kam nasozed va bo istifoda az tarozui odilona, ki kh'ak'k'i kasero kam namesozad, barkashed. In komil kardani paimonavu tarozu dar duniovu okhirat baroiaton bekh'tar va ok'ibatash nektar ast.

36) Va ei pisari Odam, az on chi dar borai on ma'lumot nadori, pairavi nakun, zero dar in surat tobei gumonkh'ovu takhminkh'o meshavi. Iak'inan inson az amali nek va bade, ki gushu chashmu k'albashro dar on istifoda karda ast, pursida meshavad. Baroi neki savob va baroi badi ch'azo mebinad.

37) Va dar zamin bo kibr va khiromon rokh' marav. Beshak agar tu dar zamin bo kibr k'adam zani, kh'argiz bo in k'adam guzoriat zaminro surokh namesozi va kh'argiz k'omatat ba balandiiu darozii kukh'kh'o namerasad. Modom ki chunin ast, pas kibr varzidan chi zarurat dorad?!
38) Ei inson, kh'ar on ki dar guzashta zikr shud, kori badi on nazdi Parvardigorat mamnu' ast. U az anch'omdikh'andai on rozi nameshavad, balki ba vai nafrat mekunad.

39) In amru nakh'i va akh'komkh'o az on kh'ikmate ast, ki Parvardigorat onro ba sui tu vakh'i firistoda ast va ei inson, bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digar magir, zero dar surati ma'budi digar giriftanat ruzi k'iiomat, dar kh'ole ki on ruz kh'am az sui khud va kh'am az sui mardum malomatshudavu az kh'ar neki rondashuda megardi, ba duzakh afkanda meshavi.

40) Ei on kasone, ki dav'o dored farishtagon dukhtaroni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astand, pas oio Parvardigoraton shumoro bo farzandoni narina ikhtisos dod va farishtagonro baroi Khud dukhtar girifta ast?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi megued, pok ast. Beshak, shumo dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sukhani bag'oiat zisht megued, chunki ba Parvardigor farzand nisbat medikh'ed va farishtagonro bo furu raftanaton dar kufr dukhtaronash mekh'isobed.

41) Va Ba durusti ki Mo dar in K'ur'on akh'kom, pandkh'o va masalkh'oi ibratomuzro baion namudem, to mardum az on ibrat girifta, ba korkh'oi foidaovar ik'dom karda, korkh'oi zararovarro tark namoiand. Va kh'ol on ki ba'ze az shakhsoni vozhgunsirisht bo in akh'komu andarzkh'ovu masalkh'oi ibratbakhsh, tankh'o duri az kh'ak' va az on nafratashon afzoish meiobad.

42) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Agar kh'amrokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chigunae akh'li shirk az rui tukh'mat va durug' in da'voro dorand, ma'budkh'oe mebud, on gokh' in ma'budkh'o ba sui Allokh'i Sokh'ibi arsh rokh' mech'ustand, to bo rokh'i nizo' va sa'ii mag'lubsozi kh'okimiiati mutlak'i kulli ch'akh'onro az Vai bisitonand."
43) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az vasfe, ki mushrikon mekunand, poku muk'addas va az on chi dar kh'ak'k'i U meguiand, bisior bartar va volotar ast.

44) Osmonkh'ovu zamin va kulli mavch'udoti onkh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba poki mekhonand va kh'ech' chize nest, magar in ki Uro iakch'o bo sitoish ba poki iod mekunad, valekin shumo tarzi tasbekh'i onkh'oro namefakh'med. Shumo tankh'o tasbekh'i kasero fakh'mida metavoned, ki Parvardigorro monandi khudaton fak'at ba vositai zabon ba poki mekhonad. Kh'amono U Zoti Burdbor buda, bandagonro dar kh'ol uk'ubat namekunad, Bakhshandai gunokh'i tavbakunandagon ast.

45) Va ei Paiombar, chun K'ur'onro tilovat kuni, pas akh'li shirk pandkh'o va oiatkh'oi az shirku kufru gunokh' bozdorandai onro shunavand, Mo baini tu va baini ashkhosi munkiri okhirat pardae k'aror medikh'em, ki onkh'oro kh'amchun uk'ubati az kh'ak' rui toftanashon az sarfakh'm raftani K'ur'on man' mekunad.

46) Va Mo bar k'albi onkh'o pardakh'o k'aror dodaem, to K'ur'onro nafakh'mand va dar gushkh'oiashon sangini k'aror dodaem, to K'ur'onro dar amal nashunavand. Va vak'te tu dar K'ur'on tankh'o Parvardigoratro nom burda, ma'budkh'oi botili onkh'oro zikr nakuni, ba sababi nafratashon az K'ur'on va az iaktoparasti pusht megardonand va dur meshavand.

47) Mo shevai ba K'ur'on gush andokhtani peshvoioni mushrikonro bekh'tar medonem. Mak'sadi onkh'o az gush kardani K'ur'on kh'idoiat ioftan nest, balki mekhokh'and vak'ti tilovatat onro maskhara karda, bekh'udakori kunand. Va Mo on takzib va nak'shai az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) man' namudani mardumro, ki bo kh'am gushaki mekunand, bekh'tar medonem. On gokh', ki in ch'amoai bo kufr dar kh'ak'k'i kheshtan zulmkarda meguiand: "Ei mardum, beshak, shumo az mardi ch'odushudai kamak'l pairavi dored."

48) Ei Paiombar, nigokh' kun, ki chi guna turo bo sifatkh'oi nodurust tavsif kardand, ba kh'amin sabab gumrokh' shuda, dar kh'olati sargardoni k'aror giriftand, sipas ba rokh'i kh'ak' kh'idoiat nameioband.

49) Va mushrikon ba mak'sadi inkori e'tik'odi zindashavii ba'di marg guftand: "Oio chun memirem va ustukhon gardida, ch'asadamon mepusad, oio az nav zinda gardonida meshavem?! Ba durusti, in kor nomumkin ast."
50) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Ei mushrikon, agar monandi sangkh'o sakht va monandi okh'an k'avi gashtan tavoned, dar kh'ole ki kh'ech' gokh' az ukh'dai in kor namebaroed-

51) io ba makhluk'i digar, ki sakhtiiu k'uvvatash az nazari shumo az sangu okh'an buzurgtar ast, tabdil iobed, begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro chunonchi bori iakum paido kard, az nav barmegardonad va chunonchi bori nakhust ofarid, dubora zinda mesozad. Pas ba zudi in ch'amoai iakrav meguiand: "Moro ba'di marg ki zinda mesozad?!" Ba onkh'o bigu: "Shumoro ba'd az marg On Zote dubora barmegardonad, ki bori nakhust be namunai guzashta ofarid." Pas onkh'o ba zudi sari khudro ba ma'noi maskhara kardani posukhi dodaat mech'unbonand va zindashavii ba'di margro nomumkin kh'isobida meguiand: "In zinda gardonidani murdagon kai ba vuk'u' mepaivandad?!" Dar ch'avobashon bigu: "Shoiad on nazdik boshad." Zero kh'ar chi omadanist, nazdik ast.

52) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruze, ki shumoro ba zamini makh'shar faro mekhonad, az nav zindaaton mesozad, pas Uro kh'amd gufta da'vatashro mepazired va gumon mekuned, ki dar zamin ch'uz zamoni andak naistoda buded.

53) Va ei Paiombar, ba bandagoni mu'minam bigu, ki vak'ti guftugu bo iakdigar bekh'tarin kalimaro ba zabon orand va az kalimakh'oi k'abekh'i nafratovar biparkh'ezand.
