Zero Shaiton az on suistifoda burda, baroi tabokh' gardonidani duniovu okhirati onkh'o talosh mekunad. Ba durusti ki Shaiton baroi inson dushmani oshkor ast. Baroi kh'amin boiad inson az Shaton ekh'tiiot kunad.

54) Ei mardum, Parvardigoraton shumoro bekh'tar medonad, kh'ech' chizi shumo az Vai makhfi namemonad. Agar khokh'ad, shumoro ba vasilai tavfik' dodan ba imon va amali nek kardan mavridi rakh'matash k'aror medikh'ad va agar khokh'ad, shumoro ba vasilai makh'rum sokhtan az imon va dar kh'olati kufr mironidan azob mekunad. Va ei Paiombar, Mo turo ba sui mardum nigakh'bon nafiristodem, ki ba imon ovardan mach'burashon sokhta, az kufr bozashon dori va amalashonro kh'isobu kitob namoi. Tu az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tablig'gar firistoda shudai, on chi amr mekunad, ba mardum merasoni.

55) Va ei Paiombar, Parvardigorat tamomi mavch'udoti osmonkh'ovu zamin, kh'olatkh'oi onkh'o va ba chi sazovor budanashonro bekh'tar medonad va kh'amono Mo ba'zei paiombaronro bo te'dodi ziiodi pairavon va furud ovardani Kitob bar ba'ze bartar sokhtem va ba Dovud Zaburro dodem.

56) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Ei mushrikon, agar ba shumo zarare rasad, ononero, ki ba da'voi shumo g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budand, faro bikhoned. Pas onkh'o ba sababi notavoni k'udrati az shumo dursozii ziionro nadorand va onro ba digar kas intik'ol doda kh'am nametavonand." Kh'ar ki och'iz ast, Ma'bud nest.

57) In ch'amoai farishtagon va digaron, ki mushrikon onkh'oro ba sifati ma'bud meparastand, khud dar ch'ustuch'ui kori neke kh'astand, ki onkh'oro ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdik sozad va bo kh'am dar bobi on ki ba vositai ibodat chi kase ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdiktar meshavad, rak'obat mekunand va ba rakh'matash umed dorand va az uk'ubatash metarsand. Ei Paiombar, Ba durusti ki boiad az azobi Parvardigorat kh'azar kard.

58) Va kh'ech' dekh'a io shakh're az dekh'akh'oi sokinonash kofire nest, ch'uz in ki Mo azob va kh'alokati Khudro k'abl az ruzi k'iiomat ba sababi kufr varzidanashon ba onkh'o furud meorem io on dekh'avu shakh'rro bo rokh'i k'atl io digar rokh'kh'o ba uk'ubati sakht mubtalo megardonem. In kh'alok sokhtan va azob k'azoi ilokh'i buda, dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz navishta shuda ast.

59) Va Mo furud ovardani nishonakh'oi kh'issii dalolatkunandai rostguii Paiombaramonro ba monandi zinda gardonidani murdagon va g'aira, ki mushrikon darkhost kardaand, tankh'o baroi on tark sokhtem, ki on nishonakh'oro bar ummatkh'oi sobik' nozil namudem, pas onkh'oro durug' shumurdand. Va kh'amono baroi k'avmi Samud modashuturro ba sifati alomati ravshan dodem, pas onkh'o ba in nishonai k'udrati Mo kofir shudand, ba'd az on dar kh'ol onkh'oro mubtaloi azob gardonidem. Va Mo alomatkh'oi k'udratamonro ba vositai paiombaron namefiristem, magar baroi bim dodani ummatkh'oiashon, to musalmon shavand.

60) Va ei Paiombar, iod kun vak'tero, ki ba tu guftem: "Ba durusti, Parvardigorat bo k'udratash tamomi mardumro ikh'ota karda ast. Onkh'o dar k'abzai k'udrati ilokh'i k'aror dorand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo az sharri eshon mukh'ofizat mekunad. Baroi kh'amin on chi ba tu dastur shuda ast, ba mardum birason." Va kh'avodisi dar shabi Isro' baroiat oshkor nishon dodaamon tankh'o baroi ozmoishi mardum bud, ki oio ba on rukhdodkh'o imon meorand, io onro inkor mekunand?! Va Mo darakhti "Zak'k'um"-i dar K'ur'on zikrshudaro, ki dar k'a'ri ch'akh'annam ruiida iste'molkunandagonash la'natshuda kh'astand, tankh'o baroi ozmoishi mardum k'aror dodem. Agar ba in du nishonai k'udrat imon naorand, kh'argiz ba chizi digar imon nameorand. Va in mushrikonro bo furud ovardani oiatkh'o metarsonem, pas bo tarsonidanamon tankh'o kufr va dar gumrokh'i furu raftanashon afzun megardad.

61) Va ei Paiombar, on vak'tero iod kun, ki ba farishtagon guftem: "Dar peshi Odam baroi izkh'ori salom, na ibodat sach'da kuned." Pas kh'amagi itoat namuda, sach'da kardand, magar Iblis, ki az rui kibr az ich'roi farmonamon sar pechida guft: "Oio nazdi kase, ki uro az gil ofaridai sach'da kunam, kh'ol on ki maro az otash khalk' kardai?! Man az Odam sharofati beshtar doram."

62) Iblis ba Parvardigorash guft: "Baroiam az kh'oli in makhluk'e, ki uro bo dastur dodanat baroi nazdash sach'da kardan, bar man bartari dodai, khabar dekh'. Charo uro, ki az gil ofarida shuda ast, az man bolotar guzoshti?! Savgand mekhuram, agar maro to okhiri dunio zinda dori, dili farzandonashro ba suiam moil mesozam va onkh'oro az rokh'i rostat berokh'a mekunam, ba istisnoi adadi kami bandagonat, ki onkh'oro kh'ifz kardai va onkh'o bandagoni boikhlosi Tu kh'astand."

63) Parvardigor bo mak'sadi takh'k'iri vai guft: "Az paii ich'roi rokh'i barguzidaat bishav, pas kh'ar ki az farzandoni Odam turo pairavi kunad, ba durusti, duzakh podoshi komili kirdorkh'oi tuvu onkh'ost.

64) Va az miioni bandagon kh'ar kiro metavoni, bo sadoi ba sui gunokh' da'vatkunandaat az rokh'i durust munkh'arif bigardon va ba vositai lashkariioni savora va piiodai ba itoatat farokhonandaat bar onkh'o bong bizan va bo onkh'o dar molkh'oiashon az rokh'i orosta namudani kh'ar fa'oliiati khilofi shariat va dar farzandonashon bo da'voi durug'i nisbat dodani nasabi onkh'o ba g'airi padaroni khud, az rokh'i zino ba dunio ovardani eshon va dar vak'ti nomguzori guzoshtani nomkh'oi shirkolud sharik bishav va ba onkh'o va'dakh'oi durug' va orzukh'oi beasosro orosta bisoz." Va Shaiton ba bandagon tankh'o va'dakh'oi durug'i firebanda medikh'ad.

65) Dar idoma guft: "Beshak, tu bar bandagoni mu'minam, ki Maro kholisona ibodat va itoat mekunand, tasallut nadori." Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharri turo az onkh'o bartaraf mesozad. Va Parvardigorat ba sifati Korsozi bandagon, ki korashonro ba U mesuporand, kofi ast.

66) Ei mardum, Parvardigori shumo Zote ast, ki baroi shumo dar bakh'r kishtikh'oro ba kh'arakat medarorad, to ba vositai tich'orat va g'aira az fazlash ruzi bich'ued. Ba durusti, U nisbat ba shumo bisior Mekh'rubon ast. Osonsozii vasilakh'oi kasbi rizk' az alomatkh'oi rakh'mati Ust.

67) Va ei mushrikon, vak'te dar bakh'r ba shumo falokat va nokhushie rasad va khavfi kh'alokshaviaton boshad, az khotiraton on chi g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastided, nopadid meshavad, tankh'o Uro iod karda, iori mekhokh'ed. Pas chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba fariodaton birasad va shumoro az on kh'olat solim rakh'onida, dar khushki k'aror gired, az iaktoparasti rui megardoned va ba sui butkh'o barmegarded. Va inson nisbat ba ne'matkh'oi Parvardigor bisior nosipos ast.

68) Ei mushrikon, vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro az kh'olati dakh'shatnoki bakh'r nach'ot dod, oio az on ki U khushkiro tavre gardonad, ki shumoro zeri zamin furu barad, dar amoned?! Io az on ki misli k'avmi Lut az osmon bar shumo boroni sang furud orad, sipas nigakh'bon va iovare naiobed, ki az kh'alokat kh'ifzaton karda, kumakaton rasonad, dar amoned?!

69) Io az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) boz shumoro ba bakh'r bargardonida, ba'd az on bar shumo tunbodi sakhte firistad, pas ba sababi on ki nisbat ba ne'mati marotibai iakum nach'ot ioftanaton nosiposi karded, shumoro g'ark' sozad, sipas baroi khud kasero naiobed, ki ba sababi on chi bo shumo kardem, az Mo kh'ak'talabi kunad va ioriaton dikh'ad, dar amoned?!

70) Va iak'inan Mo nasli Odamro ba vositai ak'l, sach'da kunonidani farishtagon nazdi Padari onkh'o va dodani digar lutfu ekh'sonkh'oi Khesh giromi sokhtem va baroiashon chorpoion va markabkh'oero, ki dar khushki va kishtikh'oero, ki dar bakh'r onkh'oro mebardorad, musakhkhar sokhtem va ba onkh'o khurdani, nushidani, kh'amsaron va digar ne'matkh'oi kh'alolro ruzi namudem va onkh'oro bar beshtari on chi ofaridaem, bartarii buzurg bakhshidem. Az in ru, boiad shukri ne'matkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o orand.

71) Va ei Paiombar, ruzero iod kun, ki Mo kh'ar iak gurukh'i mardumro kh'amrokh'i peshvoiashon, ki dar dunio ba vai pairavi mekardand, da'vat mekunem. Pas nomai a'moli kh'ar kase, ki ba dasti rostash doda shavad, pas on gurukh' onro bo khushi k'iroat mekunand va az muzdi onkh'o agarchi monandi rishtai safedi dokhili donai khurmo khurd boshad, kam karda nameshavad va mavridi zulm k'aror namegirand.

72) Va kh'ar ki dar in kh'aioti dunio az paziruftani kh'ak'ik'at va ba on taslim shudan kurdil boshad, pas ruzi k'iiomat nobinoiash shadidtar gashta, rokh'i ch'annatro nameiobad va gumrokh'tar ast. Zero podosh az nav'i amal ast.

73) Va ei Rasuli Mo, k'arib bud, ki in mushrikon turo az K'ur'oni ba suiat paig'om firistodaamon barmegardondand, to bo khokh'ishi tab'i dili onkh'o dar kh'ak'k'i Mo g'airi onro bibofi. Va agar darkhostashonro ich'ro mekardi, begumon onkh'o turo dusti khosi khesh barmeguzidand.

74) Va agar Mo ba vositai dar rokh'i kh'ak' ustuvor gardonidanat bar tu ekh'son namekardem, beshubkh'a, k'arib bud, ki andak ba sui onkh'o rag'bat namuda, bo onkh'o dar peshnikh'odashon muvofik'at mekardi, zero dasisai onkh'o k'avi va maili tu ba imon ovardanashon khele ziiod ast. Vale Mo turo az on ki ba suiashon mail namoi, nigokh' doshtem.

75) Va agar dar on chi mushrikon peshnikh'od kardand, ba onkh'o mail mekardi, ba tu dar dunio azobi duchand va dar okhirat azobi duchandro mechashondem, sipas baroi khud iovarero nameiofti, ki azobi Moro az tu boz dorad.

76) Va beshak, k'arib bud, ki kofiron bo adovat turo az sarzamini Makka noorom kunand, to az on be bozgasht ikhroch'at sozand, vale Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro az rondanat man' kard va tu bo farmoni Parvardigorat kh'ich'rat kardi va agar onkh'o turo berun menamudand, pas az tu dar Makka ch'uz zamoni andak bok'i namonda, kh'alok megashtand.

77) In kh'ukm, ki agar mushrikon turo az Makka merondand, ba'd az andak zamon kh'alok meshudand, shevai bo paiombaronamon, ki pesh az tu guzashtand, amalishuda ast. Kh'ar paiombarero, ki k'avmash az miioni khud rondand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o azobashro furud ovard. In iake az shevakh'oi sobiti ilokh'i ast. Va ei Paiombar, baroi shevai Mo tag'iirot nameiobi, balki on dar kh'ama davru zamon ustuvor va dar amal ch'ori meboshad.

78) Namozro dar komiltarin surat dar vak'tkh'oi muk'arrarshuda az zavoli oftob, ki shomili namozi peshinu asr ast, to torikii shab, ki namozi shomu khuftanro darbar megirad, ado kun va namozi bomdodro ado namuda, k'iroatro dar on tuloni namo. Zero begumon dar namozi bomdod farishtagoni shabona va ruzona kh'ozir meshavand.

79) Va ei Paiombar, dar k'ismate az shab barkhez va namoz bikhon, to namozi shab dar baland shudani darach'akh'oiat izofa gardad. Dar kh'olati adoi namozi takh'ach'ch'ud k'asdi onro doshta bosh, ki Parvardigorat ruzi k'iiomat turo baroi mardumi az sakh'nai dakh'shatnoki makh'shar dar kh'aros k'arordoshta ba sifati shafoatgar barangezad va mak'omi shafoati buzurgtarin, ki kh'ama khaloik' onro sitoish kunand, az oni tu boshad.

80) Va ei Paiombar, bigu: "Parvardigoro, tamomi daromadan va baromadankh'oi maro dar toat va khushnudii Khud k'aror bidekh' va az nazdat baroiam daleli oshkore nasib gardon, ki ba vositai on bar ziddi dushman ba man kumak merasoni."

81) Va ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Islom omad, va'dai Parvardigor dar borai piruz gashtani on takh'ak'k'uk' ioft va shirku kufr az miion raft. Ba durusti, botil nobudshavandai nopoidor buda, dar muk'obili kh'ak'ik'at tob nameorad."

82) Va K'ur'onro, ki shifobakhshi bemorikh'oi ch'akh'lu kufru shubkh'ai dilkh'o va bemorii ch'ismoni va baroi mu'minoni boamal rakh'mat ast, nozil mekunem va in Kitob ba kofiron g'air az kh'alokat chizi digarero afzun namesozad, zero shunidani on onkh'oro ba khashm meorad, inchunin takzib va az kh'ak'ik'at rui toftani in ch'amoaro beshtar megardonad.

83) Va chun ba inson az misoli tandurusti va tavongari ne'matero in'om kunem, az shukguzori va itoati Parvardigor rui megardonad va az rui kibru g'urur az zikri U dur meshavad va chun ba u fak'r, bemori va digar nav'i sakhtikh'o rasad, az rakh'mati ilokh'i sakht noumed megardad.

84) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Kh'ar inson bar ravishe kor mekunad, ki ba kh'olatash dar kh'idoiat va zalolat monand ast." Pas Parvardigori shumo on kasero, ki ba sui kh'ak'ik'at rakh'ioftatar ast, bekh'tar medonad.

85) Va ei Paiombar, kofironi akh'li Kitob az tu oidi kh'ak'ik'ati rukh' mepursand. Dar ch'avobi onkh'o bigu: "Kh'ak'ik'ati rukh'ro ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kase namedonad va ba shumovu kulli makhluk'ot dar in bob nazar ba ilmi Parvardigor ba ch'uz donishi andak chize doda nashuda ast."

86) Va savgand ba Zoti Khesh, ki agar Mo ba vositai makh'v sokhtan az sinakh'ovu kitobkh'o az miion burdani paig'omi ba tu nozil kardaamonro khokh'em, iak'inan onro az bain mebarem, sipas kasero baroi khud korsoz va iovar nameiobi, ki muk'obili Mo ioriat doda, onro bargardonad.

87) Lekin az rui rakh'mati Parvardigorat vakh'ii ba tu nozilkardai Khudro az bain naburdem va onro makh'fuz guzoshtem. Ba durusti, fazli Parvardigorat nisbat ba tu buzurg ast. Chunki turo paiombar barguzid, bo omadanat nubuvvatro khotima dod va bar tu K'ur'onro furud ovard.

Chun mushrikon diltang meshudand, ki K'ur'on az nav'i sukhani inson ast va tag'iir dodanashro peshnikh'od mekardand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati zerin az onkh'o ovardani kitobi monand ba K'ur'onro khosta guft:
88) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Agar tamomi insonkh'o va ch'inkh'o baroi ovardani kitobe, ki az likh'ozi san'ati sukhanvari, tartibi zebo, shirinii baion ba in K'ur'oni bar tu nozilshuda monandi doshta boshad, ch'am' shavand, kh'argiz monandi onro ovarda nametavonand, agarchi ba'zeashon baroi ba'zei digar madadrason boshand."

89) Va begumon Mo baroi mardum dar K'ur'on nav'kh'oi gunoguni andarzkh'ovu ibratkh'o, amrkh'ovu nakh'ikh'o va k'issakh'oro baion namudaem, to imon orand, pas beshtari mardum ba ch'uz nosiposi va inkori K'ur'on chizero namepazirand.

Chun mushrikon az ovardani kitobi misli K'ur'on och'iz mondand, baroi notavonsozii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) peshnikh'odkh'oro og'oz kardand:
90) Va mushrikon guftand: "Mo kh'argiz ba tu imon nameorem, to on ki baroi mo az zamini Makka chashmai khushknoshavandae berun sozi,-
91) io bustoni serdarakhti khurmovu angur doshta boshi, pas dar vasati on ba tavri farovon ch'uikh'oro ch'ori namoi,-
92) io chunonchi da'vo mekuni, osmonro baroi azobamon bar mo pora-pora furu birezi io Khudo va farishtagonro ba tavri oshkor biovari, to dar mavridi rost budani da'voi tu guvokh'i dikh'and,-

93) io khonai ba vositai tillo va g'airi on oroishiofta doshta boshi io ba osmon baroi va dar surati ba osmon baromadanat ba paiombarii tu imon nameorem, magar vak'te az nazdi Khudo kitobi navishtashudae biovari, ki dar on daloili isboti paiombariatro k'iroat kunem." Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Parvardigoramro ba poki mekhonam! Man monandi digar paiombaroni Khudo insone besh nestam. K'udrati ovardani chizero nadoram. Pas chi guna khostakh'oi shumoro ovarda metavonam?!"

94) Va vak'te ba kofiron kh'idoiat omad, onkh'oro az imon ovardan ba Allokh'u Rasul va az amal bo K'ur'on tankh'o kh'amin man' kard, ki eshon az nav'i odami budani paiombarro rad namuda, inkorkunon guftand: "Oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sui mo az nav'i odami paiombar firistoda ast?!"

95) Ei Paiombar, dar raddi inkori onkh'o bigu: "Agar dar zamin farishtagone mebudand, ki ba monandi kh'olati shumo ba osudagi zindagi va raftuomad mekardand, beguftugu, ba sui onkh'o az nav'i khudashon farishtaero paiombar mefiristodem. Kh'olati shumo niz kh'amin guna ast."

96) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) miioni manu shumo ba sifati Guvokh' basanda ast, ki man paiombari U buda, tankh'o paig'omkh'oi Uro baroiaton merasonam." Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagonash Bokhabari Bino ast. Chize az U makhfi nest va asrori k'albro medonad.

97) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar ki tavfik'i kh'idoiatro dikh'ad, pas begumon vai kh'idoiatioftai kh'ak'ik'i ast va kh'ar kiro az kh'idoiat makh'rum gardonida, gumrokh' sozad, pas ei Paiombar, kh'argiz baroi in ch'amoa ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dustonero nameiobi, ki onkh'oro ba sui kh'ak'ik'at kh'idoiat namoiand, ziionro az onkh'o dur karda, baroiashon manfiat orand. Va onkh'oro ruzi k'iiomat bar chekh'raashon ba zamin kashida, dar kh'ole nobino va gung va noshunavo kh'astand, ch'am' meorem. Ch'oiashon duzakh boshad, kh'ar gokh' garmii otashi on orom shavad, otashi onkh'oro afzun megardonem.

98) In azobe, ki ruzi k'iiomat bo on ru ba ru megardand, ch'azoi onkh'o ast, ba sabab on ki onkh'o oiatkh'oi bar paiombar nozilkardai Moro inkor karda va zindashavii ba'di margro nomumkin kh'isobida guftand: "Oio vak'te memirem va ba ustukhonkh'oi pusida tabdil shuda, porakh'oi poshkhurda megardem, oio ba'd az in dubora zinda meshavem?!"

Chun mushrikon shubkh'aero, ki dar borai inkori zindashavii ba'd az marg ba on chang mezanand, zikr kardand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar raddi shakki onkh'o guft:
99) Oio munkironi zindashavii ba'di marg namedonand on Allokh'e, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro bo vuch'udi azamatashon kh'ast karda ast, ba kh'ast sokhtani mislashon Tavono ast?! Kh'ar ki chizi buzurgero padid ovarda tavonad, k'udrati ofaridani az on kamtarro dorad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dunio baroi onkh'o vak'ti muaiian guzoshta ast, ki ba'di sipari shudanash zindagiashon anch'om meiobad va baroi ba'di marg dubora zinda shudani onkh'o mukh'late ta'iin sokhta ast, ki dar on shubkh'ae nest. Pas mushrikon bo vuch'udi oshkoru ravshan budani dalelkh'oi dubora zindashavi g'airi inkori on chizero napaziruftand.

100) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Agar shumo moliki khazinakh'oi rakh'mati beintikh'oi Parvardigoram meshuded, begumon az tarsi tamom shudanash az kharch'i on khuddori mekarded, to fak'ir nashaved." Va inson tabiatan bakhil ast, magar kase, ki mu'min boshad, zero banda dar surati imon doshtan molashro ba umedi savobi ilokh'i sarf mekunad.

Az sababi on ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az ch'onibi mushrikon bo takzib va aziiati ziiod ru ba ru shudand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mak'sadi tasalli dodanashon dar oiatkh'oi zerin k'issai Muso va Fir'avnu k'avmashro ovarda guft:
101) Va Ba durusti ki Mo ba Muso nukh' daleli ravshanero, ki bar paiombariash guvokh'i medod, dodem. On mu'ch'izakh'o inkh'oiand: aso, dasti nuronii durakhshon, k'akh'tsoli, kamshavii makh'sulot, tufon, malakh, shapush, k'urbok'k'akh'o va khun. Pas ei Paiombar, az iakh'ud bipurs. Ba Muso zamone on mu'ch'izakh'oro dodem, ki bo on nazdi guzashtagonashon omad, pas Fir'avn ba u guft: "Ei Muso, beshak, man turo mardi ch'odushuda gumon mekunam. Zero tu korkh'oi kh'airatovar anch'om medikh'i."

102) Muso (alaikh'is salom) dar ch'avobi Fir'avn guft: "Ei Fir'avn, tu iak'inan medoni, ki mu'ch'izakh'oro g'airi Allokh'i Parvardigori osmonkh'ovu zamin digar kase furud naovarda ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in mu'ch'izakh'oro kh'amchun dalelkh'oi isbotgari tavonoii Khud va rostguii paiombarash nozil karda ast, vale tu didavu donista onro inkor mekuni. Va ei Fir'avn, man medonam, ki tu iak'inan kh'alokshudai ziionkori."
103) Pas Fir'avn k'asd namud, ki Muso va k'avmashro bo rondan az sarzamini Misr uk'ubat kunad. Pas Mo u va kulli lashkariionashro bo g'ark' sokhtan dar dario kh'alok gardonidem.
104) Va ba'di kh'aloksozii Fir'avu lashkariionash ba Bani Isroil guftem: "Dar sarzamini Shom zindagi kuned. Pas chun k'iiomat shavad, kh'amaatonro baroi bozpursi ba maidoni makh'shar meorem."

105) Va Mo K'ur'onro bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba rosti nozil karda, dar on ba adolat, akhlok'i kh'amidaiu korkh'oi nek farmuda, az zulmu bedodi va akhlok'u korkh'oi bad nakh'i namudem va K'ur'on ba rosti va betag'iirot va takh'rifot nozil shuda ast. Va ei Paiombar, Mo turo nafiristodem, ch'uz ba sifati muzhdadikh'andai parkh'ezkoron ba ch'annat va tarsonandai kofironu isionkoron az duzakh.

106) Va K'ur'onro ch'udo-ch'udo nozil karda, bo tafsil baion sokhtem, to tu onro ba mardum oromona tilovat kuni, zero chunin khondan boisi andeshidan va khubtar dark namudani on megardad. Va Mo onro vobasta ba kh'odisakh'o va kh'olatkh'o parokanda-parokanda nozil kardem.

107) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Agar ba K'ur'on imon biiored, imon ovardanaton chizero ba on nameafzoiad io agar imon naored, kofir gashtanaton az on chizero kam namekunad." Ba durusti, on kasone, ki kitobkh'oi osmonii guzashtaro khonda, vakh'i va nubuvvatro shinokhtaand, chun ba onkh'o K'ur'on tilovat shavad, ba khotiri siposguzorii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar chekh'raashon ba zamin sach'dakunon meaftand.

108) Va dar sach'da meguiand: "Parvardigori mo az va'dakhilofi pok ast. On chi dar mavridi mab'us gashtani Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va'da doda ast, amali shuda ast. Beshak, va'dai Parvardigori mo dar in va digar mavridkh'o begumon vok'e'shavanda ast."

109) Va nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar chekh'rakh'oiashon ba zamin sach'dakunon aftida, az tarsi azobi U megiriand va shunidani K'ur'onu andeshidani ma'nokh'oi on shikastakh'olii onkh'oro dar barobari Parvardigorashon afzun megardonad.

110) Ei Paiombar, ba on kase, ki "Io Allokh', Io Rakh'mon" guftanatro inkor mekunad, bigu: "Kalimakh'oi "Allokh'" va "Rakh'mon" az nomkh'oi Parvardigorand. Pas Uro ba vasilai kh'ar iakei on io digar nomkh'oi zeboiash bikhoned." Va k'iroati namozatro az kh'ad ziiod baland makun, ki dar in surat mushrikon sadoiatro meshunavand va onro az kh'ad ziiod past makun, ki mu'minon sadoiatro nameshunavand va az baini in du rokh'i miionaro ch'ustuch'u namo.

111) Va ei Paiombar, bigu: "Sitoish Allokh'i arzandai kh'ama guna sutudankh'oro, ki az doshtani farzand va anboz pok meboshad va U dar podshokh'i sharik nadorad va ba U zillatu khori namerasad, ba kumak va madadi kh'ech' kas niiozmand nest." Va Uro ba buzurgii ziiod iod karda, ba U dar podshokh'i sharik, iovar va farzandro nisbat madekh'.

1) Sitoish bo sifatkh'oi ifodagari kamolu azamat va ne'matkh'oi oshkoru nikh'on khosi Khudoi Iagonaest, ki K'ur'onro ba Banda va Rasulash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozil namuda va dar on az kh'ak' kach'iero k'aror nadoda ast.

2) Balki onro Kitobi rost gardond, ki dar on ziddiiat va ikhtilof mavch'ud nest, to kofironro az azobi sakhte az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsonad va mu'minonero, ki korkh'oi shoista anch'om medikh'and, bashorat dikh'ad, ki onkh'oro podoshi nek ast. Kh'ech' podoshe ba podoshi onkh'o barobar nest.
3) Mu'minoni boamal dar on podoshi nek abadi memonand.

4) Va to in ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba vasilai K'ur'on k'avmi iakh'udu nasoro va ba'ze mushrikonero, ki meguiand: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi Khud farzand girifta ast.", az azob bitarsonad.

5) Na in gurukh'i durug'bofandagoni da'voi nisbat dodani farzand ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ilmu kh'uch'ch'at nadorand va na padaronashon, ki mushrikon dar in bobat ba onkh'o tak'lid kardaand. In kalimae, ki be tafakkur az zabonashon mebaroiad, bisior zisht ast. Onkh'o ch'uz sukhani durug'i besanad chize nameguiand.

6) Pas shoiad tu Paiombar agar onkh'o ba in K'ur'on imon naorand, az andukh'i ziiod khudro kh'alok gardoni. Chunin makun, zero vazifai tu tankh'o tablig' buda, kh'idoiati onkh'o dar ikhtiiori Parvardigor ast.
7) Beshak, Mo kulli mavch'udoti rui zaminro zinati on sokhtaem, to ozmoishashon kunem, ki chi kaseashon az rui amali pisandidai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bekh'tar va chi kaseashon badtarand.

8) Va iak'inan Mo kh'ama makhluk'oti rui zaminro ba khoki az giiokh' kholi tabdil medikh'em. In kh'odisa ba'd az intikh'oi kh'aioti mavch'udoti zamin surat megirad. Baroi kh'amin boiad onkh'o az in guftakh'o ibrat girand.

9) Ei Paiombar, k'issai askh'obi g'or va lavkh'aashonro, ki nomashon dar on navishta shuda bud, az nishonakh'oi taach'ch'ubovari Mo mapindor, balki digar nishonakh'oi k'udratamon ba misli osmonkh'ovu zamin az in k'issa taach'ch'ubovartar ast.

10) Ei Paiombar, on zamonero iod kun, ki iak gurukh' ch'avononi boimon bo mak'sadi nach'oti dini khesh firor karda, ba g'or panokh' burdand, pas dar duo khitob ba Parvardigorashon guftand: "Parvardigori mo, ba mo az nazdi Khud bo omurzidani gunokh'on va nach'ot dodan az dasti dushman rakh'mat bidekh' va az in koramon, ki imon ovarda, az nazdi kofiron kh'ich'rat namudem, baroiamon ba rokh'i kh'ak' va rosti kh'idoiat shudanro nasib bigardon."
11) Sipas ba'di raftan va ba g'or panokh' burdan bar gushkh'oiashon az shunidani sado parda zadem va bar onkh'o solkh'oi ziiod khobro afkandem.

12) Sipas onkh'oro ba'di khobi tuloniashon bedor kunonidem, to ba mardum ma'lum gardonem, ki kadom iake az du gurukh'i bo iakdigar oidi muddati dar g'or mondanashon bakh'skunanda muddati onch'o budanashonro dak'ik' kh'isob karda ast.

13) Ei Paiombar, Mo turo dar borai khabari onkh'o ba rostii ori az shak ogokh' mesozem. Iak'inan onkh'o ch'avonone budand, ki ba Parvardigori khud imon ovarda, az dasturoti U itoat kardand va Mo kh'idoiat va dar rokh'i kh'ak' ustuvor mondanashonro beshtar gardonidem.

14) Va dilashonro ba vositai imon, ustuvor mondan dar in ch'oda va sabr namudan dar tarki vatan k'uvvat bakhshidem. On gokh', ki dar nazdi podshokh'i kofir barkhosta, imonashon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro e'lon sokhta, pas ba u guftand: "Parvardigori mo, ki ba U imon dorem va ibodatash mekunem, Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin ast. Kh'argiz g'air az U ma'budkh'oi sun'iro nameparastem. Agar g'air az Uro biparastem, ba durusti, on vak't sukhani zolimonai dur az kh'ak'ik'at guftaem."

15) Sipas ba'zei on ch'avonon ba ba'zei digar nigarista guftand: "In k'avmi mo baroi ibodat ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'o giriftaand, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o dar borai durustii amalashon kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan nadorand. Pas kh'ech' kas az shakhse, ki bo nisbat dodani sharik dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' mebofad, zolimtar nest.-

16) Va chun az k'avmi khesh kanor rafted va on chiro, ki g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ibodat mekardand, tark karda, ch'uz Allokh'i Iagona kasero naparastided, pas bo mak'sadi nach'ot dodani dinaton ba g'or panokh' bared, to Parvardigoraton ba shumo az rakh'mati Khud gustaronida, az dushmanonaton kh'ifzaton kunad va baroiaton az kh'olati dar on k'aror doshtaaton vasoili zindagiro oson gardonad, ki az on dar ivazi makh'rum shudan az kh'amzistii k'avmaton manfiat mebared."

17) Pas on ch'avonon farmonro ich'ro kardand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar onkh'o khobro afkanda, az sharri dushmanon kh'ifzashon namud va ei binandai onkh'o, oftobro medidi, ki kh'angomi az mashrik' durakhshidan az g'ore, ki onkh'o k'aror doshtand, ba samti rosti dokhilash megardid va chun vak'ti g'urub nopadid meshud, ba samti dasti chapash gashta, ba g'or namerasid. Pas askh'obi g'or dar ch'oi doim soiador budand, garmoi oftob ozorashon namedod va dar ch'oi vasei g'or k'aror doshtand, kh'avo ba andozai zaruri baroiashon merasid. In dar g'or panokh' dodani onkh'o, afkandani khob bar eshon, ba samti chapu rost gashtani oftob, vus'ati makonashon va nach'ot dodanashon az dushmanon az nishonakh'oi kh'airatovari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, dalolatgari k'udrati ilokh'ist. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar ki tavfik'i kh'idoiatro dikh'ad, pas u kh'idoiatioftai vok'eist va kh'ar kiro az kh'idoiat makh'rum sokhta, gumrokh' sozad, pas kh'ech' gokh' baroiash iovarero nameiobi, ki ba u tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro dikh'ad. Zero tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rost tankh'o dar ikhtiiori Parvardigor ast.

18) Va ei binanda, tu onkh'oro az sababi boz budani chashmonashon bedor mepindoshti, kh'ol on ki dar vok'e' onkh'o khob budand va Mo onkh'oro dar kh'olati khob gokh'o ba sui rost va gokh'o ba sui chap megardondem, to in ki zamin ch'asadashonro nakhurad. Va sagi onkh'o du poiashro bar ostonai g'or daroz karda bud. Agar onkh'oro medidi, az tars az peshashon pusht tofta megurekhti va az didanashon vuch'udatro dakh'shat faro megirift.

19) Va chunonchi nishonakh'oi kh'airatovari k'udrati Khudro, ki nisbat ba onkh'o anch'om dodem, iod namudem, kh'amin guna onkh'oro ba'di guzashtani muddati tuloni az khob bedor sokhtem, to az iakdigar muddati dar khob budanashonro bipursand. Iakei onkh'o pursid, ki chi mik'dor dar khob buded? Ba'zeashon dar ch'avob guftand: "Iak io nim ruz dar khob budem." Va ba'zei digarashon, ki muddati khob raftanashon baroiash noma'lum bud, guft: "Parvardigoraton muddati dar kh'olati khob istodani shumoro bekh'tar medonad. Baroi kh'amin, ilmi in mas'alaro ba U kh'avola karda, sargarmi korkh'oe shaved, ki ba shumo alok'amandi va manfiat dorad. Pas az baini khud iakero bo in pulkh'oi nuk'ragin ba shakh'ri baroiamon ma'ruf firisted, pas vai nigokh' kunad, ki az akh'olii shakh'r ki taom va kasbi poktar dorad, pas az on baroiamon k'ute bierad va dar daromadanu baromadan va muomila bo mardum orom buda, mokh'iru furutanu khushakhlok' boshad va bo kh'arakati khato kore nakunad, ki kasero az makoni pinkh'onshudai shumo ogokh' sozad. Zero ma'lum shudani makoni pinkh'onshudai mo boisi pesh omadani zarari ziiode megardad.

20) Ba durusti ki agar k'avmaton az kh'oli shumo ogokh' gashta, dar borai ch'oi pinkh'onshudaaton ma'lumot ioband, ba vositai sangsor shumoro ba k'atl merasonand io shumoro ba dini botilashon, ki pesh az bo fazli Parvardigor kh'idoiat ioftanaton pairavash buded, barmegardonand va agar boz ba on oiin bargarded, digar kh'argiz dar duniovu okhirat rastagor nameshaved, balki dar kh'ardu ch'akh'on ba sababi tarki dini barkh'ak' va bozgasht ba dini botil ziioni buzurg mebined."

21) Va on guna ki Mo nisbat ba askh'obi g'or korkh'oi taach'ch'ubovari isbotkunandai k'udrati Kheshro ba misli solkh'oi ziiod dar kh'olati khob nigokh' doshtan va sipas az khob bedor kardan anch'om dodem, kh'amchunin akh'olii shakh'rashonro az kh'oli onkh'o ogokh' sokhtem, to onkh'o bidonand, ki va'dai Parvardigor dar borai piruzii mu'minon va zinda gashtani murdagon kh'ak' buda, dar omadani k'iiomat shakke nest. Chun kh'olati askh'obi g'or baroi mardumi on davr oshkor shud va onkh'o az dunio darguzashtand, shakhsoni az vok'eai eshon ogokh' bo iakdigar nazarkh'oi gunogun doshtand. Ikhtilofi onkh'o dar borai on bud, ki bo ch'avononi g'or chi kor kunand? Gurukh'e az mardum guftand: "Dar nazdi daromadgokh'i g'or imorate bisozed, ki onkh'oro az chashmi digaron pushida, mukh'ofizat kunad. Parvardigorashon kh'olashonro bekh'tar medonad. Zero az kh'olashon barmeoiad, ki onkh'o nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imtiioz doshtaand." Va shakhsoni sokh'ibnufuz, ki doroi ilm va da'vati durust nabudand, guftand: "Ba mak'sadi giromidosht va iodovarii ch'oigokh'i onkh'o, dar atrofi ch'oi k'arordoshtaashon baroi ibodat masch'ide mesozem."

22) Ba'ze kasoni dar sarguzashtashon ziiod fururafta dar mavridi adadashon khokh'and guft: "Onkh'o se shakhs budand, sagashon chorumashon bud." Va ba'zei digarashon guiand: "Onkh'o chor shakhs budand, sagashon panch'umashon bud." On chi kh'ardu gurukh' dar in mavrid meguiand, az rui pairavii gumonu takhmin va beasos ast. Va iak k'ismi digarashon guiand: "Onkh'o kh'aft shakhs budand, sagashon kh'ashtumashon bud." Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Parvardigoram adadashonro bekh'tar medonad. Adadashonro ch'uz iak gurukh'i andake, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o ta'lim doda ast, kasi digar namedonad." Pas, bo akh'li Kitob va g'airashon dar borai adadi askh'obi g'or va digar kh'olatashon ch'uz munozarai oshkor, ki dar on furu naravi, munozara makun. Tankh'o oidi onone az askh'obi g'or ch'idol kun, ki vobasta ba onkh'o baroiat vakh'i nozil shuda ast. Va dar borai tafsiloti kh'olati askh'obi g'or az akh'li Kitobu digaron mapurs. Chunki akh'li Kitob az tafsiloti in rukhdod ma'lumot nadorand.

23) Ei Paiombar, baroi chize, ki pagokh' k'asdi anch'omashro dori "Ba durusti ki fardo onro mekunam" magu. Zero namedoni, ki oio fardo onro karda metavoni, io iagon monea pesh meoiad.- In k'avli Parvardigor baroi kh'ar musalmon rakh'namoi ast.

24) Magar on ki anch'omi onro ba khosti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vobasta karda, "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ad, fardo on korro mekunam" bigui. Va agar guftanashro faromush kardi, pas bo guftani "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ad", Parvardigoratro iod kun va bigu: "Umed doram Parvardigoram maro ba chize, ki az rui kh'idoiat va tavfik' az in kor nazdiktar boshad, rakh'namoi khokh'ad kard."
25) Va askh'obi g'or dar g'orashon sesadu nukh' sol mondand.

26) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muddati dar g'or istodani onkh'oro bekh'tar medonad." Iak'inan Mo az muddati dar on ch'o istodani onkh'o khabar dodem. Ba'di sukhani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'avli kase e'tibor nadorad. Ofarinish va ilmi kh'ama mavch'udote, ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin g'oiband, tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat Bino ast, kh'amai chizro mebinad va bag'oiat Shunavo ast, kh'ama chizro meshunavad. Onkh'o g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korsoze nadorand, ki korkh'oiashonro korsozi kunad va kasero dar kh'ukmi Khesh sharik namegardonad, iagona kh'ukmfarmo Ust.

Vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati mazkur baion kard, ki kh'ukm az Ust, dar oiati zerin Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro ba khondan va pairavi namudani kh'ukmi ba suiash vakh'ishuda dastur doda guft:
27) Va ei Paiombar, K'ur'onero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tu vakh'i firistoda ast, khonda, mutobik'ash amal kun. Kalimoti U tag'iirdikh'anda nadorad, chunki on kh'amagi adolat va sadok'at ast. Va g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) panokh'gokh'ero nameiobi, ki panokh' bibari.

28) Va dar kh'amsukh'batii kasone, ki Parvardigorashonro dar avval va okhiri ruz (doimo) bo ikhlos meparastand va kh'och'at mekhokh'and, bimon. Va chashmonat az mu'minoni mukhlisi tangdast dur nashavad, dar kh'ole ki k'asdi kh'amnishini bo tavongaron va ashrofonro dori. Va az kase, ki k'albashro bo mukh'r nikh'odan bar on az zikramon g'ofil sokhtaem, itoat makun. On g'ofildil turo ba dur namudani fak'iron az mach'lisat amr karda va pairavii khostakh'oi nafsashro az itoati Parvardigorash pesh meguzorad va amalkh'oiash zoe'shudai bee'tibor ast.

29) Va ei Paiombar, ba in ch'amoai az iodi Khudo g'ofil bigu: "On chi baroiaton ovardaam, kh'ak'ik'ati az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton buda, boftavu sokhtai khudi man nest. Man da'vati shumoro oidi on ki mu'minoni tangdastro az mach'lisam bironam, k'abul namekunam. Pas kh'ar ki az miioni shumo ba in kh'ak'ik'at imon ovardan khokh'ad, pas ba on imon orad va ba zudi az podoshi rokh'i barguzidaash khushkh'ol megardad va kh'ar ki az miioni shumo ba on kofir shudan khokh'ad, pas kofir shavad va ba zudi ba sababi uk'ubati dar intizorash buda ba kh'olati bad duchor meshavad." Ba durusti ki Mo baroi shakhsoni bo barguzidani kufr bar ch'onashon zolim otashi azimero omoda sokhtaem, ki devori on ikh'otaashon mekunad, pas az azob gurekhtan nametavonand va agar az shiddati tashnagi ob khosta, talabi fariodrasi kunand, bo nushonidani obi monand ba ravg'ani tirai sakhtkh'arorat ba fariodashon rasida meshavad, on ob az garmii bisior chekh'raashonro birion mekunad. Chi bad ast in nushobae, ki ba vositai on ba dodashon rasida meshavad, pas on obi misli ravg'ani tira tashnagiashonro bartaraf namesozad, balki onro meafzoiad va alangai otashi bar chekh'raashon budaro khomush namegardonad va otashi ch'akh'annam, ki duzakhiion dar on furud meoiand va ch'oi megirand, manzilgokh'i nikh'oiat bad ast.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in oiatkh'o azobi baroi zolimon omodasokhtai Khudro zikr kard, dar oiati zerin podoshi baroi mu'minon omodashudaro baion namuda guft:
30) Ba durusti, kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista mekunand, dar kh'ak'ik'at kori nek namudaand, pas onkh'oro savobi azim ast va kh'amono Mo savobi kasero, ki kori nek anch'om doda ast, zoe' namesozem, balki ach'ri kardakh'oiashonro ba purragi medikh'em.

31) In ch'amoai bo imondori va anch'omi korkh'oi nek tavsifshudaro baroi istik'omati kh'ameshagi bustonkh'oest, ki dar on abadi memonand, az zeri manzilkh'oiashon rudkh'oi shirini bikh'isht ch'ori meboshad, onkh'o dar ch'annat bo dastmonakh'oi tilloi oroish doda meshavand va liboskh'oi sabzi az abreshimi tunuk va g'afs omodagashta mepushand, bar takhtkh'oi bo pardakh'oi zebo muzaiian takia mezanand. Savobi inkh'o bag'oiat khub ast. Va ch'annate, ki dar on istik'omat mekunand, manzilgakh'i nek ast.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi mazkur savobi mu'minon va zolimonro baion kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin baroi in du toifa masalero ovarda guft:
32) Va ei Paiombar, dostoni du mardero, ki iake kofir va digarash mu'min bud, baion kun. Mo az baini on du baroi kofirash du adad bog'e az angurkh'o dodem va on bog'kh'oro bo tokkh'oi angur ikh'ota kunonidem va dar masokh'ati kholii baini bog'kh'o ziroatkh'oro ruionidem.

33) Kh'ardui bog'kh'o makh'suloti khudro ba misli khurmovu anguru digar nav'i kh'osilotro ba bor meovard va az on chizero kam namekard, balki kh'osilotashro purra medod va dar baini on bog'kh'o bo mak'sadi ba osoni ob dodani ziroatkh'oi zamin nakh'rero ch'ori kardem.

34) Va sokh'ibi bog'kh'o g'air az in boiigari va makh'suloti digar niz dosht. Pas az rui g'urur bo mak'sadi ta'siri bad rasonidan ba rafik'i mu'minash dar kh'ole bo u guftugu mekard, guft: "Moli man az doroii tu beshtar buda va az nigokh'i k'avmdori va neru az tu boizzattar va nerumandtaram."

35) Va on mardi kofir dar kh'ole ki ba sababi kufr va kibru g'urur bar khud sitam karda bud, kh'amrokh'i rafik'i mu'minash ba bog'ash vorid shud, to onro ba rafik'ash namoish dikh'ad. U guft: "Gumon namekunam in bog'e, ki mebini fano shavad. Zero ba khotiri bok'i mondanash tamomi asbobro istifoda burdaam.-

36) Va gumon nadoram, ki k'iiomat barpo shavad. Beshak, in dunio kh'aioti doimi ast. Va agar ba farzi misol k'iiomat barpo shavad, pas chun boz zinda shuda, ba sui Parvardigoram bargardonida shavam, begumon ba'di zinda shudan ch'oi bozgashtero meiobam, ki az in bog' bekh'tar ast. Zero dar dunio tavongar budanam, tak'ozo mekunad, ki ba'di dubora zindashavi niz tavongar bosham."

37) Rafik'i mu'minash dar kh'ole ki az rokh'i guftugu bo kh'amsukh'bati kofirash raddu badal mekard, ba u guft: "Oio ba on Zote, ki padarat Odamro az khok, ba'd az on turo az obi mani khalk' kard, sipas turo mardi doroi a'zoi badani barobaru komil sokht, kofir shudai?! On Khudoe, ki ba anch'omi in guftakh'o k'udrat dorad, baroi dubora turo zinda sokhtan niz K'odir meboshad.
38) Valekin man sukhani guftai turo nameguiam, balki meguiam: "U Allokh' Parvardigori Poki man ast, ki az fazlash ba man neki karda ast va kh'argiz kasero dar ibodat sharikash namegardonam. -

39) Va charo vak'ti ba bog'at daromadan "Kh'ar chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khost, kh'amon meshavad", "Kh'ech' kas ch'uz ba iorii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'uvvat nadorad", nagufti?! Zero U Parvardigorest, ki kh'ar chi khokh'ad, mekunad va tankh'o U doroi nerui vok'eist. Pas agar tu maro az khudat fak'irtar va adadi farzandonamro kamtar mebini,-

40) pas shoiad, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba man az bog'i tu bekh'tarro dikh'ad va bar bog'i tu az osmon ofatero firistad, pas bustonat ba zamini begiiokh', ki k'adam dar on ba sababi narmiash melag'zhad, mubaddal gardad,-
41) io obi on ba zeri zamin furu ravad, pas ba kh'ech' rokh'e onro ba dast ovarda natavoni. Chun obash zeri zamin furu ravad, digar on buston bok'i namemonad."

42) Va on chi mardi mu'min tavak'k'u' dosht, takh'ak'k'uk' paido kard. Pas nobudi makh'suloti bustoni kofirro ikh'ota namud, ba'd az in on mardi kofir az shiddati kh'asratu pushaimonii molkh'oi dar imorat va islokh'i bog' kharch' kardaash dastonashro ba kh'am mezad va bog' bar sutunkh'oi khud, ki bar on shokhakh'oi toki angur kashida meshud, furu aftoda bud va meguft: "Ei kosh, ba Parvardigori Iagonaam imon meovardam va kasero dar ibodat shariki U namesokhtam."

43) Va in mardi kofir ch'amoae nadosht, ki uro az uk'ubati az osmon furudomada kh'imoiat kunand, dar kh'ole k'ablan az doshtani tarafdoronu kheshovandoni ziiod iftikhor dosht va az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bog'ashro nobud gardonid, intik'om giriftan natavonist.

44) In ch'o piruzi tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va savobash ba bandagoni mu'minash, ki podoshi duchandashon medikh'ad, bekh'tarin va saranch'omash ba bandagoni tavbakori mu'minash bekh'tarin ast.

45) Va ei Paiombar, baroi shakhsoni fireftai dunio masalero baion kun. Dunio dar zavolpaziri va sur'ati siparishaviash ba monandi obi boronest, ki Mo onro az osmon furud ovardem, pas ba vositai in ob rastani ruiida, zamoni chidanash faro rasid, pas on rastani on chunon shikastavu pora gardid, ki bodkh'o ch'uz'kh'oi porashudai onro parokanda sokhta, ba digar gushakh'o meburd, pas zamin ba kh'olati k'abli bargasht. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ama chiz k'udratmand ast, chize Uro notavon gardonida nametavonad, ba kh'ar chi khokh'ad, kh'aiot mebakhshad va kh'ar chiro khokh'ad, nobud mesozad.

46) Mol va farzandon az vasoili zinati zindagonii dunio kh'astand. Mol ruzi k'iiomat kh'ech' sude nadorad, magar on ki dar rokh'i rizoi ilokh'i kharch' shuda boshad. Va korkh'ovu guftorkh'oi shoista nazdi Parvardigorat az rui savob az zinati dunio bekh'tar buda va on bekh'tarin umed va orzust. Zero zinati dunio fano meshavad, ammo savobi kirdorkh'o va guftorkh'oi mavridi pisandi Parvardigor ch'ovidon ast.

47) Va ruzero iod kun, ki dar on kukh'kh'oro az ch'oiashon dur mekunem va zaminro ba sababi az bainravii kukh'kh'o va darakhtonu imoratkh'o namoion mebini va tamomi makhluk'otro dubora zinda karda, ch'am' mesozem. Pas az onkh'o kasero nameguzorem, magar on ki zindaash megardonem.

48) Va mardum ba nazdi Parvardigorat dar kh'ole kh'ama saf zadaand, kh'ozir karda meshavand va ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Kh'amono imruz nazdi Mo tankh'o, poiluch, barakh'nai khatnanoshuda omaded, chunonchi bori nakhust shumoro kh'amin guna ofaridem, balki gumon karded, ki kh'argiz az nav zinda nameshaved va gumon karded, ki Mo baroi ch'azo dodani shumo zamonu makonero muk'arrar namekunem."

49) Va Kitob a'mol guzoshta meshavad. Pas ba'zekh'o onro bo dasti rost va ba'zei digar bo dasti chap megirand. Ei inson, tu ba'd az in kofironro az on chi dar on Kitob mavch'ud ast, dar kh'olati tars mebini. Zero onkh'o kufru gunokh'oni kardaashonro medonand va meguiand: "Ei voi bar mo! In chi Kitobest, ki kh'ech' kirdori khurdu kaloni moro naguzoshta, magar in ki onro shumorida, kh'ifz karda ast." Va onkh'o tamomi gunokh'oni dar dunio sodirkardaashonro dar on Kitob navishtai sabtshuda meioband va ei Paiombar, Parvardigorat dar kh'ak'k'i kase zulm namekunad, kh'ech' kasro begunokh' ch'azo namedikh'ad va az podoshi ibodati bandai farmonbardor chizero kam namegardonad.

50) Va ei Paiombar, iod kun on vak'tero, ki ba farishtagon guftem: "Nazdi Odam bo k'asdi arzi salom sach'da kuned." Pas kh'amagi baroi ich'roi farmoni Parvardigorashon sach'da kardand, magar Iblise, ki az ch'umlai ch'inkh'o buda, farishta nabud, pas u az ich'roi amri Khudo sarpechi karda, az sach'da kibr varzida, az itoati Parvardigorash berun shud. Ei mardum, oio shumo Iblisro bo farzandonash g'airi Man baroi khud dust megired, kh'ol on ki onkh'o dushmanaton kh'astand?! Pas chi guna dushmani khudro dust k'aror medikh'ed?! Kirdori zolimone, ki dar ivazi dusti bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shaitonro baroi khud dust intikhob kardaand, bisior bad ast.

51) In kasone, ki ch'uz Man dust giriftaed, misli shumo bandaand. Vak'te Man osmonkh'ovu zaminro ofaridam, onkh'oro shokh'idi ofarinishi on nasokhtaam, balki onkh'o on zamon vuch'ud nadoshtand va ba'zeashonro dar ofarinishi ba'zeashon shokh'id nagardonidaam. Zero iagona sokh'ibi ofarinish va tadbir Man mebosham. Va shaitonkh'oi insivu ch'inniero, ki digaronro gumrokh' mesozand, baroiam iovar nagiriftaam, chunki Man az iovaron beniiozam.

52) Va ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o ruzi k'iiomatro zikr kun, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mushrikon meguiad: "Ma'budkh'oero, ki ba da'voi shumo anbozkh'oi Man budand, da'vat kuned, shoiad baroiaton kumak rasonand." Pas mushrikon ma'budkh'oro da'vat mekunand, onkh'o da'vati obidonashonro namepazirand va kumakashon namerasonand va Mo baini butparastonu ma'budkh'oiashon makoni kh'alokati mushtarak k'aror dodaem. On makoni kh'alokati mushtarak otashi duzakh ast.
53) Va mushrikon otashi ch'akh'annamro bo chashm mebinand, pas iak'in mekunand, ki kh'atman giriftori duzakh meshavand va az on baroi ak'ib gashtan ch'oero nameioband.

54) Va kh'amono Mo dar in K'ur'oni bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilshuda bo shevakh'oi gunogun masalkh'oi mukhtalifi ziiodro baion sokhtem, to insonkh'o az on pand girand, lekin beshtarin chize, ki az ch'onibi khususan insoni kofir oshkor meshavad, ch'idoli nokh'ak' ast.

55) Va kofironro az imon ovardan ba Kitobi az sui Parvardigor ovardai Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va omurzishkhokh'i az Parvardigorashon nuk'soni baion boz nadoshta ast. Dar K'ur'on baroi onkh'o masali ziiod baion shuda va kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi vozekh' omada ast. Kofironro az imon ovardan va omurzish khostan on man' namuda ast, ki onkh'o bo iakravi talab dorand, to azobi ummatkh'oi sobik' baroi eshon vok'e' shavad va uk'ubati va'dashudaro bo chashm mushokh'ida kunand.

56) Va paiombaronamonro namefiristem, magar muzhdarasoni akh'li imonu ibodat va bimdikh'andai akh'li kufru ma'siiat. Onkh'o bar k'albkh'oi bandagon bo vodor kardanash ba kh'idoiat tasallut nadorand. Va kofiron sarfi nazar az vozekh' budani daloil bo paiombaron munozara mekunand, to ba vositai botili khesh kh'ak'ik'ati bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilgashtaro az bain barand. Va onkh'o K'ur'on va on chiro, ki az on bim doda shudand, ba mazkh'aka va maskhara megirand.

57) Va nest sitamgortar az shakhse, ki ba vositai oiatkh'oi Parvardigorash pand doda shudaast, pas U nisbat ba uk'ubati takh'didshudaash beparvoi namuda az on oiatkh'o ibrat namegirad, va rui tofta kufru ma'siiatkh'oi dar zindagonii dunio anch'om dodaashro faromush sokhta tavba namekunad. Iak'inan Mo bar k'albi shakhsoni doroi sifatkh'oi mazkur pardakh'oero kashidaem, ki az fakh'mi K'ur'on man'ashon mesozad va dar gushkh'oiashon sanginiro guzoshtaem, pas in ch'amoa onro dar amal nameshunavand va agar ba imon ovardan da'vatashon kuni, pas modom ki dar k'albashon parda va dar gushkh'oiashon sangini guzoshta shuda ast, kh'argiz da'vati turo namepazirand. Baroi on ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar mavzui az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) darkhosti zudtar ch'azo dodani takzibgaron lab nakushoiand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati zerin ba on kas khitob karda guft:

58) Va ei Paiombar, Parvardigorat Bakhshandai gunokh'i tavbakoron, Sokh'ibi rakh'mati farogirandai kh'amai chiz ast. Az rakh'matkh'oi ilokh'i on ast, ki ba isionkoron mukh'lat medikh'ad, to az gunokh' tavba kunand. Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in toifai az kh'ak'ik'at ruitoftaro ch'azo medod, beshubkh'a, dar kh'amin dunio favran baroi onkh'o azob meovard, lekin U Zoti Burdbori Mekh'rubon ast. Azobashonro ba ta'khir guzosht, to az amalkh'oi bad tavba kunand. Balki onkh'oro zamonu makoni muaiianest, ki dar surati tavba nakardan dar on zamonu makoni ta'iingardida baroi kufr va az rokh'i rost rui toftanashon ch'azo doda meshavand. Kh'ech' gokh' g'airi on panokh'gokh'e nameioband, ki dar on panokh' barand.

59) Va on akh'li kofiri dekh'akh'oi ba shumo nazdik ba monandi dekh'ai k'avmi Kh'udu Solekh'u Shuaib vak'te bo kufru gunokh' bar ch'onashon sitam kardand, kh'alokashon kardem va baroi kh'alok sokhtanashon vak'ti muaiian muk'arrar namudem.

60) Va ei Paiombar, vak'tero iod kun, ki Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba khodimash Iusha' ibni Nun guft: "Kh'amvora to rasidanam ba makh'alli ch'am'shavii du dario rokh' meravam io to vak'ti bo bandai neki Khudo mulok'ot karda, az u donish giriftanam muddati durudaroz rokh' meravam."

61) Pas kh'ardu ba rokh' baromadand. Chun ba makh'alli ch'am'shavii du dario rasidand, mokh'ii birionashonro, ki kh'amchun tushai safar girifta budand, faromush kardand. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mokh'iro zinda gardonid va on mokh'i dar dario rokh'ashro, ki ba nak'b monandi doshta, du tarafi ob bo kh'am ch'am' nameshud, pesh girift.
62) Pas chun onkh'o az on makon guzashtand, Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba khidmatgorash guft: "Khuroki pagokh'iamonro bidekh'. Dar kh'ak'ik'at az in safaramon bo dushvorii sakht rubaru shudem."

63) Khidmatgori Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Vak'te ba kharsang panokh' burdem, didi, ki chi kh'odisa rukh dod?! Pas kh'amono man faromush kardam, ki kh'olati mokh'iro ba tu guiam va onro az khotiram ba ch'uz Shaiton kase naburda ast. Mokh'i zinda shud va dar bakh'r rokh'ero baroi khud pesh girift, ki kasro ba kh'airat meovard."

64) Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba khodimash guft: "On chi mech'ustem, kh'amin ast. In nishonai makoni bandai solekh'i Khudost." Pas az onch'o ba ak'ibashon bozgashta, paikh'oi k'adamashonro ch'ustand, to az rokh'e, ki omada budand, berun nashavand. Ba'di bargasht va ch'ustuch'u ba nazdi kharsang va az onch'o ba makoni daromadai mokh'i rasidand.

65) Pas chun ba makoni gumshudai mokh'i rasidand, onch'o bandae az bandagoni solekh'i Moro paido kardand. Mo ba on bandai solekh'amon az nazdi Khud rakh'mat doda va az nazdamon baroiash donishe, ki mardum az on ogokh'i nadorand, omukhta budem. On chiro in k'issai K'ur'oni karim dar bar girifta ast, donishi atokardai Parvardigor ba Khazir (alaikh'is salom) kh'amin ast.

66) Muso (alaikh'is salom) bo furutani va narmi ba vai guft: "Oio az tu pairavi kunam, ba sharti on ki maro az ilmi ba tu omuzonidai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki donishi rokh'iobi ast, biomuzoni?"
67) Khazir (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Iak'inan tu bar donishe, ki bo man mebini, tavoni sabrro nadori. Zero donishi man bo ilmi tu muvofik'at namekunad.
68) Va chitavr dar korkh'oe, ki dar on rokh'i durustro namedoni -zero tu dar borai on ba k'adri donishat kh'ukm mekuni-, sabr karda metavoni?!"

69) Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ad, maro dar barobari korkh'oe, ki az ch'onibi tu mebinam, bosabru farmonbardorat khokh'i ioft va man kh'ech' amri turo nofarmoni namekunam."

70) Khazir (alaikh'is salom) ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Agar maro pairavi kuni, pas manro az korkh'oi mekardaam, ki onro mebini, az chize namepursi, to on ki khudam sharkh'u baioni kh'ak'ik'ati onro og'oz kunam."

71) Pas chun dar in bora ittifok' kardand, ba sui sokh'ili dario raftand, to on ki kishtiero vokhurdand. Ba kishti az sababi ekh'tirom doshtani sokh'ibonash ba Khazir (alaikh'is salom) biduni mablag' savor shudand, ba'd az in Khizr (alaikh'is salom) bo barkandani iake az takhtakh'oi kishti onro surokh kard. Dar kh'ol Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba u guft: "Oio kishtiero, ki mardumi on moro biduni mablag' savor kardand, bo mak'sadi g'ark'sozii savoragonash surokh kardi? Ba durusti ki kori badi buzurge anch'om dodi."
72) Khazir (alaikh'is salom) ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Oio ba tu naguftam, bar on chi az ch'onibi man mebini, kh'argiz sabr karda nametavoni?!"
73) Muso (alaikh'is salom) dar ch'avob guft: "Maro baroi on ki bo faromushi paimoni bo tu bastaamro tark kardam, ik'ob makun va bar man dar kh'amsukh'bat shudanam bo tu fishor naor va sakht magir."

74) Boz ba'di az kishti faromadan ba sokh'ili dario rakh'sipor shudand, pas pisarbachai nobolig'ero didand, ki bo digar kudakon bozi mekard. Khizr (alaikh'is salom) uro ba k'atl rasonid. Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba u guft: "Oio insoni poki nobolig'i begunokh'ro ba k'atl merasoni?! Ba durusti ki kori zishte kardi."
75) Khazir (alaikh'is salom) ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Muso, man ba tu gufta budam, iak'inan tu bo man bar korkh'oi mekardaam sabr karda nametavoni."

76) Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Agar ba'di in bor az tu chizero pursam, pas maro az khud ch'udo bisoz. Dar kh'ak'ik'at on gokh' ba okhirin markh'ila, ki dar tarki kh'amsukh'batii man ma'zur donista meshavi, merasi. Zero dar on surat man farmoni turo se marotiba khilof kardaam."

77) Boz ba rokh' baromadand, to on ki chun nazdi akh'li dekh'ae omadand, az onkh'o taom khostand, pas sokinoni on dekh'a az taom dodanashon va ba ch'o ovardani kh'ak'k'i mekh'moniashon khuddori namudand. Pas Musovu Khazir dar on dekh'a devori bog'ero ioftand, ki ba suk'ut va kharob shudan nazdik bud. Pas Khazir (alaikh'is salom) on devorro ustuvoru rost kard. Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba vai guft: "Agar muzdi kori kardaatro giriftan mekhosti, onro megirifti, chunki ba'di az mekh'mondoriamon khuddori kardani sokinoni in dekh'a, ba mablag' niioz dorem."

78) Khazir (alaikh'is salom) ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "In e'tirozat ba nagiriftani kh'ak'i kor makh'alli ch'udoi baini man va baini tust. Ba zudi baroiat tafsiri korkh'oero, ki az ch'onibi man dida, bar on sabr nakardi, khabar khokh'am dod.

79) Ammo kishtie, ki baroi surokh kardanash ba man erod girifti, az shakhsoni notavone bud, ki dar bakh'r ba vasilai on kor mekardand, k'udrati kh'imoiatashro nadoshtand. Pas bo surokh sokhtani kishti khostam onro illatdor kunam, to on kishti ba dasti podshokh'i peshi ruiashon buda k'aror nagirad. On podshokh' kh'ar kishtii solimro az sokh'ibonash bo mach'buri megirift va ba kishtii illatdor dastdarozi namekard.

80) Ammo pisarbachae, ki baroi kushtanash ba man erod girifti, pas padaru modarash mu'min va khudash dar ilmi Khudo kofir bud. Pas khavfi onro doshtem, ki agar ba balog'at birasad, volidainashro az rui ba vai mukh'abbati bisior doshtanashon io ba sababi kh'och'atmandiashon ba vai ba tug'ionkori va kufr vodor mesozad.

81) Pas khostem Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ivazash ba onkh'o farzande dikh'ad, ki az rui diionatu poki az gunokh' az on pisarbacha bekh'tar va az rui mekh'ruboni ba padaru modar nazdiktar boshad.

82) Va ammo devori bog'e, ki obod kardam va ba man erod girifti, az du kudaki khurdsoli iatimi sokini shakh'ri raftaamon buda, dar zeri on molashon dafnshuda bud. Pas ei Muso, Parvardigorat khost, ki onkh'o ba sinni balog'at rasand va moli khudro az zeri on devor berun orand. Zero agar devor kh'ozir aftad, molashon oshkor va nobud megardad. In tadbir rakh'mati Parvardigorat dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o bud va in korkh'oro az ich'tikh'odam nakardaam. Tafsiri korkh'oe, ki bo didani on sabr karda natavonisti, kh'amin ast.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi mazkur k'issai Khazir (alaikh'is salom)-ro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin sarguzashti Zulk'arnainro ovard, chunki miioni on du alok'amandi mavch'ud ast, zero kh'ardu baroi pushtibonii zaifon kushish kardaand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'amin munosibat guft:
83) Va ei Paiombar, mushrikon va iakh'udikh'o bo mak'sadi ozmoish turo az khabari Zulk'arnain mepursand. Bigu: "Kh'atman ba shumo az khabari Zulk'arnain poraero khokh'am khond, to az on pand bigired."
84) Kh'amono Mo ba u dar zamin kh'ukm va k'udrat dodem va az kh'ar chiz rokh'u ravishi rasidan ba mak'sadashro ato namudem.
85) Pas u kh'amai rokh'u ravishkh'oi ba mak'sad rasidanro, ki baroiash dodem, istifoda burd va ba samti g'arb kh'arakat kard.

86) Vai rakh'sipor shud, to on ki vak'te az samti mag'ribi oftob dar nazar ba okhiri zamin rasid, oftobro did, ki misle dar chashmai purkh'arorati doroi gili siiokh' g'urub mekunad va nazdi makoni g'urubi oftob k'avmi kofirero paido kard. Mo ba u ikhtiior doda guftem: "Ei Zulk'arnain, io in mardumro az rokh'i k'atl va digar rokh'kh'o azob medikh'i va io dar kh'ak'k'ashon neki mekuni."

87) Zulk'arnain guft: "Ammo kh'ar ki ba'di ba ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) da'vat namudani mo shirk ovarda, in gunokh'ro idoma dikh'ad, pas ba zudi dar dunio ba vositai k'atl uro much'ozot mekunem, sipas ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigorash barmegardad, pas Parvardigorash uro azobi mudkh'ish medikh'ad.

88) Va ammo kh'ar ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda va amali shoista anch'om dikh'ad, pas uro bikh'isht ast. Ch'annat az ch'onibi Parvardigor baroi mu'minoni boamal podosh meboshad va ba zudi nisbatash az farmoni khesh dasturi narmu muloimero sodir mesozem."
89) Sipas vai rokh'i khilofi iakumro dunbol karda, ba samti tului oftob rakh'sipor gasht.

90) Vai ba rokh' baromad, to on ki vak'te dar nazar ba makoni tului oftob rasid, oftobro paido kard, ki bar k'avme metobad, ki baroi mukh'ofizatashon az oftob vasilakh'oero ba monandi imoratkh'o va soiakh'oi darakhton k'aror nadodadaem.
91) Kori Zulk'arnain kh'amin guna bud. Va kh'amono ilmi Mo tamomi neru va saltanati uro ikh'ota namuda bud.
92) Sipas vai g'airi du rokh'i avval, rokh'i digarero miioni mashrik'u mag'rib dunbol namud.
93) Rakh'sipor shud, to on ki ba rakhnai miioni du kukh' rasid, pas az tarafi on kukh'kh'o k'avmero ioft, ki k'arib sukhani kasero namefakh'mand.

94) Onkh'o guftand: "Ei Zulk'arnain, beshak, Ia'ch'uch'u Ma'ch'uch' dar zamin bo rokh'i kushtor va digar vositakh'o fasodkori dorand. Pas oio mik'dori molero baroiat muk'arar kunem, ba sharti on ki miioni movu onkh'o devor bisozi?"

95) Zulk'arnain guft: "Mulk va saltanatero, ki Parvardigoram ba man ruzi karda ast, baroiam az mole, ki shumo medikh'ed, bekh'tar meboshad. Pas maro ba vositai korgaron va abzori kori kumak kuned, to miioni shumovu onkh'o devor bisozam.

96) Porakh'oi okh'anro kh'ozir kuned." Pas porakh'oi okh'anro kh'ozir namudand. Zulk'arnain bo porakh'oi okh'an baini du kukh' sokhtani devorro og'oz kard, to on ki bo bino baini du kukh'ro barobar sokht, ba korgaron guft: "Bar in porakh'oi okh'an otash afruzed." To on ki on k'it'akh'oi okh'an surkh gasht, guft: "Baroiam mis biovared, to bar on birezam."
97) Pas Ia'ch'uch'u Ma'ch'uch' az sababi baland budani devori sokhtai Zulk'arnain boloi on baromada natavonistand va az tarafi poion onro surokh kh'am karda natavonistand, zero khele sakht bud.

98) Zulk'arnain guft: "In devor rakh'mate az sui Parvardigori man ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo in vosita Ia'ch'uch'u Ma'ch'uch'ro az fasodkori dar zamin boz medorad va mardumro az sharri onkh'o mukh'ofizat mekunad. Pas chun pesh az barposhavii k'iiomat zamoni baroi berun shudani onkh'o muaiian namudai Parvardigoram faro rasad, U in devorro ba zamin kh'amvor mesozad va va'dai Parvardigoram dar borai ba zamin kh'amvor sokhtani devor va khuruch'i Ia'ch'uch'u Ma'ch'uch' kh'ak' buda, khilof nameshavad."

99) Va dar okhirzamon khaloik'ro bek'aror va ba'zero bo ba'zeashon omekhta mesozem. Va dar sur damida meshavad, pas kh'ama khaloik'ro baroi bozpursi va giriftani podosh ba tavri kh'airatovar ch'am' meorem.
100) Va duzakhro baroi kofiron ba surati bisior ravshan namoion megardonem, to onro mushokh'ida kunand.

101) Onro baroi kofirone namoion mesozem, ki dar dunio az iodi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kur budand, zero bar chashmonashon pardai monei iodi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bud va oiatkh'oi Moro dar amal shunida nametavonistand.

102) Oio on kasone ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudaand, gumon dorand, ki bandagoni Maro az farishtagonu paiombaronu shaiotin ch'uz Man ma'bud megirand va in kor Maro ba khashm nameorad va ch'azoiashon namedikh'am?! Ba durusti ki Mo ch'akh'annamro kh'amchun manzili istik'omatii doimii kofiron omoda namudaem.
103) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei mardum, oio shumoro az kasone, ki az baini bandagon az likh'ozi amal ziionkorontarin insonkh'o kh'astand, bokhabar sozam?

104) Onkh'o kasonean, ki ruzi k'iiomat mebinand, ki taloshi dar dunio kardaashon zoe' shuda ast, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o mepindorand, ki dar sa'ii khesh nekukorand va az kardakh'oiashon manfiat mebarand. Ammo vok'eiiat khilofi pindori onkh'ost."

105) In ch'amoa kasoneand, ki ba oiatkh'oi dalolatkunandai tavkh'idi Parvardigorashon va mulok'oti U kofir shudaand, pas amalkh'oi onkh'o ba sababi kofir gashtan botil shuda ast. Ba kh'amin sabab ruzi k'iiomat onkh'o nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) arzishe nadorand.
106) In ch'azoi baroiashon omodashuda ch'akh'annam ast, ba sababi on ki onkh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudand va oiatkh'oi Maro va paiombaroni Maro maskhara giriftand.

Pas az on, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'azoi kofironro zikr namud, ba zikri ch'azoi mu'minon shuru' namuda guft:
107) Kh'amono kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardand va korkh'oi nek kardand, manzili onkh'o baroi arch'guzoriashon bolotarin darach'akh'oi bikh'isht ast.
108) Onkh'o dar ch'annat ba tavri abadi memonand, az on ba ch'oi digar raftanro talab namekunand, zero kh'ech' podoshe ba bikh'ishtu ne'matkh'oi on barobar nameshavad.

109) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Kh'amono kalimoti Parvardigoram ziiod ast. Pas agar obi dario baroi navishtani on ba rang tabdil gardad, beshak, obi dario pesh az anch'om ioftani kalimakh'oi Parvardigoram tamom meshavad va agar dariokh'oi digarero biiorem, onkh'o niz tamom meshavand."

110) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ba durusti, man monandi shumo bashar kh'astam, ba suiam vakh'i firistoda meshavad, ki Ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ii shumo, Ma'budi iagona ast. U Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Pas kh'ar ki az mulok'oti Parvardigorash metarsad, pas boiad amali kholisonai ba shariat mutobik' anch'om dikh'ad va dar ibodati Parvardigori khesh kasero sharik nagardonad."
1) "Kof. Kh'o. Io. Ain. Sod." Dar og'ozi surai "Bak'ara" sukhan oidi oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) In zikri rakh'mati Parvardigorat bar bandaash Zakariio (alaikh'is salom) ast. Onro baroiat bo mak'sadi ibrat giriftanat k'issa mekunem.
3) On gokh', ki u Parvardigorashro pinkh'oni duo kard, to duoiash ba k'abulshavi nazdiktar boshad.

4) Vai guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, Ba durusti ki ustukhonkh'oiam notavon shuda va safedii muii saram ziiod gashta ast va kh'ech' gokh' az duoi Tu bebakh'ra nabudam, balki kh'ar vak't Turo duo kardaam, onro paziruftai.

5) Va kh'amono man az on khavf doram, ki kheshovandonam ba'di margam mashg'uli dunio gardida, kh'uk'uk'i dinro ba ch'o nameorand va kh'amsaram nozoi ast, tavallud karda nametavonad. Pas baroiam az nazdi Khesh farzandi iorirason ato kun,-
6) farzande, ki az man nubuvvatro meros mebarad va onro az khonadoni Ia'k'ub meros mebarad va ei Parvardigoram, uro dar dinu akhlok'u donishash pisandida bigardon."

7) Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) duoi Zakariio (alaikh'is salom)-ro pazirufta nidoiash kard: "Ei Zakariio, Ba durusti ki Mo baroi tu on chiro, ki az shunidanash shodmon meshavi, khabar medikh'em. Begumon duoi turo paziruftem va ba tu pisare bo nomi Iakh'io medodem, pesh az u in nomro ba kasi digar naguzoshtaem."

8) Zakariio (alaikh'is salom) bo kh'airat az k'udrati Khudo pursid: "Parvardigoro, chi guna man sokh'ibi farzand meshavam, dar kh'ole ki kh'amsaram zani nozoi ast va man niz ba okhiri pironsoli va za'fi ustukhonkh'oiam rasidaam?!"

9) Farishtai vobastashuda guft: "Kor kh'amon gunae ast, ki megui, kh'amsarat zani nozoi va khudat az kh'isobi pironsoli va notavonii ustukhonkh'oi badanat ba okhiri umr rasidai, lekin Parvardigorat gufta ast: "Ofaridani Iakh'io az modari nozoi va padari ba okhiri umr rasida baroi Man khele oson ast va ei Zakariio, beshak, pesh az in turo dar kh'ole ki chize nabudi va vuch'ud nadoshti, ofaridam."

10) Zakariio (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, baroi oromii dilam ba man alomate muk'arrar soz, ki ba vok'e'shavii muzhdai ovardai farishtagon dalolat kunad." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft: "Nishonai tu baroi rukh dodani muzhdai ovardai farishtagon on ast, ki se ruz be iagon bemori, dar kh'olati tandurusti sukhan gufta nametavoni."

11) Pas Zakariio (alaikh'is salom) az namozgokh'i khesh nazdi k'avmash baromad, pas be sukhan ba onkh'o bo in ma'no ishora kard, ki: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dar avval va okhiri ruz ba poki iod kuned."

12) Pas Iakh'ioi pisari Zakariio (alaikh'is salom) ba dunio omad. Vak'te Iakh'io ba sinni shoistai khitob rasid, ba vai guftem: "Ei Iakh'io, Tavrotro bo ch'iddiiat va talosh bigir." Va ba u dar khurdsoli fakh'm, ilm, ch'iddiiat va iroda doda budem.
13) Va ba u az nazdi Khesh rakh'mat dodem va az gunokh'on pokash sokhtem va u bandai parkh'ezkor bud, dasturoti ilokh'iro ba ch'o ovarda, az korkh'oi mamnu' kh'azar mekard.

14) Va u dar kh'ak'k'i padaru modarash nekukori mekh'rubon bud va az itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va volidainash kibr namevarzid, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va padaru modarashro nofarmoni namekard.

15) Va bar u az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ruzi vilodatash va ruze, ki memirad va ruze, ki dar k'iiomat bori digar zinda barangekhta meshavad, salom bod. In se mavridi zikrshuda vakh'shatnoktarin markh'ilai kh'aioti inson ast. Vak'te Iakh'io (alaikh'is salom) dar in markh'ilakh'o emin mond, dar g'airi on kh'ech' khavfe bar vai nest.
16) Va ei Paiombar, dar K'ur'oni bar tu nozilshuda khabari Mariam (alaikh'is salom)-ro iod kun. On gokh', ki az nazdi akh'lash kanor raft va dar makone az samti shark'ii onkh'o tankh'o mond.

17) Pas Mariam baroi khud dar barobari k'avmash pardae girift, ki uro az chashmi onkh'o va digaron bipushonad, to vak'ti ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro nabinand. Ba'd az in Mo ba suiash Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom)-ro firistodem. Pas Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom) dar nazdash ba surati insoni durustandom namoion gardid. Mariam (alaikh'is salom) az on tarsid, ki vai nisbatash badi mekhokh'ad.

18) Pas vak'te ki Mariam (alaikh'is salom) Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom)-ro ba surati inson did, ki nazdash meoiad, guft: "Ei shakhs, kh'amono man az badii tu ba Allokh'i Mekh'rubon panokh' mebaram, agar botak'vo va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) metarsida boshi."
19) Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Man odami nestam. Ba durusti ki man firistodai Parvardigorat kh'astam. Maro ba sui tu firistod, to baroiat farzandi poke ato kunam."

20) Mariam (alaikh'is salom) bo taach'ch'ub pursid: "Chitavr man sokh'ibi farzand meshavam va kh'ol on ki bo man na shavkh'ar va na kasi digar nazdiki nakarda ast va zani zinokor nestam, to farzand doshta bosham?"

21) Ch'abrail ba vai guft: "Kh'ak'ik'at kh'amon tavr ast, ki gufti, na shavkh'ar va na kase bo tu nazdiki nakarda ast va zani zinokor kh'am nesti, lekin Parvardigorat guft: "Baroiam be padar ofaridani farzand kori khele oson ast va to farzandi ba tu bakhshidashuda baroi mardum alomati isbotkunandai k'udrati Parvardigor va az ch'onibi Mo baroi tuvu kase, ki ba vai imon orad, moiai rakh'mat boshad. Va in ofarinishi farzandat az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tak'diri muk'addarshuda va dar Lavkh'i makh'fuz sabtgashta meboshad."
22) Pas Mariam (alaikh'is salom) ba'di damidani Ch'abrail bo Iso bordor shud. Pas u bo kh'amli shikamash ba makoni az nazdi mardum dur kanor raft.

23) Pas uro dardi zoimon girift va nazdi tanai darakhti khurmo burd. Mariam (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei kosh, pesh az in ruz memurdam va chizi bearzishe meshudam, ki shinokhta va iod karda nameshud, to mardum dar kh'ak'k'am gumoni bad namekardand."
24) Pas Iso (alaikh'is salom) az zeri k'adamkh'oiash uro ba in mazmun sado kard: "G'amgin mashav. Ba durusti ki Parvardigorat dar zeri poikh'oiat ch'uiborero k'aror dodaast, ki az obi on menushi.
25) Va tanai darakhti khurmoro girifta, ba sui khud larzon, to baroiat khurmoi taru tozai khudi kh'ozir chidashuda rezonad.-

26) Pas az khurmo bikhur va az ob binush va az on ki sokh'ibi navzod shudai, osudakhotir bosh va g'amgin mashav. Pas agar az miioni mardum kasero bini, ki turo dar borai khabari navzodat mepursad, pas ba vai bigu: "Man ba khotiri Khudovandi Mekh'rubon khomush istodanro bar khud voch'ib sokhtaam, baroi kh'amin imruz kh'argiz bo kase az insonkh'o sukhan namekunam."
27) Pas Mariam pisarash Isoro bardoshta, ba nazdi k'avmash ovard. K'avmash ba ma'noi inkor guftand: "Ei Mariam, Ba durusti ki amali bag'oiat k'abekh' ovardi, chunki be padar farzand tavallud kardai.
28) Ei dar ibodat Shabekh'i Kh'orun, padarat mardi zinokor va modarat zani zinokor nabud. Tu az khonadoni ma'ruf ba diionat va poki kh'asti. Chitavr be padar farzand tavallud mekuni?!"
29) Pas Mariam (alaikh'is salom) ba pisarash Iso (alaikh'is salom), ki dar gakh'vora bud, ishora kard. K'avmash bo taach'ch'ub guftand: "Chitavr mo bo kudaki gakh'vora gap mezanem?!"
30) Iso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ba durusti ki man bandai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astam, baroiam Inch'ilro dod va maro iake az paiombaronash gardonid.-
31) Va maro kh'ar kuch'o bosham, ba bandagon bisior sudrason sokht va maro to vak'te zindaam, ba adoi namoz va pardokhti zakot amr kard.-
32) Va maro dar kh'ak'k'i modaram nekukor gardonid va az itoati Khud mutakabbiri isionkor nagardonid.-
33) Va bar man az Shaitonu iovaronash ruzi tavalludam va ruzi margam va ruzi dar okhirat zinda shudanam amon ast. Shaiton dar in se markh'ilakh'oi dakh'shatnok ba man ziion namerasonad."

34) In shakhsi bo sifatkh'oi mazkur mavsuf Isoi pisari Mariam va k'avli dar boraash guftashudai durust kh'amin ast, na sukhani kasone, ki dar mavridi Iso shubkh'a mekunand va az nazdi khud gap mebofand.

35) Kh'argiz baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sazovor nest, ki farzand girad, U az in tukh'matkh'o pok ast. Chun korero iroda kunad, pas iak'inan kh'amin k'adar basanda ast, ki ba on "Kh'ast shav" guiad, ba'di in on kor ba vuch'ud meoiad. Kh'ar kas chunin k'udrat doshta boshad, vai az doshtani farzand pok ast.

36) Va ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Parvardigori man va Parvardigori shumost. Pas, kholisona tankh'o Uro ibodat namoed. In chizkh'oi baroiaton zikr kardaam rokh'i rost buda, shumoro ba rizoi ilokh'i merasonad.

37) Pas ikhtilofkunandagon az miioni k'avmash dar mavridi Iso (alaikh'is salom) ikhtilof namuda, ba gurukh'kh'oi parokanda ch'udo shudand. Ba'zei onkh'o ba vai imon ovarda guftand: "Iso (alaikh'is salom) Paiombar ast." Ba'zei digarashon monandi iakh'udikh'o ba vai kofir gashtand, inchunin iddai digare oidi Iso (alaikh'is salom) ziiodaravi namuda, guftand: "U pisari Khudo ast." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az in ak'idakh'o pok ast. Pas voii shakhsoni dar borai Isoi pisari Mariam (alaikh'is salom) ikhtilof karda, az shokh'id gashtani ruzi buzurgi k'iiomat bo sakh'nakh'oi mudkh'ish va kh'isobu kitobu uk'ubate, ki dar on mavch'ud ast.

38) Onkh'o on ruz, ki nazdi Mo meoiand, chi k'adar shunavo va chi k'adar bino meshavand, ammo vak'te shunavoiu bino meshavand, ki digar didanu shunidan baroiashon foida nadorad, lekin zolimon dar dunio az rokh'i rost dar gumrokh'ii oshkorand. Ba kh'amin sabab, onkh'o to zamoni nogakh'on omadani k'iiomat, ki dar kh'oli anch'om dodani zulmand, omodagii onro namebinand.

39) Va ei Paiombar, mardumro az ruzi kh'asratu nadomat bim bidekh', on ruze, ki badkor baroi badkoriash va nekukor baroi on ki ibodatro beshtar anch'om nadoda ast, izkh'ori pushaimoni mekunand, chun sakh'ifai a'moli bandagon pechida shuda va kh'isobu kitobashon khotima iobad va kh'ar kas ba sui on chi dar dunio tak'dim karda ast, bargardad, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o dar dunio maftuni dunio shuda, az okhirat g'ofiland va onkh'o ba ruzi k'iiomat imon nameorand.

40) Ba durusti ki ba'di fanoi khaloik', tankh'o Mo bok'i memonem, zaminro bo kh'ar ki va kh'ar chi dar rui on ast, ba meros mebarem, zero kulli mavch'udoti rui on fano meshavand va Mo ba'di onkh'o poidorem va chunone khokh'em, bar onkh'o kh'ukm mekunem va ruzi k'iiomat baroi kh'isobu kitob va ch'azoi korkh'oiashon tankh'o ba sui Mo bargardonida meshavand.
41) Va ei Paiombar, dar K'ur'oni bar tu omada khabari Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro iod kun. Ba durusti, vai bandai bisior sodik'u tasdik'kunandai oiatkh'oi ilokh'i va paiombar bud.

42) Chun ba padarash Ozar guft: "Ei padaram, charo g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) butero meparasti, ki agar duo kuni, duoiatro nameshunavad va agar ibodatash kuni, ibodatatro namebinad va az tu zararero dur karda va baroiat foidae ovarda nametavonad?!
43) Ei padaram, Ba durusti ki maro az tarik'i paig'om donishe omada ast, ki ba tu naomada ast. Pas maro pairavi namo, to turo ba rokh'i rost rakh'namoi kunam.

44) Ei padaram, Shaitonro ba vositai itoat kardanash ibodat makun. Kh'amono Shaiton ba Parvardigori Mekh'rubon isionkor ast. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro ba sach'dai Odam amr kard, ammo vai az ich'roi farmon sarpechi namud.

45) Ei padaram, kh'amono man az on metarsam, ki agar dar rokh'i kufr bimiri, az ch'onibi Parvardigori Mekh'rubon baroiat uk'ubat merasad, pas, ba sababi dustiat bo Shaiton, dar azob k'arini vai megardi."

46) Ozar ba pisarash Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Ibrokh'im, oio tu az butkh'oe, ki man meparastam, rui metobi?! Savgand mekhuram, agar az badguii butkh'oiam boz naisti, begumon turo sangsor mekunam. Va az man muddati tuloni ch'udo shuda, bo man kh'amsukh'bat mashav."

47) Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba padarash guft: "Salom bar tu! Az sui man ba tu nokhushi namerasad. Ba zudi az Parvardigoram baroiat omurzish va kh'idoiat mekhokh'am. Kh'amono U nisbatam bisior Mekh'rubon ast.

48) Va az shumo va az on chi g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted, duri mech'uiam va tankh'o Parvardigoramro parastida, chizero sharikash namegardonam. Beshak, man ba sababi parastishi Parvardigoram badbakht nameshavam, on guna ki shumo ba sababi ibodati butkh'oi khud badbakht meshaved."

49) Pas chun Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) mushrikonro bo ma'budkh'oiashon, ki g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ibodat mekardand, tark kard, baroi az dast dodani khonadonash ba vai ivaz dodem. Pas ba u pisarash Iskh'ok' va naberaash Ia'k'ubro bakhshidem va kh'ar iakei on duro paiombar gardonidem.
50) Va ba onkh'o az rakh'mati Khud bo nubuvvat khairi ziiod ato kardem va ba onkh'o az rokh'i zaboni bandagon sitoishi neki doimi k'aror dodem.
51) Va ei Paiombar, dar K'ur'oni ba tu nozilshuda khabari Muso (alaikh'is salom)-ro iod kun. Kh'amono u bandai barguzida bud va paiombari doroi mak'omi baland bud.
52) Va Muso (alaikh'is salom)-ro -ba e'tibori ch'oigirshavi- az samti rosti kukh'i Tur nido namudem va uro nazdik sokhta, bo vai roz guftem.

53) Va ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) az rakh'mat va lutfi Khesh Kh'oruni barodarashro ba sifati paiombar bakhshidem. Zero Muso (alaikh'is salom) az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) inro khost va duoiash pazirufta shud.

54) Va ei Paiombar, dar K'ur'oni bar tu nozilshuda khabari Ismoil (alaikh'is salom)-ro iod kun. Ba durusti ki u bandai dar va'dai khud sodik' bud, kh'ar chi va'da medod, onro beguftugu ich'ro mekard va paiombari doroi mak'omi baland bud.
55) Va khonadonashro ba barpo doshtani namoz va pardokhtani zakot amr mekard va nazdi Parvardigorash bandai pisandida bud.
56) Va ei Paiombar, dar K'ur'oni bar tu nozilshuda khabari Idris (alaikh'is salom)-ro iod kun. Begumon vai bandai bisior sodik' va doim tasdik'kunandai oiatkh'oi Parvardigorash va paiombar bud.
57) Va bo dodani nubuvvat nomashro bolo burdem. Binobar in, vai doroi ch'oigokh'i baland bud.

58) In paiombaroni dar in sura tavsifshuda, shuru' az Zakariio (alaikh'is salom) to Idris (alaikh'is salom) kasoneand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar onkh'o in'om namud, az nasli Odam (alaikh'is salom) va az nasli kasone, ki kh'amrokh'i Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) bar kishti savorashon kardem va az nasli Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) va Ia'k'ub (alaikh'is salom) va az kasone, ki baroiashon tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba dinro dodem va onkh'oro barguzida, paiombar sokhtem. Chun oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro meshunidand, ki tilovat meshavad, az tarsi U giriakunon ba sach'da meaftodand.

59) Pas ba'd az in ch'amoai barguzida pairavoni badkoru gumrokh'e omadand, ki namozro zoe' sokhta, onro ba surati zaruri ado nakardand va gunokh'onero ba monandi zinokori, ki nafsashon mekhost, murtakib shudand. Pas kh'atman dar duzakh bo badiiu noumedi rubaru khokh'and gasht,-

60) ch'uz kase, ki az kutokh'ii sodirkardaash samimona tavba kunad va ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon orad va kori shoista anch'om dikh'ad, pas in toifai bo sifatkh'oi mazkur tavsifshuda voridi ch'annat meshavand va az podoshi amalkh'oiashon agarchi andak kh'am boshad, kam karda nameshavad.-

61) Bog'kh'oi sukunati kh'ameshagi, ki Khudoi Mekh'rubon ba onkh'o va'dai dukhuli onro doda ast, kh'ol on ki dar dunio bo vuch'udi ch'annatro nadidan, ba on imon dorand. Beshak, va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai ch'annat agarchi az chashm noaion ast, kh'atman meoiad.

62) Onkh'o dar bikh'isht kalomi bekh'uda va zisht nameshunavand, balki salomi iakdigar va salomi farishtagonro meshunavand va kh'ar pagokh' va begokh' onch'o baroiashon taomi ba tab'i dilashon muvofik' meoiad.
63) In ch'annati tavsifshuda ch'oest, ki onro az bandagonamon baroi shakhsi farmonbardori az man'shudakh'o parkh'ezkor ba meros medikh'em.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi zikrshuda savobi bandagoni botak'voro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin iake az ma'nokh'oi tak'voro, ki ich'roi amri Parvardigor ast, ovarda guft:
64) Va ei Ch'abrail, ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bigu: "Beshak, farishtagon az peshi khud nozil nameshavand, balki onkh'o tankh'o bo amri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furud meoiand. On chi az korkh'oi okhirat peshi rui most va on chi az korkh'oi dunio pushti sari khesh meguzorem va on chi miioni duniovu okhirat ast, az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va ei Paiombar, Parvardigorat chizero faromushkunanda nest."

65) U Kholik'u Moliki osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini on va Chorasozi korkh'oi osmonkh'ovu zamin ast. Pas tankh'o Uro biparast, chunki fak'at U sazovori ibodat ast va dar anch'omi ibodat ustuvor bosh. Zero kh'argiz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) monand nadorad, ki dar ibodat sharikash gardad.
66) Va kofiri munkiri zindashavii ba'di marg az rui tamaskhur meguiad: "Oio vak'te bimiram, az k'abram bo kh'aioti ch'adid zinda berun karda meshavam?! In nomumkin ast."

67) Oio in munkiri zindashavi ba iod nameorad, ki Mo uro k'abl az in dar kh'ole chize nabud, ofaridem, to bo andeshidan oidi ofarinishi iakum ba kh'ak'ik'at doshtani ofarinishi duium imon orad?! Bo vuch'udi on ki ofarinishi duium nisbat ba iakum osontar ast.

68) Pas ei Paiombar, savgand ba Parvardigorat, ki in munkironro bo shaitonkh'oe, ki onkh'oro gumrokh' sokhtaand, az k'abrashon ba maidoni makh'shar ch'am' meorem, sipas onkh'oro ba sui darvozakh'oi duzakh dar kh'ole ki khoru zor va ba zonu aftodaand, kh'ozir meronem.
69) Sipas az baini kh'ar iak dastai gumrokh' nofarmontarini onkh'oro ba Parvardigori Mekh'rubon bo sakhti berun mekashem. Inkh'o peshvoioni kofironu mushrikonand.
70) Sipas Mo iak'inan kasonero, ki ba daromadani duzakh va uk'ubati on sazovortarand, bekh'tar medonem.

71) Va kase az shumo mardum nest, ch'uz in ki kh'atman az puli siroti rui duzakh meguzarad. Guzashtani on k'azoi kh'atmist, ki Parvardigorat onro kh'ukm karda ast. Kase kh'ukmi Uro rad karda nametavonad.

72) Sipas ba'd az guzashtani puli sirot on kasonero, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va duri az mamnuot parkh'ez kardaand, solim nigokh' medorem va zolimonro bar zonu aftoda ba duzakh rakh'o mekunem. Az on firor karda nametavonand.

73) Va chun oiatkh'oi vozekh'i Mo, ki bar Paiombaramon nozil kardaem, ba mardum khonda shavad, kofiron ba mu'minon guiand: "Kadome iake az gurukh'i movu shumo az rui mak'om bekh'tar va az rui mach'lis zebotar ast?! Gurukh'i mo io gurukh'i shumo?!"

74) Va adadi ummatkh'oi k'abl az in kofironi bo peshravii moddii khud iftikhorkunanda, ki kh'alokashon kardaem, nikh'oiat ziiodand. Onkh'o az nigokh'i amvol va zokh'iri andom az in ch'amoa bekh'tar budand. Zero libosi fokhir mepushidand va ch'ismashon dar rokh'at k'aror dosht.

75) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Kh'ar ki dar gumrokh'ii khesh furu meravad, pas Khudoi Mekh'rubon uro mukh'lat khokh'ad dod, to gumrokh'iash beshtar shavad, to on ki chun azobi favrii dar dunio ba onkh'o va'dashudaro mushokh'ida kunand, io azobi ba k'iiomat guzoshtashudaro binand, pas on vak't khokh'and donist, ki chi kase az rui mak'om badtar va az rui iovaron kamtar ast. Oio gurukh'i onkh'ost, io gurukh'i mu'minon?"

76) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muk'obili on ki ba kofiron mukh'lat doda ast, to zalolatashon beshtar gardad, imon va ibodati bandagoni kh'idoiatioftai Khudro afzun mesozad. Va ei Paiombar, amalakh'oi shoista, ki sokh'ibashro ba khushbakhtii ch'ovidon merasonad, dar nazdi Parvardigorat az nigokh'i podosh bekh'tar va az nigokh'i ok'ibat nektar meboshad.
