77) Ei Paiombar, oio kasero didi, ki ba kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi Mo kofir shuda, va'dai uk'ubati ruzi k'iiomatro inkor kard va guft: "Agar bimiram va boz zinda gardonida shavam, begumon ba man mol va farzandoni ziiod doda meshavad."
78) Oio u az g'aib ogokh'i dorad, ki bar asosi on chunin meguiad?! Io az nazdi Parvardigorash paimon girifta ast, ki uro kh'atman ba bikh'isht medarorad va baroiash molu farzandoni ziiod medikh'ad?!
79) Kor on guna ki u mepindorad, nest. Beshak, tamomi on chiro, ki meguiad va mekunad, menavisem va ba khotiri da'voi botilash uk'ubatro bar uk'ubatash afzun mesozem.

80) Va ba'd az in ki uro kh'alok gardonem, kh'amai mol va farzandoni guzoshtaashro ba meros mebarem va dar ruzi k'iiomat nazdamon dar kh'ole tankh'o meoiad, ki kh'ama molu mansabi dar dunio doshtaash az vai sitonida shuda ast.
81) Va mushrikon baroi ibodati kheshtan ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oro giriftaand, to in ma'budkh'o onkh'oro pushtibon va iovare boshand, ki bo madadashon sokh'ibi izzat gardand.

82) Vok'eiiat on guna ki mushrikon mepindorand, nest. Ba zudi in ma'budkh'oe, ki mushrikon g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastand, ibodatashonro inkor karda, az onkh'o bezori ch'usta, dushmanashon khokh'and shud.
83) Ei Paiombar, oio nadidi, ki Mo shaitonkh'oro firistoda, onkh'oro bar kofiron musallat sokhtem? Shaitonkh'o kofironro ba anch'omi gunokh' va man'i mardum az dini Khudo sakht ba ch'ush meorand.

84) Pas, ei Paiombar, az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zudtar kh'alok kardani mushrikon va kofironro matalab. Ba durusti ki Mo umri onkh'oro ba tavri dak'ik' shumor mekunem. Chun mukh'latashon anch'om shavad, onkh'oro ch'azo medikh'em.
85) Ei Paiombar, ruzi k'iiomatro iod kun, ki bandagoni botak'voro ba monandi mekh'mononi obrumand savori markabkh'oi khos, bo izzatu ikrom ba sui Parvardigori Mekh'rubonashon ch'am' mesozem.
86) Va kofironro dar kh'ole ki tashnaand, ba sui duzakh meronem.
87) In ch'amoai kofiron baroi ba'zei digarashon sokh'ibi shafoat nestand, ch'uz kase, ki dar dunio bo imon ovardan ba Khudoi Mekh'rubon va paiombaronash az nazdi U paimon girifta ast.
88) Va k'avmi iakh'udu nasoro va ba'zei mushrikon meguiand: "Allokh'i Mekh'rubon baroi Khud farzand girifta ast."
89) Ei sokh'iboni in sukhan, Ba durusti ki shumo sukhani bag'oiat zisht gufted.
90) Az in sukhani zishtaton osmonkh'o k'arib bishikofad va zamin az on bitarkad va kukh'kh'o pora-pora shuda birezand.
91) In kh'ama baroi on ast, ki onkh'o ba Khudoi Mekh'rubon farzandro nisbat dodaand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az in da'voi botili mushrikon pok ast.
92) Va baroi Khudoi Mekh'rubon loik' nest, ki farzand girad. Chunki U az doshtani farzand pok ast.
93) Kase dar osmonkh'o va zamin az farishtagon, insonkh'o va ch'inkh'o nest, magar in ki ruzi k'iiomat bo furutani va izkh'ori ach'z nazdi Khudoi Mekh'rubon meoiad.
94) Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ilmi Khesh onkh'oro ikh'ota karda va onkh'oro dak'ik' shumorida ast. Baroi kh'amin kh'ech' korashon az Khudo makhfi nameboshad.
95) Va kh'ar kadomi onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigorash tankh'o meoiad. Madadrason va doroi nadorad.

96) Beshak, kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om medikh'and, Allokh'i Mekh'rubon dustashon khokh'ad dosht va dar k'albi bandagonash mukh'abbatashonro ch'oi khokh'ad dod.

97) Pas, ei Paiombar, Ba durusti ki Mo in K'ur'onro bo zaboni tu furud ovardem va osonash sokhtem, to bo in Kitob bandagoni botak'voro muzhda bidikh'i va k'avmi dar khusumat va napaziruftani kh'ak' sarsakhtro az azob bitarsoni.

98) Va adadi ummatkh'oe, ki pesh az k'avmat kh'alokashon gardonidem, nikh'oiat ziiod ast. Pas oio imruz az on ummatkh'o kasero meiobi?! Io az onkh'o sadoi pinkh'onero meshunavi?! On uk'ubate, ki ba ummatkh'oi k'abli rasid -vak'te Parvardigor khokh'ad-, ba digaron niz merasad.
1) "To. Kh'o." Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) Ei Paiombar, Mo K'ur'onro bar tu nafiristodaem, ki bo g'amgin gashtanat baroi imon naovardani k'avmat sababi ranch'at gardad.
3) Beshak, onro nozil namudem, to baroi bandagone, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o tavfik'i tars az Khudro doda ast, pande boshad.
4) K'ur'on az ch'onibi Parvardigore furud omada ast, ki zamin va osmonkh'oi balandro ofarida ast. K'ur'on Kitobi azim ast, zero az sui Parvardigori Boazamat nozil shuda ast.
5) Khudoi Mekh'rubon chunonchi loik'i Zoti Ust, bar Arsh baromad.
6) Kh'amai mavch'udoti osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini onkh'o va mavch'udoti zeri khok az nigokh'i ofarinish, molikiiat va chorasozi tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.
8) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Ma'budi barkh'ak' ast, ch'uz U digar ma'budi barkh'ak' nest. Nomkh'oi dar zeboi bag'oiat komil tankh'o az Ust.

Va kh'angome, ki paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ruigardoniro az k'avmash duchor meshud, k'issai Muso (alaikh'is salom) baroiash kh'amchun tassalo nozil shuda, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft:
9) Va ei Paiombar, kh'amono khabari Musoi pisari Imron (alaikh'is salom) baroiat omada ast.

10) On gokh', ki dar safarash otashero did, pas ba khonavodaash guft: "Dar kh'amin ch'oiaton bimoned. Kh'amono man otashero didam. Shoiad baroiaton az on otash shu'lae biioram, io rakh'namoe paido kunam."
11) Pas, chun vai nazdi otash omad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro sado karda guft: "Ei Muso,-
12) beshak, Man Parvardigori tuiam. Pas ba khotiri omodagii munoch'ot bo Man kafshkh'oiatro az poiat bikash. Zero iak'inan tu dar sarzamini muk'addasi "Tuvo" k'aror dori.-
13) Va ei Muso, Man turo baroi tablig'i paiomam barguzidaam. Pas ba on chi ba tu paig'om mefiristam, bo dik'k'at gush andoz.
14) Ba durusti, Man Allokh' kh'astam, g'airi Man digar ma'budi barkh'ak' vuch'ud nadorad. Pas tankh'o Maro biparast va ba khotiri iodi Man namozro dar komiltarin surat bikhon.

15) Kh'amono k'iiomat omadani va vok'e'shavanda ast. Mekhokh'am, ki vak'ti onro pinkh'on doram, to kh'ar kas dar badali on chi az neki io badi mekunad, ch'azo doda shavad. Kase vak'ti k'iiomatro namedonad. Bandagon tavassuti paiombar tankh'o nishonakh'oi onro medonand.
17) Va ei Muso, in chize, ki dar dasti rosti tust, chist?"

18) Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "In asoi man ast, kh'angomi rokh' gashtan bar on takia mekunam va bo on darakhtonro mezanam, to bargkh'oiashon baroi gusfandonam birezad va maro dar on ch'uz in foidakh'oi bisior ast."
20) Pas Muso (alaikh'is salom) asoro ba zamin afkand. Pas on nogakh'on ba more tabdil gasht, ki bosur'at va sabuki dar zamin kh'arakat mekard.
21) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Asoro bigir va az in ki on ba shakli mor tabdil ioft, matars. Chun onro bigiri, Mo zud ba kh'oli avvalaash barmegardonem.-
22) Va dastatro ba zeri bag'alat bar, to kh'amchun alomati duiumi isbotgari paembariat, biduni bemorii pesi safed va durakhshon berun shavad.-
23) Ei Muso, Mo in du alomatro nishon dodem, to ba tu ba'ze az alomatkh'oero nishon dikh'em, ki buzurgii k'udrati Mo va kh'ak'ik'at doshtani risolati turo isbot mekunad.-
24) Ei Muso, nazdi Fir'avn birav. Ba durusti ki u dar kufr va sarkashi az itoati Parvardigor az kh'ad guzashta ast."
25) Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, sinaamro farokh bisoz, to ozoru aziiatro takh'ammul karda tavonam.
26) Va koramro oson namo.
27) Va ba man baroi talaffuzi kalomi fasekh' tavonoi bakhsh,-
29) Va baroiam az akh'li khonadonam iovare k'aror bidekh', ki maro dar korkh'oiam kumak rasonad.
30) Barodaram Kh'oruni pisari Imronro iovaram gardon.
31) Ba vositai vai kamari maro mustakh'kam bisoz.
33) to Turo ba poki beshtar iod namoem-
34) va Turo ziiodtar zikr kunem.
35) Iak'inan Tu moro mebini, kh'ech' kori mo az Tu pushida nest."
36) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft: "Ei Muso, Mo ba tu on chiro khosti, dodem.
37) Va kh'amono ba tu iak bori digar lutfu ekh'son namudem.
38) On gokh', ki ba modarat ilkh'om firistodem on chi ba vai ilkh'om firistoda shud, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo az sharri Fir'avn kh'ifz mekunad

39) Chun ba modarat ilkh'om firistodem, uro ba in mazmun dastur dodem, ki farzandatro ba'di vilodat dar sanduk' guzor va sanduk'ro ba dario afkan, pas, dario ba zudi uro bo farmoni Mo ba sokh'il meafkanad, ba'd az in Fir'avn, ki dushmani Man va dushmani ust, uro megirad. Va ei Muso, bar tu az ch'onibi Khud mukh'abbat guzoshtam, to mardum turo dust dorand va to dar soiai kh'ifzu nigakh'boniam parvarish biiobi.

40) On gokh', ki khokh'arat az dunbolat raft. Kh'ar vak'te sanduk' kh'arakat mekard, vai niz az pasash meraft va onro dunbol menamud. Pas vai ba kasone, ki kudaki daruni sanduk'ro giriftand, guft: "Oio shumoro ba sui shakhse rakh'namoi bikunam, ki in tiflro nigokh'ubin mekunad, shir medikh'ad va parvarish menamoiad?" Pas bo bargardonidanat ba nazdi modarat bar tu lutfu ekh'son namudem, to az bozgashtat ba nazdash shodu masrur shuda va ba khotiri tu g'amgin nashavad. Va mardi k'ibtii bo musht zadaatro ba k'atl rasonidi. Pas Mo bar tu bo nach'ot dodanat az much'ozot ekh'son namudem va turo pai dar pai az kh'ar sanch'ishe, ki bo on duchor shudi, rakh'onidem. Pas az on sarzamin berun shudi va nazdi akh'li Madian solkh'o istodi, sipas ei Muso, dar vak'te, ki baroi guftugu bo tu muk'addar gashta bud, ba makoni guftugu bo Parvardigorat omadi.
41) Va turo barguzidam, to paiombari Man boshi, paig'omi Maro ba mardum birasoni.
42) Ei Muso, tu va barodarat Kh'orun bo alomatkh'oi dalolatkunanda bar k'udrat va vakh'doniiati ilokh'i biraved va az da'vat kardani mardum ba sui Man va az zikri Man susti nakuned.
43) Kh'ardu nazdi Fir'avn biraved. Zero vai dar kufr va sarkashi az itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'ik'at az kh'ad guzashta ast.
44) Pas bo vai sukhani narm bigued, ba umedi on ki pand megirad va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tarsida, tavba mekunad.

45) Muso (alaikh'is salom) va Kh'orun (alaikh'is salom) guftand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, kh'amono mo khavf dorem, ki k'abl az on ki da'vati uro ba anch'om rasonem, zud moro much'ozot kunad, io bo rokh'i k'atl va digar rokh'kh'o dar sitam bar mo az kh'ad guzarad."
46) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o guft: "Natarsed. Iak'inan Man bo kumak va dastgiriam kh'amrokh'i shumoiam. On chi miioni shumovu Fir'avn rukh medikh'ad, meshunavam va mebinam.

47) Pas nazdash rafta, ba vai bigued: "Ei Fir'avn, kh'amono mo paiombaroni Parvardigori tuem. Pas Bani Isroilro kh'amrokh'amon bifirist va onkh'oro bo kushtani pisaron va zinda guzoshtani zanonashon shikanch'a makun. Beshak, mo az nazdi Parvardigorat kh'uch'ch'atero ovardaem, ki rostguiamonro nishon medikh'ad. Va kase az azobi ilokh'i emin ast, ki imon meorad va az kh'idoiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pairavi mekunad.

48) Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar mo paig'om firistoda ast, ki kh'amono azobi ilokh'i dar dunio va okhirat bar kasest, ki oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro durug' kh'isobida va az oiini paiombaron rui megardonad."
49) Fir'avn bo mak'sadi inkori dini ovardai Musovu Kh'orun (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Muso, pas on Parvardigoraton, ki chunone da'vo dored, shumoro ba sui man firistoda ast, kist?"
50) Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Parvardigori mo on Zote ast, ki ba kh'ar chiz surat va shakli munosib doda, sipas kh'ar iak makhluk'ro ba vazifai khosash rakh'namoi namuda ast."
51) Fir'avn guft: "Pas kh'oli ummatkh'oi guzashta ba misli k'avmi Nukh', Kh'ud, Lut va g'aira, ki kofir budand, chist?"

52) Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba Fir'avn guft: "Ilmi kh'oli ummatkh'oi peshina nazdi Parvardigoram dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz sabt ast. Parvardigoram dar donistani kh'oli onkh'o khato namekunad va on chiro dar borai onkh'o medonad, faromush namesozad.-

53) On Parvardigoram, ki zaminro baroiaton bo mak'sadi rui on zistan ba monandi gakh'vora sokht va baroiaton dar on rokh'kh'oi shoistai rokh'ravi k'aror dod va az osmon obi boron furud ovard, pas bo on ob nav'kh'oi gunoguni rastanikh'oro berun ovard."

54) Ei mardum, az ne'matkh'oi poke, ki baroi shumo berun ovardem, bikhured va chakh'orpoioni khudro bicharoned. Begumon dar in ne'matkh'oi zikrshuda baroi shakhsoni sokh'ibak'l dalelkh'oi isbotkunandai k'udrat va vakh'doniiati ilokh'i ast.

55) Mo padaraton Odam (alaikh'is salom)-ro az khoki zamin ofaridem va vak'te memired, bo rokh'i dafn kardanaton shumoro ba zamin barmegardonem va ruzi k'iiomat bori digar shumoro az on zinda berun mesozem.
56) Va ba durusti, Mo baroi Fir'avn kh'amai nukh' nishonai k'udrati Khudro oshkor sokhtem, vai onro mushokh'ida karda, pas durug' shumorid va az imon ovardan sarpechi namud.
57) Fir'avn guft: "Ei Muso, oio nazdamon baroi on omadai, ki moro bo rokh'i ch'odui ovardaat az Misr berun bikuni va podshokh'ii on baroi tu bimonad?-

58) Pas ei Muso, begumon baroiat ba monandi ch'odui ovardaat ch'odu meorem. Pas, baini mo va baini khud zamonu makonero muaiian kun, ki na mo va na tu ba va'dai dodaamon khilof nakunem va fosilai on makon baini kh'ardu gurukh' barobar boshad.
59) Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba Fir'avn guft: "Va'dagokh'i movu shumo ruzi id ast, ki mardum khudro oroish medikh'and va dar vak'ti chosht baroi ch'ashni idashon ch'a'm meshavand."
60) Pas Fir'avn pusht bargardonida raft. Pas kh'amai kh'ilai khudro ch'am' kard. Sipas ba khotiri Muso (alaikh'is salom) piruz gashtan dar zamonu makoni ta'iinshuda omada, kh'ozir shud.

61) Muso (alaikh'is salom) ch'odugaroni Fir'avnro nasikh'at karda guft: "Voi bar shumo! Ekh'tiiot shaved! Bo rokh'i ch'odue, ki mardumro mefirebed, bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' nabofed, ki Parvardigor shumoro bo uk'ubate az nazdi Khesh reshakan mesozad. Va kh'amono kh'ar ki bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' mebofad, ziion dida, ba kh'adafi khud namerasad."
62) Pas chun ch'odugaron gapi Muso (alaikh'is salom)-ro shunidand, bo iakdigar ba munok'isha pardokhtand va dar miioni khud pinkh'oni gushaki kardand.

63) Ba'ze ch'odugaron ba ba'zeashon pinkh'oni guftand: "Ba durusti ki Muso va Kh'orun ch'odugarand, bo ch'odui ovardaashon mekhokh'and, ki shumoro az sarzamini Misr berun kunand va ravishu mazkh'abi dar dunio olitarin va volotarinatonro az miion barand.

64) Pas koratonro ustuvor sozed va ba ikhtilof rokh' nadikh'ed, bo kh'am muttakh'id boshed, sipas saf zada, pesh raved, kh'ar chi dored, iakbora biafkaned va kh'amono imruz kh'ar kas bar ziddi dushmanash piruz shavad, ba khostai dilash noil megardad."
65) Ch'odugaron ba Muso guftand: "Ei Muso, az du iakero ikhtiior kun. Io tu nakhust ch'odui khudro meafkani io mo in korro mekunem."

66) Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Balki nakhust shumo on chi dored, afkaned." Ch'odugaron ch'odui khudro afkandand. Pas nogakh'on resmonkh'o va asokh'oi afkandaashon az sababi ch'odui sokhtaashon dar nazari Muso ba monandi morkh'oe namud, ki bo sur'at kh'arakat mekard.
67) Pas Muso (alaikh'is salom) dar vuch'udash az on chi sokhtand, ekh'sosi tars kard.
68) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi osudakhotir kardani Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Az on chi dar nazarat namudor shuda ast, natars. Ei Muso, Ba durusti ki tu bar onkh'o g'olib megardi.

69) Va asoero, ki dar dasti rosti tust, biafkan, to ba more tabdil shavad, ki tamomi ch'odui sokhtai onkh'oro furu barad. Zero Ba durusti ki on chi onkh'o sokhtaand, ch'uz makri ch'odugari chize nest va ch'odugar kh'ar kuch'o boshad, ba khostai dilash noil namegardad."

70) Muso (alaikh'is salom) asoi dastashro afkand, on ba shakli mor tabdil iofta, kh'amai ch'odui sokhtaashonro furu burd. Pas ch'odugaron kh'amagi baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sach'da aftodand, zero onkh'o iak'in kh'osil namudand, ki kori kardai Muso (alaikh'is salom) ch'odu nest, balki on az sui Parvardigori olamiion ast. Onkh'o guftand: "Ba Parvardigori Musovu Kh'orun va Parvardigori kulli mavch'udot imon ovardem."

71) Fir'avn imon ovardani ch'odugaronro inkor karda, takh'didomez guft: "Oio k'abl az on ki man ba shumo rukhsat dikh'am, ba Muso imon ovarded?! Kh'amono Muso rakh'bari shumo sokh'iron ast, ki baroiaton ch'odugariro ta'lim doda ast. Pas man beshubkh'a dastonu poikh'oi shumoro iakero az tarafi rost va digarero az tarafi chap meburam va ch'ismatonro bar tanakh'oi darakhti khurmo ba dor meovezam, to bimired va baroi digaron darsi ibrat garded va beguftugu, on vak't medoned, ki kadome az mo azobash k'avitar va doimitar ast, azobi man io azobi Parvardigori Muso?"

72) Ch'odugaron dar ch'avob ba Fir'avn guftand: "Ei Fir'avn, mo pairavii turo bar pairavii oiatkh'oi ravshani baroiamon omada va bar Zote, ki moro ofarida ast, pesh nameguzorem. Pas, kh'ar chi dar kh'ak'k'i mo kardan mekhokh'i, bikun. Ba durusti, tu bar mo tankh'o dar kh'amin dunioi foni saltanat dori va ba zudi in saltanatu k'udrati tu zavol meiobad.

73) Ba durusti ki mo ba Parvardigori khesh imon ovardem, ba umedi on ki gunokh'oni guzashtaamonro ba monandi kufru g'air az on az mo makh'v gardonad va ch'urmi ch'odugariro, ki tu moro baroi omukhtanash va az in rokh' muk'obili Muso muboriza burdan mach'bur kardai, nobud sozad. Va podoshi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi baroi mo va'da dodi, bekh'tar va azobi U az azobi takh'didkardai tu poidortar ast."

74) Ba durusti, kh'ar kas ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigorash meoiad, dar kh'ole ki ba U kofir shuda ast, kh'amono uro otashi duzakh ast. Vai dar duzakh abadi memonad. Dar onch'o na memirad, to az azob rokh'at shavad va na kh'aioti khush meguzaronad.

75) Va kh'ar ki ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigorash meoiad, dar kh'ole ki ba U imon ovarda va korkh'oi shoista karda ast, pas baroi in ch'amoai bo sifatkh'oi azim tavsifshuda manzilkh'o va darach'akh'oi baland ast.

76) On darach'akh'oiu manzilkh'oi baland bog'kh'oi istik'omati kh'ameshagi ast, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oiash rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad, akh'li ch'annat onch'o abadi memonand. Va in podoshi mazkur ch'azoi kh'ar shakhsi az kufr va ma'siiat pokshuda ast.

77) Va kh'amono ba Muso paig'om firistodem, ki: "Bo bandagonam az Misr shabona ba rokh' baro, to kase berun raftani onkh'oro ekh'sos nakunad baroiashon dar dario ba'di bo asoi dastat zadanash rokh'i khushkero bikusho, dar kh'ole ki khudro emin donista, na az ta'k'ibi Fir'avn lashkariionash metarsi va na az g'ark' gardidan dar dario mekh'arosi."

78) Pas Fir'avn iakch'o bo lashkariionash onkh'oro dunbol kard. Pas onkh'oro az dario pushonid on chi pushonid, ki kh'ak'ik'atashro ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kase namedonad. Fir'avn bo pairavoni khud kh'amagi dar dario g'ark' shudand va Musovu kh'amrakh'onash nach'ot ioftand.
79) Va Fir'avn k'avmashro bo oroish dodani kufr va fireftan bo botil gumrokh' sokht va onkh'oro ba sui kh'ak' rakh'namoi nakard.

80) Mo ba Bani Isroil ba'di az sharri Fir'avn va pairavonash nach'ot dodanashon guftem: "Ei Bani Isroil, kh'amono Mo shumoro az sharri dushmanaton rakh'o namudem va baroiaton va'da dodem, ki dar samti rosti vodii vok'e' dar ch'onibi kukh'i Tur bo Muso sukhan mekunem va dar vodii "Tiikh'" az lutfi Khesh baroi shumo nushobai monandi asal shirin va parandai khurdkh'ach'mi khushtam'i shabekh'i bedona furud ovardem.

81) Az khurdanikh'oi pokizaiu kh'alole, ki ba shumo ruzi kardaem, bikhured va az marzi kh'alol ba kh'arom naguzared, zero dar surati az marzi muk'arrarshuda guzashtan g'azabam bar shumo furud meoiad va bar kh'ar ki g'azabam nozil shavad, pas vai beshak, dar duniovu okhirat kh'alok va badbakht megardad.
82) Va Man baroi kase, ki tavba kunad va imon biiorad va kori nek anch'om dikh'ad, sipas dar rokh'i durust ustuvor bimonad, iak'inan Bakhshanda kh'astam."
83) Va ei Muso, chi bois shud, ki az k'avmat peshtar kh'arakat kuni va onkh'oro dar ak'ib guzori?

84) Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Onkh'o, ki az paiam meoiand, k'avmi manand. Ba zudi ba man merasand. Va man ba nazdat az k'avmam peshtar omadam, to ba khotiri ba suiat shitoftanam az man rozi bishavi."

85) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft: "Pas Mo iak'inan k'avmatro, ki ba'di kheshtan guzoshti, bo gusolaparasti ozmudem. Somiri onkh'oro ba ibodati gusola da'vat karda, ba in vosita gumrokh'ashon sokht."

86) Pas Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba nazdi k'avmash az sababi gusolaparastiashon g'azabnok va g'amgin bargasht. Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei k'avmi man, oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton va'dai nek nadoda bud, ki ba shumo Tavrotro nozil mekunad va ba bikh'isht dokhilaton megardonad?! Magar az in va'da zamoni ziiod guzasht, ki onro faromush karded?! Io bo in koraton khosted, ki g'azab va azobi Parvardigoraton bar shumo furud oiad? Baroi kh'amin va'dai maro dar borai on ki to vak'ti bargashtanam boiad dar itoat ustuvor bimoned, khilof karded?!"

87) K'avmi Muso guftand: "Ei Muso, mo va'dai turo bo ikhtiiori khud khilof nakardem, balki dar in kor mach'bur budem. Ba durusti ki az zaru zevari k'avmi Fir'avn borkh'oi sangin bar dush doshtem, pas onro baroi rakh'oi az kh'arom dar chokh'e afkandem. Pas chunonchi mo onro dar chokh'e afkandem, Somiri khoki sumi aspi Ch'abaril (alaikh'is salom)-ro, ki bo khud dosht, afkand."

88) Pas Somiri baroi Bani Isroil az zevarkh'o ch'asadi gusolai bech'onero berun sokht, ki monandi gov sado dosht. Pas shakhsoni ba kori Somiri fireftashuda guftand: "Ma'budi shumo va ma'budi Muso kh'amin gusola meboshad. Muso onro faromush karda, inch'o guzoshta rafta ast."

89) Oio in gurukh'e, ki fireftai gusola shuda, onro ibodat kardand, namebinand, ki in gusola bo onkh'o gap namezanad, ba sukhanashon ch'avob namedikh'ad va az onkh'ovu digaron zararero dur va baroi onkh'ovu digaron foidaero ovarda nametavonad?!

89) Va dar kh'ak'ik'at Kh'orun pesh az bargashtani Muso ba onkh'o gufta bud: "Dar zargarii in gusola az tillo va sado doshtani on baroi shumo ch'uz ozmoish chize nest, to mu'min az kofir ch'udo shavad. Va ei k'avmi man, Ba durusti ki Parvardigori shumo Sokh'ibi rakh'mat meboshad, na on ma'budii sun'iaton, ki na tankh'o shumoro rakh'mat karda nametavonad, balki ziionu foidae nadorand. Pas dar borai tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro parastidan az man pairavi kuned va amramro oidi tarki parastishi g'airi U itoat namoed."
91) Fireftagoni gusolaparasti guftand: "To zamoni ba sui mo bargashtani Muso dar gusolaparasti bok'i memonem."
92) Muso ba barodarash Kh'orun guft: "Vak'te didi mardum g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gusolaro parastida, gumrokh' shudand, chi turo man' kard-
93) az on ki onkh'oro tark sokhta, ba man bipaivandi?! Oio amri maro, ki turo bar onkh'o ch'onishinam guzoshtam, itoat nakardi?!"

94) Chun Muso (alaikh'is salom) amali anch'omdodai barodarashro bad kh'isobida, az rishu sarash girifta, uro ba sui kheshtan mekashid, Kh'orun bo mak'sadi shafk'atkhokh'i guft: "Ei Pisari modaram, az rish va muii saram magir. Zero man baroi kh'amrokh'i mardum bok'i mondan uzr doram. Kh'amono az on tarsidam, ki agar onkh'oro tankh'o guzoram, parokanda meshavand, pas megui, ki tu Bani Isroilro parokanda sokhtai va tavsiiai dar mavridi onkh'o dodaamro rioia nakardai."
95) Muso ba Somiri guft: "Ei Somiri, kh'oli tu chist?! Chi bois shud, ki chunin kori bade kuni?!"

96) Vai ba Muso guft: "Man chizero didam, ki onkh'o nadidand. Ba durusti ki Ch'abrailro bar aspe savor didam, pas, az khoki nak'shi k'adami aspash iak k'abza giriftam, pas, onro dar zari obshudae, ki ba surati gusola sokhta budam, afkandam, az on ch'asadi gusolai doroi sado paido shud va nafsam kori kardaamro kh'amin guna baroiam oroish dod."

97) Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba Somiri guft: "Pas az baini mardum birav. Zero to zindai, sazoiat on ast, ki megui: "Ba kase dast namerasonam va kase kh'am ba man dast narasonad." Minba'd az ch'am'iiat rondashuda umr ba sar mebari. Va kh'amono ruzi k'iiomat turo va'dagokh'e ast, ki dar on bozpursi va much'ozot meshavi. Va ba sui gusolaat, ki onro ma'budi khud girifti va g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar bandi ibodati on mondi, nazar andoz. Savgand, ki mo bar on otash mefaruzem, to ob shavad, sipas Ba durusti ki onro dar dario posh medikh'em, to az on kh'ech' asare bok'i namonad."

98) Ei mardum, kh'amono ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ii shumo Allokh'i Iagonaest, ki g'air az U ma'budi kh'ak'ik'i nest. Tamomi chizro bo ilmi Khesh ikh'ota karda ast. Chize az doirai ilmi Parvardigor berun nameboshad.

99) Ei Paiombar, on guna ki ba tu khabari Musovu Fir'avn va k'avmi onkh'oro k'issa kardem, inchunin baroiat akhbori ummatkh'o va paiombaroni guzashtaro k'issa mekunem, to tasallii khotirat gardad. Va ba durusti, bar tu az nazdi Khesh K'ur'onero dodem, ki shakhsi pandpazir az on pand megirad.

100) Kh'ar ki az in K'ur'oni bar tu nozilshuda rui gardonida, ba on imon naorad va ba farmudaash amal nakunad, pas beshak, u ruzi k'iiomat dar kh'ole meoiad, ki gunokh'i buzurgero bar dushash bardoshta va sazovori uk'ubati dardovar shuda ast.-
101) Dar on uk'ubat abadi memonad. Va bori sangini gunokh', ki ruzi k'iiomat onro mebardorand, nikh'oiat bad ast.

102) Ruze, ki farishtai vobastashuda baroi zindashavii murdagon nafkhai duiumro dar sur medamad va on ruz kofironro ch'am' meorem, dar kh'ole ki badan va chashmonashon az didani dakh'shatkh'oi k'iiomat kabud gashta ast.
103) Onkh'o ba iakdigar pinkh'oni meguiand: "Beshak, shumo dar olami k'abr ba'di marg az dakh' ruz beshtar naistodaed."
104) Mo on chiro baini khud pinkh'oni meguiand, bekh'tar medonem. On gokh', ki ok'iltarinashon meguiad: "Kh'amono shumo dar olami k'abr az iak ruz beshtar naistodaed."

105) Va ei Paiombar, onkh'o az tu oidi kh'olati kukh'kh'o dar ruzi k'iiomat mepursand. Pas dar ch'avob bigu: "Parvardigoram kukh'kh'oro az reshaash barmekanad va posh medikh'ad, pas ba gardu g'ubor tabdil meshavad.
106) Pas zamini bardorandai kukh'kh'oro chunon kh'amvor mesozad, ki dar rui on imorat va giiokh'e bok'i namemonad.
107) Ei binandai on kh'olat, tu az sababi kh'amvor shudani zamin dar on na kach'iero mebini va na pastivu balandiero.

108) Mardum dar on ruz az sadoi da'vatkunanda ba sui makh'shar pairavi mekunand, onkh'o ba ch'uz pairaviash rokh'e nadorand va kh'ama ovozkh'o az tarsi Khudoi Mekh'rubon khomush meshavad, pas dar on ruz ch'uz sadoi past chizero nameshunavi.
109) Dar on ruzi dakh'shatnok shafoati shafoatkunandae foida namerasonad, ch'uz kase, ki Allokh'i Mekh'rubon ba u rukhsati shafoat doda va sukhanashro dar mavridi shafoat pisandida ast."

110) On chi mardum az kori k'iiomat dar oianda mebinand va on chi dar dunio ba'di khud meguzorand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amaro medonad va bandagon az rui ilmi khud zot va sifoti Khudoro ikh'ota karda nametavonand.

111) Va chekh'rai bandagon baroi Allokh'i Zindai Namirandai doim Chorasozanda va gardonkunandai korkh'oi onkh'o khoru zabun gashta ast. Va beshubkh'a, kh'ar kas bar dushi khesh gunokh'ro bardorad, ba sababi on ki bo ma'siiat khudro ba kh'alokat meandozad, ba mak'sadash narasida ast.

112) Va kh'ar ki korkh'oi shoista anch'om dikh'ad, dar kh'ole ki ba Allokh'u paiombaronash imon dorad, pas ba podoshash purra noil megardad va az kh'ech' nav' sitame ba ma'noi on ki begunokh' uk'ubat shavad, namekh'arosad va az kamshavii savobi korkh'oi shoistaash niz nametarsad.

113) Va Mo chunonchi k'issakh'oi guzashtagonro furud ovardem, kh'amin guna in K'ur'onro bo zaboni arabii ravshan nozil kardem va dar on nav'kh'oi mukhtalifi va'dai uk'ubatro baion sokhtem, to onkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsand io K'ur'on baroiashon pandero paido kunad va ibrat girand.

114) Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti Bartaru Pok, Podshokh'i tamomi mavch'udot, Khud va sukhanash kh'ak', az on chi mushrikon vasf mekunand, munazzakh' ast. Va Ei Paiombar, k'abl az on ki Ch'abrail paiomi kheshro bar tu ba anch'om rasonad, dar tilovati K'ur'on kh'amrokh'ash shitob makun va bigu: "Ei Parvardigori man, donishamro ilova bar on chi ba man omukhtai, afzun bisoz."

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in oiatkh'o k'issai Muso (alaikh'is salom) va imon naovardani Fir'avnu g'aflati Bani Isroilro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin baroi targ'ibi kase, ki az faromushi ba ma'siiat dast zada, sipas az on tavba mekunad, k'issai Odam (alaikh'is salom)-ro baion namuda guft:
115) Va Ba durusti ki Mo k'abl az in Odamro ba nakhurdan az darakht suporish doda, uro az in amal man' namudem va ok'ibati onro baroiash baion sokhtem, pas u suporishamonro az iod barovard va besabri karda, az darakht khurd va az vai dar rioiai suporish irodai mustakh'kam nadidem.

116) Va ei Paiombar, iod kun vak'tero, ki ba farishtagon guftem: "Ba ma'noi arzi salom nazdi Odam sach'da kuned." Pas kh'amaashon sach'da kardand, ch'uz Iblise, ki kh'amrokh'ashon bud, vale az ch'umlai farishtagon nabud, az rui kibr az sach'da namudan sar pechid.

117) Pas Mo guftem: "Ei Odam, Ba durusti ki Iblis dushmani tu va kh'amsarat ast. Pas u naboiad tu va kh'amsaratro bo rokh'i vasvasa, ki itoatash kuned, az ch'annat berun sozad, zero agar az onch'o berun shavi, duchori sakhtikh'oi ziiod megardi.
118) Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ch'annat taomat medikh'ad, pas gurusna nameshavi va libosat mepushonad, pas barakh'na namemoni.
119) Va serobat mesozad, pas tashna namemoni va turo dar zeri soia megirad, pas garmii oftob ba tu namerasad."

120) Pas Shaiton Odamro ba vasvasa andokhta guft: "Oio turo ba khurdani darakhte rakh'namoi kunam, ki kh'ar kas az on bikhurad, kh'ech' gokh' namemirad, balki abadi zinda memonad va sokh'ibi podshokh'ii beintikh'o megardad?"

121) Pas Odam va Kh'avvo az on darakht khurdand, pas sharmgokh'ashon ba'di on ki pushida bud, oshkor shud va ba kandani bargkh'oi darakhtoni ch'annat va bo on pushonidai sharmgokh'ashon og'oz kardand. Va Odam amri Parvardigorashro nofarmoni namud, zero farmoni Uro dar mavridi parkh'ez az iste'moli darakht ba ch'o naovard, pas az kh'addi muk'arrarshuda guzasht.
122) Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Odamro barguzid va tavbaashro paziruft va ba vai tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro bakhshid.

123) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Odamu Kh'avvo guft: "Kh'ardui shumo bo Iblis iakch'o az ch'annat poion raved. Shaiton dushmani shumo va shumo dushmani vai kh'asted. Pas agar ba shumo az nazdi Man sharkh'u baioni rokh'am oiad, pas kh'ar ki az baioni rokh'am pairavi karda, mutobik'ash kor kunad va munkh'arif nashavad, pas az rokh'i kh'ak' gumrokh' namegardad va dar okhirat ba sababi azob badbakht nameshavad, balki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro dokhili ch'annat mesozad.

124) Va kh'ar ki az zikri Man rui gardonida, onro k'abul nakunad, pas ba durusti, baroiash dar duniovu olami k'abr zindagii dushvor ast va ruzi k'iiomat uro dar kh'ole ba ch'onibi makh'shar meronem, ki nobino va bekh'uch'ch'at ast.
125) In bandai az zikram bargashta meguiad: "Ei Parvardigoram, charo imruz maro dar kh'olati nobinoi kh'ashr kardi, kh'ol on ki man dar dunio bino budam?"

126) Allokh' dar raddi da'voiash meguiad: "Kh'amin guna dar dunio oiatkh'oi mo baroiat omad, pas az onkh'o rui tofta, tarkashon namudi. Va kh'amin tavr imruz dar azob ba kh'oli khud tark karda meshavi."

127) Va Mo kh'ar kasero, ki dar shakh'vatkh'oi kh'arom furu rafta va ba dalelkh'oi ravshani Parvardigorash imon nameorad, kh'amin guna ch'azo medikh'em. Va kh'amono azobi ilokh'i dar okhirat dar k'iios ba zindagonii dushvori duniovu olami k'abr zishttar, shadidtar va poiandatar ast.

128) Oio baroi mushrikon ma'lum nashuda ast, ki Mo k'abl az onkh'o ummatkh'oi ziiodero kh'alok kardem, kh'ol on ki mushrikon dar manzilkh'oi ummatkh'oi kh'alokshuda rokh' meravand va osori azobi ba onkh'o rasidaro mebinand?! Ba durusti, dar kh'alokati on ummatkh'o baroi sokh'ibkhiradon ibratkh'oi ziiod ast.

129) Va ei Paiombar, agar kalimai Parvardigorat dar mavridi on ki kasero pesh az omadani kh'uch'ch'at azob namekunad va niz agar mukh'lati baroiashon nazdash muaiianshuda namebud, onkh'oro dar kh'ol azob mekard, chunki in mushrikonu kofiron sazovori azoband.

130) Pas ei Paiombar, dar barobari on chi takzibgaronat nisbatat az vasfkh'oi botil meguiand, sabr kun va pesh az tului oftob dar namozi bomdod va pesh az g'urubi oftob dar namozi asr Parvardigoratro ba poki iod namo va sitoish kun va niz dar ba'ze soatkh'oi shab dar namozi shomu khuftan va kh'angomi zavoli oftob ba'di khotima ioftani tarafi avvali ruz dar namozi peshin va ba'di khotima ioftani tarafi duiumi on dar namozi shom Parvardigoratro ba poki iod namo va sitoish kun, ba umedi on ki podoshatro nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'osil karda, rozi megardi.

131) Va ba sui on zebu zinati kh'aioti dunio, ki gurukh'kh'oe az in ch'amoai takzibkunandaro az on bakh'ramand sokhtaem, to imtikh'onashon namoem, manigar. Zero on chi ba onkh'o dodaem, zavoliobanda meboshad. Va podoshi Parvardigorat, ki baroiat va'da doda ast, to rozi bishavi az lazzatkh'oi zavolpaziri ba mushrikonu kofiron dodaash bekh'tar va poiandatar ast. Chunki podoshi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'at' namegardad va doim bok'i memonad.

132) Va ei Paiombar, khonadonatro ba adoi namoz amr kun va khud bar adoiash sabr namo. Az tu baroi khudat va digaron ruzi nametalabem. Mo turo ruzi medikh'em. Va ok'ibati nek dar duniovu okhirat az bandagoni parkh'ezkorest, ki az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) metarsand, farmonashro ich'ro mekunand va az man'kardaash duri mech'uiand.

133) Va in kofironi takzibkunandai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) guftand: "Charo Mukh'ammad az sui Parvardigorash baroi mo alomatero nameorad, ki daleli rostgui va nubuvvatash boshad?" Oio baroi in takzibgaron K'ur'on, ki Kitobkh'oi guzashtaro tasdik' mekunad, naomada ast?!

134) Va agar Mo in takzibkunandagoni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro ba sababi kufr varzidan va sarkashi kardanashon pesh az firistodani paiombar va nozil sokhtani Kitob kh'alok gardonem, dar ruzi k'iiomat baroi kufri khesh bakh'ona ovarda meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, charo dar dunio pesh az on ki imruz ba sababi uk'ubat khorivu rasvoi ba mo furud oiad, baroiamon paiombar nafiristodi, to ba vai imon orem va az oiatkh'oi az sui Tu ovardaash pairavi kunem?!"

135) Ei Firistodai Mo, ba in takzibgaron bigu: "Kh'ar iake az movu shumo muntaziri ok'ibati koramon kh'astem. Pas muntazir boshed. Pas khokh'ed donist, ki sokh'iboni rokh'i rost va rakh'ioftagon kikh'oiand, mo io shumo?"
1) Zamoni kh'isobi a'moli bandagon dar ruzi k'iiomat nazdik shuda ast, kh'ol on ki onkh'o az sababi sargarmi ba zindagonii dunio dar g'aflat k'aror doshta, az okhirat ruigardonand.

2) Ba in g'aflatzadagon az ch'onibi Parvardigorashon kh'ech' iak oiati tozanuzul nameoiad, magar in ki onkh'o ba on bo bozi va betavach'ch'ukh'i gush andokhta, mak'sadashon az shunidani paiomkh'oi ch'adid bakh'ra burdan nest.

3) Onkh'o oiatkh'oi K'ur'onro dar kh'ole gush mekunand, ki dilashon az on g'ofil ast. Va kasone, ki bo kofirshavi bar ch'onashon zulm kardand, rozashonro pinkh'on doshta, makhfiiona guftand: "In marde, ki da'voi paiombari dorad, ba monandi shumo insone besh nest. Az shumo kh'ech' bartari nadorad. Kitobu dinash ch'odust. Oio az u pairavi mekuned, kh'ol on ki medoned, ki u niz ba monandi shumo inson ast va on chi ovarda ast, ch'odu meboshad?"

4) Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) guft: "Parvardigoram az sukhanoni pinkh'oniaton ogokh' ast. Zero U tamomi k'avli az zaboni guiandaash dar osmonkh'o va zamin berunshavandaro medonad. Va U Shunavoi Dono ast. Sukhani bandagonro meshunavad va az a'molashon ogokh'i dorad."

5) Balki onkh'o dar mavridi dini ovardai Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) duchori dudilagi va sargardoni shudand. Pas iak bor "Dini ovardaash khobkh'oi pareshoni beta'bir ast" guftand, bori duium "Ne, vai in oiinro az peshi khud bofta va on kh'ech' asose nadorad" guftand va bori seium "Ne, balki vai shoir ast. Agar dar da'voi khesh sodik' boshad, pas ba monandi paiombaroni k'abli mu'ch'iza biiorad. Zero paiombaroni k'abli bo khud ba misli asoi Muso va modashuturi Solekh' mu'ch'iza ovardaand" guftand.

6) Kh'ech' dekh'ai pesh az in gurukh'i kofiri mu'ch'izakhokh' guzashta, ki az paiombaronashon mu'ch'iza khostand va on ba onkh'o chunonchi mekhostand, ovarda shud, ba mu'ch'izai khostaashon imon naovardaand, balki onro ba durug' budan nisbat dodaand, pas, Mo kh'alokashon kardaem. Pas, inkh'o, ki mu'ch'iza talab dorand, agar khostaashon ich'ro shavad, oio imon meorand?! Kh'argiz imon nameorand!

7) Va ei Paiombar, Mo pesh az tu tankh'o mardonro az nav'i bashar ba kh'aisi paiombar firistoda, ba onkh'o vakh'i mekardem. Mo farishtagonro paiombar nafiristodaem. Agar inro namedoned, pas az donishmandoni akh'li Kitob va Inch'il bipursed.
8) Va Mo paiombaronamonro sokh'ibi ch'asade nagardonidaem, ki chize nakhurand, balki onkh'o niz ba monandi digaron mekhurdand va dar dunio ch'ovidmonanda nabudand.

9) Sipas baroi paiombaronamon va'dai Khudro takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshidem. Pas onkh'oro bo kh'ar ki az mu'minon khostem, az kh'alokat nach'ot dodem va shakhsoni bo kufru ma'siiat az kh'ad guzarandaro kh'alok sokhtem.

10) Kh'amono Mo ba sui shumo K'ur'onero nozil kardaem, ki agar ba on imon ovarda, ba dasturotash amal kuned, dar on sharaf, izzat va iftikhori shumost. Oio inro namefakh'med? Agar mefakh'med, pas, shitob namoed va ba K'ur'on imon ovarda, rakh'namoikh'oi onro amali sozed.
11) Va adadi akh'li dekh'akh'oe, ki ba sababi bo kufr bar ch'oni kheshtan sitam kardan kh'alokashon namudem va ba'di onkh'o k'avmi digarero kh'ast namudem, nikh'oiat ziiod ast.
12) Pas vak'te azobi reshakansozandai Moro didand, nogakh'on onkh'o az on dekh'akh'o az khavfi kh'alok gashtan shitobon megurekhtand.

13) Pas bo tamaskhur nido meshudand: "Nagurezed va ba sui nozu ne'mate, ki dar on buded va manzilkh'oiaton bargarded, shoiad az shumo az dunioi doshtaaton chize pursida meshavad va oidi korkh'oi mukh'im bo shumo mashvarat surat megirad."
14) In sitamkoron ba gunokh'i khud e'tirof karda guftand: "Ei voi bar mo, ki kh'alok shuda va ziion didaem. Ba durusti ki mo az sababi ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir gashtan zolim budem."

15) Pas e'tirofi gunokh' va dar kh'ak'i khesh duoi bad kardan guftori doimiashon bud, to on ki Mo onkh'oro ba monandi ziroati daravshuda va ba monandi otashi khomushgashta murdai bekh'arakat gardonidem.
16) Va Mo osmon va zamin va mavch'udoti miioni on duro baroi bozi va bekh'uda naofaridem, balki onkh'oro baroi k'udratnamoi ofaridem.
17) Agar Mo mekhostem, begumon zanu farzandro az on chi nazdi Khud dorem, megiriftem va in korro nakardem, chunki az on poku beniiozem.

18) Balki kh'ak'ik'atero, ki ba sui Paiombaramon vakh'i firistodaem, bar botili akh'li kufr meafkanem, pas onro kullan makh'v mesozad, pas botili onkh'o nogakh'on az miion meravad va zavol meiobad. Va ei kasone, ki bo tukh'mat Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro sokh'ibi zanu farzand medoned, shumoro baroi in vasfi noloik'i ba U nisbat dodaaton kh'alokat va azobi sakht ast.

Chun doshtani zanu farzand ma'noi niiozmandiro ifoda mekunad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati zerin Moliki kulli mavch'udot va Beniiozii Kheshro baion karda guft:
19) Va kh'ama mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va farishtagoni nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az ibodati U kibr namevarzand va khasta nameshavand.
20) Onkh'o doim tasbekh'i Uro meguiand va az on susti namekunand.

21) Balki mushrikon baroi ibodat g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oero giriftaand, ki murdagonro zinda karda nametavonand. Modome chunin ast, pas chi guna onkh'o chizero meparastand, ki az zindasozii murdagon notavon ast?!

22) Agar dar osmonkh'ovu zamin g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oi digare mebudand, iak'inan osmonkh'ovu zamin ba sababi munok'ishai ma'budkh'o dar podshokh'i tabokh' megasht, dar kh'ole vok'eiiat khilofi in buda, nizomi koinot munazzam ast. Pas Khudoi Sokh'ibi Arsh az on chi mushrikon Uro tavsif mekunand, ki guio sharik dorad, poku bartar meboshad.

23) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar podshokh'i va kh'ukm Iagona ast. Kh'ech' kas Uro az on chi tak'dir va kh'ukm karda ast, namepursad va U bandagonashro az korashon mepursad va baroi on podoshashon medikh'ad.

24) Balki mushrikon g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi ibodat ma'budkh'oro giriftand. Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon bigu: "Baroi isboti sazovori ibodat budani butkh'oiaton dalelatonro biiored. Dar in Kitobi bar man nozilshuda va Kitobkh'oi bar paiombaroni k'abl az man nozilshuda dalele nest, ki durustii kori shumoro isbot kunad. Balki beshtari mushrikon ch'uz ba nodoni va tak'lid ba chize takia namekunand va az in ru kh'ak'ik'atro namedonand. Binobar in, onkh'o az paziruftani kh'ak'ik'at ruigardonand.

25) Va ei Paiombar, Mo pesh az tu kh'ech' paiombarero nafiristodaem, magar in ki ba vai paig'om mekardem, ki beshubkh'a, ba ch'uz Man ma'budi barkh'ak' nest. Pas tankh'o Maro biparasted va az shirk biparkh'ezed.

26) Va mushrikon guftand: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) farishtagonro dukhtaroni Khud girifta ast." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on durug'e, ki mushrikon meguiand, pok ast. Balki farishtagon bandagoni giromiiu ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'ariband.

27) Farishtagon dar guftani sukhan az Parvardigorashon peshdasti namekunand, to vak'te ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) farmon nadikh'ad, chize nameguiand va onkh'o bo amri U amal karda, kh'ech' gokh' ba nofarmoni rokh' namedikh'and.

28) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korkh'oi guzashta va oiandai farishtagonro medonad va onkh'o shafoat namekunand, ch'uz on kasero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az u rozi gardad va ich'ozati shafoatro dikh'ad va onkh'o ba sababi khavfashon az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amesha dar kh'arosand, ki duchori nokhushi nashavand. Dar amru nakh'i bo U khilof namekunand.

29) Va ba farzi misol, agar kase az farishtagon "Ba durusti ki man g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'bud kh'astam" guiad, pas beshubkh'a, Mo uro ruzi k'iiomat bo uk'ubati abadii duzakh ch'azo medikh'em. Kasonero, ki bo kofir shudan va shirk ovardan bar ch'oni khesh sitam kardaand, kh'amin guna ch'azo medikh'em.

30) Oio kofiron namedonand, ki osmonkh'o va zamin bo kh'am chaspida budand. Baini on du ch'udoi nabud, to az osmon boron rezad. Pas Mo on duro az kh'am ch'udo kardem va kh'ar chize az kh'aivonot va nabototro az obi az osmon ba zamin nozilshuda ofaridem. Pas oio az in ibrat namegirand va ba Allokh'i Iagona imon nameorand?!

31) Va dar zamin kukh'kh'oi ustuvorro ofaridem, to mavch'udoti ruiash k'arordoshtaro ba iztirob naorad va dar zamin rokh'kh'oi pakh'nro k'aror dodem, to bandagon dar safarkh'oi khesh rokh'ashonro ioband.

32) Va osmonro be sutun chun shift k'aror dodem, ki az aftodan ba zamin va az akhbor duzdidani shaitonkh'o makh'fuz ast. Va mushrikon az nishonakh'oi k'udrati ilokh'i dar osmon ba misli oftobu mokh' rui tofta, az on ibrat namegirand.

33) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki shabro baroi rokh'at va ruzro baroi kasbi rizk' va oftobro nishonai ruz va mokh'ro nishonai shab ofarida ast. Kh'ar iake az oftobu mokh' dar madori makhsusi khud kh'arakat mekunad va az on kach' nameshavad.

34) Va ei Paiombar, k'abl az tu baroi kh'ech' kas az insonkh'o dar dunio ch'ovidonagi nadodaem. Pas agar mukh'lati kh'aiotat dar in dunio anch'om iobad va bimiri, magar onkh'o ba'd az tu bok'i memonand?! Kh'argiz chunin nest!

35) Kh'ar iak nafsi mu'min io kofir dar in dunio chashandai marg ast. Va Mo shumo mardumro dar kh'aioti dunio bo sakhtikh'o va ne'matu ibodatkh'o meozmoem va ba'di marg tankh'o ba sui Mo bargardonida meshaved. Pas shumoro baroi kirdorkh'oiaton podosh medikh'em.

36) Va ei Paiombar, kh'ar vak't, ki in ch'amoai mushrikon turo binand, kh'atman ba maskharaat megirand va bo mak'sadi pairavoni kheshro az tu dur kardan meguiand: "Magar on kase, ki nisbat ba ma'budkh'oi shumo badgui mekunad, kh'amin ast?" Va onkh'o bar zammi on ki turo tamaskhur mekunand, K'ur'oni nozilkardai Allokh'i Mekh'rubon va ne'matkh'oi Uro niz inkor va nosiposi menamoiand. Az in ru, kofiron loik'tarand, ki aib girifta shavand, zero kh'ama badiro dar khud ch'am' sokhtaand.

37) Inson tabiatan bar shitobkori khalk' shuda ast. Baroi kh'amin, mekhokh'ad kh'ar kor k'abl az vak'tash anch'om shavad. Shitobkorii mushrikon dar borai talabi azob az kh'amin bob ast. Ei kasone, ki zudtar omadani azobi Maro mekhokh'ed, kh'atman ba shumo on chiro, ki omadanashro favri talab dored, nishon medikh'am. Pas zud omadani onro talab nakuned.
38) Va kofironi munkiri rastokhez meguiand: "Ei musalmonon, on zindashavaii ba'di marg, ki ba mo va'da dodaed, kai rukh medikh'ad, agar shumo dar da'voi khesh oidi vok'e'shavii on sodik' kh'asted?"

39) Agar in ch'amoai kofironi munkiri zindashavii ba'd az marg on vak'tero medonistand, ki otashro az chekh'ra va pushtashon dur karda nametavonand va on ruz iovare nadorand, ki uk'ubatro az onkh'o dur sozad, agar inro medonistand, kh'argiz zud omadani azobro nametalabidand.

40) In otashe, ki kofiron bo on azob meshavand, tavre nameoiad, ki onkh'o az zamoni vuk'uash ogokh'i doshta boshand, balki on nogakh'on omada, onkh'oro kh'airon mesozad. Pas onro dur karda nametavonand va ba onkh'o mukh'lat doda nameshavad, to tavba namoiand va mavridi rakh'mati ilokh'i k'aror girand.

Chun Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az tamaskhur va takzibi k'avmashon ranch' burdand, Khudo dar oiati zerin on kasro tasalli doda guft:
41) Va agar k'avmat maskharaat mekunand, andukh'gin mashav, zero tu nakhustin paiombare nesti, ki mavridi tamaskhur k'aror girifta boshi. Ba durusti ki paiombaroni pesh az tu guzashta niz mavridi tamaskhur k'aror giriftaand. Ba kh'amin sabab, kofironi maskharakunandaro azobe ikh'ota namud, ki chun paiombaron onkh'oro az on bim medodand, on azobro maskhara mekardand.

42) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikone, ki zud omadani azobro darkhost dorand, bigu: "Agar Allokh'i Mekh'rubon bar shumo shab va ruz uk'ubat va kh'alokatero nozil sozad, chi kase shumoro az on kh'ifz mekunad?!" Balki onkh'o az pand va dalelkh'oi Parvardigorashon ruigardonand. Az rui nodoni va bekhiradi dar borai on andesha namekunand.

43) Io mushrikon ma'budkh'oe dorand, ki onkh'oro az azobi Mo kh'imoiat mekunand?! Ma'budkh'oi botili onkh'o bo dur kunonidani zarar va ch'albi foida ba khud kumak karda nametavonand. Kase, ki kheshtanro iori karda natavonad, chi guna az ukh'dai iorii digaron mebaroiad?! Va mushrikon az azobi Mo panokh' doda nameshavand.

44) Balki Mo in kofiron va padaronashonro ba khotiri tadrich'an kh'aloksozi bo gustaronidani ne'matkh'oiamon bakh'ramand sokhtem, to on ki dar ne'mat umri daroz didand va mag'rur shuda, kufrashonro idoma dodand. Oio in ch'amoai mag'ruri ne'mat va darkhostkunandagoni zudtar omadani uk'ubat namebinand, ki Mo az atrofi zaminashon bo mag'lub kunonidanashon kam mekunem, to ibrat girand va uk'ubati bar digaron vok'e'shuda bar onkh'o naoiad?! Inkh'o g'olib nestand, balki mag'luband.

45) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei mardum, kh'amono shumoro bo paig'ome, ki Parvardigoram ba man mefiristad, az uk'ubat metarsonam." Va noshunavoion chun az azobi ilokh'i bim doda shavand, on chiro, ki ba suiash da'vat meshavand, dar amal nameshunavand.

46) Va ei Paiombar, agar ba in ch'amoae, ki mekhokh'and uk'ubati ilokh'i zud vok'e' shavad, kh'issae az azobi Parvardigorat birasad, meguiand: "Ei voi bar mo, ki kh'alok gashta, ziion kardaem. Begumon mo ba sababi shirk ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va bovar nakardani dini Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) sitamkor budaem."

47) Va ruzi rastokhez baroi akh'li makh'shar tarozukh'oi boadolat nasb mekunem, to bo istifoda az on korkh'oiashon barkashida shavad, pas dar on ruz kh'ech' kas bo kamshavii nekikh'o io afzunshavii badikh'oiash mavridi zulm k'aror namegirad va agar amali vaznshavanda misli vazni donai sipand khurd kh'am boshad, onro kh'ozir mesozem. Va Mo ba kh'aisi kh'isobgar basandaem. Kh'amai kori bandagonro ba tavri dak'ik' kh'isob mekunem.
48) Va kh'amono Mo ba Muso va Kh'orun (alaikh'is salom) Tavrotro, ki ch'udokunandai kh'ak'u botil va kh'alolu kh'arom buda, baroi mu'minon kh'idoiatgar va baroi parkh'ezkoron pandu andarz bud, dodem.
49) On parkh'ezkorone, ki bo vuch'udi nadidani Parvardigorashon ba U imon ovarda va az uk'ubatash metarsand va onkh'o az ruzi rastokhez dar kh'arosand.

50) Va in K'ur'oni bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilkardai Mo baroi kase, ki pand giriftan khokh'ad, andarz buda, doroi sud va khairi bisior ast. Oio shumo bo vuch'udi in onro inkor karda, ik'ror namekuned va rakh'namoii onro ich'ro namenamoed?!
51) Va iak'inan Mo ba Ibrokh'im dar khurdiash ba muk'obili k'avmash kh'uch'ch'at dodem va shoistagiashro ba dodani kh'uch'ch'at medonistem.
52) On gokh', ki u ba padarash Ozar va k'avmash guft: "In butkh'oe, ki onkh'oro bo dastoni khesh sokhta va dar bandi ibodatashon mondaed, chist?"
53) K'avmash ba u guftand: "Padaronamonro ioftem, ki butkh'oro meparastidand. Pas mo niz az rui tak'lid ba padaronamon onkh'oro parastidem."
54) Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei pairavoni guzashtagon, kh'amono shumo va padaronaton, ki dar butparasti tak'lidashon kardaed, az rokh'i kh'ak'ik'at dar gumrokh'ii oshkor buded."
55) K'avmash guftand: "Oio nazdamon omada, in sukhanonro az rui ch'iddiiat megui io tu az kh'azlkunandagoni?"

56) Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Balki ch'iddi meguiam va in shukhi nest. Parvardigori shumo, On Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin ast, ki onkh'oro be namuna ofarid va man oidi Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin budani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az guvokh'onam. Butkh'oi shumo dar in kh'issae nadorand."

57) Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) bo khud guft: "Savgand ba nomi Allokh', ba'd az on ki butkh'oro guzoshta, ba ch'ashn giriftani idaton meraved, baroi ma'budkh'oiaton chorae mesozam, ki az didani on badaton meoiad."

58) Pas Ibrokh'im butkh'oiashonro chunon maida kard, ki ba k'it'akh'oi khurd tabdil ioftand va kaloni butkh'oro nashikast, to k'avmi mushrikash nazdi on buti kalon bargashta, dar borai butshikan pursand.

59) Chun onkh'o az ch'ashni idashon bargashta, butkh'oiashonro porashuda ioftand, az kh'am pursidand: "Ki khudoioni moro chunin pora karda ast? Beshak, kh'ar ki in korro karda boshad, az ch'umlai sitamkoron ast. Zero u chizero, ki loik'i ta'zimu ekh'tirom ast, takh'k'ir namuda ast."
60) Ba'zeashon guftand: "Ch'avonero shunidaem, ki in ma'budkh'oi moro doim bo badi iod karda, ta'n mezad, on ch'avon Ibrokh'im khonda meshavad. Shoiad kh'amon Ibrokh'im in korro karda boshad."

61) Peshvoioni k'avmashon guftand: "Ibrokh'imro dar peshi nazari mardum kh'ozir kuned, to onkh'o bar e'tirofi u dar mavridi amali anch'omdodaash shokh'id shavand. Dar in surat ik'rorash baroi shumo kh'uch'ch'at megardad."
62) Pas Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro kh'ozir namuda pursidand: "Ei Ibrokh'im, oio in amali zishtro dar kh'ak'k'i ma'budkh'oi mo tu anch'om dodi?"

63) Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) bo mak'sadi rishkhand va dar nazdi ommai mardum oshkor kardani ach'zi butkh'oiashon guft: "In korro man nakardaam, balki onro kaloni butkh'o karda ast. Pas butkh'o gap mezada boshand, az kalonashon pursed."

64) Pas mushrikon andeshida, ba khud omadand va baroiashon ma'lum shud, ki butkh'o sudu zarar rasonida nametavonand. Pas ba'ze ba ba'zei digar guftand: "Kh'amono shumo ba sababi parastishi in ma'budkh'oi khudsokhta sitamkored."

65) Sipas ba iakravi va kufrashon gashta guftand: "Ei Ibrokh'im, beshak, tu iak'inan medoni, ki in butkh'o sukhan karda nametavonand. Pas chi guna moro megui, ki dar borai in kh'odisa az onkh'o pursem?!" Mak'sadi mushrikon az in sukhan ziddi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) kh'uch'ch'at ovardan bud, vale gapi guftaashon bar'aks alaikh'i khudi onkh'o dalel gasht.

66) Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba ma'noi inkori gapi k'avmash guft: "Pas oio g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) butkh'oero meparasted, ki ba shumo chize foida va zarar rasonida nametavonand?! Butkh'oi shumo, kh'atto az sud va ziion rasonidan ba kheshtan och'izand.

67) Zishti bod bar shumo va bar on butkh'oe, ki g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted, kh'ol on ki zarar va foida rasonida nametavonand. Oio ak'laton inro namegirad, to ibodati onkh'oro tark kuned?!" Vak'te butparaston az in ki bo rokh'i kh'uch'ch'at bar ziddi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) muboriza barand, och'iz shudand, ba istifodai neru ru ovarda guftand:
68) "Agar Ibrokh'imro baroi intik'omi shikastani butkh'o ch'azo dodani boshed, pas uro otash bizaned."

69) Onkh'o otash afrukhta, Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro dar on andokhtand. Pas, Mo guftem: "Ei otash, bar Ibrokh'im sard va moiai salomati bosh." Pas, otash kh'amin guna shud va ba u osebe narasonid.

70) Va k'avmi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) khostand dar kh'ak'k'i u dasisa kunand, ba in tartib, ki uro dar otash suzonand va Mo nairangashonro botil sokhtem va khudashonro kh'alokshudai mag'lubgashta gardonidem.
71) Va uro kh'amrokh'i Lut nach'ot dodem va on duro ba sui sarzamini Shom, ki dar on bo barangekhtani paiombaron va gustaronidani nekikh'o baroi mavch'udot barakat dodaem, berun sokhtem.

72) Va vak'te Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) az Parvardigorash khost, ki ba u farzand ruzi namoiad, baroiash Iskh'ok' va ilova bar on Ia'k'ubro bakhshidem va kh'ar iake az Ibrokh'im, Iskh'ok' va Ia'k'ubro bandagoni solekh'i itoatkor sokhtem.

73) Va in paiombaroni iodshudaro peshvoione gardonidem, ki mardum ba onkh'o dar kh'ama kori nek pairavi mekardand, mardumro bo ich'ozati Parvardigor ba ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rokh' menamudand va ba onkh'o paig'om firistodem, ki nekikh'o kuned va namozro dar komiltarin surati on barpo dored va zakot dikh'ed va onkh'o ba Mo taslimgashta budand.

74) Va ba Lut dovari baini tarafkh'oi da'vogar va ilmi mutaallik' ba masoili diniro dodem va uro az azobi ba sokinoni dekh'aash furud ovardaamon, ki amali fakh'sh mekardand, solim nigokh' doshtem. Kh'amono onkh'o k'avmi badkori az itoati Parvardigorashon khorich' budand.

75) Va Lutro ba rakh'matamon vorid namudem, chun uro az uk'ubati ba k'avmash rasida nach'ot dodem. Begumon vai az ch'umlai bandagoni solekh'e bud, ki farmonkh'oi Moro ba ch'o meovard va az man'kardakh'oiamon parkh'ez menamud.

76) Va ei Paiombar, k'issai Nukh'ro iod kun. Vak'te k'abl az Ibrokh'im va Lut Parvardigorashro nido kard, pas Mo bo dodani khostaash duoi uro paziruftem, pas vai va khonavodai mu'minashro az andukh'i buzurg rakh'o sokhtem.

77) Va uro az makri k'avme, ki oiatkh'oi Moro oidi ta'iid va isboti rostguiash durug' shumurdand, nach'ot dodem. Ba durusti ki onkh'o k'avmi fasodkori badkor budand. Ba kh'amin sabab, kh'amaashonro bo g'ark' sokhtan dar dario kh'alok gardonidem.

78) Va ei Paiombar, k'issai Dovud va pisarash Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom)-ro iod kun. On gokh', ki onkh'o dar borai vok'eai marbut ba du shakhsi da'vogar, ki nazdashon ovarda shud, dovari kardand. Iake az on du gusfandone dosht, ki shab ba kishtzori nafari duium daromada, ziroatashro khurda tabokh' gardonida budand. Va Mo shokh'idi dovarii Dovud va Sulaimon budem. Chize az dovarii onkh'o az ilmi Mo g'oib nabud.

79) Va Mo dar in mas'ala kh'ukmi munosibtarro ba Sulaimon, na ba padarash Dovud fakh'monidem va baroi Dovudu Sulaimon nubuvvat va ilmi akh'komi shariatro doda, Sulaimonro dar in bob khos nasokhtem. Va kukh'kh'oro bo Dovud rom kardem, ki bo Dovud tasbekh' meguftand va niz parandagonro ba u rom gardonidem. Va anch'omdikh'andai fakh'monidani durustii kh'alli mas'ala ba Sulaimon, atokunandai nubuvvatu ilm ba padaru pisar va romsozandai kukh'kh'ovu parandagon ba Dovud Mo budem.

80) Va ba Dovud tarzi sokhtani ch'avshankh'oro ta'lim dodem, to on ch'avshankh'o shumoro az on ki silokh' badanatonro pora sozad, mukh'ofizat kunad. Pas ei mardum, oio shumo shukrguzori in ne'mati in'omkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'asted?

81) Va baroi Sulaimon bodi tundvazandaro musakhkhar sokhtem. Chun Sulaimon onro ba vazidan ba sui sarzamini Shom, ki bo firistodani paiombaron va gustaronidani nekikh'o dar on barakat dodaem, farmon medod, bo farmonash kh'arakat mekard. Va Mo tamomi chizro medonem. Kh'ech' chiz az Mo pinkh'on namemonad.

82) Va az miioni shaitonkh'o on kasonero musakhkhar gardonidem, ki ba khotiri naf'i Sulaimon zeri dario furu rafta, marvorid va nav'kh'oi digari sangkh'oi k'imatro berun meovardand va ch'uz in digar korkh'oro ba misli imoratsozi anch'om medodand. Va Mo te'dod va amalkh'oi onkh'oro nigokh'doranda budem. Kh'ech' chizi onkh'o az Mo dur namemond.

83) Va ei Paiombar, k'issai Aiubro iod kun. Vak'te Parvardigorashro kh'angomi rasidani ranch' duo karda guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, kh'amono man mubtaloi bemori va az dast dodani khonadonam gashtaam va Tu az tamomi mekh'rubonon mekh'rubontar kh'asti. Pas in ranch'ro az man bartaraf bigardon."

84) Pas duoiashro paziruftem va ranch'i ba vai rasidaro bartaraf sokhtem va khonadoni az dast dodaash va mislashonro bo onkh'o ba u dodem. Mo in korkh'oro ba khotiri rakh'mate az nazdi Khesh va pandi bandagoni bo ibodat farmonbardor kardem, to ba misli Aiub (alaikh'is salom) bosabr boshand.
85) Va ei Paiombar, Ismoil va Idris va Zulkiflro zikr kun. Kh'ar iake az inkh'o dar kh'amai dardu ranch' va ich'roi mas'uliiatkh'oi bandagi az ch'umlai bandagoni bosabr budand.

86) Va onkh'oro ba rakh'matamon dokhil sokhta, paiombar gardonidem va ba ch'annat voridashon mekunem. Ba durusti, onkh'o az bandagoni neki Mo budand. Ibodati Uro mekardand va zokh'iru botini solekh' doshtand.

87) Va ei Paiombar, k'issai sokh'ibi mokh'i Iunusro iod kun. On gokh', ki be ich'ozai Parvardigorash az sababi ziiod dar isionkori furu raftani k'avmash az korashon g'azabnok az nazdashon raft. Pas pindosht, ki Mo kh'argiz ba vai bo much'ozot namudanash baroi on ki be ich'ozat mardumro tark karda rafta ast, tangi nameorem. Pas vak'te mokh'i uro furu burd, duchori tangi va kh'abs shud. Pas u dar torikikh'oi shabu dariovu shikami mokh'i duo karda, ba gunokh'i khesh ik'ror namud va ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavba ovarda guft: "Ch'uz Tu Ma'budi barkh'ak' vuch'ud nadorad. Tu Zoti Poku Muk'addas kh'asti. Kh'amono man az ch'umlai sitamkoron budam."

88) Pas Mo duoi Iunusro paziruftem va uro bo berun kardan az torikikh'ovu shikami mokh'i az andukh'i sakht rakh'onidem. Va chunonchi Iunus (alaikh'is salom)-ro az andukh'i sakht nach'ot dodem, vak'te mu'minon giriftori dardu ranch' shavand va Moro duo kunand, kh'amin guna onkh'oro nach'ot medikh'em.

89) Va ei Paiombar, k'issai Zakariioro iod kun. Vak'te Parvardigori Iagonaashro duo karda guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, maro befarzandi tankh'o maguzor va Tu bekh'tarini vorisoni. Pas baroiam farzande ruzi namo, ki ba'd az man bok'i bimonad va rokh'amro pesh barad."

90) Pas Mo duoiashro paziruftem va baroiash Iakh'ioro bakhshidem va kh'amsarashro islokh' namudem. Pas kh'amsari Zakariio ba'd az on ki nozoi bud, zoianda shud. Ba durusti ki Zakariio va kh'amsaru farzandash kh'amesha ba sui anch'omi korkh'oi nek meshitoftand va Moro duo mekardand, dar kh'ole ki ba savobi nazdamon rag'bat va az uk'ubatamon kh'aros doshtand. Va onkh'o zoriiu tavallokunandai Mo budand.

91) Va ei Paiombar, k'issai Mariamro iod kun, on zane, ki sharmgokh'i khudro az zino nigokh' dosht. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sui u Ch'abrailro firistod. Ch'abrail dar vai damid, pas Mariam bordor shud va Mariamu pisarash baroi mardum alomati isbotkunandai k'udrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va nishonai on budand, ki chize Uro notavon sokhta nametavonad. Zero Parvardigor Isoro bepadar ofarid.
92) Ei mardum, in millati shumo iak millat va on millati Islom ast va Man Parvardigori shumoiam. Pas tankh'o Maro biparasted.
93) Va mardum parokanda gashtand. Onkh'o ba iaktoparast, mushrik, kofir va mu'min ch'udo shudand. Va ruzi k'iiomat inkh'o kh'amagi nazdi Mo barmegardand, pas onkh'oro ba sazoi a'molashon merasonem.

94) Pas kh'ar ki az onkh'o amalkh'oi shoista anch'om dikh'ad, dar kh'ole ki u ba Khudo, paiombaron va ruzi okhirat imon dorad, pas kori nekash rad va nosiposi nameshavad, balki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savobi onro duchand medikh'ad va onro ruze, ki barangekhta shavad, dar nomai a'molash navishta meiobad, pas bo didani podoshash khushkh'ol megardad.
95) Va baroi akh'li dekh'ae, ki Mo ba sababi kufr kh'alokashon sokhtem, boz ba dunio bargashtan va tavba namudanu paziruftashavii tavbaashon nomumkin ast.
96) Onkh'o kh'argiz barnamegardand, to vak'te ki devori monei khuruch'i Ia'ch'uch' va Ma'ch'uch' boz shavad va Ia'ch'uch'u Ma'ch'uch' az kh'ar balandii zamin shitobon baroiand.

97) Va bo berun omadani Ia'ch'uch'u Ma'ch'uch' k'iiomat nazdik gashta va dakh'shat va sakhtikh'oiash oshkor shavad. Pas nogakh'on didagoni kofiron az shiddati dakh'shati k'iiomat kushodavu khira gardad va guiand: "Ei voi bar mo. Ba durusti ki mo dar dunio sargarmi bekh'udakori shuda, dar g'aflat k'aror doshtem va baroi imruz omodagi nadidem, balki ba sababi kufru ma'siiat sitamkor budem."

98) Ei mushrikon, kh'amono shumo va on chi ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ibodat mekuned, inchunin insonkh'o va ch'inkh'oe, ki az shirk ovardani shumo rozi budand, otashangezi duzakh kh'asted. Shumo va ma'budkh'oiaton voridi duzakh meshaved.

99) Agar in ma'budkh'o sazovori ibodat mebudand, kh'ech' gokh' kh'amrokh'i mushrikone, ki onkh'oro meparastidand, ba duzakh namedaromadand. Va kh'ar iake az obidonu ma'budon dar duzakh abadi memonand, kh'argiz az on khorich' nameshavand.
100) Duzakhiion dar ch'akh'annam ba sababi dardu ranch'i sakhte, ki duchor megardand, sado va nolai shadid dorand va onkh'o dar duzakh az shiddati dakh'shat sadokh'oro nameshunavand.

101) Vak'te mushrikon guftand: "Iso (alaikh'is salom) va farishtagone, ki mavridi parastish k'aror giriftaand, dokhili duzakh meshavand." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ch'avobi onkh'o guft: "Beshak, kasone, ki ba monandi Iso az akh'li saodat budanashon dar ilmi Mo guzashta ast, onkh'o az duzakh dur karda meshavand."
102) Akh'li saodat sadoi duzakhro nameshunavand va onkh'o dar ne'mat va lazzatkh'oe, ki nafsashon khokh'ad, abadi memonand. Ne'mati baroiashon rasida kh'ech' gokh' gusasta nameshavad.

103) Vak'te dari duzakh bar boshandagonash basta meshavad, dakh'shati buzurgash bikh'ishtiionro nametarsonad va farishtakh'o onkh'oro bo tabrik peshvoz girifta meguiand: "In on ruzest, ki dar dunio ba shumo va'da doda meshud va imruz bo didani ne'matkh'oi ch'annat shod meshaved."

104) Ruze, ki Mo monandi on ki kotib sakh'ifaro bo navishtakh'oi on mepechad, osmonro mepechem. Va khaloik'ro bo kh'amon kh'olate, ki nakhustin bor ofarida shudaand, ch'am' meorem. Mo dar in bora va'dai k'at'i, ki khilof nameshavad, dodaem. On chiro, ki va'da medikh'em, ich'ro mekunem.

105) Va kh'amono Mo ba'd az on ki dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz navishtem, dar Kitobkh'oi bar paiombaron nozilkardaamon navishta budem: "Beshubkh'a, zaminro bandagoni solekh'amon, ki ibodati Moro ba ch'o meorand, ba meros mebarand." Murod az bandagoni solekh' ummati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) meboshand.

106) Beguftugu, dar on chi az pand furud ovardem baroi k'avme, ki Parvardigorashonro bar asosi shariati U ibodat mekunand, manfiat va kifoiat ast. Zero bandagoni Khudoparast az irshodoti K'ur'on foida mebarand.

107) Va ei Mukh'ammad, Mo turo nafiristodem, ch'uz baroi rakh'mati tamomi mavch'udot. Zero tu doroi sifatkh'oi volo meboshi va doim dar taloshi kh'idoiati mardum va rakh'onidanashon az azobi ilokh'i kh'asti.

108) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Kh'amono ba man az sui Parvardigoram vakh'i firistoda meshavad, ki Ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ii shumo, Ma'budi Iagonai besharik, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Pas baroi ba U imon ovardan va az dasturotash itoat kardan taslim shaved."

109) Pas ei Paiombar, agar in ch'amoa az on chi ovardai, rui toband, ba onkh'o bigu: "Shumoro az vuk'ui uk'ubat ogokh' kardam. Man va shumo dar nadonistani zamonash iaksonem. Va man dar bobi on ki azobi ba shumo va'da dodai Parvardigor kai meoiad, az shumo donotar nestam."

110) Beshubkh'a, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sukhani oshkoratonro medonad va sukhanero, ki pinkh'on mekuned, niz medonad, kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi namemonad va dar iak'inan shumoro baroi sukhanoni oshkoru pinkh'onaton podosh medikh'ad.

111) Va man namedonam, shoiad Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo mak'sadi ozmoish va az bobi tadrich'an kh'alok gardonidan va to mukh'lati dar ilmi U muk'addar bakh'ra burdanaton ba shumo mukh'lat doda ast, to dar kufru gumrokh'iaton beshtar furu raved.

112) Rasuli Allokh' (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) Parvardigorro duo namuda guftand: "Ei Parvardigoram, baini mo va baini k'avmamon, ki dar kufrashon pofishori dorand, bo kh'ukmi kh'ak' faisala namo. Va muk'obili on chi az kufru takzib megued, az Parvardigori Mekh'rubonamon iori mech'uem."

1) Ei mardum, az Parvardigoraton bo ich'roi farmonkh'o va parkh'ez az man'kardakh'oiash bitarsed. Beshubkh'a, on kh'avodisi dakh'shatnoke, ki dar k'iiomat az misoli zaminlarza va g'aira ba vuk'u' mepaivandad, rukhdodi kh'arosangezi buzurg buda, omodagi baroi on bo anch'omi korkh'oi mavridi pisandi Parvardigor farz ast.

2) On ruze, ki zaminlarzai k'iiomatro mushokh'ida mekuned, kh'ar zani shirdikh'andai piston ba dakh'oni tifli shirkhor az kudaki khud g'ofil memonad va kh'ar zani bordor az shiddati tars bachai shikamashro furu meandozad va mardumro bo az dast dodani ak'l az sakh'nai dakh'shatnoki on ruz monandi maston mebini, kh'ol on ki onkh'o mast nestand, valekin azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat sakht buda, ak'lashonro az bain burda ast.

4) Bar on shaitoni insi va ch'innii sarkash navishta va kh'ukm shuda ast, ki kh'ar ki az vai pairavi namuda, ba u bovar kunad, pas ba durusti, pairavashro az rokh'i kh'ak' gumrokh' mesozad va ba vositai kufru ma'siiat uro ba sui duzakh meronad.

5) Ei mardum, agar dar mavridi k'udrat doshtani Mo oidi zinda gardoninataton ba'd az marg shubkh'a dored, pas, dar borai ofarinishi khesh andeshed. Begumon Mo padaraton Odamro az khok ofaridem, sipas nasli uro az obi manii mard, ki dar bachadoni zan ch'oigir meshavad, khalk' kardem, sipas obi mani ba khuni basta tabdil meshavad, ba'd az on khuni basta ba poragushti shabekh'i k'it'ai gushti khoidashuda mubaddal megardad, sipas on gushtpora io ba makhluk'i doroi shaklu andom tabdil iofta, dar bachadoni zan to vak'ti ba surati navzodi zinda berun shudan bok'i memonad io ba makhluk'i nok'isandom tabdil gashta, bachadon onro pesh az mukh'lat berun meafkanad, to ba shumo k'udrati Kheshro az rokh'i dar chand markh'ila ofaridanaton baion kunem. Va ch'aninkh'oero, ki khokh'em, to faro rasidani nukh' mokh' mukh'lati muaiiangashta dar bachadonkh'o nigokh' medorem, sipas shumoro ba surati tifl az batni modaronaton berun mesozem, sipas shumoro zeri nazoratamon megirem, to ba kamoli neru va ak'l birased va ba'zeaton pesh az in memirad va ba'zei digaraton to rasidan ba pironsoli umr mebinad, sinne, ki dar on neru va khirad notavon meshavad, kh'atto kh'olatash az kh'olati kudak badtar megardad, az on chi pesh medonist, chizero namedonad. Va zaminro khushki berastani mebini, pas chun bar on obi boronro furud biiorem, ba sababi ruidani rastani boz shavad va ba sababi rushdi nabotot baland gardad va az kh'ar nav'i nabotot rastanikh'oi zebomanzarro berun sozad.

6) On chi baroiaton oidi nakhustin zamoni ofarinish, markh'ilakh'oi on va kh'olatkh'oi minba'dai vilodati tifl zikr kardem, bo mak'sadi on ast, ki imon ored, ki Allokh'i Kholik'aton Parvardigori barkh'ak' ast va to imon ored, ki U murdagonro zinda mesozad va iak'inan U ba kh'ama chiz K'odir meboshad. Kh'ech' chiz och'izash sokhta nametavonad.
7) Va to imon ored, ki k'iiomat omadanist, dar omadani on shubkh'ae nest va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) murdagonro az k'abrkh'oiashon barmeangezad, to ba onkh'o podoshi a'molashonro dikh'ad.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati seium kh'olati kasonero, ki bo tak'lidi kur-kurona gumrokh' shudaand, baion namud, dar oiati zerin kh'olati gumrokh'ii peshvoioni kufrro zikr karda guft:
8) Va ba'zei kofiron biduni donishi rasonanda ba sui kh'ak'ik'at va biduni pairavii rakh'namoi barkh'ak' va biduni kitobi ravshangari az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omada dar borai iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bakh's mekunad-

9) dar kh'ole gardani khudro az rui takabbur bargardonanda ast, to mardumro az imon ovardan va daromadan ba dini Khudo man' namoiad. Dar dunio baroi shakhsi doroi chunin sifatkh'o bo rasidani uk'ubat khori ast va ruzi k'iiomat ba u azobi otashi nikh'oiat suzandaro mechashonem.

10) Ruzi k'iiomat ba vai gufta meshavad: "In azobi chashidaat ba sababi kufr va ma'siiatest, ki onro bo dastoni khesh kasb kardai va iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagonash sitamgor nest, kasero begunokh' azob namekunad."

11) Va ba'ze mardum dar kh'olati noustuvor k'aror doshta, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bo shubkh'a ibodat mekunad. Pas agar uro nekie ba misli tandurusti va tavongari birasad, imon va ibodatashro idoma medikh'ad va agar ba sababi bemorivu tangdasti ba u ozmoishe birasad, az dinash foli bad girifta, az on barmegardad. Chunin banda dunioro az dast doda ast, zero kufrash rizk'ashro afzun namesozad va okhiratro ba sababi giriftori ba uk'ubati ilokh'i az dast doda ast. Ziioni kh'ak'ik'ii oshkor kh'amin ast.

12) Ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) butkh'oero meparastad, ki agar nofarmoniashon kunad, zarare rasonida nametavonand va agar az onkh'o farmonbardori kunad, k'udrati foida rasonidanro niz nadorand. Ibodati butkh'o, ki zienu foida rasonida nametavonand, gumrokh'ii vok'eii az kh'ak'ik'at dur ast.

13) In kofiri butparast chizero meparastad, ki ziionash az sudash nazdiktar ast. Ma'bude, ki ziionash az sudash nazdiktar boshad, baroi kase, ki az u iori ch'uiad, iovari bisior zisht va baroi kase, ki uro ior girad, iori bisior bad ast.

14) Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kasonero, ki ba U imon meorand va korkh'oi shoista mekunand, ba bog'kh'oe medarorad, ki az zeri k'asrkh'oi on rudrkh'o ch'ori ast. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar on chi khokh'ad, mekunad. Kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, rakh'mat va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, azob medikh'ad. Kase Uro dar kh'ech' kore mach'bur sokhta nametavonad.

15) Kh'ar kas gumon mebarad, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' gokh' Paiombarashro dar duniovu okhirat nusrat namedikh'ad, resmonero dar sak'fi khonaash ovezad, ba'dan khudro dar on ovekhta, nafasgir shavad, sipas bingarad, ki oio in chorai kardaash khashmashro az miion mebarad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), sarfi nazar az khostan io nakhostani kofironi iakrav Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro nusrat medikh'ad.

16) Va chunonchi ba shumo dalelkh'oi ravshani isbotgari zindashavii ba'd az margro baion namudem, inchunin ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) K'ur'onro dar kh'ole ki az oiatkh'oi ravshan iborat ast, furud ovardem va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo fazlash ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro medikh'ad.

17) Ba durusti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ruzi k'iiomat k'azovat mekunad baini kasone az in ummat, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaand va iakh'udu sobein[ Toifae az pairavoni paiombaron], nasoro, otashparaston va butparaston. Pas, mu'minonro ba ch'annat va kofironro ba duzakh medarorad. Beguftugu, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tamomi guftoru kirdori bandagonash Guvokh' ast. Chize az U makhfi namemonad va kh'atman ba onkh'o podosh khokh'ad dod.

18) Ei Paiombar, oio namedoni, ki kh'amai farishtagoni osmonkh'o va insonkh'ovu ch'inkh'oi boimoni zamin ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sach'dai ibodat anch'om medikh'and va niz oftobu mokh' va sitoragoni osmon va kukh'kh'o va darakhton va khazandagoni zamin ba U sach'dai itoat menamoiand va bisiori mardum ba U sach'dai toat mekunand?! Va adadi ziiodi digarashon az sach'dai toat khuddori menamoiand, pas azobi Parvardigor dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o ba sababi kufr varzidan k'at'i gashta ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro ba sababi kofir shudan ba khoriiu rasvoi kh'ukm kunad, pas kh'ech' kase nest, ki uro giromi dorad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar chi khokh'ad, anch'om medikh'ad, kh'ech' kas Uro dar kore mach'bur sokhta nametavonad.

Chun Khudo dar oiati mazkur kasonero, ki sach'dai itoat mekunand va kasone, ki az in nav'i sach'da khuddori menamoiand, baion kard, dar oiati zerin ok'ibati kh'ardu gurukh'ro zikr namuda guft:
19) In du toifai muk'obili iakdigari akh'li imonu kufr dar borai Parvardigorashon bo kh'am bakh'su munozara kardaand, ki kadome az onkh'o kh'ak' kh'astand. Pas otashi duzakh kofironro monandi ikh'otasozii libos pushandaashro dar ikh'ota megirad va az boloi sarashon obi bag'oiat ch'ush rekhta meshavad.
20) Bo on ob az shiddati kh'aroratash on chi dar batni akh'li duzakh ast va inchunin pustkh'oi badanashon ob karda meshavad.
21) Va onkh'oro gurzkh'oi okh'aninest, ki farishtagon bo on bar fark'i sarashon mezanand.
22) Kh'ar bore az shiddati ranch'u azob k'asdi az duzakh berun shudanro kunand, boz ba on bargardonida meshavand va ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Azobi otashi suzandaro bichashed."

23) Va toifai mu'minone, ki ba Parvardigor imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba bustonkh'oe medarorad, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtoni on rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in ch'amoaro bo dastmonakh'oi tillogin va marvoridkh'o oroish medikh'ad va libosashon dar onch'o az kh'arir ast.

24) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) akh'li ch'annatro dar dunio ba sui guftorkh'oi nek ba monandi guftani "Kalimai shakh'odat", "Allokh'u akbar" va "Alkh'amdu lillokh'" rakh'namoi mekunad va onkh'oro ba sui ch'odai pisandidai Islom rakh'namoi menamoiad.

25) Albatta, kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudaand va mardumro az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) [dini Islom] va daromadan ba Masch'id-ul-kh'arom boz medorand, chunonchi mushrikon soli "Sulkh'i Kh'udaibiia" bo mu'minon chunin karda budand, pas ba onkh'o azobi dardovar mechashonem. Masch'id-ul-kh'arom makonest, ki onro k'iblai namozi mardum va az oinkh'oi kh'ach' k'aror doda, sokini doimii Makka va az digar kishvar ba in sarzamin voridshavandaro dar on iakson gardonidaem. Va kh'ar ki dar onch'o k'asdan gunokh' karda, irodai az kh'ak' bargashtan kunad, ba u az uk'ubati dardovar mechashonem.

26) Va ei Paiombar, iod kun on vak'tero, ki baroi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) makon va kh'ududi Khonai Ka'baro ba'd az on ki noma'lum bud, baion kardem va ba u vakh'i firistodem, ki dar ibodati Man chizero sharik magardon, balki tankh'o Maro ibodat kun va khonaamro baroi tavofkunandagon va namozguzoron az palidikh'oi kh'issi va ma'navi pok bisoz-

27) va dar baini mardum fariod karda, onkh'oro ba ziiorati in Khona, ki Mo dasturat dodem, to onro buniod kuni, da'vat namo, to onkh'o nazdat piioda va savorai kh'ar shuturi log'ar oiand. Shuturon onkh'oro az kh'ar rokh'i dur bardoshta biiorand,-

28) to dar marosime kh'ozir shavand, ki ba onkh'o manfitakh'oi ziiod ba misli mag'firati gunokh', kasbi savob, vakh'datu iakporchagi va g'airi onro ch'alb mesozad va to nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bar chakh'orpoione, ki dar ruzkh'oi ma'lum (dakh'umi mokh'i Zulkh'ich'ch'a va se ruzi ba'd az on) zabkh' mekunand, zikr sozand. In bo mak'sadi izkh'ori sipos az ne'mati chakh'orpoionest, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruziashon namuda ast. Pas khud az gushti k'urbonikh'o iste'mol kuned va ba shakhsi fak'iri sakht niiozmand niz bikhuroned.

30) In korkh'oi zikriofta az taroshidani muii sar, kutokh' kardani nokhun, dur sokhtani chirkinikh'oi badan, vafo ba nazr va tavofi Khonai Ka'ba, ki ba anch'omash dastur shudaed, ich'roi onro bar shumo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zaruri gardonida ast. Binobar in, ba korkh'oi amrkardai Parvardigor ekh'tirom guzored. Va kh'ar ki bo k'asdi ta'zimi kh'ududi guzoshtai ilokh'i va parkh'ez az poimolsozii kh'aromkh'o az on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'oli ekh'rom man' karda ast, duri ch'uiad, pas chunin kor nazdi Parvardigorash dar dunio va okhirat baroiash bekh'tar ast. Va ei mardum, iste'moli gushti shuturonu govonu gusfandon bar shumo kh'alol shuda ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az in chakh'orpoion "Kh'omi", Bakh'ira" va "Vasila" -ro chunonchi mushrikon meguiand, kh'arom nakarda, balki tankh'o murdor, khun va g'aira, ki kh'ukmi onro dar K'ur'on mekhoned, kh'arom karda ast. Pas az parastishi palidi, ia'ne butkh'o va az kh'ar sukhani botil va durug' boftan dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va mardum duri bich'ued.

31) Az palidii butparasti va sukhani botilu durug' duri ch'usta, az dinkh'oi botil ba sui dini pisandidai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargashta, kasero dar ibodat ba U sharik nagardoned. Va kh'ar ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk orad, guio az osmon aftoda, pas io parandagon gushtu ustukhonashro meraboiand io bodi sakht uro dar makoni dur meandozad.

33) Baroi shumo dar chakh'orpoioni k'urboni to vak'ti faro rasidani mukh'lati baroi zabkh' muaiianshuda, ki kh'angomi nazdikshavi ba Khonai az zeri kh'ukmfarmoii mutakabbironi tug'iongar ozodkardai Parvardigor ast, manfiatkh'oi ziiode monandi savorshavi, istifodai pashmu naslu shiri on chakh'orpoionro dored.

34) Va Mo baroi kh'ar iak ummati guzashta k'urbonii chakh'orpoionro muk'arrar namuda budem, to vak'ti zabkh'i onkh'o nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro zikr kunand. In bo kh'adafi siposguzorii ne'mati chakh'orpoion (shuturu govu gusfand) bud, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruziashon namud. Pas Ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ii shumo mardum Ma'budi Iagona ast. Binobar in, bo itoatkori tankh'o ba U taslim shaved. Va ei Paiombar, bandagoni furutani boikhlosro ba bikh'isht va podoshi farovoni Parvardigorashon muzhda bidekh'-

35) on bandagone, ki chun nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zikr shavad, az uk'ubati U tarsida, az mukholifatash duri mech'uiand va dar surati rasidani ranch'e sabrro peshai khud mesozand va namozro ba tavri komil ba ch'o meorand va az on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruziashon doda ast, dar rokh'i khair kharch' mekunand.

36) Va shuturonu govoni k'urboniro baroiaton az nishonakh'oi din k'aror dodaem. Shumoro dar on manfiatkh'oi dini va duniavii bisior ast. Pas kh'angomi zabkh'i k'urboni ba'di on ki bar poi istoda, saf zada, dast va poikh'oro ch'uft karda, daroz mekashand va iake az du dastashon baroi peshgiri az ramidan basta meshavad, bar on "Bismillokh'" bigued. Pas chun ba'd az zabkh' ba pakh'lu aftodand, shumo sokh'iboni k'urboni az gushti on iste'mol kuned va az on ba fak'iri k'anoatpeshae, ki az talbandagi khuddori mekunad va ba fak'iri oshkoro talbanda bikhuroned. Chunonchi Mo in chakh'orpoionro baroi bor kunonidan va savor shudan rom kardem, inchunin onkh'oro baroiaton rom namudem, ki ba kh'ar kuch'o khokh'ed, burda, k'urboni mekuned, az khostaaton sarpechi namekunand, to baroi ne'mati rom sokhtani in kh'aivonot shukri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o ored.

37) Va kh'ech' gokh' gushtkh'o va khunkh'oi k'urboni ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) namerasad, vale ba sui U parkh'ezkoriaton dar bobi chakh'orpoion bolo meravad. Ia'ne bo ich'roi k'urboni dar nazdiki ch'ustan ba U az khud ikhlos nishon dikh'ed. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in chakh'orpoionro kh'amin guna ba shumo rom karda ast, to Uro baroi on ki ba shumo tavfik'i kh'idoiati rasidan ba kh'ak'ro doda ast, ba buzurgi iod karda, shukrguzori kuned. Va ei Paiombar, bandagonero, ki dar ibodat va muomila bo mardum nekukorand, ba bikh'isht va podoshi farovoni Parvardigorashon muzhda bidekh'.

38) Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az mu'minon sharri dushmanonashonro dur mesozad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' bandai dar amonat khiionatkoru nosiposi ne'matkh'oiashro dust namedorad, balki ba u nafrat dorad.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati guzashta kh'imoiati Khudro az mu'minon baion namud va az in e'loni Parvardigor akh'li imon osudakh'ol gashtand, dar oiati zerin baroiashon ch'angidan bo kofironro ich'ozat doda guft:
39) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba mu'minone, ki kofiron alaikh'ashon mech'angand, ch'angidanro ich'ozat doda ast, zero onkh'o az tarafi dushmanon mavridi zulm k'aror giriftaand. Va begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'udrati onro dorad, ki biduni ch'ang mu'minonro bar kofiron piruz sozad, lekin kh'ikmati ilokh'i tak'ozo namuda ast, to mu'minonro bo rokh'i muk'obili kofiron ch'angidan biozmoiad.
