40) On mu'minone, ki kofiron onkh'oro bo zulm az manzilkh'oiashon berun kardaand, onkh'o gunokh'e sodir nakardaand, ch'uz in ki meguftand: "Parvardigoramon Allokh' ast. Mo g'air az U digar Parvardigor nadorem." Va agar on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi paiombaronu mu'minon az ch'angidan bo dushmanonashon ch'oiz gardonida ast, naboshad, begumon dushmanon ba makonkh'oi ibodat dastdarozi mekunand, pas khonak'okh'i obidoni nasroni va kalisokh'oi masekh'iion va kinishtkh'oi iakh'udiion va masoch'idi baroi namoz omodashudai musalmononro, ki dar on masoch'id nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bisior zikr mekunand, kharob mesozand. Va albatta, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kasero, ki dinu Paiombarashro iori rasonad, nusrat medikh'ad. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba nusrat dodani kase, ki dini Uro iori mekunad, bag'oiat K'aviiu G'olib ast.

41) In ch'amoai ba nusrati Khudo va'dashuda kasoneand, ki agar ba onkh'o dar zamin bo g'olibsoziashon bar alaikh'i dushman k'udrat dikh'em, namozro dar komiltarin surat barpo medorand va zakoti molashonro mepardozand va ba kori farmudai shariat amr va az kori man'kardai shariat nakh'i mekunand. Va ok'ibati korkh'o dar dodani savobu much'ozoti on tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barmegardad.

42) Va ei Paiombar, agar k'avmat turo ba durug'gui nisbat dikh'and, pas sabr kun, zero nakhustin paiombare nesti, ki az sui k'avmat mavridi takzib k'aror megiri. Iak'inan pesh az k'avmi tu k'avmi Nukh' va k'avmi Od va k'avmi Samud Paiombaroni khudro takzib kardaand.
43) Va k'avmi Ibrokh'im va k'avmi Lut paiombaroni kheshro durug'gui shumurdand.

44) Va sokinoni shakh'ri Madian Shuaib va Fir'avnu pairavonash Musoro durug'gui shumurdand. Pas uk'ubatamro az k'avmi paiombaroni mazkur bo mak'sadi tadrich'an kh'alok sokhtani onkh'o ba ta'khir guzoshtam, sipas onkh'oro giriftori azob namudam. Pas andesha namo, ki chi guna Man korashonro napisandidam. Ba durusti, Man in gurukh'i mavsufro ba sababi kufr varzidan kh'alok sokhtam.

45) Pas dekh'akh'oi nikh'oiat ziiodest, ki Mo akh'lashro dar kh'ole bo kufr varzidanashon zolim budand, bo azobi reshakansozanda kh'alok kardem, pas manzilashon kharobshudai az sokinonash kholist. Va te'dodi chokh'kh'oi az istifodabarandagon ba sababi kh'alok shudanashon kholi va shumorai k'asrkh'oi balandi oroishiofta, ki sokinonashro az uk'ubat nigokh' doshta natavonist, bag'oiat ziiod ast.

46) Oio in ch'amoai takzibkunandai oiini ovardai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar zamin sairu gasht namekunand, to osori dekh'akh'oi nobudshudaro binand, pas bo ak'lashon dar boraash biandeshand va ba sarguzashti sokinonash amalan gush faro dikh'and, to az on pand girand. Pas beshubkh'a, nobinoi, nobinoii didagon nest, balki nobinoii kh'ak'ik'ii kh'aloksozandai kas, nobinoii dilkh'ost. Alomati nobinoii dil on ast, ki sokh'ibash az chize pandu ibrat namegirad.

47) Va ei Paiombar, kofironi k'avmat az tu zudtar omadani azobi dunio va okhiratro talab mekunand, chunki onkh'o az uk'ubati in duniovu on dunio bim doda shudaand. Va kh'argiz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) azobero, ki ba kofiron va'da doda ast, khilof namekunad. On kh'odisae, ki ruzi ch'angi Badr bar sari akh'li kufr omad, az ch'umlai azobi favrii duniost. Va beshubkh'a, iak ruza azobi okhirat az sababi shiddati on monandi kh'azor sol az solkh'oi dunio ast, ki shumor mekuned.

48) Va shumorai akh'li dekh'akh'oe, ki baroiashon mukh'lat dodam, kh'ol on ki onkh'o ba sababi kufr varzidanashon zolim budand, bag'oiat bisior ast. Onkh'oro dar kh'ol uk'ubat nakardam, to tadrich'an kh'alokashon gardonam, sipas ba azobi reshabarandoz giriftorashon sokhtam va bozgashtashon ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui Man ast. Onkh'oro baroi kofir gashtanashon bo azobi doimi ch'azo medikh'am.
49) Bigu, ei mardum, ba durusti ki man baroi shumo bimdikh'andai oshkoram. On chi ba man vakh'i firistoda shavad, baroiaton merasonam.

50) Pas, on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovarda va korkh'oi shoista mekunand, onkh'oro az nazdi Parvardigorashon mag'firati gunokh'on va dar ch'annat ruzii poku farovonu arzishmandi abadi ast.

51) Va kasone, ki dar takzibi oiatkh'oi Mo sa'i mevarzand, dar kh'ole ki ba pindori khud mekhokh'and Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro och'iz gardonand va az azobi U rakh'oi ioband, in ch'amoa ioroni duzakhand. Chunonchi dust mudom bo dustash iakch'ost, onkh'o niz az duzakh ch'udo nameshavand.

52) Va Mo k'abl az tu Paiombar rasul va nabiero nafiristodaem, magar on ki vak'te Kitobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro tilovat karda ast, Shaiton bar k'iroatash shak andokhta ast, to ba mardum omekhta sozad, ki on az vakh'ii ilokh'i ast. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shubkh'aiu vasvasai afkandai Shaitonro botil namuda, oiatkh'oiashro ustuvor megardonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai kh'amai chiz buda, chize az U makhfi nest, dar ofarinish, muk'arrarsozii tak'dir va chorasozi bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

53) Shaiton dar k'iroati paiombar shubkh'a meafkanad, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shubkh'ai afkandai vairo baroi munofik'on va mushrikone, ki sangdil gashtaand, vasilai ozmoish sozad. Va kh'amono sitamkoroni munofik'u mushrik bo Allokh'u Rasulash adovati sakht doshta, az kh'ak'ik'at durand.

54) Va to kasone, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o donish doda ast, iak'in kh'osil kunand, ki K'ur'on ba tu Paiombar ba rosti az sui Parvardigorat vakh'i shuda ast, pas imonashon ba on afzun gardad va dilashon bo on orom va ba akh'komash taslim shavad. Va beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mu'minonro ba rokh'i rost rakh'namoi mekunad. In podoshi taslim shudan va orom giriftani k'albashon ba Kitobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

55) Va shakhsoni ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofirshudai takzibgar paivasta dar mavridi K'ur'oni bar tu nozilshuda dar kh'olati shubkh'a k'aror dorand, to on ki k'iiomat nogakh'on ba onkh'o oiad, io onkh'oro azobi ruze faro girad, ki dar on kofironu mushrikonro rakh'mat va khaire nest. Murod az ruzi mavsuf k'iiomat ast, ki ba kofironu mushrikon rakh'm karda nameshavad.

56) Farmonravoii ruzi k'iiomat, ki ba in ch'amoa azobi va'dashuda meoiad, tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kase ch'uz U dar on ruz podshokh'i nadorad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baini mu'minonu kofiron dovari mekunad. Ba kh'ar kadomi onkh'o bo on chi sazovorand, kh'ukm menamoiad. Pas kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon meorand va korkh'oi nek anch'om medikh'and, onkh'oro podoshi azimi bustonkh'oi doroi ne'matkh'oi doimii k'at'noshavanda ast.

57) Va on kasone, ki kofir meshavand va oiatkh'oi bar Paiombaramon nozilkardai Moro durug' meshumorand, onkh'oro azobi khorkunanda ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in ch'amoaro bo azobi Khesh dar duzakh khor megardonad.

58) Va on kasone, ki manzil va sarzamini kheshtanro baroi rizoi Parvardigor va izzat dodani din tark karda, sipas dar rokh'i ch'ikh'od kushta meshavand, io memirand, begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o dar ch'annat ruzii neki doimii bezavol medikh'ad. Va beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bekh'tarini ruzirasonon ast.

59) Beguftugu, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba makone medarorad, ki onro mepisandand va on ch'annati abadist. Va Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donoi Burdbor ast. Amalu mak'sadashonro medonad va az burdboriash onkh'oro dar dunio baroi kutokh'iashon zud azob namedikh'ad.

60) In va'daest, ki ba mukh'och'iron dodaem. Va kh'ar kas az sitampesha ba misli on chi bar vai sitam shuda ast, intik'om bigirad, baroi in amalash gunakh'kor namegardad. Sipas chun on zolim boz ba sitamkorii khud bargardad, pas kh'atman Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mazlumro ziddi on zolim nusrat medikh'ad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tavbakoron Bakhshandai Omurzanda ast.

61) Piruz gardonidani mazlum alaikh'i zolim ba sababi on ast, ki iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on chi khokh'ad, K'odir ast. Darovardani shab dar ruz va darovardani ruz dar shab bo ziiodu kamshavii on az k'udrati Ust va kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavoi Donost. Sukhani bandagonashro meshunavad va korashonro medonad. Chize az guftoru kirdorashon az U makhfi nest va ba zudi onkh'oro ba sazoi a'molashon merasonad.

62) On chi az darovardani shab dar ruz va ruz dar shab zikr gardid, ba sababi on ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Ma'budi barkh'ak' ast, dinash kh'ak', va'dai dodaash kh'ak' va mu'minonro piruz gardonidanash kh'ak' ast va beshubkh'a, on chi mushrikon meparastidand, botil ast va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo zotu kh'ukmu saltanatash az makhluk'ot Bartaru Buzurg ast. Sifati kibr khosi Ust.

63) Ei Paiombar, oio namebini, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az osmon boron furud meorad, pas zamin ba'di rekhtani boron ba sababi ruiidani nabotot sarsabz megardad. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagon bag'oiat Mekh'rubonu az onchi sudashon meorad Bokhabar ast. Bo mekh'ruboniash az osmon boron furud meorad va zaminro bo giiokh'on sarsabz megardonad Kh'ech' manfiati bandagon az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pushida nest.

64) Tamomi mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va tamomi mavch'udoti zamin tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti Beniiozi Sutuda ast. Ba kase va chize niioz nadorad va dar kh'ama kh'olat shoistai sutudan ast.

65) Ei Paiombar, oio namebini, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tamomi ch'onvaron va ashioi bech'oni zaminro ba khotiri sud va niiozkh'oiaton va niz kishtikh'oro, ki bo farmoni U az iak kishvar ba kishvari digare kh'arakat mekunand, baroiaton musakhkhar gardonid va osmonro az aftodan ba zamin nigokh' medorad, magar bo khostash, zero agar U khokh'ad, osmon ba zamin meaftad. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagonash Mekh'rubonu Doroi rakh'mati farovon ast. Binobar in, bo vuch'udi zulmi bandagon mavch'udoti mazkurro takh'ti farmoni onkh'o k'aror doda ast.

66) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki shumoro ba'di nesti kh'ast namuda, zinda sokht, sipas chun umraton anch'om iobad, shumoro memironad sipas, ba'di marg shumoro boz zinda megardonad, to baroi korkh'oiaton bozpursiaton karda, podoshaton dikh'ad. Beshak, inson nisbat ba ne'matkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) agarchi oshkorand, bo ibodati g'airi U nosiposi guzaro ast.

67) Baroi akh'li kh'ar millate shariate muk'arrar namudaem, ki onkh'o mutobik'ash amalkunandaand. Pas naboiad mushrikonu pairavoni digar dinkh'o dar borai shariati ovardaat bo tu Paiombar nizo' kunand. Zero tu dar rokh'i rost va onkh'o dar rokh'i botil kh'astand. Va mardumro ba sui Parvardigorat da'vat kun, to ibodat va tavkh'idro tankh'o baroi u anch'om dikh'and. Beshubkh'a, tu dar rokh'i rost k'aror dori. Dar on kh'ech' kach'i nest.

68) Va agar onkh'o ba'di oshkorshavii dalel boz kh'am bo tu munozara kunand, pas korashonro ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'avola namuda, takh'didomez bigu: "On chi mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bekh'tar medonad. Korkh'oiaton az U makhfi nameboshad va dar ruzkh'oi nazdik baroiaton podosh medikh'ad."
69) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat baini shumo mu'minon va kofiron dar borai on chi az umuri dini, ki dar dunio bo iakdigar ikhtilof mekarded, dovari mekunad.

70) Ei Paiombar, magar namedoni, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tamomi mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va zaminro medonad va chize az U makhfi nest?! Beshak, in kh'ama dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz sabt ast. Iak'inan donistani in chizkh'o bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bisior oson ast.

71) Va mushrikon g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) butkh'oero ibodat mekunand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi ibodatashon dar Kitobkh'oiash kh'uch'ch'ate furud naovarda ast va khud niz baroi in amal daleli ilmi nadorand. Takiagokh'i asosii mushrikon tak'lidi khato ba padaronashon ast. Va zolimon madadrasone nadorand, ki kh'angomi omadani uk'ubati ilokh'i onro bartaraf sozad.

72) Va chun ba akh'li K'uraish oiatkh'oi vozekh'i Mo dar K'ur'on tilovat shavad, vak'ti shunidan dar chekh'rai kofiron alomati inkori onro az girekh'i abruiashon meshinosi. Nazdik ast ba on kasone, ki oiatkh'oi Moro baroiashon mekhonand, kh'amla namoiand. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Oio shumoro az chize, ki az khashm va girekh'i abruiaton badtar ast, ogokh' sozam? On otashi duzakh ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro ba kofiron va'da doda ast. Va duzakh, ki ba sui on barmegarded, ch'oi bisior bad ast."

73) Ei mardum, baroiaton masale baion shuda ast, pas bo dik'k'at ba on gush kuned va ibrat gired. Beshak, on ma'budkh'oe, ki g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted, kh'argiz magasero, bo vuch'udi khurdi ofarida nametavonand, zero onkh'o och'izand. Va agar kh'amaashon baroi ofaridani on magas ch'am' shavand, az ukh'dai ofaridanash namebaroiand. Va agar magas khushbui va kh'ar chizi ba on monandro az ma'budkh'oiaton raboiad, k'udrat nadorand, ki onro az dasti magas rakh'onand. Va az sababi on ki ma'budkh'oi shumo az ofaridani magas va az rakh'onidani chizkh'oiashon och'izand, ma'lum gasht, ki onkh'o az ich'roi korkh'oi kalontar notavontarand. Vak'te chunin ast, pas chitavr onkh'oro g'air az Allokh'i Iagona ibodat mekuned?! Kh'am on but, ki chizkh'oi kheshro az magas rakh'onida nametavonad va kh'am magas darmondai notavonand.

74) Mushrikon ta'zimi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro chunonchi shoistai Zotash ast, ba ch'o naovardaand, zero makhluk'otro ba U sharik mesozand. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat Nerumandi kh'amesha G'olib ast. Ofaridani osmonkh'ovu zamin va digar mavch'udot az nishonakh'oi k'udrat va k'uvvati Ust. Ammo ma'budkh'oi botili mushrikon notavonu khor buda, kh'ech' chizro khalk' karda nametavonand.

75) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az farishtagon va az mardum paiombaronero intikhob mekunad. Ba'zei farishtagonro ba misli Ch'abrail ba sui paiombaroni nav'i bashar va paiombaroni az insonkh'o barguzidaashro ba sui mardum mefiristad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavoi Binost. Sukhani mushrikonro dar kh'ak'k'i paiombaron meshunavad va on kasero, ki baroi risolatash barguzida ast, mebinad.

76) Khudo akh'voli k'abl az ofaridan va ba'di margi farishtagon va insonkh'oi ba sifati paiombar barguzidaashro medonad. Va korkh'o ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardonida meshavad. Bandagonashro dubora zinda megardonad va onkh'oro baroi amalashon podosh medikh'ad.

77) Ei mu'minoni mutobik'i kh'ukmi shar' amalkunanda, dar namoz tankh'o baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruku' va sach'da kuned va korkh'oi nekro az k'abili sadak'a va paivandi alok'ai kheshovandi anch'om dikh'ed, ba umedi on ki ba ch'annat noil gashta, az ch'akh'annam nach'ot meiobed.

78) Va dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kholis baroi U ch'ikh'od namoed. U shumoro barguzida va dinatonro sodavu oson gardonida ast, ki dar on tangi va sakhti nest. In dini oson, dini padaraton Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ast. Va begumon Parvardigor shumoro dar Kitobkh'oi pesh va K'ur'on musalmon nomida ast, to Paiombarash bar shumo guvokh' boshad, ki farmudakh'oi ilokh'iro ba shumo rasonida ast va shumo bar ummatkh'oi guzashta guvokh' boshed, ki paiombaronashon farmudakh'oi ilokh'iro ba onkh'o rasonidand. Pas baroi in ne'matkh'o bo barposozii namoz dar surati komil shukri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o ored va zakoti molatonro bidikh'ed va dar kh'amai korkh'oiaton ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) panokh' bared va takia kuned. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi mu'minone, ki Uro Korsoz va Iovar giriftaand, neku Korsoz va neku Iovar ast. Uro Dusti khud gired, shumoro dust megirad, az U kumak khokh'ed, ba shumo iori merasonad.
1) Beshak, bandagoni boimoni muvofik' ba shariat amalkunanda bo kh'osil sokhtani ch'annat va nach'ot az duzakh rastagor gardida, ba orzuiashon merasand,-
2) kasone, ki dar namozashon furutan, a'zoi badanashon orom va k'albashon az sargarmikh'o kholist-
3) va kasone, ki az botilu bekh'udagi va sukhanu kori oludai ma'siiat rui megardonand-
4) va kasone, ki baroi poksozii nafs az sifatkh'oi bad va poksozii mol zakotashonro medikh'and-
5) va kasone, ki sharmgokh'ashonro bo dur nigokh' doshtani on az zino, livotagari va amalkh'oi fakh'sh nigokh' doshta, pokdomani mekunand-
6) ch'uz az kh'amsaron va kanizoni khud, zero onkh'o bo bakh'ra bardoshtan az kh'ambistarii kh'amsaronu kanizonashon malomat nameshavand,-
7) pas kh'ar ki az g'airi kh'amsaron va kanizonash bakh'ra burdan khokh'ad, vai bo tarki kh'alol va dastdarozi ba kh'arom az marzkh'oi guzoshtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guzashta ast-
8) va kasone, ki nigakh'dorandai amonatkh'oi Khudovu bandagon va akh'di kheshand, amonat va akh'dro zoe' namesozand, balki ba on vafo mekunand-
9) va kasone, ki namozkh'oiashonro bo adoi on dar vak'tkh'oi muaiian va rioiai farzu voch'ibu sunnatkh'oiash paivasta ba ch'o meorand.
10) In ch'amoai tavsifshuda merosbaroni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand,-
11) kasoneand, ki bolotarin mak'omi ch'annatro ba meros mebarand, onkh'o dar ch'annat abadi monda, rokh'atashon k'at' nameshavad.
12) Va Ba durusti ki Mo Padari bashariiat Odamro az shirai gil khalk' kardem.
13) Sipas farzandonashro nasl ba nasl az obi manie, ki to vak'ti tavallud dar bachadoni zan k'aror megirad, ofaridem.

14) Sipas ba'di obi nutfai bachadon khuni bastai surkh ofaridem, pas on khuni bastaro misli k'it'ai gushti khoidashuda gardonidem, pas az on gushtpora ustukhonkh'oi sakht khalk' namudem, pas ba on ustukhonkh'o gusht pushonidem, sipas uro bo damidani rukh'ash va barovardan ba dunio makhluk'i digare padid ovardem. Pas Boazamatu Volomak'om ast Allokh'i bekh'tarini sozandagon.
15) Sipas ei mardum, shumo ba'd az sipari kardani markh'ilakh'oi mazkur va anch'om ioftani mukh'lati zindagii khesh memired.
16) Sipas ba'di marg ruzi k'iiomat kh'atman dubora baroi bozpursi va giriftani podosh barangekhta meshaved.
17) Va Ba durusti ki Mo boloi shumo mardum kh'aft tabak' osmonro ofaridem va Mo az ofaridakh'oi Khesh g'ofilu onkh'oro faromushsozanda nabudem va nestem.

18) Va Mo az osmon ba andozai niiozi mavch'udot obi boron nozil sokhtem. Onro ziiod nafiristodem, to fosid nashavad va kam nakardem, to ba onkh'o basanda boshad. Pas onro dar zamin k'aror dodem, mardum va digar mavch'udot az on manfiat mebarand. Va albatta, Mo baroi az bain burdani obi boron, to az on istifoda karda natavoned, K'odir kh'astem.
19) Pas Mo bo on ob baroi shumo bustonkh'oi khurmo va angur padid ovardem, shumoro dar on bustonkh'o monandi anch'ir, anor va seb mevakh'oi gunogunrangi gunogunshakli ziiod ast va az onkh'o mekhured.

20) Va baroi shumo darakhti zaitunero, ki dar mintak'ai kukh'i Sino meruiad, padid ovardem, on darakht ruiida, az makh'sulotash ravg'an berun ovarda shuda, ba sifati ravg'an va nonkhurish istifoda meshavad.

21) Va ei mardum, shumoro dar chakh'orpoion (shuturu govu gusfand) ibratest, ki az on k'udrat va lutfi ilokh'iro bar kheshtan meshinosed va shumoro az shikami on chakh'orpoion shiri kholisi baroi nushandagon guvoro menushonem va shumoro dar onkh'o manfiatkh'oi ziiode ba monandi bakh'rabari az savorshavi, pashm, pust va g'airi on buda va az gushti onkh'o iste'mol mekuned.
22) Va az baini chakh'orpoion dar khushki bar shuturon va dar dario bar kishtikh'o savor karda meshaved.

23) Va Mo Nukh'ro sui k'avmash firistodem, to da'vatashon kunad. Pas ba onkh'o guft: "Ei k'avmi man, tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro biparasted. Shumo ch'uz U ma'budi barkh'ak' nadored. Oio bo ich'roi dasturot va khuddori az mamnuot parkh'ezkori namekuned?!"

24) Pas rakh'baronu peshvoioni ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofirshudai k'avmash ba pairavonashon va mardum guftand: "In marde, ki da'voi paiombari dorad, misli shumo insone besh nest. Mak'sadash ba dast ovardani rakh'bari va peshvoi ast va agar Allokh' ba mo paiombar firistodan mekhost, uro az miioni farishtagon mefiristod, na az insonkh'o. Mo in da'voi Nukh'ro az guzashtagonamon nashunidaem.
25) Beguftugu, Nukh' mardest, ki ba iak nav'i devonagi mubtalo shuda ast va chi guftanashro namedonad. Pas to iak muddati muaiian muntaziri u bimoned, to kh'ak'ik'atash ba mardum ravshan gardad."
26) Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Parvardigoro, maro alaikh'i in mardum iori doda, az onkh'o ba sababi takzibashon intik'omamro bisiton."

27) Pas ba sui Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) vakh'i firistodem, ki dar peshi nazari Mo va muvofik'i ta'limi dodaamon kishti bisoz. Pas chun dasturi Mo dar borai kh'alok sokhtani onkh'o oiad va obi tanur ch'ushida favvora zanad, pas dar kishti az kh'ar nav'i mavch'udoti zinda du ch'ufti naru modaro savor kun, to nasl idoma iobad va khonadonatro niz ba on savor kun, ch'uz on kas misli kh'amsar va farzandat az khonadonat, ki sukhani ilokh'i oidi kh'alok namudanashon guzashta ast. Va bo Man dar borai kasone, ki bo kufr varzidanashon zulm kardaand, guftugu makun va nach'otashonro matalab. Kh'amono onkh'o bo g'ark' shudan dar tufon kh'alok karda meshavand.
28) Pas chun tu bo mu'minoni kh'amrokh'at ba kishti savor shuded, pas bigu: "Sitoish sazovori Khudovandest, ki moro az dasti zolimon rakh'onida, onkh'oro kh'alok gardonid."
29) Va bigu: "Parvardigoro, maro dar zamin bobarakat furud biior va Tu bekh'tarini furudovarandagoni."

30) Albatta, dar on chi az nach'ot dodani Nukh'u mu'minon va kh'alok sokhtani kofiron zikr gardid, dalolatkh'oi ravshani nishondikh'andai k'udrati Mo dar piruz gardonidani paiombaron va nobud gardonidani takzibgaroni onkh'ost va Mo Ba durusti ki bo firistodani Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) ba sui k'avmash onkh'oro ozmudem, to mu'min az kofir va farmonbardor az nofarmon ch'udo shavad.
31) Sipas ba'di kh'alokati k'avmi Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) ummati digarero padid ovardem.

32) Pas dar bainashon paiombarero az nav'i khudashon firistodem, ki mardumro da'vat karda meguft: "Tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro biparasted. Shumo g'airi U ma'budi barkh'ak' nadored. Oio bo ich'roi dasturot va khuddori az mamnuot parkh'ezkori namekuned?!"

33) Va ashrofonu peshvoioni k'avmash, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shuda, okhiratu ach'ru ch'azoi onro durug' donista va ne'mati dar dunio ba onkh'o dodai Mo tug'iongarashon sokhta bud, ba pairavonashon va ommai mardum guftand: "In mard monandi shumo ch'uz insone besh nest. Az on chi mekhured, mekhurad va az on chi menushed, menushad. U az shumo iagon bartari nadorad, ki loik'i paiombari boshad.-

34) Va agar shumo misli khud insonero pairavi kuned, albatta, on vak't ziionkored, chunki ibodati ma'budkh'oi kheshro tark karda, ba kase pairavi namudaed, ki az shumo kh'ech' bartari nadorad va az ich'roi farmonash foidae nadidaed.
35) Oio in mardi da'vogari nubuvvat ba shumo va'da medikh'ad, ki vak'te memired va khok gashta, ustukhonkh'oiaton pusida shavad, az k'abraton boz zinda karda meshaved?! Oio in ba ak'l rost meoiad?!
36) On chi ba shumo va'da doda meshavad, ki ba'di marg va khok shudan boz zinda karda meshaved, kori aslan duru nomumkin ast.

37) Zindagoni ch'uz kh'aioti in dunio nest, okhirat vuch'ud nadorad, zindakh'oiamon memirand va az nav zinda nameshavand va digaron tavallud shuda, kh'aiot mebinand va mo ba'd az marg dar ruzi k'iiomat az k'abramon baroi pursish berun ovarda nameshavem.
38) Begumon in shakhsi da'vogari mak'omi paiombari mardest, ki bo in da'voiash bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' bofta ast va mo kh'argiz uro tasdik' namekunem."
39) On paiombar guft: "Parvardigoro, maro alaikh'i in k'avm iori doda, intik'omamro az onkh'o ba sababi maro takzib namudanashon bisiton."
40) Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ch'avobash guft: "Albatta, ba'di guzashtani zamoni andak in k'avmi takzibgari dinat baroi kori kardaashon pushaimon megardand."

41) Pas ba sababi on ki iakravi va sarkashi namuda, sazovori azob shudand, onkh'oro sadoi shadidi kh'aloksozanda faro girift. Pas Mo onkh'oro misli khasu khoshoki rui sel kh'alokshuda gardonidem. Pas k'avmi sitamkor kh'alok shavand.
42) Sipas ba'd az kh'aloksozii onkh'o ummatkh'oi digarero ba monandi k'avmi Lut, Shuaib, Iunus va g'aira padid ovardem.
43) Kh'ech' ummate az in ummatkh'oi takzibgar, novobasta az imkonote, ki dorand, az vak'ti baroi kh'alokati onkh'o muk'arrargashta pesh va ak'ib nameravand.

44) Sipas paiombaroni Khudro pai dar pai firistodem. Kh'ar gokh' ba in ummatkh'o paiombari ba suiashon firistodashuda omad, uro durug'gui donistand. Ba kh'amin sabab, Mo ba'zeashonro ba dunboli ba'zei digar kh'alok kardem va chunon nobud shudand, ki az onkh'o ch'uz sukhanoni mardum dar boraashon chize namond. Pas on k'avme, ki ba dini paiombaron imon nameorand, kh'alok gardand.

45) Sipas Muso va barodarash Kh'orunro bo nishonakh'o [Aso, dasti durakhshon, malakh, shapush, k'urbok'k'a, khun, tufon, khushksoli va kamshavii makh'sulot]-i nukh'gonai nishondikh'andai k'udratamon va kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan firistodem.
46) Onkh'oro ba sui Fir'avnu ashrofoni k'avmash firistodem. Pas kibr varzida, ba Musovu Kh'orun imon naovardand va onkh'o bo sitam bar k'avmashon kh'ukmfarmoi karda, mutakabbir budand.
47) Pas guftand: "Oio ba insonkh'oe misli khud, ki az mo bartari nadorand, imon meorem, kh'ol on ki k'avmashon Bani Isroil mute' va farmonbardori mo kh'astand?!"
48) Pas Musovu Kh'orunro dar on chi az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ovardaand, takzib namudand. Ba sababi takzibashon bo g'ark' shudan dar bakh'r kh'alok gashtand.
49) Va Mo Ba durusti ki ba Muso Tavrotro dodem, to k'avmash az on istifoda karda, ba sui kh'ak' rokh' ioband.
50) Va Iso ibni Mariam va modarash Mariamro nishonai k'udrati Khesh gardonidem. Vai biduni shavkh'ar bordor shud. Va modaru pisarro bar teppai shoistai sukunatu doroi amn va obi ch'ori panokh' dodem.
51) Ei paiombaron, az khurdanikh'oi pokizai kh'alol bikhured va amali neki mutobik'i shariat kuned. Albatta, Man amalero, ki ba ch'o meored, medonam, chize az Man makhfi nameboshad.

52) Va ei paiombaron, ba durusti, in millati shumo, millati iakto va on millati Islom ast va Man Parvardigori shumo kh'astam, ch'uz Man ma'budi kh'ak'ik'i nest, pas bo ich'roi amrkh'o va parkh'ez az man'kardakh'oiam az Man bitarsed.

53) Pas ba'di paiombaron k'avmashon dini kheshtanro pora sokhta, ba gurukh'kh'o ch'udo shudand. Kh'ar gurukh' sheftai bovarkh'oiash gashta, onro dini mak'bul mekh'isobad va on chi nazdi toifai digar ast, namepazirad.
54) Pas, ei paiombar, onkh'oro to omadani azob dar kh'olati nodoni va kh'airatashon biguzor.

55-56) Oio in gurukh'kh'oi bo iakdigar mukholifi sheftai bovarkh'oiashon mepindorand, ki mol va farzandone, ki dar dunio baroiashon medikh'em, az bobi dar dunio pesh az okhirat dodani nekikh'o va nishoni rizoi Mo az onkh'ost va inchunin dar okhirat neki mebinand?! Kh'argiz chunin nest. In ne'matkh'oro ba khotiri tadrich'an kh'alok sokhtanashon medikh'em, vale onkh'o inro ekh'sos namekunand.

55-56) Oio in gurukh'kh'oi bo iakdigar mukholifi sheftai bovarkh'oiashon mepindorand, ki mol va farzandone, ki dar dunio baroiashon medikh'em, az bobi dar dunio pesh az okhirat dodani nekikh'o va nishoni rizoi Mo az onkh'ost va inchunin dar okhirat neki mebinand?! Kh'argiz chunin nest. In ne'matkh'oro ba khotiri tadrich'an kh'alok sokhtanashon medikh'em, vale onkh'o inro ekh'sos namekunand.
57) Beshak, kasone, ki bo vuch'udi imon doshtan va amali nek kardan az Parvardigorashon dar kh'arosand-
58) va kasone, ki ba oiatkh'oi Kitobi U imon meorand-
59) va kasone, ki Parvardigori kheshro ba iagonagi meparastand va chizero ba U sharik namesozand-

60) va on kasone, ki dar ich'roi korkh'oi nek talosh mekunand va bo in vasila ba Parvardigor nazdiki mech'uiand, dar kh'ole kh'aros dorand, ki chun ruzi k'iiomat peshi Parvardigorashon bargardand, sadak'avu korkh'oi nekashonro namepazirad.
61) In gurukh'i tavsifshuda ba ich'roi korkh'oi shoista meshitoband va onkh'o baroi on amalkh'oi nek az digarkh'o peshdasti megirand.

62) Va Mo kh'ech' kasro ch'uz ba k'adri tavonash mukallaf namesozem. Va nazdi Mo Kitobest, ki dar on kori kh'amaro sabt kardaem, on Kitob ba rosti sukhan meguiad va ba onkh'o bo kamshavii neki va afzunshavii badi zulm karda nameshavad.
63) Balki k'albi kofiron az in Kitob va az K'ur'on dar g'aflat ast va onkh'o g'air az kufr amalkh'oi digare dorand, ki anch'omash medikh'and.
64) Kh'angome, ki ruzi k'iiomat shakhsoni khushguzaroni onkh'oro bo azob much'ozot kunem, nogakh'on fariod mekashand va kumak mekhokh'and.

65) Ba onkh'o bo k'asdi noumedsozi az rakh'mati ilokh'i gufta meshavad: "Imruz fariod nazaned va az kase kumak nakhokh'ed. Zero ba durusti, inch'o iovare nadored, ki shumoro az azobi Mo pushtiboni kunad.-
66) Iak'inan oiatkh'oi Kitobi Khudo dar dunio ba shumo tilovat meshud, pas vak'ti shunidanash bo kh'issi adovat rui tofta, barmegashted.

67) Inro dar kh'ole mekarded, ki bo da'voi on ki shumo akh'li Kh'aram kh'asted, kibr varzida, khudro az mardum bolo meshumurded, ammo shumo akh'li Kh'aram nested, balki akh'li on parkh'ezkoronand va dar atrofi on bo sukhanoni k'abekh' shabnishini mekarded. Shumo ekh'tiromi Kh'aramro ba ch'o nameovarded.

68) Oio in mushrikon dar borai K'ur'on andesha namekunand, to ba on imon orand va ba dasturotash amal kunand, io ba sui onkh'o chize omad, ki ba guzashtagonashon naomada bud va ba kh'amin sabab az on rui tofta, durug'ash medonand.

69) Io Mukh'ammadero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sui onkh'o paiombar firistod, nameshinosand va baroi kh'amin munkirash kh'astand?! Mushrikon shakhsi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), rostk'avli va amonatdorii uro meshinokhtand.

70) Balki meguiand: "U devona ast." Beshubkh'a, kofironu mushrikon durug' meguiand, balki Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba onkh'o kh'ak'ik'atro ovarda ast, ki u paiombar ast va beshtarashon az kh'ak'ik'at bezorand. Az kh'asad va taassubi ch'okh'ilona kh'ak'ik'atro dust namedorand.

71) Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korkh'oro mutobik' ba khokh'ishi mushrikon ich'ro mekard, osmonkh'o va zamin va niz kasone, ki dar onkh'o mavch'udand, tabokh' meshudand, chunki makhluk' farch'omi kor va tadbiri durustu nodurustro namedonad. Balki Mo ba onkh'o K'ur'onro, ki moiai iftikhoru sharofat va andarzgui onkh'ost, firistodem, vale eshon az on chi moiai iftikhoru sharofat va andarzguiashon ast, ruigardonand.

72) Ei Paiombar, oio tu dar ivazi oiini ovardaat az in ch'amoa muzd khostai va onkh'o ba kh'amin sabab da'vatatro namepazirand?! Chunin kore az sui tu surat nagirifta ast. Zero podoshi Parvardigorat az muzdi onkh'o bekh'tar buda va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bekh'tarini rizk'dikh'andagon ast.
73) Va ei Paiombar, begumon tu onkh'o va digaronro ba rokh'i rost, ki rokh'i Islom ast, da'vat mekuni.
74) Va albatta, kasone, ki ba okhirat, bozpursi, podosh va uk'ubatash imon nadorand, az rokh'i Islom ba rokh'kh'oi g'alati ravonsozanda ba duzakh munkh'arif shudaand.
75) Va agar Mo bar onkh'o rakh'm kunem va k'akh'tiiu gurusnagiashonro dur sozem, dar zalolatashon sargardon bok'i monda, shukr namekunand.

76) Va kh'amono Mo onkh'oro bo musibatkh'oi gunogun ozmudem, pas dar barobari Parvardigorashon az khesh furutani nishon nadodand va bo shikastakh'oliiu zori duo nakardand, to musibatkh'oiashonro dur sozad.
77) To on ki vak'te ruzi k'iiomat az uk'ubati sakht bar ruiashon darero kushoem, onkh'o dar on uk'ubat az kh'ar kushoish va neki noumed megardand.

Az sababi on ki naboiad shakhsi az kh'issi shunavoi, binoi va ak'l istifodabaranda ruzi rastokhezro inkor kunad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kofiron ne'mati shunavoi, binoi va ak'li in'omkardaashro iodras shuda guft:
78) Va ei takzibgaroni ruzi rastokhez, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki baroi shumo gushu chashm va k'albro ofarida ast, to shunidan, didan va dark kardan tavoned, ammo bo vuch'udi in ne'matkh'o shukri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro kam ba ch'o meored.
79) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki shumo mardumro dar zamin ofarid va ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani podosh tankh'o ba sui U ch'am' ovarda meshaved.

80) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki zinda megardonad, kase g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'udrati inro nadorad va memironad, kase ch'uz U ba mironidan k'odir nest va andozagirii digargunii shabu ruz az likh'ozi toriki, rushnoi, kutokh'iiu darozi tankh'o ba U taalluk' dorad. Oio namefakh'med, ki U K'odir va Iagona Chorasozi korkh'ost?!
81) Balki in gurukh' sukhane guftand, ki dar kufr ba sukhani padaron va guzashtagonashon monand ast.
82) Onkh'o bo mak'sadi mukh'ol donistan guftand: "Oio chun memirem va khok gashta, ustukhonkh'oiamon mepusad, oio baroi bozpursi dubora zinda karda meshavem?

83) Kh'amono in va'dai dubora zindashavi ba mo va pesh az in ba padaronu guzashtagonamon doda shuda bud, vale kh'ech' nadidem, ki on takh'ak'k'uk' iobad, in va'da ch'uz sukhanoni botilu durug'i guzashtagon chize nest."
84) Ei Paiombar, ba in kofironi munkiri rastokhez bigu: "Agar donish dored, in zamin va kasone, ki dar zaminand, az ki ast?!"

85) Khokh'and guft: "Az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast." Pas ba onkh'o bigu: "Oio andesha namekuned, ki Parvardigori sokh'ibi zamin va mavch'udoti on k'udrati dubora zinda gardonidani shumoro dorad?!"
86) Bigu: "Parvardigori kh'aft tabak'ai osmon va Parvardigori arshi buzurg, ki kh'ech' makhluk'e az on buzurgtar nest, ki ast?!"
87) Khokh'and guft: "Khos az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast." Pas ba onkh'o bigu: "Oio bo ich'roi dasturot va khuddori az mamnuot parkh'ezkori namekuned, to az azobi U solim bimoned?!"

88) Bigu: "Agar donish doshta boshed, ba Man khabar dikh'ed, ki podshokh'ii tamomi mavch'udot az oni kist, kh'ol on ki U kh'ar kiro az bandagonash khokh'ad, panokh' medikh'ad va agar U azobi bandaero khokh'ad, kh'ech' kas onro bartaraf sokhta nametavonad?!"

89) Khokh'and guft: "Podshokh'ii kulli mavch'udot az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast." Pas ba onkh'o bigu: "Modome in kh'ak'ik'atro e'tirof mekuned, chitavr ak'laton rabuda shuda ast, ki g'airi Uro meparasted?!"

90) Kor chunonchi da'vo dorand, nest, balki Mo ba onkh'o kh'ak'ik'atro ovardaem va iak'inan onkh'o dar nisbat dodani shariku farzand ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' meguiand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az in tukh'matkh'o pok ast.

91) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) farzand nagirifta ast va kh'amrokh'ash ma'budi barkh'ak' vuch'ud nadorad. Ak'idai kofiron botil ast. Agar ba farzi misol, bo U digar ma'budi barkh'ak' mebud, on gokh' kh'ar ma'bud kh'issai ofaridaashro meburd va ba'zeashon bar ba'zei digarashon g'olib meshud, pas nizomi koinot tabokh' megasht, kh'ol on ki chize az in korkh'o rukh nadoda ast. Pas Ma'budi kh'ak'ik'i Iagona Allokh' ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az tavsifi mushrikon, ki ba U sharik va farzandro nisbat medikh'and, pok meboshad.
92) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai pinkh'on va oshkori makhluk'ot buda, chize az U makhfi nest. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bartar az on ast, ki sharik doshta boshad.
93) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Parvardigoro, agar on uk'ubatero, ki ba in mushrikon va'da dodai, ba man binamoi-

94) Parvardigoro, agar onkh'oro bo azobi va'dadodaat much'ozot kuni, dar kh'ole man dar k'aidi kh'aiot va shokh'idi on bosham, pas maro dar bainashon k'aror madekh', ki azobi onkh'o domangiram gardad."
95) Va albatta, Mo baroi on ki ba tu azobero, ki ba kofiron va'da dodaem, nishon dikh'em, k'odirem. Mo kh'argiz az ich'roi in va digar korkh'o notavon nestem.

96) Ei Paiombar, ba kase, ki ba tu badi mekunad, bo shevai bekh'tarin posukh dekh', az gunokh'ash darguzar va dar ozorash sabr namo. On chizkh'oe, ki mushrikon nisbat ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az doshtani sharik va durug'gui meguiand va on chizkh'oe, ki nisbat ba tu az sifatkh'oi devonagi, shoiri, sokh'iri va g'aira meguiand, Mo kh'amai inro bekh'tar medonem.
97) Va bigu: "Parvardigoro, az vasvasakh'oi Shaiton ba Tu panokh' mebaram.
98) Va Parvardigoro az on ki shaitonkh'o dar korkh'oi man kh'ozir gardand, ba Tu panokh' mebaram."

99) Kofiron ba rokh'i nodurusti khesh idoma medikh'and, to on ki ba kase az in ch'amoa marg oiad va azobi furudomadaro mushokh'ida kunad, az umri rafta va gunokh'onash pushaimon gashta meguiad: "Parvardigoro, maro ba zindagonii dunio bargardon.

100) Chun ba dunio bargardam, shoiad kori shoista mekunam." Ne, kh'argiz! Kh'ak'ik'at on guna ki talab dorad, nest, balki in talabash sukhani kholiest, ki meguiadu pazirufta nameshavad. Zero agar ba farzi misol, ba dunio bargardonida shavad, kh'ech' gokh' ba va'daash vafo namekunad. Va onkh'o to ruze, ki zinda gardonida meshavand, baini dunio va okhirat dar olami barzakhand. Az in sabab, ba sui dunio bargashta nametavonand, to nuk'sonashonro ch'ubron sozand va tabokh'korikh'oiashonro islokh' kunand.

101) Pas chun farishtai muvazzaf bori duium dar sur, ki nishonai zindashavii murdagon ast, bidamad, dar bainashon kheshovandie, ki az on iftikhor mekardand, namemonad va az kh'oli kh'am namepursand, zero dar on ruz darmondai dakh'shati k'iiomat va mashg'uli kh'oli khud kh'astand.

102) Pas kh'ar ki korkh'oi vaznshudaash bo bartar gashtani nekikh'o bar badikh'oiash sangin shavad, pas inkh'o dar kh'ak'ik'at rastagorand, zero onkh'o ba ch'annat noil shuda, az ch'akh'annam nach'ot meioband.

103) Va kh'ar ki korkh'oi vaznshudaash bo bartar gashtani badikh'o bar nekikh'oiash sabuk shavad, pas in gurukh' kasoneand, ki bo anch'omi korkh'oi zararovar va tarki imonu amali solekh' ba ch'oni khesh ziion rasonidaand, onkh'o dar duzakh abadi memonand, kh'argiz az on berun nameshavand.
104) Otash chekh'raashonro mesuzonad va az shiddati turshrui labkh'oi bolovu poionashon kushoda monda, dandonkh'oiashon namoion meshavad.
105) Ba onkh'o bo mak'sadi sarzanish gufta meshavad: "Oio dar dunio oiatkh'oi K'ur'on bar shumo tilovat nashuda bud, pas onkh'oro durug' kh'isobided?!"
106) Dar ch'avob meguiand: "Parvardigoro, badbakhtiamon, ki dar ilmi azalii Tu guzashta bud, bar mo g'olib omad va mo mardumi az kh'ak' gumrokh'gashta budem.-
107) Parvardigoro, moro az otashi duzakh berun soz, pas agar ba kufru gumrokh'ii khesh bargardem, on vak't beguftugu, nisbat ba khud sitam kardaem va digar uzre nadorem."
108) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meguiad: "Dar duzakh zalilona bimoned va bo Man sukhan nakuned.-
109) Beshak, gurukh'i bandagoni mu'minam meguftand: "Bor Ilokh'o, mo ba Tu imon ovardaem. Pas gunokh'onamonro biomurz va bar mo rakh'm bikun va Tu bekh'tarini rakh'mkunandagon kh'asti."-

110) Pas shumo in bandagoni mu'minamro ba rishkhand girifta, onkh'oro maskhara mekarded. To kh'adde ba maskharaashon mashg'ul shuded, ki in kor iodi Maro az khotiraton faromush sokht va shumo bo tamaskhur bar kh'oli onkh'o mekhandided.-
111) Albatta, Man imruz (k'iiomat) baroi in bandagoni boimonam ch'annatro podosh dodam, ba sababi on ki dar ibodat va ozorkh'oi shumo sabr kardand. Zero iak'inan onkh'o ba murodashon rasidaand.

Chun kofironu mushrikon az Khudo darkhosti ba dunio bozgashtanro kardand, to kambudiashonro ch'ubron kunand, Khudo dar oiati zerin umri dodaashro khotirrason namud, ki agar tavba kardan mekhostand, mukh'lati dar dunio ba onkh'o atoshuda basanda bud.
112) Dar rui zamin chand sol istoded? Chi k'adar vak'ti khudro zoe' sokhted?
113) Dar ch'avob meguiand: "Mo dar rui zamin iak ruz io k'isme az ruz istodem. Pas az on kasone, ki ba shumoridani ruzkh'o va mokh'kh'o mashg'ul budand, bipurs."

114) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meguiad: "Ba durusti ki dar zamin zamoni andak istodaed, ki dar on sabr kardanaton baroi ibodat oson bud. Agar andak ilm medoshted, medonisted, ki muddati dar dunio istodani shumo dar k'iios ba istodanaton dar duzakh nikh'oiat nochiz ast."

115) Ei mardum, magar gumon kardaed, ki Mo shumoro ba monandi chakh'orpoion bekh'udavu kholi az kh'ikmat ofaridaem, podoshu uk'ubate vuch'ud nadorad va shumo ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani podoshi amal nazdi Mo bargardonida nameshaved?!

116) Pas Allokh'i Podshokh'i kh'ak'ik'i az sifatkh'oi noloik' va az on ki bandagonashro bekh'uda biofarad, Bartar va Pok ast. Bo bandagon kh'ar chi khokh'ad, mekunad. Khud va va'davu sukhanash kh'ak' ast. Ba ch'uz U ma'bude nest. Parvardigori arshest, ki on buzurgtarin makhluk' ast. Parvardigori buzurgtarin makhluk', Parvardigori kh'amai makhluk'ot ast.

117) Va kh'ar ki bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digarero, ki baroi sazovori ibodat budanash dalel nadorad, biparastad, pas beshak, podoshi amali badash nazdi Parvardigorash ast. Parvardigorash ch'azoiashro medikh'ad. Kh'amono kofiron rastagor nameshavand. Kh'argiz ba ch'annat namedaroiand va abadi dar duzakh memonand.
118) Va ei Paiombar, bigu: "Parvardigoro, maro mag'firat namo va ba man rakh'm kun va Tu nisbat ba bandai gunakh'korat Bekh'tarini rakh'mkunandagon kh'asti va tavbaashro mepaziri."
1) In suraest, ki Mo onro furud ovardem va amal ba akh'komi onro farz gardonidem va dar on oiatkh'oi ravshanro nozil namudem, to in ki az akh'komash pand girifta, mutobik' ba on amal mekuned.

2) Kh'ar iak zan va mardi zinokori much'arradro sad toziiona bizaned va agar ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi k'iiomat imon dored, naboiad shumoro dar kh'ak'ashon rakh'mdiliiu mekh'ruboni faro girad, ki az ich'roi kh'addi ilokh'i khuddori kuned, io onro sabuk sozed. Va boiad dar vak'ti barpo namudani kh'ad bar mardu zani zinokor bo mak'sadi pakh'n sokhtani khabari much'ozot va peshgirii onkh'o va digaron az amali zino ch'am'e az mu'minon kh'ozir boshand.

3) Baroi nishon dodani zishtii az kh'ad ziiodi zinokori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in oiat zikr kard, ki kh'ar mardi ba zinokori odatkarda ba izdivoch' mail namekunad, ch'uz bo zani monandi khud zinokor io zani mushriki az zinokori beparkh'ez, bo vuch'udi on ki izdivoch' bo in zan man' ast va niz kh'ar zani ba zinokori odatkarda ba izdivoch' mail namekunad, ch'uz bo mardi misli khud zinokor io mushriki az zinokori beparkh'ez, bo vuch'udi on ki izdivoch' bo in mard man' ast. Va nikokh'i zani zinokor va nikokh'i mardi zinokor bar mu'minon kh'arom shuda ast.

4) Va kasone, ki zanoni pokdoman (niz mardoni pokdoman)-ro ba zino tukh'mat mekunand, sipas baroi isboti on chor shokh'id nameorand, pas ei kh'okimon, onkh'oro kh'ashtod toziiona bizaned va shakh'odati onkh'oro kh'argiz k'abul nakuned va in tukh'matchiioni zanoni pokdoman az toati ilokh'i khorich'and,-

5) ch'uz kasone, ki ba'di anch'omi in gunokh' ba sui Khudo tavba karda va a'moli kheshro islokh' mesozand, beshak, Parvardigor tavba va shakh'odati onkh'oro mepazirad. Zero begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tavbakoron Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

6) Va mardone, ki zanonashonro ba zino tukh'mat mekunand va g'air az khud shokh'id nadorand, to ba rostguiashon guvokh'i dikh'ad, boiad kh'ar iakei onkh'o chor bor ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shokh'idi dikh'ad, ki dar on chi nisbat ba kh'amsarash gufta ast, rost meguiad.
7) Sipas bori panch'um alaikh'i khud duo kunad, ki agar dar in da'vo az ch'umlai durug'guion boshad, la'nati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar u bod.

8) Bo kh'amin zan sazovor megardad, ki bar u kh'addi zinokori ch'ori gardad. Va az zani tukh'matshuda shakh'odatash kh'addi zinoro dur mesozad. Boiad chor bor ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shokh'idi dikh'ad, ki mard dar da'voiash durug'gui ast.
9) Sipas bori panch'um alaikh'i khud duo namoiad, ki agar mard dar da'voiash az ch'umlai rostguion boshad, pas bar zan g'azabi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bod.

10) Va ei mardum, agar buzurgvori va rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo namebud va agar U nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakunanda Tavbapaziri dar chorasozi va akh'komash Kh'akim namebud, shumoro baroi gunokh'onaton dar kh'ol much'ozot va rasvo mesokht.

11) Kh'amono kasone, ki nisbat ba Modari mu'minon Oisha tukh'mati nikh'oiat azimi zinokoriro ovardand, ch'amoai mansub ba shumo budand. Ei mu'minon, tukh'mati in toifaro baroi khud bad mapindored, balki on baroi shumo khair ast, zero bo vuk'ui in kh'odisa mu'minon podosh girifta, safashon pok shud va pokii Modari mu'minon sobit gardid. Kh'ar kas dar in tukh'mat shirkat kard, ch'azoi gunokh'i kardaashro megirad. Va kh'ar ki az tukh'matgaron bakhshi azimashro bar ukh'da girifta, avvalin shuda onro og'oz bakhshid, uro azobi buzurg ast. On kase, ki k'ismi azimi in bukh'tonro bar ukh'da girifta, avvalin shuda onro nashr sokht, rakh'bari munofik'on Abdullokh' ibni Salul ast.

12) Kh'angome mardon va zanoni mu'min in rukhdodro nisbat ba barodaroni mu'mini khesh shunidand, gumon nakardand, ki on shakhsoni mavridi tukh'mat k'arorgiriftaand, va guftand: in sukhan durug'i oshkor ast?!

13) Charo kasone, ki ba Modari mu'minon Oisha (raziiallokh'u ankh'o) tukh'mat zadand, bar isboti da'voiashon chakh'or guvokh' naovardand?! Pas agar chakh'or guvokh' nameorand -kh'argiz ovarda kh'am nametavonand- onkh'o dar kh'ukmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug'gui kh'astand.

14) Va ei mu'minon, agar bar shumo fazl va rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dunio va okhirat namebud -chun shumoro dar kh'ol ba azob giriftor nasokht va tavbai tavbakoronro paziruft-, beshubkh'a, ba shumo az sababi on ki dar in durug' va tukh'mat ziiod furu rafted, uk'ubati buzurg merasid.

15) Zamone ba shumo uk'ubat merasid, ki az kh'amdigar in kh'odisaro rivoiat menamuded va bo vuch'udi beasosi chizero ba kh'am nak'l mekarded, ki dar boraash ilm nadoshted va in korro oson mekh'isobided, dar kh'ole ki on nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bisior buzurg ast, zero iak shakhsi begunokh' bo rokh'i durug' tukh'mat shuda ast.

16) Va charo vak'te on bukh'tonro shunided, nagufted: "Baroi mo dar borai in rukhdodi zisht sukhan kardan ravo nest. Parvardigoro, Tu poku beaibi. In tukh'mati nisbat ba Modari mu'minon Oisha (raziiallokh'u ankh'o) ovozashud durug'i buzurg ast."

17) Agar dar kh'ak'ik'at imon dored, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro khotirrason mekunad va pand medikh'ad, ki minba'd kh'argiz ba sui in guna tukh'matkh'o barnagarded va shakhsi begunokh'ero ba zinokori tukh'mat nazaned.

18) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo oiatkh'oi shomili akh'kom va pandkh'oro baion mesozad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai korkh'oi shumost, chize az U pushida nest, kh'atman ach'ri korkh'oiatonro ato mekunad, dar chorasozi va akh'komash Kh'akim ast.

19) Ba durusti, kasone dust medorand, ki korkh'oi zisht, az on ch'umla tukh'mat ba zinokori dar baini mu'minon pakh'n shavad, onkh'oro dar dunio bo ich'roi kh'addi tukh'matgari azobi dardovar va dar okhirat azobi duzakh ast va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug'i tukh'matgaron, ok'ibati korkh'oi bandagon va sudi onkh'oro medonad va shumo inro namedoned.

20) Va ei kasone, ki dar in tukh'mat giriftor gashtaed, agar lutf va rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba shumo namebud va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon namebud, beshak, shumoro zud uk'ubat mekard.

21) Ei mu'minoni poiband ba akh'komi shariat, az rokh'kh'oi Shaiton dar botilro zinat dodanash pairavi nakuned va kh'ar ki az rokh'kh'oi Shaiton pairavi kunad, iak'inan gumrokh' va gunakh'kor megardad, chunki Shaiton ba kirdorkh'ovu guftorkh'oi k'abekh' va kori khilofi shariat amr mekunad. Va ei mu'minon, agar lutf va rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba shumo namebud, kh'argiz kase az shumo bo rokh'i tavba pok namegasht, vale Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, bo paziruftani tavbaash pok megardonad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavoi Donost. Kh'ech' sukhanu amalaton az U pushida nest va baroi kh'ar iak guftoru kirdor podoshaton medikh'ad.

22) On kasone az shumo, ki dar din akh'li fazl va sokh'ibi farokhii ne'matand, naboiad baroi k'at'i kumakashon az kheshovandoni fak'ir va miskinon va mukh'och'ironi rokh'i Khudo, ba sababi on ki inkh'o murtakibi gunokh' shudaand, savgand khurand va boiad gunokh'ashonro bakhshand va az on darguzarand. Oio dust namedored, ki vak'te kutokh'ii onkh'oro mebakhshed va az on darmeguzared, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'oni shumoro bakhshad?! Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakor Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Pas bandagon dar sifatkh'oi bakhshandagi va mekh'ruboni ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pairavi kunand. Vak'te Abubakri Siddik' (raziiallokh'u ankh'u) savgand iod kard, ki kumaki khudro az Mistakh'i pisari Usosa k'at' mekunad, zero vai dar tukh'mati Oishai Siddik'a (raziiallokh'u ankh'o) dast dosht, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oiati mazkurro nozil namud.
23) Kasone, ki zanoni pokdomani az zinokori bekhabari boimonro tukh'mat mekunand, kh'atman dar dunio va okhirat az rakh'mati ilokh'i ronda meshavand va onkh'oro ruzi k'iiomat azobi buzurg ast.

24) In azobi buzurg dar okhirat ruze rukh medikh'ad, ki zabonashon va dastashon va poikh'oiashon bo on chi dar dunio az sukhani botil meguftand va on chi az ma'siiat mekardand, alaikh'i onkh'o guvokh'i medikh'and.

25) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on ruz savobashonro boadolat ba purragi medikh'ad va iak'in mekunand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Khud Kh'ak' va akhbor, va'daiu takh'didash niz kh'ak'ik'ati oshkor ast.

26) Kh'ama mardonu zanon va sukhanonu kirdorkh'oi nopok munosib va muvofik'i nopokon va kh'ama mardonu zanon va sukhanonu kirdorkh'oi pok munosib va muvofik'i pokonand. On ch'amoai mardonu zanoni pok az on chi mardonu zanoni nopok nisbatashon meguiand, pok kh'astand, onkh'oro az sui Parvardigor mag'firati gunokh'on va rizk'i farovoni ch'annat ast.

Az sababi on ki ogokh' shudan az andomi nikh'oni sababi ch'ush zadani shakh'vat gashta, ok'ibat shakhsro ba zino merasonad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati zerin bo mak'sadi nigakh'dorii nazar az ch'oikh'oi shakh'vatangez dastur dod, to pesh az daromadan ba khonakh'o az sokh'iboni on rukhsat pursida shavad.
27) Ei mu'minoni poiband ba akh'komi shariat, ba khonakh'oi g'airi khud to vak'ti az sokinoni on baroi daromadan ich'ozat pursidan va ba onkh'o salom guftanaton dokhil nashaved. Salom va talabi ich'ozat chunin ast: "Assalomu alaikum. Ich'ozati daromadan kh'ast?" Kh'angomi vurudi khonai begonagon ich'ozat pursidan, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro ba anch'omi on farmuda ast, baroiaton az daromadani nogakh'oni bekh'tar ast. Shumoro ba in kor Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rakh'namoi namud, to pand gired va onro ich'ro sozed.

28) Pas agar dar on khonakh'o kasero paido nakarded, to vak'ti az ch'onibi shakhsi sokh'ibrukhsat ich'ozat shudan ba on dokhil nashaved. Va agar sokh'ibkhonakh'o ba shumo "Bargarded" guiand, pas bargarded va nadaroed. Albatta, in baroiaton bekh'tar ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chi mekuned, medonad, kh'ech' amalkh'oiaton az U makhfi nest va baroi on podoshaton medikh'ad.

29) Bar shumo gunokh'e nest, ki ba khonakh'oi umumi ba misli dukonkh'o va mekh'monkhonakh'oi baroi naf'i omma omoda shuda beich'ozat daroed. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korkh'o va kh'olatkh'oero, ki oshkor va pinkh'on mekuned, medonad. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest va kh'atman shumoro ch'azoi sazovor medikh'ad.

Chun nigokh' ba zani nomakh'ram khabarrasoni zino ast, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo mak'sadi peshgiri az on ba pushidani chashm farmon dod va guft:
30) Ei Paiombar, ba mardoni imondor bigu, ki chashmoni khudro az nigokh' kardan ba zani nomakh'ram va avratkh'o boz dorand va sharmgokh'i khudro az vok'e' shudan dar kh'arom va namoionshavii on kh'ifz kunand. In kh'ifzi chashmon az nazari kh'arom va kh'ifzi sharmgokh'kh'o baroiashon nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) poktar ast. Beguftugu, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mekunand, Ogokh' ast. Chize az U makhfi nest va baroiashon podosh khokh'ad dod.

31) Va ba zanoni imondor bigu, ki chashmoni khudro az nigokh' kardan ba chizkh'oi kh'arom nigokh' dorand va sharmgokh'ashonro bo duri ch'ustan az kori fakh'sh va pushidani kh'ich'ob kh'ifz kunand va naboiad oroishi kheshro baroi g'air oshkor sozand, ch'uz on chi misli libos oshkoru pushonidani on nomumkin ast va rusarikh'oiashonro bar girebonkh'oiashon andozand, to muikh'o va gardanashonro bipushonad va oroishi pinkh'onashonro oshkor nasozand, magar baroi shavkh'aronashon, padaronashon, padaroni shavkh'aronashon, farzandonashon, farzandoni kh'amsaronashon, barodaronashon, barodarzodakh'oiashon, khokh'arzodakh'oiashon, zanoni boe'timod, novobasta az on ki beimon io imondor kh'astand, g'ulomon va kanizonashon, dunbolaravone az mardon, ki maili ch'insi nadorand va kudakone, ki az sababi khurdsoli oidi avrati zanon ogokh'i nadorand. Va naboiad zanon poikh'oiashonro dar zamin kuband, to on chi az zinati khesh monandi khalkhol[Kh'alk'ai tillo io nuk'ra, ki zanon baroi zinati poi mebandan] va g'aira, ki pinkh'on mekardand, oshkor shavad. Va ei mu'minon, kh'amagi az nigokh'i kh'arom va digar gunokh'on ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavba kuned, to shoiad ba ch'annat noil gashta, az ch'akh'annam nach'ot iobed.

Chun durudaroz much'arrad mondani mard va zan sababi pakh'nshavii zinokori megardad, Khudo dar oiati zerin ba kumak rasonidani zanoni beshavkh'ar va mardoni bezan baroi izdivoch' dastur doda guft:
32) Va ei mu'minon, mardonu zanoni much'arradi khud va g'ulomonu kanizoni boimonatonro izdivoch' kunoned. Agar fak'ir boshand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro az fazli gusturdaash tavongar mesozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Sokh'ibi rizk'i farokh buda, akh'voli bandagonro medonad. Tavongar sokhtani kase rizk'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro kam namegardonad.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati bolo ba mu'minon amr kard, to mardonu zanoni much'arradro izdivoch' kunonand, dar oiati zerin ba mardu zani much'arrad dastur medikh'ad, ki dar surati nadoshtani k'udrati izdivoch' boiad pokdomanii khudro nigokh' dorand.
33) Va kasone, ki az sababi fak'iri izdivoch' karda nametavonand, boiad az zino pokdomani ch'uiand, to vak'te Parvardigor onkh'oro az fazli gusturdaash tavongar gardonad. Va on g'ulomone, ki bo pardokhtani mol baroi ozodshaviashon az khoch'agonashon darkhosti navishtani ak'di ozodi kunand, pas bar khoch'agonashon paziruftani navishtani ak'dnoma bo on g'ulomon shart va zarur ast, agar dar g'ulomon tavoni pardokhtani bakh'oi ozodi va dar dindori solekh' budanashonro donand. Va boiad khoch'agon ba g'ulomon az moli ba onkh'o atokardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bidikh'and, ba in ma'no, ki ch'uz'e az mablag'i ozodii dar ak'dnoma k'aidshudaro kam kunand, to dar ozodshaviashon kumak rasonand. Va kanizoni kheshtanro agar k'asdi pokdomani namoiand, baroi talab va ba dast ovardani matoi dunio, ki az rokh'i fokh'ishagi kasb mekunand, ba zino mach'bur nasozed. On guna ki Abdullokh' ibni Ubaii Saluli munofik' bo du kanizash, ki pokdomani va duri az fokh'ishagiro khostand, kh'amin korro kard. Va kh'ar ki az shumo kanizonro ba anch'omi amali fakh'sh vodor mekunad, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba'di mach'bursozi Bakhshandai gunokh'oni kanizon buda, nisbatashon Mekh'rubon ast. Chunki onkh'o az tarafi khoch'agonashon ba amali zino mach'bur shuda va gunakh'kor khoch'agonashon kh'astand.

34) Va ei mardum, ba durusti ki Mo ba sui shumo oiatkh'oi ravshani ch'udosozandai kh'ak' az botil va sarguzashti mu'minon va kofironi k'abl az shumo guzashtaro furud ovardem va baroiaton pandero nozil kardem, ki tak'vopeshagon az on pand megirand.

35) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Nuri osmonkh'ovu zamin va rakh'namoi kh'amai mavch'udot ast. Dostoni nuri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dili mu'min monandi tok'est, ki dar on charog' ast, charog' dar shisha ast, shisha misli sitorai durakhshon ast, on charog' az ravg'ani darakhti muboraki Zaitun afrukhta meshavad, on darakhtro na pagokh' va na begokh' chize az oftob namepushonad, ravg'anash az sababi pokiash agarchi otash ba on narasad, k'arib medurakhshad. Pas agar ba on otash rasad, chi meshavad?! Nuri charog' bar nuri shisha zam shuda ast. K'albi mu'min vak'te dar on nuri kh'idoiat medurakhshad, kh'amin guna ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar ki az bandagonash khokh'ad, tavfik'i kh'idoiati pairavii K'ur'onro medikh'ad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi mardum kh'ar chizro bo ovardani masalkh'o baion mekunad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai kh'amai chiz ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nest.

36) In charog' dar masch'idkh'oe furuzon sokhta meshavad, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amr namuda ast, to mak'om va imorati on baland gardad va onch'o nomi U bo sadoi azon, zikr, namoz iod shavad, dar onch'o dar avval va okhiri ruz bo mak'sadi talabi rizoi ilokh'i namoz meguzorand-

37) dar on masch'idkh'o mardone namoz meguzorand va Khudoro ba poki iod mekunand, ki onkh'oro kharid va furush az iodi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va khondani namoz dar komiltarin surat va pardokhtani zakot ba shakhsoni arzanda g'ofil namesozad, onkh'o az k'iiomat metarsand, on ruze, ki k'albkh'o dar on baini tama' ba rakh'oi az azob va tars az on noorom buda va didagon ba kh'ar taraf mecharkhad.

38) On mardon in korkh'oi shoistaro anch'om medikh'and, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ivazi korkh'oi nekashon podoshi bekh'tarin amalkh'oi onkh'oro bidikh'ad va az fazlash mukofoti onkh'oro afzun gardonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, ba k'adri a'molash ruzii bekh'isob medikh'ad, balki chand barobar beshtar az amalkh'oi solekh'ash ato mekunad.

39) Va amalkh'oi kofiron bepodosh buda, monandi sarobi biioboni beobu alaf ast. Shakhsi tashna onro dida, ob mepindorad, pas ba sui on kh'arakat mekunad, to vak'te ki nazdikash biioiad, obero nameiobad. Kofir niz kh'amin guna ast. Gumon mekunad, ki amalkh'oi kardaash ba vai foida merasonad, ammo chun ba'di margash zinda gardonida shavad, podoshi korkh'oi kardaashro nameiobad va nazdiki on a'moli sarobmonandi khesh kh'ukmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro meiobad, pas kh'isobi korashro komilan mepardozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zud Kh'isobkunanda va Much'ozotdikh'anda ast.

40) Io a'moli akh'li kufr ba monandi torikikh'oi bakh'ri chuk'urest, ki rui onro mavch' faro girifta ast, az boloi on mavch', mavch'i digarest, az boloiash abri pushonandai sitorakh'ost, torikikh'oe, ki ba'zeash bar rui ba'zei digarash ch'am' shudaand. Kh'ar ki duchori chunin toriki shavad, chun dastashro berun orad, az shiddati toriki k'arib onro namebinad. Kh'olati kofir niz kh'amin guna ast. Torikikh'oi nodoni, shubkh'a, kh'airat, mukh'ri dilash rui kh'am ch'am' gashtaand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar ki kh'idoiat va donishi Kitobi Khudro ruzi nakunad, pas u kh'ech' rakh'namo va kitobe, ki az on rushnoi bich'uiad, nadorad.

41) Ei Paiombar, oio namedoni, kh'amai makhluk'oti osmonkh'ovu zamin va parandagon, ki bolkh'oiashonro dar fazo mekushoiand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba poki iod mekunand? Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az tamomi in makhluk'ot namozi onero, ki misli inson namoz mekhonad va tasbekh'i onero, ki misli parrandagon tasbekh' meguiad, medonad. Va on chi mekunand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonad. Chize az U makhfi nest.

42) Va molikiiatu kh'ukmfarmoii osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast va dar ruzi k'iiomat bozgasht baroi pursuch'uiu giriftani podosh iagona ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

43) Ei Paiombar, oio namedoni, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) abrkh'oro okh'ista meronad, sipas ba'ze porakh'oiashro bo ba'zei digarash ch'am' meorad, sipas onro rui kh'am anboshta mesozad, pas boronro mebini, ki az dokhili abrkh'o berun meshavad va az samti osmon az abrkh'oi rui kh'am anboshtae, ki chun kukh'kh'o buzurgand, ba monandi sangrezakh'o porakh'oi iakhshudai obro furud meorad, pas bo on zholakh'o ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, ziion merasonad va az kh'ar ki khokh'ad, onro boz medorad, k'arib ast, ki durakhshandagii bark'i abrkh'o az shiddati rushnoi chashmkh'oro khira sokhta, az bain bibarad.

44) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shab va ruzro bo darozu kutokh' gardidan, raftan va omadan paiopai meorad. Beshak, dar in nishonakh'o baroi sokh'ibkhiradon pandest, ki az on k'udrat va vakh'doniiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dark mekunand.

45) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar ch'onvarero, ki dar zamin mech'unbad, az nutfa ofarida ast, pas ba'zeashon ba misli mor dar zamin bo shikam khazida rokh' meravand va ba'zeashon ba misli insonkh'o va parandagon bo du poi rokh' meravand va ba'zeashon ba misli chakh'orpoion bo chakh'or poi rokh' meravand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar chi khokh'ad, meofarad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ama chiz K'odir ast. Chize Uro och'iz gardonida nametavonad.

46) Beshak, Mo bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) oiatkh'oi ravshani dalolatkunanda ba rokh'i kh'ak'ro furud ovardem. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar kase khokh'ad, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro medikh'ad va on rokh' uro ba ch'annat mebarad.

47) Va munofik'on meguiand: "Ba Allokh'u Rasul imon ovardem va az dasturashon itoat kardem." Sipas toifae az onkh'o ba'd az da'voi imondori va farmonbardori, az amri Allokh'u Rasulash oidi ch'ikh'od va g'aira sarpechi karda, rui metoband. Va in gurukh'i az farmoni Allokh' va Rasulash sarpechida agarchi da'voi imondori kunand, mu'min nestand.

48) Vak'te in gurukh'i munofik' ba sui Allokh' va Rasulash da'vat shavand, to Rasuli Allokh' dar bainashon oidi on chi bo iakdigar da'vo dorand, dovari kunad, nogakh'on ba'zeashon ba illati nifok' az kh'ukmi u rui metoband.
49) Va agar donand,ki kh'ak' ba naf'ashon meboshad va donand, ki Rasuli Allokh' ba foidai onkh'o kh'ukm mekunad, bo taslimi komil va furutani nazdash meoiand.

50) Oio dar dili in munofik'on bemorii doimi ast, io dar mavridi nubuvvati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) shubkh'a dorand, io az on metarsand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash dar dovari ba onkh'o zulm mekunand?! Ne, chunin nest, balki in raftori munofik'on az rui illati sitamkoriest, ki ba sababi rui toftan az kh'ukmi Rasuli Allokh' va sarkashi dar onkh'o ch'oi girifta ast.

Chun Khudovand dar oiatkh'oi mazkur mavk'e'girii munofik'onro zikr namud, ki farmoni U va Paiombarashro namepazirand, dar oiati zerin mavk'e'girii mu'minonro dar barobari farmoni Khud va Paiombarash baion sokhta guft:
51) Albatta, k'avli mu'minon chun ba sui Allokh' va Rasulash da'vat shavand, to dar bainashon kh'ukm kunad, on ast, ki meguiand: "Sukhanashro shunidem va amrashro itoat kardem." Va in gurukh'i tavsifshuda dar duniovu okhirat rastagoroni vok'ei kh'astand.

52) Va kh'ar ki az Allokh'u Rasulash itoat karda, ba kh'ukmashon taslim megardad va az ok'ibati gunokh' metarsad va bo ich'roi amr va duri ch'ustan az nakh'i az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ez mekunad, pas tankh'o in ch'amoai doroi sifatkh'oi mazkur bo kh'osil namudani khairi duniovu okhirat rastagoroni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand.

53) Va munofik'on ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sakhttarin savgandkh'oiashonro khurdand, ki agar onkh'oro ba ch'ikh'od dastur dikh'i, kh'atman mebaroiand. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Savgand nakhured. Zero durug'gui va itoati nuki zabonii shumo ma'lum ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mekuned, Ogokh' ast. Kh'ar k'adar taloshi pinkh'on doshtani korkh'oiatonro kuned, az U pushida namemonad."

54) Ei Paiombar, ba in munofik'on bigu: "Dar oshkoru nikh'on az Allokh' itoat kuned va az Rasulash itoat kuned. Pas agar az itoati Allokh'u Rasulash rui gardoned, pas bar vai anch'omi tablig'e, ki bar dushash guzoshta shuda ast, voch'ib ast va bar shumo toat va amal ba dini ovardaash, ki ba on mukallaf gashtaed, voch'ib ast. Va agar az Rasuli Allokh' bo ich'roi amrash va parkh'ez az nakh'iash itoat kuned, ba sui kh'ak' rokh' meiobed. Va bar Rasuli Allokh' ch'uz tablig'i oshkor chize nest. Vazifai u on nest, ki shumoro baroi kh'idoiat shudan mach'bur sozad."

55) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kasone az shumo, ki ba U imon ovardaand va korkh'oi nek mekunand, va'da doda ast, ki onkh'oro ba muk'obili dushmanonashon nusrat medikh'ad va chunonchi mu'minoni guzashtaro ch'onishin gardonid, onkh'oro niz dar zamin ch'onishin mesozad va inchunin va'da doda ast, ki dini baroiashon pisandidai Islomro pobarch'o va piruz megardonad va baroiashon va'da doda ast, ki kh'olatashonro ba'di kh'arosashon ba amniiat va osoish tabdil medikh'ad. Onkh'o tankh'o Maro parastida, chizero ba Man sharik namesozand. Va kh'ar ki ba'd az in ne'matkh'o nosiposi kunad, pas in gurukh'i nosipos az itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khorich'and.

56) Va namozro dar komiltarin suratash barpo namoed va zakoti molatonro bipardozed va Rasuli Allokh'ro bo ich'roi amrash va parkh'ez az nakh'iash itoat namoed, ba umedi on ki ba rakh'mati ilokh'i noil garded.
57) Ei Paiombar, kofironro och'izsozandai Man mapindor, ki chun bar onkh'o azobam furud oiad, az on rakh'oi ioband. Va ch'oiashon ruzi k'iiomat ch'akh'annam ast va on ch'oii nikh'oiat bad ast.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi guzashta akh'komi ich'ozatpursii shakhsoni ozodi ba balog'at rasidaro ovard, dar oiati zerin akh'komi mutaallik' ba rukhsatkhokh'ii g'ulomon, shakhsoni ozodi nobolig' va kudakoni ba balog'at rasidaro baion namuda guft:
58) Ei mu'minoni mutobik'i shariat amalkunanda, boiad g'ulomonu kanizon va kudakoni ozodi nobolig'aton az shumo dar se vak't ich'ozati daromadan pursand: k'abl az namozi bomdod, dar vak'ti ivaz kardani liboskh'oi khob va dar vak'ti nisfiruzi, vak'te ki liboskh'oiatonro baroi khobi k'ailula az tan mekashed va ba'di namozi khuftan, zero in vak'ti khobidan va kashidani liboskh'oi g'airi khob va pushidani liboskh'oi khob ast. In vak'tkh'o baroi shumo se vak'ti khilvat va oshkorshavii avrat ast. Onkh'o naboiad dar in vak'tkh'o nazdaton daroiand, magar ba'd az ich'ozati shumo. Bar shumo va bar onkh'o gunokh'e nest, ki pas az in se vak't beich'ozat daroiand. In gurukh'i iodshuda nazdaton bisior raftuomadkunanda buda, ba'zeaton bo ba'zei digaraton ziiod raftuomad va shinukhez mekuned. Pas farmudani onkh'o, ki dar kh'ama kh'olat pesh az daromadanashon rukhsat pursand va be ich'ozat nadaroiand, dushvor ast. Chunonchi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo akh'komi vobasta ba ich'ozatpursiro baion kard, kh'amin guna oiatkh'oi dalolatkunandai akh'komi Kheshro baion mesozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai foidai bandagon buda, dar muk'arrar sokhtani akh'komash Bokh'ikmat ast.

59) Va chun kudakoni shumo ba balog'at birasand, pas boiad kh'ama vak't kh'angomi daromadani khona ich'ozat pursand, chunonchi peshtar dar borai kalonsolon kh'amin kh'ukm zikr shud. Chitavre, ki Parvardigor ba shumo akh'komi vobasta ba ich'ozatpursiro zikr namud, kh'amin guna oiatkh'oiashro baroiaton baion mesozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai foidai bandagon buda, dar muk'arrar sokhtani akh'komash Bokh'ikmat ast.

60) Va pirazanoni ba sababi piri az kh'aiz va bordorshavi notavon, ki ba nikokh' umed nadorand, bar onkh'o gunokh'e nest, ki ba'ze az libosi khudro ba misli chodar ba zamin guzorand, dar kh'ole oroishi makhfiero, ki pushonidanash farz ast, oshkor nasozand va parkh'ez kardanashon az guzoshtani on liboskh'o baroiashon bekh'tar ast, zero pokdomaniiu pushish beshtar rioia megardad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavoi Dono ast. Sukhanatonro meshunavad va amalatonro medonad. Kh'ech' sukhan va amalaton az U makhfi namemonad va ba zudi podoshatonro khokh'ad dod.

61) Bar kur gunokh' nest va bar lang gunokh' nest va bar bemor gunokh' nest, ki korkh'oi misli ch'ikh'odi rokh'i Khudoro, agar az ukh'daash nabaroiand, tark kunand va bar shumo mu'minon dar khurdan az khonakh'oiaton, khonakh'oi farzandonaton, khonakh'oi padaronaton, khonakh'oi modaronaton, khonakh'oi barodaronaton, khonakh'oi khokh'aronaton, khonakh'oi amukh'oiaton, khonakh'oi ammakh'oiaton, khonakh'oi tag'okh'oiaton, khonakh'oi kholakh'oiaton, on khonakh'oe, ki mukh'ofizatash ba shumo kh'avola shuda ast (ba misli bog'bon) io khonakh'oi dustaton -zero dust odatan az in kor shod megardad- gunokh'e nest, ki dastach'am'i io tankh'o mekhured. Pas chun ba khonakh'oe chun khonakh'oi zikrshuda va g'airi on daroed, ba kh'ar kase, ki dar onch'ost, bo guftani "Assalomu alaikum" salom dikh'ed. Pas agar onch'o kase naboshad, dar on surat bo guftani "Bar mo va bar bandagoni solekh'i Khudo salom" bar khudaton salom dikh'ed In salomi muboraki pokro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) muk'arrar sokhta ast. Barakat va pokiash dar on ast, ki boisi nashri mukh'abbatu ulfat shuda, khotiri shunavandaashro khush megardonad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba monandi tavzekh' dodani in sura oiatkh'oi Kheshro baroiaton baion mesozad, to onro fakh'med va amal kuned.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi k'abli kh'angomi daromadani khona odobi ich'ozat khostanro zikr kard, dar oiati zerin odobi vak'ti raftan ich'ozat pursidanro baion namuda guft:
62) Ba durusti, mu'minoni dar imoni khesh sodik' kasoneand, ki ba Allokh' va Rasulash imon ovardaand va chun dar kori mukh'immi ba naf'i musalmonon bo Rasuli Allokh' boshand, to vak'te az u ich'ozat napursand, nameravand. Kasone, ki vak'ti raftan az tu Paiombar ich'ozat mepursand, in ch'amoa bandagoneand, ki ba Allokh' va Rasulash imoni vok'ei dorand. Pas chun onkh'o baroi ba'ze korkh'oi mukh'immi khesh az tu ich'ozat pursand, ba kh'ar kase az onkh'o khokh'i, ich'ozat bidekh' va baroiashon talabi omurzishi gunokh' bikun. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bakhshandai gunokh'i bandagoni tavbakor buda, nisbatashon Mekh'rubon ast.

63) Ei mu'minon, ekh'tiromi Rasuli Allokh'ro ba ch'o ored. Vak'te uro fariod mekuned, bo ismash "Ei Mukh'ammad" io bo ismi padarash "Ei Pisari Abdullokh'" gufta fariod nakuned, chunonchi ba'zei shumo bo ba'zei digar kh'amin korro mekuned. Balki "Ei Firistodai Allokh'", "Ei Paiombari Allokh'" bigued. Chun Rasuli Allokh' shumoro ba kori ba naf'i umumi da'vat kunad, da'vati uro monandi da'vati iakdigar, ki odatan kh'amdigarro ba korkh'oi bearzish mekhoned, nagardoned, balki zud ba ich'roiash shitobed. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az shumo kasonero, ki beich'ozat pinkh'oni meravand, medonad. Pas, kasone, ki az dasturi Rasuli Allokh' sarpechi mekunand, az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba ranch'u ofate duchor mesozad io onkh'oro ba azobi dardovari tok'atfarso mubtalo megardonad, kh'azar namoiand.

64) Ei mardum, Ogokh' boshed! Beshubkh'a, kh'amai on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az rui ofarinish, molikiiat va chorasozi tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Ei mardum, U kh'olatero, ki dar on k'aror dored, medonad, chize az U pinkh'on nest. Va ruzi k'iiomat, ki ba'di rastokhez ba sui U bargardonida meshavand, onkh'oro az korkh'oi dar dunio anch'omdodaashon ogokh' mesozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ama chizro medonad. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest.

1) Boazamat va Doroi ekh'soni ziiod ast on Khudovande, ki ba banda va paiombarash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) K'ur'oni ch'udosozandai kh'ak' va botilro nozil namud, to insonkh'o va ch'inkh'oro az azobi ilokh'i bim bidikh'ad.

2) On Zote, ki kh'ukmfarmoii osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Ust va kh'ech' farzande nagirifta ast va dar kh'ukmfarmoi sharike nadorad va kh'amai chizro ofarida ast, pas kh'ar iak makhluk'ro mutobik'i ilmu kh'ikmati Khesh ba tavri munosib andozagirii dak'ik' karda ast.

3) Va mushrikon baroi ibodati kheshtan ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oero giriftaand, ki kh'ech' chizi khurdu kalonero nameofarand va on ma'budkh'o khud ofarida meshavand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astashon karda ast. Va on ma'budkh'o az khud zararero dur va baroi khud manfiatero ch'alb sokhta nametavonand va az ukh'dai mironidani zindakh'o va zinda gardonidani murdakh'o va az k'abr dubora zinda kardani favtidakh'o namebaroiand.

Chun Khudo dar oiati mazkur shirk ovardani mushrikonro ba onkh'o iodovari sokht, dar oiati zerin mavze'giriashon bo K'ur'on va sunnatro ovarda guft:
4) Va kofiron meguiand: "Begumon in K'ur'on durug'est, ki onro Mukh'ammad az nazdash bofta, ba Allokh' nisbat medikh'ad va mardumi digar dar in kor ba vai kumak rasonidaand." Beshubkh'a, in kofiron sitam va bukh'toni buzurg kardaand. Zero K'ur'on Kalomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kase az insonkh'ovu ch'inkh'o monandi on Kitobe ovarda nametavonad.
5) Va in takzibgaroni K'ur'on meguiand: "In K'ur'on afsonakh'oi peshiniion buda, Mukh'ammad onro nuskhabardori karda ast. Pas on afsonakh'o bar vai dar avval va okhiri ruz k'iroat meshavand."

6) Ei Paiombar, ba in takzibgaron bigu: "K'ur'onro Khudoe furud ovarda ast, ki asrori osmonkh'o va zaminro medonad. In Kitob on tavre shumo da'vo dored, boftashuda nest." Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo mak'sadi tashvik'ashon ba tavba guft: "Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi tavbakoron Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast."

7) Va mushrikoni takzibgari Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) meguiand: "In mardi da'vogari nubuvvat chi guna paiombar ast, ki misli digaron taom mekhurad va baroi kasbi rizk' dar bozorkh'o megardad? Charo Allokh' kh'amrokh'ash farishtaero nafiristod, to rafik'ash shuda, sukhanoni uro tasdik' namuda, kumakash rasonad?-

8) Io charo ba vai az osmon ganch'e furud ovarda nameshavad, io charo bog'e nadorad, ki az makh'suloti on bikhurad va az rokh' raftan dar bozoru ch'ustuch'ui rizk' beniioz shavad?" Va sitamgaron meguiand: "Ei mu'minon, shumo az firistodai Allokh' pairavi namekuned, balki az marde pairavi mekuned, ki ak'lash ba sababi ch'odu tira shuda ast."

9) Ei Paiombar, binigar, ki onkh'o chi guna turo bo sifatkh'oi botili kh'airatovari khilofi ak'l vasf mekunand. Gokh'o ch'odugaru gokh'o ch'odushuda va ba'zan devona meguiand. Ba kh'amin sabab, az kh'ak' gumrokh' gardida, rokh'i rostro paimuda nametavonand va baroi dar rostk'avliiu amonatat ta'n rasonidan niz rokh'e iofta nametavonand.

10) Boazamat va Doroi ekh'soni ziiod ast on Khudoe, ki agar khokh'ad, ba tu dar dunio az on chi mushrikon meguiand, bekh'tarro medikh'ad, bog'kh'oero medikh'ad, ki az zeri k'asr va darakhtonash rudkh'o ch'ori meshavad, az mevai on mekhuri va ba tu k'asrkh'oero medikh'ad, ki dar on osuda maskan megiri.

11) Sukhanoni mushrikon ba mak'sadi ch'ustuch'ui kh'ak'ik'atu dalel nest, balki onkh'o k'iiomatro durug' mekh'isoband va Mo baroi kase, ki k'iiomatro durug' mekh'isobad, otashi buzurgi sakht shu'lavar omoda namudaem.

12) Chun ch'akh'annam kofironro mushokh'ida mekunad, dar kh'ole onkh'o az makoni dur ba sui on ronda meshavand, ch'akh'annamiion az ch'onibi on ba sababi g'azabi sakhtash sadoi ch'ushidani shadid va ch'ushu khurushi az g'azab ba vuch'ud omadaro meshunavand.

13) Va chun in ch'amoai kofiron dar duzakh dar makoni tang afkanda shavand, dar kh'ole dastonashon bo zavlonakh'o ba gardanashon basta shuda ast, dar kh'ak'k'i khud duoi kh'alokat mekunand, to az in azob rakh'oi ioband.
14) Ei kofiron, imruz baroi kh'alokati khesh iak bor duo nakuned, balki ziiod duoi kh'alokat bikuned, lekin bidoned, ki duoi shumo k'abul nameshavad va dar azobi duzakh abadi memoned.

16) Dar ch'annat baroi parkh'ezkoron kh'amai ne'mati mekhostaashon mavch'ud ast. Onch'o abadi memonand. In ne'matkh'o va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, onro parkh'ezgoron az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) talab mekunand. Beshak, va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takh'ak'k'uk' meiobad va U kh'ech' gokh' ba va'daash khilof namekunad.

17) Va ruzero iod kun, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mushrikoni takzibgarro bo on chi ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastand, ch'am' mesozad, pas ba mak'sadi sarkubii ibodatkunandagon ba ma'budkh'o meguiad: "Oio shumo bandagoni Maro ba ibodati khesh dastur doda, gumrokh' sokhtaed, io onkh'o az nazdi khud gumrokh' shudand?!"

19) Pas ei mushrikon, kh'amono on ma'budkh'oe, ki ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastided, shumoro dar on chi dar kh'ak'k'ashon da'vo karda megufted, ba durug'gui nisbat dodand. Pas az rui och'izi uk'ubati ilokh'iro az khud bartaraf sokhta va ba khud iori rasonida nametavoned. Va ei mu'minon, kh'ar ki az shumo bo shirk ovardan sitam kunad, Mo ba u azobi buzurgero mechashonem, chunonchi shakhsoni zikrshuda onro mechashand.

Chun mushrikon taomkhuri va dar bozor rokh'ravii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro inkor namuda, ba gumoni kheshtan khilofi mak'omi nubuvvat donistand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o ch'avob gardonida guft:
20) Va ei Paiombar, Mo k'abl az Tu paiombaronro nafiristodaem, magar in ki onkh'o bashar budand, g'izo mekhurdand va dar bozorkh'o rokh' meraftand. Tu dar in bora nakhustin paiombar nesti. Va ei mardum, Mo ba'zei shumoro baroi ba'zei digar ba sababi dar tavongarivu fak'iri va tandurustivu bemori az iakdigar fark' kardanaton vasilai ozmoish gardonidaem. Oio dar ozmoishkh'oi Mo sabr mekuned, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi sabraton podosh dikh'ad? Va Parvardigorat bandagoni bosabru besabr, farmonbardoru nofarmonro mebinad.

22) Ruze, ki kofiron kh'angomi marg, dar olami k'abr, vak'ti dubora zindashavi, zamoni bozpursi, kh'angomi daromadan ba duzakh farishtagonro mushokh'ida mekunand, dar in ch'oikh'o baroi kofiron bashorate nest, bar khilofi mu'minon, ki ba ch'annat bashorat doda shavand va farishtagon ba kofiron meguiand: "Bashorat ba ch'annat bar shumo mutlak'o kh'arom ast."

23) Va Mo ba on chi kofiron dar dunio az amalkh'oi nek mekardand, k'asd namudem, pas korkh'oi onkh'oro az sababi kofir shudanashon dar botilshavi va bemanfiati misli g'ubori parokandae, ki dar rushnoii az panch'ara voridshavandai oftob dida meshavad, gardonidem.

24) Dar on ruz k'arorgokh' va istirokh'atgokh'i mu'minoni akh'li ch'annat az k'arorgokh' va istirokh'atgokh'i kofironi nozparvar dar dunio nektar va bekh'tar ast. In ba sababi imon va amali shoistai onkh'ost.
25) Va ei Paiombar, ruzero iodovar shav, ki osmon az abrkh'oi safedi tunuk bishikofad va farishtagon ba sababi bisiori bo te'dodi ziiod ba sui makh'shargokh' furud ovarda shavand.
26) Ruzi k'iiomat podshokh'ii rostinu sobit az Khudovandi mekh'rubon ast. Va on ruz bar kofiron bag'oiat sakht, ammo baroi mu'minon bisior oson boshad.

27) Va ei Paiombar, iod kun ruzero, ki shakhsi zolim ba sababi tarki pairavii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az rui pushaimoni dastonashro gazida meguiad: "Ei kosh, az Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar on chi az nazdi Parvardigorash ovard, pairavi mekardam va bo u rokh'i nach'otro intikhob menamudam."
28) Az shiddati taassuf dar kh'ak'k'i khud duoi bad karda meguiad: "Ei voi bar man! Kosh man falon kofirro dust namegiriftam.-

29) Ba durusti, in dusti kofir maro az K'ur'on ba'd az on ki ba vositai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba man rasida bud, gumrokh' gardonid." Va Shaiton insonro bisior tankh'oguzoranda ast. Chun giriftori mushkilot shavad, Shaiton az vai bezori mech'uiad va tarkash mekunad.
30) Va dar on ruz Paiombar az kh'oli k'avmash bo shikoiat meguiad: "Ei Parvardigoram, kh'amono k'avmeam, ki maro ba suiashon firistodi, in K'ur'onro tark karda, az on rui gardonidand."

31) Va ei Paiombar, on chunone, ki tu az ch'onibi k'avmat ozor didi va onkh'o mardumro az paziruftani dinat man' kardand, Mo kh'amin guna baroi kh'ar paiombari guzashta az much'rimoni k'avmash dushmanero karor dodem. Va Parvardigorat kh'amchun Kh'idoiatgari kh'ak'ik'at va Madadrasoni tu alaikh'i dushmanonat basanda ast.

32) Va kofiron guftand: "Charo in K'ur'on bar Paiombar iakbora nozil karda nashud? Charo on bar vai parokanda-parokanda furud meoiad?" Ei Paiombar, in K'ur'onro kh'amin guna parokanda-parokanda furud ovardem, to bo in rokh' k'albatro ustuvor gardonem va baroi oson shudani kh'ifz va fakh'm onro okh'ista-okh'ista nozil kardem.

33) Va ei Paiombar, mushrikon bo peshnikh'odkh'oiashon kh'ech' iak shubkh'aiu e'tirozero nazdat nameorand, magar in ki Mo bar muk'obilash posukhi kh'ak'k'i ustuvor va baioni bekh'taru zebotarero meorem.

34) On kasone, ki ruzi k'iiomat bar chekh'raashon kashon-kashon sui duzakh ronda meshavand. In ch'amoa makonashon badtarin va rokh'ashon az kh'ak' durtarin ast, zero ch'oiashon duzakh va rokh'ashon kufru gumrokh'ist.
35) Va beshak, Mo ba Muso Tavrotro dodem va barodarash Kh'orunro kh'amrokh'ash paiombar gardonidem, to iovarash boshad.

36) Pas ba Musovu Kh'orun guftem: "Nazdi Fir'avn va k'avmash, ki oiatkh'oi Moro durug' meshumorand, biraved."
