Onkh'o amri Moro ich'ro karda, nazdi Fir'avnu k'avmash rafta, ba sui iaktoparasti da'vatashon namudand. Fir'avn va k'avmash Musovu Kh'orunro durug'gu donistand. Mo onkh'oro ba kh'amin sabab ba shiddat kh'alok sokhtem.

37) Va k'avmi Nukh' vak'te ki bo durug'gu donistani Nukh' paiombaronro durug'gu kh'isobidand, onkh'oro bo g'ark' sokhtan dar bakh'r kh'alok namudem va kh'alok kardani onkh'oro dalolati k'udratamon bar reshakan kunonidani zolimon gardonidem va Mo baroi kofiron dar ruzi k'iiomat uk'ubati dardovar omoda kardaem.
38) Va Mo Odi k'avmi Kh'ud va Samudi k'avmi Solekh' va askh'obi chokh' va dar miioni in se k'avmi mazkur ummatkh'oi ziiodero kh'alok namudaem.

39) Va Mo baroi kh'ar kadomi in k'avmkh'oi kh'alokshuda kh'alok sokhtani ummatkh'oi peshin va sababkh'oi onro tavsif kardem, to pand girand va kh'amaashonro ba sababi kufr va iakravi ba shiddat nobud gardonidem.

40) Va k'avmi takzibgari tu kh'angomi raftan ba sarzamini Shom az nazdi dekh'ai k'avmi Lut, ki ba sababi amali bachabozi duchori uk'ubat shuda, zeri sangboron k'aror girifta budand, guzashtaand. Boiad onkh'o az on ibrat megiriftand. Magar nobino budand, ki onro nadidaand?! Ne, balki onkh'o ba zindashavii pas az marg, ki ba'di on mavridi pursish k'aror megirand, mu'tak'id nestand va ba on umed nadorand.
41) Va ei Paiombar, vak'te in k'avmi takzibgar bo tu rubaru shavand, turo tamaskhur karda, az rui rishkhand va inkor meguiand: "Oio in ast on kase, ki Allokh' uro ba sui mo paiombar firistoda ast?!-

42) Ba durusti, k'arib bud, ki moro az ibodati ma'budkh'oiamon barmegardond. Agar dar ibodati onkh'o sabr namekardem, albatta, u moro az on barmegardond." Va ba zudi chun dar k'abr va ruzi k'iiomat azobro binand, khokh'and donist, ki gumrokh' kist, onkh'o io Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)?! On ruz iak'in khokh'and kard, ki onkh'o gumrokh'and.
43) Ei Paiombar, ba Man khabar bidekh', oio kase, ki az khokh'ishoti khesh ma'bud sokhta, onro itoat namoiad, magar tu nigakh'bonash gardida, uro az kufr man' karda, ba sui imon barmegardoni?!

44) Ei Paiombar, oio gumon mebari aksari kasone, ki onkh'oro ba sui iaktoparasti va itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) faro mekhoni, ba sukhanat amalan gush mekunand, io kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ovardaatro mefakh'mand? Iak'inan onkh'o dar bobi shunidan va fakh'midan monandi chakh'orpoionand, balki az chakh'orpoion kh'am gumrokh'tarand.

45) Ei Paiombar, oio ba osarkh'oi ofarinishi Parvardigorat nigokh' namekuni, ki chi guna soiaro dar zamin gustaronid? Va agar mekhost, ki on soiaro oromi bekh'arakat sozad, in korro mekard. Sipas Mo oftobro alomati dalolatgari soia gardonidem, ki on ba vositai oftob daroz va kutokh' meshavad.
46) Sipas Mo soiaro bo rokh'i kamshavi ch'am' mesozem, on mutobik'i balandshavii oftob andak-andak ch'am' meshavad. Kase ch'uz Mo in korro karda nametavonad.

47) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Parvardigorest, ki shabro baroi shumo monandi libos gardonid, on shumovu digar ashioro mepushonad va khobro vasilai rokh'at gardonid, dar on az sargarmikh'oiaton istirokh'at mekuned va ruzro vak'te gardonid, ki dar on ba sui korkh'oi khesh rakh'sipor meshaved.

48) Va U Khudoest, ki bodkh'oro muzhdarasoni furud omadani boron, ki ch'uz'e az rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagon ast, firistod. Va Mo az sui osmon obi poksozandaro furud ovardem. Bandagon kheshro bo istifoda az on pok mesozand,-

49) to bo obi boron zamini murdai beobu alafro bo ruionidani nav'kh'oi gunoguni rastani va pakh'n namudani sabzrangi zinda gardonem va on obro az ofaridakh'oiamon ba chakh'orpoion va mardumi ziiod nushonem.

50) Va Ba durusti ki Mo dar K'ur'on nav'kh'oi gunoguni dalelkh'oro baion sokhtem, to bandagon az on ibrat girand. Pas beshtari mardum ch'uz inkori kh'ak'ik'at va kh'ak'noshinosi chizero napaziruftand.

51) Va agar mekhostem, dar kh'ar iak dekh'a paiombare mefiristodem, ki mardumro az uk'ubati ilokh'i bim dikh'ad, lekin inro nakhostaem. Kh'amono Mo Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro paiombari tamomi mardum firistodem.

52) Modom ki chunin ast, pas kofironro dar peshnikh'odkh'oiashon va darkhostashon, ki bo onkh'o mudoro namoi, itoat makun va dar ozorashon va sakhtikh'oi rokh'i da'vat sabr namuda, bo K'ur'on muk'obilashon ch'ikh'odi buzurg kun.

53) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Parvardigorest, ki obi du bakh'rro iakch'o kard, obi shirini taskinsozandai tashnagiro bo obi shuri badmazza iakch'o namud va dar bainashon parda va moneae k'aror dod, ki on du obi shirin va shurro az omekhtashavi nigokh' medorad.

54) Va U Parvardigorest, ki az obi nutfai mard va zan insonkh'oro ofarid. Pas uro sokh'ibi irtiboti kheshovandi va domodi gardonid. Va ei Paiombar, Parvardigori tu Tavono ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro och'iz namesozad. Az nutfai mardu zan ofaridani insonkh'o nishonai k'udrati Ust.

55) Va kofiron ba ch'uz Khudo ma'budkh'oero ibodat mekunand, ki agar itoatashon kunand, ba onkh'o foida nameorand va agar az itoatashon sar pechand, k'udrati ziion rasonidan nadorand. Va kofir bo khilofkoriash Parvardigorashro ba khashm ovarda, iovar va pairavi Shaiton ast.
56) Va ei Paiombar, begumon Mo turo muzhdadikh'andai mu'minon va bimdikh'andai kofiron firistodaem.

57) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Man az shumo dar ivazi tablig'i vakh'ii ilokh'i muzd namepursam. Lekin kh'ar ki az shumo khokh'ad, ki bo kharch'i molash ba sui khushnudii Khudo rokh'ero pesh bigirad, pas in korro anch'om bidikh'ad."

58) Va ei Paiombar, dar kh'amai korkh'oiat ba Allokh'i Zindai Poiandai kh'argiz namiranda tavakkul bikun va Uro az kulli aibu nuk'son ba poki bikhon va sipos bigu. Va ogokh' budani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az gunokh'oni bandagonash basanda ast. Kh'ech' gunokh'e az U pushida nest va dar oiandai nazdik baroi on gunokh'on onkh'oro much'ozot mekunad.

59) On Khudoe, ki osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini on duro dar shash ruz ofarid, sipas ba tavri loik'i zotash bar rui arsh baromad. U Khudoi Mekh'rubon ast. Pas ei Paiombar, dar mavridi U Ogokh'ero bipurs. On Ogokh' khudi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, ki kh'amaro medonad. Chize az U makhfi nest.

60) Va chun ba kofiron "Ba Khudoi Mekh'rubon sach'da kuned" gufta shavad, meguiand: "Khudoi mekh'rubon kist? Mo Uro nameshinosem va e'tirof namekunem. Oio ba chize, ki dasturamon medikh'i, sach'da namoem va kh'ol on ki mo uro nameshinosem?" Va amri Paiombar dar borai sach'da ba Khudoi Mekh'rubon az imon duriashonro beshtar sokht.

61) Boazamat va Doroi ekh'soni ziiod ast on Ofaridgore, ki baroi sitorakh'ovu saiiorakh'o dar osmon manzilkh'o ba vuch'ud ovarda ast va dar on oftobi nurafshon va mokh'i ravshanro padid ovarda ast. Mokh' bo nuri az oftob kasbkardaash zaminro rushan mesozad.

62) Va U Khudovandest, ki shab va ruzro pai dar pai gardonid, on du az paii iakdigar meoiand, baroi on kas, ki bikhokh'ad az oiatkh'oi ilokh'i ibrat bigirad va kh'idoiat iobad, io shukri ne'matkh'oi Parvardigorashro ba ch'o ovardan bikhokh'ad.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar in surai muboraka kofironi az imonu ibodat ruigardonandaro ovard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin sifati bandagoni solekh'i ba sui ibodat ruiovarandaro baion namuda guft:
63) Va bandagoni makhsusi Khudoi Mekh'rubon mu'minone kh'astand, ki dar zamin bovik'oru khoksorona rokh' meravand va vak'te ch'okh'ilon bo onkh'o sukhan kunand, posukhi ch'okh'ilona namegardonand, balki dar ch'avobashon sukhani nek gufta, az khud ch'okh'ili nishon namedikh'and.
64) Va kasoneand, ki kh'issae az shabro baroi Parvardigorashon dar kh'olati sach'da va k'iiomi namozi takh'ach'ch'ud meguzaronand.
65) Va kasoneand, ki dar duo meguiand: "Parvardigoro, uk'ubati duzakhro az mo dur gardon." Kh'amono azobi duzakh baroi kase, ki kofir memirad, doimii k'at'noshavanda ast.
66) Kh'amono duzakh baroi kase dar on k'aror megirad, k'arorgokh'i bad va baroi kase dar on sukunat mekunad, maskani bad ast.

67) Va kasoneand, ki chun moli khudro kharch' mekunand, ba isrofkori rokh' namedikh'and va dar kharch' namudani mol baroi shakhse, ki nafak'aash ba zimmaashon voch'ib ast, sakhtgiri namekunand va bukhl namevarzand va kharch'ashon miioni isrofkori va sakhtgiri dar kh'addi miiona ast.

68) Va kasoneand, ki bo Khudo ma'budi digarero nameparastand va kasero, ki Khudo kushtanashro kh'arom karda ast, namekushand, ba ch'uz dar mavridkh'oe ba misli kushtani k'otil, mu'mini az din bargashta va zanu mardi sokh'ibkh'amsari zinokor, ki k'atlashon shar'an ich'ozat ast va zino namekunand va kh'ar ki in gunokh'oni kabiraro anch'om dikh'ad, ruzi k'iiomat uk'ubati onro mebinad.
69) Ruzi k'iiomat uk'ubatash duchand sokhta meshavad va dar ch'akh'annam dar kh'olati khori abadi memonad.

70) Lekin kh'ar, ki tavba kunadu imon biiorad va amali shoistae, ki samimiiatashro dar tavba nishon medikh'ad, anch'om dikh'ad, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amalkh'oi badi in toifaro ba nekikh'o mubaddal mesozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bakhshandai gunokh'oni tavbakoron buda, nisbatashon Mekh'rubon ast.
71) Va kh'ar ki tavba kunad va bo anch'omi ibodat va tarki ma'siiat samimiiati tavbaashro nishon dikh'ad, pas iak'inan tavbai vai pazirufta meshavad.

72) Va kasoneand, ki dar mach'liskh'oi botilu durug' ba misli ch'okh'oi ma'siiat shirkat namekunand va vatk'e az nazdi guftoru kirdori lag'vu puchi bekh'uda guzarand, zud meguzarand, dar kh'ole ki khudro bo pok nigokh' doshtan az oludashavi ba on giromi medorand.

73) Va kasoneand, ki chun bo oiatkh'oi K'ur'on va nishonakh'oi k'udrati Parvardigorashon dar koinot pand doda shavand, az shunidani oiatkh'oi Kalomi Parvardigor va az mushokh'idai nishonakh'oi k'udrati ilokh'i dar olami kh'asti khudro noshunavo va nobino namegirand.

74) Va kasoneand, ki dar duoiashon meguiand: "Parvardigoro, ba mo zanon va farzandonero ato namo, ki bo parkh'ezkori va dar rokh'i rost k'aror doshtan ravshanii chashmamon boshand va moro baroi parkh'ezkoron peshvoi rokh'i kh'ak'ik'at va sazovori ik'tido gardon."

75) Ba in ch'amoai mavsuf ba sababi dar ibodat sabr kardanashon olitarin manzilgokh'kh'oro dar firdavsi barin podosh doda meshavad va ba onkh'o az sui farishtagon salom gufta meshavad va dar onch'o az kh'ama guna ofatkh'o solim memonand,-
76) Onkh'o dar ch'annat ch'ovidon memonand. Ch'annat k'arorgokh'i nikh'oiat khub va ch'oigokh'i nikh'oiat zeboest.

77) Ei Paiombar, ba kh'amai mardum bigu: "Agar ibodat va duoiaton naboshad, Parvardigoram ba shumo e'tinoe namekunad va nazdash arzishe nadored. Pas beshak, shumo kofiron Paiombarro dar on chi az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ovard, durug'gui kh'isobided. Pas ch'azoi takzibaton mulozimaton gashta, az shumo ch'udo nameshavad."
1) "To. Sin. Mim."Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) In oiatkh'oi K'ur'onest, ki kh'ak'ro az botil oshkor mesozad.

3) Ei Paiombar, shoiad tu az imon naovardani mardumi Makka ziiod andukh'gin shuda, khudro kh'alok gardoni. Zero bisior mekhokh'i, ki onkh'o imon biiorand. Ba kh'oli khud rakh'm kun. Khudro bo g'ami ziiod kh'alok masoz!
4) Agar khokh'em, bar onkh'o az osmon mu'ch'iza furud meovarem, ki dar barobarash gardanashon taslim gardad. Vale inro nakhostem, to onkh'oro ozmoish kunem, ki oio ba g'aib imon meorand?!

5) Va ba in mushrikon az sui Khudoi Mekh'rubon kh'ech' pandi tozanuzul bo kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi vakh'doniiati Khudo va rostguii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nameoiad, magar in ki onkh'o az shunidan va tasdik'i on rui megardonand.
6) Pas beshak, vakh'ii ovardai paiombaronashonro durug' shumurdand. Pas ba zudi baroiashon kh'ak'ik'ati khabarkh'oe, ki onro maskhara mekardand, meoiad va onkh'o duchori azob megardand.
7) Oio in ch'amoai mushrik dar kufri khesh bok'i monda, ba zamin bo taammul nigokh' namekunand, ki Mo chi guna dar on kh'ar nav' rastanikh'oi zebomanzari doroi foidakh'oi ziiodro ruionidaem?!
8) Albatta, dar ruionidani rastanikh'oi gunogun az zamin nishonai ravshani k'udrati Parvardigor ba zinda gardonidani murdagon ast va dar ilmi Parvardigor ma'lum ast, ki beshtarashon imon nameorand.
9) Va ei Paiombar, kh'amono iagona Parvardigorat G'olibi dar kh'ak'k'i bandagonash Mekh'rubon ast.

10) Va ei Paiombar, vak'tero ba iod biior, ki Parvardigorat Musoro nido karda, farmud: "Nazdi k'avme birav, ki bo kofir gashtanashon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va badarg'a kardani k'avmi tu zulm namudaand.
11) On zolimon k'avmi Fir'avnand." Muso onkh'oro bo narmiiu mekh'ruboni ba parkh'ezkori amr mekard.
12) Muso guft: "Parvardigoro, kh'amono man metarsam, ki onkh'o maro dar on chi az Tu baroiashon merasonam, durug'gui mekh'isoband.
13) Va sinaam az durug'gui kh'isobidanashon tang megardad va zabonam az guftan boz memonad. Pas Ch'abrailro ba sui barodaram Kh'orun bifirist va paiombarash gardon, to iovaram boshad.
14) Va onkh'o bar man az sababi on ki mardi k'ibtiro kushtaam, da'voi k'isos dorand. Pas metarsam, ki maro mekushand."

15) Khudo ba Muso guft: "Kh'argiz turo kushta nametavonand. Pas tuvu barodarat Kh'orun kh'amrokh'i mu'ch'izakh'oe, ki dalolatkunandai rostk'avlii shumost, biraved. Begumon Mo bo nusrat va ta'iidi Khesh bo shumoem, on chi megued va on chi ba shumo gufta meshavad, meshunavem, kh'ech' chiz az Mo dur namemonad.
16) Pas nazdi Fir'avn biraved va ba vai bigued: "Kh'amono mo az nazdi Parvardigori kh'ama mavch'udot ba sui tu firistoda shudaem.
17) Bo in paig'om omadaem, ki Bani Isroilro az bandi g'ulomi ozod karda, bo mo bifirist."
18) Fir'avn ba Muso guft: "Oio turo dar khurdsoliat nazdi khud tarbiiat nakardem va solkh'oi ziiodi umrat dar baini mo naistodi? Chi bois gasht, ki da'voi nubuvvat kuni?!
19) Va chun mardi k'ibtiero bo mak'sadi giriftani intik'omi kh'amk'avmi khesh k'atl namudi, kori buzurge kardi va tu az ch'umlai nosiposoni ekh'sonkh'oi man kh'asti."
20) Muso ba khatoi khesh e'tirof kard va ba Fir'avn guft: "Man on mardro dar kh'ole kushtam, ki k'abl az omadani paig'omi ilokh'i az ch'okh'ilon budam.

21) Pas, ba'di k'atlash az nazdaton ba shakh'ri Madian gurekhtam, zero az on tarsidam, ki shumo maro dar ivazash ba k'atl merasoned. Pas, Parvardigoram ba man donish dod va maro az paiombaroni ba sui mardum firistodashuda gardonid.

22) Va in ki maro biduni g'ulomi khesh gardonidanat tarbiiat kardi, bo vuch'udi on ki Bani Isroilro g'ulom sokhti, dar kh'ak'ik'at ne'mati arzandai minnat ast, valekin in ekh'soni ba man kardaat monei turo da'vat kardanam nameshavad."
23) Fir'avn ba Muso guft: "Va Parvardigori mavch'udot, ki tu da'voi paiombari U budanro dori, kist?"

24) Muso dar ch'avobi Fir'avn guft: "U Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin va mavch'udoti miioni onkh'ost. Agar shumo iak'in doshta boshed, ki U Parvardigori kulli makhluk'ot ast, pas tankh'o Uro parasted."
25) Fir'avn khitob ba peshvoioni k'avmash, ki dar atrofash budand, guft: "Oio posukhi Muso va da'voi durug'i uro nameshunaved?!"
26) Muso guft: "Allokh' Parvardigori shumo va Parvardigori padaroni guzashtai shumost."
27) Fir'avn guft: "Kh'amono in marde, ki az rui da'voi khesh ba sui shumo firistoda shuda ast, devona meboshad. Dar posukhi savol chi guftanashro namedonad va gapkh'oe meguiad, ki khud namefakh'mad."
28) Muso guft: "Agar baroi fakh'midan ak'l medoshted, On Khudoe, ki shumoro ba suii U da'vat mekunam, Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin va Parvardigori tamomi makhluk'oti miioni onkh'ost."
29) Fir'avn ba'di och'iz mondan az ovardani kh'uch'ch'at ba Muso guft: "Savgand mekhuram, agar g'airi man digar ma'budro ibodat kuni, begumon turo az ch'umlai zindoniion megardonam."
30) Muso ba Fir'avn guft: "Agarchi nazdat bar isboti rostguii khesh kh'uch'ch'at biioram, oio boz kh'am maro zindon mekuni?!"
31) Fir'avn guft: "Agar dar da'voiat sodik' boshi, pas kh'uch'ch'ati isbotkunandai nubuvvati kheshro biiovar."
32) Pas Muso asoi kheshtanro ba zamin afkand, va nogakh'on on ba azhdakh'oi oshkor tabdil ioft.
33) Va dastashro zeri girebonash darovard, pas onro nogakh'on be on ki bemorii pust boshad, baroi binandagon safedi tobon berun ovard.
34) Fir'avn ba peshvoioni k'avmash, ki dar atrofash budand, guft: "Beshak, in mard sokh'iri donandai san'ati ch'odugarist.
35) Mekhokh'ad shumoro bo ch'oduiash az sarzaminaton berun sozad. Pas nazari shumo chist? Dar borai vai chi k'aror k'abul kunem?"
36) Peshvoioni k'avmash guftand: "Mas'alai uro bo barodarash ba ta'khir andoz va baroi uk'ubatashon shitob makun va dar shakh'rkh'oi Misr kasonero bifirist, ki ch'odugaronro ch'am' sozand,-
37) to tamomi sokh'ironi k'avii donandai san'ati ch'odugariro nazdat orand."
38) Pas Fir'avn ch'odugaronashro baroi rak'obati Muso dar zamonu makoni muaiian ch'am' kard.
39) Va ba mardum gufta shud: "Oio shumo ch'am' meshaved, to bined, ki oio Muso g'olib megardad io ch'odugaron?-
40) Ba umedi on ki agar ch'odugaron alaikh'i Muso g'olib oiand, az dini onkh'o pairavi mekunem."
41) Pas vak'te ch'odugaron omadand, ba Fir'avn guftand: "Agar mo dar in muboriza alaikh'i Muso piruz gardem, oio sokh'ibi mukofoti moddi io ma'navi meshavem?"
42) Fir'avn ba onkh'o guft: "Ore, kh'atman shumo sokh'ibi mukofot meshaved. Va dar surati bar Muso piruz shudanaton bo giriftani mansabkh'oi baland az ch'umlai muk'arraboni darboram megarded."
43) Muso bo e'timod ba kumaki Khudo va baioni in ki mu'ch'izakh'oiash ch'odu nest, ba onkh'o guft: "On chiro az resmon va asokh'oiaton afkandan mekhokh'ed, biafkaned."
44) Pas ch'odugaron resmonkh'o va asokh'oi kheshtanro afkandand va dar vak'ti afkandan guftand: "Savgand ba azamati Fir'avn, kh'amono mo g'olib meshavem va Muso mag'lub megardad."
45) Pas Muso asoi khudro afkand, pas on ba surati azhdakh'oe tabdil shuda, nogakh'on ch'oduero, ki sokh'iron bo tazvir va khaiolbofi dar nazari mardum mesokhtand, furu meburd.

46) Pas chun sokh'iron didand, ki asoi Muso sekh'ri afkandai onkh'oro furu mebarad, az ukh'dai idorai khesh baromandand va beikhtiior chunon ba zamin sach'dakunon aftodand, ki guio kase onkh'oro afkanda boshad.
47) Onkh'o guftand: "Ba Parvardigori tamomi makhluk'ot imon ovardem,-
48) Parvardigori Muso va Kh'orun (alaikh'is salom)."

49) Fir'avn imoni ch'odugaronro inkor karda guft: "Oio pesh az on ki ba shumo ich'ozat dikh'am, ba Muso imon ovarded? Kh'amono Muso rakh'baraton buda, ch'odugariro ba shumo vai ta'lim doda ast. Shumo kh'amagi baroi az Misr berun sokhtani mardum bo iakdigar ittifok' bastaed. Pas ba zudi much'ozoti maro dar kh'ak'k'i khesh khokh'ed donist. Kh'atman dastkh'ovu pokh'oiatonro aksi iakdigar -iakero az tarafi rost va digarero az tarafi chap-meburam va kh'amaatonro bar tanakh'oi darakhti khurmo ba dor meovezam. Kaseatonro bok'i nameguzoram."

50) Ch'odugaron dar ch'avobi Fir'avn guftand: "In ki dar in dunio moro bo buridani dastu poi va ba dor ovekhtan metarsoni, zarare nadorad. Zero shikanch'ai tu zavoliobanda ast. Ba durusti, mo ba sui Parvardigoramon barmegardem va U moro ba rakh'mati doimiash dokhil mesozad.
51) Beshak, az sababi on ki mo avvalin shakhsoni ba Muso imon ovardaem, umed dorem, ki Parvardigoramon khatokh'oi dar guzashta sodirkardaamonro mag'firat karda, makh'v megardonad."

52) Va Mo ba Muso paig'om firistoda, uro amr kardem, ki bo Bani Isroil shabona ba sui dario kh'arakat bikun. Chunki kh'atman Fir'avn va lashkariionash az dunbolaton meshavand, to shumoro bargardonand.

53) Pas Fir'avn ch'am'ovarandagoni kheshtanro baroi ch'am' sokhtani lashkariionash firistod, to Bani Isroilro az rokh'ashon bargardonand. Zero u ogokh' shuda bud, ki onkh'o shabona ba rokh' baromadaand.
54) Fir'avn Bani Isroilro kh'ech' shumurda guft: "Ba durusti ki inkh'o toifai andak kh'astand.
55) Va kh'amono onkh'o bo korkh'oi khud khashmi moro meorand.
56) Va kh'amono mo baroi peshgirii onkh'o gurukh'i doim omodaiu bedorem."
57) Pas Mo Fir'avnro bo k'avmash az sarzamini doroi bustonkh'oi sarsabz va chashmakh'oi ch'ori-
58) va khazinakh'oi moli va maskankh'oi zeboi Misr berun ovardem.
59) Kh'amin guna Fir'avn va k'avmashro az ne'matkh'o berun ovardem. Va baroi Bani Isroil dar sarzamini Shom ba'd az Fir'an va k'avmash ne'matkh'oi monand ba ne'matkh'oi onkh'oro ato namudem.
60) Pas Fir'avn bo k'avmash dar vak'ti shuruk'i oftob az paii Bani Isroil kh'arakat kardand.

61) Pas chun Fir'avn va k'avmi vai bo Musovu k'avmash rubaru shuda, iakdigarro didand, ioroni Muso guftand: "Kh'amono Fir'avnu k'avmash ba zudi ba mo merasand va mo k'udrati onro nadorem, ki bo onkh'o muk'obiliiat nishon dikh'em."
62) Muso ba k'avmash guft: "Kor on tavre shumo tasavvur dored, nest. Kh'amono Parvardigoram bo nusrat va ta'iidi Khesh kh'amrokh'i man ast. Ba zudi maro ba rokh'i nach'ot rakh'namoi mekunad."

63) Pas ba Muso paig'om firistoda, uro farmon dodem, ki asoi khudro ba dario bizan. Muso asoiashro ba dario zad, pas on pora gashta, ba adadi k'abilakh'oi Bani Isroil ba duvozdakh' guzargokh' tabdil shud. Pas kh'ar iak k'it'ai porashuda dar buzurgi va ustuvori misli kukh'i buzurge gardid, ki az on ob nameguzasht.
64) Va Fir'avnu k'avmashro nazdik sokhtem va onkh'o ba gumoni in ki on duvozdakh' rokh'i kushodashuda guzargokh' ast, voridi dario shudand.
65) Va Muso va kh'amai Bani Isroilro, ki kh'amrokh'ash budand, nach'ot dodem. Kase az onkh'o kh'alok nashud.
66) Sipas Fir'avnu k'avmashro bo g'ark' shudanashon dar dario kh'alok sokhtem.
67) Kh'amono dar porashavii dario, nach'oti Musovu pairavoni vai va kh'alokati Fir'avnu k'avmash nishonai rostguii Muso bud va beshtari kh'amrakh'oni Fir'avn imon naovardand.
68) Va ei Paiombar, beshak, Parvardigorat G'olibi az dushmanonash intik'omsiton buda, nisbat ba dushmanoni tavbakorash Mekh'rubon ast.
69) Va ei Paiombar, bar onkh'o k'issai Ibrokh'imro tilovat kun.
70) Vak'te ba padarash Ozar va k'avmash guft: "On chi g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted, chist?"
71) Onkh'o bo iftikhor guftand: "Mo butkh'oro meparastem va dar ibodati onkh'o bardavom bok'i memonem."
72) Ibrokh'im ba onkh'o guft: "Vak'te butkh'oiatonro duo mekuned, oio onkh'o duoiatonro meshunavand?
73) Io agar az onkh'o itoat kuned, ba shumo foida meorand, io agar az itoatashon sarkashi namoed, ba shumo zarar merasonand?"

74) Onkh'o guftand: "Chun duo kunem, duoiamonro nameshunavand, agar az onkh'o itoat kunem, baroiamon foida nameorand va kh'angomi nofarmoni zarar namerasonand, balki padaroni khudro didaem, ki kh'amin korro mekardand. Baroi kh'amin mo niz ba padaronamon tak'lid mekunem.
75) Ibrokh'im guft: "Oio shumo andeshidaed, ki g'air az Khudo chiro meparasted-
76) va padaroni guzashtaaton chiro meparastidand.
77) Pas, Ba durusti ki kh'amai on ma'budkh'oi shumo dushmanoni manand. Lekin Parvardigori kh'amai mavch'udotro meparastam,-
78) on Parvardigore, ki maro khalk' karda ast, pas, U maro ba sui nekii duniovu okhirat rakh'namoi mekunad.
79) Va on Parvardigore, ki chun gurusna shavam, tankh'o U maro mekhuronad va chun tashna monam, fak'at U maro serob megardonad.
80) Va chun bemor shavam, tankh'o U maro shifo mebakhshad. Man g'air az U shifodikh'andai digar nadoram.
81) Va chun mukh'lati zindagiam ba okhir birasad, tankh'o U maro memironad va ba'di marg fak'at U maro zinda megardonad.
82) Va on Parvardigore, ki dar ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o az U umedi omurzidani khatoi kheshro doram."
83) Ibrokh'im duo kard va guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, ba man ilmi amik'i dini bidekh' va maro ba paiombaroni guzashta bipaivand, ba in surat, ki maro kh'amrokh'ashon dokhili ch'annat gardon.
84) Va baroiam dar miioni kasone, ki ba'd az man meoiand, zikri khair va nomi nek k'aror bidekh'.
85) Va maro az merosbaroni manzilkh'oi ch'annate, ki bandagoni mu'minat onch'o dar nozu ne'matand, k'aror doda, sokini abadii on bigardon.

86) Va padaramro mag'firat kun, zero vai beguftugu, bo shirk ovardan az ch'umlai shakhsoni az rokh'i kh'ak' gumrokh' bud." Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) zamone dar kh'ak'k'i padarash duo kard, ki kh'anuz az akh'li duzakh budanash ma'lum nabud, vale chun duzakhi budanash ma'lum shud, Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) az padarash bezori ch'usta, minba'd dar kh'ak'k'ash duoi khair nakard.

88) ruze, ki dar on na moli dar dunio ch'am'ovardai mardum va na farzandonashon, ki bo onkh'o iftikhor mekardand, foidaashon namerasonad,-

89) ch'uz on kas, ki ba nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo dili az shirku nifok'u riiokori va khudpisandi pok biioiad." In guna shakhs az moli dar rokh'i Khudo sarfkarda va farzandoni solekh'i khesh, ki ba'd az marg dar kh'ak'k'i vai duo mekardand, sud mebarad.
90) Va on ruz ch'annat baroi kasone, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot tak'vo mekardand, nazdik gardonida meshavad.
91) Va duzakh dar makh'shargokh' baroi shakhsoni az rokh'i rost gumrokh' namoion sokhta meshavad.
92) Va ba duzakhiion baroi sarzanishashon gufta meshavad: "Butkh'oe, ki dar dunio onkh'oro ibodat mekarded, kuch'oiand?!

93) Onkh'oro ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastided. Oio on ma'budkh'o bo kh'imoiat kardani shumo az uk'ubat baroiaton kumak merasonand?! Io onkh'o az uk'ubat boz istodan va ba khud iori dodan metavonand?!"
94) Pas ba'zei on gumrokh'kunandagon boloi ba'zei digar kh'amrokh'i gumrokh'on ba duzakh afkanda meshavand.
95) Va tamomi shaitonkh'oi iovari Iblis, biduni istisno ba duzakh afkanda meshavand.
96) Mushrikon dar duzakh dar kh'ole ki bo ma'budkh'oi sun'ii khesh kashmakash mekunand, meguiand:
97) "Savgand ba Allokh', mo az rokh'i durust dar gumrokh'ii oshkor k'aror doshtem-
98) vak'te shumoro ba Parvardigori kulli mavch'udot barobar sokhta, monandi U ibodat mekardem.
99) Va moro az rokh'i durust ch'uz badkorone, ki ba ibodati ma'budkh'o da'vatamon namudand, kase gumrokh' nasokhta ast.
100) Pas mo imruz shafoatgarone nadorem, ki nazdi Khudo shafoat kunand, to moro az azobi U birakh'onand.
101) Va dusti samimii kh'imoiatgar niz nadorem.
102) Pas kosh mo ba zindagonii dunio imkoni bozgasht medoshtem, to az ch'umlai mu'minon megashtem.
103) Kh'amono dar zikri k'issai Ibrokh'im va ok'ibati takzibgaron baroi ibratgirandagon ibrate kh'ast va beshtarashon mu'min nabudand.
104) Va iak'inan Parvardigori tu Paiombar G'olibi az dushmanonash intik'omsiton buda, nisbat ba dushmanoni tavbakorash Mekh'rubon ast.
105) K'avmi Nukh' on gokh', ki uro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand, tamomi paiombaronro durug'gui shumurdand.
106) Vak'te ba onkh'o barodari nasabiashon Nukh' guft: "Oio bo tarki ibodati g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ezkori namekuned?!
107) Man baroiaton az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) paiombari amonatnigakh'dor kh'astam. Az paig'omi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizero ziiodu kam namekunam.
108) Pas bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va ba on chi shumoro amr va az on chi nakh'i mekunam, maro itoat namoed.
109) Va man dar ivazi rasonidani paiomi Khudo az shumo muzd talab namekunam. Podoshi man ch'uz bar Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion bar kase nest.
110) Pas bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va ba on chi shumoro amr va az on chi nakh'i mekunam, maro itoat namoed."
111) K'avmash ba vai guftand: "Ei Nukh', oio mo ba tu imon meorem va az dinat pairavi va bo on amal mekunem, kh'ol on ki pairavonat mardumi pastand, dar bainashon sarvaronu ashrofon nestand?!"
112) Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) dar ch'avob guft: "Man dar borai on chi in mu'minon mekunand, chi medonam?! Man nigakh'boni onkh'o nestam, ki tamomi korashonro kh'isobu kitob kunam.
113) Kh'isobashon tankh'o dar ikhtiiori Parvardigori man ast, ki oshkoru nikh'onashonro medonad. Agar shumo fakh'm medoshted va chi guftanatonro mefakh'mided, kh'ech' gokh' chunin namegufted.
114) Va man kh'argiz darkhosti shumoro pazirufta, mu'minonro az mach'lisi khesh nameronam, ki shumo imon biovared.
115) Man bimdikh'andai oshkore besh nestam. Shumoro az azobi Khudo metarsonam."
116) K'avmash ba vai guftand: "Ei Nukh', agar az da'vati khesh boz naisti, begumon mavridi dashnom k'aror megiri va az shakhsoni bo rokh'i sangsor kushtashuda megardi."
117) Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) Parvardigorashro duo karda guft: "Parvardigoro, ba durusti, k'avmam maro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand va ba man dar on chi az nazdi Tu ovardaam, bovar nakardand.

118) Pas miioni man va miioni onkh'o kh'ukme karda, onkh'oro baroi pofishori dar botil kh'alok soz va maro bo kh'amrakh'oni mu'minam az on chi k'avmi kofiramro bo on kh'alok mesozi, rakh'oi bibakhsh."
119) Pas duoi Nukh'ro paziruftem va uro bo mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ash buda dar kishtii pur az mardum va kh'aivonot nach'ot dodem.
120) Sipas ba'd az onkh'o k'avmi bok'imondai Nukh'ro g'ark' sokhtem.
121) Kh'amono dar zikri k'issai Nukh'u k'avmash, nach'ot ioftani onkh'o va kh'alokshavii kofiron baroi ibratgirandagon pandest va beshtarashon mu'min nabudand.
122) Va beshak, Parvardigori tu Paiombar G'olibi az dushmanonash intik'omsiton buda, nisbat ba dushmanoni tavbakorash Mekh'rubon ast.
123) K'avmi Od vak'te paiombarashon Kh'udro durug'gu donistand, kh'ama paiombaronro durug'gu shumurdand.
124) Ba khotir biior on gokh', ki barodari nasabiashon Kh'ud ba onkh'o guft: "Oio bo tark kardani parastishi g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ezkori namekuned?!
125) Man baroiaton az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) paiombari amonatnigakh'dor kh'astam. Az paig'omi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizero ziiodu kam namekunam.
126) Pas bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va ba on chi shumoro amr va az on chi nakh'i mekunam, maro itoat namoed.
127) Va man dar ivazi rasonidani paiomi ilokh'i az shumo muzd talab namekunam. Podoshi man ch'uz bar Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion bar kase nest.
128) Oio shumo dar kh'ar makoni baland bekh'uda kokhi sar ba falak kashidae mesozed, ki dar duniovu okhirat baroiaton sude nameorad?!
129) Va k'al'akh'ovu k'asrkh'oe bino mekuned, ki guio dar in dunio abadi memoned va az on ch'udo nameshaved?!
130) Va vak'te kasero ba vositai k'atlu zarb much'ozot mekuned va kh'amlavar meshaved, chun sarkashonu mutakabbiron berakh'mona ch'azo medikh'ed va kh'amlavar megarded.
131) Pas bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va ba on chi shumoro amr va az on chi nakh'i mekunam, maro itoat namoed.
132) Va az g'azabi Parvardigore, ki ba shumo ne'matkh'oero doda ast, ki onro medoned, bitarsed.
133) Ba shumo ne'matkh'o va farzandoni ziiod doda ast.
134) Va ba shumo bog'kh'o va chashmakh'oi ch'ori ato namuda ast.
135) Ei k'avmam, kh'amono man baroi shumo az azobi ruzi buzurgi k'iiomat metarsam."
136) K'avmash ba u guftand: "Pand dodanu nadodani tu baroiamon barobar ast. Mo ba tu imon nameorem va az rokh'amon namegardem."
137) In chizkh'oe, ki az nazdat bofta va moro az on metarsoni, ch'uz dinu odat va akhlok'i peshiniion chize nest.

139) Pas takzibi Kh'udi paiombarashonro idoma dodand. Binobar in onkh'oro bo bodi az khairu barakat kholi kh'alok sokhtem. Kh'amono dar zikri kh'alokati k'avmi Kh'ud baroi ibratgirandagon pand ast va beshtarashon mu'min nabudand.
140) Va beshak, Parvardigori tu Paiombar G'olibi az dushmanonash intik'omsiton buda, nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash Mekh'rubon ast.
141) K'avmi Samud bo durug'gu donistani paiombarashon Solekh' kh'ama paiombaronro durug'gu shumurdand.
142) On gokh', ki barodari nasabiashon Solekh' ba onkh'o guft: "Oio bo tarki ibodati g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ezkori namekuned?!
143) Man baroiaton az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) paiombari amonatnigakh'dor kh'astam. Az paig'omi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizero ziiodu kam namekunam.
144) Pas bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va ba on chi shumoro amr va az on chi nakh'i mekunam, maro itoat namoed.
145) Va man dar ivazi rasonidani paiomi ilokh'i az shumo muzd talab namekunam. Podoshi man ch'uz bar Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion bar kase nest.
146) Oio umedvored, ki dar khairu ne'mat osudaiu emin guzoshta meshaved?!
147) Dar bog'kh'o va chashmakh'oi ch'ori?
148) Dar ziroatkh'o va darakhtoni khurmoe, ki mevai on muloimi pukhta rasida ast?
149) Va kukh'kh'oro mokh'irona pora mekuned, to baroi khud khonakh'o bisozed.
150) Pas bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed va ba on chi shumoro amr va az on chi nakh'i mekunam, maro itoat namoed.
151) Va taslimi amri kasone mashaved, ki bo sodir namudani gunokh' dar kh'ak'k'i kheshtan ch'inoiat kardaand,-
152) kasone, ki bo nashri ma'siiat dar rui zamin fasodkori mekunand va khudro bo poibandi ba ibodat islokh' namesozand."
153) K'avmash dar ch'avob guftand: "Kh'amono tu az ch'umlai shakhsoni borkh'o ch'odushudai, to kh'adde, ki ch'odu dar ak'lat ta'sir rasonida, onro tira karda ast.
154) Tu ba monandi mo insone besh nesti. Az mo kh'ech' bartari nadori, ki loik'i paiombari boshi. Pas agar dar da'voiat sodik'i, alomate biiovar, ki ba paiombariat dalolat kunad."

155) Solekh', ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba u modashuturi az dokhili kharsang berun ovardaashro mu'ch'iza doda bud, ba k'avmash guft: "In modashuture, ki dar peshi chashmaton namoion ast, khobu khaiol nest, az obnushi kh'issai khudro dorad va shumo kh'issai khudro dored. Vai dar ruzi kh'issai shumo ob namenushad va shumo dar ruzi kh'issai vai ob namenushed.

156) Bo kushtan io zadan ba vai ziion narasoned, zero agar chunin kuned, ba sababi in amali badi khesh shumoro az nazdi Khudo azobe merasad, ki ba vositai on dar ruzi buzurg kh'alokaton megardonad. Buzurgii on ruz dar on ast, ki ba shumo baloi sakht furud meoiad."

157) Pas Samudi k'avmi Solekh' baroi kushtani modashutur bo kh'am ittifok' bastand. Az bainashon badbakhttarinashon onro kusht. Pas az in baroi korashon pushaimon shudand. Zero iak'inan medonistand, ki duchori uk'ubat megardand, ammo kh'angomi mushokh'idai azob pushaimoni foida nadorad.
158) Pas onkh'oro uk'ubati va'dashudai zilzila va na'rai sakht faro girift. Ba durusti ki dar zikri sarguzashti Solekh' va k'avmash baroi ibratgirandagon pand ast va beshtarashon mu'min nabudand.
159) Va beshak, Parvardigori tu Paiombar G'olibi az dushmanonash intik'omsiton buda, nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash Mekh'rubon ast.

166) Va kh'amsaronatonro, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi k'azoi shakh'vati shumo khalk'ashon karda ast, rakh'o mesozed? Balki shumo bo in amali k'abekh'i khilofi fitrati solim az marzkh'oi guzoshtai Parvardigor guzashtaed."
167) K'avmash dar ch'avob guftand: "Ei Lut, savgand mekhurem, ki agar az in sukhanoni khud boz naisti, tu va kh'amrakh'onat az dekh'ai mo ikhroch' khokh'ed gasht."
168) Lut (alaikh'is salom) dar posukhashon guft: "Beshak, man ba in amali shumo nafrat doram va nopisandash medonam."
169) Vai ba Parvardigorash rui ovarda guft: "Parvardigoro, az azobe, ki ba zudi ba in gurukh' az sababi sodir kardani amali zisht merasoni, maro va khonadonamro nach'ot bidekh'."
170) Pas Mo duoi Lutro paziruftem va uro bo kh'amai akh'li baitash nach'ot dodem,-
171) ch'uz kh'amsarash, ki beimon buda, az bok'imondagoni kh'alokshuda gardid.
172) Ba'd az on ki Lut bo khonadonash az dekh'ai ba nomi "Sadum" baromad, pas az vai bok'imondai k'avmashro ba shiddat kh'alok sokhtem.

173) Va bar onkh'o az osmon monandi nozilshavii boron sangkh'oro furud ovardem. Pas borone, ki bar in ch'amoai az sui Lut takh'didshuda furud omad, boroni bade bud. Lut mudom in k'avmro az azobi Khudo bim doda, ta'kid menamud, ki agar kori badashonro idoma dikh'and, duchori uk'ubati sakht megardand.
174) Begumon dar zikri k'issai k'avmi Lut, ki ba sababi anch'omi amali zisht ba uk'ubati sakht mubtalo gashtand, baroi ibratgirandagon pand ast va beshtarashon imon nadoshtand.
175) Va beshak, Parvardigori tu Paiombar G'olibi az dushmanonash intik'omsiton buda, nisbat ba dushmanoni tavbakorash Mekh'rubon ast.

184) Va az azobi Khudoe, ki shumo va ummatkh'oi guzashtaro khalk' karda ast, bitarsed."

189) Pas takzibi khudro idoma dodand. Dar natich'a ba onkh'o azobi bag'oiat kh'avlnok rasid. Ba'd az ruzi garmoi sakht abrporae bar sarashon soia afkand va bar onkh'o boroni otash borida, kh'amaashonro nobud sokht. Kh'amono ruzi kh'alok sokhtani onkh'o, ruzi dakh'shatnok bud.

192) Va kh'amono in K'ur'oni bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) furudomada az sui Parvardigori tamomi mavch'udot nozil karda shuda ast.
193) Onro Ch'abraili amonatnigakh'dor (alaikh'is salom) furud ovarda ast.
194) Ei Paiombar, onro Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom) bar dilat nozil namuda ast, to az zumrai paiombarone boshi, ki mardumro az azob bim medikh'and.
195) Onro bo zaboni arabii ravshan nozil karda ast.
196) Va iak'inan K'ur'on dar Kitobkh'oi guzashtagon zikr shuda ast. Kitobkh'oi osmonii k'abli dar borai nuzuli K'ur'on bashorat dodaand.
197) Oio baroi in ch'amoai takzibgar kh'amin alomati isbotkunandai rostk'avliat basanda nest, ki Bani Isroil ba monandi Abdullokh' ibni Salom barkh'ak' budani in Kitobi bar tu nozilshudaro medonand?!

199) pas on g'airi arab in Kitobro bar akh'li Makka k'iroat mekard, imon nameovardand. Chunki bakh'ona ch'usta meguftand: "Mo in Kitobro namefakh'mem." Pas shukri Khudoro ba ch'o orand, ki K'ur'on bo zaboni modariashon furud omada ast.
200) Mo kh'amin guna kufr va takzibro dar dilkh'oi badkoron dokhil kardem.
203) Pas vak'te azob nogakh'on oiad, az rui kh'asrat meguiand: "Oio ba mo mukh'lat doda meshavad, to tavba kunem?"

204) Oio in kofiron bo guftani: "Kh'argiz ba tu imon nameorem, to vak'te ki osmonro chunonchi da'vo dori, pora-pora bar saramon furu birezi", mekhokh'and azobi Mo zudtar pesh az zamoni muaiianshuda ba onkh'o birasad?!
205) Pas ei Paiombar, ba Man khabar bidekh', agar Mo in kofironi az k'abuli imon ruitoftaro solkh'oi daroz bo ne'matkh'oiamon bakh'ramand sozem,-
206) sipas ba onkh'o ba'di solkh'oi darozi bakh'rabari az nozu ne'mat azobe, ki baroiashon va'da doda meshud, biioiad,-
207) on ne'mate, ki dar dunio az on bakh'ramand megashtand, ba onkh'o chi manfiate mebakhshad?! Kh'amai on ne'matkh'o zavol iofta, baroiashon kh'ech' manfiate namerasonad.
208) Va Mo kh'ech' ummatero kh'alok nasokhtaem, magar in ki baroiashon bo firistodani paiombaron va nozil kardani Kitobkh'o kh'ech' uzre bok'i naguzoshtem.
209) Paiombaron onkh'oro ba khotiri pand dodanashon az uk'ubati Mo metarsonidand va Mo kh'argiz bo azob namudanashon zolim nabudem.
210) Va in K'ur'onro bar Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) shaitonkh'o nozil nakardaand.
211) Va sazovor nest, ki Shaitonkh'o onro bar k'albi Paiombar nozil kunand va onkh'o in korro karda kh'am nametavonand.

212) Baroi on shaitonkh'o az ukh'dai in kor namebaroiand, ki onkh'o az makoni shunidani K'ur'on dar osmon barkanorshuda kh'astand. Modom ki chunin ast, pas chi guna ba onch'o merasand va onro furud meorand?!
213) Pas kh'amrokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digarero ibodat makun, zero agar ba Allokh'i Iagona shirk biiori, az ch'umlai azobshudagon megardi.
214) Va ei Paiombar, az k'avmat nakhust nafaroni nazdiktarin, pas nazdiktar, ba'dan nazdikro bim bidekh', zero agar dar shirk bimonand, giriftori azobi ilokh'i megardand.
215) Va guftoru kirdoratro baroi mu'minone, ki az tu pairavi mekunand, bo mekh'ru dilsuzi ba onkh'o narm gardon va furutani namo.
216) Pas agar az farmonat dar borai iaktoparasti va itoati Khudo nofarmoni kunand, on vak't ba onkh'o bigu: "Beshak, man az on shirku ma'siiate, ki anch'om medikh'ed, bezoram."
217) Va dar korkh'oiat ba Khudoi G'olibe takia kun, ki az dushmanonash intik'om girifta, ba dushmanoni tavbakorash Mekh'rubon ast.
218) On Khudoe, ki chun ba namoz barkhezi, turo mebinad.
219) Va dar baini namozguzoron az iak kh'olat ba kh'olate gashtanatro niz mebinad. Korkh'oe, ki tu va digaron mekuned, az U makhfi nest.
220) Iak'inan U Shunavoi Donost. K'ur'on va zikrero, ki dar namoz mekhoni, meshunavad va az mak'sadat ogokh'i dorad.

Chun mushrikon da'vo kardand, ki K'ur'onro ba Paiombari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) shaitonkh'o furud meorand va Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) shoir ast, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati zerin ba onkh'o ch'avob doda guft:
221) Oio shumoro khabar dikh'am shaitonkh'oe, ki bo da'voi shumo in K'ur'onro nozil kardaand, bar ki furud meoiand?
222) Shaitonkh'o bar kh'ar durug'gui bisior badkor ba misli folbinkh'o furud meoiand.
223) Shaitonkh'o az olami malakut ma'lumotro duzdida, ba dustoni folbini khesh meafkanand va beshtari folbinkh'o durug'guiand. Agar iak kalima rost biguiand, sad kalimai digar durug' meguiand.
224) Va az shoiron, ki da'vo dored, Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az zumrai onkh'ost, gumrokh'on pairavi menamoiand. Gumrokh'on she'ri ech'odkardai onkh'oro rivoiat mekunand.

225) Ei Paiombar, magar iake az alomatkh'oi gumrokh'ii shoironro namebini, ki onkh'o dar kh'ar rokh'e sargardon va bekh'adaf megardand. Dar ash'orashon gokh'o madkh'u gokh'o mazammat va ba'zan kori digar mekunand.
226) Va onkh'o durug' meguiand. Meguiand, on korro kardem, dar kh'ole ki onro nakardaand. Va ba guftai khud amal namekunand.

227) Magar on shoirone ba monandi Kh'asson ibni Sobit, ki imon ovardaand va amali nek kardaand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bisior zikr kardaand ba'di az sui dushmanon mavridi zulm k'aror giriftanashon az onkh'o intik'omi khudro sitonidaand. Va ba zudi kasone, ki bo shirk ovardan ba Khudo va sitam dar kh'ak'k'i mardum zulm kardaand, khokh'and donist, ki ba kuch'o bozmegardand. Onkh'o ba ch'oi bag'oiat kh'avlnok va bozpursii dak'ik' bozmegardand.

1) "To. Sin." In oiatkh'oi bar tu Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilgashta oiatkh'oi K'ur'on va Kitobi ravshanest, ki dar on shubkh'aiu nofakh'mi nest. Kh'ar ki dar borai K'ur'on biandeshad, medonad, ki on az sui Khudo omada ast.
2) In oiatkh'o rakh'namoi sui kh'ak'ik'at va muzhdarasoni mu'minon ast-
3) on mu'minone, ki namozro bo surati komil barpo medorand va zakoti molashonro dar ch'okh'oi muk'arrarsokhtai Khudo medikh'and va onkh'o ba podoshu uk'ubati okhirat iak'in dorand.

4) Ba durusti, kofirone, ki ba okhirat va podoshu uk'ubati on imon nameorand, Mo a'moli zishti onkh'oro baroiashon oroish va nek nishon dodaem. Eshon korkh'oi zishti kheshtanro idoma medikh'and. Pas onkh'o dar kh'olati sargardoni k'aror girifta, ba sui kh'ak' rokh' nameioband.

5) In ch'amoai vasfshuda kasoneand, ki onkh'oro dar dunio ba vositai kushtashavi va asir aftodan azobi bad buda va onkh'o dar okhirat vok'ean ziionkortarin mardumand. Zero dar k'iiomat bo ch'ovid mondan dar duzakh bar ch'oni khud va khonadonashon ziion meorand.
6) Va begumon K'ur'on ba tu Paiombar az nazdi Parvardigore doda meshavad, ki dar ofarinish, chorasozi va akh'komash Kh'akimi Dono ast. Manfiati bandagon az U pushida nest.

7) Ei Paiombar, zamonero ba iod biior, ki Muso ba khonadonash guft: "Kh'amono man otashero didam. Ba zudi baroiaton az nazdi on otash az furuzonandai on khabare meoram, ki moro rakh'namoi mekunad, io az on baroiaton shu'lai otashe meoram, to khudro ba in vosita az sardi garm sozed."

8) Pas chun Muso ba makoni otash rasid, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro nido kard: "Muk'addas ast Khudoe, ki nishonai k'udratash dar otash namoion ast va muborakand farishtagone, ki dar atrofi on k'aror dorand. Va Parvardigori olamiion az sifatkh'oi noloik'e, ki gumrokh'on Uro bo on tavsif mekunand, Boazamat va Pok ast."
9) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khitob ba Muso guft: "Ei Muso, kh'amono Man Allokh'i kh'amesha G'olibi dar ofarinish, andozagiri va shu Kh'akim kh'astam.

10) Va asoi kheshro biafkan." Muso farmoni Khudoro ich'ro karda asoiashro afkand. Pas chun Muso asoro did, ki kh'arakat mekunad, misli on ki mori chobuk ast, az nazdash pusht tofta, firor kard va ba ak'ib barnagasht. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Muso guft: "Az in asoi ba mor ivazshuda natars. Zero ba darusti ki paiombaron dar nazdi Man az kh'ech' chiz nametarsand.
11) Lekin kh'ar ki bo sodir namudani ma'siiat bar ch'oni khesh sitam kunad, sipas tavba namoiad, pas kh'amono Man nisbat ba vai bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubonam.

12) Va dastatro ba girebonat dokhil kun, on biduni on ki ba bemorii makhav mubtalo gashta boshad, dar kh'ole berun meshavad, ki misli barf safed ast. In az ch'umlai nukh' mu'ch'izai aso, dasti tobon, malakh, shapush, k'urbok'k'a, khun, tufon, k'akh'ti va kamshavii kh'osilot buda, rostk'avlii turo nishon medikh'ad, tu bo mach'mui in mu'ch'izakh'o ba sui Fir'avn va k'avmash firistoda shudai. Kh'amono onkh'o az sababi kofirshavi k'avmi az itoati Khudo khorich' budand."
13) Pas chun in mu'ch'izakh'oe, ki bo on Musoro ta'iid namudem, dar surati ravshan baroiashon omad, guftand: "In mu'ch'izakh'oi ba Muso omada ch'odui oshkor ast."

14) Va Fir'avnu k'avmash az rui zulm va kibr varzidan az k'abuli kh'ak'ik'at ba in mu'ch'izakh'oi ravshan kofir shudand va ik'ror nakardand, kh'ol on ki k'albashon dar borai on ki in mu'ch'izakh'o az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ast, iak'in dosht. Pas ei Paiombar, andesha kun, ki ok'ibati shakhsoni dar zamin bo kufru gunokh' fasodkor ba chi anch'omid. Beshubkh'a, Mo onkh'oro kh'alok va makh'v gardonidem.

15) Va Mo ba durusti ki ba Dovud va pisarash Sulaimon donish, az on ch'umla donishi zaboni parrandagonro dodem. Va Dovudu Sulaimon shukri ilokh'iro ba ch'o ovarda guftand: "Sipos Khudovandero, ki bo nubuvvatu ilm moro bar beshtari bandagoni mu'minash bartari bakhshid."

16) Va Sulaimon az padarash Dovud nubuvvat, ilm va saltanatro ba meros burd va u ekh'soni Khudoro dar kh'ak'k'i kheshtan va padarash iodovari namuda guft: "Ei mardum, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi mo k'udrati fakh'midani sukhani parrandagonro omukhta ast va baroiamon az kh'ar chize, ki ba paiombaronu podshokh'on doda ast, ato namuda ast. Ba durusti ki in lutfu ekh'sonkh'oi Parvardigor fazli oshkor ast."
17) Va baroi Sulaimon sipokh'iionash az ch'in va odami va parranda az kh'ar gusha ch'am' ovarda shud. Pas onkh'o bo tartib ronda meshudand.

18) Artishi Sulaimon paivasta bo nizom ronda meshudand, to on ki chun ba vodii muron (makone dar Shom) rasidand, iak murchae guft: "Ei ch'amoai murchagon, ba manzilkh'oi khesh daroed, to Sulaimon va lashkariionash nadonista shumoro kh'alok nasozand. Zero agar onkh'o az shumo Ogokh' boshand, kh'argiz poimolaton namekunand."

19) Pas chun Sulaimon sukhani on murcharo shunid, az gapi guftaash khandai bo tabassum namud va ba Parvardigorash muroch'iat karda guft: "Parvardigoro, ba man tavfik'u ilkh'om dekh', to shukri ne'matero, ki ba man va padaru modaram in'om kardai, ba ch'o oram va amali shoistai mavridi pisandi Turo anch'om dikh'am va maro bo rakh'mati Khesh dar zumrai bandagoni solekh'at dokhil namo."

20) Va Sulaimon ch'uioi akh'voli parrandagon shuda, onkh'oro az nazar guzaronid va kh'udkh'udro dar miionashon nadid. Pas, guft: "Charo man kh'udkh'udro namebinam? Oio az didanash chize mone' shuda ast io vai az ch'umlai g'oibshudagon ast?"

21) Pas chun g'oib budani kh'udkh'ud ma'lumash gardid, guft: "Savgand mekhuram, ki uro much'ozoti sakht mekunam io sarashro baroi uk'ubati g'oib gashtanash meburam io baroiam dar borai nabudanash daleli ravshani baiongari uzrashro meorad."

22) Pas kh'udkh'ud dar g'oibiash duru daroz naistod. Pas chun omad, ba Sulaimon guft: "Man dar borai chize ogokh'i ioftam, ki tu az on ogokh' nesti va az nazdi sokinoni shakh'ri Saba' baroiat khabari rosti az shubkh'a kholi ovardaam.

23) Beshak, man onch'o zanero paido kardam, ki bar mardumi on sarzamin kh'ukmroni mekard va ba in zan kh'ar chiz az abzori neru va saltanat doda shuda ast va u sokh'ibi takhti buzurge buda, az rui on korkh'oi raiiatashro idora mekunad.

24) On zan va k'avmashro dar kh'olate ioftam, ki ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba oftob sach'da mekunand va Shaiton dar nazarashon amalkh'oi shirku gunokh'ashonro oroish doda, pas onkh'oro az rokh'i kh'ak' bargardonida ast. Binobar in, ba sui kh'ak' rokh' nameioband.

25) Shaiton korkh'oi shirku gunokh'ro dar nazarashon zinat dod, to onkh'o ba Allokh'i Iagona sach'da nakunand, On Zote, ki boroni dar osmonkh'o va rastanii dar zamin pinkh'onro berun mesozad va on chiro az korkh'oi khesh pinkh'on va on chiro oshkor mekuned, medonad.
26) U Allokh'est, ki ch'uz U ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ie nest, Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast."
27) Sulaimon ba kh'udkh'ud guft: "Khokh'em did, ki oio tu dar da'voi khesh rost guftai io az ch'umlai durug'guion kh'asti."

28) Pas Sulaimon nomae navisht va onro ba kh'udkh'ud doda guft: "In nomai maro bibar va onro nazdi akh'li Saba' biandoz va ba onkh'o bisupor va az nazdashon ba iak tarafe, ki turo nabinand, kanor birav, pas ba on chi dar borai noma meguiand, gush faro bidekh'."
29) Malikai Saba' nomaro girifta guft: "Ei ashrofon, kh'amono ba sui man nomai arzishmand andokhta shuda ast.
30) Mazmuni in nomai az sui Sulaimon firistodashudai bo "Bismillokh'i-r-rakh'moni-r-rakh'im" og'ozshuda chunin ast, ki:
31) "Kibr navarzed va dar kh'ole nazdam oed, ki ba iaktoparasti va tarki shirk, ki shumoro ba sui on da'vat mekunam, taslimshuda va farmonbardor boshed. Zero shumo oftobro meparasted.""

32) Malika guft: "Ei sarvaronu amaldoron, dar in bobat rokh'i durustro baroiam baion kuned. Man to vak'te ki shumo nazdam kh'ozir nashaved va nazari kheshtanro matrakh' nakuned, dar kh'ech' kore kh'ukm namekunam va tasmim namegiram."

33) Amaldoroni k'avmash guftand: "Mo doroi nerui buzurg va sokh'iboni korzori shadidem va dar in bobat nazari asosi- nazari tust. Pas bubin, ki moro ba chi amr mekuni. Chunki ba kh'ar kore, ki dastur medikh'i, mo k'udrati amali gardonidani onro dorem."

34) Malika guft: "Kh'amono podshokh'on vak'te ba dekh'ae daroiand, onro bo kushtoru odamrabori va g'oratgari tabokh' megardonand va sarvaronu ashrofonashro ba'di sokh'ibizzatu arch'mand budanashon khor mesozand. Va podshokh'on zamone alaikh'i sokinoni dekh'ae g'olib shavand, kh'amin guna raftor mekunand, to tukhmi kh'aibat va tarsro dar k'albi mardum bikorand.
35) Va ba durusti ki man ba sokh'ibi noma va k'avmash armug'on mefiristam va mebinam, ki firistodagonam ba'di rasonidani on armug'on az nazdash chi khabar meorand."

36) Pas vak'te firistodai on malika kh'amrokh'i iovaronash bo tukh'fai shokh'ona nazdi Sulaimon omadand, Sulaimon tukh'fa ovardani onkh'oro rad karda guft: "Oio mekhokh'ed bo molkh'oiaton ba man kumak rasoned, to dik'k'atamro az mas'alakh'oi mutaallik' ba shumo ba digar taraf bargardoned. Pas nubuvvat, saltanat va doroie, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro baroiam doda ast, az on chi ba shumo ato karda ast, bekh'tar ast. Balki in shumoed, ki bo on chi az matoi dunio baroiaton tukh'fa meshavad, shodmon megarded."

37) Sulaimon ba firistodai Malika guft: "Bo tukh'fai ovardaat nazdi Malika va k'avmash bargard. Pas savgand, ki agar Malikavu k'avmash ikhtiioran nazdamon naoiand, mo bo lashkare nazdashon meoem, ki tavoni muk'obiliiatashro nadorand va onkh'oro az shakh'ri Saba' ba'di on ki onch'o sokh'ibizzatu arch'mand budand, zalilona va takh'k'irshuda berun mesozem."
38) Sulaimon khitob ba sarkardagoni k'avmash guft: "Ei buzurgon, ki az shumo takhti Malikai Saba'ro pesh az on ki bo atrofiionash nazdam taslimshuda oiand, baroiam meorad?"

39) Iake az ch'inkh'oi k'avipaikari nerumand posukh doda guft: "Man takhti Malikai Saba'ro pesh az on ki az in ch'oiat barkhezi, nazdat meoram. Va beshak, man baroi bardoshtani on takht nerumand buda, vobasta ba ch'avokh'ir va digar ashioi arzishmandash amonatdoram. Az in ch'ikh'at az on chizero kam namesozam."

40) Mardi neki donishmandi dar mach'lisi Sulaimon kh'ozir buda, ki doroi ilmi Kitob va az donandagoni ismi a'zam bud, on isme, ki agar ba vasilai on az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chize darkhost shavad, on duoro k'abul mekunad, guft: "Man takhti uro k'abl az iak mizha zadanat nazdat meoram. Ba in ma'no, ki Khudoro duo mekunam, onro dar kh'ol kh'ozir mesozad." Khudo duoi on mardro paziruft. Pas vak'te Sulaimon takhti Malikaro nazdi khud kh'ozir did, guft: "In az fazli Parvardigori man ast, to maro biozmoiad, ki oio shukri ne'matkh'oi Uro ba ch'o meoram, io nosiposi mekunam? Va kh'ar ki shukri Khudoro ba ch'o orad, pas foidaash ba khudash barmegardad. Zero Parvardigor Tavongar ast. Shukri shumo kh'ech' chizi Uro nameafzoiad. Va kh'ar ki ne'matkh'oi Khudoro nosiposi karda, shukrashro ba ch'o naorad, pas ba durusti, Parvardigoram az shukrguzoriash Beniiozu Karim ast." Az ch'umlai karamash on ast, ki az bandagoni nosipos ekh'sonashro k'at' namesozad.

41) Sulaimon guft: "Takhti shokh'ii Malikaro az shakli doshtai on tag'iir dikh'ed, to bubinem oio pai burda, takhtashro meshinosad, io az ch'umlai on kasone megardad, ki ba shinokhtani ashioi khud pai namebarand."

42) Pas vak'te Malikai Saba' nazdi Sulaimon omad, ba vai kh'amchun sanch'ishash gufta shud: "Oio takhti tu kh'amin guna ast?" Vai dar posukh mutobik' ba pursish guft: "Guio in takht kh'amon takhti man ast." Pas Sulaimon guft: "Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pesh az in Malikai Saba' ba mo ilm dod va mo k'abl az vai tobe' va tobei amri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) budem."

43) Va on chi in Malika az rui pairavii k'avmash va tak'lidkori g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastid, uro az iaktoparasti bargardonida bud. Kh'amono Malika az ch'umlai k'avmi kofir bud. U niz kofir bud.

44) Ba Malika gufta shud: "Ba k'asr dokhil shav." On k'asr ba shakli boloi ob monandi dosht. Pas chun Malika on k'asrro did, onro kh'avzi ob pindosht. Pas du sok'i poikh'oiashro barakh'na kard, to dokhili on gardad. Sulaimon guft: "Ba durusti ki in k'asri kh'amvoru az shishakh'o sokhta shuda ast." Sulaimon uro ba Islom da'vat kard. Da'vati Sulaimonro pazirufta guft: "Parvardigoro, beshak, man bo parastidani digar ma'budkh'oi botil dar kh'ak'k'i khesh zulm kardaam va bo Sulaimon ba Allokh'i Ofaridgori kulli mavch'udot mute' va taslim shudam."

45) Va kh'amono Mo ba sui Samud barodari nasabii onkh'o Solekh'ro firistodem, ki tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro biparasted. Pas onkh'o nogakh'on dar barobari da'vati Solekh' ba du gurukh'i mu'minonu kofiron ch'udo shuda, dar borai on ki kadomashon kh'ak'k'and, bo kh'am kashmakash mekardand.

46) Solekh' ba onkh'o guft: "Charo k'abl az darkhosti rakh'mat zudtar omadani azobro talab mekuned?! Charo az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omurzidani gunokh'onatonro namekhokh'ed, to mavridi rakh'matash k'aror gired?!"

47) K'avmash az k'abuli kh'ak' sarkashi karda, dar ch'avob guftand: "Mo az tu va az mu'minoni kh'amrokh'at foli bad giriftaem." Solekh' ba onkh'o guft: "Ilmi nokhushikh'oi bar saraton omada, ki bo on az mo foli bad megired va diltang megarded, nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Chize az U pushida nest. Balki shumo bo rasidani neki va badi ozmuda meshaved."
48) Va dar shakh'ri Solekh' bo nomi "Kh'ich'r" nukh' marde budand, ki dar zamin bo kufru gunokh' ba fasodkori mashg'ul buda va dar on bo imonu amali shoista islokh'kori namekardand.

49) Ba'zei onkh'o ba ba'zei digarashon guftand: "Boiad kh'ar kadomi shumo ba nomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savgand bikhured, ki kh'atman shab ba khonai Solekh' va pairavonash rafta, onkh'oro ba k'atl merasonem, sipas ba sokh'ibi khunash meguem: "Mo dar k'atli Solekh' va pairavonash kh'ozir nabudem va kh'amono mo dar on chi guftem, rostguem."

50) Va onkh'o baroi kushtani Solekh' va pairavonash dasisai makhfero tarkh'rezi kardand va Mo baroi nusrat va nach'ot dodani vai az dasti kofironi k'avmash tadbiri k'avi sokhtem va onkh'o inro namedonistand.

51) Pas ei Paiombar, andesha namo, ki ok'ibati makri onkh'o bo chi anch'omid. Ok'ibati makrashon ba on anch'omid, ki Mo onkh'oro bo uk'ubati Khesh az bekh barkandem va az avval to okhir kh'alokashon gardonidem.

52) Pas in khonakh'oi onkh'ost. Devorkh'oi maskankh'oiashon bo sak'fkh'oi on ba sababi zulmashon furu rekhta, az sokin kholi monda ast. Kh'amono dar in azobi ba sababi zulm ba onkh'o rasida baroi k'avme, ki tavoni Moro medonand, pand ast.
53) Va mu'minoni k'avmi Solekh'ro az azob rakh'o namudem va onkh'o bo ich'roi dasturot va khuddori az mamnuot parkh'ezkori mekardand.

54) Va ei Paiombar, k'issai Lutro iod kun. Zamone ki vai k'avmashro sarzanish va korashonro rad karda, ba onkh'o guft: "Oio khislati zishti bachaboziro dar makh'filkh'oi kheshtan ba surati oshkor, dar kh'ole ki iakdigarro mebined, anch'om medikh'ed?!

55) Oio shumo bo mak'sadi shakh'vatroni ba ch'oi zanon bo mardon omezishi ch'insi mekuned?! Mak'sadi shumo az in amali zisht tankh'o misli chakh'orpoion k'azoi shakh'vat ast. Shumo pokdomani va farzand namekhokh'ed. Tankh'o mekhokh'ed shakh'vati kh'aivoniatonro k'one' sozed. Balki shumo mardume kh'asted, ki farz budani imonu pokivu tarki ma'siiat va farch'omi koratonro namedoned.

56) Pas posukhi k'avmi Lut ch'uz in nabud, ki guftand: "Khonadoni Lutro az dekh'aaton berun sozed. Kh'amono onkh'o mardume kh'astand, ki az palidi poki mech'uiand." In sukhanro bo tamaskhur ba khonadoni Lut guftand. Zero khonadonash bo in k'avmi bachaboz dar kori fakh'sh shirkat namekardand, balki bar'aks kori zishtashonro inkor menamudand.
57) Pas Lut va khonadonashro ba istisnoi kh'amsarash solim nigokh' doshtem. Bar kh'amsarash kh'ukm namudem, ki az zumrai shakhsoni dar azob bok'imonda boshad, to monandi onkh'o kh'alok gardad.

58) Va az osmon monandi rezishi boron bar sari onkh'o sang rekhtem. Pas on boroni kasone, ki az azobi ilokh'i bim doda shudand, vale parvo nakarda, imon naovardand, boroni nikh'oiat badi kh'aloksozanda bud.

59) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Sipos Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro baroi ne'matkh'oiash va amoni ilokh'i bar bandagoni barguzidaash (askh'obi Paiombar) az azobe, ki bo on k'avmi Lut va Solekh'ro nobud kard." Magar Allokh'i Ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ii podshokh'i kh'ama mavch'udot bekh'tar ast, io on ma'budkh'oe, ki mushrikon meparastand va moliki zararu foida nestand?!

60) Io chi kase osmonkh'o va zaminro biduni namunai k'abli ofarid va baroi shumo mardum az osmon obi boronro furud ovard, pas Mo bo on ob baroi shumo bog'kh'oi zebo ruionidem?! Shumo az ukh'dai ruionidani on bog'kh'o namebaromaded, zero k'udrati chunin amalero nadored. Tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro meruionad. Oio kh'amrokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digare in korro karda ast?! Kh'argiz nakarda ast, balki onkh'o mardume kh'astand, ki az kh'ak' barmegardand va bo zulm Kholik'ro bo makhluk' iakson mekh'isoband.

61) Io chi kase zaminro oromi ustuvore gardonid, ki sokinonashro ba iztirob nameorad va dar dokhili on dariokh'oi ch'oriro padid ovard va baroi zamin kukh'kh'oi ustuvorro ofarid va baini bakh'ri shirinu shur fosila k'aror dod, ki az omekhtagii obi shur bo shirin va fosidsoziiu g'airi k'obili iste'mol gashtani on peshgiri mekunad?! Oio kh'amrokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digare in korro karda ast?! Kh'argiz nakarda ast, balki beshtarashon iagonagiashro namedonand. Zero agar medonistand, kh'argiz ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk nameovardand.

62) Io vak'te bandai bechorai dar sakhti aftoda Uro duo kunad, chi kase duoiashro mepazirad va bemoriiu tangdasti va g'airaro az inson bartaraf mesozad va shumoro dar zamin ch'onishin megardonad, nasl ba nasl ba'zeaton ch'onishini ba'zei digar meshaved?! Oio kh'amrokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digare in korro karda ast?! Kh'argiz nakarda ast, valekin shumo kam pand megired.

63) Io chi kase shumoro bo nasb kardani nishonakh'ovu sitoragon dar torikikh'oi khushki va dario rakh'namoi menamoiad?! Va chi kase shamolkh'oi bashoratrasoni nazdikshavii boridani boronro, ki ch'uz'e az rakh'mati ilokh'i bar bandagon ast, mefiristad?! Oio kh'amrokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digare in korro mekunad?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on makhluk'ote, ki mushrikon ba U sharik mesozand, poku muk'addas ast.

64) Io chi kase ofarinishro dar bachadoni zan markh'ila ba markh'ila og'oz mekunad, sipas uro ba'di mironidan dubora zinda megardonad?! Va chi kase az osmon bo rekhtani boron va az zamin bo ruionidani giiokh' ba shumo ruzi medikh'ad?! Oio kh'amrokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digare in korro mekunad?! Ei Paiombar, ba in ch'amoai mushrikon bigu: "Agar shumo dar da'voi kh'ak' budanaton sodik'ed, pas baroi isboti durustii amali shirki khesh kh'uch'ch'at biiored."

65) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Farishtagon dar osmonkh'ovu mardum dar zamin g'aibro namedonand, lekin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro medonad. Va onkh'o ch'uz Parvardigor namedonand, ki kai baroi bozpursi zinda karda meshavand."

66) Io donishashon oidi k'iiomat takomul iofta, pas dar mavridi on iak'in kh'osil namudaand?! Ne, balki onkh'o dar borai okhirat dar shak va kh'airatand, balki beshubkh'a, rushnoii k'albashon az didani on kur shuda ast.
67) Va kofiron inkorkunon meguiand: "Oio chun bimirem va khok gardem, oio az nav zinda gardonida shudanamon imkon dorad?

68) Kh'amono ba mo va k'ablan ba padaronamon va'da doda shuda bud, ki kh'amaamon az nav zinda gardonida meshavem, vale to imruz kh'ak'ik'ati inro nadidaem. In va'da ch'uz afsonakh'oi guzashtagon, ki onro dar kitobkh'oiashon ch'am'ovari kardaand, chize nest."

69) Ei Paiombar, ba in munkironi rastokhez bigu: "Ba kh'ar ch'oe az zamin khokh'ed, sairu gasht biraved. Pas andesha kuned, ki farch'omi kori takzibgaroni rastokhez bo chi anch'omid." Begumon Mo onkh'oro baroi durug' shumurdani zindashavii ba'di marg kh'alok kardem.
70) Va ba sababi on ki mushrikon az da'vati tu rui gardonidaand, g'amgin mashav va sinaat az on chi dasisa mekunand, tang nagardad. Zero kh'atman Parvardigor turo alaikh'i onkh'o piruz mesozad.
71) Va kofironi munkiri rastokhez az k'avmat meguiand: "Agar shumo dar da'voi khud sodik' boshed, on azobe, ki tu va mu'minon onro ba mo va'da medikh'ed, kai takh'ak'k'uk' meiobad?"
72) Ei Firistodai Mo, ba onkh'o bigu: "Shoiad ba'zei on azobe, ki zudtar omadanashro talab mekuned, ba shumo nazdik shuda boshad."

73) Va ei Paiombar, ba durusti, Parvardigorat dar kh'ak'k'i mardum sokh'ibi fazli buzurg ast. Az kh'amin sabab, bo vuch'udi kufru ma'siiat darkh'ol onkh'oro giriftori azob namegardonad. Vale beshtari mardum Khudoro baroi on chi ba onkh'o in'om mekunad, siposguzori namekunand.
74) Va albatta, Parvardigorat on chiro k'albi bandagonash pinkh'on va on chiro oshkor mesozad, medonad. Kh'ech' chize az U pushida nest va dar oiandai nazdik onkh'oro ba sazoi a'molashon merasonad.
75) Va kh'ech' chizi az mardum dar osmon va zamin pinkh'onmondae nest, magar in ki on dar Kitobi ravshani Lavkh'i makh'fuz sabtshuda ast.

76) Ba durusti ki in K'ur'oni bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilshuda baroi Bani Isroil aksari on chiro, ki dar boraash ikhtilof mekunand, baion mesozad va kach'raftorikh'oi onkh'oro kashf menamoiad.
77) Va ba durusti ki K'ur'on baroi mu'minoni bo on amalkunanda kh'idoiat va rakh'mat ast.

78) Ei Paiombar, beshubkh'a, Parvardigorat ruzi k'iiomat bo kh'ukmi odilonaash baini mu'minonu kofiron k'azovat mekunad. Ba mu'minon rakh'm va kofironro azob mekunad. Va U G'olibi Donost. Az dushmanoni Khud intik'om girifta, kh'ak'k'u nokh'ak' nazdash omekhta nameshavad.
79) Pas ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavakkul kun va dar tamomi korkh'oiat ba U takia namo. Ba durusti ki tu bar dini durusti oshkor k'aror dori.

80) Ei Paiombar, kh'amono tu ba kasone, ki k'albashon ba sababi kufr murda ast, da'vatatro shunavonida nametavoni va niz onro ba ashkhose, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro az shunidani kh'ak' noshunavo sokhta ast, vak'te ki az nazdat ruitofta pusht gardonand, shunavonida nametavoni.

81) Va tu kasonero, ki rushnoii k'albashon az didani kh'ak'ik'at kur shuda ast, az zalolatashon kh'idoiat karda nametavoni. Pas, baroi onkh'o g'amgin mashav va khudro ranch' madekh'. Tu da'vati kheshro ch'uz ba kase, ki ba oiatkh'oiamon imon meorad, fakh'monida nametavoni. Zero makh'z mu'minon farmonbari farmonkh'oi Parvardigorand.

82) Va chun ba sababi isror varzidanashon bar kufru gunokh' vuk'ui azob k'at'i shavad va dar zamin badtarin mardum bok'i monand, zamoni nazdikshavii k'iiomat iake az buzurgtarin nishonakh'oi on, ch'onvarero az zamin berun meovarem, on ch'onvar kh'amrokh'i onkh'o bo zaboni baroiashon fakh'mo gap mezanad, ki mardum oiatkh'oi bar Paiombari Mo nozilshudaro tasdik' namekardand.

83) Va ei Paiombar, ruzero iod kun, ki Mo az kh'ar iak ummat ch'amoaero az kasone, ki oiatkh'oi Moro durug' meshumurdand, ch'am' meorem, pas onkh'o az avval to okhir ch'am'ovari shuda, ba ch'oi bozpursi ronda meshavand.

84) Rondani onkh'o idoma meiobad, to on ki chun ba ch'oi kh'isobotdikh'i merasand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o bo sarzanish meguiad: "Oio shumo oiatkh'oi dalolatkunandai iagonagi va darbargirandai shariatamro durug' shumurded, kh'ol on ki dar borai on oiatkh'o ikh'otai ilmi nadoshted, to botil budanashro isbot sozed va ilman takzib kuned? Io shumo bo on oiatkh'oi Mo chi kor mekarded, tasdik' menamuded io takzib?!"

85) Va az sababi on ki bo kufr varzidanashon va durug' shumurdani oiatkh'oi ilokh'i zulm kardaand, azob bar onkh'o vok'e' megardad. Pas onkh'o baroi kh'imoiat az kheshtan sukhan namekunand, chunki az pushtiboni och'iz buda, kh'uch'ch'atkh'oiashon botil ast.

Chun kofiron zindashavii ba'di margro inkor kardand, Khudovand dar oiati minba'da kh'olati khob va az on barkhostanro, ki avval ba marg va soni ba zindashavi shabokh'at dorad, khotirrason namuda guft:
86) Oio in munkironi rastokhez bo taammul nigokh' namekunand, ki Mo shabro ofaridem, to dar on bo khob orom girand va ruzro ravshan ofaridem, to dar on niiozkh'oi khudro dida, az paii kasbi ruzi shavand. Albatta, dar in khobkh'oi pai dar pai va az khob barkhostan baroi k'avme, ki imon meorand, alomatkh'oi ravshan ast.

87) Va ei Paiombar, ruzero ba iod biior, ki farishtai muvazzafshuda bori duium dar sur medamad. Pas kh'ar ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, ba vakh'shat aftida, kh'arosnok megardad, magar kase, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az fazlash uro az in kh'olat istisno namuda ast. Va dar on ruz tamomi makhluk'ot itoatkunon va khoru zor nazdi Parvardigor meoiand.

88) Va dar on ruz kukh'kh'oro dida, gumon mebari, ki dar makonashon ustuvori bekh'arakatand, kh'ol on ki onkh'o dar vok'e' ba monandi sur'ati kh'arakati abrkh'o kh'arakat mekunand. San'ati Parvardigorest, ki kh'amai chizro mustakh'kam mesozad. Ba durusti, U az on chi mekuned, Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' amali shumo az U pushida namemonad va dar oiandai nazdik baroi on podoshaton medikh'ad.
89) Kh'ar ki dar ruzi k'iiomat imon va amali shoista biovarad, pas uro ch'annat ast va onkh'o bo dariofti osudagi az ch'onibi Parvardigor az vakh'shati on ruz dar amnu osoishand.

90) Va kh'ar ki ruzi okhirat kufr va ma'siiat biovarad, uro duzakh ast. Pas onkh'o dar duzakh bar chekh'raashon afkanda meshavand va ba eshon bo sarzanish va ikh'onat gufta meshavad: "Oio ba shumo ch'azoe ch'uz ch'azoi kufru ma'siiate, ki dar dunio anch'om medoded, doda meshavad?"

91) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Man ma'mur gardidaam, to Parvardigori Makkaro, ki onro doroi kh'urmat sokhta ast, ibodat kunam. Dar in sarzamin naboiad khunrezi va zulm surat girad va kushtani saidu buridani darakhtonash ch'oiz nest. Va molikiiati tamomi chiz az Ust. Va ma'mur shudaam, ki bo anch'omi ibodat az ch'umlai bandagoni ba Parvardigor mute' va taslimshuda bosham.

92) Va ma'mur shudaam, ki K'ur'onro bar mardum bikhonam." Pas kh'ar ki bo rakh'namoii K'ur'on kh'idoiat shuda, tibk'i on amal kunad, foidai kh'idoiatash ba khudash barmegardad va kh'ar ki gumrokh' shuda, az rakh'namoikh'oiash munkh'arif gardida, onro inkor namuda, amal nakunad, pas bigu: "Man az zumrai bimdikh'andagonam. Shumoro az uk'ubati ilokh'i bim medikh'am, ammo kh'idoiataton dar dasti man nest."

93) Va ei Paiombar, bigu: "Sipos Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro baroi ne'matkh'oi bekh'isobash. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nishonakh'oi k'udrati Kheshro dar vuch'udi shumo, osmonkh'ovu zamin va ruzi baroiaton nishon medikh'ad, pas on alomatkh'oro on chunon khokh'ed shinokht, ki shumoro baroi ba kh'ak'ik'at taslim shudan rakh'namoi mekunad." Va Parvardigori tu az on chi mekuned, g'ofil nest, balki az tamomi amalkh'oiaton ogokh' ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nameboshad va dar oiandai nazdik baroi a'molaton ba shumo podosh medikh'ad.
1) "To. Sin. Mim." Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) In oiatkh'oi K'ur'oni ravshangari kh'ak' az botil ast.
3) Mo bar tu ba rosti va aini kh'ak'ik'at ba'ze az khabari Muso va Fir'avnro ba khotiri k'avme, ki imon meorand, k'iroat mekunem. Zero makh'z akh'li imon az in akhbor foida megirand.

4) Kh'amono Fir'avn dar sarzamini Misr az kh'addash tach'ovuz karda, khudro buzurg shumurd va mardumi Misrro ba gurukh'kh'oi parokandai mukhtalifi bo kh'am mukholif tabdil dod. Toifae az onkh'oro, ki az Bani Isroil iborat budand, ba vositai kushtani pisaronashon va baroi khidmatgori va ikh'onat bok'i guzoshtani dukhtaronashon notavon mesokht. Beshak, Fir'avn dar zamin bo sitamkoriiu sarkashi va kibr az zumrai fasodkoron bud.

5) Va Mo iroda namuda budem, ki nisbat ba Bani Isroil, ki az sui Fir'avn notavon gardonida shuda budand, bo kh'aloksozii dushmanashon va berun ovardani onkh'o az kh'addi notavoni ekh'son namoem va onkh'oro peshvoioni rokh'i kh'ak' bigardonem, to digaron ba onkh'o pairavi kunand va onkh'oro ba'd az kh'alokati Fir'avn vorisi sarzamini muk'addasi Shom k'aror dikh'em.
Chunonchi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'oi digar ishora ba kh'amin ma'no meguiad: "Va ba Bani Isroil, ki Fir'avn va k'avmash onkh'oro shikanch'a doda, khor mesokhtand, k'alamravi shark'u g'arbi on sarzaminro (mak'sad sarzaminkh'oi Shomi sharif) ba meros dodem...".[A'rof: 137].

6) Va inchunin khostem bo sokh'ibi mulk gardonidani Bani Isroil ba onkh'o k'udrat bakhshem va ba Fir'avn va buzurgtarin iovarash Kh'omon va iovaronashon bo dastoni navzodi Bani Isroil zavoli saltanatashonro, ki doim az in rukhdod kh'azar mekardand, nishon dikh'em.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati mazkur farch'omi mulki Fir'avn, izzatu e'tibori Muso va Bani Isroilro ovard, dar oiati zerin nash'unamo ioftani Muso to davroni ba risolat rasidanashro zikr namuda guft:
7) Va ba Modari Muso bo in mazmun ilkh'om firistodem, ki uro shir bidekh'. Pas chun dar borai pisarat az sharri Fir'avn va k'avmash bitarsi, ki uro mekushand, pas uro dar sanduk'e guzor va on sanduk'ro dar darioi Nil andoz va nisbatash az g'ark' shudan va sharri Fir'avn kh'aroson mabosh va ba sababi firok'ash g'amgin mashav. Ba durusti, Mo Musoro nazdat zinda barmegardonem va uro az firistodagoni Khud ba sui mardum megardonem.

8) Modari Muso farmudai Moro dar borai guzoshtani pisarash dar sanduk' va afkandanash dar darioi Nil ich'ro namud. Pas khonadoni Fir'avn Musoro paido karda, uro az dario giriftand, to ok'ibat kor ba on anch'omad, ki irodai ilokh'i oidi on ki Muso dushmani Fir'avn va boisi ch'albi andukh'i k'avmi vai gardida, saltanash bo dastoni kh'amin tifli navzod sarnagun meshavad, takh'ak'k'uk' iobad. Beshubkh'a, Fir'avn va vazirash Kh'omon va iovaronashon ba sababi kufru tug'ion va fasodkori amdan khatokor budand.

9) Va vatk'e Fir'avn khost Musoro ba k'atl rasonad, kh'amsarash ba u guft: "In tifli navzod baroi man va tu sarchashmai shodmonist. Uro nakushed, shoiad vai ba mo bo khidmatrasoni foida mebakhshad io in ki uro bo rokh'i pisarkhoni ba khud farzand megirem." Va onkh'o az farch'omi kor bekhabar budand, ki takhti saltanati Fir'avn bo dastoni Muso vozhgun megardad.

10) Va k'albi Modari Muso az tamomi korkh'oi dunio ba ch'uz pisarash kholi gardid. Vai az kh'olati farzandash sabr karda nametavonist, kh'atto az shiddati alok'amandi ba u k'arib oshkor mekard, ki Muso farzandi ust, agar Mo k'albashro ustuvor namesokhtem va sabrash namebakhshidem. Mo k'albi Modari Musoro orom va ustuvor sokhtem, to dar barobari k'azoi ilokh'i az mu'minoni bosabri tavakkulkunanda boshad.

11) Va Modari Muso ba'd az on ki pisarashro dar dario afkand, ba khokh'arbuzurgi Muso guft: "Az paii Muso birav, to bidoni bo vai chi rukh medikh'ad." Pas, khokh'arbuzurgi Muso barodarashro az dur did, to kh'ak'ik'ati korash kashf nagardad va Fir'avn bo k'avmash namedonistand in dukhtar khokh'arbuzurgi Muso buda, dar ch'ustuch'ui ust.

12) Va Muso bo tadbiri sokhtai Mo az nushidani shiri zankh'oi g'air pesh az on ki uro nazdi modarash bargardonem, khuddori kard. Pas chun khokh'arbuzurgash did, ki kh'amsari Fir'avn va khodimakh'oi k'asr ba khotiri shir dodani Muso kh'aris kh'astand, ba onkh'o guft: "Oio man shumoro ba khonadone rakh'namoi kunam, ki sarparastii shir dodan va nigokh'ubini in kudakro bar ukh'da megirand va onkh'o dar kh'ak'k'i in navzod khairkhokh'and?!"

13) Pas Musoro ba nazdi Modarash bargardonidem, to chashmash bo az nazdik didani pisarash orom girad va az firok'ash g'amgin nashavad va bidonad, ki va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki Musoro nazdash megardonad, kh'ak' va rost bud, valekin aksari onkh'o in va'daro namedonistand va kase az on ki in zan Modari Musoi navzod ast, ogokh'i nadosht.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi k'abli davroni khurdsolii Muso (alaikh'is salom)-ro ovard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin markh'ilai ch'avonii uro zikr namuda guft:
14) Va chun Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba sinni nerumandshavii ch'ismoniash rasid va k'avi gasht, ba vai fakh'm va k'abl az paiombari oidi dini Bani Isroil donish ato namudem. Va on guna ki ba Muso dar badali ibodat podosh dodem, dar kh'ar zamon va makon ba bandagoni nekukoramon kh'amin guna podosh medikh'em.

15) Va Muso kh'angomi istirokh'ati mardum dar khonakh'oiashon voridi shakh'r shud. Pas dar shakh'r du mardero paido kard, ki bo iakdigar nizo' va zanozani mekardand. Iake az onkh'o az k'abilai Bani Isroil, k'avmi Muso va digarash az k'ibtikh'oi k'avmi Fir'avn, dushmanoni Muso bud. Pas on marde, ki az k'avmi Muso bud, az vai talab kard, to uro alaikh'i mardi digare, ki az k'ibtikh'oi dushmanoni Muso ast, kumak kunad. Ba'd az in Muso on mardi k'ibtiro iak musht zad, pas az shiddati mushtash bo iak zarba uro ba k'atl rasonid. Muso ba'd az in rukhdod zud ba khud omad va guft: "Kh'amono in amal az oroishot va ig'vogarikh'oi Shaiton ast. Ba durusti, Shaiton baroi kase, ki az u pairavi kunad, dushmani gumrokh'sozandai oshkor ast. Kore, ki az sui man rukh dod, az sababi adovati Shaiton surat girifta, mekhokh'ad maro gumrokh' sozad."

16) Muso ba gunokh'i khesh e'tirof namud va ba Parvardigorash rui ovarda guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, begumon man bo kushtani mardi k'ibti bar khud sitam kardam. Pas gunokh'amro biomurz." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba'di in duovu istig'for Musoro mag'firat kard. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

17) Muso duoi khudro idoma doda guft: "Ei Parvardigori man, ba sababi on chi az neru, kh'ikmat va ilm bar man in'om kardai, pas kh'argiz baroi much'rimon dar ch'inoiatashon iorirason va kh'imoiatgar namegardam."

18) Pas chun az ch'onibi Muso k'atli mardi k'ibti ba vuk'u' paivast, vai dar shakh'r kh'aroson gashta, muntazir bud, ki chi kh'odisa rukh medikh'ad. Pas nogakh'on did on marde, ki diruz az u muk'obili mardi k'ibti kumak mekhost, imruz alaikh'i k'ibtii digar iori mech'uiad. Muso ba on mard guft: "Kh'amono tu gumrokh'i oshkor kh'asti."

19) Pas chun Muso khost ba on mardi k'ibti, ki dushmani u va mardi iakh'udi bud, kh'amla namoiad, mardi iakh'udi az sababi on ki az Muso shunid, ki ba vai "Kh'amono tu gumrokh'i oshkor kh'asti" gufta bud, gumon kard Muso k'asd dorad ba vai kh'amla kunad, pas ba Muso guft: "Oio on guna ki diruz mardero kushti, imruz mekhokh'i maro bikushi? Mak'sadi tu tankh'o az on iborat ast, ki mekhokh'i dar zamin k'udratmand boshi, mardumro bikushi va nisbat ba onkh'o sitam namoi. Va namekhokh'i az islokh'garoni tarafkh'oi nizo'kunanda boshi."

20) Va chun in khabar ovoza gasht, marde az durtarin gushai shakh'r az rui dilsuzi ba Muso, ki az ch'onibi tobeoni Fir'avn mavridi paigard k'aror girifta, dastgir meshavad, shitobon omada guft: "Ei Muso, kh'amono ashrofoni k'avmi Fir'avn dar mavridi k'atli tu bo kh'am mashvarat dorand. Ba durusti, man baroi tu az khairkhokh'on kh'astam. Dilam baroiat az on ki onkh'o turo dastgir karda, ba k'atl rasonand, mesuzad."

21) Pas Muso mashvarati on mardi nosekh'ro ba inobat girifta, az shakh'r kh'aroson berun shuda, muntazir bud, ki bo vai chi rukh medikh'ad. Ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui ovard va guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, maro az in k'avmi zolim nach'ot bidekh', to ba man oseb narasonand."
22) Va vak'te Muso ba tarafi Madian rakh'sipor gasht, guft: "Shoiad Parvardigoram maro ba bekh'tarin rokh' rakh'namoi kunad va digar az on berun nashavam."

23) Va chun nazdi chokh'i Madian, ki mardum az on ob megiriftand, rasid, iak gurukh' az mardumero ioft, ki chorvokh'oiashonro ob medodand va g'air az onkh'o du zanero ioft, ki gusfandonashonro to zamone ki mardum chorvokh'oi khudro ob dikh'and, az ob boz medorand. Muso ba on du zan guft: "Shumoro chi shuda ast, ki gusfandonatonro iakch'o bo mardum ob namedikh'ed?!" On du zan dar posukh guftand: "Mo tibk'i odatamon to zamone ki chuponkh'o az nazdi chokh' bargardand, gusfandonamonro ob namedikh'em, zero az omekhtashavi bo nomakh'ramon kh'azar mekunem va padaramon piramardi solkhurda buda, gusfandonro inch'o ovarda, ob doda nametavonad. Mo mach'burem, ki in korro khudamon kunem."

24) Pas k'albi Muso baroi on du zan ba rik'k'at omad va gusfandoni onkh'oro ob dod. Sipas ba sui soiae bargashta, zeri on istirokh'at namud va Parvardigorashro bo ishora ba kh'och'atmandiash duo karda guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, kh'amono man ba kh'ama guna khaire, ki onro baroiam furud meori, niiozmand kh'astam."

25) Pas on du zan raftand va ba padarashon az Muso k'issa kardand. Padarashon iakeashonro baroi da'vat namudani Muso firistod. Pas u sharmginona nazdi Muso omada guft: "Beshak, Padaram turo nazdash mekhonad, to baroiat dar badali on ki baroi mo az chokh' ob kashidi, muzdatro bidikh'ad." Pas vak'te ki Muso ba nazdi padari onkh'o omad va sarguzashtashro k'issa namuda, az akhbori khesh ogokh' sokht, on mard khotiri Musoro ch'am' karda guft: "Natars. Az badii k'avmi zolimi Fir'avn va pairavonash nach'ot iofti. Zero onkh'o dar shakh'ri Madian saltanat nadorand. Inch'o ba tu zarar rasonida nametavonand."

26) Iake az on du dukhtar ba padarashon guft: "Ei Padaram, uro muzdur bigir, to gusfandonamonro nigokh'ubin kunad. Zero in mard baroi on ki uro muzdur bigiri, loik' ast, zero vai nerumand va amonatdor ast. Bo neruiash vazifai chuponiro ba ch'o meorad va bo amonatdoriash on chi bar ukh'daash amonat guzoshta shavad, kh'ifz mekunad."

27) Padari on du dukhtar ba Muso khitob karda guft: "Kh'amono man mekhokh'am az in dukhtaronam iakeashro ba ak'di nikokh'at daroram, ba sharti on ki tu dar ivazi makh'rash muddati kh'asht sol gusfandoni moro nigokh'ubin mekuni. Pas agar muddatro dakh' sol takmil dikh'i, pas in az khairkhokh'ii khudi tust, vale baroiat voch'ib nest. Zero ak'di baini manu tu kh'asht sol basta meshavad va az in beshtar ikhtiiori ast. Va namekhokh'am turo ba ich'roi kore ukh'dador sozam, ki baroiat mashak'k'at orad. Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ad, begumon maro az bandagoni neke meiobi, ki ba akh'dashon vafodor buda, onro nameshikanand."

28) Muso guft: "In ak'di baini man va baini tu bar asosi on shartkh'oe basta shud, ki tavofuk' namudem. Kh'ar kadom az du mukh'lati dakh' io kh'asht solro baroiat ich'ro kunam, ba va'dai khud vafo kardaam. Az man az in beshtarro darkhost namekuni. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar on chi guftem va ak'd bastem, Shokh'idu Nigakh'bon ast."

29) Pas chun Muso komiltarini du mukh'lat (dakh' sol)-ro ba itmom rasonid va bo khonadonash az Madian ba sui Misr ravon shud, az ch'onibi kukh'i Tur otashero did. Ba khonadonash guft: "Kh'aminch'o isted. Beshak, man otashero didam. Shoiad man baroiaton az nazdi on otash khabare io shu'laero biioram, ki az on otash furuzon namoed, to khudro az sardi garm sozed."

30) Pas chun Muso nazdi on otash omad, Parvardigorash az ch'onibi vodii tarafi rosti Muso, dar makone, ki ba sababi bo vai guftugu kardanash onro muborak gardonida bud, az samti iak darakht uro bo in mazmun nido namud: "Ei Muso, begumon man Allokh'i Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion kh'astam."

31) Va inchunin bo in ma'no ba u nido kard: "Asoiatro biandoz." Muso baroi ich'roi amri ilokh'i onro andokht. Pas vak'te asoro did, ki mech'unbad, misli on ki dar sur'atnoki ba mor shabokh'at dorad, az tars pusht gardonida gurekht va ak'ib barnagasht. Parvardigorash uro nido karda guft: "Ei Muso, biio va az asoi misli mor ch'unbanda matars. Zero begumon tu az sharri on va az sharri kh'ar chi kh'aros dori, az ch'umlai bandagoni dar amon buda kh'asti.
