32) Dastatro ba girebonat dokhil kun, biduni marazi makhav safed berun meshavad." Muso dastashro ba girebonash darovard, chun onro berun ovard, monandi barf safed bud. Parvardigor dar idoma guft: "Dastatro ch'am' sokhta, bar sinaat biguzor, to ekh'sosi tarsat orom shavad." Vak'te ki Muso dastashro bar sinaash guzosht, tarsash bartaraf gasht. Pas aso va dasti safed kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi az Parvardigorat ba Fir'avn va ashrofoni k'avmash firistoda shudaand. Kh'amono Fir'avn va pairavonash ba sababi kufr va ma'siiatashon k'avmi az itoati Khudo khorich' budand.

33) Muso (alaikh'is salom) iltich'okunon ba Parvardigorash rui ovarda guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, kh'amono man az onkh'o shakhsero kushtaam. Pas khavf doram, ki agar bo risolati Tu nazdashon ravam, maro dar badali on mardi kushtaam mekushand.

34) Va barodaram Kh'orun, kalomi u az kalomi man ravshantar ast. Pas uro kh'amrokh'am kh'amchun iovar bifirist, ki agar Fir'avn va k'avmash maro durug'gu shumorand, Kh'orun maro tasdik' namuda, dar guftakh'oiam muvofik'at namoiad. Ba durusti, man metarsam, ki onkh'o maro ba durug'gui nisbat medikh'and, chunonchi ummatkh'oi guzashta paiombaronashonro takzib karda budand."

35) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba darkhosti Muso (alaikh'is salom) posukh doda guft: "Ei Muso, Mo turo bo firistodani barodarat ba sifati paiombari iovar k'uvvat mebakhshem va baroi kh'ardui shumo kh'uch'ch'at va ta'iidi kheshro k'aror medikh'em. Pas onkh'o ba shumo zarar rasonida nametavonand. Beshak, shumo va mu'minoni pairavaton ba vasilai mu'ch'izakh'oe, ki onro baroiaton firistodaem, alaikh'i Fir'avn va k'avmash piruzed."

36) Pas vak'te Muso (alaikh'is salom) bo mu'ch'izakh'oi ravshani ato namudai Mo ba nazdi Fir'avn va k'avmash omad, onkh'o guftand: "On chi Muso ovarda ast, ch'uz ch'odui boftae chize nest. Va mo in guna da'voi nubuvvatro dar davroni padaroni guzashtaamon nashunidaem."

37) Va Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba Fir'avn khitob karda guft: "Parvardigoram kasero, ki az nazdi U kh'idoiat ovarda ast va niz on kasero, ki dar okhirat farch'omi nek az ust, medonad. Kh'amono zolimon ba murodi khesh namerasand va az on chi kh'aros dorand, nach'ot nameioband."

38) Va Fir'avn peshvoioni k'avmashro mukhotab k'aror dod va guft: "Ei ch'am'i ashrofon, man baroi shumo ch'uz khud digar ma'budero namedonam. Pas ei Kh'omon, baroiam bar gil otash biafruz, to sakht shavad. Ba'dan bo istifoda az on gili sakhtshuda binoi balande bisoz, shoiad ma'budi Musoro binam va dar boraash ittilo' iobam. Va kh'amono man gumon mekunam, ki Muso dar da'voi khud oidi on ki guio az ch'onibi Khudo ba sui man va k'avmam firistoda shuda ast, az durug'guion ast."

39) Va kibri Fir'avn va lashkariionash shiddat ioft va onkh'o dar sarzamini Misr ba nokh'ak' kheshtanro buzurg shumurdand va rastokhezro inkor namuda, pindoshtand, ki onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo ba sui Mo bargardonida nameshavand.

40) Ba kh'amin sabab, Mo Fir'avnu lashkariionashro giriftem, pas onkh'oro dar bakh'r afkandem, kh'amagi g'ark' va kh'alok gardidand. Pas ei Paiombar, andesha kun, ki farch'omi zolimon bo chi anch'omid? Begumon onkh'o ok'ibat nobud gashtand.

41) Va Fir'avnro bo lashkariionash peshvoioni sarkashonu zolimon k'aror dodem, ki onkh'o bo nashri kufru zalolat paioravonashonro ba sui duzakh faro mekhonand. Va ruzi k'iiomat ba onkh'o bo rakh'onidanashon az duzakh kumak rasonida nameshavad. Balki ba sababi ech'odi odatkh'oi bad va da'vati digaron ba zalolat uk'ubatashon duchand megardad. Bar onkh'o gunokh'i amali khud va ch'urmi kasone, ki dar gumrokh'i pairaviashon kardaand, navishta meshavad.
42) Va dar in dunio ilova bar azobi okhirat az dunboli onkh'o rasvoi va la'natro firistodem. Va onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat az mazammatgashtagoni az rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durshudagonand.

43) Va Ba durusti ki Mo ba'd az on ki ba sui ummatkh'oi guzashta paiombaronamonro firistodem, pas k'avmashon takzibashon namudand va ba kh'amin sabab onkh'oro kh'alok sokhtem, ba Muso Tavrotro dodem, dar kh'ole in Kitob shomili andarzkh'oe bud, ki didai botinii mardumro ravshan mekard, to onkh'o on chi ba foidaashon ast, ich'ro va on chi ba zararashon ast, tark kunand va onkh'oro ba sui neki rakh'namoi menamud va baroiashon moiai rakh'mat bud, chunki khairi dunio va okhiratro darbar megirift, to mardum ne'matkh'oi Khudoro ba khotir ovarda, siposguzori kunand va imon biiorand.

44) Va ei Paiombar, tu dar ch'onibi g'arbii kukh'i Tur (ba e'tibori ch'oigirshavii Muso (alaikh'is salom)) kh'uzur nadoshti. On gokh', ki Mo baroi Muso farmoni risolatro bo firistodanash ba sui Fir'avn va k'avmash ba anch'om rasonidem. Va tu dar on vok'ea az ch'umlai kh'ozirshudagon nabudi, to az in k'issa ogokh' gashta, onro ba digaron nak'l kuni, balki kh'ar chi dar in bora megui, az paig'omi Parvardigor ast.

45) Valekin Mo ba'd az Muso (alaikh'is salom) ummatkh'o va khaloik'i ziiodero kh'ast namudem. Pas bar onkh'o zamoni daroz guzasht, to kh'adde, ki akh'di Khudoro faromush kardand. Va tu dar baini akh'li Madian sokin nabudi, ki bar in mushrikoni davroni khesh oiatkh'oi Moro tilovat kuni, valekin Mo turo az nazdamon firistodem. Baroi tu k'issai Muso (alaikh'is salom) va dar Madian sukunat kardanashro paig'om namudem va ba mardum on chiro gufti, ki Khudo onro vakh'i namuda bud.

46) Va tu dar ch'onibi kukh'i Tur vak'te Mo Muso (alaikh'is salom)-ro nido karda, baroiash paig'om firistodem, kh'uzur nadoshti, to onro dida, ba mardum k'issa kuni, valekin Mo turo kh'amchun rakh'mat az ch'onibi Parvardigorat ba sui mardum firistodem, pas sarguzashti Muso (alaikh'is salom)-ro baroiat vakh'i firistodem, to k'avmero bim dikh'i, ki k'abl az tu ba onkh'o kh'ech' paiombari bimdikh'anda naomada bud, to onkh'o pand girand va ba paig'omi ovardaat imon orand.

47) Va agar chunin namebud, ki chun ba onkh'o ba sababi on chi az kufr va ma'siiat anch'om dodaand, uk'ubati ilokh'i merasid, pas baroi on ki ba eshon paiombar naomad, kh'uch'ch'at ovarda meguftand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, charo ba mo paiombarero nafiristodi, to az oiatkh'oiat pairavi namoem va mutobik'i on amal karda, az mu'minoni ich'rokunandai amrat boshem", onkh'oro k'abl az on ki turo paiombar bifiristem, dar kh'ol uk'ubat mekardem. Lekin uk'ubatro az onkh'o ba ta'khir andokhtem, to in ki bo firistodani paiombar uzrashonro barkh'am dikh'em.

48) Pas chun Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az ch'onibi Parvardigorash bo risolat nazdi k'uraishikh'o omad, mushrikon dar boraash az iakh'udikh'o pursidand. Iakh'udikh'o ba onkh'o in kh'uch'ch'atro talk'in namuda guftand: "Charo monandi on mu'ch'izakh'oe, ki ba Muso baroi isboti risolatash ba misli aso va dasti tobon doda shuda bud, ba Mukh'ammad doda nashuda ast?" Ei Paiombar, dar posukhashon bigu: "Oio iakh'udikh'o ba on chi k'abl az in ba Muso doda shud, kofir nashudand?! Onkh'o dar mavridi Tavrot va K'ur'on guftand: "Kh'amono Tavrotu K'ur'on Kitobkh'oi ch'odugari buda, iake digarero tak'viiat medikh'ad." Va niz guftand: "Ba durusti ki mo ba Tavrotu K'ur'on kofirem.""

49) Ei Paiombar, ba in toifa bigu: "Agar shumo dar da'voi khesh, ki guio Tavrotu K'ur'on Kitobkh'oi ch'odugari kh'astand, sodik' boshed, pas az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kitobero biiored, ki on az Tavrotu K'ur'on rakh'namotar boshad. Agar chunin Kitob biiored, man az on pairavi mekunam."

50) Ba'd az in agar k'uraishikh'o da'vati turo oidi on ki az nazdi Khudo kitobi az Tavrotu K'ur'on rakh'namotar biiorand, posukh naguiand va ich'ro nakunand, pas iak'inan bidon, ki takzibi onkh'o vobasta ba in du Kitobi osmoni az dalel nest, balki on bar asosi pairavii khostakh'oi nafsashon surat girifta ast. Va kh'ech' kas az shakhse, ki biduni kh'idoiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khokh'ishoti nafsashro pairavi kunad, gumrokh'tar nest. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kasone, ki bo kufr bar ch'onashon zulm mekunand, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro namedikh'ad.

51) Va Mo beshak, sukhanoni K'ur'onro dar borai ummatkh'oi guzashta ba mushrikon va iakh'udikh'o takror ba takror rasonidem. Zamone ki onkh'o paiombaronamonro durug'gui donistand, zud bar eshon uk'ubatro furud naovardem, to az Kalomi Khudo pand girifta, imon orand va ba uk'ubat duchor nashavand.
52) On kasone, ki k'abl az nuzuli K'ur'on bar imonashon ba Tavrot ustuvor mondaand, onkh'o ba K'ur'on imon meorand. Zero onkh'o khabar va tavsifkh'oi K'ur'onro dar Kitobkh'oi khesh paido mekunand.

53) Va vak'te bar onkh'o K'ur'on tilovat shavad, meguiand: "Mo ba in Kitob imon dorem. Kh'amono on biduni shubkh'a kh'ak' buda, az ch'onibi Parvardigoramon nozil karda shuda ast. Ba durusti ki mo k'abl az K'ur'on musalmon budem, chunki ba on chi dar guzashta paiombaron ovardaand, imon doshtem."

54) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba in toifai bo sifatkh'oi mazkur tavsifshuda, az sababi on ki dar imon ovardan ba Kitobi kheshtan sabr kardand va ba bi'sati Paiombari okhirzamon (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) imon ovardand, du bor podoshashon medikh'ad. Va onkh'o ba vasilai savobkh'oi a'moli shoistaashon gunokh'oni sodirkardai khudro dur mesozand va az on chi baroiashon ruzi namudaem, dar korkh'oi khair sarf mekunand.

55) Va vak'te ki in ch'amoai boimoni akh'li Kitob sukhani botilro shunavand, az on rui gardonida, tavach'ch'ukh' namekunand va ba botilkoron khitob karda meguiand: "Moro podoshi a'molamon va shumoro podoshi a'molaton ast. Az dashnom va ozori mo solim kh'asted. Mo kh'amsukh'batii ch'okh'ilonro namech'uem, chunki on ba din va dunioiamon ziion merasonad."

56) Ei Paiombar, ba durusti, tu ba kh'ar ki ba monandi Abutolib va digaron, ki dustashon dori, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba paziruftani imonro doda nametavoni, valekin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Iagona Zotest, ki ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba k'abuli imonro medikh'ad. Va U dar borai kasone, ki dar ilmi azaliash kh'idoiatioftaand, Donotar ast.

57) Va mushrikoni Makka baroi adami pairavi az Islom va imon naovardan bakh'onach'ui karda guftand: "Agar mo Islomi ovardai turo pairavi kunem, dushmanonamon moro az zaminamon meraboiand."Magar Mo baroi in mushrikon kh'aramero k'aror nadodaem, ki dar on rekhtani khun va sitamgari man' ast, onkh'o dar onch'o az kh'uch'umi digaron dar amonand, ba in makon makh'suloti kh'ar chiz kh'amchun rizk'i makhsus az nazdi Mo ovarda meshavad?! Vale aksariiatashon on chiro Allokh' taolo baroiashon in'om namuda ast, namedonand, to shukri Uro ba ch'o orand.

58) Va chi baso akh'li dekh'akh'oe mavch'ud budand, ki ne'matkh'oi Khudoro nosiposi namudand va dar gunokh' furu raftand. Ba onkh'o azobi Kheshro firistodem va kh'alokashon sokhtem. Pas in makonkh'oi istik'omatii ba kharobazor tabdilgardidai onkh'ost, ki mardum az nazdi in khonakh'oiashon meguzarand, ba'di az bain raftani sokinonash ba ch'uz zamoni andak az ch'onibi ba'zei rakh'guzaron digar kase dar in makonkh'o sukunat nakarda ast. Va Mo Merosbari kh'ak'ik'ii osmonkh'ovu zamin va tamomi mavch'udot kh'astem.

59) Va ei Paiombar, kh'argiz Parvardigori tu akh'li shakh'rkh'oro kh'alok namesozad, magar zamone ki dar kalontarini on shakh'rkh'o paiombarero firistoda, baroi sokinonash bakh'onaero naguzorad, chunonchi turo dar Umm-ul-k'uro (Makka) barangekhta ast. On paiombar ba mardum oiatkh'oi Moro tilovat mekunad. Va Mo akh'li shakh'rkh'oro agar dar rokh'i kh'ak'k'and, kh'alok namesozem, balki onkh'oro vak'te kh'alok megardonem, ki bo kufr varzidan va sodir kardani ma'siiat zolim boshand.

Vak'te mushrikon sakhtikh'oi ch'ang va k'at'shavii tich'oratashonro uzr ovardand, ki agar az kh'ak'ik'at pairavi namoiand, duchori on megardand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ch'avobashon guft:
60) Va kh'ar chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo doda ast, pas az on dar zindagonii dunio bakh'ra mebared va bo on khudro oroish medikh'ed, ammo ok'ibat fano megardad. Va savobi nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar okhirat az mato' va oroishoti dunio bekh'tar va poiandatar ast. Oio dar in bobat andesha namekuned, to zindagonii poiandaro az dunioi foni muk'addam guzored.

61) Oio kase, ki dar okhirat baroiash ch'annat va ne'matkh'oi poiandai onro va'da dodaem, pas vai kh'atman ba on noil megardad, bo kase, ki baroiash mol va zinati zindagonii dunioro doda, uro bo matoi dunio bakh'ramand sokhtem, sipas u ruzi k'iiomat az ch'umlai kh'ozirkardashudagon ba duzakh meboshad, barobar ast?!
62) Va ruze, ki Parvardigorashon onkh'oro nido karda meguiad: "On ma'budkh'oiaton, ki onkh'oro dar dunio sharikoni Man mekh'isobided va ch'uz Man meparastided, kuch'oiand?!"

63) On kasone az da'vatgaron ba sui kufr, ki azob bar eshon voch'ib shavad, meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, in gurukh'est, ki mo onkh'oro gumrokh' sokhtaem. Onkh'oro ba misli khud gumrokh' kardem. Az eshon ba Tu izkh'ori bezori menamoem. Onkh'o moro nameparastidand, balki Shaitonro meparastidand."

64) Va ba onkh'o gufta shavad: "Ma'budkh'oi ba Man sharik sokhtai khudro faro khoned, to shumoro az in rasvoi rakh'o namoiand." Pas onkh'o ma'budkh'oiashonro nido mekunand, pas on khudoioni sun'i nidoi obidonashonro namepazirand. Va akh'li shirku kufr azobi baroiashon omodashudaro mushokh'ida karda, orzu menamoiand, ki kosh, dar dunio ba sui kh'ak' kh'idoiat meioftand.
65) Va ruze, ki Parvardigorashon onkh'oro nido karda meguiad: "Ba paiombarone, ki onkh'oro ba suiaton firistodam, chi posukh doded?"

66) Pas on chi az on kh'uch'ch'at meovardand, bar onkh'o pushida gardida, chizero ba iod nameorand. Dar natich'ai dakh'shatkh'oi on ruz ba'zeashon az ba'zeashon namepursand, zero iak'in dorand, ki ba duzakh medaroiand.

67) Pas ammo kh'ar ki az in mushrikon az kufrash tavba kunad va ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash imon orad va amali nek anch'om dikh'ad, umed ast az rastagorone boshad, ki ba ch'annat noil gashta, az ch'akh'annam nach'ot iobad.

68) Va ei Paiombar, Parvardigorat kh'ar on chiro khokh'ad, meofarad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, baroi ibodat va nubuvvatash barmeguzinad. Mushrikon doroi ikhtiior nestand, ki muk'obili Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) e'tiroz kunand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mushrikon ba U sharik k'aror medikh'and, pok va bartar ast.

69) Va Parvardigori tu on chiro k'albashon pinkh'on mesozad va on chiro oshkor mesozad, medonad. Kh'ech' chize az U pushida nest va begumon onkh'oro dar badali on chi oshkor va pinkh'on kardaand, ch'azo khokh'ad dod.

70) Va U Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Ma'budest, ki g'air az U digar ma'budi kh'ak'ik'i nest. Sitoish dar dunio va okhirat tankh'o az Ust va kh'ukmi ich'roshavandae, ki kh'ech' kase onro rad karda nametavonad, az Ust. Va ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo fak'at ba sui U bargardonida meshaved.

71) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Ba man khabar dikh'ed. Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shabro bar shumo to ruzi k'iiomat doimi gardonad, g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kist ma'bude, ki ba shumo monandi rushnoii ruz rushnoi meorad?! Oio ba in kh'uch'ch'atkh'o gush namekuned va namedoned, ki ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kase az ukh'dai in kor namebaroiad."

72) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Ba man khabar dikh'ed. Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzro bar shumo to ruzi k'iiomat doimi gardonad, g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kist ma'bude, ki ba shumo shabero orad, ki dar on orom gired, to az mashak'k'ati korkh'oi ruz istirokh'at kuned?! Oio in nishonakh'oi k'udrati Allokh'ro namebined va iak'in namekuned, ki shabro tankh'o U baroiaton meorad?!"

73) Va az rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on ast, ki baroi shumo mardum shabro torik gardond, to dar on ba'd az ranch'i kori ruz orom gired va ruzro rushan gardond, to dar on baroi talabi ruzi talosh namoed va to shumo ne'matkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro siposguzori karda, nosiposi namekuned.
74) Va ruze, ki Parvardigorashon onkh'oro nido karda meguiad: "On ma'budkh'oiaton, ki onkh'oro dar dunio sharikoni Man mekh'isobided va ch'uz Man meparastided, kuch'oiand?!"

75) Va Mo az kh'ar iak ummat paiombarashonro kh'ozir mesozem, ki bar kufru takzibi ummatash guvokh'i dikh'ad. Va ba takzibgaroni on ummatkh'o meguem: "Dar borai durust budani kufr va takzibaton kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi khudro biiored." Pas kh'uch'ch'atkh'oiashon k'at' megardad va iak'in menamoiand, ki kh'ak'k'i ma'budiiat iagona az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va ma'budkh'oe, ki az nazdi khesh shariki Parvardigor meboftand, az onkh'o nopadid meshavand.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi k'abli baion kard, ki Fir'avn dar zamin ba sababi saltanatash tug'ion varzid, dar oiatkh'oi zerin sababi tug'ioni K'orunro dar tavongariash zikr namuda meguiad:
76) Kh'amono K'orun az k'avmi Muso (alaikh'is salom) bud, pas bar onkh'o kibr namud. Va baroiash on k'adar khazinakh'oi amvol dodem, ki bardoshtani kalidkh'oi khazinakh'oiash bar gurukh'i nerumand sangini mekard. On gokh', ki k'avmash ba u guftand: "Khudpisandona khushkh'oli makun. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on kasonero, ki khudpisandona khushkh'ol meshavand, dust namedorad, balki ba onkh'o nafrat dorad va azobashon medikh'ad.

77) Va dar on chi Allokh'i mutaol az amvol baroiat doda ast, bo sarf kardanash dar korkh'oi nek saroi okhiratro bitalab va kh'issai khudro az khurdan, nushidan, pushidan va g'aira biduni isrofkori faromush masoz va on guna ki Parvardigorat ba tu neki karda ast, muomilaatro bo U va bandagonash nek bigardon va dar zamin bo ma'siiat va tarki ibodat dar talabi fasodkori mabosh. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni bo ma'siiatu tarki ibodat fasodkorro dust namedorad, balki nisbat ba onkh'o nafrat dorad."

78) K'orun guft: "Kh'amono in amvol baroiam bo ilm va k'udrate, ki doram, doda shuda va man sazovori onam." Oio K'orun namedonist, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'abl az u az ummatkh'o kasonero kh'alok karda ast, ki az vai nerumandtar va dar ch'am'ovarii doroi makh'orati beshtar doshtand?! Doroi va nerumandi sudashon nabakhshid. Va ruzi k'iiomat gunakh'koron az gunokh'onashon pursida nameshavand, zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'oni onkh'oro medonad. On chi ruzi okhirat az gunakh'koron pursida shavad, ba mak'sadi sarkubi va sarzanish ast.

79) Pas K'orun bo kh'adafi nishon dodani shukukh'ash kh'amrokh'i anbukh'i pairavonash bo oroishotash savori markabkh'o nazdi k'avmash baromad. Az askh'obi K'orun on kasone, ki ba oroishoti zindagonii dunio tama' doshtand, guftand: "Ei kosh, monandi on chi baroi K'orun az zinati dunio doda shuda ast, baroi mo niz doda meshud. Ba durusti, K'orun shakhsi doroi bakh'rai buzurg ast."

80) Va kasone, ki ba onkh'o donish doda shuda bud, chun K'orunro bo on oroishash didand va tamannoi askh'obashro shunidand, guftand: "Voi bar shumo! Podoshi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va on chi dar okhirat az ne'mat omoda karda ast, baroi kase, ki ba U imon ovarda va kori shoista anch'om doda ast, az ch'okh'u ch'aloli K'orun bekh'tar ast." Va ba guftani in kalom va tibk'i on amal kardan tankh'o bandagoni sobire muvaffak' meshavand, ki dar muk'addam guzoshtani podoshi ilokh'i az matoi fanopaziri dunio sabr mekunand.

81) Pas Mo K'orun va manzilashro bo kh'ama doroiash ba zamin furu burdem. In intik'omamon dar natich'ai sarkashiash surat girift. Pas K'orun g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gurukh'e nadosht, ki uro kumak kunand va khud niz az azobi ilokh'i khudro kumak karda natavonist.

82) Va on kasone, ki diruz k'abl az ba zamin furu raftani K'orun orzui dar ch'oiash budanro doshtand, imruz kh'olati uro dida, kh'asratzada shuda va az in rukhdod ibrat girifta meguftand: "Oio namedonistem, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruziro baroi kh'ar ki az bandagonash khokh'ad, farokh va baroi kh'ar ki khokh'ad, tang megardonad? Agar lutfi ilokh'i bar mo namebud, ki dar badali sukhani guftaamon moro uk'ubat nakard, begumon moro monandi K'orun ba zamin furu meburd." Ba durusti ki kofiron dar duniovu okhirat rastagor nameshavand, balki farch'omi korashon dar kh'ardu ch'akh'on ba zarar duchor gashtan ast.

83) Mo on saroi okhiratro baroi kasone, ki namekhokh'and dar zamin az k'abuli imon va pairavii on nokh'ak' kibr kunand va k'asdi fasodkori nadorand, manzili osoish va izzatmandi k'aror medikh'em. Va farch'omi neki iborat az ne'matkh'oi ch'annat va rizoi Parvardigor az bandagoni parkh'ezkorest, ki farmoni U ich'ro va az man'kardaash duri mech'uiand.

84) Kh'ar ki ruzi k'iiomat bo kori nek ba monandi namoz, zakot, ruza va g'aira biioiad, pas podoshi az amali kardaash bekh'tarro megirad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ivazi iak neki ba vai dakh' savob medikh'ad. Va kh'ar ki ruzi k'iiomat bo kori bad ba monandi kufr, ribokhuri, zinokori va g'airi on biioiad, pas ba kasone, ki korkh'oi bad kardaand, g'airi on chi mekardaand, ch'azoe doda nameshavad. Dar ivazi iak amali bad iak ch'azo megirand.

85) Kh'amono on Khudoe, ki bar tu K'ur'onro furud ovard va tablig'i in Kitob va bo on amal namudanro baroiat farz gardonid, beshak, turo ba sui Makka fatkh'sozanda barmegardonad. Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon bigu: "Parvardigoram on kasero, ki kh'idoiat ovarda va on kasero, ki az kh'idoiat va kh'ak'ik'at dar zalolati oshkor ast, bekh'tar medonad."

86) Va ei Paiombar, tu k'abl az bi'sat umedi onro nadoshti, ki ba suiat K'ur'on firistoda shavad, lekin rakh'mati Parvardigorat furud omadani onro bar tu tak'ozo namud. Pas ba kofiron dar zalolatashon madadrason mabosh.

87) Va naboiad in mushrikon turo az oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba'd az on ki onkh'oro bar tu nozil karda ast, bargardonand, ki dar natich'a tilovat va tablig'ashro tark namoi. Va mardumro ba sui imon ba Parvardigorat, iaktoparasti va amal mutobik' ba shariat da'vat kun. Va az mushrikon mabosh, balki az iaktoparastone bosh, ki kh'ech' chizro ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik namegardonand.

88) Va kh'amrokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digarero ibodat makun. G'air az U ma'budi barkh'ak' vuch'ud nadorad. Ch'uz U kh'ama chiz kh'alok meshavad. Kh'ukm tankh'o az Ust. Kh'ar chi khokh'ad, kh'ukm mekunad. Va shumo ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo fak'at ba sui U bargardonida meshaved.
1) "Alif. Lom. Mim" Dar ibtidoi surai Bak'ara sukhan dar borai tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.

2) Oio mardum gumon dorand, ki bo guftani "Ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaem", biduni on ki ozmoish gashta, sadok'atashon dar imondori isbot shavad, ba kh'olashon guzoshta meshavand?! Kh'ak'ik'ati kor on guna ki gumon mebarand, nest.

3) Va Mo begumon kasonero, ki k'abl az onkh'o budand, ozmudem. Pas iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sadok'ati sodik'onro dar imondori ba shumo ma'lum va oshkor megardonad va durug'i durug'guionro dar imondori ma'lum va oshkor megardonad.

4) Balki kasone, ki monandi shirk va digar nav'i gunokh'on korkh'oi bad anch'om medikh'and, oio gumon dorand Moro och'iz megardonand va az uk'ubatamon nach'ot meioband?! Chi baso zisht ast on chi dovari mekunand. Onkh'o kh'ech' gokh' Allokh'ro notavon sokhta nametavonand va agar dar kh'olati kufr bimirand, kh'argiz az uk'ubati Mo rakh'o nameshavand.

5) Kh'ar ki ruzi k'iiomat bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) umedi mulok'otro dorad, to ba vai podosh dikh'ad, boiad bidonad, ki begumon mukh'lati baroi in vokhuri muk'arrarsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba zudi meoiad. Va U Shunavandai guftori bandagon, Donandai kirdori onkh'ost. Chiz az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dur namemonad va dar ivazi kh'ar iak guftor va kirdor ba sokh'ibash ch'azo khokh'ad dod.

7) Va on kasone, ki imon ovarda, dar imtikh'oni Mo sabr mekunand va amalkh'oi nek anch'om medikh'and, begumon gunokh'onashonro dar badali korkh'oi nekashon makh'v mesozem va dar okhirat baroiashon az on chi dar dunio ba ch'o meovardand, podoshi bekh'tar medikh'em.

8) Va Mo insonro farmon dodem, ki nisbat ba padaru modarash neki kunad. Va ei inson, agar padaru modarat turo vodor sozand, to ba Man on chiro, ki dar borai sharik k'aror dodanash ilm nadori, sharik gardoni, pas onkh'oro dar in kor itoat makun. Zero agar itoati makhluk' boisi nofarmonii Kholik' gardad, dar in surat itoati makhluk' man' ast. Ruzi k'iiomat bozgashti shumo tankh'o ba sui Man ast. Pas shumoro az on chi dar dunio anch'om medoded, ogokh' mesozam va podoshaton medikh'am. Dar sarguzashti Sa'd ibni Abuvak'k'os (r) chunin kh'odisa rukh doda bud va u az modarash itoat nakard.

9) Va on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om medikh'and, ruzi k'iiomat onkh'oro dar zumrai solekh'on vorid sokhta, kh'amrokh'i onkh'o kh'ashrashon megardonem va ba eshon podoshi bandagoni solekh'ro medikh'em.

10) Va ba'ze az mardum meguiand: "Ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardem". Pas vak'te ki kofiron onkh'oro baroi imonashon ozor dikh'and, uk'ubati kofironro misli azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meshumorand, pas baroi muvofik'at bo akh'li kufr az Islom berun meshavand. Va ei Paiombar, agar ba tu az ch'onibi Parvardigorat nusrat oiad, meguiand: "Ei mu'minon, kh'amono mo kh'amrokh'i shumo sokh'ibi imon budem." Oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi dar k'albi mardum ast, Ogokh'tar nest?! Imon va kufri k'albkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pushida namemonad. Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az rozi k'alb ogokh' ast, onkh'o chi guna mekhokh'and Uro az imoni khesh bokhabar sozand?!
11) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) begumon bandagonero, ki imoni vok'ei ovardaand, medonad va begumon munofik'oni dar zokh'ir mu'min, ammo dar botin kofirro niz medonad.

12) Va kofiron ba mu'minon guiand: "Din va rokh'i moro pairavi kuned va mo gunokh'oni shumoro bar dush megirem va ba ch'oi shumo dar ivazi on gunokh'on much'ozot meshavem." Va onkh'o az gunokh'oni akh'li imon chizero bardoshta nametavonand. Ba durusti, eshon dar in da'voi khesh durug'guiand.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati mazkur baion namud, ki kofiron gunokh'oni digaronro namebardorand, shoiad khonanda az in k'avl chunin bifakh'mad, ki kofironi da'vatgar ba zalolat niz gunokh'i ilovagi namegirand. Binobar in, Parvardigor dar oiati zerin baroi bartaraf sokhtani in darki nodurust guft:
13) Va beshak, in mushrikoni da'vatgar ba sui botil gunokh'oni sodirkardai khudro mebardorand va niz gunokh'oni kasonero, ki dar on botil ba onkh'o pairavi kardaand, mebardorand va az gunokh'i pairavoni onkh'o chize kam nameshavad. Va onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat az on botilkh'oe, ki dar dunio meboftand, pursida meshavand.

14) Va ba durusti ki Mo Nukh'ro ba sifati paiombar ba sui k'avmash firistodem. Pas vai dar baini k'avmash muddati nukh'sadu panch'okh' sol istoda, onkh'oro ba iaktoparasti da'vat mekard. Pas k'avmash uro takzib karda, kufrashonro idoma dodand. Ba kh'amin sabab, tufon onkh'oro faro girift va eshon ba sababi inkori Khudo va takzibi paiombaron zolim budand. Ba'd az in kh'amagi kh'alok shudand.
15) Pas Mo Nukh' va mu'minoni dar kishti bo u budaro az g'ark'shavi nach'ot dodem va kishtiro moiai ibrati mardum sokhtem, to az on ibrat girand.

16) Va ei Paiombar, k'issai Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro iod kun. Zamone ki u ba k'avmash guft: "Tankh'o Allokh'ro biparasted, dasturkh'oiashro ich'roi namoed, az man'kardkh'oiash parkh'ez kuned va az uk'ubatash bitarsed". Agar khair va sharro medoned, in korkh'oi amrshuda baroi shumo az kh'ama chiz bekh'tar ast.

17) Ei mushrikon, shumo begumon butkh'oero meparasted, ki sud va ziion ovarda nametavonand va chun da'voi loik'i ibodat budani ma'budkh'oiatonro mekuned, az peshi khud durug' mebofed. Kh'amono ononero, ki ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted, baroi shumo moliki ruzi nestand, to rizk'aton dikh'and. Pas rizk'ro az nazdi Allokh'i mutaol bitalabed, zero tankh'o U ruzidikh'anda ast va fak'at Uro ibodat kuned va baroi ruzii ba shumo in'om namudaash Uro siposguzori namoed. Ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo tankh'o ba sui U bargardonida meshaved, na ba nazdi butkh'oiaton."

18) Va ei mushrikon, agar on chiro Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ovarda ast, durug' meshumored, ba Man ziione namerasoned, zero ba durusti ki ummatkh'oi k'abl az shumo niz monandi k'avmi Nukh', Od va Samud paiombaronashonro ba durug'gui nisbat dodaand. Va ba zimmai paiombar ch'uz tablig'i oshkor chize nest. Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba shumo farmoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro vozekh' rasonida ast.

19) Oio in takzibgaron namebinand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bori nakhust chi guna khalk'ro ofarid, sipas onro ba'di fanoshavi boz barmegardonad?! Beshak, in kor baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) benikh'oiat oson ast. U Zoti Tavonost. Chize Uro och'iz sokhta nametavonad.

20) Ei Paiombar, ba in gurukh'e, ki ruzi k'iiomatro durug' medonand, bigu: "Dar zamin sairu saiokh'at kuned, ba'd az on biandeshed, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bori avval mavch'udotro chitavr ofarida ast. Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mardumro ba'd az margashon baroi bozpursi zinda megardonad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ama chiz bag'oiat Tavono ast. Chize Uro och'iz namegardonad. On guna ki dar avval khaloik'ro ofarid, kh'amin tavr onkh'oro dubora barmeangezad.

21) Az bandagonash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, bo adlash azob mekunad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, mavridi rakh'matash k'aror medikh'ad. Va dar ruzi k'iiomat chun az k'abr barangekhta shaved, baroi bozch'ui tankh'o ba sui U bozgardonida meshaved.

22) Va shumo na dar zamin va na dar osmon az Parvardigoraton rakh'oi nameiobed va az uk'ubatash khalosi nadored. Va shumo g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korsoz va iorirasone nadored, ki koratonro sarparasti kunad va azobatonro bartaraf sozad."

23) Va kasone, ki ba oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ba mulok'oti U dar k'iiomat kofir shudaand, in ch'amoa az rakh'mati Mo noumed gashtaand. Pas ba sababi kufrashon kh'argiz voridi ch'annat nameshavand va in gurukh'ro ruzi okhirat azobi dardovar ast.

24) Pas posukhi k'avmi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba'd az on ki onkh'oro ba iaktoparasti da'vat namuda, az butparasti man' kard, ch'uz on nabud, ki guftand: "Ibrokh'imro bo k'asdi sitonidani intik'omi ma'budkh'oi khesh bikushed io uro dar otash afkaned." Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro az otash solim berun ovard. Kh'amono dar solim berun ovardani Ibrokh'im az otash baroi k'avme, ki imon meorand, ibratkh'oi ziiod ast. Zero tankh'o mu'minon mardumi ibratpazirand.

25) Va Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba k'avmash guft: "Ba durusti ki shumo g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) butkh'oro ma'budi khud giriftaed, onkh'oro ba khotiri dar zindagonii dunio bo kh'am shinos va dust shudan ibodat mekuned. Sipas ruzi k'iiomat in paivandi dustiaton k'at' gashta, kh'angomi mushokh'idai azob ba'zeaton az ba'zei digaraton bezori mech'ued va ba'zeaton ba'zei digaratonro la'nat mekuned. Va ch'oiaton duzakh ast. Va shumo na az ch'onibi butkh'o va az ch'onibi kase kumakrasonkh'oe nadored, ki azobi ilokh'iro bartaraf sozand."

26) Pas Lut (alaikh'is salom) ba Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) imon ovard. Va Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Begumon man ba sui Parvardigoram ba zamini muboraki Shom kh'ich'rat mekunam. Kh'amono U G'olibi shikastnopazir buda, kh'ar ki ba suiash kh'ich'rat namoiad, uro khor namesozad, dar tak'dir va tadbirash bag'oiat Kh'akim ast."

27) Va Mo ba Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) Iskh'ok' va Ia'k'ubi pisari Iskh'ok'ro ato namudem va nubuvvat va Kitobkh'oi az suiamon nozilshudaro dar naslash k'aror dodem va ba u dar dunio podoshi sabrashro bo solekh' gardonidani farzandonash va bak'oi nomi nekash dodem. Va begumon Ibrokh'im dar okhirat az ch'umlai solekh'on buda, monandi onkh'o ach'r megirad. Mukofoti dar dunio ba vai atoshuda muzdi okhiratashro kam namekunad.

28) Va ei Paiombar, Lut (alaikh'is salom)-ro ba khotir biior, on gokh', ki ba k'avmash guft: "Kh'amono shumo gunokh'i nikh'oiat zisht sodir mekuned. K'ablan kh'ech' kase az ch'akh'oniion dar anch'omi amali bachabozi shumoro peshdasti nakarda va ba in guna ma'siiati k'abekh' dast nazada ast. Shumo nakhustin mardume kh'asted, ki in amali badi khilofi sirishti solimro ba vuch'ud ovarded.

29) Oio shumo dar kh'ak'ik'at baroi k'azoi shakh'vati khud bo mardon dar mak''adashon omezishi ch'insi mekuned va rokh'i musofironro mebanded, pas onkh'o az tarsi on ki dar kh'ak'k'ashon chunin amali zishti bachabozi nakuned, az peshaton nameguzarand va dar mach'liskh'oiaton kori munkar ba misli urionshavi va bo guftoru kirdor ozor dodani rakh'guzaronro anch'om medikh'ed?! Pas posukhi k'avmash ba'd az on ki onkh'oro az in guna a'moli k'abekh' man' kard, ch'uz on nabud, ki guftand: "Agar dar da'voi khesh sodik'i, pas azobi Allokh'ro, ki moro az on metarsoni, biior."

30) Lut (alaikh'is salom) ba'di on ki k'avmash ba iakravii khud idoma dodand va bo tamaskhur azobi Khudoro talabidand, Parvardigorashro duo karda guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, maro alaikh'i k'avme, ki dar zamin bo nashri kufr va ma'siiatkh'oi makhsusan k'abekh' fasodkori mekunand, nusrat bidekh'."

31) Va chun farishtagoni firistodai Mo nazdi Ibrokh'im omada, uro ba Iskh'ok' va ba'd az Iskh'ok' ba pisarash Ia'k'ub muzhda dodand, ba vai guftand: "Beshak, mo akh'li in dekh'ai "Sadum"-i k'avmi Lutro kh'alok megardonem. Kh'amono akh'li in dekh'a ba sababi sodir kardani amali fakh'shi bachabozi sitamkorand."

32) Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba farishtagon guft: "Ba durusti, dar on dekh'ae, ki shumo mekhokh'ed akh'lashro kh'alok gardoned, Lut ast. U az zolimon nest." Farishtagon guftand: "Dar borai on kasone, ki dar in dekh'a mavch'udand, mo ogokh'ii beshtar dorem. Mo iak'inan Lutro bo akh'lash az kh'alokati bar sokinoni in dekh'a nozilshavanda nach'ot medikh'em, magar kh'amsarash, ki vai az zumrai bok'imondagoni kh'alokshavanda boshad. Uro bo kh'amrakh'onash kh'alok megardonem."

33) Va chun farishtagoni firistodai Mo baroi kh'aloksozii k'avmi Lut (alaikh'is salom) nazdash omadand, omadani onkh'o Lutro badkh'ol va diltang sokht, zero u az k'avmash kh'aros dosht, ki nisbat ba in mekh'monkh'o dastdarozi nakunand, chunki farishtagon ba surati mard omada budand va k'avmi Lut (alaikh'is salom) ba ch'oi zankh'o bo mardkh'o omezish mekardand. Va farishtagon ba Lut guftand: "Natars. K'avmat ba tu oseb rasonida nametavonand. Va az on ki turo az kh'alok gardonidani onkh'o ogokh' namudem, g'amgin mashav. Kh'amono Mo tu va khonadonatro az kh'alokat nach'ot medikh'em, ch'uz kh'amsarat, ki az ch'umlai bok'imondagoni kh'alokshavanda boshad. Uro bo kh'amrakh'onash iakch'o kh'alok khokh'em kard.

34) Ba durusti, mo bar sari akh'li in dekh'ai bachaboz ba sababi on ki doim az toati Khudo berun meshavand va amali fakh'sh anch'om medikh'and, baroi uk'ubatashon az osmon uk'ubati buzurgero furud meorem. On uk'ubati az osmon nozilshavanda az sang-gilkh'o iborat ast."

36) Va ba sui Madian barodari nasabiashon Shuaibro firistodem. Pas Shuaib guft: "Ei k'avmi man, tankh'o Allokh'ro biparasted va bo ibodati U podoshi ruzi okhiratro umed namoed va dar zamin ba sababi sodir namudani gunokh' va nashri on fasodkori makuned."

37) Ba'dan k'avmash uro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand. Ba sababi in kor onkh'oro zilzilai sakht faro girift. Pas dar manzilashon bar rui aftoda gashtand, dar kh'ole ki ruiashon ba khok chaspida bud va kh'arakat namekardand.

38) Va Mo inchunin Odi k'avmi Kh'ud va Samudi k'avmi Solekh'ro kh'alok sokhtem. Va ei akh'li Makka, az maskankh'oi in du k'avm dar "Kh'ich'r" va "Shich'r"-i shakh'ri Kh'azramavt - iake az kalontarin shakh'rkh'oi Iaman - ba shumo ma'lum shuda ast, ki onkh'o kh'alok sokhta shudaand. Maskankh'oi fururekhtaashon shokh'idi kh'alokati onkh'ost. Va Shaiton ba onkh'o amalkh'oi kufr va digar ma'siiatkh'oro zinat bakhshid, pas onkh'oro az rokh'i rost bargardond. Va k'avmi Odu Samud chun paiombaronashon ba onkh'o ta'lim dodaand, sokh'ibi chashmi bino va ak'lu idrok budand, kh'ak'ik'at va zalolat, rokh'i rost va kach'ro medidand va mefakh'midand, vale bo in vuch'ud pairavii kh'idoiatro tark karda, tobei khokh'ishoti nafsi khesh shudand.

39) Va K'orunro - chun bar k'avmi Muso tug'ion namud va mag'rur gasht - kh'amrokh'i shukukh'ash bo furu burdanash ba zeri zamin va Fir'avn va vazirash K'orunro bo g'ark' kunonidan dar bakh'r nobud kardem. Va Muso begumon ba onkh'o oiatkh'oi ravshani nishondikh'andai sidk'ashro ovard, pas onkh'o dar sarzamini Misr az imon ovardan ba u kibr varzidand va tavoni az Mo rakh'oi iofta, az azobamon solim mondanro nadoshtand.

40) Pas kh'ama kasoni dar guzashta zikrshudaro ba ivazi gunokh'ashon bo uk'ubati Khesh kh'alok gardonidem. Pas az bainashon k'avmi Lutand, ki Mo bar in k'avm bodi shadidi kh'amrokh' bo sang-gilro firistodem. Va az bainashon k'avmi Solekh' va k'avmi Shuaiband, ki fariodi shadid onkh'oro faro girift. Va az bainashon K'orun ast, ki uro bo kh'amai molikiiatash ba zamin furu burdem. Va az bainashon k'avmi Nukh', Fir'avn va Kh'omon kh'astand, ki onkh'oro bo g'ark'sozi dar dario kh'alok gardonidem. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i in nombarshudakh'o sitam nakarda va onkh'oro biduni ch'urm kh'alok nasokhta ast, vale eshon khud bo sodir kardani ma'siiat bar ch'oni kheshtan zulm karda, sazovori azob gashtand.

41) Dostoni kasone, ki g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) butkh'oro ma'bud megirand va ba umedi manfiat io shafoat onkh'oro meparastand, monandi dostoni tortanak ast. Tortanak baroi kh'imoiai khud az kh'ar nav' dastdarozi khonae megirad va kh'ol on ki khonai tortanak begumon notavontarini khonakh'o buda, uro az dushman kh'imoiat karda nametavonad. Butkh'oi mushrikon niz kh'amin guna kh'astand. K'udrati onro nadorand, ki ba parastandagonashon sud io ziion rasonand. Agar mushrikon in kh'ak'ik'atro medonistand, kh'ech' gokh' ch'uz Parvardigori Iagona ma'budi digar namegiriftand.

42) Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro mushrikon ba ch'uz U ibodat mekunand, medonad. Kh'ech' chize az U pushida nest. Va U G'olibi shikastnopazir buda, dar ofarinish, tak'dir va chorasozii korkh'o bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

43) Va Mo in masalkh'oro baroi mardum baion mekunem, to onkh'oro az khobi g'aflat bedor sozad va dar didani kh'ak' bino gardonad va ba sui kh'ak' rakh'namoi kunad. Va in masalkh'oro ch'uz bandagoni donandai shariat va kh'ikmatkh'oi ilokh'i kase ba tavri zaruri dark namekunad.

44) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) osmonkh'o va zaminro ba kh'ak' ofarida, on duro bekh'uda khalk' nakarda ast. Kh'amono dar in ofarinish baroi mu'minon daleli ravshani nishondikh'andai k'udrati Khudost. Chunki akh'li imon az kh'astii makhluk'ot bar vuch'udi bezavoli Parvardigor va loik'i ibodat budani U pai mebarand. Ammo kofiron az nazdi nishonakh'oi k'udrati ilokh'i dar ch'akh'oni kh'asti meguzarand, ammo az on ibrat namegirand va ba azamati Ofaridgor pai namebarand.

45) Ei Paiombar, on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tu az K'ur'on furud ovarda ast, bar mardum tilovat kun va namozro dar komiltarin surat ich'ro namo. Ba durusti ki namozi ba tavri sakh'ekh' ich'roshuda sokh'ibashro az aftidan dar gunokh' va amalkh'oi nopisand boz medorad. Zero namozi sakh'ekh' ba ch'o ovardashuda dar k'albi banda nurero ech'od menamoiad, ki uro az sodir namudani gunokh' boz medorad va ba anch'omi amalkh'oi shoista rakh'namoi mekunad. Va iak'inan zikri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'ar chiz buzurgtar ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar on chi mekuned, medonad. Kh'ech' amali shumo az Khudo makhfi nest. Albatta, ba shumo dar ivazi kirdoraton ch'azo khokh'ad dod. Agar amali shoista karded, podoshi nek va agar amali bad anch'om doded, ch'azoi bad megired.

46) Va ei mu'minon, bo iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob ch'uz bo uslubi nektarin va ravishi olitarin, ki az da'vat bo mav'iza va kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ravshan iborat ast, guftugu va ch'idol makuned, magar on kasone az onkh'o, ki bo sarkashi va iakravi dar bakh's zulm namudand va alaikh'i shumo ch'ang e'lon kardand, pas dar in surat to vak'ti paziruftani Islom io bo khori pardokhtani ch'izia (moliiot) muk'obilashon bich'anged. Va ba iakh'udu nasoro bigued: "Mo ba on K'ur'one, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro ba mo furud ovarda va on Tavrot va Inch'ile, ki on duro ba shumo nozil karda ast, imon ovardaem. Va Ma'budi mo va Ma'budi shumo iakest, dar kholik'iiat, ibodat va sifot sharik nadorad va mo tankh'o mute' va taslimshudagoni U kh'astem."

47) Va chunonchi bar paiombaroni k'abl az tu Kitob furud ovardem, kh'amin tavr K'ur'onro bar tu nozil kardem. Pas ba'zei kasone, ki Mo ba onkh'o Kitobi Tavrotro dodaem, chun onro tilovat kunand, ba K'ur'on imon meorand, zero eshon dar Kitobkh'oiashon vasfi K'ur'onro meioband. Chunonchi Abdullokh' ibni Salom (r) imon ovarda bud. Va az mushrikon ba'zeashon ba K'ur'on imon meorand. Va ba oiatkh'oi Mo ch'uz kofirone, ki odatashon kufr varzidan va inkori kh'ak' ast, kase kofir nameshavad.

48) Va ei Paiombar, tu k'abl az K'ur'on kh'ech' kitobero khondan va bo dasti rostat chizero navishtan nametavonisti. Zero tu shakhse budi, ki savodi khondan va navishtan nadoshti. Va agar tu khondan va navishtan metavonisti, kh'atman mardumi nodon dar paiombariat shak mekardand va in makh'orati turo bakh'ona megiriftand, ki K'ur'onro az Kitobkh'oi guzashta rubardor kardai.

49) Balki K'ur'oni bar tu Paiombar nozilshuda oiatkh'oi ravshanest, ki dar k'albi mu'minone, ki ba onkh'o ilm doda shuda ast, ch'oi girifta ast. Va oiatkh'oi Moro ba ch'uz onkh'oe, ki bo kufr va shirk bar khud sitam kardaand, kase inkor namekunad.

50) Va mushrikon meguiand: "Charo chunone ba paiombaroni sobik' mu'ch'izakh'o doda meshud, ba Mukh'ammad az nazdi Parvardigorash chunin mu'ch'izakh'o nozil karda nashuda ast?" Ei Paiombar, ba in toifai mu'ch'izatalab bigu: "Kh'amono furud ovardani mu'ch'izakh'o dar dasti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'ar gokh' khokh'ad, onro nozil mekunad. In ba man vobastagi nadorad. Man baroi shumo az omadani azobi ilokh'i tankh'o bimdikh'andai oshkoram."

51) Ei Paiombar, oio baroi in ch'amoai mu'ch'izatalab basanda nest, ki Mo bar tu K'ur'onro furud ovardem, dar kh'ole ki in Kitob bar onkh'o tilovat meshavad. Kh'amono dar K'ur'on baroi k'avme, ki imon meorand, rakh'mat va pand ast. Mu'minon az irshodoti K'ur'on foida mebarand. Kitobi ba in k'avmi mu'ch'izakhokh' nozilshuda az mu'ch'izakh'oi khostaashon bekh'tar va sudmandtar ast.

53) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Khudo ba sifati Shokh'id bar rostguii man dar on chi ovardaam va bar takzibi shumo basanda ast. On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, medonad. Dar osmon va zamin chize az Khudo pinkh'on namemonad. Va kasone, ki ba botil - kh'ar chi g'air az Khudo parastida shavad - imon meorand va ba Khudoi iagona loik'i ibodat kofir meshavand, in toifa ziiondidagoni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand. Zero onkh'o imonro bo kufr ivaz kardaand."

53) Va ei Paiombar, mushrikon az tu zudtar nozil kardani azobero, ki onkh'oro az omadanash kh'ushdor medikh'i, metalaband. Va agar mukh'lati baroi much'ozotashon muk'addarsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki tak'dim va ta'khir nameshavad, namebud, ba onkh'o k'at'an azobi talab namudaashon meomad. Va beshubkh'a, azob ba onkh'o nogakh'on meoiad va onro ekh'sos namekunand va intizorii omadanashro nadorand.
54) Onkh'o az tu zudtar ovardani azobi va'da dodaatro metalaband va kh'amono duzakhe, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro baroi akh'li kufr va'da namuda ast, ikh'otakunandai kofiron ast.

55) Ruze, ki uk'ubat onkh'oro az boloiashon faro megirad va az zeri poikh'oiashon chun bistari khobashon megardad [Ia'ne, azobi ch'akh'annam onkh'oro az kh'ar taraf ikh'ota mekunad] va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo sarzanish ba onkh'o meguiad: "Ch'azoi shirk va ma'siiatero, ki dar dunio anch'om medoded, bichashed."

56) Ei bandagonam, ki ba Man imon ovardaed, az sarzamine, ki dar on Maro osoishta ibodat karda nametavoned, kh'ich'rat namoed. Kh'amono zamini Man pakh'novar ast. Pas tankh'o Maro biparasted va chizero ba Man sharik masozed.
57) Naboiad tarsi marg shumoro az kh'ich'rat namudan boz dorad. Kh'ar kas chashandai marg ast. Sipas ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va ch'azo tankh'o ba sui Man bargardonida meshaved.

58) Va kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaand va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, kh'amono Mo onkh'oro dar manzilkh'oi baland dar ch'annat, ki az zeri on rudrkh'o ch'ori meboshad, sokin megardonem, onkh'o dar on ch'o ch'ovidon monda, fano nameshavand. In podoshi mu'minoni boamal chi podoshi neke ast,-
59) on mu'minoni boamale, ki dar ibodat va tarki ma'siiat sabr menamoiand va dar tamomi korkh'oiashon tankh'o ba Parvardigorashon takia mekunand.

60) Chi baso ziiodand ch'onvarone, ki rizk'ashonro ch'am'ovari kardan va bardoshtan nametavonand, onkh'o va shumoro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi medikh'ad. Binobar in, shumo az tarsi gurusnagi bar tarki kh'ich'rat ma'zur nested. Va U Shunavandai guftorkh'o, Donandai mak'sad va korkh'oi shumost. Kh'ech chiz az U pushida nest va ba shumo dar badali kh'ar sukhan va amalaton podosh khokh'ad dod.

61) Va agar tu Paiombar az in mushrikon bipursi, ki: "Osmonkh'o va zaminro ki ofarida va oftob va mokh'ro, ki paii iakdigar meoiand, ki rom karda ast?", onkh'o begumon dar posukh meguiand: "Onkh'oro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ofarida ast". Modom ki onkh'o ba in e'tirof dorand, pas chi guna az imon ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardonida meshavand va ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oero meparastand, ki sud io ziion rasonida nametavonand?!

62) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az rui kh'ikmati ba Khud ma'lum az bandagonash baroi kh'ar ki khokh'ad, rizk'ro farokh va baroi kh'ar ki khokh'ad, onro tang mesozad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai kh'ama chiz ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nest. On chi ba bandagonash sud merasonad, medonad.

63) Va ei Paiombar, agar az mushrikon bipursi, ki: "Az osmon obro ki furud ovard, ba'dan bo on zaminro pas az on ki khushkida bud, ruionid?", onkh'o kh'atman meguiand: "Boronro az osmon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furud ovarda, bo on zaminro ruionid." Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Sitoish Allokh'i mutaolro, ki alaikh'i shumo kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan ovard." Balki kh'osili kor on ast, ki beshtarashon nameandeshand. Zero agar andesha mekardand, kh'ech' gokh' on ma'budkh'oero, ki foida va zarar namerasonand, nameparastidand.

64) Va in zindagonii dunio bo lazzatkh'o va matoi dar on mavch'ud baroi dilbokhtagonash ba g'air az sargarmi va bozi chize nest. Zud fano meshavad. Va kh'amono saroi okhirat kh'aioti vok'ei ast. Chunki on poidor memonad. Agar in kh'ak'ik'atro medonistand, kh'ech' gokh' dunioi fanopazirro az k'arorgokh'i abadi muk'addam nameguzoshtand.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi k'abli tanok'uzi e'tik'odii mushrikonro zikr kard, ki bo vuch'udi e'tirof ba on ki Allokh' iagona Ofaridgor ast, dar ma'budiiat ba U shirk meorand, dar oiati zerin ziddiiati ak'idavii digarashonro baion namud. Vak'te ki mushrikon dar kh'olati tars k'aror girand, masalan az g'ark' shudan dar dario khavf doshta boshand, kholisona ba Parvardigor rui ovarda, iltich'o mekunand, ammo ba much'arradi az in vaz'i tarsnok rakh'o gashtan dubora ba shirki kheshtan barmegardand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ishora ba kh'amin nokh'amvorii ak'idavii mushrikon guft:
65) Va chun mushrikon dar dario ba kishtikh'o savor meshavand, tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro mekhonand, Uro kholisona duo mekunand, to onkh'oro az g'ark' shudan nach'ot dikh'ad. Pas chun onkh'oro az g'ark'shavi nach'ot doda, ba khushki rasonad, nogakh'on ba kh'olati shirki kheshtan bargashta, ma'budkh'oiashonro meparastand.

66) Onkh'o shirk meorand, to in ki ba on chi az ne'matkh'o baroiashon in'om namudaem, nosiposi kunand va to in ki az matoi zavoliobandai zindagonii dunio bakh'ramand gardand. Pas iak'inan ba'di marg farch'omi badashonro khokh'and donist.

67) Oio munkironi ne'mati nach'otiobi az dario ekh'soni digari Moro nadidand, ki baroi onkh'o Makkaro sarzamini makh'fuzi doroi amniiat gardonidem, dar on khun va molashon dar amon ast va dar aini zamon digar mardumi atrofashon rabuda meshavand, mavridi kh'uch'um k'aror megirand, ba k'atl merasand, asir meaftand, zanon va farzandonashon kaniz va g'ulom megardand va amvolashon rabuda meshavad. Oio onkh'o ba botil (ma'budkh'oi sun'i) imon meorand va nisbat ba ne'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nosiposi karda, shukrguzori namekunand?!

68) Kh'ech' kas az bandae, ki bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' bofta, ba U sharikero nisbat medikh'ad io kh'ak'ik'ati ovardai Paiombarashro vak'te ba vai meoiad, durug' medonad, zolimtar nest. Oio dar duzakh baroi kofiron va amsoli onkh'o ch'oi nest?! Albatta, kh'ast.

69) Va kasone, ki ba khotiri talabi rizoi Mo muk'obili dushman va nafsashon ch'ikh'od mekunand, iak'inan onkh'oro baroi paido kardani rokh'i durustamon kh'idoiat menamoem. Va kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo nusrat, madad va kh'idoiati Khesh kh'amrokh'i mu'minon ast.
1) "Alif. Lom. Mim." Dar ibtidoi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) Fors Rumro mag'lub sokht.
3) In mag'lubiiat dar nazdiktarin sarzamini Rum ba kishvarkh'oi Fors, ki atrofi Shom bud, surat girift. Va rumikh'o ba zudi ba'd az shikastashon dubora forskh'oro mag'lub megardonand.

4) In g'olibiiati rumikh'o dar zarfi chand sol, ia'ne na kamtar az se va na beshtar az dakh' sol ba vuk'u' mepaivandad. Tamomi kor k'abl az piruzii rumikh'o va ba'd az on dar ikhtiiori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va ruze, ki rumikh'o forskh'oro shikast medikh'and, mu'minon khushkh'ol meshavand.

5) Onkh'o ba sababi nusrat dodani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba rumikh'o khushkh'ol meshavand. Zero mardumi Rum akh'li Kitob kh'astand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro muk'obili kh'ar ki khokh'ad, nusrat medikh'ad. Va U G'olibi Shikastnopazir buda, nisbat ba bandagonash bag'oiat Mekh'rubon ast.

6) In g'olibiiat va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. U ba in va'dai Khesh khilof namekunad. Bo takh'ak'k'uk' ioftani on iak'ini akh'li imon ba va'dai ilokh'i dar borai piruz shudanashon afzun meshavad. Ammo aksari mardum ba illati kufrashon inro namefakh'mand.

7) Onkh'o imonu akh'komi shariatro namedonand. Tankh'o zokh'iri kh'aioti dunioro, ki ba kasbi ruzi va buniodi tamadduni moddi taalluk' dorad, medonand va onkh'o az okhirat, ki saroi kh'aioti ch'ovidon ast, dar g'aflat va ruigardon buda, nisbat ba on parvo nadorand.

8) Oio in mushrikoni takzibgar dar borai khud nameandeshand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro chi guna ofarida va andomashonro barobar sokhta ast?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini on duro ch'uz ba kh'ak' va mukh'lati muaiian naofarida ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) makhluk'oti nombarshudaro az rui kh'ikmat khalk' karda, baroi bak'oi onkh'o dar dunio mukh'lati muaiian guzoshta ast. Va beshak, bisiori mardum ba mulok'oti Parvardigorashon dar k'iiomat k'at'an kofirand. Binobar in, bo anch'omi korkh'oi shoistai mavridi rizoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi rastokhez omodagi namebinand.

9) Oio onkh'o dar zamin sairu saiokh'at nakardand, to andesha namoiand, ki farch'omi ummatkh'oi k'abl az eshon guzashta bo chi anch'omid?! Onkh'o az inkh'o nerumandtar budand, zaminro baroi ziroat va imoratsozi zeru ru kardand va onro beshtar az on chi inkh'o obod kardand, obod namudand va paiombaronashon ba onkh'o dalelkh'oi vozekh'i isbotkunandai iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ovardand. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o sitam nakarda ast, balki onkh'o ba sababi kufr varzidan khud bar ch'oni khud sitam kardaand.

10) Sipas farch'omi on kasone, ki a'molashon bo shirk ovardan va sodir kardani gunokh'on bad bud, bisior zisht gardid, chunki onkh'o oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro durug' shumurdand va paivasta onro maskhara mekardand.

11) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ofarinishi mardumro biduni namunai guzashta og'oz mekunad, ba'dan onkh'oro memironad, sipas onkh'oro boz barmegardonad. Sipas shumo ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani podosh tankh'o ba sui U bozgardonida meshaved.

12) Va ruzi barposhavii k'iiomat mushrikon az rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) noumed meshavand va umedashon az U k'at' megardad. Chunki onch'o baroi isboti durustii kufrashon kh'uch'ch'at ovarda nametavonand.

13) Va onkh'oro az ma'budkh'oiashon, ki dar dunio ibodat mekardand, shafoatkunandagone naboshad, to az azobi ilokh'i rakh'oiashon sozad va ba ma'budkh'oiashon kofir megardand. Zero khudoioni sun'iashon dar vak'ti niiozmandi ioriashon rasonida nametavonand. Kh'amagi kh'alok meshavand.
14) Va ruzi barposhavii k'iiomat mardum ba e'tibori amalkh'oi dar dunio ich'ro kardaashon dar giriftani podosh ch'udo meshavand. Iak gurukh' ba ch'annat va iak gurukh'i digar ba duzakh meravand.
15) Va ammo on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista mekunand, pas onkh'o dar bikh'isht bo noil gashtan ba ne'matkh'oi abadi khushkh'ol megardand.

16) Va on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir meshavand va oiatkh'oi bar Paiombar firistodai Mo va rastokhezu bozpursii ruzi okhiratro durug' mekh'isoband, pas onkh'o baroi uk'ubat kh'ozir kunonida shuda, ba on vorid gashta, onch'o abadi memonand.
17) Pas vak'te ba shabongokh' (vak'ti namozi shomu khuftan) va vak'te ba subkh' (vak'ti namozi bomdod) vorid shaved, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba poki iod kuned.

18) Va sitoish dar osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Khudost. Dar osmonkh'o farishtagon va dar zamin digar mavch'udot Uro sipos meguiand. Va chun ba okhiri ruz (vak'ti namozi asr) va nimruzi (vak'ti namozi peshin) daroed, Uro ba poki iod kuned.

19) U zindaro az murda berun meorad - monandi berun ovardani inson az nutfa va murg' az tukhm - va murdaro az zinda berun meorad - monandi berun ovardani nutfa az inson va tukhm az murg' - va zaminro pas az khushkiash bo rekhtani boron va ruionidani giiokh'on zinda mesozad. Va chunonchi zamin ba'd az khushki va bekh'osili zinda gardid, shumo niz kh'amin guna baroi bozpursi va giriftani podosh az k'abrkh'oiaton berun karda meshaved.

20) Va az nishonakh'oi boazamati Khudo, ki k'udrat va vakh'doniiati Uro nishon medikh'ad, on ast, ki shumo mardumro az khok ofarid, on gokh', ki padaraton Odamro az on kh'ast namud. Sipas shumo nogakh'on bo mururi zamon ba odami tabdil shuda, ba vasilai naslgiri afzun gardida, dar shark'u g'arbi zamin parokanda shuded.

21) Va az nishonakh'oi boazamati Khudo, ki k'udrat va vakh'doniiati Uro nishon medikh'ad, on ast, ki baroi shumo mardon az nav'i khudi shumo ch'uftkh'oro ofarid, to az sababi on ki baini shumo va zankh'o kh'amnav'i vuch'ud dorad, nafsaton bo onkh'o orom girad va bainaton mukh'abbat va shafk'atro k'aror dod. Kh'amono dar on chi zikr gardid, baroi k'avme, ki andesha mekunand, dalel va rakh'namoikh'oi ravshan ast. Zero tankh'o akh'li khirad ak'li khudro ba kor medarorand va sud mebarand.

22) Va az nishonakh'oi boazamati Khudo, ki k'udrat va vakh'doniiati Uro nishon medikh'ad, ofaridani osmonkh'o va zamin va gunogunii zabonkh'o va rangkh'oi shumost. Kh'amono dar on chi zikr gasht, baroi kasone, ki doroi donish va chashmi botin kh'astand, dalel va rakh'namoikh'oi ravshan ast.

23) Va az nishonakh'oi boazamati Khudo, ki k'udrat va vakh'doniiati Uro nishon medikh'ad, khobidanaton dar shab va ruz ast, to az ranch'i koraton istirokh'at kuned va ruz dar paii ch'ustani rizk' az Parvardigor shaved. Kh'amono dar on chi zikr gasht, baroi k'avme, ki sukhanro bo tafakkur gush mekunand va onro amali mesozand, dalel va rakh'namoikh'oi ravshan ast.

24) Va az nishonakh'oi boazamati Khudo, ki az k'udratu vakh'doniiati U darak medikh'ad, on ast, ki dar osmon ba shumo bark'ro nishon medikh'ad, dar kh'ole ki az otashakkh'o metarsed va ba boron tama' mekuned va baroi shumo az osmon obi boronro furud meorad, pas bo on zaminro ba'd az khushkiash bo ruionidani rastanikh'o zinda mesozad. Kh'amono dar on chi zikr karda shud, baroi k'avme, ki meandeshand va bo in nishonakh'o bar kh'ak'ik'ati rastokhez pai mebarand, dalel va rakh'namoikh'oi ravshan ast.

25) Va az nishonakh'oi boazamati Khudo, ki k'udrat va vakh'doniiati Uro nishon medikh'ad, on ast, ki osmon va zamin bo khosti U pobarch'o buda, na osmon meaftad va na zamin kharob meshavad. Sipas vak'te U shumoro bo damindani farishta dar sur bo da'vate az zamin faro khonad, nogakh'on shumo baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo az k'abrkh'oiaton berun meoed.
26) Va kh'ar ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin vuch'ud dorad, az rui molikiiat, ofarinish va tak'dir tankh'o az oni Ust. Tamomi mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va zamin mute' va taslimi amri U kh'astand.

27) Va U Zotest, ki biduni namunai sobik' khalk'ro paido mesozad, sipas ba'd az fano sokhtan onro boz barmegardonad va bargardonidan baroi U az bori nakhust ofaridanash osontar ast. Albatta, kh'ar du kh'am nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oson ast. Zero agar Parvardigor khalk' kardani chizero khokh'ad, bo guftani "Kh'ast shav" onro ba vuch'ud meorad. Va dar kh'ar sifate az sifatkh'oi ifodagari kamol sifati balandtarin az Ust. Va U Zoti G'olib buda, dar ofarinish va ta'iini tak'dir Bokh'ikmat ast.

28) Ei mushrikon, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo dostoni bargirifta az khudi shumoro baion namuda ast. Oio az baini g'ulomon va kanizonaton sharikone dored, ki bo shumo dar kh'ar on chi ruziaton dodaem, shariki barobar boshand, chunonchi ba'zeaton az shariki ozodash metarsad, ki molashro bo u tak'sim mekunad, az g'ulomonu kanizonaton bitarsed, ki bo shumo molatonro tak'sim mekunand?! Oio nisbat ba khesh az g'ulomon va kanizonaton inro mepisanded?! Albatta, namepisanded. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on ki az makhluk'otash sharik nadoshta boshad, loik'tar ast. Mo dalelkh'oi mukhtalifro kh'amin guna bo ovardani masalkh'o baroi k'avme, ki meandeshand, baion mesozem.

29) Sababi gumrokh'ii kasone, ki zulm kardaand, komil nabudani kh'uch'ch'at io adami mavch'udiiati on nest, balki onkh'o az sababi on ki kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bar kheshtan namedonand, az khokh'ishoti nafsashon pairavi karda, ba guzashtagonashon tak'lid namudaand. Pas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kasro gumrokh' sozad, ki uro kh'idoiat karda metavonad?! Kh'ech' kas az ukh'dai in kor namebaroiad. Va onkh'o iovarone nadorand, ki uk'ubati ilokh'iro az eshon bartaraf kunad.

30) Pas, ei Paiombar, tu (va pairavonat) az kh'ama dinkh'o rui tofta, ba Islom, ki ba on rakh'namoi shudai, ru ovarda, dar on ustuvor bimon, dine, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mardumro bar on sirishta ast. Ofarinishi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro digarguni nest. In dini durust ast, lekin beshtari mardum kh'ak' budani onro namedonand.

31) Bo tavba namudan az gunokh'oni khesh ba sui Khudo bargarded va bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot az U bitarsed va namozro dar komiltarin surati on barpo sozed va az ch'umlai mushrikon maboshed, ki bar khilofi fitrati solim amal karda, dar ibodat ba Khudo shirk meorand,-

32) az on mushrikone, ki dinashonro digargun sokhta, ba ba'zei on imon ovarda, ba ba'zeash kofir gashta, ba gurukh'kh'o ch'udo shudaand. Kh'ar gurukh' bo botili nazdi khesh khushkh'oland. Tankh'o khudro kh'ak' va digaronro nokh'ak' medonand.

33) Va vak'te ba mushrikon sakhtie ba monandi bemori, tangdasti, k'akh'tsoli va g'aira birasad, tankh'o Parvardigorashonro duo mekunand, bo iltich'o va zori ba suiash barmegardand, to on dushvoriro az onkh'o dur sozad. Sipas chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo bartaraf sokhtani on sakhti ba onkh'o az rakh'matash bichashonad, nogakh'on gurukh'eashon ba kh'olati k'abli bargashta, dar duo va ibodat makhluk'otro shariki Parvardigorashon mesozand.

34) Biguzor ba ne'matkh'oe, ki ba onkh'o dodaem, az ch'umla ba ne'mati dur sokhtani bemori, tangdasti, k'akh'tsoli va g'aira nosiposi kunand. Ba'dan az on chi dar in dunio mavch'ud ast, bakh'ramand shaved, pas begumon ruzi k'iiomat bo chashmoni khud khokh'ed did va khokh'ed donist, ki shumo dar zalolati oshkor ba sar meburded.

35) Chi bois gashta ast, ki onkh'o ba Khudo shirk meorand va kh'ol on ki dar borai isboti durustii amali khesh kh'uch'ch'at nadorand?! Mo bar onkh'o kh'uch'ch'at va kitobe furud naovardaem, ki oidi shirk ovardanashon az on istidlol kunand va on kh'uch'ch'atu kitob ba durustii shirkashon dalolat namuda, sakh'ekh' budani kufrashonro isbot sozad.

36) Va chun ba mardum az ne'matkh'oi Khesh ba monandi tandurusti va tavongari ne'matero chashonem, bo on mag'rurona khushkh'ol meshavand. Va agar ba onkh'o ba sababi gunokh'onashon sakhtie ba monandi tangdasti va bemori rasad, ki g'amginashon mesozad, nogakh'on onkh'o az rakh'mati Khudo va khotima ioftani in sakhtikh'o noumed meshavand.

37) Oio namebinand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az bandagonash ba kh'ar kas khokh'ad, bo mak'sadi ozmoishi siposguzori va nosiposiash rizk'ashro farokh va bo mak'sadi ozmoishi sabr va besabriash onro tang mesozad?! Kh'amono dar farokhruzi sokhtani ba'ze va tangruzi sokhtani ba'zei digar baroi mu'minon dalolatkh'oi ravshani lutf va rakh'mati ilokh'ist.

38) Pas, ei musalmon, ba kheshat kh'ak'k'i neki va paivandi kheshiashro bidekh' va ba mukh'toch' on mik'dor, ki kh'och'atashro dur sozad va ba g'aribi az vatanash dur sadak'a bidekh'. In kharch'i doroi dar rokh'kh'oi mazkur baroi kasone, ki podoshi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro mekhokh'and, bekh'tar ast. Va bandagone, ki chunin kumakkh'oro anch'om medikh'and, bo noil gashtan ba ch'annat va solim mondan az ch'akh'annam rastagoroni vok'ei kh'astand.

Chun dar oiati mazkur a'moli vaslkunanda ba Khudo ovarda shud, dar oiati zerin korkh'oero baion namud, ki kh'adaf az on na kasbi rizoi ilokh'i, balki ba dast ovardani matoi nochizi dunio ast.
39) Va on chi ba mardum az amvoli khud medikh'ed, bo mak'sadi on ki onkh'o molkh'oiatonro bo ilovagi (ribo) baroiaton bargardonand, pas on nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ziiod nameshavad. Va on chi az amvoli khesh ba shakhsi niiozmand medikh'ed, dar kh'ole shumo bo in amali khud rizoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro khosta, mak'sadaton kasbi mak'om io ba dast ovardani moli mardum nest, pas inkh'o kh'amon kasoneand, ki ach'rashon nazdi Khudo duchand meshavad.

40) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iagona Zotest, ki shumoro ofarida, sipas ruziaton doda, ba'dan shumoro memironad, sipas az nav zindaaton megardonad. Oio az butkh'oiaton, ki onkh'oro ba sifati sharikoni U meparasted, kase az in korkh'oi nombarshuda chizero ich'ro karda metavonad?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mushrikon meguiand va e'tik'od dorand, Pok va Bartar ast.

41) Tabokh'i -ba monandi khushksoli, kamshavii boron va afzoishi bemoriiu vabokh'o- dar khushki va dario ba sababi gunokh'oni sodirnamudai mardum oshkor gardid. In tabokh'i zokh'ir shud, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dunio ba onkh'o ch'azoi ba'zei korkh'oi badashonro dikh'ad, to bo tavba kardan ba sui U bargardand.

42) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Dar zamin sairu saiokh'at kuned. Pas dar borai ummatkh'oi guzashtai takzibgar biandeshed, ki ok'ibati onkh'o bo chi anch'omid. Khotimai korashon bisior bo badi anch'omid. Aksariiati onkh'o mushrik budand. Ba Allokh'i Iagona shirk meovardand. Binobar in, onkh'o kh'alok gardonida shudand."

43) Pas, ei Paiombar, k'abl az omadani ruzi k'iiomat, ki vak'te barpo shavad, kase onro bargardonda nametavonad, ruiatro ba sui dini Islom rost kun. Dar on ruz mardum ch'udo meshavand. Iak gurukh' ba sui ch'annat ravon shuda, ba ne'mati abadi merasand va iak gurukh'i digar giriftori azobi duzakh megardand.

44) Kh'ar ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shavad, pas ziioni kufrash, ki dar duzakh ch'ovid mondan ast, ba khudash barmegardad. Va kh'ar ki bo mak'sadi talabi rizoi Khudo amali shoista anch'om dikh'ad, pas onkh'o baroi kheshtan daromadani ch'annat va az ne'matkh'oi on ba tavri abadi bakh'ra burdanro omoda mesozand.

45) Mardum ruzi k'iiomat ch'udo meshavand, to in ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on kasone, ki imon ovardaand va amalkh'oi shoistai mavridi rizoi Uro anch'om dodaand, az fazlu ekh'sonash podosh dikh'ad. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shakhsonero, ki ba U va paiombaronash kofir meshavand, dust namedorad, balki ba onkh'o sakht nafrat doshta, dar okhirat sakht azobashon medikh'ad.

46) Va az nishonakh'oi boazamati Khudo, ki k'udrat va vakh'doniiati Uro nishon medikh'ad, firistodani bodkh'oi muzhdarason ast, ki bandagonro ba nazdikshavii rekhtani boron bashorat medikh'and va to Parvardigor ba shumo mardum bo on chi ba'd az boron az sarsabzi va khurrami kh'osil megardad, az rakh'mati Khesh bichashonad va to kishtikh'o dar bakh'r bo khosti U kh'arakat kunand va to bo tich'orati bakh'ri az fazli U ruzi bitalabed va to shukri ne'matkh'oiashro ba ch'o ored va in shukrguzori boisi afzun shudani ruziaton gardad.

47) Va ei Paiombar, Mo begumon k'abl az tu paiombaroni ziiodero ba sui ummatkh'oiashon firistodem. Pas onkh'o ba k'avmashon kh'uch'ch'atkh'oero, ki rostguiashonro nishon medod, ovardand. K'avmashon paig'omi ovardai paiombaronashonro takzib kardand. Ba kh'amin sabab, Mo az kasone, ki amalkh'oi bad anch'om dodand, intik'om girifta, onkh'oro bo uk'ubati Khud kh'alok sokhtem va paiombaronro bo mu'minoni pairavashon az kh'alokat nach'ot dodem. Va nach'otu nusrat dodani mu'minon kh'ak'k'est, ki Mo onro bar Khesh kh'atmi gardonidaem.

48) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki bodkh'oro mefiristad, pas bodkh'o abrkh'oro ba kh'arakat medarorand, pas U abrkh'oro dar osmon kam io ziiod, kh'ar guna, ki khokh'ad, pakh'n mesozad va abrkh'oro k'it'a-k'it'a megardonad. Pas tu ei binanda, mushokh'ida mekuni, ki az baini on abrkh'o boron berun meoiad. Pas chun Parvardigor ba bandagoni khostaash boronro rasonad, nogakh'on onkh'o az rakh'mati ilokh'i, ki baroiashon boron nozil karda va on boisi ruiidani nabototi zamin va farokh'am shudani niiozmandikh'oi khud va chorpokh'oiashon gashta ast, khushkh'ol meshavand.
49) Va albatta, onkh'o k'abl az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar eshon boron nozil sozad, az nuzuli on noumed budand.

50) Pas, ei Paiombar, ba osori boron, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo rakh'mati Khud onro bar bandagonash furud meorad, binigar, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zaminro ba'd az bekh'osili chi guna bo ruionidani nav'kh'oi mukhtalifi nabotot zinda megardonad. Beshak, On Zote, ki in zamini khushkidai bekh'osilro zinda gardonid, U Zindasozandai murdakh'ost. Va U ba kh'ar chiz Tavonost. Chize Uro och'iz namesozad.

51) Va savgand, ki agar Mo baroiashon bodi zararrason firistem va ziroatashonro tabokh' sozad, pas onkh'o ziroati khudro ba'di sabzrangi zardshuda binand, begumon pas az mushokh'idai zardshavii on ba digar ne'matkh'oi sershumori Khudo nosiposi mekunand.

52) Pas on guna ki sukhanatro ba murdagon shunavonida nametavoni va onro ba shakhsoni noshunavo vak'te rui tofta meravand, shunavonida nametavoni, kh'amin tavr az ukh'dai kh'idoiati on kasone, ki ba sababi rui gardonidan va foida naburdan az paig'om ba murdagon va noshunavoion shabokh'at dorand, namebaroi.

53) Va tu nametavoni ba kurdiloni az rokh'i durust gumrokh' tavfik'i paimudani rokh'i durustro bidikh'i. Begumon tu sukhanatro ba shakhsone metavoni bishunavoni va tibk'i on amal kunand, ki ba oiatkh'oi Mo imon meorand. Zero az on chi megui, fak'at mu'minon foida megirand. Pas onkh'o taslim va mutei amri Mo kh'astand.

54) Ei mardum, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki shumoro az obi bearzish ofarid, sipas ba'd az davroni notavonii tifliaton markh'ilai nerumandii mardiro k'aror dod, sipas ba'd az davroni mardi markh'ilai notavoni va pironsoliro k'aror dod. U on chi az za'f va k'uvvat khokh'ad, meofarad. Va U Parvardigori Donandai kh'ama chiz buda, kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest, Tavonoi ach'znopazir ast.

55) Va ruzi barposhavii k'iiomat gunakh'koron savgand iod mekunand, ki dar k'abrashon ch'uz zamoni andak naistodaand. Chunonchi az shinokhti muddati dar k'abr istodanashon bargardonida meshavand, kh'amin tavr dar dunio az kh'ak' bargardonida meshudand.

56) Va kasone az paiombaron va farishtagon, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o donish va imon doda ast, meguiand: "Beshak, shumo dar k'abraton ba on andoza, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ilmi azalii Khesh az ruzi khalk' shudanaton to ruzi dubora zinda gardonidanaton navishta bud, istoded. Pas, imruz ruzi az nav zinda sokhtani mardum ast, valekin shumo iak'in nadoshted, ki rastokhez kh'atman vok'e' meshavad. Az in sabab, onro inkor karded."

57) Pas ruze, ki khaloik' baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo dubora zinda gardonida shavand, ba zolimon uzrkh'oi az peshi khud boftaashon sud namerasonad va az onkh'o talab karda nameshavad, ki bo tavba Khudoro az kheshtan rozi gardonand. Zero digar fursati tavba va bozgasht ba sui Parvardigor guzashta ast.

58) Va Ba durusti ki Mo dar in K'ur'on baroi mardum kh'ar guna masalro baion namudem, to kh'ak' az botil ch'udo va ravshan shavad. Va ei Paiombar, savgand, ki agar tu dar borai sodik' budanat ba onkh'o kh'uch'ch'at biiori, kh'atman kofiron meguiand: "Shumo da'vogaroni nubuvvat dar on chi ovardaed, botilkorone besh nested".

59) Chunonchi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar k'albi in toifai ba oiatkh'oi ovardaat kofirgashta mukh'r nikh'oda ast, kh'amin guna bar k'albi on kasone, ki kh'ak' budani dinatro namedonand, mukh'r menikh'ad.

60) Pas ei Paiombar, bar takzibi k'avmat sabr kun. Kh'amono va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai on ki baroiat nusrat va k'udrat medikh'ad, kh'ak' buda, takh'ak'k'uk' meiobad. Va naboiad on kasone, ki ba rastokhez iak'in nadorand, boisi shitobkori va besabrii tu gardand.
1) "Alif. Lom. Mim." Dar ibtidoi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) Ei Paiombar, in oiatkh'oi ba tu nozilshuda, oiatkh'oi Kitobi doroi kh'ikmat ast.
3) On baroi kasone, ki bo ich'roi kh'uk'uk'i Kholik'u khalk' nekukorand, moiai kh'idoiat va rakh'mat ast.
4) On nekukorone, ki namozro dar komiltarin surati on barpo mesozand va zakoti molro medikh'and va onkh'o ba rastokhezu bozpursi va savobu ik'obi okhirat iak'in dorand.
5) In toifai mavsuf bar kh'idoiati Parvardigorashon ustuvorona k'aror dorand va inkh'o bo noil gashtan ba ch'annat va nach'ot az ch'akh'annam rastagoroni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi k'abli sifoti nekukoronro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin sifoti badkoronro ovarda guft:
6) Ba'ze az mardumon ba monandi Nazr pisari Kh'oris sukhanoni sargarmsozandaro barmeguzinand, to mardumro beilm az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sui on gardonand va oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba maskhara girand. Dar okhirat baroi in gurukh'i doroi sifatkh'oi iodshuda azobi khorsozanda ast.

7) Va vak'te bar on banda oiatkh'oi Mo khonda shavad, az shunidanash mutakabbirona pusht megardonad, guio on oiatkh'oro nashunida ast, misli on ki dar du gushash az shunidani sado sangini ast. Pas ei Paiombar, uro ba azobi dardovare, ki muntazirash ast, "muzhda" bidekh'.
8) Kh'amono on kasone, ki imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om medikh'and, baroi onkh'o bustonkh'oi doroi ne'mat ast. Onch'o az ne'matkh'oi omodasokhtai Khudo bakh'ra mebarand.

9) Dar ch'annat ch'ovidon memonand. Inro ba onkh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va'dai barkh'ak' doda va dar vuk'ui va'dai U shakke nest. Va U Zoti G'olib buda, dar ofarinish, tak'dir va akh'komash Bokh'ikmat ast.

10) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) osmonkh'oro biduni sutun barafroshta ofarid. Shumo osmonkh'oro bo chashmi sar mebined, ki sutun nadorand. Va dar zamin kukh'kh'oi ustuvorro nasb kard, to zamin shumoro nach'unbonad va dar on az kh'ar nav' kh'aivon muntashir sokht. Va Mo az osmon obi boronro furud ovardem, pas dar zamin az kh'ar ch'ufti khushmanzar giiokh'onero, ki mardum va chakh'orpoion az on sud mebarand, ruionidem.

11) In zikrshudakh'o ofaridai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astand. Pas ei mushrikon, ba Man on chiro ma'budkh'oi ba ch'oi Khudo meparastidaaton ofaridaand, nishon dikh'ed?! Balki zolimon az rokh'i rost dar gumrokh'ii oshkorand. Zero onkh'o ba kh'aisi ma'bud chizkh'oero shariki Parvardigor medonand, ki k'udrati ofaridan nadorand, bar'aks on ma'budkh'oiashon makhluk'and.

12) Va Mo begumon ba Luk'mon kh'ikmat (dar din fakh'mi amik' va dar korkh'o dariofti durusti)-ro dodem va ba u guftem: "Ei Luk'mon, baroi on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tu dar anch'omi ibodat tavfik' doda ast, shukri Uro ba ch'o biior. Va kh'ar ki shukri Parvardigorashro ba ch'o meorad, pas foidai on iak'inan ba khudash barmegardad. Zero Khudo az siposguzorii banda Beniioz ast. Va kh'ar ki nisbat ba ne'mati Khudo nosiposi mekunad va kofir meshavad, pas ziioni kufron va kufrash ba sui khudash bargashta, ba Khudo chize zarar namerasonad. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az tamomi makhluk'ot Beniioz buda, dar kh'ama kh'olat Sutuda ast."

13) Va ei Paiombar, on zamonero ba iod biior, ki Luk'mon ba pisarash dar kh'ole ki uro ba kori nek targ'ib va az kori bad man' mekard, guft: "Ei pisaram, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' kas va kh'ech' chizro sharik magardon. Kh'amono ibodati g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i khud zulmi buzurg ast. Zero banda bo shirk ovardan dar duzakh ch'ovidon memonad."

14) Va Mo insonro amr kardem, ki dar g'airi ma'siiat padar va modarashro itoat va nisbat ba onkh'o neki kunad. Modarash uro dar batnash kh'aml namud, kh'ol on ki dar vak'ti bordori bo mashak'k'at andar mashak'k'at rubaru meshud. Va ch'udo sokhtani farzand az shirkhoragi bo intikh'oi du sol az zamoni vilodat surat megirad. Va ba inson guftem: "Dar barobari ne'matkh'o shukri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o biior, sipas baroi on ki turo volidainat parvarish dodaand, shukri onkh'oro ich'ro namo. Bozgasht tankh'o ba sui Man ast. Ba'd az on ba kh'ar kas dar ivazi amalash ch'azo khokh'am dod.

15) Va agar padaru modarat bo takia ba farmonravoii khud bar farzand taloshashonro sarf sozand, to turo vodor namoiand, ki on chiro dar boraash donish nadori, ba Man sharik gardoni, dar in surat az volidainat itoat makun. Va kh'amrokh'i onkh'o dar dunio bo neki, nigokh' doshtani alok'a va ekh'son muomila namo. Va rokh'i on kasero pairavi kun, ki bo iaktoparasti va ibodat ba sui Man bargashta ast. Sipas ruzi k'iiomat bozgashti kh'amai shumo tankh'o ba sui Man ast, ba'dan on chiro dar dunio anch'om medoded, baroiaton khabar doda, ba nekon ch'azoi nek va ba badon ch'azoi bad medikh'am."

16) Luk'moni Kh'akim dar idoma guft: "Ba durusti ki neki io badi kh'archand monandi vazni donai ispand khurd va dar dokhili kharsang pinkh'on buda, kase az on ittilo' naiobad io dar kh'ar ch'oi osmonkh'o io zamin boshad, pas begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat onro meorad va ba anch'omdikh'andai on podosh medikh'ad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Borikbin buda, korkh'oi nozuk az U pushida namemonad, az kh'ak'ik'at va mavzei tamomi chiz Bokhabar ast.

17) Ei pisaram, namozro ba surati komil barpo namo va ba mardum amri ma'ruf va nakh'ii munkar bikun va dar barobari on chi dar in rokh' ba tu merasad, bosabr bosh. Iak'inan in korkh'o az korkh'oi doroi akh'amiiatest, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ich'roi onro bar tu voch'ib gardonida va ch'uz amali sokhtanash digar ikhtiior nadori.

18) Va mutakabbirona ruiatro az mardum barmagardon va dar zamin bo shodmonii iakch'o bo g'urur rokh' marav. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar khiromida rokh'ravandai az ne'matkh'o iftikhorkunandaro, ki bar mardum kibr namuda, shukri ne'matkh'oro ba ch'o nameorad, dust namedorad.

19) Va dar rokh' raftan kh'addi miionaro, ki nishonai tamkini shakhs ast, rioia namuda, shitobon va okh'ista rokh' marav va sadoiatro past bikun, to ba digaron ozor narasoni. Begumon zishttarin sadokh'o - sadoi kharon ast. Zero ovozi bisior baland dorand."

20) Ei mardum, oio namedoned va mushokh'ida namekuned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton az on chi dar osmonkh'o ba misli oftob, mokh' va sitoragon va on chi dar zamin ba misli ch'onvaron, darakhton va nabotot mavch'udand, manfiat burdanro oson sokhta va baroiaton ne'matkh'oi Khudro ba misli surati zebo va andomi nek, ki namoionand va ne'matkh'oi digarashro ba misli khirad va donish, ki az chashm pinkh'onand, ba itmom rasonda ast?! Va ba'ze az mardum bo vuch'udi kh'amai in ne'matkh'o dar borai iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), biduni kh'ech' nav' donishi bargirifta az paig'omi ilokh'i va biduni khiradi solim va kitobi ravshangari osmoni ch'idol mekunand.

21) Va vak'te ki ba in ch'amoai ch'idolgar gufta shavad: "Az paig'omi furudovardai Khudo pairavi kuned", meguiand: "Mo az on pairavi namekunem, balki az parastishi butkh'o, ki padaronamonro bar on ioftaem, pairavi mekunem." Oio agarchi Shaiton guzashtagonashonro ba sababi butparasti gumrokh' sokhta, sui azobi otashi furuzoni duzakh da'vat kunad, mushrikon onkh'oro pairavi mekunand?!

22) Va kh'ar ki kholisona ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui meorad va kh'ol on ki u nekukor ast, pas beshak, ba ustuvortarin dastovez chang zada ast, ki kh'ar kas az khavfu khatar nach'ot ioftan khokh'ad, ba kh'amin dastovez chang mezanad, chunki on kh'ech' gokh' k'at' nameshavad. Va bozgashti tamomi korkh'o tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Ba'dan ba kh'ar kas ch'azoi amalashro khokh'ad dod.

23) Va kh'ar ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shavad, pas naboiad kufrash turo ei Paiombar, andukh'gin gardonad. Ruzi k'iiomat bozgashti kh'amai onkh'o ba sui Most, ba'dan ba onkh'o a'moli badi anch'omdodaashonro khabar doda, azobashon mekunem. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai asrori k'albkh'ost. Kh'ech' sirre az U pushida nest.
24) Mo onkh'oro bo dodani lazzatkh'oi dunio zamoni andak bakh'ramand mesozem, sipas dar ruzi k'iiomat baroi daromadan ba azobi sakhti duzakh mach'burashon mekunonem.

25) Va ei Paiombar, agar tu az in mushrikon bipursi: "Osmonkh'o va zaminro ki ofarida ast?", begumon dar posukh "Onkh'oro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ofarida ast" meguiand. Ba onkh'o bigu: "Sitoish Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro, ki bar muk'obilaton kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan ovard." Balki beshtarashon az rui ch'okh'ili namedonand, ki chi kase sazovori sitoish ast.

26) Kh'ar on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin vuch'ud dorad, az rui ofaridan, molikiiat va tadbir tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az tamomi makhluk'otash Beniioz buda, dar duniovu okhirat az ch'onibi kulli mavch'udot Sutuda ast.

27) Va agar kh'ama darakhtoni zamin burida shuda, az on k'alam sokhta shavad va bakh'r ba rang tabdil doda shavad va agarchi kh'aft bakh'ri digar ba on iori dikh'and, kalomi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba okhir namerasad, zero kalomash anch'om nadorad. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) G'olibi Shikastnopazir buda, dar ofarinish va chorasozi bag'oiat Bokh'ikmat ast.

28) Ei mardum, beguftugu, ofaridani shumo va ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo zinda gardonidanaton dar osoni misli ofaridan va zinda gardonidani iak fard ast. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti Shunavost, shunidani iak sado uro az sadoi digar g'ofil namesozad, Binost, didani chize Uro az didani chizi digar mashg'ul namegardonad. Inchunin ofaridan va dubora zinda kardani iak fard Uro az ofaridan va zinda gardonidani digaron man' namekunad.

29) Ei mukhotab, oio namedoni, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az shab kam mesozad, to ruzro afzun gardonad va az ruz kam mesozad, to shabro afzun gardonad va U masiri kh'arakati oftob va mokh'ro muaiian karda ast. Kh'ar kadomi on to zamoni muaiian dar madorash kh'arakat mekunad. Va oio namedoni, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Bokhabar ast, kh'ech' amali shumo az U pushida nest va baroiaton dar badali on ch'azo khokh'ad dod?!

30) In tadbiru andozagirii makhluk'ot shokh'idi medikh'ad, ki iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar Zot, sifot va korkh'oiash Kh'ak' ast va on chi mushrikon g'air az U meparastand, botili beasos ast va iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo Zot, k'udrat va mak'omash az kh'amai mavch'udot Bartaru Buzurgtar ast.

31) Ei mukhotab, oio nadidai, ki kishtikh'o dar bakh'r bo lutf va rom gardonidani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'arakat mekunand, to ba shumo mardum ba'ze az nishonakh'oi azimi Khudro, ki bar k'udrat va lutfi U dalolat mekunand, nishon dikh'ad.
