Ba durusti, dar in iodshudakh'o baroi kase, ki dar musibat ziiod bosabr va dar ne'mat ziiod shukrguzor ast, dalolatkh'o bar k'udrati ilokh'ist.

32) Va chun onkh'oro az kh'ar ch'onib mavch'i ba kukh'kh'o va abrkh'o monand ikh'ota namoiad, tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro duo mekunand, duo va ibodatro kholis baroi U anch'om medikh'and. Pas chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) duoiashonro bipazirad va onkh'oro ba sui khushki nach'ot doda, az g'ark'shavi nigokh' dorad, pas az onkh'o ba'ze miionarav buda, shukri bar zimmaash voch'ibro ba kh'addi komil ba ch'o nameorad va ba'zei digar nisbat ba ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i nosiposi mevarzad. Va oiatkh'oi Moro tankh'o shakhsi monandi in bandai zikrshudai akh'dshikani nosipos, ki chun az giriftori nach'otash dodem, ba va'daash vafo va shukrguzori nakard, inkor mekunad.

33) Ei mardum, az g'azabu azobi Parvardigoraton bo ich'ro kardani dasturot va khuddori az man'kardakh'oiash biparkh'ezed va az uk'ubati ruze bitarsed, ki dar on padar az farzandash chizero dur sokhta nametavonad va farzand niz az padarash chizero bartaraf namesozad. Beshak, va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai ch'azoi ruzi okhirat durust buda, noguzir ba vuk'u' mepaivandad. Pas, naboiad kh'aioti dunio shumoro bo lazzat va sargarmikh'o bifirebad va naboiad Shaiton shumoro bo burdborii Parvardigor, ki bandagonashro zud ch'azo namedikh'ad, g'ofil sokhta, bifirebad.

34) Beshak, ilmi zamoni farorasii k'iiomat tankh'o nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, kai barposhavii onro U medonad, boronro kh'ar vak'te khokh'ad, furud meorad va pisar io dukhtar, nekbakht io badbakht budani ch'anini bachadoni modaronro iagona U medonad. Va kh'ech' kas namedonad, ki pagokh' az neki va badi chiro anch'om medikh'ad, va kh'ech' kas namedonad, ki dar kuch'o memirad, balki in kh'amaro iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) medonad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest.
1) "Alif. Lom. Mim." Dar ibtidoi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) In K'ur'oni ovardai Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), ki dar on shakke nest, az sui Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion nozil shuda ast.

3) Kh'amono kofiron meguiand: "Mukh'ammad in Kitobro dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo az peshi khud bofta ast." Kh'ak'ik'at on guna ki onkh'o da'vo dorand, nest, balki K'ur'on Kitobi barkh'ak' ast, dar bobi on ki bar tu Paiombar az sui Parvardigorat furud omada ast, shakke nest, to k'avmero az azob bitarsoni, ki pesh az tu ba onkh'o bimdikh'andae naomada bud, to ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat ioband va az on pairavi karda, amal kunand.

4) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Onest, ki osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti bainashonro dar shash ruz ofarid va kh'ol on ki U k'udrat dosht onkh'oro dar kamtar az iak mizha zadan ofarad, sipas chunonchi shoistai Ust, bar arsh baromad. Va ei mardum, shumo ch'uz U iovar va shafoatkunanda nadored, ki ioriaton rasonad io nazdash ba naf'i shumo shafoat kunad. Oio nameandeshed, to Allokh'i Iagonaro biparasted va az shirk biparkh'ezed.

5) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ama korkh'oi mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va zaminro chorasozi mekunad. Sipas on kor dar ruze, ki mik'dorash az on chi shumo dar dunio meshumored, kh'azor sol ast, ba sui U bolo meravad.
6) In Ofaridgori Chorasozi umuri mavch'udot Donandai nikh'on va oshkor ast, chize az U makhfi nest, G'olibi az dushmanon intik'omsitonu nisbat ba bandagonash Mekh'rubon ast.
7) On Zote, ki kh'ar chi ofarid, neku ofarid va ofaridani nakhustin bashar - Odamro biduni namunai sobik' az gil og'oz namud.
8) Sipas nasli uro az fishurdai obi bearzishi nutfa khalk' kard.

9) on gokh' ofarinishi uro barobarandom ba itmom rasonid va ba vositai farishta az rukh'i Khesh [rukh'e, ki khud ofarid] dar on damid va baroi shumo gushkh'o va chashmkh'o va k'albkh'oro ofarid, to bishunaved, bubined va bifakh'med. Shumo dar barobari in ne'matkh'o kam shukrguzori mekuned.

10) Va mushrikoni takzibgari rastokhez meguiand: "Vak'te memirem va zeri zamin nopadid shuda, ch'ismamon ba khok tabdil megardad, oio az nav zinda gardonida meshavem?! In ba ak'li mo nameg'unch'ad." Balki onkh'o dar vok'e' ba zindashavii ba'd az marg kofirand.

11) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikoni takzibgari zindashavii ba'di marg bigu: "Shumoro on farishtai marg, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) giriftani ch'onatonro ba u kh'avola karda ast, memironad. Ba'dan ruzi k'iiomat baroi pursuch'u va giriftani ch'azo tankh'o ba sui Parvardigoraton bargardonida meshaved."

12) Va ruzi k'iiomat gunakh'koronro dar kh'ole mebini, ki ba ba sababi inkori rastokhez peshi Parvardigorashon sarafkandavu sharmandaand va meguiand: "Parvardigoro, on rastokhezero, ki durug' meguftem, bo chashmi sar didem va daleli rostguii paiombaronro shunidem. Pas moro ba zindagonii dunio bargardon, to amali nek anch'om dikh'em, ki Turo az mo rozi gardonad. Kh'amono mo inak nisbat ba rastokhez va rostk'avlii paiombaron iak'in kardem." Agar tu gunakh'koronro dar in kh'olat mushokh'ida kuni, begumon sakh'nai dakh'shatnokro mebini.

13) Va agar ba kh'ar kas dodani kh'idoiati tavfik'ro mekhostem, onro ba vai medodem, valekin k'avli Man az rui kh'ikmat va adolat k'at'i gashta ast, ki kh'atman ruzi k'iiomat duzakhro az kh'amai ch'inkh'o va insonkh'oi kofir pur mekunam. Zero khud imonu rokh'i rostro guzoshta, kufr va zalolatro barguzidand.

14) Ruzi k'iiomat ba onkh'o sarzanishkunon gufta meshavad: "Pas, ba sababi on ki dar dunio az mulok'oti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar k'iiomat baroi bozpursi g'ofil buded, azobro bichashed. Kh'amono Mo niz shumoro dar azob meguzorem, to az on ranch' bared. Va baroi on gunokh'one, ki dar dunio sodir mekarded, azobi abadii duzakhro bichashed."

Chun Khudovand dar oiatkh'oi zikrshuda kh'olati gunakh'koronro ovard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin kh'olati mu'minonro baion karda guft:
15) Beshak, ba oiatkh'oi bar Paiombar furudovardai Mo kasone imon meorand, ki chun bo on oiatkh'o pand doda shavand, baroi Khudo sach'dakunon ba zamin meaftand va Parvardigorashonro ba poki iod karda, sitoish mekunand va onkh'o kh'argiz az ibodat va sach'dai U kibr namevarzand.

16) Pakh'lukh'oi onkh'o az rakhtkh'oi khobashon dur meshavad, ch'oigakh'i khobi kheshro guzoshta, dar namozu g'airi on az tarsi azob va tama' ba rakh'mati ilokh'i ba Parvardigorashon ru ovarda, Uro duo mekunand va az amvole, ki Mo ba onkh'o ruzi dodaem, dar rokh'amon kharch' menamoiand.

17) Pas kh'ech' kas on chiro, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi mu'minon dar ivazi on chi dar dunio az a'moli nek anch'om medodand, kh'amchun podosh omoda namuda ast, ki boisi oromishi chashmonashon megardad, namedonad. In podoshest, ki az sababi azamatash kh'ech' kas ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai on ogokh'ii komil nadorad.

18) Oio bandae, ki ba Parvardigor imon ovarda, tibk'i dasturotash amal mekunad, monandi bandai az itoati U khorich'shuda ast?! Kh'ech' gokh' in du toifa nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar podosh barobar nestand.

19) Ammo on kasone, ki imon meorand va korkh'oi shoista mekunand, pas podoshi baroi onkh'o omodashuda bustonkh'oi ch'oi istik'omati abadi ast. Dar badali on chi az korkh'oi nek anch'om medodand, bo ikromi ilokh'i dar on bog'kh'o k'aror megirand.

20) Va ammo on kasone, ki bo kufru ma'siiat az itoati Khudo berun shudaand, pas ruzi k'iiomat k'arorgokh'i baroi onkh'o omodagardida duzakh buda, onch'o abadi memonand. Kh'ar vak't k'asdi az on otash berun shudanro kunand, ba on bargardonida meshavand va ba onkh'o bo sarzanish gufta meshavad: "Azobi otashero, ki paiombaron dar dunio shumoro az on metarsonidand, ammo onro inkor mekarded, bichashed."

21) Va Mo iak'inan ba in takzibgaroni az toati Parvardigorashon khorich' agar tavba nakunand, k'abl az azobi buzurgtari ruzi k'iiomat dar dunio ba'ze az ranch'kh'o va sakhtikh'oro mechashonem, to ba sui ibodati Khudo bargardand.

22) Va kh'ech' kas az on shakhse, ki bo oiatkh'oi Parvardigorash pand doda shud, vale pand nagirift, sipas az on oiatkh'o biduni tavach'ch'ukh' rui toft, zolimtar nest. Beshak, Mo az much'rimoni bo kufru gunokh' az oiatkh'oiamon bargashta intik'om megirem.

23) Va iak'inan Mo ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) Tavrotro dodem. Pas ei Paiombar, az mulok'oti khud bo Muso dar shabi Isro' va vok'eai Me'roch' shak makun. Va Kitobi bar Muso nozilkardaamonro baroi Bani Isroil kh'idoiatgar az gumrokh'i gardonidem.

24) Va chun Bani Isroil dar ich'roi amrkh'o va duri az man'kardakh'oi ilokh'i va ozoru aziiatkh'oi rokh'i da'vat sabr kardand, Mo az baini eshon peshvoionero k'aror dodem, ki mardum dar rokh'i kh'ak' pairavashon budand va bo ich'ozat va tak'viiat bakhshidani Mo ba onkh'o mardumro ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat mekardand. Va onkh'o ba oiatkh'oi Mo, ki bar Paembarashon furud ovardem, k'oteona bovar doshtand.

25) Ei Paiombar, kh'amono ruzi k'iiomat baini onkh'o dar borai on chi bo iakdigar dar dunio ikhtilof mekardand, iagona Parvardigorat k'azovat karda, kh'ak'ro az nokh'ak' ch'udo mesozad va ba kh'ar kas ch'azoi bosazo medikh'ad.

26) Oio kuffori Makka kur shudaand va ba kh'amin illat baroiashon ma'lum nagashta ast, ki Mo k'abl az onkh'o chi k'adar ummatkh'oi guzashtaro kh'alok sokhtaem, dar kh'ole ki kofironi Makka dar maskankh'oi ummatkh'oi sobik', ki pesh az kh'alokshaviashon dar onch'o mezistand, rokh' meravand, vale pand namegirand. Beshak, dar on chi bo ummatkh'oi k'abli ba sababi kufr va ma'siiatashon rukh doda ast, ibratkh'oi ziiod mavch'ud buda, daleli rostguii paiombaron ast. Oio in takzibkunandagoni oiatkh'oi ilokh'iro ba ma'noi paziruftan va pand giriftan nameshunavand?!

27) Oio in durug'shumorandagoni rastokhez namebinand, ki Mo obi boronro ba sui zamini khushkidai begiiokh' mefiristem, pas ba vositai on ziroatero, ki shuturonu govonu gusfandonashon va khudashon az on mekhurand, meruionem?! Oio inro namebinandu namefakh'mand, ki Kholik'i dar ruionidani zamini khushkida Tavono murdagonro niz zinda sokhta metavonad?!

28) Va takzibgaroni rastokhez zudtar omadani azobro talab namuda meguiand: "In kh'ukme, ki da'vo dored ruzi k'iiomat baini movu shumo faisala mekunad va mo ba duzakh va shumo ba bikh'isht meraved, kai vok'e' meshavad?"

29) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "In va'da ruzi k'iiomat takh'ak'k'uk' meiobad. K'iiomat ruzi k'azovat baini bandagon meboshad. On ruz ba kasone, ki dar dunio kofir shuda, ba'd az mushokh'idai azob imon ovardaand, imonashon sud namebakhshad va inchunin onkh'o ba ak'ib bargardonida, mukh'lat doda nameshavand, to tavba kunand va ba sui Parvardigorashon bargardand."
30) Pas ei Paiombar, az inkh'o rui bargardon, zero dar zalolat furu raftaand va muntaziri on azobe bosh, ki ba onkh'o furud meoiad. Kh'amono onkh'o muntaziri azobi va'dadodaat kh'astand.

1) Ei Paiombar, (kh'amrokh'i pairavonat) bo ich'roi amrkh'o va parkh'ez az nakh'ikh'o bar tak'vo va tars az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sobitk'adam monda, tankh'o az U bitars va az khostakh'oi kofiron va munofik'on pairavi makun. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai makri kofironu munofik'on buda, dar ofarinish va tadbiri korkh'oiash bag'oiat Bokh'ikmat ast.

2) Va az on chi Parvardigorat ba tu vakh'i mefiristad, pairavi kun. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Ogokh' ast. Kh'ech' chize az ogokh'ii U dur nest va dar ivazi kh'ar sukhanu amal ba sokh'ibash ch'azo khokh'ad dod.
3) Va dar kh'amai korkh'oiat tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia namo. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati Nigakh'bon baroi kase, ki ba U e'timod mekunad, basanda ast.

4) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kh'ech' marde dar sinaash du dil k'aror nadoda ast. Va kh'amsaronatonro, ki bo onkh'o "Zikh'or" mekuned, modaronaton nasokhta ast va farzandkhondakh'oiatonro pisaroni aslii shumo nagardonida ast. Chunonchi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba banda iak dil medikh'ad, kh'amin guna kh'amsaronaton modar va farzandkhondakh'oiaton pisaroni shumo nameshavand. "Zikh'or", ki mard bo kh'amin rokh' kh'amsarashro ba misli modar va khokh'arash bar khud kh'arom mesozad va inchunin pisarkhond giriftan az odatkh'oi davroni ch'okh'iliiat buda, Islom onro botil sokhta ast. In "Zikh'or" va pisarkhond giriftan sukhanest, ki shumo onro bo dakh'onaton megued, ammo kh'ak'ik'ate nadorad. Kh'amsar - modar va pisarkhond - farzand shuda nametavonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ak'ro meguiad, to bandagon mutobik' ba on amal kunand va U ba rokh'i rost rakh'namoi mekunad.

5) Ononero, ki pisari khesh mepindored, ba padaroni kh'ak'ik'iashon nisbat dikh'ed. Chunki in mansub donistani onkh'o ba padaronashon nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) adolati vok'ei ast. Pas agar padaronashonro nadoned, to ba onkh'o nisbatashon dikh'ed, on vak't onkh'o barodaroni dini va g'ulomoni ozodkardai shumo kh'astand. Ba onkh'o bo nidoi "Ei barodaram" io "Ei pisari amakam" muroch'iat kuned. Va chun khato karda, pisarkhondaro ba padarkhondaash nisbat dikh'ed, bar shumo kh'ech' gunokh'e nest, valekin vak'te k'asdan inro ba zabon meored, gunakh'kor meshaved. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Baroi kh'amin onkh'oro zud much'ozot namekunad va fursatashon medikh'ad.

6) Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba mu'minon dar on chi onkh'oro ba suiash mekhonad, az khudashon sazovortar ast. Agar dar kore maili onkh'o bo maili Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) muk'obil k'aror girad, pas khostai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az khostai onkh'o bartar ast va kh'ak'k'i mukholifat nadorand. Va kh'amsaronash kh'ukman modaroni kh'amai mu'minonand. Ba'd az vafoti Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kh'ech' kas az mu'minon nametavonad bo zanonash ak'di izdivoch' bandad. Va dar meros sokh'iboni k'arobati kheshovandi dar Kitobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba iakdigar az akh'li imon va kh'ich'rat, ki k'ablan dar zukh'uri Islom az kh'amdigar meros meburdand va ba'dan in kh'ukm mansukh shud, sazovortarand, ch'uz on ki shumo mu'minon dar kh'ak'k'i dustoni g'airi vorisaton kori neke az vasiiat io ekh'son kuned, pas ba in kh'ak' dored. In kh'ukm dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz muk'arrar va sobit ast. Binobar in, boiad bo on amal namoed.

7) Va ei Paiombar, iod kun vak'tero, ki Mo az paiombaron va makhsusan az tu va az Nukh' va Ibrokh'im va Muso va Isoi pisari Mariam oidi iagona parastidani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), duri az shirk va ba mardum rasonidani vakh'ii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) paimoni k'at'i giriftem. Va az onkh'o dar borai vafodori ba va'daashon, ki risolatkh'oi ilokh'iro ba digaron merasonand, paimoni ustuvor giriftem.

8) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in paimonro girift, to az rostk'avlii paiombaron, ki bandagoni sodik'and, bo mak'sadi izkh'ori sharofatashon va sarkubsozii kofiron bipursad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kofiron dar k'iiomat uk'ubati dardovari duzakhro omoda namuda ast.

9) Ei mu'minoni poibandi kh'ukmi shariat! Ne'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bar khud ba iod biiored. On gokh', ki lashkarkh'oi kofiron baroi muk'obili shumo ch'angidan bo ch'am'i bisior ba Madina omadand va munofik'on bo iakh'udikh'o ioriashon dodand. Pas Mo bar onkh'o shamoli shadidi Sabo va lashkarkh'oi iborat az farishtagonro, ki bo chashm onkh'oro namedided, firistodem. In madadrasoni boisi g'olibiiati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) gardida, az dasti kofiron kore naomad va pusht bartofta, gurekhtand. Va on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar on Bino ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest va bar kh'ar kas dar badali amalash ch'azoi arzanda khokh'ad dod.

10) Vak'te ki kofiron az boloi vodi az samti mashrik' va az poioni on az samti mag'rib sui shumo omadand va on zamon didakh'o az tamomi chiz ch'uz az dushman bargashtand va k'albkh'o az shiddati tars ba kh'anch'arakh'o rasidand va shumo dar borai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gumonkh'oi mukhtalif mekarded. Ba'zan ba piruzi umed mebasted va ba'zan noumed meshuded.
11) Dar inch'o mu'minon bo rubaru gashtani dushvorikh'oi bisior ozmoish shudand va az shiddati kh'aros sakht ba iztirob aftodand. Bo in rokh' mu'minoni sodik' va munofik'on oshkor gardidand.

12) Va on vak't munofik'on va bandagoni zaifimon, ki dar k'albi onkh'o shubkh'a vuch'ud dosht, meguftand: "On chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash ba mo az piruzi va k'udratmandi dar zamin va'da dodaand, ch'uz sukhani botili beasos chize nest."

13) Va ei Paiombar, on zamonero iod kun, ki toifae az munofik'on ba akh'li Madina guftand: "Ei mardumi Iasrib (nomi Madina k'abl az zukh'uri Islom), dar atrofi Khandak' baroi shumo ch'oi istodan nest. Binobar in, ba khonakh'oiaton bargarded." Va gurukh'i digari onkh'o bo da'voi on ki guio khonakh'oiashon kushoda buda, dushman metavonad voridi on gardad, az Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ich'ozat megiriftand, to ba manzilkh'oiashon bargardand, kh'ol on ki manzilkh'oiashon chunonchi da'vo doshtand, kushoda nabud. Onkh'o bo ovardani in bakh'onai durug' ch'uz firor az maidon chize namekhostand.

14) Va agar dushman az kh'ar gushai Madina ba khonakh'oi akh'li nifok' vorid shavad va az onkh'o talab kunad, to ba kufr va shirk bargardand, begumon onkh'o in khostai dushmanro ba ch'o meorand va az murtad shudan va ba kufr bargashtan ch'uz zamoni andak khuddori nakhokh'and kard.

15) Va kh'amono in munofik'on ba'd az on ki az ch'angi Ukh'ud firor kardand, akh'd dodand, ki agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) minba'd onkh'oro dar nabardi digar kh'ozir sozad, kh'atman alaikh'i dushmanon mech'angand va az maidoni ch'ang firor namekunand, ammo ba akh'di khud vafo nakardand. Va banda az on chi bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) akh'd mebandad, pursida va kh'isobu kitob khokh'ad shud.

16) Ei Paiombar, ba in munofik'on bigu: "Agar az marg io tarsi kushta shudan firor kuned, kh'argiz sude ba kh'olaton nadorad. Zero mukh'lati kh'aiot dar tak'dir muaiian ast. Va agar az ch'ang firor kuned va mukh'lati margaton faro narasida boshad, pas dar dunio ba ch'uz zamoni andaki dar tak'diraton muk'arrargardida bakh'ra namebared."

17) Ei Paiombar, ba munofik'on bigu: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i shumo badie ba monandi marg va kushtashavi bikhokh'ad io dar kh'ak'k'i shumo nekie ba monandi solim mondan az kh'ar guna ziion bikhokh'ad, chi kase metavonad shumoro az on khostai ilokh'i mukh'ofizat kunad?! Kh'ech' kas az ukh'dai in kor namebaroiad." Va munofik'on baroi kheshtan g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korsoz va iovare nameioband, ki korkh'oiashonro korsozi kunad va uk'ubati Parvardigorro az onkh'o dur gardonad.

18) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kasonero az shumo, ki digaronro az ch'ang dar saffi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) boz medorand va ba barodaronashon meguiand: "Nazdi mo biioed, bo kh'amrokh'i Mukh'ammad dar ch'ang shirkat nakuned, ki k'atl merased". Va in munofik'oni bozdorandai digaron az nabard dar nabard ch'uz zamoni andak shirkat namekunand.

19) Ei mu'minon, munofik'on bo mol, ch'on va mukh'abbati khesh dar munosibat bo shumo ziiod bakhiland. Bo molashon ioriaton namekunand, ch'onashonro az on ki kh'amrokh'aton ziddi dushman bich'angand, ba khatar nameguzorand va shumoro dust namedorand. Pas ei Paiombar, chun ch'ang og'oz gashta, tarsi dushman vok'e' shavad, onkh'oro mebini dar kh'ole ba sui tu nazar mekunand, ki chashmonashon az tarsui misli du chashmi shakhsi az sakhti sakaroti marg dar ranch'u uk'ubat k'aror doshta davr mezanad. Ba'dan vak'te tars az onkh'o biravad va orom shavand, bo zabonkh'oi tezi khesh shumoro ozor doda, vobasta ba moli g'animat bisior bakhili karda, onro kh'arisona mech'uiand. In toifai sokh'ibi sifatkh'oi zikriofta imoni kh'ak'ik'i naovardand, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) podoshi amalkh'oiashonro botil sokht. Va in botil sokhtani podoshi amal bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bisior oson ast.

20) In munofik'oni tarsu gumon mekunand, ki gurukh'kh'oi bar ziddi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va mu'minon ch'am'omada to mu'minonro nobud nasozand, kh'argiz barnamegardand. Va agar ba farzi misol, in ch'amoakh'oi kofir bori digar baroi ch'angidan alaikh'i mu'minon biioiand, in munofik'on dust medorand, ki berun az Madina kh'amrokh'i bodiianishinkh'o boshand, az onch'o dar boraaton bipursand, ki ba'di ch'ang bo dushman bo shumo chi kh'odisa rukh dod? Va ei mu'minon, agar onkh'o dar baini shumo mebudand, kh'ech' gokh' ch'uz zamoni andak namech'angidand. Baroi kh'amin, naboiad ba onkh'o tavach'ch'ukh' namoed va az adami kh'uzurashon afsus khured.

21) Beshak, baroi shumo dar on chi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) gufta va on chi karda ast, namunai nek ast. Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ch'oni khudro dar khatar guzoshta, bo shumo alaikh'i dushman dar ch'ang shirkat varzid. Modom ki Paembari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chunin karda ast, pas, chitavr shumo ch'onatonro dareg' donista, bakhili mekuned?! Tankh'o nafare pairavi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) meshavad, ki ba savobu rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi okhirat umed doshta, amal mekunad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ziiod ba iod meorad. Ammo kase, ki ba okhirat umed nadorad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ziiod iod namekunad, pairavi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nameshavad.

22) Va zamone, ki mu'minon gurukh'kh'oi muk'obilashon ch'am'omadai dushmanro didand, guftand: "In kh'amon ozmoishu ranch' va rasidan ba piruziest, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash onro ba mo va'da dodaand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash ba mo rost guftaand. Chunki va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash takh'ak'k'uk' meiobad." Va iak'inan didani gurukh'kh'oi dushman imon va ba amri ilokh'i taslim shudani mu'minonro afzun sokht.

23) Az mu'minon mardone kh'astand, ki bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar on chi akh'd bastaand, sodik' monda, ba akh'dashon, ki dar rokh'i ch'ikh'od az khud ustuvori va sabr nishon medikh'and, vafodori namudand. Pas ba'zei onkh'o az dunio guzashtand io dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kushta shudand va ba'zei digarashon dar intizori shakh'odatand va in mu'minoni sodik' akh'di bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bastaashonro digargun nasokhtand, on guna ki munofik'on akh'dshikani kardand,-

24) to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni sodik'i vafodor dar badali sadok'at va vafodoriashon podosh dikh'ad va munofik'onro agar khokh'ad, bo biduni tavba dar kufr mironidanashon uk'ubat namoiad io bo dodani tavfik'i bozgasht az kufr tavbai onkh'oro k'abul kunad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

25) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kuffori K'uraish, k'abilai G'atafon va gurukh'kh'oi digari dushmanro az ch'angi Khandak' dar kh'olati khashm va g'amginiashon bargardond, zero onkh'o ba orzui khesh narasidand, ba on chi az reshakan sokhtani mu'minon mekhostand, noil nashudand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ravon kardani bodi Sabo va farishtagon mu'minonro az nabard bo kofiron beniioz gardonid. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Nerumandi G'olib ast. Kh'ech' kas bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'asdi ch'angidan namekunad, magar on ki kh'atman mag'lub megardad.

26) Va Khudo iakh'udikh'oero, ki dar in nabard ba kofironi az k'aboili gunogun ch'am'omada, iori dodand, az k'al'akh'oiashon, ki dar on az dushman panokh' meburdand, furud ovard va dar k'albashon tarsro afkand. Shumo mu'minon iak gurukh'i onkh'oro mekushted va iak gurukh'i digarashonro asir megirifted.

27) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro ba'd az kh'alokati in iakh'udikh'o moliki ziroatkh'oiashon va k'al'akh'oiashon va mablag'u chorvokh'oiashon gardonid va inchunin sarzamini Khaibarro, ki kh'anuz dar on k'adam naguzoshta buded, vale ank'arib k'adam khokh'ed guzosht, dar molikiiati shumo k'aror dod. In baroi mu'minon va'da va muzhdai buzurg ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ar chiz Tavono ast. Chize Uro notavon namegardonad.

28) Ei Paiombar, ba kh'amsaronat, ki az tu talab dorand, to nafak'ai onkh'oro farokh gardoni, kh'ol on ki in imkoniiatro nadori, bigu: "Agar shumo zindagonii dunio va zinati onro mekhosta boshed, pas nazdam biioed, to ba shumo on kh'adiaero, ki ba zanoni talok'gardida doda meshavad, bidikh'am va bo neki, biduni rasonidani zarar va ozor talok'aton doda, az bandi nikokh'i khesh rakh'oiaton sozam.

29) Va agar shumo rizoi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash va dar okhirat ch'annatro mekhosta boshed, pas bar in sharoiti maishi sabr kuned. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kasone az shumo, ki bo sabr va muoshirati neki oiladori nekukorand, begumon ach'ri azim omoda namuda ast."

30) Ei kh'amsaroni Paiombar, kh'ar ki az shumo gunokh'i oshkor anch'om dikh'ad, ruzi k'iiomat azobash duchand gardonida meshavad. Chunki ch'oigokh'i zani Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az digar zanon fark' dorad va kh'arimi vai boiad pok nigokh' doshta shavad. Va in duchand gardonidani uk'ubat bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat oson ast.

31) Va kh'ar ki az shumo (zanoni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)) bar itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash idoma dikh'ad va amali shoistai mavridi rizoi ilokh'iro ba ch'o orad, ba vai duchandi podoshi digar zanonro medikh'em va dar okhirat baroiash podoshi arzishmandi ch'annatro omoda sokhtaem.

32) Ei kh'amsaroni Mukh'ammadi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), shumo dar fazilat va sharofat monandi digar zanon nested, balki agar farmonkh'oi Khudoro ich'ro namoed va az man'kardakh'oiash biparkh'ezed, digar zanon bo shumo dar fazl va sharaf barobar nameshavand va ba mak'omaton namerasand. Pas vak'te ki bo mardoni begona guftugu mekuned, sukhanatonro narm va sadoiatonro borik nasozed, zero agar chunin kuned, kase, ki dar k'albash bemorii nifok' va shakh'vati kh'arom dorad, ba shumo tama' menamoiad. Va sukhani neki dur az shubkh'aiu ch'iddi va ba k'adri zarurat bigued.

33) Va dar khonakh'oiaton bimoned va biduni kh'och'at berun nabaroed va on guna ki zanoni k'abl az Islom bo mak'sadi ch'albi mardoni begona andom va vasilakh'oi kh'usnashonro oshkor mesokhtand, andom va vasilakh'oi ch'amoli kheshtanro oshkor nasozed va namozro ba surati komil barpo dored va zakoti molatonro bidikh'ed va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulashro itoat kuned. Ei kh'amsaroni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va ei khonadoni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhokh'ad ozor va badiro az shumo dur sozad va nafsatonro ba vositai orostan bo akhlok'i kh'amida va kholi sokhtan az akhlok'i razila komilan pok gardonad, to minbad dar on khulk'i bad bok'i namonad.

34) Va on chi dar khonakh'oiaton az oiatkh'oi nozilnamudai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va sunnati poki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) khonda meshavad, iod kuned. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Sokh'ibi lutfi azim buda, az kh'ama chiz Bokhabar ast. Az daloili lutf va ogokh'ii U on ast, ki shumoro kh'amsari Paiombarash va modari mu'minon barguzid.

35) Beshak, mardoni bo ibodat taslimshuda va zanoni taslimshuda va mardoni boimon va zanoni boimon va mardoni farmonbardori Parvardigor va zanoni farmonbardor va mardoni dar imon va k'avli khud samimi va zanoni samimi va mardoni dar ibodat, musibat va duri az ma'siiat bosabr va zanoni bosabr va mardoni furutan va zanoni furutan va mardoni bo molkh'oi kheshtan dar sadak'akh'oi farz va nafl sadak'adikh'anda va zanoni sadak'adikh'anda va mardoni kholisona dar ruzakh'oi farzu nafl ruzagir va zanoni ruzagir va mardoni sharmgokh'i khudro bo pushonidan az nazari begonagon va duri ch'ustan az zinovu muk'addimakh'oi zino nigokh'doranda va zanoni sharmgokh'ashonro nigokh'doranda va mardoni bo zabonu k'alb va oshkoru nikh'on zikrkunandai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va zanoni zikrkunanda, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi inkh'o mag'firati gunokh' va dar ruzi k'iiomat podoshi azimi ch'annatro mukh'aiio gardonida ast.

36) Va baroi mardi boimon va zani boimon durust nest, ki vak'te Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash ba onkh'o oidi kore kh'ukm kunand, dar paziruftan io raddi on ikhtiior doshta boshand. Va kh'ar ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulashro nofarmoni mekunad, pas beshak, az rokh'i rost oshkor gumrokh' shuda ast.

37) Va ei Paiombar, ba iod biior, vak'te shakhse, ki (ia'ne Zaid ibni Kh'orisa (r)) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ne'mati Islom bar vai in'om namud va tu bo ozodsozi az g'ulomi bar vai ekh'son namudi, baroi mashvarat dar borai talok'i kh'amsarash Zainabi dukhtari Ch'akh'sh nazdat omad, tu ba u megufti: "Kh'amsaratro nigokh' bidor va uro talok' madekh' va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi farmon va parkh'ez az nakh'iash bitars". Va khabari az sui Zaid talok'shavii Zainab va bo vai izdivoch' kardanatro, ki in ma'lumotro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar tu paig'om firistoda bud va ba zudi onro oshkor mesokht, dar k'albat pinkh'on mekardi va dar oshkor sokhtanash az sukhani mardum metarsidi, kh'ol on ki dar kh'ama kh'olat Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sazovortar ast, ki az U bitarsi. Pas zamone Zaid az Zainab kh'och'ati khudro barovard va az vai dilsard gashta, talok'ash dod, Mo uro ba ak'di nikokh'i tu darovardem, to minba'd bar mu'minon dar izdivoch' bo kh'amsaroni pisarkhondakh'oiashon ba'd az talok' va guzashtani iddaashon gunokh'e naboshad. Va amri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) noguzir ich'roshavanda ast.

38) Bar Mukh'ammadi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), dar on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az izdivoch' bo kh'amsari pisarkhondaash muk'addar sokhta, onro baroiash kh'alol gardonida ast, gunokh' va tak'sire nest. Vai dar in kor az rokh'i paiombaroni guzashta pairavi karda ast. Binobar in, vai az baini paiombaron nakhustin kase nest, ki chunin korero karda boshad. Va kh'ukmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oidi izdivoch' bo Zainab va botilsozii pisarkhondagi, ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nametavonist in kh'ukmro tark sozad, k'azo va k'adari ich'roshavandai radnopazir bud.

39) Paiombaron kasoneand, ki ba mardum paig'omkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro merasonand va g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kase nametarsand. Vak'te onkh'o kori kh'alolro ba ch'o meorand, ba sukhani mardum parvo namekunand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati Nigakh'boni amali bandagon, ki kh'amai onro kh'isob karda, podoshashon medikh'ad, basanda ast. Agar kori nek kardand, podoshi nek va agar kori bad sodir kardand, ch'azoi bad megirand.

40) Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) padari kh'ak'ik'ii kh'ech' kas az mardoni shumo nest. Baroi kh'amin Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) padari Zaid nest, ki nikokh'i Zainab ba'd az talok' bar vai kh'arom boshad. Vale u Firistodai Khudo ba sui mardum va khotami paiombaron ast. Ba'd az u digar paiombar nameoiad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai kh'ama chiz ast. Kh'ech' kori bandagon az U pinkh'on namemonad.
41) Ei mu'minoni poibandi shariat! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro bo k'alb, zabon va digar a'zoi badan bisior iod kuned.
42) Va dar og'oz va anch'omi ruz, ki in du vak't fazilati ziiod dorad, Uro bo guftani "Subkh'onallokh'" va "Lo ilokh'a illalokh'" az kh'amai aibu nuk'son ba poki nisbat dikh'ed.

43) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki bar shumo takh'sin mefiristad va mavridi rakh'mati Khesh k'aroraton medikh'ad va farishtagonash dar kh'ak'k'aton duoi nek mekunand, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro az torikikh'oi kufr ba sui nuri imon berun sozad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba mu'minon bag'oiat Mekh'rubon ast. Dar surati amri Uro ich'ro kardanashon onkh'oro azob namedikh'ad.

44) Ruze, ki mu'minon bo Khudo mulok'ot mekunand, durudi U bar onkh'o "Salom va amon bar shumo az kh'ar guna nokhushi" ast. Va Khudo ba onkh'o baroi ibodat va tarki ma'siiat ach'ri sakhovatmandonai ch'annatro omoda sokhta ast.

45) Ei Paiombar, Ba durusti ki Mo turo ba sui mardum dar borai on ki paig'omkh'oi Moro ba onkh'o rasonidai, shokh'id va muzhdarasoni mu'minon ba ch'annat va bimdikh'andai kofiron az duzakh firistodem.
46) Va inchunin turo bo amri Khudo kh'amchun da'vatgar ba sui tavkh'id va ibodat va charog'i nurafshon, ki kh'ar tolibi kh'idoiat az rushnoii on istifoda mebarad, firistodem.

47) Va mu'minoni poibandi shariatro bashorat dekh', ki baroiashon az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) fazli azimi farogir ast. Akh'li imon dar dunio piruz va dar okhirat bo noil gashtan ba ch'annat rastagor meshavand.

48) Va az kofiron va munofik'on dar on chi turo ba sui on faro mekhonand va bo shariat mukholifat dorad, itoat makun va az ozorashon rui gardon, shoiad in boisi imon ovardanashon gardad va dar tamomi korkh'oiat, az ch'umla dar mavridi alaikh'i dushman piruzshavi bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavakkul kun. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sifati Nigakh'bonu Iorirason kofist, ki bandagon dar umuri dunio va okhirat bar U takia kunand.

49) Ei mu'minoni poibandi shariat! Chun bo zanoni boimon ak'di nikokh' basted, sipas onkh'oro k'abl az kh'ambistari talok' doded, pas baroi shumo bar onkh'o kh'ech' nav'i idda -na iddai bo didani se kh'aiz va na iddai bo guzashtani se mokh'- nest, zero ba sababi on ki shumo bo onkh'o kh'ambistar nashudaed, az ch'anin pok budani bachadonashon ma'lum ast. Va ba zanone, ki talok'ashon medikh'ed, bo mak'sadi dilbardori ba k'adri tavonaton az amvoli kheshtan baroiashon kh'adia bidikh'ed va onkh'oro biduni rasonidani ozor rakh'o sozed, to nazdi khonadonashon biravand.

50) Ei Paiombar, Mo ba tu kh'amsaroneatro, ki makh'rashonro pardokht kardai va kanizoneatro, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba tu az kh'isobi g'animat doda ast, kh'alol gardonidem va inchunin nikokh'i dukhtaroni amakat va dukhtaroni ammaat va dukhtaroni tag'oiat va dukhtaroni kholaatro, ki kh'amrokh'at az Makka ba Madina kh'ich'rat kardaand va niz izdivoch'i zani boimonro agar biduni makh'r khudro ba tu bakhshad va ba izdivoch'i on zan mail doshta boshi, kh'alol gardonidem va in nav' nikokh', ia'ne on ki zan biduni makh'r khudro ba marde bakhshad, khosi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) buda va baroi digaron ravo nameboshad. Ba durusti, Mo on chiro bar mu'minon dar borai kh'amsaronashon voch'ib gardonidaem, ki kh'ak'k'i bo beshtar az chor zan izdivoch'ro nadorand va on chiro bar onkh'o dar borai kanizonashon voch'ib gardonidaem, ki metavonand az kanizoni khud biduni makh'dudiiat dar adad bakh'ra barand, medonem. Va az akh'komi mazkur ba'zero makhsus baroi tu ch'oiz k'aror doda, digaronro az on istisno namudem, to in ki bar tu tangi va mashak'k'at naboshad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

51) Ei Paiombar, az kh'amsaronat kh'issai kh'ar kiro khokh'i, metavoni ba ta'khir andozi va shab dar kanorash namoni va az onkh'o kh'ar kiro khokh'i, metavoni dar kanori kheshtan ch'oi doda, shab kh'amrokh'ash bimoni. Va kh'ar kasero az on kh'amsaronat, ki kh'issaashonro kanor guzoshtai, talab kuni, to dar kanorat bimonad, pas dar in kor bar tu gunokh'e nest. In kh'ukmi dar borai sakh'mi kh'amsaronat ba tu ikhtiior dodan va dar in kor farokhi bakhshidan, dar oromshavii chashmonashon va g'amgin nagashtanashon va rozi shudani kh'amaashon ba on chi baroiashon dodai, vasilai nazdiktar ast, chunki onkh'o medonand, ki tu voch'ibero tark nakardai va dar kh'ak'k'i kh'ech' kadomashon bukhl navarzidai. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chi dar k'albi shumo mardon az rag'bat ba ba'zei zanon va berag'bati ba ba'zei digar mavch'ud ast, medonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donoi Burdbor ast. Az kh'amai kori bandagon ittiloi komil dorad, chize az U makhfi nest, ammo bo vuch'udi in az rui kh'ilmi Khesh onkh'oro dar kh'ol azob namekunad, balki mukh'lat medikh'ad, to tavba kunand.

52) Va ei Paiombar, minba'd baroiat ch'uz kh'amsaronat bo digar zanon izdivoch' namudan kh'alol nest va inchunin baroiat kh'alol nest, ki tamomi kh'amsaronat io ba'zeashonro talok' bidikh'i, to dar ivazi onkh'o bo digar zanon ak'di izdivoch' namoi va agarchi ch'amoli on zanoni mekhostaat turo ba kh'airat andozad, g'air az kanizonat, ki bakh'ramandi az onkh'o shumorai makh'dud nadorad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'amai chiz Nigakh'bon ast. Kh'ukmi mazkur nishondikh'andai fazilati kh'amsaroni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ast. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) talok' dodan va g'airi onkh'o bo digar zanon izdivoch' namudani Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro mamnu' sokht.

53) Ei mu'minoni poibandi shariat! Ba khonakh'oi Paiombari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) vorid nashaved, magar ba'd az on ki ba shumo bo da'vat namudanaton ba taom ich'ozati daromadanro dikh'ad va dar khonaash pukhtani taomro muntazir shuda, durudaroz nashined, vale chun ba ziiofat da'vat shaved, pas ba khonaash daroed. Pas vak'te taomro khurded, zud bargarded va ba'd az tanovuli taom bo kh'amdigar sargarmi sukhan gashta naisted. Kh'amono istodani shumo ba'd az khurdani taom Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro ozor medikh'ad, pas sharm medorad, ki az shumo talabi ba khonakh'oi khesh bargashtanro kunad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az dastur ba kh'ak' sharm namedorad. Binobar in, ba shumo farmon dod, ki ba khonakh'oiaton biraved va bo istodani tuloni dar khonai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ozorash nadikh'ed. Va chun az kh'amsaroni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kh'och'atero ba misli zarf va g'aira pursidan khokh'ed, pas onro az pasi parda bipursed va rubaru napursed, to chashmaton ba onkh'o narasad va kh'arimi poki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) makh'fuz bimonad. In az pasi parda khostani kh'och'at baroi pok mondani k'albkh'oi shumo va k'albkh'oi onkh'o az kh'ama guna shubkh'a vasilai bekh'tar ast, to Shaiton ba dilaton rokh' naiobad va amali badro dar nazaraton ch'ilva nadikh'ad. Va ei mu'minon, baroiaton loik' nest, ki dar manzili Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) istoda, bo kh'am sargarmi sukhan shuda, uro ozor dikh'ed va niz loik' nest, ki ba'd az margash bo kh'amsaronash ak'di izdivoch' banded. Zero zanoni vai kh'ukman modaroni mu'minonand va mu'min shar'an nametavonad bo modarash izdivoch' kunad. Begumon ozor dodani Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va ba'd az vafotash bo kh'amsaronash izdivoch' namudan kh'arom buda, nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'i azim shumurda meshavad.

54) Agar az a'moli khesh chizero oshkor kuned io onro dar k'albaton pinkh'on sozed, kh'argiz az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pushida namemonad. Chunki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai kh'ama chiz ast. Tamomi ch'uz'iioti a'moli bandagonro medonad va ruzi k'iiomat dar ivazi kh'ar kor podoshashon medikh'ad. Agar kori nek anch'om doda boshand, podoshi nek va illo ch'azoi bad megirand.

55) Bar kh'amsaroni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va digar zanoni musalmon gunokh'e nest, ki padaronashon va farzandonashon va barodaronashon va barodarzodagonashon va khokh'arzodagoni nasabi io shirkhoraashon va zanoni boimon va kanizonashon onkh'oro bekh'ich'ob binand va kh'amsukh'bat shavand. Va ei zanoni boimon, az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi amrkh'o va parkh'ez az nakh'ikh'oiash bitarsed. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ama chiz Guvokh' ast. Kh'ar chi az ch'onibi shumo sodir meshavad, Khudo onro mushokh'ida mekunad va medonad.

56) Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdi farishtagonash bar Mukh'ammadi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) sano mefiristad va farishtagonash dar kh'ak'k'i Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) duoi nek mekunand. Ei mu'minoni poibandi shariat! Bar Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) salavot va kh'atman salom bifiristed.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati k'abli mu'minonro amr kard, ki ekh'tiromi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro nigokh' dorand va ba on kas salavotu salom firistand, dar oiati zerin az ozori eshon man' namud va guft:
57) Ba durusti, kasone, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulashro bo k'avl io amal ozor medikh'and, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dunio va okhirat onkh'oro az rakh'matash dur sokhta ast va dar k'iiomat baroi onkh'o azobi khorsozanda omoda karda ast. Ch'azoi ozori Paiombari Allokh' kh'amin guna ast.

58) Va kasone, ki bo sukhan io amali khud mardoni boimon va zanoni boimonro biduni on ki murtakibi gunokh'e shudaand, ozor medikh'and, pas iak'inan in ozordikh'andagon bar dushi khesh durug' va gunokh'i oshkorro bardoshtaand.

59) Ei Paiombar, ba kh'amsaronat va dukhtaronat va zanoni akh'li imon bigu, ki rusarikh'oiashonro bar kheshtan biandozand, to nazdi mardoni begona a'zoi satrshavandaashon oshkor nashavad. In pushidani rusari baroi on ki az toifai zanoni ozod budanashon ma'lum gardad, pas misli kanizon mavridi dastdarozi va ozor k'aror nagirand, vasilai nazdiktar ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

60) Ei Paiombar, agar munofik'on az nifok' (pinkh'onsozii kufr va oshkorsozii imon) va on nafarone, ki dar dilkh'oiashon bemorii shakh'vatparasti dorand va on kasone, ki ba Madinai Munavvara akhbori durug'ro meorand, to baini mu'minon ch'udoi andozand, az kirdori khesh khuddori nakunand, begumon Mo turo bar onkh'o musallat megardonem va ba much'ozot dodanashon dastur medikh'em, sipas onkh'o bo tu dar Madina ch'uz zamoni andak kh'amsoiagi namekunand. Zero ba sababi fasodkori dar zamin io kushta meshavand io az in sarzamin badarg'a megardand.
61) Onkh'o az rakh'mati Khudo rondashudagonand. Kh'ar kuch'o ioft shavand, dastgir gashta va ba shiddat kushta meshavand. Chunki onkh'o munofik'and va dar zamin ba fasodkori dast zadaand.

62) K'onuni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar sha'ni munofik'on vak'te nifok'ashonro oshkor sozand, kh'amin ast. In k'onunro dar ummatkh'oi k'abli ch'ori karda ast. K'onuni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) doimamalkunanda ast. Kh'argiz baroi on kh'ech' nav' digarguniero nameiobi.

63) Ei Paiombar, mushrikon turo bo mak'sadi inkor va takzib az k'iiomat mepursand. K'avmi iakh'ud niz suol mekunand, ki k'iiomat kai rukh medikh'ad? Ba onkh'o bigu: "Ilmi zamoni vuk'ui on nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Man dar in mas'ala donish nadoram." Va tu ei Paiombar, chi medoni, ki shoiad barposhavii k'iiomat nazdik boshad?
64) Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofironro az rakh'matash ronda va dar k'iiomat baroiashon otashi sakht alangazanandaro omoda sokhta ast.
65) Duzakhikh'o dar azobi on otash ch'ovidoni abadi memonand. Onkh'o dar duzakh kh'ech' k'aribe va ioridikh'anda nameioband, ki baroiashon manfiat rasonad va azobashonro bartaraf sozad.

66) Ruzi k'iiomat chekh'raashon dar otashi duzakh az iak kh'olat ba kh'olati digar gardonda meshavad. Onkh'o az shiddati kh'asratu nadomat meguiand: "Ei kosh, mo dar dunio bo ich'roi amr va parkh'ez az nakh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasuli Uro itoat mekardem."
67) Va duzakhiion daleli beasos ovarda meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, kh'amono mo farmoni peshvoionamon va buzurgoni k'avmamonro itoat kardem. Pas onkh'o moro az rokh'i rost gumrokh' sokhtand.
68) Ei Parvardigori mo, ba in peshvoion va buzurgoni k'avm, ki moro az rokh'i rost gumrokh' kardand, du barobar beshtar azob bidekh' va onkh'oro az rakh'mati Khud ba kulli dur gardon."

69) Ei mu'minoni boamal! Paiombaratonro ozor nadikh'ed, zero dar surati ozor dodanash ba kasone monand meshaved, ki Musoro bo aibnok donistani badanash ozor dodand, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pok budanashro az on chi guftand, oshkor sokht va az on tukh'mat solim budanash ma'lum gasht. Va Muso nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) obrumand bud. Darkhostash rad va taloshash nokom nameshud.
70) Ei bandagoni mu'mini boamal! Az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi amrash va parkh'ez az nakh'iash bitarsed va sukhani rostu durust bigued.

71) Agar az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tarsida, sukhani rostu durust gued, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amalkh'oiatonro islokh' gardonda, onro mepazirad va gunokh'onatonro makh'v sokhta, ba muk'obili kirdorkh'oi bad ba shumo ch'azo namedikh'ad. Va kh'ar ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulashro itoat kunad, pas vai biduni shak, ba komiobii azime noil gashta ast, ki kh'ech' komiobi bo on barobar nest. In komiobi az daromadan ba ch'annat va rasidan ba rizoi ilokh'i iborat ast.

72) Ba durusti ki Mo ich'roi mas'uliiatkh'oi shar'i va nigakh'dorii molkh'o va sirkh'oro bar osmonkh'o va zamin va kukh'kh'o peshkash kardem, pas onkh'o az bardoshtani in amonatkh'o khuddori namudand va az ok'ibati on tarsidand va inson onro bardosht. Iak'inan inson bar khesh sitamgari az ok'ibati kh'amli in amonat nikh'oiat nodon bud.

73) Inson on amonatro bo tak'diri Khudo bardosht, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mardoni munofik' va zanoni munofik' va mardoni mushrik va zanoni mushrikro baroi nifok' va shirkashon azob kunad va tavbai mardoni boimon va zanoni boimonero, ki amonati bar zimma giriftaashonro nek ich'ro namudand, bipazirad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

1) Sitoish makhsusi Parvardigorest, ki kh'amai mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va mavch'udoti zamin ba e'tibori ofarinish, molikiiat va tadbir az Ust. Va sitoish dar okhirat niz fak'at khosi Ust. Va U dar ofaridan va tadbiri korkh'o Kh'akim buda, az akh'voli bandagon Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nest.

2) Kh'ar on chi az ob va rastani dar zamin furu meravad va kh'ar on chi az rastani va g'airi on az zamin berun meshavad va kh'ar on chi az boron, ruziiu farishtagon az osmon furud meoiad va kh'ar on chi az farishtagon, a'moli bandagon va rukh'ashon ba osmon mebaroiad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'uz'iiot va kulliioti onro medonad. Va U dar kh'ak'k'i mu'minon nikh'oiat Mekh'ruboni Bakhshandai gunokh'oni bandagoni tavbakor ast.

3) Va kofiron meguiand: "Kh'ech' gokh' ba mo k'iiomat nameoiad." Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Ore, ba Parvardigori G'aibdonam savgand, ki k'iiomat kh'atman ba shumo meoiad, vale zamoni omadani onro ch'uz Khudo kase namedonad. Zero tankh'o U az g'aib Ogokh' ast. Az ilmi Khudo dar osmonkh'o va na dar zamin ba andozai khurdtarin murcha va na az on khurdtar va na kalontar makhfi namemonad, balki on iak'inan dar kitobi ravshani "Lavkh'i Makh'fuz" sabt shuda ast." "Lavkh'i Makh'fuz" kitobest, ki dar on tamomi chiz to ruzi k'iiomat sabt gashta ast.

4) Khudo dar "Lavkh'i Makh'fuz" kh'amai chizro sabt namuda ast, to ba kasone, ki imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om medikh'and, podosh bidikh'ad. Baroi in gurukh'i doroi sifatkh'oi mazkur az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mag'firati gunokh' va ruzi k'iiomat ruzii arzishmandi ch'annat ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az gunokh'onashon guzashta, azobashon namekunad.

5) Va kasone, ki dar botil sokhtani oiatkh'oi nozilkardai Mo talosh namuda, on oiatkh'oro "ch'odu" va Paiombari firistodaamonro "ch'odugar va shoir" guftand, ruzi k'iiomat baroi in toifai bo sifatkh'oi mazkur tavsifshuda badtarin va sakhttarin azobi dardovar ast.

6) Olimoni sakh'obagon va olimoni akh'li Kitob guvokh'i medikh'and, ki on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az paig'om bar tu nozil karda ast, begumon kh'ak' ast va on mardumro ba rokh'i Parvardigori G'olibi dar dunio va okhirat Sutuda kh'idoiat mekunad.

7) Va kofiron az rui taach'ch'ub va tamaskhuri Paiombari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba iakdigar guftand: "Oio mekhokh'ed shumoro ba marde rakh'namoi kunem, ki baroiaton az on khabar medikh'ad, ki vak'te bimired va ch'ismaton dar zamin ba purragi pora-pora sokhta shavad, ba'd az marg dubora kh'atman zinda gardonida meshaved?"

8) Kofiron guftand: "Oio in mard bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' bofta ast, ki da'vo dorad mo ba'di marg boz zinda gardonida meshavem io vai devona ast va baroi kh'amin chunin sukhanoni beasos meguiad?" Kh'ak'ik'at on guna ki onkh'o mepindorand, nest, balki kh'osili kalom, on kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nameorand, ruzi k'iiomat ba uk'ubati sakht giriftor meshavand va dar dunio dar gumrokh'ii az rokh'i rost dur umr ba sar mebarand.

9) Oio in takzibgaroni ruzi k'iiomat on chi zeri k'adamashon az zamin va on chi boloi sarashon az osmon kh'ast, namebinand?! Agar Mo bikhokh'em, onkh'oro ba zeri zamin furu mebarem io osmonro k'it'a-k'it'a bar onkh'o furu merezem. Ba durusti ki dar nigokh'u tafakkur dar osmonu zamin baroi kh'ar bandae, ki ba vasilai ibodat ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barmegardad, alomati k'at'ii k'udrati ilokh'i ast. Ofaridgori dar in kor Tavono k'udrat dorad, ki shumoro ba'd az margaton va porashavii ch'ismaton az nav zinda gardonad.

10) Va iak'inan Mo az nazdi Khud ba Dovud (alaikh'is salom) nubuvvat va saltanatro dodem va ba kukh'kh'o va parandagon guftem: "Ei kukh'kh'o va ei parandagon, kh'amrokh'i Dovud tasbekh' bigued." Va Mo baroi Dovud (alaikh'is salom) okh'anro narm gardonidem, to az on kh'ar olotero, ki bikhokh'ad, bisozad.

11) Ba u guftem: "Ei Dovud, az okh'an ch'avshankh'oi vase' bisoz, to ch'angovaronatro az zarari dushman mukh'ofizat kunad va mekhkh'oro baroi boftani ch'avshan munosibi kh'alk'akh'o gardonida, onro na ba on andoza borik bikun, ki dar kh'alk'akh'o naistad va na ba on andoza g'afs bikun, ki dar kh'alk'akh'o nadaroiad. Va ei khonadoni Dovud, kori shoista anch'om bidikh'ed. Kh'amono on chi shumo mekuned, Man onro mebinam. Kh'ech' koraton az Man makhfi namemonad va dar muk'obili on ch'azoiaton medikh'am."

12) Va Mo shamolro takh'ti farmoni Sulaimoni pisari Dovud (alaikh'is salom) k'aror dodem. Shamol subkh' ba masofai iak mokh' va begokh' ba masofai iak mokh' kh'arakat mekard. Va chashmai misro baroi vai ravon sokhtem, to az on kh'ar chi khokh'ad, bisozad. Va az ch'inkh'o gurukh'ero mutei amri Sulaimon gardonidem, ki bo amri Parvardigorash dar peshash kor mekardand. Va kh'ar ki az chinkh'o az ich'roi farmoni Mo kach' shavad, az uk'ubati otashi alangador ba u mechashonem.

13) Ch'inkh'o baroi Sulaimon kh'ar on chi az ma'badkh'ovu k'asrkh'o va much'assamakh'o va kosakh'oi monand ba kh'avzkh'oi kalon va degkh'oi ustuvori taompazi, ki az sababi kh'ach'mi ziiod doshtan ch'unbonida nameshudand, mekhost, mesokhtand. Va Mo ba onkh'o guftem: "Ei khonadoni Dovud, dar barobari on chi Khudo bar shumo in'om karda ast, shukri Uro ba ch'o ored." Va az bandagonam te'dodi kami onkh'o shukrguzori ne'matand.

14) Pas vak'te Mo margi Sulaimonro kh'ukm kardem, tankh'o ch'onvari chubkhor, ki asoi takiakardai uro mekhurd, ch'inkh'oro ba margash rakh'namoi kard. Pas zamone Sulaimon ba zamin aftod, ba ch'inkh'o ma'lum gasht, ki g'aibro namedonand. Zero agar onkh'o g'aibro medonistand, dar in azobi khorkunanda namemondand. Ch'inkh'o on umuri sanginro bo in gumon ich'ro mekardand, ki Sulaimon zinda ast va onkh'oro nazorat dorad.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi k'abli ne'mati bar Dovud (alaikh'is salom) va pisarash Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom) dodai Khudro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin lutfu ekh'sonash bar k'abilai Saba'ro baion sokht. Bo in fark', ki Dovudu Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom) ne'matkh'oi Uro shukrguzori kardand, ammo k'abilai Saba' nosiposi namudand.
15) Kh'amono baroi k'abilai Saba' dar ch'oi sukunatashon alomati ravshani k'udrat va ekh'soni Khudo bar onkh'o bud. On alomat az du bustone iborat bud, ki iakei on az samti rost va digarash az samti chapi shakh'r k'aror dosht. Mo ba onkh'o guftem: "Az rizk'i Parvardigoraton khured va dar barobari lutfu ekh'sonash shukri Uro ba ch'o ored. In shakh'ri poki doroi ne'matkh'oi farovon va in Parvardigori Bakhshandai gunokh'oni bandagoni tavbakor ast."

16) Pas akh'li Saba' az shukrguzorii Mo va imon ba paiombaron rui gardondand. Pas Mo az onkh'o bo tabdil dodani ne'matkh'oiamon intik'om girifta, azobashon kardem. Ba onkh'o seli takhribkunanda firistodem. On sel devorkh'oi shakh'rashonro kharob va kishtashonro g'ark'i ob sokht. Va ba onkh'o dar badali on du bog'i serkh'osil du bog'i doroi mevakh'oi talkh dodem va in du bog' giiokh'i besamari "Gaz"[ iake az rastanikh'oi buttagii khudrui surkhchubi sakht, ki dar ch'angalkh'oi sokh'ili dario, zaminkh'oi shuru sanglokh va kukh'u biiobon meruiand] va kame az darakhti "Kunor"[Darakhti bisior tanovar] dosht.

17) Mo ba on sabab k'abilai Saba'ro bo "azobi tabdili ne'mat" much'ozot kardem, ki onkh'o kofir shudand va az shukrguzorii ne'matkh'o rui toftand. Va Mo bo in azobi shadid kasero ba ch'uz bandai nosiposi ne'matkh'o va munkiri Khudo uk'ubat namekunem.

19) Pas onkh'o ba ne'mati nazdiksozii masofakh'o nosiposi kardand va guftand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, bo bartaraf sokhtani in dekh'akh'o miioni safarkh'oi mo dur kun, to ranch'i safarro chashem va imtiiozi markabkh'oiamon oshkor shavad." Va onkh'o bo nosiposii ne'mati ilokh'i, rui gardondan az siposguzori va khudro az fak'iron bolo donistan bar ch'oni kheshtan sitam namudand. Pas Mo onkh'oro ba sukhankh'oi sari zaboni mardum tabdil dodem, ki az eshon baroi nasli minba'da ch'uz k'issavu kh'ikoiot nishone namond. Va onkh'oro dar shakh'rkh'oi mukhtalif ba purragi parokanda sokhtem va bo iakdigar raftuomad karda nametavonistand. Ba durusti ki dar in k'issai akh'li Saba', ki Khudo dar avval baroiashon ne'mat dod va ba'd az nosiposi onkh'oro giriftori uk'ubat sokht, baroi kh'ar bandae, ki dar toatu musibat va duri az ma'siiat sabr varzida, ba ne'matkh'oi Parvardigor shukrguzori menamoiad, ibrati azim ast.

20) Va Iblis gumonashro nisbatashon, ki onkh'oro az rokh'i durust gumrokh' mesozad, takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshid. Pas onkh'o, ba istisnoi toifai kami muminon dar kufru zalolat az Iblis pairavi namudand. Ammo akh'li imon bo pairavi nakardan az Iblis umedashro barbod dodand.

21) Va Iblis bar onkh'o kh'ech' k'udrate nadosht, ki bo istifoda az on ich'boran gumrokh'ashon sozad, balki vai tankh'o dar nazarashon gunokh'ro oroish medod va ig'vo meandokht. Lekin Mo ba Iblis dar ig'voangezii onkh'o ich'ozat doda budem, to kh'olati on kasero, ki ba okhirat va ch'azoi on imon meorad, az on kase, ki dar borai okhirat shubkh'a dorad, ba digaron ma'lum sozem. Va ei Paiombar, Parvardigorat ba kh'amai chiz Nigakh'bon ast. Tamomi amalkh'oi bandagonro kh'ifz karda, dar ivazash ba onkh'o ch'azo medikh'ad.

22) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Ononero, ki g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi khud pindoshted, nido kuned, to ba shumo foida rasonand io zararero bartaraf sozand. Ma'budkh'oi botilaton dar osmonkh'o va zamin ba andozai iak zarra moliki chize nestand va dar osmonkh'o va zamin bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shariki nadorand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' iovare nadorad. Zero U az sharik va iovar Beniioz ast."

23) Va nazdi Khudo shafoat sud namebakhshad, magar ba on kase, ki U baroiash rukhsati shafoat dikh'ad. Khudo tankh'o ba bandai pisandidaash ich'ozati shafoat medikh'ad, zero U Boazamat ast. Az dalelkh'oi azamatash on ast, ki chun dar osmon sukhan guiad, farishtagon dar barobari on dar kh'oli furutani bol mezanand va onkh'oro dakh'shati sakht faro megirad. Farishtagon dar kh'olati tarsu dakh'shat memonand, to on ki in iztirob az k'albashon bartaraf karda shavad. Ba'd az bartaraf shudanash onkh'o ba Ch'abrail meguiand: "Parvardigoraton chi guft?" Ch'abrail meguiad: "Parvardigoramon sukhani kh'ak'ro guft va U bo Zot va saltanatash az kh'amai chiz Bartaru Buzurgtar ast."

24) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Ki shumoro az osmonkh'o bo furud ovardani boron va az zamin bo ruionidani ziroat, mevakh'oi mukhtalif va g'aira ruzi medikh'ad?!" Bigu: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi medikh'ad. Va ei mushrikon, ba durusti ki mo io shumo bar kh'idoiat io zalolati oshkor k'aror dorem. Az movu shumo iake kh'idoiatshuda va digare gumrokh' ast." Beshak, mu'minon akh'li kh'idoiat va mushrikon akh'li zalolatand.
25) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Shumo ruzi k'iiomat az gunokh'oni sodirkardai mo pursida nameshaved va mo niz az on chi shumo anch'om medoded, pursida nameshavem."

26) Ba onkh'o bigu: "Parvardigoramon ruzi k'iiomat movu shumoro bo kh'am ch'am' mesozad, sipas dar bainamon odilona k'azovat karda, kh'ak'ro az nokh'ak' ch'udo mekunad. Va U Dovari Odilu Donost. Chi guna va chi dovari kardanashro khub medonad."

27) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "On ma'budkh'oi kheshtanro, ki dar ibodat sharikoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'aror doded, ba man nishon dikh'ed. Kh'argiz, kor chunonchi mepindored, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik dorad, nest. Balki U Allokh'i G'olibi, dar ofarinish, tak'dir va tadbiri umur Bokh'ikmat ast."

28) Va ei Paiombar, Ba durusti ki Mo turo ba sui tamomi mardum muzhdarasoni akh'li tak'vo ba ch'annat va bimdikh'andai akh'li kufru gunokh' az duzakh firistodem. Vale beshtari mardum inro namedonand. Chunki agar medonistand, turo ba durug'gui nisbat namedodand.
29) Va mushrikon zudtar omadani azobi va'dashudaro talab karda meguiand: "Agar shumo dar da'voi kheshtan oidi on ki guio mo ba azob mubtalo meshavem, kh'ak' boshed, azobi va'da kardaaton kai meoiad?"

30) Ei Paiombar, ba in gurukh'e, ki zudtar omadani azobro mekhokh'and, bigu: "Azobi shumo ruzi muaiian dorad. Az on ruzi ta'iingashta iak lakh'za ak'ib va iak lakh'za pesh nameraved. Ruzi va'dai uk'ubat k'iiomat ast."

31) Va kofiron meguiand: "Mo kh'argiz na ba in K'ur'on, ki bo pindori Mukh'ammad az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) furud omada ast va na ba Kitobkh'oi osmonii guzashta imon nameorem." Va ei Paiombar agar tu bubini, on gokh', ki sitamkoron ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi nazdi Parvardigorashon boz doshta meshavand, dar kh'ole ki bo iakdigar raddu badal mekunand, kh'ar kas mas'uliiat va malomatro bar dushi kasi digar meafkanad, pairavone, ki az ch'onibi rakh'baronashon kh'ak'ir shumurda meshudand, ba rakh'baroni mutakabbiri kheshtan meguiand: "Agar shumo moro az rokh'i rost gumrokh' namekarded, ba Allokh' va Rasulash imon meovardem", kh'olati taach'ch'ubovarero khokh'i did.

32) Va peshvoioni az k'abuli kh'ak' kibrvarzida ba pairavonashon, ki dar dunio onkh'oro kh'ak'ir meshumurdand, guiand: "Oio mo shumoro az kh'idoiati ovardai Mukh'ammad man' namudem? Ne, balki shumo khud zolim va fasodkor buded."

33) Va pairavone, ki az ch'onibi rakh'baronashon bek'adr shumurda meshudand, ba rakh'baronashon, ki az k'abuli kh'ak' kibr varzidaand, guiand: "Balki on nairange, ki shumo shabu ruz dar kh'ak'k'i mo anch'om medoded, boisi az kh'idoiat makh'rumshaviamon gasht. Zero shumo moro dastur medoded, to ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shavem va ba U shirk ovarda, digar mavch'udotro biparastem." Va onkh'o vak'te azobro mushokh'ida kunand, nadomatashonro az on ki dar dunio kofir budand, pinkh'on mesozand va medonand, ki azob meshavand. Va Mo bar gardani kofiron zavlonakh'oro mezanem. Onkh'o bo in uk'ubati shadid ch'azo doda nameshavand, magar ba sababi on chi dar dunio az kufr va ma'siiat anch'om medodand.

Vak'te mushrikon Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro takzib kardand, Khudo bo furud ovardani oiati zerin eshonro tasalli doda, khotirrason namud, ki ummatkh'oi k'abli niz paiombaronashonro ba durug'gui nisbat medodand va naboiad az in odati kofiron dilsard shud.
34) Va Mo dar kh'ech' dekh'ae paiombari az azobi ilokh'i bimdikh'andaero nafiristodem, magar on ki kasoni ne'matparvardai doroi saltanatu mansabu moli onch'o guftand: "Ba durusti ki mo ba on chi firistoda shudaed, kofir kh'astem."

35) Va iftikhorkunon guftand: "Mo sokh'ibi amvol va farzandoni beshtarem. Va on chi shumo mepindored, ki guio mo giriftori azob meshavem, durug' ast. Mo na dar dunio va na dar okhirat uk'ubat karda nameshavem."

36) Ei Paiombar, ba in bandagoni mag'rur bigu: "Ba durusti ki Parvardigoram rizk'i kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, farokh megardonad, to siposguzori va nosiposii uro bisanch'ad va rizk'i kh'ar ki khokh'ad, tang megardonad, to bosabri va besabrii uro bisanch'ad." Valekin beshtari mardum namedonand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat Kh'akim ast. Tamomi korkh'oiash az rui kh'ikmat surat megirad. Ba'zei bandagon kh'ikmati Uro dark mekunand va ba'zei digar az on g'ofiland.

37) Va molkh'o va farzandonaton, ki bo onkh'o iftikhor mekuned, chize nestand, ki shumoro ba rizoi Mo nazdik sozand, lekin kh'ar ki ba Khudo imon orad va amali shoista anch'om dikh'ad, pas in toifa bandagon ba sababi korkh'oi neki dar dunio kardaashon podoshi duchand megirand. Inchunin amvoli dar rokh'i Khudo sarfkardaashon boisi ba khushnudii ilokh'i nazdik shudanashon megardad va farzandoni bo imon va tak'vo parvarish dodaashon dar kh'ak'k'ashon duoi nek mekunand. Va onkh'o dar balandtarin manzilkh'oi ch'annat az khavfi azob, marg va zavoli ne'mat dar amonand.

38) Va kofirone, ki dar bargardonidani mardum az oiatkh'oi Mo tamomi taloshi khudro mebakhshand va dar rokh'i takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshidani in kh'adaf sa'i menamoiand, dar dunio ziion mebinand va dar okhirat duchori azob megardand.

39) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Beshak, Parvardigoram az bandagoni Khud rizk'i kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, farokh va rizk'i kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, tang mesozad. Va kh'ar chi dar rokh'i ilokh'i kharch' mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dunio ba shumo ba ivazash ne'mati bekh'tar va dar okhirat ch'annatro ato mekunad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bekh'tarini ruzidikh'andagon ast." Az in ru, kh'ar kas ruzi mekhokh'ad, boiad onro tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bikhokh'ad.

40) Va ei Paiombar, ruzero ba khotir biior, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar on kh'ama mushrikonro ch'am' megardonad, sipas bo mak'sadi sarzanishi onkh'o ba farishtagon meguiad: "Oio inkh'o dar dunio ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro meparastidand?!"

41) Farishtagon meguiand: "Tu az kh'ama aibu nuk'son va anboz Poku Muk'addas kh'asti! Iagona Dustu Iovari mo Tui, na onkh'o. Baini movu mushrikon paivandi dusti mavch'ud nest. Balki onkh'o Shaitonkh'oro meparastidand. Shaitonkh'o khudro ba surati farishtagon vonamud mesokhtand va mushrikon onkh'oro ibodat mekardand. Beshtarashon ba Shaitonkh'o imon doshtand."

42) Va ruzi kh'ashru bozpursi ma'budkh'oiaton baroi kasone, ki dar dunio onkh'oro ibodat mekardand, moliki foida va zarar nestand. Va Mo ba shakhsone, ki bo kufru ma'siiat bar ch'oni kheshtan sitam namudaand, meguem: "Azobi duzakhero, ki dar dunio onro durug' mepindoshted, bichashed."

43) Va vak'te bar mushrikoni takzibkunanda oiatkh'oi ravshani bar paiombaron nozilkardai Mo khonda shavad, meguiand: "Ba durusti, in Mukh'ammad mardest, ki mekhokh'ad shumoro az on chi padaronaton dar guzashta meparastidand, bargardonad." Va niz meguiand "In K'ur'on ch'uz sukhanoni durug'i dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo boftashuda chize nest." Va chun K'ur'on ba kofiron az nazdi Khudo oiad, dar mavridi on meguiand: "In Kitob ch'uz ch'odui oshkor chize nest. Zero kh'amsaru shavkh'ar va padaru pisarro az iakdigar ch'udo mesozad."

44) Va Mo k'ablan ba onkh'o kh'ech' kitobero nadodaem, ki onro khonand, to rakh'namoiashon kunad, ki K'ur'on sukhani boftai khudi Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ast. Va Mo ba sui onkh'o pesh az firistodani tu (Paiombari okhirzamon (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)) kh'ech' paiombari az azobi ilokh'i bimdikh'andaero niz nafiristodaem.

45) Va ummatkh'oi pesh az k'avmat guzashta ba misli k'avmi Od, Samud va Lut paiombaronashonro ba durug'gui nisbat dodaand. Va mushrikoni k'avmat ba dakh'iaki on chi ba ummatkh'oi sobik' az neru, doroi va adad doda budem, narasidaand. Pas, on ummatkh'o paiombarashonro takzib kardand. Neru, doroi va adadi ziiodashon sudashon nabakhshid va duchori uk'ubat gashtand. Pas, ei Paiombar, andesha kun, ki inkoru ik'obi Man bar onkh'o chi guna bud.

46) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Kh'amono man shumoro ba ich'roi iak kor mashvaratu andarz medikh'am. Mashvarat va andarzam on ast, ki kholis baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khudro az kh'ama khostakh'oi nafsaton kholi namuda, du nafar-du nafar io tankh'o-tankh'o barkhezed, sipas dar borai raftori ioraton Mukh'ammad, ba vizha oidi khiradmandi, sadok'at va amonatdoriash andesha namoed, to baroiaton iak'inan ma'lum gardad, ki vai devona nest. Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) baroi shumo pesh az omadani azobi shadid bimdikh'andae besh nest. U shumoro az on bim medikh'ad, ki agar az shirk tavba nakuned, ba azobi sakht duchor meshaved."

47) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikoni takzibkunanda bigu: "Man dar muk'obili tablig'i paiom az shumo chize namekhokh'am. Agar farazan az shumo podosh io muzd bikhokh'am, pas on muzd az shumost. Podoshi man fak'at bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va U bar kh'amai chiz Guvokh' meboshad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shokh'idi tablig'i risolati man va kori shumost. Ch'azoi korkh'oi shumoro ba purragi medikh'ad."

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi mazkur alaikh'i akh'li botil va shirk kh'uch'ch'at ovard, dar oiati zerin in ravishro ba kh'aisi k'onuni doimamalkunanda baion namuda meguiad:
48) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ba durusti, Parvardigoram kh'ak'ro bar botil musallat mesozad va botilro az bain mebarad. U Donandai g'aibkh'ost. Kh'ech' chiz dar osmonu zamin az U pinkh'on namemonad."
49) Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikoni takzibkunanda bigu: "Kh'ak' (Islom) omad va botil az bain rafta, az on asar va nerue bok'i namond va minba'd ba nufuzi k'abliash barnamegardad."

50) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Agar man dar on chi baroi shumo merasonam, az rokh'i durust gumrokh' shavam, pas zarari on ba khudam bargashta, az on ba shumo ziione namerasad va agar kh'idoiat ioftam, pas ba sababi on rakh'namoikh'oi kh'akimonaest, ki Parvardigoram ba man paig'om mefiristad. Iak'inan Parvardigoram Shunavandai sukhanoni bandagon buda, bag'oiat Nazdik ast, shunidani sukhanonam bar U dushvor nest."

51) Va ei Paiombar, agar on zamonero mushokh'ida mekardi, ki in mushrikoni takzibgar ruzi k'iiomat ba'd az didani uk'ubat ba dakh'shat meaftand, digar gurezgokh' va panokh'gokh' nameioband va az makoni nazdik dastgir karda meshavand, begumon kh'olati kh'airatovarero medidi.

52) Va vak'te onkh'o ch'oii bozgashtashonro binand, meguiand: "Ba ruzi k'iiomat imon ovardem." Va onkh'o chi guna metavonand ba imon dastrasi paido kunand, dar kh'ole ki bo berun shudan az saroi amal ba saroi ch'azo makoni ba dast ovardani imon az onkh'o dur monda ast?!

53) Va chi guna imoni onkh'o kh'osil va pazirufta meshavad, kh'ol on ki pesh az in dar dunio ba okhirat kofir gashta budand va az makoni dur az dariofti kh'ak' ch'okh'ilona gumoni nodurust andokhta, dar sha'ni Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) "ch'odugar", "folbin" va "shoir" meguftand?!

54) Va baini kofiron va baini on chi az kh'osil namudani lazzatkh'oi zindagi, tavba namudan az kufr, nach'ot ioftan az duzakh va bozgasht ba zindagonii dunio, ki onro mekhokh'and, ch'udoi andokhta shuda va onkh'o az rasidan ba on man' karda meshavand, chunonchi pesh az in bo ummatkh'oi takzibkunandai ba in kofiron monand kh'amin kor anch'om doda shud. Beshak, onkh'o oidi iaktoparastiiu imon ba rastokhez, ki paiombaronashon baroiashon ovardand, dar shubkh'ai barangezandai kufr k'aror doshtand.

1) Sitoish Allokh'i Ofaridgori osmonkh'o va zamin biduni namunai sobik'. Parvardigore, ki farishtagonro firistodagoni Khesh sokht, ba'zeashon farmonkh'oi ilokh'iro vobasta ba umuri koinot ba ch'o meorand va ba'zei digarashon paig'omi Uro ba paiombaron merasonand. U farishtagonro dar adoi amonati ba zimmaashon guzoshtashuda nerumand gardonda, onkh'oro doroi du va se va chor bol ofarida ast, ki baroi amalisozii amri ilokh'i bo istifoda az on bolkh'o parvoz mekunand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar ofarinishi farishtagon va mardumon kh'ar chiro ba monandi uzv, kh'usn io sado khokh'ad, afzun mesozad. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'amai chiz Tavono ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro och'iz namegardonad.

2) K'uflkushoi tamomi chiz dar dasti Parvardigor ast. Az in ru, kh'ar chiro az rizk', kh'idoiat, saodat va digar ne'matkh'o kushoiad, kh'ech' kas onro man' karda nametavonad va kh'ar chiro az in nombarshudakh'o boz medorad, kh'ech' kas ba'd az boz doshtanash az ukh'dai firistodani on namebaroiad. Va U Zoti G'olibi shikastnopazir buda, dar ofarinish, tak'dir va chorasozii korkh'o bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.

3) Ei mardum, bo k'alb, zabon va digar a'zoi badan ne'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dar kh'ak'k'i khud ba iod ored. Oio g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ofaridgore vuch'ud dorad, ki ba shumo az osmon bo furud ovardani boron va az zamin bo ruionidani ziroat va mevach'ot ruzi dikh'ad?! G'air az U ma'budi barkh'ak' nest. Pas chi guna ba'di in az in kh'ak'ik'at bargardonida meshaved va dar kh'ak'k'ash durug' bofta, da'vo mekuned, ki sharik dorad, dar kh'ole ki U shumoro ofarida va rizk'aton doda ast?!

4) Va ei Paiombar, agar k'avmat turo ba durug'gui nisbat medikh'and, pas sabr bikun, chunki tu nakhustin paiombari mavridi takzibi mardum k'aror girifta nesti, kh'amono k'abl az tu ummatkh'oi ziiode ba monandi k'avmi Od, Samud, Lut va digaron niz paiombaronro takzib namudand. Va tamomi korkh'o tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardonida meshavad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ok'ibat takzibkunandagonro kh'alok va paiombaronu mu'minonro iori medikh'ad.

5) Ei mardum, begumon va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vobasta ba rastokhez va ch'azoi ruzi k'iiomat kh'ak'ik'ati makh'z ast. Binobar in, naboiad lazzatkh'o va shakh'vatkh'oi zindagonii dunio shumoro az omodagi baroi okhirat fireb dikh'ad va inchunin naboiad Shaiton shumoro bo oroish dodani botil va moil kunonidan ba sui dunio az ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bifirebad.

6) Ei mardum, iak'inan Shaiton baroi shumo dushmani kh'ameshagi ast. Baroi kh'amin, shumo niz bo paivasta bar ziddash muboriza burdan uro dushman gired. Kh'amono Shaiton pairavonashro ba sui kufr faro mekhonad, to ok'ibat dar ruzi k'iiomat az kh'amdamoni duzakh boshand.

7) Kasone, ki bo pairavi az Shaiton kofir meshavand, baroi onkh'o azobi sakht ast. Va kasone, ki ba Khudo imon ovarda va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om medikh'and, baroi onkh'o az ch'onibi Khudo mag'firati gunokh'on va podoshi azimi ch'annat ast.

8) Ba durusti, kase, ki Shaiton dar nazarash kori badashro zinat doda, pas u on amalro nek pindoshta ast, ba monandi kase nest, ki Khudo kh'ak'ro baroiash orosta sokhta, pas u onro e'tik'odan pazirufta ast. Pas Khudo kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, gumrokh' va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, kh'idoiat mekunad. Kh'ech' kas Uro dar kore mach'bur sokhta nametavonad. Modom ki chunin ast, pas ei Paiombar, khudro baroi gumrokh'ii gumrokh'on az andukh'i bisior kh'alok magardon. Beshak, kh'ar on chi onkh'o mekunand, Khudo onro medonad. Kh'ech' amalashon az U pushida namemonad.

9) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki bodkh'oro barmeangezad, pas on bodkh'o abrkh'oro ba kh'arakat medarorand, pas Mo abrkh'oro ba sarzamini begiiokh' meronem va ba sababi boroni az abrkh'o nozilshuda zaminro ba'd az khushkiash bo ruionidani nabotot zinda megardonem. Chunonchi Mo in zaminro ba'di begiiokh'i va khushki bo ruionidani nabotot zinda sokhtem, ruzi k'iiomat zindashavii murdagon niz kh'amin guna surat megirad.

10) Kh'ar ki dar dunio io okhirat izzat mekhokh'ad, pas naboiad onro ch'uz az Khudo az kasi digar talabad. Zero kh'ama izzati duniovu okhirat tankh'o dar ikhtiiori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Zikri pokash ba sui U bolo meravad va U amali shoistai bandagonro ba sui Khud mebardorad va mepazirad. Va kasone, ki dasisakh'oi badero - ba misli nak'shai k'atli Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) - tadbir mekunand, onkh'oro azobi sakht ast. Va makri in kofiron botil va tabokh' gashta, onkh'o ba mak'sadashon namerasand.

11) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) On Zotest, ki padaraton Odamro az khok ofarid, sipas shumoro az obi nutfa khalk' kard, sipas shumoro naru moda sokht, to bo kh'amdigar izdivoch' kuned. Va kh'ech' zane kh'ech' ch'aninero dar batnash namebardorad va vaz'i kh'aml namekunad, magar in ki bordorshavi va tavallud bo ilmi Khudo surat megirad. Chize az U makhfi namemonad. Va bar umri kh'ech' kas az khalk'ash afzun va az on kam karda nameshavad, magar on ki in afzun va kamshavi dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz sabtshuda ast. Kh'amono ich'roi in korkh'o - az khok ofaridan, ba markh'ilakh'oi mukhtalif ch'udo sokhtani umri bandagon va sabt kardani muddati kh'aioti onkh'o dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz - bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat oson ast.

12) Va du dario bo kh'am barobar nestand. Iakeash guvoroi shirinu az sababi shirini nushidanash oson va duiumash shuri turshu az sababi shurii ziiod nushidanash nomumkin ast. Va az kh'ar kadomi on du darioi mazkur gushti tozai dilkashi mokh'iro mekhured va az onkh'o marvoridu march'on berun ovarda, baroi zinat onro mepushed. Va ei binanda, tu kishtikh'oro mebini, ki bo kh'arakati raftan va omadanashon darioro meshikofand, to ba vositai tich'orat az fazli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) talab namoed va to dar barobari ne'matkh'oi bekh'isob shukri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o ored.

13) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shabro dar ruz dokhil namuda, ruzro tuloni mesozad va ruzro dar shab dokhil namuda, shabro tuloni mesozad va oftob va mokh'ro musakhkhar sokhta ast. Kh'ar iakei oftobu mokh' to muddati nazdi Khudo muaiiani k'iiomat kh'arakat mekunand. In Zote, ki tamomi inro muaiian megardonad va ba kh'arakat medarorad, Allokh'i Parvardigori shumost, podshokh'i az Ust. Va on butkh'oe, ki ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ibodatashon mekuned, ba andozai pusti donai khurmo moliki chize nestand. Pas chitavr shumo ba ch'oi Man ma'budkh'oi sun'iro meparasted?!

14) Agar ma'budkh'oiatonro duo kuned, duoiatonro nameshunavand, zero onkh'o mavch'udoti bech'oni noshunavoiand va agar farazan, duoiatonro shunavand, kh'argiz ba shumo posukh gufta nametavonand. Va ruzi k'iiomat az on ki shumo onkh'oro dar dunio shariki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'aror doda, ibodat mekarded, bezori mech'uiand. Pas ei Paiombar, kase ba tu chun Allokh'i az tamomi chiz Bokhabar khabari rost namedikh'ad.

15) Ei mardum, shumo dar kh'ama kor va kh'olati khesh ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) niiozmand kh'asted va iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Beniiozi dar duniovu okhirat baroi on chi nisbat ba bandagonash muk'addar mesozad, Sutuda ast.
16) Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bikhokh'ad, shumoro kh'alok sokhta, az bain mebarad va dar ivazi shumo makhluk'i nave meorad, ki tankh'o Uro ibodat namuda, az shirk duri mech'uiand.
17) Va in az bain burdani shumo va dar ivaz makhluk'i nave ovardan bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kori nomumkin va dushvor nest.

18) Va kh'ech' gunakh'kore gunokh'i kasi digarro namebardorad, balki kh'ar kas gunokh'i khudro mebardorad. Va agar bandai az gunokh'onash sanginbor bandai digarero ba bardoshtani gunokh'onash da'vat kunad, az gunokh'oni on da'vatkunanda chize bardoshta nameshavad, agarchi on da'vatshuda az kheshovandoni nazdikash boshad. Ei Paiombar, tu beshak, az azobi ilokh'i kasonero bim medikh'i, ki g'oibona az Parvardigorashon metarsand va namozro dar komiltarin surat barpo medorand. Tankh'o kh'amin toifa az bim dodanat sud mebarand. Va kh'ar ki az gunokh'on, ki buzurgtarini on shirk ast, pok shavad, pas begumon ba foidai khesh pok megardad. Chunki naf'i on ba khudash merasad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az ibodati bandagonash Beniioz ast. Va ruzi k'iiomat bozgasht baroi pursuch'u va giriftani ch'azo tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.
19) Va chunonchi nobino va bino barobar nestand, kh'amchunin kofiru mu'min az rui martaba barobar nestand.
20) Va chunonchi torikikh'o va rushnoi barobar nestand, kh'amchunin kufru imon barobar nest.
21) Va chunonchi soia va bodi purkh'arorat barobar nest, kh'amchunin ch'annatu duzakh barobar nest.

22) Va chunonchi zindakh'o va murdakh'o barobar nestand, kh'amchunin mu'minonu kofiron barobar nestand. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'idoiatashro ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, meshunavonad. Va ei Paiombar, tu nametavoni pandatro ba kofirone, ki ba murdagoni k'abrkh'o monandand, bishunavoni.
23) Tu baroi onkh'o tankh'o Paiombari az azobi ilokh'i bimdikh'andai.

24) Ei Paiombar, kh'amono Mo turo ba kh'ak' muzhdarasoni mu'minon ba ch'annat va tarsonandai kofiron az ch'akh'annam firistodaem. Va dar guzashta ummate nabud, ki dar miionashon paiombari onkh'oro az uk'ubati ilokh'i bimdikh'anda naguzashta boshad.

25) Va ei Paiombar, agar k'avmat turo ba durug'gui nisbat dikh'and, pas sabr kun, chunki tu nakhustin paiombari mavridi takzibi mardum k'aror girifta nesti. Ba durusti, ummatkh'oi k'abl az k'avmi tu guzashta, misli k'avmi Od, Samud va Lut paiombaronashonro durug'gu donistaand. Paiombaron ba onkh'o mu'ch'izakh'oi vozekh'i nishondikh'andai sidk'i khesh va sakh'ifakh'o va kitobkh'oi baroi akh'li andesha rushangar ovarda budand.

26) Ammo bo in vuch'ud onkh'o ba Man va paiombaronam kofir shudand va firistodagonamro dar vakh'ii ovardaashon tasdik' nakardand. Sipas Man kofir shudagonro kh'alok sokhtam. Pas ei Paiombar, andesha kun, ki inkori Man bar onkh'o chi guna bud?! Beshak, on inkori sakht bud.

27) Ei Paiombar, magar namebini, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az osmon obi boron furud ovard, pas Mo bo on ob ba'd az on ki darakhtonro serob sokhtem, mevakh'oi gunogunrangi surkhu sabzu zard va g'aira berun ovardem. Va ba'zei kukh'kh'o rokh'kh'oi safed va surkhi gunogunrang va ba'zei digarashon rokh'kh'oi nikh'oiat siiokh' dorand.

28) Va az mardum va khazandagon va chakh'orpoion (shuturonu govonu gusfandon) niz ba monandi gunogunrangii mevakh'o va kukh'kh'o rangkh'oi gunogun dorand. Begumon az bandagoni Khudo fak'at kasone az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) metarsand va ta'zimashro ba ch'o meorand, ki dar borai U ilm dorand. Zero makh'z donishmandoni Khudoshinos oidi sifot, shariatu dalelkh'oi k'udrati U sokh'ibi ma'rifatand. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti G'olib buda, nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshanda ast.

29) Beshak, bandagone, ki Kitobi bar Paiombar nozilkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro tilovat karda, mutobik'ash amal mekunand va namozro ba surati komil barpo medorand va az on chi baroiashon ruzi dodaem, ba sifati zakot va digar nav'i sadak'ot pinkh'oni va oshkor kharch' menamoiand, onkh'o bo in korkh'o nazdi Khudo ba tich'orate umed bastaand, ki kh'argiz beravnak' nameshavad-

30) to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) podoshi a'molashonro ba tavri komil bidikh'ad va onkh'oro az fazl va ne'matash afzun bisozad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Sokh'iblutf ast. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagoni doroi chunin sifatkh'o Bakhshandavu az a'moli nekashon Shukrguzor ast.

31) Va ei Paiombar, Mo on chi ba suiat az K'ur'on vakh'i mefiristem, kh'ak' buda, Kitobkh'oi pesh az in guzashtaro tasdik' menamoiad. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagonash Bokhabari Bino ast. U ba kh'ar paiombar vobasta ba niiozi ummatonash paig'om mefiristad.

32) Sipas Mo K'ur'onro ba ummatoni Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), ki bandagoni barguzidaamon kh'astand, dodem. Pas ba'zei onkh'o bo anch'omi kh'aromkh'o va tarki farzkh'o bar khesh sitamkorand va ba'zeashon bo tarki kh'aromkh'o, anch'omi farzkh'o va tarki ba'ze az mustakh'abkh'ovu sodir namudani ba'ze makrukh'ot miionaravand va ba'zeashon bo tarki kh'aromkh'ovu makrukh'ot va anch'omi voch'ibkh'ovu mustakh'abkh'o dar ich'roi nekikh'o bo ich'ozati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) peshk'adamand. In barguzidani ummatoni Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va baroi onkh'o dodani K'ur'on fazli buzurgest, ki kh'ech' fazle bo on iakson nameshavad.

33) Bog'kh'oi baroi sukunati kh'ameshagi, ki in bandagoni barguzida ba on medaroiand, dar on bog'kh'o bo pushidani marvorid va dastmonakh'oi tilloi oroish doda meshavand va libosashon dar onch'o az abreshim ast.

34) Va onkh'o ba'd az dukhuli ch'annat meguiand: "Sitoish Khudoero, ki andukh'i az tarsi voridshavi ba duzakh paidoshudaro az mo bartaraf sokht. Iak'inan Parvardigoramon Bakhshandai gunokh'oni tavbakoron buda, az ibodatashon Shukrguzor ast.

35) On Zote, ki makh'z az fazli Khesh moro dar saroi istik'omati doimi furud ovard, kh'ol on ki a'molamon arzishi inro nadosht. Dar ch'annat ba mo kh'ech' guna mashak'k'at namerasad va inchunin dar inch'o ba mo kh'ech' guna afsurdagii khotir namerasad."
