Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi guzashta podoshi bandagoni barguzidaashro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin ch'azoi kofironro baion namuda guft:
36) Va kasone, ki kofir shudaand, baroi onkh'o otashi duzakh ast, dar onch'o kh'ameshagi memonand. Bar onkh'o kh'ukmi marg sodir namegardad, to bimirand va az uk'ubat rokh'at bishavand va az onkh'o uk'ubati duzakh sabuk sokhta nameshavad. Mo ruzi k'iiomat ba kh'ar bandai nosiposi ne'matkh'oi Parvardigor kh'amin guna ch'azo medikh'em.

37) Va kofiron dar duzakh bo balandtarin sado fariod mekashand va iori khosta meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, moro az otash berun kun, to baroi noil gashtani rizoi Tu bar khilofi a'moli zishti dar dunio sodirkardaamon amali shoista anch'om dikh'em va az uk'ubatat solim monem." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ch'avobashon meguiad: "Oio Mo ba shumo on k'adar umre nadodem, ki dar on muddat kh'ar ki pand giriftan mekhost, pand megirift va az gunokh'onash tavba karda, amali solekh' anch'om medod?! Va g'air az in baroiaton paiombari az azobi ilokh'i bimdikh'anda omada bud, ammo shumo uro takzib namuded. Ba'd az in shumo digar kh'uch'ch'at nadored va ma'zur nested. Binobar in, uk'ubati duzakhro bichashed. Pas baroi shakhsoni bo kufru ma'siiat bar ch'oni khesh sitamkor kh'ech' ioridikh'andae nest, ki onkh'oro az azobi ilokh'i rakh'o sozad io onro sabuk gardonad."

38) Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai g'aibi osmonkh'o va zamin ast. Kh'ech' chiz dar osmonkh'ovu zamin az U makhfi namemonad. Beguftugu, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on neki va badiero, ki bandagon dar k'albi khesh onro pinkh'on mesozand, medonad.

39) Khudo Zotest, ki ba'zei shumo mardumro dar zamin ch'onishin va ch'oiguzini ba'zei digar k'aror doda ast, to shumoro biozmoiad, ki chi kor mekuned. Ba'd az in kh'ar ki ba Khudo va risolati paiombaron kofir gardad, pas gunokh' va uk'ubati kufrash bar zarari khudash barmegardad va ba U zarare namerasonad. Va kufri kofiron nazdi Parvardigorashon baroi onkh'o ch'uz adovati shadid chizero afzun namegardonad va kufri kofiron baroi onkh'o ch'uz khasorat chizero ziiod namegardonad. Zero onkh'o agar imon meovardand, ba ch'annat merasidand va chun kufr varzidand, az on makh'rum gashta, duchori khasorati buzurg shudand.

40) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Ba man az ma'budkh'oi khesh, ki onkh'oro dar dunio shariki Khudo donista, ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ibodat mekarded, khabar dikh'ed. Onkh'o kadom ch'uz'i zaminro khalk' kardaand?! Magar kukh'kh'oro ofaridaand?! Io dariokh'oro ofaridaand?! Io khazandagonro ofaridaand?! Io ma'budkh'oiaton bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ofaridani osmonkh'o sharikand?! Io Mo baroi mushrikon kitobe dodaem, ki dar on vobasta ba durustii butparasti dalel dorand?! Ma'lum ast, ki chunin nest. Balki kasone, ki bo kufru ma'siiat bar ch'oni kheshtan sitam kardaand, ba'zeashon ba ba'zei digar ch'uz fireb chize va'da namedikh'and."

41) Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) osmonkh'o va zaminro az zavol va tag'iiriobii nizomi kh'arakati onkh'o nigokh' medorad. Va agar farazan, osmonkh'o va zamin zavol ioband io nizomi kh'arakatashon digargun shavad, kh'ech' kas ba'd az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on duro az in kh'olat nigokh' doshtan nametavonad. Beshak, Parvardigor Burdbor ast, bandagonashro zud ch'azo namedikh'ad, nisbat ba tavbakoron Bakhshanda ast.

42) Va in kofironi takzibgari Makka savgandi ustuvori k'at'i iod kardand, ki agar ba onkh'o paiombari az uk'ubati ilokh'i bimdikh'anda oiad, kh'atman nazar ba k'avmi iakh'udu nasoro va digaron bekh'tar kh'idoiat meioband va tobei kh'ak' meshavand. Pas chun Paiombari Parvardigor Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), ki onkh'oro az uk'ubati ilokh'i bim medod, nazdashon omad, omadani vai baroiashon ch'uz duri az kh'ak' va dilbastagi ba botil chizero afzun nasokht. Eshon ba savgandi k'at'ii iodkardai khud vafo nakardand.

43) Ba nomi Khudo savgand iod kardani onkh'o az rui niiat va mak'sadi nek nabud, balki on baroi kibr varzidan dar zamin va firebidani mardum bud. Va asarkh'oi dasisai bad ba ch'uz sokh'ibonash kasero ikh'ota namekunad. Pas oio in mutakabbironi nairangboz muntaziri k'onuni sobiti ilokh'i kh'astand, ki onkh'oro monandi ummatkh'oi sobik' ba kh'alokat rasonad?! Vak'te sababi kh'alokati ummatkh'oi guzashta baroiashon ma'lum gasht, pas kh'ech' gokh' baroi k'onuni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oidi on ki mutakabbironro kh'alok mesozad, tabdilero nameiobi va kh'ech' gokh' baroi k'onuni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oidi on ki kh'aloksoziash bar g'airi mutakabbiron vok'e' namegardad, digarguniero nameiobi. Zero in k'onuni doimii betag'iiri ilokh'ist.

44) Oio takzibkunandagoni tu az mardumi K'uraish dar zamin sairu saiokh'at namekunand, to dar borai farch'omi ummatkh'oi takzibgari k'abl az onkh'o guzashta biandeshand?! Oio onkh'o ok'ibat bo badtarin surat kh'alok nashudand?! Va on ummatkh'o az kofironi K'uraish nerumandtar budand. Va kh'ech' chiz dar osmonkh'o va zamin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro och'iz namesozad va az U rakh'oi nameiobad. Ba durusti, U Donoi Tavono ast. Amalkh'oi in toifai takzibkunandaro medonad, kardakh'oiashon az U pushida namemonad, kh'ar vak'te khokh'ad, k'udrati kh'alok sokhtanashonro dorad.

45) Va agar Khudo mardumro ba sababi gunokh'oni anch'om dodaashon zud uk'ubat mekard, kh'atman tamomi akh'li zaminro favran kh'alok mesokht va onkh'o moliki markabkh'o va amvol nameshudand, vale onkh'oro to faro rasidani muddati nazdash ma'lumi ruzi k'iiomat ba ta'khir meguzorad. Pas chun ruzi k'iiomat biioiad, begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba a'moli bandagonash Bino ast, kh'ech' kori onkh'o az U makhfi nest va ba muk'obili kh'ar iak kirdor podoshashon medikh'ad. Agar amali nek kardaand, podoshi nek va agar amali bad anch'om dodaand, ch'azoi bad megirand.
1) "Io. Sin." Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) Savgand ba K'ur'oni doroi oiatkh'oi ustuvore, ki na dar guzashta va na dar oianda kh'ech' kitobe onro takzib nakarda ast va namekunad.
3) Ei Paiombar, kh'amono tu az ch'umlai firistodagoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sui mardum kh'asti, to onkh'oro ba khudoshinosi va iaktoparasti amr kuni.
4) Tu bar rokh'i rost va shariati pobarch'o k'aror dori.
5) In rokh'i rost va shariati pobarch'o az sui Khudoi kh'amesha G'olibi nisbat ba bandagonash Mekh'rubon furud ovarda shuda ast.

6) Mo in Kitobro ba suiat nozil kardaem, to on k'avmero, ki k'ablan padaronashon az azobi ilokh'i bim doda nashudaand, bim bidikh'i. Onkh'o ba kh'amin sabab az imon va tavkh'id g'ofiland. Murod az k'avmi mazkur mardumi arab kh'astand, ki dar guzashta paiombare ba suiashon mab'us nashuda ast. Kh'amchunin ak'vomi g'airi arab, ki bim dodan az azobi ilokh'i az onkh'o gusasta shuda bud, ba paiombaroni bimdikh'anda niiozmand budand.

7) Beshak, uk'ubati ilokh'i baroi beshtari onkh'o, ki ba'di rasidani paig'om tavassuti firistodagoni Khudo imon naovardand va bar kufri khesh mondand, voch'ib gardida ast. Pas onkh'o ba Khudovu Paiombarash imon nameorand va ba kh'ak'ik'ati az sui Khudo ovardaash amal namekunand.

8) Kh'olati onkh'o ba kh'olati on kasone monand ast, ki dar gardanashon zavlona zada va dastonashon bo gardanashon zeri zanakhdon ch'am' karda shuda ast. Ba kh'amin sabab sarashonro ba ch'onibi osmon bardoshtaand va onro kham karda nametavonand. Kofiron niz az imon ovardan ba Khudo zavlona zada shudaand. Binobar in, tobei kh'ukmi ilokh'i nameshavand va dar barobari on sar kham namekunand.

9) Va Mo baroi on, ki in kofiron kh'ak'ik'atro k'abul nakunand, az peshi ruiashon devor va az pushti sarashon devor k'aror dodaem va bar chashmonashon az didani on parda pushidaem. Baroi kh'amin, kh'ak'ik'atro dida va az on istifoda burda nametavonand. Chun kofironi mazkur iakravi kardand va bar kufri kheshtan bok'i mondand, duchori chunin kh'olat gashtand.
10) Ei Paiombar, bar in kofironi muk'obili kh'ak' sitezach'u az azobi ilokh'i onkh'oro tarsonidan va natarsonidanat iakson ast. Chunki eshon ba on chi az nazdi Parvardigor ovardai, imon nameorand.

11) Kh'amono az bim dodani tu kase bakh'ra mebarad, ki in K'ur'onro tasdik' karda, az akh'komash pairavi namoiad va dar khilvat az Khudovandi Mekh'rubonash bitarsad. Pas bandai doroi in sifatkh'oro ba mag'firati gunokh'on va ba dast ovardani ach'ri arzishmandi ch'annat muzhda bidekh'.

12) Kh'amono Mo Khud ruzi k'iiomat murdagonro baroi pursuch'u zinda megardonem va on chi dar zindagonii dunio az a'moli neku bad tak'dim kardaand va inchunin osori khair (monandi sadak'ai ch'oriia) io sharri (monandi kufr) ba'di marg guzoshtaashonro menavisem. Va begumon Mo tamomi chizro dar Kitobi ravshani Lavkh'i Makh'fuz kh'isob va sabt kardaem.
13) Va ei Paiombar, ba in takzibgaroni iakrav moch'aroi mardumi dekh'aro misol bizan, on gokh', ki firistodagon nazdashon omadand, baion kun, to az on ibrat girand.

14) Vak'te Mo dar avval ba suiashon du firistodaro ravon namudem, to onkh'oro ba iaktoparasti va ibodati Khudo da'vat kunand, pas onkh'o on du firistodaro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand. Ba'd az in Mo on duro bo ravon sokhtani firistodai seium tak'viiat dodem. Pas on se firistoda ba akh'li dekh'a guftand: "Mo se nafar ba suiaton firistoda shudaem, to shumoro ba iaktoparasti va pairavi az shariat da'vat namoem."

15) Akh'li dekh'a ba on firistodagon guftand: "Shumo monandi mo insone besh nested. Az mo bartari nadored. Va Khudoi Mekh'rubon kh'ech' paig'ome nafiristoda ast. Begumon shumo bo in da'voi khesh dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo durug' megued."

16) On firistodagon dar raddi takzibi onkh'o guftand: "Ei akh'li dekh'a, Parvardigoramon medonad, ki mo ba sui shumo az nazdi U firistoda shudaem. Kh'amin donistani Khudo baroi isboti da'voi mo basanda ast.
17) Va mas'uliiati mo tankh'o az on iborat ast, ki dasturoti shar'ro ba tavri vozekh' baroiaton birasonem. Mo moliki kh'idoiati shumo nestem."

18) Akh'li dekh'a ba firistodagon guftand: "Mo az shumo foli bad giriftaem. Savgand iod mekunem, agar az da'vat ba iaktoparasti khuddori nakuned, mo shumoro bo rokh'i sangsor to kh'addi marg ch'azo medikh'em va az ch'onibi mo ba shumo azobi dardovar merasad."

19) On firistodagon dar ch'avobi onkh'o guftand: "Ba sababi on ki kufr varzida va pairavii paiombaronro tark kardaed, shumi bo khudi shumost. Oio agar mo Khudoro ba iodi shumo orem, vuch'udamonro dar bainaton boisi nakh'si meshumored?! Balki shumo mardume kh'asted, ki bo kufr va ma'siiat az marzkh'oi ilokh'i guzashtaed.

20) Va marde az durtarin gushai shakh'r boshitob omad va ba mardum guft: "Ei k'avmam, az on chi in firistodagon ovardaand, pairavi kuned." On mardi nekkhokh' baroi on boshitob omad, ki az mavridi ozor k'aror giriftan va ba k'atl rasonidani firistodagon az sui mardum khavf dosht.

21) On mardi neksirisht dar idomai sukhanash guft: "Ei k'avmi man, kasonero pairavi namoed, ki az shumo dar ivazi tabg'ilashon muzd namepursand va onkh'o dar on chi az ch'onibi Khudo merasonand, kh'idoiatioftagonand. Kh'ar ki doroi chunin sifatkh'o boshad, arzandai pairavi ast."

22) Va on mardi khairkhokh' guft: "Charo man On Zotero, ki maro ofarida ast, naparastam? Chi maro az in boz medorad?! Shumoro az ibodati Ofaridgoraton chi man' mesozad?! Va ruzi k'iiomat bo zindashavi tankh'o ba sui U bargardonida meshaved, to ch'azoi amali khudro bigired.

23) Oio g'air az Ofaridgoram ma'budkh'oi botil bigiram?! Agar Khudoi Mekh'rubon bar man badiero khokh'ad, shafoati in ma'budkh'oi botil chizero az man bartaraf sokhta nametavonad. Inkh'o na foida merasonand va na zararero dur mekunand va inchunin tavoni onro nadorand, ki az badii khostai Khudo agar dar kufr bimiram, maro rakh'o sozand.
24) Kh'amono man vak'te onkh'oro ch'uz Khudo ma'bud bigiram, dar zalolat va khatoi oshkor k'aror doram. Zero makhluk'i noloik'ro parastida, ibodati Ofaridgori barkh'ak'ro tark kardaam.

25) Ei k'avmam, man ba Parvardigori kheshtan va Parvardigori kh'amai shumo imon ovardaam. Pas ba sukhanam gush kuned. Az on ki maro az kushtashavi metarsoned, kh'ech' parvo nadoram." Ok'ibat on mardro kushtand va Khudo uro dokhili ch'annat gardonid.

26) Ba'd az on ki on mard ba shakh'odat rasid, bo mak'sadi arch'guzori ba u gufta shud: "Ba ch'annat daro."Zamone ki u ba ch'annat daromad va ne'matkh'oi onch'oro mushokh'ida kard, orzu namuda guft: "Ei kosh, on k'avmam, ki maro takzib karda, kushtand, medonistand, ki-
27) Parvardigoram gunokh'onamro mag'firat namud va maro az bandagoni giromi gardonid. Ei kosh, onkh'o inro medonistand, to misli man imon meovardand va sokh'ibi chunin podosh meshudand."

28) Va Mo ba'd az kushtashavii on mardi nosekh' baroi kh'aloksozii k'avmash lashkariionero az farishtagoni osmon furud naovardem. Zero kh'alok sokhtanashon baroiamon bag'oiat oson bud. Va kh'ikmati Mo tak'ozo namekard, ki baroi az bain burdani on mardumi beimon az osmon farishtagonro furud orem, zero onkh'o arzishi inro nadoshtand, balki muk'arrar namudem, ki kh'alokatashon bo fariodi sakhte az ch'onibi osmon surat girad.

29) Onkh'o tankh'o bo iak fariodi sakhte, ki onro tavassuti Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom) firistodem, ba kh'alokat rasidand. Pas onkh'o ba'd az on fariod nogakh'on khomush gashta, murdand va az onkh'o nishone bok'i namond. Kh'olatashon ba kh'olati otashe monandi dosht, ki dar avval furuzon bud, ammo ba'dan khomush shuda, az on asare namond.

30) Ei nadomatu kh'asrat bar bandagoni takzibkunanda dar k'iiomat, vak'te ki uk'ubati duzakhro bubinand. Chunki kh'ar firistodae dar dunio az nazdi Khudo ba onkh'o meomad, kh'atman uro maskhara mekardand. In bois shud, ki dar okhirat baroi kutokh'ii khud kh'asratzadai pushaimon shavand.

31) Oio in takzibgaroni maskharakunandai paiombaron dar borai te'dodi ziiodi ummatkh'oi k'ablan guzashta, ki Mo onkh'oro kh'alok sokhtem, ma'lumot nadoshtand, to az ta'rikhi kh'aiotashon pand girand?! Beshak, on ummatkh'o az bain raftand va digar ba in dunio bargashta nametavonand, balki ba natich'ai a'molashon merasand.
32) Va kh'ech' ummate nest, magar on ki k'at'an ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Mo kh'ozir karda meshavad, to ba onkh'o podoshi amalashonro bidikh'em.

33) Va in zamini khushki begiiokh' baroi bandagoni takzibkunandai rastokhez alomati ravshani nishondikh'andai kh'ak'ik'at doshtani on ast. Mo bar in zamin az osmon boron rekhta, onro bo ruionidani giiokh'oni gunogun zinda sokhtem va az on donakh'oi mukhtalifro berun ovardem, to mardum az on donakh'o bikhurand. Albatta, On Zote, ki bo rekhtani boron va ruionidani giiokh'on zamini murdaro zinda gardonid, k'udrat dorad, ki ba'd az marg ba murdagon kh'aioti dubora bakhshad.
34) Va dar zamin bog'kh'oi darakhtoni khurmo va angurro kh'ast namudem va dar on chashmakh'oero berun sokhtem, ki kh'osiloti bog'kh'oro ob medikh'ad,-

35) to mardum az mevakh'oi in'omkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bikhurand, kh'ol on ki onro dastonashon nasokhta ast. Oio bandagon ba'd az in ne'matkh'o bo imon va ibodat shukri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o nameorand?!
36) Az kh'amai aibu nuk'son pok ast On Zote, ki az rastanikh'oi zamin va az khudi mardum va az makhluk'oti khushkiiu darioi va g'airi on, ki onro namedonand, ch'ufti naru modaro ofarida ast.
37) Va omadani shab baroi onkh'o alomati ravshani nishondikh'andai iagonagii Parvardigor ast. Mo az shab rushnoiro berun mekashem, pas nogakh'on mardum ba zulmati shab dokhil meshavand.

38) Va dar masiri muaiian kh'arakat namudani oftob baroi onkh'o alomati vozekh'i vakh'doniiati Parvardigor ast. Oftob ba sui k'arorgokh'i khud, ki andozai onro ch'uz Khudo kase namedonad, kh'arakat mekunad va az k'arorgokh'ash nameguzarad. In andozagirii Khudoi G'olibu Donandai umuri makhluk'ot ast. Kh'ech' kori onkh'o az U pushida namemonad.

39) Va mokh' baroi onkh'o alomati ravshani vakh'doniiati Parvardigor ast. Mo baroi mokh' manzilgokh'kh'oi kh'arakati kh'ar iak shabai onro muaiian kardaem. Mokh' dar og'oz khurd ast. Ba'dan kalon va boz khurd meshavad, to kh'adde ki dar boriki, kach'i, zardrangiiu kukh'nagi monandi shokhi kukh'nai khurmo megardad.

40) Oftobu mokh' va shabu ruz tibk'i andozai muaiian namudai Khudo andozagiri shudaand. Na oftob imkon dorad ba mokh' bipaivandad, to masiri kh'arakati uro tag'iir dikh'ad io nurashro az bain barad va na shab imkon dorad bar ruz k'abl az faro rasidani mukh'lati on sabk'at girad va dokhil shavad. Va kh'ar iake az in makhluk'oti mazkur va digar saiioravu kakh'kashonkh'o bo andozagirii Khudo masiri khosi khudro dorand, ki dar on kh'arakati kheshro ba osoni va biduni tag'iir idoma medikh'and.

41) Va alomati digar baroiashon oidi isboti vakh'doniiati Khudo va in'omi U bar bandagon on ast, ki Mo dar zamoni Nukh' nasli az tufon nach'otioftai Odamro dar kishtii pur az makhluk'ot bardoshtem. Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) dar on kishti bo suporishi Khudo az kh'ar makhluk' iak ch'uftro bardoshta bud.
42) Va alomati digari vakh'doniiati Khudo va in'omi U bar bandagon on ast, ki Mo baroi onkh'o ba monandi kishtii Nukh' markabkh'oi savori ofaridem.
43) Va agar Mo khokh'em, g'ark'ashon mesozem. Onkh'o ba'd az g'ark'shavi fariodrase nadorand, ki ba fariodashon birasad va na onkh'o az in vartai kh'alokat rakh'oi doda meshavand,-

44) magar on ki Mo onkh'oro bo nach'ot dodan az g'ark'shavi mavridi rakh'matamon k'aror dikh'em va to zamoni faro rasidani mukh'lati muaiian az kh'aiot bakh'ramand shavand, to az in kh'avodis pand girifta, imon orand.

45) Va chun ba in mushrikoni az imon rui gardonida gufta shavad, ki az sakhtikh'oi peshi ruiaton k'arordoshtai k'iiomat va az dunioi fonii pushtgardonanda barkh'azar boshed, to in ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo rakh'matash bar shumo ekh'son namoiad, onkh'o in farmonro ich'ro namekunand, balki az on beparvoiona rui megardonand.

46) Va ba on mushrikoni sitezach'u az oiatkh'oi Parvardigorashon kh'ech' oiati nishondikh'andai vakh'doniiati Khudo va arzandai ibodat budani U nameomad, magar in ki onkh'o az on oiatkh'o rui tofta, ibrat namegirand.

47) Va vak'te ba in toifa gufta shavad, ki az amvoli ba shumo ruzi namudai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba fak'iron va miskinon ekh'son kuned, kofiron dar ch'avobi mu'minon inkorkunon meguiand: "Oio mo ba kase taom dikh'em, ki agar Khudo mekhost, Khud uro taom medod? Mo khilofi khosti Khudo amal namekunem. Shumo mu'minon begumon dar khatoi oshkor va duri az kh'ak' k'aror dored."
48) Va kofironi munkiri rastokhez meguiand: "Ei akh'li imon, agar shumo dar da'voiaton sodik' boshed, pas va'dai az nav zindashavii murdagon kai rukh medikh'ad?"

49) In toifai takzibgari rastokhez tankh'o muntaziri damidani nafkhai iakum kh'astand. Nafkhai mironidan onkh'oro dar kh'ole g'ofilgir mesozad, ki ba korkh'oi duniavii tich'oratu chuponi va g'air az on sargarm meboshand.

50) Pas vak'te fariodi shadidi mironidan onkh'oro g'ofilgir sozad, digar ba iakdigar tavsiia karda nametavonand va niz ba nazdi khonadonu manzilashon bargashta nametavonand, balki dar kh'olati sargarmi ba umuri dunio memirand.
51) Va dar sur nafkhai duiumi zinda sokhtan damida meshavad. Pas onkh'o nogakh'on az k'abrkh'oiashon barkhesta, baroi bozpursi va giriftani podosh ba sui Parvardigorashon meshitoband.

52) Kofironi takzibkunandai rastokhez bo nadomat meguiand: "Ei voi bar mo! Moro az k'abramon ki zinda gardond?" Dar posukhi onkh'o gufta meshavad: "In on va'daest, ki Khudoi Mekh'rubon doda bud. Az in ru, rastokhez boiad noguzir rukh medod. Va firistodagoni Khudo dar on chi ba mardum oidi on rasonidaand, rost gufta budand."

53) Zindashavi ba'd az marg tankh'o asari iak nafkhai duiumi zinda sokhtanest, ki dar sur damida meshavad. Pas nogakh'on kh'amai khaloik' ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani podosh nazdamon kh'ozir karda meshavand.

54) Dovarii on ruz bar asosi adolat surat megirad. Pas ba kh'ech' kas bo afzunsozii badikh'o va kamsozii nekikh'oiash zulm karda nameshavad va ba shumo bandagon tankh'o ch'azoi on a'mole doda meshavad, ki dar dunio anch'om medoded. Shumo dar okhirat podoshatonro ba purragi megired.

55) Ba durusti ki akh'li ch'annat vak'te ruzi k'iiomat ne'mati abadi va komiobii azimro mushokh'ida mekunand, sargarmi rokh'ati khud gashta, dar borai digaron nameandeshand, onkh'o az ne'matkh'oi bikh'isht khursandona bakh'ra mebarand.
56) Akh'li ch'annat bo kh'amsaronashon zeri soiakh'oi ch'annat bar takhtkh'o takiakunon dar ne'mat k'aror megirand.
57) Baroi onkh'o dar ch'annat nav'kh'oi mukhtalifi meva, misli anguru anch'iru khurmo ast va baroi onkh'o kh'ar chi metalaband, mukh'aiio megardad. Khostakh'oi akh'li ch'annat kh'osil meshavad.

58) Baroi ch'annatiion bolotar az ne'matkh'oi nombarshuda, ne'mati solim mondan az kh'ama nokhushikh'o ast. Ba onkh'o az ch'onibi Parvardigori Mekh'rubon durud gufta meshavad. Vak'te Parvardigor ba akh'li bikh'isht durud firistad, onkh'o az tamomi nokhushikh'o solim memonand va ilova bar in olitarin salomu durudro ba dast meorand.

59) Va dar k'iiomat ba mushrikon gufta meshavad: "Ei much'rimon, az mu'minon ch'udo shaved." Onkh'o kh'ak' nadorand bo shumo akh'li imon iakch'o boshand. Zero podosh va sifoti shumo az podosh va sifoti akh'li kufru shirk fark' mekunad.

60) Ei farzandoni Odam, oio Man shumoro tavassuti paiombaronam tavsiia va suporish nadodam, ki bo sodir kardani kufr va ma'siiat Shaitonro itoat nakuned. Kh'amono Shaiton nisbat ba shumo dushmani oshkor ast. Chitavr shakhsi bokhirad az guftakh'oi dushmani oshkori khesh itoat mekunad?!

61) Va ba shumo farzandoni Odam suporish dodam, ki tankh'o Maro biparasted va az shirk varzidan barkh'azar boshed. Zero fak'at ibodatu itoati Man rokh'i rostest, ki shumoro ba rizo va ch'annatam merasonad. Ammo shumo tavsiia va suporishi Maro ich'ro nakarded va az on sarpechi namuded.
62) Va iak'inan Shaiton az shumo khalk'i bisiorero gumrokh' sokht. Oio shumo ak'le nadored, ki ba itoat va ibodati Man farmonaton dikh'ad va az pairavii Iblisi dushmani oshkoraton boz dorad?!
63) In kh'amon duzakhest, ki dar dunio baroi ch'azoi kufraton bo on ba shumo va'dai azob doda meshud va az nazaraton g'oib bud. Ammo imruz ch'akh'annamro bo chashmi sar mebined.
64) Imruz ba sababi on ki dar dunio kufr mevarzided, dokhili duzakh shaved va az shiddati kh'arorati on ranch' bared.

65) Imruz Mo bar dakh'onashon mukh'r menikh'em va eshon lol gashta, kufru ma'siiati anch'om dodai kheshtanro inkor karda nametavonand va bo Mo vobasta ba on chi dar dunio anch'om medodand, dastonashon ba zabon meoiad va poikh'oiashon dar borai on gunokh'one, ki sodir namudaand va ba sui ma'siiat k'adam zadaand, guvokh'i medikh'ad.

66) Va agar Mo binoii onkh'oro az bain burdan khokh'em, onro az bain mebarem va az on makh'rum gardida, pas ba sui rokh'i baroiashon ma'lum sabk'at megirand, to az on guzarand. Pas chi guna dida metavonand, to az rokh' guzarand, dar kh'ole binoi nadorand?! Az rokh' guzashtanashon imkon nadorad.
67) Va agar Mo bikhokh'em, suratashonro maskh mekunem va onkh'oro dar manzilashon bar poiashon meshinonem. Pas ch'oiashonro tark namuda va pesh rafta va ba ak'ib bargashta nametavonand.

68) Va az mardum umri kh'ar kiro tuloni mesozem, uro ba markh'ilai notavoni barmegardonem. Oio nameandeshand va dark namekunand, ki in dunio saroi abadi nest, balki iagona okhirat ch'oi buduboshi doimist.

69) Va Mo ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) she'r naomukhtaem va she'rsaroi ba u namesazad. Zero in kor ba tabiatash sozgor nest. Binobar in, da'voi shumo, ki uro shoir mekh'isobed, asos nadorad. On chi ba u omukhtaem, ch'uz pand va K'ur'oni ravshan baroi kasone meandeshand, chize besh nest.

70) To Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kh'ar bandai zindadili ravshanzamirro bim dikh'ad, chunki kh'amin toifa bandagon az K'ur'on sud mebarand va to azob bar kofiron voch'ib gardad. Zero bo nuzuli vakh'ii okhirin va rasidani da'vat ba akh'li kufr kh'uch'ch'at bar onkh'o ba tamom rasida, uzre nadorand.

71) Oio in mushrikon az didani alomatkh'oi k'udrati Mo kurand va namedonand, ki Mo baroi onkh'o az on chi dastonamon onro anch'om doda ast, chakh'orpoion (shuturu govu gusfand)-ro ofaridem, pas onkh'o moliki on chakh'orpoion gashta, az onkh'o mutobik' ba tak'ozoi naf'ashon istifoda mebarand?!
72) Va on chakh'orpoionro baroi onkh'o rom kunonidem. Pas az ba'zeash ba kh'aisi markabi savori istifoda mebarand va borkh'oi kheshro bar on bor mekunand va az gushti ba'zei digarash mekhurand.

73) Va baroi onkh'o dar on chakh'orpoion g'air az savorshavi va khurdani gushtashon manfiatkh'oi digare ba misli istifoda az pustkh'o, pashmkh'o va mablag'kh'oi az savdoiashon ba dast omada mavch'ud ast va inchunin baroi onkh'o dar on chakh'orpoion nushidanikh'o mavch'ud ast, ki az shiri chakh'orpoion menushand. Oio Kholik'i iagonai Bakhshandai in ne'matkh'oro shukrguzori namekunand?!

74) Va mushrikon g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oi digarero girifta, onkh'oro ba umedi on meparastand, ki ba ibodatkunandagonashon kumak mekunand va az azobi ilokh'i nach'otashon medikh'and.

75) On ma'budkh'o na ba khud va na ba ibodatkunandagonashon kumak karda nametavonand. Va mushrikon dar dunio baroi ma'budkh'oiashon chun sipokh'i nigakh'bon buda, ruzi k'iiomat kh'amagi dar azobi ch'akh'annam kh'ozir kunonida meshavand, dar kh'ole ba'ze az ba'zei digar bezori mech'uiand.

76) Pas ei Paiombar, sukhani mushrikonu kofiron, ki risolatatro inkor karda, turo shoir, ch'odugar, folbin meguiand, naboiad andukh'ginat sozad. Kh'amono onkh'o az in guftakh'o kh'ar chiro pinkh'on va kh'ar chiro oshkor mekunand, Mo medonem. Kh'ech' chize az Mo pushida nest va dar badali on ba sokh'ibonash ch'azo khokh'em dod.

77) Oio insoni munkiri ruzi k'iiomat andesha namekunad va namedonad, ki Mo uro az nutfa ofaridaem, sipas dar batni modar markh'ilakh'oi muaiianro az sar guzaronida, ba dunio omad va ba voia rasid, pas nogakh'on vai ch'idolgar va dushmani sarsakhtu oshkoroi Mo shud?! Oio u dar borai ofarinish va markh'ilakh'oiash naandeshid, to ba rastokhez imon orad?!

78) Va in insoni kofir baroiamon g'ofilona va ch'okh'ilona misol zada, az ustukhonkh'oi pusida dalel ch'usta, vuk'ui rastokhezro inkor karda va ofarinishi khudro az iod barovarda ast. U meguiad: "In ustukhonkh'oro dar kh'ole ki pusidaand, ki dubora zinda mesozad?!"

79) Ei Mukh'ammad, dar posukhash bigu: "In ustukhonkh'oi pusidaro Ofaridgore zinda mesozad, ki bori nakhust onkh'oro ofarida bud. Zote, ki nakhustin bor ustukhonkh'oro ofarida ast, kh'argiz az dubora zinda sokhtan och'izi namekashad. Va U Donandai tamomi makhluk'ot ast.

80) On Zote, ki az darakhti sabzi tar baroi shumo mardum otash padid ovard. Pas shumo nogakh'on az on darakht otash meafruzed. On Khudovande, ki du chizi bo kh'am zid (namnokii obi darakht va otashi furuzon)-ro iakch'o ch'am' gardonid, tavoni zindasozii murdagonro niz dorad."

81) Oio On Zote, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro bo vuch'udi azamati on du ofarida ast, bar dubora zinda sokhtanashon K'odir nest?! Ore, albatta, in k'udratro dorad. Va U Ofaridgori kh'amai mavch'udotu Donandai onkh'o ast. Kh'ech' amali bandagon az U pushida namemonad.

82) Begumon chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) paido sokhtani chizero khokh'ad, ba on chiz bo guftani "Kh'ast shav" farmon medikh'ad, pas on ba tavri khostaash kh'ast meshavad. Ofaridani makhluk'ot, mironidan, boz ba onkh'o kh'aiot dodan va g'airi on niz bo iak amr ich'ro megardad.

83) Pas Khudoe, ki kh'ukmfarmoii kh'ama chiz dar dasti U buda, nisbat ba makhluk'otash kh'ar chi khokh'ad, anch'om medikh'ad, az aibu nuk'soni nisbat dodai mushrikon poku bartar ast. Va shumo ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui U bargardonida meshaved. On ruz ba shumo ch'azoi a'molatonro medikh'ad.
1) Savgand ba on farishtagon, ki dar ich'roi farmon va ibodat ustuvorona saf mekashand.
2) Pas savgand ba on farishtagon, ki abrkh'oro bo shiddat ba ch'oii khostai Khudo meronand.
3) Pas savgand ba on farishtagon, ki Kalomi Khudoro mekhonand.
4) Ei mardum, begumon Ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ii shumo Kholik'i Iagonai besharik ast.
5) U Parvardigori osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini on du va Parvardigori mashrik'kh'o va mag'ribkh'oi oftob ast.
6) Ba durusti ki Mo osmoni ba zamin nazdiktarinro bo zinati zeboi sitoragon, ki dar nazar kh'amchun marvoridi durakhshon metoband, oroish dodem.
7) Va osmonro az kh'ar iak shaitoni sarkashi nofarmon bo sitoragon kh'ifz namudem.

8) Vak'te farishtagoni sokini osmon bo iakdigar dar borai vakh'ii marbuti shar' va tak'diroti Khudo guftugu mekunand, Shaitonkh'o sukhani onkh'oro shunida nametavonand va az kh'ar ch'onib bo ozarakhshkh'o suiashon tir andokhta meshavad.
9) Shaitonkh'o bo ozarakhsh baroi on sangsor karda meshavand, ki az shunidani guftugui farishtagon dur va ronda shavand. Va onkh'oro dar okhirat azobi sakhti abadi ast.

10) Magar on Shaiton, ki az guftugui farishtagon iak kalimaro, ki kh'anuz on ma'lumot ba akh'li zamin narasida ast, raboiad, pas ozarakhshi durakhshon on Shaitonro dunbol karda, bisuzonad. Ba'zan Shaiton k'abl az on ki ozarakhsh uro suzonad, kalimai rabudaashro ba barodaronash ilk'o mekunad. Ba'dan on sukhan ba folbinon rasida, az nazdi khud bar on sad durug'i digarro ilova mesozand.

11) Pas ei Mukh'ammad, az kofironi munkiri ruzi k'iiomat bipurs, ki oio ofaridani onkh'o sakhttar, ch'ismashon k'avitar va a'zoi badanashon buzurgtar ast va io osmonkh'ovu zamin va farishtagoni ofaridaamon?! Kh'amono Mo onkh'oro az loii chaspak khalk' kardaem. Modom ki onkh'o az iak mavch'udi zaif (loii chaspak) ofarida shudaand, pas chitavr mag'rurona rastokhezro inkor mekunand?!

12) Ei Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), balki tu az k'udrati Khudovand va takzibi mushrikon dar taach'ch'ubi va in mushrikon az shiddati durug' donistani ruzi k'iiomat sukhanonatro maskhara mekunand.
13) Va chun onkh'o bo andarze pand doda shavand, az on pand va foida namegirand. Zero k'albashon sakht shuda ast.
14) Va zamone ki az ch'onibi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) mu'ch'izai nishondikh'andai rostk'avliashro binand, sakht taach'ch'ub va tamaskhur mekunand.
15) Va meguiand: "On chi Mukh'ammad ovarda ast, ch'odui ravshane besh nest.
16) Oe chun mo bimirem va ba khoku ustukhonkh'oi pusida tabdil ebem, oio dubora zinda karda meshavem? In mukh'ol ast.
17) Oio padaroni guzashtai mo dubora zinda karda meshavand?"

18) Ei Mukh'ammad, dar ch'avobashon bigu: "Ore, shumo ba'd az on ki ba khoku ustukhonkh'oi pusida tabdil meshaved va inchunin padaroni guzashtaaton boz zinda megarded. Bale, Khudo kh'amagii shumoro dar kh'ole ki khoru kh'ak'ired, az nav zinda mesozad.

19) Pas begumon tankh'o iak damidan dar sur (damidani duium) rukh medikh'ad, ba'd az on kh'amagi ba sui dakh'shati ruzi k'iiomat nazar karda, muntazir meshavand, ki Khudo nisbatashon chi kor mekunad."
20) Va mushrikoni takzibkunandai ruzi k'iiomat meguiand: "Ei voi bar mo! In ruzi much'ozot ast. Imruz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagon dar badali a'molashon ch'azo medikh'ad."
21) Ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "In on ruzi k'azovat baini bandagon ast, ki dar dunio durug'ash meshumorided."

22-23) On ruz ba farishtagon farmon doda meshavad: "Bandagoni bo shirk bar kheshtan sitamkarda va shakhsone, ki dar shirku takzib shabekh'i mushrikonand va ma'budkh'oi ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ibodat kardai onkh'oro ch'am' sozed, pas rokh'i duzakhro baroiashon nishon dikh'ed va onkh'oro ba sui on bironed. Zero k'arorgokh'i onkh'o ch'akh'annam ast.

22-23) On ruz ba farishtagon farmon doda meshavad: "Bandagoni bo shirk bar kheshtan sitamkarda va shakhsone, ki dar shirku takzib shabekh'i mushrikonand va ma'budkh'oi ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ibodat kardai onkh'oro ch'am' sozed, pas rokh'i duzakhro baroiashon nishon dikh'ed va onkh'oro ba sui on bironed. Zero k'arorgokh'i onkh'o ch'akh'annam ast.
24) Va onkh'oro k'abl az voridsozi ba ch'akh'annam baroi pursuch'u boz dored. Zero eshon az a'molashon pursida meshavand. Ba'd az savolu ch'avob onkh'oro ba sui duzakh bironed."

25) Ba mushrikon sarzanishkunon gufta meshavad: "Shumoro chi shuda ast, ki ba iakdigar kumak namekuned?! Kh'ol on ki dar dunio kh'amdigarro kumak merasonded va da'vo mekarded, ki butkh'oiaton ba ioriaton meoiand."
26) Balki mushrikon ruzi k'iiomat dar barobari farmoni ilokh'i taslimgashtai kh'ak'irand. Onkh'o az sababi ach'z va bechoragi ba kh'amdigar iori doda nametavonand.
27) Va ba'zeashon ba ba'zei digarashon rui ovarda, bo kh'am nizo' namuda, iak dasta iak dastai digarashonro sarzanish mekunand. Dar kh'ole ki sarzanish dar ruzi k'iiomat baroiashon sud namebakhshad.

28) Pairavon ba rakh'baronashon meguiand: "Ba durusti ki shumo rakh'baron ba sui mo az ch'onibi dinu kh'ak'ik'at omada, kufru shirku gunokh'ro dar nazaramon oroish medoded va moro az dini kh'ak'ik'ii ovardai firistodagoni Khudo mutanaffir mesokhted."
29) Peshvoion ba pairavonashon meguiand: "Kh'ak'ik'at on guna nest, ki da'vo dored. Balki shumo khud dar dunio bar kufr k'aror doshta, mu'min nabuded.
30) Va mo bar shumo pairavon az rokh'i k'udrat va zuri tasallut nadoshtem, to dar kufru shirku gunokh' giriftoraton sozem. Balki khudaton mardumi dar kufru zalolat az kh'ad guzashta buded.

31) Pas bar movu shumo on va'dai Parvardigoramon, ki gufta bud: "Savgand iod mekunam, ki duzakhro az tu (Shaiton) va az tamomi pairavonat pur khokh'am kard" takh'ak'k'uk' ioft. Az in ru, mo va shumo on chiro Parvardigoramon va'da doda ast, noguzir chashandaem.
32) Pas dar dunio shumoro ba sui zalolatu kufr da'vat kardem. Ba durusti ki mo khud niz az rokh'i kh'idoiat gumrokh' shuda budem."
33) Pas ba durusti ki ruzi k'iiomat peshvoionu pairavon dar uk'ubat sharikand.
34) Begumon chunonchi Mo azobamonro ba inkh'o chashondem, bo digar gunakh'koron niz kh'amin korro mekunem.

35) Kh'amono vak'te dar dunio ba in mushrikon "Lo ilokh'a illalokh'" gufta meshud, to bo talaboti in kalima amal kunand, az paziruftan va tobe' gardidan ba tak'ozoi on kibr mevarzidand va onro khudpisandona rad mekardand.

36) Va baroi kufri khesh dalel ovarda meguftand: "Oio mo ibodati ma'budkh'oi khudro baroi sukhani shoiri devonae tark kunem?!" Mushrikon bo in tavsifi takh'k'iromez Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro dar nazar doshtand.

37) Kh'amono mushrikon bo in sukhan durug'i buzurge boftaand. Zero Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) devona va mach'nun nest, balki u K'ur'onero ovarda ast, ki mardumro ba sui tavkh'id va ibodat faro mekhonad va niz paiombaroni sobik'ro dar on chi az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oidi tavkh'id va okhirat ovardaand, tasdik' karda, bo onkh'o mukholifat nakarda ast.
38) Ba durusti, shumo mushrikon ba sababi kufru takzibaton ruzi k'iiomat azobi dardovarero mechashed.
39) Va ba shumo mushrikon tankh'o ch'azoi kufru ma'siiati dar dunio sodir namudaaton doda meshavad. Mo shumoro az amalaton beshtar ch'azo namedikh'em.
40) Lekin on bandagoni boimoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki onkh'oro khos baroi ibodati Khud barguzida va Uro kholisona ibodat mekunand, az azobi on ruz dar amonand.
41) Baroi in bandagon az nazdi Khudo rizk'i doroi sifoti ma'lum (pokiza, zebo va abadi) ast.

42) Ba akh'li ch'annat az laziztarin nav'i mevakh'o ruzi doda meshavad va onkh'o bar zammi in ne'matkh'o bo baland gardidani martabaashon va sharafiob shudan ba didori ilokh'i mavridi ikrom k'aror megirand.
43) Onkh'o dar bog'kh'oi abadii doroi ne'matkh'oi rangorangi farovon ba lutfu ekh'sonkh'oi zirkshuda noil megardand.
44) Bar takhtkh'o rubarui kh'amdigar takiazada meshinand va az didori iakdigar lazzat mebarand.
45) Girdogirdi onkh'o k'adakh'kh'oi pur az sharobe, ki dar pokizagi ba chashmai ch'ori shabokh'at dorad, davr doda meshavad.
46) Sharobi safedrang, ki kh'ar ki onro nushad, lazzat mebarad.

47) Sharobi ch'annat monandi khamri dunio nest. On masti nadorad, ki khiradro tira sozad va nushandagonash duchori sardard nameshavand. Sharobi ch'annat bar khirad va ch'ismi istifodabarandaash ta'siri bad namerasonad.
48) Va nazdi akh'li bikh'isht zanoni pokdoman mavch'udand, on zanon ch'uz az shavkh'aronashon ba sui mardoni begona namenigarand, chashmoni zeboi vase' dorand.
49) Kh'uroni ch'annat ba e'tibori safedii omekhta bo zardi ba tukhmi makh'fuzi paranda, ki kase ba on dast narasonida ast, monand kh'astand.
50) Pas ba'zei akh'li ch'annat ba sui ba'zei digarashon rui ovarda, az iakdigar dar borai kh'avodisi dunio mepursand.
51) Az bainashon iake meguiad: "Kh'amono man dar dunio kh'amnishine doshtam, ki rastokhezro inkor mekard.
52) U bo inkor va tamaskhur ba man meguft: "Dustam, oio tu az on kasone kh'asti, ki zindashavii murdagonro tasdik' mekunand?!
53) Oio zamone bimirem va ba khoku ustukhonkh'oi pusida tabdil shavem, oio dubora zinda gardonida shuda, baroi a'moli dar dunio anch'om dodaamon ch'azo doda meshavem?"
54) On mardi mu'min ba dustoni ch'annatii kheshtan meguiad: "Oio bo man ba duzakh nazar namekuned, to binem, ki ok'ibati kh'amnishini munkiri rastokhezam bo chi anch'omida boshad?"
55) Ba'dan on mardi akh'li ch'annat ba duzakh nazar meandozad, pas on kh'amnishini [dar dunio] munkiri ruzi k'iiomatro dar miioni duzakh mebinad.

56) U ba kh'amnishini duzakhiash meguiad: "Ei kh'amnishinam, k'asam ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), k'arib bud, ki maro bo da'vatat ba kufr va inkori ruzi k'iiomat dokhili duzakh namuda, ba kh'alokat merasondi.
57) Va agar Parvardigoram bo kh'idoiat va tavfik' nisbat ba man lutf namekard, begumon monandi tu az on kasone megashtam, ki ba sui azob kh'ozir kunonida meshavand."

Chun on shakhsi ch'annati sukhani khudro bo rafik'i duzakhiash ba poion merasonad, ba dustoni akh'li bikh'ishtash khitob karda meguiad:
58) "Mo akh'li ch'annat minba'd namemirem,-
59) ba g'air az margi nakhustinamon, ki dar dunio onro chashida budem. Ammo dar ch'annat zindavu ch'ovid memonem. Va mo azob doda nameshavem, on guna ki kofiron giriftori azob megardand.
60) Kh'amono in podoshi baroi mo ruzi namudai Parvardigor, ki az daromadani bikh'isht, ch'ovid mondan dar on va nach'ot ioftan az duzakh iborat ast, komiobi va zafarmandii benazir ast."
61) Boiad amalkunandagon baroi ba dast ovardani in guna podoshi azim amal kunand. Zero tich'orati biduni khasorat kh'amin ast.

62) Oio in ne'mati dar ch'annat baroi mukhlison omodasokhtai Khudo ch'oigokh'u karomati bekh'tar va fazilati beshtar dorad io on darakhti ba nomi "Zak'k'um"-i dar K'ur'on nafrinshuda, ki taomi kofiron buda, gurusnagiro bartaraf namesozad?!

63) Beshak, Mo darakhti "Zak'k'um"-ro baroi bandagone, ki bo kufru ma'siiat bar khud sitam kardaand, vositai ozmoish k'aror doda budem. Vak'te ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba mushrikon dar borai mavch'udiiati on dar duzakh khabar dodand, onkh'o bo raddu maskhara guftand: "Otash darakhtro mesuzonad. Imkon nadorad, ki dar dokhili otash darakht biruiad."
64) Beshak, darakhti "Zak'k'um" dar ch'oi palid, ia'ne dar k'a'ri duzakh meruiad.
65) Mevai on zishtnamo buda, ba kallakh'oi Shaitonkh'o monand ast. In ba ma'noi on ast, ki samaraash ta'mi nikh'oiat bad dorad.
66) Pas Ba durusti ki kofiron az mevai talkhu zishti on mekhurand va az on shikamkh'oi kholii khudro pur mekunand.
67) Iak'inan kofironro ba'di khurdani mevai darakhti "Zak'k'um" nushobai bo khunu zardob oludai bag'oiat garm ast.
68) Sipas begumon ba'd az in bozgashtashon ba sui azobi duzakh ast. Onkh'o az iak azob ba azobi digar intik'ol doda meshavand.
69) Kh'amono in kofiron padaronashonro az rokh'i kh'idoiat gumrokh' paido karda, kur-kurona ba onkh'o tak'lid namuda budand.
70) Pas onkh'o az paii padaronashon shitobon pairavi mekunand.
71) Va beshak, k'abl az k'avmi zolimi tu aksari guzashtagon gumrokh' shudaand. Pas ei Paiombar, k'avmi tu nakhustin ummati gumrokh' nestand.
72) Va ba durusti, Mo dar baini on ummatkh'oi guzashta paiombaroni ziiod firistodem, ki eshonro az azobi ilokh'i bim medodand, vale onkh'o ba sukhanoni firistodagon gush nakardand va kofir shudand.

73) Pas ei Paiombar, nigokh' bikun, ki farch'omi k'avmkh'oi az ch'onibi paiombaronashon bimdodashudai sarkash bo chi anch'omid. Onkh'o ok'ibat ba sababi kufr varzidan va paiombaroni Khudoro ba durug'gui nisbat dodanashon duzakhi shudand,-
74) magar bandagoni barguzidai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki az uk'ubat eminand.

75) Va beshak, vak'te ki k'avmi Nukh' uro takzib kardand, vai dar kh'ak'k'ashon duoi bad karda, Moro ba fariod khond. Pas Mo ba fariodash chi posukhdikh'andai khub budem. Zero duoi uro bar k'avmash zud paziruftem.
76) Va Nukh' (alaikh'is salom)-ro bo akh'li bait va mu'minoni kh'amrakh'ash az ozori k'avmash va tufoni azimi bar kofiron firistodaamon solim nigokh' doshtem.
77) Va tankh'o khonadoni Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) va mu'minoni pairavashro nach'ot dodem va k'avmi kofirashro dar tufon g'ark' sokhtem.
78) Va baroi Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) dar miioni ummatkh'oi oianda nomi nek bok'i guzoshtem. Naslkh'oi minba'da uro ba neki iod mekunand.
79) Durud bar Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) dar miioni millatkh'oi oianda. Kase uro bo zishti iod namekunad, balki nomi nekash dar ch'akh'on bok'i memonad.
80) Kh'amono Mo on guna ki Nukh' (alaikh'is salom)-ro podosh dodem, bandagoni bo ich'roi ibodat va itoat nekukorro niz kh'amin guna podosh medikh'em.
81) Beshak, Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) az bandagoni mu'mini farmonbardori Mo bud.
82) Sipas k'avmi bok'imondai beimonashro ba vositai tufon g'ark' sokhtem. Kh'ech' kase az onkh'o bok'i namond.
83) Va kh'amono Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) az kh'amkeshoni Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) bud. Dini on du dar da'vati mardum ba iaktoparasti az iakdigar fark' namekard.
84) Ei bandai kh'ushmand, on zamonero, ki Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) bo k'albi az shirk solimu khairkhokh'i khaloik' ba Parvardigorash ru ovard, iod kun, to az sarguzashtash ibrat bigiri.
85) On gokh', ki Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba padarash va k'avmash sarzanishkunon guft: "G'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chiro meparasted?!
86) Oio mekhokh'ed ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oi durug'inro ibodat kuned?!

87) Ei mardum, dar kh'ak'k'i Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion chi gumon dored?! Vak'te ki bo Khudoi iagona dar kh'olate mulok'ot mekuned, ki digar mavch'udotro ibodat kardaed, ba andeshaaton U nisbat ba shumo chi kor mekunad?!"
88) Pas Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba sitoragon nazare andokht. Vai baroi on ki kh'amrokh'i k'avmi mushrikash ba idgokh' naravad, kh'ila kard.
89) Ba'dan bakh'ona pesh ovarda guft: "Beshak, man bemoram."
90) Ba'd az in k'avmash uro guzoshta, khudashon ba idgokh' raftand.
91) Pas Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba sui ma'budkh'oi k'avmi kheshtan mail namuda, bo tamaskhur guft: "Oio az taomi baroiaton omodasokhtai mushrikon namekhured?!
92) Shumoro chi shuda ast, ki gap namezaned va ba savol ch'avob namedikh'ed?! Magar chunin mavch'udi lol loik'i ibodat ast?!"
93) Pas Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) bar butkh'o mail karda, bo dasti rostash chunon onkh'oro zarbakh'oi mustakh'kam zad, ki pora-pora shudand.
94) Butparaston ba'd az in rukhdod shitobon nazdi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) omadand.

95) Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ustuvorona ziddashon muk'obiliiat nishon doda, bo sarzanish guft: "Oio g'air az Allokh'i Iagona butkh'oero meparasted, ki khudi shumo onkh'oro bo dastonaton metaroshed?!
96) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumo va a'molatonro ofarida ast. Az ch'umlai korkh'oiaton kh'amin butparastii shumost. Az in ru, tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) arzandai ibodat ast."

97) Vak'te butparaston az on ki bo kh'uch'ch'at Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro mag'lub sozand, notavon mondand, bo kh'am mashvarat kardand. Ba'd az mashvarat guftand: "Baroi Ibrokh'im sokhtmone bisozed. Onro az kh'ezum pur karda, otash afruzed va uro dar on otash biafkaned."

98) Pas k'avmi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) dar kh'ak'k'ash k'asdi bad kardand. Khostand Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro kushta, az vai khalos shavand. Pas Mo onkh'oro ziiondida gardonidem. Zero otashi afrukhtaashonro sard va boisi emin mondani Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) k'aror dodem.

99) Va Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ba durusti, man sarzamini k'avmamro tark karda, kh'ich'rat mekunam, to baroi ibodati Parvardigoram ch'oi munosibero biiobam. Beshak, U maro ba nekii dunio va okhirat rakh'namoi khokh'ad kard.
100) Ei Parvardigoram, baroiam farzandi solekh' ruzi namo, to dar in diiori g'urbat maro iori doda, ba ch'oi k'avmam k'aror girad."
101) Pas Mo duoi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro paziruftem va uro ba vilodati farzande, ki ba voia rasida, burdbor boshad, muzhda dodem. On farzand Ismoil (alaikh'is salom) bud.

102) Ba'dan chun Ismoil (alaikh'is salom) ba dunio omada, navch'avon gardid va ba sinne rasid, ki metavonist bo padarash kor kunad, padarash Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) khob did. Khobi firistodagoni Khudo iak nav' vakh'i ba kh'isob meravad. Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba pisarash Ismoil (alaikh'is salom) oidi mukh'tavoi khobash k'issa karda guft: "Ei Pisaram, ba durusti ki man dar khob didam, ki turo zabkh' mekunam. Pas, binigar, ki dar in bobat chi andesha dori." Ismoil (alaikh'is salom) ba padarash Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Padaram, on chi Khudo ba tu dar borai zabkh'i man amr karda ast, ich'ro kun. Agar Khudo khokh'ad, kh'atman maro dar barobari kh'ukmash az bandagoni bosabri khushnud meiobi."

103) Pas chun padaru pisar taslim va mutei amri ilokh'i shudand va Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) pisarash Ismoil (alaikh'is salom)-ro ba tarafi peshoniash ba zamin guzosht, to farmoni zabkh'ro ich'ro kunad.

104) Va Mo Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom)-ro dar kh'ole ki ba anch'omi suporishi zabkh'i pisarash Ismoil (alaikh'is salom) azmi k'ote' dosht, ba in ma'no nido kardem, ki "Ei Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom),-

105) Ba durusti ki tu bo azmi k'at'i bar zabkh'i pisarat khobi didai khudro takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshidi. Kh'amono Mo on guna ki ba tu bo rakh'onidanat az in ozmoishi sakht podosh dodem, ba bandagoni nekukor niz kh'amin guna podosh medikh'em va onkh'oro az imtikh'onu sakhtikh'o berun mesozem."
106) Beshak, in ozmoishi oshkor bud. Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) az on bo komiobi va sarbalandi berun omad.
107) Va baroi zabkh' dar badali Ismoil (alaikh'is salom) k'uchk'ori buzurgch'ussaero dodem.
108) Va baroi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) dar miioni millatkh'oi oianda nomi nek bok'i guzoshtem.
109) Durudi Khudo bar Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) az kh'ama guna nokhushikh'o.
110) On guna ki Mo ba Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) dar ivazi ibodatkh'oiash podosh dodem, ba bandagoni nekukor niz kh'amin guna podosh medikh'em.
111) Kh'amono Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) az bandagoni mu'mini dar ich'roi ibodat vafodori Mo bud.

112) Va Mo uro ba vilodati pisari digare bo nomi Iskh'ok', ki ba'd az ba voia rasidan paiombar va bandai solekh' megardad, muzhda dodem. In mukofoti farmonbardorii Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) dar k'oteona azm namudanash bar amali gardonidani amri zabkh'i iagona farzandash bud.

113) Va Mo bar Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) va pisarash Iskh'ok' (alaikh'is salom) az nazdi Khesh barakat furud ovardem. Ne'mati Khudro bar onkh'o farovon sokhtem. Az ch'umla naslashonro ziiod gardonidem. Va az nasli on du ba'zeashon bo anch'omi ibodat nekukor va ba'zeashon bo sodir namudani kufru gunokh' bar ch'oni kheshtan sitamgari oshkor budand.
114) Va Ba durusti ki Mo bar Muso va barodarash Kh'orun bo dodani mak'omi nubuvvat imtinon namudem.
115) Va Musovu Kh'orun va k'avmashon Bani Isroilro az g'ulomoni Fir'avn gashtan va dar darioi Nil g'ark' shudan solim nigokh' doshtem.
116) Va onkh'oro alaikh'i Fir'avn va sipokh'iionash nusrat dodem. Pas begumon onkh'o bar dushmanonashon g'olib omadand.
117) Va ba Musovu Kh'orun az sui Khud Kitobi Ravshan dodem. Murod az Kitobi mazkur Tavrot ast.
118) Va Muso va Kh'orunro ba rokh'i rost rakh'namoi namudem. Mak'sad az rokh'i rost Islom ast, ki pairavonashro ba rizoi ilokh'i merasonad.
119) Va baroi on du dar miioni millatkh'oi oianda nomi nek bok'i guzoshtem.
120) Durudi Khudo bar Muso va barodarash Kh'orun. On du bo durudi Parvardigor az kh'ama guna nokhushi dar amonand.
121) On guna ki Mo ba Muso va Kh'orun in podoshi nekro dodem, ba bandagoni nekukor niz kh'amin guna podosh medikh'em.
122) Begumon Muso va barodarash Kh'orun az bandagoni mu'mini bo shariat amalkunandai Mo budand.
123) Va kh'amono Ilios az firistodagoni Khudo bud. Parvardigor bo dodani mak'omi risolat va nubuvvat bar vai ekh'son namud.

124) Ba iod biior zamonero, ki u ba k'avmash Bani Isroil guft: "Ei k'avmi man, oio bo ich'roi amrkh'oi ilokh'i, az ch'umla tavkh'id va duri az nakh'ikh'oiash, az ch'umla shirk ovardan parkh'ezkori namekuned?!
125) Oio ch'uz Khudo ma'budaton Ba'lro[ nomi butest, ki k'avmi Ilios onro meparastidand] meparasted va ibodati Allokh'i Bekh'tarini ofaridgoronro kanor meguzored?!
126) Oio ibodati Khudoi Parvardigori shumo va Parvardigori padaroni guzashtaatonro tark mekuned?! Tankh'o U sazovori ibodat ast. Kh'ech' chiz ch'uz U loik'i ibodat nest."
127) Pas k'avmash uro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand. Binobar in, onkh'o dar azobi duzakh kh'ozir kunonida meshavand.
128) Magar on bandagoni barguzidai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az k'avmi Ilios, ki imon ovarda, dar ibodat boikhlos budand. Inkh'o az azob dar amonand.
129) Va baroi Ilios (alaikh'is salom) dar miioni millatkh'oi oianda nomi nek bok'i guzoshtem.
130) Durudi Khudo bar Ilios az kh'ama guna nokhushikh'o.
131) Ba durusti, Mo on guna ki ba Ilios (alaikh'is salom) in podoshi nekro ato namudem, ba bandagoni mu'mini nekukoramon niz kh'amin guna podosh medikh'em.
132) Kh'amono Ilios (alaikh'is salom) az bandagoni mu'mini dar imonash sodik'i Mo bud.
133) Va begumon Lut (alaikh'is salom) az paiombaron buda, k'avmi kofirashro az azobi duzakh bim doda, mu'minonashonro ba ch'annat muzhda medod.
134) Ei bandai kh'ushmand, ba iod biior on zamonero, ki Mo Lut (alaikh'is salom) va tamomi khonadonashro az azob solim nigokh' doshtem,-
135) ba ch'uz kh'amsarash, ki azobi bar k'avmi Lut (alaikh'is salom) nozilshuda uro niz faro girift. Zero kh'amsarash monandi on k'avm kofir bud.
136) Sipas k'avmi bok'imondai uro, ki takzibash namudand, kh'alok sokhtem.
137) Va beshak, shumo akh'li Makka kh'angomi safari khesh ba sui Shom ruzona az nazdi maskankh'oiashon meguzared.
138) Va inchunin shabona az onch'o meguzared. Oio andesha namekuned va pand namegired, ki ok'ibati kufru takzibu amali zishti bachabozii onkh'o bo chi anch'omid?!
139) Va begumon bandai Mo Iunus (alaikh'is salom) az firistodagoni Khudo buda, kofironi k'avmashro az uk'ubati duzakh bim doda, mu'minonashonro ba ch'annat muzhda medod.
140) Zamone biduni ich'ozati Parvardigor az nazdi k'avmash firor karda, ba kishtii az savoragon va mato' pur savor shud.

141) Pas kishti az sababi pur budan k'arib g'ark' megasht. Binobar in, akh'li kishti bo shumuli Iunus (alaikh'is salom) baini khud k'ur'akashi kardand, to ba'zero ba dario afkanda, bori onro sabuk sozand. Zero metarsidand, ki kishti g'ark' gashta, kh'amaashon kh'alok meshavand. Pas Iunus (alaikh'is salom) dar k'ur'akashi az mag'lubshudagon gardid. Mardumi kishti uro ba dario afkandand.

142) Pas vak'te ki akh'li kishti uro ba dario afkandand, nakh'ang uro girift va furu burd va kh'ol on ki Iunus (alaikh'is salom) ba sababi kori kardaash shoistai malomat bud. Zero vai biduni ich'ozati Khudo az nazdi k'avmash firor namud.
143) Pas agar Iunus (alaikh'is salom) k'abl az rukh dodani in kh'odisa az bandagoni ziiod zikrkunandai Khudo namebud va dar batni mokh'i tasbekh' nameguft,-
144) begumon dar batni nakh'ang to on ruze, ki bandagon barangekhta meshavand, meistod. Shikami nakh'ang k'abrash megasht.
145) Pas Mo uro az batni mokh'i dar sarzamini az darakhtu imorat kholi afkandem, dar kh'ole badanash az sababi muddati daroz dar batni nakh'ang istodan notavon gashta bud.
146) Va Mo dar on sarzamini beimorat va begiiokh' bar boloi sari Iunus (alaikh'is salom) darakhte az kadu ruionidem, to az on bikhurad va az garmi zeri soiaash panokh' barad.
147) Va Mo uro ba sui k'avmash, ki sad kh'azor, balki beshtar az sad kh'azor budand, firistodem.
148) Pas onkh'o ba Iunus (alaikh'is salom) imon ovardand. Pas Mo k'avmi uro to faro rasidani mukh'lati muaiian az zindagonii dunio bakh'ramand sokhtem.

149) Pas ei Mukh'ammad, az mushrikon bo mak'sadi inkor bipurs: "Oio dukhtaronro, ki dustashon namedored, ba Parvardigoraton va pisaronro, ki dustashon medored, ba khudaton ikhtisos medikh'ed?! In chi guna tak'simot ast?!"
150) Chitavr mushrikon da'vo mekunand, ki farishtagon az ch'insi moda kh'astand va kh'ol on ki onkh'o kh'angomi ofaridani farishtagon kh'ozir va shokh'id nabudand?!
151-152) Ogokh' boshed! Ba durusti ki mushrikonu kofiron az shiddati dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo durug' boftanashon meguiand,-
152-152) "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) farzand zoda ast. Va shak nest, ki onkh'o dar in da'voi khud durug'gui kh'astand."
153) Oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dukhtaronro bar pisaron barguzida ast?! Kh'argiz chunin nest.
154) Ei mushrikon, shumoro chi shuda ast, ki chunin k'azovati zolimona mekuned?! Dukhtaronro ba Khudo va pisaronro ba khud ikhtisos medikh'ed?! Oio chi guftanatonro mefakh'med?!
155) Oio andesha namekuned, ki ak'idaaton botil ast?! Agar andesha mekarded, kh'ech' gokh' in sukhanro namegufted.
156) Io shumo az kitobi osmoni io az paiombari Khudo daleli ravshan dored?!
157) Agar dar da'voiaton sodik' kh'asted, pas on kitobatonro, ki durustii amali shumoro isbot mekunad, biiored.

158) Va mushrikon baini Khudo va baini maloikakh'oi az chashmashon pinkh'on nasabi kheshi k'aror dodaand. Onkh'o farishtagonro dukhtaroni Parvardigor meshumorand. Va iak'inan farishtagon medonand, ki Khudo ruzi k'iiomat mushrikonro baroi bozpursi kh'ozir mesozad.
159) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mushrikon Uro bo vasfi noloik'i doshtani anbozu farzand va g'airi on tavsif mekunand, poku muk'addas ast.
160) Ch'uz bandagoni barguzidai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u). Onkh'o Allokh'ro tankh'o bo sifatkh'oi ifodagari ch'amolu kamol tavsif menamoiand.
161) Pas Ba durusti ki shumo mushrikon va on chi g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted,-
162) kasero az ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gumrokh' sokhta nametavoned,-

163) magar kase, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro az akh'li duzakh kh'ukm karda ast. Pas Parvardigor kh'ukmi Khudro nisbatash amali mesozad va u kofir gashta, ba duzakh medaroiad. Ammo shumo va ma'budkh'oiaton in k'udratro nadored.

164) Va farishtagon bandagii khud va butloni da'voi mushrikonro baion karda guftand: "Va az mo kh'ech' kas nest, magar on ki dar ibodat va itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mak'omi ma'lumi khudro dorad.
165) Va begumon mo farishtagon dar ibodatu itoati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) safzada istodaem.
166) Va begumon mo farishtagon Allokh'ro az sifatkh'oi noloik' poku muk'addas medonem va ba poki mekhonem."
167) Va Ba durusti ki mushrikoni Makka k'abl az bi'sati Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) meguftand:-
168) "Agar az Kitobkh'oi guzashtagon -masalan monandi- Tavrot kitob medoshtem,-
169) beshak, kholisona ibodat karda, bandagoni mukhtori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meshudem."

170) Onkh'o durug' meguftand. Chunki vak'te ki Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) baroiashon K'ur'onro ovard, ba on kofir gashtand. Pas begumon onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat azobero, ki dar intizorashon meboshad, khokh'and donist.
171) Va kh'amono kalimai radnopaziri Mo dar borai bandagoni ba sifati paiombar firistodashudaamon guzashta ast, ki-
172) albatta, paiombaroni Mo bo tavonu dalele, ki ba onkh'o dodaem, alaikh'i dushmanonashon nusrat doda meshavand -
173) va albatta, sipokh'iioni Mo, ki bo mak'sadi baland bardoshtani Kalimai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mech'angand, g'olib kh'astand.
174) Pas ei Paiombar, az in mushrikoni sarkash to vak'ti omadani azobashon, ki tankh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zamoni onro medonad, rui bigardon.

175) Va vak'te ki azobi ilokh'i furud meoiad, ba onkh'o nigokh' kun, ki ba chi kh'olate duchor meshavand. Pas begumon eshon ok'ibati kufri khudro khokh'and did. Ammo in didanashon on zamon foida nadorad.
176) Oio mushrikon talab mekunand, ki azobi Mo ba onkh'o zud oiad?!
177) Pas chun azobi Mo ba onkh'o nozil shavad, subkh'i onkh'o chi subkh'i badest.
178) Va ei Paiombar, az onkh'o to vak'te ki Khudo bar uk'ubatashon kh'ukm kunad, rui bigardon.

179) Va vak'te ki azobi ilokh'i furud meoiad, ba onkh'o nigokh' kun, ki ba chi kh'olat duchor meshavand. Pas begumon eshon ok'ibati kufri khudro khokh'and did. Ammo in didanashon on zamon foida nadorad.
180) Ei Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), Parvardigori K'odiru Nerumand va G'olibi Tu az on chi mushrikon Uro bo sifatkh'oi nuk'son tavsif mekunand, poku muk'addas ast.
181) Va durudi Khudo bar firistodagoni arch'mandash.
182) Va kh'amai sano va sitoishi nek makhsusi Allokh'i Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast. Zero tankh'o U arzandai sitoish ast.

1) "Sod". (Dar ibtidoi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.) Savgand ba K'ur'oni doroi iodovari, ki andarzkh'oi dar dunio va okhirat ba mardum foidaovar medikh'ad, kh'ak'ik'at chunonchi mushrikon mepindorand, nest, balki Khudo anboz nadorad.
2) Lekin kofiron az paziruftani tavkh'id dar g'ururu takabbur va bo Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar ikhtilof va adovat k'aror dorand.

3) Mo k'abl az k'avmi tu Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ummatkh'oi bisiorero kh'alok sokhtaem, ki firistodagonamonro durug'gui shumurda budand. Pas onkh'o kh'angomi nuzuli azob fariod karda, kumak khostand va on zamon baroi onkh'o zamoni rakh'oi az azob nabud. Ba kh'amin sabab, dodu fig'on va kumak khostanashon sudashon nakard.

4) Va mushrikon az on taach'ch'ub mekunand, ki ba onkh'o az nav'i khudi eshon paiombari az uk'ubati ilokh'i bimdikh'anda omada ast. Va kofiron vak'te dalelkh'oi rostk'avlii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro didand, guftand: "In mard ch'odugaru durug'gui guzaro ast. Mardumro ch'odu menamoiad va dar da'voi on ki guio firistodai Khudost, durug' meguiad.
5) Oio in mard ma'budkh'oi bisiorro iak ma'bud sokhta, ibodatro ba iak Khudo makh'dud karda ast?! Beshak, in korash bag'oiat kh'airatovar ast."

6) Va peshvoionu rakh'baroni mushrikon az ch'am'omadashon rafta, ba tobeonashon guftand: "Rokh'i khudro idoma doda, ba dini Mukh'ammad vorid nashaved va dar ibodati ma'budkh'oiaton sabr kuned. Kh'amono da'vat namudani Mukh'ammad shumoro ba ibodati iak ma'bud kori tarkh'rezishudai mak'sadnok ast. Vai bo in rokh' mekhokh'ad zabardast gardad va movu shumoro zerdasti khud sozad.
7) Mo in da'vati uro dar baini padaronamon va inchunin dar dini Iso nashunidaem. Gapkh'oe, ki az Mukh'ammad meshunavem, durug' va sukhani boftae besh nest.

8) Oio imkon dorad, ki K'ur'on az baini mo khos bar Mukh'ammad nozil karda shuda, bar mo nozil nashavad, kh'ol on ki mo peshvoioni mardum kh'astem?" Balki in mushrikon dar borai paig'omi Khudo, ki bar tu furud omada ast, dar shak k'aror dorand. Va onkh'o kh'anuz uk'ubati Maro nachashidaand. Az on ki mukh'latashon dodaam, firefta shudaand. Agar uk'ubati Maro mechashidand, kh'ech' gokh' ch'asorat namekardand, ki ba kufru shirk va shak ru biiorand.

9) Io in mushrikoni takzibkunanda sokh'ibi khazinakh'oi rakh'mati Parvardigori kh'amesha G'olibu be nikhoiat Atokunandaat kh'astand?! On Zote, ki ba kh'ar kas kh'ar chize khokh'ad, ato mekunad. Nubuvvat az khazinai ekh'soni Parvardigor ast. Onro ba kh'ar kas khokh'ad, medikh'ad. Mak'omi nubuvvat dar ikhtiiori mushrikon nest, ki onro ba kh'ar ki khokh'and, bidikh'and va az kh'ar ki khokh'and, boz dorand.

10) Io molikiiat va saltanati osmonkh'ovu zamin va on chi baini on du k'aror dorad, az oni onkh'ost, ki ba kh'ar ki kh'ar chiro khokh'and, bidikh'and va az kh'ar ki kh'ar chiro khokh'and, man' kunand. Agar chunin mepindorand, pas abzor va vasilakh'oi ba osmon rasonandaro istifoda burda, ba sui osmon ravand, to k'udrat paido kunand, ki ba kh'ar ki kh'ar chiro khokh'and, bidikh'and va az kh'ar ki kh'ar chiro khokh'and, boz dorand. Ammo onkh'o kh'ech' gokh' az ukh'dai in kor namebaroiand.

11) In kofironi ba durug'gui nisbatdikh'andai Paiombari Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) monandi sipokh'iioni dar guzashta takzibkunandai firistodagoni Khudo lashkari kh'ak'iri shikastkhurda kh'astand. Chunonchi dastakh'oi dar guzashta takzibkunandai paiombaron kh'alok shudand, inkh'o niz kh'amin guna nobud karda meshavand.

12) Inkh'o nakhustin k'avmi takzibkunanda nestand. Begumon k'abl az onkh'o k'avmi Nukh' (alaikh'is salom), Od va Fir'avni sokh'ibsipokh', ki mardumro bo istifoda az sipokh'iiash shikanch'a medod, paiombaronro takzib kardand.

13) Va niz Samud va k'avmi Lut va k'avmi Shuaibi sokinoni dekh'ai doroi darakhtoni pechida paiombaronro takzib namudand. Inkh'o kh'amon dastakh'oe budand, ki dar durug'gu shumurdani firistodagoni Khudo dar iak ch'abkh'a k'aror doshtand.

14) Beshak, kh'ar iake az in dastakh'o paiombaronro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand. Binobar in, azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o voch'ib gasht. Azobi ilokh'i agarchi to muddate ta'khir guzoshta shud, ok'ibat domangirashon gardid.

15) Va beshak, in gurukh'i takzibgari Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) tankh'o muntaziri onand, ki nafkhai duium dar sur damida shavad, on nafkhae, ki bozgasht nadorad. Agar on vak't dar kh'olati kufr bimirand, giriftori uk'ubati Parvardigor meshavand.
16) Va kofiron bo maskhara meguiand: "Ei Parvardigoramon, pesh az omadani k'iiomat zud dar kh'amin dunio kh'issai moro az azob biior."

17) Ei Paiombar, ba on sukhanoni bade, ki mushrikon meguiand, sabr namo. Va bandai Mo Dovudro, ki dar sarkubsozii dushman va ibodat nerui azim dosht, iod kun. Beshak, Dovud bo tavba va amalkh'oi shoista ba sui Khudo ziiod bozgashtkunanda bud.
18) Mo kukh'kh'oro baroi Dovud rom sokhtem, dar kh'ole ki dar okhir va avvali ruz (kh'angomi chosht) kh'amrokh'ash tasbekh' meguftand.

19) Va parandagonro dar kh'ole dar osmon ch'am'ovardashuda budand, baroi Dovud rom kardem. Kh'ar vak'te Dovud tasbekh' meguft, parandagoni osmon az parvoz boz istoda, kh'amrokh'ash ba tasbekh'gui og'oz menamudand. Kh'amai kukh'kh'o va parandagon mutei Dovud buda va dar guftani tasbekh' bo vai kh'amnavoi mekardand.

20) Va Mo saltanati Dovudro bo ato namudani kh'aibat, nerumandi va g'olibiiat alaikh'i dushman ustuvor gardonidem. Va ba Dovud kh'ikmatu nubuvvat va sukhani balig'u dovarii baini kh'ak'u botilro dodem.
21) Va ei Paiombar, oio baroiat khabari da'vogaron rasida ast?! On gokh', ki onkh'o boloi ibodatgokh'i Dovud baromadand.

22) Vak'te on du kas nogakh'oni nazdi Dovud daromadand, pas az onkh'o ba vakh'shatu iztirob aftod. Zero on da'vogaron az rokh'i g'airi ma'muli nogakh'oni voridi khonaash shudand. Vak'te ki iztirobi Dovud baroiashon ma'lum gasht, guftand: "Natars. Zero mo du shakhsi alaikh'i iakdigar da'vogare kh'astem va az mo iake bar digare zulm karda ast. Binobar in, baini mo odilona dovari kun va kh'angomi k'azovat dar nisbat ba mo ch'avr makun va moro ba rokh'i rostu durust rakh'namoi namo."

23) Iake az on du da'vogaron ba Dovud guft: "Ba durusti, in mard barodari man ast. U navadu nukh' gusfandi moda dorad va man iak gusfandi moda doram. Pas az man talab kard, ki az kh'ak'i khud dast kashida, on iak gusfandi modaro ba vai bidikh'am. Va az sababi on ki dar sukhanvari makh'orat dorad, maro dar bakh's mag'lub sokht."

24) Dovud ba'di shunidani da'vo bainashon dovari namuda, khitob ba da'vogar guft: "Vak'te barodarat az tu darkhost karda boshad, ki gusfandi modai khudro ba gusfandonash ilova namoi, savgand mekhuram, ki vai nisbatat sitam karda ast. Va begumon beshtari sharikon, ba'zeashon bar ba'zei digarashon bo sitonidani kh'ak'k'i iakdigar va beinsofi ch'avr mekunand, ba istisnoi on kasone, ki imon ovardaand va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand. Mu'minoni boamal nisbat ba sharikoni khud zulm namekunand. Va bandagoni doroi sifati imonu amal nikh'oiat andakand." Va Dovud iak'in namud, ki Mo uro ozmudaem. Pas, vai az Parvardigorash mag'firat khost va ba khotiri nazdiki bo U ba sach'da aftod va tavba kard.
25) Pas Mo duoi uro paziruftem va in lag'zhishashro bakhshidem. Va kh'amono Dovud nazdi Mo az bandagoni muk'arrab bud va baroiash dar okhirat saranch'omi nek ast.

26) Ei Dovud, Mo turo dar zamin ch'onishin[ia'ne, khalifai Khud io ch'onishini paiombaroni guzasht] k'aror dodem, ki dar umuri dini va duniavi k'azovat kuni. Modom ki chunin ast, pas baini mardum odilona dovari kun va dar k'azovat tobei khostai nafs mabosh, ki ba khotiri mavch'udiiati paivandi kheshi io dusti ba iake az da'vogaron mail namoi. Zero agar chunin kardi, begumon khostai nafs turo az rokh'i rosti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gumrokh' mesozad. Beshak, kasone, ki az rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gumrokh' shudaand, ba sababi on ki ruzi kh'isobro faromush sokhtaand, onkh'oro azobi sakht ast. Chunki agar okhiratro ba iod ovarda, metarsidand, kh'ech' gokh' sui khostai nafs mail namekardand.
27) Va Mo osmonu zamin va mavch'udoti bainashonro barabas khalk' nakardaem. In pindori kofiron ast. Pas ruzi k'iiomat voii kofiron az otashi duzakh, agar ba kh'amin e'tik'od bimirand.

28) Mo bandagonero, ki ba Khudo imon ovarda, Paiombari Uro itoat karda va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, kh'ech' gokh' bo bandagone, ki dar zamin az rokh'i kufru ma'siiat fasod mekunand, barobar namegardonem. Niz kh'ech' gokh' bandagoni parkh'ezgori ich'rokunandai dasturotamonro bo kofironu munofik'oni dar gunokh' g'utidai badkor barobar namesozem. Barobar sokhtani in du toifa zulm ba kh'isob meravad va chunin kor ba Khudo loik' nest, balki mu'minoni botak'voro ba ch'annat va kofironi besaodatro ba duzakh medarorad. Chunki onkh'o nazdi Parvardigor iakson nestand. Baroi kh'amin podoshashon niz fark' mekunad.

29) In K'ur'on Kitobest, ki Mo onro bar tu nozil sokhtem, Kalomi purbarakat va khairu sudi ziiod dorad. Onro nozil namudem, to mardum dar borai oiatkh'o va ma'nokh'oiash tafakkur namoiand va bandagoni doroi khiradi solim az rakh'namoikh'oiash pand girand.

30) Va Mo az rui lutfu ekh'sonamon ba Dovud (alaikh'is salom) pisarash Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom)-ro bakhshidem, to chashmash bo didanash rushan shavad. Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom) chi bandai neke bud. Ba durusti ki u bandai nikh'oiat tavbakori sui Khudo bozgashtkunanda bud.

31) Ei Paiombar, zamonero iod kun, ki dar vak'ti namozi asr aspkh'oi asili tezrav, ki ruii du poi va iak dast istoda, iak dasti digarashonro bardoshta, tankh'o sumashonro ba zamin meguzoshtand, ba Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom) namoish doda shud. Namoishi aspkh'o to g'urubi oftob idoma ioft.

32) Pas Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Kh'amono man mukh'abbat ba mol (az ch'umla mukh'abbat ba aspkh'o)-ro az zikri Parvardigoram muk'addam guzoshtam, to on ki oftob bo pardai zulmati shab nopadid gashta, g'urub kard va az adoi namozi asr der mondam.
33) Aspkh'oro nazdam bargardoned." Pas vak'te ki aspkh'oro nazdash bargardondand, bo shamsherash ba pai namudani sok'kh'oi poi va zadani gardani onkh'o shuru' kard.

34) Va ba durusti ki Mo Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom)-ro ozmudem va bar takhti shokh'iash ch'innero ba surati inson afkandem, ki iak muddati kutokh' dar mamlakatash kh'ukmfarmoi kard. Sipas podshokh'i dubora ba Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom) bargasht va Khudo uro alaikh'i ch'inkh'o musallat gardonid.

35) Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, gunokh'onamro omurz va ba man saltanati khose ato kun, ki ba'di man kh'ech' kas az mardum onro nadoshta boshad. Beshak, Tu bag'oiat Atokunanda kh'asti."

36) Pas Mo duoiashro paziruftem va ba vai bodro musakhkhar sokhtem. Bod novobasta az shiddat va sur'atash, bo farmoni Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom) narm kh'arakat karda, uro kh'ar kuch'o mekhost, meburd.
37) Va inchunin ch'inkh'oro mutei u sokhtem. Ba'zeashon me'morgar va ba'zeashon g'avvos budand. Zeri dario furu rafta, az on marvorid berun meovardand.
38) Va iddai digari ch'inkh'oi sarkash dar zanch'irkh'o basta shuda, zeri farmoni Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom) k'aror doshtand. Az ch'oii kheshtan kh'arakat karda nametavonistand.
39) Ei Sulaimon, in atoi Mo bar tust. Onro ba khotiri darkhostat ba tu dodem. Pas az on ba kh'ar ki khokh'i, dekh' va az kh'ar ki khokh'i, boz bidor, baroi dodanat io boz doshtanat pursida nameshavi.
40) Va kh'amono Sulaimon (alaikh'is salom) nazdi Mo az bandagoni muk'arrab bud va baroiash dar okhirat ch'oi bozgashti nek (ch'annat) ast.
41) Va ei Paiombar, bandai Mo Aiubro iod kun. Vak'te Parvardigori khudro khonda guft: "Kh'amono Shaiton maro ba ranch' [kh'olati g'amu andukh'] va azob duchor sokhta ast."

42) Pas ba Aiub guftem: "Bo poiat bar zamin bizan. In ob baroi shustushui va nushidan ast". Vai bo poiash bar zamin zad. Az zamin baroi nushidan va shustushui ob berun omad. Vak'te az on ob shustushui kard, kh'amai dardu azobash az bain raft.

43) Mo duoi Aiub (alaikh'is salom)-ro paziruftem, ranch'u azobashro bartaraf sokhtem va ba u khonavodaash va kh'amrokh'i khonavodaash monandi onkh'oro az farzandonu naberagon ba u ato kardem, in az ch'onibi Mo rakh'mate dar kh'ak'k'i Aiub (alaikh'is salom) va podoshi dar sakhtikh'o sabr namudanash bud va to az in sarguzasht sokh'ibkhiradon pand bigirand, ki ok'ibati sabr kushoish va kasbi savob ast.

44) Vak'te Aiub (alaikh'is salom) az kh'amsarash ba g'azab omada, savgand iod kard, ki uro sad toziiona mezanad, Mo ba vai guftem: "Bo dasti khesh iak dasta shokhakh'oi darakhti khurmoro bigir, pas bo on kh'amsaratro bizan, to savgandatro ba ch'o ovarda boshi va savgandi khudro mashikan." Aiub (alaikh'is salom) iak dasta shokhakh'oi darakhti khurmoro girifta, bo on kh'amsarashro zad. Kh'amono Mo uro dar barobari sakhtikh'o bandai bosabr ioftem. Vai chi bandai neke bud. Begumon Aiub (alaikh'is salom) bandai ziiod tavbakori ba sui Khudo bozgashtkunanda bud.

45) Va ei Paiombar, bandagoni mukhtoru paiombaroni Mo, Ibrokh'im va Iskh'ok' va Ia'k'ubro, ki dar ibodat va ch'ustuch'ui rizoi ilokh'i sokh'ibi nerui azim va dar shinokhti kh'ak'ik'at doroi basirat budand, iod kun.

46) Kh'amono Mo bo khususiiate, ki onkh'oro bo on khos gardonida budem, dar kh'ak'k'ashon ekh'son namudem. Khususiiat az on iborat bud, ki onkh'o bo iodovarii okhirat, ich'ro namudani amali shoista va da'vati mardum ba omodagii ruzi k'iiomat k'albi khudro obod mesokhtand.
47) Va beshak, onkh'o az zumrai bandagoni baroi ibodat barguzidai nikh'oiat neki Mo budand. Onkh'oro ba on mak'sad barguzidem, ki risolati Moro ba mardum birasonand.

48) Va ei Paiombar, Ismoil ibni Ibrokh'im va Iasa' va Zulkiflro iod kun va ba onkh'o sanoi nek bifirist. Chunki in ch'amoa arzandai sanoi nekand. Va kh'amai onkh'o az bandagoni neki barguzidai Khudo kh'astand.
49) In iodovarii bandagoni mazkur bo sanoi nek dar K'ur'on ast. Va begumon dar okhirat baroi parkh'ezkoroni ich'rokunandai dasturoti ilokh'i ch'oi bozgashti nek ast.
50) On ch'oi bozgashti nek bog'kh'oe baroi sukunati kh'ameshagist. Onkh'o dar kh'ole voridi bikh'isht meshavand, ki darkh'oiash baroi istik'bolashon boz karda shuda ast.

51) Bikh'ishtikh'o dar ch'annat bar takhtkh'oi orosta takia mezanand, onkh'o dar onch'o kh'ar chi az mevakh'oi ziiodi rangorang va nushobakh'oi mukhtalif khokh'and, az khodimonashon darkhost mekunand, to onro peshkash sozand.
52) Va nazdi akh'li ch'annat zanone mavch'udand, ki ch'uz shavkh'aronashon digar ba kase nigokh' namekunand, onkh'o bo iakdigar kh'amsinnu soland.
53) Ei parkh'ezkoron, in podoshi nekest, ki baroi ruzi k'iiomat dar ivazi a'moli shoistai dar dunio anch'om dodaaton va'da doda meshaved.
54) Kh'amono in ne'matkh'oi iodshuda rizk'i Mo ast. Onro ruzi okhirat ba bandagoni parkh'ezkoramon ruzi menamoem. On ruzii ch'ovidona ast.
55) In podoshi parkh'ezkoron ast. Va beshak, ba bandagoni bo kufru ma'siiat az kh'ududi ilokh'i tach'ovuzkor digar nav' ch'azo doda meshavad. Baroi onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat badtarin ch'oi bozgasht ast.
56) Ch'oi bozgashtashon duzakh buda, dar okhirat voridi on meshavand, duzakh onkh'oro ikh'ota karda, az on ranch' mebarand, otashi ch'akh'annam chun bistarashon megardad. Pas on chi bistari badest.
57) In azobi akh'li ch'akh'annam obi nikh'oiat purkh'arorat va zardobi az ch'asadi duzakhiion berunshavanda ast. Pas az in nushoba, ki tashnagiro bartaraf namesozad, boiad binushand.
58) Baroi akh'li duzakh az shakli in azob uk'ubati digarest. Onkh'oro chand nav' azobest, ki ruzi k'iiomat bo on ch'azo doda meshavand.

59) Vak'te duzakhiion voridi duzakh shavand, dar bainashon monandi tarafkh'oi da'vogar dashnomu nosazogui sar mezanad, iak gurukh' az gurukh'i digar bezori mech'uiand. Ba'zeashon meguiand: "In toifai akh'li duzakh kh'amrokh'aton ba duzakh medaroiand." Ba'zei digar posukh doda meguiand: "Khush naomadand. Kh'amono onkh'o ba ch'akh'annam vorid shuda, monandi mo ranch' mebarand."

60) Pairavon ba rakh'baronashon meguiand: "Ei peshvoion, balki shumo khush naomaded. Zero kh'amin shumo bo gumrokh'sozi va ig'vogari sababi giriftorii mo ba in azobi sakht gashted. Pas in makon, ki k'arorgokh'i kh'amai most, chi ch'oi badest."
61) Pairavon meguiand: "Ei Parvardigoramon, kh'ar kas moro az rokh'i rost gumrokh' sokhta, in uk'ubatro ba saramon ovard, azobashro dar otashi duzakh du barobar bigardon."

62) Va mutakabbironi sarkash dar ruzi k'iiomat meguiand: "Charo mo kh'amrokh'i khud dar ch'akh'annam mardonero namebinem, ki onkh'oro dar dunio az zumrai kasoni badi badbakhti loik'i azob mekh'isobidem?

63) Oio tamaskhuri mo dar kh'ak'k'i onkh'o khato bud va baroi kh'amin loik'i ch'akh'annam nashudaand io tamaskhuramon dar kh'ak'k'ashon durust bud va imruz voridi ch'akh'annam shudaand, ammo chashmamon ba onkh'o nameaftad?!"
64) Ba durusti ki bo iakdigar da'vo kardani kofiron ruzi k'iiomat kh'ak'ik'atest, ki dar on shakke nest.

65) Ei Paiombar, ba kofironi k'avmat bigu: "Ba durusti ki man bimdikh'andai shumo az azob kh'astam. Agar ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shaved va firistodagonashro ba durug'gui nisbat dikh'ed, giriftori azob megarded. Va kh'ech' ma'budi barkh'ak'k'i loik'i ibodat ba ch'uz Allokh'i dar azamat va ismu sifat Iagonai bar kh'amai chiz G'olib, ki kulli makhluk'ot tobei U meboshand, vuch'ud nadorad.
66) U Parvardigori osmonkh'ovu zamin va Parvardigori kh'amai mavch'udoti bainashon buda, G'olibu Bakhshandai gunokh'i bandagoni tavbakor ast."
67) Ei Paiombar, ba takzibkunandagon bigu: "Beshubkh'a, K'ur'on doroi khabari bag'oiat mukh'im ast.
68) Shumo az in khabari mukh'im rui gardonida, ba on tavach'ch'ukh' namenamoed.

69) Man oidi on guftugu va bakh'se, ki vobasta ba ofaridani Odam (alaikh'is salom) dar baini farishtagon doir gashta bud, ilm nadoshtam, agar Khudo baroiam paig'om namefiristod. Bo paig'omi ilokh'i dar borai on ma'lumot kh'osil kardam.
70) Khudo ba man paig'om namefiristad, magar baroi on ki man shumoro az azobi U bimdikh'andai oshkoram."
71) Ei Paiombar, on zamonero ba khotir biior, ki Parvardigorat ba farishtagon guft: "Ba durusti ki Man az gil insone (Odam (alaikh'is salom))-ro meofaram.

72) Pas zamone ofaridanashro ba itmom rasonidam va surati uro somon bakhshidam va dar u az rukh'i mutaallik' ba Khud damidam, nazdash ba sach'da biraved." [sach'dai arzi salom bud, na sach'dai ibodat].

73) Pas farishtagon amri Khudoro ba ch'o ovarda, kh'ama dar iakch'oiagi nazdi Odam (alaikh'is salom) ba ma'noi arch'guzori va arzi salom sach'da kardand. Kh'ech' kas az ich'roi farmon sarpechi nakard,-
74) magar Iblis, ki az sach'da kardan kibr varzid va ba kh'amin sabab az zumrai kofiron gardid.

75) Khudo guft: "Ei Iblis, turo az sach'da kardan nazdi Odam, ki Man uro bo du dasti (bemonandi) Khud ofaridaam, chi boz dosht?! Oio kibr varzidi va kh'amin boisi az sach'da khuddori namudanat gardid io k'abl az in niz khudro az digaron bartar mekh'isobidi va kibr doshti?!"
76) Iblis guft: "Man az Odam bekh'tar kh'astam. Tu maro az otash ofaridai va uro az gil ofaridai." Az rui pindori Iblis guio otash az gil sharofati beshtar dosht.
77) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba Iblis guft: "Modom ki chunin mepindori va az ich'roi dasturam sarpechi mekuni, pas az ch'annat berun shav. Zero tu begumon az rakh'mati Man rondashuda kh'asti.
78) Va la'natu g'azabam bar tu to ruzi k'iiomat, ki rui ch'azost."
79) Iblis guft: "Modome maro az rakh'mati Khesh ronda, mavridi la'nat va g'azabat k'aror dodi, pas ba man to ruze, ki bandagonatro dubora zinda megardoni, mukh'lat bidekh' va ch'onamro masiton."
80) Khudo guft: "Pas Ba durusti ki tu az mukh'latdodashudagoni,-
81) to ruzi vak'ti ma'lum, ki kh'alok gashtanat dar on muaiian karda shuda ast."
82) Iblis guft: "Pas ba k'udrat va izzatat savgand iod mekunam, ki kh'atman kh'amai farzandoni Odamro gumrokh' mesozam,-
83) ba ch'uz on bandagonat, ki Tu onkh'oro az gumrokh'shavi nigokh' doshta, kholis baroi ibodati Khud k'arorashon dodai."
84) Khudo guft: "Pas kh'ak' az Man ast va Man tankh'o kh'ak'ro meguiam:
85) "Savgand iod mekunam, ki ruzi k'iiomat duzakhro az tu va az kh'amai kasone az farzandoni Odam, ki dar kufr pairavii turo kardaand, pur mesozam."
86) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon bigu: "Man dar badali on chi az paig'omi Khudo merasonam, az shumo podosh talab namekunam. Va man az zumrai bandagone nestam, ki az peshi khud sukhan bofam.
87) K'ur'on baroi insonkh'o va ch'inkh'oi bolig'u ok'il ba ch'uz pand chize nest.
88) Va shumo kh'atman ba'di zamoni nazdik chun bimired, rost budani khabari in K'ur'onro khokh'ed donist."
1) K'ur'on Kitobest, ki az sui Allokh'i G'olibi Mag'lubnashavandai dar ofaridan, tadbir va akh'komash bag'oiat Kh'akim nozil kardashuda ast. K'ur'on kalomi makhluk' nest.

2) Ei Paiombar, kh'amono Mo K'ur'onro, ki shomili kh'ak'ik'at ast, bar tu furud ovardem. Akhborash durust va akh'komash odilona ast. Pas tankh'o Allokh'i Iagonaro dar kh'ole tavkh'id va ibodati khudro kholis baroi U k'aror medikh'i, biparast.

3) Ogokh' boshed! Dini kholi az shirk tankh'o az Khudo ast. Va kasone, ki ch'uz Khudo az butkh'o va digar ma'budkh'o baroi khud iovar megirand, bakh'ona pesh ovarda meguiand: "In ma'budkh'oro fak'at baroi on meparastem, ki moro az rui mak'om ba Khudo nazdik sozand, kh'och'atkh'oiamonro ba U rasonand, nazdi Khudo shafoatamon kunand." Ba durusti, Khudo ruzi k'iiomat baini mu'minoni iaktoparast va kofironi mushrik dar on chi oidi iaktoparasti ikhtilof mekardand, dovari menamoiad. Beshak, Khudo ba on bandae, ki durug'gui nosipos buda, az durug'gui va nosiposi ba Khudo shirk meorad va ba ne'matkh'o nosiposi mekunad, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro namedikh'ad.

4) Agar Khudo farzand giriftan mekhost, az khalk'ash on chiro mekhost, barmeguzid va ba ch'oi farzandash k'aror medod. U az on chi mushrikon meguiand, pok meboshad. U Khudoi dar Zotu sifot va af'oli Khud Iagonai bar tamomi makhluk'otash G'olib ast.

5) Khudo osmonkh'o va zaminro baroi kh'ikmati mukh'im ofarida ast. On du ro chunonchi sitamkoron mepindorand, barasab khalk' nakarda ast. Shabro bar ruz mepechad va ruzro bar shab mepechad. Vak'te iakeash oiad, digarash nopadid megardad. Va oftob va mokh'ro musakhkhar sokhta ast. Kh'ar iaki on du to vak'ti nazdi Khudo muaiian (ba okhir rasidani kh'aioti dunio) kh'arakat mekunad. Ogokh' boshed! U Zoti kh'amesha G'olibi az dushmanonash Intik'omch'ui Bakhshandai gunokh'i tavbakoron ast.

6) Ei mardum, Khudo shumoro az iak shakhs (Odam (alaikh'is salom)) khalk' kard, sipas kh'amsarash Kh'avvoro az on padid ovard. Va baroi shumo az chakh'orpoion (shutur, gov, gusfand, buz) kh'asht nav', az kh'ar sinf iak nar va iak modaro ofarid. U shumoro dar batni modaronaton markh'ila ba'd az markh'ila dar torikikh'oi segona (shikam, zakh'don, bachadon) meofarad. In Zoti Ofaridgori mavch'udot Allokh'i Parvardigori shumost. Molikiiat va farmonravoi tankh'o az Ust. G'air az U ma'budi kh'ak'ik'i nest. Modom ki chunin ast, pas chitavr az ibodati U ba ibodati makhluk'ot bargardonida meshaved?!

7) Ei mardum, agar ba Parvardigoraton kofir shaved, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az imoni shumo Beniioz ast. Kufraton ba U ziion namerasonad, balki zarari on ba khudi shumo barmegardad. Va U az bandagonash kufrro namepisandad va onkh'oro ba kufr amr namekunad. Zero Khudo ba korkh'oi zishtu nopisand farmon namedikh'ad. Va agar Uro dar barobari lutfu ekh'sonkh'oiash siposguzori kuned va imon ored, siposguzorii shumoro mepisandad va dar badali on ach'raton medikh'ad. Va kh'ech' kas gunokh'i kasi digarro bar dushi khesh namegirad. Balki kh'ar kas dar garavi amali khud ast. Sipas bozgashtaton ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui Parvardigoraton ast. Pas shumoro az on chi dar dunio anch'om medoded, bokhabar mesozad va podoshaton khokh'ad dod. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az asrori k'albi bandagon nek Ogokh' ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida namemonad.
