8) Va chun ba insoni kofir ziione ba misli bemori, az dast dodani amvol, tarsi g'ark'shavi dar dario va g'aira birasad, sui Parvardigorash bargashta, tankh'o Uro mekhonad, to on ziionro bartaraf gardonad. Sipas chun Parvardigor ba vai ne'mate ba misli bartaraf sokhtani on zarar bidikh'ad, Khudoero, ki k'ablan duo va zoriiu tavallo mekard, faromush va tark mesozad va baroi Khudo anbozkh'o k'aror medikh'ad, to digaronro az rokh'i vaslkunanda ba U gumrokh' kunad. Ei Paiombar, ba shakhsi doroi in sifat bigu: "Az kufrat dar umri bok'imondaat, ki zamoni andak ast, muvak'k'atan bakh'ramand shav. Zero begumon tu ruzi k'iiomat az kh'amdamoni duzakh kh'asti. Chunonchi dust az dustash ch'udo nameshavad, tu niz az duzakh ch'udo nameshavi."

9) Oio on kase, ki mutei Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, soatkh'oi shabi khudro dar kh'olati sach'da va k'iiom meguzaronad, dar kh'ole az okhirat metarsad va ba rakh'mati Parvardigorash umed dorad, bekh'tar ast io on kofire, ki dar sakhti Khudoro parastida, dar farokhi kofir gashta, shirk meorad?! Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Oio kasone, ki ba sababi dar borai Khudo ma'rifat doshtan on chiro U bar onkh'o voch'ib karda ast, medonand bo kasone, ki inro namedonand, barobarand?!" Ba durusti ki fark'i baini in du gurukh'ro tankh'o bandagoni doroi khiradi solim dark mekunand.

10) Ei Paiombar, ba bandagoni boimonam bigu: "Az Parvardigori khud bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot bitarsed. Baroi on kasone az shumo, ki neki mekunand, dar in dunio bo piruz gashtan alaikh'i dushman, tandurusti va kasbi mol va dar okhirat bo noil gashtan ba ch'annat podoshi nek ast. Va zamini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pakh'novar ast. Dar on baroi ioftani makoni munosibi ibodat kh'ich'rat kuned. Kh'amono ruzi k'iiomat ba bandagoni bosabr podoshashon bekh'isob ba purragi doda meshavad, zero bisior va gunogunrang ast."
11) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Kh'amono man az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amr shudaam, ki tankh'o Uro parastida, ibodatro kholis baroi U anch'om dikh'am.
12) Va ba man dastur doda ast, ki az baini in ummat nakhustin bandai mute' va taslimshudai U bosham."
13) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ba durusti, agar man Parvardigoramro nofarmoni kunam, az azobi ruzi buzurg metarsam." Murod az on ruzi k'iiomat ast.
14) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Man tankh'o Allokh'ro parastida, ibodati khudro kholis baroi U megardonam. Ch'uz U chizero nameparastam."

15) Pas, ei mushrikon, kh'ar chiro az butkh'o mekhokh'ed, biparasted. Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ziionkoroni kh'ak'ik'i on kasoneand, ki ruzi k'iiomat nisbat ba khud va khonadonashon ziion rasonidaand." Dar okhirat bo khonadonashon mulok'ot namekunand. Chunki agar akh'li oilaashon dokhili ch'annat shavand, onkh'o dar duzakh memonand va agar kh'amaashon voridi duzakh shavand, onch'o niz iakdigarro namebinand. Ogokh' boshed! Khasorati vok'eii oshkor kh'amin ast.

16) Baroi ziionkoroni okhirat az boloi sarashon dudu alangai otashu kh'arorat va az zeri k'adamashon dudu alangai otashu kh'arorat ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo zikri in azob bandagonashro metarsonad va az mubtaloi on gashtan kh'ushdorashon medikh'ad. Ei bandagonam, pas az Man bo ich'roi dasturotam va parkh'ez az man'kardakh'oiam bitarsed.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi mazkur akh'voli much'rimonro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin akh'voli bandagoni solekh'ro baion namuda meguiad:
17) Va kasone, ki az ibodati on chi g'airi Khudo parastida meshavad, duri mech'uiand va bo tavbai sodik'ona sui Khudo bozmegardand, onkh'oro kh'angomi marg, dar k'abr va ruzi k'iiomat ba dukhuli ch'annat bashorat doda meshavad. Ei Paiombar, modom ki chunin ast, pas bandagonamro muzhda bidekh',-

18) on bandagone, ki sukhanro gush mekunand, neku badi onro ch'udo mesozand, ba'dan az sukhani bekh'tarini sudmand pairavi menamoiand. In bandagoni doroi sifatkh'oi mazkur on kasoneand, ki Khudo ba onkh'o tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro medikh'ad va inkh'o kh'amon sokh'iboni khiradi solimand.

19) Bar kh'ar ki az sababi kufru zalolatro idoma dodanash kalimai azob k'at'i gardad, pas tu Paiombar k'udrati onro nadori, ki ba vai tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro bidikh'i. Ei Paiombar, oio tu on kasero, ki doroi chunin vasf buda, dar otashi duzakh k'aror megirad, az on otash rakh'onida metavoni?!

20) Lekin kasone, ki az Parvardigorashon bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuotash metarsand, baroiashon manzilkh'oi balandi boloi kh'am sokhtashuda ast, az zeri manzilkh'oiashon nakh'rkh'o ch'ori meboshad. In va'daro Khudo ba onkh'o doda ast. Khudo ba va'daash khilof namekunad.

21) Ei bandai kh'ushmand, kh'amono tu az rui mushokh'idai khud mebini va medoni, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az osmon obi boronro furud ovarda, pas onro dar chashmakh'o va mach'rokh'oi zamin dokhil namuda, sipas bo on ziroati gunogunrangro berun meorad, sipas ba'di guzashtani chand muddat on ziroat khushk megardad, pas tu binanda onro ba'd az on ki sabzrang bud, zardrang mebini, sipas Khudo on ziroatro ba'di khushkshavi shikastai reza-reza megardonad. Kh'amono dar on chi zikr gasht, baroi sokh'iboni k'albi zinda iodovari va pand ast! [Mak'sad az in oiati karima barkh'azar namudani bandagon az furu raftan dar mukh'abbati dunio ast]

22) Oio kase, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sinaashro ba Islom boz karda va kh'idoiat iofta ast, pas vai bar basirate az ch'onibi Parvardigorash k'aror dorad, bo kase, ki k'albash sakht shuda, Khudoro iod namekunad, barobar ast?! In du kh'argiz iakson nestand. Pas kh'idoiatioftagon nach'ot meioband va voi bar kh'oli kasone, ki k'albashon az tark kardani zikri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sakht shuda ast, ki khasorati buzurg mebinand. Inkh'o dar gumrokh'ii oshkorand.

23) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) K'ur'onro, ki bekh'tarin sukhan ast, furud ovard, Kitobe, ki ba'zeash bo ba'zei digar dar rosti, zeboi, alok'amandi va adami ziddiiat shabokh'at dorad, dar on k'issakh'o va akh'kom, va'da va takh'did, vasfi akh'li kh'ak'k'u botil va g'aira takror andar takror meoiad. Kasone, ki az Parvardigori khud metarsand, chun oiatkh'oi doroi takh'didro shunavand, badanashon ba larza meaftad, sipas chun oiatkh'oi doroi bashorat va umedvorkunandaro shunavand, badanashon va k'albashon bo zikr kardani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rakh'mat, savob va ch'annatash narm megardad. In sifatkh'oi K'ur'on va ta'sirnokiash kh'idoiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, bo on ba kh'ar kase khokh'ad, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro medikh'ad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar kase tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro nadikh'ad va gumrokh' shavad, pas, kh'ech' kas uro kh'idoiat karda nametavonad.

24) Oio on kase, ki dar kh'olati kufr az dunio meguzarad, Khudo dastu poiashro zavlona zada, uro ba duzakh meandozad, vai kushish mekunad, ki khudro az azobi badi duzakh bo chekh'raash nigokh' bidorad, bo on kase, ki Khudo ba vai tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro medikh'ad, pas ruzi k'iiomat bo tavfik'i Parvardigor voridi ch'annat megardad, iakson ast?! Va on ruz ba kasone, ki bo kufru ma'siiat bar ch'oni khud sitam kardaand, gufta meshavad: "Samarai talkhi kufru ma'siiatero, ki dar dunio anch'om medoded, bichashed. Ch'azoi shumo kh'amin ast."

25) Ummatkh'oi k'abl az in mushrikon guzashta paiombaroni Khudoro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand, pas azob ba onkh'o az ch'oe nogakh'on omad, ki az on ch'o omadanashro takhmin namekardand, to bo tavba omodagi binand.

26) Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo on uk'ubat baroi on ummatkh'o dar zindagonii dunio rasvoi va sharmandagiro chashond va kh'amono azobi okhirat, ki dar intizori onkh'ost, az azobi kh'aioti dunio buzurgtar va sakhttar ast, agar in kh'ak'ik'atro medonistand.

27) Va begumon Mo baroi mardum dar in K'ur'on vobasta ba khairu shar, kh'ak'k'u botil, kufru imon va g'aira masalakh'oi gunogun ovardaem, to mardum az on ibrat bigirand va mutobik'i kh'ak' amal karda, botilro tark sozand.

28) Dar kh'ole ki in Kitob K'ur'oni bo zaboni arabi furudomada buda, dar on inkh'irof va nomafkh'umi vuch'ud nadorad, to onkh'o bo ich'roi dasturot va khuddori az mamnuot az azobi Khudo biparkh'ezand.

29) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi baioni kh'olati mushrik va iaktoparast mardi g'ulomi chand khoch'ai shariki bo kh'am kashmakashkunanda va mardi ba iak khoch'ai mard khosro misol zada ast, ki iakum agar ba'ze az khoch'agonashro rozi kunad, ba'zei digarashon ba khashm meoiand va on g'ulom doim dar vaz'iiati kh'airatu iztirob umr ba sar mebarad, ammo duium fak'at iak khoch'a dorad, khostai khoch'aashro medonad, ba osoni khushnudash mesozad va az kh'amin sabab dar vaz'iiati orom va osuda k'aror dorad. Oio in du mard az rui masal barobarand?! Kh'ech' gokh' barobar nestand. Sitoish fak'at arzandai Allokh' taolost. Lekin aksari mushrikon inro namedonand va ba kh'amin illat shirk meorand.
30) Ei Paiombar, kh'amono tu noguzir memiri va mushrikoni k'avmat niz memirand.
31) Sipas iak'inan shumo mardum ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigori khud bo kh'am dar borai on chi ikhtilof dored, da'vo mekuned. In bois meshavad, ki kh'ak' az nokh'ak' ch'udo gardad.

32) Va kh'ech' fard az on kase, ki nisbat ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' bofta, Uro sokh'ibi sharik va kh'amsaru farzand medonad va vakh'ii az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ovardai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro takzib mekunad, zolimtar nest. Oio dar duzakh baroi kofironi takzibgari Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) k'arorgokh' va maskan vuch'ud nadorad?! Bale, onkh'o dar duzakh k'arorgokh' va maskan dorand.

Chun Khudo dar oiati k'abli durug'gui va takzibkunandaro zikr kard, dar oiati zerin rostgui va tasdik'kunandaro baion sokhta guft:
33) Va on kasone az k'abili paiombaron va g'airi onkh'o, ki sukhan va amali sodik'ona ovardand va sidk'ro tasdik' namuda, mutobik'ash amal kardand, in toifa parkh'ezkoroni kh'ak'ik'ie kh'astand, ki amrkh'oi ilokh'iro ba ch'o meorand va az man'kardakh'oiash duri mech'uiand.
34) Baroiashon nazdi Parvardigorashon kh'ar chi az ne'matkh'oi laziz mekhokh'and, mavch'ud ast. In ch'azoi bandagonest, ki amali khudro bo Kholik' va khalk' nek sokhtaand.

35) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba in bandagoni nekukor az lutfu ekh'sonash in'om mekunad, to badtarin gunokh'onero, ki dar dunio sodir menamudand, ba vositai tavba az onkh'o makh'v gardonad va ba onkh'o bo ch'azoi bekh'tar az on chi dar dunio az a'moli shoista anch'om medodand, podosh dikh'ad.

36) Oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandaash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar umuri dinu dunio va kh'ifz namudanash az dushman basanda nest?! Bale, k'at'an basanda ast. Va ei Paiombar, kofironi K'uraish az rui ch'akh'olat va bekhiradi turo az on chi ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az butkh'o meparastand, metarsonand, ki guio ma'budkh'oi botilashon k'udrati ba tu ziion rasondanro dorand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar ki tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro nadikh'ad, pas kh'ech' kas ba vai tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro doda nametavonad.

37) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar ki tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro dikh'ad, pas kh'ech' gumrokh'kunanda az ukh'dai gumrokh'soziash namebaroiad. Oio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti G'olibi Mag'lubnashavandai az kofironu bandagoni nofarmon Sokh'ibintik'om nest?! Ore, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amesha G'olibi az kofiron va isionkoron Intik'omgiranda ast.

38) Va ei Paiombar, agar tu az in mushrikon pursi, ki: "Osmonkh'o va zaminro ki ofarida ast?", dar ch'avob kh'atman meguiand: "On duro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khalk' karda ast." Ba onkh'o bo mak'sadi nishon dodani za'fi ma'budkh'oiashon bigu: "Baroiam az on chi ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az butkh'o meparasted, khabar dikh'ed. Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba man irodai zarar rasondan kunad, oio ma'budkh'oiaton onro az man bartaraf sokhta metavonand?! Io agar U iroda kunad, ki ba man az nazdi Khud rakh'mat mebakhshad, oio ma'budkh'oiaton on rakh'matro az man man' karda metavonand?!" Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Fak'at Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) maro basanda ast. Dar korkh'oiam ba U takia mekunam. Bandagoni tavakkulkunanda tankh'o ba U takia mekunand."

39) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei k'avmi man, bar kh'olati khesh az shirk ovardan ba Khudo, ki onro baroi khud barguzidaed, bok'i bimoned va koratonro idoma dikh'ed. Kh'amono man niz kori khudro az da'vat ba tavkh'id va ibodati kholisona, ki az sui Khudo ba anch'omi on ma'mur gashtaam, idoma medikh'am. Pas beshak, farch'omi kh'ar iake az in du rokh'ro khokh'ed donist,-
40) khokh'ed donist, ki dar dunio bar ki azobi khoru rasvosozanda meoiad va ruzi k'iiomat bar ki azobi ch'ovidona furud meoiad."

41) Ei Paiombar, Mo bar tu K'ur'onro, ki shomili kh'ak'ik'at ast, baroi manfiati mardum firistodem, to munkironro az azob kh'ushdor va mu'minonro ba ch'annat muzhda dikh'i. Pas kh'ar ki kh'idoiat iobad, on ba foidai khudi ust. Az kh'idoiat ioftanash ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) foidae nest. Chunki Parvardigor az on Beniioz ast. Va kh'ar ki gumrokh' shavad, pas ziioni on ba khudi vai barmegardad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az gumrokh'iash ziion namebinad. Va tu bar onkh'o nigakh'bon nesti, ki bar kh'idoiat mach'burashon sozi. Vazifai tu tankh'o az tablig'i paig'omi Kholik' ba khalk' iborat ast.

42) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki rukh'i makhluk'otro kh'angomi faro rasidani margashon k'abz mekunad va niz rukh'i on makhluk'otero, ki dar khobashon namurdaand, mesitonad. Pas Parvardigor dar kh'olati khob rukh'i on makhluk'otero, ki bar onkh'o margashonro kh'ukm karda ast, nigokh' medorad va rukh'i on makhluk'otero, ki bar onkh'o margashonro kh'ukm nakarda ast, to vak'ti dar ilmash ma'lum rakh'o mesozad. Kh'amono dar k'abzi rukh'u rakh'o sokhtani on va mirondani makhluk'otu zinda gardonidani onkh'o baroi k'avme, ki meandeshand, dalelkh'oi bisior ast. In dalelkh'o isbotkunandai onand, ki Khudoi bar chunin korkh'o Tavono k'udrati ruzi k'iiomat dubora zinda sokhtani bandagonashro dorad.

43) Kh'amono mushrikon biduni ich'ozati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az butkh'oiashon bo pindori botili khesh shafoatgaronro giriftaand, to ma'budkh'oiashon ba onkh'o naf' rasonand. Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon bigu: "Oio agarchi butkh'oiaton na baroi khud va na baroi shumo moliki chize naboshand va chizero nafakh'mand, bo in vuch'ud onkh'oro shafoatgar megired?! Oio bo vuch'udi az on ki butkh'oiaton mavch'udoti karu kuru gungand, baroiaton zarar va foida rasonda nametavonand, boz kh'am onkh'oro shafoatgari khud mepindored?!"

44) Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon bigu: "Kh'ama guna shafoat tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kase nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'uz bo ich'ozati U shafoat karda nametavonad. Ba on kasone, ki kh'ak'k'i shafoat doda meshavad, onkh'o fak'at baroi bandagoni mavridi pisandi Parvardigor shafoat mekunand. Molikiiat va farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Ust. Sipas shumo ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo tankh'o ba nazdi U bargardonda meshaved. On ruz ba shumo dar ivazi kardakh'oiaton ch'azoi bosazo medikh'ad."

45) Va chun iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zikr karda shavad, k'albi kasone, ki ba okhirat, rastokhez, bozpursi va giriftani ch'azoi on ruz imon nadorand, tang gashta, mutanaffir meshavad. Va chun ma'budkh'oe, ki ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parastida meshavand, iod karda shavand, nogakh'on mushrikon shodmon megardand.

46) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Bor Ilokh'o! Ei Khudoi biduni namunai sobik' Kholik'i osmonkh'o va zamin! Ei Donandai nikh'on va oshkor! Kh'ech' chiz az Tu makhfi nest. Iagona Tu ruzi k'iiomat baini bandagonat dar borai on chi bo iakdigar dar dunio ikhtilof mekardand, k'azovat karda, kh'ak'ro az nokh'ak' va badbakhtro az nekbakht ch'udo menamoi."

47) Va agar tamomi doroii zamin va monandi on iakch'o bo on az oni kasone mebud, ki bo kufru gunokh' bar ch'oni khud sitam namudaand, ruzi k'iiomat kh'angomi mushokh'idai azob kh'ozir budand kh'amai onro dar badali az azobi shadid rakh'o sokhtani khesh bidikh'and. Vale onkh'o in k'adar doroi nadorand. Agar ba farzi misol, chunin doroi kh'am medoshtand, az onkh'o ba ivazi rakh'oi az duzakh pazirufta nameshud. Va baroi onkh'o az ch'onibi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on k'adar nav'kh'oi uk'ubat namoion megardad, ki intizorash va gumonashro nadoshtand.

48) Va baroi mushrikon badikh'oi on chi az shirku ma'siiat anch'om dodaand, oshkor megardad va onkh'oro uk'ubate, ki vak'te bo on dar dunio tarsonida meshudand, maskharaash mekardand, ikh'ota menamoiad.

49) Pas chun ba insoni kofir zarare, az k'abili bemori, tangdasti va mislash birasad, Moro mekhonad, to onro bartaraf gardonem. Sipas chun Mo az rui fazli Khesh ba in insoni kofir ba misli tandurusti va doroi ne'mate dikh'em, meguiad: "Beshak, Khudo baroi on in ne'matro ba man doda ast, ki medonad man loik'i onam." Balki dar kh'ak'ik'at on ne'mat ba vai ba khotiri ozmoish va tadrich'an kh'alok sokhtanash doda shuda ast, valekin beshtari kofiron inro namedonand. Binobar in, vak'te Khudo ba onkh'o ne'mat medikh'ad, mag'rur megardand.
50) Ba durusti ki kofironi k'abl az onkh'o guzashta niz in sukhanro gufta budand. Pas on doroi va ch'oigokh'ero, ki dar dunio kasb mekardand, az onkh'o azobro dur nakard.

51) Pas ba onkh'o ch'azoi on chi az shirku ma'siiat anch'om doda budand, rasid. Va on kasone az in mushrikoni k'avmat, ki bo shirku gunokh' bar ch'oni khud zulm kardaand, beshak, ba onkh'o niz misli kofironi guzashta ch'azoi korkh'oi badi sodir namudaashon khokh'ad rasid va kh'argiz onkh'o az k'udrati ilokh'i rakh'o nameshavand va Uro och'iz sokhta nametavonand.

52) Oio mushrikon in guna sukhanonro meguiand va namedonand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba khotiri sanch'idani siposguzori va nosiposi, baroi kh'ar ki khokh'ad, rizk'ashro farokh va ba khotiri sanch'idani sabru khashm az tak'dir, baroi kh'ar ki khokh'ad, onro tang mesozad?! Begumon dar in farokhu tang sokhtani rizk'i bandagon baroi k'avme, ki imon dorand, oidi tadbiri Khudo rakh'namoikh'oi oshkor ast. Zero tankh'o mu'minon az in rakh'namoikh'o sud mebarand. Kofiron az in rakh'namoikh'o khudpisandona ru metoband.

53) Ei Paiombar, ba on bandagoni Man, ki bo kufru ma'siiat az kh'ad guzashta, bar ch'oni khud ch'inoiat kardaand, bigu: "Az rakh'mati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va bakhshida shudani gunokh'onaton noumed nashaved. Zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iak'inan kh'amai gunokh'oni bandagoni tavbakorro mebakhshad. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bakhshandai gunokh'oni bandagoni tavbakor buda, nisbat ba onkh'o bag'oiat Mekh'rubon ast.

54) Va k'abl az on ki ruzi k'iiomat ba shumo uk'ubat oiad, sipas az butkh'oiaton io akh'li oilaaton kasero naiobed, ki bo rakh'onidanaton az on uk'ubat kumakaton kunad, bo tavba va amalkh'oi shoista ba sui Parvardigoraton bargarded va ba U taslim shaved.

55) Va k'abl az on ki ba shumo uk'ubat nogakh'on oiad va kh'ol on ki omadani onro kh'is namekarded, to omodagi bined, az K'ur'on, ki bekh'tarin Kalomi az sui Parvardigoraton ba Paiombaraton nozil shuda ast, pairavi kuned, amrashro ich'ro va az nakh'iash biparkh'ezed.

56) Ba anch'omi in rakh'namoikh'o shitobed, to kase ruzi k'iiomat az shiddati nadomat naguiad: "Voi dareg' az on ki bo kufru gunokh' dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kutokh'ii ziiod kardaam va ba durusti, man dar dunio akh'li imon va ibodatro maskhara menamudam."

57) Io in ki kase ruzi k'iiomat az tak'dir kh'uch'ch'at ovarda naguiad: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba man tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i rostro medod, kh'atman bo anch'omi amrkh'oiash va khuddori az nakh'ikh'oiash az zumrai parkh'ezkoron megashtam."
58) Io in ki kh'angomi mushokh'idai azob orzu karda naguiad: "Kosh, iak bori digar sui dunio bargashta tavonam, to tavba kunam va dar pindoru guftoru kirdor az bandagoni nekukor gardam.""

59) Dar ch'avob ba in banda gufta meshavad: "Kh'ak'ik'ati kor dar bobi kh'idoiat on tavre nest, ki imruz da'vo dori. Ore, begumon ba tu oiatkh'oi Mo omada bud, pas tu onkh'oro durug' shumurdi va az imon ovardan kibr varzidi va ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va oiatkh'ovu paiombaronash az zumrai kofiron gashti."

60) Va kasone, ki bo nisbat dodani sharik io farzand dar dunio bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) durug' boftaand, tu onkh'oro ruzi k'iiomat dar kh'olate mebini, ki ruikh'oiashon kh'amchun nishonai badbakhti siiokh' gashta ast. Oio dar duzakh baroi bandagone, ki az imon ovardan kibr varzidaand, k'arorgokh' nest?! Ore, iak'inan onkh'o dar duzakh k'arorgokh' dorand.

61) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagonero, ki bo ich'roi dasturotash va khuddori az mamnuotash parkh'ezkori kardaand, bo vorid sokhtanashon ba makoni komiobi va orzu namudaashon (ia'ne, ch'annat) az uk'ubatash solim nigokh' medorad. Kh'ech' nav' azob ba akh'li ch'annat namerasad. Va onkh'o baroi az dast dodani lazzatkh'oi dunio g'amgin nameshavand.

62) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Ofaridgori kh'amai chiz ast. Ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Kholik'e nest. Va U bar tamomi chiz Nigakh'bon ast. Korkh'oi kulli mavch'udotro tadbir namuda, onro kh'ar guna ki khokh'ad, megardonad.

63) Kalidkh'oi khazinakh'oi ne'mat dar osmonkh'o va zamin fak'at az Ust. Az on ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, medikh'ad va az kh'ar ki khokh'ad, boz medorad. Va on kasone, ki ba oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir meshavand, onkh'o ziionkoroni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand. Zero dar dunio az imon va dar okhirat az ch'annat makh'rum gashtaand.

64) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikon, ki az tu mudom ibodati butkh'oro darkhost dorand, bigu: "Ei kasone, ki vobasta ba khudoshinosi ch'okh'il kh'asted, oio maro ba ibodati g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amr mekuned, kh'ol on ki ch'uz U kh'ech' kas va kh'ech' chiz loik'i ibodat nest?! Man kh'argiz g'airi Allokh'i iagonaro nameparastam."

65) Va ei Paiombar, kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tu va ba paiombaroni k'abl az tu guzashta paig'om firistoda ast, ki agar ba U anboz k'aror bidikh'i, iak'inan savobi kori nekat botil meshavad va iak'inan dar duniovu okhirat az zumrai ziionkoron megardi. Chunki dar dunio dinatro az dast medikh'i va dar okhirat ba duzakh medaroi.
66) Balki iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ibodat bikun va az shirk biparkh'ez va baroi ne'matkh'oi atonamudai U az shukrguzoronash bosh.

67) Va chun mushrikon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sharik k'aror dodand va az darki k'udrati ilokh'i, ki zamin ruzi k'iiomat bo kh'ama kukh'kh'o, darakhton, dario va bakh'rkh'oiash dar k'abzai (bemisli) U boshad va osmonkh'o dar dasti rosti (bemisli) U pechida meshavand, g'ofil mondand, ta'zimi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba tavri loik' ba ch'o naovardand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mushrikon meguiand va e'tik'od dorand, poku muk'addas va bartar meboshad.

68) Va farishtai muvazzaf ba damidani sur ruzi k'iiomat nafkhai duiumro dar sur medamad, ba'd az in kh'ar ki dar osmonkh'o va kh'ar ki dar zamin mavch'ud ast, memirad, magar on kas az akh'li osmonkh'o va zamin, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) (to iak muddati digar) zinda mondanashro khosta ast. Sipas on farishta bori duium baroi zinda gardonidani murdagon dar sur medamad, pas, nogakh'on kh'amai murdagon zinda gashta, az k'abrashon rost meshavand, dar kh'ole ki bo tarsu kh'aros ba kh'ar samt nazar meandozand va intizori mekashand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba onkh'o chi kor mekunad.

69) Va chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat baroi k'azovat baini bandagon tach'alli namoiad, zamin bo nuri Parvardigori khud rushan megardad va sakh'ifakh'oi a'moli bandagon ba dasti sokh'ibonashon suporida meshavad va paiombaron va ummati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ovarda meshavand, to ummati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar borai on ki paiombaron dar dunio vakh'ii ilokh'iro ba mardum rasonda budand, shokh'idi dikh'and va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baini bandagon odilona dovari mekunad va ba onkh'o dar on ruz zulm karda nameshavad. Badii kase afzun va nekii kase kam namegardad.

70) Va Khudo ba kh'ar kas ch'azoi amali anch'om dodaashro ba purragi medikh'ad. Novobasta az on ki amali nek io bad karda ast, ch'azoi onro komil megirad. Va on chi bandagon anch'om medikh'and, Parvardigor dar borai on Ogokh'tar ast. Kh'ech' chize az U makhfi nest va onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat ba e'tibori amal ch'azo mebinand.

71) Va farishtagon kofironro gurukh'-gurukh' bo zillat va takh'k'ir ba sui duzakh meronand. Vak'te ki onkh'o nazdi duzakh meoiand, farishtagoni nigakh'boni duzakh darkh'oiashro mekushoiand va duzakhiionro sarzanishkunon istik'bol girifta meguiand: "Oio ba shumo az nav'i khud paiombarone, ki baroiaton oiatkh'oi Parvardigoratonro bikhonand va shumoro az vokhurii ruzi k'iiomat, ki azobi sakht dorad, kh'ushdor va bim dikh'and, naomada budand?!" Kofiron e'tirof karda meguiand: "Bale, in kor surat girifta bud. Vale kalimai azob dar kh'ak'k'i kofiron k'at'i gardida ast. Mo dar dunio az zumrai kofiron budem."

72) Ba onkh'o bo mak'sadi ikh'onat va noumed sokhtan az rakh'mati ilokh'i va khuruch' az duzakh gufta meshavad: "Az darkh'oi duzakh vorid shaved, dar kh'ole onch'o abadi memoned. Pas ch'oii bandagone, ki khudbuzurgbini karda, az k'abuli kh'ak' kibr varzidaand, chi k'adar zisht ast."

73) Va farishtagon bandagonero, ki az uk'ubati Parvardigorashon bo ich'roi amrkh'o va kh'azar az nakh'ikh'o parkh'ez mekardand, bo mekh'ruboni va izzatu ikromi khos, gurukh'-gurukh' ba sui ch'annat rakh'namoi va ba zudtar vurudi on targ'ib mekunand. Chun ba nazdi ch'annat omada merasand, kh'ol on ki darkh'oi ch'annat ba khotiri istik'bolashon az k'abl kushoda shuda ast va farishtagoni muvazzafi peshvozgiri ba onkh'o meguiand: "Salom bar shumo az kh'ar nokhushi va ziion! Dar dunio k'alb va a'molaton pok bud. Pas baroi kh'ameshagi dokhili ch'annat shaved."

74) Va mu'minon chun voridi ch'annat meshavand, meguiand: "Sitoish on Parvardigorero, ki va'dai tavassuti paiombaron ba mo dodai Khudro takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshid. Parvardigor ba mo dar dunio az zaboni paiombaronash dukhuli ch'annatro va'da doda bud. Va imruz zamini ch'annatro ba mo meros dod. Az ch'annat dar kh'ar ch'oii mekhostaamon furud meoem va onch'o manzil megirem. Pas ach'ri on bandagone, ki dar dunio fak'at ba khotiri kasbi rizoi ilokh'i korkh'oi nek anch'om medodand, chi k'adar nek ast."

75) Va on ruz farishtagonro mushokh'ida mekuni, ki atrofi Arshro ikh'ota namudaand, dar kh'ole Parvardigorashonro az guftoru pindori noloik' ba poki khonda, sitoishi Uro meguiand. Va Khudo baini khaloik' odilona dovari mekunad. Ba'di k'azovat kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, giromi va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, duchori azob mesozad. Va gufta meshavad: "Sitoish Allokh'i Parvardigori ch'akh'oniionro, ki dar baini bandagon dovari karda, mu'minonro mavridi rakh'matash k'aror dod va kofironro ba azob giriftor sokht."
1) "Kh'o. Mim." Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) In K'ur'on Kitobi az sui Allokh'i kh'amesha G'olibi az manfiati bandagon Ogokh' bar Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozil karda shuda ast,-

3) Parvardigori Bakhshandai gunokh'on, Tavbapaziri tavbakoron, Sakhtuk'ubat bar tavbanokardagon, Sokh'ibi lutfu ekh'son. Ch'uz U ma'budi kh'ak'ik'i vuch'ud nadorad. Bozgashti kh'ama bandagon dar ruzi k'iiomat fak'at ba sui U ast. Ba'd az bozgasht ba onkh'o ch'azoi sazovor khokh'ad dod.

4) Dar borai oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki bar iagonagii U va rostguii firistodagonash dalolat mekunad, tankh'o kofiron ch'idol menamoiand. Chunki ak'li kofiron tira ast. Pas ei Paiombar, baroi onkh'o g'amgin mashav va naboiad gashtuguzorashon dar kishvarkh'o va tich'oratu ne'mati farovon doshtanashon turo bifirebad. Zero Khudo ba khotiri tadrich'an kh'alok sokhtan va ba domi g'urur andokhtanashon ba onkh'o ne'mati bisior medikh'ad.

5) K'abl az k'avmi kofiri tu k'avmi Nukh' va ba'd az onkh'o gurukh'kh'oi ziiod, az k'abili k'avmi Od, Samud, Lut, Shuaib va k'avmi Fir'avn niz firistodagoni Khudoro ba durug'gui nisbat doda budand. Va kh'ar iakei in ummatkh'o k'asdi paiombarashon kardand, to uro dastgir kunand va ba k'atl rasonand. Va onkh'o bo istifoda az botili khesh ch'idol namudand, to ba in vasila kh'ak'ro az bain barand. Pas Man tamomi in ummatkh'oro giriftam va kh'alok sokhtam. Pas nigokh' kun, ki uk'ubatam dar kh'ak'k'ashon chi guna bud. Vok'ean onkh'o bo uk'ubati sakht nobud shudand.

6) Va ei Paiombar, on guna ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai kh'alok sokhtani ummatkh'oi guzashta kh'ukm namud, kh'amchunin kalimai Parvardigorat bar kofiron, ki onkh'o kh'atman akh'li duzakh kh'astand, k'at'i gashta ast.

7) Ei Paiombar, farishtagoni muk'arrabe, ki arshi Parvardigori turo mebardorand va farishtagone, ki dar atrofi arsh k'aror dorand, kh'amagi Parvardigorashonro az pindoru guftori noloik' ba poki iod karda, sitoish mekunand va ba U imon dorand va baroi mu'minon omurzish khosta meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, ilm va rakh'mati Tu kh'amai chizro faro girifta ast. Pas kasonero, ki az gunokh'onashon tavba karda va az dini Tu pairavi namudaand, mag'firat namo va onkh'oro az azobi duzakh kh'ifz kun."

8) Farishtagon dar idomai duoi khud meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, va mu'minonro kh'amrokh'i on padaronashon va kh'amsaronashon va farzandonashon, ki dar dunio amalkh'oi nek doshtand, ba bog'kh'oi ch'ovidonai ba onkh'o va'da dodaat dokhil bisoz. Kh'amono Tu Khudoi kh'amesha G'olibi shikastnopaziru dar tak'dir va chorasozii korkh'oi bandagon bag'oiat Kh'akim kh'asti.

9) Va onkh'oro az ch'azoi a'moli badashon kh'ifz namo. Baroi kardakh'oi zishtashon eshonro uk'ubat makun. Va Tu kh'ar kiro ruzi k'iiomat az ch'azoi amalkh'oi badash nigakh' bidori, pas, ba durusti ki nisbat ba on banda bo nach'ot dodanash az uk'ubat markh'amat kardai. Va in makh'fuz mondan az azobi duzakh va vorid shudan ba bikh'isht komiobii kh'ak'ik'i buda, kh'ech' komiobie ba on barobar nameshavad."

10) Begumon on bandagone, ki ba Khudo va firistodagonash kofir meshavand, ruzi k'iiomat vak'te voridi duzakh gardand va khudro nafratu nafrin kunand, nido karda meshavand: "Beshak, nafrat va nafrini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo az nafratu nafrini shumo bar khesh buzurgtar ast. Illati mavridi nafratu nafrini Khudo k'aror giriftani shumo dar on ast, ki dar dunio tavassuti paiombaron ba sui imon da'vat meshuded, ba'd az da'vati onkh'o boz kufr mevarzided va ba Khudo shirk meovarded."

11) Kofiron dar ruzi k'iiomat, ki tavba va e'tirof dar onch'o sud nadorad, ba gunokh'i khesh ik'ror karda meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, Tu moro du bor mirondi va du bor zinda gardondi. (Mironidani iakum kh'olati k'abl az kh'ast shudan va mironidani duium dar vak'ti marg k'abzi ch'on ast. Zindasozii iakum, az nesti ba kh'asti ovardan va zindasozii duium, zinda kunonidani ba'd az marg ast.) Pas mo ba gunokh'onamon ik'ror mekunem. Modom ki ba gunokh'amon e'tirof namudem, pas oio ba sui berun shudan az duzakh rokh'e vuch'ud dorad, to az nav ba zindagonii dunio bozgashta, a'molamonro islokh' namuda, Turo az khud khushnud gardonem?!"

12) In uk'ubati shumo mushrikon ba sababi on ast, ki vak'te dar dunio Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba tankh'oi khonda meshud va chize ba U sharik k'aror doda nameshud, ba U kofir megashted va shirk mevarzided va chun ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk ovarda meshud, onro tasdik' mekarded. Pas kh'ukm tankh'o az oni Allokh'i bo Zotu k'udratash az kh'ama chiz Bartari Buzurg ast.

13) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki nishonakh'oi Khudro baroiaton dar gushavu kanorakh'o va dar vuch'udi khudi shumo nishon medikh'ad, to ba iagonagi va k'udrati Khesh rakh'namoiaton sozad va baroi shumo az osmon obi boronro furud meorad, to sababi rizk'aton boshad va Khudo bo in ob nabotot va ziroatkh'oro ruionad. Va az nishonakh'oi vakh'doniiatu k'udrati ilokh'i tankh'o kase pand megirad, ki bo tavba va ikhlos ba sui U bozmegardad.

14) Ei mu'minon, modom ki chunin ast, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dar kh'ole duo va ibodat kuned, ki duo va ibodati kheshro kholis baroi U gardoned va az shirk kh'azar namoed va agarchi in ba kofiron pisand naoiad va ba g'azabashon orad.

15) Khudo arzandai on ast, ki duo va ibodat iagona baroi U anch'om doda shavad. Zero U Doroi martabakh'oi baland buda, az kh'ama mavch'udot Bartaru Parvardigori arshi azim ast. U paig'omi ba ch'on monandashro bar kh'ar ki az bandagonash khokh'ad, furud meorad va bandagon mutobik' ba on amal karda, zinda meshavand va inchunin digaronro zinda mesozand, to paiombaron mardumro az omadani ruzi vokhuri bim dikh'and. Murod az ruzi vokhuri, k'iiomat ast, ki kh'amai mardum az avval to okhir onch'o bo iakdigar vomekhurand.

16) Ruze, ki bandagon kh'amagi dar ch'oii kh'amvor ch'am' omada, namoion meshavand. Kh'ech' chize az onkh'o bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pushida namemonad. Kh'am khud va kh'am a'mol va ch'azoiashon nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) oshkor ast. On ruz Allokh'i Kh'okimi mutlak' mepursad: "Imruz farmonravoi az oni ki ast?!" In suol iak ch'avob dorad. Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Khud ch'avob medikh'ad: "Imruz farmonravoi az Allokh'i dar Zotu sifotu korash Iagonai bar kh'ama chiz G'olib ast. Imruz khaloik' tankh'o takh'ti farmoni U kh'astand.

17) Imruz [ruzi k'iiomat] ba kh'ar kas dar badali on chi az neki va badi karda ast, ch'azo doda meshavad. Imruz zulme nest. Zero dovar Khudoi Odil ast. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) a'moli bandagonro Zudkh'isobkunanda ast. Chunki onkh'o dar ikh'otai ilmi Parvardigor k'aror dorand.

18) Ei Paiombar, onkh'oro az ruzi k'iiomat, ki omadanash nazdik ast, bitarson. K'iiomat omadanist va kh'ar chi omadanist, k'arib ast. Dar on ruz dilkh'o az shiddati tars az ch'oi khud bolo rafta, ba kh'alk'i sokh'ibonash merasad, dar kh'ole az andukh' pur gashtavu khomushand, az onkh'o kase ch'uz bo ich'ozati Khudo gap namezanad. Bandagoni bo shirku gunokh' bar ch'oni khesh sitamgar dust va shafoatgare nadorand. Agar ba farzi misol, chunonchi mepindorand, shafoatgar kh'am doshta boshand va dar kh'ak'k'ashon shafoat kunad, shafoatkhokh'iash pazirufta nameshavad.
19) On chiro chashmkh'o duzdona nigokh' mekunand va on chiro sinakh'o pinkh'on medorand, Khudo kh'amaashro medonad. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nest.

20) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) odilona k'azovat mekunad. Nisbat ba kase bo kam kardan az nekikh'o io afzun sokhtani badikh'oiash sitam ravo namebinad. Va on ma'budkh'oe, ki mushrikon ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastand, chize dovari namekunand. Zero ma'budkh'oiashon moliki chize nestand. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti Shunavandai guftori bandagon, Binandai mak'sad va kirdori onkh'ost. Dar ivazi kh'ar guftoru kirdor onkh'oro ch'azo khokh'ad dod.

21) Oio in mushrikoni K'uraish dar zamin sairu gasht nakardaand, to dar borai ok'ibati ummatkh'oi takzibgare, ki k'abl az onkh'o budand, andesha namoiand. Ok'ibati ummatkh'oi peshin dakh'shatnok bud. Onkh'o az in mushrikon k'avitar budand va dar zamin bo me'mori osori beshtar bok'i guzoshtand. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro ba sababi gunokh'onashon kh'alok sokht. Va onkh'o mukh'ofize nadoshtand, ki az azob kh'ifzashon namoiad.

22) In uk'ubati sakht az on sabab ba onkh'o rasid, ki paiombaronashon baroiashon az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dalelkh'oi vozekh'i radnopazir meovardand, pas ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shudand va paiombaronro durug'gui shumurdand. Ba kh'amin sabab, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro bo vuch'udi nerumandi kh'alok gardond. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat Nerumandi bar kofiron Sakhtuk'ubat ast.

Vak'te Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bo takzibi k'avmi khud rubaru shudand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiati zerin k'issai Muso (alaikh'is salom) va Fir'avnro zikr kard, to ba on kas muzhda dikh'ad, ki ok'ibat piruz megardand.
23) Kh'amono Mo Muso (alaikh'is salom)-ro bo nishonakh'oi ravshani Khesh va daleli k'at'i firistodem,-
24) ba sui Fir'avn va vazirash Kh'omon va K'orun. Pas onkh'o guftand: "Muso ch'odugar buda, dar da'voiash, ki paiombari Khudost, durug'gui guzaro ast."

25) Pas vak'te Muso (alaikh'is salom) az sui Mo bo daleli isbotkunandai sidk'ash ba nazdi onkh'o omad, Fir'avn guft: "Pisaroni on mu'minonero, ki kh'amrokh'ash kh'astand, bikushed va zanonashonro bo mak'sadi ikh'onat [pastzani] bok'i guzored." Va makri kofiron oidi kam sokhtani adadi mu'minon ch'uz taloshi nobudshavandai beasar chize nest.

26) Va Fir'avn guft: "Maro biguzored, ki Musoro bo mak'sadi ch'azo dodan bikusham va biguzor Parvardigorashro faro khonad, to uro az uk'ubatam birakh'onad. Kh'amono man az on metarsam, ki Muso dinatonro ivaz mekunad io bo kushtor va vaironkori fasodro dar zamin oshkor mesozad."

27) Va Muso (alaikh'is salom) chun az takh'didi Fir'avn ogokh' shud, guft: "Begumon man az sharri kh'ar shakhse, ki az k'abuli kh'ak' va imon kibr varzida, ba k'iiomat va kh'isobu ch'azoi on imon nadorad, ba Parvardigori khud va Parvardigor shumo panokh' burdaam."

28) Va az khonadoni Fir'avn mardi mu'mine, ki imonashro az k'avmash pinkh'on medosht, tasmimi onkh'oro dar borai kushtani Muso (alaikh'is salom) inkor namuda guft: "Oio mardero biduni gunokh', tankh'o baroi on ki "Parvardigori man Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast" meguiad, ba k'atl merasoned, kh'ol on ki vai az sui Parvardigoraton ba shumo kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi durustii nubuvvatashro ovarda ast?! Va agar ba farzi misol, Muso durug'gui boshad, pas ziioni on ba khudash barmegardad va agar rostgui boshad, dar in surat ba'ze az azobe, ki bo on shumoro takh'did mekunad, zud dar in dunio domangiraton megardad." Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on kase, ki marzkh'oi ilokh'iro poimol sokhta, dar kh'ak'k'i U va paiombaronash durug' mebofad, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro namedikh'ad.

29) On mardi mu'min guft: "Ei k'avmi man, podshokh'i imruz az shumo buda, dar sarzamini Misr g'olib kh'asted. Pas agar ba sababi k'atli Muso uk'ubati ilokh'i ba surog'amon oiad, ki moro baroi rakh'o shudan az on iori medikh'ad?!" Fir'avn guft: "Tankh'o Nazar va kh'ukmi man boiad pazirufta shavad. Nazari man on ast, ki boiad ba khotiri az bain burdani ziion va fasod Muso kushta shavad. Va man shumoro ch'uz ba sui rokh'i durust rakh'namoi namekunam."

30) Va on mardi mu'min ba k'avmash khairkhokh'i namuda guft: "Agar Muso (alaikh'is salom)-ro bikushed, man begumon metarsam bar shumo az duchor gashtan ba misli azobi gurukh'kh'oi guzashta, ki muk'obili paiombaronashon dar iak ch'abkh'a k'aror giriftand va Khudo onkh'oro kh'alok sokht.

31) misli odati kofironi k'avmi Nukh' va Od va Samud va kasone, ki ba'd az onkh'o omadand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro baroi kufr va takzibi paiombaron kh'alok gardonid. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i bandagonash zulmro namekhokh'ad. U bandagonashro tankh'o ba sababi gunokh'onashon azob mekunad. In ch'azoi ba amal muvofik' ast.

32) Va ei k'avm, kh'amono man bar shumo az ruzi k'iiomat, ki ruzi fariodi iakdigar ast, metarsam. On ruz mardum kh'amdigarro ba e'tibori paivandi kheshovandi io dar dunio mansab doshtan baroi kumak fariod namuda, gumon mebarand, ki in kumaktalabi dar on lakh'zakh'oi dakh'shatnok ba onkh'o sud mebakhshad.

33) Ruze, ki az tarsi duzakh pusht gardonida, firor mekuned. On ruz mukh'ofizatgar nadored, ki shumoro az uk'ubati ilokh'i nigakh' dorad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar ki tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba imonro nadikh'ad, pas kase uro kh'idoiat karda nametavonad. Zero tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba imon tankh'o dar ikhtiiori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast."

34) Va beshak, k'abl az Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba sui shumo Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) bo dalelkh'oi ravshani isbotkunandai iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omad. Pas shumo az on chi u ovard, to zamoni vafotash paivasta dar shak va takzib k'aror doshted. Chun vafot kard, shubkh'aaton beshtar shud va gufted: "Kh'argiz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba'd az Iusuf (alaikh'is salom) paiombarero barnameangezad." Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) monandi az kh'ak' gumrokh' sokhtani shumo, kh'ar bandai az marzkh'oiash tach'ovuzkunandai dar iagonagiash shakovarandaro gumrokh' megardonad.

35) Kasone, ki dar borai oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), biduni on ki ba onkh'o dalel omada boshad ch'idol mekunand, to on oiatkh'oro botil gardonand, in korashon nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va nazdi mu'minon bag'oiat nafratovar va zisht ast. On guna ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar k'albi in toifai ch'idolgaron mukh'r nikh'oda ast, kh'amin tavr bar k'albi kh'ar kasi az k'abuli kh'ak' mutakabbiri gardankash mukh'r menikh'ad.
36) Va Fir'avn ba Kh'omoni vazirash guft: "Ei Kh'omon, baroiam binoi balande bisoz, shoiad man ba rokh'kh'o birasam,-

37) ba rokh'kh'oi osmonkh'o, to ba ma'budi Muso, ki meguiad, Khudoi kh'ak'ik'i ast, nazar kunam va shak nest, ki man Musoro dar da'voiash durug'gui mepindoram." Va kh'amin guna ba Fir'avn zishtii amali az Kh'omon darkhost kardaash zinat doda shud va az rokh'i durust ba rokh'kh'oi zalolat bargardonida shud. Va iak'inan makri Fir'avn oid ba taloshi g'olib sokhtani botili khud va mag'lub sokhtani kh'ak'ik'ati ovardai Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba khasorat anch'omid. Fir'avn dar nak'shaash koiomb nagasht va ok'ibat badbakhtii abadi domangirash gardid.
38) Va mardi az khonadoni Fir'avn imon ovarda k'avmashro ba sui kh'ak'ik'at nasikh'at va dalolat karda guft: "Ei k'avmi man, maro pairavi kuned, to shumoro ba sui rokh'i durust rakh'namoi namoiam.

39) Ei k'avmi man, beshak, in zindagonii dunio bakh'rabardori az lazzatkh'oi foni ast. Pas naboiad dunio shumoro fireb dikh'ad. Va kh'amono okhirat bo ne'matkh'oiash k'arorgokh'i ch'ovidona ast. Modome chunin ast, pas bo ibodat baroi obodsozii okhirati kheshtan amal kuned. Boekh'tiiot boshed, ki shug'li kh'aioti dunio okhiratro az iodaton nabarad.

40) Kh'ar ki amali bad kunad, pas ch'uz ba misli on chi karda ast, ch'azo doda nameshavad. Az amalkh'oi badash beshtar ch'azo namebinad. Va kasone, ki novobasta az mard io zan budanashon fak'at ba khotiri Khudo amali nek anch'om medikh'and, ba sharti on ki onkh'o ba Khudo va paiombaron imon doshta boshand, pas in ch'amoai sokh'ibi sifatkh'oi kh'amidai mazkur ruzi k'iiomat voridi ch'annat meshavand. Khudo dar ch'annat ba onkh'o ne'matkh'oi abadiro, biduni kh'isob ruzi mesozad.-

41) Va ei k'avmi man, chi shuda ast, ki man shumoro bo faro khondan ba imon va amali solekh' ba sui nach'ot az khasorati dunio va okhirat da'vat mekunam va shumo maro bo faro khondan ba kufru ma'siiat ba sui duzakh da'vat mekuned?!

42) Shumo maro ba sui botili kheshtan da'vat mekuned, to ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir shavam va ba U chizero sharik sokhta, biparastam, ki dar borai durustii ibodatash ilm nadoram, va man shumoro ba imon ovardan ba Allokh'i kh'amesha G'olibi Bakhshandai gunokh'on da'vat mekunam.

43) Kh'ak'k'o, ki on chi shumo maro ba imon ovardan va itoat kardani on da'vat mekuned, na dar dunio va na dar okhirat k'udrati paziruftani duoro nadoshta, dar du olam bearzish ast va nochor bozgashti kh'amagii mo tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast va bandagoni bo kufru ma'siiat az kh'ad guzashta ruzi k'iiomat kh'amdamoni duzakhand. On guna ki dust domani dustashro rakh'o namekunad, kh'amin tavr in toifa niz az duzakh ch'udo namegardand."

44) Fir'avn va atrofiionash nasikh'at va pandi on mardi mu'minro napaziruftand. On mardi nosekh' ba'd az in ba onkh'o guft: "Dar ruzkh'oi nazdik on chiro ba shumo az nasikh'at peshkash namudam, ba iod khokh'ed ovard va baroi napaziruftani on pushaimon khokh'ed shud. Va man kh'amai korkh'oi khudro fak'at ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'avola mekunam. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Binandai a'moli bandagon ast."

45) Pas chun onkh'o nak'shai kushtani on mardro kashidand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro az badikh'oi makrashon kh'ifz namud va khonadoni Fir'avnro uk'ubati g'ark'shavi ikh'ota kard. U bo sipokh'iionash dar darioi Nil g'ark' shud.

46) Onkh'o ba'd az marg dar daruni k'abr subkh' va shom bar otash arza meshavand va ruzi k'iiomat farmon sodir megardad, ki: "Pairavoni Fir'avnro baroi dar dunio ba Khudo kufr varzidan, paiombaroni Uro durug'gui shumurdan va mardumro az rokh'i ilokh'i bozdoshtan voridi sakhttarin azob namoed."

47) Va ei Paiombar, on zamonero iod kun, ki pairavon va peshvoioni duzakhi bo kh'am da'voiu kashmakash mekunand. Pas pairavoni notavon ba peshvoioni mutakabbirashon meguiand: "Ba durusti, mo dar kh'aioti dunio dar gumrokh'i pairavi shumo budem. Pas oio ch'uz'e az in uk'ubatro ba ukh'dai khud girifta, onro az mo dur mesozed?!"

48) Peshvoioni mutakabbir dar ch'avob meguiand: "Beshak, kh'amai mo, sarfi nazar az peshvo va pairav budanamon dar duzakh kh'astem. Kase k'udrati nadorad, ki porai uk'ubati kasi digarro ba zimmai khesh bigirad. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar baini bandagon dovari karda, ba kh'ar kas uk'ubati arzanda doda ast."

49) Va peshvoionu pairavoni giriftori azobi otashi duzakh chun az on ki az duzakh khorich' shavand va bo mak'sadi tavba ba dunio bargardand noumed meshavand, bo khitob ba farishtagoni nigakh'boni duzakh meguiand: "Parvardigoratonro bikhoned, to az in uk'ubati abadi ba andozai iak ruz onro az mo sabuk gardonad."

50) Va farishtagoni nigakh'boni duzakh dar posukh ba darkhosti akh'lash meguiand: "Oio paiombaronaton nazdaton bo dalelkh'oi vozekh' naomada budand?!" Kofiron meguiand: "Bale, omada budand." Farishtagon bo tamaskhur meguiand: "Modom chunin ast, pas khudaton Khudoro bikhoned, to azobatonro sabuk gardonad. Zero mo baroi kofiron shafoat namekunem." Va begumon duoi kofiron dar butlon va nobudi ast. Ba illati on ki ba Khudo kofir shudaand, duoiashon k'abul nameshavad.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi guzashta k'issai Fir'avn, ok'ibati kori u va pairavonash dar dunio va okhiratro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin kori paiombaronu mu'minon va dar dunio va okhirat g'olibshavii onkh'oro baion namuda guft:
51) Beguftugu, Mo firistodagonamon va mu'minonro dar dunio bo g'olib gardonidan va k'uvvat dodanashon muk'obili dushman va inchunin onkh'oro dar okhirat, ki shokh'idon barmekhezand, bo dokhil sokhtanashon ba ch'annat va vorid kardani dushmanonashon ba ch'akh'annam kumak mekunem. Ruzi k'iiomat paiombaron, farishtagon va mu'minon dar makh'shargokh' barkhosta, oid ba on ki vakh'ii ilokh'i dar dunio ba mardum rasonida shud va ummatkh'o onro takzib kardand, shokh'idi medikh'and.

52) Mo paiombaronamon va mu'minonro dar ruze kumak mekunem, ki ba bandagoni bo kufru ma'siiat bar ch'onashon sitamkarda, ma'zarat khostanashon az sitamkori sud namebakhshad. Va onkh'oro dar on ruz ronda shudan az rakh'mati ilokh'i va onkh'oro saroi badi ch'akh'annam ast.
53) Va Mo begumon ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) ilme ato namudem, ki Bani Isroil bo istifoda az on ba sui rokh'i rost kh'idoiat meshudand va dar bainashon Tavrotro nasl ba nasl ba meros guzoshtem-
54) Mo in korro ba khotiri rakh'namoi ba sui rokh'i durust va pande baroi sokh'iboni ak'li solim kardem.

55) Ei Paiombar, dar barobari takzib va ozori k'avmat sabr bikun. Kh'amono va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiat oid ba piruz gashtan va az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) madad giriftan kh'ak' meboshad. Va baroi gunokh'at omurzish bikhokh' va dar avval va okhiri ruz Parvardigoratro az kh'ama aibu nuk'son ba poki iod namo va Uro sitoish bigu.

56) Beshak, kasone, ki dar borai oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), biduni ba onkh'o az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omadani kh'uch'ch'at ch'idol mekunand, to oiatkh'oro botil gardonand, begumon dar k'albashon kibrest, ki onkh'oro vodor mesozad, to bo ch'idoli beasos kh'ak'ro zertobei khud sozand va onkh'o kh'argiz ba in khostaashon, ki kh'ak' dar zeri amrashon k'aror girad, namerasand. Pas, ei Paiombar, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) panokh' bibar. Beguftugu, U Shunavandai guftori bandagon, Binandai kirdori onkh'o ast. Kh'ech' iak sukhan va amalashon az U makhfi nabuda, kh'atman dar badali on podoshashon medikh'ad.

57) Iak'inan ofaridani osmonkh'ovu zamin az rui azamatu pakh'novari az ofaridani mardum buzurgtar ast. On Zote, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro bo vuch'udi azamatu vus'atashon ofarida ast, k'udrati az nav zindasozii murdagonro dorad, to ba onkh'o podoshi amalkh'oiashonro bidikh'ad. Vale aksari mardum in kh'ak'ik'atro namedonand va az in paiomi ofarinishi osmonkh'ovu zamin dark namekunand, ki rastokhezi murdagon dar k'iiomat kh'ak'ik'at ast, to pand bigirand.

58) Va bino bo nobino iakson nest va inchunin on kasone, ki ba Khudo va firistodagonash imon ovardaand va a'moli shoista anch'om dodaand bo kase, ki az sababi doshtani e'tik'odi fosid va sodir kardani gunokh' badkori mekunad, iakson nestand. Beshubkh'a, shumo andak pand megired. Chunki agar pand megirifted, fark'i baini in du gurukh'ro mefakh'mided va sa'i menamuded, ki baroi kasbi rizoi ilokh'i az mu'minoni boamal boshed.

59) Beshak, k'iiomat, ki on ruz murdagon baroi bozch'ui va giriftani podosh zinda sokhta meshavand, noguzir omadanist, dar omadanash shak nest. Valekin beshtari mardum ba omadani k'iiomat imon nameorand va binobar in, omodagi namebinand.

60) Va ei mardum, Parvardigoraton meguiad: "Iagona Maro ibodat kuned va kh'och'ati khudro fak'at az Man khokh'ed, to duoiatonro k'abul kunam va shumoro mavridi afv va rakh'matam k'aror dikh'am. Kh'amono on kasone, ki az tankh'o Maro parastidan khudro buzurg kh'isobida, kibr mevarzand, ruzi k'iiomat ba duzakh khoru zor khokh'and daromad."

61) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) On Zotest, ki shabro baroi shumo torik sokht, to dar on orom bigired va istirokh'at kuned va ruzro ravshan sokht, to mashg'uli kor bishaved. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar mardum Sokh'ibi lutfi azim ast. Chunki ba onkh'o ne'matkh'oi oshkoru nikh'onashro ato namuda ast. Valekin beshtari onkh'o dar badali in ne'matkh'o shukri Uro ba ch'o nameorand.

62) In Allokh'i Sokh'ibne'mati Parvardigori shumo, Ofaridgori kh'ama mavch'udot ast. Iagona Ofaridgor Ust. Ch'uz U ma'budi barkh'ak' vuch'ud nadorad. Modom chunin ast, pas, chitavr shumo az ibodati Allokh'i Iagona ba parastishi mavch'udote, ki az rasonidani foida va zarar och'izand, barmegarded?!

63) Chunonchi in ch'amoa az imon va ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardonda shudand, kh'amin guna kasone, ki alomatkh'oi nishondikh'andai iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro inkor mekardand, dar kh'ar zamon va makon az imon va ibodat bargardonda meshavand va tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba kh'ak'ro nameioband.

64) Ei mardum, On Khudoe, ki zaminro baroi shumo ch'oi istik'omat va k'arorgokh' gardonid va osmonro doroi binoi ustuvori az aftodan ba zamin makh'fuz gardonid va dar bachadoni modaronaton surati shumoro kashid, pas suratkh'oiatonro zebo sokht va ba shumo az taomkh'oi poki laziz ruzi dod. In Sokh'ibi ne'matkh'o, Allokh'i Parvardigori shumo ast. Pas Allokh'i Parvardigori tamomi makhluk'ot Boazamat va Sokh'ibi khairu ekh'soni ziiod ast. G'air az U Parvardigore nest.

65) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Parvardigori kh'amesha Zindai Namiranda ast. Ch'uz U ma'budi barkh'ak' nest. Pas iagona Uro ibodat kuned va tankh'o az U kh'och'at khokh'ed, ibodat va kh'och'at khostani khudro kholis baroi U k'aror dikh'ed va az shirk biparkh'ezed. Kh'amai sitoishkh'oi zaboni va amali makhsus va loik'i Allokh'i Parvardigori makhluk'ot ast.

66) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Kh'amono vak'te ba man dalelkh'oi ak'li va nak'lii ravshan oid ba butloni ibodati ma'budkh'oi sun'ii shumo omad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) maro az ibodati on butkh'oi az rasonidani foida va zarar notavon, ki shumo onkh'oro ba ch'oi U meparasted, k'at'an man' kard. Va inchunin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba man farmon doda ast, ki bo ibodat tankh'o taslimu mutei Parvardigori kulli khaloik' bosham. Khaloik' ch'uz U Parvardigor nadorand."

67) U Zotest, ki Padaraton Odamro az khok ofarid. Sipas shumoro az obi nutfa, sipas az khuni basta khalk' kard. Ba'dan shumoro az batni modaronaton tifl berun ovard, sipas shumoro bok'i meguzorad, to ba sinni kamoli nerui badanaton birased, ba'd az rasidan ba in sinnu sol shumoro bok'i meguzorad, to solmand bishaved. Va ba'zeaton pesh az in mefavtad. Va Khudo chunin mekunad, to kh'aiot bined va ba mukh'lati dar ilmi U ma'lum, ki kamu ziiod nameshavad, birased va to ak'latonro kor farmuda, in dalelkh'oi ravshanro bifakh'med va imon biiored.

68) U iagona Zotest, ki ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, kh'aiot mebakhshad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, memironad. Pas vak'te ki korero kh'ukm kunad, ba on "Kh'ast shav" meguiad, on ba'di farmon zud ba vuch'ud meoiad.

69) Ei Paiombar, oio kasonero, ki dar borai oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'idol namuda, oiatkh'oro bo vuch'udi on ki oshkor bar iagonagi va k'udrati ilokh'i dalolat mekunand, durug' donista, chi guna az kh'ak'ik'at rui megardonand, nadidi?!

70) On kasone, ki K'ur'on va on kh'ak'ik'atero, ki paiombaronamonro bo on firistodem, durug' donistand. Pas, in gurukh'i ch'idolkunandagoni takzibgar ok'ibati ch'idoli nokh'ak' va takzibashonro khokh'and donist va khotimai badi kheshro bo chashmi sar khokh'and did.

71) Ch'idolkunandagoni takzibgar zamone ok'ibati zishti in amali kheshro khokh'and donist, ki zavlonakh'o dar gardankh'oiashon va zanch'irkh'o dar poikh'oiashon az ch'onibi nigakh'bononi ch'akh'annam kashon-kashon sui azobi duzakh burda meshavand.
72) Onkh'o sui obi benikh'oiat purkh'arorat kashida shuda, sipas dar otash afrukhta meshavand.
73) Sipas sarzanishkunon ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Ma'budkh'oi sun'ie, ki shumo onkh'oro dar ibodat shariki Khudo k'aror medoded, kuch'oiand?!-

74) Butkh'oe, ki ba ch'oi Khudo meparastided, kh'ol on ki ba shumo zarar va foida rasonida nametavonistand?!" Kofiron dar posukh meguiand: "On ma'budkh'oiamon az mo nopadid gashtaand. Binobar in, imruz onkh'oro namebinem. Balki dar dunio chizi loik'i ibodatro nameparastidem." Khudo ba monandi gumrokh' sokhtani in ch'amoa dar kh'ar zamon va makon kofironro az rokh'i durust gumrokh' mesozad.
75) Ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "In azobaton ba sababi on ast, ki shumo dar zamin az shirk ovardani khesh nokh'ak' shodi menamuded va dar shodi bo kibru g'ururu fakhrfurushi az kh'ad meguzashted.-
76) Az darkh'oi duzakh daroed, dar kh'ole onch'o abadi memoned. Pas k'arorgokh'i shakhsoni az k'abuli kh'ak' kibrvarzida chi k'adar bad ast!"

Va kh'angome, ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az k'avmash on chiro, ki giriftor shud, Khudovand uro ba sabr farmon dod va bo on chi ba u va'da doda bud, tasalli doda guft:
77) Ei Paiombar, modom ki ok'ibati mushrikon chunin ast, pas dar barobari ozor va takzibi k'avmat sabr bikun. Kh'amono va'dai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ak' buda, dar takh'ak'k'uk' ioftani on kh'ech' shakke nest. Pas agar ba'ze az on azobero, ki ba onkh'o va'da medikh'em, ba tu dar zindagiat nishon dikh'em, on guna ki dar ch'angi Badr surat girift io turo k'abl az nishon dodani azobashon bimironem, pas ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui Mo bargardonida meshavand. On ruz baroiashon ch'azoi munosib doda, eshonro ba ch'akh'annam medarorem.

78) Va ei Paiombar, ba durusti, Mo k'abl az tu paiombaroni ziiodero sui k'avmashon firistodem. Onkh'o az ch'onibi k'avmashon mavridi ozor va takzib k'aror giriftand. Ammo dar barobari takzib va ozorkh'o sabr kardand. Mo az on paiombaron khabari ba'zeashonro ba tu k'issa kardaem va az onkh'o khabari ba'zei digarashonro ba tu k'issa nakardaem. Va kh'ech' paiombare kh'ak' nadosht, ki ba mardum az nazdi khud mu'ch'izae orad, ch'uz bo khosti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u). Az in ru, peshnikh'odi kofiron ba paiombaronashon oidi ovardani mu'ch'iza zulm makh'sub meshavad. Pas chun amri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vobasta ba fatkh' io k'azovat baini paiombaron va k'avmashon biioiad, U dar bainashon odilona k'azovat mekunad. Kofiron kh'alok gardonida shuda, paiombaron nach'ot meioband. Va botilkoron ba illati on ki dar dunio kofir budand, dar on sakh'nai k'azovati baini bandagon ch'onashonro ba kh'alokat afkanda, ziioni buzurg mebinand.
79) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki baroi shumo shuturu govu gusfandu buzro ofarid, to bar ba'zeashon savor shaved va az gushti ba'zei digarashon bikhured.

80) Va baroi shumo dar in makhluk'ot foidakh'oi ziiodi dar kh'ar asru zamon navin ast. Va Khudo in chakh'orpoionro baroiaton ofarid, to az in rokh' ba kh'och'atkh'oi dili kheshtan birased va dar khushki bar rui ba'zei in chakh'orpoion va dar bakh'r bar rui kishtikh'o bardoshta meshaved.

81) Va Khudo nishonakh'oi Khudro, ki bar iagonagiiu k'udratash dalolat mekunad, ba shumo nishon medikh'ad. Pas az nishonakh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kadom iakeashro inkor mekuned, dar kh'ole ki alomati iagonagiiu k'udrati ilokh'i budani onro medoned?!

82) Oio in takzibgaron dar zamin sairu saiokh'at nakardand, to dar borai chi guna surat giriftani ok'ibati kori ummatkh'oi k'abl az onkh'o guzashta andesha namoiand va ibrat girand?! Ummatkh'oi guzashta az in mushrikon az likh'ozi shumora beshtar va az likh'ozi nerui ch'ismoni buzurgtar va az likh'ozi asarkh'oi me'mori dar zamin namoiontar budand. Pas chun uk'ubati ilokh'i ba surog'ashon omad, on doroi va nerue, ki dar dunio kasb mekardand, az onkh'o uk'ubatro bartaraf sokhta natavonist.

83) Pas, chun paiombaroni Khudo ba onkh'o dalelkh'oi ravshan ovardand, onro takzib namudand va ba ilmi khesh, ki mukholif ba vakh'ii ovardai firistodagoni Parvardigor bud, rozi va khushnud shudand va onkh'oro uk'ubate ikh'ota sokht, ki vak'te paiombaron eshonro az on metarsonidand, onro maskhara menamudand.
84) Pas, vak'te uk'ubati Moro didand, e'tirof karda guftand: "Mo ba Allokh'i Iagona imon ovardem va ba butkh'oiamon, ki shariki Khudo k'arorashon medodem, kofir shudem."

85) Pas, vak'te ki onkh'o uk'ubati Moro mushokh'ida kunand, imonashon sudashon namerasonad. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) in k'onunro muk'arrar karda, on dar borai bandagonash guzashta ast, ki imon kh'angomi mushokh'idai azob ba sokh'ibash manfiat namebakhshad. Va kofiron vak'ti nozilshavii uk'ubat, az sababi kofir shudan va tavba nakardanashon bar ch'onashon ziion rasondaand.
1) "Kh'o. Mim" Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) In K'ur'on az sui Allokh'i bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon nozil shuda ast.

3) K'ur'on Kitobest, ki oiatkh'oiash bo zaboni arabi baroi akh'li ilm va andesha mufassal va ravshan baion karda shuda ast. Dar in oiat khos gardonidani akh'li ilmu nazar ba khotiri on ast, ki makh'z kh'amin toifa az maoni va rakh'namoikh'oi on bakh'ra mebarand.

4) Kitobe, ki muzhdarasoni mu'minon ba bikh'isht va bimdikh'andai kofiron az duzakh ast. Pas beshtari mardum az rakh'namoikh'oi on rui toftand. Dar natich'a onkh'o kh'idoiatkh'oi K'ur'onro baroi paziruftanash nameshunavand.

5) Va meguiand: "Dilkh'oiamon az on chi moro ba sui on mekhoni, bo pushishkh'o pushonida shuda, da'vatatro namefakh'mad va dar gushkh'oi mo vaznini buda, da'vatatro nameshunavad va baini mo va baini tu parda k'aror dorad, baroi kh'amin sukhanonat ba mo namerasad. Pas tu bo ravishi khud kor kun va mo bo ravishi khud kor mekunem. Mo kh'ech' gokh' tobei rokh'i tu nameshavem."

6) Ei Paiombar, ba in toifai sarkash bigu: "Kh'amono man misli shumo odami kh'astam. Fark'i man az shumo dar on ast, ki ba man az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vakh'i meshavad, ki ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ii shumo, Ma'budi Iagona ast. Modome chunin ast, pas rokh'i rosti ba U vaslkunandaro bipaimoed va az U talabi omurzishi gunokh'onatonro bikuned. Va kh'alokatu uk'ubat bar bandagone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shirk meorand,-
7) bandagone, ki zakoti molashonro namepardozand va onkh'o ba okhirat va ne'matu azobi on kofirand."
8) Kh'amono on bandagone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va firistodagonash imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista mekunand, baroi onkh'o podoshi ch'ovidonai nogusastanii ch'annat ast.

9) Ei Paiombar, mushrikonro bo sarzanish bigu: "Oio shumo ba on Zote, ki zaminro dar du ruz (iakshanbe va dushanbe) ofarid, kofir megarded va ba U dar ibodat anbozkh'o k'aror medikh'ed?! On Kholik'i Volomak'om Parvardigori tamomi makhluk'ot ast."

10) Va U dar zamin az boloi on kukh'kh'oi ustuvorro padid ovard, to zamin ba larza naoiad va dar zamin bo ne'matkh'oi farovon barakat dod, zaminro baroi sokinonash doroi khairi doimi sokht va dar on g'izokh'oi mardumon va digar kh'aivonotro dar tamomii chor ruz andozagiri va tak'sim kard, chor ruzi barobari bekamu ziiod, baroi on kasone, ki dar borai ofarinishi zamin va mavch'udotash mepursand. Ruzi iakshanbe va dushanbe zamin ofarida shud va ruzi seshanbe va chorshanbe g'izokh'o andozagiri va tak'sim gardid.

11) Sipas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'asdi ofarinishi osmonro namud, kh'ol on ki osmon on vak't misli dud bud. Pas ba osmon va zamin guft: "Ikhtiioran io ich'boran tobei farmoni Man garded. Shumo ch'uz in chorai digar nadored!" Osmon va zamin guftand: "Mo dar kh'oli farmonbardori nazdat omadem. Parvardigoro, mo iagona mutei irodai Tu kh'astem."

12) Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ofarinishi osmonkh'oro dar du ruz (panch'shanbe va ch'um'a) ba itmom rasonid. Bo kh'amin ofarinishi osmonkh'o va zamin dar shash ruz anch'om shud. Va Parvardigor dar kh'ar osmon muk'addarot va amrashro oid ba itoat va ibodatash paig'om firistod. Va Mo osmoni nazdiktarin ba zaminro bo sitoragoni durakhshon oroish dodem va onro ba vositai sitoragon az khabarduzdii shaitonkh'o kh'ifz namudem. In korkh'o andozagirii Allokh'i G'olibu Donandai makhluk'ot ast.

13) Ei Paiombar, ba'd az in agar k'avmat az imon ovardan ba dinat ru toband, pas ba onkh'o bigu: "Man shumoro az duchor shudan ba misli azobi shadidi bar Odi k'avmi Kh'ud va Samudi k'avmi Solekh' furud omada kh'ushdor dodam va tarsondam."

14) Vak'te paiombaronashon ba sui onkh'o paiopai omadand va kh'amagi iak paiomro rasondand, ki "Ba g'air az Allokh'i Iagona kase va chizero ibodat nakuned", k'avmi kofirashon guftand: "Agar Parvardigori mo mekhost, farishtagonro ba sifati paiombarash nozil mekard. Modome shumo odami kh'asted, pas mo ba kh'ar on chi bo on firistoda shudaed, kofirem. Zero shumo az mo fark'e nadored."

15) Ammo Odi k'avmi Kh'ud, ilova bar on ki ba Khudo kofir shudand, dar zamin banokh'ak' kibr varzida, nisbat ba digaron sitam kardand va fireftai nerui khud gashta guftand: "Ki az rui neru az mo k'avitar ast?" Ba pindori k'avmi Kh'ud, kh'ech' kas az onkh'o nerumandtar nabud. Khudo dar posukhashon guft: "Oio in kofironi mutakabbir nadonistaand va nadidaand, ki begumon Allokh'i Nerubakhshi Ofaridgorashon az onkh'o Nerumandtar ast?!" Va onkh'o kh'amesha oiatkh'oi Moro, ki tavassuti paiombarashon Kh'ud ba eshon merasid, inkor mekardand.

16) Pas Mo bar Odi k'avmi Kh'ud dar kh'aft ruzi baroiashon nakh's bodi doroi sadoi iztirobangezi nikh'oiat sardro firistodem. [Nakh's guftani on ruzkh'o ba e'tibori kofironi k'avmi Kh'ud ast. Zero k'avmi Od dar in muddat duchori uk'ubati sakht shudand]. Mo chunin kardem, to ba onkh'o dar dunio azobi khoru rasvokunandaro bichashonem. Va kh'amono azobi okhirat onkh'oro beshtar rasvo mesozad va onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat kasero nameioband, ki bo rakh'onidanashon az duzakh kumakashon kunad.

17) Va ammo Samudi k'avmi Solekh', Mo onkh'oro bo baioni rokh'i rost kh'idoiat namudem. Pas zalolatro bar kh'idoiat bartari dodand. Onkh'oro ba sababi kufru ma'siiate, ki mekardand, porai otashi azobi khorsozanda faro girift va nobud sokht.
18) Va Mo on bandagonero, ki imon ovardand va paivasta bo ich'roi dasturot va khuddori az mamnuot parkh'ezkori mekardand, az azobi bar k'avmashon, Samud omada nach'ot dodem.

19) Va on ruzero iod kun, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dushmanonashro ba sui otashi duzakh ch'am' mesozad. Pas nigakh'bononi ch'akh'annam gurukh'kh'oi avvalro boz medorand, to gurukh'kh'oi minba'da ba onkh'o paivandand. Kh'ech' nafarashon az azob firor karda nametavonad.

20) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro sui otash ch'am' meorad, to on ki vak'te nazdi otash kh'ozir meshavand va korkh'oi badashonro rad mekunand, gushkh'oiashon va chashmkh'oiashon va pustkh'oiashon dar borai on chi az kufr va ma'siiat dar dunio anch'om medodand, bar ziddashon shokh'idi medikh'and.

21) Va kofiron ba pustkh'oi badanashon meguiand: "Charo alaikh'amon oid ba on chi mo dar dunio az ma'siiat mekardem, guvokh'i doded?!" Pustkh'oi badanashon dar posukh meguiand: "Moro on Khudoe, ki kh'amai chizro guio gardonid, guio gardonida ast. Va U shumoro bori nakhust dar dunio ofarid va dar ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozch'ui va giriftani podosh tankh'o ba sui U bargardonida shudaed.

22) Va kh'angomi dar dunio sodir kardani gunokh' az on pinkh'on nameshuded, ki mabodo gushkh'oiaton va chashmkh'oiaton va pustkh'oiaton bar muk'obilaton guvokh'i dikh'ad. Chunki shumo ba bozch'ui, uk'ubat va podoshi ba'di marg bovar nadoshted. Valekin mepindoshted, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) beshtari on chiro anch'om medikh'ed, namedonad. Fikr mekarded koraton az U makhfi memonad. Az in ru, mag'rur shuded."
23) Va in gumoni badaton, ki dar kh'ak'k'i Parvardigoraton karded, shumoro kh'alok gardond. Pas binobar in, dar dunio va okhirat az ch'umlai ziionkoron gashted.

24) Pas, agar in ch'amoa, ki a'zoi badanashon muk'obilashon guvokh'i medikh'and, sabr kunand, sabrashon kh'ech' manfiate nadorad, chunki otashi ch'akh'annam maskan va k'arorgokh'i onkh'o ast. Va agar az Khudo raf'i uk'ubat va rizoiashro khokh'and, pas onkh'o kh'ech' gokh' ba rizoi ilokh'i va dukhuli ch'annat noil namegardand.

25) Va Mo baroi in kofiron kh'amnishinonero az shaitonkh'o omoda sokhtaem, ki paivasta kh'amrokh'ashon kh'astand. Pas, kh'amnishinonashon ba onkh'o a'moli badashonro dar dunio oroish medikh'and va inchunin korkh'oi okhiratashonro oroish doda, fikri k'iiomat va omodagiashro az iodashon mebarorand. Va bar kofiron va'dai azob dar iakch'oiagi bo ummatkh'oe az ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, ki k'abl az onkh'o guzashtaand, k'at'i shuda ast. Kh'amono inkh'o va on ummatkh'oi sobik' ziionkorand. Chunki ruzi k'iiomat bo dukhuli duzakh bar khud va khonavodaashon ziioni sakht merasonand.

26) Va kofiron chun az on ki bo kh'uch'ch'at muk'obiliiat nishon dikh'and, och'iz mondand, baini khud mashvarat karda guftand: "Ba in K'ur'one, ki Mukh'ammad baroiaton k'iroat mekunad, gush faro nadikh'ed, tobei rakh'namoikh'oiash nashaved va vak'ti k'iroatash dodu fariod va sadoi kheshtanro baland kuned, shoiad alaikh'i Mukh'ammad piruz garded. In koraton sabab megardad, ki vai tilovati K'ur'onu da'vatro tark mekunad va mo rokh'at meshavem."
27) Va Mo begumon ruzi k'iiomat ba on kasone, ki kofir meshavand va paiombaronro takzib mekunand, uk'ubati sakht mechashonem va onkh'oro baroi a'moli badi shirku gunokh'ashon ch'azo medikh'em.

28) In uk'ubati mazkur, uk'ubati dushmanoni Khudo ast. Ch'azoiashon otashi duzakh ast. Onkh'oro dar duzakh manzili abadi ast. Eshon ba sababi on ki paivasta oiatkh'oi Moro inkor mekardand va bo vuch'udi vozekh' va k'avi budan, ba on imon nameovardand, bo in azob ch'azo doda meshavand.

29) Va kasone, ki ba Khudo kofir shudaand va paiombaronro durug'gu donistaand, ruzi k'iiomat meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, on du kase az ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, ki gumrokh'amon sokhtand, iakeashon Iblis, poiaguzor va da'vatgar ba sui kufr va digarashon K'obili pisari Odam, poiaguzori khunreziro ba mo nishon bidekh', to dar otash zeri k'adamkh'oiamon pakhshashon kunem, to az nafaroni dar poiontarin tabak'ai duzakh - sakhttarin ch'oi uk'ubat ch'oigirshavanda boshand."

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi k'abli much'ozoti dushmanonashro ovard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin podoshi dustonashro zikr karda guft:
30) Kh'amono on kasone, ki meguiand: "Parvardigori mo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, g'air az U Parvardigore nadorem", sipas dar ich'roi dasturot va duri ch'ustan az man'kardakh'oi Parvardigori kheshtan sobit memonand, farishtagon kh'angomi sakaroti marg bar onkh'o furud omada meguiand: "Az marg va kh'avodisi mo ba'di on natarsed va baroi on chi dar dunio az dast dodaed, andukh'gin nashaved va muzhdagoni bidikh'ed ba vurudi ch'annati abadi, ki dar dunio bo on dar ivazi imon va amali shoistaaton va'da doda meshuded.-

31) Mo dar zindagonii dunio iovaroni shumo budem, guftoru kirdori durustro talk'inaton mekardem va kh'ifzaton menamudem va dar okhirat niz iovaronaton kh'astem. Dusti va iorii mo bo shumo doimi ast. Va baroi shumo dar ch'annat on chi nafsaton az lazzat va shakh'vat mekhokh'ad, farokh'am ast va baroi shumo dar ch'annat on chi metalabed, mavch'ud ast.
32) In ruzi az sui Allokh'i nisbat ba tavbakoron Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon khos baroi shumo omoda shuda ast."

33) Va kh'ech' kas az rui guftor az on bandae bekh'tar nest, ki mardumro ba iaktoparasti va amal bo shariat da'vat mekunad va amali shoistai mavridi pisandi ilokh'iro anch'om medikh'ad va meguiad: "Kh'amono man az zumrai taslimshudagoni kh'ukmi Khudo kh'astam." Kh'ar kas chunin kunad, pas vai az ch'umlai nektarin insonkh'o ast.

34) Neki va a'moli shoistai mavridi pisandi ilokh'i bo badi va gunokh'on, ki Khudoro khashgin mesozand, iakson nestand. Badi va zishtii mardumro bo bekh'tarin khislat posukh bidekh'. Dar natich'a, nogakh'on kase, ki baini vai va baini tu dushmanii derina bud, ba sababi bo shevai bekh'tarin posukh dodanat chun dusti mushfik'at megardad.

35) Va ba in khislati kh'amida fak'at kasone komiob sokhta meshavand, ki bar ozor va badraftorii mardum sabr mekunand va ba in khislat tankh'o bandae komiob sokhta meshavad, ki az akhlok'i kh'amida sokh'ibi sakh'mi buzurg ast. Zero raftori mazkur khair va naf'i ziiod dorad.
36) Va agar Shaiton turo ba kori bad vasvasa kunad, pas ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) panokh' bibar. Kh'amono U Shunavandai sukhanu Donandai akh'voli tu ast.

37) Omadani shab va ruz va oftobu mokh' paii kh'am az nishonakh'oi azamat va dalolat ba iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Ei mardum, kh'argiz oftob va mokh'ro sach'da nakuned va iagona Allokh'i Kholik'i in mavch'udotro sach'da kuned, agar dar kh'ak'ik'at Uro meparasted.

38) Pas, agar onkh'o takabbur kunand va rui gardonida, ba Allokh'i Ofaridgori iagona sach'da naorand, in ba azamati Parvardigorat khalal namerasonad, zero on farishtagone, ki nazdi Parvardigorat kh'astand, shab va ruz Uro ba poki iod mekunand va kh'amd meguiand va onkh'o az ibodat khasta nameshavand.

39) Va az nishonakh'oi ravshani Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki azamat, vakh'doniiat va k'udratmandii Uro ba zinda sokhtani murdagon nishon medikh'ad, on ast, ki tu zaminro khushkidai begiiokh' mebini, pas chun bar on obi boronro furud orem, zamin ba sababi ruiidani rastani ba kh'arakat medaroiad va baland meshavad. Begumon On Khudoe, ki in zamini murdaro bo giiokh' zinda sokht, kh'atman ba murdagon baroi bozpursi va giriftani podoshi amal kh'aiot mebakhshad va onkh'oro az k'abrashon zinda megardonad. Iak'inan U bar kh'amai chiz Tavono ast. Zindasozii murdagon Uro och'iz namesozad, chunonchi zindasozii zamini khushkidai begiiokh' och'izash nasokht.

40) Kh'amono kasone, ki dar mavridi oiatkh'oi Mo bo inkor, takzib va takh'rif az rokh'i rost kach' meshavand, kh'olashon bar Mo pushida nest. Mo onkh'oro medonem. Oio kase, ki dar otash afkanda meshavad, bekh'tar ast, io kase, ki ruzi k'iiomat az azob emin meoiad?! Ei mardum, kh'ar chi az nekiiu badi mekhokh'ed, bikuned. Mo ba shumo neku badro baion sokhtaem. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on chiro mekuned, mebinad. Kh'ech' amalaton az U makhfi nest.

41) Begumon kasone, ki vak'te az sui Khudo ba onkh'o K'ur'on omad, ba on kofir gashtand, ruzi k'iiomat much'ozot meshavand. Va kh'amono K'ur'on Kitobi doroi izzatu shavkat ast. Kh'ech' kas onro takh'rif io digargun sokhta nametavonad.

42) Kh'ech' iak botilkore ba K'ur'on na az likh'ozi ma'noiu na az likh'ozi lafz bo tabdilu takh'rif io kamu ziiod sokhtan rokh' nameiobad. On az sui Parvardigori dar ofarinish, ta'iini tak'dirot va akh'komash bag'oiat Bokh'ikmati kh'amesha Sutuda nozil shuda ast.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi guzashta kh'olati takzibgaroni K'ur'onro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin bo zikri misol az paiombaroni k'abli Rasuli akram (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro ba sabr da'vat namuda, tasalli dod va guft:
43) Ei Paiombar, iak'inan on chi ba tu az durug'gui shumurdanat gufta meshavad, ainan sukhanonest, ki ba paiombaroni k'abl az tu gufta meshud. Pas sabr kun. Shakke nest, ki Parvardigorat ba bandagoni tavbakorash Sokh'ibi mag'firat va ba tavbanokardagon Sokh'ibi ik'obi dardovar ast.

44) Va agar Mo in K'ur'onro ba zaboni g'airi arabi furud biiorem, kh'atman kofironi arab meguiand: "Charo oiatkh'oi in Kitob ba surati mufassal tavzekh' doda nashud, to onro bifakh'mem?! Oio meshavad, ki K'ur'on ba zaboni g'airi arabi nozil gardad va paiombare, ki onro meorad, arab boshad?!" Ei Paiombar, ba in kofiron bigu: "K'ur'on baroi mu'minon kh'idoiat az zalolat va baroi on chi dar sinakh'o az nodoni va g'aira ch'oi dorad, shifo ast. Va kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon nameorand, dar gushkh'oiashon vaznini ast va K'ur'on bar onkh'o boisi kurdiliashon meboshad. Binobar in, onro nameshunavand va namefakh'mand. In toifa monandi shakhsoneand, ki az makoni dur fariod karda meshavand. Chun kase az makoni dur khonda shavad, pas chi guna sadoi fariodkunandaro meshunavad?!"

45) Va ba durusti, Mo ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) Tavrotro dodem. Pas dar borai on bo tasdik'u takzib ikhtilof surat girift. Ba'zei k'avmi Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba Tavrot imon ovardand va ba'zei digarashon kofir gashtand. Va agar irodaiu tak'diri Parvardigorat, ki baini bandagon ruzi k'iiomat oid ba ikhtilofashon k'azovat mekunad, vuch'ud namedosht, kh'atman baini du gurukh'i dar mavridi Tavrot ikhtilofkunanda dovari namuda, kh'ak'ro az nokh'ak' ch'udo sokhta, iakumro sokh'ibizzat va duiumro khor mesokht. Va kh'amono kofiron nisbat ba K'ur'on dar shakki much'ibi iztirob k'aror dorand.

46) Kh'ar ki amali shoista kunad, pas sudash ba khudash barmegardad. Khudo az amali neki kase manfiatdor nest. Va kh'ar ki amali bad kunad, pas on bar zarari khudi ust. Ma'siiati kh'ech' kas ba Parvardigor zarar namerasonad. U ba kh'ar nafar dar badali korkh'oiash ch'azo medikh'ad. Va ei Paiombar, Parvardigorat ba bandagonash sitamkor nest. Binobar in, amali nekashonro kam va amali badashonro afzun namesozad. Kh'ar chi anch'om dodaand, kh'amonro megirand.

47) Ilmi vak'ti barposhavii k'iiomat tankh'o ba Parvardigor kh'avola megardad. Fak'at U medonad, ki k'iiomat kai ba vuk'u' mepaivandad. Ch'uz U kase dar borai on khabar nadorad. Va kh'ech' mevakh'o az g'ilofkh'oi khud, ki dar on nigakh'dori meshavand, namebaroiand va kh'ech' ch'insi moda bordor namegardad va kh'amlashro tavallud namekunad, magar on ki in kh'ama bo ilmi Parvardigor surat megirad. Kh'ech' chize az ikh'otai ilmash berun nest. Va ei bandai kh'ushmand, ruzero ba khotir biior, ki Parvardigorat mushrikoni butparastro baroi shirk ovardanashon sarzanishkunon fariod mekunad: "On ma'budkh'oi botilaton, ki onkh'oro sharikoni Man mepindoshted, kuch'o kh'astand?!" Mushrikon bo kh'asrat meguiand: "Inch'o nazdat e'tirof menamoem va ba Tu e'lon mekunem, ki az miioni mo kh'ech' kas bar sharik doshtanat guvokh'i namedikh'ad."
48) Va on chi k'ablan az k'abili butkh'o meparastidand, az onkh'o g'oib megardad va iak'in kh'osil mekunand, ki onkh'o az azobi Khudo kh'ech' ch'oi gurez nadorand.

49) Inson az talabi tandurusti, doroi, farzand va digar nav'i ne'matkh'o khasta nameshavad va agar ba vai tangdasti, bemori va digar nav'i musibatkh'o rasad, pas az rakh'mati ilokh'i k'alban va ch'isman sakht noumed megardad.

50) Va agar Mo ba inson az nazdi Khud ba'd az on ki ba vai ofat va bemori rasida bud, tandurusti, tavongari va ofiiat chashonem, kh'atman meguiad: "In ne'matkh'o khos ba man taalluk' dorad. Chunki man loik'i in nav' in'om mebosham. Va gumon nadoram, ki k'iiomat barpo gardad. Va agar farazan, k'iiomat ba vuk'u' paivandad va man ba sui Parvardigoram bargardonida shavam, begumon dar nazdi U sokh'ibi tavongari va doroi kh'astam. On guna ki ba man dar dunio ne'mat dod, zero arzandagii onro doshtam, kh'amin tavr dar okhirat niz dar kh'ak'k'am in'om mekunad." Pas ba durusti, Mo kofironro az on chi az kufru ma'siiat kardaand, khabar medikh'em va ba onkh'o az azobi nikh'oiat sakht mechashonem.

51) Va vak'te Mo bar inson bo ne'mati tandurusti, ofiiat va digar ne'matkh'o in'om namoem, az zikru ibodat g'ofil shuda, bo khudpisandi rui megardonad va khudro dur mesozad. Va vak'te ba u bemori, tangdasti va digar nav' sakhtikh'o birasad, pas vai duoi ziiod va durudaroz karda, ba Parvardigor az ranch'kh'oi khud shikoiat mebarad, to onkh'oro bartaraf sozad. Agar Khudo baroiash ne'mat dikh'ad, shukrguzori namekunad va agar ba musibat duchor shavad, besabri menamoiad.

52) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikoni takzibgar bigu: "Ba man khabar dikh'ed! Agar in K'ur'on az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omada boshad, sipas shumo ba on kofir garded va durug'ash shumored, ba'd az in kh'olaton chi meshavad?! Va ki gumrokh'tar az on kasest, ki bo vuch'udi ravshan va k'avi budani kh'ak'ik'at, bo on dar mukholifat va adovati sakht k'aror dorad?!"

53) Beshak, Mo ank'arib nishonakh'oi Khudro ba kofironi Makka dar gushavu kanorakh'oi zamin bo kishvarkushoii musalmonon va dar vuch'udi khudi onkh'o bo fatkh'i Makka nishon khokh'em dod, to baroiashon kh'ak' budani K'ur'on ma'lum gardad. Oio baroi in mushrikon kh'amin k'adar basanda nest, ki Parvardigorat bar kh'ama chiz Guvokh' ast?! Oio shakh'odati Khudo dar borai az sui U furud omadani K'ur'on basanda nest?! Shakh'odati ki az shakh'odati U buzurgtar ast?! Agar mushrikon kh'ak'ch'u mebudand, shakh'odati Parvardigorashon baroiashon basanda bud va ba on iktifo mekardand.

54) Ogokh' boshed! Kh'amono mushrikon az vokhurii Parvardigorashon dar ruzi k'iiomat sakht shubkh'a dorand. Chunki onkh'o ba rastokhez va okhirat imon nadorand. Ba kh'amin illat, eshon bo anch'omi amalkh'oi nek baroi ruzi vopasin omodagi namebinand. Ogokh' boshed! Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ilm va k'udratash Ikh'otagari kh'ama chiz ast.
1) "Kh'o. Mim" Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) "Ain. Sin. K'of" Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.

3) Ei Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), Allokh'i dar intik'omgiri az dushman G'olibi dar tadbir va khalk'i khaloik' Kh'akim ba tu va ba paiombaroni k'abl az tu guzashta kh'amin guna paig'om mefiristad.

4) Kh'ar on chi dar osmonkh'o va kh'ar on chi zamin vuch'ud dorad, az rui ofarinish, molikiiat va tadbir fak'at az Ust. Va U Parvardigori bo Zot, mak'om va g'alaba az kh'ama chiz Bartaru Buzurgtar ast.

5) Az azamati Parvardigor on ast, ki osmonkh'o bo vuch'udi buzurgi va balandi k'arib ast az kh'aibat va tarsi U az boloi zaminkh'o pora-pora shavand. Va farishtagon bo izkh'ori ach'z va ta'zim Parvardigorashonro ba poki nisbat doda, sitoish mekunand va az U baroi mu'minoni akh'li zamin omurzish mekhokh'and. Ogokh' boshed! Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Omurzandai Mekh'rubon ast.

6) Va kasone, ki ch'uz Allokh'i iagona butkh'oro shafoatgar va ma'budi kheshtan megirand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar a'molashon Nazoratkunanda va dar kamini onkh'o ast. On chi anch'om medikh'and, tamomi onro sabt mekunad va dar badali kh'ar amal ch'azoiashon medikh'ad. Va tu Paiombar vobastashudai nazorati a'moli onkh'o nesti. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) turo az kori onkh'o namepursad. Vazifai tu tankh'o az tablig'i paig'omi ilokh'i iborat ast.

7) Va ei Paiombar, chunonchi Mo ba paiombaroni guzashta paig'om namudem, ba kh'amin monand ba tu K'ur'oni bo zaboni arabiro paig'om firistodem, to akh'li Makka va arabkh'oi sokini dekh'akh'oi atrofi on, inchunin tamomi mardumi rui zaminro az azobi Parvardigor bim bidikh'i va onkh'oro az ruzi k'iiomat, ki Khudo kulli khaloik'ro az avval to okhir dar iak makoni kh'amvor baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo ch'am' mesozad, bitarsoni. Dar barposhavii k'iiomat shak nest. Mardum on ruz ba du gurukh' ch'udo shuda, mu'minon dar ch'annat va kofiron dar ch'akh'annam k'aror megirand.
