8) Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, kh'amai mardumro ummati iakporchai pairavi dini Islom mekard va onkh'oro voridi ch'annat mesokht, valekin Uaz rui kh'ikmati Khud kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, ba dini Islom va ch'annat dokhil megardonad. Va on bandagone, ki bo kufru ma'siiat bar ch'onashon sitam kardaand, onkh'o dust va madadrasone nadorand, ki dustashon bigirad va baroiashon kumak rasonda, az azobi ilokh'i nach'otashon bidikh'ad.

9) Balki mushrikon ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budkh'oi digar giriftaand. Agar onkh'o dar vok'e' ma'bud bikhokh'and, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iagona Ma'budi barkh'ak' ast. Ch'uz U kase zarar va foida namerasonad. Va iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba murdagon bo barangekhtanashon baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo kh'aiot mebakhshad va U bar kh'ama chiz Tavono ast.

10) Va on chi shumo mardum dar mavridi on az usuli din io masoili ch'uz'i ikhtilof mekuned, pas kh'ukmi on ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'avola megardad. Boiad baroi kh'allash ba K'ur'on va sunnat muroch'iat shavad. In Sokh'ibi sifatkh'oi mazkur Allokh'i Parvardigori man ast. Dar tamomi korkh'oiam fak'at ba U tavakkul kardaam va bo tavba tankh'o sui U barmegardam.

11) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) biduni namunai sobik' Padidovarandai osmonkh'o va zamin ast. Baroi shumo az nav'i khudaton ch'uftkh'o va inchunin ba khotiri naf'i shumo az chakh'orpoion (shuturu govu gusfandu buz) ch'insi narina va modina ofarid. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro bo izdivoch'i ch'uftkh'oi narina va modina afzun gardonida, dar zamin muntashir mesozad va baroiaton az gusht va shiri chakh'orpoion ruzi medikh'ad. Kh'ech' chize az makhluk'ot ba U shabokh'at nadorad. Va U Shunavandai guftori bandagon, Binandai kirdori onkh'ost. Chize az doirai ilmash dur nest va dar muk'obili kh'ar amal ba sokh'ibash podosh khokh'ad dod. Agar banda kori nek kard, podoshi nek va agar kori bad kard, podoshi bad mebinad.

12) Kalidkh'oi khazinakh'oi osmonkh'o va zamin fak'at az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. U rizk'ro bo mak'sadi sanch'ishi siposguzori va nosiposi ba kh'ar ki az bandagonash khokh'ad, farokh va onro bo mak'sadi sanch'ishi sabr va besabri ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, tang mesozad. Beshak, U Donandai kh'amai chiz ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida namemonad.

13) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi shumo az din misli on chi Nukh'ro ba tablig' va tatbik'ash amr kard va on chi ba tu Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) vakh'i firistodem va on chi Ibrokh'im va Muso va Isoro ba tablig' va tatbik'ash farmon dodem, baion va izkh'or namud. Khulosai farmonamon ba paiombaron az on iborat bud, ki dinro barpo namoed va dar on ba parokandagi rokh' nadikh'ed. On chi mushrikonro ba sui on da'vat mekuned, ki iaktoparast shavand va az shirk khuddori kunand, bar onkh'o nikh'oiat sangin va buzurg ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az bandagonash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, barmeguzinad va ba vai tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba itoatu ibodatro medikh'ad va kh'ar ki bo tavba ba itoatash bargardad, uro ba sui Khesh rakh'namoi mekunad.

14) Va kofironu mushrikon dar borai din parokanda nashudand, magar ba'd az ba onkh'o omadani ilm oidi kh'ak'ik'at va bi'sati Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va illati ba gurukh'i kofiru mu'min ch'udo shudani onkh'o adovat, kh'asad va zulmashon ast. Va agar iroda va tak'diri dar ilmi Parvardigorat guzashta, ki azobi inkh'oro to mukh'lati nazdash ma'lum (k'iiomat) ba ta'khir meguzorad, vuch'ud namedosht, kh'atman dar bainashon k'azovat mekard va dar dunio k'abl az okhirat ba khotiri kufr va durug'gu shumurdani paiombaron azobashon mekard. Va beshak, on kasone az iakh'udu nasoroi kh'amasri tu Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), ki ba onkh'o ba'd az guzashtagonashon va ba'd az in mushrikoni dar din parokandashuda Tavrot va Inch'il ba meros doda shud, oidi K'ur'on dar shakki iztirobangez k'aror dorand.

15) Pas ei Paiombar, mardumro ba sui in dini rost da'vat kun va dar in rokh' kh'amon guna ki Khudo turo amr karda ast, ustuvor bimon va az khostakh'oi botili mushrikon va akh'li Kitob pairavi makun. Va kh'angomi bakh's bo onkh'o bigu: "Man ba kh'amai kitobkh'oe, ki Khudo ba paiombaroni Khud nozil namuda ast, imon doram va U maro farmon doda ast, to dar baini shumo odilona dovari namoiam. Allokh' Parvardigori man va Parvardigori shumo ast. A'moli mo az khudamon va a'moli shumo az khudaton ast. Khudo ba kh'amai movu shumo novobasta az nek io bad budani amalamon ch'azoi sazovor khokh'ad dod. Parvardigor mo va shumoro az korkh'oi iakdigar namepursad, balki kh'ar kas ch'avobgui kirdori khud ast. Baini mo va baini shumo ba'di ravshan gashtani kh'uch'ch'at va rokh'amon ch'idole nest. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baini kh'amaamon ch'am' mesozad va bozgasht tankh'o ba sui U buda, dar onch'o ba kh'ar nafar podoshi sazovor medikh'ad. On vak't rostgui az durug'gui va kh'ak' az botil ch'udo megardad."

16) Va on kasone, ki dar borai dini Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba'd az on ki mardum onro paziruftand, ch'idol mekunand, to digaronro ba shak andozand, kh'uch'ch'ati in ch'idolgaron nazdi Parvardigorashon va niz nazdi mu'minon beasari zavoliobanda ast. Va bar onkh'o az sababi kufr varzidan va inkor namudani kh'ak'ik'at g'azabi ilokh'i va ruzi k'iiomat baroiashon azobi nikh'oiat sakht ast.

Chun Khudo dar oiati mazkur butloni daleli kofironro ovard, dar oiati zerin asosi kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi sakh'ekh'i fardi musalmonro, ki K'ur'on ast, baion karda guft:
17) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki K'ur'onro ba kh'ak' va shomili rosti va niz tarozui adolatro nozil karda ast, to k'azovat dar baini mardum bar asosi insof surat girad. Va chi baso barposhavii k'iiomat, ki in ch'amoa onro durug' meshumorand, nazdik boshad. On chi omandanist, nazdik ast.

18) On kasone, ki ba k'iiomat imon nadorand, zudtar omadani onro metalaband. Zero onkh'o ba bozpursi, podoshu uk'ubati okhirat mu'tak'id nestand. Va mu'minon az vuk'ui k'iiomat dar kh'arosand, chunki az masiri khud dar on ruz metarsand va iak'inan medonand, ki k'iiomat kh'ak' ast. Ogokh' boshed! Kh'amono on kasone, ki dar borai k'iiomat ch'idol mekunand va digaronro ba shak meandozand, beguftugu, dar gumrokh'ii nikh'oiat dur az kh'ak' k'aror dorand.

19) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbati bandagonash Sokh'ibi lutfi ziiod ast. Ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, ruzi medikh'ad. Mutobik'i kh'ikmat va lutfash, rizk'i kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, farokh va az kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, tang megardonad. Va U Nerumand ast, kase mag'lubash sokhta nametavonad, G'olib ast, az dushmanonash intik'om mesitonad.

20) Kh'ar ki bo anch'omi amalkh'oi shoista savobi okhiratro bikhokh'ad, savobashro duchand megardonem. Dar ivazi iak neki az dakh' to kh'afsad va az on beshtar ach'r megirad. Va kh'ar ki tankh'o dunioro bikhokh'ad, az on ba vai sakh'mi dar tak'dirash muaiianro medikh'em va dar okhirat kh'ech' sakh'me nadorad. Zero u dunioro az saroi abadii okhirat muk'addam guzoshta ast.

21) Io mushrikon ma'budkh'oe dorand, ki baroiashon chizkh'oero az din ba misli shirk ovardan, kh'alol donistani kh'arom va kh'arom donistani kh'alol, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rukhsat nadoda ast, muk'arrar sokhtaand?! Va agar irodaiu tak'diri Khudo, ki dovarii ikhtilofkunandagoni umuri dinro to faro rasidani vak'ti muaiian ba ta'khir meguzorad, vuch'ud namedosht, kh'atman dar bainashon k'azovat mekard. Va kh'amono baroi on bandagone, ki bo shirku ma'siiat bar ch'oni khud sitam mekunand, dar k'iiomat azobi dardovare ast.

22) Va tu ei bandai kh'ushmand, shakhsoni bo shirku gunokh' bar ch'oni khesh sitamkardaro ba sababi on chi az gunokh' anch'om dodaand, az uk'ubat kh'aroson mebini, kh'ol on ki on azobi amali sodir kardaashon bar onkh'o noguzir vok'e'shavanda ast. Tarsi kholi az tavba sudashon namebakhshad. Va kasone, ki ba Khudovu firistodagonash imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista mekunand, bar khilofi zolimon dar bosharaftarin, khushtarin va olitarin k'it'akh'oi ch'annat k'aror girifta, az ne'matkh'oi on lazzat mebarand. Baroiashon nazdi Parvardigorashon kh'ar on chi az ne'matkh'oi abadi mekhokh'and, mavch'ud ast. In fazli buzurgest, ki kh'ech' fazle bo on barobar nest.

23) In muzhdai buzurgest, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavassuti firistodagoni Khud on bandagonashro, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista kardaand, ba on bashorat medikh'ad. Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Man az shumo dar ivazi tablig'am muzd namekhokh'am, ch'uz iak chiz, ki manfiati on ba khudaton barmegardad. Chizi az shumo mekhostaam on ast, ki maro ba khotiri k'arobati kheshovandii dar bainaton doshtaam dust bidored." Va kh'ar ki amali nek kunad, Mo dar on amal ach'rashro afzun mesozem. Dar badali iak amali nek az dakh' to kh'afsad savob va az on kh'am ach'ri beshtar megirad. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Omurzandai Siposguzor ast. Gunokh'i bandagoni tavbakorashro meomurzad va ba amalkh'oi kholisonaashon bo duchand sokhtani ach'rashon izkh'ori siposguzori mekunad.

24) Mushrikon mepindorand, ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) K'ur'onro az nazdi khesh bofta, onro bardurug' ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat medikh'ad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ch'avobi gumoni botilashon meguiad: "Ei Paiombar, agar k'asdi bar Man durug' boftan dar dilat khutur kunad, bar dilat mukh'r mezanam." Vak'te chunin kh'olat pesh naomada ast, pas in daleli on ast, ki K'ur'on az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omada ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) botilro makh'v mesozad va kh'ak'ro ba sababi kalimotash bok'i meguzorad. Ba durusti, U Donandai asrori k'albi bandagon ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest.

25) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki tavbai bandagonashro az kufru ma'siiat agar tavba kunand, mepazirad va az a'moli badi onkh'o darmeguzarad va on chi anch'om medikh'ed, medonad. Korkh'oiaton az U pushida namemonad va dar ivazi on ba shumo ch'azoi sazovor khokh'ad dod.

26) Va duoi kasonero, ki imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om medikh'and, mepazirad va bar onkh'o az fazlash bo dodani on chi darkhost nakardaand, afzun mesozad. Va baroi kofiron dar ruzi k'iiomat azobi nikh'oiat sakht ast.

27) Va agar Khudo rizk'ro baroi kh'amai bandagonash farokh mekard, begumon dar zamin khudpisandiiu sitam mekardand va az kh'addi loik'i bandagi tach'ovuz menamudand. Valekin Parvardigor rizk'ro on andoza kam io ziiod furud meovarad, ki Khud mekhokh'ad. Ba durusti ki U ba akh'voli bandagonash Bokhabari Bino ast. Bakhshidan va boz doshtani rizk' az rui kh'ikmati ilokh'i surat megirad.

28) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki boronro bar bandagonash ba'd az on ki az on noumed meshavand, furud meorad va boroni osori rakh'matashro parokanda karda, zaminro bo ruionidani nabotot zinda mesozad. Va U Korsozi korkh'oi bandagon buda, dar kh'ama kh'olatkh'o Sutuda ast.

29) Va osmonkh'ovu zamin va on chi dar on az makhluk'oti shigiftangez pakh'n namuda ast, az alomatkh'oi iagonagi va k'udrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va U bar ch'am'ovarii shumo baroi bozpursi va ch'azo kh'ar vak't inro bikhokh'ad, K'odir ast. Chunonchi bori nakhust ofaridani khaloik' Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro och'iz nasokht, kh'amin guna dubora ch'am' kardanashon niz Uro och'iz namesozad.

30) Va ei mardum, on chi az musibat dar ch'on io molaton rasida ast, kh'amaash ba sababi gunokh'onest, ki khudaton anch'om dodaed. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az beshtari gunokh'onaton darguzashta, baroi on much'ozotaton namekunad.

31) Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) much'ozotatonro khokh'ad, shumo bar nach'ot ioftan az on k'odir nested. Va shumo ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' korsoz va iovar nadored, ki korkh'oiatonro sarparasti kunad va ioriaton doda, az uk'ubat rakh'oiaton sozad.
32) Va kishtikh'oi dar bakh'r kh'arakatkunandai ba e'tibori balandi monandi kukh'kh'o, az alomatkh'oi k'udrat va iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

33) Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bikhokh'ad, bodkh'oi takh'rikdikh'andai kishtikh'oro az vazidan boz medorad, pas az kh'arakatashon bar rui bakh'r boz meistand. Kh'amono dar on chi az ofaridani kishtikh'o va musakhkhar sokhtani bodkh'o zikr karda shud, baroi kh'ar kasi dar musibat bisior sabrkunandavu dar ne'mat bisior shukrguzor dalolatkh'oi ravshani k'udrati ilokh'i ast.

34) Io agar khokh'ad, kishtikh'oro ba sababi gunokh'one, ki mardum anch'om medikh'and, bo firistodani tundbodkh'o g'ark' megardonad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az bisiori gunokh'i mardum darguzashta, much'ozotashon namekunad.

35) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chunin mekunad, to on kasone, ki dar borai oiatkh'oi ilokh'i bo kh'adafi botil sokhtanashon ch'idol mekunand, vak'ti g'ark'shavii kishtikh'o bidonand, ki az kh'alokat ch'oii gurez nadorand. Baroi kh'amin, onkh'o dar on lakh'zakh'o tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui meorand va g'airi Uro az iod mebarorand.

36) Pas on chi ba shumo mardum az doroi, mansab, farzand va g'aira doda meshavad, matoi zavoliobandai kh'aioti dunio ast. Va on chi az ne'mati abadii ch'annat nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omoda shuda ast, bekh'tar va poiandatar ast. In ne'mati abadii ch'annat khos baroi on kasone omoda shuda ast, ki ba Allokh'u paiombaronash imon meorand va mudom dar korkh'oi khud tankh'o bar Parvardigorashon tavakkul mekunand.

37) Va kasone, ki az gunokh'oni kabira va k'abekh' duri mech'uiand va chun az amal io sukhani kase khashmgin shavand, az lag'zhishash darmeguzarand va ch'azoiash namedikh'and. In darguzashtan az lag'zhishi digaron agar dar on khair va manfiat boshad, az rui fazli onkh'ost.

38) Va kasone, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va tarki mamnuot ba da'vati Parvardigorashon posukh medikh'and va namozro dar komiltarin surati on barpo medorand va bo kh'am oidi korkh'oi mukh'im mashvarat mekunand va az on chi ruziashon sokhtaem, ba khotiri kasbi rizoi ilokh'i dar rokh'i khair kharch' menamoiand.

39) Va kasone, ki chun ba onkh'o zulm rasad, az zolim agar loik'i afv naboshad, baroi kh'ifzi izzati khesh intik'om mesitonand. Sitonidani intik'om az zolim, makhsusan dar surate, ki bakhshidanash ba manfiati kor nest, kh'ak'k'i onkh'ost.

40) Ch'azoi badi ba monandi on badi ast. Kh'ar ki khokh'ad, metavonad kh'ak'k'i khudro bigirad, ammo ba sharte, ki nisbat ba tarafi digar zulm nakunad va az kh'ad naguzarad. Pas kh'ar ki az shakhsi nisbatash badi karda guzasht namuda, ch'azoiash nadikh'ad va tiragii baini khud va barodarashro islokh' sozad, pas podoshash bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oero, ki dar ch'on, mol va nomusi mardumon sitam mekunand, dust namedorad, balki ba in toifa sakht nafrat dorad.
41) Va iak'inan kh'ar ki ba'd az mavridi sitam k'aror giriftanash az zolim intik'om sitonad, pas bar in ch'amoai intik'ogiranda sarzanish va uk'ubate nest, zero onkh'o kh'ak'k'i kheshro giriftaand.

42) Kh'amono sarzanish va uk'ubat bar kasone ast, ki ba mardum zulm ravo mebinand va dar zamin murtakibi ma'siiat meshavand va banokh'ak' kibr va fasod mekunand. Dar okhirat in toifaro azobi dardovar ast.

43) Va kh'ar shakhse bar ozori digaron sabr mekunad va gunokh'ashonro mebakhshad, in sabr namudan va bakhshidan baroi on shakhs va ch'omea neki ovarda, in du khislat az talaboti shar' va sazovori sitoish buda, tankh'o bandai az akhlok' doroi sakh'mi azim ba on komiob megardad.

44) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro az kh'idoiat makh'rum sokhta, baroiash tavfik' nadikh'ad, pas on banda ba'd az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korsoze nadorad, ki korashro sarparasti kunad. Va kasone, ki bo kufr va gunokh' bar ch'onashon sitam mekunand, chun ruzi k'iiomat azobro mushokh'ida kunand, onkh'oro mebini, ki bo tamanno meguiand: "Oio baroi bozgasht ba dunio rokh'e kh'ast, ki mo bargardem va az kardakh'oiamon tavba kunem?"

45) Va ei Paiombar, tu zolimonro mushokh'ida mekuni, ki bar otashi duzakh peshkash karda meshavand, dar kh'ole onkh'o ba illati khoriiu rasvoi furutanand, in sitamkoron az tarsi shiddati azobi ch'akh'annam ba sui otash az gushai chashm duzdona nigokh' mekunand. Va mu'minon meguiand: "Kh'amono ziionkoroni vok'ei bandagone kh'astand, ki ruzi k'iiomat az sababi giriftori ba uk'ubat bar ch'oni khud va akh'li oilaashon ziion rasondaand." Ogokh' boshed! Beshak, on kasone, ki bo kufru ma'siiat bar ch'oni kheshtan sitam kardaand, dar azobi abadii k'at'noshavanda k'aror khokh'and girift.

46) Va in sitamgaron dar k'iiomat iovarone nadorand, ki ba onkh'o bo rakh'o namudanashon az uk'ubati ilokh'i kumak rasonand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro az tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak' makh'rum sokhta, gumrokh' gardonad, pas baroiash kh'ech' rokh'i rasonanda ba kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak' mavch'ud nest.

47) Ei mardum, da'vati Parvardigoratonro k'abl az omadani ruzi k'iiomat az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u), ki kh'ech' kas onro bargardonda nametavonad, bo shitoftan ba anch'omi ibodat va adami ta'khir bipazired. Shumo on ruz baroi panokh' burdan kh'ech' panokh'gokh'e nadored va gunokh'oni dar dunio sodir kardai khudro bo kh'ech' rokh' inkor karda kh'am nametavoned.

48) Ei Paiombar, ba'd az in agar onkh'o az farmonat rui gardonand, pas Mo turo nazoratgari a'molashon nafiristodaem. Bar zimmai tu tankh'o tablig'i amri ilokh'i ast. Kh'isobashon bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va beshak, chun Mo az sui Khud ba inson rakh'matero ba misli tavongari, tandurusti va monandi on bichashonem, bo on shod megardad va agar ba insonkh'o ba sababi gunokh'onashon badiiu nokhushi birasad, pas iak'inan tabiati onkh'o dar barobari ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i nosiposi ast, ne'matkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro shukr namekunand, balki az tak'diri bokh'ikmatash khashmgin meshavand.

49) Molikiiat va kh'ukmfarmoii osmonkh'o va zamin khos az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Kh'ar on chi az ch'insi nar io moda va g'airi onro khokh'ad, meofarad. Ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, dukhtaronro mebakhshad va az pisar makh'rumash mesozad va ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, pisaronro mebakhshad va az dukhtar makh'rumash mesozad-

50) io ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, dukhtaru pisarro iakch'o mebakhshad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, nozoi megardonad. Kh'amono U Donoi Tavono ast. On chi dar oianda ba vuk'u' mepaivandad, medonad. In alomati kamoli ilm va kh'ikmati Ust. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida namemonad va chize notavonash namesozad.

51) Baroi kh'ech' odami durust nest, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo vai sukhan biguiad, magar bo paig'om (ilkh'om va g'airi on) io az pushti parda (sukhanashro meshunavad, Uro namebinad) io ba suiash farishtaero misli Ch'abrail mefiristad. Pas farishtai firistodashuda ba paiombare, ki az nav'i odami ast, bo rukhsati ilokh'i on chiro Khudo khokh'ad, paig'om mefiristad. Kh'amono U dar Zotu sifotash az kh'ama Bartar, dar ofarinish, ta'iini tak'diri khaloik' va akh'komash Bokh'ikmat ast.

52) Va Ei Paiombar, chunonchi Mo ba paiombaroni guzashta paig'om firistodem, kh'amchunin ba tu az nazdi Khud K'ur'oni monand ba ch'onro paig'om firistodem. K'abl az nozilshavii K'ur'on chi budani kitobkh'oi paiombaroni peshin va niz chi budani kh'ak'ik'ati imonro namedonisti, valekin Mo K'ur'onro Nure gardonidem, ki ba sababi on az bandagoni Khesh kh'ar kiro khokh'em, kh'idoiat mekunem. Va begumon tu mardumro ba sui rokh'i rost (dini Islom) rakh'namoi mesozi,-

53) rokh'i Khudoe, ki kh'ar chi dar osmonkh'o va kh'ar chi dar zamin ast, az rui ofarinish, molikiiat va tadbir tankh'o az Ust. Ogokh' boshed! Tamomi korkh'o az rui tak'dir va tadbir fak'at ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barmegardad.
1) "Kh'o. Mim" Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) Savgand ba K'ur'oni ravshansozandai rokh'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'.
3) Mo in Kitobro Kalomi ba zaboni arabi k'aror dodem, to shumo mardumi arab maonii onro bifakh'med va onro ba digaron birasoned.
4) Va ba durusti, in K'ur'on dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz, nazdi Mo doroi mak'omi baland va doroi kh'ikmat ast. Oiatkh'oi on dar bobi amr va nakh'i az ch'umlai oiatkh'oi mukh'kami g'airi mutashobekh' ast.

5) Oio Mo shumoro ba illati on ki shirk va ma'siiati bisior sodir mekarded, ba kh'olaton voguzorem va nozil sokhtani K'ur'onro bar shumo tark namoem?! Kh'ech' gokh' chunin namekunem, balki rakh'mati Mo aksi inro tak'ozo menamoiad.
6) Va Mo dar baini ummatkh'oi k'abli paiombaroni ziiod firistoda budem.
7) Va ba on ummatkh'o kh'ech' paiombare az sui Khudo nameomad, magar on ki uro maskhara mekardand.

8) Pas Mo on ummatkh'oi az k'avmi tu nerumandtarro kh'alok kardem. Binobar in, az kh'aloksozii k'avmkh'oi az ummatkh'oi guzashta notavontar och'izi namekashem. Va dar K'ur'on dostoni kh'alokati ummatkh'oi peshin ba misli k'avmi Od, Samud, Lut va Sokinoni Madian guzashta ast.

9) Va agar tu Paiombar az mushrikoni takzibkunanda bipursi, ki "Osmonkh'o va zaminro ki ofarida ast?", iak'inan dar ch'avob meguiand: "Onkh'oro Khudoi kh'amesha G'olibi Donandai kh'ama chiz ofarida ast."

10) U Ofaridgorest, ki zaminro baroi shumo ba monandi gakh'vora makoni osoish gardonid, rui on ba osoni rokh' meraved, az ne'matkh'oiash istifoda mebared va baroi shumo dar zamin va kukh'u vodikh'oi on rokh'kh'o padid ovard, to dar sairu gashti kheshtan bo istifoda az on rokh'i khudro paido kuned.

11) Va U On Ofaridgorest, ki az osmon ba andozai niiozi shumo va chakh'orpoionu ziroataton ob nozil sokht, pas Mo ba vositai on ob zamini khushki begiiokh'ro zinda gardondem. Chunonchi Khudo in sarzamini khushki begiiokh'ro bo ruionidani rastanikh'o zinda gardond, kh'amin guna shumoro bo bakhshidani kh'aioti dubora az k'abrkh'oiaton berun meorad.

12) Va U Zotest, ki tamomi nav'kh'oi makhluk'ot ba misli shabu ruz, mardu zan va g'airaro ofarid va baroi shumo az kishtikh'o va chakh'orpoion markabkh'oero k'aror dod, ki dar safarkh'oi khud bar onkh'o savor meshaved. Dar dario az kishti va dar khushki az chakh'orpoion istifoda mebared.

13) Khudo in markabkh'oro baroi shumo omoda sokht, to dar safarkh'oi khesh bar pushtashon k'aror gired, sipas chun bar kishtikh'o va chakh'orpoion k'aror girifted, ne'mati Parvardigoraton oidi taskhiri savorakh'oro ba iod biiored va va bo zabon bigued: "Az kh'ama guna sharik va nuk'son poku muk'addas ast On Zote, ki in markabro baroiamon musakhkhar gardond, chunonchi khokh'em, bar on farmonravoi mekunem va kh'ol on ki agar taskhiri Khudo namebud, mo bo nerui ch'ismonii khesh tok'ati rom sokhtani onro nadoshtem-
14) va k'at'an mo ba'd az marg baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo iagona sui Parvardigoramon barmegardem."

15) Va mushrikon mu'tak'id budand, ki ba'zei bandagoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) porai az U tavalludshuda meboshand. Onkh'o meguftand: "Farishtagon dukhtaroni Allokh' kh'astand." Beshak, insoni guiandai in sukhan kofiri kufru zalolatash oshkor ast.

16) Ei mushrikon, oio shumo e'tik'od dored, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi ofarid, dukhtaronro baroi Khudash girifta va pisaronro baroi shumo barguzida ast?! Vok'ean in e'tik'odi shumo tak'simoti zolimona ast!

17) Va vatk'e iakei onkh'o ba vilodati dukhtar, ki onro shabekh'i Khudoi Mekh'rubon k'aror medikh'ad, bashorat doda shavad, chekh'raash az shiddati g'amu andukh' siiokh' va vuch'udash pur az khashm megardad. Pas chi guna ba Khudo chizero mansub medonad, ki onro khudash namekhokh'ad?!

18) Oio mushrikon ba Parvardigor makhluk'ero nisbat medikh'and, ki dar zaru zevar parvarish doda meshavad va baionu mantik'ash dar ch'idol ba sababi za'fash ravshan nest va az khud kh'imoiat karda nametavonad?!

19) Va mushrikon farishtagonro, ki bandagoni Allokh'i Mekh'rubon kh'astand, ch'insi modina nomidaand. Oio zamoni ofaridani farishtagon kh'ozir budand va az kh'amin tarik' ma'lum kardand, ki onkh'o modinaand?! Begumon farishtagon in shakh'odatashonro menavisand va ruzi k'iiomat az on pursida shuda, ba illati durug' guftanashon uk'ubat meshavand.

20) Va onkh'o az tak'dir kh'uch'ch'at ovarda meguiand: "Agar Khudo mekhost, mo farishtagonro ibodat namekardem. Modom ki ibodati mo bar asosi irodai Khudo surat megirad, pas ma'lum meshavad, ki U az in koramon rozi ast." Mushrikon dar in bobat donish nadorand. Onkh'o beshak, durug' meguiand.

21) Magar Mo ba in mushrikon k'abl az K'ur'on kitobe dodaem, ki ibodati g'airi Khudoro baroiashon durust medonist va ba kh'amin sabab onkh'o ba on kitob ustuvorona chang mezanand va az on kh'uch'ch'at meorand?!

22) Ne, kh'argiz chunin kore nashuda ast, balki onkh'o az tak'lid kh'uch'ch'at ovarda meguiand: "Kh'amono mo padaroni kheshtanro bar oiin va rokh'i arzandai pairavi ioftem. Beshak, onkh'o butkh'oro meparastidand. Va mo begumon dar ibodat bar paii onkh'o rafta, rokh'iofta kh'astem."

23) Va ei Paiombar, chunonchi mushrikoni k'avmat takzib namudand va dar amali shirkashon tak'lidkori ba padaronashonro kh'uch'ch'at k'aror dodand, kh'amin guna Mo k'abl az bi'sati tu dar kh'ech' iak dekh'ae paiombari bimdikh'andaero nafiristodem, ch'uz on ki rakh'baroni ne'matparvardai onkh'o meguftand: "Mo padaronamonro bar oiin va rokh'i arzandai pairavi ioftaem va iak'inan mo az paii onkh'o pairavi mekunem." Binobar in, k'avmi tu avvalin gurukh'i dar kufr va shirk tak'lidgari guzashtagonashon nestand.

24) Paiombarashon ba onkh'o meguft: "Oio agarchi man baroi shumo dinero ovardaam, ki az rokh'i padaroni kheshtanro bar on paido kardaaton bekh'tar ast, bo vuch'udi in az rokh'i padaronaton pairavi mekuned?!" Rakh'baroni ne'matparvardaashon meguftand: "Begumon mo ba da'vatu kh'idoiate, ki tu va paiombaroni k'abli bo on firistoda shudaed, kofir kh'astem."
25) Dar natich'a, Mo az ummatkh'oi guzashtai takzibgari paiombaron intik'om girifta, kh'alokashon sokhtem. Pas biandesh, ki ok'ibati onkh'o chi guna bud. Beshak, ok'ibati korashon nikh'oiat bad bud.
26) Va ei Paiombar, zamonero iod kun, ki Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba padarash va k'avmash guft: "Kh'amono man az on butkh'oe, ki g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ibodat mekuned, bezoram,-
27) g'air az On Zote, ki maro ofarida ast. Pas U maro begumon ba pairavii dinash, ki ba naf'i man ast, rakh'namoi khokh'ad kard."

28) Va Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) kalimai tavkh'id (Lo ilokh'a illallokh')-ro dar nasli minba'dai khesh poidor sokht, to onkh'o bo tavba kardan az shirku ma'siiat ba sui Khudo bargardand. Binobar in, kh'amesha dar baini nasli Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) bandagone mavch'udand, ki Khudoro ba iagonagi parastida, az shirk duri mech'uiand.

29) Man in ch'amoai mushrikro zud kh'alok nakardam, balki onkh'o va padaroni k'ablan guzashtaashonro to vak'ti baroiashon omadani K'ur'on va paiombari oshkorsozandai akh'komi shariat (Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)) bo bok'i guzoshtan dar dunio bakh'ramand gardonidam.

30) Va vak'te ba onkh'o K'ur'on, ki Kitobi barkh'ak' ast, omad, guftand: "In K'ur'on ch'odu ast. Mukh'ammad moro bo in rokh' ch'odu mekunad. Va Ba durusti ki mo ba in Kitob kofir kh'astem. Kh'ech' gokh' ba on imon nameorem."

31) Va mushrikoni takzibgar guftand: "Charo Khudo in K'ur'onro ba ch'oi Mukh'ammadi fak'iri iatim, ba iake az du mardi ba e'tibori ch'okh'u mol buzurgi Makka va Toif furud naovard?" Murod az on du mard Valid ibni Uk'ba va Urva ibni Mas'udi Sak'afi bud.

32) Ei Paiombar, magar rakh'mati Parvardigori turo onkh'o tak'sim mekunand va onro ba kh'ar ki khokh'and, medikh'and va az kh'ar ki khokh'and, boz medorand?! Mo dar baini eshon asbobi ruziashonro dar zindagonii dunio tak'sim kardaem va dar rizk' darach'akh'oi ba'zeashonro az ba'zei digarashon bolo burda, iak iddaro fak'ir va iak iddaro g'ani sokhtaem, to ba'zeashon dar koru pesha zertobei ba'zei digar gardand. Va rakh'mati Parvardigorat bar bandagonash dar okhirat az on chi onkh'o dar in dunio ch'am' meorand, bekh'tar ast.

33) Va agar chunin namebud, ki vak'te mardum dar baini kofiron rizk'i farokhro mushokh'ida kunand, kh'amaashon dar kufr ummati vokh'id megardand, begumon Mo baroi khonakh'oi kasone, ki ba Khudoi Mekh'rubon kofir meshavand, sak'fkh'o va nardbonkh'oi nuk'ragin k'aror medodem, ki bo on nardbonkh'o ba sui manzilkh'oi balandashon mebaromadand.
34) Va baroi khonakh'oiashon darvozakh'oi nuk'ragin va baroi khudashon takhtkh'oi nuk'ragin k'aror medodem, ki bar on takhtkh'o takia mekardand.

35) Va baroi onkh'o tillo medodem. Va tamomi in nombarshudakh'o ch'uz matoi kh'aioti dunio chize nest. Sudash ba illati fanopaziri nikh'oiat andak ast. Va ne'matkh'oi abadii okhirat dar nazdi Parvardigorat khosi bandagoni parkh'ezkor buda, az dunio bekh'tar va poiandatar ast.

36) Va kh'ar ki ba K'ur'on bo nigokh'i noustuvorona nazar kunad, ki uro ba rui gardondan az on birasonad, Mo Shaitonero kh'amchun uk'ubat bar vai musallat mesozem. Dar natich'a, Shaiton kh'amnishinash gashta, gumrokh'iashro afzun mesozad.

37) Va begumon on shaitonkh'oi bar bandagoni az K'ur'on ruigardon musallatgashta onkh'oro az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barmegardonand, dar natich'a, onkh'o amri Khudoro ba ch'o nameorand va az on chi nakh'i namuda ast, duri namech'uiand va eshon mepindorand, ki ba sui kh'ak' rokh'ioftagonand. Baroi kh'amin, az zalolati khud tavba namekunand.

38) Kori bandai az K'ur'on va zikri Khudo ruigardonida ba kh'amin minvol idoma meiobad, to on ki vak'te ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Mo oiad, orzu karda meguiad: "Ei kh'amnishinam, koshki baini man va baini tu ba andozai masofai baini mashrik' va mag'rib duri mebud. Chunki tu kh'amnishini bade budai."

39) Va imruz dar uk'ubat sharik budanaton kh'argiz ba shumo foidae namebakhshad, zero shumo bo kufru gunokh' bar ch'oni khesh sitam kardaed. Imruz sharikonaton az azobaton chizero bar zimmai khud namegirand.

40) Kh'amono inkh'o az shunidani kh'ak' kar va az didani on kurand. Pas oio tu ei Paiombar, az ukh'dai shunavonidani karkh'o io rakh'namoii kurkh'o io rakh'namoii on kase, ki az rokh'i rost dar gumrokh'ii oshkor k'aror dorad, baromada metavoni?!
41) Pas agar turo k'abl az on ki onkh'oro duchori uk'ubat gardonem, bo mironidanat az bain barem, pas beshak, Mo az onkh'o bo ch'azo dodanashon dar dunio va okhirat intik'om megirem.

42) Io agar Mo ba'ze az uk'ubati ba onkh'o va'da dodai Khudro ba tu nishon dikh'em, dar in surat intik'omgiriero khokh'i did, ki eshon az on kh'argiz rakh'oi nameioband, chunki begumon Mo bar onkh'o Tavono kh'astem. Kofiron dar kh'ech' kor Moro mag'lub sokhta nametavonand.

43) Ei Paiombar, modom ki chunin ast, pas ba on chi ba sui tu vakh'i meshavad, ustuvorona chang bizan va amal bikun. Chunki tu vok'ean dar rokh'i durust k'aror dori. Dar in rokh' kh'ech' pechidagi va pushidagie nest. Kh'ama chiz vozekh' ast.

44) Va kh'amono in K'ur'on baroi tu Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va baroi k'avmat moiai sharafi buzurg ast. Va beshubkh'a, shumo dar ruzi k'iiomat az imon ovardan ba K'ur'on, pairavi kardan az kh'idoiatkh'oiash va da'vati mardum ba sui on pursida meshaved.
45) Va ei Paiombar, on firistodagonamonro, ki k'abl az bi'sati tu barangekhtaem, bipurs, ki "Oio Mo dar ibodat ch'uz Khudoi Mekh'rubon ma'budkh'oi digar k'aror dodaem, ki parastida shavand?!"

46) Va iak'inan Mo Muso (alaikh'is salom)-ro bo mu'ch'izakh'oi Khud ba sui Fir'avn va ashrofoni k'avmash firistodem. Pas vai ba onkh'o guft: "Beguftugu, man firistodai Parvardigori kulli makhluk'ot kh'astam."
47) Pas vak'te Muso bo mu'ch'izakh'oiamon nazdi Fir'avnu ashrofoni k'avmash omad, nogakh'on onkh'o ba mu'ch'izakh'o tamaskhuromez khandidand.

48) Va Mo ba Fir'avn va ashrofoni k'avmash kh'ech' kh'uch'ch'atero oid ba durustii on chi Muso (alaikh'is salom) ovarda ast, nishon namedodem, magar in ki on az kh'uch'ch'ati k'abliash buzurgtar bud. Va Mo onkh'oro ba azobi dunio duchor kardem, to az kufri khud bargardand, ammo in kor sudashon nabakhshid.

49) Va vak'te porae az azob ba onkh'o rasid, ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) guftand: "Ei ch'odugar, Parvardigoratro bo on chi ba tu zikr karda ast, ki agar imon orem, azobamonro dur mesozad, duo kun. Agar Parvardigori tu azobro dur sozad, begumon mo kh'idoiatioftai mu'min megardem."
50) Pas chun Mo az onkh'o uk'ubatro bartaraf sokhtem, ba nogokh' eshon akh'di khudro shikastand va ba on vafo nakardand.

51) Va Fir'avn dar baini k'avmash bo fakhr az saltanatash fariod karda guft: "Ei k'avmi man, oio podshokh'ii Misr az man nest?! Va oio in nakh'rkh'oi Nil az zeri k'asrkh'oi man ch'ori nameshavand?! Pas oio saltanat va azamati maro namebined?!
52) Balki man az in Muso, ki rondashudai notavoni kh'ak'ir ast va ba illati dar zabonash uk'da doshtanash k'arib sukhanashro khub baion karda nametavonad, bekh'taram?!
53) Modome Muso paiombari Khudost, pas charo Parvardigorash baroi isboti durustii paiombariash bar vai dastmonakh'oi tilloi furud naovarda ast io farishtagon bo vai paiopai naomadaand?!"

54) Fir'avn dar natich'ai in sukhanon bo istifoda az sabukmag'zii k'avmash onkh'oro takh'rik dod, pas eshon takh'ti ta'siri guftakh'oiash k'aror girifta, uro itoat kardand. Zero Ba durusti ki onkh'o k'avmi az itoati Khudo khorich' budand.
55) Pas chun Fir'avn va k'avmash bo idoma dodani kufr Moro ba g'azab ovardand, az onkh'o intik'om giriftem, pas kh'amagii onkh'oro g'ark' sokhtem.

56) Pas Ei Paiombar, Mo Fir'avn va k'avmashro baroi kofironi k'avmat va digar mardum peshgom va moiai ibrat gardonidem, to kh'ar ki khokh'ad, az sarguzashtashon ibrat girad va az kirdorashon duri ch'uiad.

57) Va ei Paiombar, chun Iso ibni Mariam, ki nasoro uro ba sifati ma'budi kheshtan mekh'isoband, dalel va misol k'aror doda shud, nogakh'on k'avmat ba sababi in dalel va misol az shodiiu surur fariod mekardand. Vak'te Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba mushrikon oiati "Kh'amono shumo akh'li shirk va on chi g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted, inchunin insonkh'o va ch'inkh'oe, ki az amali shirki shumo rozi kh'astand, otashangezi duzakh kh'asted, shumo bo ma'budkh'oiaton ba duzakh medaroed."-ro tilovat kardand, Abdullokh' ibni Zib'arii Tamimi ba on kas guft: "Oio nasoro Isoi pisari Mariamro nameparastand, kh'ol on ki tu megui, Isoi Masekh' paiombar va iake az bandagoni solekh'i Khudo bud?! Agar tibk'i oiati khondaat Iso dar otash k'aror girad, mo roziem, ki kh'amrokh'i vai ba duzakh vorid shavem."
Chun mushrikon in "dalel" va misoli zikrkardai Abdullokh' ibni Zib'arii Tamimiro shunidand, khursandona fariod kardand.
Pas Khudo dar raddi onkh'o oiati "Ba durusti, kasone, ki (monandi Iso) az akh'li saodat budanashon dar ilmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guzashta ast, onkh'o az duzakh dur karda meshavand." [1] -ro furud ovard.

58) Va onkh'o dar idoma guftand: "Oio ma'budkh'oi mo bekh'tarand io Iso ibni Mariam?!"Abdullokh' ibni Zib'arii Tamimi va amsolash in dalelu misolro baroi rasidan ba kh'ak'ik'at ech'od nakardand, balki bo mak'sadi dust doshtani ch'idoli nokh'ak' ech'od namudand. Balki onkh'o tabiatan k'avmi khusumatgari iakrav kh'astand.

59) Isoi pisari Mariam, ki Mo bar vai bo dodani risolat in'om kardem, bandae besh nabud. Va Isoro baroi Bani Isroil masale k'aror dodem. Onkh'o az tarzi ofaridani vai dar borai k'udrati ilokh'i kh'uch'ch'at meovardand. Zero Parvardigor uro biduni padar ofarid, on guna ki Odam (alaikh'is salom)-ro biduni padaru modar khalk' kard.

60) Va agar Mo bikhokh'em, shumo farzandoni Odamro kh'alok mesozem va ba ch'oi shumo farishtagonero meofarem, ki dar zamin ch'oiguzini shumo meshavand, iagona Khudoro meparastand va az shirk duri mech'uiand.

61) Va Ba durusti ki nuzuli Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) alomate az alomatkh'oi buzurgtarini farorasii k'iiomat va sababi donistani nazdikshavii on ast. Zero vai dar okhiri zamon furud meoiad. Pas dar borai vuk'ui k'iiomat shak makuned va maro dar on chi az sui Khudo ba shumo ovardaam pairavi namoed. In paiomi ovardai man rokh'i rostu durust ast. Dar on kh'ech' nav' kach'i nest.
62) Va naboiad Shaiton bo takh'rik va ig'vogarii khud shumoro az rokh'i rost bargardonad. Zero Shaiton baroi shumo dushmani oshkor ast.

63) Va vak'te Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) bo dalelkh'oi ravshani nishondikh'andai durustii risolatash sui k'avmash omad, ba onkh'o guft: "Man az nazdi Khudo ba shumo kh'ikmat ovardam, to onro ta'limaton dikh'am va to ba'zei on chiro az k'abili umuri dini, ki dar boraash bo iakdigar ikhtilof mekuned, baroiaton ravshan sozam. Pas az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi dasturot va khuddori az mamnuotash bitarsed va maro dar on chi shumoro amr va az on chi nakh'i mekunam, pairavi kuned.
64) Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Parvardigori man va Parvardigori shumo ast. Pas iagona Uro biparasted. In iaktoparasti rokh'i rostu durust ast."

65) Pas az baini nasronikh'o, ki Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) ba sui onkh'o mab'us gashta bud, gurukh'kh'oe dar borai vai ikhtilof namudand. Iak gurukh' Isoro Khudo, gurukh'i duium pisari Khudo va gurukh'i seium uro bo modarash Khudo meguftand. Pas voi bar kasone, ki bo tavsifi Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) ba iake az in vasfkh'o bar ch'oni khud sitam kardaand, ki ba uk'ubati dardovari ruzi k'iiomat duchor megardand.

66) Oio gurukh'kh'oi dar borai Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) ikhtilofkunanda tankh'o muntaziri on kh'astand, ki k'iiomat nogakh'oni ba onkh'o oiad, kh'ol on ki onkh'o omadanashro ekh'sos namekunand?! Agar k'iiomat dar kh'olate faro rasad, ki onkh'o kofirand, dar in surat ch'oiashon otashi duzakh ast.
67) Nafarone, ki dar dunio bo kh'am dar kufru gumrokh'i dust kh'astand, ruzi k'iiomat ba'zeashon dushmani ba'zei digarashon megardand, magar bandagoni parkh'ezkor, ki dustiashon k'at'noshavanda ast.

68) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o meguiad: "Ei bandagonam, imruz bar shumo az kh'odisakh'oi k'iiomat kh'arose nest va shumo baroi on ki lazzatkh'oi dunioro az dast dodaed, g'amgin namegarded.
69) Bandagone, ki ba K'ur'oni bar paiombarashon nozilkardai Mo imon doshtand, taslimshudagoni farmonu nakh'ii on budand va amri K'ur'onro ich'ro va az nakh'ii on parkh'ez mekardand.
70) Shumo va bandagoni dar imon ba shumo monand ba ch'annat daroed, dar onch'o bo noil shudan ba ne'matkh'oi ch'ovidona shodmon khokh'ed shud."

71) Khodimoni akh'li ch'annat bo zarfkh'oi tilloi va k'adakh'kh'oi bedasta dar atrofi ch'annatiion davr mezanand va dar ch'annat kh'ar chi nafsashon mekhokh'ad va az didanash chashmkh'o lazzat mebarand, mavch'ud ast va shumo akh'li ch'annat dar ch'annat abadi memoned. Kh'argiz az on berun nameshaved.
72) Va in ch'annati tavsifshuda kh'amon makonest, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro az rui fazli Khud dar ivazi a'molaton ba shumo meros doda ast.
73) Baroiaton dar ch'annat mevakh'oi mukhtalifi ziiod ast. Shumo az on mevakh'o mekhured.

Chun Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar oiatkh'oi peshin podoshi bandagoni parkh'ezkorro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin ch'azoi badkoronro baion namuda guft:
74) Kh'amono kofiron va mushrikon ruzi k'iiomat dar azobi duzakh abadi memonand.
75) Azobi duzakh az onkh'o sabuk gardonda nameshavad va onkh'o dar on azob az rakh'mati ilokh'i noumedand.
76) Va vak'te kofironu mushrikonro dokhili duzakh mesozem, Mo ba onkh'o sitam nakardaem, valekin eshon khud bo kufru shirk bar ch'oni khud sitam kardaand.

77) Va onkh'o nigakh'boni duzakhro fariod karda meguiand: "Ei Molik, [farishtai muvazzaf ba nigakh'bonii duzakh ] az Parvardigorat darkhost kun, ki moro bimironad, to az uk'ubat biosoem." Molik dar ch'avobashon meguiad: "Begumon shumo dar uk'ubat abadi memoned. Kh'argiz namemired va azobaton k'at' nameshavad."
78) Ba durusti ki Mo dar dunio baroiaton kh'ak'ro ovardem, valekin beshtari shumo kh'ak'ro namepisandided va az on nafrat doshted.

79) Agar mushrikon vobasta ba k'atli Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) makr kardand va nak'shai onro tarkh'rezi namudand, pas Mo begumon alaikh'i onkh'o chorai az dasisaashon ustuvortarro omoda kardem.

80) Io mepindorand, ki Mo rozkh'oi pinkh'oni va sukhanoni bo iakdigar gushaki mekardaashonro nameshunavem?! Bale, Mo inkh'oro meshunavem va farishtagonamon dar nazdashon on chiro anch'om medikh'and, paivasta menavisand.

81) Ei Paiombar, ba on kasone, ki Khudoro Sokh'ibi dukhtar medonand, dar kh'ole ki U az in tukh'matashon pok ast, bigu: "Agar ba farzi misol, Khudo farzand medosht, pas, man az nakhustin ibodatkunandagoni on farzand mebudam."
82) Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin, Parvardigori Arshi azim az on chi mushrikon Uro tavsif mekunand, ki guio sharik va zanu farzand dorad, poku muk'addas ast.

83) Ei Paiombar, modome chunin ast, pas onkh'oro to vak'ti mulok'oti on ruzashon, ki dar on ba duchor shudani uk'ubat va'da doda meshavand, rakh'o bisoz, to dar botilashon furu ravand va bozi kunand. Murod az ruzi va'dashuda k'iiomat ast.

84) Va Khudo On Zotest, ki dar osmon Ma'budi barkh'ak' va dar zamin Ma'budi barkh'ak' ast. Va U dar ofarinishi khaloik', tak'dir va tadbiri korkh'o Kh'akimu Donandai akh'voli bandagon ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nest.

85) Va Bobarakat ast On Zote, ki molikiiati osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini on du tankh'o az oni Ust. Va ilmi zamoni barposhavii k'iiomat fak'at nazdi Ust. Kase ch'uz U dar boraash ogokh'i nadorad. Va ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo iagona ba sui U bargardonda meshaved.

86) Va on ma'budkh'oi sun'i, ki mushrikon onkh'oro ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparastand, nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moliki shafoat nestand, ch'uz kasone ba monandi Isoi Masekh', Uzair va farishtagon, ki ba iagonagii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shokh'idi dodaand, kh'ol on ki onkh'o guvokh'ii dodaashonro medonand.

87) Va agar tu az mushrikon bipursi, ki "Onkh'oro ki khalk' karda ast?", kh'atman dar ch'avob "Moro Khudo khalk' karda ast" meguiand. Vak'te ba in ik'ror dorand, pas chi guna khudro az ibodati U barmegardonand?!

88) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az shikoiati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az takzibi k'avmash va az sukhani dar zimni shikoiat guftaash, ki "Ei Parvardigoram, kh'amono inkh'o k'avmeand, ki ba dini man imon nameorand", ogokh' ast.

89) Pas az in k'avmi mushrikat ru bigardon va ba onkh'o sukhane bigu, ki az zararashon emin bimoni. Pas eshon begumon azobashonro khokh'and donist. Kh'ukmi az mushrikon ru gardondani Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va guftani sukhane, ki az ziionashon emin bimonand, dar Makka k'abl az kh'ich'rat bud.
1) "Kh'o. Mim" Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) Savgand ba K'ur'oni ravshansozandai rokh'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak', -
3) iak'inan Mo K'ur'onro dar shabi bobarakati K'adr nozil sokhtem. Begumon Mo bo in K'ur'on bandagonamonro az azobamon bim medikh'em.

4) Dar on shabi bobarakati K'adr kh'amai kori ustuvori mutaallik' ba ruzii makhluk'ot, mukh'lati kh'aioti onkh'o va on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar davomi sol ba vuch'ud meorad, faisala karda meshavad.
5) Mo on korkh'oi ustuvorro az nazdi Khesh faisala mekunem. Beshak, Mo firistandai paiombaron kh'astem.

6) Firistodagonamonro baroi rakh'mati Parvardigori tu Paiombar ba mardum mefiristem. Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai guftori bandagon, Donandai kirdoru niiati onkh'o ast. Chize az U pinkh'on nest.
7) U Parvardigori osmonkh'ovu zamin va Parvardigori mavch'udoti baini onkh'ost. Agar ba in iak'in dored, pas ba Paiombaram imon ored va ch'uz Man chizero naparasted.

8) Ba ch'uz U Ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ie nest. Kh'aiot mebakhshad va memironad. G'airi U kh'ech' kas az ukh'dai bakhshidani kh'aiot va mironidan namebaroiad. U Parvardigori shumo va Parvardigori padaroni guzashtai shumo ast.
9) Mushrikon ba in kh'ak'ik'at bovar nadorand, balki onkh'o dar shak k'aror doshta, bo botili khesh mashg'uli bozi va sargarmi kh'astand.
10) Pas, ei Paiombar, muntaziri azobi k'aribulvuk'ui k'avmat bosh. Ruze, ki osmon monandi dudi oshkorero meorad. Kh'ama onro az sakhtii gurusnagi bo chashmi sar mebinand.
11) On dudmonand k'avmatro faro megirad. Ba k'avmat gufta khokh'ad shud: "In uk'ubati ba shumo rasida azobi dardovar ast."

12) On vak't onkh'o tazarru'kunon sui Parvardigorashon rui ovarda meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, uk'ubatatro az mo bartaraf bisoz. Agar onro bartaraf namoi, kh'atman mo ba Tu va Paiombarat imon meorem."
13) Chi guna mushrikoni k'avmat pand girifta, tavba menamoiand? Kh'ol on ki dar kh'ak'ik'at baroiashon Paiombari risolatash oshkor omada bud, onkh'o rostgui va amonatdoriashro medonistand?!
14) Sipas az tasdik'ash ru gardondand va dar kh'ak'k'ash guftand: "In mard az ch'onibi kase ta'lim dodashudai devona ast. U firistodai Khudo nest."
15) Kh'amono Mo chun az shumo azobro andak bartaraf sozem, kh'atman shumo ba sui kufr va takzibi khesh barmegarded.
16) Ei Paiombar, muntazir bosh, ki kofironi k'avmatro dar ruzi ch'angi Badr ba uk'ubati azim megirem. Beshak, Mo intik'omgirandaem.

17) Va beshak, Mo k'abl az in mushrikon k'avmi Fir'avnro ozmudem va ba onkh'o Firistodai giromik'adri ilokh'i, Muso omada, mardumro ba iaktoparasti va ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) faro khond.

18) Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba Fir'avn va k'avmash meguft: "Bani Isroilro ba man voguzored. Chunki onkh'o tankh'o bandagoni Khudo kh'astand. Shumo kh'ak' nadored onkh'oro g'ulomi khud sozed. Kh'amono man baroi shumo az sui Khudo firistodai amonatdoram. Dar rasondani paiomi ilokh'i amonatro rioia mekunam. Az on chizero kam va ba on chizero izofa namesozam.-
19) Va bo tarki ibodat bar Khudo kibr navarzed va khudro az digaron buzurg nashumored. Zero kh'ak'k'o, ki man ba shumo kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan ovardaam.
20) Va beshak, az on ki maro sangsor karda, ba k'atl rasoned, ba Parvardigori khesh va Parvardigori shumo panokh' mebaram.
21) Va agar paig'omi az sui Khudo ovardai maro tasdik' nakuned, pas khudro az man kanor bigired va az rasonidani zarar khuddori namoed."
22) Pas Muso (alaikh'is salom) Parvardigorashro duo karda guft: "Ba durusti, Fir'avnu pairavonash k'avmi sakht gunakh'korand. In ch'amoa loik'i onand, ki zudtar giriftori uk'ubat shavand."
23) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guft: "Pas bandagoneamro, ki akh'li imonand, dar kh'issae az shab ba rokh' baror. Begumon shumo az ch'onibi Fir'avn va k'avmash ta'k'ib khokh'ed shud.

24) Va chun bo Bani Isroil az bakh'r ba'di az zarbi asoi dastat porashavii on guzashti, onro chunonchi kh'ast, kushodai orom guzor. Chunki kh'atman Fir'avn va sipokh'iionash bo g'ark' gashtanashon dar in bakh'r kh'alok karda meshavand."
25) Fir'avnu k'avmash ba'di khud chi k'adar bog'kh'o va chashmakh'oi ch'ori
26) va chi k'adar ziroatkh'oi mukhtalif va mach'lisgokh'u maskanu diioru bozorkh'oi bekh'tarinu garonbakh'o
27) va chi k'adar ne'matkh'oe, ki dar on shodonu sarmast buda, lazzat meburdand, bok'i guzoshtand.

28) Sarguzashti Fir'avn va k'avmash kh'amin guna bud. Va Mo bog'kh'o, chashmakh'o, ziroatkh'o va mach'lisgokh'u maskanu diioru bozorkh'oi garonbakh'oi onkh'oro ba k'avmi digar ba meros dodem. Murod az "k'avmi digar" dar in oiat Bani Isroil kh'astand.
29) Pas, osmon va zamin bar Fir'avnu k'avmash kh'angomi dar bakh'r g'ark' shudan nagirist va ba onkh'o mukh'lat doda nashud, to tavba kunand.

30) Va kh'amono Mo Bani Isroilro az azobi khorkunandai Fir'avnu atrofiionash nach'ot dodem. Fir'avn va lashkariionash pisaroni Bani Isroilro mekushtand va dukhtaronashonro ba k'asdi ikh'onat zinda nigokh' medoshtand.
31) Mo onkh'oro az uk'ubati Fir'avn rakh'onidem. Kh'amono Fir'avn bandai mutakabbir va az tach'ovuzgaroni kh'addi amru dini ilokh'i bud.
32) Va iak'inan Mo Bani Isroilro az rui ilmamon bar mardumi zamonashon barguzidem. Zero te'dodi paiombaronashon ziiod bud.[2]
33) Va az mu'ch'izakh'oi ba vositai onkh'o Musoro ta'iid namudaamon, ba Bani Isroil chizkh'oero ba monandi nushobai shabekh'i asal, gushti bedona va g'airi on dodem, ki ne'mati oshkor budand.
34) Kh'amono in k'avmi mushriki takzibkunandai Makka rastokhezro inkor karda meguiand:-
35) "Ba ch'uz margi avvali mo digar marge nest. Ba'd az murdan kh'aiot vuch'ud nadorad. Va mo pas az marg zinda karda nameshavem.
36) Ei Mukh'ammad, agar tu va pairavonat dar on chi da'vo dored, ki Khudo murdagonro baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo zinda mesozad, rostgued, pas padaroni murdai moro zinda sokhta biiored."

37) Ei Paiombar, oio ba e'tibori k'udrat va k'uvvat mushrikoni takzibkunandai k'avmi tu bekh'tarand io k'avmi Tubba' va on kasone ba monandi k'avmi Od va Samud, ki k'abl az onkh'o guzashtaand. Mo kh'amai onkh'oro kh'alok kardem. Ba durusti ki eshon k'avmi sakht gunakh'kor budand.
38) Va Mo osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini on duro ba bozi va bekh'uda naofaridaem.
39) Beguftugu, Mo on duro ba khotiri kh'ikmati buzurg ofaridaem. Valekin beshtari mushrikon inro namedonand.
40) Kh'amono ruzi k'iiomat, ki Khudo baini bandagon dovari mekunad, zamoni va'dai bozpursi va ch'azoi kh'ama khaloik' ast. On ruz Khudo khalk'ro ch'am' meorad.

41) Ruze, ki kh'ech' kheshovande ba kheshovandash va kh'ech' kh'amnishine ba kh'amnishinash andaktarin manfiat namerasonad va onkh'o az azobi Khudo man' karda nameshavand. Chunki on ruz kh'ukmfarmoi tankh'o az Khudo ast. Kh'ech' kase on ch'o da'voi shokh'igari namekunad.

42) Magar kase az bandagon, ki Khudo ba vai rakh'm kunad. Bandagoni mavridi rakh'mati Khudo k'arorgirifta ruzi k'iiomat az a'moli shoistai dar dunio anch'omdodai khud sud mebarand. Ba durusti, Khudo Zoti G'olibi Mag'lubnashavandai dar ofarinish, tak'dir va tadbirash Kh'akim ast.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi k'abli k'iiomatro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin dar okhirat bar asosi ch'azo ch'udoshavii mardumro ovarda guft:
43) Begumon darakhti "Zak'k'um", ki Khudo onro dar k'a'ri ch'akh'annam ruionida ast,-
44) taomi on kasest, ki murtakibi gunokh'i azimi kufr shuda ast. Kofiron az mevai palidi on mekhurand.
45) Mevai on monandi ravg'ani siiokh' buda, az shiddati kh'arorat dar shikami duzakhiion mech'ushad,-
46) monandi ch'ushidani obi nikh'oiat purkh'arorat.
47) Ba farishtagoni posboni duzakh gufta meshavad: "Uro bigired, pas bo durushti kashon-kashon ba vasati otashi duzakh bared.
48) Sipas az boloi sarash obi ch'ush birezed. Minba'd u az azob ch'udo nameshavad."
49) Va bo sarzanish ba u gufta meshavad: "In uk'ubati dardovarro bichash. Kh'ak'k'o, ki tu ba da'voi khud dar baini k'avmat doroi izzatu karomat budi.
50) Beshak, in on uk'ubatest, ki shumo dar borai vuk'ui on shak mekarded. Ammo imruz bo mushokh'idai on shakkaton dur shud."
51) Iak'inan bandagoni parkh'ezkor bo ich'roi dasturot va khuddori az mamnuot, ruzi k'iiomat dar istik'omatgokh'i doroi amn k'aror megirand. Onkh'o az kh'ama guna nokhushi emin kh'astand,-
52) dar bustonkh'o va chashmakh'oi ch'ori.
53) Onkh'o dar ch'annat abreshimi borik va g'afs mepushand, dar kh'ole ki rubarui kh'am nishasta, ba iakdigar pushtgardon nameshinand.
54) Chunonchi Mo akh'li ch'annatro bo in ne'matkh'o giromi medorem, kh'amin guna onkh'oro bo zanoni zeboi sokh'ibi chashmoni vasei safediash sap-safed va siiokh'iash sip-siiokh' izdivoch' menamoem.
55) Akh'li ch'annat khodimonashonro faro mekhonand, to baroiashon kh'ar nav'i mevai mekhostaashonro kh'ozir sozand, kh'ol on ki onkh'o az k'at'shavi va zarari on mevakh'o eminand.
56) Onkh'o dar ch'annat abadi memonand. Dar onch'o ch'uz margi avvali dar dunio chashidaashon digar margro namechashand va Parvardigorashon onkh'oro az azobi duzakh nigokh' medorad.
57) In az rui lutfi Parvardigorat nisbat ba akh'li ch'annat ast. In dukhuli ch'annat va duri az duzakh komiobii buzurgest, ki kh'ech' komiobi ba on barobar nest.
58) Pas, ei Paiombar, begumon Mo in K'ur'onro bo furud ovardan ba zaboni tu (arabi) oson kardem, to k'avmat maonii onro bifakh'mand va pand bigirand.
59) Pas, tu muntaziri g'olibiiati khud va mag'lubiiati dushmanonat bosh. Albatta, onkh'o niz muntaziri mag'lubiiat va kh'alokati tu kh'astand.
1) "Kh'o. Mim." Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) In K'ur'on Kitobi az sui Allokh'i G'olibi Shikastnopaziri dar ofarinish, tak'dir va chorasozii kori khaloik' Kh'akim nozil shuda ast.
3) Kh'amono dar osmonkh'o va zamin baroi mu'minon oidi k'udrat va vakh'doniiati Khudo dalelkh'oi ziiod ast. Az in dalelkh'oi ch'akh'oni kh'asti makh'z akh'li imon pand megirand.

4) Va ei mardum, begumon dar ofarinishi shumo az nutfa, sipas az gushtpora, sipas az khuni basta va niz dar ofarinishi kh'ar ch'unbanda, ki Khudo onro dar zamin parokanda megardonad, baroi mardume, ki ba ofaridgorii Khudo iak'in dorand, kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi ziiodi iagonagii Ust.

5) Va dar paii kh'am omadani shab va ruz va dar on chi Khudo az osmon az boron furud ovarda, pas ba sababi on ba zamin ba'di on ki begiiokh'i murda bud, bo ruionidani giiokh'oni mukhtalif kh'aiot bakhshid va niz dar gardish dodani vazidani bodkh'o, ki onro ba khotiri manfiatkh'oi shumo gokh'o az iak samt va gokh'o az samti digar meorad, baroi mardume, ki ak'li khudro ba kor medarorand, dalelkh'oi ziiodest, to az in dalelkh'oi ch'akh'oni kh'asti bar iagonagiiu k'udrati ilokh'i, khususan bar zindasozii murdagon pai barand va bifakh'mand.

6) Ei Paiombar, in oiatkh'o va dalelkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast, ki Mo onkh'oro bar tu ba rosti mekhonem. Agar k'avmi kofirat ba sukhan va dalelkh'oi Mo imon naorand, pas ba'd az in ba kadom sukhan imon meorand va kadom kh'uch'ch'atro tasdik' mekunand?!
7) Ruzi k'iiomat voi ba kh'ar iak bandai bisior durug'gui gunakh'kore, ki-

8) paivasta dar K'ur'on oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro meshunavad, ki bar u khonda meshavad, sipas bar kufru gunokh'ash idoma doda, khudro az k'abuli kh'ak' buzurg mekh'isobad, guio on oiatkh'oro nashunida ast. Pas, ei Paiombar, in shakhsi kofirro ba azobi dardovari k'iiomat "muzhda" bidekh'.
9) Va chun az K'ur'on chize ba u birasad, onro ba rishkhand megirad. Ruzi k'iiomat baroi maskharakunandagoni K'ur'on azobi khorsozanda ast.

10) Dar okhirat otashi duzakh onkh'oro az peshi ruiashon muntazir ast. Va moli kasbkarda va butkh'oi ba ch'uz Khudo ma'bud giriftaashon az onkh'o chizero az azob bartaraf namesozad va baroiashon azobi azim ast.

11) In Kitobi bar Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilkardai Mo kh'idoiatgari rokh'i rost ast. Va kasone, ki ba oiatkh'oi bar u firistodai Parvardigorashon kofir megardand, baroi onkh'o azobi badtarinu sakht dardovar ast.

12) Ei mardum, iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) On Zotest, ki bakh'rro baroi shumo musakhkhar gardonid, to kishtikh'o dar on bo farmoni U kh'arakat kunand va to shumo bo istifoda az nav'kh'oi gunoguni kasbi kh'alol az fazli U ruzi talab namoed va to ne'matkh'oiashro shukrguzori kuned.

13) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar on chi dar osmonkh'o az oftobu mokh'u sitoragon va kh'ar on chi dar zamin az dariokh'o, darakhton, kukh'kh'o va g'aira vuch'ud dorad, baroi shumo musakhkhar sokhta ast. Kh'amai in ne'matkh'o az fazl va ekh'soni U ast. Ba durusti, dar musakhkhar sokhtani in mavch'udot baroi k'avme, ki oid ba nishonakh'oi ilokh'i dar ch'akh'oni kh'asti meandeshand va az on ibrat megirand, dalelkh'oi ziiodi k'udrat va vakh'doniiati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.

14) Ei Paiombar, ba mu'minon bigu: "Kofironero, ki nisbat ba shumo badi karda, ba ne'mat va azobi ilokh'i parvoe nadorand, afv kuned, zero begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar iak gurukh'i mu'minoni sobir va kofironi az marzkh'o tach'ovuzkunandaro ba sababi on chi dar dunio mekardand, ch'azo khokh'ad dod."

15) Kh'ar ki amali shoista mekunad, pas, natich'ai on ba naf'i khudi on shakhs barmegardad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba amali neki bandagon niioz nadorad va kh'ar ki amali bad anch'om medikh'ad, pas, natich'aash ba zarari sokh'ibash khotima meiobad, on amali bad ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ziion nameorad. Sipas shumo rui k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui Parvardigoraton bargardonida meshaved va U dar on ruz kh'ar kasro ba ch'azoi a'molash merasonad.

16) Va beshak, Mo ba Bani Isroil Tavrot va mutobik' ba akh'komash dar baini mardum dovari namudanro dodem va beshtari paiombaronro az nasli Ibrokh'im dar sulolai Bani Isroil k'aror dodem va ba onkh'o az nav'kh'oi gunoguni ne'matkh'oi kh'alol ruzi namudem va onkh'oro bar akh'li olami zamonashon bartar gardonidem.

17) Va ba Bani Isroil dar korkh'oi dini dalelkh'oi tavzekh'dikh'andai kh'ak' az botilro dodem. Pas, onkh'o dar korkh'oi dini ikhtilof nakardand, magar ba'd az on ki bo bi'sati Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba onkh'o donish omad va kh'uch'ch'at barpo shud. Illati ikhtilofashon dar on bud, ki onkh'o az rui kh'irsi mansabu ch'okh'talabi baini khud ziddi iakdigar dushmani va sitam namudand. Ei Paiombar, iak'inan Parvardigorat ruzi k'iiomat dar bainashon dar on chi ikhtilof mekardand, dovari menamoiad va kh'ak'ro az nokh'ak' ch'udo mesozad.

18) Sipas Mo turo az din bar rokh'u ravishi rostu ustuvore k'aror dodem, ki paiombaroni k'abliro niz ba on amr kardaem. Mardumro ba sui imon va amali nek faro mekhoni. Pas, az in rokh'u ravish pairavi namo va az khostakh'oi kasone, ki kh'ak'ik'atro namedonand, pairavi makun. Zero khostakh'oi onkh'o shakhsro gumrokh' mesozad.

19) Kh'amono kasone, ki kh'ak'ik'atro namedonand, agar az khostakh'oiashon pairavi kuni, kh'ech' gokh' onkh'o az tu chizero az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) man' karda nametavonand. Va Ba durusti ki zolimoni kh'ama raviiakh'o dar dushmani alaikh'i mu'minon ba'zeashon iovari ba'zei digar kh'astand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Madadrasoni bandagoni parkh'ezkorest, ki dasturotashro ich'ro namuda, az man'kardakh'oiash duri mech'uiand.

20) In K'ur'on vasilai didani kh'ak'ik'at va botil va baroi k'avme, ki iak'in dorand, kh'idoiat ba rokh'i durust va rakh'mat ast. Chunki makh'z akh'li iak'in bo K'ur'on ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat meioband, to Parvardigorashon az onkh'o rozi gashta, eshonro dokhili ch'annat kunad.

21) Oio kasone kufr va gunokh' sodir kardaand, mepindorand, ki Mo onkh'oro dar ch'azo misli bandagone k'aror medikh'em, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi nek anch'om dodaand, kh'aiotu marg va duniovu okhiratashon iakson meboshad?! In chi dovarii zishtest!

22) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) osmonkh'o va zaminro ba khotiri kh'ikmati buzurge ofarida ast va to ba kh'ar iak kas dar ivazi on chi az neki va badi anch'om doda ast, podosh doda shavad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbatashon bo kam kardani nekikh'o io afzun sokhtani badikh'oiashon sitam namekunad.

23) Ei Paiombar, ba on kase nazar bikun, ki az khostakh'oi nafsi khud pairavi karda, onro chun ma'bud k'aror doda, khilofash kore namekunad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) loik'i zalolat budani uro donista, gumrokh'ash sokhta va bar shunavoi va k'albash mukh'r zada va bar binoiash parda andokhta ast. Vai ba kh'amin illat kh'ak'ro nameshunavad va onro namebinad. Pas ba'd az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro gumrokh' sokhta ast, ki baroiash tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro medikh'ad?! Oio dar mavridi zararkh'oi pairavii khostakh'oi nafs va manfiatkh'oi pairavii shariat nameandeshed, to pand bigired?!

24) Va kofironi munkiri ruzi k'iiomat meguiand: "Ch'uz kh'aioti dunioi mo kh'aioti digare nest, iak k'ator naslkh'o memirand va barnamegardand va iak k'ator naslkh'oi ch'adid ba dunio meoiand va Ba durusti ki omadu rafti shabu ruz va guzashti aiiom moro memironad." Va in kofiron dar borai inkori rastokhez ilme nadorand. Onkh'o fak'at az rui gumon kor megirand va kh'ak'k'o, ki gumon kh'ak'ro sobit namesozad.

25) Va chun bar mushrikoni munkiri rastokhez oiatkh'oi ravshani Mo tilovat shavad, onkh'o kh'ech' kh'uch'ch'ate nadorand, magar in sukhanashon, ki ba Paiombar va askh'obash meguiand: "Agar shumo dar da'voi zindashavii ba'd az marg sodik'ed, pas padaroni murdai moro zinda sozed."

26) Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ofaridanaton ba shumo kh'aiot mebakhshad, sipas shumoro memironad, sipas shumoro ba'di marg baroi bozpursi va giriftani podoshi amal dar ruzi k'iiomat, ki shakke dar barpo shudanash nest, ch'am' meorad, valekin beshtari mardum inro namedonand. Binobar in, bo ich'roi amali shoista baroi ruzi okhirat omoda nameshavand."

27) Va podshokh'ii osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Pas naboiad g'airi U ibodat shavad. Va ruzi barposhavii k'iiomat, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) murdagonro baroi bozpursi va giriftani podosh zinda mesozad, botilkoron ziion mebinand. Onkh'o kasone kh'astand, ki ba Ofaridgori iagona shirk meorand va talosh mekunand, to kh'ak'ro botil va botilro kh'ak' ch'ilva dikh'and.

28) Va ei Paiombar, on ruz kh'ar ummatro bar zonu nishasta mebini, onkh'o muntazirand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chi amre sodir mekunad. Kh'ar iak ummat ba sui nomai a'molash, ki farishtagon navishtaand, da'vat meshavad. Imruz ba shumo mardum podoshi on chi dar dunio az neki va badi anch'om medoded, doda meshavad.

29) In Kitobi Mo, ki farishtagon dar on kh'amesha amalkh'oiatonro menavishtand, alaikh'i shumo ba kh'ak'ik'at va rosti guvokh'i medikh'ad. Onro bikhoned. Begumon Mo ba farishtagoni kotibi a'mol amr karda budem, ki on chi dar dunio anch'om medoded, kh'amai onro binavisand.

30) Va ammo kasone, ki imon ovardaand va amalkh'oi nek kardaand, pas Parvardigorashon bo rakh'matash onkh'oro ba ch'annat vorid mesozad. In podoshi ba onkh'o bakhshidai ilokh'i komiobii ravshan ast. Kh'ech' komiobi ba on barobar shuda nametavonad.

31) Va ammo kasone, ki kofir shudaand, pas bo sarzanish ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Oio oiatkh'oi Man bar shumo tilovat nameshud, pas az imon ovardan ba on kibr mevarzided va mardumi gunakh'kor buded, kofir gashta, ma'siiati ziiod sodir menamuded?!

32) Va chun ba shumo gufta meshud: "Kh'amono va'dai Parvardigor dar borai zinda gardonidani bandagon va ch'azo dodani onkh'o kh'ak' ast va dar omadani k'iiomat shakke nest, binobar in, baroi okhirat omoda shaved", megufted: "Mo chi budani k'iiomatro namedonem. Mo dar omadani on fak'at andak gumon dorem va iak'in nadorem."
33) Va baroi kofiron badikh'oi kufru ma'siiati dar dunio anch'om dodaashon namoion megardad va eshonro azobe ikh'ota menamoiad, ki vak'te bo on bim doda meshudand, maskharaash mekardand.

34) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o meguiad: "Imruz Mo shumoro dar otashi duzakh rakh'o mekunem, kh'amon guna ki shumo mulok'oti imruzi khudro faromush karda, bo imon va a'moli shoista omodagi nadided va k'arorgokh'i shumo otash ast va iovarone nadored, ki azobatonro dur sozand.

35) In azob ba sababi on ast, ki shumo oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba maskhara girifted va kh'aioti dunio bo lazzat va shakh'vatkh'oiash shumoro fireb dod." Pas, imruz kofironi tamaskhurkunandai oiatkh'oi ilokh'i az ch'akh'annam namebaroiand, balki dar on abadi memonand va inchunin onkh'o ba sui dunio bargardonida nameshavand, ki amalkh'oi nek anch'om dikh'and va Parvardigorashon az eshon rozi gardad.
36) Pas sitoish makhsusu loik'i Allokh'i Parvardigori osmonkh'o va Parvardigori zamin va Parvardigori kh'amai makhluk'ot ast.
37) Va dar osmonkh'o va zamin azamatu ch'alolu saltanat fak'at az Ust va U Allokh'i G'olibi Mag'lubnashavanda buda, dar ofarinish, tak'dir, chorasozii korkh'o va akh'komash bag'oiat Kh'akim ast.
1) "Kh'o. Mim." Dar og'ozi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
2) In K'ur'on Kitobi az sui Allokh'i G'olibi Shikastnopaziri dar ofarinish, tak'dir va chorasozii umuri khaloik' Kh'akim nozil shuda ast.

3) Mo osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini onkh'oro bekh'uda khalk' nakardaem, balki tamomi onro ba rosti ba khotiri kh'ikmatkh'oi buzurge va bo andozagirii mukh'lati nazdi Khudo ma'lum ofaridaem. Ba'ze az kh'ikmatkh'oi ofaridani in mavch'udot on ast, ki bandagon ba in vosita Kholik'i kheshtanro shinosand, iagona Uro ibodat kunand, az shirk parkh'ez namoiand va to zamoni muaiian talaboti mas'uliiati ch'onishinii rui zaminro ba ch'o orand. Va kofiron az on chi dar K'ur'on bo on bim doda meshavand, rui gardonda, nisbat ba on izkh'ori betavach'ch'ukh'i menamoiand.

4) Ei Paiombar, ba in mushrikoni az kh'ak' bargashta bigu: "Ba man dar borai kh'ama ma'budkh'oi botilaton, ki onkh'oro ba ch'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted, khabar dikh'ed. Baroiam nishon dikh'ed, ki in butkh'oiaton az zamin chiro ofaridaand?! Magar dario io kukh'ero ofaridaand?! Io onkh'o bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar khalk'i osmonkh'o shariku sakh'mguzorand?! Agar dar da'voiaton, ki guio ma'budkh'oiaton loik'i ibodat kh'astand, sodik' boshed, pas baroiam kitobi k'abl az K'ur'on nozilgardida io ilmi az khud bok'iguzoshtai peshiniionro biiored."

5) Va kh'ech' kas gumrokh'tar az on kase nest, ki ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) butero meparastad, ki to ruzi k'iiomat duoiashro namepazirad va butkh'o az duoi obidonashon g'ofiland. Vak'te butkh'oi mushrikon az shunidan va k'abuli duo dar g'aflatand, ma'lum ast, ki k'udrati zarar va foida rasondanro niz nadorand.

6) Va vak'te ruzi k'iiomat mardum ch'am' ovarda shavand, ma'budkh'oi botil, ki dar dunio ba mushrikon manfiat rasonida nametavonistand, on ruz dushmanashon gashta, az mushrikon bezori mech'uiand va az ch'onibi onkh'o ibodat shudani kheshtanro inkor mekunand va dar in bora izkh'ori beittiloi menamoiand.

7) Va chun oiatkh'oi vozekh'i bar Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilkardai Mo ba akh'li Makka khonda shavad, kofiron dar mavridi K'ur'on, vak'te ba vositai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba onkh'o biioiad, biduni andesha meguiand: "In Kitob ch'odui oshkor buda, paig'omi Khudo nest."

8) Oio mushrikon meguiand: "Ba durusti, Mukh'ammad in Kitobro az peshi khud bofta, onro ba Khudo nisbat doda ast"?! Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Agar ba farzi misol, man onro az nazdi khesh bofam, kh'atman Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) maro ch'azo medikh'ad va shumo baroiam az azobi U kh'ech' chizro dur sokhta nametavoned. Modom ki chunin ast, pas man chi guna bo durug'gui dar kh'ak'k'i Parvardigor ch'onamro dar ma'razi kh'alokat k'aror medodaam?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar borai on ki shumo dar ta'na zadani K'ur'on va erod giriftan ba man furu meraved, az kh'ama Donotar ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baini man va baini shumo ba sifati Guvokh' basanda ast. Va U ba bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast."

9) Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikoni takzibgari paiombariat bigu: "Man nakhustin firistodai Khudo nestam, ki da'vatam boisi taach'ch'ubi shumo gardad. K'abl az man firistodagoni bisiore guzashtaand. Va namedonam, ki Khudo bo man va bo shumo dar dunio chi kor mekunad. Man ch'uz on chi Khudo ba suiam paig'om mefiristad, digar az kh'ech' chiz pairavi namekunam. Kh'amai guftoru kirdoram bar asosi paig'omi ilokh'i surat megirad. Va man bimdikh'andai oshkore besh nestam. Shumoro az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bim medikh'am."

10) Ei Paiombar, ba in takzibgaron bigu: "Ba man khabar dikh'ed. Agar in K'ur'on az nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omada ast, dar kh'ole shumo ba on kofir shudaed va shokh'ide az Bani Isroil bo takia ba ma'lumoti Tavrot oid ba K'ur'on dar borai az nazdi Khudo nozil gashtani on shokh'idi doda, az kh'amin sabab ba on imon biiorad va shumo az imon ovardan ba in Kitob kibr varzed, oio dar in surat zolim makh'sub nameshaved?! Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba k'avmi zolim tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro namedikh'ad."

11) Va kasone, ki ba K'ur'oni ovardai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kofir shudaand, dar sha'ni akh'li imon meguiand: "Agar on chi Mukh'ammad ovarda ast, kh'ak' buda, ba neki kh'idoiat menamud, kh'ech' gokh' in mu'minoni fak'iru g'ulomu bechora dar paziruftani on moro sabk'at namekardand." Va ba illati on ki kofiron ba vasilai K'ur'oni ovardai Paiombarashon kh'idoiat naioftaand, pas doim meguiand: "In Kitobi Mukh'ammad durug'i k'adim ast. Mo durug'ro pairavi namekunem."

12) Va Kitobi Tavrot k'abl az K'ur'on omada ast. Khudo Tavrotro ba Muso (alaikh'is salom) nozil namud, dar kh'ole ki on baroi mu'minoni Bani Isroil peshvoi rokh'i kh'ak' va rakh'mat bud. Va in K'ur'on Kitobi bo zaboni arabi bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilgardidai tasdik'gari Kitobkh'oi guzashta ast, to Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba sababi on kasonero, ki bo shirku gunokh' bar ch'oni khud sitam kardaand, az omadani uk'ubat kh'ushdor va bim dikh'ad va on baroi nekukoron, ki bo Kholik' va khalk' alok'ai nek dorand, bashorat ast.

13) Kh'amono kasone, ki "Iagona Parvardigori mo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast" meguiand, sipas bar imon va amali shoista ustuvorona bok'i memonand, bar onkh'o az kh'avodisi okhirat tarse nest va inchunin onkh'o baroi az dast dodani lazzati dunio va tarki doroii khud dar on g'amgin nameshavand.
14) In ch'amoai doroi sifatkh'oi mazkur kh'amdamoni ch'annatand, dar onch'o abadi meistand. Onkh'o ba sababi on ki dar dunio amalkh'oi shoista mekardand, kh'amin guna ch'azo doda meshavand.

15) Va Mo ba inson farmoni k'at'i dodaem, ki nisbat ba padaru modari khud dar kh'oli kh'aiot va ba'di margashon neki kunad, ba sharti on ki nekiash khilofi shar' naboshad. Ba khusus modarash, ki bo mashak'k'at uro dar batnash bardosht va bo mashak'k'at tavalludash kard. Va muddati kh'amli ch'anin va muddati ch'udoshavii tifl az shiri modar si mokh' ast. Pas inson markh'ilakh'oi gunogunro pushti sar karda, umr mebinad to on ki chun ba sinni kamoli nerui ak'lu ch'ismash va ba chil solagi birasad, meguiad: "Ei Parvardigori man, baroiam ilkh'om bibakhsh, to shukri ne'matero, ki bar man va bar padaru modaram in'om namudai, ba ch'o biioram va amali shoistai mavridi rizoi Turo anch'om dikh'am va amali nekamro bipazir va farzandonamro islokh' bikun. Beshak, man az gunokh'onam ba suiat tavba kardaam va man begumon az zumrai taslimshudagon va farmonbardoroni amri Tu kh'astam."

16) Inkh'o kasoneand, ki Mo az onkh'o kh'ar on chi az amalkh'oi shoista kardaand, mepazirem va az badikh'oiashon guzashta, baroi on ch'azoiashon namekunem, eshon dar zumrai akh'li ch'annat k'aror megirand. In va'dai sodik'onaest, ki dar dunio va'da doda meshudand. Va'dai ilokh'i noguzir takh'ak'k'uk' meiobad.

Chun Khudovand dar oiatkh'oi k'abli neki ba volidainro bo mak'sadi targ'ib zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin namunai ozori padaru modarro bo kh'adafi mutanaffir sokhtani bandagon az on baion namuda guft:
17) Va on kase, ki ba volidainash meguiad:"Man az kh'ar dui shumo dilgiram! Oio ba man va'da medikh'ed, ki ba'di marg az k'abr zinda berun ovarda meshavam, kh'ol on ki k'ablan k'arnkh'oi ziiod guzashta va dar on mardumi bisior murda va kh'ech' iakeashon zinda nashuda ast?!" Va padaru modarash az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) madad mekhokh'and, to farzandashonro ba sui imon rakh'namoi kunad va ba vai meguiand: "Voi bar kh'olat! Agar imon naori, kh'alokat domangirat meshavad. Ba Khudoi Iagona imon biior. Beshak, va'dai Khudo dar borai zinda gardondani murdagon kh'ak' ast. Dar vuk'ui on kh'ech' shakke nest." Pas farzandashon takroran rastokhezro inkor karda, meguiad: "In da'voi rastokhezi murdagon ba ch'uz afsonakh'oi az kitobkh'oi peshiniion nak'lshudai sabtgashta chize besh nest. In khabar az sui Khudo sobit nashuda ast."

18) Inkh'o kasoneand, ki takh'ak'k'uk'i azob bar onkh'o dar zumrai ch'inkh'o va insonkh'oi k'abl az onkh'o guzashta k'at'i gardida ast. Ba durusti, eshon ziionkorand. Zero bo daromadani duzakh nisbat ba khesh va khonadonashon ziion merasonand.

19) Va kh'ar kadome az in du gurukh'i akh'li bikh'isht va duzakh mutobik'i amalashon martabakh'o dorand. Martabakh'oi sokinoni ch'annat darach'akh'oi balandi on va martabakh'oi ch'akh'annamiion tabak'akh'oi ch'uk'uri on ast. Va to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o ch'azoi a'molashonro purra bidikh'ad va ruzi k'iiomat nisbatashon bo kam kunonidani nekikh'o va afzun sokhtani badikh'o sitam karda nameshavad.

20) Va ruze, ki kofironi takzibgari paiombaronashon bar otashi duzakh afkanda meshavand, to giriftori uk'ubat gardand va ba onkh'o az rui sarzanish va tanbekh' gufta meshavad: "Dar zindagonii dunioi khud lazzatkh'oiatonro ba purragi kh'osil namuded va az on lazzatkh'o bakh'ra burded. Modom ki chunin ast, pas imruz ba sababi on ki dar zamin banokh'ak' kibr mevarzided va bo kufru ma'siiat az itoati Khudo khorich' meshuded, bo uk'ubati khorsozanda ch'azo doda meshaved."

21) Va ei Paiombar, baroi kofironi Makka k'issai Kh'udi barodari nasabii k'avmi Odro zikr kun. Vak'te u k'avmashro, ki dar sarzamine ba nomi "Akh'k'of" (ismi ch'oi vok'e' dar k'ismati ch'anubii nimch'azirai Arabiston) mezistand, az omadani azobi Khudo kh'ushdor dod va kh'ol on ki k'abl az Kh'ud va ba'd az vai paiombaroni ziiode guzashta, kh'amai onkh'o k'avmi khudro az uk'ubati Khudo kh'ushdor doda meguftand: "Iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro biparasted. Ba U chize va kasero sharik nasozed. Ei k'avmi man, Ba durusti ki man bar shumo az azobi ruzi buzurgi k'iiomat metarsam."

22) K'avmi Kh'ud (alaikh'is salom) dar ch'avobi da'vatash guftand: "Oio tu nazdamon omadai, to moro az ibodati ma'budkh'oiamon bargardoni?! Bidon, ki kh'argiz ba in mak'sadat namerasi! Agar tu dar da'voiat sodik'i, pas baroiamon on azobero, ki bo on takh'didamon mekuni, biior."

23) Kh'ud (alaikh'is salom) dar ch'avob guft: "Kh'amono ilmi zamoni omadani azob nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Man dar in bobat chize namedonam. Va man kh'amchun firistodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sui mardum tankh'o on paig'omero ba shumo merasonam, ki baroi tablig'ash firistoda shudaam. Vale man shumoro k'avme mebinam, ki zararu foidai kheshro namedoned. Ba kh'amin illat korkh'oi mufidro tark namuda, korkh'oi zararovar anch'om medikh'ed."

24) Pas, chun azobi khostaashon ba onkh'o omad va dar kanorai osmon abri pakh'nshudai ba ch'onibi maskankh'oiashon ravongardidaro didand, guftand: "In abri dar kanorai osmon pakh'ngardida bar mo boron meborad." Kh'ud (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Kor on guna ki shumo mepindored, nest. In abr boron nameborad, balki on kh'amon azobest, ki zud omadani onro darkhost menamuded. Bodest, ki dar on azobi dardovar ast.

25) On bod bo amri Parvardigorash az nazdi kh'ar chize guzarad, onro nobud mekunad."Pas k'avmi Kh'ud (alaikh'is salom) kh'alok gashtand, ch'uz khonakh'oi istik'omatiashon kh'ech' chize dida nameshud. Khonakh'oiashon kh'amchun shokh'idi on ki k'ablan dar in ch'oikh'o mezistand, bok'i mond. Mo k'avmi gunakh'kori idomadikh'andai kufru ma'siiatro kh'amin guna ch'azo medikh'em.

26) Va begumon Mo ba k'avmi Kh'ud az abzori k'udratmandi chizkh'oero doda budem, ki ba shumo nadodaem va ba onkh'o gushi shunavo va chashmi bino va k'albi doroi idrok ato namudem. Pas vak'te azobi ilokh'i omad, gushashon va chashmashon va k'albashon az azob chizero az onkh'o bartaraf sokhta natavonist. Chunki in k'avm paivasta oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro inkor mekardand. Va onkh'oro azobe ikh'ota kard, ki chun Kh'ud bo on kh'ushdorashon medod, onro ba maskhara megiriftand.

27) Va ei Akh'li Makka, iak'inan Mo sokinoni dekh'akh'oi atrofatonro kh'alok sokhtem. K'abl az shumo k'avmi Od, Samud, Lut va Askh'obi Madianro kh'alok kardem. Va kh'uch'ch'atkh'oro baroi onkh'o gunogun gardonidem, to in ki az kufrashon bargardand.

28) Pas, charo ba k'avmkh'oi guzashta butkh'oiashon, ki onkh'oro ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'bud girifta, bo ich'roi ibodat va zabkh'i chorvo ba onkh'o nazdiki mech'ustand, iori nadodand?! Ma'budkh'oiashon ioriashon nakardand, balki dar mukh'imtarin lakh'zakh'o az onkh'o g'oib gashtand. Va in durug' va boftai shakhsiashon bud, ki khudro umedvor sokhta, meguftand, on butkh'o sudashon merasonand va nazdi Khudo shafoatashon mekunand.

29) Va ei Paiombar, vak'tero iod kun, ki Mo ba suiat iak idda ch'inkh'oro ravon kardem, dar kh'ole mekhostand ba K'ur'on gush faro bidikh'and. Pas chun baroi shunidani K'ur'on kh'ozir gashtand, ba kh'am guftand: "Khomush boshed, to onro bishnavem." Pas vak'te Rasuli Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) k'iroati khudro ba itmom rasonid, ch'inkh'o ba sifati bimdikh'andagon nazdi k'avmashon bargashtand. Onkh'o k'avmi kheshro bim medodand, ki agar imon naorand, ba uk'ubati shadid giriftor meshavand.

30) Ch'inkh'o ba'd az bozgashtan ba k'avmashon guftand: "Ei k'avmi mo, kh'amono mo Kitobi muk'addasero shunidem, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro ba'd az Muso (alaikh'is salom) furud ovarda, Kitobkh'oi k'abl az on guzashtaro tasdik' mekunad. In Kitob mo va insonkh'oro ba sui kh'ak'ik'at va rokh'i rosti Islom kh'idoiat menamoiad.

31) Ei k'avmi mo, da'vati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro ba sui rosti k'abul kuned va imon biiored, ki u Paiombari Khudost, to Parvardigor ba in sabab gunokh'onatonro bakhshad va shumoro az uk'ubati dardovari k'iiomat solim nigakh' dorad. Zero agar da'vatashro napazired va ba risolatash imon naored, kh'atman mubtaloi azobi sakht megarded.

32) Va kh'ar ki da'vati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro ba sui kh'ak' napazirad, pas bo firor dar zamin az azobi ilokh'i rakh'o shudan nametavonad va u ch'uz Parvardigor ioronu iovarone nadorad, ki az azob nach'otash dikh'and. In toifa az kh'ak' dar gumrokh'ii oshkor k'aror dorand."

33) Oio in mushrikoni takzibgari ruzi k'iiomat namedonand, On Khudoe, ki osmonkh'ovu zaminro ofarid va az ofaridanashon bo vuch'udi pakh'noi va buzurgiashon och'iz nagasht, bar zinda gardonidani murdagon baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo Tavono ast?! Bale, Khudo bar in kor K'odir ast. Zero shakke nest, ki U ba tamomi chiz tavonoi dorad.

34) Va on ruze, ki kofiron ba otashi ch'akh'annam afkanda shavand, to mavridi azob k'aror girand, bo sarzanish ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Oio in azobi peshi chashmaton namoion kh'ak' nest?! Io in ki chunonchi dar dunio megufted, azobi duzakh durug' ast?!" Kofiron meguiand: "Bale, savgand ba Parvardigoramon, ki on kh'ak' ast." Khudo ba onkh'o meguiad: "Pas, ba sababi on ki dar dunio ba Ma'budi kh'ak'ik'i kufr varzided, azobro bichashed."

35) Pas, ei Paiombar, bar takzibi k'avmat monandi Nukh', Ibrokh'im, Muso va Iso, ki paiombaroni doroi irodai k'avi budand, sabr bikun va baroiashon zud omadani azobro talab nakun. Ruze, ki k'avmi takzibgarat dar k'iiomat uk'ubati ba onkh'o va'dashudaro binand, on az shiddatash dar nazarashon chunon menamoiad, ki guio dar dunio ba ch'uz soati andake az ruz naistodaand. In K'ur'oni bar Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilgashta az sui Khudo ba insonkh'o va ch'inkh'o tablig' va kofi ast. Pas ba vositai azob tankh'o k'avme kh'alok karda meshavand, ki bo kufru gunokh' az toati Khudo khorich'and.
1) On kasone, ki kofir meshavand va mardumro az oiini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) barmegardondand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amalkh'oi onkh'oro botil mesozad.

2) Va on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista mekunand va khosatan ba K'ur'oni bar Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) furudovardai Khudo -va K'ur'on Kitobi barkh'ak'i az sui Parvardigorashon omada ast-, imon meorand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az onkh'o amalkh'oi badashonro makh'v sokhta, ch'azoiashon namedikh'ad va umuri duniavi va ukhraviashonro islokh' menamoiad.

3) In podoshi du gurukh'i mazkur ba sababi on ast, ki kofiron az botil pairavi kardand va mu'minon az kh'ak'ik'ati az sui Parvardigori onkh'o omada pairavi kardand. Chun sa'ii mu'minonu kofiron gunogun ast, ch'azoiashon niz fark' dorad. On guna ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ukmi Khudro dar borai gurukh'i mu'minonu kofiron baion sokht, kh'amin guna baroi kh'amai mardum kh'olatkh'oiashonro baion menamoiad va shabekh'ro ba shabekh' paivand medikh'ad.

4) Pas chun shumo mu'minon bo kofironi ch'angch'ui dar maidonkh'oi nabard rubaru gashted, pas bo shamsherkh'oiaton gardanashonro bizaned. Ba muk'obilashon to vak'te ch'angidanro idoma dikh'ed, ki onkh'oro ziiod ba k'atl rasoned va dar saffashon zarbakh'oi mukh'lik vorid sokhta, shukukh'i eshonro barkh'am zaned. Zamone ki chunin karded, pas tanobi asirkh'oro ustuvor banded. Pas vak'te onkh'oro asir girifted, shumo tibk'i tak'ozoi manfiat baini du chiz ikhtiior dored: agar khokh'ed, bar onkh'o ekh'son karda, biduni ivaz ozodashon namoed va agar khokh'ed, dar ivazi mol io g'airi on rakh'oiashon sozed. To vak'te ch'angidan va asirsozii kofironi ch'angch'uiro idoma dikh'ed, ki nabard bo musalmon gardidani akh'li kufr io bastani sozishnomai sulkh' khatm shavad. In mavridi ozmoish k'aror giriftani mu'minon ba vositai kofironu gardishi ruzgor bainashon dar g'olib va mag'lub shudan kh'ukmi ilokh'ist.
