Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mekhost, biduni ch'ang az kofiron intik'om megirift, valekin U alaikh'i dushmanoni ch'angkhokh' ch'ikh'odro muk'arrar karda ast, to ba'zeatonro ba vasilai ba'zei digar biozmoiad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mu'minonro mesanch'ad, ki chi kase ziddi dushman mech'angad va chi kase az ch'ang ak'ib menishinad. Inchunin kofironro bo mu'minon mesanch'ad. Agar mu'minro kushad, mu'min ch'annat medaroiad va agar mu'min kofirro kushad, kofir duzakh medaroiad. Va kasone, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kushta shavand, pas kh'argiz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) a'moli onkh'oro botil namesozad.
5) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dunio ba onkh'o tavfik'i pairavi az kh'ak'ro medikh'ad va kh'olatashonro islokh' mesozad.

6) Va dar k'iiomat onkh'oro dokhili ch'annat mekunad. Parvardigor dar dunio tavassuti paiombaron bo vasfi ch'annat onro baroiashon shinosonda ast. Az in sabab onkh'o dar okhirat manzilkh'oi kheshro meshinosand.

7) Ei kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon ovardaed va mutobik'i shariati U amal mekuned, agar Paiombar va dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro iori dikh'ed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro bo g'olib sokhtanaton alaikh'i dushmanonaton iori medikh'ad va k'adamkh'oiatonro dar maidoni nabard ustuvor megardonad.

8) Va kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash kofir meshavand, pas onkh'o sakht ziion karda va kh'alok gardidaand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savobi amalkh'oi onkh'oro botil sokhta ast.

9) In azob ba sababi on ast, ki kofiron K'ur'oni bar Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dust namedorand va nisbat ba on nafrat dorand, zero K'ur'on onkh'oro ba tavkh'id da'vat mekunad. Pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) a'molashonro botil mesozad va dar duniovu okhirat khasorat mebinand.

10) Oio in ch'amoai takzibgar dar zamin sairu saiokh'at nakardand, to biandeshand, ki ok'ibati takzibkunandagoni k'abl az onkh'o guzashta bo chi anch'omid. Farch'omi kofironi peshin mudkh'ish bud. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro bo farzandon, doroi, manzil va kh'ar chi ba eshon taalluk' dosht, nobud kard. Va baroi kofiron dar kh'ar zamonu makon misli on uk'ubatkh'o ast.
11) In ch'azoi mazkuri toifai akh'li imonu kufr ba sababi on ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Korsoz va Iovari mu'minon ast va kofiron kh'ech' korsoz va iovare nadorand.

12) Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on kasonero, ki ba U va Firistodaash imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista mekunand, ba bog'kh'oe dokhil mesozad, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va dararakhtonash rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad. Va on kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Firistodaash kofir meshavand, dar dunio bo pairavi az khostakh'oi nafsashon ruzkh'oi andak bakh'ra mebarand va monandi khurdani chakh'orpoion mekhurand, ch'uz k'one' kunonidani shikam va sharmgokh'ashon g'ame nadorand va ruzi k'iiomat ch'oi istik'omati onkh'o otashi duzakh ast.

13) Va dar guzashta sokinoni shakh'rkh'oi ziiode mezistand, ki onkh'o az sokinoni Makkai shakh'ri tu, ki az on khorich'at kardand, nerumandtar va doroi molu farzandoni beshtar budand. Vak'te firistodagoni Khudoro durug'gui shumurdand, onkh'oro kh'alok kardem. Pas chun azob ba onkh'o omad, kh'ech' madadrasone nadoshtand, ki az on rakh'oiashon sozad. Agar Mo kh'amin guna kh'alokati akh'li Makkaro khokh'em, kh'ech' chiz monei on nameshavad.

14) Oio gurukh'e, ki az sui Parvardigorashon daleli ravshan dorand, Khudoro bar asosi ilm meparastand, bo on toifae, ki Shaiton amali badashonro baroi onkh'o zinat doda va az talk'inoti khostakh'oi nafsi khud ba misli butparasti, sodir kardani gunokh' va takzibi firistodagoni Khudo pairavi menamoiand, iaksonand?!

15) Vasfi shigiftangezi ch'annat, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) daromadani onro ba parkh'ezkoroni ich'rokunandai dasturotash va'da doda ast, dar ch'umlakh'oi minba'da meoiad. Dar ch'annat nakh'rkh'oe az ob ast, ki khushbui va ta'mash bo durudaroz istodan tag'iirnaiobanda meboshad va nakh'rkh'oe az shir ast, ki ta'mash digargun nagashta va nakh'rkh'oe az sharobi baroi nushandagon laziz va nakh'rkh'oe az asali az kh'amai oludagikh'o pok ast. Va baroi akh'li bikh'isht dar bikh'isht kh'ar on chi dilashon az nav'kh'oi mukhtalifi mevakh'o mekhokh'ad, omoda ast va ba zammi in ne'matkh'o az sui Parvardigorashon gunokh'onashon makh'v gashta, dar ivazi korkh'oi badashon ch'azo namebinand. Magar bandagoni sokh'ibi chunin podosh bo kasone, ki dar otashi duzakh ch'ovid meistand va az obi nikh'oiat purkh'arorati on nushonida meshavand, pas on ob az shiddati garmiash rudakh'oi shikamashonro pora mesozad, iaksonand?!

16) Va ei Paiombar, az munofik'on kasoneand, ki ba sukhanoni tu na ba mak'sadi paziruftan gush meandozand. Pas chun az nazdat baroiand, khudro ba nodoni zada, az guftakh'oiat ru gardonda, ba sakh'obagone, ki Khudo ba eshon ilm doda ast, meguiand: "Mukh'ammad kame peshtar dar rafti sukhanronii khud chi guft?" Inkh'o kasone kh'astand, ki azbaski Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar k'albashon mukh'r nikh'oda ast, khair ba dilashon rokh' nameiobad va onkh'o az khokh'ishoti nafsashon pairavi mekunand. Pairavii khokh'ishoti nafs eshonro az didani kh'ak'ik'at nobino sokhta ast.

17) Va kasone, ki ba rokh'i rost va pairavii dini Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) rokh' ioftaand, Khudo kh'idoiat va tavfik'ashonro ba sui neki afzun sokhta va ba onkh'o amal kardan ba korkh'oero ilkh'om mebakhshad, ki az otashi ch'akh'annam kh'ifzashon menamoiad.

18) Pas magar kofiron tankh'o muntaziri on kh'astand, ki k'iiomat ba onkh'o nogakh'on va biduni ogokh'ii k'abli oiad?! Pas iak'inan alomatkh'oiash ba misli bi'sati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va du pora gashtani mokh' omada ast. Pas chun k'iiomat oiad, chi guna pand giriftanashon ba onkh'o sud merasonad?!

19) Pas, ei Paiombar, iak'in doshta bosh, ki ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi kh'ak'ik'i vuch'ud nadorad va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi gunokh'i khesh va gunokh'oni mardon va zanoni boimon omurzish talab bikun. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shug'li shumoro dar ruz va k'arorgokh'atonro dar shab medonad. Kh'ech' kh'oli shumo az U makhfi namemonad.

20) Va mu'minon bo orzui on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar Paiombarash surai shomili nabard bo dushmanro furud orad, meguiand: "Kosh, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) suraero nozil mekard, ki dar on ch'angidan alaikh'i dushmanon zikr meshud?!" Pas ei Paiombar, chun Parvardigor surai az likh'ozi baion va kh'ukm mukh'kamero nozil sozad va dar on nabard bar muk'obili dushman zikr karda shavad, munofik'oni bemordilro mebini, ki ba suiat misli on kase nigokh' mekunand, ki az shiddati tars az marg madkh'ush gashta ast. Pas voi bar kh'olashon, ki ba sababi az nabard rui gardondan va az marg tarsidan azob va kh'alokatashon nazdik gashta ast.

21) Itoat az amri Khudo va sukhani nek guftanashon bekh'tar ast. Pas, chun ch'ang alaikh'i dushman farz shavad va kor ch'iddi gardad, pas agar bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar imon va itoat sodik' boshand, in baroi onkh'o az nifok' va nofarmoni bekh'tar ast.

22) Va agar az imon va toati Khudo rui bitobed, dar zamin az shumo ch'uz bo kufru gunokh' fasodkori va k'at'i paivandi kheshiaton digar chize intizor shuda nameshavad. On gokh' ba davroni ch'okh'iliiat barmegarded.

23) In gurukh'i dar zamin fasodkori k'at'kunandai paivandi kheshi kasoneand, ki Khudo az rakh'matash onkh'oro dur karda, pas gushashonro az shunidani kh'ak' kar va chashmonashonro az didani on kur gardonida ast.

24) Pas charo in bandagoni ruigardon dar borai ma'nokh'oi K'ur'on nameandeshand?! Agar onkh'o dar in bob meandeshidand, ba kh'ar kori nek rokh' meioftand va az kh'ar kori bad dur meshudand. Magar bar dilkh'oiashon k'uflkh'oi mustakh'kam zada shuda ast va ba kh'amin illat nasikh'at ba on rokh' nameiobad va pand namegirand?!

25) Kh'amono on kasone, ki ba'd az barpo shudani kh'uch'ch'at bar onkh'o va ma'lum gashtani sidk'i Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az imon ba sui kufru nifok' barmegardand, Shaiton ba onkh'o kufru nifok'ro oroish va oson namuda va onkh'oro bo orzukh'oi durudaroz andokhta ast.

26) In gumrokh'iashon ba sababi on ast, ki onkh'o ba tavri makhfi ba mushrikone, ki ba K'ur'oni bar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilkardai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mukh'abbat nadorand, guftand: "Mo ba zudi dar ba'ze korkh'o, monandi bargardondani mu'minon az nabard shumoro itoat mekunem." Va on chi pinkh'on va on chi oshkor mekunand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amaashro medonad. Kh'argiz korkh'oi onkh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pinkh'on namemonad va kh'ar chiro khokh'ad, ba Paiombarash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) oshkor mesozad.

27) Pas vak'te farishtagoni k'obizi rukh' ch'onashonro k'abz mekunand, dar kh'ole ki bo gurzkh'oi okh'anin bar chekh'rakh'o va pushtkh'oiashon mezanand, akh'voli onkh'o dar on sakh'nai mudkh'ish va uk'ubati sakht chi guna khokh'ad bud?!

28) In azob ba sababi on ast, ki onkh'o az korkh'oi khashmginsozandai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba misli kufru nifok'u dushmani bo din pairavi mekunand va ba amalkh'oi nazdiksozanda ba Parvardigor va ch'albsozandai rizoiash ba misli imon va pairavii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nafrat dorand. Pas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) a'molashonro botil megardonad.

29) Oio munofik'oni bemordil mepindorand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kinakh'oi dar k'albashon nisbat ba Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va mu'minon pushidaro berun nameorad va oshkor namesozad?! Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on kinakh'oro bo ovardani sanch'ishkh'o oshkor mesozad, to mu'mini dar imonash sodik' az munofik' ch'udo shavad.

30) Va ei Paiombar, agar Mo mekhostem, munofik'onro baroi tu meshinosondem, pas tu onkh'oro az rui alomatkh'oiashon meshinokhti. Va kh'atman onkh'oro az shevai sukhanashon meshinosi. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korkh'oi shumoro medonad. Kh'ech' koraton az U makhfi namemonad va dar badali on podoshaton medikh'ad.

31) Va beshak, Mo shumo mu'minonro bo rokh'i muboriza va ch'ang bar ziddi dushman mesanch'em, to much'okh'idoni vok'ei va dar maidoni nabard sabrkunandagoni shumoro ba digaron ma'lum sozem va to a'molatonro sanch'ida, bandai sodik'ro az g'airi on ch'udo namoem.

32) Kh'amono kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash kofir meshavand va khud az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ru tofta, digaronro niz az on barmegardondand va ba'd az on ki nubuvvati Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) baroiashon ma'lum gardid, bo vai mukholifat va dushmani mekunand, kh'argiz ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zarrae ziione namerasonand, balki ba khud ziion merasonand va iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amalkh'oiashonro botil megardonad.

33) Ei mu'minoni poibandi shariat! Bo ich'ro namudani amrkh'o va duri ch'ustan az nakh'ikh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) itoat kuned va az Paiombarash itoat kuned va amalkh'oi khudro bo kufru riiokori botil nagardoned.

34) Ba durusti, kasone, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir meshavand va khud az dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rui gardonida, digaronro niz az on barmegardondand, sipas biduni tavba dar kh'olati kufr vafot mekunand, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az gunokh'onashon nameguzarad, balki baroi on gunokh'on ch'azoiashon medikh'ad va onkh'oro abadi ba duzakh medarorad.

35) Pas, ei mu'minon, dar barobari dushmanon izkh'ori notavoni nakuned va onkh'oro k'abl az on ki shumoro ba musolakh'a da'vat namoiand, ba musolakh'a faro nakhoned va shumo az kofiron bartar va g'olib kh'asted va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo nusrat va ta'iidash kh'amrokh'i shumo ast va U kh'argiz az podoshi a'molaton chizero kam namegardonad, balki bo fazlash onro afzun mesozad.

36) Ba durusti, zindagonii dunio bozi va sargarmi ast. Azbaski on chunin ast, naboiad shakhsi bokhirad az a'moli okhirat g'ofil bimonad. Va agar ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash imon ored va az azobi ilokh'i bo anch'om dodani dasturot va khuddori az mamnuot biparkh'ezed, ba shumo podoshi korkh'oiatonro ba purragi medikh'ad va az shumo kh'amai amvolatonro talab namekunad, balki tankh'o andozai zakoti onro darkhost menamoiad.

37) Agar U az shumo kh'amai amvolatonro bitalabad, pas dar talabi on farmoni k'oteona bidikh'ad, bakhili mekuned va kinakh'o va mukh'abbat nadoshtanaton ba in taklifro az k'albaton berun mesozad. Ba kh'amin sabab, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az rui mekh'ruboni kh'ama molatonro darkhost namekunad.

38) Ogokh' boshed! Shumo ei ch'amoai akh'li imon, da'vat meshaved, to dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'isme az amvoli kheshtanro kharch' sozed. Pas ba'zei shumo az rui bukhl az on khuddori mekunad va kh'ar ki az kharch'i iak k'ismi molash dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bukhl varzad, pas begumon bo makh'rum gashtan az podosh ba zarari khud bakhili menamoiad. Va kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Beniioz buda, mukh'toch'i kharch'i shumo nest va kh'amono shumo ba U niiozmand kh'asted. Va agar az Islom ba sui kufr bargarded, shumoro kh'alok mesozad va ba ch'oi shumo k'avmero meorad, sipas on k'avm ba monandi shumo bandagoni isionkor nameshavand, balki farmonbardori Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) megardand.
1) Ei Paiombar, ba durusti, Mo bo sulkh'i Kh'udaibiia baroi tu fatkh'i oshkorero nasib kardem.

2) To Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'i k'abl az fatkh' va ba'd az fatkh'i turo baroiat mag'firat kunad va bo g'olib gardonidani dinat ne'mati Khudro bar tu ba itmom rasonad va kh'idoiati turo ba rokh'i dini Islom afzun sozad -
3) va baroiat alaikh'i dushmanonat nusrati k'avie bakhshad, ki kh'ech' kas saddi rokh'i on gashta natavonad va ba'd az on khorie naboshad.

4) Khudo On Zotest, ki dar k'albi mu'minon ustuvori va oromishro ech'od kard, to imonashon bar imonashon afzun shavad. Va sipokh'iioni osmonkh'o va zamin iagona az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Ba vositai in lashkariion kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, kumak merasonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat Donoi Bokh'ikmat ast. Manfiati bandagonro medonad va ba onkh'o az rui kh'ikmat g'olibiiat medikh'ad.

5) To Khudo mardoni boimon va zanoni boimonro ba bog'kh'oe dokhil gardonad, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtonash rudkh'o ch'ori meboshand va az onkh'o a'moli badashonro mavkh' namuda, baroi on much'ozotashon nakunad. Va in noil gashtan ba ch'annat va mavkh' shudani gunokh'on nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) komiobii buzurg ast. Kh'ech' komiobi ba on barobar nameshavad.

6) Va to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mardon va zanoni munofik' va mardon va zanoni mushrikro, ki dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gumoni bad mebarand, azob dikh'ad. Onkh'o mepindorand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dinashro piruz namesozad. Kh'ar on chi onkh'o az kh'avodisi badi ruzgor nisbat ba akh'li imon muntazir budand, khudashonro ikh'ota namoiad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sababi kufru badgumoni bar onkh'o g'azab karda va az rakh'matash durashon sokhta va baroiashon duzakhro omoda karda ast. Eshon ruzi k'iiomat abadi dokhili duzakh meshavand. Va duzakh ch'oii bozgashti nikh'oiat bad ast.

7) Va lashkariioni osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. U bo in lashkariion ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, kumak mekunad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti kh'amesha G'olibi dar ofarinish, tak'dir va tadbiri korkh'oi khaloik' Kh'akim ast.

8) Ei Paiombar, kh'amono Mo turo ba sifati guvokh' va muzhdarason va bimdikh'anda firistodaem. Tu ruzi k'iiomat dar kh'ak'k'i ummatonat guvokh' megardi, mu'minonro ba on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dunio ba misli g'olibiiat va k'udratmandi va ba on chi dar okhirat ba misli ch'annat va ne'matkh'oi on baroiashon omoda karda ast, muzhdagoni medikh'i va kofironro az on metarsoni, ki ok'ibat dar dunio az ch'onibi akh'li imon shikast mekhurand va dar okhirat duchori azobi shadidi duzakh meshavand.

9) To shumo ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash imon biiored va Rasulashro bo iori rasonidan k'uvvat bidikh'ed va uro k'adrdoni namoed va dar avval va okhiri ruz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az kh'ama aibu nuk'son ba poki nisbat dikh'ed.

10) Ei Paiombar, iak'inan kasone, ki k'abl az bastani sozishnomai Sulkh'i Kh'udaibiia dar "Bai'ati Rizvon" bo tu dar borai ch'ang alaikh'i mushrikoni Makka akh'd mebandand, onkh'o dar kh'ak'ik'at bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) akh'd mebandand. Zero mu'minonro ba ch'angidan alaikh'i onkh'o Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) amr namuda, dar ivazash ach'rashon medikh'ad. Vak'ti bai'at dasti bemisli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar rui dasti onkh'o bud. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'amai akh'volashon ogokh'i dorad. Kh'ech' amalashon az Parvardigor pushida namemonad. Pas, kh'ar ki akh'di khudro oid ba madad rasonidani din shikasta, ba on vafo nakunad, begumon zarari akh'dshikaniash ba khudash bozmegardad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on ziion namebinad. Va kh'ar ki bar akh'di bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bastai khesh vobasta ba iori dodani dinash vafo kunad, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiash podoshi buzurgi ch'annatro khokh'ad dod.

11) Ei Paiombar, ba zudi vak'te az Sulkh'i Kh'udaibiia barmegardi, on bodiiashinkh'oe, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro az kh'amsafariat ba sui Makka vopas guzosht, ba tu meguiand: "Moro az kh'amsafariat nigokh'ubini molkh'o va farzandonamon mashg'ul sokht. Pas az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi gunokh'onamon omurzish bikhokh'." Munofik'on bo zabonashon az Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) darkhosti omurzishi gunokh'ro mekunand, vale on dar k'albashon nest. Chunki eshon kh'anuz az gunokh'onashon tavba nakardaand. Ba onkh'o bigu: "Agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo neki khokh'ad io agar ba shumo badi khokh'ad, kh'ech' kas baroiaton az k'udrati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chizero boz doshta nametavonad. Balki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' amali shumo kh'archand bikushed, ki onro makhfi nigokh' dored, az U pinkh'on namemonad."

12) Bakh'onai peshovardaaton vobasta ba khuddori az kh'amsafari bo Rasuli Allokh' vok'eiiat nadorad, balki shumo gumon doshted, ki Rasuli Allokh' va mu'minon ch'umlagi kh'alok megardand va minba'd ba Madina kh'argiz barnamegardand. Va Shaiton inro dar k'albaton oroish dod va nisbat ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) badgumoni karded, ki guio dinashro iori namedikh'ad va shumo ba sababi badgumoni dar kh'ak'k'i U va tarki kh'amrakh'ii Rasulash k'avmi kh'alokshuda gashted.

13) Va kh'ar ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash imon naorad, pas vai kofir ast va Mo baroi kofiron otashi shu'lavari shadidro omoda sokhtaem. Ruzi k'iiomat bo on otash azob doda meshavand.

14) Va farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin iagona az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Az bandagonash gunokh'i kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, bakhshida, uro bo fazlash ba ch'annat medarorad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, az rui adlash azob mekunad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakor bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

15) Vak'te shumo mu'minon baroi giriftani g'animatkh'oi Khaibar, ki Khudo onro ba'd az Sulkh'i Kh'udaibiia baroiaton va'da namud, biraved, iak'inan bodiianishinone, ki Khudo onkh'oro az kh'amrakh'ii Paiombarash dar safari Makka vopas guzosht, khokh'and guft: "Moro guzored, to bo shumo baroi giriftani amvoli g'animat biravem." Onkh'o bo in talabi khud mekhokh'and va'dai Khudoro, ki g'animatkh'oi Khaibar khos ba mu'minon doda meshavad, tag'iir dikh'and. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Shumo kh'argiz az dunboli mo nakhokh'ed omad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'abl az bozgashtamon az Sulkh'i Kh'udaibiia chunin kh'ukm karda ast, ki g'animatkh'oi Khaibar tankh'o ba ishtirokchiioni on Sulkh' mutaallik' ast." Pas begumon onkh'o khokh'and guft: "Shumo moro az on ki kh'amrokh'aton ba Khaibar ravem, bo amri ilokh'i boz namedored, balki nisbatamon kh'asad dored." Kor on guna ki in bodiianishinon mepindorand, nest, balki onkh'o az amr va nakh'ii ilokh'i ba ch'uz andaki on kh'ech' chizero namefakh'mand. Az in sabab, ba gunokh' dast mezanand.

16) Ei Paiombar, ba bodiianishinoni az kh'amrakh'ii tu ba sui Makka vopasmondashuda bo mak'sadi sanch'ish bigu: "Ba zudi shumo ba ch'angi k'avme da'vat meshaved, ki dar nabard sokh'ibi nerui shadidand. Bo onkh'o dar rokh'i Khudo mech'anged io biduni ch'ang islom meorand. Pas, agar az farmoni Khudo dar da'vat ba ch'ang bo k'avmi mavsuf itoat kuned, baroiaton ach'ri neki ch'annatro medikh'ad. Va agar az itoati farmonash ru gardoned -chunonchi k'ablan az kh'amrakh'ii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba Makka khuddori namuded- shumoro ba uk'ubati bag'oiat dardovar giriftor mesozad."

17) Bar shakhsoni ma'zur ba misli nobino io lang io bemor -agar az shirkat dar nabardi dushman vopas nishinand- kh'ech' gunokh'e nest. Va kh'ar ki az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash itoat kunad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro ba bustonkh'oe vorid mesozad, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtonash rudkh'o ch'ori meboshand va kh'ar ki az itoati Allokh'u Rasulash rui tobad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro ba azobi nikh'oiat dardovar mabtalo megardonad.

18) Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az mu'minon kh'amon vak'te ki dar Sulkh'i Kh'udaibiia zeri on darakht bo tu akh'd mebastand, rozi gasht. Zamone bo tu akh'd bastand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imonu ikhlos va sidk'i dilkh'oiashonro medonist, pas dar dilkh'oiashon oromishro ech'od namud va dar ivazi az dast dodani dukhuli Makka ba onkh'o bo fatkh'i nazdik (fatkh'i Khaibar) podosh dod.
19) Va Khudo ba onkh'o g'animatkh'oi ziiodero ato kard, ki onro az akh'li Khaibar megirand. Va iak'inan Khudo Zoti G'olibi dar ofarinish, tak'dir va chorasozii korkh'oi bandagon Bokh'ikmat ast.

20) Ei mu'minon, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton g'animatkh'oi bisiorero va'da doda ast, ki onro dar kishvarkushoikh'oi minba'da ba dast meored. Pas, ba shumo in g'animatkh'oi Khaibarro zud ato namud. Va vak'te ki iakh'udikh'o ba'd az shumo k'asdi ba khonadonaton oseb rasonidanro kardand, Khudo dastonashonro az zarari shumo boz dosht. Va g'animatkh'oi Khaibarro zud nasibaton gardond, to shukri Uro ba ch'o ored va to on molkh'oi g'animat baroi shumo mu'minon alomati az sui Parvardigor iori va dastgiri ioftanaton gardad va niz Khudo shumoro ba rokh'i rost rakh'namoi sozad.

21) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo g'animatkh'oi digarero va'da karda ast, ki kh'olo bar kh'osil namudani on k'odir nagashtaed. Iagona Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar on Tavono ast. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ilm va tadbirash on g'animatkh'oro ikh'ota karda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ama chiz Tavono ast.

22) Va ei mu'minon, agar kofiron bo shumo bich'angand, kh'atman bo shikast rubaru shuda, az nazdaton pusht gardonida, megurezand, sipas kh'ech' korsoz va iorirasone nameioband, ki korashonro sarparasti namoiad va ba onkh'o alaikh'i shumo iori dikh'ad.

23) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) g'olibiiati mu'minonu shikasti kofironro dar kh'ar zamonu makon k'onuni sobiti tag'iirnopazir gardonida ast. In k'onun k'abl az in takzibgaron dar baini ummatkh'oi peshin guzashta ast. Va ei Paiombar, kh'argiz baroi k'onuni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tag'iirotero nameiobi.

24) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zotest, ki vak'te tak'riban kh'ashtod nafar mushrik dar Kh'udaibiia omada, khostand ba shumo oseb rasonand, dastoni onkh'oro az shumo va dastoni shumoro az onkh'o boz dosht. Shumo on mushrikonro nakushted va niz ozorashon nadoded, balki ba'd az on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar asir giriftani on dastai musallakh' k'udrataton bakhshid va g'olibaton sokht, onkh'oro rakh'o namuded. Va on chi mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on Bino ast. Kh'ech' amalaton az U pushida namemonad.

25) Onkh'o kasone kh'astand, ki ba Allokh' va Rasulash kofir shudand va shumoro az Masch'id-ul-kh'arom man' kardand va az rasidani chorvokh'oi k'urboni ba makh'kh'ali zabkh'i khud dar sarzamini Kh'aram peshgiri namuda, on chorvokh'o dar nimarokh' bozdoshta shudand. Va agar mardon va zanoni boimon, ki onkh'oro nameshinosed, namebudand va khavfi on nameraft, ki onkh'oro nashinokhta, kh'amrokh'i kofiron mekushed, pas bo kushtanashon ba shumo, be ogokh'iaton ori gunokh' va pardokhti khunbakh'o merasad, kh'atman Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo fatkh'i Makkaro rukhsat medod, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba misli mu'minoni Makka kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, ba rakh'mati Khesh dokhil sozad. Agar dar Makka mu'minon az kofiron ch'udo mebudand, kh'amono kofironi in sarzaminro ba azobi dardovar mubtalo menamudem.

26) Zamone, ki kofiron g'urur va taassubi akh'li ch'okh'iliiatro, ki ba barposozii kh'ak'ik'at alok'ae nadorad, balki ba khostai nafs alok'amand ast, dar dilashon ch'oi doda, az dukhuli Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar soli Kh'udaibiia ba Makka kibr varzidand, chunki tarsidand, ki dar surati daromadani Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba Khonai Khudo onkh'o mag'lub makh'sub meshavand. Pas Khudo az sui Khud bar Paiombarash va bar mu'minon sobitk'adami va oromishro furud ovard, mu'minon az in kori mushrikon ba khashm omadand, ammo khudro idora karda, vokunish nishon nadodand va Khudo mu'minonro poibandi kalimai "Lo ilokh'a illalokh'" va inchunin poibandi ich'roi talaboti on sokht, onkh'o talaboti kalimai tavkh'idro ich'ro mekardand va ba in kalima az digaron sazovortar va shoistai on budand. Zero Khudo khairero, ki dar k'albashon nukh'ufta bud, medonist. Va Khudo kh'ama chizro medonad. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi namemonad.

27) Iak'inan Khudo ba Rasulash khobi rostro nishon dod. Rasuli Khudo dar khobash did, ki kh'atman shumo ioronash kh'amrokh'ash -agar Khudo khokh'ad- dar kh'olate ba Masch'id-ul-kh'arom medaroed, ki az sharri dushmanon dar amon buda, ba'zeaton kh'amchun nishoni khotimaiobii marosimi kh'ach' muii sarashro taroshida, ba'zeaton onro kutokh' kardaed. Minba'd az aziiati mushrikon nametarsed. Pas Khudo chizero az manfiataton medonist, ki shumo namedonisted. Pas Khudo k'abl az takh'ak'k'uk'i khobi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bo vurudash ba Makka dar on sol, fatkh'i nazdikero muk'arrar sokht. Murod az in fatkh' Sulkh'i Kh'udaibiia va fatkh'i Khaibar bud, ki Khudo on du piruziro bo dasti mu'minoni ishtirokchii Sozishnomai Sulkh' ba ich'ro darovard.

28) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) On Zotest, ki Rasulash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro bo baioni ravshan va dini barkh'ak'k'i Islom firistod, to onro bar kh'amai dinkh'oi mukholifash g'olib sozad. Inro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shokh'idi doda va U ba sifati Shokh'id basanda ast.

29) Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) Firistodai Khudo ast. Va sakh'obagoni kh'amrokh'ash bo kofironi ch'angch'u shadidu sakhtgir, ammo baini khud dustu mekh'rubon kh'astand. Ei binanda! Tu onkh'oro dar kh'olati ruku' va sach'da mebini, ki az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) talab dorand, to bo mag'firati gunokh'on va dodani podoshi azim ba onkh'o lutf namoiad va az onkh'o rozi gardad. Alomati durakhshoni va namudi zeboiashon dar chekh'raashon az asarkh'oi sach'da namoion ast. In vasfi dar Tavroti Muso (alaikh'is salom) nisbatashon vorid shuda ast. Va vasfashon dar Inch'ili Iso (alaikh'is salom) on ast, ki onkh'o ba e'tibori kamol va kh'ambastagi monandi ziroate kh'astand, ki khushakh'oi khurdashro berun ovarda, pas on khushakh'o reshakh'oro k'avi sozad, pas on ziroat ba'd az zaifi sakht shavad, pas bar tanaash rost istad. K'uvvatu kamolash ziroatkoronro ba kh'airat meorad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ioroni Paiombarashro niz kh'amin guna gardonida ast, to ba sababi onkh'o kofironro ba khashm biiorad. Zero zamone dushmanon neruiu kamol va vakh'dati sakh'obagonro medidand, g'azabnok meshudand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sakh'obagone, ki imon ovardaand va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, mag'firati gunokh'on va podoshi buzurgi ch'annatro va'da karda ast. Onkh'o baroi gunokh'onashon much'ozot nameshavand.

1) Ei mu'minoni pairavi shariat! Dar guftoru kirdori khud bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash peshdasti nakuned va bo ich'roi dasturot va duri az mamnuot az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bitarsed. Ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai guftorkh'o, Donandai kirdorkh'oi shumo ast. Kh'ech' guftor va kirdoraton az U pushida namemonad.

2) Ei mu'minoni pairavi shariat! Vak'ti sukh'bat bo Rasuli Allokh' odobro rioia karda, sadoiatonro az sadoiash baland nakuned va nomashro oshkor nagired, chunonchi ba'zeaton nomi ba'zeatonro megired, balki uro mekh'rubonona bo vasfi "Ei Paiombar" io "Ei Rasul" nido kuned. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro az baland namudani sado va zikri ismi Paiombarash ba khotiri on man' karda ast, ki khavf meravad savobi a'molaton bo in korkh'o botil shavad, kh'ol on ki shumo botil shudanashro kh'is namekuned.

3) Ba durusti ki on kasone, ki nazdi Rasuli Allokh' kh'angomi bo vai kh'amsukh'bat shudan sadoiashonro past mekunand, inkh'o kasone meboshand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dilashonro ba khotiri tak'vo sanch'ida, onro az kh'ama nav'i oludagikh'o pok sokhta ast. Ruzi k'iiomat baroiashon mag'firati gunokh'on va podoshi buzurgi dukhuli ch'annat ast.
4) Ei Paiombar, ba durusti, on bodiianishinone, ki turo az beruni kh'uch'rakh'oi kh'amsaronat sado mekunand, aksariiatashon mak'omi voloiatro namedonand va ak'lashonro ba kor namedarorand.

5) Va ei Paiombar, agar bodiianishinon to nazdashon baromadanat sabr menamudand va ba'd az on bo sadoi past va narm kh'amrokh'at sukh'bat mekardand, in baroiashon bekh'tar bud. Zero dar in surat ekh'tiromi turo ba ch'o meovardand. Va Khudo nisbat ba bandagon Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Gunokh'i on bodiianishinonro, ki az rui nodoni khilofi odob amal kardand, mebakhshad.

6) Ei mu'minoni pairavi shariat, agar shakhsi fosik'e ba shumo az sui k'avme khabare biiorad, pas dar borai durustii on takh'k'ik' karda, dar tasdik'ash nashitobed zero agar be takh'k'ik' onro tasdik' kuned, khavfi on ast, ki bo ch'inoiate dar kh'ole kh'ak'ik'at doshtanashro namedoned, ba k'avme oseb birasoned, pas chun durug' budanash ma'lum shavad, az kori nisbat ba on begunokh'on sodir kardai khesh pushaimon garded.

7) Va ei mu'minon, bidoned, ki dar miioni shumo Rasuli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiash paig'om meoiad. Az durug' biparkh'ezed. Zero dar surati durug' guftanaton Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro ogokh' mesozad. Rasuli Allokh' on chiro ba sud va ziioni shumo ast, bekh'tar medonad. Agar vai az shumo dar bisiore az peshnikh'odkh'oiaton itoat kunad, kh'atman dar ranch'e, ki onro baroiaton namekhokh'ad, giriftor megarded. Vale Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo fazli Khud imonro dar nazaraton makh'bub sokht va onro dar k'albaton zinat dod va imon ovarded va kufru berunshavi az toat va ma'siiatro dar nazaraton nafratovar sokht. In ch'amoai bo sifatkh'oi mazkur vasfshuda rakh'ravoni kh'ak'ik'ii rokh'i durust kh'astand.

8) In dar nazari shumo makh'bubsozii imon va nafratovar sokhtani kufru fosik'i va gunokh', fazl va ne'mati ilokh'i nisbat ba shumo ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donoi Bokh'ikmat ast. Bandagoni shukrguzorashro medonad va ba onkh'o tavfik' medikh'ad. Kh'ar chiro bo kh'ikmatash dar ch'oii munosibi on meguzorad.

9) Va ei akh'li imon, agar du gurukh'i mu'minon muk'obili kh'amdigar bich'angand, pas shumo dar bainashon bo da'vat namudan ba dovar k'aror dodani kh'ukmi ilokh'i musolakh'a andozed. Pas agar iake az on du taraf az musolakh'a sarpechi karda, bar alaikh'i tarafi digar zulmu taaddi ravo binad, pas bar muk'obili on gurukh'i zolimi tach'ovuzgar bich'anged, to ba sui kh'ukmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardad. Pas agar onkh'o ba sui kh'ukmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargashtand, pas dar baini du taraf bo adolatu insof sulkh' andozed va dar dovari adolat namoed. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shakhsoni dar dovariashon odilro dust medorad.

10) Beshak, mu'minon barodari dinii iakdigar kh'astand. Modom ki chunin ast, pas ei mu'minon baini du barodaraton agar bo kh'amdigar bich'angand, sulkh' andozed. Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi farmonkh'o va parkh'ez az man'kardakh'oiash bitarsed.

11) Ei mu'minon! Naboiad mardone az bainaton mardoni digarro maskhara kunand. Zero shoiad on shakhsoni maskharashuda nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az maskharakunandagon bekh'tar boshand. Asosan nisbat ba shakhs bakh'oi Khudo e'tibor dorad. Va niz naboiad zanone zanoni digarro maskhara kunand. Zero shoiad on zanoni maskharashuda nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az zanoni maskharakunanda bekh'tar boshand. Va barodaroni kheshtanro aib nagired, zero aib giriftani onkh'o dar kh'ukmi aib giriftani khudi shumo ast va iakdigarro bo lak'abkh'oi nokhush sado nakuned. Chunonchi k'abl az omadani Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba Madina ba'ze az mardumi ansor chunin mekardand. Kh'ar ki khilofi in guftakh'o amal kunad, pas vai fosik' ast. Sifati fosik'i ba'd az imondori bag'oiat zisht ast. Va kasone, ki az in gunokh'on tavba nakunand, pas inkh'o dar kh'ak'ik'at sitamkor kh'astand. Bo anch'omi ma'siiat kheshro ba ch'oii kh'alokatovar afkanda, bar ch'onashon sitam namudaand.

12) Ei mu'minoni pairavi shariat, az bisiori gumonkh'oi beasosi az sabab va burkh'on kholi biparkh'ezed. Iak'inan ba'zei gumonkh'o -ba misli badgumoni nisbat ba shakhsi zokh'iran solekh'- gunokh' ast va aibkh'oi mu'minonro ch'ustuch'ui va ch'osusi nakuned va az g'aibati iakdigar duri bich'ued. G'aibat dar kh'oli adami kh'uzuri barodari mu'min guftani sukhane ast, ki agar onro shunavad, meranch'ad. Oio kase az shumo dust medorad, ki gushti badani barodari murdaashro bikhurad?! Pas, shumo in korro namepisanded va az on nafrat dored. Modom ki az khurdani gushti badani barodaraton nafrat dored, az g'aibatash niz boz isted. Zero g'aibati mu'min dar kh'ukmi iste'moli gushti ust. Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi amr va parkh'ez az nakh'iiash bitarsed. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Tavbapaziri Mekh'rubon ast.

13) Ei mardum! Ba durusti ki Mo shumoro az iak ch'insi mard va zan ba ismi Odamu Kh'avvo ofaridem. Azbaski kh'amai shumo az iak aslu nasab kh'asted, kh'ak' nadored ba'ze bar ba'zei digar bo nasab fakhr kuned. Va Mo shumoro ba'd az ofaridan millatkh'o va k'abilakh'oi bisior va dar zamin parokanda sokhtem, to kh'amdigarro bishinosed, na in ki bar iakdigar az millatu k'abilai khud bifakhred. Chunki imtiiozi asosiaton az iakdigar tak'vo ast. Iak'inan giromitarinaton nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ezkortarini shumo ast. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Zoti Donoi Bokhabar ast. Akh'voli shumoro medonad va az nuk'sonu kamolaton purra ogokh' ast. Kh'ech' chizi shumo az U pushida nest.

14) Ba'ze az akh'li bodiia nazdi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) omada guftand: "Mo ba Khudo va Rasulash imon ovardaem." Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Shumo imon naovardaed, vale "Taslim shudaem va mute' gashtaem" bigued va kh'anuz imon ba dilaton rokh' naiofta ast, ammo intizor meravad, ki on dar oianda ba on rokh' iobad. Va ei bodiianishinon, agar shumo dar imonu amali nek az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash itoat kuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az amalkh'oiaton chizero kam namesozad. Shakke nest, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i bandagon bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast."

15) Iak'inan mu'minoni kh'ak'ik'i kasone kh'astand, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash imon ovarda, sipas dar e'tik'odashon shak nakardaand va bo molashon va ch'onashon dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'ikh'od karda, az sarfi on du bukhl navarzidaand. In sokh'iboni sifatkh'oi nombarshuda dar kh'ak'ik'at mu'minoni sodik' meboshand.

16) Ei Paiombar, ba in bodiianishinon bigu: "Oio mekhokh'ed Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro dar borai dini kheshtan ogokh' sozed, kh'ol on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar on chi dar osmonkh'o va kh'ar on chi dar zamin ast, kh'amaro medonad va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai kulli chizkh'ost. Baroi kh'amin, U niiozmandi on nest, ki az dinaton ogokh'ash gardoned."

17) Ei Paiombar, in bodiianishinon islom ovardanashonro bar tu minnat mekunand. Ba onkh'o bigu: "Islom ovardanatonro bar man minnat nakuned. Zero naf'i on -agar kh'osil shavad- ba khudi shumo barmegardad. Balki agar shumo dar da'voiaton oidi paziruftani Islom sodik'ed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar shumo minnat menikh'ad, ki baroiaton tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui imonro doda ast."

18) Beshubkh'a, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rozi osmonkh'o va zaminro medonad. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest. Va kh'ar on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on Bino ast. Kh'ech' amalaton az U makhfi nest va shumo baroi neku badi on ch'azoi khudro megired.
1) "K'of." Dar ibtidoi surai Bak'ara sukhan oidi tafsiri oiatkh'oi shabekh'i in kh'uruf guzashta ast.
Ba K'ur'oni karimi doroi khairu barakat va ma'noi ziiod savgand, ki shumo bandagon ruzi k'iiomat iak'inan baroi bozpursi va giriftani podosh zinda gardonida meshaved.

2) Ei Paiombar, illati az ch'onibi kofiron inkorsozii dinat on nest, ki onkh'o az tu tavak'k'ui durug'ro doshta boshand, zero ch'umlagi turo ba sifati mardi rostk'avl meshinosand, balki az on taach'ch'ub kardaand, ki ba onkh'o na az nav'i farishtagon, balki az nav'i khudashon paiombari bimdikh'anda omada ast. Pas kofiron bo kh'airat meguiand: "Az baini insonkh'o omadani paiombar kori nikh'oiat taach'ch'ubovar ast.

3) Oio vak'te memirem va khok megardem, dubora zinda karda meshavem?! In bozgashti rukh' ba ch'asad ba'd az pusidani on dar khok va az nav zindashavi kori nomumkin ast. In kor ba ak'lamon rost nameoiad."

4) Ba durusti ki Mo kh'ar on chiro zamin az ch'ismi onkh'o mekhurad va fano mesozad, medonem. Kh'ech' zarrai onkh'o az Mo pushida namemonad. Va nazdi Mo Kitobest, ki tamomi tak'diroti onkh'oro dar zindagi va ba'd az on ba tavri mufassal kh'ifz mekunad.

5) Balki in mushrikon vak'te Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) K'ur'onro ba onkh'o ovard, onro durug' shumurdand. Pas eshon dar kori oshufta va omekhtae k'aror dorand. K'albashon dar takzibashon orom nest. Oidi K'ur'on nazarkh'oi mukhtalif doshta, gokh'o onro ch'odu va gokh'o she'ru folbini mekh'isoband. Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi k'abli az tarafi mushrikon mavridi takzib k'aror giriftani rastokhezro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin dalelkh'oi vuk'ui onro baion namuda meguiad:
6) Oio in takzibgaroni ruzi k'iiomat az alomatkh'oi k'udrati ilokh'i dar koinot rui gardonida, dar borai osmoni boli sarashon bo tafakkur nigokh' nakardand, ki Mo onro chi guna ofarida, bo sitoragon zinatash dodem, kh'ol on ki on kh'ech' surokhie nadoshta, az kh'amai aibu nuk'son solim ast?! On Parvardigore, ki osmonro ba in nazmu nizom ofarid, kh'argiz az zinda kardani murdagon och'izi namekashad.

7) Va zaminro baroi imkonpazir gashtani sukunati bandagonamon gustaronidem va dar on kukh'kh'oi ustuvorro furu afkandem, to zaminro ustuvor nigokh' dorad va dar on kh'ar nav'i giiokh' va darakhti zebomanzarro ruionidem.
8) Mo tamomi in mavch'udotro ba khotiri bino gardonidan va pand dodani kh'ar bandai bo ibodat ba sui Khudo bozgardanda ofaridem.
9) Va Mo az osmon obi doroi khairu naf'i ziiodero furud ovardem. Pas ba vositai on ob bog'kh'o va niz on chiro ba misli donai ch'avu gandum va g'airi on, ki ch'am'ovari mekuned, ruionidem.
10) Va ba vositai on ob darakhtoni balandi khurmoro ruionidem, dar kh'ole ki shukufakh'oiash rui kh'amand.

11) Kh'amai inro baroi rizk'i bandagon ruionidem. Va niz bo on ob baroi zamini khushkidai begiiokh' kh'aiot bakhshidem. On guna ki Mo zamini murdaro bo rekhtani boron zinda sokhtem, kh'amin guna ba murdagon kh'aiot mebakhshem va onkh'o az k'abr zinda berun meoiand.
12) Ei Rasuli Mo, k'abl az in takzibkunandagoni k'avmat ummatkh'oi ziiode paiombaronashonro durug'gui kh'isobidaand. K'avmi Nukh' va Askh'obi Chokh' va Samud Paiombaroni Khudoro durug'gui donistand.
13) Va k'avmi Od va Fir'avn va k'avmi Lut paiombaronro durug'gui kh'isobidand.

14) Va k'avmi Shuaib, sokinoni dekh'ai doroi darakhtoni pechida va k'avmi Tubba' -podshokh'i Iaman- paiombaronashonro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand. Kh'amaashon paembaroni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro takzib kardaand. Pas, bar onkh'o azobi va'dadodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'at'i gardid.
15) Oio Mo az ofarinishi nakhustini shumo och'izi kashidaem, ki az dubora zinda gardonidanaton och'izi bikashem?! Balki onkh'o dar borai ofarinishi ch'adidi ba'd az marg dar kh'airatand.
16) Va iak'inan Mo insonro ofaridem va nafsash kh'ar on chiro ba vai vasvasa mekunad, medonem va Mo bo ilmi Khud ba kh'ar iak inson az shokh'ragi gardanash, ki bo k'albash paivand ast, nazidktarem.
17) On zamonero iod kun, ki du farishtai vobastai sabti a'moli bandagon korkh'oi uro sabt menamoiand. Iakei on du farishta az tarafi rost va digare az tarafi chapash nishasta ast.
18) Inson kh'ech' sukhani nek io badero ba zabon nameorad, magar on ki nazdash farishtae nigakh'bonu kh'ozir ast. Kh'ar chi guiad, az sui farishta nazorat va kitobat meshavad.
19) Va ba kh'ar iak inson sakhtii marg ba rosti meoiad. Kh'ech' kas az on ch'oi gurez nadorad. Ei insoni g'aflatzada, in marg kh'amon chizest, ki az on dakh'shat mekashidi va megurekhti.
20) Va farishtai vobastai damidani sur nafkhai duiumro dar sur medamad. On ruzi k'iiomat ast, ki ba kofiron dar on ruz va'dai ch'azoi bad doda shuda ast.
21) Va on ruz kh'ar kas dar kh'olate ba makh'shar meoiad, ki kh'amrokh'ash du farishta buda, iake uro pesh-peshi khud mebarad va digare bar a'molash guvokh'i medikh'ad.

22) Ba insoni kofir gufta meshavad: "Ba durusti ki tu dar dunio az sababi ba shakh'vatkh'o va lazzatkh'o firefta gashtanat az imruz dar g'aflat budi. Pas, Mo bo on chi az azob mushokh'ida mekuni, pardaro az peshi chashmonat bardoshtem, pas imruz chashmonat bisior tezbin gashta ast. Kh'ar chiro, ki az on dar g'aflat k'aror doshti, mebinad.
23) Va farishtai dar dunio kh'amdamu kh'amnafasash meguiad: "In kh'ama amalkh'oi ust, ki nazdam biduni kamu ziiod omoda va kh'ozir ast."

24) Khudo ba on du farishtae, ki iake uro pesh-peshi khud ba makh'shar meburd va digare bar a'molash guvokh'i medod, meguiad: "Kh'ar kasero, ki dar dunio kh'ak'ro inkor karda, muk'obili on sarkashi namuda, -
25) kh'ak'k'i bar dushash voch'ib budaro ziiod man' karda, marzkh'oi shar'ro poimol sokhta, ba va'daiu takh'idkh'oi ilokh'i shubkh'a dosht, ba duzakh andozed.
26) On kase, ki kh'amrokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digar k'aror doda, onro meparastid, pas uro niz ba azobi sakht afkaned."
27) Kh'amdamash az baini shaitonkh'o az vai bezori ch'usta meguiad: "Ei Parvardigori mo, man gumrokh'ash nakardam, vale khud dar zalolati az kh'ak' nikh'oiat dur k'aror dosht."

28) [Allokh' ta'olo] meguiad: "Nazdi Man kashmakash nakuned. Inch'o nizo' foida nadorad. Va kh'ol on ki Man ba durusti, dar dunio ba vositai firistodagonam va'dai azobi shadidi mutaallik' ba kofironu isionkoronro ba shumo tak'dim karda budam.

29) Sukhani Man tag'iir doda nameshavad va va'dai Man khilof namegardad va Man kh'argiz nisbat ba bandagon bo kam kardani neki io afzun sokhtani badi sitamgar nestam, balki kh'ar kas ch'azoi amali khudro megirad."

30) Ei bandai sokh'ibkhirad, iod kun ruzero, ki Mo ba duzakh meguem: "Oio az kofiron va badkoron pur gashtai?!" Va duzakh dar ch'avob bo mak'sadi talabi beshtar va ba khotiri Khudo g'azab karda meguiad: "Ilokh'o, oio az in kh'am beshtar kh'ast?!"

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi k'abli va'dai uk'ubati kofironro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin ne'matkh'oi baroi mu'minon omoda sokhtaashro baion namuda meguiad:
31) Va ch'annat baroi bandagoni az kufr va gunokh' parkh'ezkor nazdik sokhta meshavad. Ch'annatro bo ne'matkh'oiash dar kh'ole ki az onkh'o dur nest, mushokh'ida menamoiand.

32) Ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "In kh'amon ne'matest, ki Khudo onro ba shumo va'da doda bud." Ch'annat baroi kh'ar bandae nazdik ovarda meshavad, ki bo tavba ba sui Khudo bozgashta, marzkh'oi shariatro nigokh' medorad.
33) On kas, ki dar pinkh'oni -dar onch'o, ki ch'uz Parvardigor kh'ech' kas uro namedid- az Parvardigori Mekh'rubon mekh'arosid va bo k'albi poki ruiovarda ba Khudo bo U mulok'ot kard.
34) Ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Ba ch'annat dar kh'olate vorid shaved, ki az kh'amai nokhushi solimed. In ruzi abadii zavolnopazir ast."

35) Baroi akh'li ch'annat dar ch'annat kh'ar on chi mekhokh'and, farokh'am ast va nazdi Mo afzun bar in ne'matkh'oe ba monandi didori Parvardigor mavch'ud ast, ki na chashme onro dida, na gushe onro shunida va na dar gushai khotiri kase guzashta ast.

36) Va ummatkh'oe, ki Mo onkh'oro k'abl az in mushrikoni takzibgari akh'li Makka kh'alok sokhtem, nikh'oiat bisiorand. On k'avmkh'oi guzashta az in mushrikon nerumandtar budand. Pas, onkh'o azbaski nerumand budand, kishvarkh'oro ch'ustuch'u kardand, ki shoiad az margu azobi ilokh'i ch'oi gurez meioband, ammo chunin makonero paido nakardand.

37) Iak'inan dar zikri sarguzashti ummatkh'oi nerumandi k'ablan kh'alokshuda baroi on kas, ki doroi k'albi bedor ast io ba nasikh'at dar kh'ole az on g'ofil nest, bo dik'k'at gush faro medikh'ad, pandu andarz ast.

38) Va Mo beshak, osmonkh'ovu zamin va mavch'udoti baini onkh'oro dar shash ruz ofaridem -agarchi k'udrat doshtem, ki in makhluk'otro dar iak lakh'za biofarem- kh'ol on ki ba Mo az ofaridani inkh'o -on guna ki iakh'udikh'o mepindorand- andaktarin khastagi va ranch' narasida ast.

39) Pas ei Paiombar, bar on chi k'avmi iakh'ud va g'airi onkh'o meguiand, sabr bikun va Parvardigoratro kh'amd gufta, kholis ba khotiri U k'abl az tului oftob namozi bomdod va k'abl az g'urubi on namozi asrro barpo namo.
40) Va dar kh'issae az shab ba khotiri Parvardigorat namoz bikhon va ba'd az adoi kh'ar namoz Uro az kh'ama aibu nuk'son ba poki nisbat bidekh'.
41) Va ei Paiombar, bo dik'k'at ba in sukhan gush kun! Chun farishtai vobastashuda ba damidan dar sur az ch'oii dur nafkhai duiumro medamad, murdagon az k'abr barmekhezand.
42) Ruze, ki khaloik' fariodi rastokhezro ba rosti meshunavand. On ruze, ki in fariod ba gushashon merasad, ruzi az k'abrkh'o berun omadani murdagon baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo ast.

43) Ba durusti ki tankh'o Mo kh'aiot mebakhshem va memironem. Ch'uz Mo kh'ech' kas in k'udratro nadorad. Va ruzi k'iiomat bozgashti bandagon baroi bozpursi va giriftani podoshi amal tankh'o ba sui Mo ast.
44) Ruze, ki zamin az boloi makhluk'oti dokhilash shikof megardad, onkh'o az zerash shitobon berun meoiand. In barangekhtan va ch'am'ovarii khaloik' bar Mo bag'oiat oson ast.

45) Mo on chiro in ch'amoai takzibgar meguiand, bekh'tar medonem. Va ei Paiombar, tu bar onkh'o musallat nagashtai, ki baroi imon ovardan mach'burashon bisozi. Mas'uliiati tu fak'at az tablig'i amri ilokh'i ba bandagon iborat ast. Pas, ba vositai K'ur'on on kasero, pand bidekh', ki az va'dai uk'ubati Man ba kofiron va isionkoron mekh'arosad. Chunki az irshodoti K'ur'on makh'z kh'amin bandagoni az azobi Khudo bimnok pand megirand.
1) Savgand ba bodkh'o, ki khokro ba kh'ar su parokanda mesozand -
2) pas savgand ba abrkh'o, ki boroni ziiodro mebardorand -
3) pas savgand ba kishtikh'o, ki dar bakh'r ba osoni meravand -
4) pas savgand ba farishtagoni tak'simsozandai amri Khudo vobasta ba korkh'oi bandagon, ki -
5) iak'inan on chi Parvardigor ba shumo az bozpursi va giriftani podoshi amal va'da doda ast, beshubkh'a, rostu durust ast -
6) va Ba durusti ki bozpursii bandagon dar ruzi k'iiomat kh'atman vok'e'shavanda ast. Dar vuk'ui on kh'ech' shakke nest.
7) Savgand ba osmoni zebokhilk'ati doroi rokh'kh'oi ziiod, ki -
8) beshak, shumo akh'li Makka dar sukhani ziddu nak'iz k'aror dored. Gokh'o K'ur'onro she'ru gokh'o ch'odu, gokh'o Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro shoir va gokh'o ch'odugar megued.

9) Az imon ovardan ba K'ur'on va Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kase bozgardonda meshavad, ki dar ilmi azalii Khudo bozgardonda shuda boshad. Azbaski Khudo medonad, ki on banda rokh'i zalolatro barguzida, imon nameorad, ba vai tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro namedikh'ad.
10) La'nat bod bar in ch'amoai kazzob, ki dar sha'ni Firistodai Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va K'ur'on sukhanoni noch'o meguiand, -
11) on kasone, ki az saroi okhirat dar ch'akh'olati kheshtan g'ofiland. Nisbat ba ruzi k'iiomat parvo nadorand.
12) Onkh'o mepursand, ki ruzi ch'azo kai ba vuk'u' mepaivandad?! Dar kh'ole inro mepursand, ki baroi k'iiomat kh'ech' omodagi nadidaand.
13) Khudo dar posukhashon meguiad: "Kh'amon ruz, ki onkh'o dar otash suzonda meshavand."
14) On ruz ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Azobatonro bichashed. In on azobest, ki vak'te shumo dar dunio az vuk'ui on bim doda meshuded, az rui tamaskhur kh'ar chi zudtar omadanashro talab mekarded."
15) Begumon ruzi k'iiomat parkh'ezkoroni ich'rosozandai dasturot va durich'uianda az mamnuot dar bustonkh'o va chashmakh'oi ch'ori ch'oi megirand.
16) Dar kh'ole ki savobi azimi atonamudai Parvardigori kheshro bo rozigi mepazirand. Zero iak'inan onkh'o k'abl az daromadani ch'annat dar dunio bandagoni nekukor budand.
17) Onkh'o dar kh'issai andake az shab khob meraftand va aksari onro bo toatu ibodat sipari menamudand.
18) Va sakh'argokh'on az Khudo mag'firati gunokh'onashonro mekhostand.
19) Va dar amvolashon baroi gado va shakhsi ba sababkh'oi mukhtalif az rizk' makh'rum, ki gadoi namekunad, g'airi zakot kh'ak' va sakh'm bud.

20) Va dar kukh'kh'o, bakh'rkh'o, nakh'rkh'o, darakhton, rastanikh'o va kh'aivonoti rui zamin baroi shakhsoni ba ofaridgori va suratofarinii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iak'indoshta alomatkh'oi dalolatgar bar k'udrati U ast.
21) Va dar vuch'udi shumo mardum alomatkh'oi k'udrati ilokh'i nikh'oiat ziiod ast. Oio in alomatkh'oro namebined, to pand bigired?!
22) Va dar osmon rizk'i dini va duniavii shumo ast va niz tamomi khairu sharre, ki ba on va'da doda meshaved, dar osmon sabtshuda ast.

23) Pas savgand ba Parvardigori osmon va zamin, monandi on ki shumo sukhan mekuned va dar sukhan kardani khud shakke nadored, dubora zinda gashtanaton kh'amin guna kh'ak' ast va dar vuk'ui on shakke nest.
24) Ei Paiombar, oio khabari shigiftovari mekh'mononi izzatmandi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom), ki farishtagon budand, baroiat omada ast?!

25) Vak'te nazdi Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) daromadand, pas ba u "Bar tu salom mefiristem" guftand. Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) dar ch'avob "Bar shumo paivasta salom bod" gufta, az dilash guzaronid, ki inkh'o k'avmi noshinosand.
26) Pas az nazari mekh'monkh'o pinkh'oni sui khonavodaash raft, pas az nazdi akh'li baitash gusolai farbekh'i birionero ovard. Vai fikr kard, ki in mekh'monon az nav'i basharand.
27) Pas gusolaro dar nazdiki mekh'monon guzoshta, bo mekh'ruboni guft: "Oio az taomi kh'ozirkardaam namekhured?"

28) Pas chun mekh'monon chize nakhurdand, Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) dar k'albash az onkh'o ekh'sosi kh'aros kard. Farishtagon inro pai burda, uro orom sokhta guftand: "Natars! Mo ba sui tu az peshi Khudo firistoda shudaem." Va uro ba vilodati farzandi donishmand bashorat dodand. Murod az farzandi donishmand dar in oiat Iskh'ok' (alaikh'is salom) ast.
29) Pas chun kh'amsarash in bashoratro shunid, az shodi fariodkunon omad, pas bar chekh'raash sili zad va bo taach'ch'ub guft: "Oio pirazane, ki dar asl nozoi ast, farzand tavallud mekunad?!"

30) Farishtagon ba u guftand: "Parvardigorat chunin gufta ast. Kh'ar chi Khudo biguiad, kase onro rad karda nametavonad. Ba durusti ki U dar ofarinish va tak'dirash Kh'akimu Donandai kh'amai khaloik' va manfiati onkh'o ast."
31) Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) ba farishtagon guft: "Pas, ei Firistodagoni Khudo, chi kori zarure dored?! Bo kadom mak'sad inch'o omadaed?!"
32) Farishtagon dar ch'avob guftand: "Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moro ba sui k'avmi gunakh'kore firistoda ast, ki paivasta gunokh'oni azim sodir menamoiand, -
33) to bar onkh'o az sui bolo sangkh'oi az gili sakht sokhtashudaro partob namoem, -
34) sangkh'oero partob namoem, ki ei Ibrokh'im, on sangkh'o nazdi Parvardigorat khos baroi bandagoni az marzkh'o tach'ovuzkunandai dar kufru ma'siiat fururavanda alomatguzori shuda ast."
35) Pas Mo on mu'minonero, ki dar dekh'ai k'avmi Lut (alaikh'is salom) budand, az on dekh'a berun ovardem, to giriftori azob nashavand.
36) Pas Mo dar on dekh'a tankh'o iak khonae az musalmonon -akh'li baiti Lut (alaikh'is salom)--ro paido kardem.

37) Va dar on dekh'a baroi kasone, ki az azobi dardovar metarsand, alomatkh'oi nishondikh'andai in rukhdodro guzoshtem, to bo mushokh'idai asarkh'oi uk'ubat pand bigirand va az in guna amalkh'o biparkh'ezand.
38) Va dar sarguzashti Muso (alaikh'is salom) baroi kh'ar ki az uk'ubati dardovar metarsad, pand ast. On gokh', ki Mo uro bo kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi vozekh' firistodem.

39) Pas Fir'avn ba neru va sipokh'iionash takia karda, az k'abuli kh'ak' rui tofta, dar sha'ni Muso (alaikh'is salom) guft: "U ch'odugar ast. Mardumro ch'odu mekunad. Io shoiad devona ast. Chi guftanashro namedonad."

40) Pas Mo Fir'avn va sipokh'iionashro giriftem, pas onkh'oro dar bakh'r afkandem. Onkh'o ch'umlagi g'ark' gashta, kh'alok shudand. Va Fir'avn korkh'oero az takzibi Muso (alaikh'is salom) va da'voi khudoi anch'om dod, ki sazovori uk'ubat bud.

41) Va dar sarguzashti Odi k'avmi Kh'ud baroi kh'ar ki az uk'ubati dardovar metarsad, pand ast. On gokh', ki bar onkh'o bodi az kh'amai khairu barakat kholiro firistodem. On bod kh'omili boron va bordorsozandai darakhton nabud.
42) On bod bar kh'ar chize az insonkh'o io amvol va g'airi on mevazid, onro nameguzosht, magar on ki nobudash mekard va monandi ustukhoni pusidai pora-pora megardonid.

43) Va dar sarguzashti Samudi k'avmi Solekh' baroi kh'ar ki az azobi dardovar metarsad, pand ast. On gokh', ki Mo ba onkh'o guftem: "To vak'ti khotima ioftani umri khesh az kh'aioti dunio bakh'ra bared."

44) Pas Samudi k'avmi Solekh' az farmoni Parvardigorashon kibr varzidand va khudro az k'abuli imon va ibodat buzurg kh'isobidand. Pas onkh'oro fariodi buzurgi margovar faro girift va onkh'o nuzuli onro intizori mekashidand. Chunki eshon se ruz k'abl az omadani uk'ubat dar borai vuk'ui on ogokh'onida shuda budand.
45) Dar natich'a onkh'o natavonistand azobi furudomadaro az khesh dur sozand va niz k'uvvate nadoshtand, ki ba vositai on az azob khuddori namoiand.
46) Va ba durusti ki Mo k'abl az in nombarshudagon k'avmi Nukh' (alaikh'is salom)-ro bo g'ark' kardan dar bakh'r kh'alok gardonidem. Zero onkh'o iak'inan k'avmi khorich' az toati Khudo budand.
47) Va Mo osmonro khalk' karda, binoi onro bo nerui Khud ustuvor namudem. Va begumon Mo atrofi onro paivasta pakh'nsozandaem.
48) Va zaminro baroi sokinonash gustaronidem va onro baroiashon chun farsh gardonidem. Pas Mo chi omodasozandai khube kh'astem.
49) Va az kh'ar chiz ba monandi ch'insi nar va moda, osmon va zamin, khushki va dario ch'uft ofaridaem, to shumo oid ba vakh'doniiat va k'udrati Khudo biandeshed va tankh'o Uro biparasted.

50) Pas bo ich'roi ibodat va tarki ma'siiat az uk'ubati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sui savobash firor namoed. Beshak, man baroi shumo mardum az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bimdikh'andai oshkoram.
51) Va kh'amrokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi digare k'aror nadikh'ed. Begumon man baroi shumo mardum az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bimdikh'andai oshkoram.

52) Ummatkh'oi guzashta niz ba monandi akh'li Makka firistodagoni Khudoro ba durug'gui nisbat medodand. Ba onkh'o kh'ech' firistodae az nazdi Parvardigor nameomad, magar on ki dar kh'ak'k'ash meguftand: "In mard ch'odugar io devona ast."

53) Oio kofironi guzashta bo kofironi imruza kh'amdigarro bar durug'gui shumurdani paiombaron vasiiat namudaand?! Ne, kh'argiz chunin nest, balki tug'ionashon onkh'oro atrofi in kor ch'am' ovarda ast.
54) Ei Paiombar, chun kofironi takzibgar dinatro namepazirand, pas az onkh'o rui bigardon. Zero tu malomatshavanda nesti. Paig'omi Khudoro baroiashon rasonidai.
55) Va naboiad az onkh'o rui gardonidanat boisi tarki nasikh'atashon gardad. Onkh'oro nasikh'at bikun va pand bidekh'. Zero ba durusti ki pand dodan ba mu'minon sud merasonad.
56) Va Man ch'inkh'o va insonkh'oro tankh'o ba khotiri ibodati Khesh khalk' kardaam. Onkh'oro khalk' nakardaam, ki ba Man sharik biiorand.
57) Man az onkh'o kh'ech' rizk'e namekhokh'am va namekhokh'am, ki Maro taom dikh'and.

58) Iak'inan fak'at Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Ruzidikh'anda, Sokh'ibi k'uvvat, Bag'oiat Nerumand ast. Tamomi mavch'udot niiozmandi rizk'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va mutei nerui U kh'astand.

59) Pas, ei Paiombar, kh'amono kasone, ki bo durug'gui donistani tu bar ch'onashon sitam mekunand, monandi kh'issai dustoni guzashtaashon kh'issai uk'ubati khudro dorand. On uk'ubat dar vak'ti muaiian meoiad. Pas onkh'o naboiad az Man k'abl az faro rasidani mukh'lati on uk'ubat zudtar omadanashro bitalaband.
60) Pas, voi bar kh'oli kofironu takzibgaroni paiombaroni ilokh'i az ruzi k'iiomat, ki ba onkh'o vuk'ui on ruz va'da doda meshavad.
1) Savgand ba kukh'e, ki Khudo dar boloi on bo Muso (alaikh'is salom) guftugu karda ast-
2) va savgand ba Kitobi navishtashuda-
3) dar sakh'ifakh'oi kushoda, ba monandi Kitobkh'oi k'abli -
4) va savgand ba Khonae dar osmon, ki farishtagon onro bo ibodat ta'mir mekunand-
5) va savgand ba osmoni barafroshta, ki baroi zamin chun sak'f ast-
6) va savgand ba bakh'ri pur az ob, ki-
7) ei Paiombar, kh'amono azobi Parvardigorat bar kofiron noguzir vok'e'shavanda ast.
8) Azobi Khudo kh'ech' bozdorandae nadorad, ki peshashro bigirad.
9) Azobi Parvardigorat dar ruze rukh medikh'ad, ki zamin iak'inan kh'amchun alomati barposhavii k'iiomat ba shiddat mech'unbad va noorom megardad.
10) Va kukh'kh'o biduni shak, az ch'oikh'oi khud ba kh'arakat medaroiand.
11) Pas, on ruz kh'alokatu khasorat domangiri kofironi takzibgari va'dai Khudo megardad-
12) on kasone, ki dar botil furu rafta, bozi mekunand. Dar dunio nisbat ba rastokhez va okhirat parvo nadorand.
13) Ruze, ki onkh'o ch'onibi otashi duzakh ba sakhti kashida shuda, dar on afkanda meshavand.
14) On ruz ba kofiron gufta meshavad: "In kh'amon otashest, ki vak'te paiombaronaton dar dunio az on kh'ushdoraton medodand, onro durug' mekh'isobided. -
15) Oio in uk'ubate, ki mushokh'idaash mekuned, ch'odu ast?! Io shumo onro namebined?!

16) Ba otashi duzakh vorid shaved, kh'arorati onro bichashed va ranch' bikashed. Pas, dar ranch'i on sabr mekuned io sabr namekuned, kh'ardu kh'am baroiaton barobar ast. Imruz ba shumo tankh'o ch'azoi on kufru ma'siiate doda meshavad, ki onro dar dunio anch'om medoded."

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi k'abli ch'azoi takzibkunandagonro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin podoshi mu'minoni parkh'ezkorro ovarda guft:
17) Kh'amono bandagone, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va parkh'ez az mamnuot az Parvardigorashon metarsand, dar bog'kh'o va ne'matkh'oi azimi abadi k'aror megirand.

18) Onkh'o bo chizkh'oe, ki Parvardigorashon baroiashon az khurdanikh'o, nushidanikh'o va izdivoch' bo kh'uroni ch'annati medikh'ad, lazzat mebarand. Va Parvardigorashon onkh'oro az azobi ch'akh'annam nigokh' medorad. Akh'li ch'annat ba ne'matkh'o noil shuda, az ranch'i ch'akh'annam makh'fuz memonand.

19) Ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Ba sababi on amalkh'oi shoistae, ki dar dunio ba ch'o meovarded, az on chi dilaton mekhokh'ad, bikhured va binushed. Khurdan va nushidan guvoroiaton bod. Dar khurdanikh'o va nushidanikh'oi ch'annat kh'ech' zararu ziione nest."

20) Akh'li ch'annat bar rui takhtkh'oi orosta, ki ba'zei on dar pakh'lui ba'zei digarash guzoshta shuda ast, takia mezanand. Va onkh'oro bo zanoni safedpusti doroi chashmoni siiokh'i vase' k'arin megardonem.

21) Va on kasone, ki imon meorand va farzandonashon dar imon ba onkh'o pairavi mekunand, Mo dar ch'annat farzandonashonro agarchi misli padaronashon amal nakarda boshand, ba onkh'o mepaivandem, to osoishashon ziiod shavad va az savobi korashon chizero kam namekunem. Kh'ar inson dar barobari on chi az amali bad io nek anch'om medikh'ad, dar garav ast. Kh'ech' kas az amali vai chizero bar dushi khud namegirad.
22) Va Mo paivasta baroi akh'li ch'annat nav'kh'oi gunoguni mevakh'o va kh'ar gushtero, ki dilashon mekhokh'ad, ilova mesozem.

23) Onkh'o dar ch'annat az dasti iakdigar k'adakh'i sharobero megirand, ki az iste'molash sukhani botil ba zabonashon berun nameoiad va ak'lro az dast doda, gunakh'kor nameshavand. Bar khilofi sharobi dunio, ki vak'te kase onro nushad, sukhanoni bekh'uda meguiad va ba sababi az dast dodani ak'lash gunakh'kor megardad.
24) Va dar atrofashon navch'avonone davr mezanand, ki khos baroi khidmati onkh'o muvazzaf gashtaand. On navch'avonon dar safo va pokii surat monandi marvoridi dar sadaf makh'fuzand.
25) Va ba'zei onkh'o ba ba'zei digar rui ovarda, az kh'olati dar dunio doshtai kh'amdigar mepursand.
26) Dar ch'avob meguiand: "Ba durusti ki mo dar dunio dar baini khonavodai khud az azobi ilokh'i bimnok budem.
27) Pas, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo kh'idoiat namudanamon ba Islom bar mo in'om kard va moro az uk'ubati otashi nikh'oiat purkh'arorati duzakh nigakh' dosht.

28) Iak'inan mo dar dunio Uro meparastidem va duo mekardem, ki moro az otashi duzakh nigakh' dorad. Beshak, U Zoti Nekukori dar va'dai Khud Sodik', nisbat ba bandagonash bag'oiat Mekh'rubon ast. Az nishonakh'oi rakh'mat va lutfi Khudo dar kh'ak'k'amon on ast, ki moro kh'idoiat namuda, voridi bikh'isht gardond va az duzakh dur sokht.
29) Pas ei Paiombar, mardumro bo K'ur'on pand bidekh'. Chunki tu ba sababi on chi Parvardigorat az imon va ak'l baroiat in'om karda ast, folbin va devona nesti.
30) Balki takzibgaron meguiand, ki kh'amono Mukh'ammad Firistodai Khudo nest, shoir ast. Mo muntazirem, ki marg uro az bain bibarad. On gokh' az vai rokh'at meshavem.
31) Ei Paiombar, ba in dasta bigu: "Margi maro muntazir boshed. Pas man niz begumon muntaziri azobe kh'astam, ki Khudo ba sababi takzibaton onro bar shumo furud khokh'ad ovard."

32) Oio ak'lashon onkh'oro ba guftani in sukhan, ki Firistodai Khudo folbin va devona ast, suporish medikh'ad?! Kofiron bo in k'avli khesh mekhokh'and dar iak shakhs du sifatero ch'am' sozand, ki on du dar asl ch'am' nameshavad. Balki onkh'o k'avmi az kh'ududi Khudo tach'ovuzkunanda buda, ba shariat va ak'li solim takia namekunand.

33) Io onkh'o meguiand, ki kh'amono Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) K'ur'onro az nazdi khesh bofta, vakh'ii ilokh'i nest?! K'ur'on kalomi boftai Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nest, balki kofironi takzibkunanda az rui kibr imon nameorand va ba chunin tukh'matkh'o dast mezanand.
34) Agar dar da'voi kheshtan, ki K'ur'on sukhani boftai Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ast, sodik' boshand, pas ba in monand sukhanero biiorand.

35) Oio onkh'o biduni ofaridagor khalk' shudaand?! Io onkh'o khud kholik'i khud kh'astand?! Imkon nadorad, ki chize be kholik' ba vuch'ud oiad. Inchunin nomumkin ast, ki makhluk' khudro biofarad. Modome kh'ak'ik'at chunin ast, pas charo kofironu mushrikon Kholik'i Iagonaro nameparastand?!

36) Io onkh'o osmonkh'ovu zaminro ofaridaand?! Ne, chunin nest, balki eshon ba kholik'iiati Khudo iak'in nadorand. Zero agar ba ofaridgoriash iak'in medoshtand, fak'at Uro meparastidand ba Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) imon meovardand.

37) Io khazinakh'oi rizk'u nubuvvati Parvardigorat nazdi onkh'ost, ki onro ba kh'ar kas khokh'and, medikh'and va az kh'ar kas khokh'and, boz medorand?! Io onkh'o dar korkh'oi in koinot mutobik' ba khosti khesh tasallut dorand?!

38) Io onkh'o nardbon dorand, ki ba vasilai on sui osmon baromada, onch'o ba paig'omi ilokh'i gush faro medikh'and, ki guio eshon kh'ak' kh'astand?! Agar chunin boshad, pas on kase az in kofiron, ki ba vakh'ii ilokh'i gush faro doda ast, vobasta ba da'voi dar rokh'i durust budanashon kh'uch'ch'ati ravshanero biiorad.
39) Oio dukhtaron az Khudo va pisaron az shumo kh'astand?! Kh'ol on ki shumo baroi khud pisaronro khos mesozed va az dukhtaron nafrat dored.
40) Io ei Paiombar, tu az onkh'o dar ivazi tablig'i risolati khud muzd mekhokh'i, dar natich'ai in darkhostat onkh'o ba bardoshtani bori sangine mukallaf shudaand, ki tavoni kh'amlashro nadorand?!
41) Io nazdashon ilmi g'aib ast, pas onkh'o sirri ogokh'i ioftaashonro ba mardum menavisand va az rozi pushida kh'ar chiro khokh'and, ba mardum khabar medikh'and?!

42) Io in ch'amoai takzibgar mekhokh'and nisbat ba tu va dinat tavtea kunand?! Az tavteai onkh'o nakh'aros, balki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia bikun. Zero kofiron khud giriftori makri khesh megardand. Makri sokhtaashon ba tu ziion namerasonad.

43) Io onkh'o g'air az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ie dorand?! Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mushrikon ba U nisbat medikh'and, munazzakh' ast. Kh'ech' pursishi guzashta ch'avobi musbat nadorad va ch'avobi musbat doshtan nametavonad.

44) Va agar in kofiron az sui osmon porakh'oi baroi azobashon ba zamin suk'utkunandaro binand, meguiand: "In k'it'akh'o chun kh'ar vak'ta abri rui kh'am ch'am'shuda meboshand." Onkh'o az mushokh'idai on ibrat namegirand va imon nameorand.
45) Pas, ei Paiombar, in kofironi k'avmatro to zamoni mulok'oti ruzi k'iiomatashon, ki dar on azob meshavand, dar iakravi va inkorashon bok'i biguzor.
46) Ruze, ki makrashon chize az azobro az onkh'o bartaraf namesozad va ba onkh'o bo nach'ot dodanashon az on azob kumak karda nameshavad.

47) Va iak'inan baroi kasone, ki bo shirku ma'siiat bar ch'onashon sitam mekunand, k'abl az azobi okhirat dar dunio bo kushtashavi va asir aftodan va dar olami k'abr azob ast. Vale beshtarashon in kh'ak'ik'atro namedonand. Ba kh'amin illat kufrashonro idoma medikh'and.

Vak'te Khudo dar oiatkh'oi k'abli butloni pindori mushrikonro baion namud, dar oiatkh'oi zerin Paiombarashro ba adami tavach'ch'ukh' ba onkh'o va sabr namudan bar ozorashon farmon doda guft:
48) Va ei Paiombar, dar barobari k'azoi Parvardigorat va kh'ukmi shar'ii U sabr kun. Zero Ba durusti ki tu zeri nazar va inoiati khosi Mo k'aror dori. Va chun az khobat barmekhezi, Parvardigoratro ba poki bikhon va sitoishash namo.
49) Va dar kh'issae az shab Parvardigoratro ba poki bikhon va namoz barpo bidor va namozi bomdodro dar on vak'te, ki sitoragon ba sababi rushnoii ruz nopadid meshavand, ado namo.
1) Savgand ba sitora chun bo tului fach'r nopadid shavad, ki-
2) kh'argiz ioraton Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az rokh'i kh'idoiat munkh'arif nashuda va gumrokh' nagashta ast. Balki vai insoni kh'idoiatiofta ast.
3) Va K'ur'onro bo pairavii khostai nafsash nameguiad.
4) Begumon in Kitob paig'omest, ki Khudo onro ba vositai Ch'abrail ba Paiombarash vakh'i firistoda ast.
5) Onro baroiash Ch'abraili farishtai bisior k'avi ta'lim doda ast.
6) Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom) shakli zebo dorad. Pas u dar barobari Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba surati aslii khud rost istod.
7) Va Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom) dar tarafi balandi osmon k'aror dosht.
8) Sipas Ch'abrail ba Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nazdik shud. Pas beshtar nazdik gasht.
9) Pas, nazdikiash ba Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba andozai nazdikii du kamon io az on kh'am nazdiktar gardid.
10) Pas Ch'abrail ba bandai Khudo Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) on chiro boiad vakh'i mefiristod, vakh'i firistod.
11) K'albi Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) on chiro chashmonash did, inkor nakard.
12) Ei mushrikon oio shumo Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro durug'gui mekh'isobed va bo vai dar borai on chi Khudo baroiash dar shabi Isro' namoish doda va dida ast, ch'idol mekuned?!
13) Va savgand, ki iak'inan Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) Ch'abrail (alaikh'is salom)-ro bori digar ba surati asliash dar shabi Isro' va Me'roch' dida ast.
14) Dar nazdi Sidrat-ul-muntakh'o. On darakhti nikh'oiat buzurge dar osmoni kh'aftum ast.
15) Ch'annati ma'vo va maskani parkh'ezkoron dar nazdi Sidrat-ul-muntakh'o ast.
16) Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) zamone Ch'abaril (alaikh'is salom)-ro did, ki Sidraro chizi buzurge mepushond, ki az kh'ak'ik'ati on ch'uz Khudo kase ogokh' nest.
17) Chashmi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba samti rostu chap kach' nashud va az kh'addi khud tach'ovuz nakard.

18) Kh'amono Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar shabi Me'roch' ba'ze az nishonakh'oi Parvardigorashro, ki bar iagonagi va k'udrati U dalolat mekard, did. Vai on shab ch'annatu duzakh va digar makhluk'oti azimro mushokh'ida kard.
19) Ei mushrikon, ba Man oidi butkh'oiaton ba nomi Lot va Uzzo -
20) va niz oidi Manoti buti seiumi digaraton khabar dikh'ed! Oio in butkh'o ba shumo zarar va foida rasonida metavonand?!
21) Ei mushrikon, oio pisar az shumo va dukhtar az Khudo ast?! Kh'ol on ki shumo baroi khud pisaronro khos sokhta, ba dukhtaron nafrat dored.
22) Dar in kh'olat, in tak'simbandii mutobik' ba khostai khesh anch'om dodaaton tak'simbandii zolimona ast.

23) In butkh'o ba ch'uz nomkh'oi kholi az ma'no chize besh nestand. Az sifatkh'oi ma'budiiat sakh'me nadorand. Onkh'oro shumo va padaronaton az nazdi khud nomguzori namudaed. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vobasta ba onkh'o kh'ech' dalele furud naovarda ast. Mushrikon dar e'tik'odashon tankh'o az gumon va az on chi nafsashon az zinatkh'oi shaitoni mekhokh'ad, pairavi mekunand. Va Ba durusti ki az sui Parvardigorashon tavassuti Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba onkh'o rakh'namoi omad, ammo kh'idoiat naioftand.
24) Magar on chi inson az shafoati butkh'o mekhokh'ad, ba dast meorad va kh'osil megardad?!

25) Ne, kh'argiz chunin nest. Pas begumon okhirat va dunio iagona az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. U az dunio va okhirat ba kh'ar ki kh'ar chiro khokh'ad, medikh'ad va az kh'ar ki kh'ar chiro khokh'ad, boz medorad.

26) Va dar osmonkh'o chi baso farishtagoni bisiore kh'astand, ki agar ba kase shafoat kardan khokh'and, shafoatashon kh'ech' manfiat namebakhshad, magar ba'di on ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kh'ar ki khokh'ad, ich'ozai shafoat dikh'ad va az shafoatshavanda rozi gardad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' gokh' ba shafoati butkh'o, ki dar dunio az suii akh'li shirk mavridi ibodat k'aror megiriftand, rukhsat namedikh'ad va niz kh'ech' gokh' az mushrikon rozi nameshavad.

27) Kh'amono kasone, ki ba rastokhezii ruzi k'iiomat imon nadorand, farishtagonro bo nomkh'oi zanona nomguzori mekunand. Ba ak'idai onkh'o guio farishtagon dukhtaroni Khudo kh'astand. Khudo az tukh'matkh'oi kofironu mushrikon poku muk'addas ast.

28) Va mushrikon dar borai in nomguzoriashon donish nadorand. Onkh'o oidi in korashon tankh'o az takhmin va gumon pairavi menamoiand. Va gumon az kh'ak' chizero beniioz namegardonad va ch'oii onro namegirad.
29) Pas, ei Paiombar, az on kas, ki ba zikri Khudo pusht karda va ch'uz zindagonii dunio chize namekhokh'ad, ba okhirat imon nameorad va baroiash omodagi namebinad, rui bigardon.

30) Kh'addi nikh'oii kofiron az donish kh'amin talabi dunio ast. Zero onkh'o ch'okh'il buda, ba iak'in narasidaand. Ei Paiombar, kh'ar ki az rokh'i kh'ak' kach' rafta ast, Parvardigorat uro bekh'tar medonad va U ba on kas, ki ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat iofta ast, Donotar ast. Chize az U pinkh'on nest.

31) Va on chi dar osmonkh'o va on chi dar zamin vuch'ud dorad, az rui molikiiat, kh'ukmfarmoi, ofarinish va tadbir iagona az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mavch'udoti baini osmonkh'o va zaminro ofarida ast, to ba on kasone, ki dar dunio badi mekunand, dar badali a'molashon ch'azoi loik' dikh'ad va ba mu'minone, ki amalkh'oi shoista ba ch'o meorand, bo ch'annat podosh dikh'ad.

32) On bandagoni nekamal kasoneand, ki az gunokh'oni kabira va gunokh'oni k'abekh' duri mech'uiand, lekin gunokh'oni sag'iraashon bo tarki kabira va anch'omi ibodatkh'oi bisior bakhshida meshavad. Ei Paiombar, kh'amono Parvardigorat Doroi mag'firati vase' ast. Kh'ar gokh' bandagon az gunokh'onashon tavba kunand, onkh'oro mebakhshad. U zamone Padaraton Odamro az khok ofarid va zamone shumo dar batni modaronaton ch'anin buda, markh'ilakh'oi pai dar paii ofarinishro pasi sar mekarded, az akh'volaton Ogokh'tar bud va Ogokh'tar kh'ast.[4] Kh'ech' chize az in kh'olatkh'o az U makhfi nest. Pas kheshtanro bo nisbat dodan ba porsoi ta'rifu tavsif nakuned. Zero U bekh'tar medonad, ki chi kase bo ich'roi dasturot va duri ch'ustan az man'kardakh'oiash parkh'ezkori karda ast.
33) Oio zishtii kh'olati kasero, ki ba'd az nazdik shudan ba Islom az on rui toft, didi?!
34) Va moli andak dod va onro boz dosht. Zero bukhl ba sirishtash tabdil iofta ast. Ammo bo in vuch'ud, khudro ta'rifu tavsif mekunad.
35) Oio nazdash ilmi g'aib ast, pas ba kh'amin sabab g'aibro mebinad va az rui on sukhan mekunad?!

36) Oio vai nisbat ba Khudo durug' mebofad?! Oio ba in shakhsi nisbat ba Khudo durug'bof az on chi dar sakh'ifakh'oi nakhustin, ki Khudo onro bar Muso (alaikh'is salom) furud ovarda bud, khabar doda nashuda ast?!
37) Va az navishtakh'oi sakh'ifakh'oi Ibrokh'ime, ki tamomi dasturoti Khudoro ba tavri shoista ba itmom rasonid, khabar doda nashuda ast?!
38) Navishtakh'oi sakh'ifakh'oi Muso (alaikh'is salom) va Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) chunin bud, ki kh'ech' inson gunokh'i g'airashro bar dush namegirad.
39) Va in ki kh'ar inson tankh'o ch'azoi amali khudro kh'osil menamoiad.
40) Va in ki dar ruzi k'iiomat amalash ba vai oshkor nishon doda meshavad.
41) Sipas ch'azoi amalash baroiash ba purragi ato megardad.
42) Va in ki ei Paiombar, anch'om va ch'oi bozgashti bandagon ba'd az marg ba sui Parvardigori tust.
43) Va in ki U kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, khushkh'ol gardonda, mekhandonad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, andukh'gin gardonda, megirionad.
44) Va in ki U zindagonro dar dunio memironad va ba murdagon dar ruzi rastokhez kh'aiot mebakhshad.
45) Va in ki U du ch'ufti nar va modaro ofarida ast-
46) az nutfa ofarida ast, vak'te on dar rakh'mi zan guzoshta shavad.
47) Va in ki ba'd az marg dubora zinda gardonidani murdagon bar Khudo ast.
48) Va in ki U az bandagonash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, tavongar mesozad va ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, sarmoia medikh'ad.
49) Va in ki U Parvardigori sitorae ba nomi "Shi'ro" ast. Ba'ze az k'abilakh'oi mushriki arab on sitoraro meparastidand.
50) Va in ki U Odi avvali k'avmi Kh'udro vak'te bar kufrashon bok'i mondand, kh'alok kard.
51) Va Samudi k'avmi Solekh'ro kh'alok kard. Pas az onkh'o kasero bok'i naguzosht.

52) Va k'abl az Odu Samud k'avmi Nukh'ro kh'alok sokht. Iak'inan k'avmi Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) az Odu Samud zolimtar va sarkashtar budand. Daleli zolimtar va sarkashtar budanashon on ast, ki Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) nukh'sadu panch'okh' sol onkh'oro ba sui iaktoparasti da'vat kard, vale imon naovardand.
53) Va dekh'akh'oi k'avmi Lutro ba ch'onibi osmon bardosht, sipas on dekh'akh'oro chappa karda, ba sui zamin sarozer afkand.
54) Sipas on dekh'akh'oro ba'di ch'onibi zamin sarnagunshavi sangkh'oi ziiod pushonida, zeri sangboron mondand.
55) Pas, ei inson, dar borai kadom iak nishonakh'oi Parvardigorat, ki daleli k'udrati Ust, ch'idol mekuni?! Oio pand namegiri?!
56) In Paiombare, ki ba suii shumo firistoda shuda ast, az nav'i paiombaroni bimdikh'andai k'ablan guzashta ast.
57) K'iiomat nazdik shuda ast.
58) Ba ch'uz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' kas va kh'ech' chiz onro bartaraf sokhta va az zamoni vuk'ui on ogokh' gashta nametavonad.
59) Oio az K'ur'on taach'ch'ub mekuned, ki on az nazdi Khudo omada ast?!
60) Va tamaskhurkunon ba K'ur'on mekhanded va kh'angomi shunidani pandkh'oi on giria namekuned?!
61) Va shumo az irshodotash g'ofil buda, parvoi onro nadored?!
62) Pas tankh'o dar barobari Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sach'da namoed va kholis Uro biparasted.

1) Omadani k'iiomat nazdik shud va mokh' dar akh'di Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dunim gasht. Dunim gashtani mokh' az mu'ch'izakh'oi kh'issii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bud.

2) Va agar mushrikon dalelu mu'ch'izai isbotkunandai rostk'avlii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro binand, az k'abuli on rui megardonand va meguiand: "On chi mo az dalelu mu'ch'iza mebinem, ch'odui az bainravanda ast."

3) Va kh'ak'ik'ati baroiashon omadaro durug' donistand va dar takzibi on az khostakh'oiashon pairavi kardand. Va kh'ar kori neku bad ruzi k'iiomat k'aror megirad va ba nikh'oiatash merasad. Khair bo akh'lash dar ch'annat va shar bo akh'lash dar duzakh k'aror megirand.
4) Va iak'inan ba akh'li Makka az sarguzashti ummatkh'oi guzashta, ki Khudo onkh'oro ba sababi kufru sitamashon kh'alok gardonida bud, akhbori baroi az kufru zulm boz doshtanashon kofi omada ast.

5) On chi az akhbori guzashtagon ba in kofiron omada ast, kh'ikmati tom ast, to dalel bar onkh'o barpo gardad. Pas oiatkh'oi K'ur'on ba k'avme, ki ba Khudo va ruzi okhirat imon nameorand, sud namebakhshad.

6) Ei Paiombar, modom ki kofironi Makka kh'idoiat naioftand, pas az onkh'o rui gardon va rakh'oiashon namo. On ruzero iod kun, ki farishtai muvazzaf ba damidan dar sur onkh'oro ba sui kori on chunon mudkh'ishe faro mekhonad, ki khaloik' k'ablan monandi onro nameshinokhtand.
7) Onkh'o dar kh'ole az k'abrkh'oiashon berun meshavand, ki chashmonashon az shiddati k'iiomat furukh'ishta buda, onkh'o dar bisiori va omekhtashavi misli on ki malakhi parokanda boshand.
8) Ba sui da'vatkunanda ch'onibi makh'shar meshitoband. Kofiron az mushokh'idai shiddat va dakh'shatkh'oi okhirat meguiand: "In ruzi bag'oiat dushvor ast."

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi k'abli az da'vati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) rui toftani kofironro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin bo mak'sadi tasalli dodani on kas khabar dod, ki ummatkh'oi guzashta niz paiombaronashoro ba durug'gui nisbat medodand.
9) Ei Paiombar, k'abl az takzibkunandagoni k'avmi tu k'avmi Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) Paiombarashonro takzib kardaand. Pas, vak'te Mo bandai Khud Nukh' (alaikh'is salom)-ro nazdashon firistodem, uro durug'gu shumurdand va guftand: "U devona ast." Va onkh'o Nukh' (alaikh'is salom)-ro bo kh'ar dashnomu nosazogui va takh'did ba k'atl az adoi risolat boz doshtand.
10) Pas Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) Parvardigorashro duo karda guft: "Ba durusti ki k'avmam maro mag'lub sokhta, da'vatamro napaziruftand. Pas bo furud ovardani uk'ubati Khesh az onkh'o intik'om bigir."
11) Pas, Mo darkh'oi osmonro bo obi paiopaii farovon rezanda boz namudem.

12) Va chashmakh'oi zaminro shikoftem va az tamomi ch'oii zamin ob favvora mezad. Pas obi osmonu zamin ba khotiri kore, ki Khudo onro dar azal muk'addar sokhta bud, iakch'o gardid. Onkh'o ba istisnoi kasone, ki Parvardigor nach'otashon dod, ch'umlagi g'ark' shudand.
13) Va Nukh'ro bar kishtii doroi takhtakh'o va mekhkh'o savor namudem va uro bo pairavonash az kh'alokat nach'ot dodem.

14) Kishti dar mavch'kh'oi purtalotumi ob zeri nazar va kh'ifzi Mo kh'arakat mekard. Mo in korro baroi podosh dodani Nukh' (alaikh'is salom), ki k'avmash uro durug'gu donistand va ba nubuvvatash kofir gashtand, anch'om dodem.
15) Va ba durusti, Mo in uk'ubati k'avmi Nukh' (alaikh'is salom)-ro kh'amchun ibrat guzoshtem. Pas, oio ibratpazire kh'ast, ki az ta'rikhi onkh'o pand bigirad.
16) Pas, uk'ubati Man dar kh'ak'k'i takzibgaron va onkh'oro az kh'alokat bim dodanam chi guna bud?! Uk'ubatam chunon mudkh'ish bud, ki az doiari tavsif berun ast!
17) Va Mo iak'inan K'ur'onro baroi az on pand va ibrat giriftan oson gardonidaem. Pas oio ibratpazire kh'ast, ki az andarzkh'oi on pand bigirad?!

18) K'avmi Od Paiombarashon Kh'ud (alaikh'is salom)-ro ba durug'gui nisbat dodand. Pas, ei akh'li Makka, andesha kuned, ki uk'ubatam nisbat ba onkh'o chi guna bud?! Va andesha kuned, ki Man bo azob dodani eshon digaronro chitavr kh'ushdor dodam?!
19) Kh'amono Mo bar k'avmi Kh'ud (alaikh'is salom) dar ruzi bad va nomuborake, ki nakh'sii on baroiashon to ruzi vurudashon ba ch'akh'annam idomaiobanda ast, tundbodi sardero firistodem.
20) On tundbod mardumro az ch'oiashon barmekand, misli on ki onkh'o tanakh'oi darakhti khurmoi az bekh kandashuda boshand va sarozer ba zamin meandokht.
