21) Pas, ei akh'li Makka, andesha kuned, ki azobam nisbat ba onkh'o chi guna bud?! Va andesha kuned, ki Man bo uk'ubat kardani onkh'o chitavr digaronro kh'ushdor dodam?!
22) Va Mo iak'inan K'ur'onro baroi az on pandu ibrat giriftan oson gardonidaem. Pas oio ibratpazire kh'ast, ki az andarzkh'oi on pand bigirad?!
23) K'avmi Samud bim dodan va kh'ushdorkh'oi Paiombarashon Solekh'ro durug' kh'isobidand.
24) Pas bo inkor guftand: "Oio iak insonero az nav'i khudamon pairavi mekunem?! Kh'amono agar mo tobei u shavem, dar in surat az rokh'i durust dar duriiu inkh'irof va ranch' k'aror megirem.
25) Oio paig'omi Khudo az bainamon makhsus baroi Solekh' furud ovarda shuda ast?! Ne, chunin nest, balki u durug'gui guzaroi bisior khudkhokh' ast."
26) Kh'atman onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat khokh'and donist, ki chi kase durug'gui guzaroi bisior khudkhokh' ast?! Solekh' io onkh'o?!

27) Begumon Mo modashuturro ba khotiri imtikh'on az kharsang berun meorem va nazdashon mefiristem. Pas, ei Solekh', muntazir bishav va nazorat bikun, ki onkh'o bo on modashutur chi kor mekunand va nisbat ba khudashon chi vok'ea rukh medikh'ad va dar barobari ozorashon sabr namo.

28) Va ba k'avmat khabar bidekh', ki obi chokh'ashon dar baini onkh'o va modashutur tak'simshuda ast. Iak ruz az k'avmat va iak ruz az modashutur buda, dar kh'issai kh'ar ruza tankh'o sokh'ibi on kh'ozir meshavad.
29) Pas, k'avmi Solekh' dustashonro fariod kardand, to modashuturro bikushad. Pas, vai shamsherro girift va amri k'avmashro ba ch'o ovarda, onro ba k'atl rasond.
30) Pas, ei akh'li Makka, dar borai on ki Man onkh'oro chi guna azob kardam va chi guna bo azobi onkh'o digaronro bim dodam, biandeshed?!

31) Ba durusti ki Mo bar onkh'o kh'amagi iak sadoro barangekhtem va on sado kh'amaashonro kh'alok sokht. Pas, onkh'o monandi shokhakh'oi khushki zeri poii chorpoioni og'il poimolshudai shakhsi og'ildor gashtand.
32) Va kh'amono Mo K'ur'onro baroi az on pand va ibrat giriftan oson gardonidaem. Pas, oio kase kh'ast, ki az andarzkh'oi on pand bigirad?!
33) K'avmi Lut bim dodanu kh'ushdorkh'oi Paiombarashon Lutro durug' shumurdand.

34) Kh'amono Mo bar in k'avm tundbodero barangekhtem, ki onkh'oro sangrboron mekard, ba ch'uz khonadoni Lut (alaikh'is salom), ki subkh'gokh'on onkh'oro az in azob rakh'oi bakhshidem. Lut (alaikh'is salom) kh'amrokh'i khonadonash k'abl az vuk'ui azob dar k'ismati okhiri shab az on dekh'a berun shud.

35) Mo khonadoni uro az uk'ubat rakh'onidem, to nisbatashon az nazdi Khud in'om namoem. On guna ki ba Lut (alaikh'is salom) podosh dodem, kh'amin tavr ba kh'ar kas, ki shukri ne'matkh'oi Khudoro ba ch'o meorad, podosh medikh'em.
36) Va dar kh'ak'ik'at Lut (alaikh'is salom) onkh'oro az uk'ubati Mo bim dod. Pas onkh'o dar borai bim dodani vai ch'idol karda, onro durug' kh'isobidand.

37) Va in k'avmi badkor az Lut (alaikh'is salom) darkhost namudand, ki onkh'oro bo farishtagoni ba surati mekh'mon tashrifovarda rakh'o bisozad va saddi rokh'ashon nashavad, to nisbat ba mekh'monon amali fakh'sho anch'om dikh'and. Pas chashmonashonro az didani mekh'monon pushonidem va mekh'mononro dida natavonistand. Va ba onkh'o guftem: "Uk'ubati Man va natich'ai az bim dodanam sarpechi namudaatonro bichashed."
38) Va dar vak'ti subkh' ba onkh'o azobe omad, ki to zamoni vurudashon ba okhirat idoma meiobad. Dar okhirat azobi shadidtar domangirashon megardad.
39) Va ba onkh'o guftem: "Azobi Man va natich'ai az bim dodanam sarpechi namudaatonro bichashed."
40) Va kh'amono Mo K'ur'onro baroi az on pand va ibrat giriftan oson gardonidaem. Pas, oio kase kh'ast, ki az andarzkh'oi on pand bigirad?!
41) Va iak'inan ba vositai Muso va Kh'orun (alaikh'is salom) ba Fir'avn kh'ushdorkh'oi ziiod omada bud.

42) K'avmi Fir'avn kh'amai kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi az nazdamon omadaro takzib kardand. Pas Mo onkh'oro dar ivazi korashon ba sifati Parvardigori G'olibi K'odire, ki mag'lub namegardad va az chize och'iz nameshavad, azob namudem.
43) Ei mardumi Makka, oio kofironi shumo az kofironi iodshudai k'avmi Nukh', Od, Samud, Lut, Fir'avn va k'avmash bekh'tarand io shumo dar Kitobkh'oi osmoni nomai ozodi az azobro dored?!
44) Io kofironi Makka meguiand: "Mo ch'am'i muttakh'ide kh'astem, ki kh'ar kase ba mo k'asdi bad namoiad va ittikh'odamonro parokanda kardan khokh'ad, az vai intik'om megirem"?!
45) Ba zudi ch'am'i in kofiron shikast doda meshavad va muk'obili mu'minon pusht megardonand. In va'dai Khudo ruzi ch'angi Badr takh'ak'k'uk' paziruft.
46) Balki k'iiomate, ki durug'ash meshumorand, zamoni va'dai azobi onkh'ost. Va azobi k'iiomat az azobi dar ch'angi Badr chashidaashon azimtar va talkhtar ast.
47) Iak'inan on kasone, ki murtakibi kufru ma'siiat meshavand, dar gumrokh'i va ranch'u azoband.
48) Ruze, ki dar otash bar chekh'raashon kashida meshavand va ba onkh'o bo sarzanish gufta meshavad: "Azobi otashi duzakhro bichashed."
49) Kh'ak'k'o, ki Mo tamomi mavch'udotro tibk'i ilm va irodai Khesh bo tak'diri sobik' ofarida va dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz navishtaem.
50) Va vak'te ki ba vuch'ud ovardani chizero khokh'em, farmoni Mo ch'uz guftani iak ch'umlai "Kh'ast shav" besh nest. Bo kh'amin on monandi iak bor ba kh'am zadani chashm dar kh'ol paido meshavad.
51) Va begumon Mo ummatkh'oi guzashtai dar kufr shabekh'i shumoro kh'alok gardonidem. Pas oio ibratpazire kh'ast, ki az in ibrat bigirad va az kufrash boz istad?!
52) Va kh'ar korero, ki bandagon anch'om medikh'and, on dar kitobkh'oi farishtagoni kotibi a'mol navishta va sabtshuda ast. Kh'ech' amali onkh'o az farishtagon favt nameshavad.
53) Va kh'ar iak guftoru kirdori khurd va kalon dar sakh'ifakh'oi a'mol va Lavkh'i Makh'fuz navishtashuda ast. Ba zudi onkh'o baroi kh'ar iak guftoru kirdori khesh ch'azoi sazovor mebinand.

54) Kh'amono bandagone, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va duri az mamnuoti shariat parkh'ezkori mekunand, dar bog'kh'ovu rudkh'oi ch'ori ch'oi megirand. On ch'o az ne'matkh'oi mukhtalifi Parvardigorashon bakh'ra mebarand.

55) Dar ch'oi nishasti pisandida, ki dar on bekh'udagi va gunokh' nest, nazdi Khudoi Moliku Podshokh'i mutlak'i bag'oiat K'udratmand. Modom ki akh'li ch'annat dar chunin mak'omand, pas az ne'matkh'oi dar onch'o kh'osil menamudaashon mapurs!
1) Allokh'i Sokh'ibi rakh'mati benikh'oiat pakh'novar -
2) K'ur'onro bo oson sokhtani kh'ifzi lafz va fakh'mi ma'noiash ba mardum ta'lim dod,-
3) insonro dar bekh'tarin surat ofarid, -
4) baroiash ta'lim dod, ki chi guna on chiro dar k'albash mavch'ud ast, bo rokh'i nutk'u navishtan baion sozad.
5) Oftob va mokh' bo kh'isobi muaiiani dak'ik' kh'arakat mekunand, to mardum te'dodi solkh'o va kh'isobro bidonand.
6) Va rastanikh'oi besok'a va darakhton ikhtiioran amri Khudoro ba ch'o meorand va az dasturotash itoat mekunand.
7) Va osmonro chun sak'fi zamin barafroshta ofarid va adolatro dar zamin muk'arrar namuda, bandagonashro ba rioiai on amr kard.
8) Adolatro dar zamin muk'arrar gardonid, to shumo mardum dar kh'ak'k'i iakdigar zulm va dar tarozu khiionat nakuned.
9) Va vaznro dar baini khesh bo adolat ich'ro namoed va vak'te baroi digaron chizero barmekashed, az tarozu kam nasozed.
10) Va zaminro bo in nizomi shigiftangez baroi sukunati khaloik' ba vuch'ud ovard.
11) Dar zamin darakhtoni mevadikh'anda va darakhtoni khurmoi doroi g'ilofkh'o ast.
12) Va dar zamin donakh'oi ba monandi gandum va ch'av doroi kokh' va nabototi khushbu ast.
13) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
14) Khudo Odam (alaikh'is salom)-ro az gili khushki monandi safol ofarid.
15) Va Iblisi padari ch'inkh'oro az shu'lai otashi az dud toza kh'ast namud.
16) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
17) U Parvardigori mashrik'i tobistona va zimistona va mag'ribi tobistona va zimistonai oftob ast.
18) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
19) Khudo bakh'ri shur va shirinro dar kh'ole zokh'iran iakch'o meshavand, ravon sokht.
20) Dar bainashon moneae ast, ki kh'ar iakero az tug'ion bar digarash man' mesozad, to shuri va shirinii on du bok'i bimonad.
21) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
22) Az mach'mui on du bakh'r marvoridi khurdu kalon berun meoiad.
23) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
24) Va kh'ukmfarmoii kishtikh'oi dar bakh'r chun kukh'kh'o bo bodbonkh'oi barafroshta ch'ori tankh'o az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast.
25) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
26) Kh'amai khaloik'i ruzi zamin noguzir kh'alokshavanda kh'astand.
27) Va ei Paiombar, iagona Parvardigori tu, ki Sokh'ibi azamat va ekh'son bar bandagon ast, poidor memonad. U Zoti Zindai Poianda ast.
28) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!

29) Tamomi farishtagoni osmonkh'o va ch'innu insi zamin paivasta kh'och'atkh'oiashonro az Khudo mekhokh'and. U kh'ar vak't dar kore -ba misli zinda sokhtan, mironidan, ruzi dodan, fak'iru tavongar gardondan- az korkh'oi bandagon ast.
30) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
31) Ei insonkh'o va ch'inkh'o, Mo iak'inan ba zudi k'asdi kh'isobu kitobi shumoro khokh'em kard va ba kh'ar kas podoshi nek io badi loik'i amalashro khokh'em dod.
32) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!

33) Khudo ruzi k'iiomat ba insonkh'o va ch'inkh'o meguiad: "Ei ch'amoai ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o! Agar az atrofi osmonkh'o va zamin baroi berun raftani khesh rokh'i baromad paido karda tavoned, pas in korro anch'om dikh'ed va az baini on du berun raved. Kh'ech' gokh' shumo chunin korero ch'uz bo k'udratu k'uvvat kardan nametavoned. Ammo shumo az kuch'o chunin k'udratu k'uvvat dored?!"
34) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
35) Ei ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o! Bar shumo shu'lai kholi az dud va dudi kholi az shu'la firistoda meshavad. Pas khudro az on mukh'ofizat karda nametavoned.
37) Pas chun osmon baroi nuzuli farishtagon bishikofad, pas on monandi ravg'ani gudokhta surkh gardad.
38) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
39) Pas dar on ruzi dakh'shatovar az kh'ech' inson va ch'inne dar borai gunokh'ash pursida nameshavad. Chunki Khudo kh'amai onro medonad.
40) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
41) Gunakh'koron ruzi k'iiomat bo alomati siiokh'ii chekh'ra va kabudii chashmonashon shinosoi megardand. Pas az muikh'oi peshoni va k'adamkh'oi onkh'o girifta shuda, ba otash andokhta meshavand.
42) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
43) Ba much'rimon bo tanbekh' gufta meshavad: "In kh'amon duzakhest, ki gunakh'koron dar dunio onro durug' medonistand. Imruz kh'ak'ik'at doshtanashro inkor karda nametavonand.
44) Onkh'o baini otashi ch'akh'annam va baini obi garmi nikh'oiat purkh'arorat raftuomad menamoiand."
45) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
46) Va baroi on kase, ki az istodan dar barobari Parvardigorash dar ruzi k'iiomat metarsad, du buston ast.
47) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
48) On du buston doroi shokhakh'oi buzurgu sarsabzi pursamar ast.
49) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
50) Dar vasati on bustonkh'o du chashma ch'ori meboshad.
51) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
52) Dar on bustonkh'o az kh'ar meva nav'i taru khushki on mavch'ud ast.
53) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!

54) Akh'li ch'annat bar bistarkh'oe takia mezanand, ki astarkh'oi onkh'o az abreshimi g'afs ast. Va chidani mevakh'oi on du buston ba kh'ar kas nazdik va dastras ast. Nafari rost, nishasta va takiazada ba osoni metavonad onro bigirad.
55) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
56) Dar on bustonkh'o zanone kh'astand, ki ch'uz shavkh'aronashon digar ba kh'ech' kas nazar namekunand va k'abl az shavkh'aronashon na inson va na ch'inne bo onkh'o nazdiki nakarda ast.
57) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
58) Kh'uroni ch'annat dar safo va kh'usn misli on ki iok'utu march'onand.
59) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
60) Kh'ak'k'o, ki ch'azoi neki bo ibodat ch'uz neki bo ch'annat chize nest.
61) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
62) Va baroi on kase, ki az istodan dar barobari Parvardigorash dar ruzi k'iiomat metarsad, ba ch'uz on du buston, du bustoni digar ast.
63) Pas, ei ch'am'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
64) On du buston bag'oiat sabzi moil ba siiokh'i kh'astand.
65) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
66) Dar on du buston du chashmai favvorazananda buda, ch'araioni obi chashmakh'o kh'ech' gokh' k'at' namegardad.
67) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
68) Dar on du buston mevakh'oi farovon va darakhti buzurgi khurmo va anor ast.
69) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
70) Dar bustonkh'oi iodshuda zanoni khushakhlok'i sokh'ibch'amol kh'astand.
71) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
72) Zanoni zebochashme, ki dar kushkkh'o pardapushand.
73) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
74) Kh'ech' inson va ch'inne k'abl az kh'amsaronashon bo onkh'o nazdiki nakarda ast.
75) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
76) Bikh'ishtikh'o bar bolinkh'oi bo rupushkh'oi sabzrang rupushishuda va bistarkh'oi nikh'oiat zebo takia mezanand.
77) Pas ei gurukh'i ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o, shumo kadom iake az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigoratonro durug' meshumored va inkor mekuned?!
78) Ismi Parvardigori Doroi azamat va ekh'sonat bag'oiat Buzurg va Bobarakat ast.
1) Chun k'iiomat noguzir barpo gardad, -
2) on ruz kh'argiz kase k'iiomatro durug' nameshumorad, on guna ki dar dunio onro durug' mekh'isobid.
3) K'iiomat kofironro bo darovardan ba ch'akh'annam poion mesozad, mu'minoni parkh'ezkorro bo dokhil sokhtan ba ch'annat bolo mebarad.
4) On gokh', ki zamin ba shiddat larzonda shavad.
5) Va kukh'kh'o reza-reza karda shavand.
6) Pas kukh'kh'o monandi g'ubori parokanda gardand.
7) Va shumo on ruz se gurukh' megarded.
8) Pas bandagone, ki nomai a'molashonro ba dasti rost megirand, doroi mak'omu martabai nikh'oiat balandand.
9) Va bandagone, ki nomai a'molashonro ba dasti chap megirand, makoni nikh'oiat bad va kh'olati past dorand.
10) Va kasone, ki dar dunio dar ich'roi korkh'oi nek sabk'at mekunand, dar okhirat baroi dukhuli ch'annat peshdast kh'astand.
11) Iak'inan in ch'amoai peshdast nazdi Khudo muk'arraband.
12) Onkh'o dar bog'kh'oi doroi ne'matkh'oi farovon ch'o megirand. Onch'o az ne'matkh'oi mukhtalif bakh'ra mebarand.
13) Gurukh'i ziiode az in ummat va az ummatkh'oi guzashta -
14) va dar okhiri zamon shumorai andake az mardum sabk'atkunanda va nazdi Khudo muk'arraband.
15) Onkh'o bar takhtkh'oi az tillo boftashuda takia mezanand.
16) Bar takhtkh'o rubarui kh'amdigar takia mezanand. Onkh'o ba pushti iakdigar nigokh' namekunand.
17) Dar atrofashon baroi khidmat navch'avonone davr mezanand, ki kh'argiz ch'avoniashon az bain nameravad va namemirand.
18) On navch'avonon dar atrofashon bo k'adakh'kh'oi bedasta va kuzakh'oi dastador va sog'ari sharob az khamri dar ch'annat ch'ori davr mezanand.
19) Sharobi ch'annat monandi sharobi dunio nest. Nushandagonash ba sababi on sadrdard nameshavand va ak'lashon tira namegardad.
20) Va inchunin on navch'avononi khidmatgor dar atrofashon bo kh'ar nav' mevae az on mevakh'oe, ki ch'annatiion barmeguzinand, davr mezanand.
21) Va niz bo gushti paranda az kh'ar on gushte, ki dilashon mekhokh'ad, davr mezanand.
22) Va baroi onkh'o dar ch'annat zanoni sokh'ibi chashmoni siiokh'i vasei bag'oiat zebo mavch'ud ast.
23) Zanoni ch'annat monandi marvoridi dar sadaf makh'fuz kh'astand.
24) In podosh ba khotiri on amalkh'oi shoistaest, ki dar dunio onro anch'om medodand.
25) Onkh'o dar ch'annat sukhani fakh'sh va oluda ba gunokh', ki sokh'ibashro gunakh'kor sozad, nameshunavand.
26) Lekin salomi farishtagon va salomi iakdigarro meshunavand.
27) Va bandagone, ki nomai a'molashonro ba dasti rost megirand, mak'omu martabaashon nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nikh'oiat baland ast.
28) Onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat zeri soiai darakhti "Sidr"-i bekhori beozor k'aror megirand-
29) va zeri darakhti mavzi mevakh'oiash boloi iakdigar pakh'lu ba pakh'lu chidashuda -
30) va zeri soiai gusturdai doimi -
31) va obi kh'amvora ravon -
32) va mevakh'oi farovoni nomakh'dud, ki -
33) kh'argiz az onkh'o k'at' namegardad, mavsimi muaiian nadorad va kh'ech' gokh' chize monei ba dast ovardanash nameshavad -
34) va bistarkh'oi barafroshtai bar rui takhtkh'o guzoshtashuda.
35) Ba durusti, Mo kh'uroni ch'annatro ba tavri g'airi ma'muli kh'ast namudem.
36) Pas onkh'oro dushizai dastnorasida gardonidem.
37) Onkh'oro makh'bubai shavkh'aronu bo iakdigar kh'amsinnu sol sokhtem.
38) Mo zanoni bikh'ishtro baroi akh'li saodat, ki kh'amchun alomati nekbati ba samti rost burda meshavand, ba vuch'ud ovardem.
39) Onkh'o gurukh'i ziiode az ummatkh'oi sobik' -
40) va gurukh'i ziiode az ummati Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kh'astand.
41) Va bandagone, ki nomai a'molashonro ba dasti chap megirand, kh'olat va ok'ibati nikh'oiat bade dorand.
42) Onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat dar vasati bodkh'oi doroi kh'arorati shadidi chun zakh'r ta'sirrason va obi bag'oiat purkh'arorat -
43) va soiai dudi siiokh'i -
44) na khushvazanda va na nekmanzar k'aror megirand.
45) Beshak, onkh'o dar dunio k'abl az giriftori ba in uk'ubat dar nozu ne'mat ba sar meburdand. Ch'uz shakh'vatkh'oiashon g'ami digare nadoshtand.
46) Va bar gunokh'oni buzurgi kufru shirk idoma medodand va az on khuddori namekardand.
47) Va rastokhezro inkor karda, bo tamaskhur meguftand: "Oio vak'te memirem va ba khoku ustukhonkh'oi pusida tabdil megardem, oio ba'd az in dubora zinda karda meshavem?!
48) Oio padaroni mo, ki k'ablan darguzashtaand, zinda meshavand?!"
49) Ei Paiombar, ba in munkironi rastokhez bigu: "Ba durusti ki guzashtagon va oiandagon
50) kh'atman ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani podosh ch'am' ovarda meshavand.
51) Sipas iak'inan shumo, ei gumrokh'oni takzibgari rastokhez, ruzi k'iiomat -
52) az mevai darakhti "Zak'k'um", ki badtarin meva ast, mekhured.
53) Pas, az mevai in darakhti talkh shikamkh'oi kholii khudro pur mekuned.
54) Pas az boloi on az obi nikh'oiat purkh'arorat menushed.
55) Pas shumo on guna ki shuturoni duchori bemorii tashnagi ziiod ob menushand, az on obi doroi kh'arorati sakht ziiod menushed."
56) In taomi talkhu obi bag'oiat purkh'arorati nombarshuda ziiofati takzibgaroni gumrokh' dar ruzi ch'azo ast. Onkh'o bo chunin ziiofat peshvoz girifta meshavand.
57) Ei takzibkunandagoni gumrokh'! Mo shumoro ba'd az on ki vuch'ud nadoshted, kh'ast kardem. Pas charo bovar namekuned, ki ba'di margaton Mo iak'inan shumoro zinda megardonem?!
58) Ei mardum! Oio on obi nutfaro, ki dar bachadoni kh'amsaronaton merezed, didaed va dar borai on andeshidaed?!
59) Oio shumo on obi nutfaro meofared io Mo kholik'i onem?!
60) Mo dar bainaton margro muk'addar gardonidaem. Kh'ar kas dar dunio mukh'lati muaiian dorad. Vak'te margash faro rasad, iak lakh'za pesh io ak'ib nameravad. Va Mo kh'argiz och'iz nestem, ki -
61) ofarinish va suratkh'oi shumoro tabdil dikh'em va shumoro dar ofarinish va suratkh'oe, ki onro namedoned, kh'ast namoem.

62) Va begumon shumo medoned, ki Mo paidoishi avvalro chi guna khalk' kardaem. Pas charo pand namegired va bovar nadored, ki Allokh'i bori nakhust shumoro ofarida k'udrati boz zinda sokhtanatonro dorad?!
63) Oio ba on donakh'oe, ki dar zamin mekored, bo ibrat nigaristaed va dar borai on andeshidaed?!
64) Oio on donakh'oro shumo meruioned io Mo ruionandai onem?!

65) Agar khokh'em, on ziroatro ba'di on ki zamoni pukhtanash nazdik meoiad, giiokh'i khushkgashtai bekh'osil megardonem. Ba'd az in shumo az on ki ziroataton duchori chunin kh'olat shuda ast, dar taach'ch'ub memoned va megued:
66) "Kh'amono Mo kh'alokshudaem. Zero kh'osilotamon nobud shud.
67) Balki mo az ruzi makh'rum kh'astem."
68) Oio shumo ba obe, ki kh'angomi tashnagi az on menushed, bo ibrat nigaristaed va dar borai on andeshidaed?!
69) Oio on obro az abr shumo furud ovardaed io Mo furudorandai onem?!
70) Agar khokh'em, obro chunon shur mesozem, ki kornoshoiam megardad. Pas charo shukr namekuned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro bo rakh'matash baroiaton shirin gardonida ast.
71) Magar shumo ba otashe, ki onro baroi manfiatkh'oiaton furuzon mesozed, bo ibrat nigaristaed va dar borai on andeshidaed?!
72) Magar darakhtero, ki az on otash furuzon megardad, shumo kh'ast namudaed io Mo bo mak'sadi rakh'mat nisbat ba shumo kh'astsozandai onem?!
73) Mo in otashro baroiaton vasilai khotirrasoni gardonidaem, ki otashi duzakhro ba iodaton orad va inchunin onro baroi musofironaton manfiat gardonidaem.
74) Pas Parvardigori Azimi khudro az vasfkh'oi noloik' ba poki iod bikun.
75) Pas ba makon va mavk'e'kh'oi sitoragon savgand iod mekunam.
76) Va ba durusti, savgand ba makon va mavk'e'kh'oi sitoragon -agar azamati onro bidoned- nikh'oiat savgandi buzurg ast. Chunki dar on nishonakh'o va ibratkh'oi ziiode nukh'ufta ast.
77) Iak'inan in Kitobe, ki baroi shumo mardum tilovat meshavad, K'ur'oni balandmartabai doroi manfiat va barakati bekh'isob ast.
78) On dar Kitobi az chashmi bandagon pushidai Lavkh'i Makh'fuz navishta shuda ast.
79) Ba ch'uz farishtagoni az aibu ma'siiat pokgardonidashuda kase ba on dast namerasonad.
80) K'ur'on az sui Parvardigori tamomi olamiion bar Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) furud ovarda shuda ast.
81) Oio shumo mushrikon nisbat ba kh'amin Kitob beparvoi mekuned va onro durug' mekh'isobed?!
82) Va dar ivazi shukri on ki Khudo baroiaton ne'mat doda ast, ruzi dodani Uro durug' shumurda, nozilshavii boronro ba sitoragon nisbat doda, megued: "Mo ba sababi falonu falon sitora boron ioftem"?!

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi guzashta ba'ze az dalelkh'oi rastokhezro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin khost bo ishora bar on ki munkironi rastokhez peshi rokh'i margro namegirand, k'udratashro dar zindasozii murdagon nishon dikh'ad. Zero Zote, ki memironad, tavoni bakhshidani kh'aiotro niz dorad.
83) Pas charo vak'te ch'on ba gulu merasad, onro barnamegardoned?!
84) Va shumo on zamon ba nafari dar kh'olati sakarot k'aror doshta menigared va az dastaton kore nameoiad.
85) Va Mo bo ilmu tavonoi va farishtagonamon ba on nafari dar kh'olati sakarot k'aror doshta az shumo nazdiktarem, vale shumo ch'am'i farishtagonro namebined.
86) Pas agar shumo on guna ki da'vo dored, ki guio baroi much'ozoti a'molaton zinda karda nameshaved, charo -
87) rukh'i maiitro barnamegardoned, agar dar da'voiaton sodik'ed?! Zero shumo kh'argiz az ukh'dai in kor namebaroed!
88) Pas ammo agar maiit az zumrai sabk'atkunandagon ba anch'omi a'moli nek boshad -
89) pas baroiash rokh'ati kh'ameshagi va rizk'i poku rakh'mat va bustoni doroi ne'matkh'oi farovon ast. U dar ch'annat az kh'ar ne'mati dilkhokh'ash bakh'ra mebarad.
90) Va ammo agar maiit az kasone boshad, ki nomai a'molashon ba dasti rostashon doda meshavad -
91) pas ba kh'ar iakei onkh'o az ch'onibi barodaroni akh'li saodatashon salom gufta meshavad.
92) Va ammo agar maiit az takzibkunandagoni gumrokh' buda, dini Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro durug' shumurda boshad -
93) pas "ziiofatash" az obi bag'oiat purkh'arorat ast.
94) Va ba otashi ch'akh'annam darovarda va bo on suzonda meshavad.
95) Ei Paiombar, kh'amono in k'issai bar tu zikrgashta aini vok'eiiat ast. Dar on shakke nest.
96) Pas Ismi Parvardigori Boazamati khudro az kh'ama aibu nuk'son ba poki nisbat bidekh'.

1) Kh'ama makhluk'oti osmonkh'o va zamin doim Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az kulli aibu nuk'son ba poki iod mekunand. Va U Zoti G'olibi dar ofarinish va muk'arrar sokhtani tak'dirot Bokh'ikmat ast.

2) Molikiiat va kh'ukmfarmoii mutlak'i osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az oni Ust. Ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, kh'aiot mebakhshad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, memironad. Va U ba tamomi chiz Tavono ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro och'iz namegardonad.

3) U az kh'amai mavch'udot Pesh va ba'di fanoi mavch'udot Bok'i va ba vasilai makhluk'otash Oshkor va ba e'tibori kunkh'i Zotash Nikh'on ast. Va U Donandai kh'ama chiz ast. Kh'ech' chiz az ilmash dur namemonad.

4) U Zotest, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro dar muddati shash ruz -shuru' az ruzi iakshanbe to ruzi ch'um'a- ofarid va kh'ol on ki k'udrati dar iak dam ofaridanashonro dosht, sipas on guna ki shoistai Zotash buda, kunkh'i on az fakh'mu idroki bashar khorich' ast, bar arsh baromad. Kh'ar on chi az boron, donakh'oi ziroat va g'aira ba zamin furu meravad va on chi az rastanikh'o, ma'dankh'o va g'aira az zamin berun meshavad va on chi ba monandi boron, paig'om va g'aira az osmon furud meoiad va on chi az farishtagon, a'moli bandagon va rukh'ashon sui osmon mebaroiad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amaashro medonad. Va ei bandagon, kh'ar kuch'o kh'asted, U bo ilmi Khud kh'amrokh'i shumo ast. Va kh'ar on chi mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro mebinad. Kh'ech' amali shumo az U pinkh'on nest va dar badali on baroiaton podoshi nek io bad medikh'ad.

5) Molikiiat va kh'ukmfarmoii mutlak'i osmonkh'o va zamin fak'at az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Va kh'amai korkh'o tankh'o ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bargardonida meshavad. Ruzi k'iiomat bandagonashro bozpursi karda, onkh'oro ba ch'azoi a'molashon merasonad.

6) U shabro dar ruz dokhil mesozad va az dunbolash toriki omada, mardum istirokh'at mekunand va ruzro dar shab dokhil mesozad va az dunbolash rushani omada, mardum az paii ruziashon meshavand. Va U az asrori k'albi bandagon Ogokh' ast. Kh'ech' sirre az U makhfi namemonad.

7) Ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash imon ored va az on amvole, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro dar on namoiandai Khud va ch'onishini digaron gardonida ast, kharch' namoed. Dar sarfi molaton, ki dar asl ba Parvardigor taalluk' dorad, mutobik'i shariat amal kuned. Pas on kasone az shumo, ki imon meorand va molashonro dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sarf mekunand, baroiashon podoshi azimi ch'annat ast.

8) Va shumoro az imon ovardan ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chi boz medorad va kh'ol on ki Paiombaraton (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) shumoro faro mekhonad, to ba Parvardigoraton imon ored, dar kh'ole Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vak'te az kamari padaronaton berunaton kard, az shumo paimon girifta bud, ki ba U imon meored?! Agar k'asdi imon ovardan doshta boshed, pas ba sui on bishitobed.

9) U Zotest, ki bar Bandaash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) oiatkh'oi ravshanro nozil mesozad, to vai shumoro az torikikh'oi kufr va nodoni ba ch'onibi nuri imonu donish berun orad. Va iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i shumo bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Az in ru, baroi kh'idoiati shumo Paiombari rakh'namoi muzhdarasonashro firistod.

10) Va ei mu'minon, shumoro az in ki molatonro dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kharch' namoed, chi boz medorad, kh'ol on ki merosi osmonkh'o va zamin iagona az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast?! Kasone az shumo, ki molashonro k'abl az fatkh'i Makka kholisona dar rokh'i Khudo kharch' kardand va baroi piruzii Islom alaikh'i kofiron ch'angidand, bo kasone, ki molashonro ba'd az fatkh'i Makka kharch' kardand va alaikh'i kofiron ch'angidand, barobar nestand. Nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mak'om va darach'ai gurukh'i iakum az mak'om va darach'ai gurukh'i duium, ki molashonro ba'd az fatkh'i Makka kharch' namuda va bo kofiron ch'angidaand, buzurgtar va bolotar ast. Va kh'ak'k'o, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ar du gurukh' ch'annatro va'da doda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mekuned, Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' amali shumo az U pushida namemonad va dar ivazi on ba shumo ch'azoi sazovor medikh'ad.

11) Chi kase molashro bo rizomandi va ikhlos ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amchun k'arz medikh'ad, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba vai savobi bakhshidani molashro duchand bidikh'ad va ruzi k'iiomat uro podoshi arzishmandi ch'annat boshad?!

12) Ei bandai kh'ushmand! Ba khotir biior on ruzero, ki mardon va zanoni boimonro mebini, ki nurashon peshopeshashon va az ch'onibi rostashon kh'arakat mekunad. On ruz ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Muzhdai shumo imruz dukhuli bustonkh'oest, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtoni on rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad, dar kh'ole shumo dar on ch'o abadi memoned. In podosh kh'amon komiobii azimest, ki kh'ech' komiobi ba on barobar nameshavad."

Chun Khudo dar oiati guzashta kh'olati mu'minonro dar ruzi k'iiomat zikr kard, dar oiati zerin kh'olati munofik'onro ovarda guft:
13) On ruzero iod kun, ki mardon va zanoni munofik' ba mu'minon meguiand: "Moro muntazir shaved, to az nuri shumo rushnoi girem va baroiamon dar guzashtani puli sirot kumak rasonad." Ba onkh'o bo tamaskhur ch'avob gufta meshavad: "Ba ak'ibaton bargarded, pas az onch'o rushnoi bich'ued va az on istifoda bared." Pas baini onkh'o devore zada meshavad, ki on dar dorad. Dar darunash az sui mu'minon ch'annatu ne'matkh'oi on va dar berunash az sui munofik'on azob ast.

14) Munofik'on mu'minonro nido karda meguiand: "Magar mo dar rokh'i Islom va toatu ibodat kh'amrokh'i shumo nabudem?!" Mu'minon meguiand: "Ore, kh'amrokh'amon buded. Valekin shumo khudro bo nifok' duchori balo va kh'alokat namuded va muntazir buded, ki mu'minon mag'lub shavand va shumo kufratonro oshkor kuned va dar borai g'alabai mu'minonu rastokhez shak doshted va tama'kh'oi durug'aton firebaton dod, to on ki farmoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) vobasta ba margaton omad, kh'ol on ki az rokh'aton barnagashted va Shaiton shumoro dar borai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) fireb dod.

15) Pas, ei munofik'on, imruz az shumo va az kofiron bakh'oi rakh'oi az azobi Khudo girifta nameshavad va ch'oi bozgashti shumo va kofiron otashi duzakh ast. Otashi duzakh sazovori shumo va shumo sazovori on kh'asted. Va duzakh ch'oi bozgashti nikh'oiat bad ast."

16) Oio baroi mu'minon zamoni on faro narasida ast, ki dilashon ba khotiri zikri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ba khotiri on chi az K'ur'on dar mavridi va'dai ch'annat va takh'didi uk'ubat omada ast, narmu orom gardad va dar sangdili monandi on kasone az iakh'udu nasoro naboshand, ki k'ablan ba onkh'o Kitob doda shuda bud, pas baini onkh'o va bi'sati paiombaronashon zamoni tuloni guzasht va ba kh'amin sabab dilashon sakht gardid?! Va onkh'o beshtarashon az toat ba ma'siiat berunshuda kh'astand.

17) Ei mu'minon! Bidoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zaminro ba'di khushkiash bo ruionidani giiokh'on zinda mesozad. Iak'inan Mo baroi shumo dalelkh'oi k'udrat va vakh'doniiati ilokh'iro baion menamoem, to onkh'oro bifakh'med va iak'in doshta boshed, ki Ofaridgori Kh'aiotbakhshi zamini murda tavoni narm sokhtani dilkh'oi sakhti shumo va inchunin tavoni ba'di marg zinda kardanatonro dorad.

18) Kh'amono on mardone, ki kh'issae az molashonro sadak'a mekunand va niz on zanone, ki kh'issae az molashonro sadak'a mekunand va amvoli khudro be minnat va ozor dodani fak'ir kholisona ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amchun k'arz medikh'and, baroiashon savobi amalashon duchand gardonda meshavad. Dar ivazi iak neki az dakh' to kh'afsad savob megirand. Va ilova bar in ba onkh'o nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) podoshi arzishmandi ch'annat ast.

19) Va on kasone, ki ba Khudo va kh'amai paiombaronash imon meorand, iak'inan in ch'amoa bandagoni sadok'atmand meboshand. Va shakh'idon nazdi Parvardigorashon baroiashon savobi arzishmand ast va eshon ach'ri khesh va nuri kheshro dorand, ki ruzi k'iiomat peshopesh va az samti rostashon kh'amrokh'ashon kh'arakat mekunad. Va kasone, ki ba Khudo va paiombaronash kofir meshavand va oiatkh'oi bar Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozilkardai Moro durug' meshumorand, onkh'o kh'amdamoni duzakh kh'astand. Ruzi k'iiomat dar duzakh abadi memonand.

20) Ei mu'minon! Bidoned, ki zindagonii dunio bozi va sargarmii k'alb va zinat dodani khud va bo doroii on baini kh'am fakhrfurushi va dar afzoishi molkh'o va farzandon rak'obat kardan ast. Misli dostoni borone, ki rastanii on kishovarzonro ba kh'airat meguzorad. Sipas on rastanii sabz dere naguzashta, khushk meshavad, pas tu ei binanda, onro ba'di sabzrangi zardgashta mebini. Sipas on giiokh' rezashudai shikasta megardad. Va dar okhirat baroi kofironu munofik'on azobi shadid va baroi mu'minon az sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omurzish va izkh'ori rizomandi ast. Va kh'aioti dunio ch'uz matoi nopoidori boisi fireb chize nest. Kh'ar kase matoi fanoshavandai dunioro az ne'mati kh'ameshagii okhirat muk'addam meguzorad, iak'inan khasorati buzurg mebinad.

21) Ei mardum! Ba sui a'moli shoista, ba misli tavba va g'airi on, ki sababi az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton mag'firat shudani gunokh'onaton megardad va inchunin ba sui on ch'annate, ki vus'atash monandi vus'ati osmonkh'o va zamin ast, bo iakdigar sabk'at namoed va bishitobed. Ch'annat baroi kasone omoda shuda ast, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va paiombaronash imon dorand. In podosh fazli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Onro az bandagonash ba kh'ar kas khokh'ad, medikh'ad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar mu'minon Sokh'ibi fazli buzurg ast.

22) Kh'ech' musibate, ba misli khushksoli va monandi on ba shumo dar zamin va niz kh'ech' musibate ba shumo dar ch'onaton namerasad, magar in ki on musibat k'abl az on ki makhluk'otro biofarem, dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz maktub va sabtshuda ast. Begumon sabti kh'ar musibat dar Lavkh'i Makh'fuz bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kori nikh'oiat oson ast.

23) Ei mardum! Inro ba shumo khabar dodem, to ba khotiri on chi az dastaton meravad, g'amgin nagarded va ba sababi on chi Khudo ba shumo az ne'matkh'o medikh'ad, mag'rurona shodi nakuned. Kh'amono Khudo kh'ech' bandai mutakabbiri bo ne'matkh'o bar mardum fakhrkunandaro dust namedorad.

24) On kasone, ki dar ato namudani on chi boiad ato namoiand, bukhl mevarzand va mardumro ba bukhl varzidan amr menamoiand, dar kh'ak'ik'at ziionkorand. Va kh'ar ki ba toatu ibodati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pusht megardonad, ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zarar namerasonad, balki khudro duchori zarar mesozad, zero Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iak'inan Beniiozi dar tamomi kh'olat Sutuda ast. U ba ibodati bandagon niioz nadorad.

25) Kh'amono Mo Paiombaronamonro bo kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi vozekh' firistodem va kh'amrokh'ashon Kitob va tarozui adolatro furud ovardem, to mardum baini kheshtan bo adolat muomila kunand. Va okh'anro, ki dar on baroi mardum nerui sakht va manfiatkh'oi ziiod ast, ba vuch'ud ovardem. Onkh'o az okh'an baroi muboriza alaikh'i dushmanon aslikh'a mesozand va onro dar kasbu korashon istifoda mebarand. Va to ilmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagon oshkor gardad, ki chi kase dini U va Paiombaronashro nusrat medikh'ad. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Nerumandi G'olib ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro mag'lubu notavon sokhta nametavonad.

26) Va ba durusti, Mo Nukh' va Ibrokh'imro firistodem va paiombari va kitobkh'oro dar naslashon k'aror dodem. Pas az nasli Nukh'u Ibrokh'im ba'zeashon ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat ioftand va beshtarashon az itoati Khudo khorich' shudand.

27) Sipas ba dunboli onkh'o Paiombaronamonro ba sui mardum pai dar pai firistodem. Va ba dunbolashon Isoi pisari Mariamro ravon kardem va ba u Inch'ilro dodem va dar dili kasone, ki ba Isoi pisari Mariam imon ovardand va uro pairavi namudand, mekh'r va shafk'atro k'aror dodem. Ba kh'amin sabab onkh'o bo kh'amdigar dustu mekh'rubon budand. Va nasronikh'o dar dini kheshtan ziiodaravi namudand va gushanishiniro ikhtiro' karda, izdivoch' va digar ne'matkh'oi kh'alolro baroi khud kh'arom gardonidand. Mo gushanishiniro bar onkh'o farz nasokhta budem. Balki onro az nazdi khesh bar din ilova kardand. Mo az onkh'o tankh'o pairavii khushnudii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro talab kardem. Pas on gushanishiro ba surati zaruri rioia nakardand. Pas Mo ba mu'minonashon ach'rashonro dodem. Va bisiorashon bo takzibi dini Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az toati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khorich' kh'astand.

28) Ei mu'minon! Az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi amr va parkh'ez az nakh'iiash bitarsed va ba Firistodaash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) imon biiored, to Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo az rakh'matash du ach'r -iak ach'r baroi imon ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va iak ach'r baroi imon ba Paiombaroni guzashta- ato namoiad va baroiaton nure k'aror dikh'ad, ki ba vasilai on dar dunio rokh'iob garded va ruzi k'iiomat kh'angomi guzashtan az puli sirot az rushnoiash istifoda namoed va to ba sababi parkh'ezkori va imonaton gunokh'onatonro bakhshida, shumoro ch'azo nadikh'ad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagonash Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

29) Ei mu'minon! Mo baroi shumo fazlamonro vobasta ba on ki ach'ratonro duchand megardonem, baion sokhtem, to iakh'udikh'o va nasronikh'oi akh'li Kitob bidonand, ki onkh'o az fazli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'ech' chize k'odir nestand va nametavonand az on ba kh'ar ki khokh'and, bidikh'and va az kh'ar ki khokh'and, onro boz dorand va bidonand, ki fazl tankh'o dar dasti Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. Onro ba kh'ar bandae khokh'ad, medikh'ad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Sokh'ibi fazli buzurg ast.

1) Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sukhani on zan -Khavlai dukhtari Sa'laba--ro, ki dar borai shavkh'arash -Avs ibni Somit vak'te bo kh'amsarash zikh'or namud- bo tu raddu badal mekard va az kori shavkh'arash ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shikoiat meburd, ba purragi shunid va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guftugui shumoro meshunavad. Kh'ech' chize az U makhfi nest. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Shunavandai guftori bandagon, Binandai kirdori onkh'o ast.

2) Kasone az shumo, ki bo kh'amsaronashon zikh'or karda "Tu baroi man misli pushti modaram kh'asti" meguiand, dar in sukhanashon durug' guftaand. Chunki kh'amsaronashon modaronashon nestand. Ba durusti ki modaronashon tankh'o on zanone kh'astand, ki onkh'oro ba dunio ovardaand. Va kh'amono eshon bo in k'avlashon sukhani nikh'oiat zisht va durug' meguiand. Va albatta, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Afvkunandai Omurzanda ast. Baroi az gunokh'i in sukhan pok shudanashon kafforaro muk'arrar gardonida ast.

3) Va kasone, ki bo zanonashon zikh'or mekunand, sipas mekhokh'and bo kh'amsaroni zikh'ornamudaashon kh'ambistar shavand, pas bar onkh'o k'abl az on ki bo kh'amsaronashon kh'amkhoba shavand, adoi kaffora bo ozodsozii iak g'ulom farz ast. Shumo ba ich'roi kh'ukmi mazkur amr shudaed, to az on pand bigired va az zikh'or khuddori namoed. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' amali shumo az U makhfi nest.

4) Pas, kh'ar ki baroi ozod sokhtan g'ulom paido nakunad, pas dar in surat bar vai pesh az on ki bo kh'amsarash kh'amkhoba shavad, du mokh' paiopai ruza giriftan farz ast. Ammo kh'ar ki du mokh' paiopai ruza giriftan natavonad, pas bar u taom dodani shast miskin farz ast. Mo in kh'ukmro muk'arrar gardonidem, to imonaton ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash afzun gardad va mutobik' ba farmudakh'oi shariat beshtar amal namoed. Va in akh'kom kh'ududi muk'arrarsokhtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. In kh'ududro U guzoshta ast va shumo naboiad onro poimol kuned. Va baroi kofirone, ki ba akh'komu kh'ududi guzoshtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir megardand, azobi dardovar ast.

5) Kh'amono kasone, ki bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash dushmani mevarzand, khoru rasvo sokhta meshavand, chunonchi ummatkh'oi k'abl az onkh'o guzashtai bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulonash dushmani varzida khoru rasvo sokhta shudand. Va kh'amono Mo oiatkh'oi ravshanro furud ovardem. Va baroi kasone, ki ba Allokh'u Rasul va oiatkh'oi U kofir megardand, azobi khorsozanda ast.

6) Ei bandai ok'il! Ruzero iod kun, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ama kofironro az k'abrashon barmeangezad, pas onkh'oro az amalkh'oi badi dar dunio anch'om dodaashon ogokh' mesozad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tamomi korashonro ba surati dak'ik' kh'isobida, kh'ech' chize az U zoe' nashuda ast va onkh'o korkh'oiashonro az khotir barovardaand. On ruz kh'ar kori khudro dar nomai a'molashon sabtshuda mebinand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar kh'amai chiz Guvokh' ast. A'moli bandagon az U makhfi namemonad.

7) Ei Paiombar! Oio namedoni, ki kh'ar on chi dar osmonkh'o va kh'ar on chi dar zamin ast, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amaashro medonad. Chize az U makhfi nest. Kh'ech' guftugui pinkh'onii se nafare nest, magar on ki U bo ilmash chorumi onkh'ost va kh'ech' guftugui pinkh'onii chor nafare nest, magar on ki U bo ilmash panch'umi onkh'o ast va kh'ech' guftugui pinkh'onii panch' nafare nest, magar on ki U shashumi onkh'o ast va kh'ech' guftugui pinkh'onii nafaroni kamtar io beshtar az adadi mazkur nest, magar on ki onkh'o kh'ar kuch'o boshand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ilmash kh'amrokh'ashon ast. Sukhani bandagon az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) makhfi nameboshad. Sipas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi k'iiomat onkh'oro az korkh'oi anch'om dodaashon bokhabar mesozad. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai tamomi chiz ast. Chize az U pinkh'on nest.

8) Ei Paiombar! Oio iakh'udikh'oro nadidi, ki vak'ti didani mu'minon bo iakdigar gushaki mekunand. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro az in kor man' kard. Sipas ba sui on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro nakh'i namuda ast, barmegardand va bo kh'amdigar dar borai gunokh' -ba misli g'aibati akh'li imon- va zulm kardan ba musalmonon va nofarmonii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) roz meguiand. Va ei Paiombar, chun onkh'o nazdat biioiand, bo ch'umlae bar tu salom medikh'and, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo on bar tu salom nadoda ast. Onkh'o ba ch'oii "Assalomu alaik" "Assomu alaik - Marg bar tu" meguiand. Va dar mach'liskh'oi khud bo mak'sadi takzibi Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) meguiand: "Charo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) moro ba sababi on chi meguem, azob namedikh'ad?! Agar Mukh'ammad rostk'avl mebud, kh'atman U moro bo in sukhanonamon uk'ubat mekard." Duzakh baroi uk'ubatashon basanda ast. Onkh'o voridi duzakh meshavand va azobi sakht mekashand. Pas duzakh ch'oii bozgashti nikh'oiat bad ast.

9) Ei mu'minoni tobei shariat! Vak'te baini khud roz megued, pas dar borai gunokh' io zulm namudan ba kase io nofarmonii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) roz magued, to ba iakh'udikh'o monand nagarded va dar borai ibodat va tarki ma'siiat roz bigued. Va az On Khudoe, ki ruzi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani ch'azo tankh'o ba sui U ch'am' ovarda meshaved, bitarsed.

10) Kh'amono rozgui oidi gunokh'u zulmu nofarmonii Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) az zinat va ig'vogarikh'oi Shaiton ast, to mu'minonro andukh'gin gardonad, ki dushmanon dar pinkh'oni nisbat ba onkh'o tavtea mesozand. Va Shaiton bo zinatash ba mu'minon ch'uz bo irodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) chize zarar rasonida nametavonad. Va boiad mu'minon dar kh'ama korkh'oiashon ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) takia kunand.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi guzashta odobi sukhanro baion namud, dar oiati zerin odobi mach'lisro zikr karda meguiad:
11) Ei mu'minoni pairavi shariat! Chun ba shumo "Dar mach'liskh'o ch'oiro farokh kuned" gufta shavad, pas ch'oiro farokh sozed. Agar chunin kuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dunio va okhirat ba shumo farokhi mebakhshad. Va chun ba shumo "Az ba'zei ch'oii nishastaton barkhezed, to akh'li fazl onch'o nishinand" gufta shavad, pas barkhezed. Agar in guftaro ich'ro namoed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) darach'akh'oi kasone az shumoro, ki imon ovardaand va ba onkh'o ilm doda shuda ast, baland mebardorad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' kori shumo az U pushida nest va dar badali kh'ar iak guftoru kirdor baroiaton podoshi nek io bad medikh'ad.

12) Vak'te sakh'obagon mekhostand, ki bo Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ziiod rozgui kunand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba onkh'o guft: Ei mu'minon! Vak'te mekhokh'ed bo Rasuli Allokh' (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) rozgui kuned, pas k'abl az rozguii khesh sadak'a bidikh'ed. In tak'dimi sadak'a baroiaton bekh'tar va poksozandatar ast. Zero shumo bo in amal toati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'oi meored va nafsatonro pok mesozed. Pas, agar chize baroi sadak'a naiobed, dar in kh'olat bo Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) roz guftanaton boke nadorad, zero Khudo Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Gunokh'oni bandagonashro mebakhshad va onkh'oro ba kori az tavonashon beshtar amr namekunad.

13) Oio shumo tarsided, ki agar k'abl az rozguiaton sadak'akh'o dikh'ed, ba in sabab fak'ir meshaved?! Pas vak'te amali farmudai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro anch'om nadoded va U tavbaatonro pazirufta, ba shumo tarki sadak'aro rukhsat dod, pas namozatonro ba tavri komil barpo bidored va zakoti molatonro bidikh'ed va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash itoat namoed. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az on chi mekuned, Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' amali shumo az U makhfi nest va dar ivazi kh'ar iak kor podoshaton medikh'ad.

14) Ei Paiombar! Oio munofik'onro nadidi, ki bo k'avmi iakh'ud dusti namudand, bo k'avme, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sababi kufru gunokh'ashon bar onkh'o khashm girifta ast?! In munofik'on na az shumo mu'minonand va na az iakh'udikh'o, balki gokh' dar saffi shumo va gokh' dar saffi iakh'udikh'o kh'astand. Va munofik'on doim bardurug' savgand mekhurand, ki onkh'o az shumoiand va akhboratonro ba iakh'udikh'o namerasonand va kh'ol on ki onkh'o dar savgand iod kardan durug' guftanashonro medonand.

15) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar okhirat baroiashon azobi nikh'oiat sakht omoda sokhta ast. Onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat dar poiontarin tabak'ai ch'akh'annam ch'oi megirand. Ba durusti ki on chi akh'li nifok' dar dunio az amalkh'oi kufr mekardand, benikh'oiat bad ast!

16) Munofik'on savgandkh'oi durug'ashonro chun sipar giriftaand, to bo zokh'iran musalmon nishon dodani khesh doroi va ch'onashonro kh'ifz kunand. Dar natich'a mardumro az rokh'i rost bozdoshtand. Zero kh'amesha dar tankh'oi mu'minonro ikh'onat menamudand va talosh mevarzidand, to eshonro rukh'aftoda sozand. Pas, baroiashon azobi khorsozanda ast.

17) Kh'argiz molkh'o va farzandonashon az onkh'o chizero az azobi Khudo bartaraf namesozad. Munofik'on kh'amdamoni duzakhand. Onkh'o dar duzakh abadi memonand. Azobashon kh'ech' gokh' k'at' namegardad.

18) Ei Paiombar! Iod kun ruzero, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'amai munofik'onro baroi giriftani ch'azoi korkh'oiashon boz zinda megardonad. Pas, onkh'o on guna ki baroi shumo mu'minon bardurug' savgand mekhurand va khudro musalmon meguiand, kh'amin tavr ruzi k'iiomat baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) savgandi durug' iod mekunand, ki onkh'o dar dunio mu'min budand va korkh'oshonro tankh'o ba khotiri kasbi rizoi Khudo anch'om medodand va gumon mebarand, ki onkh'o bo in savgandkh'oi durug'ashon sude ba dast meorand va zararero az khesh dur mesozand. Ogokh' boshed! Iak'inan munofik'on dar savgandkh'oi khud durug'gu kh'astand.

19) Shaiton bar munofik'on musallat gardida, ba kh'amin sabab bo rokh'i vasvasa zikri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az iodashon barovarda ast. Binobar in, mutobik' ba rizoi ilokh'i kor namekunand, balki bo korkh'oiashon Uro ba g'azab meorand. In ch'amoa lashkariion va pairavoni Shaitonand. Ogokh' boshed! Begumon lashkariion va pairavoni Shaiton dar dunio va okhirat ziionkor kh'astand. Chunki onkh'o kh'idoiatu ch'annatro bo zalolatu ch'akh'annam ivaz kardaand.

20) Beshak, onkh'oe, ki bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Rasulash dushmani mevarzand, in toifa dar shumori on ummatkh'oi kofire k'aror khokh'and girift, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro dar dunio va okhirat khoru rasvo gardonida ast.

21) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar ilmi azaliash kh'ukm karda ast, ki kh'atman Man (Allokh') va Paiombaronam bo burkh'on va neru bar dushmanonamon piruz megardem. Chunki begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat Nerumandi kh'amesha G'olib ast. Ba Paiombaronash iori medikh'ad va az dushmanash intik'om megirad.

22) Ei Paiombar, kh'ech' k'avmero, ki ba Khudo va ruzi okhirat imoni kh'ak'ik'i dorand, nameiobi, ki bo dushmanoni Khudo va Paiombarash dusti namoiand, agarchi on dushmanoni Khudo va Paiombarash padaronashon io pisaronashon io barodaronashon io kheshovandonashon boshand. Chunki imoni kh'ak'ik'i dust doshtani dushmanoni Khudo va Paiombarashro man' mekunad va robitai imoni az kh'ama robitakh'o bolotar ast. Vak'te baini paivandi imoni va digar paivandkh'o ziddiiat ba vuch'ud meoiad, alok'ai imoni muk'addam guzoshta meshavad. In bandagone, ki bo dushmanoni Khudo va Paiombarash dusti namekunand, kasoneand, ki Khudo imonro dar k'albashon ustuvor sokhta va bo burkh'on va nure az sui Khud ba onkh'o k'uvvat bakhshida ast. Va Khudo onkh'oro ruzi k'iiomat ba bog'kh'oe dokhil mesozad, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtkh'oiash rudkh'o ch'ori buda, onch'o abadi memonand. Khudo az in bandagon rozi shuda, minba'd ba onkh'o khashm namegirad va onkh'o niz bo noil gashtan ba ne'matkh'oi kh'ameshagi va didori ilokh'i az U rozi meshavand. In ch'amoai doroi sifatkh'oi mazkur sipokh'iioni Khudo kh'astand. Kh'amesha marzkh'oi guzoshtai Uro rioia menamoiand. Ogokh' boshed! Iak'inan sipokh'iioni Khudo rastagori kh'ak'ik'i meboshand. Zero ba ch'annat noil megardand va az otashi ch'akh'annam emin memonand.

1) Tamomi makhluk'oti osmonkh'o va tamomi makhluk'oti zamin doim Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az tamomi aibu nuk'son ba poki iod mekunand. Va U Zoti kh'amesha G'olibi Kh'akim ast. Ofaridani mavch'udot, akh'komu tak'dirot bar asosi kh'ikmatash surat megirad.

2) U Parvardigorest, ki kofironi Bani Nazir az iakh'udikh'oi akh'li Kitobro dar avvalin bori ch'am'ovarii lashkar az sui mu'minon az manzilkh'oiashon dar Madina ba sui Shom berun sokht. Onkh'o az k'abilakh'oi iakh'udii sokh'ibi Tavrot budand. Vak'te paimonashonro shikastand va bo mushrikon kh'amdast shudand, Khudo onkh'oro az khonakh'oiashon ikhroch' namud. Shumo mu'minon gumon namekarded, ki onkh'o az maskankh'oiashon berun meshavand. Zero nerui ziiod doshtand va dar k'al'akh'oi mustakh'kam panokh' burda budand. Va khud gumon doshtand, ki k'al'akh'oi ustuvorashon onkh'oro az uk'ubati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'imoiat mekunad. Pas azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az ch'onibe ba onkh'o omad, ki az onch'o omadani onro fikr namekardand va kh'atto dar khotirashon nameguzasht. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Paiombarash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro dastur dod, ki alaikh'i in iakh'udikh'o bich'angad va onkh'oro az manzilkh'oiashon berun kunad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar dilashon tarsi sakhtro andokht. Onkh'o manzilkh'oi khudro az darun bo dastoni khud vairon mesokhtand, to musalmonon az on istifoda nakunand va musalmonon manzilkh'oiashonro az berun vairon mesokhtand. Pas, ei khiradmandon, az in kh'odisai nisbat ba Bani Nazir rukhdoda, ki ba sababi kufr varzidanashon giriftori uk'ubat gashtand, ibrat bigired, to monandi onkh'o duchori uk'ubat nashaved.

3) Va agar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar k'abilai Bani Nazir az khonakh'oiashon berun shudanashonro muk'addar namesokht, kh'atman onkh'oro dar kh'amin dunio bo kushtashavi va asir shudanashon uk'ubat menamud. Va onkh'oro dar okhirat azobi abadii otashi duzakh ast.

4) In kh'odisai ibratomuzi bo Bani Nazir vok'e'shuda ba sababi on ast, ki onkh'o bo kufru paimonshikani bo Allokh'u Paiombarash dushmani varzidand. Va kh'ar ki bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dushmani mevarzad, pas giriftori uk'ubati shadid megardad, zero iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Sakhtuk'ubat ast.

5) Ei ch'am'i mu'minon! Shumo dar ch'ang bo Bani Nazir ba mak'sadi khashmgin kardani onkh'o kh'ar darakhti khurmoero k'at' karded io onro bar reshakh'oiash pobarch'o guzoshta, k'at' nakarded, to az on istifoda namoed, pas kh'ardui koraton bo amri Allokh' (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) surat girifta bud va in amali shumo on guna ki iakh'udikh'o da'vo dorand, az bobi fasodkori dar zamin nabud. In korro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba shumo rukhsat dod, to ba mu'minon izzat bakhshad va iakh'udikh'oi akh'dshikani az toatash berunshudaro khor gardonad.

6) Va on chiro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az amvoli Bani Nazir ba Paiombari Khud bargardond, shumo baroi kasbi on molkh'o asponu shuturonro natokhtaed va ranch' nakashidaed, vale Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Paiombarashro bar kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, g'olib mesozad. U Paiombarashro bar muk'obili Bani Nazir piruz sokht va sarzaminashonro, biduni ch'ang fatkh' namud. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ama chiz Tavono ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro och'iz namesozad.

7) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar chiro ba Paiombarash az amvoli akh'li dekh'akh'o be ch'ang in'om namud, pas on az Allokh' va Paiombarash va kheshoni Paiombarash (Bani Kh'oshim va Bani Muttalib), ki az in amvol baroiashon chun ivaz az sadak'a doda meshavad va niz az iatimon va fak'iron va shakhsi az sababi nadoshtani mablag' rokh'monda ast, to molkh'o tankh'o dar baini tavongaron dast ba dast nagardad va fak'iron makh'rum namonand. Va ei mu'minon, Rasuli Allokh' kh'ar chiro az amvoli be ch'ang kh'osilgashta ba shumo dikh'ad, onro bigired va az kh'ar chi shumoro nakh'i kunad, az on khuddori namoed. Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi amrkh'oiash va khuddori az nakh'ikh'oiash bitarsed. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Sakhtuk'ubat ast. Az uk'ubatash barkh'azar boshed.

8) Kh'issae az amvoli mazkur ba on fak'ironi mukh'och'iri rokh'i Khudo sarf megardad, ki mach'buran az manzilkh'oiashon va molkh'oiashon ronda shudaand. Onkh'o dar kh'ole az manzilkh'o va molkh'oiashon ronda shudaand, ki dar dunio az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ruzi va dar okhirat khushnudiashro metalaband va az rokh'i muboriza ziddi botil ba dini Allokh'u Rasulash iori medikh'and. In gurukh'i tavsfishuda mu'minoni sodik'and.

Chun Khudo dar oiati k'abli vasfi neki mukh'och'ironi Makkaro ovard, dar oiati ba'di sifati ch'avonmardii ansorikh'oi Madinaro baion sokhta guft:
9) Va sakh'obagoni ansori, ki dar Madina k'abl az mukh'och'iron furud omadand va imon ba Allokh'u Paiombarashro barguzidand, sakh'obagoni az Makka ba nazdashon kh'ich'rat kardaro dust medorand va agar az amvoli biduni nabard kh'osilgashta va g'aira tankh'o ba mukh'orich'on doda shavad, ansorikh'o dar k'albashon nisbat ba mukh'och'iron kh'ech' khashm va kh'asadero nameioband, agarchi khud niiozmand va fak'ir kh'am boshand, mukh'och'ironro dar kh'issakh'oi duniavi az khud pesh meguzorand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagonero, ki az bukhli omekhta bo kh'irsi nafs nigokh' medorad va onkh'o amvoli khudro dar rokh'i U sarf mekunand, pas, in toifa bo noil gashtan ba ch'annat va nach'ot az ch'akh'annam dar kh'ak'ik'at rastagorand.

10) Va on kasone, ki ba'd az sakh'obagoni mukh'och'ir va ansor to ruzi k'iiomat ba dunio meoiand va ba in du gurukh' pairavi mekunand, meguiand: "Parvardigoro, gunokh'oni mo va on barodaroni diniamonro, ki bo imon ovardan ba Tu va Paiombarat moro peshdasti namudaand, biomurz va dar k'albamon nisbat ba kh'ech' kase az mu'minon kinaro ch'o madekh'. Parvardigoro, iak'inan Tu Bakhshoiandai Mekh'ruboni."

11) Ei Paiombar, oio munofik'onro nadidi, ki doim ba barodaroni ak'idaviashon az iakh'udikh'oi kofiri akh'li Kitobi Tavrot meguiand: "Dar manzilkh'oiaton bok'i bimoned. Mo shumoro tankh'o nameguzorem va ba musalmonon namesuporem. Savgand mekhurem, agar musalmonon shumoro az manzilkh'oiaton khorich' sozand, kh'atman bo k'asdi izkh'ori kh'ambastagi kh'amrokh'aton mebaroem va dar kh'amrokh'aton baromadan kh'argiz kasero -agar az khuruch' man'amon kunad- itoat namekunem va agar musalmonon ba muk'obilaton bich'angand, mo ba shumo alaikh'i onkh'o iori merasonem." Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shokh'idi medikh'ad, ki munofik'on dar da'voi kheshtan oidi on ki guio kh'amrokh'i iakh'udikh'o mebaroiand va agar zarur shavad, bar ziddi musalmonon mech'angand, durug'gui kh'astand.

12) Va savgand iod mekunam, ki agar musalmonon k'avmi iakh'udro az manzilkh'oiashon berun kunand, munofik'on bo onkh'o namebaroiand va agar musalmonon bo iakh'udikh'o bich'angand, munofik'on ioriashon namedikh'and va agar farazan, ba iakh'udikh'o iori dikh'and, begumon az ch'angidan alaikh'i musalmonon pusht metoband va megurezand, sipas ba munofik'on iori doda nameshavad, balki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onkh'oro khoru rasvo mesozad.

13) Ei mu'minon! Kh'ak'k'o, ki tarsi shumo dar k'albi munofik'on va iakh'udikh'o az tarsi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) sakhttar ast. Sababi az shumo beshtar va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kamtar kh'arosidanashon on ast, ki onkh'o mardumi befakh'mand. Zero agar fakh'm medoshtand, medonistand, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi tarsidan loik'tar ast. U shumoro bar munofik'onu iakh'udikh'o musallat sokhta ast.

14) Ei mu'minon! Iakh'udikh'o bo shumo dastach'am'ona namech'angand, magar dar dekh'akh'oi bo k'al'akh'oi mustakh'kam mukh'ofizatshuda io az pushti devorkh'o. Onkh'o az sababi tarsui k'udrati ruioruii shumoro nadorand. Adovatashon dar bainashon nikh'oiat sakht ast. Onkh'oro iakdast mepindori va dar vok'e' k'albashon parokandai mukhtalif ast. Sababi ba kh'amdigar dushmani va ikhtilof doshtanashon on ast, ki onkh'o k'avmi nofakh'mand. Kh'ak'ik'at, kh'idoiat va rokh'i durustro dark namekunand.

15) Dostoni in ch'amoai iakh'udikh'o dar kufr va uk'ubati bar sarashon omada ba dostoni mushrikoni Makka, ki k'abl az onkh'o kame peshtar dar ch'angi Badr ok'ibati kufrashonro chashidand, monand ast. Dar on ch'ang ba'zei mushrikoni Makka ba k'atl rasidand va ba'zei digarashon asir gashtand. Va onkh'oro dar okhirat azobi dardovar ast.

16) Dostoni munofik'on dar munosibat bo iakh'ud monandi dostoni Shaiton ast. Chun ba inson kufrro oroish medikh'ad, pas vak'te inson ba sababi vasvasakh'oiash kofir meshavad, Shaiton ba vai meguiad: "Iak'inan man az tu bezoram. Zero tu ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kofir gashti. Ba durusti ki man az Allokh'i Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion metarsam."

17) Pas ok'ibati kori Shaiton va insoni farmonbardorash on ast, ki onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat dar duzakh k'aror girifta, onch'o abadi memonand. Va ch'azoi kasone, ki bo poimol sokhtani marzkh'oi ilokh'i bar khud sitam mekunand, kh'amin ast.

18) Ei mu'minoni poibandi shariat! Az Khudo bo ich'ro namudani amrkh'o va parkh'ez az nakh'ikh'oiash bitarsed va boiad kh'ar kas biandeshad, ki baroi fardoi k'iiomat chi amal tak'dim namuda ast. Va az Khudo bitarsed. Iak'inan Khudo az on chi mekuned, Ogokh' ast. Amalkh'oi shumo az U pushida namemonad va dar badali kh'ar iak kor podoshaton medikh'ad.

19) Va ba monandi kasone naboshed, ki Khudoro bo tarki dasturot va duri nach'ustan az man'kardakh'oiash az iod barovardand, pas ba kh'amin sabab Khudo onkh'oro az iodi khudashon faromush sokht. Az in ru, onkh'o kore nakardand, ki ba vositai on ch'onashonro az g'azab va azobi ilokh'i nach'ot dikh'and. In ch'amoae, ki bo tarki amrkh'o va dast zadan ba ma'siiat Khudoro faromush kardand, az toati ilokh'i khorich' kh'astand.

20) Akh'li ch'akh'annam va akh'li ch'annat barobar nestand. Balki chunonchi amalkh'oiashon dar dunio gunogun bud, kh'amin tavr ch'azoi amalkh'oiashon niz fark' dorad. Begumon akh'li ch'annat rastagoroni vok'ei kh'astand. Chunki ba murodi kheshtan noil meshavand va az chizkh'oi baroiashon nomatlub emin memonand.

21) Ei Paiombar! Agar Mo in K'ur'onro bar kukh'e furud meovardem, kh'atman onro bo vuch'udi ustuvoriash az shiddati tarsi Khudo dar kh'olati furutani va pora-porashavi medidi. Zero in K'ur'on doroi pandkh'o va takh'didkh'oi sakht ast. Va Mo in tamislkh'oro ba mardum baion mesozem, to onkh'o biandeshand va az pandkh'oi K'ur'oni azim ibrat bigirand.
22) U On Khudoest, ki ch'uz U ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ie nest, Donandai nikh'on va oshkor ast. U dar duniovu okhirat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Rakh'matash kh'amai khaloik'ro faro girifta ast.

23) U On Khudoest, ki ch'uz U ma'budi kh'ak'ik'ie nest, Kh'ukmfarmoi mutlak', az kh'ama nuk'son Pok, az kulli aibkh'o Solim, Tasdik'kunandai Paiombaron bo dodani mu'ch'iza, Nigakh'bonu Noziri a'moli bandagon, G'olibi bemag'lubiiat, Sokh'ibi k'udrati azim, Doroi azamatu ch'alol ast. Kh'amai khaloik' takh'ti tasarrufash k'aror dorand. Khudo az on chi akh'li shirk ba U sharik megardonand, Pok ast.

24) U Khudoi Kholik'i khaloik', Kh'astkunandai mavch'udot, Suratgari makhluk'ot mutobik'i irodai Khesh ast. U nomkh'oi zebovu nektarin dorad. On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin mavch'ud ast, mudom Uro az kh'ar aibu nuk'son ba poki iod mekunand. Va U Khudoi G'olibi Bokh'ikmat ast. Ofaridani makhluk'ot, guzoshtani akh'kom va ta'iini tak'dirot bar asosi kh'ikmatash surat megirad.

1) Ei mu'minoni poibandi akh'komi shariat! Dushmanoni Man va dushmanoni khudro dust magired. Shumo asrori kheshro, ki naboiad onro oshkor kuned, ba sababi in dustiaton dar ikhtiiorashon meguzored, kh'ol on ki onkh'o ba dini tavassuti Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba shumo omada kofirand. Onkh'o Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va shumoro az khonakh'oiaton tankh'o ba khotiri imonaton ba Allokh'i Parvardigoraton berun mesozand. Dar munosibat bo shumo kh'ak'k'i kheshovandiro ba inobat namegirand. Agar shumo az Makka kholis ba mak'sadi ch'ikh'od dar rokh'i Man va talabi rizoiam berun shuda boshed, pas onkh'oro dust magired. Shumo bo onkh'o makhfiiona dusti menamoed va asrori musalmononro baroiashon oshkor mesozed, kh'ol on ki Man on chi oshkor va on chi pinkh'on mesozed, kh'amai onro medonam. Kh'ech' kori shumo az man pushida nest. Va kh'ar ki az shumo bo kofiron dusti namoiad, az vasati rokh' kach' va az kh'ak'ik'at gumrokh' shuda ast.

2) Agar onkh'o bar shumo zafar ioband, nisbat ba shumo adovati dar k'albashon makhfiro berun meorand va dastonashonro bo k'atlu zadan va zabonashonro bo dashnomu kh'ak'orat ba suiaton daroz mekunand va k'abl az kh'ar chiz monandi khud kofir shudani shumoro orzu dorand.

3) Kheshovandonaton va farzandonaton -agar ba khotiri onkh'o bo kofiron dusti namoed- kh'argiz ba shumo foidae namerasonand. Ruzi k'iiomat Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar bainaton ch'udoi meandozad. Askh'obi ch'annatro ba ch'annat va askh'obi ch'akh'annamro ba ch'akh'annam medarorad. Shumo on ruz ba iakdigar sude namebakhshed. Va kh'ar chi mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro mebinad. Kh'ech' koraton az U pinkh'on nest va dar ivazi kh'ar iak kor ch'azo megired.

4) Ei mu'minon! Kh'amono baroiaton dar sarguzashti Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) va mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ash sarmashk'i nek ast, vak'te onkh'o ba k'avmi kofiri khud guftand: "Iak'inan mo az shumo va butkh'oe, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) meparasted, bezorem. Mo ba dinaton kofir kh'astem va baini mo va shumo adovat va nafrat oshkor shuda ast, to zamone ki ba Allokh'i Iagona imon ored va az shirk duri ch'ued." Bar shumo mu'minon niz farz ast, ki ba Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) va pairavonash pairavi karda, az k'avmi beimoni khud izkh'ori bezori namoed, magar dar in sukhani Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom), ki ba padarash guft: "Kh'atman az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omurzishi gunokh'onatro mekhokh'am va az azobi ilokh'i chizero az tu dur sokhta nametavonam." Dar in talabi omurzish dar kh'ak'k'i kofir ba Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) pairavi makuned. Zero vai in sukhanro k'abl az on ki az padarash noumed gardad, gufta bud. Mu'min naboiad az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omurzishi gunokh'oni kofirro bikhokh'ad. Ibrokh'im va pairavonash meguftand: "Ei Parvardigoramon, mo dar kh'ama korkh'oiamon ba Tu takia mekunem va ba suiat tavbakunon barmegardem va ruzi k'iiomat bozgashti kh'ama ba sui Tu ast.

5) Ei Parvardigori mo, moro bo musallat sokhtani kofiron zerdastashon k'aror madekh'. Zero agar chunin kuni, onkh'o meguiand: "Agar musalmonon kh'ak' mebudand, kh'ech' gokh' mo bar onkh'o musallat nameshudem." Va ei Parvardigori mo, gunokh'onamonro mag'firat namo. Beshak, Tu Zoti bag'oiat G'olibi Bokh'ikmat kh'asti. Ofarinish, muk'arrar sokhtani akh'kom va tak'dirotat bar asosi kh'ikmatat surat megirad."

6) Ei mu'minon! Iak'inan dar k'issai Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) va mu'minoni kh'amrokh'ash baroi kasone namunai ibrati nek ast, ki az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nekii dunio va okhiratro mekhokh'and. Makh'z kh'amin bandagon metavonand ba onkh'o pairavi kunand. Va kh'ar ki az in namunai ibrati nek rui gardonad, pas ok'ibati on bar zarari khudi ust, zero ba durusti, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az ibodati bandagonash Beniiozi dar kh'ama kh'olat Sutuda ast.

7) Ei mu'minon! Umed ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baini shumo va baini dushmanonaton bo rakh'namoiashon ba Islom mukh'abbat k'aror dikh'ad va onkh'oro barodaroni imoniaton gardonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar tamomi chiz K'odir ast. K'udrati ba sui imon moil kunonidani dili onkh'oro dorad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Gunokh'oni tavbakoronro meomurzad.

8) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro az neki kardan va adolat namudan nisbat ba on kasone, ki muk'obilaton az rui adovat ba dinaton nach'angidaand va shumoro az manzilkh'oiaton berun nasokhtaand, nakh'i namekunad.Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagoni nisbat ba khud, akh'li oila va zerdastonashon odilro dust medorad.

9) Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro az dusti bo kasone nakh'i mekunad, ki ba sababi imonaton muk'obilaton mech'angand va shumoro az khonakh'oiaton berun mesozand va dar khorich' kardanaton ba iakdigar iori medikh'and. Va kh'ar ki az shumo bo onkh'o dusti namoiad, pas in ch'amoa dar kh'ak'ik'at bo mukholifat ba amri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) dar kh'ak'k'i khud sitamkorand.

10) Ei mu'minon! Vak'te ki zanoni boimon az sarzamini kufr ba sarzamini Islom kh'ich'rat karda, nazdaton biioiand, pas sadok'atashonro dar bobi imondori bisanch'ed. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az imonashon Ogokh'tar ast. Kh'ech' asrori k'alb az U pushida nameboshad. Pas agar ba'di sanch'ish bo on chi baroiaton oshkor megardad, imon doshtanashonro donisted, pas onkh'oro ba sui shavkh'aroni kofirashon barnagardoned. Baroi zanoni boimon ak'di nikokh' bastan bo mardoni beimon va baroi mardoni beimon ak'di nikokh' bastan bo zanoni boimon kh'alol nest. Va ba shavkh'aroni on zanon makh'rkh'oi sarf namudaashonro bidikh'ed. Va bar shumo mu'minon gunokh'e nest, ki chun makh'rkh'oi on zanonro bidikh'ed, ba'di guzashtani iddaashon onkh'oro ba ak'di nikokh'i kheshtan darored. Va zanoni kofiri g'airi akh'li Kitob io az din bargashtaro dar ak'di nikokh'aton nigokh' nadored. Chunki nikokh'i on zan bo shumo ba sababi kufrash k'at' megarded. Va shumo az mardoni kofir makh'rkh'oi ba zanoni kofirshudaaton dodai khudro talab kuned va mardoni kofir niz makh'rkh'oi ba kh'amsaroni imon ovardaashon dodai khudro talab kunand. In bargardonidani makh'rkh'o az sui shumo va onkh'o kh'ukmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ast. U dar bainaton kh'ar chi khokh'ad, kh'ukm mekunad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai amalkh'ovu kh'olatkh'oi bandagon buda, dar akh'komash bag'oiat Bokh'ikmat ast.

11) Va agar farazan, ba'zei kh'amsaronaton az din bargashta, ba sui kofiron ravand va shumo makh'ri onkh'oro az kofiron talab kuned, ammo kofiron makh'rashonro nadikh'and, pas shumo alaikh'i kofiron ch'angida, az onkh'o g'animat ba dast ored, pas ba shavkh'aroni zanoni murtadshudai nazdi kofiron rafta az on g'animat misli makh'ri sarf namudaashonro bidikh'ed. Va az uk'ubati On Khudoe, ki shumo ba U imon dored, bo ich'ro namudani amrkh'oiash va duri ch'ustan az nakh'ikh'oiash bitarsed.

12) Ei Paiombar! Vak'te ki zanoni boimon nazdat omada -on guna ki dar kh'odisai Fatkh'i Makka in kh'olat pesh omad- bo tu ba sharti on baiat kunand, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ech' chizero sharik nasozand, balki tankh'o Uro biparastand va ba duzdi dast nazanand va az zinokori biparkh'ezand va farzandonashonro -on guna ki dar zamoni ch'okh'iliiat ba khotiri tarsi fak'r io nangi ch'okh'ili chunin mekardand- nakushand va farzandoni az rokh'i kh'arom ba dunio ovardaashonro bo bukh'ton ba shavkh'aronashon nisbat nadikh'and va turo dar kori pisandida -ba misli kh'angomi musibat az navkh'agari, muikani va ruikani nakh'i namudanat- nofarmoni nakunand, pas bo onkh'o bai'at namo va ba'd az on baroi gunokh'onashon az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) omurzish bitalab. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

Chun Khudo dar og'ozi sura az dusti varzidan bo dushmanoni Khud va mu'minon kh'ushdor dod, dar khotima niz ta'kidan kh'amin mavzu'ro zikr karda guft:
13) Ei mu'minoni poibandi shariat! Bo k'avme, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bar onkh'o khashm girifta ast, dusti makuned. In k'avmi g'azabshuda ba okhirat imon nadorand, balki onkh'o on guna ki az bargashtani murdagonashon ba nazdashon noumedand -chunki munkiri rastokhezand- kh'amin guna az okhirat noumed meboshand.

1) Tamomi makhluk'oti osmonkh'o va tamomi makhluk'oti zamin doim Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az kh'ama aibu nuk'son ba poki mekhonand. Va U Zoti kh'amesha G'olibi Kh'akim ast. Ofaridani mavch'udot, akh'kom va tak'dirot bar asosi kh'ikmatash surat megirad.

2) Ei mu'minoni poibandi shariat! Charo ba digaron on korero megued, ki khud onro amali namesozed, va charo amali nokardaatonro "Kardaem" megued?! Chunonchi ba'zeaton "Man ba vasilai shamsheram muk'obili dushman ch'angida, ba onkh'o zarba zadam" meguiad, ammo dar kh'ak'ik'at in korro nakarda ast.

3) Nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) guftani chize, ki khud onro namekuned, nikh'oiat zisht ast. Boiad mu'min dar munosibat bo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bosadok'at boshad. Amalash bo guftorash mutobik'at kunad.

4) Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on mu'minonero, ki baroi khushnudiash dar rokh'ash pakh'lu ba pakh'lu safzada mech'angand, misli on ki onkh'o imorati ba kh'am paivand kh'astand, dust medorad.

Chun Parvardigor dar oiati k'abli muk'obili dushman ch'angidanro zikr kard va mu'minoni dar rokh'ash pakh'lui kh'amdigar istodaro makh'd kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin bo mak'sadi barkh'azar doshtani mu'minon az mukholifat bo Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) k'issai k'avmi Muso va Isoro ovarda guft:
5) Va ei Paiombar, on zamonero iod kun, ki Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba k'avmash guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Charo bo mukholifat kardani farmonam maro ozor medikh'ed, kh'ol on ki medoned, man dar kh'ak'ik'at firistodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sui shumo kh'astam?!" Pas vak'te onkh'o az rokh'i rost kach' shudand, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'albashonro az rokh'i rost va ustuvori dar on kach' gardond. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba k'avmi az toatash khorich'shuda tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui kh'ak'ro namedikh'ad.

6) Va ei Paiombar, on zamonero iod kun, ki Isoi pisari Mariam (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Iak'inan man firistodai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sui shumoiam, dar kh'ole Tavroti k'abl az khud nozilshudaro tasdik' mekunam va ba bi'sati paiombari ba'd az man meomada, ki nomash Akh'mad ast, bashorat medikh'am." Pas chun Isoi pisari Mariam (alaikh'is salom) bo kh'uch'ch'atkh'oi rostk'avliash nazdashon omad, guftand: "Azbaski in ch'odui oshkor ast, mo kh'ech' gokh' az on pairavi namekunem."

7) Va kh'ech' kas az on shakhse, ki dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo nisbat dodani anbozu farzand durug' mebofad, kh'ol on ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) uro ba sui dini iaktoparastii Islom faro mekhonad, sitamkortar nest. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba bandagone, ki bo shirku gunokh' bar ch'onashon sitam mekunand, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i durustro namedikh'ad.

8) In takzibgaron ba vasilai sukhanoni fosid va badnom kardani kh'ak' mekhokh'and Nuri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro khomush sozand va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Nurashro bo piruz gardonidani Islom dar tamomi gushaiu kanori zamin komil megardonad, agarchi kofiron inro dust nadorand.

9) U Khudoest, ki Paiombarash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro bo dini kh'idoiatgari Islom va dini targ'ibgar ba ilmi nofe' va amali solekh' firistod, to Islomro bar kh'ama dinkh'o g'olib sozad va agarchi mushrikon k'udratmand gashtanashro dust nadorand.
10) Ei mu'minoni poibandi shariat! Oio man shumoro ba anch'omi tich'orati sudmand, ki az azobi dardovar nach'otaton medikh'ad, rakh'namoi kunam?!

11) Tich'orati sudmand on ast, ki ba Allokh'u Rasulash imon biiored va bo kharch'i molkh'oiaton va ch'onaton kholisona dar rokh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'ikh'od kuned. In amal baroiaton az tamomi korkh'oiaton bekh'tar ast. Agar bekh'tar budanashro medoned, pas onro anch'om dikh'ed.

12) Agar shumo in korkh'oro amali sozed, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'onatonro mebakhshad va shumoro ba bog'kh'oe, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtkh'oiash rudkh'o ch'ori ast, dokhil mesozad va niz shumoro ba k'asrkh'oi doroi ne'matkh'oi poku kh'alovatbakhsh dar bog'kh'oi baroi istik'omati abadi vorid mesozad. In podosh rastagorii buzurg ast. Kh'ech' rastagori ba on barobar nest.

13) Va az foidakh'oi tich'orati iodshuda ne'mati digarest, ki shumo dar kh'amin dunio ba on noil gashtanro dust medored. On ne'mat nusrati ilokh'i alaikh'i dushmanon, fatkh'i k'aribulvuk'ui Makka va sarzaminkh'oi digar ast. Va ei Paiombar, mu'minonro bashorat bidekh', ki dar in dunio g'olib megardand va dar okhirat voridi ch'annat meshavand.

14) Ei mu'minon! Chunonchi ioroni makhsusi Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) iovaroni dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) budand, shumo niz iovaroni dini U boshed. Zamone Isoi pisari Mariam ba ioroni makhsusash guft: "Chi kase bo toatu ibodat va tablig'i risolat dar rui ovardan ba sui Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iovaroni man ast?", onkh'o dar ch'avob guftand: "Mo iovaroni dini Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'astem." Pas iak idda az Bani Isroil ba vai imon ovardand va iak iddai digar kofir shudand. Pas Mo mu'minonashonro ba muk'obili kofironashon k'uvvat bakhshidem. Pas shakhsoni ba Isoi Masekh' (alaikh'is salom) imon ovarda alaikh'i kofiron g'olib gashtand.

1) Ba poki iod mekunand kh'amai mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va kh'amai mavch'udoti zamin, Allokh'i Kh'ukmfarmoi Muk'addasi G'olibi Mag'lubnashavanda dar ofarinish va dar kh'amai akh'kom va ta'iini tak'dir Kh'akimro az tamomi aibu nuk'son.

2) U On Zotest, ki dar baini arabkh'oi az khondanu navishtan nodon Paiombarero az nav'i khudashon barangekht, ki baroiashon oiatkh'oi Khudoro tilovat mekunad va onkh'oro az kufru akhlok'i bad pok megardonad va ba onkh'o K'ur'on va Sunnatro ta'lim medikh'ad. Va iak'inan in mardum k'abl az bi'sati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar gumrokh'ii oshkor k'aror doshtand. Eshon pesh az omadani Islom but meparastidand, khuni iakdigarro merekhtand va bo kheshovandon k'at'i robita menamudand.

3) Va Khudo Paiombarashro inchunin baroi kh'idoiati k'avmkh'oi digari arab va tamomi millatkh'oi rui zamin, ki kh'anuz ba dunio naomada, ba arabkh'oi mavch'ud napaivastaand va dar oianda meoiand, firistoda ast. Va Khudo kh'amesha G'olibu dar ofarinish, akh'kom va ta'iini tak'dir nikh'oiat Kh'akim ast.

4) In bi'sati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba sui arabkh'o va kh'amai millatkh'oi dunio fazli Khudo ast, onro ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, medikh'ad. Va Khudo Doroi lutfi buzurg ast. Iake az nishonakh'oi lutfash firistodani Paiombari ummati Islom ba sui ch'umlagi millatkh'oi rui zamin ast.

Va kh'angome ki Khudovand az ne'mati risolati paiombar va az nozili K'ur'on iodovar shud, kh'oli ba'ze az pairavoni Muso (alaikh'issalom) az on chi rui gardondand va amal nakardan ba on chize dar tavrot omadaast zikr namuda in ummatro ogokh' kard az pairavi ba onkh'o, binobar in guft:
5) Sifati iakh'udikh'oe, ki ba amali gardonidani dasturoti Tavrot vazifador gashtand, sipas onro ich'ro nakardand va mas'uliiatashonro kanor guzoshtand, monandi sifati khar ast, ki kitobkh'oi kalonkh'ach'mro mebardorad, ammo chi budani onro namedonad?! Sifati k'avmi iakh'ud, ki oiatkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro durug' shumurdand, nikh'oiat zisht ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba k'avmi zolim tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i kh'ak'ro namedikh'ad.

6) Ei Paiombar, bigu: "Ei kasone, ki bar iakh'udiiat ba'd az tag'iir ioftani on bok'i mondaed, agar mepindored, ki iagona shumo, na digar mardum dustoni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'asted, pas orzui marg kuned, to kh'ar chi zudtar ba samarai dustii khesh birased, agar dar da'voiaton vobasta ba on ki guio dustoni Parvardigored, sodik' boshed."

7) Va iakh'udikh'o ba sababi on chi az kufru ma'siiatu zulm va takh'rifi Tavrot sodir namudaand, kh'argiz margro orzu namekunand, balki orzui dar dunio abadi zistanro dorand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai zolimon ast. Kh'ech' amali onkh'o az U pushida namemonad va dar badali kh'ar iak kirdoru guftorashon ch'azoi sazovor megirand.

8) Ei Paiombar, ba in iakh'udikh'o bigu: "Kh'amono marge, ki shumo az on paivasta megurezed, der io zud ba shumo merasad. Sipas ba sui Allokh'i Donandai nikh'on va oshkor bargardonda meshaved, pas shumoro az on chi anch'om medikh'ed, ogokh' mesozad va ba ch'azoi bosazoi khud merased."

9) Ei mu'minoni poibandi akh'komi shariat! Vak'te ki muazzin dar ruzi ch'umu'a ba'd az baromadani khatib ba minbar baroi namoz fariod mekunad, pas ba khotiri shirkat dar khutba va namoz ba ch'onibi masch'id bishitobed va dodu sitadro tark kuned, to shumoro az toati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) mashg'ul nasozad. In shitoftan ba sui masch'id va tarki tich'orat baroi shumo mu'minon az sargarmi ba korkh'oi digar bekh'tar ast. Agar bekh'tar budanashro medoned, pas amri Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba ch'o ored.

10) Pas vak'te ki namozi ch'umu'aro ba ch'o ovarded, pas baroi kasbi kh'alol dar zamin parokanda shaved va bo rokh'i kh'alol az fazli Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ch'ustuch'u namoed va kh'angomi talabi ruzi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ziiod iod kuned, ba umedi on ki bo rasidan ba bikh'isht va nach'ot az duzakh rastagor garded.
