11) Va ei Paiombar, chun iak iddai mu'minon tich'orat io sargarmiero mushokh'ida kardand, parokanda gashta, ba sui on berun raftand va turo dar kh'olati bar rui minbar rost istodanat rakh'o sokhtand. Ei Paiombar, ba onkh'o bigu: "Podoshi nazdi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az sargarmi va tich'orate, ki baroi on parokanda shuda, berun rafted, bekh'tar ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Bekh'tarini ruzidikh'andagon ast."

1) Ei Paiombar! Vak'te munofik'on dar mach'lisat kh'ozir shavand, bo zabon meguiand: "Mo guvokh'i medikh'em, ki tu Firistodai Khudoi." Va Khudo Khud medonad, ki tu Firistodai U kh'asti va Khudo guvokh'i medikh'ad, ki munofik'on dar da'voiashon vobasta ba on ki shakh'odatashon samimi ast, durug'gui meboshand.

2) Onkh'o savgandkh'oi durug'ashonro, ki guio imon dorand, chun sipar sokhta, khudro az kushtashavi va asorat mukh'ofizat mekunand. Dar natich'a, mardumro bo nashri shak va fitnakori az rokh'i Khudo barmegardonand. Iak'inan on chi onkh'o az nifok' va savgandkh'oi bardurug' anch'om medikh'and, nikh'oiat zisht ast.

3) In ba on sabab ast, ki onkh'o munofik'ona imon ovardand, ammo on ba k'albashon narasid, sipas ba Khudo pinkh'oni kofir gashtand. Pas Khudo ba illati kufr bar k'albkh'oiashon mukh'r nikh'od va imon ba on rokh' nameiobad. Ba kh'amin sabab, munofik'on foidai khudro dark namekunand.

4) Va ei binanda, vak'te munofik'onro mebini, ch'ism va shaklashon turo ba shigift meorad, zero osori maishat dar simoiashon namoion ast va agar sukhan biguiand, ba guftorashon gush meandozi, chunki bo san'ati banland sukhan meguiand. Munofik'on dar mach'lisi tu Paiombar monandi onand, ki guio chubkh'oi takiadodashuda boshand, kh'ech' chizero namefakh'mand. Az tarsui kh'ar sadoi sakhtro ziddi khud mepindorand. Onkh'o dushmanoni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand. Pas, ei Paiombar, az onkh'o barkh'azar bosh, to asroratro oshkor nakunand va muk'obilat makr nasozand. Khudo la'natashon kunad, ki chi guna az imon bo vuch'udi rushanii dalelkh'oi on barmegardand.

5) Va chun ba munofik'on "Nazdi Rasuli Allokh' omada, az amalkh'oi khud uzr bikhokh'ed, to az Allokh' baroi gunokh'onaton omurzish khokh'ad" gufta shavad, bo maskhara sari kheshro metakonand va onkh'oro mebini, ki az ich'roi in farmon rui megardonand va onkh'o az paziruftani kh'ak'ik'at va tobe' gashtan ba on kibr mevarzand.

6) Ei Paiombar! Baroi munofik'on omurzish khostanat va omurzish nakhostanat iakson ast. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'argiz gunokh'oni onkh'oro nameomurzad. Iak'inan Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba k'avme, ki az toatash khorich' meshavand va paivasta ba gunokh' dast mezanand, tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba rokh'i kh'ak'ro namedikh'ad.

7) Munofik'on kasoneand, ki meguiand: "Molatonro bar fak'iron va bodiianishinoni atrofi Madina, ki dar nazdi Paiombari Khudo kh'astand, kharch' nakuned, to az atrofash parokanda bishavand." Va khazinakh'oi osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Khudo ast. Az on ba kh'ar ki khokh'ad, ruzi medikh'ad. Valekin munofik'on in kh'ak'ik'atro namefakh'mand.

8) Rakh'bari munofik'on, Abdullokh' ibni Ubai meguiad: "Savgand iod mekunam, ki agar ba Madina bargardem, kh'atman nafaroni k'avii izzatmand -man va k'avmam- nafaroni khoru beizzat -Mukh'ammad va askh'obash--ro az Madina berun mesozad. Va izzatu k'udrat fak'at az oni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va Paiombarash va mu'minon ast. Abdullokh' ibni Ubai va pairavonash sokh'ibi izzatu k'udrat nestand. Valekin munofik'on inro namedonand.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi guzashta sifati bukhli munofik'onro ovard, dar oiati zerin mu'minonro az in khislat barkh'azar doshta, onkh'oro ba sarfi amvoli khesh dar rokh'i Khud farmon doda guft:
9) Ei mu'minoni boamal! Amvolaton va farzandonaton shumoro az khondani namoz va digar farzkh'oi dini sargarm nasozand. Va kh'ar ki sargarmi molkh'o va farzandonash gashta, farzkh'oro -ba misli namoz va g'airi on- tark mesozad, pas begumon onkh'o ziionkoroni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand. Zero ruzi k'iiomat ba ch'onashon va khonadonashon ziion merasonand.

10) Va az ba'zei molkh'oe, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) onro ba shumo ruzi doda ast, kharch' kuned, k'abl az on ki ba iakei shumo alomatkh'oi marg biioiad, pas on ruz biguiad: "Ei Parvardigoram, charo margi maro to iak muddati andak ba ta'khir naguzoshti, to az molam dar rokh'at sadak'a kunam va az zumrai bandagoni shoistakor bosham."

11) Va kh'argiz Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) margi kasero chun mukh'latash faro rasad va umrash khotima iobad, ba ta'khir nameguzorad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az korkh'oe, ki mekuned, Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' koraton az U pushida nest va dar badali kh'ar iak guftoru kirdor ch'azoi loik' megired.

1) Ba poki iod mekunand kh'amai mavch'udoti osmonkh'o va kh'amai mavch'udoti zamin Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro az tamomi aibu nuk'son. Podshokh'ii mutlak', tankh'o az oni Ust va sitoish khos va loik'i Ust. Va U bar kh'ama chiz Tavono ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro och'iz namesozad.

2) U On Khudoest, ki shumo mardumro ofarida ast. Pas az shumo ba'zeaton kofir gashta, voridi duzakh meshavad va az shumo ba'zeaton mu'min gashta, dar bog'kh'oi abadi ch'o megirad. Va on chi mekuned, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba on Bino ast.

3) Khudo osmonkh'o va zaminro bo kh'ikmati azimi shomili foidakh'oi dunio va okhirat ofarid va shumoro surat dod, pas suratkh'oiatonro az rui lutfash zebo gardond. Agar Khudo mekhost, suratatonro zisht mesokht. Va ruzi k'iiomat bozgasht tankh'o ba sui Ust. On ruz ba shumo ch'azoi sazovor medikh'ad.

4) Khudo on chiro dar osmonkh'o va on chiro dar zamin ast, medonad va niz az a'molaton on chiro oshkor va on chiro pinkh'on mesozed, medonad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Donandai khairu sharri dar sinakh'oiaton nukh'ufta ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nameboshad.

5) Ei mushrikon! Oio ba shumo khabari kofironi k'ablan guzashta ba misli k'avmi Nukh', Od, Samud va digaron naomada ast?! Pas onkh'o dar dunio farch'omi badi kufri kheshro chashidand va baroiashon dar okhirat azobi dardnok ast?! Ore, in khabar ba shumo rasid va dar in bora ogokh'i dored. Modom ki az k'issai onkh'o ogokh'ed, pas az on ibrat gired va pesh az nuzuli azob ba sui Khudo tavba kuned.

6) Sababi uk'ubati onkh'o dar on bud, ki paivasta paiombaronashon bo dalelkh'oi ravshan nazdashon meomadand, pas onkh'o imkoni paiombar gashtani odamiro rad karda meguftand: "Oio odamiion moro ba rokh'i kh'ak' rakh'namoi menamoiand?!" Pas onkh'o kofir shudand va az imon rui gardondand. In amalashon ba Khudo ziion namerasonad. Va Khudo az imon va ibodatashon beniioz ast. Zero ibodatashon ba Khudo sud namebakhshad. Va Khudo Zoti Beniiozu dar guftoru kirdorash Sutuda ast.

7) Kofiron da'vo dorand, ki Khudo onkh'oro ba'di margashon zinda namesozad. Ei Paiombar! Ba munkironi rastokhez bigu: "Ore, savgand ba Parvardigoram, ki ruzi k'iiomat kh'atman zinda karda meshaved, sipas az amalkh'oi dar dunio kardaaton ogokh' sokhta meshaved. Va in zinda gardonidanaton bar Khudo nikh'oiat oson ast. U bori nakhust shumoro ba vuch'ud ovard va tavoni onro dorad, ki baroi bozpursi va ch'azo dubora zindaaton sozad."

8) Pas ei mardum, ba Khudovu Paiombarash va K'ur'one, ki Mo onro ba Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) furud ovardaem, imon ored. Va Khudo az on chi anch'om medikh'ed, Bokhabar ast. Amalkh'oiaton az U pushida nest va dar badali kh'ar kor ch'azoi arzandai khudro megired.

9) Ei Paiombar, ruzero iod kun, ki Khudo shumoro baroi ruzi k'iiomat ch'am' meorad, to podoshi korkh'oiatonro bidikh'ad. On ruzi oshkorshavii khasorat va ziioni kofiron ast. Zero mu'minon dar okhirat manzilkh'oi akh'li duzakhro dar ch'annat meros mebarand va kofiron manzilkh'oi akh'li ch'annatro dar duzakh meros mebarand. Va kh'ar ki ba Khudo imon meorad va amali shoista mekunad, gunokh'onashro makh'v mesozad va uro ba bustonkh'oe medarorad, ki az zeri k'asrkh'ovu darakhtonash rudkh'o ch'orist, bikh'ishtiion dar bikh'isht ch'ovidon memonand. Onkh'o az bikh'isht berun nameshavand va ne'matkh'oiash k'at' namegardad. In komiobii buzurge ast, ki kh'ech' komiobie barobari on nest.

10) Va on kasone, ki kofir meshavand va oiatkh'oi bar Paiombaramon nozilkardai Moro durug' meshumorand, onkh'o kh'amdamoni otashi duzakh buda, dar onch'o abadi memonand va ch'oi bozgashtashon nikh'oiat zisht ast.

11) Ba kh'ech' kase dar ch'onu molu farzandash musibate ch'uz bo k'azo va k'adari ilokh'i namerasad. Va kh'ar ki ba Parvardigor va k'azovu k'adarash imon meorad, k'albashro baroi taslim gashtan dar barobari akh'kom va rizomandi ba tak'dir rakh'namoi mekunad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az kh'amai chiz ba purragi Ogokh' ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest.

12) Va az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) itoat kuned va az Paiombarash itoat kuned. Pas agar az paig'omi ovardai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) rui gardoned, gunokh'i on ba shumo barmegardad, zero mas'uliiati vai tankh'o az tablig'i ravshani chizkh'oe iborat ast, ki ba tablig'ash farmon shuda ast. Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) mas'uliiati kheshro ba tavri zaruri ich'ro karda ast.

13) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iagona Ma'budi loik'i ibodat ast, ch'uz U kh'ech' kas va kh'ech' chiz loik'i ibodat nest. Va mu'minon boiad dar tamomi korashon tankh'o ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavakkul kunand.

14) Ei mu'minoni poibandi akh'komi shariat! Ba durusti, ba'zei kh'amsaronaton va farzandonaton baroiaton dushmanand. Zero shumoro az zikri Khudo va muboriza dar rokh'i kh'ak' mashg'ul mesozand va az in rokh' mone' meshavand. Pas az onkh'o boekh'tiiot boshed, ki shumoro az ibodat boz nadorand. Va agar az lag'zhishkh'oi zanonu farzandonaton darguzared va az on ru gardoned va onkh'oro bubakhshed, pas iak'inan Khudo Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast. Gunokh'onatonro mebakhshad va shumoro mavridi rakh'mash k'aror medikh'ad. Chunki ch'azo az nav'i amal ast.

15) Beshak, amvolaton va farzandonaton baroiaton vasilai sanch'ish kh'astand. Ba'zan shumoro ba kasbi ruzii kh'arom va tarki ibodat vodor mesozand. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nazdash podoshi azimi ch'annat ast. Kh'ar ki toati Uro az toati farzandon va sargarmii amvolash pesh meguzorad, sokh'ibi ch'annati abadi megardad.

16) Pas az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) on k'adar, ki tavon dored, parkh'ez namoed va ba on chi Allokh'u Paiombarash meguiand, gush faro dikh'ed va az on itoat kuned va ba khotiri foidai khud amvoli baroiaton bakhshidai Allokh'ro dar rokh'kh'oi nek kharch' sozed. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'ar kiro az kh'irsi omekhta bo bukhli nafsash nigokh' dorad, pas onkh'o rastagoroni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand. Ba ch'annat noil meshavand va az ch'akh'annam rakh'oi meioband.

17) Agar shumo bo kharch'i molaton dar rokh'i khair ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) k'arzi nek dikh'ed, onro baroiaton duchand megardonad, dar ivazi iak neki az dakh' to kh'afsad va az on beshtar podosh medikh'ad va gunokh'onatonro mebakhshad. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bag'oiat Shukrguzori Burdbor ast. Dar badali amali andak podoshi farovon medikh'ad va dar badali gunokh' zud uk'ubat namekunad.
18) U Donandai pinkh'on va oshkor, kh'amesha G'olibi dar ofarinish, akh'kom va ta'iini tak'dirot bag'oiat Bokh'ikmat ast.

1) Ei Paiombar! Vak'te tu io kase az ummatonat k'asdi talok' dodani kh'amsaratonro mekuned, pas onkh'oro dar og'ozi iddaashon talok' dikh'ed, ba in surat, ki talok' dar kh'olati pokii zan az odati mokh'ona va biduni kh'amkhobagi surat girad va kh'isobi iddaro nigokh' dored, to agar dubora zindagiro bark'aror namudan khokh'ed, onkh'oro k'abl az guzashtani se idda bargardoned va bo ich'roi farmonkh'o va duri ch'ustan az kh'aromkh'o az azobi Allokh'i Parvardigoraton biparkh'ezed. Kh'amsaroni talok'shudaatonro to vak'ti guzashtani iddashon az khonakh'oe, ki dar on sukunat mekardand, berun makuned va khudashon niz az on khonakh'o naboiad berun shavand, ch'uz on ki kori fakh'shi oshkore ba misli zino sodir kunand. Va in marzkh'oi guzoshtai Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi bandagon ast. Va kh'ar ki marzkh'oi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro poimol megardonad, pas begumon bar khud sitam namuda ast. Zero bo isioni amri ilokh'i ch'onashro ba khatar guzoshta ast. Ei talok'dikh'anda! Tu namedoni, ki shoiad Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba'd az in talok' dar k'albat nisbat ba kh'amsarat rag'batro paido mesozad va az nav zindagii mushtarakatonro bark'aror menamoed.

2) Pas chun kh'amsaroni talok'shudaaton ba sipari shudani muddati iddaashon nazdik shavand, pas onkh'oro bo maili khesh va muoshirati nek bargardoned, io bo adoi kh'uk'uk'ashon ba surati loik' az onkh'o ch'udo shaved, to iddaashon guzarad va zimomi korashonro ba dast girand. Va vak'ti bargardonidan io az onkh'o ch'udoshavi, ba mak'sadi peshgiri az rukh dodani ch'angu ch'idol, az bainaton du nafari odilro shokh'id k'aror dikh'ed. Va ei shokh'idon, shakh'odatro kholis baroi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ich'ro namoed. Bo akh'komi mazkur kase pand doda meshavad, ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) va ruzi okhirat imon dorad. Zero makh'z kh'amin bandagon az pand va iodovari sud mebarand. Va kh'ar ki bo ich'roi farmonkh'o va khuddori az kh'aromkh'o az uk'ubati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) parkh'ez menamoiad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiash az kh'ar sakhti rokh'i berun omadanro padid meorad.

3) Va uro az ch'oe rizk' medikh'ad, ki dar gushai khotirash nameguzasht va az onch'o omadani rizk'ro namepindosht. Va kh'ar ki dar korkh'oiash bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) tavakkul kunad, pas U baroiash basanda ast. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) khostaashro ba ich'ro rasonda, dar kh'ech' kor notavoni namekashad. Begumon Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kh'ar chiz andozae k'aror doda ast. Dushvori va farokhi farch'omi khudro dorad va kh'ech' kadomi on doimi nest.

4) Va kh'amsaroneaton, ki ba sababi piri az kh'aiz noumed gashtaand, agar dar tarzi shumurdani iddaashon shubkh'a kuned, pas iddai onkh'o se mokh' ast va zanone, ki ba sababi khurdsoli kh'aiz namebinand, pas iddai onkh'o niz se mokh' ast. Va poioni iddai zanoni kh'omila az talok' io vafoti shavkh'ar vaz'i kh'amlashon ast. Va kh'ar ki az uk'ubati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi amrkh'o va duri ch'ustan az nakh'ikh'o parkh'ez mekunad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) korkh'oiashro oson mesozad.

5) Ei akh'li imon! In akh'komi mazkur kh'ukmi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) buda, onro ba suiaton furud ovarda ast, to mutobik'ash amal kuned. Va kh'ar ki az azobi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi amrkh'o va khuddori az nakh'ikh'o parkh'ez mekunad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) gunokh'onashro az vai makh'v megardonad va dar okhirat baroiash ach'ri buzurgi dukhuli ch'annatro medikh'ad.

Chun Khudovand dar oiatkh'oi k'abli kh'ukmi talok' va dubora bark'aror sokhtani zindagiro baion namud, dar oiatkh'oi zerin kh'ukmi bo nafak'a va manzil ta'min kunonidani zanro ovarda guft:
6) Ei shavkh'aron! Kh'amsaroni dar idda k'arordoshtaatonro dar onch'o, ki khud sukunat mekuned, ba k'adri tavonaton sokin sozed. Khudo shumoro az tavonaton beshtar mukallaf namesozad. Va bo mak'sadi ba kh'amsaroni khesh tangi ovardan bar onkh'o dar nafak'a, ch'oii zist va g'airi on zarar narasoned. Va agar bordor boshand, pas bar onkh'o to vak'ti vaz'i kh'amlashon nafak'a dikh'ed. Pas agar onkh'o farzandonatonro ba'di ch'udoi baroi shumo shir dikh'and, pas muzdashonro dikh'ed. Va dar borai muzdi shir dodan baini kh'amdigar ba tavri pisandida mashvarat kuned. Va agar shavkh'ar az pardokhtani muzdi mekhostai kh'amsarash bukhl varzad va kh'amsar niz bakhili namuda, ch'uz ba mik'dori khostaash rozi nashavad, pas padar zani shirdikh'andai digarero ich'ora girad, to farzandashro shir dikh'ad.

7) Boiad kh'ar mardi tavongar bar zani talok'shuda va farzandash az doroiash nafak'a kunad va kh'ar ki rizk'ash tang gardonida shuda ast, pas az on chi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba vai doda ast, ba andozai k'udratash nafak'a kunad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kasero ch'uz ba k'adri on chi ba u doda ast, mukallaf namesozad. Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bandagonro az andozai ato namudaash va az tavonashon berun mukallaf namegardonad. Kh'atman Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba'di dushvoriiu tangdasti farokhiiu tavongariro padid meorad.

Vak'te ki Khudo dar oiatkh'oi bolo iakchand farmoni Khudro ovard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin az nofarmoni barkh'azar doshta, ok'ibati badi onro baion sokhta guft:
8) Va chi k'adar ziiod kh'astand akh'li dekh'akh'oe, ki az anch'om dodani amri Parvardigorashon va paiombaroni U sarkashi kardand, pas Mo onkh'oro baroi gunokh'onashon kh'isobi sakht namudem va onkh'oro dar dunio uk'ubati dakh'shatnok dodem. Dar okhirat niz ba uk'ubati sakht mubtalo meshavand.
9) Pas ok'ibati gunokh'onashonro chashidand va saranch'omi korashon dar dunio va okhirat khasorat gardid.

10) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiashon uk'ubati shadid omoda namuda ast. Pas ei khiradmandon, ki ba Khudo va Paiombarash imon dored, az uk'ubati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo ich'roi farmonkh'o va duri ch'ustan az kh'aromkh'o biparkh'ezed. Kh'amono Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba sui shumo K'ur'onro nozil namuda ast. In Kitob ok'ibati badi gunokh' va farch'omi neki ibodatro ba iodaton meorad.

11) Paiombarero firistod, ki ba shumo oiatkh'oi vozekh'i Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro mekhonad, to kasonero, ki imon meorand va korkh'oi shoista mekunand, az torikikh'oi zalolat ba sui nuri kh'idoiat berun sozad. Va kh'ar ki ba Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) imon meorad va amali shoista anch'om medikh'ad, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) uro ba bustonkh'oe medarorad, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtonash rudkh'o ch'ori ast, ch'annatiion onch'o abadi memonand. Beshak, Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) rizk'i ch'annatiionro nek megardonad. Zero sokh'ibi ch'annati ch'ovidon meshavad.

12) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) On Zotest, ki kh'aft osmon va monandi osmonkh'o kh'aft zaminro ofarid. Paig'om va k'azovu k'adar dar borai koinot va shariat doim dar baini osmonkh'o va zamin ch'ori meboshad, to bidoned Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) ba kh'ama chiz K'odir ast va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az rui ilm kh'ama chizro ikh'ota karda ast. Kh'ech' chiz dar osmonkh'o va zamin az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pushida nest.

1) Ei Paiombar! Charo chizero -ba misli bakh'ra burdan az kanizat Moriia-, ki onro Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiat mubokh' gardonida ast, bar khud kh'arom megardoni, dar kh'ole ki bo in amalat khushnudii kh'amsaronatro mekhokh'i, chunki onkh'o az alok'ai tu bo Moriia rashk burda, norokh'at shudaand?! Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nisbat ba tu bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.

2) Ba durusti ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroiaton ba vositai kaffora -agar az kori savgandkhurdai khesh bekh'tarero paido kuned io onro shikaned- rokh'i kushodani savgandkh'oiatonro muk'arrar namuda ast. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Iovari shumost. Va U Donandai kh'olat va manfiati bandagon buda, dar kh'ukm va tak'dirash Bokh'ikmat ast.

3) Va ei bandai kh'ushmand, zamonero iod kun, ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba iake az kh'amsaronash bo nomi Kh'afsa sukhani khosero pinkh'oni guft. Az ch'umla ba vai guft, ki minba'd bo kanizash Moriia nazdiki namekunad. Pas, chun Kh'afsa on sukhanro ba Oisha khabar dod va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Paiombarashro az oshkorshavii asrorash ogokh' gardonid, Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) Kh'afsaro sarzanish namud va ba vai ba'ze az sukhanoni ba Oisha guftaashro zikr kard va az guftani ba'zei digarash khudro nigokh' dosht. Pas, vak'te Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ba Kh'afsa oshkor sokhtani asrorashro khabar dod, Kh'afsa pursid: "Ki turo az in guftugui baini manu Oisha bokhabar sokht?" Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) guft: "Maro Allokh'i Donoi kulli Ogokh' az kh'ama pushidakh'o khabar kard."

4) Tavba kardani kh'ardui shumo Kh'afsa va Oisha lozim va zarur ast. Zero kh'amono k'albi shumo ba dustdorii kore moil gasht, ki Paiombari Khudo onro namekhost. Shumo dust doshted, ki Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) Moriiaro bar khud kh'arom sozad, ammo vai in korro dust namedosht. Va agar muk'obili Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) bo rashkkh'oi bemavrid va oshkor sokhtani rozash kh'amdasti kuned va khatoi kheshro idoma dikh'ed, pas Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) Korsozu Iorirasoni Paiombarash ast va Ch'ibril va mu'minoni solekh' duston va iorirasonash kh'astand. Va ba'di madadi ilokh'i farishtagon iorirasonash meboshand.

5) Agar Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) shumoro talok' dikh'ad, iak'inan Parvardigorash baroiash dar badali shumo kh'amsaroni az shumo bekh'tari taslimshudagon, imonovardagon, itoatkunandagoni amri Khudovu Paiombar, tavbakoron, ibodatkunandagoni Parvardigori khesh, ruzadoron, shavkh'ardidagon va dushizakh'oro medikh'ad. Ammo Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kh'amsaronashonro talok' nadodand.

6) Ei mu'minoni poibandi kh'ukmi shariat! Khud va khonadonatonro az otashi buzurge, ki otashangezi on mardum va sangkh'oiand, nigokh' dored. Baroi nigakh'bonii on otash farishtagone muvazzaf sokhta shudaand, ki dar munosibat bo duzakhiion durushtguftori sakhtraftorand. Onkh'o kh'ech' gokh' on chiro Khudo farmonashon medikh'ad, nofarmoni namekunand va on chi az sui Khudo amr megirand, onro be ta'khir va susti ba ch'o meorand.

7) Ruzi k'iiomat ba kofiron gufta meshavad: "Ei kofiron! Imruz az kufru ma'siiati dar dunio sodir kardaaton uzr naored. Kh'argiz uzrkh'oiaton k'abul namegardad. Kh'amono imruz ba shumo ch'azoi on chi dar dunio az kufru takzibi paiombaron mekarded, doda meshavad. "

8) Ei mu'minoni poibandi shariat! Az gunokh'oni khud ba sui Khudo tavbai sodik'ona namoed. Umed meravad, ki Parvardigoraton az shumo gunokh'onatonro makh'v sozad va ruzi k'iiomat shumoro ba bustonkh'oe dokhil kunad, ki az zeri k'asrkh'o va darakhtonash rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad. Dukhuli ch'annat dar ruze surat megirad, ki Khudo Paiombarash Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) va kasoni bo vai imonovardaro bo darovardan ba duzakh rasvo namesozad. Nurashon dar boloi puli sirot peshopeshashon va az samti rostashon kh'arakat mekunad. Onkh'o meguiand: "Ei Parvardigori mo, baroiamon nuramonro komil bisoz, to voridi ch'annat shavem va monandi munofik'on naboshem, ki nurashon dar boloi puli sirot khomush meshavad va gunokh'oni moro biomurz. Kh'ak'k'o, ki Tu bar kh'amai chiz Tavonoi. Az komil sokhtani nuramon va omurzidani gunokh'onamon och'izi namekashi."

9) Ei Paiombar! Ba muk'obili kofiron ba vositai shamsher va ba muk'obili munofik'on ba vositai zabonu tatbik'i kh'ududi shar'i ch'ikh'od kun va bar onkh'o sakht bigir, to az tu bim doshta boshand va ruzi k'iiomat ch'oigokh'ashon duzakh ast va duzakh ch'oii bozgashti nikh'oiat bad ast.

10) Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi kofiron oidi on ki alok'aashon bo mu'minon baroiashon sud namebakhshad, kh'amsari Nukh' va kh'amsari Lutro masal zada ast. Onkh'o kh'amsaroni du bandai solekh'amon budand. Pas bo bargashtan az rokh'i Khudo va kumak rasonidan ba akh'li kufr dar kh'ak'k'i shavkh'aronashon khiionat kardand. Pas on du Paiombar ba e'tibori kh'amsari az onkh'o az azobi Khudo chizero bartaraf nasokhtand va kh'angomi margashon ba onkh'o gufta shud: "Kh'amrokh'i kofiron va fosik'oni ba duzakh voridshuda dokhili duzakh shaved."

11) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi mu'minon vobasta ba on ki alok'aashon bo kofiron -agar dar rokh'i rost sobitk'adam bimonand- ba onkh'o zarare namerasonad, sarguzashti kh'amsari Fir'avnro masal zada ast. On gokh', ki vai guft: "Ei Parvardigoram, baroiam nazdat dar ch'annat khonae bisoz va maro az saltanati Fir'avn va korkh'oi badash rakh'oi bakhsh va maro az k'avme, ki bo pairavii Fir'avn bar khud zulm kardaand, rakh'oi bakhsh."

12) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) baroi mu'minon k'issai Mariam binti Imronro, ki farch'ashro az zino nigokh' dosht, masal zada ast. Pas U Ch'ibrilro amr kard, ki dar gireboni perokh'anash az rukh'i mutaallik' ba Khudo bidamad va Mariam bo k'udrati ilokh'i biduni shavkh'ar kh'omila gasht va dasturoti Parvardigorash va kitobkh'oi ba Paiombaron furud ovardaashro tasdik' kard va Mariam az farmonbardoroni Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bud.
1) Bag'oiat Boazamat va Bobarakat ast Khudoe, ki podshokh'i tankh'o dar dasti Ust va U bar kh'ama chiz Tavono ast. Kh'ech' chiz Uro och'iz namesozad.

2) On Zote, ki marg va kh'aiotro ofarid, to shumo mardumro ozmoish kunad, ki kadomaton amali bekh'tar anch'om medikh'ed. Va U Khudoi G'olibi Mag'lubnashavandai Bakhshandai gunokh'i bandagoni tavbakor ast.

3) On Zote, ki kh'aft osmonro biduni rasidan ba iakdigar ruii kh'am ofarid. Ei binanda! Dar ofaridakh'oi Khudoi Mekh'rubon kh'ech' ziddiiat io adami tanosubero mushokh'ida namekuni. Agar dar in bora shubkh'a dori, pas chashmatro bigardon va bo dik'k'at nazar kun. Oio rakhnaero mebini?! Kh'argiz chunin chizero namebini. Balki kh'ama ofaridakh'oi Khudo ustuvor va dak'ik'and.
4) Sipas chashmi khudro borkh'o bargardon, chashmat ba suiat sarozeri kh'airon va dar ofaridai Khudo kh'ech' khalalero mushokh'ida nokarda va on az nazar andokhtan khastashuda barmegardad.

5) Va ba durusti, Mo osmoni ba zamin nazdiktarinro ba vositai sitorakh'oi durakhshon oroish dodem va az on sitorakh'o baroi rondani shaitonkh'o shu'lakh'oi otash sokhtem. Kh'ar gokh' shaitonkh'o k'asdi duzdidani akhbori osmonro kunand, on shu'lakh'oi otash onkh'oro ronda, mesuzonand. Va Mo baroi onkh'o dar okhirat azobi duzakhro omoda kardaem.
6) Va ruzi k'iiomat baroi shakhsone, ki ba Parvardigorashon kofir meshavand, azobi duzakh ast. Va duzakh ch'oii bozgashti nikh'oiat bad ast.
7) Vak'te ki kofiron dar duzakh afkanda shavand, az on sadoi zishti sakhtero meshunavand va duzakh monandi ch'ushidani deg mech'ushad.

8) Duzakh az shiddati g'azabash k'arib ast, ki bar sokinonash pora-pora shuda, az kh'am ch'udo gardad. Kh'ar gokh' gurukh'e dar on afkanda shavand, farishtagoni nigakh'boni duzakh malomatkunon az onkh'o mepursand: "Oio dar dunio ba shumo kh'ech' paiombari bimdikh'andae naomada bud, ki az uk'ubati Khudo shumoro bim va kh'ushdor dikh'ad?!"

9) Kofiron dar posukh guiand: "Ore, ba mo paiombari az uk'ubati Khudo bimdikh'anda omada bud, pas, uro durug'gu donistem va guftem: "Khudo ba mo kh'ech' paig'omero furud naovarda ast. Ba durusti, shumo paiombaron az kh'ak'ik'at dar gumrokh'ii buzurge k'aror dored."

10) Va niz onkh'o guiand: "Agar mo sukhanoni paiombaronro amalan meshunidem io ak'lamonro ba kor darovarda, kh'ak'ro az botil ch'udo mekardem, imruz dar zumrai akh'li ch'akh'annam nabudem, balki imon ovarda, az akh'li ch'annat megashtem."

11) Pas onkh'o ba gunokh'i khud az kufr va takzibi paiombaron e'tirof mekunand. Bo ik'rorashon loik'i duzakh budanashonro nishon medikh'and. Ba kh'amin sabab, akh'li duzakh az rakh'mati Khudo dur bod!

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi bolo sifat va ch'azoi akh'li duzakhro baion kard, dar oiati zerin sifat va podoshi akh'li bikh'ishtro ovarda guft:
12) Kh'amono kasone, ki dar khilvat az Parvardigorashon metarsand, onkh'oro mag'firati gunokh'on va ach'ri buzurgi ch'annat ast.
13) Va ei mardum, sukhani khudro pinkh'on kuned io onro oshkor sozed, dar ilmi Khudo kh'ardu barobar ast. Zero kh'ak'k'o, ki U Donandai asrori k'albkh'oi bandagon ast.

14) Oio Zote, ki kh'ama mavch'udotro ofarida ast, nikh'on va pushidatar az nikh'onro namedonad va kh'ol on ki U vobasta ba amalkh'oi bandagonash Borikbini az on Bokhabar ast?! Albatta, chize az U pushida nest.

15) U Khudoest, ki zaminro baroiaton narmi osonistik'omat sokht. Pas dar gushavu atrofi zamin sairu tamosho kuned va az rizk'i dar on baroiaton omodasokhtaash bikhured. Va shumo iagona ba sui U barangekhta shuda, mavridi bozpursi k'aror girifta, ch'azoi sazovor doda meshaved.
16) Oio khudro az Khudoe, ki dar osmon ast, az on ki shumoro monandi K'orun ba zeri zamin furu barad, pas zamin ba'd az oromish nogakh'on ba larza oiad, emin mekh'isobed?!

17) Oio az Khudoe, ki dar osmon ast, az on ki bar shumo misli k'avmi Lut tundbodi sangbor firistad, khudro dar amon mekh'isobed?! Pas chun uk'abati Maro bubined, az on bim dodanamro khokh'ed donist, ammo ba'd az didani azob in donistan ba shumo sude namebakhshad.

18) Va kh'ech' shakke nest, ki ummatkh'oi pesh az in mushrikon guzashta paiombaronro durug'gui shumurdand. Vak'te onkh'o kufru takzibi kheshro idoma dodand, duchori uk'ubati ilokh'i gashtand. Pas inkori Man bar kufru takzibashon chi guna bud?! Beshak, inkori nikh'oiat sakht bud.

19) Oio in ch'amoai takzibgar parrandagoni boloi sari khudro, ki bolkh'oiashonro gokh'o ch'am' va gokh'o onro pakh'n mekunand, namebinand?! On parrandagonro az aftodan ba zamin g'airi Khudoi Mekh'rubon digar kase nigokh' namedorad. Begumon U kh'ama chizro mebinad.
20) Ei kofiron! Agar Khudo azobatonro khokh'ad, kist on lashkariioni shumo, ki az on azob ch'uz Khudoi Mekh'rubon baroiaton kumak merasonad?! Beshak, kofiron dar firebi Shaiton giriftor kh'astand.

21) Agar Khudo rizk'ashro az shumo boz dorad, kist kase, ki ba shumo rizk' medikh'ad?! Balki kh'osili kalom on ast, ki kofiron dar sarkashi va kibru khuddori az k'abuli kh'ak' iakravi mekunand va isror mevarzand.
22) Oio on kase, ki vozhgun bar chekh'raash rokh' meravad rokh'ioftatar ast io on kase, ki bar rokh'i rost dar kh'olati rost istodan rokh' meravad?!

23) Ei Paiombar! Ba mushrikoni takzibgar bigu: "Khudo On Zotest, ki shumoro ofarid va baroiaton gushkh'o va chashmkh'o va k'albkh'oro ato namud. Uro dar badali ne'matkh'oiash andak siposguzori mekuned."

24) Ei Paiombar! Ba mushrikoni takzibgar bigu: "Khudo On Zotest, ki shumoro dar zamin pakh'n sokht. Ammo az dasti butkh'oiaton kore nameoiad. Va shumo ruzi k'iiomat baroi pursuch'u va giriftani ch'azo tankh'o ba sui U ch'am' ovarda meshaved. Modom ki kh'ak'ik'at chunin ast, pas fak'at Uro biparasted va iagona az U bikh'arosed."

25) Va takzibkunandagoni rastokhez vok'e'shavi onro durug' donista meguiand: "Ei Mukh'ammad! In va'dai azob, ki tu va ioronat paivasta moro az on bim medikh'ed, kai ba vuk'u' mepaivandad?! Agar shumo dar da'voi khesh sodik'ed, pas zamoni omadani onro baion kuned."
26) Ei Paiombar! Dar posukhashon bigu: "Ba durusti, ilmi zamoni vuk'ui k'iiomat nazdi Khudo ast, kase ba ch'uz U onro namedonad va man iak'inan baroiaton bimdikh'andai oshkoram."

27) Pas chun kofiron ruzi k'iiomat azobi Khudoro az nazdik binand, chekh'raashon digargun va siiokh' megardad va ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "In kh'amon azobest, ki dar dunio zud omadanashro talab mekarded."

28) Ei Paiombar! A'moli in mushrikoni takzibgarro inkor karda bigu: "Ba man khabar dikh'ed! Agar Khudo man va mu'minoni kh'amrokh'i maro bimironad io bo lutfash bar mo rakh'm karda, mukh'lati margi moro ba ta'khir guzorad, pas, kofironro az azobi dardovar chi kase merakh'onad?! Kase onkh'oro az azob rakh'onida nametavonad."

29) Ei Paiombar! Ba in mushrikon bigu: "U Khudoi Mekh'rubonest, ki shumoro tankh'o ba parastishi Khud faro mekhonad. Mo ba U imon ovardaem va dar kh'amai korkh'oiamon bar U tavakkul namudaem. Pas, der io zud kh'atman khokh'ed donist, ki chi kase dar gumrokh'ii oshkor va chi kase dar rokh'i rost k'aror dorad."

30) Ei Paiombar! Ba in mushrikon bigu: "Ba man khabar dikh'ed! Agar obi menushidaaton dar zamin on chunon furu ravad, ki ba on rasidan natavoned, pas ki ba shumo obi ch'orii farovon meorad?! Kh'ech' kas ch'uz Khudo az ukh'dai in kor namebaroiad."
1) "Nun". Savgand ba k'alam va ba on chi mardum bo k'alamkh'oiashon menavisand, ki-
2) tu Paiombar ba sababi in'omi nubuvvat az ch'onibi Parvardigor devona nesti. Balki az in tukh'mati mushrikon poku beaibi.
3) Va kh'amono baroiat dar ivazi on ki sakhtikh'oi tablig'i risolat ba mardumro takh'ammul dori, savobi k'at'noshavandai beminnat ast. Kh'ech' kas kh'ak'k'i bar tu minnat kardanro nadorad.
4) Va begumon tu sokh'ibi akhlok'i buzurgi k'ur'oni kh'asti. Khudro bo akhlok'i kh'amidai mavch'ud dar Kalomi Khudo bo bekh'tarin surat orostai.
5) Pas iak'inan tu ba zudi khokh'i did va mushrikon khokh'and did, ki-
6) vak'te kh'ak'ik'at oshkor shavad, ma'lum megardad, ki kadom iake az shumo giriftori devonagi ast?!

7) Ei Paiombar! Ba durusti, Parvardigorat kasonero, ki az rokh'ash gumrokh' shudaand, bekh'tar medonad va niz kasonero, ki kh'idoiat ioftaand, bekh'tar medonad. Gumrokh'ii mushrikon va dar rokh'i rost k'aror doshtani tu bo mu'minoni kh'amrokh'atro khub medonad.
8) Pas dar umuri dinat az mushrikoni takzibgar itoat makun.
9) Mushrikon orzu dorand, ki tu az kh'isobi din bo onkh'o narmi va sozish kuni, pas bo tu narmi va sozish kunand.
10) Va az kh'ar nafari bardurug' bisior savgandkhurandai kh'ak'ir itoat makun,-
11) on nafare, ki mardumro ziiod g'aibat mekunad va bo sukhanchini dar bainashon tukhmi tafrik'a mekorad,-
12) bisior monei neki buda, dar molu ch'onu nomusi mardum taarruz namuda, ba gunokh' ziiod dast mezanad,-
13) durushtkhui sangdil ast, ba'd az in kh'ama sifot kh'aromzoda ast.
14) Vai ba illati on ki moli bisior va farzandoni ziiod dorad, az imon ovardan kibr mevarzad.
15) Chun baroiash oiatkh'oi Mo khonda shavad, meguiad: "In afsonakh'oi boftai guzashtagon ast."
16) Beshak, Mo bar biniash dog'i sharmandagiiu khori khokh'em guzosht.

17) Begumon Mo in mushrikonro bo k'akh'ti va gurusnagi ozmudem, on guna ki k'ablan sokh'iboni bog'ro ozmuda budem. Chunki onkh'o savgand khurdand, ki dar vak'ti bomdodon mevakh'oi bog'ro shitobon mechinand, to fak'iron az on nakhurand.
18) Va onkh'o dar savgandi khud "In shoallokh'" nameguftand.
19) Pas, shabona az ch'onibi Parvardigorat otashi buzurge omad va atrofi bog'ro dar kh'ole ki sokh'ibonash khob budand, pechida, onro nobud kard va peshi rokh'i onro girifta natavonistand.
20) Pas, on bog' monandi shabi nikh'oiat torik siiokh' gasht.
21) Pas, kh'angomi subkh' kh'amdigarro fariod karda meguftand:-
22) "Agar mevakh'oiatonro chidan khokh'ed, pas sakh'ari barvak't k'abl az omadani fak'iron ba nazdi ziroati khesh biraved."
23) Pas, dar avvali subkh' shitobon ch'onibi ziroatashon rakh'sipor shudand va onkh'o bo sadoi past sukh'bat mekardand.
24) Ba iakdigar meguftand: "Naboiad imruz fak'ire nazdaton ba bog' dokhil shavad."
25) Va dar avvali subkh' bo azmi man' namudani mevakh'o az fak'iron rakh'sipor shuda, pindoshtand, ki bar ich'roi khostaashon k'udrat dorand.
26) Pas, vak'te bog'ashonro sukhta didand, ba kh'amdigar guftand: "Ba durusti ki mo rokh'ro gum kardaem. Zero bog'i mo chunin nabud.
27) Ne, mo rokh'ro gum nakardaem, balki ba sababi mak'sadi bad doshtanamon, ki fak'ironro az mevakh'oi on makh'rum mesozem, az chidani mevakh'oiash makh'rum gashtem."

28) Az baini onkh'o bekh'tarin nafarashon guft: "Vak'te shumo k'asd karded, ki fak'ironro az mevakh'oi bog'aton makh'rum megardoned, oio ba shumo naguftam: "Charo Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u)-ro ba poki namekhoned va az gunokh'onaton ba sui U barnamegarded?!"
29) Onkh'o dar ch'avob guftand: "Parvardigoramonro az kh'ama aibu nuk'son ba poki mekhonem. Kh'amono mo bo makh'rum sokhtani fak'iron bar ch'onamon sitam kardem."
30) Pas, ba'zei onkh'o ba ba'zei digarashon rui ovarda, iakdigarro malomat mekardand.
31) Onkh'o bo izkh'ori nadomat meguftand: "Ei voi bar mo! Beshak, mo bo man' kardani kh'ak'k'i fak'iron az kh'ad guzashtem.

32) Umed dorem, ki Parvardigoramon baroi mo dar ivazi on bog'i ba komi otash rafta bog'i bekh'tare dikh'ad. Iak'inan mo tankh'o ba sui Parvardigoramon rag'bat namuda, az U mag'firati gunokh'on va nekiro mekhokh'em."
33) Azobi Mo nisbat ba bandagoni nofarmon kh'amin guna ast. Va azobi okhirat buzurgtar ast, agar shiddat va bak'oi onro medonistand.
34) Ba durusti ki baroi parkh'ezkoron dar nazdi Parvardigorashon bustonkh'oi doroi ne'matkh'oi abadi ast.
35) Oio Mo -on guna ki mushrikon mepindorand- musalmononro dar podosh monandi kofiron megardonem?!
36) Ei mushrikon! Shumoro chi shuda ast, ki chunin k'azovati g'airi odilona mekuned?!
37) Io shumo kitobe dored, ki barobarii bandagoni farmonbardor va nofarmonro dar on kitob mekhoned?!
38) Oio dar on kitobaton mekhoned, ki kh'ar chi baroi khud dar okhirat bikhokh'ed, onro barmeguzined?!
39) Io in ki shumo bar ukh'dai Mo paimonkh'oi k'at'ii to ruzi k'iiomat poidor dored, ki bar asosi on kh'ukmi ba tab'i dilatonro ba naf'i khesh sodir menamoed?!
40) Ei Paiombar! Az sokh'iboni in sukhan bipurs: "Kadom iakei onkh'o ba in kh'ukmi guio bo mu'minon iakson budanashon kafil kh'astand?!"

41) Io in ch'amoa ch'uz Khudo ma'budkh'oe dorand, ki onkh'oro dar podosh bo mu'minon barobar megardonand?! Agar dar da'voiashon, ki guio az likh'ozi podosh bo mu'minon iaksonand, sodik' boshand, pas ma'budkh'oi khudro kh'ozir sozand.

42) Ruzi k'iiomat kh'amaro dakh'shati nikh'oiat shadid faro megirad va Parvardigor sok'i bemonandi Khudro oshkor mesozad va mardum ba sui sach'da da'vat meshavand. Pas mu'minon sach'da mekunand va kofironu munofik'on sach'da karda nametavonand.

43) Dar kh'ole ba sach'da da'vat meshavand, ki chashmonashon sarozer buda, khori va pushaimoni onkh'oro faro megirad. Va Ba durusti ki dar dunio ba sach'da kardan dar nazdi Khudo da'vat meshudand, kh'ol on ki onkh'o az giriftorikh'oi imruza dar ofiiat budand.

44) Pas, ei Paiombar, maro kh'amrokh'i on kase, ki in K'ur'onro durug' meshumorad, biguzor. Begumon Mo in ch'amoaro az makone zina ba zina ba samti azobi Khud mekashem, ki "tavtea" budani onro namedonand.

45) Va baroiashon iak muddat mukh'lat medikh'am, to dar gunokh' furu ravand. Kh'amon tadbiri Man nisbat ba akh'li kufru takzib nikh'oiat k'avi ast. Kh'argiz onkh'o az uk'ubatam rakh'oi nameioband va solim namemonand.

46) Ei Paiombar! Oio tu dar badali tablig'i risolati Khudo az onkh'o muzd talab mekuni, pas eshon az pardokhtash garoni mekashand?! Magar sababi az tu rui gardonidanashon kh'amin ast?! Iak'inan chunin nest. Zero tu az onkh'o chize talab nakardai. Pas charo tobei tu nameshavand?!
47) Io ilmi g'aib nazdi onkh'ost, pas kh'ar dalelero bikhokh'and, az g'aib menavisand va az tu beniioz gardida, muk'obilat ch'idol mekunand?!

48) Pas, ei Paiombar, baroi kh'ukmi Parvardigorat, ki onkh'oro bo dodani mukh'lat okh'ista-okh'ista kh'alok mesozad, sabr kun va dar diltangi az mardum va shitobkori monandi Iunusi sokh'ibi mokh'i mabosh, vak'te, ki Parvardigorashro nido kard va kh'ol on ki vuch'udi vai dar torikii shab va torikii batni mokh'i pur az g'am bud.
49) Agar ba fariodi Iunus markh'amati Parvardigorash namerasid, kh'atman mokh'i uro dar biioboni begiiokh'u darakht meafkand va u mavridi malomat k'aror megirift.
50) Pas, Parvardigorash Iunusro barguzid va uro az bandagoni doroi guftoru kirdor va mak'sadi solekh' gardonid.

51) Va beshak, vak'te kofiron K'ur'onro shunidand, nazdik bud, ki turo bo chashmonashon az shiddati nigokh'i tezashon az poi aftonand va kh'alok sozand. Va onkh'o az kh'avoi nafsashon pairavi karda, meguiand: "Ba durusti ki in mardi da'vogari nubuvvat devona ast."
52) Va kh'ak'k'o, ki K'ur'on baroi insonkh'o va ch'inkh'o andarz va iodovari ast.
1) Kh'odisai biduni shak takh'ak'k'uiobandai k'iiomat.
2) Khudo bo suoli zerin azamati on ruzro nishon doda meguiad: Chist on kh'odisai biduni shak takh'ak'k'uk'iobanda?!
3) Va tu chi medoni, ki on kh'odisai buzurg chist?! [Kh'avodisi on ruz az doirai tasavvuri inson berun ast]
4) Samudi k'avmi Solekh' va Odi k'avmi Kh'ud k'iiomati bo sakh'nakh'oi kh'avlnokash kubandai mardumro durug' shumurdand.
5) Pas ammo Samudi k'avmi Solekh', Khudo onkh'oro bo fariodi nikh'oiat sakhtu mudkh'ish kh'alok sokht.
6) Va ammo Odi k'avmi Kh'ud, Khudo onkh'oro ba vasilai bodi bag'oiat sardi doroi sadoi vakh'shatnoki az kh'ad ziiod tundvazanda kh'alok sokht.

7) Khudo on bodro bar onkh'o kh'aft shab va kh'asht ruzi paiopai ravon namud, ki kh'amaro nobud kard. Pas tu k'avmi Kh'udro dar manzilkh'oiashon kh'alokshudai bar zamin afkanda medidi, guio ki onkh'o tanakh'oi darakhti khurmoi pusidai darunkholii ba zamin aftoda boshand.
8) Pas, oio az onkh'o ba'd az in uk'ubat kasero bok'imonda mebini?!
9) Va Fir'avn va ummatkh'oi k'abl az vai guzashta va k'avmi Lut, ki dekh'akh'oi onkh'o zeru zabar gashta ast, ba khatokh'oi azimi shirku kufr dast zadand.
10) Pas onkh'o Paiombari Parvardigorashonro itoat nakardand va uro durug'gui shumurdand. Pas Parvardigor kh'amagiro ba shiddat kh'alok va reshakan sokht.

11) Kh'amono vak'te ob az likh'ozi balandi az kh'addi khud guzasht, Mo bo amri Khesh padaroni shumoro dar kishtii sokhtai Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) savor kardem. Azbaski mukhotaboni in oiat on zamon dar kamari padaronashon k'aror doshtand, Khudo dar inch'o onkh'oro mukhotab k'aror dod.
12) To Mo on kishti va sarguzashtashro oidi kh'alokati kofiron va nach'oti mu'minon moiai pandu ibrat gardonem va gushkh'oe, ki kh'ar chiro shunavand, dar iod mesuporand, onro az khud kunand.
13) Pas vak'te farishtai muvazzaf iak bor dar sur nafkhai duiumro bidamad.
14) Va zamin va kukh'kh'o bardoshta shavand, pas chunon iak daf'a kufta shavand, ki pora-pora gardand.
15) Pas k'iiomat dar on ruz ba vuk'u' mepaivandad.
16) Va osmon baroi nuzuli farishtagon rakhna meshavad, pas dar on ruz ba'd az ustuvori sustu notavon megardad.
17) Va farishtagon dar gushaiu kanori osmon k'aror megirand va on ruz arshi Parvardigoratro kh'asht farishtai muk'arrab boloi sari khud mebardorand.

18) Ei mardum! Shumo on ruz bar Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) peshkash meshaved. Kh'ech' asroraton az Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) pinkh'on namemonad. Balki U dar borai kh'amai ch'uz'iioti korkh'oiaton ittilo' dorad.
19) Pas, ammo kh'ar kase, ki nomai a'molash ba dasti rostash doda shavad, bo khushkh'oli meguiad: "Nomai a'molamro girifta, khoned.
20) Kh'amono man dar dunio medonistam va iak'in doshtam, ki ba'd az marg zinda meshavam va bo ch'azoi a'molam rubaru megardam."
21) Pas, vai dar zindagonii pisandidai abadi ch'oi megirad.
22) Dar bustoni balandmakoni balandmak'om.
23) Mevakh'oi on ba akh'li ch'annat nazdik va dastras ast.

24) Ba onkh'o bo mak'sadi arch'guzori gufta meshavad: "Ba sababi on amalkh'oi shoistae, ki dar dunio tak'dim karded, az ne'matkh'oi on ba tavri guvoro, ki az khurdanu nushidanash ozor namebined, bikhured va binushed."

25) Va ammo kh'ar kase, ki nomai a'molash ba dasti chapash doda shavad, az shiddati pushaimoni meguiad: "Ei kosh, nomai a'molam ba man doda nameshud. Zero a'moli zishtam, ki dar on sabt shuda ast, boisi uk'ubatam megardad.
26) Va ei kosh, bo chi anch'om ioftani kh'isobamro namedonistam.
27) Ei kosh, margi chashidaam koramro tamom mekard va digar zinda namegashtam.
28) Molam az azobi ilokh'i chizero az man dur nakard.
29) On chi dar dunio ba muk'obili kh'ak'ik'at kh'uch'ch'at meovardam va niz k'udratu mansabam, ki bar on takia mekardam, botil va az man nopadid gardid."
30) Ba farishtagon gufta meshavad: "Uro bigired, pas bar dastu gardanash zavlona bizaned.
31) Sipas uro ba duzakh vorid sozed, to az azobi on ranch' barad.
32) Sipas uro dar zanch'ire, ki darozii on kh'aftod ziro' ast, dokhil namoed."
33) Zero Ba durusti ki vai ba Allokh'i Boazamat imon nadosht.
34) Va digaronro ba taom dodani miskin targ'ib namekard.
35) Pas imruz dar k'iiomat dusti mushfik'e nadorad, ki uk'ubatro az vai bartaraf gardonad.
36) Va u baroi khurdan g'air az khunu zardobi ch'asadi duzakhiion, taome nadorad.
37) On taomro tankh'o kofironu mushrikon mekhurand.
38) Savgand ba on chi mebined-
39) va savgand ba on chi namebined, ki-
40) iak'inan K'ur'on Kalomi Khudo buda, onro Paiombari giromi ba mardum mekhonad.
41) Va K'ur'on sukhani shoir nest. Chunki az vazni she'ri kholi ast. Shumo imoni andak meored.
42) Va niz K'ur'on sukhani folbin nest. Zero in kalom az guftori folbinon fark' dorad. Shumo pandi andak megired.
43) Balki K'ur'on Kitobi az sui Parvardigori tamomi mavch'udot nozilshuda ast.
44) Va agar ba farzi misol, Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar kh'ak'k'i Mo az nazdi khud ba'zei sukhanonro meboft,-
45) kh'atman bo k'udrat va k'uvvat peshi rokh'ashro megiriftem va az vai intik'om mesitondem,-
46) sipas ragi muttasil ba k'albashro meburidem.
47) Pas kase az shumo Moro az uk'ubatash boz doshta nametavonist.
48) Va beshak, K'ur'on baroi kasone, ki bo ich'roi dasturot va duri ch'ustan az mamnu'ot parkh'ezkori menamoiand, pandu nasikh'at ast.
49) Va begumon Mo medonem, ki az baini shumo mardum iak idda in K'ur'onro takzib va iak iddai digar onro tasdik' mekunand.
50) Va iak'inan durug' kh'isobidani K'ur'on baroi kofiron dar ruzi k'iiomat kh'asrat va pushaimoni ast.
51) Va kh'ak'k'o, ki K'ur'on iak'ini makh'z ast. Dar nuzulash az sui Khudo kamtarin shak nest.
52) Ei Paiombar! Modome chunin ast, pas bo zikri ismi boazamati Parvardigorat Uro az kh'ama aibu nuk'sonkh'o ba poki bikhon.
1) Darkhostkunandae az mushrikon bo tamaskhur bar khud va k'avmash azobi kh'atman vok'e'shavandai k'iiomatro darkhost namud, ki agar on kh'ak' boshad, pas biguzor vok'e' shavad.
2) On azob baroi kofiron vok'e' gashta, kase nest, ki onro az onkh'o dur sozad.
3) Azobi k'iiomat az ch'onibi Khudoi Doroi martabaiu darach'akh'oi oli va lutfu ekh'sonkh'o ba vuk'u' mepaivandad.
4) Farishtagon va Ch'ibril dar ruzi k'iiomat, ki mik'dori darozii on panch'okh' kh'azor sol ast, ba sui Khudo bolo meravand.
5) Pas, ei Paiombar, biduni shikoiat va betobi sabr kun.
6) Iak'inan kofiron in azobro az imkon dur mepindorand.
7) Va Mo onro noguzir vok'e'shavanda medonem.
8) On ruz, ki osmon misli misu tillo va digar nav'i ma'dankh'oi obshuda megardad-
9) Va kukh'kh'o dar sabuki va porashavi ba misli pashmi rang karda shuda meshavand.
10) Va nazdiktarin dust az kh'oli nazdiktarin dustash namepursad. Zero kh'ar kas dar on ruz mashg'uli khud ast.

11) Nazdiktarin duston va kheshovandon ba iakdigar nishon doda meshavand va kh'amdigarro mebinand, vale az sababi shiddati sakh'nai on ruz kase az kh'oli kase namepursad. Gunakh'kori sazovori otashi ch'akh'annam tamanno menamoiad, ki az azobi on ruz dar ivazi khesh farzandonashro peshkash sozad.
12) Va kh'amsarash va barodarashro peshkash kunad.
13) Va kheshovandonashro, ki uro ch'oi medodand va vak'ti sakhtikh'o dar pakh'luiash meistodand, peshkash namoiad.
14) Va kh'amai insonkh'o, ch'inkh'o va makhluk'oti zaminro peshkash karda, sipas in ivaz uro az on uk'ubati mudkh'ish nach'ot dikh'ad.
15) Kh'argiz kor on guna ki in ch'inoiatkor mepindorad, nest! Iak'inan otashi okhirat shu'lazananda ast.
16) Az shiddati kh'arorat pusti sarro az ch'oiash sakht barmekanad.
17) Kh'ar kiro, ki dar dunio az imonu amali shoista rui tofta va ba on pusht gardonida ast, ba sui khud faro mekhonad.
18) Va u mol ch'am' ovarda, pas onro dar khazinaash nigokh' doshta, az kharch' namudanash dar rokh'i khair bukhl varzida ast.
19) Ba durusti ki inson sakht kamtok'at ofarida shuda ast.
20) Vak'te ba vai badie ba misli bemori io tangdasti rasad, besabri mekunad.
21) Va vak'te ba vai nekie ba misli ne'mati farovon va tavongari rasad, onro az kharch' dar rokh'i khair bisior boz medorad.
22) Ba istisnoi namozguzoroni vok'ei, ki az in du vasf solimand.
23) On kasone, ki namozi khudro bardavom mekhonand va chize onkh'oro az namoz man' namekunad.
24) Va on kasone, ki dar molkh'oiashon kh'issai muaiian ast.
25) On kh'issaro ba shakhsi pursanda va kase, ki namepursad, vale bo kadom sababe az ruzii kofi makh'rum monda ast, medikh'and.
26) Va on kasone, ki ba vuk'ui ruzi ch'azo bovarii k'at'i dorand.
27) Va on kasone, ki novobasta az anch'omi amalkh'oi shoista az azobi Parvardigorashon tarsonand.
28) Beshak, naboiad az azobi Parvardigorashon khudro emin donist. Shakhsi bokhirad kh'amesha az on ki shoiad giriftori azobi ilokh'i shavad, dar kh'aros ast.
29) Va on kasone, ki sharmgokh'ashonro bo pushonidanu dur doshtan az zino va a'moli zisht nigokh' medorand.
30) Magar bar kh'amsaronashon io kanizonashon. Chunki onkh'o bo bakh'ra burdani shakh'voni az kh'amsaron va kanizonashon malomat nameshavand.
31) Pas, on kasone, ki ba g'air az kh'amsar va kanizashon az ch'oi digar talabi bakh'ra burdani shakh'voni kunand, pas in gurukh' dar kh'ak'ik'at az marzkh'oi guzoshtai Khudo tach'ovuzgaronand.
32) Va on kasone, ki amonatkh'oi moli, asror va g'airi on va akh'di bo Khudo va mardum bastai kheshtanro rioia menamoiand. Ba amonatkh'o khiionat namekunand va akh'dashonro nameshikanand.
33) Va kasone, ki shakh'odatkh'oiashonro ba tavri lozim ba ch'o meorand. K'arobati kheshi io adovati kase dar shakh'odatashon ta'sire nameguzorad.
34) Va on kasone, ki bar namozkh'oiashon bo khondani on dar vak'tash va takh'orati komilu rioiai kh'uzuri botini mukh'ofizat mekunand.
35) In gurukh' sokh'ibi sifatkh'oi mazkur dar bustonkh'oi ch'ovidon bo ne'matkh'oi mukhtalif va didori Parvardigor ikrom khokh'and shud.
36) Ei Paiombar! Pas, mushrikoni k'avmatro chi shuda ast, ki dar atrofat ch'am' omada, dar durug'gui shumurdanat meshitoband.
37) Turo gurukh'-gurukh' az samti rost va chap ikh'ota kardaand.
38) Oio kh'ar kadomashon tama' dorad, ki Khudo uro ba ch'annati abadi vorid sozad va kh'ol on ki bar kufrash bok'i ast?!

39) Kh'argiz kor chunonchi kofironu mushrikon mepindorand, nest! Kh'amono Mo onkh'oro az chize ofaridaem, ki onro medonand. Mo onkh'oro az obi kh'ak'iri nutfa ofaridaem. Eshon bandagoni nikh'oiat notavonand. Baroi kheshtan moliki zararu foida nestand. Modom ki chunin ast, pas chitavr kibr mevarzand?!
40) Pas, savgand ba Parvardigori mashrik'kh'o va mag'ribkh'oi oftobu mokh' va digar sitorakh'o, ki Mo beshubkh'a, K'odirem.

41) Iak'inan Mo bar on ki ba ch'oii mushrikon bandagoni itoatkori az onkh'o bekh'tarro kh'ast gardonem va onkh'oro kh'alok sozem, k'udrat dorem. Va Mo vak'te tabdilashonro khokh'em, az anch'omi on mag'lub va och'iz nestem.

42) Pas ei Paiombar, onkh'oro biguzor, ki dar botilu gumrokh'iashon furu ravand va dar zindagonii dunioiashon bozi kunand, to vak'te ki bo ruzi k'iiomat, ki tavassuti K'ur'on ba onkh'o dar on ruz va'dai azob doda meshavad, rubaru gardand.
43) On ruz, ki az k'abrkh'oiashon shitobon ba ch'onibi makh'shar berun meoiand, guio ki onkh'o bo iakdigar ch'onibi nishonae sabk'at mekunand.
44) Dar kh'ole chashmonashon sarozer afkanda buda, khoriiu nadomat onkh'oro faro megirad. In kh'amon ruzest, ki dar dunio vuk'ui on ba onkh'o va'da doda meshud, vale parvoe nadoshtand.

1) Beshak, Mo Nukh'ro ba sui k'avmash firistodem, ki k'avmatro k'abl az omadani azobi dardovar bitarson. Chunki agar onkh'o bim dodanatro ba inobat nagirand va kufru shirkashonro idoma dikh'and, ba uk'ubati nikh'oiat sakht duchor meshavand.

2) Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) ba onkh'o guft: "Ei k'avmi man! Begumon man baroi shumo az duchor shudanaton ba azobi sakht bimdikh'andai oshkoram. Dar surati az shirku kufr tavba nakardanaton, ba azobi mudkh'ish giriftor meshaved.

3) Man bo bim dodanam az shumo tankh'o kh'aminro tak'ozo doram, ki iagona Khudoro biparsted va bo anch'omi farmonkh'oiash va duri ch'ustan az man'kardakh'oiash az azobash parkh'ez namoed va maro itoat kuned.

4) Agar in shartkh'oro ich'ro sozed, Khudo gunokh'oni ba kh'uk'uk'i bandagon taalluk' nadoshtaatonro mag'firat mekunad va shumoro az ne'matkh'oi in dunio to mukh'lati dar ilmash muaiian bakh'ramand mesozad va shumoro bo azobash kh'alok namegardonad. Zaminro obod mekuned va az zindagi bakh'ra mebared. Begumon chun mukh'lati baroi marg muk'arrarsokhtai Khudo oiad, on ba ta'khir guzoshta nameshavad. Agar in kh'ak'ik'atro medonisted, kh'atman shitobon imon meovarded va az shirku gumrokh'i barmegashted."
5) Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) khitob ba Parvardigorash guft: "Ei Parvardigoram! Ba durusti ki man k'avmamro ba surati paivasta shabu ruz ba ibodat va iaktoparasti da'vat kardam.
6) Pas da'vati man ba onkh'o ch'uz nafrat va dur shudan az on kh'ech' chizero afzun nasokht.

7) Va kh'amono man kh'ar vak't onkh'oro ba ibodati Tu va itoati khud da'vat kardam, to gunokh'onashonro mag'firat kuni, gushkh'oi kheshro bo angushtonashon makh'kam namudand, to sukhanamro nashunavand va ruiashonro bo liboskh'oi khud pushonidand, to maro nabinand va az paziruftani kh'ak' ba shiddat kibr varzida, bar kufru shirkashon idoma dodand.
8) Sipas man onkh'oro oshkor da'vat namudam.
9) Sipas Ba durusti ki man bo istifoda az shevakh'oi mukhtalif ba'zan sadoiamro dar da'vat baroiashon baland va ba'zan da'vatro baroiashon pinkh'on va sadoiamro past namudam.
10) Pas ba onkh'o guftam, ki bo rokh'i tavba az Parvardigoraton mag'firati gunokh'onatonro bikhokh'ed. Zero U nisbat ba tavbakoron iak'inan Omurzanda ast.
11) Agar az Parvardigoraton omurzish khokh'ed, kh'ar gokh' ba boron niioz paido kuned, onro bar shumo pai dar pai furud meorad va ba k'akh'ti duchor nameshaved.

12) Va amvol va farzandonatonro afzun mesozad va baroiaton bustonkh'oi serkh'osil medikh'ad, to az mevakh'oiash istifoda namoed va baroiaton rudkh'o medikh'ad, to az obash nushed va ziroatu chorvokh'oi kheshro serob gardoned.
13) Ei k'avmi man! Shumoro chi shuda ast, ki az azamati Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) nametarsed va bebokona Uro nofarmoni mekuned?!
14) Kh'ol on ki U shumoro markh'ila ba markh'ila, nakhust az nutfa, sipas az khuni basta va ba'dan az gushtpora khalk' karda ast."
15) Oio namebined va namedoned, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) kh'aft osmonro rui kh'am chi guna kh'ast namuda ast?!
16) Va az baini osmonkh'o dar osmoni dunio mokh'ro dar zulmati shab baroi akh'li zamin nurafkan sokhta va oftobro misli charog'i durakhshon gardonida ast.
17) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shumoro bo ofaridani padaraton Odam az khok az zamin ofarida ast. Sipas shumo az nabototi on g'izo mekhured.
18) Sipas shumoro ba'di marg ba zamin barmegardonad va iak'inan shumoro ruzi k'iiomat baroi pursuch'u va giriftani ch'azo az zamin berun meorad.
19) Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) zaminro baroi shumo pakh'novari k'obili sukunat gardonida ast.
20) To dar on baroi talabi ruzii kh'alol dar rokh'kh'oi pakh'novar rokh' biraved.

21) Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) guft: "Ei Parvardigoram! Kh'amono onkh'o amri maro vobasta ba ibodat va iaktoparasti itoat nakardand va az farmoni rakh'baroni nokasashon, ki Tu ba onkh'o molu farzandi ziiod in'om kardi, pas mol va farzandashon ba onkh'o ch'uz zalolat chizero afzun nasokht, itoat namudand."
22) Va on rakh'baroni nokasashon bo ig'voandozii pairavonashon ba muk'obili Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) makri bag'oiat buzurge kardand.
23) Va ba pairavonashon guftand: "Ibodati butkh'oiatonro tark nakuned va makhsusan ibodati butkh'oero ba nomi "Vadd" va "Suvo'" va "Iag'us" va "Ia'uk'" va "Nasr" tark nakuned."
24) Va onkh'o ba vasilai in butkh'oiashon mardumi bisiorero gumrokh' sokhtand. Va Parvardigoro, ba nafaroni bo kufru shirk bar ch'oni khesh sitam ravodidagon ch'uz zalolat chizero afzun magardon.

25) Onkh'o ba sababi khatokh'oi sodir kardaashon dar dunio bo tufon g'ark' karda shuda, pas az marg bevosita ba otash darovarda shudand, pas ba g'airi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) iovarone naioftand, ki onkh'oro az uk'ubat rakh'o kunand.

26) Va chun Nukh' (alaikh'is salom) az ch'onibi Khudo khabardor gasht, ki az k'avmash ba ch'uz pairavonash digar kase imon nameorad, guft: "Ei Parvardigori man! Dar zamin az kofiron kh'ech' sokinero bok'i maguzor.
27) Ba durusti ki agar Tu onkh'oro bok'i guzori va mukh'lat dikh'i, bandagoni boimonatro gumrokh' mesozand va az khud tankh'o farzandi badkori nofarmonu nikh'oiat nosipos ba dunio meorand.

28) Ei Parvardigoram! Gunokh'oni maro va padaru modaramro va kh'ar mu'minero, ki ba khonai man medaroiad va mardoni boimon va zanoni boimonro biomurz va baroi on nafarone, ki bo kufru ma'siiat bar ch'onashon sitam ravo didaand, ch'uz kh'alokat va khasorat chizero afzun masoz."

1) Ei Paiombar! Ba ummatat bigu: "Khudo ba man vakh'i firistoda ast, ki iak gurukh'e az ch'inkh'o dar mintak'ai "Batni nakhla" ba K'ur'on khondanam gush andokhtand. Va chun nazdi k'avmashon bargashtand, ba onkh'o guftand: "Ba durusti, mo kalomi k'iroatshavandai dar bobi baion va fasokh'at bag'oiat shigiftangezero shunidem.
2) In Kalom bandagonro ba pindoru guftoru kirdori durust rakh'namoi menamoiad. Pas ba on imon ovardem va ba Parvardigori khud kh'argiz kasero sharik namegardonem.
3) Va imon ovardem, ki azamat va ch'aloli Parvardigoramon baland buda, kh'argiz U on guna ki mushrikon da'vo dorand, kh'amsar va farzand nagirifta ast.
4) Va Iblis dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo bo nisbat dodani kh'amsar va farzand sukhani kach' megufta ast.

5) Va vak'te ki insonkh'o va ch'inkh'oi mushrik ba Khudo kh'amsar va farzand nisbat medodand, mo mepindoshtem, ki onkh'o dar kh'ak'k'i Khudo durug' nameguiand. Bo tak'lid ba sukhanashon bovar mekardem.

6) Va dar zamoni ch'okh'iliiat mardone az nav'i odami budand, ki vak'te kh'angomi safar dar ch'oii khavfnok furud meomadand, ba mardone az nav'i ch'inkh'o panokh' burda meguftand: "Ba rakh'bari in vodi az sharri kamkhiradoni k'avmash panokh' mekhokh'am." Pas, ch'inkh'o bar'aks khavfu kh'arosi on insonkh'oro afzun mesokhtand.
7) Va insonkh'o on guna ki shumo ch'inkh'o mepindoshted, gumon doshtand, ki Khudo kh'ech' gokh' kasero ba'd az margash baroi pursuch'u va giriftani ch'azo zinda namesozad.

8) Va mo khabari osmonro ch'uio shudem, pas onro bo posbonkh'oi nerumand az farishtagoni mukh'ofizatgar va bo shu'lakh'oi otash pur ioftem. Farishtakh'o osmonro az duzdidani akhbor, ki k'ablan in korro anch'om medodem, nigokh' medorand va kh'ar ki ba on nazdik shavad, otashporakh'o uro mesuzonand.

9) Va mo k'ablan dar makonkh'oe az osmon nishasta, ba akhbori baini farishtagon gush meandokhtem va onro ba folbinon khabar medodem. Ammo vaz' minba'd digar ast. Pas, kh'ar ki az mo khokh'ad ba akhbori osmon gush faro dikh'ad, baroi khud otashporai omodaero meiobad, ki agar nazdik shavad, uro mesuzonad.
10) Va mo namedonem, ki sababi in posbonii shadid dar chist? Oio ba sokinoni zamin badi khosta shuda ast io Parvardigorashon ba onkh'o khair khosta ast?! Mo ba akhbori osmon dastrasi nadorem.
11) Va mo ch'inkh'o ba'zeamon parkh'ezkoru nekukor va ba'zeamon kofiru fosik'and. Mo gurukh'kh'oi mukhtalifi iborat az kofiru musalmon dorem.

12) Va mo iak'in namudem, ki agar Khudo dar kh'ak'k'amon irodai kore kunad, kh'argiz az U dar kh'ech' makone rakh'oi nameiobem va kh'argiz bo rokh'i firor az U rakh'o nameshavem. Chunki ilmi U kh'amaro ikh'ota karda ast.

13) Va mo vak'te K'ur'oni rakh'namo ba sui nekiro shunidem, ba on imon ovardem. Pas kh'ar ki ba Parvardigorash imon biiorad, az kamshavii nekikh'oiash va ilova gardidani gunokh'e bar gunokh'onash namekh'arosad.

14) Va az mo ba'zeamon bo toatu ibodat musalmon va mutei Khudo va ba'zeamon zolimi az rokh'i durust kach'rafta kh'astand. Pas kh'ar ki bo toatu amali nek mutei Khudo gardad, pas inkh'o kasoneand, ki kh'idoiat va rokh'i rostro k'asd karda, ok'ibat ba ch'annat merasand.
15) Va ammo zolimoni az rokh'i Khudo kach'rafta, pas onkh'o kh'ezumi duzakhand. Duzakh ba vasilai onkh'o va amsolashon afrukhta meshavad."

16) Va chunonchi ba Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) paig'om shud, ki iak gurukh' az ch'inkh'o ba tilovati K'ur'onash gush faro dodaand, kh'amin guna baroiash paig'om rasid, ki agar ch'inkh'o va insonkh'o dar rokh'i Islom ustuvor monand va ba talabotash amal namoiand, Mo baroiashon obi farovon menushonem va ba onkh'o ne'matkh'oi gunogun medikh'em.

17) To onkh'oro dar in ne'matkh'o ozmoish namoem, ki oio shukri onro ba ch'o meorand io noshukri mekunand. Va kh'ar ki az K'ur'oni nozilsokhtai Parvardigorash rui gardonad, uro ba azobi nikh'oiat sakhti tok'atfarso dokhil mesozad.

18) Va niz ba Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) paig'om shuda ast, ki masch'idkh'o khosi Khudo meboshand. Pas dar onch'o kasero bo Khudo ibodat makuned, to monandi iakh'udikh'o va nasronikh'o naboshed, ki dar ibodatgokh'ashon ba Khudoi iagona shirk meorand.

19) Va niz paig'om omada ast, ki chun bandai Khudo Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dar "Batni nakhla" istoda, Parvardigorashro meparastid, ch'inkh'o kh'angomi shunidani tilovati K'ur'onash az izdikh'omi bisior k'arib bud ruii kh'am meistodand.
20) Ei Paiombar! Ba in mushrikon bigu: "Ba durusti, man iagona Parvardigoramro meparastam va dar ibodat chizero ba U sharik namesozam."

21) Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Agar Khudo baroi shumo zararero muk'addar sokhta boshad, man tavoni peshgirii onro nadoram va agar U khairero az shumo boz doshtan khokh'ad, man k'udrat nadoram, ki onro baroiaton ch'alb sozam."
22) Ei Paiombar! Ba onkh'o bigu: "Agar man az Khudo itoat nakunam, kh'ech' gokh' kase maro az uk'ubatash panokh' doda nametavonad va kh'ech' gokh' ba ch'uz U panokh'gokh'e nameiobam.

23) Lekin man moliki onam, ki dasturoti Khudo va risolatkh'oi Uro ba shumo rasonam. Va kh'ar ki az Khudo va Rasulash nofarmoni mekunad, pas baroiash otashi ch'akh'annam ast, ch'akh'annamiion dar onch'o ba tavri abadi ch'ovidon memonand."

24) Va kofiron bar kufrashon to vak'ti dar ruzi k'iiomat didani azobi baroiashon va'dashuda isror mevarzand. Pas khokh'and donist, ki chi kase az nigokh'i iovar notavontar va chi kase az nigokh'i te'dodi iovar kamtar ast.

25) Ei Paiombar! Ba in mushrikoni munkiri rastokhez bigu: "Man namedonam, ki oio uk'ubati ba shumo va'da dodashuda nazdik ast io Parvardigoram baroi on mukh'latero muaiian karda ast, ki kase az on ch'uz U khabar nadorad."
26) U Donandai g'aib ast. Kh'ech' chiz az U pushida nest. Pas kasero az g'aibash ogokh' namesozad, balki on makhsusi Zotash bok'i memonad,-

27) magar on paiombar, ki uro baroi ogokh' sokhtanash az g'aib ikhtiior namoiad. Pas uro az on chi khokh'ad, ogokh' megardonad va az samti peshi on paiombar va az samti pushtash farishtagoni nigakh'bone mefiristad, to ch'uz u kh'ech' kas az on g'aib ogokh' nashavad.

28) Khudo az samti peshu pushti on paiombari mukhtor farishtagoni nigakh'bon mefiristad, to vai bidonad, ki paiombaroni k'ablan guzashta risolatkh'oi Parvardigorashonro ba mardum rasonidaand va Khudo bo ilmi Khesh kh'ar chi nazdi farishtagon va paiombaron mavch'ud ast, kh'amaro ikh'ota karda ast, kh'ech' chize az U makhfi nest va adadi kh'ama chizro ba tavri dak'ik' kh'isobida ast.
1) Ei Ch'oma bar tan pechida! Khitob ba Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) mutaallik' ast.
2) Shab ba istisnoi kh'issai andaki on namoz guzor.
3) Nisfe az shab namoz guzor io az nisfi on andak kam bikun va to seiaki avvali on namoz guzor.
4) Io bar nisfi shab afzun gardon va to du kh'issai seiaki shab namoz guzor va chun K'ur'on tilovat kardi, kh'urufashro oshkor soz va oromona bikhon.
5) Ei Paiombar! Namozi shab bikhon, zero Mo iak'inan K'ur'onro, ki az nigokh'i shomil budani farzkh'o, kh'ududi shar'i, akh'kom, odob va g'aira sukhani garon ast, baroiat paig'om khokh'em firistod.

6) Kh'amono namoz dar soatkh'oi shab ba e'tibori muvofik'ati k'albi namozguzor bo zabonash va pok gardonidani nafsash bota'sirtar va ba e'tibori talaffuz va k'iroati K'ur'on durusttar va ustuvortar ast.
7) Begumon tu ruzona dar korkh'oiat sargarmii bisior dori. Ba kh'amin sabab, az tilovati K'ur'on boz memoni. Pas dar shab namoz guzor.
8) Va Parvardigoratro bo zikrkh'oi mukhtalif iod kun va bo ibodati kholisona az kh'ama gusasta gashta, tankh'o ba sui U rui biior.
9) U Parvardigori mashrik' va Parvardigori mag'rib ast. Ba ch'uz U kh'ech' ma'budi barkh'ak' nest. Pas, Uro dar kh'amai korkh'oiat Korsoz bigir.
10) Va bar on chi takzibgaron az tamaskhur va dashnom meguiand, sabr namo va onkh'oro biduni rasonidani ozor tark namo.

11) Va Maro bo takzibgaroni sokh'ibi lazzatkh'oi fanopaziri dunio rakh'o bisoz, muk'obilashon raddu badal makun, az korkh'oiashon khashmgin mashav va onkh'oro to faro rasidani mukh'lati azobashon andake mukh'lat bidekh'.
12) Begumon nazdi Mo dar okhirat zavlonakh'oi sangin va otashi shu'lavari duzakh ast.
13) Va nazdi Mo dar onch'o taomest, ki az shiddati talkhi guluro megirad va ilova bar in azobi dardovar ast.
14) In uk'ubat dar kh'ak'k'i kofiron ruze kh'osil megardad, ki zamin va kukh'kh'o ba larza meoiand va kukh'kh'o az sakhtii kh'avodisi okhirat ba teppai regkh'oi ravoni parokanda tabdil meioband.
15) Biduni shakku tardid, Mo ba sui shumo Paiombari dar k'iiomat bar a'molaton guvokh'ro firistodem, chunonchi ba sui Fir'avn Paiombar Musoro firistoda budem.

16) Pas, Fir'avn Musoro nofarmoni kard. Pas, Mo uro dar dunio bo g'ark' gashtan dar bakh'r ch'azoi sakht dodem va dar okhirat niz bo otashi duzakh uk'ubati sakht khokh'em dod. Binobar in, shumo az sarguzashti onkh'o pand bigired va Paiombaratonro nofarmoni nakuned.

17) Pas, agar shumo ba Khudo kofir shaved va Paiombarashro durug'gu shumored, chitavr az azobi sakhti ruzi tuloni, ki ba sababi shiddat va daroziash mui sari kudakonro safed mesozad, parkh'ez menamoed?!
18) Osmon dar on ruz az shiddati dakh'shatkh'oiash shikofta meshavad. Va'dai Khudo noguzir ich'roshavanda ast.

19) Kh'amono in baioni dakh'shatkh'oi k'iiomat pand ast. Mu'minon az shunidanash sud mebarand. Pas, kh'ar ki az dakh'shati k'iiomat nach'ot ioftan khokh'ad, rokh'i ba Parvardigorash vaslkunandaro pesh girad.

20) Ei Paiombar! Beshak, Parvardigorat medonad, ki tu va iak gurukh' mu'minoni kh'amrokh'at gokh'o kamtar az du seiaki shab va gokh'o nisfi on va ba'zan seiaki onro bo namoz sipari mesozed. Va Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) shab va ruzro andozagiri mekunad va soatkh'oi on duro dak'ik' medonad. U medonist, ki shumo kh'argiz k'udrati kh'isobi soatkh'oi shabro nadored va guzaronidani aksari on bo namoz baroiaton dushvor meboshad. Ba kh'amin sabab, tavbai shumoro paziruft. Pas, az shab kh'ar andoza, ki ba shumo muiassar shavad, namoz guzored. Ei mu'minon! Khudo medonist, ki az shumo ba'zeaton bemor gashta, notavon meshavand va iak gurukh'i digar bo mak'sadi talabi ruzi safar mekunand va iak gurukh'i digar bo mak'sadi kasbi rizoi Khudo va barafroshtani kalimai Kh'ak' bo kofiron mech'angand. Namozi shab ba in toifakh'oi mazkur dushvor ast. Pas, az shab kh'ar andoza, ki baroiaton muiassar shavad, namoz guzored va namozkh'oi panch'vak'taro barpo dored va zakoti molatonro dikh'ed va az iak kh'issai doroiaton dar rokh'i Khudo kholisona khair kuned va onro kh'amchun muomilai k'arz bo Khudo kh'isobed. Va shumo kh'ar chi az neki ba naf'i khesh tak'dim menamoed, onro nazdi Khudo az kardaaton bekh'tar va az likh'ozi savob buzurgtar meiobed. Va az Khudo omurzishi gunokh'onatonro bikhokh'ed. Ba durusti ki Khudo nisbat ba bandagoni tavbakorash bag'oiat Bakhshandai Mekh'rubon ast.
1) Ei Bandai az kh'arosi mulok'oti Ch'ibril ch'oma bar tan pechida!
2) Barkhez va darkh'ol mardumro az azobi Khudo bim bidekh'.
3) Va iagona Parvardigoratro bo azamat iod bikun.
4) Va khudro az gunokh' va libosatro az palidi pok gardon.
5) Va az palidii butparasti va g'airi on dur bosh.
6) Va bo bisior shumurdani amali solekh'at bar Khudo minnat makun.
7) Va ba khotiri Khudo dar barobari ozori kofiron sabr namo.
8) Pas, vak'te dar sur nafkhai duium damida shavad.
9) Pas, ruzi damidani nafkha ruzi nikh'oiat sakht ast.
10) On ruz bar kofiron oson nest.
11) Ei Paiombar! Maro kh'amrokh'i on kas, ki uro dar batni modarash tankh'oi be molu farzand ofaridaam, voguzor. Manzur az shakhsi mazkur Valid ibni Mug'ira ast.
12) Va baroiash moli farovon dodaam.

13) Va baroiash farzandone dodaam, ki dar kh'ar makh'file kh'amrokh'ash kh'ozir meshudand. Chun Valid pisari Mug'ira tavongar bud, farzandonash az safari tich'orati beniioz budand va az padarashon ch'udo nameshudand.
14) Va ba vai dar aishu rizk'u farzand vus'ati ziiod bakhshidaam.
15) Sipas u sarfi nazar az on ki munkiri Khudo ast, tama' dorad, ki ne'matkh'oi Khudro baroiash afzun sozam.
16) Kh'argiz kor on guna ki mepindorad, nest! Zero kh'amono u nisbat ba oiatkh'oi bar Paiombar nozilsokhtai Mo sitezach'ui takzibgar ast.
17) Beshak, Man uro ba azobi on chunon sakht khokh'am andokht, ki tok'at k'arda nametavonad.
18) Ba durusti ki in kofiri az ne'matkh'oi Khudo bakh'ramand oidi on ki dar borai K'ur'on chi biguiad, andeshid va sukhani zishtero dar zekh'nash andoza va omoda namud.
19) Pas, giriftori la'nat va azob bod, ki chi guna andoza girift.
20) Sipas, giriftori la'natu azob bod, ki chi guna andoza girift.
21) Sipas tach'didi nazar namud va andeshid.
22) Sipas vak'te ki oidi ta'n rasondan ba K'ur'on sukhani asosnok naioft, ruiashro tursh kard va ch'abin girift.
23) Sipas ba imon ovardan pusht gardonid va az pairavii Rasuli Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kibr varzid.
24) Pas vai guft: "In sukhani ovardai Mukh'ammad Kalomi Khudo nest, balki on ch'oduest, ki onro az digaron rivoiat mekunad.
25) In sukhani Khudo nest, balki begumon sukhani odami ast."
26) Kh'atman Man in kofirro ba tabak'ai Sak'ari duzakh medaroram. Onch'o az kh'arorati otash abadi ranch' mebarad.
27) Va ei Mukh'ammad, chi turo ogokh' kard, ki "Sak'ar" chist?!

28) Sak'ar kh'ech' chizero az azobshavandagon bok'i nameguzorad va rakh'o namesozad, magar in ki onro shikanch'a mekunad. Sipas onkh'o ba kh'olati k'abli barmegardand va boz duchori azobi "Sak'ar" meshavand. Azob dar "Sak'ar" ba kh'amin surat idoma meiobad.
29) On pusti badanro ba shiddat mesuzonad va siiokh' megardonad.
30) Nigakh'bononi "Sak'ar" nuzdakh' farishtaand.

31) Va k'aror nadodem mukh'ofizatgari duzakh ba ch'uz farishtagonro. Insonkh'o tok'ati onro nadorand, ki bo onkh'o muk'obiliiat kunand. Va Mo shumorai farishtagonro nagardonidem, ch'uz baroi ozmoishi kofiron, to iakh'udikh'o va nasronikh'o, ki ba onkh'o Tavrotu Inch'il doda shuda ast, ba sadok'ati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) iak'in kh'osil namoiand, zero in adadi mazkur dar borai nigakh'bononi duzakh dar Kitobi onkh'o niz omada ast va imoni mu'minon bo muvofik'ati akh'li Kitob bo eshon afzun shavad va iakh'udu nasoro va mu'minon shubkh'a nakunand va to on kasone, ki dar dilashon bemorii shak va za'fi imon ast va inchunin kofiron guiand: "Khudo bo in masali ta'iini nuzdakh' farishtai nigakh'boni duzakh chi khosta boshad?!" Chunonchi Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) bo zikri in adad munkironashro gumrokh' va tasdik'kunandagonashro kh'idoiat kard, kh'amin guna kh'ar shakhsero khokh'ad, gumrokh' va kh'ar shakhsero khokh'ad, kh'idoiat mekunad. Va te'dodi lashkarieni Parvardigoratro ch'uz U kase namedonad. Zero te'dodashon bag'oiat ziiod ast. Va "Sak'ar" ch'uz pand baroi insonkh'o chize nest, to az azamati Khudo ogokh' gardand va bo iodovarii on ba sui imon va amali solekh' shitoband.
32) Kh'argiz vok'eiiat chunonchi ba'ze mushrikon mepindorand, ki guio tavoni muk'obiliiat bo nigakh'bononi duzakhro dorand, nest! Savgand ba mokh'.
33) Va savgand ba shab chun bo omadani ruz bargardad.
34) Va savgand ba subkh' chun ravshan gardad, ki-
35) iak'inan "Sak'ar" iake az balokh'oi azimtarin ast.
36) Dar kh'ole ki on baroi bim dodani mardum ast,-
37) baroi on kase az shumo mardum, ki mekhokh'ad bo imon va amali shoista sui ch'annat pesh ravad io bo kufr va gunokh' az ch'annat ak'ib aftad va ba ch'akh'annam ravad.
38) Kh'ar nafar dar garavi amalkh'oi khesh ast. Amalkh'oiash uro io kh'alok mesozand va io az kh'alokat nach'otash medikh'and,-
39) magar on kasone, ki nomai a'molashon ba dasti rostashon doda meshavad. In ch'amoa ba sababi gunokh'onashon uk'ubat nameshavand, balki mavridi omurzishi Khudo k'aror megirand.
40) Onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat dar ch'annatkh'o mepursand,-
41) az kofironi bo ma'siiati ziiod kh'alokshuda.
42) Akh'li ch'annat az akh'voli akh'li duzakh pursida meguiand: "Shumoro chi ba duzakh darovard?"
43) Kofiron dar posukh meguiand: "Mo dar dunio az ch'umlai kasone, ki namozkh'oi farzro barpo menamudand, nabudem.
44) Va az doroii khud ba fak'iron taom namedodem.
45) Va kh'amrokh'i botilkoronu gumrokh'on dar butlonu gumrokh'i furu meraftem. Kh'ar on chi onkh'o meguftand va mekardand, mo niz onro meguftem va mekardem.
46) Va ruzi ch'azoro durug' medonistem.
47) Mo dar in rokh'i botilu gumrokh'i to ba surog'amon omadani marg bok'i mondem. Marg moro az tavba boz dosht."

48) Pas, ruzi k'iiomat miionaravii shafoatgaron az farishtagon va paiombaronu solekh'on ba onkh'o sud namebakhshad. Zero sharti k'abulshavii shafoat on ast, ki Allokh' (ch'alla ch'alolukh'u) az shafoatshavanda khushnud boshad.
49) Pas, chi bois shuda, ki in mushrikon az K'ur'on rui toftaand?!
50) Onkh'o dar rui toftan va nafrat az K'ur'on ba kharoni vakh'shii sakhtramidae monand kh'astand, ki-
51) az tarsi sher gurekhtaand.

52) Balki kh'ar iake az in mushrikon mekhokh'ad baroiash sakh'ifakh'oi boz doda shavad va on sakh'ifakh'o khabar dikh'and, ki Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) firistodai Khudo ast. Sababi in khokh'ishashon dar adami mavch'udiiati kh'uch'ch'at io za'fi on nest, balki onkh'o khud mardumi mutakabbir va sarkashand.
53) Ne, kh'argiz ba onkh'o sakh'ifakh'oi kushoda doda nameshavad! Balki sababi dar zalolat isror namudanashon on ast, ki onkh'o az ruzi okhirat nametarsand va ba on imon nadorand.
54) Ne, kh'argiz ba onkh'o sakh'ifakh'oi kushoda doda nameshavad! Kh'amono K'ur'on pandu andarz ast.
55) Pas kh'ar ki K'ur'onro khonda, az on ibrat giriftan khokh'ad, onro bikhonad va ibrat bigirad.

56) Va onkh'o pand namegirand, magar in ki Khudo onro khokh'ad. Khudo sazovori on ast, ki bo ich'roi amrkh'o va duri ch'ustan az nakh'ikh'o az azobash parkh'ez karda shavad va loik'i on ast, ki agar bandagon tavba namoiand, gunokh'onashonro omurzad.
1) Savgand ba ruzi k'iiomate, ki mardum nazdi Khudo rost meshavand.

2) Va savgand ba nafsi poki sokh'ibi khudro kh'angomi kutokh'i dar toat va anch'omi gunokh' sarzanishgar, ki shumo bandagon iak'inan ba'd az marg dubora baroi pursuch'u va giriftani ch'azo zinda gardonida meshaved.
3) Oio inson gumon mebarad, ki Mo kh'argiz ustukhonkh'oiashro ba'd az margash ch'am' nameorem va uro zinda namegardonem?!
4) Ore, Mo K'odir kh'astem, ki sarangushtoni uro ba monandi kh'olati avval durustu barobar sozem.
5) Balki insoni kofir bo inkori rastokhez mekhokh'ad, ki badkoriro dar oiandaash bemonea idoma dikh'ad va chize saddi rokh'ash nashavad.
6) Vai bo mak'sadi nomumkin donistani vuk'ui k'iiomat mepursad: "Ruzi k'iiomat kai ba vuk'u' mepaivandad?!"
7) Pas, chun chashm bo mushokh'idai sakh'nakh'oi mudkh'ishi k'iiomat, ki ba on bovar nadosht, dar kh'airat monad va dakh'shatzada gardad-
8) va rushnoii mokh' az bain ravad-
9) va oftobu mokh' iakch'o ch'am' karda shuda, nizomi koinot khalaldor gardad,-
10) insoni badkor on ruz guiad: "Imruz kuch'o metavon gurekht?!"
11) Imruz kh'argiz ch'oi firor va panokh'gokh'e nest, ki shakhsi badkor ba on panokh' barad.
12) Ei Paiombar! On ruz ch'oi bozgasht baroi pursuch'u va giriftani ch'azo iagona ba sui Parvardigori tu ast.
13) On ruz inson az amalkh'oi pesh firistoda va amalkh'oi ba ta'khir guzoshtai anch'om nadodaash ogokh' sokhta meshavad.
14) Balki inson alaikh'i khud shokh'id ast. Chunki a'zoi badanash bar muk'obilash guvokh'i medikh'ad.
15) Va agarchi uzrkh'oi ziiod pesh ovarda, az khesh difo' kardan khokh'ad, ki guio kh'ech' amali bad nakarda ast, baroiash foida nadorad.
16) Ei Paiombar! Zabonatro bo k'iroati K'ur'on ba khotiri on ki az iodat naravad, shitobkori namuda, kh'arakat madekh'.
17) Beshak, ch'am'ovarii K'ur'on dar k'albat va nigakh'dorii k'iroati on dar zabonat bar ukh'dai Most.
18) Pas, chun Firistodai Mo, Ch'abrail K'ur'onro bar tu khond, pas, khomush istoda, ba k'iroatash gush andoz va ba'd az anch'om dodanash onro takror kun.
19) Sipas baroi tu sharkh'u tavzekh' dodani on bar ukh'dai Most.

20) Kh'argiz kor chunonchi shumo da'vo dored, ki ruzi k'iiomat ba vuk'u' namepaivandad, nest. Shumo medoned, ki Khudoi bori avval ofarandai mavch'udot az zinda gardonidanaton ba'd az margaton och'izi namekashad. Lekin sababi ruzi k'iiomatro durug' shumurdanaton on ast, ki shumo kh'aioti zudguzari dunioro dust medored.
21) Va kh'aioti abadii okhiratro, ki rokh'i noil shudan ba on anch'omi toatu ibodat va parkh'ez az ma'siiat ast, rakh'o mesozed.
22) On ruz chekh'rakh'oi akh'li imon va saodat durakhshon buda,-
23) ba sui Parvardigorash nazar mekunand va az ch'amoli bemisli U bakh'ra mebarand.
24) Va on ruz chekh'rakh'oi akh'li kufr va shak'ovat tira ast.
25) Iak'in dorand, ki bar onkh'o uk'ubati buzurgi kamarshikan furud meoiad.
26) Kh'argiz kor chunonchi mushrikon da'vo dorand, ki guio ba'd az marg duchori uk'ubat nameshavand, nest. Pas, chun ch'oni kh'ar iakei onkh'o ba gulu birasad.
27) Va mardumi atrofash meguiand: "Ki bar vai ruk'ia mekhonad?! Shoiad shifo meiobad?!"
28) Va insoni dar kh'olati naz'i ch'on k'arordoshta ba iak'in medonad, ki in kh'olati ch'udoi az zindagonii dunio ast.
29) Va sakhtikh'o kh'angomi intikh'oi dunio va og'ozi masiri okhirat ch'am' meshavand.
30) Chun dar vak'ti marg ba kh'olati mazkur duchor gardi, tankh'o ba sui Parvardigorat ronda meshavi va baroi a'molat ch'azoi loik' megiri.
31) Pas, bandai kofir na ba paiombarash bovar kard va na namozi farzashro ado namud.
32) Vale risolati paiombarashro durug' shumurd va az on ru toft.
33) Sipas vai dar kh'ole ba nazdi khonadonash raft, ki kh'angomi rokh' raftan az kibru g'urur mekhiromid.
34) Khudo uro bo takh'did meguiad: "Azobi namekhostaat ba tu nazdik shuda ast. Pas on azob ba tu loik'tar ast!"
35) Boz ta'kidan meguiad: "Azobi namekhostaat ba tu nazdik shuda ast. Pas, on azob ba tu loik'tar ast."
36) Oio inson mepindorad, ki Khudo uro bekh'uda va biduni mukallaf sokhtan ba toatu ibodat rakh'o mesozad?!
37) Oio vai k'ablan obi andake az mani nabud, ki dar bachadon rekhta meshud?!
38) Sipas khuni basta gardid, pas Khudo uro khalk' namud, ba'd az on ofarinishashro durustandom sokht?!
39) Pas az nav'i in inson ch'insi nar va modaro ofarid?!
40) Oio in Kholik'i inson az nutfa va khuni basta bar zinda sokhtani murdagon K'odir nest, to onkh'oro bozpursi karda, podosh dikh'ad?! Bale, iak'inan U in k'udratro dorad.
1) Dar kh'ak'ik'at bar inson zamoni durudaroze guzashta ast, ki dar on zamon az u kh'ech' nishone nabud.

2) Ba durusti ki Mo insonro dar kh'ole ki uro bo taklifoti shar'i ozmudan mekhostem, az obi nutfai omekhtai mard va zan ofaridem. Ba kh'amin sabab, uro shunavoi bino gardonidem, to mas'uliiatashro ich'ro kunad.

3) Begumon Mo ba vositai paiombaronamon insonro ba rokh'i durust rakh'namoi namudem. Rokh'i rost va kach' baroiash oshkor shud. Vai minba'd io ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat iofta, bandai mu'mini siposguzor meshavad va io az rokh'i rost gumrokh' gashta, bandai kofiri nosiposi ne'matkh'oi Khudo megardad.

Chun Khudo dar oiati guzashta bandai kh'idoiatiofta va gumrokh'ro ovard, dar oiati zerin podoshi on duro zikr karda guft:
4) Kh'amono Mo baroi kofiron zanch'irkh'o va zavlonakh'o va otashi shu'lavar omoda sokhtaem. Bo zanch'irkh'o ba ch'onibi duzakh kashida shuda, bo zavlonakh'o dar dokhili on basta meshavand.
5) Shubkh'ae nest, ki mu'minoni farmonbardori Khudo ruzi k'iiomat az k'adakh'i pur az sharobi omekhta bo kofuri khushbui menushand.

6) Chashmai bo buii kofur khushbue, ki az on bandagoni mutei Khudo menushand. Onkh'o chashmaro ba kh'ar makon az manzilashon khokh'and, kh'amrokh' bo khud ch'ori mesozand. Obi on beokhiri kh'amesha dastras ast.
7) Onkh'o kasoneand, ki ba nazri khesh dar toati Khudo vafo mekunand va az ruzi k'iiomat, ki badii on muntashiri farogir ast, metarsand.
8) Va bo vuch'udi on ki az sababi niiozmandi va rag'bat doshtanashon taomro dust medorand, onro ba fak'ironu iatimonu asiron medikh'and.
9) Onkh'o ba khud meguiand: "Iak'inan mo shumoro tankh'o ba khotiri rizoi Khudo taom medikh'em. Az shumo dar ivazi in amal kh'ech' podosh va shukrguzoriro namekhokh'em.
10) Kh'amono mo az Parvardigoramon dar ruzi nikh'oiat sakhte, ki chekh'rakh'oi tirabakhton az shiddat va kh'avlnokii on ruz tursh gardad, metarsem."
11) Pas, Khudo onkh'oro bo luftash az sharri on ruz nigokh' medorad va ba khotiri ikromashon dar chekh'rakh'oiashon ch'amolu nur va dar k'albashon surur medikh'ad.

12) Va Khudo ba onkh'o ba sababi on ki dar ibodat, musibat va tarki gunokh' sabr kardand, ch'annat va abreshimro podosh medikh'ad. Az ne'mati ch'annat lazzat mebarand va liboskh'oi abreshimi mepushand.
13) Dar ch'annat bar takhtkh'oi orosta takia mezanand. Onch'o garmii oftob va sardii sakhtro namebinand, ki az on du ozurda shavand. Balki paivasta zeri soiai kh'avoi mu'tadil k'aror megirand.
14) Soiakh'oi darakhtoni ch'annat ba onkh'o nazdik va mevakh'oiash dastras gardonida shuda ast, to kh'ar shakhsi istoda, nishasta va takiazada az on ba osoni bikhurad.

15) Va dar atrofi onkh'o khodimon bo zarfkh'oi nuk'ragin va k'adakh'kh'oi nuk'ragini obgina davr mezanand. Vak'te akh'li ch'annt ba nushidan mail kunand, khidmatchiion bo in zarfkh'o nushobai dilkhokh'ro ba onkh'o peshkash mesozand.
