16) On k'adakh'kh'oi obgina az nuk'rae kh'astand, ki misli shisha daruni on az berun namoion ast. Khidmatguzoron k'adakh'kh'oro ba mik'dori serob gashtani akh'li ch'annat andoza megirand va onro ziiod io kam namekunand.
17) Va ba in bandagoni izzatmand az k'adakh'i pur az sharobi omekhta bo zanch'abil nushonida meshavad.
18) Onkh'o dar ch'annat az chashmae menushand, ki "Salsabil" nomida shuda ast.

19) Va dar peromuni akh'li ch'annat navch'avonone davr mezanand, ki doim ch'avon bok'i monda, solkhurda nameshavand. Vak'te on navch'avononro bubini, onkh'oro dar durakhshoni, kh'usni chekh'ra, adadi ziiod va ch'udoiashon monandi marvoridi pareshongashta mepindori.
20) Va chun ba ch'annat nazar kuni, onch'o ne'matkh'oi az doirai tavsif khorich' va podshokh'ii azimro mebini. Kh'ech' podshokh'i bo on barobar nest.

21) Bar tani akh'li ch'annat liboskh'oi mukh'tashami abreshimi nozuki sabzrang va abreshimi g'afs boshad. Va ba onkh'o dastmonakh'oi nuk'ragin pushonida meshavad va Parvardigorashon baroiashon nushobai nikh'oiat pok menushonad.
22) Va ba onkh'o bo mak'sadi ikrom gufta meshavad: "In ne'matkh'o baroiaton podoshi amalkh'oi nekaton ast va taloshaton nazdi Khudo pazirufta ast."
23) Ei Paiombar! Begumon Mo bar tu K'ur'onro k'ism-k'ism furud ovardem va onro iakbora nozil nakardem.
24) Pas, ba kh'ukmi Parvardigorat dar tak'dir io shariat sabr kun va az kh'ech' gunakh'kore dar da'vatash ba gunokh' va az kh'ech' kofire dar da'vatash ba kufr itoat makun.
25) Va Parvardigoratro dar og'ozi ruz bo namozi subkh' va anch'omi ruz bo namozi peshinu asr iod kun.
26) Va dar pose az shab bo namozi shomu khuftan Uro iod kun va ba'd az shomu khuftan dar porai daroze az shab dar namozi takh'ach'ch'ud Uro ba poki iod kun.
27) Beshak, in mushrikon kh'aioti zudguzari dunioro dust medorand va ruzi sangini k'iiomatro, ki sakhtikh'oi ziiod dorad, vomeguzorand.

28) Mo onkh'oro ofaridem va bo k'avi sokhtani paivandkh'o, a'zoi badan va g'aira ofarinishashonro k'avi gardonidem. Va vak'te bikhokh'em, onkh'oro kh'alok megardonem va dar ivaz shabekh'ashonro padid meorem.
29) Kh'amono in sura pandu iodovari ast. Pas, kh'ar ki rokh'i rasonanda ba Parvardigorashro pesh giriftan khokh'ad, onro pesh girad.

30) Va pesh giriftani in rokh'ro namekhokh'ed, magar on ki Khudo onro az shumo bikhokh'ad. Kh'amai kor dar ikhtiiori Ust. Begumon Khudo Donandai sudu ziioni bandagon buda, dar ofarinish, guzoshtani tak'dir va akh'kom bag'oiat Bokh'ikmat ast.

31) U az bandagonash kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, ba rakh'matash vorid mesozad va ba vai tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui imon va amali shoistaro medikh'ad. Va U baroi kasone, ki bo kufru ma'siiat bar ch'oni kheshtan sitam namudaand, azobi dardovari duzakhro omoda sokhta ast.
1) Savgand ba bodkh'oi monandi mui gardani asp paiopai firistoda- shuda-
2) pas savgand ba bodkh'oi ba shiddat vazanda-
3) va savgand ba bodkh'oi parokandasozandai boron-
4) pas savgand ba farishtagone, ki baroi rasuloni ilokh'i akh'komi ch'udosozandai kh'ak' az botilro furud meorand-
5) pas savgand ba farishtagoni nozilkunandai paig'omi ilokh'i,-
6) to uzri bandagon bartaraf gardad va az uk'ubati Parvardigor bim doda shavand,-
7) iak'inan on chi ba shumo dar borai rastokhez, bozpursi va rasidan ba ch'azoi a'mol va'da doda meshavad, noguzir vok'e'shavanda ast.
8) Pas, chun nuri sitoragon makh'v sokhta shavad va ravshaniashon az bain ravad-
9) va chun osmon baroi nuzuli farishtagon rakhna gardad-
10) va chun kukh'kh'o az makonashon barkanda shuda, on chunon pora-pora karda shavand, ki monandi g'ubori dar kh'avo parokanda gardand-
11) va chun paiombaron dar vak'ti muaiian ch'am'ovari gardand-
12) korkh'oi mutaallik' ba paiombaron baroi ruzi buzurg ba ta'khir guzoshta shuda ast va onkh'o on ruz bar ummatonashon shokh'idi medikh'and-
13) baroi ruzi faisalakunanda baini bandagon, to kh'ak' az nokh'ak' va nekbakht az tirabakht ch'udo shavad.
14) Va ei Paiombar, chi turo ogokh' sokhta ast, ki ruzi faisalakunanda chist?!
15) Dar on ruz baroi bandagone, ki dar dunio risolati paiombaroni Khudoro durug' mekh'isobidand, kh'alokatu azob va khasorati buzurg ast.
16) Oio vak'te ummatkh'oi sobik' kofir shudand va paiombaronro durug' shumurdand, Mo onkh'oro kh'alok nasokhtem?!
17) Sipas takzibkunandagoni minba'daro ba dunboli guzashtagon mefiristem va monandi onkh'o kh'alok mesozem.
18) Chunonchi Mo ummatoni sobik'i takzibgarro nobud kardem, bo gunakh'koroni takzibgari risolati Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) niz chunin mekunem.
19) Dar on ruz baroi bandagone, ki dar dunio uk'ubati Khudoro durug' mekh'isobidand, kh'alokatu azob va khasorati buzurg ast.
20) Ei mardum! Oio Mo shumoro az obi nutfai kh'ak'ir naofaridem?!
21) Pas, obi nutfaro dar makoni ustuvor k'aror dodem. Murod az makoni mazkur bachadoni zan ast.
22) To muddati ma'lumi bordorii zan.
23) Pas, Mo sifati navzod, tak'dir, rang va g'airai uro andozagiri kardem. Pas Mo dar anch'om dodani in korkh'o bag'oiat K'udratmandem.
24) Dar on ruz baroi bandagone, ki dar dunio k'udrati Khudoro durug' mekh'isobidand, kh'alokatu azob va khasorati buzurg ast.
25) Oio Mo zaminro tavre naofaridaem, ki tamomi shumoro ch'am' meorad va bar rui khud ch'oi medikh'ad?!
26) Zamin zindagonro bo zistan bar ruiash va murdagonro bo dafn namudan dar zerash ch'am' meorad va ch'oi medikh'ad.

27) Va dar zamin kukh'kh'oi ustuvori baland kh'ast namudem, to onro az larzidan nigokh' dorad va ba shumo mardum obi shirin nushonidem. On Khudoe, ki in korkh'oro anch'om doda ast, az zinda gardonidanaton och'izi namekashad.
28) Dar okhirat baroi on bandagone, ki dar dunio ne'matkh'oi Khudoro durug' mekh'isobidand, kh'alokatu azob va khasorati buzurg ast.
29) Ba takzibgaron gufta meshavad: "Ei takzibgaron! Ba sui on uk'ubate biraved, ki dar dunio onro durug' meshumurded.
30) Ba zeri soiai dudi otashi duzakh, ki se shokha dorad, biraved.
31) Na dar on soiai dudi otash sardi ast, ki az kh'arorati garmi osuda shaved va na az shumo shu'lai otashro boz medorad."
32) Kh'amono otashi duzakh sharorakh'oero meafkanad, ki kh'ar iakei on dar buzurgi monandi k'asr ast.
33) On sharorakh'o dar azamat va rang guio shuturoni siiokh'and.
34) Dar on ruz baroi bandagone, ki dar dunio uk'ubati Khudoro durug' mekh'isobidand, kh'alokatu azob va khasorati buzurg ast.
35) K'iiomat ruzest, ki takzibgaron dar on az shiddati dakh'shat va kh'airat chize nameguiand.
36) Va ba onkh'o ich'ozat doda nameshavad, ki dar nazdi Parvardigor az kufr va korkh'oi badashon uzrkhokh'i kunand.
37) Dar okhirat baroi bandagone, ki dar dunio khabarkh'oi onro durug' mekh'isobidand, kh'alokatu azob va khasorati buzurg ast.
38) Imruz ruzi dovari ast. Mo shumo va ummatkh'oi guzashtaro dar iak makon ch'am' meorem.
39) Pas, agar shumo makre dored, ki ba vasilai on az azobi on ruz nach'ot ioftan metavoned, pas, az on makr ba muk'obilam istifoda bared.
40) Dar okhirat baroi bandagone, ki dar dunio ruzi dovariro durug' mekh'isobidand, kh'alokatu azob va khasorati buzurg ast.
41) Ba durusti ki bandagoni parkh'ezkori ich'rosozandai farmonkh'o va durich'uianda az man'kardakh'oi Khudo zeri soiakh'oi darakhtoni ch'annat va chashmakh'oi doroi obi shirini ravon ch'oi megirand-
42) va dar vasati mevakh'oe, ki khurdanashro mekhokh'and.
43) Ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "Ba sababi amalkh'oi shoistae, ki dar dunio anch'om medoded, az ne'matkh'oi ch'annat bikhured va binushed.
44) Begumon Mo chunonchi ba shumo podosh dodem, ba bandagoni nekukor niz kh'amin tavr podosh medikh'em."
45) Dar okhirat baroi bandagone, ki dar dunio ne'matkh'oi ch'annatro durug' mekh'isobidand, kh'alokatu azob va khasorati buzurg ast.
46) Ba takzibgaron gufta meshavad: "Dar dunio iak muddati andak az ne'matkh'oiash bikhured va bakh'ramand bishaved. Kh'amono shumo ba illati kufr varzidan va takzibi paiombaron gunakh'kor kh'asted."
47) Dar okhirat baroi bandagone, ki dar dunio ch'azoi on ruzro durug' mekh'isobidand, kh'alokatu azob va khasorati buzurg ast.
48) Va chun ba takzibgaron gufta shavad, ki ba khotiri Khudo namoz guzored, namoz nameguzorand.
49) Dar okhirat baroi bandagone, ki dar dunio vakh'ii paiombaronro durug' mekh'isobidand, kh'alokatu azob va khasorati buzurg ast.
50) Agar onkh'o ba K'ur'on imon nameorand, pas ba'd az in ba kadom sukhan imon meorand?!
1) In ch'amoai mushrik ba'd az on ki Khudo ba suiashon Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro firistod, dar borai chi az iakdigar mepursand?!
2) Onkh'o az iakdigar dar borai K'ur'oni shomili khabari buzurgi ruzi k'iiomat mepursand.
3) On K'ur'one, ki onkh'o dar tavsifash ikhtilof dorand. Iak idda onro ch'odu, iddai digar she'r, gurukh'e fol va gurukh'i digar afsonakh'oi guzashtagon medonand.
4) Kh'argiz vok'eiiat on guna ki onkh'o mepindorand, nest! Kh'atman onkh'o farch'omi badi takzib namudani K'ur'onro khokh'and donist.
5) Boz kh'am vok'eiiat on guna ki mepindorand, nest. Onkh'o iak'inan in farch'omi badi amalashonro khokh'and donist.
6) Oio Mo zaminro baroi sukunatashon makoni omoda nasokhtem?!
7) Va kukh'kh'oro dar zamin monandi mekhkh'o k'aror nadodem, to onro az larzidan nigokh' dorand?!
8) Va shumo mardumro ch'uftkh'oi narina va modina ofaridem.
9) Va khobatonro vasilai istirokh'ati ch'ismaton gardonidem.
10) Va shabro bo zulmatash ba monandi libos pushonandai shumo sokhtem.
11) Va ruzro maidoni kasb va ch'ustuch'ui ruzi sokhtem.
12) Va az boloi shumo kh'aft osmoni mustakh'kamro kh'ast namudem.
13) Va oftobi monandi charog' rushnoidikh'andaro padid ovardem.
14) Va az abrkh'oi zamoni boridanashon farorasida obi ba tavri farovon rezanda nozil gardonidem.
15) To ba vasilai on ob dona va rastanii doroi nav'kh'oi gunogunro berun sozem-
16) va bog'kh'oi bo bisiorii shokhakh'oi darakhtonash anbukh'i pechidaro berun sozem.

Vak'te Parvardigor dar oiatkh'oi bolo ne'matkh'oi nishondikh'andai k'udratashro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin mavzui rastokhez va okhiratro ovard. Zero On Khudoe, ki baroi ofaridani in ne'matkh'o k'udrat dorad, bar barangekhtani murdagon va bozpursii onkh'o niz K'odir ast.
17) Kh'amono ruzi dovarii baini bandagon zamoni muaiiani khudro dorad, ki az on pesh va ak'ib nameravad.
18) Ruze, ki farishtai muvazzaf nafkhai duiumro dar sur medamad, pas shumo mardum gurukh'-gurukh' ba makh'shargokh' meoed.
19) Va osmon kushoda meshavad va misli darkh'oi boz doroi rakhnakh'o va surokhikh'o megardad.
20) Va kukh'kh'o on chunon kh'arakat doda meshavand, ki ba changu g'ubori poshkhurda shabokh'at paido mekunand, pas monandi obnamo megardand.
21) Ba durusti ki duzakh kamingiriftai muntaziri akh'li khud ast.
22) Duzakh ch'oi bozgashti zolimon ast.
23) Onkh'o dar onch'o zamonkh'oi durudarozi beokhir bok'i memonand.
24) Onkh'o dar onch'o kh'avoi sardi bartarafsozandai kh'arorati otash va nushobai laziz namechashand,-
25) Onkh'o ba ch'uz obi nikh'oiat purkh'arorat va zardobi az badani akh'li duzakh ch'orishavanda kh'ech' chiz namechashand.
26) Ch'azoi ba amali kufr va zalolatashon muvofik'.

27) Begumon onkh'o dar dunio az kh'isob va bozpursii Khudo dar k'iiomat kh'aros nadoshtand. Zero ruzi k'iiomatro inkor mekardand. Agar az rastokhez metarsidand, imon meovardand va amalkh'oi shoista anch'om medodand.
28) Va oiatkh'oi Moro, ki ba paiombaron furud ovardem, mutlak'an durug' meshumurdand.
29) Va Mo kh'ar iak amalashonro dak'ik' shumoridaem va sabt kardaem. On dar nomai a'molashon navishtashuda ast.
30) Ei zolimon! Ba kh'amin sabab in azobi abadiro bichashed. Pas, Mo kh'argiz bar shumo ch'uz azob chizero afzun namesozem.

31) Iak'inan makoni rasidan ba rastagori baroi parkh'ezkorone ast, ki dasturoti Khudoro ich'ro namuda, az kh'aromkh'o duri mech'uiand. Onkh'o dar onch'o ba orzui kh'ameshagiashon, ki ch'annat ast, noil megardand.
32) Onkh'oro bustonkh'o va darakhtoni angur ast.
33) Va dukhtaroni norpistoni kh'amsinnu sol ast.
34) Va k'adakh'i pur az sharob ast.
35) Onkh'o dar bustonkh'o sukhani botil va durug' nameshunavand va dar baini iakdigar durug' nameguiand.
36) Parvardigorat ba onkh'o in ne'matkh'oro az rui fazlash ba tavri kofi podosh khokh'ad dod,-

37) Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin va Parvardigori mavch'udoti baini onkh'o, Parvardigori dar dunio va okhirat Mekh'rubon. Bandagon k'udrati az U pursidani chizero nadorand, magar on chiro ich'ozat dikh'ad.

38) Ruze, ki Ch'abrail va farishtagon safzada rost meistand. Dar borai shafoati kase sukhan nameguiand, ba istisnoi on shakhse, ki Khudoi Mekh'rubon shafoat shudanashro ich'ozat bidikh'ad va on shafoatshavanda sukhani -ba misli kalimai tavkh'id- durust gufta boshad.

39) In ruzi tavsifshuda, ruzi dar kh'ak'ik'at vok'e'shavanda ast. Pas, kh'ar ki dar on ruz az azobi ilokh'i nach'ot ioftan khokh'ad, bo amalkh'oi solekh' rokh'i vaslkunanda ba Parvardigorashro pesh girad.

40) Ei mardum! Ba durusti, ki mo shumoro az azobe nazdik bim medikh'em. Ruze, ki inson ba amali dar dunio anch'om dodai khud nazar mekunad va kofir khalosi az azobro orzu namuda meguiad: "Ei kosh, man ba monandi kh'aivonot khok megashtam." Kh'aivonot dar ruzi k'iiomat bo amri Khudo khok meshavand.
1) Savgand ba on farishtagone, ki ch'oni kofironro ba shiddat va durushti mekashand-
2) va savgand ba on farishtagone, ki ch'oni mu'minonro ba osoni berun meorand-
3) va savgand ba on farishtagone, ki bo amri Khudo az osmon ba sui zamin bo shitob kh'arakat mekunand-
4) pas savgand ba on farishtagone, ki dar ich'roi farmoni Khudo bo iakdigar sabk'at menamoiand.
5) va savgand ba on farishtagone, ki amri Khudoro oid ba korkh'oi bandagon ich'ro mesozand, bo in kh'ama savgand, ki shumo baroi pursuch'u va giriftani podosh kh'atman barangekhta meshaved.
6) Ruze, ki zamin kh'angomi damida shudani nafkhai duium ba larza meoiad.
7) Ba dunboli nafkhai duium nafkhai digar damida meshavad.
8) Dar on ruz k'albi kofironu fosik'on tarson ast.
9) Osori zillat bar chashmoni sokh'iboni on k'albkh'o oshkor ast.
10) Onkh'o dar dunio meguftand: "Oio mo ba'd az on ki memirem, ba zindagonii dunio barmegardem?!
11) Oio chun ba ustukhonkh'oi pusida tabdil iobem, ba zindagonii dunio barmegardem?!"
12) Onkh'o az rui tamaskhur meguiand: "Agar in khabar durust boshad, pas bozgashti mo ba kh'aioti dubora ziionovar ast."
13) Zinda sokhtani murdagon nikh'oiat kori oson ast. Pas, begumon on az iak bor fariodi farishtai muvazzaf ba damidan dar sur iborat ast.
14) Pas, nogakh'on kh'amai onkh'o ba'd az on ki murda budand, bar rui zamin zinda kh'ozir meshavand.
15) Ei Paiombar! Oio baroiat khabari Muso (alaikh'is salom) bo Parvardigorash va Fir'avni dushmanash omada ast?!
16) Chun Parvardigorash uro dar vodii poki "Tuvo" nido kard.
17) Khudo ba Muso guft: "Ba sui Fir'avn birav. Zero ba durusti ki vai dar zulm va kibru g'urur az kh'ad guzashta ast.
18) Pas ba Fir'avn bigu, ki oio tu ba pokshavi az kufru gunokh' mail dori?!
19) Va oio mekhokh'i turo ba sui Parvardigorat rakh'namoi kunam, pas az U tarsida, tibk'i khushnudiash amal namoi?!

20) Muso (alaikh'is salom) nazdi Fir'avn raft va uro ba iaktoparasti faro khond, Fir'an Muso (alaikh'is salom)-ro durug'gui shumurd, pas Muso (alaikh'is salom) ba vai mu'ch'izakh'oi buzurgi "Dasti durakhshon" va "Asoi ba azhdakh'o tabdiliobanda"-ro nishon dod, to ba risolatash bovar kunad.
21) Pas Fir'avn on mu'ch'izai buzurgro durug' shumurd va az amri Muso nofarmoni kard.

22) Sipas az imon ovardan ba dini Muso (alaikh'is salom) ru gardonid, dar kh'ole ki dar zamin ba anch'omi ma'siiat va muk'obiliiat bo kh'ak' talosh namuda, mardumro suporish medod, to ba sukhanoni Muso (alaikh'is salom) gush naandozand va sokh'ironro ch'am' ovard, to bar ziddash muboriza barand.
23) Pas, k'avm va pairavonashoro bo mak'sadi mag'lub sokhtani Muso (alaikh'is salom) ch'am' ovarda, k'avmashro nido karda guft:
24) "Man Parvardigori bartarini shumo kh'astam. Shumo boiad tankh'o farmoni maro ich'ro namoed va az kase itoat nakuned."
25) Pas, Khudo uro ba azobi dunio (g'ark' sokhtan dar darioi Nil) va azobi okhirat (darovardan ba duzakh) giriftor namud.
26) Kh'amono dar k'issai Fir'avn baroi kase, ki az Khudo metarsad, pandu ibrat ast. Makh'z nafaroni khudotars az khondani sarguzashti inkh'o dars megirand.
27) Ei takzibgaroni rastokhez! Oio kh'ast kardani shumo baroi Khudo dushvortar ast io kh'ast kardani osmonkh'o?! Khudo osmonkh'oro ofarida ast.
28) Khudo balandii osmonro baland sokhta, pas onro chunon barobar gardonid, ki dar on khalal va rakhnagi vuch'ud nadorad.
29) Va shabi osmonro bo g'urubi khurshed zulmoni va nuri onro bo durakhshidani khurshed oshkor sokht.
30) Va ba'di ofaridani osmon zaminro pakh'n kard va manfiatkh'oi shumoro dar on ch'oigir namud.
31) Az zamin obkh'oi onro ba surati chashmakh'oi ch'ori va charogokh'i onro bo ruionidani giiokh'on berun ovard.
32) Va kukh'kh'oro dar zamin ustuvor gardonid.
33) Ei mardum! Kh'amai in ne'matkh'o baroi naf'i shumo va naf'i chakh'orpoionaton ast. Ofaridgori in mavch'udot az zinda sokhtani shumo ba'd az marg och'izi namekashad.
34) Pas, chun nafkhai duium, ki bo dakh'shatash kh'amaro faro megirad, rukh dikh'ad va k'iiomat barpo shavad.
35) Ruze, ki kh'ar inson amalkh'oi nek io badi anch'om dodai khudro ba iod meorad.
36) Va duzakh baroi kh'ar binanda kh'ozir va oshkor karda meshavad.
37) Pas, ammo on kase, ki dar gumrokh'i az kh'ad guzarad-
38) va kh'aioti fanopaziri dunioro az kh'aioti abadii okhirat muk'addam guzorad,-
39) pas ba durusti ki ch'oi bozgasht va k'arorgokh'ash duzakh ast.
40) Va ammo kase, ki az istodan dar nazdi Parvardigorash tarsad va nafsashro az pairavii khostakh'oi kh'aromash nigokh' dorad,-
41) pas begumon ch'oi bozgasht va k'arorgokh'ash bikh'isht ast.
42) Ei Paiombar! In takzibgaroni rastokhez az tu dar borai k'iiomat pursida, meguiand: "K'iiomat kai ba vuk'u' mepaivandad?"
43) Tu dar in bobat ilm nadori, to onro ba takzibgaron zikr kuni va donistani soati vuk'ui k'iiomat ba tu dakhl nadorad. Vazifai tu az on iborat ast, ki pesh az omadanash omoda shavi.
44) Ilmi komili vak'ti vuk'ui k'iiomat tankh'o ba sui Parvardigorat voguzor meshavad.
45) Beshak, tu bimdikh'andai on shakhse kh'asti, ki az k'iiomat metarsad. Bandagoni az on kh'aroson az bim dodanat sud mebarand.
46) Mushrikon dar ruzi bo chashmoni kheshtan mushokh'ida namudani k'iiomat misli onand, ki guio dar dunio tankh'o shomgokh'i iak ruz io choshtgokh'i iak ruz istodaand.
1) Rasuli Khudo (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) ruiashro tursh kard va pusht gardond.

2) Zero Abdullokh' pisari Ummi Maktumi nobino baroi darkhosti rakh'namoi nazdash omad. Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) on lakh'zakh'o ba da'vati rakh'baroni mushrikon sargarm va ba kh'idoiatashon umevor bud.
3) Va ei Paiombar, tu chi medoni, ki shoiad on nobino bo shunidani sukhanonat az gunokh'onash pok megardad?!
4) Io shoiad az kalomat pand megirad, pas on pand uro sud mebakhshad.
5) Ammo on shakhs, ki bo takia ba doroiash khudro az imon ovardan ba risolati tu beniioz medonad,-
6) pas tu tankh'o ba u rui meori va tankh'o ba u mepardozi.
7) Va agar vai bo tavba nakardan az gunokh'onash pok nagardad, bar tu kh'ech' zarare nest.
8) Va ammo on kas, ki baroi talabi khair nazdat shitobon omad-
9) va kh'ol on ki u az Parvardigorash metarsad,-
10) pas tu sargarmi rakh'baroni mushrikon gardida, az u dar g'aflat memoni.
11) Kh'argiz kor chunin nest! Kh'amono in oiatkh'o baroi bandagoni ba on moil pand ast.
12) Pas, kh'ar ki zikri Khudoro khokh'ad, Uro zikr kunad va az K'ur'on pand girad.
13) In K'ur'on nazdi farishtagon dar sakh'ifakh'oi giromii-
14) doroi mak'omu makoni balandu pokgardonidashuda,-
15) dar dasti farishtagoni kotibi a'moli bandagonu,-
16) nazdi Parvardigorashon arch'mandi nekukor sabt gashta ast.
17) La'nat bar insoni kofir, ki chi k'adar ba Khudo kufr mevarzad va nosiposi mekunad!
18) Khudo uro az chi ofarid, ki dar zamin murtakibi kibru kufr va nosiposi megardad?!
19) Uro az nutfai kh'ak'ir kh'ast namuda, pas ofarinishashro markh'ala ba markh'ala andozagiri kard.
20) Sipas rokh'i az batni modar berun shudanashro oson sokht.
21) Sipas uro ba'd az anch'omi umrash memironad va uro to ruzi rastokhez dar k'abr ch'oigir mesozad.
22) Sipas uro kh'ar vak'te khokh'ad, baroi pursuch'u va giriftani ch'azo zinda megardonad.
23) Kh'argiz kor chunonchi kofir mepindorad, ki guio kh'ak'k'i Khudoro ich'ro namuda ast, nest! Kh'anuz on chiro Khudo baroiash farz gardonida ast, ich'ro nakarda ast.
24) Pas, boiad insoni kofir ba taomi mekhurdaash bo dik'k'at nazar kunad! On taom chi guna ba vuch'ud omada ast?!
25) Kh'amono Mo obro, ki asli paidoishi taom meboshad, bo neru va farovoni az osmon rekhtem.
26) Sipas zaminro ba vasilai nabotot kh'akimona shikoftem.
27) Pas, dar on donakh'oi gandum va monandi onro ruionidem.
28) Va dar on darakhtoni angur va rastanikh'oi iste'molshavandaro ruionidem.
29) Va dar on darakhtoni zaitun va khurmoro ruionidem.
30) Va dar on bustonkh'oi serdarakhtro ruionidem.
31) Va dar on meva va alafi chakh'orpoionro ruionidem.
32) Baroi manfiati shumo va baroi manfiati chakh'orpoionaton.
33) Pas, chun sadoi dakh'shatovaru gushkharoshi nafkhai duium kh'osil gardad.
34) Ruze, ki kh'ar kas az barodarash megurezad.
35) Va az modarash va padarash megurezad.
36) Va az kh'amsarash va farzandonash megurezad.
37) On ruz kh'ar iakeashon baroi khud giriftorii buzurge dorand, ki uro az kasi digar g'ofil mesozad.
38) On ruz chekh'rai nekbakhton durakhshon ast.
39) Az ne'matkh'oi omoda kardai Khudo khandonu shodon ast.
40) Va on ruz bar chekh'rakh'oi tirabakhton g'ubor ast.
41) On ruz chekh'rakh'oi tirabakhtonro toriki faro megirad.
42) Inkh'o kasone kh'astand, ki dar dunio kufr va badkoriro iakch'o ch'am' sokhta budand.
1) Chun ch'irmi oftob pechida shuda va nurash az bain ravad-
2) va chun sitoragon furu rezand va rushaniashon makh'v gardad-
3) va chun kukh'kh'o az makoni khud ch'unbonda shavand-
4) va chun shuturoni moda, ki garonbakh'otarin amvoli onkh'o bud, az ch'onibi sokh'ibonashon tark gashta, muattal guzoshta shavand-
5) va chun kh'aivonkh'oi vakh'shi az kh'ar taraf bo insonkh'o dar iak makon ch'am' ovarda shavand-
6) va chun dariokh'o afrukhta shuda, ba otash tabdil ioband-
7) va chun insonkh'oi dar nekukori va badkori shabekh'i iakdigar iakch'o ch'am' kunonida shavand-
8) va chun dukhtari zinda dar gur shuda az sui Khudo mavridi pursish k'aror girad, ki-
9) k'otilash uro ba kadom gunokh' kushta ast-
10) va chun sakh'ifakh'oi a'moli bandagon kushoda shavad, to kh'ar kas nomai amalkh'oi kheshro bikhonad-
11) va chun osmon ba monandi barkandani pust az badani gusfand barkanda shavad-
12) va chun otashi duzakh afrukhta shavad-
13) va chun bikh'isht baroi parkh'ezkoron nazdik sokhta shavad,-
14) vak'te kh'avodisi mazkur ba vuk'u' mepaivandad, kh'ar kas medonad, ki baroi on ruz chi kor karda ast.
15) Pas, savgand mekhuram ba sitoragone, ki k'abl az zukh'ur dar shab pinkh'on meshavand,-
16) sitoragone, ki dar madori khud kh'arakat karda, bo damidani subkh' nopadid shuda, monandi g'izolkh'o ba khonakh'oiashon medaroiand-
17) va savgand mekhuram ba og'ozi shab vak'te biioiad va anch'omi shab vak'te biravad-
18) va savgand mekhuram ba subkh' vak'te nurash baroiad va bidamad, -
19) iak'inan K'ur'on Kalomi Parvardigor buda, onro farishtai izzatmand (Ch'ibril) ba Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) merasonad,-
20) farishtai nerumandi nazdi Khudoi Sokh'ibi arshi azim doroi mak'omi baland,-
21) farishtai az sui akh'li osmon itoatshavandai dar rasonidani paig'omi Khudo amonatdor. Ch'ibril amini vakh'ii Parvardigor ast.
22) Va dusti shumo Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam), ki khiradmandi, amonatdori va rostk'avliashro medoned, devona nest. Shumo uro tukh'mat mezaned.
23) Va Ba durusti ki Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) Ch'ibrilro ba surati asliash dar ufuk'i oshkori osmon dida ast.
24) Va Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nisbat ba shumo dar rasonidani farmonkh'oi Khudo bukhl namevarzad va monandi folbinon dar ivazi korash az shumo muzd namekhokh'ad.
25) Va K'ur'on Kalomi Shaitoni rondashuda nest.
26) Pas, shumo ba'd az ovardani in kh'uch'ch'atkh'o baroi inkori K'ur'on chi rokh'ero pesh megired va ba kuch'o meraved?!
27) Kh'ak'k'o, ki K'ur'on baroi insonkh'o va ch'inkh'o pandi buzurg ast,-
28) baroi on kase az shumo, ki dar rokh'i rost budanro bikhokh'ad.
29) Va shumo chizero namekhokh'ed, magar in ki Allokh'i Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion onro az shumo bikhokh'ad.
1) Chun osmon baroi nuzuli farishtagon rakhna gardad-
2) va chun sitoragon az kh'am posh khurda, birezand
3) va chun dariokh'o kushoda shuda va bo iakdigar omekhta shavand
4) va chun gurkh'o baroi zindasozii murdagon zeru ru karda shavand,
5) on zamon kh'ar kase on amalero, ki peshopesh firistoda ast va on amalero, ki ba ta'khir guzoshta, anch'om nadoda ast, medonad.

6) Ei insoni kofir! Chi turo nisbat ba Parvardigorat firefta gardonda ast, ki bar khilofi farmonash kor mekuni?! Oio fireftai on gashtai, ki Parvardigorat az lutfash baroiat mukh'lat doda, darkh'ol turo much'ozot nakarda ast?!
7) Parvardigore, ki turo az nesti kh'ast karda, pas durustandomat sokht va a'zoi badanatro ba iakdigar mutanosib namuda, k'omatatro rost gardonda ast.
8) Ba kh'ar shakle, ki khost, turo ofarida ast. Az rui lutfash turo ba surati inson khalk' karda, misli kharu buzinaiu sag va g'aira naofarida ast.
9) Ei fireftagon! Kh'argiz kor chunonchi shumo tasavvur dored, nest! Balki shumo ruzi ch'azoro durug' meshumored va bo imonu amali shoista baroi on omoda nameshaved.
10) Va begumon bar shumo farishtagoni nigakh'boni a'mol guzoshta shuda ast,-
11) farishtagoni nazdi Khudo arch'mandi navisandagoni a'mol.
12) Kh'ar on chi anch'om medikh'ed, onro medonand va menavisand.
13) Kh'ak'k'o, ki nekukoron ruzi k'iiomat dar bikh'ishti abadi kh'astand.
14) Va kh'ak'k'o, ki badkoron ruzi k'iiomat dar duzakhi abadi kh'astand.
15) Onkh'o ruzi ch'azo voridi duzakh megardand va sakht ch'azo mebinand.
16) Va onkh'o kh'argiz az duzakh khorich' nameshavand, balki dar on abadi memonand.
17) Va ei Paiombar, chi turo ogokh' sokhta ast, ki ruzi ch'azo chist?!
18) Sipas chi turo ogokh' sokhta ast, ki ruzi ch'azo chist?!
19) Ruze, ki kh'ech' kas k'udrate nadorad, ki ba kase sud rasonad. Va on ruz kh'amai korkh'o tankh'o dar ikhtiiori Khudo ast. Kh'ar on chi bikhokh'ad, anch'om medikh'ad.
1) Voi bar kh'oli kamkunandagon, ki kh'alokat va khasorat mebinand,
2) On kasone, ki vak'te az mardum chizero baroi khesh bo paimona (io bo vazn) chen mekunand, kh'ak'k'ashonro ba purragi megirand.

3) Va vak'te ki ba mardum chizero paimona io vazn mekunand, dar on paimona va vazn ziion meorand va az on mekunand. Sokinoni Madinai Munavvara zamoni kh'ich'rati Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) kh'amin guna budand.
4) Oio sodirkunandagoni in ma'siiati azim dar borai on ki ba sui Khudo barangekhta meshavand, iak'in nadorand?!
5) Magar onkh'o iak'in nadorand, ki dar ruzi bag'oiat buzurgi k'iiomat baroi bozpursi va giriftani podosh zinda karda meshavand?! K'iiomat ruzi nikh'oiat dakh'shatnok ast.
6) Ruze, ki mardum dar kh'uzuri Parvardigori tamomi khaloik' rost meshavand, to mavridi pursuch'u k'aror girand.

7) Kh'argiz kor chunonchi shumo mepindored, ki guio ba'di marg zinda gashtan vuch'ud nadorad, nest! Ba durusti ki nomai a'moli kofiron va munofik'on dar ch'oe bo nomi "Sich'ch'in", dar poiontarin tabak'ai zamin ast.
8) Va ei Paiombar, turo chi ogokh' sokhta ast, ki "Sich'ch'in" chist?!
9) Nomai a'molashon tavre navishta shuda ast, ki kh'argiz az bain nameravad va kamu ziiod nameshavad.
10) On ruz voi bar kh'oli takzibkunandagon, ki khasorat mebinand va kh'alok megardand.-
11) On kasone, ki ruzi ch'azoi a'molro durug' medonand.
12) Va on ruzi ch'azoro tankh'o kase durug' meshumorad, ki az marzkh'oi guzoshtai Khudo tach'ovuzkor buda, bisior sodirkunandai gunokh' ast.
13) Chun bar u oiatkh'oi Mo, ki bar Paiombaramon (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) nozil shuda ast, khonda shavad, meguiad: "In sukhanon k'issakh'oi ummatkh'oi sobik' buda, kalomi Khudo nestand."
14) Kh'argiz kor chunonchi takzibgaron tasavvur dorand, nest! Balki gunokh'oni kardaashon bar ak'lkh'oiashon g'olib gashta, onro tira sokhta ast. Baroi kh'amin kh'ak'ik'atro namebinand.
15) Iak'inan onkh'o ruzi k'iiomat az didori Parvardigori khud makh'rum megardand.
16) Sipas onkh'o dokhili duzakh megardand va ch'azoi sakht mebinand.
17) Sipas bo sarzanish ba onkh'o gufta meshavad: "In on azobest, ki vak'te paiombaraton shumoro az on bokhabar mesokht, onro durug' mekh'isobided."
18) Kh'argiz kor chunonchi shumo tasavvur dored, ki guio bozpursi va ch'azoi a'mol vuch'ud nadorad, nest! Beshak, nomai a'moli nekukoron dar "Illiiiin" ast.
19) Va ei Paiombar, chi turo ogokh' sokhta ast, ki "Illiiiin" chist?!
20) Ba durusti ki nomai a'molashon tavre navishta shuda ast, ki kh'argiz az bain nameravad va kamu ziiod namegardad.
21) Kh'angomi e'loni nomai a'molashon farishtagoni muk'arrabi kh'ar iak osmon kh'ozir meshavand.
22) Begumon bandagoni bisior anch'omdikh'andai ibodat ruzi okhirat dar ne'mati abadi k'aror megirand.
23) Bar rui takhtkh'oi orosta takia zada, ba sui Parvardigorashon va manzarakh'oi farakh'bakhshi ch'annat menigarand.
24) Chun ba bandagoni tavsifshuda nazar andozi, dar chekh'rakh'oiashon osori ch'amolu khurramii ne'matro mebini.
25) Khodimonashon ba onkh'o az sharobe, ki bar zarfash mukh'r nikh'oda shuda ast, menushonand.
26) Az og'oz to anch'omi on sharob ba mashom buii mushk merasad. Va boiad bandagoni sabk'atkunanda bo ich'roi amali solekh' va duri az gunokh' baroi kasbi in podosh sabk'at kunand.
27) Va in sharobi bar zarfkh'oiash mukh'r nikh'odashuda az obi chashmai "Tasnim" omekhta shuda ast.
28) "Tasnim" chashmai poke dar bolotarin tabak'ai ch'annat ast, ki az on bandagoni muk'arrabi dargokh'i Khudo menushand, ammo mu'minoni digar az omekhtashudai on iste'mol mekunand.
29) Kh'amono gunakh'koron dar dunio mu'minonro tamaskhur namuda, ba kh'olashon mekhandidand.
30) Va chun az nazdi mu'minon meguzashtand, ba iakdigar chashmaki mezadand va onkh'oro maskhara menamudand.
31) Va chun ba sui khonadonashon barmegashtand, az kufr va takh'k'iri khud masrurona barmegashtand.
32) Va chun mu'minonro medidand, meguftand: "Beshak, in ch'amoa bo tarki dini padaronashon az rokh'i durust gumrokh' shudaand."
33) Va kh'ol on ki Khudo onkh'oro baroi nazorati amalkh'oi mu'minon muvazzaf nakarda ast, ki kh'ak'k'i guftani in sukhanro doshta boshand.
34) Pas, imruzi k'iiomat mu'minon ba kh'oli kofiron mekhandand, on guna ki kofiron dar dunio ba kh'oli mu'minon mekhandidand.
35) Mu'minon bar takhtkh'oi orosta takia zada, ba ne'matkh'oi abadii ch'annat menigarand.
36) Beshak, kofiron ruzi okhirat baroi on chi dar dunio mekardand, bo azobi sakht ch'azo doda meshavand.
1) Chun osmon baroi nuzuli farishtagon shikof gardad-
2) va ba farmoni Parvardigorash gush faro doda, itoat namoiad va boiad kh'am chunin kunad-
3) va chun Khudo zaminro monandi kashidani pust bikashad-
4) va chun kh'ar chi dar zerash az khazinakh'o va murdagon dorad, berun andozad va az on kholi shavad-
5) va ba farmoni Parvardigorash gush faro doda, itoat namoiad va boiad kh'am chunin kunad, on ruz inson bo a'moli khud rubaru khokh'ad shud.

6) Ei inson! Tu to vak'ti lik'oi Parvardigorat tavassuti marg dar anch'omi amali nek io bad talosh mevarzi, pas ruzi k'iiomat bo on amalat rubaru megardi va Parvardigorat turo ba podoshi on merasonad.

Chun Khudo dar oiati k'abli amali insonro ba tavri mukhtasar ovard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin kh'olati bandagonro dar okhirat zikr namuda guft:
7) Pas, ammo kh'ar ki nomai a'molash ba dasti rostash doda shavad,-
8) iak'inan Khudo uro ba osoni bozpursi mekunad. Korkh'oiashro ba vai nishon medikh'ad, ammo much'ozotash namekunad-
9) va ba nazdi khonadon va kheshovandonash dar ch'annat khushkh'olona barmegardad.
10) Va ammo kh'ar ki nomai a'molash az ch'onibi pushti sarash ba dasti chapash doda shavad,-
11) pas begumon bar alaikh'i khud kh'alokatro mekhonad-
12) va dokhili otash duzakh megardad.
13) Kh'amono vai dar baini khonadon va kheshovandonash dar dunio az kufr va gunokh'oni khud khushkh'ol bud.
14) Zero beshak vai gumon mekard, ki ba'd az marg dubora ba kh'aiot barnamegardad.

15) Ore, kh'atman Khudo chunonchi bori nakhust khalk'ash namud, dubora uro ba kh'aiot barmegardonad. Biduni shakku tardid, Parvardigorash ba akh'voli vai Bino ast. Kh'ech' chize az U pushida namemonad va dar ivazi kh'ar iak kor baroiash ch'azo medikh'ad.
16) Pas, savgand mekhuram ba on surkhi, ki ba'd az g'urubi oftob dar kanorai osmon padid meoiad.
17) va savgand mekhuram ba shab va on chi shab onro dar khud ch'am' karda ast-
18) va savgand mekhuram ba mokh' chun purra gashta, ba mokh'i tamom tabdil iobad, ki-

19) iak'inan shumo mardum ba'd az iak kh'olat bo kh'olati digar rubaru khokh'ed gasht. Nakhust nutfa buded, pas khuni basta gashted, ba'dan porai gusht shuded, sipas ba zindagonii dunio k'adam guzoshted, ba'd az kh'aioti in dunio memired va ruzi k'iiomat boz zinda megarded.
20) Pas, in kofironro chi shuda ast, ki ba Khudoi Iagona va okhirat imon nameorand?!
21) Va chun bar onkh'o K'ur'on tilovat shavad, dar barobari Kholik'i kheshtan sach'da namekunand?!
22) Balki kofiron risolati Paiombarashonro durug' meshumorand.
23) Va on chi dar k'albashon az kufru kh'asad va adovatu tug'ion pinkh'on medorand, Khudo onro bekh'tar medonad. Kh'ech' amali onkh'o az U makhfi nest.
24) Pas, ei Paiombar, onkh'oro ba azobi dardovar "bashorat" bidekh'. On azob dar intizori eshon ast.
25) Lekin on kasone, ki imon ovardand va amalkh'oi solekh' kardand, onkh'oro podoshi nogusastanii ch'annat ast.
1) Savgand ba osmoni doroi manzilkh'oi oftobu mokh'tob va digar sitorakh'o-
2) va savgand ba ruzi k'iiomat, ki dar on ch'am'ovarii kulli khaloik' va'da shuda ast-

3) va savgand ba kh'ar shokh'ide ba misli paiombaron, ki bar ummatoni kheshtan guvokh'i medikh'and va savgand ba kh'ar nafare ba misli ummatoni onkh'o, ki az sui paembaronashon bar onkh'o shokh'idi doda meshavad.
4) La'nat shudand on kasone, ki dar zamin khandak'kh'o kandand.
5) Onkh'o dar on khandak'kh'o otash afrukhtand va mu'minonro dar on andokhtand.
6) Vak'te onkh'o dar atrofi khandak'kh'oi pur az otash nishasta budand, kh'amon vak't mavridi la'nati Khudo k'aror giriftand.
7) Va onkh'o bar on chi dar kh'ak'k'i mu'minon az azobu shikanch'a anch'om medodand, shokh'id budand. Zero dar onch'o kh'uzur doshtand.
8) Va on kofiron dar mu'minon kh'ech' aibero namedidand, magar on ki mu'minon ba Parvardigori kh'amesha G'olibi dar kh'ama kh'olat Sutuda imon doshtand.
9) On Zote, ki podshokh'ii osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az Ust. Va Khudo bar kh'ama chiz Ogokh' ast. Kh'ech' amali bandagon az U makhfi nest.

10) Kh'amono on kasone, ki mardoni boimon va zanoni boimonro ba vasilai otash shikanch'a namudand, to onkh'oro az imon ba Khudoi Iagona bargardonand, sipas az gunokh'onashon tavba nakardand, pas ruzi k'iiomat onkh'oro azobi ch'akh'annam va onkh'oro azobi otashi suzon ast. In dar ivazi on amalest, ki nisbat ba mu'minon ravo didand.

11) Beshak, on kasone, ki imon ovardand va amalkh'oi solekh' kardand, onkh'oro bustonkh'oest, ki az zeri darakhtkh'o va k'asrkh'oi on bustonkh'o rudkh'o ch'ori meboshad. In podoshi mazkur rastagorii nikh'oiat buzurg ast. Kh'ech' chiz ba on barobar nameshavad.
12) Begumon azobi Parvardigorat nisbat ba zolimon va sarkashon -agarchi iak muddat ba onkh'o mukh'lat medikh'ad- nikh'oiat sakht ast.
13) Kh'amono dar dunio U ofarinishro og'oz mekunad va ruzi k'iiomat dubora onro barmegardonad.
14) Va U Bakhshandai gunokh'i tavbakoron, Dustdori parkh'ezkoron ast.
15) Sokh'ibi Arshu Doroi Zotu sifoti boazamat ast.
16) Kh'ar chi khokh'ad, anch'om medikh'ad. Kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, mebakhshad va kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, uk'ubat menamoiad. Kase Uro dar kh'ech' kor mach'bur namekunad.
17) Ei Paiombar! Oio ba tu khabari sipokh'iione, ki bar ziddi kh'ak' dar iak ch'abkh'a k'aror doshtand, omada ast?!
18) Khabari Fir'avn va Samudi k'avmi Solekh'?!

19) Monei imoni kofiron on nest, ki guio az sarguzashti ummatkh'oi sobik' khabar nadorand va kh'alok gashtani onkh'oro namedonand. Balki onkh'o bo pairavi az khostai nafsashon risolati Paiombarashonro durug' meshumorand.
20) Va Khudo a'moli onkh'oro az pushti sarashon ikh'ota karda ast. Kh'ech' amalashon az U dur nest va dar ivazi kh'ar iak amal podosh megirand.
21) In Kitob chunonchi kofiron meguiand, she'ru ch'odu io chizi digar nest, balki on K'ur'oni bosharofat va boazamat ast.
22) On dar Lavkh'i az tag'iirot va kamu ziiodshavi makh'fuz ch'oi dorad.
1) Savgand ba osmon va sitoragoni dar shab oshkorshavanda.
2) Va ei Paiombar, turo chi ogokh' sokhta ast, ki in sitoragoni buzurg chi kh'astand?!
3) Onkh'o sitoragoneand, ki bo nuri durakhshoni khud torikii shabro surokh mesozand.
4) Kh'ech' nafare nest, magar in ki Parvardigor bar vai farishtai nigakh'bonero vobasta kunonida ast, to amalkh'oiashro baroi kh'isobi ruzi k'iiomat kh'ifz namoiad.
5) Pas, boiad kh'ar iak inson dar borai on ki Khudo uro az chi ofarida ast, biandeshad, to k'udrati Ofaridgor va notavonii khudro dark kunad.
6) Khudo uro az obi ch'akh'andai dar rakh'mi zan rezanda ofarida ast.
7) On obi ch'akh'anda az miioni kamari mard va ustukhonkh'oi sinai zan berun meoiad.

8) Kh'amono Parvardigor bar bargardondani inson ba'd az margash K'odir ast. On Zote, ki bori nakhust uro az obi nutfa khalk' karda ast, tavonmandii onro dorad, ki boz zindaash sozad, to mavridi bozpursi k'aror girifta, ba ch'azoi kirdorash birasad.
9) Ruze, ki pushidakh'oi k'alb az e'tik'odot, niiatkh'o va g'aira ozmuda va kashf gardida, fosid va solekh'i on ch'udo meshavad.
10) Pas, inson dar on ruz kh'ech' k'uvvat va madadrasone nadorad, ki bo takia bar on az uk'ubat rakh'oi iobad.
11) Savgand ba osmoni doroi boron. Boron az sui osmon gashtaiu bargashta furu merezad.
12) Va savgand ba zamine, ki bo ruiidani nabotot meshikofad.
13) Iak'inan K'ur'on kalomi ch'udosozandai kh'ak'ik'at az botil va rost az durug' ast.
14) Va on bozi va botil nest, balki kalomi ch'iddi va kh'ak' ast.
15) Beshak, takzibgaroni risolati Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) dasisai bisior mekunand, to peshi rokh'i da'vatashro bigirand.
16) Va Man baroi g'olib gardonidani din va barkh'am zadani botil muk'obili dasisai onkh'o tadbiri sakht mekunam.

17) Pas, ei Paiombar, ba in kofiron mukh'lat doda, onkh'oro andake rakh'o namo. Az Khudo matalab, ki zud kh'alokashon sozad. Zero U nisbat ba dushmanoni da'vatat tadbiri Khudro dorad va chun vak'tash faro rasad, onro amali mesozad.
1) Parvardigori Volomak'omi khudro bo zikri nomash az kh'ar aibu nuk'son ba poki iod kun.
2) Zote, ki insonro ofarida, pas, ofarinishi uro rostu durust va bekhalal sokhta ast.
3) Va On Zote, ki ch'ins, nav' va sifatkh'oi makhluk'otro andozagiri karda, pas kh'ar iakei onro ba on chi munosib ast, rakh'namoi namuda ast.
4) Va On Zote, ki az zamin baroi chakh'orpoion giiokh'oni charogokh'ro berun ovarda ast.
5) Pas, onro ba'di sabzrangi khushkidai moil ba siiokh'i gardonida ast.

6) Ei Paiombar! Mo iak'inan K'ur'onro ba surati paivasta bar tu mekhonem va onro dar k'albat ch'oigir mesozem, pas kh'argiz faromushash namekuni. Vak'te ki Ch'abrail K'ur'on khonad, kh'amrokh'ash dar tilovati on sabk'at makun, on guna ki dar guzashta ba khotiri adami faromushii on chunin mekardi.
7) Ba ch'uz on chi Khudo baroi kh'ikmate mekhokh'ad onro faromush sozi. Ba durusti, Khudo oshkor va nikh'onro medonad. Kh'ech' chiz az U makhfi nest.
8) Va baroiat anch'omi korkh'oero, ki boisi rozigii Khudo gashta, turo voridi ch'annat megardonad, oson mekunem.
9) Modom ki chunin ast, pas mardumro bo K'ur'on pand bidekh', agar pand ba onkh'o sud bakhshad.
10) Begumon az sukhanonat kh'ar ki az Khudo metarsad, pand megirad. Zero makh'z bandai khudotars az on manfiat mebarad.
11) Va kofir az pandu nasikh'at duri mech'uiad va ba on nafrat dorad. Zero munkiri Khudo dar k'iiomat tirabakhttarin shakhs ast, chunki vai dar dar onch'o voridi ch'akh'annam meshavad.
12) On kase, ki ba otashi buzurgtarin medaroiad va az uk'ubati on abadi ranch' mebarad.
13) Sipas dar duzakh ch'ovidon meistad va na dar onch'o memirad, to az uk'ubatash rakh'oi iobad va na ba khushi zinda memonad.
14) Beshak, kh'ar ki az shirku ma'siiat pok shavad, rastagor gashta, ba murodi khesh merasad.
15) Va Parvardigorashro bo nav'kh'oi gunoguni zikr ba iod orad, pas namozashro ba tavri zaruri barpo dorad.
16) Vale shumo rokh'i pok sokhtani nafsro pesh namegired,[2] balki kh'aioti in dunioro az okhirat muk'addam meguzored, kh'ol on ki baini on du tafovuti nikh'oiat buzurg mavch'ud ast.
17) Iak'inan okhirat az dunio va lazzatkh'oi fanopaziri on bekh'tar va poiandatar ast. Chunki ne'matkh'oi on abadii beintikh'o meboshad.
18) Kh'amono on chi ba shumo az farmonkh'o va akhbor zikr kardem, dar sakh'ifakh'oi k'abl az K'ur'on nozilshuda bud.
19) Dar sakh'ifakh'oe, ki bar Ibrokh'im va Muso (alaikh'is salom) nozil gashta ast.
1) Ei Firistodai Khudo! Oio ba tu khabari k'iiomat, ki bo dakh'shatash mardumro faro khokh'ad girift, omada ast?!
2) Ruzi k'iiomat bandagon ba toifai tirabakhtu nekbakht ch'udo gashta, tirabakhton khor meboshand.
3) Tirabakhton kh'amesha giriftori korkh'oi mashak'k'atovar buda, dar ranch'u azoband. Bo zavlonakh'o ba sui otashi duzakh kashida meshavand.
4) Ba otashi nikh'oiat purkh'arorat medaroiand va azob mekashand.
5) Ba onkh'o az obi chashmai bag'oiat suzon nushonida meshavad.
6) Onkh'o baroi khurdan taome ch'uz "Zari'" nadorand. On badtarin va buinoktarin nav'i giiokh' bo nomi "Shibrik'" ast. Ba'di khushk shudan ba zakh'r tabdil meiobad.
7) Iste'molkunandaashro farbekh' namegardonad va gurusnagiashro bartaraf namesozad.
8) Va nekbakhton dar on ruz sokh'ibi ne'mat va tobonu shodonand.
9) Az amalkh'oi solekh'i dar dunio anch'omdodai khesh khushkh'oland. Chunki ch'azoi onro chand barobar beshtar ba dast meorand.
10) Dar bustonkh'oi balandmakoni balandmak'om k'aror megirand.
11) Dar onch'o sukhani botil va bekh'uda nameshunavand.
12) Dar onch'o chashmakh'oi ch'ori ast. Akh'li ch'annat on chashmakh'oro ba kh'ar kuch'o khokh'and, kh'amrokh'ashon mebarand va ba surati dilkhokh'ashon az on istifoda menamoiand.
13) Dar onch'o takhtkh'oi baland ast.
14) Va baroi nushidani nushobakh'o k'adakh'kh'o guzoshta shuda ast.
15) Va bolinkh'oi pakh'lui kh'am chida shuda ast.
16) Va farshkh'oi ziede inch'o va onch'o pakh'n karda shuda ast.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi peshin tafovuti nekbakhton va tirabakhtonro dar okhirat zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin tavach'ch'ukh'i kofironro ba sui osori k'udratash ch'alb mesozad, to dar in bobat andeshida, imon orand va dokhili ch'annat shuda, ba zumrai nekbakhton bipaivandand.
17) Oio in kofiron ba shuturon bo taammul namenigarand, ki Khudo onkh'oro chi guna ofarida, tobei insonkh'o karda ast?!
18) Va oio ba sui osmon bo taammul namenigarand, ki Khudo chi guna onro bardoshta, kh'amchun sak'fi makh'fuz sokht va bar sari insonkh'o suk'ut namekunad?!
19) Va oio bo taammul ba sui kukh'kh'o namenigarand, ki Khudo chi guna onkh'oro dar zamin nasb namud, to zamin insonkh'oro ba larza naorad?!
20) Va oio bo taammul ba sui zamin namenigarand, ki chi guna Khudo onro gustaronid va baroi sukunati insonkh'o omodaash kard?!

Khudo ba'di on ki dar oiatkh'oi mazkur dik'k'ati kofironro ba osori k'udratash ch'alb namud, dar oiati zerin Paiombarashro mukhotab k'aror doda guft:
21) Ei Paiombar! Modom ki chunin ast, pas onkh'oro pand bidekh' va az uk'ubati Khudo bitarson. Zero tu begumon panddikh'anda kh'asti. Vazifai tu az nasikh'ati mardum iborat ast. Tavfik'i kh'idoiat ba sui imon tankh'o dar ikhtiiori Parvardigor ast.
22) Tu bar onkh'o musallat nesti, ki ba imon ovardan mach'burashon sozi.
23) Lekin kh'ar kas az imon ovardan rui tobad va ba Khudovu Rasulash kofir shavad,
24) pas Khudo ruzi k'iiomat uro bo buzurgtarin uk'ubat azob mekunad. Fardoi okhirat ba duzakhi abadi dokhil meshavad.
25) Iak'inan bozgashti onkh'o ba'd az marg tankh'o ba sui Mo ast.
26) Sipas bozpursii onkh'o baroi korkh'oiashon bar ukh'dai Mo ast. Na tu va na digaron dar in kor mas'ul nested.
1) Savgand ba subkh'-
2) va savgand ba dakh' shabi avvali mokh'i Zulkh'ich'ch'a-
3) va savgand ba ch'uft va tok'i kh'ar chiz-
4) va savgand ba shab vak'te biioiad va bo tului subkh' bargardad, shumo kh'atman baroi a'molaton ch'azo mebined.
5) Oio dar savgand khurdan ba mavch'udoti mazkur baroi sokh'ibi khirad savgandi k'anoatbakhsh va kofi mavch'ud ast?!
6) Ei Paiombar! Oio namedoni, ki Parvardigorat bo Odi k'avmi Kh'ud chun Paiombarashonro takzib namudand, chi kor kard?!
7) K'abilai Odi mansub ba ch'addashon Iram, ki k'omatkh'oi monandi sutun baland doshtand.
8) On k'abilae, ki Khudo az nigokh'i k'uvvatu k'udrat monandashro dar kishvarkh'o naofarida bud.
9) Va oio namedoni, ki Parvardigorat bo Samudi k'avmi Solekh' chi kard?! On k'avme, ki kharsangkh'oi kukh'ro pora sokhta, az on baroi kheshtan dar vodii "Kh'ich'r" khona buniod menamudand.
10) Va oio namedoni, ki Parvardigorat bo Fir'avni doroi mekhkh'o chi kard?! Fir'avn ba in vasila mardumro shikanch'a medod.
11) Kh'amai k'avmkh'oi mazkur dar zulmu ma'siiat dar shakh'rkh'oi khesh az kh'ad guzashta budand.
12) Pas dar on shakh'rkh'o bo pakh'n sokhtani kufru gunokh' fasodkorii ziiod anch'om dodand.
13) Dar natich'ai on Parvardigorat baroiashon azobi sakhti Khudro chashonid va onkh'oro az zamin reshakan gardonid.
14) Ei Paiombar! Kh'amono Parvardigorat dar kamin ast. A'moli bandagonashro nazorat namuda, ruzi k'iiomat ba nekukoron bo ch'annat va ba badkoron bo duzakh ch'azo medikh'ad.

Chun ummatkh'oi kh'alokshudai sobik' sokh'ibi ne'mat budand, Khudovand dar oiatkh'oi ba'di baion mesozad, ki ne'mat nishonai khushnudii Uro az banda ifoda namekunad.
15) Pas, ammo az tabiati inson on ast, ki chun Parvardigorash uro ozmoish kunad, pas arch'mandash gardonad va ba u ne'mati molu farzand va ch'okh'u mansab dikh'ad, inro nishonai karomatash peshi Parvardigor kh'isobida meguiad: "Ba durusti, Parvardigoram maro giromi doshta ast. Zero man ba in arch'mandi mearzam."
16) Va ammo chun insonro ozmoish kunad, pas rizk'ashro tang sozad, inro alomati khori mekh'isobad va meguiad: "Parvardigoram maro khor karda ast."

17) Kh'argiz! Vok'eiiat chunonchi vai tasavvur dorad, ki guio doshtani ne'mat alomati khushnudii Khudo va makh'rumiiat az on alomati zillat ast, nest! Balki kh'ak'ik'at on ast, ki shumo iatimro giromi namedored va nisbatash neki namekuned.
18) Va iakdigarro ba taom dodani fak'ir tashvik' namenamoed.
19) Va merosi zanonu iatimonro novobasta az kh'aromu kh'alol budani on mekhured.
20) Va molro bisior dust medored va onro ch'am' mesozed, ammo az kharch'ash dar rokh'i Khudo bukhl mevarzed.
21) Kh'argiz naboiad shumo chunin kuned. Zamonero ba iodaton ored, ki zamin nikh'oiat ba shiddat ch'unbonda meshavad.
22) Va ei Paiombar, Parvardigorat baroi dovarii baini bandagon meoiad va farishtagon safzada-safzada meoiand.

23) Va dar on ruz duzakh bo kh'aftod kh'azor lach'om va dar kh'ar iak lach'om kh'aftod kh'azor farishta ovarda meshavad. Inson on ruz on chi dar kh'ak'k'i Parvardigor kutokh'i karda ast, ba khotir meorad va on ruz in iodovari baroiash kh'ech' foida namebakhshad! Chunki okhirat ruzi podosh ast, na ruzi amal.
24) Vai az shiddati nadomat meguiad: "Ei kosh, baroi zindagonii okhiratam, ki kh'aioti vok'ei ast, k'ablan korkh'oi nek mefiristodam."
25) Dar on ruz kase monandi uk'ubati Khudo uk'ubat namekunad.
26) Va kase monandi U kofironro bo zanch'irkh'o namebandad.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi guzashta ch'azoi kofironro ovard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin podoshi mu'minonro zikr karda guft:
27) Kh'angomi marg va ruzi okhirat ba nafsi bandai mu'min gufta meshavad: "Ei nafsi bo imon va amali solekh' oromgiranda!
28) Ba sui Parvardigorat dar kh'ole bargard, ki Tu bo ne'matkh'o az U khushnudi, U bo amalkh'oi solekh'at az tu khushnud ast.
29) Pas, dar zumrai bandagoni solekh'am dokhil bishav.
30) Va kh'amrokh'i onkh'o ba ch'annatam, ki onro baroi bandagoni solekh' omoda namudaam, dokhil bishav."
1) Savgand mekhuram ba shakh'ri Makka-
2) va on chi tu Paiombar dar in shakh'r az k'atli shakhsoni loik'i k'atl va asir giriftani shakhsoni loik'i asorat minba'd anch'om khokh'i dod, baroiat kh'alol ast-
3) va savgand mekhuram ba Odam va ba nasle, ki ba dunio meorad,
4) iak'inan Mo insonro dar ranch'u mashak'k'at ofaridaem. Inson dar dunio paivasta ba sakhtikh'oi mukhtalif duchor meshavad.
5) Oio inson mepindorad, ki chun ba gunokh' dast mezanad, kase, kh'atto Kholik'ash az u k'udrati intik'om giriftanro nadorad?!
6) Vai iftikhorkunon meguiad: "Man dar rokh'i adovati Mukh'ammad amvoli ziiod kharch' kardaam."

7) Oio in insoni az kharch'i amvolash dar rokh'i dushmani bo Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) iftikhorkunanda gumon dorad, ki kase, kh'atto Khudo uro nadida ast?! Oio ba gumonash Khudo uro az molash namepursad, ki onro az kuch'o ba dast ovard va dar kuch'o sarf namud?!
8) Oio Mo baroiash du chashmi bino khalk' nakardaem?!
9) Va oio baroiash zaboni guio va du lab naofaridaem?!
10) Va oio ba vai rokh'i nek va badro nishon nadodaem?!
11) Va charo az guzargokh'i sakhti kukh'i, ki uro az dukhuli bikh'isht boz medorad, nameguzarad va onro pasi sar namekunad.
12) Va ei Paiombar, chi turo ogokh' sokht, ki guzargokh'i sakhti kukh'i chist, to vai onro guzarad va dokhili ch'annat gardad?!
13) Guzargokh'i sakhti kukh'i ozod sokhtani g'ulomon va kanizon ast.
14) Io dar ruzi gurusnagi, ki taom kamchin ast, dodani taom ast.
15) Taom dodani tifli bepadare, ki paivandi kheshovandi dorad.
16) Io taom dodani miskini bag'oiat niiozmand.

17) Sipas az ch'umlai on kasone boshad, ki ba Khudo imon ovardaand va kh'amdigarro ba sabr namudan dar ibodat, musibat va tarki ma'siiat vasiiat menamoiand va kh'amdigarro ba mekh'ruboni nisbat ba khalk'i Khudo vasiiat menamoiand.
18) In gurukh'i doroi sifatkh'oi mazkur shakhsoni samti rost va akh'li saodatand.
19) Va on kasone, ki ba oiatkh'oi bar Paiombaramon nozilsokhtai Mo kofir meshavand, onkh'o shakhsoni samti chap va tirabakhtonand.
20) Ruzi k'iiomat bar onkh'o otashi darkh'oiash pushidashuda musallat meshavad. Az on kh'argiz berun omadan nametavonand.
1) Savgand ba oftob va rushanii on ba'di tuluash az mashrik'.
2) Va savgand ba mokh'tob chun pas az g'urubi oftob padid oiad.
3) Va savgand ba ruz chun bo rushaniash zaminro namoion sozad.
4) Va savgand ba shab chun bo zulmatash zaminro faro girad va on torik gardad.
5) Va savgand ba osmon va ba binoi ustuvori on.
6) Va savgand ba zamin va ba pakh'n sokhtanash, to bandagon bar rui on sukunat kunand.
7) Va savgand ba kh'ar iak nafs va ba durustu solim ofaridani on.
8) Pas, Khudo ba kh'ar iak nafs biduni ta'lim shinosonida ast, ki chi baroiash zarar va chi baroiash foida dorad, to iakumro anch'om dikh'ad va az duium duri ch'uiad.
9) Iak'inan kh'ar ki nafsi kheshro bo akhlok'i kh'amida oroish medikh'ad va onro az akhlok'i zisht pok mesozad, rastagor meshavad.
10) Va iak'inan kh'ar ki nafsi kheshro g'ofil va gumrokh' mesozad, ziioni sakht mebinad.

Chun Khudo dar oiatkh'oi peshin khasorati shakhsi oludai gunokh'ro zikr kard, dar oiatkh'oi zerin Samudi k'avmi Solekh'ro misol ovarda guft:
11) Samudi k'avmi Solekh' ba sababi dar gunokh' az kh'ad guzashtanashon Paiombarashon Solekh' (alaikh'is salom)-ro durug'gui shumurdand.
12) Vak'te badbakhttarini on k'avm bo tashvik'i onkh'o baroi kushtani modashutur az ch'oiash barkhost.
13) Pas, Firistodai Khudo Solekh' (alaikh'is salom) ba onkh'o guft: "Modashutur va kh'issai obashro rakh'o sozed va ozorash nadikh'ed."

14) Pas, onkh'o dar borai modashutur Paiombar Solekh' (alaikh'is salom)-ro durug'gu donistand. Pas, badbakhttarinashon bo rizoi onkh'o on modashuturro ba k'atl rasonid. Ba illati on ki mardum az kori k'otil rozi budand, dar gunokh'i kushtor sharik gashtand. Dar natich'ai in, Parvardigorashon ba sababi on gunokh'ashon onkh'oro ba tavri reshakansozi kh'alok gardonid va onkh'oro ba khoki zamin iakson karda, kh'ech' kasi onkh'o az azob rakh'oi naioft.
15) Va Khudo az ok'ibati kh'alok sokhtanashon namekh'arosad.
1) Savgand ba shab chun bo zulmatash mavch'udoti baini osmon va zaminro faro girad.
2) Va savgand ba ruz chun namoion va ravshan gardad.
3) Va savgand ba Zote, ki ch'insi nar va modaro khalk' karda ast.
4) Ba durusti ki amali shumo mardum gunogun ast. Ba'ze ibodat va ba'ze ma'siiat mekunand. Ibodat insonro ba ch'annat va ma'siiat uro ba ch'akh'annam vorid mesozad.
5) Pas, ammo kh'ar ki az molash baroi umuri voch'ib, az k'abili zakot, nafak'ai khonadon va g'aira medikh'ad va az kh'aromkh'o parkh'ez mekunad-
6) va va'dai Khudoro dar borai on ki baroi a'moli nekash ivaz va podosh khokh'ad girift, tasdik' menamoiad,-
7) pas Mo anch'omi amalkh'oi solekh' va dar rokh'i nek kharch' namudani molro bar vai oson megardonem.
8) Va ammo kh'ar ki az kharch'i molash dar rokh'kh'oi voch'ib bukhl mevarzad va bo takia ba tavongariash khudro az Ofaridgorash beniioz kh'isobida, az fazli U chize namekhokh'ad,-
9) va va'dai Khudoro dar borai on ki baroi a'moli nekash ivaz va podosh khokh'ad girift, durug' meshumorad,-
10) pas Mo baroiash ma'siiatro oson va ibodatro dushvor mesozem.
11) Va vak'te memirad va dokhili duzakh meshavad, moli ba khotiri on bukhl varzidaash az vai chizero bartaraf namegardonad.
12) Kh'amono baioni rokh'i kh'ak' az botil bar ukh'dai Mo ast.
13) Va iak'inan kh'aioti okhirat va dunio az Mo ast. Dar dunio va okhirat kh'ar chi mekhokh'em, mekunem. Kase ba koramon dakholat karda nametavonad.
14) Modom ki chunin ast, pas Man shumoro az otashi nikh'oiat sakhte, ki shu'la mezanad, metarsonam. Agar bar khilofi dasturam kor kuned, duchori uk'ubati sakht meshaved.
15) Ba otashi shu'lavari duzakh kase ch'uz shakhsi badbakhttarin vorid nameshavad. Murod az shakhsi badbakhttarin kofir ast.
16) On shakhse, ki dini ovardai Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro durug' meshumorad va az ich'roi dasturoti Khudo rui megardonad.
17) Va az on otashi shu'lavar bandai az kh'ama parkh'ezgortarin dur karda khokh'ad shud. Murod az bandai parkh'ezkortarin Abubakr (r) ast.
18) On kase, ki molashro dar rokh'kh'oi khair kharch' menamoiad, dar kh'ole ki mekhokh'ad mol va nafsash pok gardad.
19) Va mak'sadash az kharch'i mol on nest, ki kase bar vai ekh'son karda ast va ch'avobi onro dodan mekhokh'ad.
20) Lekin molashro fak'at ba khotiri talabi rizoi Parvardigori Bartarash kharch' mesozad.
21) Va kh'atman az on chi Khudo baroiash medikh'ad, khushnud khokh'ad shud.
1) Savgand ba og'ozi ruz-
2) va savgand ba shab chun bo zulmatash kh'amaro bipushad va mardum dar on orom girand-
3) ei Paiombar, Parvardigorat turo rakh'o nasokhta ast va dushman nadoshta ast. Da'voi mushrikon, ki Khudo turo rakh'o karda va dushmanat girifta ast, asos nadorad.
4) Va begumon manzili okhirat baroiat az in dunio bekh'tar ast. Chunki dar onch'o ba ne'mati abadi noil megardi.
5) Va begumon Parvardigorat baroi tu va ummatonat podoshi ziiod khokh'ad dod, pas bilofosila az atoi U khushnud megardi.
6) Iak'inan Parvardigorat turo tifli bepadar ioft, pas panokh'at dod. K'albi boboiat Abdulmuttalib va amuiat Abutolib ba tu ba rik'k'at omad va turo zeri sarparastii khud giriftand.
7) Va Parvardigorat turo dar kh'olate ioft, ki az K'ur'on va akh'komi shar'i chizero namedonisti, pas on chiro namedonisti, ta'limat dod.
8) Va Parvardigorat turo fak'ir ioft, pas tavongar sokht.
9) Modom ki chunin ast, pas, bo iatim muomilai zisht makun va uro khoru kh'ak'ir magardon.
10) Va ammo ba gadoi niiozmand bong mazan.
11) Va az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigorat sukhan bigu va shukrguzor bosh.
1) Ba durusti ki Mo sinai turo boz gardonida, k'abuli paig'omro baroiat makh'bub sokhtem.
2) Va gunokh'oni guzashtaatro bakhshidem va garonii ruzkh'oi davroni ch'okh'iliiatro, ki tu dar on umr ba sar meburdi, sabuk kardem.
3) On bori sangine, ki turo ba ranch' andokhta, k'arib kamaratro meshikast.
4) Va ba khotiri tu nomatro bardoshtem. Az in ru, kh'angomi azon, k'omat va g'aira nomat zikr meshavad.
5) Pas, begumon kh'amrokh'i dushvori va tangi osoni va farokhi ast.
6) Begumon kh'amrokh'i dushvori va tangi osoni va farokhi ast. Modom ki chunin ast, pas, naboiad aziiatu ozori k'avmat turo ba kh'aros andozad va az rokh'i da'vat bargardonad.
7) Kh'ar vak'te korkh'oiatro ba anch'om rasoni va az on forig' gardi, pas dar ibodati Parvardigorat bikush.
8) Va iagona ba sui Parvardigorat rag'bat namo.
1) Savgand ba anch'iru ch'oi ruidanash va ba zaitunu ch'oi ruidanash, sarzamini Falastini makoni bi'sati Iso (alaikh'is salom) -
2) va savgand ba Kukh'i Sinoi makoni munoch'oti Muso (alaikh'is salom) bo Khudo -
3) va savgand ba shakh'ri doroi amnu amoni Makkai makoni bi'sati Paiombar Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-
4) ba durusti ki Mo insonro dar bekh'tarin surat va kholi az khalal ofaridaem.[In oiat ch'avobi savgandkh'oi k'ablan zikr shuda ast].

5) Sipas ba'ze az insonkh'oro dar in dunio ba davroni solkhurdagi va kamkhiradi barmegardonem va az tavoni ch'ismi sud burda nametavonad. Inchunin agar inson bo gunokh' sirishti khudro tabokh' sokhta, ba ch'akh'annam daroiad, dar badtarin surat va shakl k'aror megirad.

6) Magar on kasone, ki ba Khudo imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista mekunand, pas sarfi nazar az solmandi onkh'oro savobi k'at'noshavanda buda, dar okhirat sokh'ibi ch'annati abadi meshavand. Zero onkh'o bo imon va korkh'oi nek sirishti kheshro pok gardonidaand.
7) Pas, ei inson, ba'd az mushokh'idai nishonakh'oi k'udrati Khudo, chi turo ba durug' shumurdani ruzi ch'azo vodor mesozad?!

8) Oio Khudo bo ruzi ch'azoi amal k'aror dodani k'iiomat Dovartarini dovaron va Odiltarini odilon nest?! Oio az rui khirad imkon dorad, ki Khudo bandagonashro be dovari va nadodani ch'azoi badkor va nekukor rakh'o sozad?!
1) Ei Paiombar! Paig'omi ilokh'iro bo shurui nomi Parvardigorat, ki Ofaridgori kh'amai mavch'udot ast, bikhon.
2) U insonro ba'di nutfa az k'it'ai khuni basta ofarida ast.
3) Ei Paiombar! Paig'omi ilokh'iro bikhon va Parvardigorat bag'oiat Karim ast. Karami kase ba karami U namerasad. Karamash bekanor ast.
4) On Zote, ki ba vasilai k'alam navishtanro ta'lim dod.
5) Ba inson chizkh'oero ta'lim dod, ki k'ablan onro namedonist.
6) Iak'inan insoni badkor ba misli Abuch'akh'l tug'ion mevarzad va az marzkh'oi guzoshtai Khudo meguzarad.
7) Zero bo takia ba mol va mak'omash kheshro az Khudo beniioz medonad.
8) Ei inson! Ba durusti, bozgashti tu dar ruzi okhirat tankh'o ba sui Parvardigorat ast. On ruz ch'azoi a'molatro megiri.
9) Oio korero shigiftovartar az raftori Abuch'akh'l didai, ki boz medorad-
10) bandaamon Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam)-ro chun dar nazdi khonai Ka'ba namoz guzorad.
11) Ei bandai sarkashi az namoz bozdoranda! Ba Man khabar bidekh', ki agar in mardi az namoz bozdoshtaat az ch'onibi Khudo doroi kh'idoiat va donish boshad -
12) io agar mardumro ba parkh'ezkori dastur doda boshad, oio insoni sokh'ibi chunin vasf az guzoridani namoz man' karda meshavad?!
13) Ei Paiombar, ba Man khabar bidekh'! Agar on insoni iakravi turo az ibodat bozdoranda, risolatatro durug' kh'isobad va az on ru bitobad, magar az Khudo nametarsad?!
14) Oio u namedonad, ki Khudo amalkh'oiashro mebinad va chize az Khudo makhfi namemonad?!

15) Kh'argiz kor on guna ki in ch'okh'il tasavvur dorad, nest! Savgand, ki agar az ozor va takzibi bandai Mo Mukh'ammad (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) khuddori nakunad, iak'inan uro ba sakhti az muii peshoniash ba ch'onibi duzakh mekashem.
16) Az muii peshonii nafari dar guftor durug'gui va dar raftor khatokor ast.
17) Pas, biguzor vak'ti ba ch'akh'annam afkanda shudan duston va akh'li mach'lisashro faro khonad, to agar tavonand, uro iori kunand va az otash rakh'oiash sozand.

18) Mo begumon farishtagoni nigakh'boni duzakhro faro mekhonem. Onkh'o az dasturi Khudo sarpechi namekunand va ba kh'ar kore amr shavand, onro ba ch'o meorand. On gokh' ma'lum meshavad, ki kadom iake az du gurukh' k'avitar va nerumandtarand.

19) Kh'argiz kor chunonchi in zolim mepindorad, ki guio k'udrati ba tu zarar rasonidanro dorad, nest! Dar kh'ech' kor itoatash makun va dar peshgokh'i Khudo sach'da namo va bo anch'omi ibodatkh'o ba U nazdik bishav. Zero toatu ibodat bandaro ba Khudo nazdik mesozad.

1) Ba durusti ki Mo K'ur'onro ch'am'och'am' dar shabi K'adri Mokh'i Ramazon ba osmoni dunio furud ovardem va nuzuli onro az osmoni dunio bar Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) niz dar kh'amin shab shuru' namudem.
2) Va ei Paiombar, chi turo ogokh' sokhta ast, ki shabi k'adr chist?! Oio dar borai khairu barakati on shab ogokh'i dori?!
3) Shabi k'adr doroi khairu barakati nikh'oiat buzurg ast, zero on az kh'azor mokh'e, ki shakhse onro bo toatu ibodati kholisona sipari mekunad, bekh'tar ast.

4) On shab farishtagon va Ch'ibril bo ich'ozati Parvardigorashon ba khotiri ich'roi kh'ar kori marbut ba ruzi, marg, vilodat va g'aira, ki Khudo onro dar on sol to soli oianda muk'addar sokhta ast, furud meoiand.
5) On shabi bobarakat shuru' az avval to vak'ti tului subkh' saropo salomati va khair ast.
1) Kofironi akh'li Kitob az iakh'udu nasoro va mushrikon to zamone ki ba onkh'o kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan naomad, az ittifok' va kh'ambastagiashon bar kufr ch'udoshavanda nabudand.
2) On kh'uch'ch'ati ravshan Firistodai Khudo ast, ki sakh'ifakh'oi az kh'ama guna badi va botil pokro tilovat mekunad. Ba on sakh'ifakh'o ch'uz pokon dast namerasonand.
3) Dar on sakh'ifakh'o akhbori rost va akh'komi odilona ast. Mardumro dar korkh'oi dunio va okhirat ba rokh'i durust rakh'namoi mesozad.

4) Va iakh'udu nasoro, ki ba onkh'o Kitobi Tavrotu Inch'il doda shuda ast, dar borai imon ba Rasuli Okhirzamon ikhtilof nakardand, magar ba'd az on ki Parvardigor ba sui onkh'o uro firistod. Pas az bi'sati Paiombari Okhirzamon iak iddai onkh'o imon ovardand va iak iddai digar dar kufr bok'i mondand.

5) Va kh'ol on ki onkh'o dar K'ur'on tankh'o ba on amr shuda budand, ki iagona Khudoro biparastand, dinro baroi U kholis gardonand, az shirk biparkh'ezand, bar oiini Ibrokh'im (alaikh'is salom) va Mukh'ammad bok'i bimonand va namozro barpo bidorand va zakoti molro bipardozand. Va dini rostu durust kh'amin ast. Ch'inoiat va sarkashii iakh'udu nasoro dar on ast, ki Tavrot va Inch'il niz onkh'oro ainan monandi K'ur'on ba ibodati kholisona, adoi namoz, pardokhti zakot amr namuda bud, ammo az dasturoti K'ur'on ba korkh'oi mazkur itoat nakardand.

6) Iak'inan kofiron az iakh'udu nasoroi akh'li Kitob va mushrikon dar ruzi k'iiomat ba otashi duzakh vorid shuda, dar onch'o ch'ovidon memonand. Onkh'o ba illati kufr varzidan ba Khudo va durug'gu donistani Paiombar (sallalokh'u alaikh'i va sallam) badtarin makhluk'and.
7) Iak'inan kasone, ki imon meorand va amalkh'oi shoista mekunand, onkh'o bekh'tarin makhluk'and.

8) Podoshi onkh'o nazdi Parvardigorashon bustonkh'oe ast, ki az zeri darakhtkh'o va k'asrkh'oi on rudkh'o ch'ori buda, dar onch'o ch'ovidon memonand. Parvardigor az onkh'o ba sababi imon va ibodatashon rozi megardad va onkh'o niz az Parvardigor bo noil shudan ba rakh'matash rozi megardand. Podosh va rizomandii mazkur az oni shakhsest, ki az Parvardigorash metarsad va farmoni Uro ba ch'o ovarda, az kori noravo duri mech'uiad.
1) Chun zamin dar ruzi k'iiomat ba surati munosibi azamatash bo shiddat larzonida shavad-
2) va zamin borkh'oi sangini khudro, az k'abili murdagon va g'airi on berun sozad-
3) va kh'ar inson bo taach'ch'ub guiad: "Zaminro chi shuda ast, ki chunin sakht melarzad?!"
4) On ruz zamin kh'amai korkh'oi nek va badi bar ruiash sodirshudaro bozgu mekunad va khabar medikh'ad.
5) Ba sababi on ki zaminro az in korkh'o Parvardigorat ogokh' karda va ba khabar dodani on amr namuda ast.
6) On ruz mardum az kh'isobgokh' gurukh'-gurukh' barmegardand, to ch'azoi korkh'oi dar dunio anch'omdodai khudro mushokh'ida kunand.
7) Pas, kh'ar ki ba mik'dori murcha amali khaire karda boshad, ch'azoi onro dar peshash kh'ozir mebinad.
8) Va niz kh'ar ki ba mik'dori murcha amali bade karda boshad, ch'azoi onro dar peshash kh'ozir mebinad.
1) Savgand ba asponi davandae, ki az shiddati davidan az nafasi onkh'o sado shunida meshavad-
2) pas savgand ba aspone, ki chun sumkh'oiashon ba sangkh'o barmekhurad, otash meafruzad-
3) va savgand ba asponi kh'angomi subkh' bar dushman kh'uch'umkunanda-
4) pas ba sababi sakht tokhtan changu g'ubor barmeangezand-
5) pas bo on changu g'ubor dar baini ch'am'i dushmanon medaroiand-
6) iak'inan inson nisbat ba ne'matkh'oi Parvardigorash nosiposi guzaro ast.
7) Va beshak, inson bar nosiposiash guvokh' ast. Ba sababi oshkorii in sifat dar u onro inkor karda nametavonad.
8) Va begumon u molro khele ziiod dust medorad. Az bisior dustdorii molash az kharch'i on dar korkh'oi nek bukhl mevarzad.
9) Oio in insoni mag'ruri zindagonii dunio namedonad, ki chun Khudo murdagoni dar k'abrkh'o k'arordoshtaro barangezad va onkh'oro baroi ch'azo va bozpursi kh'ozir gardonad -
10) va niiatkh'o va ak'idakh'oi dar sinakh'o pushida oshkor karda shavad, on ruz kor on guna ki u mepindosht, nakhokh'ad bud?!
11) Begumon Parvardigorashon dar on ruz az a'moli onkh'o Bokhabar ast. Kh'ech' amali bandagon az U pushida nest. Dar badali kh'ar kor ba onkh'o podosh khokh'ad dod.
1) Rukhdodi bo dakh'shatash kubandai k'albkh'o.
2) In rukhdodi bo dakh'shatash kubandai k'albkh'o chist?!
3) Va ei Paiombar, chi turo ogokh' sokhta ast, ki rukhdodi bo dakh'shatash kubandai k'albkh'o chist?! On ruzi dakh'shatnok k'iiomat ast.
4) Ruze, ki mardum misli parvonakh'o dar inch'o va onch'o parokanda gashta, k'albashon ba shiddat kubida meshavad.
5) Va kukh'kh'o az likh'ozi sabuki va poshkhurii ach'zoi on misli pashmi rangorangi kh'alloch'ishuda megardand.
6) Pas, ammo kh'ar ki a'moli nekash sangintar boshad,-
7) pas u dar zindagonii pisandidai ch'annat k'aror megirad.
8) Va ammo kh'ar ki a'moli badash sangintar boshad,-
9) pas ruzi k'iiomat maskan va k'arorgokh'ash chuk'urii khatarnok ast.
10) Va ei Paiombar, chi turo ogokh' sokhta ast, ki on chuk'urii khatarnok chist?!
11) On otashi bag'oiat purkh'arorati ch'akh'annam ast.
1) Ei mardum! Iftikhor bo doroivu farzand shumoro az ibodati Khudo mashg'ul karda ast.
2) To vak'ti murdan va daromadan ba k'abrkh'oiaton bo molu farzandi khesh iftikhor mekuned va az ibodati Khudo g'ofil memoned.
3) Kh'argiz naboiad sargarmii molu farzand shumoro az toati Khudo mashg'ul sozad. Begumon farch'omi badi in kori kheshro khokh'ed donist.
4) Sipas kh'atman farch'omi badi onro khokh'ed donist.

5) Kh'ak'k'o, ki agar shumo dubora zinda gashtan va baroi kh'ar iak amal bozpursi shudanatonro iak'inan medonisted, kh'ech' gokh' ba iftikhori molu farzand mashg'ul gashta, az ibodati Khudo g'ofil namemonded.
6) Savgand ba Zotam, ki shumo ruzi k'iiomat otashi duzakhro khokh'ed did.
7) Sipas onro dar k'iiomat ba surati mushokh'idai iak'ini va kholi az shak khokh'ed did.
8) Sipas kh'atman Khudo shumoro on ruz az ne'matkh'oi Khud ba misli tavongari, tandurusti va g'aira mepursad.
1) Savgand ba vak'ti asr, ki-
2) begumon inson dar nuk'son va kh'alokat ast.

3) Ba ch'uz on kasone, ki ba Khudo va paiombaronash imon meorand va korkh'oi shoista mekunand va iakdigarro ba kh'ak'ik'at tavsiia medikh'and va iakdigarro ba sabr dar toat, musibat va tarki gunokh' tavsiia medikh'and. Bandagoni doroi in chor sifat dar dunio va okhirat sud mebinand.
1) Voi va uk'ubati sakht bar kh'ar shakhsi bisior g'aibatchi va ta'nagari mardum.
2) On kase, ki mol ch'am' meorad va onro mekh'isobad. Ch'uz ch'am'ovari va kh'isobidani mol g'ame nadorad.
3) Vai gumon mekunad, ki moli ch'am' ovardaash uro az marg nach'ot medikh'ad va dar dunio ch'ovidonash megardonad.

4) Kh'argiz kor chunonchi in nodon tasavvur dorad, nest! Kh'atman vai ba duzakhi darkh'amshikananda andokhta meshavad. Duzakh chunon azobi sakht dorad, ki kh'ar on chi dar on afkanda shavad, onro darkh'am meshikanad va reza-reza mesozad.
5) Va ei Firistodai Mo, chi turo ogokh' sokhta ast, ki in ch'akh'annami darkh'amshikananda chist?!
6) On otashi Khudo buda, bo farmoni U afrukhta shuda ast.
7) On otashe, ki az ch'ismi duzakhiion guzashta, ba k'albashon merasad.
8) Ba durusti ki otashi ch'akh'annam bo darkh'oi ustuvor bar duzakhiion pushonida meshavad.
9) Kh'ol on ki akh'li duzakh dar sutunkh'oi tuloni basta meshavand, to az on nabaroiand.
1) Ei Paiombar! Oio khabar nadori, ki vak'te Abrakh'a va ioroni sokh'ibi filash k'asdi kharobsozii Khonai Ka'baro namudand, Parvardigorat bo onkh'o chi kard?!
2) Begumon Parvardigor makrashonro dar takhribi Ka'ba barbod dod va zoe' gardonid. Onkh'o ba kh'adafashon, ki mekhostand mardumro az ziiorati on bargardonand, narasidand.
3) Va Parvardigor bar onkh'o parandagonro gurukh'-gurukh' firistod.
4) Parandagon ba sui Abrakh'a va ioroni filsavorash sangrezakh'oe az sanggilro meandokhtand.
5) Pas, Parvardigor onkh'oro monandi bargi ziroati khurdashuda va zeri poii kh'aivonot poimolgashta gardonid.
1) Ba khotiri siposguzori az odat va ulfat dodani k'uraishikh'o.
2) Ba khotiri dar fazoi amnu osoish odat va ulfat dodani onkh'o ba safari zimistona ba sui Iaman va safari tobistona ba sui Shom.
3) Pas, boiad k'uraishikh'o iagona Parvardigori Khonai Ka'baro, ki baroi onkh'o safari tich'oratii tobistonavu zimistonaro oson gardond, ibodat kunand va az shirk ovardan parkh'ez namoiand.
4) On Zote, ki ba k'uraishikh'o ba ch'oi gurusnagi taom dod va onkh'oro ba ch'oi tars bo ch'oigir kunonidani kh'aibati Khonai Ka'ba va sokinonash dar k'albi k'avmi arab emin gardonid.
1) Oio on kasero, ki ch'azoi k'iiomatro durug' meshumorad, shinokhtai?!
2) Pas, u on shakhse ast, ki iatimro ba durushti az nazdash meronad.
3) Va kasero ba taom dodani fak'ir targ'ib namenamoiad.
4) Pas, voi va kh'alokat bar namozguzoron,-
5) on namozguzorone, ki az namozashon dar g'aflatand. Dar borai namoz beparvo kh'astand va onro az vak'tash meguzaronand.
6) On namozguzorone, ki dar namoz va digar a'moli khesh khudnamoi mekunand va korkh'oiashon kholis ba khotiri Khudo nest.
7) Va chizkh'oi ba misli suzan, deg, tabak', tabar va g'aira nochizro az koraftodagon boz medorand va ba oriiat namedikh'and.
1) Ei Paiombar! Ba durusti, Mo ba tu khairi bisior, az ch'umla kh'avzi Kavsarro dodaem.

3) Beshak, dushmanat az kh'amai khair gusasta va benomu nishon gashta ast. Agar iod shavad, tankh'o bo badi iod meshavad.

3) Va shumo niz On Ma'budi Iagona sazovori ibodatro, ki man meparastam, nameparasted.
4) Va man niz ma'budkh'oi botili ibodat mekardai shumoro nameparastam.
5) Va shumo niz On Ma'budi Iagona sazovori ibodatro, ki man meparastam, nameparasted.
6) Shumoro ak'ida va dini boftai khud va maro ak'ida va dini az sui Parvardigor nozilshudai khud ast."
1) Ei Paiombar! Vak'te nusrati Khudo baroi piruz gashtani dinat takh'ak'k'uk' iobad va Makka fatkh' shavad-
2) va mardumro bubini, ki gurukh'-gurukh' ba Islom vorid gardand,-

3) pas bidon, ki in nishonai nazdikii anch'omiobii mas'uliiati tu ast va ba khotiri shukrguzori az in ne'mati buzurg Parvardigoratro az kh'amai aibu nuk'son ba poki khonda, sitoishash bigu va az U omurzish bikhokh'. 5) Ummi Ch'amil dar kh'ole ba otashi duzakh vorid megardad, ki dar gardanash resmoni az lifi khurmo mustakh'kam bastashuda ast. Vai bo on resmon ba sui duzakh kashida meshavad.

4) Va kh'ech' kas az ofaridakh'oiash ba U monand nest.

1) Ei Firistodai Mo! Bigu: "Man ba Parvardigori mardum panokh' mebaram -
